pablum.t: n. 空洞乏味的言论；糊状婴儿食品

e.en: His speech was empty {pablum} with no real ideas.
e.zh: 他的演讲空洞无物,没有任何真正的观点。

e.en: Critics dismissed the new movie as sentimental {pablum}.
e.zh: 评论家把这部新电影斥为感伤的陈词滥调。

e.en: The novel offered nothing but cheerful {pabulum} for tired readers.
e.zh: 这本小说只为疲惫的读者提供了一些乏味的鸡汤。

e.en: Her column was criticized for serving political {pabulum}.
e.zh: 她的专栏因充斥着政治套话而受到批评。

pac.t: abbr. 政治行动委员会（political action committee）

e.en: The candidate's {PAC} raised millions in just one week.
e.zh: 该候选人的政治行动委员会一周内就筹到了数百万。

e.en: Federal law limits how much a {PAC} can donate directly.
e.zh: 联邦法律限制了政治行动委员会的直接捐款金额。

pace.t:
n. 步速；节奏
v. 踱步；调节速度

e.en: She walked at a brisk {pace} along the riverbank.
e.zh: 她沿着河岸快步行走。

e.en: The team struggled to keep {pace} with their competitors.
e.zh: 这支团队很难跟上竞争对手的步伐。

paced.t:
adj. 有节奏的
v. 踱步（过去式）

e.en: He {paced} nervously back and forth before the interview.
e.zh: 面试前他紧张地来回踱步。

e.en: The novel is well {paced} and never feels boring.
e.zh: 这部小说节奏把握得很好,从不让人觉得乏味。

pacemaker.t: n. 心脏起搏器；领跑者

e.en: Doctors fitted her grandfather with a heart {pacemaker} last month.
e.zh: 医生上个月给她外祖父装了心脏起搏器。

e.en: The {pacemaker} set a fast tempo for the marathon runners.
e.zh: 领跑员为马拉松选手设定了快速的节奏。

e.en: A professional {pacer} helped her finish the marathon under four hours.
e.zh: 一位专业领跑员帮她在四小时内跑完了马拉松。

e.en: The {pacer} kept the runners on schedule throughout the race.
e.zh: 领跑员在整场比赛中让选手们保持稳定节奏。

paces.t:
n. 步伐（复数）
v. 踱步（第三人称单数）

e.en: The store is just twenty {paces} from the bus stop.
e.zh: 那家店离公交站只有二十步远。

e.en: He {paces} the room whenever he's stuck on a problem.
e.zh: 每当遇到难题时,他都会在房间里踱来踱去。

pacesetter.t: n. 领跑者；引领潮流者

e.en: The company has long been a {pacesetter} in green technology.
e.zh: 这家公司长期以来一直是绿色科技领域的领跑者。

e.en: As {pacesetter}, she set a blistering speed for the field.
e.zh: 作为领跑者,她为整个赛场定下了飞快的节奏。

e.en: The thriller is {pacey} and impossible to put down.
e.zh: 这部惊悚小说节奏紧凑,让人欲罢不能。

e.en: I love how {pacey} the new Netflix series feels.
e.zh: 我很喜欢这部新Netflix剧集那种紧凑的节奏感。

pachinko.t: n. 弹珠机（日式博彩游戏）

e.en: Tokyo's neon-lit {pachinko} parlors are open late into the night.
e.zh: 东京霓虹闪烁的弹珠机店一直营业到深夜。

e.en: He spent the afternoon playing {pachinko} with old friends.
e.zh: 他下午和老朋友们一起玩弹珠机消磨时间。

pachuco.t: n. 墨西哥裔美国街头青年

e.en: The film celebrates the swagger of the 1940s {pachuco} subculture.
e.zh: 这部电影颂扬了1940年代帕楚科亚文化的张扬风格。

e.en: His grandfather dressed like a classic {pachuco} in old photos.
e.zh: 老照片里他祖父穿得像个经典的帕楚科青年。

pachyderm.t: n. 厚皮动物（如象、犀牛）

e.en: The zoo's newest {pachyderm} is a baby African elephant.
e.zh: 动物园最新到来的厚皮动物是一头非洲小象。

e.en: Rhinos and elephants are both classified as {pachyderms}.
e.zh: 犀牛和大象都被归类为厚皮动物。

pachysandra.t: n. 富贵草（常绿地被植物）

e.en: They planted {pachysandra} as ground cover beneath the oak trees.
e.zh: 他们在橡树下种了顶花板凳果作为地被植物。

e.en: {Pachysandra} thrives in the shady corners of the garden.
e.zh: 顶花板凳果在花园的阴凉角落里长势喜人。

pacific.t:
adj. 太平洋的
adj. 平和的

e.en: The {Pacific} Ocean is the largest body of water on Earth.
e.zh: 太平洋是地球上最大的水域。

e.en: She has a calm and {pacific} temperament that soothes everyone.
e.zh: 她性情平和温顺,让周围的人都感到安心。

e.en: The general's plan focused on {pacification} of the rebel regions.
e.zh: 将军的计划侧重于对反叛地区进行平定。

e.en: Diplomats worked tirelessly toward the {pacification} of the conflict.
e.zh: 外交官们为平息这场冲突而不懈努力。

pacifier.t:
n. 安抚奶嘴
n. 调解者

e.en: The baby finally calmed down once she got her {pacifier}.
e.zh: 宝宝拿到安抚奶嘴后终于安静下来了。

e.en: He uses humor as a {pacifier} during tense meetings.
e.zh: 他在紧张的会议中用幽默来缓解气氛。

pacifism.t: n. 和平主义；反战主义

e.en: He embraced {pacifism} after witnessing the horrors of war.
e.zh: 目睹战争的恐怖后，他开始信奉和平主义。

e.en: Her {pacifism} shaped every political stance she took.
e.zh: 她的和平主义思想影响了她的每一个政治立场。

pacifist.t:
n. 和平主义者
adj. 反战的

e.en: As a {pacifist}, he refused to serve in the military.
e.zh: 作为和平主义者，他拒绝服兵役。

e.en: The {pacifist} group organized a peaceful protest downtown.
e.zh: 那个和平主义团体在市中心组织了一场和平抗议。

e.en: Her {pacifistic} views often clashed with her family's politics.
e.zh: 她的和平主义观点常与家人的政治立场冲突。

e.en: The novel takes a strongly {pacifistic} stance on conflict.
e.zh: 这部小说对冲突持强烈的和平主义立场。

pacify.t: v. 安抚；平息（情绪、骚乱）

e.en: She tried to {pacify} the crying baby with a song.
e.zh: 她试图用一首歌安抚哭闹的婴儿。

e.en: The CEO spoke calmly to {pacify} angry shareholders.
e.zh: 首席执行官平静地说话，以安抚愤怒的股东。

pacing.t:
n. 节奏把控
v. 踱步

e.en: He kept {pacing} nervously outside the operating room.
e.zh: 他在手术室外紧张地踱来踱去。

e.en: The film's {pacing} feels slow in the second act.
e.zh: 这部电影第二幕的节奏感觉有些拖沓。

pacino.t: n. 帕西诺（人名，演员 Al Pacino）

e.en: Al {Pacino} delivered another unforgettable performance last night.
e.zh: 阿尔·帕西诺昨晚又奉献了一场难忘的表演。

e.en: My favorite {Pacino} film is still The Godfather.
e.zh: 我最喜欢的帕西诺电影仍然是《教父》。

pack.t:
v. 打包；收拾行李
n. 一包；一群

e.en: Don't forget to {pack} sunscreen for the beach trip.
e.zh: 别忘了为海滩之旅打包防晒霜。

e.en: A {pack} of wolves crossed the snowy ridge at dawn.
e.zh: 一群狼在黎明时分越过了雪岭。

package.t:
n. 包裹；软件包
v. 包装

e.en: The {package} arrived two days earlier than expected.
e.zh: 包裹比预期早到了两天。

e.en: They offered him a generous compensation {package}.
e.zh: 他们给了他一份丰厚的薪酬方案。

e.en: The cookies are individually {packaged} for freshness.
e.zh: 这些饼干是单独包装以保持新鲜的。

e.en: The deal was cleverly {packaged} as a win-win solution.
e.zh: 这笔交易被巧妙地包装成双赢方案。

e.en: The {packager} bundles dependencies before deployment.
e.zh: 打包工具会在部署前整合所有依赖项。

e.en: She works as a content {packager} for streaming platforms.
e.zh: 她在流媒体平台担任内容整合人。

e.en: Several {packages} were left at the front door.
e.zh: 几个包裹被放在了前门口。

e.en: Run npm install to download all required {packages}.
e.zh: 运行 npm install 以下载所有必需的软件包。

e.en: The brand uses recyclable {packaging} for all products.
e.zh: 该品牌的所有产品都使用可回收包装。

e.en: Eye-catching {packaging} can boost retail sales significantly.
e.zh: 吸引眼球的包装能显著提升零售销量。

e.en: His grandfather restored a vintage 1940s {Packard}.
e.zh: 他祖父修复了一辆 1940 年代的老式帕卡德汽车。

e.en: Hewlett and {Packard} founded their company in a garage.
e.zh: 惠利特和帕卡德在一间车库里创办了他们的公司。

packed.t:
adj. 挤满的；密集的
v. 打包（过去式）

e.en: The stadium was {packed} for the championship final.
e.zh: 体育场座无虚席，挤满了观看冠军决赛的人。

e.en: She {packed} her suitcase the night before the flight.
e.zh: 她在航班前一晚收拾好了行李箱。

e.en: The {packer} carefully wrapped each fragile item.
e.zh: 打包员小心地包好每一件易碎品。

e.en: He works as a meat {packer} at the local plant.
e.zh: 他在当地工厂当肉类包装工。

packet.t:
n. 数据包（网络）
n. 小包；一小袋

e.en: She tore open a {packet} of instant noodles for lunch.
e.zh: 她撕开一包方便面当午餐。

e.en: Each data {packet} travels independently across the network.
e.zh: 每个数据包都独立地在网络中传输。

e.en: The router dropped several {packets} during the outage.
e.zh: 在中断期间，路由器丢失了几个数据包。

e.en: He bought three {packets} of seeds for the garden.
e.zh: 他为花园买了三包种子。

e.en: The old {packhorse} carried supplies up the mountain trail.
e.zh: 那匹老驮马沿着山路运送补给。

e.en: She joked that she felt like a {packhorse} on moving day.
e.zh: 她开玩笑说搬家那天她觉得自己像头驮马。

packing.t:
n. 打包；装箱
n. 填料

e.en: I'm still {packing} for tomorrow's early flight.
e.zh: 我还在为明天早班机收拾行李。

e.en: Use bubble wrap as {packing} for fragile items.
e.zh: 易碎物品请用气泡膜作为包装填充物。

packinghouse.t: n. 肉类加工厂；罐头厂

e.en: The {packinghouse} processes thousands of oranges each day.
e.zh: 这家包装厂每天处理数千个橙子。

e.en: Workers at the {packinghouse} went on strike last week.
e.zh: 包装厂的工人上周罢工了。

e.en: The warehouse stocks various rubber {packings} for pipelines.
e.zh: 仓库储备各种用于管道的橡胶密封垫。

e.en: Replace worn {packings} to prevent oil leaks in the engine.
e.zh: 更换磨损的密封件以防止发动机漏油。

e.en: The traveling {packman} sold cloth and trinkets door to door.
e.zh: 那位走街串巷的小贩挨家挨户兜售布料和小饰品。

e.en: In old novels, the {packman} often brought village news.
e.zh: 在旧小说里，行商常常带来村里的消息。

packrat.t:
n. 爱囤东西的人
n. 林鼠

e.en: My dad is a total {packrat} who never throws anything away.
e.zh: 我爸是个十足的囤积狂，什么都舍不得扔。

e.en: A desert {packrat} built its nest behind the shed.
e.zh: 一只沙漠林鼠在棚屋后面筑了巢。

packs.t:
n. 一包；一群（复数）
v. 打包

e.en: She {packs} her lunch every morning before work.
e.zh: 她每天上班前都会自己装午餐。

e.en: The store sells {packs} of batteries at a discount.
e.zh: 这家店在打折出售成包的电池。

e.en: The two friends made a {pact} to stay in touch.
e.zh: 两个朋友约定一定要保持联系。

e.en: The countries signed a non-aggression {pact} after the war.
e.zh: 两国在战后签署了互不侵犯条约。

e.en: The thriller is a {pacy} read perfect for a long flight.
e.zh: 这本惊悚小说节奏明快，很适合长途飞行时阅读。

e.en: He's a {pacy} winger who can outrun any defender.
e.zh: 他是一名速度极快的边锋，能甩开任何防守者。

pad.t:
n. 垫子；便签本
v. 填充

e.en: She jotted the address on a yellow note {pad}.
e.zh: 她在一本黄色便签本上记下了地址。

e.en: The cat loves to {pad} silently across the wooden floor.
e.zh: 那只猫喜欢悄无声息地在木地板上走来走去。

e.en: The chair has a {padded} seat for extra comfort.
e.zh: 这把椅子配有加厚坐垫，更加舒适。

e.en: He {padded} his resume with exaggerated job titles.
e.zh: 他在简历上夸大职位头衔以充实内容。

padding.t:
n. 内边距（CSS）
n. 填充物

e.en: Add some {padding} around the button to make it clickable.
e.zh: 在按钮周围加些内边距，让它更容易点击。

e.en: The jacket has thick {padding} for cold winter days.
e.zh: 这件外套有厚厚的填充物，适合寒冷的冬天。

paddington.t: n. 帕丁顿（伦敦地名/小熊角色）

e.en: We caught the train from {Paddington} station to Oxford.
e.zh: 我们从帕丁顿车站搭火车去牛津。

e.en: My niece adores the {Paddington} Bear movies.
e.zh: 我侄女特别喜欢《帕丁顿熊》系列电影。

paddle.t:
n. 桨；球拍
v. 划桨

e.en: Grab a {paddle} and help me steer the canoe.
e.zh: 拿起船桨，帮我掌控独木舟的方向。

e.en: The kids love to {paddle} in the shallow end of the pool.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢在泳池的浅水区戏水。

e.en: They {paddled} across the calm lake at sunrise.
e.zh: 日出时分，他们划船穿过了平静的湖面。

e.en: The toddler happily {paddled} in the inflatable pool.
e.zh: 小孩高兴地在充气泳池里戏水。

e.en: The {paddlefish} uses its long snout to detect prey.
e.zh: 匙吻鲟用它长长的吻部来探测猎物。

e.en: Conservationists are working to protect the endangered {paddlefish}.
e.zh: 环保人士正在努力保护濒危的匙吻鲟。

e.en: The experienced {paddler} navigated the rapids with ease.
e.zh: 那位经验丰富的桨手轻松地穿过了急流。

e.en: Every {paddler} on the team trains six days a week.
e.zh: 队里的每名桨手每周都要训练六天。

paddles.t:
n. 桨（复数）
v. 划桨

e.en: The kayak comes with two lightweight {paddles}.
e.zh: 这艘皮划艇配有两支轻便的桨。

e.en: She {paddles} along the river every weekend for exercise.
e.zh: 她每个周末都沿河划船锻炼身体。

e.en: The old {paddlewheel} steamboat still runs tours on the Mississippi.
e.zh: 那艘老式明轮蒸汽船仍在密西西比河上提供观光服务。

e.en: A massive {paddlewheel} powered the riverboat against the current.
e.zh: 一个巨大的明轮驱动着河船逆流而上。

e.en: The children were {paddling} happily in the shallow stream.
e.zh: 孩子们在浅溪里快乐地戏水。

e.en: {Paddling} a canoe is harder than it looks.
e.zh: 划独木舟比看起来要难得多。

e.en: Two horses grazed quietly in the small {paddock}.
e.zh: 两匹马在小围场里安静地吃草。

e.en: Drivers gathered in the {paddock} before the race began.
e.zh: 比赛开始前，赛车手们聚集在围场区。

e.en: Farmers were planting rice in the flooded {paddy}.
e.zh: 农民们正在水稻田里插秧。

e.en: The {paddy} fields stretched green across the valley.
e.zh: 绿色的稻田一片片铺展在山谷间。

padlock.t:
n. 挂锁
v. 用挂锁锁上

e.en: She secured the gate with a heavy iron {padlock}.
e.zh: 她用一把沉重的铁挂锁锁住了大门。

e.en: Don't forget to {padlock} your bike at the station.
e.zh: 别忘了在车站给你的自行车上挂锁。

padlocked.t:
adj. 上挂锁的
v. 锁上（过去式）

e.en: The shed door was {padlocked} for the entire winter.
e.zh: 棚屋门整个冬天都用挂锁锁着。

e.en: He {padlocked} his locker before heading to class.
e.zh: 他锁好储物柜后就去上课了。

e.en: Two {painters} arrived early to start on the trim.
e.zh: 两位油漆工一早就到了,开始刷边角。

e.en: Many famous Renaissance {painters} trained in Florence.
e.zh: 许多著名的文艺复兴画家都在佛罗伦萨受过训练。

painting.t:
n. 画作；绘画
v. 绘画；涂漆

e.en: That {painting} above the sofa was done by my grandmother.
e.zh: 沙发上方那幅画是我祖母画的。

e.en: He spent the whole afternoon {painting} the garden fence.
e.zh: 他整个下午都在刷花园的围栏。

e.en: The museum displays Impressionist {paintings} on the second floor.
e.zh: 博物馆在二楼展出印象派绘画作品。

e.en: Her grandmother's {paintings} now hang in the family hallway.
e.zh: 她祖母的画作如今挂在家里的走廊上。

paintless.t: adj. 未涂漆的；无油漆的

e.en: The shop offers {paintless} dent repair for minor dings.
e.zh: 这家店为小凹陷提供免喷漆的修复服务。

e.en: {Paintless} repairs preserve the car's original factory finish.
e.zh: 免喷漆修复能保留汽车原厂的漆面。

paints.t:
n. 颜料；油漆（复数）
v. 绘画（第三人称单数）

e.en: She {paints} a watercolor every Sunday morning.
e.zh: 她每周日早晨都会画一幅水彩画。

e.en: These acrylic {paints} dry much faster than oil colors.
e.zh: 这些丙烯颜料比油画颜料干得快得多。

e.en: The car's glossy {paintwork} still looks brand new.
e.zh: 那辆车光亮的漆面看上去依然崭新。

e.en: Years of sun exposure had dulled the {paintwork}.
e.zh: 多年的日晒让漆面变得黯淡无光。

pair.t:
n. 一对；一双
v. 配对

e.en: I bought a new {pair} of running shoes online.
e.zh: 我在网上买了一双新的跑鞋。

e.en: Let's {pair} the wine with something rich and savory.
e.zh: 我们给这款葡萄酒搭配点浓郁咸香的菜吧。

paired.t:
adj. 成对的
v. 配对（过去式）

e.en: The chef {paired} the steak with a bold red wine.
e.zh: 主厨为牛排搭配了一款浓烈的红酒。

e.en: My headphones are already {paired} with my phone.
e.zh: 我的耳机已经和手机配对好了。

e.en: Cheese and honey is a surprisingly delicious {pairing}.
e.zh: 奶酪配蜂蜜是出乎意料的美味组合。

e.en: I'm having trouble {pairing} my watch with the new phone.
e.zh: 我把手表和新手机配对时出了点问题。

pairs.t:
n. 一对（复数）
v. 配对（第三人称单数）

e.en: She owns at least twenty {pairs} of shoes.
e.zh: 她至少有二十双鞋。

e.en: The teacher asked the students to work in {pairs}.
e.zh: 老师让学生们两人一组来做。

e.en: The algorithm computes {pairwise} distances between all data points.
e.zh: 该算法计算所有数据点之间的两两距离。

e.en: We ran a {pairwise} comparison of every model's accuracy.
e.zh: 我们对每个模型的准确率做了两两比较。

e.en: "Hey, {paisano}, long time no see!" he called warmly.
e.zh: “嘿,老乡,好久不见!”他热情地喊道。

e.en: The old men greeted each other as {paisano} at the cafe.
e.zh: 那些老人在咖啡馆里以老乡之礼互相问候。

e.en: He wore a silk tie with a classic {paisley} pattern.
e.zh: 他系着一条带有经典佩斯利花纹的丝绸领带。

e.en: The vintage shirt has a colorful {paisley} print all over.
e.zh: 那件复古衬衫上满是色彩鲜艳的佩斯利图案。

e.en: He stayed in his {pajamas} all Sunday morning.
e.zh: 他整个周日早上都没换下睡衣。

e.en: She bought matching {pajamas} for the whole family.
e.zh: 她给全家人买了同款的睡衣。

pak.t: n. 巴基斯坦（Pakistan 的缩写）

e.en: The team from {Pak} won the cricket series convincingly.
e.zh: 巴基斯坦队令人信服地赢下了那一系列板球比赛。

e.en: We ordered stir-fried bok choy, sometimes called {pak} choi.
e.zh: 我们点了清炒小白菜,也就是有时被称作 pak choi 的菜。

paki.t: n. 巴基斯坦人（贬义俚语）

e.en: The term {paki} is widely considered a racial slur in Britain.
e.zh: 在英国，"paki"一词被普遍视为种族歧视用语。

e.en: News outlets refuse to print the word {paki} due to its offensive history.
e.zh: 由于该词带有冒犯性历史，新闻媒体拒绝刊印"paki"一词。

e.en: {Pakistan} won the cricket match against India last night.
e.zh: 巴基斯坦昨晚在板球比赛中击败了印度。

e.en: My cousin moved to {Pakistan} for an engineering job.
e.zh: 我表哥搬到巴基斯坦从事工程工作。

pakistani.t:
adj. 巴基斯坦的
n. 巴基斯坦人

e.en: The {Pakistani} restaurant downtown serves amazing biryani.
e.zh: 市中心那家巴基斯坦餐厅的比尔亚尼饭非常好吃。

e.en: She is a {Pakistani} journalist based in London.
e.zh: 她是一位常驻伦敦的巴基斯坦记者。

e.en: We ordered onion {pakora} as an appetizer at the Indian restaurant.
e.zh: 我们在印度餐厅点了洋葱炸饼作为开胃菜。

e.en: Crispy {pakora} pairs perfectly with mint chutney.
e.zh: 酥脆的炸蔬菜饼配薄荷酱再合适不过了。

e.en: Hey {pal}, can you give me a hand with this box?
e.zh: 嘿伙计，能帮我搬一下这个箱子吗？

e.en: He's been my best {pal} since kindergarten.
e.zh: 他从幼儿园起就是我最好的朋友。

e.en: Tourists line up daily to tour Buckingham {Palace}.
e.zh: 游客们每天排队参观白金汉宫。

e.en: The mansion was so huge it felt like a {palace}.
e.zh: 那座豪宅大得像一座宫殿。

e.en: European {palaces} attract millions of visitors every year.
e.zh: 欧洲的宫殿每年吸引数百万游客。

e.en: The sultan owned several lavish {palaces} across the country.
e.zh: 苏丹在全国拥有数座奢华的宫殿。

e.en: We stayed at the Hotel {Palacio} during our trip to Madrid.
e.zh: 我们在马德里旅行时住在帕拉西奥酒店。

e.en: The {Palacio} Real is a popular landmark in Spain.
e.zh: 皇家宫殿是西班牙著名的地标。

e.en: My {paladin} character can heal teammates in the game.
e.zh: 我游戏里的圣骑士角色能治疗队友。

e.en: He fancies himself a {paladin} of free speech online.
e.zh: 他自认为是网上言论自由的捍卫者。

e.en: Archaeologists discovered {palaeolithic} tools in the cave.
e.zh: 考古学家在洞穴中发现了旧石器时代的工具。

e.en: The museum's {palaeolithic} exhibit features stone hand axes.
e.zh: 博物馆的旧石器时代展区展出了石制手斧。

e.en: The {palaeontological} dig uncovered a complete dinosaur skeleton.
e.zh: 这次古生物挖掘发现了一具完整的恐龙骨架。

e.en: She published a {palaeontological} study on ancient marine reptiles.
e.zh: 她发表了一项关于古代海洋爬行动物的古生物学研究。

e.en: The {palaeontologist} carefully brushed dust off the fossil.
e.zh: 古生物学家小心地刷去化石上的灰尘。

e.en: As a child, she dreamed of becoming a {palaeontologist}.
e.zh: 小时候她梦想成为一名古生物学家。

e.en: He studied {palaeontology} at Oxford for four years.
e.zh: 他在牛津大学学习了四年古生物学。

e.en: Modern {palaeontology} relies heavily on CT scanning technology.
e.zh: 现代古生物学高度依赖CT扫描技术。

e.en: The {palaeozoic} era saw the first appearance of land plants.
e.zh: 古生代时期出现了最早的陆生植物。

e.en: These rocks date back to the {palaeozoic} period.
e.zh: 这些岩石可以追溯到古生代。

palais.t: n. 公共舞厅；宫殿（法语）

e.en: The {Palais} Garnier in Paris hosts famous opera performances.
e.zh: 巴黎加尼叶歌剧院上演著名的歌剧表演。

e.en: Cannes festival screenings take place at the {Palais} des Festivals.
e.zh: 戛纳电影节的放映在节庆宫举行。

e.en: Servants carried the bride in a decorated {palanquin}.
e.zh: 仆人们用装饰华丽的轿子抬着新娘。

e.en: Ancient kings traveled through the city by {palanquin}.
e.zh: 古代国王乘坐轿子穿过城市。

e.en: Chefs add herbs to improve the {palatability} of bland dishes.
e.zh: 厨师加入香草来提升清淡菜肴的可口度。

e.en: The proposal lacked political {palatability} among voters.
e.zh: 该提案在选民中缺乏政治上的可接受性。

e.en: A spoonful of honey made the medicine more {palatable}.
e.zh: 一勺蜂蜜让这药变得更容易入口。

e.en: The compromise was {palatable} to both political parties.
e.zh: 这一妥协方案让两党都能接受。

e.en: The letter "y" in "yes" produces a {palatal} sound.
e.zh: "yes"中的字母y发出一个腭音。

e.en: Mandarin contains several {palatal} consonants like j and q.
e.zh: 普通话中包含几个腭音辅音，例如j和q。

e.en: Spicy food has burned the roof of my {palate}.
e.zh: 辛辣的食物烫到了我的上颚。

e.en: Wine tasting requires a refined {palate}.
e.zh: 品酒需要一个敏锐的味觉。

e.en: Sweet desserts appeal to children's {palates}.
e.zh: 甜点很合孩子们的口味。

e.en: Different cultures develop different {palates} over time.
e.zh: 不同的文化随着时间形成不同的口味偏好。

e.en: They booked a {palatial} suite overlooking the ocean.
e.zh: 他们订了一间俯瞰大海的豪华套房。

e.en: The CEO works in a {palatial} corner office.
e.zh: 这位CEO在一间宫殿般的转角办公室工作。

palatinate.t: n. 普法尔茨；伯爵领地

e.en: The {Palatinate} was once an important German territory.
e.zh: 普法尔茨曾是德国一片重要的领地。

e.en: Wines from the {Palatinate} region are famous in Europe.
e.zh: 普法尔茨地区的葡萄酒在欧洲享有盛誉。

e.en: Tourists climbed {Palatine} Hill to see the Roman ruins.
e.zh: 游客们登上帕拉蒂尼山观赏古罗马遗迹。

e.en: Medieval {palatine} counts ruled with royal authority.
e.zh: 中世纪的行宫伯爵拥有王室授予的统治权。

e.en: Divers travel to {Palau} for its world-class coral reefs.
e.zh: 潜水爱好者前往帕劳欣赏世界级的珊瑚礁。

e.en: {Palau} is a small island nation in the Pacific Ocean.
e.zh: 帕劳是太平洋上的一个小岛国。

palaver.t:
n. 闲谈；繁琐事
v. 闲聊

e.en: Booking the visa involved a lot of bureaucratic {palaver}.
e.zh: 办理签证经历了一大堆繁琐的手续。

e.en: After much {palaver}, they finally agreed on a price.
e.zh: 经过一番啰嗦的讨论，他们终于谈妥了价格。

e.en: We rented a Venetian {palazzo} for the weekend.
e.zh: 我们周末租了一座威尼斯式宫殿别墅。

e.en: She wore wide-leg {palazzo} pants to the summer party.
e.zh: 她穿着宽腿阔腿裤出席夏日派对。

pale.t:
adj. 苍白的；浅色的
v. 变苍白

e.en: You look {pale} — are you feeling sick?
e.zh: 你脸色苍白，是不是不舒服？

e.en: She painted the walls a {pale} shade of blue.
e.zh: 她把墙刷成了浅蓝色。

e.en: The moon shone {palely} through the thin clouds.
e.zh: 月亮透过薄云苍白地照耀着。

e.en: He smiled {palely} after hearing the bad news.
e.zh: 听到坏消息后他勉强地笑了笑。

e.en: The doctor noticed the {paleness} of her skin immediately.
e.zh: 医生立刻注意到她皮肤苍白。

e.en: His sudden {paleness} suggested he was about to faint.
e.zh: 他突然脸色苍白，似乎要晕倒了。

e.en: The {paleoanthropologist} examined the ancient hominid skull carefully.
e.zh: 古人类学家仔细检查了这块古代原始人头骨。

e.en: As a {paleoanthropologist}, she studies human evolution in Africa.
e.zh: 作为一名古人类学家，她研究非洲的人类演化。

e.en: Cave paintings from the {paleolithic} era still amaze researchers.
e.zh: 旧石器时代的洞穴壁画至今仍令研究者惊叹。

e.en: Some people follow a {paleolithic} diet to lose weight.
e.zh: 有些人采取旧石器时代饮食法来减肥。

e.en: The museum funds {paleontological} research across three continents.
e.zh: 该博物馆资助三大洲的古生物学研究。

e.en: This valley is one of the richest {paleontological} sites worldwide.
e.zh: 这个山谷是世界上最丰富的古生物遗址之一。

e.en: The {paleontologist} identified the bone as a velociraptor claw.
e.zh: 古生物学家鉴定这块骨头是迅猛龙的爪子。

e.en: A famous {paleontologist} gave a lecture at our university.
e.zh: 一位著名的古生物学家在我们大学做了讲座。

e.en: She switched her major from biology to {paleontology}.
e.zh: 她把专业从生物学换成了古生物学。

e.en: {Paleontology} has revealed millions of years of evolutionary history.
e.zh: 古生物学揭示了数百万年的演化历史。

paleozoic.t:
adj. 古生代的
n. 古生代

e.en: Trilobites thrived during the {paleozoic} era.
e.zh: 三叶虫在古生代时期繁盛一时。

e.en: Many {paleozoic} fossils are found in limestone formations.
e.zh: 许多古生代化石都发现于石灰岩地层中。

palermo.t: n. 巴勒莫（意大利城市）

e.en: We tasted incredible street food in {Palermo} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们在巴勒莫品尝了非常棒的街头美食。

e.en: {Palermo} is the capital of the Italian island Sicily.
e.zh: 巴勒莫是意大利西西里岛的首府。

e.en: The conflict in {Palestine} has lasted for many decades.
e.zh: 巴勒斯坦的冲突已经持续了几十年。

e.en: She wrote a thesis on the history of {Palestine}.
e.zh: 她写了一篇关于巴勒斯坦历史的论文。

palestinian.t:
adj. 巴勒斯坦的
n. 巴勒斯坦人

e.en: The {Palestinian} chef shared his grandmother's recipe for hummus.
e.zh: 这位巴勒斯坦厨师分享了他祖母的鹰嘴豆泥配方。

e.en: Many {Palestinian} families have lived in this village for generations.
e.zh: 许多巴勒斯坦家庭世代居住在这个村庄。

e.en: The artist mixed colors carefully on her wooden {palette}.
e.zh: 艺术家在木制调色板上仔细调和颜料。

e.en: This app offers a soft pastel color {palette}.
e.zh: 这款应用提供了柔和的粉彩色调。

e.en: The lady rode a gentle white {palfrey} through the forest.
e.zh: 贵妇骑着一匹温顺的白色坐骑穿过森林。

e.en: Knights kept a {palfrey} for travel and a destrier for battle.
e.zh: 骑士们用坐骑赶路，用战马打仗。

palimony.t: n. 同居分手后的赡养费

e.en: She sued her ex-partner for {palimony} after the breakup.
e.zh: 分手后她起诉前伴侣要求支付同居赡养费。

e.en: The {palimony} settlement was reportedly worth millions of dollars.
e.zh: 这笔同居赡养费据称价值数百万美元。

e.en: The medieval manuscript turned out to be a {palimpsest}.
e.zh: 这本中世纪手稿原来是一份重写本。

e.en: The city is a {palimpsest} of architectural styles from every era.
e.zh: 这座城市是各个时代建筑风格层层叠加的写照。

palindrome.t: n. 回文（正反读相同的词句）

e.en: The word "racecar" is a famous {palindrome} in English.
e.zh: 单词"racecar"是英语中一个著名的回文。

e.en: Can you think of a sentence that's a {palindrome}?
e.zh: 你能想出一个回文句子吗？

e.en: The garden was surrounded by a white wooden {paling}.
e.zh: 花园四周围着白色的木栅栏。

e.en: She watched her reflection {paling} in the dim mirror.
e.zh: 她看着自己的倒影在昏暗的镜子里渐渐变淡。

e.en: The old {palings} around the cottage needed fresh paint.
e.zh: 小屋周围的旧栅栏需要重新刷漆。

e.en: He nailed new {palings} along the back fence.
e.zh: 他沿着后院围栏钉上了新的栅栏板。

e.en: The settlers built a wooden {palisade} for protection.
e.zh: 定居者建造了一道木栅栏作为防御。

e.en: A tall {palisade} surrounds the military base.
e.zh: 军事基地四周围着一道高高的栅栏。

pall.t:
v. 变得乏味
n. 棺罩；阴影

e.en: The bad news cast a {pall} over the celebration.
e.zh: 这个坏消息给庆祝活动蒙上了一层阴影。

e.en: Even his favorite hobby began to {pall} after years.
e.zh: 几年之后，连他最爱的爱好也开始让他厌倦了。

e.en: The Roman matron draped a {palla} over her shoulders.
e.zh: 这位罗马贵妇将披肩搭在肩上。

e.en: In museums you can see statues wearing the traditional {palla}.
e.zh: 在博物馆里可以看到身着传统披肩的雕像。

palladian.t: adj. 帕拉第奥式建筑的

e.en: The mansion features a grand {Palladian} window in the foyer.
e.zh: 这座豪宅的门厅有一扇宏伟的帕拉第奥式窗户。

e.en: Thomas Jefferson admired {Palladian} architecture during his travels.
e.zh: 托马斯·杰斐逊在旅行中很欣赏帕拉第奥式建筑。

e.en: The ring is made of {palladium}, a rare silver-white metal.
e.zh: 这枚戒指由钯金制成，那是一种稀有的银白色金属。

e.en: Catalytic converters rely on {palladium} to reduce harmful emissions.
e.zh: 催化转化器依靠钯来减少有害排放。

e.en: He served as a {pallbearer} at his grandfather's funeral.
e.zh: 他在祖父的葬礼上担任了抬棺人。

e.en: Six {pallbearers} carried the coffin to the grave.
e.zh: 六位抬棺人将棺木抬到墓地。

e.en: The forklift lifted a {pallet} stacked with boxes.
e.zh: 叉车举起了一个堆满箱子的托盘。

e.en: He slept on a thin {pallet} on the floor.
e.zh: 他睡在地上一张薄薄的草垫上。

e.en: Wooden {pallets} were stacked outside the warehouse.
e.zh: 木制托盘堆放在仓库外面。

e.en: The shipment arrived on twenty heavy {pallets}.
e.zh: 这批货物装在二十个沉重的托盘上运到。

e.en: The medicine helps {palliate} the worst symptoms.
e.zh: 这种药有助于缓解最严重的症状。

e.en: Nothing could {palliate} the damage caused by the scandal.
e.zh: 任何办法都无法减轻这桩丑闻造成的损害。

palliative.t:
adj. 缓解症状的
n. 缓和疗法

e.en: She works in {palliative} care for terminally ill patients.
e.zh: 她从事临终病人的姑息治疗工作。

e.en: The reform was a {palliative}, not a real solution.
e.zh: 这项改革只是缓兵之计，并非真正的解决办法。

e.en: Her face looked {pallid} after the long illness.
e.zh: 久病之后她的脸色显得苍白。

e.en: The movie offered a {pallid} imitation of the original.
e.zh: 这部电影只是对原作的一次苍白模仿。

e.en: The doctor noticed the {pallor} of his skin.
e.zh: 医生注意到他皮肤的苍白。

e.en: A sudden {pallor} swept across her face at the news.
e.zh: 听到这个消息，她脸上骤然变得煞白。

e.en: They became quite {pally} during the office trip.
e.zh: 在公司团建期间，他们俩关系变得相当要好。

e.en: He's surprisingly {pally} with his old rivals now.
e.zh: 他现在和老对手们关系出奇地亲近。

palm.t:
n. 手掌；棕榈树
v. 藏于掌中

e.en: She held the seashell in the {palm} of her hand.
e.zh: 她把贝壳握在手掌心里。

e.en: Tall {palm} trees lined the beach at sunset.
e.zh: 夕阳下，高大的棕榈树排列在海滩边。

e.en: We spent the weekend in {Palma}, the capital of Mallorca.
e.zh: 我们在马略卡岛首府帕尔马度过了周末。

e.en: The flight to {Palma} takes about two hours from London.
e.zh: 从伦敦飞往帕尔马大约需要两个小时。

palme.t: n. 棕榈（法语）；金棕榈奖

e.en: The film won the {Palme} d'Or at Cannes.
e.zh: 这部电影赢得了戛纳电影节的金棕榈奖。

e.en: Directors dream of taking home the {Palme} d'Or.
e.zh: 导演们都梦想着捧回金棕榈奖。

palmer.t: n. 持棕枝的朝圣者；姓氏

e.en: Arnold {Palmer} is a legend in the world of golf.
e.zh: 阿诺德·帕尔默是高尔夫界的传奇人物。

e.en: The medieval {palmer} carried a branch from the Holy Land.
e.zh: 中世纪的朝圣者带回了一根来自圣地的棕枝。

palmerston.t: n. 帕麦斯顿（英国政治家）

e.en: Lord {Palmerston} served as Britain's prime minister twice.
e.zh: 帕麦斯顿勋爵曾两度出任英国首相。

e.en: {Palmerston} is also a city on New Zealand's North Island.
e.zh: 帕默斯顿也是新西兰北岛的一座城市。

e.en: The vase was decorated with a delicate {palmette} pattern.
e.zh: 花瓶上装饰着精致的棕叶饰纹样。

e.en: Greek temples often featured {palmette} motifs along the cornice.
e.zh: 希腊神庙的檐口常常装饰着棕叶饰图案。

e.en: Wild {palmetto} bushes grow throughout the Florida swamps.
e.zh: 野生矮棕榈遍布佛罗里达的沼泽地带。

e.en: South Carolina is nicknamed the {Palmetto} State.
e.zh: 南卡罗来纳州有“棕榈之州”的别称。

e.en: Pour a {palmful} of shampoo into your hand.
e.zh: 在手心里倒上一捧洗发水。

e.en: He scooped up a {palmful} of cool stream water.
e.zh: 他舀起一捧清凉的溪水。

e.en: The {palmist} examined the lines on her hand carefully.
e.zh: 那位手相师仔细端详着她手掌上的纹路。

e.en: A street {palmist} offered to read his future for ten dollars.
e.zh: 一位街头手相师愿意花十美元为他算命。

e.en: She studied {palmistry} as a hobby for many years.
e.zh: 她把研究手相术当作业余爱好已经很多年。

e.en: Many people don't take {palmistry} seriously as a science.
e.zh: 许多人不把手相术当作真正的科学看待。

palms.t: n. 手掌；棕榈树（palm 的复数）

e.en: Her {palms} were sweating before the big interview.
e.zh: 重要面试前，她的手掌直冒汗。

e.en: Coconut {palms} swayed gently in the tropical breeze.
e.zh: 椰子树在热带的微风中轻轻摇曳。

e.en: Back in 2002, executives carried a {palmtop} computer everywhere.
e.zh: 在2002年，高管们走到哪都带着掌上电脑。

e.en: The old {palmtop} could barely run a web browser.
e.zh: 那台旧掌上电脑几乎跑不动网页浏览器。

e.en: He often reminisces about the {palmy} days of his youth.
e.zh: 他常常回忆青年时代那段春风得意的日子。

e.en: Those were the {palmy} years of the music industry.
e.zh: 那是音乐产业的黄金年代。

palo.t: n. 帕洛（西语地名，如 Palo Alto）

e.en: They moved to {Palo} Alto to join a startup.
e.zh: 他们搬到了帕罗奥图，加入了一家初创公司。

e.en: {Palo} santo wood is often burned for its scent.
e.zh: 圣木常被点燃以散发香气。

e.en: She ordered a {paloma}, her favorite tequila cocktail.
e.zh: 她点了一杯帕洛玛，那是她最爱的龙舌兰鸡尾酒。

e.en: A grey {paloma} landed gently on the windowsill.
e.zh: 一只灰鸽轻轻落在了窗台上。

palomino.t: n. 金色鬃毛的淡黄马

e.en: She rode a beautiful {palomino} across the open field.
e.zh: 她骑着一匹漂亮的金色马驰骋在原野上。

e.en: The {palomino} has a striking golden coat and white mane.
e.zh: 这匹帕洛米诺马有着惊艳的金色皮毛和白色鬃毛。

e.en: The boxer was just a {palooka} with no real skill.
e.zh: 那个拳手不过是个毫无真本事的笨手。

e.en: Don't call me a {palooka} just because I lost once.
e.zh: 别因为我输了一次就叫我蠢蛋。

e.en: The spider uses each {palp} to sense its prey.
e.zh: 蜘蛛用每只触须感知猎物。

e.en: Insect taxonomy often relies on the shape of the {palp}.
e.zh: 昆虫分类学常常依赖触须的形状。

e.en: The tension in the meeting room was {palpable}.
e.zh: 会议室里的紧张气氛几乎可以触摸到。

e.en: There was a {palpable} sense of relief after the announcement.
e.zh: 公告发布后，明显能感受到一种松了口气的氛围。

e.en: The argument is {palpably} false to anyone paying attention.
e.zh: 任何留心的人都能明显看出这个论点是错的。

e.en: She was {palpably} nervous before stepping onto the stage.
e.zh: 她上台前显然非常紧张。

e.en: The doctor began to {palpate} her abdomen for tenderness.
e.zh: 医生开始触诊她的腹部，检查是否有压痛。

e.en: Vets {palpate} the animal to check for injuries.
e.zh: 兽医通过触诊来检查动物是否受伤。

e.en: Gentle {palpation} revealed a small lump under the skin.
e.zh: 轻柔的触诊发现皮下有一个小肿块。

e.en: The diagnosis was confirmed through careful {palpation}.
e.zh: 通过仔细的触诊确认了诊断结果。

e.en: Her heart began to {palpitate} as she opened the letter.
e.zh: 她打开信时心开始怦怦直跳。

e.en: Too much caffeine can make your heart {palpitate}.
e.zh: 摄入过多咖啡因会让心跳加速。

e.en: The village {padre} blessed the new fishing boat.
e.zh: 村里的神父为那艘新渔船祈福。

e.en: Soldiers often confided in the {padre} during long deployments.
e.zh: 士兵们在长期驻扎期间常向随军牧师倾诉心事。

pads.t:
n. 垫子；护具（pad 的复数）
v. 填塞；轻步走

e.en: He stuck rubber {pads} under the chair legs to prevent scratches.
e.zh: 他在椅子腿下贴了橡胶垫，防止刮伤地板。

e.en: The cat silently {pads} into the kitchen at midnight.
e.zh: 那只猫午夜悄无声息地走进厨房。

padua.t: n. 帕多瓦（意大利城市）

e.en: We took a day trip from Venice to {Padua}.
e.zh: 我们从威尼斯去帕多瓦做了一日游。

e.en: The ancient university in {Padua} dates back to 1222.
e.zh: 帕多瓦的那所古老大学可追溯到 1222 年。

e.en: The film is a {paean} to small-town American life.
e.zh: 这部电影是一首献给美国小镇生活的赞歌。

e.en: Critics wrote a {paean} praising her debut album.
e.zh: 评论家写了一篇赞美她首张专辑的颂词。

e.en: She specializes in {paediatric} cardiology at the children's hospital.
e.zh: 她在儿童医院专攻小儿心脏病学。

e.en: The {paediatric} ward is decorated with colorful murals.
e.zh: 儿科病房装饰着色彩缤纷的壁画。

paediatrician.t: n. 儿科医生（英式拼写）

e.en: Our {paediatrician} recommended a flu shot for the kids.
e.zh: 我们的儿科医生建议给孩子们打流感疫苗。

e.en: She trained for years to become a {paediatrician}.
e.zh: 她培训了多年才成为一名儿科医生。

e.en: He decided to specialize in {paediatrics} after his residency.
e.zh: 住院医师培训后，他决定专攻儿科。

e.en: The hospital's {paediatrics} department recently doubled in size.
e.zh: 医院的儿科最近规模扩大了一倍。

e.en: The court sentenced the convicted {paedophile} to twenty years.
e.zh: 法庭判处这名被定罪的恋童癖者二十年监禁。

e.en: Police raised awareness about online {paedophile} predators.
e.zh: 警方提高了人们对网络恋童癖者的警惕。

e.en: We ordered a huge {paella} to share at the Spanish restaurant.
e.zh: 我们在西班牙餐厅点了一大份海鲜饭分享。

e.en: Authentic Valencian {paella} traditionally uses rabbit and chicken.
e.zh: 正宗的瓦伦西亚海鲜饭传统上会用兔肉和鸡肉。

pagan.t:
n. 异教徒
adj. 异教的

e.en: Many ancient {pagan} festivals were absorbed into Christian holidays.
e.zh: 许多古代异教节日被吸收进了基督教的节日。

e.en: She wrote a novel about a {pagan} priestess in old Britain.
e.zh: 她写了一本关于古不列颠异教女祭司的小说。

paganini.t: n. 帕格尼尼（意大利小提琴家）

e.en: The violinist played a famous caprice by {Paganini} last night.
e.zh: 那位小提琴家昨晚演奏了帕格尼尼的著名随想曲。

e.en: Few musicians can match the technical brilliance of {Paganini}.
e.zh: 很少有音乐家能比肩帕格尼尼的高超技艺。

e.en: Modern {paganism} often emphasizes a deep connection with nature.
e.zh: 现代异教信仰通常强调与自然的深层联系。

e.en: The empire slowly replaced {paganism} with state-sponsored Christianity.
e.zh: 帝国逐渐用国家支持的基督教取代了异教信仰。

page.t:
n. 网页；页
v. 呼叫；翻页

e.en: Please turn to {page} forty-two of your textbook.
e.zh: 请翻到课本的第四十二页。

e.en: The landing {page} loads much faster after the redesign.
e.zh: 重新设计之后,着陆页加载速度快多了。

pageant.t: n. 选美活动；盛大游行

e.en: She won the local beauty {pageant} when she was seventeen.
e.zh: 她十七岁时赢得了当地的选美比赛。

e.en: The school staged a Christmas {pageant} for the parents.
e.zh: 学校为家长们上演了一场圣诞节庆典剧。

e.en: The royal wedding was full of traditional British {pageantry}.
e.zh: 那场王室婚礼充满了传统的英式盛大场面。

e.en: Olympic opening ceremonies are famous for their elaborate {pageantry}.
e.zh: 奥运会开幕式以其精心设计的盛大场面而闻名。

pageboy.t: n. 侍童；齐肩内卷发型

e.en: She got a sleek {pageboy} haircut for the new job.
e.zh: 她为了新工作剪了一个利落的童花头。

e.en: A young {pageboy} carried the rings down the aisle.
e.zh: 一个小男傧相沿着过道把戒指送了上来。

e.en: Designers used Adobe {PageMaker} long before InDesign existed.
e.zh: 在 InDesign 出现之前,设计师们一直使用 Adobe PageMaker。

e.en: My old brochures were all laid out in {PageMaker}.
e.zh: 我以前的宣传册都是用 PageMaker 排版的。

e.en: The doctor's {pager} buzzed during the middle of dinner.
e.zh: 医生的传呼机在晚餐中途响了起来。

e.en: Hospitals still rely on the humble {pager} for emergencies.
e.zh: 医院在紧急情况下仍依赖那种朴素的传呼机。

e.en: The novel runs to almost six hundred {pages}.
e.zh: 这部小说差不多有六百页。

e.en: He flipped through the {pages} looking for the recipe.
e.zh: 他翻着书页找那份食谱。

e.en: The website added {pagination} to make long lists easier.
e.zh: 该网站加入了分页功能,让长列表更易浏览。

e.en: Check the {pagination} before sending the document to print.
e.zh: 在文档付印之前请检查一下页码编排。

paging.t:
n. 分页；调页
v. 呼叫

e.en: The hospital is {paging} all available surgeons right now.
e.zh: 医院正在呼叫所有可上岗的外科医生。

e.en: Infinite scrolling has largely replaced traditional {paging} on mobile.
e.zh: 在移动端,无限滚动已基本取代了传统的翻页方式。

e.en: A wooden {pagoda} stood quietly at the edge of the lake.
e.zh: 一座木塔静静地矗立在湖边。

e.en: Tourists climbed the seven-story {pagoda} for the city view.
e.zh: 游客们爬上七层宝塔欣赏城市风光。

e.en: "{Pah}!" he scoffed, waving the suggestion away.
e.zh: “呸!”他嗤之以鼻,挥手打发了那个建议。

e.en: She let out a dismissive {pah} at his weak excuse.
e.zh: 她对他蹩脚的借口轻蔑地哼了一声。

e.en: We spent the weekend hiking around {Pai} in northern Thailand.
e.zh: 我们整个周末都在泰国北部的拜县徒步。

e.en: Backpackers often stop in {Pai} for its laid-back vibe.
e.zh: 背包客常因为悠闲的氛围而在拜县停留。

paid.t:
adj. 付费的；已支付的
v. pay 的过去式

e.en: I {paid} the bill online before leaving the restaurant.
e.zh: 我离开餐厅前就在网上付了账。

e.en: All employees will be {paid} on the first of the month.
e.zh: 所有员工将在每月一号领到工资。

e.en: We took the kids to {Paignton} beach for the holiday.
e.zh: 我们假期带孩子去了佩恩顿海滩。

e.en: {Paignton} is a popular seaside town on the English Riviera.
e.zh: 佩恩顿是英格兰里维埃拉上一个很受欢迎的海滨小镇。

e.en: She filled a small {pail} with water from the well.
e.zh: 她从井里打了一小桶水。

e.en: The child carried his sand {pail} down to the shore.
e.zh: 那孩子提着他的沙桶走向海边。

pain.t:
n. 疼痛；痛苦
v. 使痛苦

e.en: I felt a sharp {pain} in my lower back.
e.zh: 我感到下背部一阵剧痛。

e.en: Losing the championship caused him real emotional {pain}.
e.zh: 输掉冠军让他承受了真切的情感痛苦。

e.en: She gave him a {pained} smile and walked away.
e.zh: 她对他露出一个苦涩的微笑就走开了。

e.en: He looked {pained} when asked about his late father.
e.zh: 被问及已故父亲时,他显得很痛苦。

e.en: Sitting through that meeting was genuinely {painful}.
e.zh: 坐着开完那场会真是一种煎熬。

e.en: Recovery from the surgery was slow and {painful}.
e.zh: 手术后的恢复过程缓慢又痛苦。

e.en: He was {painfully} aware of his own mistakes.
e.zh: 他痛苦地意识到自己犯下的错误。

e.en: The progress on the project has been {painfully} slow.
e.zh: 项目的进展一直慢得令人难受。

e.en: The dentist prescribed a mild {painkiller} after the procedure.
e.zh: 牙医在手术后开了一种温和的止痛药。

e.en: She took a {painkiller} and went straight to bed.
e.zh: 她吃了片止痛药就直接上床睡觉了。

e.en: The dental procedure was surprisingly quick and {painless}.
e.zh: 那次牙科治疗出奇地快速而无痛。

e.en: Switching to the new app was completely {painless}.
e.zh: 切换到新应用完全没有任何麻烦。

e.en: The migration tool moves your data over {painlessly}.
e.zh: 这款迁移工具能毫不费力地把你的数据搬过去。

e.en: He pulled the splinter out quickly and {painlessly}.
e.zh: 他迅速又毫无痛感地把刺拔了出来。

e.en: She took great {pains} to get every detail right.
e.zh: 她煞费苦心地把每一个细节都做对。

e.en: He still suffers from chest {pains} after the accident.
e.zh: 事故之后他仍然时常胸痛。

painstaking.t: adj. 煞费苦心的；精心的

e.en: Restoring the painting required {painstaking} work over many months.
e.zh: 修复这幅画需要数月的精心工作。

e.en: He's known for his {painstaking} attention to historical detail.
e.zh: 他以对历史细节一丝不苟而闻名。

painstakingly.t: adv. 煞费苦心地；精心地

e.en: She {painstakingly} translated each line of the ancient manuscript.
e.zh: 她一丝不苟地翻译了那份古代手稿的每一行。

e.en: The model was {painstakingly} assembled from thousands of tiny parts.
e.zh: 那个模型是用成千上万个小零件精心拼装而成的。

paint.t:
n. 油漆；颜料
v. 绘画；刷漆

e.en: We need to {paint} the bedroom before moving in.
e.zh: 我们搬进去之前得把卧室刷一下。

e.en: A fresh coat of {paint} made the kitchen look new.
e.zh: 一层新油漆让厨房焕然一新。

e.en: We're going {paintball} for my brother's bachelor party.
e.zh: 我们要去玩彩弹射击,给我哥办单身派对。

e.en: He still has bruises from yesterday's {paintball} match.
e.zh: 昨天那场彩弹比赛之后他身上还有淤青。

e.en: Dip the {paintbrush} lightly and tap off any excess.
e.zh: 轻轻蘸一下画笔,把多余的颜料抖掉。

e.en: She rinsed the {paintbrush} carefully under warm water.
e.zh: 她用温水仔细清洗了那支画笔。

e.en: He keeps his {paintbrushes} sorted by size and shape.
e.zh: 他把画笔按大小和形状分类摆放。

e.en: The art store sells {paintbrushes} for every kind of medium.
e.zh: 那家美术用品店出售各种画材的画笔。

e.en: She {painted} the front door a cheerful yellow.
e.zh: 她把前门刷成了明快的黄色。

e.en: The {painted} walls of the cave date back thousands of years.
e.zh: 洞穴里彩绘的墙壁可以追溯到数千年前。

e.en: The {painter} finished the living room in a single day.
e.zh: 那位漆工一天就把客厅刷完了。

e.en: Vermeer was a Dutch {painter} famous for quiet domestic scenes.
e.zh: 维米尔是一位以宁静室内场景闻名的荷兰画家。

painterly.t: adj. 绘画风格的；富画意的

e.en: The film has a soft, {painterly} look in every frame.
e.zh: 这部电影每一帧都有一种柔和的、绘画般的质感。

e.en: Her photos have a distinctly {painterly} quality to them.
e.zh: 她的照片带有一种明显的画意风格。

e.en: He went to the doctor about a recurring heart {palpitation}.
e.zh: 他因反复出现的心悸去看了医生。

e.en: Anxiety can trigger sudden {palpitation} in many patients.
e.zh: 焦虑可能会让许多病人突然出现心悸。

pals.t: n. 好友；伙伴（pal 的复数）

e.en: The two boys have been {pals} since kindergarten.
e.zh: 这两个男孩从幼儿园起就是好朋友。

e.en: She went hiking with a few college {pals}.
e.zh: 她和几个大学好友一起去远足了。

e.en: His {palsied} hand trembled as he tried to write.
e.zh: 他试图写字时，那只麻痹的手颤抖不止。

e.en: The old man walked slowly on his {palsied} legs.
e.zh: 老人迈着无力的双腿慢慢走着。

e.en: The condition is a form of cerebral {palsy}.
e.zh: 这种病症是脑性麻痹的一种。

e.en: Bell's {palsy} causes temporary paralysis of facial muscles.
e.zh: 贝尔氏麻痹会导致面部肌肉暂时瘫痪。

e.en: Don't {palter} with me — give me a straight answer.
e.zh: 别跟我兜圈子，直截了当地回答我。

e.en: Politicians often {palter} when asked about their finances.
e.zh: 政客们被问及财务问题时常常含糊其辞。

paltry.t: adj. 微不足道的；不值一提的

e.en: They offered her a {paltry} sum for years of work.
e.zh: 对于她多年的工作，他们只给了一笔微不足道的酬劳。

e.en: The reward seemed {paltry} compared to the effort involved.
e.zh: 与付出的努力相比，回报显得微不足道。

e.en: {Pam} is hosting the team dinner this Friday.
e.zh: 帕姆这周五要主持团队聚餐。

e.en: He sprayed the pan with {Pam} before frying the eggs.
e.zh: 他在煎蛋前往锅里喷了一层防粘喷雾。

e.en: The {Pamir} mountains stretch across Central Asia.
e.zh: 帕米尔高原横跨整个中亚地区。

e.en: Trekking the {Pamir} highway is on her bucket list.
e.zh: 徒步帕米尔公路在她的人生清单上。

e.en: The vast {pampa} extends for hundreds of miles in Argentina.
e.zh: 广袤的潘帕斯草原在阿根廷绵延数百英里。

e.en: Gauchos still ride horses across the open {pampa}.
e.zh: 高乔牧人至今仍在开阔的潘帕草原上骑马。

pampas.t: n. 南美潘帕斯大草原

e.en: The Argentine {pampas} are famous for cattle ranching.
e.zh: 阿根廷的潘帕斯草原以养牛业闻名。

e.en: Tall {pampas} grass swayed in the autumn wind.
e.zh: 高大的蒲苇在秋风中摇曳。

e.en: She loves to {pamper} herself with a long bath.
e.zh: 她喜欢用一次长时间的泡澡来宠爱自己。

e.en: Don't {pamper} the kids too much before bedtime.
e.zh: 睡前别太娇惯孩子们。

pampered.t: adj. 被娇惯的；养尊处优的

e.en: The {pampered} cat refuses to eat any cheap food.
e.zh: 那只被宠坏的猫拒绝吃任何便宜的猫粮。

e.en: She lived a {pampered} life as the youngest child.
e.zh: 作为最小的孩子，她过着备受宠爱的生活。

pampering.t:
n. 溺爱
v. 宠爱（pamper 的现在分词）

e.en: A spa weekend is exactly the {pampering} she needed.
e.zh: 一个水疗周末正是她需要的呵护。

e.en: The hotel is known for {pampering} every guest.
e.zh: 这家酒店以悉心款待每位客人而闻名。

e.en: She picked up a {pamphlet} about local hiking trails.
e.zh: 她拿了一本介绍当地徒步路线的小册子。

e.en: The clinic distributes a free health {pamphlet} to visitors.
e.zh: 诊所免费向来访者发放一本健康宣传册。

e.en: Thomas Paine was a famous revolutionary {pamphleteer}.
e.zh: 托马斯·潘恩是一位著名的革命派小册子作者。

e.en: The {pamphleteer} stood on the corner handing out leaflets.
e.zh: 那位写传单的人站在街角分发宣传册。

pamplona.t: n. 潘普洛纳（西班牙城市）

e.en: The running of the bulls in {Pamplona} attracts tourists worldwide.
e.zh: 潘普洛纳的奔牛节吸引着全世界的游客。

e.en: Hemingway made {Pamplona} famous through his novel.
e.zh: 海明威通过他的小说让潘普洛纳声名远扬。

pan.t:
n. 平底锅
v. 平移镜头；严厉批评

e.en: Heat the {pan} before adding the oil.
e.zh: 先把锅烧热再倒油。

e.en: Critics will probably {pan} the new movie.
e.zh: 影评人很可能会狠批这部新电影。

e.en: Technology is not a {panacea} for every social problem.
e.zh: 科技并不是解决一切社会问题的灵丹妙药。

e.en: She treats meditation as a {panacea} for modern stress.
e.zh: 她把冥想当作应对现代压力的万能良方。

panache.t: n. 派头；神气十足的风度

e.en: She gave the speech with great {panache} and confidence.
e.zh: 她以极大的派头和自信发表了演讲。

e.en: He dresses with a certain {panache} that turns heads.
e.zh: 他穿着自有一股气派,令人侧目。

e.en: Ships from many nations pass through {Panama} every day.
e.zh: 许多国家的船只每天经过巴拿马。

e.en: He wore a white {Panama} hat to the wedding.
e.zh: 他戴着一顶白色巴拿马帽参加婚礼。

panamanian.t:
adj. 巴拿马的
n. 巴拿马人

e.en: The {Panamanian} government announced new canal regulations yesterday.
e.zh: 巴拿马政府昨日宣布了新的运河规定。

e.en: She loves cooking traditional {Panamanian} dishes for her family.
e.zh: 她喜欢为家人做传统的巴拿马菜。

e.en: My old {Panasonic} TV still works after fifteen years.
e.zh: 我那台旧的松下电视用了十五年还能用。

e.en: He bought a {Panasonic} camera for his travel vlog.
e.zh: 他买了一台松下相机用来拍旅行视频。

e.en: I had a stack of {pancakes} for breakfast this morning.
e.zh: 今早我吃了一摞煎饼当早餐。

e.en: The traffic flattened the can like a {pancake}.
e.zh: 车流把那个罐子压得像煎饼一样扁。

e.en: She flips {pancakes} every Sunday morning for the kids.
e.zh: 她每周日早上为孩子们翻煎薄饼。

e.en: These {pancakes} taste amazing with maple syrup and butter.
e.zh: 这些薄煎饼配枫糖浆和黄油非常好吃。

pancetta.t: n. 意式烟肉；意大利培根

e.en: The pasta sauce uses crispy {pancetta} and fresh cream.
e.zh: 这款意面酱用了脆培根和新鲜奶油。

e.en: He wrapped the chicken in thin slices of {pancetta}.
e.zh: 他用薄薄的意式培根片把鸡肉裹起来。

e.en: The {pancreas} produces insulin to regulate blood sugar levels.
e.zh: 胰腺分泌胰岛素以调节血糖水平。

e.en: Doctors removed part of his {pancreas} during the surgery.
e.zh: 医生在手术中切除了他的部分胰腺。

e.en: {Pancreatic} cancer is often diagnosed at a late stage.
e.zh: 胰腺癌往往在晚期才被发现。

e.en: The patient takes enzymes to help with {pancreatic} function.
e.zh: 病人服用酶剂以帮助胰腺功能。

e.en: Heavy drinking can lead to chronic {pancreatitis} over time.
e.zh: 长期酗酒可能导致慢性胰腺炎。

e.en: She was hospitalized last week with severe acute {pancreatitis}.
e.zh: 她上周因严重急性胰腺炎住院。

e.en: The baby {panda} climbed onto its mother's back playfully.
e.zh: 小熊猫顽皮地爬到妈妈背上。

e.en: Visitors lined up for hours to see the giant {panda}.
e.zh: 游客排了几个小时队就为看大熊猫。

pandemic.t:
n. 大流行病
adj. 大范围流行的

e.en: The {pandemic} changed how millions of people work remotely.
e.zh: 这场大流行改变了数百万人远程办公的方式。

e.en: Health officials worry about the next global flu {pandemic}.
e.zh: 卫生官员担心下一次全球流感大流行。

e.en: {Pandemonium} broke out in the stadium after the winning goal.
e.zh: 制胜进球后体育场内一片混乱沸腾。

e.en: The classroom erupted into total {pandemonium} when recess started.
e.zh: 课间休息一开始,教室里就炸开了锅。

e.en: Politicians often {pander} to voters during election season.
e.zh: 政客在选举季常常迎合选民的口味。

e.en: The show refuses to {pander} to its loudest fans.
e.zh: 这部剧拒绝迎合最吵闹的那批粉丝。

pandering.t:
n. 迎合；逢迎
v. 迎合（pander 的现在分词）

e.en: Critics accused the movie of shamelessly {pandering} to nostalgia.
e.zh: 评论家指责这部电影无耻地迎合怀旧情绪。

e.en: His speech felt like obvious {pandering} to younger voters.
e.zh: 他的演讲明显像是在讨好年轻选民。

pandora.t: n. 潘多拉（希腊神话人物）

e.en: Opening that file was like opening {Pandora}'s box.
e.zh: 打开那个文件就像打开了潘多拉的盒子。

e.en: She listens to indie playlists on {Pandora} while working.
e.zh: 她工作时用 Pandora 听独立音乐歌单。

e.en: The teacher used to {pandy} students who misbehaved in class.
e.zh: 老师过去常用戒尺打那些课堂上调皮的学生。

e.en: In old schools, a {pandy} on the hand stung badly.
e.zh: 在旧式学校里,手心挨一下戒尺会火辣辣地疼。

e.en: A stray ball cracked the window {pane} in the kitchen.
e.zh: 一个乱飞的球把厨房窗玻璃砸裂了。

e.en: Rain streaked down the glass {pane} all afternoon.
e.zh: 雨水整个下午顺着玻璃窗一道道流下。

e.en: I ordered palak {paneer} with garlic naan for dinner.
e.zh: 我点了菠菜咖喱奶酪配蒜香烤饼当晚餐。

e.en: Fresh {paneer} is easy to make at home with milk.
e.zh: 用牛奶在家做新鲜印度奶酪其实很简单。

e.en: The senator delivered a long {panegyric} praising the late president.
e.zh: 参议员发表了长篇颂词来赞美已故总统。

e.en: His review read more like a {panegyric} than honest criticism.
e.zh: 他的评论读起来更像颂词,而非诚实的批评。

panel.t:
n. 面板；专家组
v. 镶板

e.en: A {panel} of experts discussed climate policy at the conference.
e.zh: 一组专家在会议上讨论了气候政策。

e.en: The solar {panel} on the roof powers the whole house.
e.zh: 屋顶上的太阳能板为整栋房子供电。

e.en: The library had warm, oak-{paneled} walls and leather chairs.
e.zh: 图书馆墙上嵌着温暖的橡木板,还有皮椅。

e.en: They {paneled} the basement to make it look cozier.
e.zh: 他们给地下室装上了护墙板,让它看起来更温馨。

e.en: Dark wood {paneling} made the small office feel even smaller.
e.zh: 深色木质护墙板让本就狭小的办公室显得更挤了。

e.en: They removed the old {paneling} to expose the brick wall.
e.zh: 他们拆掉旧护墙板,露出了砖墙。

panelist.t: n. 专题讨论小组成员

e.en: Each {panelist} answered audience questions for about ten minutes.
e.zh: 每位嘉宾大约用十分钟回答了观众提问。

e.en: She was the youngest {panelist} on the morning talk show.
e.zh: 她是那档晨间访谈节目里最年轻的嘉宾。

panelled.t: adj. 装有镶板的（英式拼写）

e.en: The cozy pub had dark oak-{panelled} walls and leather booths.
e.zh: 那家温馨的酒馆有深色橡木护墙板和皮卡座。

e.en: They {panelled} the study to give it a classic look.
e.zh: 他们给书房装上护墙板,使其呈现古典风格。

e.en: Antique oak {panelling} covered the walls of the dining room.
e.zh: 餐厅的墙面铺着古色古香的橡木护墙板。

e.en: He stripped the old {panelling} and repainted the room white.
e.zh: 他拆掉旧护墙板,把房间重新刷成白色。

panellist.t: n. 小组讨论成员（英式拼写）

e.en: Each {panellist} was given two minutes to make opening remarks.
e.zh: 每位嘉宾有两分钟时间发表开场陈述。

e.en: The TV {panellist} disagreed sharply with the guest economist.
e.zh: 那位电视讨论嘉宾与受邀经济学家意见严重分歧。

e.en: Solar {panels} now cover most rooftops in this neighborhood.
e.zh: 如今这个社区大多数屋顶都装上了太阳能板。

e.en: The conference featured several {panels} on artificial intelligence ethics.
e.zh: 这次会议安排了多场关于人工智能伦理的专题讨论。

panfish.t: n. 适合下锅的小型食用鱼

e.en: We caught a bucket of {panfish} at the lake yesterday.
e.zh: 我们昨天在湖边钓了一桶小型食用鱼。

e.en: Bluegill is the most common {panfish} in this region.
e.zh: 蓝鳃太阳鱼是这一带最常见的小型食用鱼。

e.en: She felt a sudden {pang} of guilt after lying.
e.zh: 撒谎后她突然感到一阵内疚。

e.en: Hunger {pangs} kept him awake most of the night.
e.zh: 饥饿的剧痛让他大半夜都睡不着。

paparazzi.t: n. 狗仔队（paparazzo 的复数）

e.en: The actress was chased by {paparazzi} outside the restaurant.
e.zh: 那位女演员在餐厅外被狗仔队追拍。

e.en: {Paparazzi} swarmed the airport waiting for the celebrity.
e.zh: 狗仔队涌向机场等候那位名人。

e.en: A single {paparazzo} snapped the couple on the beach.
e.zh: 一名狗仔队员在海滩上偷拍了那对情侣。

e.en: The {paparazzo} was fined for trespassing on private property.
e.zh: 那名狗仔队员因擅闯私人财产被罚款。

e.en: I ate fresh {papaya} for breakfast in Thailand.
e.zh: 我在泰国早餐吃了新鲜的木瓜。

e.en: Ripe {papaya} has a sweet, musky flavor.
e.zh: 成熟的木瓜有一种甜美的麝香味。

e.en: The market sells ripe {papayas} for two dollars each.
e.zh: 市场上成熟的木瓜每个卖两美元。

e.en: We picked three {papayas} from the backyard tree.
e.zh: 我们从后院的树上摘了三个木瓜。

paper.t:
n. 纸；论文
adj. 纸的

e.en: Please print the report on white {paper}.
e.zh: 请把报告打印在白纸上。

e.en: She published a research {paper} in a top journal.
e.zh: 她在顶级期刊上发表了一篇研究论文。

e.en: I prefer the {paperback} edition because it's cheaper.
e.zh: 我更喜欢平装版,因为它更便宜。

e.en: The novel comes out in {paperback} next month.
e.zh: 这部小说下个月将推出平装版。

e.en: The cereal box is made of recycled {paperboard}.
e.zh: 麦片盒是用再生纸板制成的。

e.en: They package the gifts in sturdy {paperboard} boxes.
e.zh: 他们用结实的纸板盒包装礼物。

e.en: The {paperboy} delivers the morning news by bicycle.
e.zh: 送报小哥骑自行车送早报。

e.en: My neighbor's son works as a {paperboy} on weekends.
e.zh: 我邻居的儿子周末做送报员。

e.en: She fastened the documents together with a {paperclip}.
e.zh: 她用一枚回形针把文件夹在一起。

e.en: There's a box of colorful {paperclip} samples on the desk.
e.zh: 桌上有一盒彩色回形针样品。

e.en: Our office went fully {paperless} last year.
e.zh: 我们办公室去年实现了完全无纸化。

e.en: Choose {paperless} billing to save trees.
e.zh: 选择无纸账单以保护树木。

e.en: The local {papermaker} crafts handmade sheets from cotton.
e.zh: 当地的造纸匠用棉花手工制作纸张。

e.en: She trained as a {papermaker} in Japan for two years.
e.zh: 她在日本接受了两年的造纸工艺培训。

papers.t: n. 文件；证件；论文（复数）

e.en: He filed all the legal {papers} this morning.
e.zh: 他今早提交了所有的法律文件。

e.en: The professor graded student {papers} over the weekend.
e.zh: 教授周末批改了学生的论文。

e.en: A glass {paperweight} kept the documents from blowing away.
e.zh: 一个玻璃镇纸防止文件被风吹走。

e.en: Her grandmother collected antique crystal {paperweight} pieces.
e.zh: 她奶奶收藏古董水晶镇纸。

paperwork.t: n. 文书工作；书面手续

e.en: There's too much {paperwork} involved in buying a house.
e.zh: 买房涉及的文书工作太多了。

e.en: Please complete the {paperwork} before your appointment.
e.zh: 请在预约前完成相关文件填写。

paperworks.t: n. 文书工作（非标准复数）

e.en: The artist exhibited her latest {paperworks} at the gallery.
e.zh: 那位艺术家在画廊展出了她最新的纸艺作品。

e.en: His delicate {paperworks} sold out within an hour.
e.zh: 他精美的纸艺作品在一小时内售罄。

e.en: Onion skins have a thin, {papery} texture.
e.zh: 洋葱皮有一种薄薄的纸质感。

e.en: The old book had {papery} pages that crumbled easily.
e.zh: 那本旧书的书页薄如纸张,极易碎裂。

e.en: Each tiny {papilla} on the tongue contains taste buds.
e.zh: 舌头上每个微小的乳突都含有味蕾。

e.en: The dermatologist examined the inflamed {papilla} on her skin.
e.zh: 皮肤科医生检查了她皮肤上发炎的乳突。

e.en: The cat's tongue is covered with rough {papillae}.
e.zh: 猫的舌头上覆盖着粗糙的乳突。

e.en: Taste {papillae} help us distinguish sweet from sour.
e.zh: 味觉乳突帮助我们区分甜和酸。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed her with {papillary} thyroid cancer.
e.zh: 医生诊断她患有乳头状甲状腺癌。

e.en: {Papillary} muscles help control the heart valves.
e.zh: 乳头肌有助于控制心脏瓣膜。

e.en: The doctor removed a small {papilloma} from her eyelid.
e.zh: 医生从她的眼睑上切除了一个小乳头状瘤。

e.en: A {papilloma} is usually benign but should be monitored.
e.zh: 乳头状瘤通常是良性的,但应进行监测。

e.en: The HPV vaccine protects against human {papillomavirus} infection.
e.zh: HPV 疫苗可预防人类乳头瘤病毒感染。

e.en: {Papillomavirus} can cause warts on the skin.
e.zh: 乳头瘤病毒可在皮肤上引起疣。

e.en: The pamphlet used the slur {papist} to insult Catholics.
e.zh: 那本小册子用「教皇党徒」一词侮辱天主教徒。

e.en: In Tudor England, being called a {papist} was dangerous.
e.zh: 在都铎王朝时期的英国,被称为教皇党徒是危险的。

papoose.t: n. 北美印第安婴儿；婴儿背袋

e.en: The mother carried her baby in a traditional {papoose}.
e.zh: 那位母亲用传统的婴儿背带背着她的宝宝。

e.en: A wooden {papoose} was used to keep the infant safe.
e.zh: 一个木制婴儿背架被用来保护婴儿的安全。

e.en: We ordered {pappardelle} with wild boar ragu in Tuscany.
e.zh: 我们在托斯卡纳点了野猪肉酱宽面。

e.en: Fresh {pappardelle} pairs beautifully with rich meat sauces.
e.zh: 新鲜的宽面与浓郁的肉酱搭配极佳。

e.en: Sprinkle some {paprika} on the roasted potatoes for color.
e.zh: 在烤土豆上撒点红椒粉来增添色彩。

e.en: This Hungarian stew gets its rich flavor from smoked {paprika}.
e.zh: 这道匈牙利炖菜的浓郁风味来自烟熏红椒粉。

e.en: My uncle worked as a doctor in {Papua} New Guinea for years.
e.zh: 我叔叔在巴布亚新几内亚当了多年医生。

e.en: Rare birds of paradise live in the forests of {Papua}.
e.zh: 稀有的极乐鸟生活在巴布亚的森林里。

papuan.t:
adj. 巴布亚的
n. 巴布亚人

e.en: The museum displays traditional {Papuan} masks and carvings.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了传统的巴布亚面具和雕刻品。

e.en: She studied several {Papuan} languages during her fieldwork.
e.zh: 她在田野调查中研究了几种巴布亚语言。

papworth.t: n. 帕普沃思（地名/姓氏）

e.en: He had heart surgery at {Papworth} Hospital last year.
e.zh: 他去年在帕普沃斯医院做了心脏手术。

e.en: {Papworth} is famous for pioneering transplant medicine in Britain.
e.zh: 帕普沃斯以在英国开创移植医学而闻名。

e.en: Ancient Egyptians wrote on sheets of {papyrus} made from reeds.
e.zh: 古埃及人在用芦苇制成的莎草纸上书写。

e.en: The museum displayed a fragile {papyrus} scroll under glass.
e.zh: 博物馆在玻璃下展出一卷脆弱的莎草纸卷轴。

par.t: n. 标准；同等水平；（高尔夫）标准杆

e.en: Her latest novel is on {par} with her best work.
e.zh: 她最新的小说与她最优秀的作品不相上下。

e.en: He finished the round two strokes under {par}.
e.zh: 他以低于标准杆两杆的成绩完成了这一轮。

e.en: Please read the second {para} of the contract carefully.
e.zh: 请仔细阅读合同的第二段。

e.en: My brother trained as a {para} before joining the police.
e.zh: 我哥哥当过伞兵,后来加入了警察队伍。

e.en: Jesus often taught lessons through a simple {parable}.
e.zh: 耶稣常常通过简单的寓言来传授道理。

e.en: The film works as a {parable} about modern greed.
e.zh: 这部电影可以看作是关于现代贪婪的寓言。

e.en: Children love stories with hidden meanings, especially {parables}.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢有隐含意义的故事,尤其是寓言。

e.en: His novels read like extended {parables} about modern life.
e.zh: 他的小说读起来像是关于现代生活的长篇寓言。

e.en: A thrown ball traces a perfect {parabola} through the air.
e.zh: 扔出去的球在空中划出一条完美的抛物线。

e.en: The satellite dish has the shape of a {parabola}.
e.zh: 卫星天线呈抛物线的形状。

parabolic.t: adj. 抛物线的；寓言式的

e.en: The rocket followed a {parabolic} path back to Earth.
e.zh: 火箭沿着抛物线轨迹返回地球。

e.en: Engineers installed a {parabolic} mirror to focus the sunlight.
e.zh: 工程师安装了一面抛物面镜来聚焦阳光。

e.en: The radio telescope dish is shaped like a {paraboloid}.
e.zh: 射电望远镜的天线呈抛物面形状。

e.en: Engineers tested a {paraboloid} reflector to concentrate solar energy.
e.zh: 工程师测试了一种抛物面反射器来聚集太阳能。

paracelsus.t: n. 帕拉塞尔苏斯（瑞士医生）

e.en: {Paracelsus} challenged the medical doctrines of his sixteenth-century peers.
e.zh: 帕拉塞尔苏斯挑战了同时代十六世纪同行的医学教条。

e.en: Many consider {Paracelsus} the father of modern toxicology.
e.zh: 许多人将帕拉塞尔苏斯视为现代毒理学之父。

paracetamol.t: n. 扑热息痛；对乙酰氨基酚

e.en: I took two {paracetamol} tablets to ease my headache.
e.zh: 我吃了两片扑热息痛来缓解头痛。

e.en: Don't exceed the recommended daily dose of {paracetamol}.
e.zh: 不要超过扑热息痛的每日推荐剂量。

parachute.t:
n. 降落伞
v. 跳伞

e.en: The pilot pulled the cord and the {parachute} opened smoothly.
e.zh: 飞行员拉动绳索,降落伞顺利打开。

e.en: Aid workers will {parachute} supplies into the flooded region.
e.zh: 救援人员将向洪水地区空投物资。

e.en: The plane dropped supplies attached to bright orange {parachutes}.
e.zh: 飞机投下了系着亮橙色降落伞的补给品。

e.en: He {parachutes} from helicopters as part of his training.
e.zh: 作为训练的一部分,他从直升机上跳伞。

e.en: The veteran {parachutist} has logged over a thousand jumps.
e.zh: 这位资深跳伞员已经跳过一千多次。

e.en: A lone {parachutist} drifted gently toward the open field.
e.zh: 一名孤身跳伞员缓缓飘向开阔的田野。

parade.t:
n. 游行；阅兵
v. 列队行进

e.en: Thousands lined the streets to watch the holiday {parade}.
e.zh: 数千人沿街观看节日游行。

e.en: Don't {parade} your wealth in front of struggling friends.
e.zh: 不要在生活拮据的朋友面前炫耀你的财富。

e.en: The city hosts colorful {parades} every Lunar New Year.
e.zh: 这座城市每年农历新年都会举办多彩的游行。

e.en: He {parades} his new car around the neighborhood proudly.
e.zh: 他得意地开着新车在小区里到处炫耀。

e.en: Remote work has shifted the {paradigm} of office culture.
e.zh: 远程办公改变了办公室文化的范式。

e.en: Her research offers a new {paradigm} for studying memory.
e.zh: 她的研究为记忆研究提供了一种新范式。

e.en: This case is a {paradigmatic} example of corporate fraud.
e.zh: 这个案例是企业欺诈的典型例子。

e.en: The novel represents a {paradigmatic} shift in modern fiction.
e.zh: 这部小说代表了现代小说的范式转变。

e.en: The bakery {Paradis} on the corner sells amazing croissants.
e.zh: 街角那家叫Paradis的面包店卖的牛角包特别棒。

e.en: She named her cat {Paradis} after a French novel.
e.zh: 她以一本法国小说为她的猫取名Paradis。

e.en: The tropical island felt like {paradise} after the long winter.
e.zh: 漫长的冬天过后,这座热带小岛宛如人间天堂。

e.en: For book lovers, this old library is pure {paradise}.
e.zh: 对爱书的人来说,这座旧图书馆简直是天堂。

e.en: The travel magazine featured ten tropical {paradises} for honeymooners.
e.zh: 这本旅游杂志介绍了十个适合蜜月的热带天堂。

e.en: Hidden mountain valleys can feel like undiscovered {paradises}.
e.zh: 隐秘的山谷有时让人感觉像未被发现的人间天堂。

e.en: Local fishermen rowed out at dawn in a wooden {panga}.
e.zh: 当地渔民黎明时分划着木制小渔船出海。

e.en: The guide steered the {panga} carefully through the mangroves.
e.zh: 向导小心翼翼地驾驶小渔船穿过红树林。

e.en: The {pangolin} curled into a ball when it sensed danger.
e.zh: 穿山甲一感到危险就蜷成一团。

e.en: Conservation groups are fighting to protect the endangered {pangolin}.
e.zh: 环保组织正在努力保护濒危的穿山甲。

panhandle.t:
n. 狭长地带（地形）
v. 乞讨

e.en: Tornadoes often hit the Texas {panhandle} in late spring.
e.zh: 龙卷风常在晚春袭击德州狭长地带。

e.en: It's illegal to {panhandle} on the subway in this city.
e.zh: 在这座城市的地铁上行乞是违法的。

e.en: A friendly {panhandler} stood outside the coffee shop every morning.
e.zh: 每天早上都有一位友善的乞讨者站在咖啡店外。

e.en: She gave the {panhandler} a sandwich instead of cash.
e.zh: 她给了那位乞讨者一个三明治,而不是现金。

e.en: The city passed new laws restricting {panhandling} downtown.
e.zh: 该市通过了限制市中心乞讨的新法律。

e.en: He survived for months by {panhandling} near the train station.
e.zh: 他靠在火车站附近乞讨维持了好几个月生活。

panic.t:
n. 恐慌
v. 惊慌失措

e.en: Don't {panic} — the situation is completely under control now.
e.zh: 别慌,现在情况已经完全在掌控之中了。

e.en: A wave of {panic} swept through the crowd at the news.
e.zh: 听到这消息,人群中涌起一阵恐慌。

e.en: She {paniced} when she couldn't find her passport at check-in.
e.zh: 在值机时找不到护照,她一下子慌了。

e.en: Investors {paniced} as stock prices dropped sharply that morning.
e.zh: 那天上午股价大跌,投资者惊慌失措。

e.en: Stop {panicing} and take a deep breath, everything will work out.
e.zh: 别慌,深呼吸,一切都会好起来的。

e.en: She kept {panicing} about the deadline approaching too quickly.
e.zh: 她一直对截止日期临近得太快感到惊慌。

e.en: Try not to {panick} when the fire alarm goes off unexpectedly.
e.zh: 火警突然响起时尽量不要慌乱。

e.en: He started to {panick} as the elevator suddenly stopped moving.
e.zh: 电梯突然停下时,他开始慌张起来。

e.en: She {panicked} when the plane hit unexpected turbulence.
e.zh: 飞机遇到意外颠簸时她惊慌失措。

e.en: His {panicked} voice on the phone alarmed everyone immediately.
e.zh: 他在电话里惊慌的声音让大家立刻紧张起来。

e.en: She gets {panicky} whenever she has to speak in public.
e.zh: 每当要在公众场合发言,她都会慌张不安。

e.en: His voice sounded {panicky} during the emergency phone call.
e.zh: 那通紧急电话里,他的声音听起来惊慌失措。

panics.t: n./v. panic 的复数或三单

e.en: He {panics} every time the wifi drops during an exam.
e.zh: 考试时网络一断他就慌得不行。

e.en: Market {panics} can cause stock prices to crash overnight.
e.zh: 市场恐慌可能导致股价一夜暴跌。

panjandrum.t: n. 自以为是的大人物

e.en: The local {panjandrum} thought his opinion mattered more than anyone's.
e.zh: 那位地方大人物以为自己的意见比谁都重要。

e.en: Some bureaucratic {panjandrum} blocked the project for weeks.
e.zh: 某个官僚大人物把这个项目搁置了好几周。

e.en: He packed snacks and water into his bike {pannier}.
e.zh: 他把零食和水装进自行车驮包里。

e.en: The cyclist's {pannier} was stuffed with camping gear and clothes.
e.zh: 骑行者的驮包里塞满了露营装备和衣物。

panoply.t: n. 全套装备；华丽的一套

e.en: The festival offered a {panoply} of food, music, and dance.
e.zh: 这个节日呈现了丰富多样的美食、音乐和舞蹈。

e.en: Streaming services provide a vast {panoply} of viewing options.
e.zh: 流媒体服务提供了琳琅满目的观看选择。

panoptic.t: adj. 全景的，一览无余的

e.en: The hilltop offered a {panoptic} view of the entire valley.
e.zh: 山顶可以一览整个山谷的全貌。

e.en: Modern surveillance creates a nearly {panoptic} system of monitoring.
e.zh: 现代监控构建出一个近乎全方位的监视系统。

e.en: Critics compare social media to a digital {panopticon}.
e.zh: 评论者把社交媒体比作数字版的全景敞视监狱。

e.en: The prison was designed as a classic Victorian {panopticon}.
e.zh: 这座监狱按照典型的维多利亚式全景监狱设计。

e.en: The mountaintop offered a stunning {panorama} of the valley below.
e.zh: 山顶呈现出下方山谷令人惊叹的全景。

e.en: His new phone takes incredible {panorama} shots in low light.
e.zh: 他的新手机在弱光下也能拍出极佳的全景照片。

e.en: The hiking trail offers breathtaking {panoramas} of the coastline.
e.zh: 这条徒步路线沿途有令人屏息的海岸全景。

e.en: His phone captures stunning {panoramas} with just one swipe.
e.zh: 他的手机只需轻轻一划就能拍出惊艳的全景照。

e.en: The rooftop bar has {panoramic} views of the city skyline.
e.zh: 这家屋顶酒吧可以俯瞰城市天际线的全景。

e.en: She took a {panoramic} photo from the top of the mountain.
e.zh: 她在山顶拍了一张全景照片。

pans.t:
n. pan 的复数（平底锅）
v. 严厉批评

e.en: She washed the {pans} after cooking dinner.
e.zh: 她做完晚饭后洗了那些平底锅。

e.en: The critic {pans} the new movie in his review.
e.zh: 评论家在他的评论中狠批了这部新电影。

e.en: She planted a purple {pansy} in the garden.
e.zh: 她在花园里种了一朵紫色的三色堇。

e.en: The {pansy} blooms early in spring.
e.zh: 三色堇在春天早早地绽放。

e.en: Dogs {pant} heavily on hot summer days.
e.zh: 狗在炎热的夏日里大口喘气。

e.en: I started to {pant} after running up the stairs.
e.zh: 跑上楼梯后我开始气喘吁吁。

e.en: The actor wore old-fashioned {pantaloons} for the period play.
e.zh: 演员为这部时代剧穿上了老式的灯笼裤。

e.en: Her costume included silk {pantaloons} and a velvet vest.
e.zh: 她的服装包括丝绸灯笼裤和天鹅绒马甲。

e.en: A huge {pantechnicon} pulled up to move our furniture.
e.zh: 一辆巨大的搬家车停下来搬运我们的家具。

e.en: The movers loaded the {pantechnicon} with boxes all morning.
e.zh: 搬运工整个上午都在往搬家车里装箱子。

e.en: His philosophy leans toward {pantheism} and reverence for nature.
e.zh: 他的哲学倾向于泛神论和对自然的崇敬。

e.en: Spinoza is often associated with {pantheism} in Western thought.
e.zh: 斯宾诺莎在西方思想中常与泛神论相联系。

e.en: As a {pantheist}, she sees divinity in every living thing.
e.zh: 作为一个泛神论者,她在每一个生命中都看到神性。

e.en: The poet was a committed {pantheist} all his life.
e.zh: 这位诗人一生都是坚定的泛神论者。

e.en: His poetry has a deeply {pantheistic} tone.
e.zh: 他的诗歌带有浓厚的泛神论色彩。

e.en: Many ancient cultures held {pantheistic} beliefs about nature.
e.zh: 许多古老文化对自然持有泛神论信仰。

e.en: Beethoven belongs in the {pantheon} of great composers.
e.zh: 贝多芬位列伟大作曲家的殿堂之中。

e.en: The Greek {pantheon} includes Zeus, Hera, and Apollo.
e.zh: 希腊众神殿包括宙斯、赫拉和阿波罗。

e.en: A black {panther} stalked silently through the jungle.
e.zh: 一只黑豹在丛林中悄无声息地潜行。

e.en: The {panther} is an endangered species in Florida.
e.zh: 豹在佛罗里达州是濒危物种。

e.en: She bought a pack of cotton {panties} online.
e.zh: 她在网上买了一包纯棉内裤。

e.en: The lace {panties} were on sale this week.
e.zh: 那些蕾丝内裤本周在打折。

e.en: The old cottage had a roof of red {pantile}.
e.zh: 那座古老的小屋有着红色波形瓦的屋顶。

e.en: Each {pantile} was carefully placed by hand.
e.zh: 每一片波形瓦都是用手工小心铺放的。

panting.t: v. 气喘吁吁（现在分词）

e.en: The dog was {panting} after chasing the ball.
e.zh: 那只狗追完球后气喘吁吁。

e.en: She arrived at the top of the hill {panting} heavily.
e.zh: 她到达山顶时已经喘得厉害。

panto.t: n. 童话剧（pantomime 的缩写）

e.en: We took the kids to a {panto} at Christmas.
e.zh: 圣诞节我们带孩子去看了一场童话剧。

e.en: British families love attending a {panto} during the holidays.
e.zh: 英国家庭喜欢在节日期间观看童话剧。

e.en: The actor performed an entire scene in {pantomime}.
e.zh: 演员用哑剧表演了整个场景。

e.en: Children love watching the Christmas {pantomime} every year.
e.zh: 孩子们每年都喜欢看圣诞童话剧。

e.en: She keeps spices and pasta in the {pantry}.
e.zh: 她把香料和意面放在食品储藏室里。

e.en: The {pantry} was stocked with canned goods.
e.zh: 储藏室里装满了罐头食品。

e.en: He bought a new pair of {pants} for the interview.
e.zh: 他为面试买了一条新裤子。

e.en: These {pants} are too tight around the waist.
e.zh: 这条裤子腰部太紧了。

e.en: She wore a navy {pantsuit} to the press conference.
e.zh: 她穿着一套深蓝色的裤装出席新闻发布会。

e.en: The tailored {pantsuit} looked sharp and professional.
e.zh: 那套定制裤装看起来干练又专业。

e.en: The store sells matching bra and {panty} sets.
e.zh: 这家店出售配套的胸罩和内裤套装。

e.en: She prefers a cotton {panty} for everyday wear.
e.zh: 她日常更喜欢穿棉质内裤。

e.en: She wore black {pantyhose} under her skirt.
e.zh: 她在裙子里面穿了黑色连裤袜。

e.en: A run in the {pantyhose} ruined her outfit.
e.zh: 连裤袜上的一道脱线毁了她的穿搭。

panzer.t: n. 德军装甲部队/坦克

e.en: German {panzer} divisions advanced rapidly through France.
e.zh: 德国装甲师迅速推进穿越法国。

e.en: The museum displays a restored {panzer} from World War II.
e.zh: 博物馆展出一辆修复过的二战装甲坦克。

e.en: We ordered steamed {pao} for dim sum brunch.
e.zh: 我们点了蒸包当作早茶。

e.en: The bakery's pork {pao} sells out by noon.
e.zh: 那家面包店的猪肉包到中午就卖光了。

pap.t: n. 软糊食物；无聊内容

e.en: Most reality TV is just mindless {pap}.
e.zh: 大多数真人秀不过是无聊的没营养内容。

e.en: The baby happily ate the warm {pap}.
e.zh: 宝宝开心地吃着温热的糊状食物。

e.en: My little sister calls our father {papa}.
e.zh: 我的小妹妹管我们的父亲叫爸爸。

e.en: {Papa} took us fishing every Sunday morning.
e.zh: 爸爸每个星期天早上带我们去钓鱼。

papacy.t: n. 教皇之位，教皇任期

e.en: His {papacy} was marked by major reforms.
e.zh: 他的教皇任期以重大改革著称。

e.en: The {papacy} has shaped European politics for centuries.
e.zh: 教皇制度影响欧洲政治已有数百年之久。

papal.t: adj. 教皇的，罗马天主教的

e.en: Thousands gathered to receive the {papal} blessing.
e.zh: 成千上万的人聚集起来接受教皇的祝福。

e.en: The {papal} visit drew massive crowds.
e.zh: 教皇的访问吸引了大批人群。

e.en: We spent the week on a {paradisiacal} beach in Bali.
e.zh: 我们在巴厘岛一处仙境般的海滩上度过了一周。

e.en: The painting depicts a {paradisiacal} garden filled with rare flowers.
e.zh: 这幅画描绘了一座仙境般的花园,里面满是珍稀花卉。

paradox.t: n. 悖论；自相矛盾的事

e.en: It's a {paradox} that the more we share online, the lonelier we feel.
e.zh: 我们在网上分享得越多,反而越感到孤独,这真是个悖论。

e.en: The famous time-travel {paradox} still puzzles physicists today.
e.zh: 著名的时间旅行悖论至今仍让物理学家困惑。

e.en: Quantum physics is full of strange {paradoxes} that defy intuition.
e.zh: 量子物理充满了违反直觉的奇怪悖论。

e.en: The book explores famous logical {paradoxes} in plain language.
e.zh: 这本书用通俗的语言探讨了著名的逻辑悖论。

paradoxical.t: adj. 自相矛盾的；悖论的

e.en: It seems {paradoxical}, but doing less can boost productivity.
e.zh: 听起来矛盾,但少做反而能提高效率。

e.en: Her {paradoxical} success comes from embracing failure openly.
e.zh: 她的成功看似矛盾,源于坦然接受失败。

paradoxically.t: adv. 自相矛盾地；看似矛盾地

e.en: {Paradoxically}, the harder he tried to relax, the more anxious he became.
e.zh: 矛盾的是,他越想放松,反而越焦虑。

e.en: {Paradoxically}, cutting prices sometimes lowers a brand's appeal.
e.zh: 矛盾的是,降价有时反而会降低品牌吸引力。

e.en: She lit a small {paraffin} lamp during the power outage.
e.zh: 停电时她点了一盏小煤油灯。

e.en: The candles are made from blended {paraffin} and beeswax.
e.zh: 这些蜡烛由石蜡和蜂蜡混合制成。

parafoil.t: n. 翼伞（充气翼型降落伞）

e.en: The skydiver steered her {parafoil} toward the landing target.
e.zh: 跳伞员操纵着她的翼伞朝着陆目标飞去。

e.en: Modern paragliders use a {parafoil} design for better control.
e.zh: 现代滑翔伞采用翼伞设计以获得更好的操控性。

e.en: We plan to {paraglide} off the cliffs this weekend.
e.zh: 我们打算这周末从悬崖上玩滑翔伞。

e.en: It's thrilling to {paraglide} above the alpine valleys.
e.zh: 乘滑翔伞飞越高山峡谷令人激动不已。

paraglider.t: n. 滑翔伞；滑翔伞运动员

e.en: A red {paraglider} drifted slowly across the mountain ridge.
e.zh: 一只红色滑翔伞缓缓飘过山脊。

e.en: She bought a beginner {paraglider} after taking lessons in Switzerland.
e.zh: 在瑞士上完课后,她买了一只新手滑翔伞。

e.en: He is regarded as a {paragon} of professional integrity.
e.zh: 他被视为职业操守的典范。

e.en: The novel's heroine is a {paragon} of quiet courage.
e.zh: 小说的女主人公是沉静勇气的典范。

paragraph.t:
n. 段落
v. 分段

e.en: Try to summarize each {paragraph} in one short sentence.
e.zh: 试着用一句话概括每个段落。

e.en: The opening {paragraph} hooks the reader from the first line.
e.zh: 开头那段从第一句话就抓住了读者。

e.en: Break long {paragraphs} into shorter ones for easier reading.
e.zh: 把长段落拆成短段落,方便阅读。

e.en: Her essay flows smoothly between {paragraphs} without abrupt jumps.
e.zh: 她的文章段落之间过渡自然,没有突兀的跳跃。

e.en: {Paraguay} is one of the few landlocked countries in South America.
e.zh: 巴拉圭是南美少数几个内陆国家之一。

e.en: Traditional harp music is hugely popular in {Paraguay}.
e.zh: 传统竖琴音乐在巴拉圭非常流行。

paraguayan.t:
adj. 巴拉圭的
n. 巴拉圭人

e.en: We had dinner at a small {Paraguayan} restaurant downtown.
e.zh: 我们在市中心一家小巴拉圭餐厅吃了晚饭。

e.en: The {Paraguayan} team scored an upset victory in the tournament.
e.zh: 巴拉圭队在比赛中爆冷取胜。

e.en: Her green {parakeet} learned to whistle the morning theme song.
e.zh: 她那只绿鹦鹉学会了吹早间主题曲。

e.en: A noisy {parakeet} sat on the windowsill demanding seeds.
e.zh: 一只吵闹的鹦鹉停在窗台上要瓜子吃。

paralegal.t:
n. 律师助理
adj. 律师助理的

e.en: She works as a {paralegal} while studying for the bar exam.
e.zh: 她在备考律师资格考试期间做律师助理。

e.en: Our firm hired another {paralegal} to handle document review.
e.zh: 我们事务所又雇了一名律师助理来处理文件审阅。

e.en: Astronomers measure star distances using {parallax} from Earth's orbit.
e.zh: 天文学家利用地球轨道上的视差来测量恒星距离。

e.en: The website uses a smooth {parallax} effect when you scroll.
e.zh: 这个网站在滚动时使用了流畅的视差效果。

parallel.t:
adj. 平行的；类似的
n. 相似之处

e.en: The two roads run {parallel} for several miles before diverging.
e.zh: 这两条路平行延伸几英里后才分开。

e.en: There's a clear {parallel} between these two historical events.
e.zh: 这两个历史事件之间有明显的相似之处。

e.en: Modern processors achieve speed through massive {parallelism}.
e.zh: 现代处理器通过大规模并行来提高速度。

e.en: The poem's beauty comes from its careful {parallelism} of phrases.
e.zh: 这首诗的美感来自其精心构造的排比句式。

e.en: A rectangle is a special kind of {parallelogram} with right angles.
e.zh: 长方形是一种带直角的特殊平行四边形。

e.en: Draw a {parallelogram} and label each of its vertices.
e.zh: 画一个平行四边形,并标出它的每个顶点。

parallels.t:
n. 相似之处
v. 与…相似

e.en: The author draws {parallels} between ancient Rome and modern empires.
e.zh: 作者在古罗马与现代帝国之间作了类比。

e.en: The hiking trail {parallels} the river for several kilometers.
e.zh: 这条徒步小径与河流平行延伸数公里。

e.en: She won her first {Paralympic} medal in the swimming relay.
e.zh: 她在游泳接力中赢得了自己的第一枚残奥会奖牌。

e.en: His goal is to qualify for the next {Paralympic} Games.
e.zh: 他的目标是获得下届残奥会的参赛资格。

paralympics.t: n. 残疾人奥林匹克运动会

e.en: The Tokyo {Paralympics} attracted millions of viewers worldwide.
e.zh: 东京残奥会吸引了全球数百万观众。

e.en: He has been training hard for the upcoming {Paralympics}.
e.zh: 他一直在为即将到来的残奥会刻苦训练。

paralyse.t: v. 使瘫痪；使瘫痪停滞（英式拼写）

e.en: Sudden fear can {paralyse} even the most experienced speakers.
e.zh: 突如其来的恐惧能让最有经验的演讲者也僵住。

e.en: A heavy snowstorm could {paralyse} the entire transport network.
e.zh: 一场大雪可能让整个交通网络陷入瘫痪。

paralysed.t: adj. 瘫痪的；无法动弹的

e.en: He was {paralysed} from the waist down after the accident.
e.zh: 事故后他腰部以下瘫痪了。

e.en: The strike {paralysed} the city's bus system for three days.
e.zh: 罢工让该市的公交系统瘫痪了三天。

paralyses.t:
v. 使瘫痪（第三人称单数）
n. 瘫痪（paralysis 复数）

e.en: Stage fright sometimes {paralyses} her right before a performance.
e.zh: 怯场有时会让她在演出前一刻僵在原地。

e.en: A single ransomware attack {paralyses} entire hospital networks overnight.
e.zh: 一次勒索软件攻击可在一夜之间瘫痪整个医院网络。

paralysing.t: adj. 令人瘫痪的；令人动弹不得的

e.en: The fear was {paralysing} her ability to make decisions.
e.zh: 恐惧让她无法做出任何决定。

e.en: A {paralysing} strike shut down public transport for days.
e.zh: 一场瘫痪性的罢工让公共交通停摆数日。

paralysingly.t: adv. 令人瘫痪地；令人动弹不得地

e.en: The exam was {paralysingly} difficult for most students.
e.zh: 这场考试对大多数学生来说难得让人手足无措。

e.en: He found public speaking {paralysingly} stressful at first.
e.zh: 他起初觉得公开演讲压力大得让人僵住。

e.en: The accident left him with {paralysis} in both legs.
e.zh: 那场事故让他双腿瘫痪。

e.en: Decision {paralysis} hits when there are too many options.
e.zh: 选项太多时就会陷入决策瘫痪。

paralytic.t:
adj. 瘫痪的
n. 瘫痪患者

e.en: The snake's venom has a {paralytic} effect on prey.
e.zh: 这种蛇的毒液对猎物有麻痹作用。

e.en: He suffered a {paralytic} stroke last winter.
e.zh: 他去年冬天中风导致瘫痪。

e.en: Heavy snow can {paralyze} the entire city overnight.
e.zh: 大雪可能在一夜之间让整座城市瘫痪。

e.en: Stage fright tends to {paralyze} new performers.
e.zh: 怯场常常让新演员僵在原地。

paralyzed.t: adj. 瘫痪的；动弹不得的

e.en: She was {paralyzed} from the waist down after the crash.
e.zh: 车祸后她腰部以下瘫痪。

e.en: The server outage {paralyzed} our entire workflow.
e.zh: 服务器宕机让我们整个工作流停摆。

paralyzes.t: v. 使瘫痪（第三人称单数）

e.en: Fear of failure {paralyzes} many talented young writers.
e.zh: 对失败的恐惧让许多有才华的年轻作家无法动笔。

e.en: A single bug sometimes {paralyzes} the whole production line.
e.zh: 一个小故障有时就能让整条生产线瘫痪。

paralyzing.t: adj. 令人瘫痪的；令人动弹不得的

e.en: He felt a {paralyzing} fear before the job interview.
e.zh: 面试前他感到一种让人僵住的恐惧。

e.en: The blizzard was {paralyzing} traffic across the Northeast.
e.zh: 暴风雪正让东北部的交通陷入瘫痪。

e.en: The deadline pressure was {paralyzingly} intense that week.
e.zh: 那周截止日期的压力大得让人动弹不得。

e.en: She found the silence {paralyzingly} awkward.
e.zh: 她觉得那阵沉默尴尬得让人僵住。

e.en: Oxygen is weakly {paramagnetic} at room temperature.
e.zh: 氧气在室温下表现出弱顺磁性。

e.en: The lab measured the {paramagnetic} response of the new alloy.
e.zh: 实验室测量了这种新合金的顺磁响应。

e.en: Students watched a {paramecium} swim under the microscope.
e.zh: 学生们在显微镜下观察草履虫游动。

e.en: A single {paramecium} can divide several times a day.
e.zh: 一只草履虫一天可以分裂好几次。

paramedic.t: n. 急救医士；护理人员

e.en: The {paramedic} arrived within minutes of the call.
e.zh: 急救员在报警几分钟内就赶到了。

e.en: She trained as a {paramedic} after college.
e.zh: 她大学毕业后接受了急救员培训。

e.en: He took a {paramedical} course before joining the hospital.
e.zh: 他进医院前修了辅助医疗课程。

e.en: The clinic hires both doctors and {paramedical} staff.
e.zh: 这家诊所同时聘用医生和辅助医疗人员。

paramedics.t: n. 急救医士（paramedic 的复数）

e.en: The {paramedics} stabilized the patient in the ambulance.
e.zh: 急救员们在救护车上稳定了病人的状况。

e.en: Two {paramedics} rushed up the stairs with a stretcher.
e.zh: 两名急救员抬着担架冲上楼梯。

e.en: You can pass a {parameter} to customize the function's behavior.
e.zh: 你可以传一个参数来定制这个函数的行为。

e.en: Cost is the most important {parameter} in our decision.
e.zh: 成本是我们决策中最重要的指标。

e.en: The API accepts three optional {parameters} in the query string.
e.zh: 这个 API 在查询字符串里接收三个可选参数。

e.en: We need to define the {parameters} of this project clearly.
e.zh: 我们需要明确界定这个项目的范围。

e.en: The designer used a {parametric} model to generate the facade.
e.zh: 设计师用参数化模型生成了这栋建筑的立面。

e.en: This test assumes the data follows a {parametric} distribution.
e.zh: 这个检验假设数据服从某种参数分布。

paramilitary.t:
adj. 准军事的
n. 准军事人员

e.en: A {paramilitary} group controlled the border region for years.
e.zh: 一支准军事组织多年来控制着边境地区。

e.en: The police wore {paramilitary} gear during the protest.
e.zh: 警察在抗议期间穿着准军事装备。

paramount.t: adj. 最重要的；至高无上的

e.en: User safety is of {paramount} importance in this design.
e.zh: 用户安全在这个设计中至关重要。

e.en: Privacy is {paramount} when handling medical records.
e.zh: 处理医疗记录时,隐私是头等重要的。

e.en: The novel reveals the queen's secret {paramour}.
e.zh: 小说揭露了王后秘密的情人。

e.en: Letters from her {paramour} were hidden in the drawer.
e.zh: 情人写来的信被藏在抽屉里。

paranoia.t: n. 偏执；多疑；被害妄想

e.en: Social media has fueled a wave of public {paranoia}.
e.zh: 社交媒体助长了一波公众的多疑情绪。

e.en: His {paranoia} got worse after he stopped sleeping properly.
e.zh: 他不再正常睡眠后,疑神疑鬼变得更严重。

paranoiac.t:
n. 偏执狂患者
adj. 偏执的

e.en: The novel's narrator is a {paranoiac} who trusts nobody.
e.zh: 小说的叙述者是一个谁都不信任的偏执狂。

e.en: He gave a {paranoiac} interpretation of every harmless email.
e.zh: 他用偏执的方式解读每一封无害的邮件。

e.en: Don't be {paranoid} — nobody is actually watching you.
e.zh: 别多疑了,没人真的在盯着你。

e.en: The startup is {paranoid} about leaks before the launch.
e.zh: 这家创业公司在发布前对泄密极度警惕。

paranormal.t: adj. 超自然的；无法用科学解释的

e.en: She watches every show about {paranormal} activity.
e.zh: 她每一部关于灵异现象的节目都看。

e.en: Scientists found no evidence of {paranormal} events at the site.
e.zh: 科学家在那里没有发现任何超自然现象的证据。

parapet.t: n. (屋顶、桥的) 矮护墙；胸墙

e.en: He leaned on the stone {parapet} and watched the river.
e.zh: 他靠在石头矮墙上看着河水。

e.en: Snipers crouched behind the {parapet} of the rooftop.
e.zh: 狙击手蹲在屋顶的护墙后面。

e.en: The scan revealed a tumor in the {parapharyngeal} space.
e.zh: 扫描显示咽旁间隙有一个肿瘤。

e.en: Surgeons rarely operate on {parapharyngeal} masses without imaging.
e.zh: 外科医生很少在没有影像的情况下处理咽旁肿块。

paraphernalia.t: n. 各种装备、随身用品

e.en: His desk was buried under coffee {paraphernalia}.
e.zh: 他的桌子被各种咖啡器具堆满了。

e.en: Police seized drug {paraphernalia} during the raid.
e.zh: 警方在突击中查获了毒品器具。

paraphilia.t: n. 性欲倒错；异常性癖

e.en: The textbook lists several recognized forms of {paraphilia}.
e.zh: 教科书列出了几种公认的性偏好异常。

e.en: Therapists distinguish harmless {paraphilia} from disorders.
e.zh: 治疗师会把无害的性偏好和障碍区分开。

paraphrase.t:
v. 用自己的话转述
n. 释义；意译

e.en: Try to {paraphrase} the article instead of copying it.
e.zh: 试着用自己的话改写这篇文章,而不是抄写。

e.en: To {paraphrase} the author, technology shapes our habits.
e.zh: 用作者的话来改述,科技塑造了我们的习惯。

paraphrased.t: v. paraphrase 的过去式；意译过的

e.en: She {paraphrased} the long email into a single sentence.
e.zh: 她把那封长邮件改写成了一句话。

e.en: The reporter {paraphrased} his answer rather than quoting directly.
e.zh: 记者改写了他的回答,而不是直接引用。

e.en: The diving accident caused permanent {paraplegia}.
e.zh: 那次跳水事故造成了永久性下肢瘫痪。

e.en: Modern wheelchairs give people with {paraplegia} more independence.
e.zh: 现代轮椅让下肢瘫痪者更加独立。

paraplegic.t:
n. 截瘫患者
adj. 截瘫的

e.en: He became {paraplegic} after a motorcycle accident.
e.zh: 一次摩托车事故后他下肢瘫痪。

e.en: The athlete competed in the {paraplegic} division.
e.zh: 这位运动员参加了下肢瘫痪组的比赛。

paraprofessional.t: n. 辅助专业人员（如教师助理）

e.en: A {paraprofessional} supports the teacher in our classroom.
e.zh: 我们班有一位辅助教师协助主教。

e.en: The clinic employs several {paraprofessional} counselors.
e.zh: 这家诊所雇了几位辅助专业咨询人员。

parapsychological.t: adj. 超心理学的；灵异研究的

e.en: Few universities still fund {parapsychological} research today.
e.zh: 如今很少有大学还在资助超心理学研究。

e.en: He attended a {parapsychological} conference out of curiosity.
e.zh: 他出于好奇参加了一场超心理学会议。

parapsychologist.t: n. 研究灵异现象的学者

e.en: A {parapsychologist} interviewed witnesses about the haunting.
e.zh: 一位超心理学家就那次闹鬼事件采访了目击者。

e.en: The {parapsychologist} insisted his methods were scientific.
e.zh: 那位超心理学家坚称自己的方法是科学的。

parapsychology.t: n. 超心理学；灵异研究

e.en: She wrote her thesis on the history of {parapsychology}.
e.zh: 她的论文写的是超心理学的发展史。

e.en: Most scientists treat {parapsychology} as pseudoscience.
e.zh: 大多数科学家把超心理学当作伪科学。

parasail.t:
n. 拖曳伞
v. 玩拖曳伞运动

e.en: Tourists love to {parasail} above the bay at sunset.
e.zh: 游客们喜欢在日落时分在海湾上空玩拖伞。

e.en: A bright orange {parasail} drifted over the beach.
e.zh: 一只鲜橙色的拖伞在沙滩上空飘过。

parasite.t: n. 寄生虫；寄生者；揩油的人

e.en: The dog had a {parasite} living in its intestines.
e.zh: 那条狗的肠子里寄生着一种寄生虫。

e.en: He called his freeloading roommate a total {parasite}.
e.zh: 他把那个白吃白住的室友骂作十足的寄生虫。

parasites.t: n. parasite 的复数；寄生虫

e.en: Stray cats often carry intestinal {parasites}.
e.zh: 流浪猫常常带有肠道寄生虫。

e.en: Some {parasites} can survive for years inside a host.
e.zh: 有些寄生虫可以在宿主体内存活多年。

parasitic.t: adj. 寄生的；依赖他人的

e.en: Mistletoe is a {parasitic} plant that taps into trees.
e.zh: 槲寄生是一种寄生在树上的植物。

e.en: He criticized the {parasitic} business model of the platform.
e.zh: 他批评这个平台寄生式的商业模式。

e.en: The fungus has a {parasitical} relationship with its host.
e.zh: 这种真菌与宿主形成寄生关系。

e.en: She described the company as {parasitical} on local farmers.
e.zh: 她形容这家公司寄生在当地农民身上。

parasitism.t: n. 寄生现象；寄生关系

e.en: Biology class covered different forms of {parasitism}.
e.zh: 生物课讲了不同形式的寄生现象。

e.en: Brood {parasitism} lets cuckoos avoid raising their own chicks.
e.zh: 巢寄生让杜鹃不必自己抚养雏鸟。

e.en: Certain wasps {parasitize} caterpillars by laying eggs inside them.
e.zh: 某些黄蜂在毛毛虫体内产卵以寄生其中。

e.en: Cuckoos {parasitize} the nests of smaller songbirds.
e.zh: 杜鹃寄生在较小鸣禽的巢里。

parasitoid.t: n. 拟寄生生物（最终杀死宿主）

e.en: A {parasitoid} wasp eventually kills the host it grew inside.
e.zh: 拟寄生黄蜂最终会杀死它所寄居的宿主。

e.en: Farmers release {parasitoid} insects to control crop pests.
e.zh: 农民会释放拟寄生昆虫来控制农作物害虫。

e.en: He specializes in {parasitology} and tropical diseases.
e.zh: 他专攻寄生虫学和热带疾病。

e.en: The textbook is a classic introduction to medical {parasitology}.
e.zh: 这本教材是医学寄生虫学的经典入门读物。

e.en: She opened a lacy {parasol} to block the afternoon sun.
e.zh: 她撑开一把蕾丝阳伞挡住午后的阳光。

e.en: Each beach table came with a striped {parasol}.
e.zh: 每张沙滩桌都配有一把条纹遮阳伞。

e.en: The therapist massaged the tight {paraspinal} muscles.
e.zh: 治疗师按摩了紧绷的脊柱旁肌肉。

e.en: An MRI showed inflammation in the {paraspinal} region.
e.zh: 核磁显示脊柱旁区域有炎症。

parastatal.t:
adj. 半官方的
n. 国有企业

e.en: The country's largest airline is a {parastatal} company.
e.zh: 该国最大的航空公司是一家半官方企业。

e.en: Reforms forced many {parastatal} firms to compete commercially.
e.zh: 改革迫使许多半国营企业进入商业竞争。

e.en: Slow breathing activates the {parasympathetic} nervous system.
e.zh: 缓慢呼吸会激活副交感神经系统。

e.en: The drug blocks {parasympathetic} signals to the heart.
e.zh: 这种药物会阻断传向心脏的副交感信号。

e.en: Hemingway is famous for his clipped, {paratactic} style.
e.zh: 海明威以其简短并列的句式风格闻名。

e.en: Children often speak in {paratactic} sentences without conjunctions.
e.zh: 小孩说话常常是没有连词的并列短句。

e.en: She ordered a butter {paratha} with her morning chai.
e.zh: 她早上点了一份黄油薄饼配奶茶。

e.en: The chef stuffed the {paratha} with spiced potatoes.
e.zh: 厨师在薄饼里塞满了香辣土豆。

parathion.t: n. 对硫磷（一种杀虫剂）

e.en: Farmers stopped using {parathion} due to its toxicity.
e.zh: 由于剧毒,农民已停止使用对硫磷。

e.en: The lab tested soil samples for {parathion} residues.
e.zh: 实验室检测土壤样品中的对硫磷残留。

parathyroid.t:
n. 甲状旁腺
adj. 甲状旁腺的

e.en: The surgeon removed a tumor from her {parathyroid} gland.
e.zh: 外科医生切除了她甲状旁腺上的肿瘤。

e.en: Low calcium often signals a {parathyroid} problem.
e.zh: 低钙通常预示着甲状旁腺出了问题。

e.en: The {paratroop} unit trained at high altitude all summer.
e.zh: 伞兵部队整个夏天都在高海拔地区训练。

e.en: He joined a {paratroop} regiment right after graduation.
e.zh: 他毕业后立即加入了一个伞兵团。

e.en: The {paratrooper} landed safely in the open field.
e.zh: 那名伞兵安全降落在开阔的田野上。

e.en: Her grandfather served as a {paratrooper} during the war.
e.zh: 她祖父在战争期间是一名伞兵。

paratroopers.t: n. paratrooper 的复数；伞兵部队

e.en: Hundreds of {paratroopers} dropped behind enemy lines at dawn.
e.zh: 数百名伞兵在黎明时分空降到敌后。

e.en: The {paratroopers} packed their chutes before the exercise.
e.zh: 伞兵们在演习前打包好了降落伞。

paratuberculosis.t: n. 副结核病（动物疾病）

e.en: The herd was tested for {paratuberculosis} last spring.
e.zh: 去年春天牛群接受了副结核病检测。

e.en: {Paratuberculosis} can spread quickly through dairy cattle.
e.zh: 副结核病可在奶牛群中迅速传播。

e.en: {Parboil} the potatoes before roasting them in the oven.
e.zh: 先把土豆焯一下,再放进烤箱烤。

e.en: You should {parboil} the rice for five minutes.
e.zh: 你应该把米先煮上五分钟。

e.en: We picnicked at the famous {parc} near the city center.
e.zh: 我们在市中心附近著名的公园里野餐。

e.en: The hotel overlooks a beautiful {parc} full of fountains.
e.zh: 酒店俯瞰着一座满是喷泉的美丽公园。

parcel.t:
n. 包裹；一块地
v. 打包；分配

e.en: A {parcel} arrived for you while you were out.
e.zh: 你出去时来了一个包裹给你。

e.en: They bought a small {parcel} of land near the lake.
e.zh: 他们在湖边买了一小块土地。

e.en: The courier delivers {parcels} every weekday morning.
e.zh: 快递员每个工作日早晨送包裹。
