e.en: A {peahen} quietly followed the colorful male across the lawn.
e.zh: 一只雌孔雀悄悄地跟着色彩斑斓的雄孔雀穿过草坪。

e.en: The zookeeper said the {peahen} had just laid three eggs.
e.zh: 饲养员说那只雌孔雀刚下了三个蛋。

peak.t:
n. 山峰；峰值
v. 达到顶峰

e.en: Traffic usually hits its {peak} around six in the evening.
e.zh: 交通通常在傍晚六点左右达到高峰。

e.en: We reached the {peak} of the mountain just before sunset.
e.zh: 我们在日落前抵达了山顶。

peaked.t:
adj. 尖顶的；憔悴的
v. 达到顶点

e.en: App downloads {peaked} the week the trailer dropped.
e.zh: 应用下载量在预告片发布那周达到了顶峰。

e.en: You look a bit {peaked}—did you sleep at all last night?
e.zh: 你看起来有点憔悴,昨晚有睡觉吗?

e.en: Snow-capped {peaks} surrounded the small alpine village.
e.zh: 白雪皑皑的山峰环绕着这个阿尔卑斯小村庄。

e.en: Server load {peaks} every Friday night during the live stream.
e.zh: 服务器负载每周五晚直播期间都会达到峰值。

peaky.t: adj. 面色苍白的；虚弱的

e.en: She's been looking a bit {peaky} since she caught that cold.
e.zh: 她自从感冒以来看起来有些病恹恹的。

e.en: He wore a {peaky} cap pulled low over his eyes.
e.zh: 他戴着一顶鸭舌帽,压得很低盖住了眼睛。

peal.t:
n. 钟声；轰响
v. 鸣响

e.en: A loud {peal} of thunder shook the windows.
e.zh: 一声响亮的雷鸣震动了窗户。

e.en: The children burst into a {peal} of laughter.
e.zh: 孩子们突然爆发出一阵笑声。

e.en: He's allergic to anything containing {peanut} oil.
e.zh: 他对任何含有花生油的食物都过敏。

e.en: She paid a {peanut} salary for such demanding work.
e.zh: 这么辛苦的工作她只付了一点点工资。

e.en: They were paying him {peanuts} for sixty-hour weeks.
e.zh: 他每周工作六十小时,他们却只付他一点点钱。

e.en: I grabbed a handful of salted {peanuts} from the bowl.
e.zh: 我从碗里抓了一把盐焗花生。

e.en: The twins were curled up like two beans in a {peapod}.
e.zh: 双胞胎蜷缩在一起,就像豆荚里的两颗豆子。

e.en: She tossed a fresh {peapod} into the stir-fry.
e.zh: 她把一根新鲜豌豆荚扔进了炒锅里。

e.en: I sliced a ripe {pear} onto my morning oatmeal.
e.zh: 我把一个熟梨切片放在早餐燕麦粥上。

e.en: The deal went {pear}-shaped after the lawyers got involved.
e.zh: 律师介入后,这笔交易就彻底搞砸了。

e.en: She wore a single {pearl} on a thin silver chain.
e.zh: 她在细银链上戴着一颗珍珠。

e.en: His grandfather dropped another {pearl} of wisdom at dinner.
e.zh: 他爷爷在晚餐时又分享了一句金玉良言。

pearlescent.t: adj. 珠光的；有珍珠光泽的

e.en: The phone case had a soft {pearlescent} finish.
e.zh: 这款手机壳有一种柔和的珠光质感。

e.en: She painted her nails a {pearlescent} pink.
e.zh: 她把指甲涂成了珠光粉色。

e.en: My grandmother left me her favorite string of {pearls}.
e.zh: 我奶奶把她最爱的那串珍珠项链留给了我。

e.en: Don't waste your {pearls} of advice on someone who won't listen.
e.zh: 不要把你宝贵的建议浪费在不愿听的人身上。

pearly.t: adj. 珍珠似的；洁白光亮的

e.en: He flashed a {pearly} white smile at the camera.
e.zh: 他对着镜头露出了洁白如珠的笑容。

e.en: The morning sky had a soft {pearly} glow.
e.zh: 清晨的天空泛着柔和的珍珠般光泽。

e.en: The orchard's {pears} ripen in late September.
e.zh: 果园里的梨在九月底成熟。

e.en: I poached the {pears} in red wine and cinnamon.
e.zh: 我用红酒和肉桂炖煮了这些梨。

e.en: The textbook is published by {Pearson} Education.
e.zh: 这本教科书由培生教育出版。

e.en: We computed the {Pearson} correlation between the two variables.
e.zh: 我们计算了这两个变量之间的皮尔逊相关系数。

e.en: Frozen {peas} make a great ice pack for swollen ankles.
e.zh: 冷冻豌豆给肿脚踝当冰袋特别好用。

e.en: The twins are like two {peas} in a pod.
e.zh: 这对双胞胎就像一个模子里刻出来的。

e.en: The novel follows a young {peasant} who escapes to the city.
e.zh: 小说讲述了一个年轻农民逃到城里的故事。

e.en: Stop being such a {peasant}—use a fork, not your hands.
e.zh: 别这么没教养,用叉子,别用手。

e.en: The reforms aimed to improve life for the rural {peasantry}.
e.zh: 这些改革旨在改善农村农民阶层的生活。

e.en: Heavy taxes pushed the {peasantry} to the edge of revolt.
e.zh: 沉重的赋税把农民阶级推到了起义的边缘。

e.en: Medieval {peasants} worked the lord's land six days a week.
e.zh: 中世纪农民每周要为领主耕作六天。

e.en: The {peasants} gathered in the square to demand fair wages.
e.zh: 农民们聚集在广场上要求公平的工资。

e.en: Grandma still makes traditional {pease} pudding for Sunday dinner.
e.zh: 奶奶仍然做传统的豌豆布丁作为周日晚餐。

e.en: The old rhyme begins, "{Pease} porridge hot, pease porridge cold."
e.zh: 那首古老的童谣开头是"豌豆粥热,豌豆粥冷"。

e.en: The whisky has a strong, smoky {peat} flavor.
e.zh: 这款威士忌有浓郁的烟熏泥煤味。

e.en: They burned blocks of dried {peat} to heat the cottage.
e.zh: 他们烧干泥煤块来给小屋取暖。

peaty.t: adj. 含泥炭的；泥炭味的

e.en: Islay scotches are famous for their {peaty} aroma.
e.zh: 艾雷岛的苏格兰威士忌以其泥煤香气闻名。

e.en: The bog had a rich, {peaty} smell after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后,沼泽散发着浓郁的泥煤气味。

peavey.t: n. 搬运原木用的钩杆

e.en: The logger used a {peavey} to roll the heavy log downhill.
e.zh: 伐木工用搬钩把那根沉重的木头滚下山。

e.en: He plugged his guitar into an old {Peavey} amplifier.
e.zh: 他把吉他插进了一台老款Peavey音箱。

e.en: She skipped a flat {pebble} across the calm lake.
e.zh: 她让一块扁平的小石子在平静的湖面上打水漂。

e.en: A single {pebble} in my shoe ruined the whole hike.
e.zh: 鞋里的一颗小石子毁了我整次徒步。

pebbled.t: adj. 满是卵石的；有颗粒纹的

e.en: The path was {pebbled} with smooth white stones.
e.zh: 小路上铺满了光滑的白色卵石。

e.en: The leather wallet had a soft, {pebbled} texture.
e.zh: 这款皮革钱包有柔软的荔枝纹质感。

e.en: The kids collected colorful {pebbles} along the riverbank.
e.zh: 孩子们沿着河岸捡了许多彩色的小石子。

e.en: Tiny {pebbles} crunched under our hiking boots.
e.zh: 小石子在我们的登山靴下嘎吱作响。

e.en: We laid our towels on the {pebbly} beach.
e.zh: 我们把毛巾铺在布满小石子的沙滩上。

e.en: The road turned narrow and {pebbly} after the bridge.
e.zh: 过了桥之后,道路变得狭窄又布满碎石。

e.en: He pulled a {pec} muscle during yesterday's bench press.
e.zh: 他在昨天卧推时拉伤了胸肌。

e.en: The trainer recommended adding flyes to develop his {pec} strength.
e.zh: 教练建议加入飞鸟训练以增强他的胸肌力量。

e.en: My aunt always brings her famous {pecan} pie to Thanksgiving.
e.zh: 我阿姨每次感恩节都会带来她拿手的山核桃派。

e.en: He sprinkled chopped {pecan} pieces over the salad.
e.zh: 他把切碎的山核桃撒在沙拉上。

e.en: Voters seemed willing to forgive the senator's minor {peccadillo}.
e.zh: 选民似乎愿意原谅这位参议员的小过失。

e.en: Forgetting an anniversary is no mere {peccadillo} in this house.
e.zh: 在这个家里,忘记纪念日可不是什么小错。

e.en: A wild {peccary} crossed the trail just ahead of us.
e.zh: 一只野生西貒就在我们前方穿过了小径。

e.en: The {peccary} resembles a pig but belongs to a different family.
e.zh: 西貒长得像猪,但属于不同的科。

peck.t:
v. 啄食；轻吻
n. 啄

e.en: She gave him a quick {peck} on the cheek before leaving.
e.zh: 她离开前在他脸颊上快速亲了一下。

e.en: The chickens {peck} at the seeds scattered on the ground.
e.zh: 鸡儿们啄食撒在地上的种子。

e.en: Keep your {pecker} up—things will get better soon.
e.zh: 打起精神来,事情很快会好转的。

e.en: A bright red {pecker} drummed against the old oak tree.
e.zh: 一只鲜红色的啄木鸟在老橡树上敲打着。

peckerwood.t: n. 对白人的贬称；啄木鸟

e.en: In some Southern dialects, {peckerwood} just means a woodpecker.
e.zh: 在一些南方方言中,peckerwood 只是指啄木鸟。

e.en: The old man muttered about some {peckerwood} cutting through his yard.
e.zh: 老人嘀咕着有个乡巴佬抄近路穿过他的院子。

e.en: She rented a small flat in {Peckham} last summer.
e.zh: 她去年夏天在佩卡姆租了一间小公寓。

e.en: The classic sitcom is set in a fictional {Peckham} tower block.
e.zh: 这部经典情景喜剧设定在一栋虚构的佩卡姆塔楼里。

e.en: In any office, the {pecking} order becomes obvious within weeks.
e.zh: 在任何办公室里,等级秩序几周内就会变得显而易见。

e.en: The pigeons were {pecking} at crumbs near the bench.
e.zh: 鸽子们正在长椅旁啄食面包屑。

e.en: I'm feeling a bit {peckish}—shall we grab a snack?
e.zh: 我有点饿了,我们去拿点零食吃吧?

e.en: After the long meeting, everyone was {peckish} and irritable.
e.zh: 开完长会后,大家都饿得有点烦躁。

pecorino.t: n. 佩克里诺羊奶奶酪

e.en: Grate fresh {pecorino} over the pasta just before serving.
e.zh: 上桌前在意面上现磨一些佩科里诺奶酪。

e.en: The salad was topped with shavings of aged {pecorino}.
e.zh: 沙拉上撒着陈年佩科里诺奶酪的薄片。

e.en: Apples contain enough natural {pectin} to thicken the jam.
e.zh: 苹果含有足够的天然果胶,可以让果酱变稠。

e.en: She added a packet of {pectin} to help the jelly set.
e.zh: 她加了一包果胶以帮助果冻凝固。

pectoral.t:
adj. 胸部的；胸肌的
n. 胸肌

e.en: Push-ups are great for building {pectoral} strength.
e.zh: 俯卧撑非常有助于增强胸肌力量。

e.en: The fish flicked its {pectoral} fins and darted away.
e.zh: 那条鱼摆动胸鳍迅速游开了。

e.en: The bench press primarily targets the {pectoralis} major.
e.zh: 卧推主要锻炼的是胸大肌。

e.en: He strained his {pectoralis} during a heavy lifting session.
e.zh: 他在大重量训练时拉伤了胸大肌。

e.en: The treasurer was caught trying to {peculate} from the charity fund.
e.zh: 那位财务主管被抓到试图侵吞慈善基金。

e.en: Officials who {peculate} public money face severe prison sentences.
e.zh: 侵吞公款的官员将面临严厉的监禁判决。

e.en: There's a {peculiar} smell coming from the fridge.
e.zh: 冰箱里散发出一种奇怪的味道。

e.en: This bird is {peculiar} to the islands of New Zealand.
e.zh: 这种鸟是新西兰群岛特有的。

e.en: Every old house has its own charming {peculiarity}.
e.zh: 每栋老房子都有它独特的可爱之处。

e.en: One {peculiarity} of the language is its lack of articles.
e.zh: 这门语言的一个特点是没有冠词。

e.en: He behaved {peculiarly} after the second cup of coffee.
e.zh: 他喝了第二杯咖啡之后行为变得很奇怪。

e.en: This humor is {peculiarly} British and hard to translate.
e.zh: 这种幽默是英国独有的,很难翻译。

e.en: He had no {pecuniary} interest in the company's decisions.
e.zh: 他对公司的决策没有任何金钱上的利害关系。

e.en: The judge imposed a heavy {pecuniary} penalty for the violation.
e.zh: 法官对该违规行为处以高额罚款。

e.en: The new curriculum reflects modern {pedagogic} principles.
e.zh: 新课程体现了现代教学原则。

e.en: Her {pedagogic} skills made even calculus feel approachable.
e.zh: 她的教学技巧让微积分都变得平易近人。

e.en: The textbook takes a clear {pedagogical} approach for beginners.
e.zh: 这本教科书针对初学者采用了清晰的教学方法。

e.en: Teachers debated the {pedagogical} value of standardized testing.
e.zh: 老师们讨论了标准化考试的教学价值。

e.en: The lesson is {pedagogically} sound but a bit dull.
e.zh: 这堂课在教学上很扎实,但有些枯燥。

e.en: Group projects can be {pedagogically} effective when well designed.
e.zh: 小组项目设计得当时在教学上非常有效。

e.en: The old {pedagogue} corrected every grammar mistake in class.
e.zh: 那位老派教师纠正课堂上每一个语法错误。

e.en: He came across as a stiff {pedagogue} rather than a mentor.
e.zh: 他给人感觉更像一个古板的教书匠，而不是导师。

e.en: Modern {pedagogy} emphasizes active learning over rote memorization.
e.zh: 现代教学法强调主动学习，而非死记硬背。

e.en: She studied early childhood {pedagogy} at university.
e.zh: 她在大学攻读幼儿教育学。

pedal.t:
n. 踏板
v. 踩踏板；骑车

e.en: Press the brake {pedal} firmly when approaching the light.
e.zh: 接近红绿灯时要用力踩刹车踏板。

e.en: I {pedal} to work every morning to stay fit.
e.zh: 我每天早上骑车上班来保持健康。

e.en: She kept {pedaling} hard up the steep hill.
e.zh: 她在陡坡上奋力地蹬着踏板。

e.en: He sat upright, lazily {pedaling} along the river path.
e.zh: 他坐得笔直，沿着河边小路懒洋洋地骑着车。

e.en: The new bike has clip-in {pedals} for serious riders.
e.zh: 这辆新车配有专业骑手用的锁扣式踏板。

e.en: She {pedals} faster whenever a song she loves comes on.
e.zh: 每当播到她喜欢的歌，她就蹬得更快。

e.en: Don't be such a {pedant} about every comma.
e.zh: 别在每个逗号上都那么咬文嚼字。

e.en: The reviewer is a notorious {pedant} who enjoys correcting strangers.
e.zh: 那位评论员是出了名的爱挑剔的人，喜欢纠正陌生人。

pedantic.t: adj. 迂腐的；卖弄学问的

e.en: His {pedantic} tone made even simple meetings feel exhausting.
e.zh: 他那卖弄学问的语气让简单的会议都变得令人疲惫。

e.en: She's brilliant but a bit {pedantic} about citations.
e.zh: 她很聪明，但在引用格式上有点过于较真。

e.en: The professor's {pedantry} alienated half the freshman class.
e.zh: 那位教授的咬文嚼字让一半新生都疏远了他。

e.en: Avoid {pedantry} and just explain the idea clearly.
e.zh: 别卖弄学问，把意思讲清楚就行。

e.en: They tried to {peddle} fake watches near the tourist spots.
e.zh: 他们试图在景点附近兜售假表。

e.en: Politicians often {peddle} simple answers to complicated problems.
e.zh: 政客们经常对复杂问题兜售简单的答案。

e.en: A street {peddler} was selling roasted chestnuts on the corner.
e.zh: 一个街头小贩在街角卖糖炒栗子。

e.en: He's nothing more than a {peddler} of conspiracy theories.
e.zh: 他不过是个兜售阴谋论的人罢了。

e.en: The website was caught {peddling} misleading health products.
e.zh: 该网站被发现在兜售误导性的保健产品。

e.en: Stop {peddling} that outdated rumor online.
e.zh: 别再在网上散布那个过时的谣言了。

e.en: The novel portrays the villain as a {pederast} and hypocrite.
e.zh: 小说将反派描绘成一个鸡奸者兼伪君子。

e.en: Ancient texts have been mistranslated to imply every mentor was a {pederast}.
e.zh: 古籍被误译，仿佛每位导师都是恋少年者。

e.en: The historian wrote about {pederasty} in ancient Greek society.
e.zh: 那位历史学家撰写了古希腊社会中恋少年现象的研究。

e.en: Modern law treats {pederasty} as a serious criminal offense.
e.zh: 现代法律将恋少年行为视为严重的刑事犯罪。

e.en: The marble statue stood on a tall granite {pedestal}.
e.zh: 大理石雕像立在一个高高的花岗岩基座上。

e.en: Don't put your boss on a {pedestal} just yet.
e.zh: 先别急着把你老板捧上神坛。

e.en: The museum displays bronze busts on matching wooden {pedestals}.
e.zh: 博物馆将青铜半身像陈列在配套的木质底座上。

e.en: Fans tend to put their idols on impossibly high {pedestals}.
e.zh: 粉丝总是把偶像捧到高不可攀的位置上。

pedestrian.t:
n. 行人
adj. 平淡无奇的

e.en: A {pedestrian} was hit by a delivery scooter downtown.
e.zh: 一名行人在市中心被外卖电动车撞到。

e.en: The film's plot was honestly pretty {pedestrian}.
e.zh: 这部电影的情节说实话挺平庸的。

e.en: The old market street was {pedestrianised} last summer.
e.zh: 那条古老的市场街去年夏天改成了步行街。

e.en: Shop owners say the {pedestrianised} zone has boosted weekend sales.
e.zh: 店主们说步行化的区域让周末销售大增。

e.en: Drivers must yield to {pedestrians} at marked crossings.
e.zh: 司机在斑马线处必须让行人先行。

e.en: Crowds of {pedestrians} filled the square after the parade.
e.zh: 游行结束后，广场上挤满了行人。

e.en: She works in the {pediatric} ward of a children's hospital.
e.zh: 她在一家儿童医院的儿科病房工作。

e.en: This medication has a special {pediatric} dosage.
e.zh: 这种药有专门的儿童剂量。

e.en: Our {pediatrician} recommended a humidifier for the baby's cough.
e.zh: 我们的儿科医生建议给宝宝用加湿器缓解咳嗽。

e.en: She trained as a {pediatrician} before opening her own clinic.
e.zh: 她在开自己的诊所前接受过儿科医生培训。

e.en: He chose {pediatrics} because he loves working with kids.
e.zh: 他选择儿科是因为喜欢和孩子打交道。

e.en: The hospital expanded its {pediatrics} department last year.
e.zh: 那家医院去年扩建了儿科部门。

e.en: We took a {pedicab} through the narrow old town lanes.
e.zh: 我们坐人力三轮车穿过老城的窄巷。

e.en: Tourists line up for a sunset {pedicab} ride along the harbor.
e.zh: 游客们排队在海港边乘三轮车看日落。

e.en: The surgeon carefully preserved the blood {pedicle} during the flap procedure.
e.zh: 医生在皮瓣手术中小心地保留了血管蒂。

e.en: A screw was placed through the vertebral {pedicle} to stabilize the spine.
e.zh: 医生在椎弓根处打入螺钉以固定脊柱。

e.en: She booked a manicure and {pedicure} before the wedding.
e.zh: 她在婚礼前预约了美甲和足部护理。

e.en: A relaxing {pedicure} is my favorite weekend treat.
e.zh: 做一次放松的足疗是我最爱的周末享受。

e.en: The salon offers gel {pedicures} that last several weeks.
e.zh: 这家沙龙提供能维持数周的凝胶足部护理。

e.en: My grandmother gets {pedicures} every other Friday.
e.zh: 我外婆每隔一个星期五都会去做足疗。

e.en: The puppy comes with full {pedigree} papers from the breeder.
e.zh: 这只小狗附有犬舍提供的完整血统证明。

e.en: She has an impressive academic {pedigree} in machine learning.
e.zh: 她在机器学习领域有着显赫的学术背景。

pedigreed.t: adj. 有血统证明的；纯种的

e.en: He bought a {pedigreed} Border Collie from a registered breeder.
e.zh: 他从注册犬舍买了一只纯种边境牧羊犬。

e.en: The auction featured {pedigreed} horses from across Europe.
e.zh: 拍卖会展出了来自欧洲各地的纯种马。

e.en: A carved {pediment} crowns the entrance of the old courthouse.
e.zh: 一座雕刻的山花装饰着旧法院的入口。

e.en: The temple's triangular {pediment} depicts a famous battle scene.
e.zh: 神庙的三角山墙描绘了一场著名战役。

e.en: The mansion has a grand {pedimented} portico facing the garden.
e.zh: 那座宅邸有一个朝向花园的宏伟带山花门廊。

e.en: Each window is topped with a small {pedimented} hood.
e.zh: 每扇窗户上方都有一个小巧的山花式门罩。

e.en: The spider's {pedipalp} is used to sense and handle prey.
e.zh: 蜘蛛的触肢用来感知和处理猎物。

e.en: Male scorpions use a swollen {pedipalp} during courtship.
e.zh: 雄蝎在求偶时会用到膨大的触肢。

e.en: A traveling {pedlar} sold ribbons door to door in the old village.
e.zh: 一个走街串巷的小贩在旧村庄挨家挨户卖丝带。

e.en: The novel opens with a {pedlar} crossing the moors at dusk.
e.zh: 小说开篇是一个小贩在黄昏时分穿过荒原。

e.en: My {pedometer} says I walked twelve thousand steps today.
e.zh: 我的计步器显示我今天走了一万两千步。

e.en: He clipped a small {pedometer} onto his belt before hiking.
e.zh: 他在徒步前把一个小计步器别在腰带上。

e.en: The court sentenced the convicted {pedophile} to twenty years.
e.zh: 法庭判处这名被定罪的恋童犯二十年监禁。

e.en: Online platforms work hard to detect and block {pedophile} activity.
e.zh: 网络平台努力检测并阻止恋童行为。

e.en: The documentary investigates institutional cover-ups of {pedophilia}.
e.zh: 这部纪录片调查了对恋童行为的机构性掩盖。

e.en: Psychologists classify {pedophilia} as a serious paraphilic disorder.
e.zh: 心理学家将恋童癖归为严重的性偏好障碍。

e.en: The toddler had to {pee} right before we left the house.
e.zh: 小家伙在我们出门前一刻非要尿尿。

e.en: Don't drink so much water or you'll need to {pee} during the movie.
e.zh: 别喝那么多水，不然看电影中途会想上厕所。

peebles.t: n. 皮布尔斯（苏格兰地名/姓氏）

e.en: We spent a quiet weekend in {Peebles} hiking along the Tweed.
e.zh: 我们在皮布尔斯小镇沿着特威德河徒步，度过了宁静的周末。

e.en: {Peebles} is a charming market town in the Scottish Borders.
e.zh: 皮布尔斯是苏格兰边境地区一座迷人的集镇。

peed.t: v. 撒尿（pee 的过去式）

e.en: The puppy {peed} on the rug during the thunderstorm.
e.zh: 小狗在打雷时在地毯上尿了。

e.en: I {peed} myself laughing at his impression of the boss.
e.zh: 他模仿老板的样子让我笑到尿出来。

peeing.t: v. 正在撒尿（pee 的现在分词）

e.en: The dog kept {peeing} on every lamppost we passed.
e.zh: 那只狗在我们经过的每根灯柱上都要尿一下。

e.en: The kids were {peeing} themselves laughing at the cartoon.
e.zh: 孩子们看那部动画片笑到快尿裤子了。

peek.t:
v. 偷看；窥视
n. 一瞥

e.en: Take a quick {peek} at the surprise before they arrive.
e.zh: 趁他们到之前偷瞄一眼这个惊喜。

e.en: She gave us an early {peek} at her new design.
e.zh: 她让我们提前一睹她的新设计。

peekaboo.t: n. 躲猫猫（哄小孩的游戏）

e.en: The baby giggled every time grandpa played {peekaboo}.
e.zh: 每次爷爷玩躲猫猫，宝宝都咯咯笑。

e.en: She wore a top with a small {peekaboo} cutout at the back.
e.zh: 她穿了一件后背有小小镂空设计的上衣。

peel.t:
v. 剥（皮）；削皮
n. 果皮

e.en: Please {peel} the potatoes before boiling them.
e.zh: 煮土豆前请先把皮削掉。

e.en: My sunburned shoulders started to {peel} after a few days.
e.zh: 我晒伤的肩膀几天后开始脱皮。

peeled.t:
adj. 去皮的
v. peel 的过去式

e.en: She {peeled} an orange and shared the slices with her sister.
e.zh: 她剥了一个橙子，把瓣分给妹妹。

e.en: Keep your eyes {peeled} for the exit sign.
e.zh: 睁大眼睛留意出口标志。

e.en: A sharp vegetable {peeler} makes prepping carrots so much faster.
e.zh: 一把锋利的削皮器能让削胡萝卜快得多。

e.en: Grandma still prefers a paring knife over any modern {peeler}.
e.zh: 奶奶还是更爱用小刀，而不是任何现代削皮器。

peeling.t:
v. 剥皮；脱落
n. 削下的皮

e.en: The paint is {peeling} off the back of the old shed.
e.zh: 旧棚屋后面的油漆正在剥落。

e.en: He sat by the sink {peeling} apples for the pie.
e.zh: 他坐在水槽边给派削苹果皮。

peels.t:
n. 果皮（复数）
v. peel 的三单

e.en: Save the orange {peels} for making homemade marmalade.
e.zh: 把橙子皮留着自制果酱用。

e.en: This sticker {peels} off cleanly without leaving residue.
e.zh: 这张贴纸能干净地撕下来，不留残胶。

peep.t:
v. 偷看；窥视
n. 一瞥；啾啾声

e.en: I didn't hear a {peep} from the kids all afternoon.
e.zh: 整个下午我都没听到孩子们出一点声音。

e.en: Take a quick {peep} through the curtains to see who's outside.
e.zh: 从窗帘缝隙快速看一眼外面是谁。

e.en: Someone reported a {peeper} lurking near the dorm windows.
e.zh: 有人举报一个偷窥者在宿舍窗外徘徊。

e.en: The first spring {peeper} we heard meant winter was finally over.
e.zh: 我们听到的第一声春雨蛙鸣意味着冬天终于过去了。

e.en: Always check the {peephole} before opening your front door.
e.zh: 开门之前一定要先看看猫眼。

e.en: She squinted through the {peephole} but saw only darkness.
e.zh: 她眯着眼睛透过猫眼看，却只看到一片漆黑。

e.en: A neighbor was caught {peeping} through the bathroom window.
e.zh: 一名邻居被发现从浴室窗户偷窥。

e.en: Snowdrops were already {peeping} through the frosty soil.
e.zh: 雪花莲已经从结霜的泥土里探出头来了。

peeps.t:
v. peep 的三单
n. （俚）人们

e.en: I'm grabbing dinner with my {peeps} from college tonight.
e.zh: 我今晚要和大学的小伙伴们一起吃晚饭。

e.en: She {peeps} into the oven every two minutes to check the cake.
e.zh: 她每两分钟就往烤箱里瞅一眼检查蛋糕。

e.en: The old fairground had a coin-operated {peepshow} in the corner.
e.zh: 老游乐场角落里有一台投币式西洋镜。

e.en: Tabloids treated the celebrity trial like a public {peepshow}.
e.zh: 小报把那场名人审判当成公开的窥秘表演。

peer.t:
v. 凝视；仔细看
n. 同辈；同行

e.en: I leaned in to {peer} at the tiny screen.
e.zh: 我凑近去仔细看那块小屏幕。

e.en: Teenagers care deeply about {peer} approval.
e.zh: 青少年非常在意同龄人的认可。

peerage.t: n. 贵族（阶层）；贵族名册

e.en: He was awarded a life {peerage} for his service.
e.zh: 他因贡献被授予终身贵族爵位。

e.en: The {peerage} once dominated British politics.
e.zh: 贵族阶层曾主导英国政治。

peerless.t: adj. 无与伦比的；卓越的

e.en: Her {peerless} singing voice silenced the entire hall.
e.zh: 她无与伦比的歌声让整个大厅静了下来。

e.en: The chef built a {peerless} reputation in Tokyo.
e.zh: 那位厨师在东京赢得了无人可比的声誉。

peers.t:
n. 同辈；同行（复数）
v. 凝视

e.en: She {peers} into the microscope, adjusting the focus.
e.zh: 她凝视着显微镜,慢慢调整焦距。

e.en: Most of his {peers} have already been promoted.
e.zh: 他的大多数同事都已经升职了。

e.en: The cat gave me a {peery} look from the windowsill.
e.zh: 那只猫从窗台上警觉地瞅着我。

e.en: Locals were {peery} of strangers asking too many questions.
e.zh: 当地人对问东问西的陌生人心存戒备。

e.en: The puppy {pees} on the rug whenever guests arrive.
e.zh: 每次有客人来,小狗就在地毯上撒尿。

e.en: He drinks so much coffee that he {pees} every hour.
e.zh: 他咖啡喝太多,每小时都要去尿一次。

peeve.t:
v. 使恼火
n. 不满的事

e.en: Loud chewing is my biggest {peeve} at the office.
e.zh: 大声咀嚼是我在办公室最讨厌的事。

e.en: Slow Wi-Fi tends to {peeve} even patient users.
e.zh: 网速慢连耐心的用户都会被惹恼。

e.en: She looked {peeved} when no one remembered her birthday.
e.zh: 没人记得她的生日,她看起来很不高兴。

e.en: He got {peeved} after waiting two hours for a reply.
e.zh: 等了两个小时才有回复,他有点恼火。

e.en: The toddler grew {peevish} after missing his nap.
e.zh: 小家伙没睡午觉,变得脾气暴躁。

e.en: Her {peevish} tone made the meeting tense.
e.zh: 她那不耐烦的语气让会议气氛紧张。

e.en: He {peevishly} pushed his plate aside without eating.
e.zh: 他没吃就闹脾气地把盘子推到一边。

e.en: She replied {peevishly} to every harmless question.
e.zh: 对每个无害的问题,她都没好气地回答。

e.en: A {peewit} called sharply across the marshland at dawn.
e.zh: 破晓时分,一只田凫在沼泽上空尖声鸣叫。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted a rare {peewit} near the reservoir.
e.zh: 观鸟者在水库附近发现了一只罕见的田凫。

peg.t:
n. 挂钉；木栓
v. 钉住；固定（价格）

e.en: Hang your coat on the {peg} by the door.
e.zh: 把外套挂在门边的挂钩上。

e.en: The country tried to {peg} its currency to the dollar.
e.zh: 该国试图将本国货币与美元挂钩。

pegasus.t: n. （希腊神话）飞马佩加索斯；飞马座

e.en: The myth of {pegasus}, the winged horse, fascinates children.
e.zh: 飞马珀伽索斯的神话深深吸引着孩子们。

e.en: A statue of {pegasus} stood at the museum entrance.
e.zh: 博物馆门口立着一尊飞马雕像。

e.en: He organized his tools neatly on the garage {pegboard}.
e.zh: 他把工具整齐地挂在车库的洞洞板上。

e.en: A {pegboard} above the desk holds her headphones and cables.
e.zh: 书桌上方的洞洞板挂着她的耳机和线缆。

pegged.t: v. 钉住；（汇率）挂钩（peg 的过去式）

e.en: Investors {pegged} the stock's value at twice its current price.
e.zh: 投资者将该股价值估为目前价格的两倍。

e.en: She {pegged} the wet laundry to the clothesline.
e.zh: 她把湿衣服一件件夹到晾衣绳上。

pegs.t:
n. 挂钉（复数）
v. peg 的三单

e.en: The tent {pegs} bent in the rocky soil.
e.zh: 帐篷钉在多石的土里弯了。

e.en: He hangs his keys on tiny wooden {pegs}.
e.zh: 他把钥匙挂在小小的木钉上。

e.en: She drifted into the kitchen wearing a silk {peignoir}.
e.zh: 她披着丝质晨袍飘进厨房。

e.en: The boutique sold a lace {peignoir} that cost a fortune.
e.zh: 那家精品店卖一件昂贵的蕾丝晨袍。

pejorative.t:
adj. 贬义的
n. 贬义词

e.en: "Geek" was once a {pejorative} term but has changed.
e.zh: “极客”一词曾带贬义,如今含义已变。

e.en: Avoid {pejorative} language when writing about minorities.
e.zh: 在写少数群体时避免使用贬义词。

e.en: Critics used the word "populist" {pejoratively} in the article.
e.zh: 评论员在文章里贬义地使用“民粹”一词。

e.en: He spoke {pejoratively} about his former employer online.
e.zh: 他在网上贬损地谈论自己的前雇主。

e.en: Her tiny {pekinese} barked at every passing bicycle.
e.zh: 她那只小京巴对着每辆路过的自行车狂吠。

e.en: The {pekinese} curled up on the velvet cushion.
e.zh: 那只京巴蜷缩在天鹅绒坐垫上。

e.en: Crispy {peking} duck is the restaurant's signature dish.
e.zh: 脆皮北京烤鸭是这家餐厅的招牌菜。

e.en: {peking} was the older English name for Beijing.
e.zh: Peking 是北京旧时的英文名称。

pelagian.t: adj. 远洋的；（宗教）伯拉纠派的

e.en: The bishop denounced {pelagian} ideas about original sin.
e.zh: 主教谴责了关于原罪的伯拉纠派观点。

e.en: Medieval theologians fiercely debated {pelagian} doctrine.
e.zh: 中世纪神学家激烈辩论伯拉纠派教义。

e.en: Tuna are {pelagic} fish that roam the open ocean.
e.zh: 金枪鱼是在大洋中游弋的远洋鱼类。

e.en: Researchers tracked {pelagic} seabirds across the Pacific.
e.zh: 研究人员追踪了横跨太平洋的远洋海鸟。

e.en: A pink {pelargonium} bloomed in the kitchen window.
e.zh: 厨房窗台上开着一株粉色的天竺葵。

e.en: She propagated {pelargonium} cuttings every spring.
e.zh: 她每年春天都扦插繁殖天竺葵。

pele.t: n. 贝利（巴西足球运动员）

e.en: The legendary striker {pele} won three World Cups.
e.zh: 传奇前锋贝利共赢得三届世界杯冠军。

e.en: Hawaiian myths describe {pele} as the volcano goddess.
e.zh: 夏威夷神话把佩蕾描述为火山女神。

pelf.t: n. 钱财；不义之财（贬义）

e.en: The poet despised politicians chasing nothing but {pelf}.
e.zh: 诗人鄙视那些只追逐钱财的政客。

e.en: He inherited considerable {pelf} from his uncle's estate.
e.zh: 他从叔叔的遗产中继承了大笔财富。

e.en: A {pelican} scooped up fish from the harbor surface.
e.zh: 一只鹈鹕从港口水面捞起小鱼。

e.en: Tourists photographed the {pelican} perched on the dock.
e.zh: 游客们拍下了停在码头上的那只鹈鹕。

pell-mell.t:
adv. 乱哄哄地
adj. 杂乱的

e.en: The kids ran {pell-mell} into the playground after class.
e.zh: 孩子们下课后乱哄哄地冲进操场。

e.en: Files were stacked {pell-mell} on the cluttered desk.
e.zh: 凌乱的桌上文件堆得乱七八糟。

pellagra.t: n. 糙皮病（烟酸缺乏症）

e.en: {pellagra} is caused by a serious niacin deficiency.
e.zh: 糙皮病是由严重缺乏烟酸引起的。

e.en: Doctors rarely see {pellagra} in developed countries today.
e.zh: 如今发达国家的医生很少见到糙皮病。

pellet.t:
n. 小球、小颗粒
n. 弹丸

e.en: The hamster nibbled a food {pellet} from her hand.
e.zh: 仓鼠从她手心啃着一颗饲料颗粒。

e.en: A rubber {pellet} bounced off the protester's helmet.
e.zh: 一颗橡胶弹从抗议者的头盔上弹开。

pellucid.t:
adj. 清澈透明的
adj. 简明易懂的

e.en: The lake's {pellucid} water revealed every pebble below.
e.zh: 湖水清澈见底,每一块卵石都清晰可见。

e.en: Her writing style is admired for its {pellucid} clarity.
e.zh: 她的文风以清澈明晰著称。

e.en: A velvet {pelmet} hides the curtain rail above the window.
e.zh: 窗户上方的窗帘盒由天鹅绒帷幔遮住。

e.en: The decorator suggested a wooden {pelmet} for the lounge.
e.zh: 装修师建议在客厅装一个木质窗帘饰板。

peloponnese.t: n. 伯罗奔尼撒（希腊半岛）

e.en: We spent a week driving around the {peloponnese} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们花了一周自驾游伯罗奔尼撒半岛。

e.en: Ancient ruins dot the coastline of the {peloponnese}.
e.zh: 伯罗奔尼撒半岛的海岸线上散布着古代遗迹。

e.en: Thucydides chronicled the {peloponnesian} War in great detail.
e.zh: 修昔底德详尽记录了伯罗奔尼撒战争。

e.en: Students studied {peloponnesian} history for the final exam.
e.zh: 学生们为期末考试研读伯罗奔尼撒的历史。

pelota.t: n. 回力球（西班牙球类运动）

e.en: Fans cheered as the {pelota} ricocheted off the wall.
e.zh: 球从墙上弹开时,球迷们欢呼起来。

e.en: He grew up playing {pelota} in a Basque village.
e.zh: 他在巴斯克的一个村庄长大,从小就玩回力球。

pelt.t:
v. 连续投掷；（雨）倾泻
n. 毛皮

e.en: Protesters began to {pelt} the building with eggs.
e.zh: 抗议者开始向那栋楼投掷鸡蛋。

e.en: The trapper sold the fox {pelt} at the market.
e.zh: 猎人在集市上卖掉了那张狐狸皮。

pelting.t: v. 猛砸、倾泻（pelt 的 -ing 形式）

e.en: Rain was {pelting} the windshield as we drove home.
e.zh: 我们开车回家时,大雨噼里啪啦地砸在挡风玻璃上。

e.en: Kids kept {pelting} each other with snowballs all afternoon.
e.zh: 孩子们整个下午都在互相投掷雪球。

e.en: Doctors recommend {pelvic} floor exercises after childbirth.
e.zh: 医生建议产后做盆底肌肉锻炼。

e.en: The scan revealed a small fracture in his {pelvic} bone.
e.zh: 扫描显示他的骨盆有一处小骨折。

e.en: She broke her {pelvis} in a cycling accident last year.
e.zh: 她去年骑车摔伤,造成骨盆骨折。

e.en: The {pelvis} supports the weight of the upper body.
e.zh: 骨盆承担着上半身的重量。

pembroke.t: n. 彭布罗克（英国地名）

e.en: They bought a charming cottage near {pembroke} last spring.
e.zh: 去年春天他们在彭布罗克附近买了一栋可爱的小屋。

e.en: A {pembroke} corgi trotted happily beside its owner.
e.zh: 一只彭布罗克柯基欢快地跟在主人身边小跑。

pembrokeshire.t: n. 彭布罗克郡（威尔士）

e.en: The {pembrokeshire} coast path attracts thousands of hikers yearly.
e.zh: 彭布罗克郡的海岸步道每年吸引成千上万的徒步者。

e.en: We camped on a quiet beach in {pembrokeshire}.
e.zh: 我们在彭布罗克郡一处安静的海滩露营。

pemmican.t: n. 干肉饼（北美原住民食物）

e.en: Explorers carried {pemmican} for its concentrated calories on long treks.
e.zh: 探险者长途跋涉时携带肉糜饼,因为热量浓缩。

e.en: She tried making {pemmican} with dried bison and berries.
e.zh: 她试着用风干野牛肉和浆果制作肉糜饼。

pen.t:
n. 笔、钢笔
v. 书写；圈养

e.en: Could I borrow your {pen} to sign this form?
e.zh: 能借你的笔签一下这张表吗?

e.en: The farmer led the lambs back into their {pen}.
e.zh: 农夫把小羊领回了围栏里。

penaeid.t:
n. 对虾科动物
adj. 对虾科的

e.en: {penaeid} shrimp dominate global aquaculture markets today.
e.zh: 对虾科虾类在当今全球水产养殖市场占主导地位。

e.en: Researchers study {penaeid} species to improve farming yields.
e.zh: 研究人员研究对虾科物种以提高养殖产量。

e.en: The country reformed its {penal} system after years of protests.
e.zh: 经过多年抗议,该国改革了刑罚制度。

e.en: He spent a decade in a remote {penal} colony.
e.zh: 他在一个偏远的流放营度过了十年。

penalise.t: v. 处罚、惩罚（英式拼写）

e.en: The new rules {penalise} drivers who text behind the wheel.
e.zh: 新规对开车发短信的驾驶员予以处罚。

e.en: Schools should not {penalise} students for asking questions.
e.zh: 学校不该因为学生提问而惩罚他们。

penalised.t: v. 处罚（penalise 的过去式）

e.en: The team was {penalised} for an illegal substitution.
e.zh: 球队因违规换人而受到处罚。

e.en: Customers are {penalised} with extra fees for late payments.
e.zh: 逾期付款的客户会被加收额外费用。

e.en: The contract {penalises} suppliers who miss the delivery deadline.
e.zh: 合同对未按期交货的供应商加以处罚。

e.en: The algorithm {penalises} accounts that post spammy links.
e.zh: 算法会对发垃圾链接的账号予以降权。

penalising.t: v. 处罚（penalise 的 -ing 形式）

e.en: The referee kept {penalising} the home team for handball.
e.zh: 裁判一再因手球判罚主队。

e.en: Critics accuse the tax of unfairly {penalising} small businesses.
e.zh: 批评者指责该税不公平地惩罚小企业。

e.en: Referees will {penalize} players for unsportsmanlike conduct.
e.zh: 裁判会对运动员的不当行为进行处罚。

e.en: The new tax rules {penalize} late filers heavily.
e.zh: 新税法对迟报者处以重罚。

penalized.t: v. 处罚（penalize 的过去式）

e.en: The team got {penalized} for stepping out of bounds.
e.zh: 该队因出界而被判罚。

e.en: Drivers are {penalized} for speeding in school zones.
e.zh: 司机在学校区域超速会受到处罚。

e.en: The algorithm {penalizes} accounts that post spam links.
e.zh: 该算法会惩罚发布垃圾链接的账户。

e.en: This contract {penalizes} early termination with a fee.
e.zh: 这份合同对提前解约处以罚金。

penalizing.t: v. 处罚（penalize 的 -ing 形式）

e.en: The judge is {penalizing} repeat offenders more harshly.
e.zh: 法官对累犯的处罚正在加重。

e.en: The model avoids overfitting by {penalizing} large weights.
e.zh: 该模型通过惩罚过大权重来避免过拟合。

penalties.t:
n. 处罚、罚款（penalty 复数）
n. 点球

e.en: Late payments incur steep {penalties} on this credit card.
e.zh: 这张信用卡逾期还款会有高额罚款。

e.en: Both teams missed their {penalties} in the shootout.
e.zh: 两队在点球大战中都罚丢了点球。

penalty.t:
n. 处罚、罚款
n. （足球）点球

e.en: Messi calmly converted the {penalty} in extra time.
e.zh: 梅西在加时赛中冷静地罚进了点球。

e.en: There is a hefty {penalty} for canceling this booking.
e.zh: 取消这个预订需支付高额违约金。

e.en: He volunteered at the shelter as {penance} for his mistakes.
e.zh: 他到收容所做义工以弥补自己的过错。

e.en: The priest assigned a simple {penance} after confession.
e.zh: 神父在告解后指派了一个简单的赎罪苦行。

e.en: The street food in {Penang} is famous across Asia.
e.zh: 槟城的街头美食在亚洲闻名遐迩。

e.en: We took the ferry from the mainland to {Penang}.
e.zh: 我们从大陆乘渡轮前往槟城。

penarth.t: n. 佩纳斯（威尔士小镇）

e.en: They walked along the pier in {Penarth} at sunset.
e.zh: 他们在日落时分沿着佩纳斯的码头散步。

e.en: {Penarth} is a quiet seaside town near Cardiff.
e.zh: 佩纳斯是卡迪夫附近一座宁静的海滨小镇。

e.en: The newspaper costs eighty {pence} at the corner shop.
e.zh: 这份报纸在街角小店卖八十便士。

e.en: He paid the parking meter with a few {pence}.
e.zh: 他用几枚便士付了停车费。

pences.t: n. 便士（非标准复数形式）

e.en: The till was filled with stray {pences} and pound coins.
e.zh: 收银机里装满了零散的便士和英镑硬币。

e.en: She tossed the leftover {pences} into a jar.
e.zh: 她把剩下的几个便士扔进了一个罐子里。

e.en: My brother has a {penchant} for vintage watches.
e.zh: 我哥哥对古董手表情有独钟。

e.en: She showed an early {penchant} for solving puzzles.
e.zh: 她从小就对解谜表现出偏爱。

pencil.t:
n. 铅笔
v. 用铅笔写

e.en: Please sign the form in {pencil} first.
e.zh: 请先用铅笔签署这份表格。

e.en: Can you {pencil} me in for Friday afternoon?
e.zh: 你能把我暂定排在周五下午吗?

penciled.t: v. 用铅笔写（美式过去式）

e.en: She {penciled} a quick sketch on the napkin.
e.zh: 她在餐巾纸上用铅笔画了一幅速写。

e.en: The dentist {penciled} him in for next Tuesday.
e.zh: 牙医把他暂定预约在下周二。

pencilled.t: v. 用铅笔写（英式过去式）

e.en: The architect {pencilled} revisions across the blueprint.
e.zh: 建筑师在蓝图上用铅笔做了修改。

e.en: I've {pencilled} the meeting in for ten o'clock.
e.zh: 我已暂时把会议定在十点。

e.en: Sharpen your {pencils} before the exam begins.
e.zh: 考试开始前请把铅笔削好。

e.en: She keeps colored {pencils} in a tin on her desk.
e.zh: 她把彩色铅笔放在桌上的铁盒里。

pendant.t:
n. 吊坠、挂件
n. 吊灯

e.en: She wore a silver {pendant} shaped like a leaf.
e.zh: 她戴着一个叶子造型的银吊坠。

e.en: A glass {pendant} light hangs above the kitchen island.
e.zh: 厨房岛台上方挂着一盏玻璃吊灯。

pendency.t: n. 未决状态、悬而未决

e.en: The case remained on hold during the {pendency} of the appeal.
e.zh: 案件在上诉待决期间暂停审理。

e.en: Patent rights begin from the {pendency} of the application.
e.zh: 专利权从申请待审期间开始计算。

e.en: The court dismissed the {pendent} state-law claims.
e.zh: 法院驳回了附带的州法索赔。

e.en: A {pendent} chandelier lit up the marble hall.
e.zh: 一盏悬挂的水晶灯照亮了大理石大厅。

pending.t:
adj. 待处理的、未决的
prep. 在…期间

e.en: Your refund is still {pending} in our system.
e.zh: 你的退款在我们系统里仍在处理中。

e.en: The deal is on hold {pending} legal review.
e.zh: 交易暂停,等待法律审查。

e.en: {Pendle} Hill is famous for its witch trial history.
e.zh: 彭德尔山因其女巫审判的历史而闻名。

e.en: We hiked across {Pendle} on a misty Saturday.
e.zh: 我们在一个雾蒙蒙的周六徒步穿越了彭德尔。

pendleton.t: n. 彭德尔顿（地名/姓氏）

e.en: He bought a wool blanket from {Pendleton} last winter.
e.zh: 去年冬天他从彭德尔顿买了一条羊毛毯。

e.en: The rodeo in {Pendleton} draws huge crowds each fall.
e.zh: 彭德尔顿的牛仔竞技每年秋天吸引大批观众。

e.en: The willow's {pendulous} branches swayed in the breeze.
e.zh: 柳树下垂的枝条在微风中摇曳。

e.en: Heavy {pendulous} fruit weighed down the mango tree.
e.zh: 沉甸甸的果实把芒果树压弯了。

pendulum.t: n. 钟摆；摇摆不定的事物

e.en: The grandfather clock's {pendulum} swung steadily.
e.zh: 老式落地钟的钟摆稳稳地摆动着。

e.en: Public opinion swings like a {pendulum} during elections.
e.zh: 选举期间民意像钟摆一样左右摇摆。

e.en: The museum displays antique clocks with brass {pendulums}.
e.zh: 博物馆展示了带铜质摆锤的古董时钟。

e.en: Markets behave like {pendulums}, swinging between fear and greed.
e.zh: 市场就像钟摆,在恐惧与贪婪之间摆动。

penetrable.t: adj. 可穿透的；可渗透的

e.en: The fortress walls proved {penetrable} only by artillery.
e.zh: 事实证明这座要塞的城墙只有用炮火才能攻破。

e.en: His dense argument was barely {penetrable} to readers.
e.zh: 他晦涩的论述对读者而言几乎难以理解。

penetrate.t:
v. 穿透；渗入
v. 看穿，洞察

e.en: Sunlight cannot {penetrate} the thick rainforest canopy.
e.zh: 阳光无法穿透茂密的雨林树冠。

e.en: The startup struggled to {penetrate} the European market.
e.zh: 这家初创公司难以打入欧洲市场。

penetrated.t: v. 穿透（penetrate 的过去式）

e.en: Hackers {penetrated} the company's firewall last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末黑客攻破了公司的防火墙。

e.en: The drill {penetrated} the concrete in seconds.
e.zh: 电钻几秒钟就钻透了混凝土。

e.en: This lotion {penetrates} deep into dry skin.
e.zh: 这款乳液能深入渗透干燥的皮肤。

e.en: Her gaze {penetrates} right through any pretense.
e.zh: 她的目光能穿透一切伪装。

penetrating.t: adj. 有穿透力的；敏锐的

e.en: He gave her a {penetrating} look across the table.
e.zh: 他隔着桌子向她投来锐利的一瞥。

e.en: The reporter asked several {penetrating} questions.
e.zh: 记者提出了几个尖锐深入的问题。

e.en: She stared {penetratingly} at the witness during testimony.
e.zh: 作证时她锐利地盯着证人。

e.en: The critic wrote {penetratingly} about modern cinema.
e.zh: 这位评论家对现代电影的剖析鞭辟入里。

penetration.t:
n. 穿透；渗透
n. 洞察力

e.en: Smartphone {penetration} has reached ninety percent in cities.
e.zh: 智能手机在城市的普及率已达到百分之九十。

e.en: The team ran a {penetration} test on the new server.
e.zh: 团队对新服务器进行了渗透测试。

penetrative.t: adj. 有穿透力的；敏锐的

e.en: Her essay offered a {penetrative} analysis of social media.
e.zh: 她的文章对社交媒体作了透彻的分析。

e.en: The new radar has impressive {penetrative} capabilities.
e.zh: 这款新雷达具有惊人的穿透能力。

e.en: Engineers designed a tungsten {penetrator} for armored targets.
e.zh: 工程师为装甲目标设计了一种钨制穿甲弹芯。

e.en: The missile uses a kinetic {penetrator} to defeat bunkers.
e.zh: 该导弹使用动能穿甲弹头来摧毁掩体。

e.en: In Chinese mythology, {Peng} is a giant cosmic bird.
e.zh: 在中国神话中,鹏是一只巨大的神鸟。

e.en: My classmate {Peng} just got a job at Tencent.
e.zh: 我同学小鹏刚在腾讯找到工作。

e.en: My cousin lives in {Penge}, just south of London.
e.zh: 我表弟住在伦敦南面的彭奇。

e.en: The train to {Penge} leaves every fifteen minutes.
e.zh: 开往彭奇的列车每十五分钟一班。

e.en: A baby {penguin} hatched at the city aquarium today.
e.zh: 今天市水族馆里一只小企鹅破壳而出。

e.en: The {penguin} waddled across the icy beach.
e.zh: 那只企鹅摇摇摆摆地穿过冰封的海滩。

e.en: Emperor {penguins} survive winter by huddling together.
e.zh: 帝企鹅靠挤在一起取暖度过冬天。

e.en: We watched the {penguins} get fed at three o'clock.
e.zh: 我们看到企鹅在三点钟被喂食。

penh.t: (罕用) 常见于 Phnom Penh（金边）

e.en: Phnom {Penh} is the bustling capital of Cambodia.
e.zh: 金边是柬埔寨繁华的首都。

e.en: Our flight to Phnom {Penh} lands around midnight.
e.zh: 我们飞往金边的航班大约午夜降落。

e.en: Fleming discovered {penicillin} almost by accident in 1928.
e.zh: 弗莱明在1928年几乎是偶然发现了青霉素。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {penicillin} for his throat infection.
e.zh: 医生为他的咽喉感染开了青霉素。

e.en: Modern {penicillins} treat a wide range of bacterial infections.
e.zh: 现代青霉素类药物可治疗多种细菌感染。

e.en: Some patients are allergic to all {penicillins}.
e.zh: 有些病人对所有青霉素类药物都过敏。

e.en: The clinic specializes in {penile} health and urology.
e.zh: 该诊所专门从事阴茎健康与泌尿科治疗。

e.en: Doctors evaluated him for {penile} nerve damage.
e.zh: 医生为他评估阴茎神经是否受损。

e.en: The Iberian {Peninsula} includes Spain and Portugal.
e.zh: 伊比利亚半岛包括西班牙和葡萄牙。

e.en: We drove around the {peninsula} along the coast.
e.zh: 我们沿着海岸开车环绕了整个半岛。

e.en: Malaysia's {peninsular} states are linked by a long highway.
e.zh: 马来西亚半岛部分的各州由一条长长的高速公路相连。

e.en: The {peninsular} climate is warmer than the highlands.
e.zh: 半岛地区的气候比高地更温暖。

e.en: Italy and Greece both feature dramatic coastal {peninsulas}.
e.zh: 意大利和希腊都拥有壮观的沿海半岛。

e.en: Many famous {peninsulas} jut out into the Mediterranean.
e.zh: 许多著名半岛伸入地中海。

e.en: The doctor explained {penis} health during the checkup.
e.zh: 医生在检查时讲解了阴茎健康知识。

e.en: Biology class covered the anatomy of the {penis}.
e.zh: 生物课讲解了阴茎的解剖结构。

e.en: His tearful apology showed genuine {penitence}.
e.zh: 他含泪的道歉显示出真诚的悔过之心。

e.en: The monk lived in quiet {penitence} for years.
e.zh: 那位修士默默地过着忏悔的生活多年。

penitent.t:
adj. 悔过的
n. 忏悔者

e.en: The {penitent} thief returned the wallet with an apology.
e.zh: 那个悔过的小偷连同道歉一起归还了钱包。

e.en: She looked truly {penitent} after breaking the vase.
e.zh: 打碎花瓶后她看起来真的很悔恨。

e.en: Lent is traditionally a {penitential} season for Christians.
e.zh: 四旬期对基督徒来说传统上是忏悔的季节。

e.en: The choir sang a {penitential} psalm at the service.
e.zh: 唱诗班在礼拜中唱了一首忏悔诗篇。

penitentiary.t:
n. 监狱（美式）
adj. 惩戒的

e.en: He served twelve years in a federal {penitentiary}.
e.zh: 他在联邦监狱服刑了十二年。

e.en: The old {penitentiary} has been turned into a museum.
e.zh: 那座旧监狱已被改建成博物馆。

e.en: He used a small {penknife} to open the package.
e.zh: 他用一把小折刀拆开了包裹。

e.en: Grandpa always carried a {penknife} in his pocket.
e.zh: 爷爷口袋里总是揣着一把小折刀。

e.en: The doctor shone a {penlight} into my eyes.
e.zh: 医生用笔形手电照了照我的眼睛。

e.en: I keep a tiny {penlight} on my keychain.
e.zh: 我钥匙圈上挂着一支小笔形手电。

e.en: He was known as a skilled {penman} in the office.
e.zh: 他在办公室里以书法漂亮著称。

e.en: The old {penman} signed the document with a flourish.
e.zh: 那位老书写家潇洒地在文件上签了名。

e.en: Her {penmanship} is so neat it looks printed.
e.zh: 她的字写得工整得像印出来的一样。

e.en: Schools rarely teach {penmanship} in the digital age.
e.zh: 数字时代的学校很少再教书写技巧了。

penn.t: n. 宾州（Pennsylvania 缩写）；佩恩（姓氏）

e.en: She studies economics at {Penn} this semester.
e.zh: 她这学期在宾夕法尼亚大学读经济学。

e.en: William {Penn} founded the colony of Pennsylvania.
e.zh: 威廉·佩恩创立了宾夕法尼亚殖民地。

e.en: The team won its first {pennant} in twenty years.
e.zh: 该队赢得了二十年来的第一个分区冠军旗。

e.en: A red {pennant} fluttered from the top of the mast.
e.zh: 一面红色的三角旗在桅杆顶端飘扬。

penne.t: n. 彭尼意面；斜管通心粉

e.en: I ordered {penne} with spicy tomato sauce for lunch.
e.zh: 我午餐点了一份辣番茄酱通心粉。

e.en: Add the {penne} to boiling water for ten minutes.
e.zh: 把通心粉放进沸水里煮十分钟。

penned.t:
v. 撰写（pen 的过去式）
v. 关入圈栏

e.en: She {penned} a heartfelt letter to her grandmother.
e.zh: 她给奶奶写了一封情真意切的信。

e.en: The novelist {penned} three books during the pandemic.
e.zh: 那位小说家在疫情期间写了三本书。

e.en: I found a few {pennies} under the couch cushion.
e.zh: 我在沙发垫底下找到了几枚一分硬币。

e.en: She saves her {pennies} in an old glass jar.
e.zh: 她把零钱攒在一个旧玻璃罐里。

penniless.t: adj. 身无分文的；一贫如洗的

e.en: He arrived in the city {penniless} but full of hope.
e.zh: 他身无分文来到这座城市,却满怀希望。

e.en: The startup left its founders almost {penniless}.
e.zh: 那家创业公司让创始人们几乎一贫如洗。

e.en: We hiked along the {Pennine} Way last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们沿着奔宁山道徒步。

e.en: Mist often covers the {Pennine} hills in autumn.
e.zh: 秋天的奔宁山丘常常被薄雾笼罩。

e.en: Mr. {Pennington} runs the bookstore on Main Street.
e.zh: 彭宁顿先生在主街上经营那家书店。

e.en: The village of {Pennington} sits near the New Forest.
e.zh: 彭宁顿村坐落在新森林附近。

pennsylvania.t: n. 宾夕法尼亚州（美国）

e.en: My cousin grew up on a farm in {Pennsylvania}.
e.zh: 我表弟在宾夕法尼亚州的一个农场长大。

e.en: {Pennsylvania} is famous for its rolling green hills.
e.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州以连绵起伏的青山闻名。

pennsylvanian.t:
adj. 宾夕法尼亚的
n. 宾州人

e.en: She's a proud {Pennsylvanian} born and raised in Pittsburgh.
e.zh: 她是土生土长的匹兹堡人,以宾州人为荣。

e.en: The fossils date back to the {Pennsylvanian} period.
e.zh: 这些化石可以追溯到宾夕法尼亚纪。

penny.t: n. 便士（英国硬币）；美分

e.en: I don't have a single {penny} left in my wallet.
e.zh: 我钱包里连一分钱都没剩了。

e.en: Every {penny} of the donation went to the shelter.
e.zh: 捐款的每一分钱都给了收容所。

e.en: We toured {Penrhyn} Castle on our trip to Wales.
e.zh: 我们在威尔士旅行时参观了彭林城堡。

e.en: The {Penrhyn} quarry once produced famous Welsh slate.
e.zh: 彭林采石场曾出产著名的威尔士板岩。

e.en: We stopped for tea in the town of {Penrith}.
e.zh: 我们在彭里斯镇停下来喝了杯茶。

e.en: {Penrith} lies just outside the Lake District.
e.zh: 彭里斯就坐落在湖区的边缘。

penrose.t: n. 彭罗斯（姓氏，如数学家 Roger Penrose）

e.en: The lobby floor features a {Penrose} tiling pattern.
e.zh: 大堂地面采用了彭罗斯铺砖图案。

e.en: Roger {Penrose} won a Nobel Prize for his work on black holes.
e.zh: 罗杰·彭罗斯因黑洞研究获得了诺贝尔奖。

penryn.t: n. 彭林（英国康沃尔镇）

e.en: She studies at the university campus in {Penryn}.
e.zh: 她在彭林的大学校区读书。

e.en: {Penryn} is a small town near Falmouth in Cornwall.
e.zh: 彭林是康沃尔郡法尔茅斯附近的小镇。

pens.t:
n. 笔（pen 的复数）
v. 撰写；圈养

e.en: I bought a pack of black gel {pens} for class.
e.zh: 我买了一盒黑色中性笔上课用。

e.en: The farmer fixed the wooden {pens} for the sheep.
e.zh: 农夫修好了关羊的木栏。

penshurst.t: n. 彭斯赫斯特（英国地名）

e.en: {Penshurst} Place is a beautiful Tudor manor in Kent.
e.zh: 潘斯赫斯特庄园是肯特郡一座美丽的都铎式宅邸。

e.en: We had a picnic on the lawn at {Penshurst}.
e.zh: 我们在潘斯赫斯特的草坪上野餐。

pension.t:
n. 养老金；退休金
v. 发放退休金

e.en: He receives a modest {pension} from his old employer.
e.zh: 他从原单位领取一份不多的养老金。

e.en: Many young workers worry about future {pension} cuts.
e.zh: 许多年轻员工担心未来养老金会被削减。

pensionable.t: adj. 可领取养老金的（年龄、职位）

e.en: She finally reached {pensionable} age last month.
e.zh: 她上个月终于到了可以领养老金的年龄。

e.en: Only full-time staff hold {pensionable} positions here.
e.zh: 这里只有全职员工才有可领退休金的职位。

pensioner.t: n. 领养老金的人；退休者

e.en: The cafe offers a discount for every {pensioner}.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆对每位退休老人都有折扣。

e.en: My neighbor is a cheerful {pensioner} who loves gardening.
e.zh: 我邻居是一位爱园艺、性格开朗的退休老人。

pensions.t: n. 养老金（pension 的复数）

e.en: The government plans to raise state {pensions} next year.
e.zh: 政府计划明年提高国家养老金。

e.en: Many private {pensions} have lost value due to inflation.
e.zh: 许多私人养老金因通胀而缩水。

e.en: She looked {pensive} as she stared out the window.
e.zh: 她望着窗外,神情若有所思。

e.en: The film ends on a quiet, {pensive} note.
e.zh: 这部电影以一种安静、沉思的基调收尾。

pensively.t: adv. 若有所思地；忧郁地

e.en: He stirred his coffee {pensively}, lost in thought.
e.zh: 他若有所思地搅着咖啡,陷入了沉思。

e.en: She gazed {pensively} at the old family photograph.
e.zh: 她沉思地凝视着那张旧的全家福。

penstemon.t: n. 钓钟柳（一种观赏植物）

e.en: The {penstemon} along the path bloomed bright purple.
e.zh: 小路边的钓钟柳开出了鲜艳的紫色花。

e.en: Bees love the tubular flowers of the {penstemon}.
e.zh: 蜜蜂很喜欢钓钟柳的管状花朵。

e.en: Years of {pent}-up frustration finally burst out.
e.zh: 多年压抑的挫败感终于爆发了出来。

e.en: The dog had {pent}-up energy after the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行后那只狗憋了一肚子精力。

e.en: The prefix {penta} means five in Greek-derived words.
e.zh: 前缀 penta 在源自希腊语的词中表示五。

e.en: A {penta}-core processor handles five parallel threads.
e.zh: 五核处理器可以同时处理五个并行线程。

pentagastrin.t: n. 五肽胃泌素（医用试剂）

e.en: Doctors used {pentagastrin} to test stomach acid secretion.
e.zh: 医生用五肽胃泌素来检测胃酸分泌。

e.en: {Pentagastrin} stimulates the release of gastric acid.
e.zh: 五肽胃泌素能刺激胃酸的分泌。

pentagon.t: n. 五角形；(the Pentagon) 美国国防部

e.en: A {pentagon} has five equal sides and five angles.
e.zh: 五边形有五条等长的边和五个角。

e.en: The {Pentagon} announced a new defense budget today.
e.zh: 五角大楼今天公布了新的国防预算。

pentagonal.t: adj. 五边形的；五角形的

e.en: The tower has a striking {pentagonal} base.
e.zh: 这座塔有一个引人注目的五边形底座。

e.en: Soccer balls combine {pentagonal} and hexagonal panels.
e.zh: 足球由五边形和六边形拼块组合而成。

pentagons.t: n. 五角形（pentagon 的复数）

e.en: Children drew {pentagons} and triangles in math class.
e.zh: 孩子们在数学课上画五边形和三角形。

e.en: The mosaic uses small black {pentagons} on white tiles.
e.zh: 这幅马赛克在白瓷砖上用了许多黑色小五边形。

e.en: A glowing {pentagram} was painted on the floor.
e.zh: 地板上画着一个发光的五角星。

e.en: Some cultures view the {pentagram} as a protective symbol.
e.zh: 一些文化把五芒星视为护身符号。

e.en: Shakespeare wrote most of his plays in iambic {pentameter}.
e.zh: 莎士比亚的剧作大多以抑扬格五音步写成。

e.en: Counting syllables helps you hear the {pentameter} clearly.
e.zh: 数音节有助于清楚地听出五音步格律。

pentateuch.t: n. 摩西五经（旧约前五卷）

e.en: The {Pentateuch} comprises the first five books of the Bible.
e.zh: 《摩西五经》由《圣经》的前五卷组成。

e.en: Scholars debate the authorship of the {Pentateuch}.
e.zh: 学者们对《摩西五经》的作者身份争论不休。

e.en: She trains hard for the modern {pentathlon} every day.
e.zh: 她每天为现代五项运动刻苦训练。

e.en: The {pentathlon} combines five very different sports.
e.zh: 五项全能将五种截然不同的运动结合在一起。

e.en: Many folk melodies are built on a {pentatonic} scale.
e.zh: 许多民歌的旋律都建立在五声音阶上。

e.en: He taught the kids a simple {pentatonic} tune on the piano.
e.zh: 他在钢琴上教孩子们一首简单的五声音阶曲子。

e.en: He shoots wildlife with an old {Pentax} film camera.
e.zh: 他用一台老宾得胶片相机拍摄野生动物。

e.en: My first DSLR was a secondhand {Pentax} from college.
e.zh: 我的第一台单反是大学时买的二手宾得。

pentecost.t: n. 五旬节；圣灵降临节

e.en: The church holds a special service on {Pentecost}.
e.zh: 教会在五旬节会举行一场特别的礼拜。

e.en: {Pentecost} falls fifty days after Easter Sunday.
e.zh: 五旬节在复活节后第五十天。

pentecostal.t:
adj. 五旬节派的
n. 五旬节派信徒

e.en: She grew up in a {Pentecostal} church in Texas.
e.zh: 她在德州一所五旬节派教会长大。

e.en: The {Pentecostal} service featured lively music and prayer.
e.zh: 五旬节派的礼拜上有热烈的音乐和祷告。

pentecostalism.t: n. 五旬节派（基督教派别）

e.en: {Pentecostalism} has grown rapidly across Latin America.
e.zh: 五旬节运动在拉丁美洲迅速发展。

e.en: Her thesis explores the global rise of {Pentecostalism}.
e.zh: 她的论文探讨五旬节运动在全球的兴起。

penthouse.t: n. 顶层豪华公寓；阁楼套房

e.en: They moved into a {penthouse} with a rooftop pool.
e.zh: 他们搬进了一套带屋顶泳池的顶层公寓。

e.en: The {penthouse} offers stunning views of the harbor.
e.zh: 这套顶层公寓拥有壮丽的港口景观。

pentium.t: n. 奔腾（英特尔处理器）

e.en: My first computer ran on an old {Pentium} processor.
e.zh: 我的第一台电脑用的是老式奔腾处理器。

e.en: The {Pentium} chip changed personal computing in the nineties.
e.zh: 奔腾芯片在九十年代改变了个人电脑领域。

e.en: We hiked through the {Pentland} Hills near Edinburgh.
e.zh: 我们在爱丁堡附近的彭特兰丘陵徒步。

e.en: The {Pentland} Firth has notoriously strong tides.
e.zh: 彭特兰湾以其异常湍急的潮汐而闻名。

pentonville.t: n. 彭顿维尔（伦敦监狱名）

e.en: The novel is set partly inside {Pentonville} prison.
e.zh: 这部小说部分情节设定在彭顿维尔监狱内。

e.en: He grew up on a quiet street in {Pentonville}.
e.zh: 他在彭顿维尔一条安静的街道上长大。

e.en: In the books, {Pentos} is a wealthy Free City of Essos.
e.zh: 在书中,潘托斯是厄索斯大陆上一座富裕的自由城邦。

e.en: Tyrion sails to {Pentos} after fleeing King's Landing.
e.zh: 提利昂逃离君临后乘船前往潘托斯。

e.en: The {penultimate} chapter sets up the final twist.
e.zh: 倒数第二章为最后的反转做了铺垫。

e.en: She finished second in the {penultimate} round.
e.zh: 她在倒数第二轮比赛中获得了第二名。

e.en: During the eclipse, the moon entered Earth's {penumbra}.
e.zh: 日食期间,月球进入了地球的半影区。

e.en: A faint {penumbra} surrounded the streetlight in the fog.
e.zh: 雾中的路灯周围环绕着一圈淡淡的半影。

penumbral.t: adj. 半影的；模糊地带的

e.en: The eclipse cast a {penumbral} shadow across the northern hemisphere.
e.zh: 日食在北半球投下了半影。

e.en: Her novel explores the {penumbral} space between memory and dream.
e.zh: 她的小说探索了记忆与梦境之间的朦胧地带。

e.en: The writer led a {penurious} life in a tiny attic room.
e.zh: 那位作家在一间小阁楼里过着贫困的生活。

e.en: He was {penurious} with praise but generous with criticism.
e.zh: 他吝于赞美,却毫不吝啬批评。

e.en: After losing his job, he fell into utter {penury}.
e.zh: 失业后,他陷入了彻底的赤贫。

e.en: Many artists endured {penury} before achieving fame.
e.zh: 许多艺术家在成名之前都饱受贫困之苦。

penzance.t: n. 彭赞斯（英国海滨城市）

e.en: We took the night train down to {Penzance} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们坐夜班火车去了彭赞斯。

e.en: The Pirates of {Penzance} remains a beloved comic opera.
e.zh: 《彭赞斯的海盗》至今仍是深受喜爱的喜歌剧。

e.en: The {Peo} are an indigenous community with a rich oral tradition.
e.zh: 佩奥族是一个拥有丰富口头传统的原住民族群。

e.en: He typed '{peo}' by mistake instead of 'people' in the chat.
e.zh: 他在聊天里把 people 错打成了 peo。

e.en: He felt like a {peon} doing endless paperwork at the firm.
e.zh: 他在公司里整天处理文件,感觉像个小喽啰。

e.en: The landowner relied on {peon} labor for the harvest.
e.zh: 地主依靠雇工劳动来完成收割。

peonage.t: n. 以劳役抵债的制度

e.en: The system of debt {peonage} trapped workers for generations.
e.zh: 债务奴役制度将工人困住了好几代人。

e.en: Reformers fought to abolish {peonage} on the plantations.
e.zh: 改革者努力废除种植园里的债奴制度。

e.en: A single pink {peony} bloomed beside the garden path.
e.zh: 花园小径旁开了一朵粉色的牡丹。

e.en: She painted a {peony} on the silk fan.
e.zh: 她在丝绸扇子上画了一朵牡丹。

people.t:
n. 人们；人民
v. 居住于

e.en: Many {people} now work from home several days a week.
e.zh: 现在很多人每周有几天在家办公。

e.en: The app helps you connect with {people} who share your hobbies.
e.zh: 这款应用帮你结识有共同爱好的人。

peoplehood.t: n. 民族认同；群体归属感

e.en: The festival celebrates a shared sense of {peoplehood}.
e.zh: 这个节日庆祝大家共同的民族认同感。

e.en: Language plays a central role in their {peoplehood}.
e.zh: 语言在他们的民族认同中扮演着核心角色。

peopling.t: v. 使住满人；构成人口

e.en: Scholars debate the {peopling} of the Americas thousands of years ago.
e.zh: 学者们对数千年前美洲的人类迁居过程争论不休。

e.en: Tourists were {peopling} the beach by mid-morning.
e.zh: 上午过半,游客就挤满了海滩。

pep.t:
n. 活力；劲头
v. 使振作

e.en: A strong coffee gave me the {pep} to finish the report.
e.zh: 一杯浓咖啡让我有了精神写完报告。

e.en: The coach gave the team a quick {pep} talk before kickoff.
e.zh: 开赛前教练给球队做了简短的鼓舞动员。

e.en: The {Pepe} meme spread rapidly across early internet forums.
e.zh: 佩佩这个表情包在早期网络论坛上迅速流传。

e.en: My uncle {Pepe} runs a small bakery in Madrid.
e.zh: 我叔叔佩佩在马德里经营一家小面包店。

pepper.t:
n. 胡椒；辣椒
v. 撒满；连续射击

e.en: Add a pinch of black {pepper} to finish the sauce.
e.zh: 最后加一小撮黑胡椒让酱汁更香。

e.en: Reporters {pepper} the senator with questions after the vote.
e.zh: 投票后记者们连珠炮似地向参议员发问。

e.en: Crush a single {peppercorn} for that fresh, sharp aroma.
e.zh: 压碎一颗胡椒粒就能散发出那种新鲜辛辣的香气。

e.en: The shop charges a {peppercorn} rent of one pound a year.
e.zh: 那家店每年只象征性地交一英镑租金。

peppered.t: adj. 撒有胡椒的；布满的

e.en: The article was {peppered} with quotes from industry experts.
e.zh: 这篇文章中穿插着许多行业专家的引言。

e.en: She lightly {peppered} the steak before grilling it.
e.zh: 她在牛排上撒了一点胡椒再烤。

e.en: I sip {peppermint} tea to settle my stomach after dinner.
e.zh: 我饭后喝薄荷茶帮助消化。

e.en: He offered me a {peppermint} candy from the jar.
e.zh: 他从罐子里拿了一颗薄荷糖给我。

pepperoni.t: n. 意式辣味香肠（披萨配料）

e.en: We ordered a large {pepperoni} pizza for the movie night.
e.zh: 电影之夜我们点了一个大份意式辣香肠披萨。

e.en: She picked the {pepperoni} off her slice and ate just the cheese.
e.zh: 她把辣香肠挑掉,只吃奶酪部分。

e.en: Roasted red {peppers} add sweetness to the pasta sauce.
e.zh: 烤红椒能为意面酱增添甜味。

e.en: He grows several kinds of chili {peppers} on the balcony.
e.zh: 他在阳台上种了好几种辣椒。

e.en: The soup had a pleasantly {peppery} kick from the chili oil.
e.zh: 这汤因辣椒油带着一股令人愉悦的辛辣味。

e.en: Her {peppery} reply silenced everyone at the meeting.
e.zh: 她那番尖锐的回应让会上所有人都哑口无言。

peppy.t: adj. 精力充沛的；活泼的

e.en: The cafe played {peppy} pop songs all morning.
e.zh: 咖啡馆整个上午都在放轻快的流行歌。

e.en: After a nap she felt {peppy} again.
e.zh: 小睡之后她又恢复了活力。

e.en: He grabbed a cold {Pepsi} from the vending machine.
e.zh: 他从自动售货机买了一瓶冰百事可乐。

e.en: The diner serves {Pepsi} instead of Coke.
e.zh: 这家餐厅卖百事可乐,不卖可口可乐。

e.en: {Pepsin} in the stomach helps break down dietary proteins.
e.zh: 胃里的胃蛋白酶帮助分解食物中的蛋白质。

e.en: The lab studies how acidity affects {pepsin} activity.
e.zh: 实验室研究酸度如何影响胃蛋白酶的活性。

e.en: Stomach cells secrete {pepsinogen}, which acid converts into pepsin.
e.zh: 胃细胞分泌胃蛋白酶原,胃酸将其转化为胃蛋白酶。

e.en: Low {pepsinogen} levels can indicate atrophic gastritis.
e.zh: 胃蛋白酶原水平偏低可能提示萎缩性胃炎。

peptic.t: adj. 消化的；胃蛋白酶的

e.en: He was diagnosed with a {peptic} ulcer last month.
e.zh: 他上个月被诊断出患有消化性溃疡。

e.en: Spicy food can aggravate {peptic} symptoms in some people.
e.zh: 辛辣食物可能加重某些人的胃部不适症状。

e.en: Scientists designed a {peptide} that blocks the virus from entering cells.
e.zh: 科学家设计出一种能阻止病毒进入细胞的肽。

e.en: This skincare serum contains a collagen-boosting {peptide}.
e.zh: 这款护肤精华含有促进胶原蛋白生成的肽。

e.en: Tickets cost twelve dollars {per} person at the door.
e.zh: 现场购票每人十二美元。

e.en: {Per} the new policy, refunds must be requested within 30 days.
e.zh: 根据新政策,必须在三十天内申请退款。

e.en: They like to {perambulate} the old town after dinner.
e.zh: 他们喜欢晚饭后在老城里悠闲漫步。

e.en: Visitors {perambulate} the museum gardens in summer evenings.
e.zh: 夏日傍晚游客们在博物馆花园里散步。

e.en: Their evening {perambulation} along the river became a daily ritual.
e.zh: 他们沿河漫步成了每晚的固定习惯。

e.en: The book offers a leisurely {perambulation} through Victorian London.
e.zh: 这本书带读者悠然漫游维多利亚时代的伦敦。

e.en: I sleep best on crisp {percale} sheets in the summer.
e.zh: 夏天我睡在挺括的密织棉布床单上最舒服。

e.en: The hotel uses high-thread-count {percale} bedding.
e.zh: 这家酒店用的是高支数密织棉布床品。

perceivable.t: adj. 可察觉的；可感知的

e.en: There was a barely {perceivable} delay in the audio stream.
e.zh: 音频流中有一点几乎察觉不到的延迟。

e.en: The temperature drop was {perceivable} only by sensitive instruments.
e.zh: 只有灵敏的仪器才能察觉到温度的下降。

e.en: Customers {perceive} the brand as reliable and affordable.
e.zh: 顾客认为这个品牌可靠又实惠。

e.en: Cats {perceive} sounds far above the human hearing range.
e.zh: 猫能感知到远超人类听觉范围的声音。

perceived.t: adj. 被感知的；被认为的

e.en: The product's {perceived} value matters more than its actual cost.
e.zh: 产品在消费者心中的价值比实际成本更重要。

e.en: She apologized for the {perceived} slight at the meeting.
e.zh: 她为会上让人感到被冒犯一事道了歉。

e.en: The painting changes meaning depending on the {perceiver}.
e.zh: 这幅画的含义会因观看者不同而改变。

e.en: Each {perceiver} brings their own background to the experience.
e.zh: 每个感知者都把自身的背景带入这一体验。

e.en: The brain {perceives} motion even in still images sometimes.
e.zh: 有时候大脑会在静态图像中感知到运动。

e.en: He {perceives} every email as urgent, which exhausts him.
e.zh: 他把每封邮件都当成紧急的,搞得自己精疲力尽。

perceiving.t: v. 察觉中（perceive 的现在分词）

e.en: Infants are capable of {perceiving} faces from a very early age.
e.zh: 婴儿很小就能感知人脸。

e.en: She has a knack for {perceiving} subtle changes in mood.
e.zh: 她善于察觉情绪上的细微变化。

percent.t:
n. 百分之…
adj. 百分之…的

e.en: Online sales grew by twenty {percent} last quarter.
e.zh: 上个季度线上销售增长了百分之二十。

e.en: Roughly forty {percent} of users open the app daily.
e.zh: 大约有百分之四十的用户每天打开这款应用。

e.en: A small {percentage} of donations goes to administrative costs.
e.zh: 捐款中只有一小部分用于行政开支。

e.en: What {percentage} of your income do you save each month?
e.zh: 你每个月把收入的多少比例存起来?

e.en: The chart breaks down the survey results into clear {percentages}.
e.zh: 图表用清晰的百分比展示了调查结果。

e.en: Convert these decimals to {percentages} before submitting the report.
e.zh: 在提交报告前把这些小数换算成百分比。

e.en: Her test score landed in the 95th {percentile} nationally.
e.zh: 她的考试成绩在全国排进了第九十五百分位。

e.en: The dashboard shows latency at the 99th {percentile}.
e.zh: 仪表盘显示了第九十九百分位的延迟。

e.en: A visual {percept} can differ greatly from the raw retinal image.
e.zh: 视觉知觉可能与视网膜上的原始图像大不相同。

e.en: The same stimulus can produce a different {percept} in each viewer.
e.zh: 同一刺激在不同观看者那里可能产生不同的知觉。

perceptible.t: adj. 可察觉的；可感知的

e.en: There was a {perceptible} change in his tone after the news.
e.zh: 听到这个消息后,他的语气有了明显的变化。

e.en: The vibration was barely {perceptible} through the thick floor.
e.zh: 透过厚厚的地板,这股震动几乎察觉不到。

e.en: The room grew {perceptibly} colder as evening fell.
e.zh: 夜幕降临后,房间明显变冷了。

e.en: Her mood brightened {perceptibly} when he walked in.
e.zh: 他一进来,她的心情就明显好了起来。

e.en: Public {perception} of the brand has improved since the redesign.
e.zh: 自从品牌重塑以来,公众对它的看法有所改观。

e.en: Optical illusions reveal how easily {perception} can be tricked.
e.zh: 视错觉揭示了人的感知有多容易被欺骗。

e.en: Marketing campaigns aim to shape consumer {perceptions}.
e.zh: 营销活动旨在塑造消费者的认知。

e.en: Travel often changes our {perceptions} of other cultures.
e.zh: 旅行往往会改变我们对其他文化的看法。

perceptive.t: adj. 敏锐的；有洞察力的

e.en: She made a {perceptive} comment about the team's hidden tensions.
e.zh: 她对团队潜在的紧张关系做出了敏锐的评论。

e.en: A good therapist needs to be deeply {perceptive}.
e.zh: 一位好的心理治疗师需要非常敏锐。

perceptively.t: adv. 敏锐地；有洞察力地

e.en: The critic wrote {perceptively} about the film's quiet moments.
e.zh: 这位影评人对影片中那些静默时刻写得很有洞见。

e.en: She {perceptively} noted what the speaker had left unsaid.
e.zh: 她敏锐地注意到了演讲者没有说出口的话。

e.en: His {perceptiveness} about people made him a great negotiator.
e.zh: 他对人的洞察力让他成为出色的谈判者。

e.en: The novel is praised for its emotional {perceptiveness}.
e.zh: 这部小说因其细腻的情感洞察力而备受赞誉。

perceptron.t: n. 感知机（神经网络模型）

e.en: The {perceptron} is one of the simplest neural network models.
e.zh: 感知机是最简单的神经网络模型之一。

e.en: A multilayer {perceptron} can solve nonlinear classification problems.
e.zh: 多层感知机可以解决非线性分类问题。

e.en: Color constancy is a classic {perceptual} phenomenon.
e.zh: 色彩恒常性是一种经典的知觉现象。

e.en: The headphones use {perceptual} audio coding to save bandwidth.
e.zh: 这款耳机采用感知音频编码以节省带宽。

e.en: {Perceval} is a legendary knight in Arthurian tales.
e.zh: 珀西瓦尔是亚瑟王传说中的一位传奇骑士。

e.en: The opera {Perceval} retells the quest for the Holy Grail.
e.zh: 歌剧《珀西瓦尔》重述了寻找圣杯的故事。

perch.t:
v. 栖息；停留
n. 栖木；鲈鱼

e.en: The cat found a sunny {perch} on the windowsill.
e.zh: 那只猫在窗台上找到了一个晒太阳的位置。

e.en: We caught a small {perch} in the lake yesterday.
e.zh: 我们昨天在湖里钓到了一条小鲈鱼。

e.en: To sleep, {perchance} to dream — Hamlet pondered death.
e.zh: 睡去,或许还能做梦——哈姆雷特沉思着死亡。

e.en: Did you, {perchance}, see my keys on the table?
e.zh: 你是否碰巧看到我的钥匙放在桌上?

e.en: A small bird {perched} on the telephone wire outside.
e.zh: 一只小鸟停在外面的电话线上。

e.en: The village is {perched} on the edge of a cliff.
e.zh: 那个村庄坐落在悬崖边上。

perches.t: v./n. 栖息（perch 的复数/三单）

e.en: The owl {perches} silently on a branch every night.
e.zh: 那只猫头鹰每晚都静静地栖在树枝上。

e.en: The cabin {perches} above a deep mountain valley.
e.zh: 那间小屋高踞在一处深山峡谷之上。

perching.t: v. 栖息中（perch 的现在分词）

e.en: A robin is {perching} on the garden fence.
e.zh: 一只知更鸟正栖在花园的栅栏上。

e.en: She kept {perching} on the edge of the chair nervously.
e.zh: 她紧张地一直坐在椅子边上。

e.en: Scientists detected {perchlorate} in soil samples from Mars.
e.zh: 科学家在火星土壤样本中检测到了高氯酸盐。

e.en: Ammonium {perchlorate} is used as rocket fuel oxidizer.
e.zh: 高氯酸铵被用作火箭燃料的氧化剂。

percolate.t: v. 渗透；过滤；逐渐传开

e.en: Let the coffee {percolate} for a few more minutes.
e.zh: 让咖啡再渗滤几分钟。

e.en: New ideas slowly {percolate} through the company culture.
e.zh: 新想法在公司文化中慢慢渗透开来。

e.en: Slow {percolation} produces a richer, more aromatic coffee.
e.zh: 缓慢的渗滤能煮出更浓郁、更香的咖啡。

e.en: Heavy rain affects water {percolation} through the soil.
e.zh: 大雨会影响水分渗入土壤的过程。

e.en: My grandmother still uses an old stovetop {percolator}.
e.zh: 我祖母仍在使用一个旧式的炉灶咖啡渗滤壶。

e.en: The {percolator} bubbled cheerfully on the kitchen counter.
e.zh: 咖啡渗滤壶在厨房台面上欢快地咕嘟着。

e.en: He plays {percussion} in the school jazz band.
e.zh: 他在学校爵士乐队里负责打击乐。

e.en: The doctor used {percussion} to examine my chest.
e.zh: 医生用叩诊法检查了我的胸部。

e.en: The orchestra hired a new {percussionist} last month.
e.zh: 乐团上个月新聘了一位打击乐手。

e.en: As a {percussionist}, she plays drums and marimba.
e.zh: 作为打击乐手,她演奏鼓和马林巴琴。

e.en: The song has a strong {percussive} beat throughout.
e.zh: 这首歌从头到尾都有强烈的打击节奏。

e.en: Rain made a {percussive} sound on the metal roof.
e.zh: 雨点打在铁皮屋顶上发出敲击般的声响。

e.en: Doctors performed a {percutaneous} coronary intervention on the patient.
e.zh: 医生为患者实施了经皮冠状动脉介入治疗。

e.en: The drug is delivered via {percutaneous} absorption through skin.
e.zh: 该药物通过皮肤经皮吸收进行给药。

e.en: The preacher warned sinners of eternal {perdition}.
e.zh: 牧师警告罪人将面临永恒的沉沦。

e.en: He felt his career was heading straight to {perdition}.
e.zh: 他觉得自己的事业正一路滑向毁灭。

pere.t: n. 父亲（法语借词，用于人名后）

e.en: Alexandre Dumas {pere} wrote The Three Musketeers.
e.zh: 大仲马(老仲马)写了《三个火枪手》。

e.en: The label often adds {pere} to distinguish father from son.
e.zh: 标签上常加“老”字来区分父亲和儿子。

e.en: His {peregrination} across Asia lasted nearly two years.
e.zh: 他横跨亚洲的漫游持续了将近两年。

e.en: The book chronicles her {peregrination} through small European towns.
e.zh: 这本书记录了她在欧洲小镇间的漫游。

peregrine.t:
n. 游隼
adj. 漂泊的

e.en: A {peregrine} falcon dived at over 200 miles per hour.
e.zh: 一只游隼以每小时200多英里的速度俯冲。

e.en: The medieval {peregrine} traveled far from home seeking grace.
e.zh: 中世纪的朝圣者远离家乡,只为寻求恩典。

e.en: He {peremptorily} dismissed her suggestion without explanation.
e.zh: 他不容置疑地否决了她的建议,毫不解释。

e.en: The judge {peremptorily} ordered the courtroom to clear.
e.zh: 法官断然命令法庭立即清场。

peremptory.t: adj. 断然的，不容置疑的

e.en: Her {peremptory} tone left no room for discussion.
e.zh: 她那不容反驳的语气让人无法继续讨论。

e.en: The boss issued a {peremptory} demand for the report.
e.zh: 老板下达了一道不容置疑的命令,要求交报告。

perennial.t:
adj. 长期的，持续不断的
n. 多年生植物

e.en: Traffic is a {perennial} problem in this city.
e.zh: 交通是这座城市长期存在的难题。

e.en: Lavender is a hardy {perennial} that blooms every summer.
e.zh: 薰衣草是一种耐寒的多年生植物,每年夏天开花。

e.en: He is {perennially} late to morning meetings.
e.zh: 他每次早会都老是迟到。

e.en: This restaurant is {perennially} packed on weekend evenings.
e.zh: 这家餐厅周末晚上常年爆满。

perestroika.t: n. 改革（苏联时期的经济政治改革）

e.en: Gorbachev introduced {perestroika} to reform the Soviet economy.
e.zh: 戈尔巴乔夫推行“改革”以重塑苏联经济。

e.en: Many older Russians still debate the legacy of {perestroika}.
e.zh: 许多上了年纪的俄罗斯人仍在讨论“改革”的遗产。

perfect.t:
adj. 完美的
v. 使完善

e.en: This weather is {perfect} for a hike in the mountains.
e.zh: 这种天气最适合去山里徒步了。

e.en: She practiced for hours to {perfect} her piano solo.
e.zh: 她练了好几个小时,只为完美演绎那段钢琴独奏。

perfecta.t: n. 正序连赢（赛马投注）

e.en: He won big by hitting the {perfecta} at the racetrack.
e.zh: 他在赛马场押中了连赢二宝,赢了一大笔。

e.en: A {perfecta} requires picking the top two finishers in order.
e.zh: 押中连赢二宝需要按顺序选出前两名。

perfected.t:
adj. 已臻完善的
v. 使完善（过去式）

e.en: She has {perfected} her grandmother's apple pie recipe.
e.zh: 她已经把祖母的苹果派配方做到了完美。

e.en: The team {perfected} their pitch before meeting investors.
e.zh: 团队在见投资人之前把演讲打磨到了完美。

e.en: Enlightenment thinkers believed in the {perfectibility} of human nature.
e.zh: 启蒙思想家相信人性具有可完善性。

e.en: He doubts the {perfectibility} of any complex software system.
e.zh: 他怀疑任何复杂的软件系统都不可能臻于完美。

e.en: She spent years {perfecting} her latte art technique.
e.zh: 她花了好几年时间打磨拉花技艺。

e.en: The chef is still {perfecting} the new tasting menu.
e.zh: 主厨仍在不断完善新的品鉴菜单。

e.en: The cake was baked to absolute {perfection}.
e.zh: 这块蛋糕烤得恰到好处,堪称完美。

e.en: Chasing {perfection} can sometimes paralyze your creativity.
e.zh: 一味追求完美有时会让人创造力停滞。

e.en: Her {perfectionism} makes it hard to ship anything on time.
e.zh: 她的完美主义让任何东西都很难按时交付。

e.en: Therapy helped him manage his crippling {perfectionism}.
e.zh: 心理治疗帮他控制住了那种令人窒息的完美主义。

e.en: She is a total {perfectionist} when designing user interfaces.
e.zh: 她在设计用户界面时是个十足的完美主义者。

e.en: Being a {perfectionist} can both help and hurt your career.
e.zh: 做一个完美主义者对事业既有帮助,也有伤害。

e.en: His {perfectionistic} habits often lead to long working hours.
e.zh: 他完美主义的习惯常常导致工作时间过长。

e.en: She has a {perfectionistic} streak that frustrates her teammates.
e.zh: 她有一种完美主义倾向,常让队友感到无奈。

e.en: Russian verbs distinguish between {perfective} and imperfective aspects.
e.zh: 俄语动词区分完成体和未完成体两种体貌。

e.en: The {perfective} form emphasizes that an action is completed.
e.zh: 完成体形式强调动作已经完成。

e.en: The new sofa fits {perfectly} in the living room.
e.zh: 这张新沙发刚好完美地放进了客厅。

e.en: I'm {perfectly} fine with skipping dessert tonight.
e.zh: 我今晚不吃甜点完全没问题。

perfects.t: v. 使完善（第三人称单数）

e.en: She constantly {perfects} her code before pushing it.
e.zh: 她在提交代码前总是反复打磨到完美。

e.en: Practice {perfects} skills that talent alone cannot deliver.
e.zh: 练习能磨砺出仅靠天赋无法达到的技艺。

e.en: He gave a {perfervid} speech defending free speech online.
e.zh: 他发表了一场慷慨激昂的演讲,捍卫网络言论自由。

e.en: Her {perfervid} fans queued overnight for the concert.
e.zh: 她那群狂热的粉丝彻夜排队等候演唱会。

e.en: The {perfidious} ally secretly negotiated with their enemy.
e.zh: 那个背信弃义的盟友私下与敌方谈判。

e.en: He felt betrayed by his {perfidious} business partner.
e.zh: 他被自己背信弃义的生意伙伴深深伤害了。

e.en: The general was executed for his {perfidy} during the war.
e.zh: 那位将军因战时的背叛行为被处决。

e.en: History remembers his {perfidy} more than his early successes.
e.zh: 历史记住的更多是他的背叛,而非早年的功绩。

e.en: Use a fork to {perforate} the dough before baking.
e.zh: 烘烤前用叉子在面团上戳些小孔。

e.en: The bullet did not {perforate} the bulletproof vest.
e.zh: 那颗子弹没有穿透防弹背心。

e.en: The notebook has {perforated} pages for easy tearing.
e.zh: 这本笔记本的页面带有易撕的虚线孔。

e.en: The ulcer had {perforated} the wall of his stomach.
e.zh: 溃疡已经穿透了他的胃壁。

e.en: Tear along the {perforation} to remove the receipt.
e.zh: 沿着虚线撕开就可以取下那张收据。

e.en: The X-ray revealed a small {perforation} in his intestine.
e.zh: X光检查显示他的肠道有一个小穿孔。

e.en: Without internet, we {perforce} relied on paper maps.
e.zh: 没有网络,我们只好被迫依靠纸质地图。

e.en: Budget cuts {perforce} delayed several planned upgrades.
e.zh: 预算削减不可避免地推迟了好几项计划中的升级。

e.en: The band will {perform} live in Tokyo next week.
e.zh: 那支乐队下周将在东京举行现场演出。

e.en: This laptop can {perform} demanding video editing tasks easily.
e.zh: 这台笔记本能轻松完成繁重的视频剪辑任务。

performance.t:
n. 表现，性能
n. 演出

e.en: Her {performance} in the play received glowing reviews.
e.zh: 她在那部话剧中的表演获得了好评如潮。

e.en: The new chip improves graphics {performance} by thirty percent.
e.zh: 新芯片让图形性能提升了百分之三十。

e.en: All weekend {performances} of the musical sold out quickly.
e.zh: 这部音乐剧周末的所有场次都很快售罄。

e.en: Recent benchmark {performances} show the model leading the pack.
e.zh: 近期的基准测试成绩显示该模型遥遥领先。

e.en: His apology felt {performative} rather than truly sincere.
e.zh: 他的道歉显得像是表演,而非真心诚意。

e.en: Critics called the campaign mostly {performative} activism.
e.zh: 评论人士称这场运动大多是作秀式的行动主义。

e.en: Judith Butler's theory of {performativity} reshaped gender studies.
e.zh: 朱迪斯·巴特勒的述行理论重塑了性别研究。

e.en: Online identity often involves a high degree of {performativity}.
e.zh: 网络身份往往带有相当强的表演性。

e.en: The surgeon {performed} the operation in under three hours.
e.zh: 那位外科医生在不到三小时内完成了手术。

e.en: She {performed} her new song at the festival last night.
e.zh: 她昨晚在音乐节上演唱了自己的新歌。

e.en: He is the most charismatic {performer} on the tour.
e.zh: 他是这次巡演中最具魅力的表演者。

e.en: The fund has been a strong {performer} for five years.
e.zh: 该基金连续五年表现亮眼。

e.en: Street {performers} entertained crowds along the busy boardwalk.
e.zh: 街头艺人在熙熙攘攘的海滨步道上为人群表演助兴。

e.en: Top {performers} on the team received bonuses this quarter.
e.zh: 团队中表现最出色的成员本季度拿到了奖金。

e.en: The band is {performing} live at the stadium tonight.
e.zh: 乐队今晚在体育场进行现场演出。

e.en: Our new model is {performing} better than expected on benchmarks.
e.zh: 我们的新模型在基准测试中表现超出预期。

performs.t: v. 执行，表演（第三人称单数）

e.en: She {performs} on Broadway twice a week.
e.zh: 她每周在百老汇演出两次。

e.en: This phone {performs} well even under heavy use.
e.zh: 这部手机在高强度使用下也表现良好。

perfume.t:
n. 香水，香气
v. 使…散发香气

e.en: She wore a light {perfume} to the interview.
e.zh: 她面试时擦了一点淡香水。

e.en: The roses {perfume} the entire garden in June.
e.zh: 六月时玫瑰让整座花园都飘满香气。

perfumed.t: adj. 有香味的，洒过香水的

e.en: He sent her a {perfumed} letter on her birthday.
e.zh: 他在她生日时寄了一封带香气的信。

e.en: The hotel lobby was softly {perfumed} with jasmine.
e.zh: 酒店大堂里淡淡飘着茉莉的香气。

e.en: The {perfumer} blended over forty essential oils for this scent.
e.zh: 这位调香师为这款香调混合了四十多种精油。

e.en: She trained as a {perfumer} in Grasse for five years.
e.zh: 她在格拉斯学习调香师课程整整五年。

e.en: We visited a small {perfumery} on the south coast of France.
e.zh: 我们参观了法国南海岸一家小型香水店。

e.en: His passion for {perfumery} began in his grandmother's shop.
e.zh: 他对香水制作的热情始于祖母的店铺。

e.en: The store sells designer {perfumes} at a discount.
e.zh: 这家店以折扣价出售名牌香水。

e.en: Lavender {perfumes} the air around the cottage.
e.zh: 薰衣草让小屋周围空气中弥漫着芳香。

e.en: He nodded {perfunctorily} and went back to his phone.
e.zh: 他敷衍地点了点头,又低头看手机。

e.en: She thanked the audience {perfunctorily} before leaving the stage.
e.zh: 她敷衍地向观众道了谢便走下舞台。

e.en: The manager gave a {perfunctory} apology and moved on.
e.zh: 经理敷衍地道了个歉就把话题带过去了。

e.en: His {perfunctory} review missed several obvious bugs.
e.zh: 他敷衍的审查漏掉了好几个明显的漏洞。

e.en: Surgeons {perfuse} the donor organ with a cold solution.
e.zh: 外科医生用冷溶液灌注供体器官。

e.en: Warm light seemed to {perfuse} the entire room at sunset.
e.zh: 日落时暖光仿佛弥漫了整个房间。

e.en: The patient's brain {perfusion} returned to normal after surgery.
e.zh: 患者术后脑部血流灌注恢复了正常。

e.en: They monitored tissue {perfusion} throughout the operation.
e.zh: 他们在整场手术中持续监测组织灌注情况。

pergamon.t: n. 佩加蒙（古希腊城市）

e.en: The {Pergamon} Altar is the highlight of the Berlin museum.
e.zh: 佩加蒙祭坛是柏林博物馆的镇馆之宝。

e.en: Ancient {Pergamon} rivaled Alexandria as a center of learning.
e.zh: 古佩加蒙曾是与亚历山大并驾齐驱的学术中心。

e.en: Roses climbed the wooden {pergola} above the patio.
e.zh: 玫瑰攀上了庭院上方的木质藤架。

e.en: They built a small {pergola} for shade in the backyard.
e.zh: 他们在后院搭了一个小藤架用来遮阴。

e.en: {Perhaps} we should reschedule the meeting for next week.
e.zh: 也许我们该把会议改到下周。

e.en: This is {perhaps} the best coffee I've had all year.
e.zh: 这大概是我今年喝过最好的咖啡了。

peri.t: 前缀. 表示"周围、附近"

e.en: In Persian myth, a {peri} is a beautiful winged spirit.
e.zh: 在波斯神话中,佩里是美丽的有翼精灵。

e.en: The poem describes a {peri} guarding the gates of paradise.
e.zh: 这首诗描写了一位守护天堂之门的仙女。

perianth.t: n. 花被（花萼与花冠总称）

e.en: The flower's {perianth} consists of six purple petals.
e.zh: 这朵花的花被由六片紫色花瓣组成。

e.en: Botanists examine the {perianth} to identify the species.
e.zh: 植物学家通过观察花被来鉴定物种。

e.en: The doctor detected fluid in the {pericardial} sac.
e.zh: 医生发现心包腔内有积液。

e.en: She underwent surgery to relieve {pericardial} pressure.
e.zh: 她接受了手术以缓解心包压力。

pericardium.t: n. 心包（包裹心脏的膜）

e.en: The {pericardium} is a thin sac surrounding the heart.
e.zh: 心包是包裹心脏的一层薄膜。

e.en: Inflammation of the {pericardium} can cause sharp chest pain.
e.zh: 心包发炎可能引起剧烈的胸痛。

pericle.t: n. 伯里克利（古希腊政治家，罕见拼写）

e.en: In Shakespeare's play, {Pericle} sails across the Mediterranean.
e.zh: 在莎士比亚剧中,佩里克尔斯航行穿越地中海。

e.en: The character of {Pericle} faces storms and shipwrecks throughout.
e.zh: 佩里克尔斯这个角色全程都在面对风暴与船难。

pericles.t: n. 伯里克利（古希腊雅典政治家）

e.en: {Pericles} led Athens during its golden age of democracy.
e.zh: 伯里克利在雅典民主黄金时代领导着这座城邦。

e.en: The funeral oration of {Pericles} is still studied today.
e.zh: 伯里克利的葬礼演说至今仍被人们研读。

perigee.t: n. 近地点（天体轨道离地最近处）

e.en: The moon looks larger when it reaches {perigee}.
e.zh: 月球到达近地点时看起来会更大。

e.en: Satellites travel fastest at their {perigee}.
e.zh: 卫星在近地点时运行速度最快。

perihelion.t: n. 近日点（行星轨道离太阳最近处）

e.en: Earth reaches its {perihelion} in early January each year.
e.zh: 地球每年一月初到达近日点。

e.en: The comet brightened dramatically near its {perihelion}.
e.zh: 那颗彗星在接近近日点时变得格外明亮。

peril.t:
n. 严重危险
v. 使处于险境

e.en: Climbers face real {peril} on the icy ridge.
e.zh: 登山者在结冰的山脊上面临真正的危险。

e.en: Ignoring the warning signs puts swimmers in {peril}.
e.zh: 无视警示牌会让游泳者陷入险境。

perilous.t: adj. 危险的，充满风险的

e.en: They made a {perilous} journey across the frozen lake.
e.zh: 他们冒险穿越了那片结冰的湖面。

e.en: Driving in this storm would be {perilous}.
e.zh: 在这种暴风雨中开车会非常危险。

e.en: The cliff edge was {perilously} close to the trail.
e.zh: 悬崖边离小道近得让人胆战心惊。

e.en: Our funds are running {perilously} low this month.
e.zh: 这个月我们的资金已经危险地见底了。

perilymph.t: n. 外淋巴液（内耳液体）

e.en: {Perilymph} fills the outer chambers of the inner ear.
e.zh: 外淋巴液充满内耳的外侧腔室。

e.en: Damage to {perilymph} flow can cause severe vertigo.
e.zh: 外淋巴液流动受损可能导致严重眩晕。

perimeter.t:
n. 周长；周界
n. 警戒区外围

e.en: Guards patrol the {perimeter} of the compound at night.
e.zh: 夜间警卫在大院周边巡逻。

e.en: Calculate the {perimeter} of a rectangle by adding all sides.
e.zh: 把所有边加起来就能算出长方形的周长。

perinatal.t: adj. 围产期的（分娩前后）

e.en: The clinic specializes in {perinatal} care for new mothers.
e.zh: 这家诊所专门提供围产期产妇护理。

e.en: Doctors monitor {perinatal} health closely in high-risk pregnancies.
e.zh: 医生会密切监测高危妊娠的围产期健康状况。

e.en: The doctor recommended {perineal} exercises after childbirth.
e.zh: 医生建议产后做会阴部运动。

e.en: He felt {perineal} discomfort after the long bike ride.
e.zh: 长时间骑行后他感到会阴部不适。

e.en: The nurse showed her how to care for the {perineum} postpartum.
e.zh: 护士教她产后如何护理会阴部。

e.en: Cycling for hours can put pressure on the {perineum}.
e.zh: 长时间骑车会对会阴部造成压力。

period.t:
n. 时期，阶段
n. 句号；月经

e.en: The Renaissance was a remarkable {period} in European history.
e.zh: 文艺复兴是欧洲历史上一个非凡的时期。

e.en: She tracks her {period} using a phone app.
e.zh: 她用手机应用追踪自己的月经周期。

e.en: The team holds {periodic} reviews to discuss progress.
e.zh: 团队会定期开会讨论进展。

e.en: Engineers recommend {periodic} maintenance every six months.
e.zh: 工程师建议每六个月进行一次定期维护。

periodical.t:
n. 期刊，定期刊物
adj. 定期的

e.en: The library subscribes to over a hundred academic {periodicals}.
e.zh: 这家图书馆订阅了一百多种学术期刊。

e.en: He writes a column for a monthly {periodical} on design.
e.zh: 他为一本月刊设计杂志撰写专栏。

e.en: The app syncs your data {periodically} in the background.
e.zh: 该应用会在后台定期同步你的数据。

e.en: Wildfires sweep through the region {periodically}.
e.zh: 野火会周期性地席卷这一地区。

e.en: Astronomers studied the {periodicity} of the binary star's eclipses.
e.zh: 天文学家研究了这颗双星掩食的周期性。

e.en: The {periodicity} of seasonal sales helps retailers plan inventory.
e.zh: 季节性销售的周期性帮助零售商规划库存。

periodization.t: n. 历史分期，分期划分

e.en: Historians debate the {periodization} of the Middle Ages.
e.zh: 历史学家对中世纪的分期划分仍有争议。

e.en: His training plan uses strict {periodization} for peak performance.
e.zh: 他的训练计划采用严格的周期化安排以达到最佳状态。

e.en: She visits the dentist twice a year for {periodontal} cleaning.
e.zh: 她每年去牙医那里做两次牙周清洁。

e.en: Smoking significantly increases the risk of {periodontal} disease.
e.zh: 吸烟会大大增加患牙周病的风险。

e.en: My dentist referred me to a {periodontist} for gum surgery.
e.zh: 我的牙医把我转给了牙周专科医生做牙龈手术。

e.en: The {periodontist} recommended deep cleaning for her receding gums.
e.zh: 牙周医生针对她牙龈萎缩的情况建议做深层洁治。

e.en: Untreated gingivitis can progress into {periodontitis}.
e.zh: 未经治疗的牙龈炎可能发展为牙周炎。

e.en: He's being treated for advanced {periodontitis}.
e.zh: 他正在接受晚期牙周炎的治疗。

periods.t: n. period 复数：时期；句号；月经

e.en: The museum showcases art from different historical {periods}.
e.zh: 这家博物馆展出来自不同历史时期的艺术品。

e.en: Many women experience cramps during their {periods}.
e.zh: 很多女性在月经期间会出现痛经。

perioperative.t: adj. 围手术期的（术前术后）

e.en: Nurses focus on {perioperative} care to prevent infections.
e.zh: 护士专注于围手术期护理以防止感染。

e.en: The hospital improved its {perioperative} workflow last year.
e.zh: 这家医院去年优化了围手术期的工作流程。

e.en: The {periosteum} supplies blood vessels to the bone surface.
e.zh: 骨膜为骨表面提供血管供应。

e.en: A bruise on the {periosteum} can be intensely painful.
e.zh: 骨膜挫伤可能会非常疼痛。

peripatetic.t: adj. 四处奔走的，巡回的

e.en: She leads a {peripatetic} life as a travel writer.
e.zh: 作为一名旅游作家,她过着四处漂泊的生活。

e.en: His {peripatetic} career took him to twelve countries.
e.zh: 他四处奔波的职业生涯把他带到了十二个国家。

peripheral.t:
adj. 外围的，次要的
n. 外围设备

e.en: The keyboard is a basic {peripheral} for any computer.
e.zh: 键盘是任何电脑的基本外设。

e.en: That issue is {peripheral} to our main concern today.
e.zh: 那个问题与我们今天的核心关注点关系不大。

e.en: He was only {peripherally} involved in the project.
e.zh: 他只是边缘性地参与了这个项目。

e.en: I noticed the movement {peripherally} as I read.
e.zh: 我看书时用余光察觉到了那个动作。

e.en: New housing developments sprang up on the city's {periphery}.
e.zh: 新的住宅区在城市边缘陆续兴起。

e.en: She remained on the {periphery} of the conversation all evening.
e.zh: 她整晚都游离在谈话的边缘。

periphrastic.t: adj. (措辞) 迂回的，啰嗦的

e.en: His writing style is {periphrastic} and hard to follow.
e.zh: 他的写作风格迂回啰嗦,让人难以理解。

e.en: English uses a {periphrastic} construction for the future tense.
e.zh: 英语用迂说结构来表达将来时。

periphyton.t: n. 周丛生物（附着水生生物）

e.en: {Periphyton} forms a slippery layer on submerged rocks.
e.zh: 周丛生物在水下岩石上形成滑滑的一层。

e.en: Scientists study {periphyton} to assess river water quality.
e.zh: 科学家通过研究周丛生物来评估河水水质。

e.en: The submarine raised its {periscope} to scan the horizon.
e.zh: 潜艇升起潜望镜扫视海平面。

e.en: Kids built a cardboard {periscope} for their science fair.
e.zh: 孩子们为科学展做了一个纸板潜望镜。

perish.t:
v. 死亡，丧生
v. (橡胶等) 老化变质

e.en: Without water, the crops will {perish} within days.
e.zh: 没有水,庄稼几天内就会枯死。

e.en: Many ancient languages {perish} when their last speakers die.
e.zh: 许多古老语言会随着最后一位使用者去世而消亡。

perishable.t:
adj. 易腐烂的
n. 易腐食品

e.en: Store {perishable} items like milk in the fridge immediately.
e.zh: 牛奶等易腐食品要立即放进冰箱。

e.en: The shop discounts {perishable} goods near closing time.
e.zh: 这家店在快打烊时会给易腐商品打折。

perishing.t:
adj. 刺骨寒冷的
adv. 极其（英式口语）

e.en: It's absolutely {perishing} outside, so wear a thick coat.
e.zh: 外面冷得要命,穿件厚外套吧。

e.en: The hikers huddled together in the {perishing} cold wind.
e.zh: 徒步者在刺骨寒风中紧紧挤在一起。

e.en: {Peristalsis} pushes food along the digestive tract automatically.
e.zh: 蠕动会自动推动食物通过消化道。

e.en: Doctors checked whether {peristalsis} had returned after the surgery.
e.zh: 医生检查手术后肠蠕动是否已经恢复。

e.en: The lab uses a {peristaltic} pump to move sensitive fluids.
e.zh: 实验室用蠕动泵输送敏感液体。

e.en: Weak {peristaltic} contractions can cause uncomfortable bloating.
e.zh: 蠕动收缩无力会引起腹胀不适。

peristyle.t: n. 列柱围廊，廊柱庭院

e.en: The Roman villa featured a beautiful {peristyle} around the courtyard.
e.zh: 这座罗马别墅的庭院四周有一圈漂亮的列柱廊。

e.en: Tourists rested in the shade of the temple's {peristyle}.
e.zh: 游客们在神庙列柱廊的阴影下休息。

e.en: The patient receives {peritoneal} dialysis at home each night.
e.zh: 这位病人每晚在家做腹膜透析。

e.en: Doctors found fluid in the {peritoneal} cavity during the scan.
e.zh: 医生在扫描中发现腹腔内有积液。

e.en: The {peritoneum} is the thin membrane lining the abdominal cavity.
e.zh: 腹膜是覆盖腹腔的一层薄膜。

e.en: Inflammation of the {peritoneum} requires immediate medical attention.
e.zh: 腹膜发炎需要立即就医。

e.en: A burst appendix can quickly lead to {peritonitis}.
e.zh: 阑尾破裂可能很快引发腹膜炎。

e.en: She was rushed into surgery to treat severe {peritonitis}.
e.zh: 她被紧急送去手术治疗严重的腹膜炎。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed a {peritonsillar} abscess behind her tonsil.
e.zh: 医生诊断她扁桃体后方有一个扁桃体周围脓肿。

e.en: Severe {peritonsillar} pain made it hard for him to swallow.
e.zh: 严重的扁桃体周围疼痛让他难以吞咽。

periwinkle.t:
n. 长春花
n. 滨螺（小型海螺）

e.en: She painted the bedroom walls a soft {periwinkle} blue.
e.zh: 她把卧室墙壁刷成了柔和的长春花蓝。

e.en: Tiny {periwinkle} flowers covered the garden path in spring.
e.zh: 春天里小小的长春花铺满了花园小径。

perjure.t: v. 作伪证（常用 perjure oneself）

e.en: He refused to {perjure} himself to protect his boss.
e.zh: 他拒绝为了保护老板而做伪证。

e.en: Witnesses who {perjure} themselves can face serious prison time.
e.zh: 做伪证的证人可能面临严重牢狱之灾。

perjured.t: adj. 犯伪证罪的，发假誓的

e.en: The judge dismissed the case after the witness {perjured} herself.
e.zh: 证人作伪证后,法官驳回了此案。

e.en: His {perjured} testimony eventually unraveled under cross-examination.
e.zh: 他的伪证最终在交叉询问中被拆穿。

e.en: The convicted {perjurer} lost his license to practice law.
e.zh: 那名被定罪的伪证者被吊销了律师执照。

e.en: Jurors quickly recognized the witness as a habitual {perjurer}.
e.zh: 陪审员很快看出这名证人是惯于作伪证的人。

perjurious.t: adj. 作伪证的；发假誓的

e.en: The lawyer warned against making any {perjurious} statements in court.
e.zh: 律师警告不要在法庭上做任何伪证陈述。

e.en: Her clearly {perjurious} answers angered the presiding judge.
e.zh: 她明显作伪的回答激怒了主审法官。

e.en: Lying under oath is a serious crime called {perjury}.
e.zh: 宣誓后说谎是一种叫做伪证罪的严重犯罪。

e.en: He was charged with {perjury} after contradicting his earlier statement.
e.zh: 他因推翻之前的陈述而被控伪证罪。

perk.t:
n. 额外福利
v. 振作；使活跃

e.en: Free lunch is a nice {perk} of working here.
e.zh: 免费午餐是在这里工作的一项不错的福利。

e.en: A strong coffee should {perk} you up before the meeting.
e.zh: 一杯浓咖啡能让你在开会前打起精神。

e.en: She answered the phone {perkily}, even at six in the morning.
e.zh: 即便是早上六点,她接电话也活泼有劲。

e.en: The host greeted guests {perkily} as they entered the studio.
e.zh: 主持人精神抖擞地迎接走进演播室的嘉宾。

e.en: Her natural {perkiness} made her a popular morning show host.
e.zh: 她天生的活泼劲儿让她成为受欢迎的晨间节目主持人。

e.en: The puppy's {perkiness} disappeared after the long car ride.
e.zh: 漫长的车程过后,小狗的活泼劲儿消失了。

perks.t: n. 额外福利（perk 的复数）

e.en: The job offers great {perks}, including unlimited vacation days.
e.zh: 这份工作有很棒的福利,包括无限假期。

e.en: Free gym access is one of the company's nicest {perks}.
e.zh: 免费健身房使用是公司最棒的福利之一。

perky.t: adj. 活泼的；自信开朗的

e.en: She gave a {perky} smile and waved at the camera.
e.zh: 她露出一个活泼的笑容,向镜头挥手。

e.en: The barista was surprisingly {perky} for a Monday morning.
e.zh: 周一早上这位咖啡师精神得让人意外。

e.en: Gardeners mix {perlite} into soil to improve drainage and aeration.
e.zh: 园艺爱好者会在土壤里掺珍珠岩以改善排水和透气。

e.en: The lightweight bag of {perlite} barely weighed anything at all.
e.zh: 那袋轻质珍珠岩几乎没有什么重量。

perm.t:
n. 烫发
v. 烫（头发）

e.en: She got a soft {perm} to add waves to her hair.
e.zh: 她烫了个柔和的卷发,让头发更有波浪感。

e.en: Eighties pop stars often sported a tight, curly {perm}.
e.zh: 八十年代的流行明星常常顶着一头紧致的卷发。

permaculture.t: n. 永续农业；朴门农法

e.en: The farm follows {permaculture} principles to work with natural ecosystems.
e.zh: 这个农场遵循朴门永续原则,顺应自然生态运作。

e.en: She took a weekend course on backyard {permaculture} design.
e.zh: 她参加了一个关于后院朴门永续设计的周末课程。

e.en: Melting {permafrost} releases huge amounts of methane into the atmosphere.
e.zh: 融化的永久冻土向大气释放出大量甲烷。

e.en: Houses in the Arctic must be built carefully on {permafrost}.
e.zh: 北极的房屋必须小心地建在永久冻土上。

e.en: Tattoos give people a sense of {permanence} they sometimes regret.
e.zh: 纹身给人一种永久感,有时也让人后悔。

e.en: Babies slowly learn the {permanence} of objects around them.
e.zh: 婴儿慢慢学会了周围物体的恒存性。

e.en: Few {permanences} exist in such a fast-changing tech industry.
e.zh: 在变化如此之快的科技行业里,几乎没有什么恒久不变的东西。

e.en: The philosopher discussed the small {permanences} that anchor daily life.
e.zh: 这位哲学家谈到了那些支撑日常生活的小小恒常之物。

e.en: Foster children deserve {permanency} and a stable family environment.
e.zh: 寄养儿童应得到稳定的归属和一个安定的家庭环境。
