e.en: After two years, her contract was upgraded to {permanency}.
e.zh: 两年后,她的合同被转为正式长期合同。

e.en: The accident left him with a {permanent} scar on his cheek.
e.zh: 那次事故在他脸颊上留下了一道永久的疤痕。

e.en: After six months, she was offered a {permanent} position.
e.zh: 六个月后,她得到了一份正式的长期职位。

e.en: The store has {permanently} closed its downtown location.
e.zh: 这家店已永久关闭了市中心的门店。

e.en: Deleting your account will {permanently} remove all of your photos.
e.zh: 删除账号会永久移除你所有的照片。

e.en: Chemists use potassium {permanganate} as a strong oxidizing agent.
e.zh: 化学家把高锰酸钾用作强氧化剂。

e.en: A drop of {permanganate} turned the water bright purple instantly.
e.zh: 一滴高锰酸盐立刻把水染成鲜亮的紫色。

e.en: Sandy soil has high {permeability}, so water drains away quickly.
e.zh: 沙质土壤渗透性高,水会很快排走。

e.en: Engineers tested the membrane's {permeability} to different gases.
e.zh: 工程师测试了这种膜对不同气体的透过性。

e.en: The driveway uses {permeable} paving to reduce rainwater runoff.
e.zh: 这条车道使用透水铺装来减少雨水径流。

e.en: Healthy skin is only slightly {permeable} to most chemicals.
e.zh: 健康的皮肤对大多数化学物质只有轻微的渗透性。

e.en: The smell of fresh bread began to {permeate} the entire house.
e.zh: 新鲜面包的香味开始弥漫整间屋子。

e.en: New safety rules now {permeate} every level of the company.
e.zh: 新的安全规定如今渗透到公司的每个层级。

e.en: The smell of garlic {permeated} every room in the apartment.
e.zh: 大蒜的味道弥漫了公寓里每一个房间。

e.en: A sense of optimism {permeated} the team after the big win.
e.zh: 大胜之后,一股乐观情绪弥漫了整个团队。

permeates.t: v. 渗透（第三人称单数）

e.en: A faint coffee aroma {permeates} the entire office in the morning.
e.zh: 早晨,一股淡淡的咖啡香弥漫整个办公室。

e.en: Concern about climate change {permeates} her latest novel.
e.zh: 对气候变化的担忧贯穿了她最新的小说。

e.en: A faint smell of jasmine was {permeating} the whole garden.
e.zh: 一股淡淡的茉莉花香正弥漫着整个花园。

e.en: AI is steadily {permeating} every corner of modern workplaces.
e.zh: 人工智能正在稳步渗透到现代职场的每个角落。

e.en: Engineers measured water {permeation} through the new waterproof fabric.
e.zh: 工程师测量了水在这种新防水面料中的渗透情况。

e.en: The {permeation} of social media into politics is undeniable.
e.zh: 社交媒体对政治的渗透已无可否认。

e.en: She {permed} her hair into tight curls for the wedding.
e.zh: 她为了婚礼把头发烫成了紧致的卷发。

e.en: His freshly {permed} hair was the talk of the office.
e.zh: 他刚烫好的头发成了办公室里的话题。

permian.t:
adj. 二叠纪的
n. 二叠纪

e.en: The {Permian} period ended with the largest mass extinction in history.
e.zh: 二叠纪以历史上最大规模的物种灭绝事件告终。

e.en: Texas oil drillers actively extract crude from the {Permian} basin.
e.zh: 得克萨斯的石油钻探者在二叠纪盆地积极开采原油。

e.en: The court debated the {permissibility} of the new evidence.
e.zh: 法庭就这份新证据是否可采纳进行了辩论。

e.en: Engineers questioned the {permissibility} of such high noise levels.
e.zh: 工程师们质疑如此高的噪声水平是否可被允许。

e.en: Casual jeans are {permissible} on Fridays at this office.
e.zh: 在这家公司,周五允许穿休闲牛仔裤。

e.en: The maximum {permissible} dose is clearly printed on the bottle.
e.zh: 瓶上清楚标明了最大允许剂量。

e.en: You need {permission} from your parents to join the trip.
e.zh: 你需要得到父母的同意才能参加这次旅行。

e.en: The app is asking for {permission} to access your location.
e.zh: 该应用正在请求获取你位置信息的权限。

e.en: Check the file's {permissions} if you can't open it.
e.zh: 如果打不开这个文件,检查一下它的权限设置。

e.en: The app requests too many {permissions} just to send messages.
e.zh: 这款应用只是发个消息却申请了太多权限。

e.en: Her parents were quite {permissive} about screen time.
e.zh: 她父母对她使用电子屏幕的时间相当宽容。

e.en: The company has a {permissive} dress code for engineers.
e.zh: 这家公司对工程师的着装要求相当宽松。

e.en: Critics blamed the school's {permissiveness} for the rowdy behavior.
e.zh: 批评者把学生的喧闹行为归咎于学校的放任态度。

e.en: There's a fine line between trust and outright {permissiveness}.
e.zh: 信任和彻底放任之间只有一线之隔。

permit.t:
n. 许可证
v. 允许

e.en: You need a parking {permit} to leave your car here.
e.zh: 你需要一张停车许可证才能把车停在这里。

e.en: The rules don't {permit} pets in this restaurant.
e.zh: 规定不允许宠物进入这家餐厅。

permits.t: n./v. 许可证；允许（第三人称单数）

e.en: Construction {permits} can take several weeks to be approved.
e.zh: 施工许可证可能要好几周才能审批下来。

e.en: The contract {permits} either party to cancel with notice.
e.zh: 合同允许任何一方在事先通知后取消。

permitted.t: v. 允许（过去式）；被允许的

e.en: Dogs are not {permitted} inside the children's play area.
e.zh: 儿童游乐区内不允许带狗进入。

e.en: She was finally {permitted} to take a short break.
e.zh: 她终于获准稍作休息。

permittee.t: n. 获得许可者；持证人

e.en: The {permittee} must display the license clearly at the entrance.
e.zh: 持证人必须在入口处醒目地展示许可证。

e.en: As the {permittee}, she is responsible for the event's safety.
e.zh: 作为持证人,她要对活动的安全负责。

e.en: Weather {permitting}, we'll have the picnic on Saturday afternoon.
e.zh: 天气允许的话,我们周六下午就去野餐。

e.en: The agency is {permitting} more outdoor concerts this summer.
e.zh: 主管部门今年夏天批准更多户外音乐会的举办。

e.en: Each {permutation} of the password takes hours to test.
e.zh: 每一种密码排列都要花几个小时来测试。

e.en: The team tried every {permutation} of the starting lineup.
e.zh: 教练尝试了首发阵容的每一种组合。

pernambuco.t: n. 伯南布哥（巴西州名）

e.en: We flew to {Pernambuco} for the carnival celebrations.
e.zh: 我们飞往伯南布哥参加狂欢节活动。

e.en: {Pernambuco} sits on Brazil's northeastern coast.
e.zh: 伯南布哥位于巴西东北部沿海地区。

e.en: Social media spreads {pernicious} rumors at alarming speed.
e.zh: 社交媒体以惊人的速度传播有害的谣言。

e.en: The drug had a slow but {pernicious} effect.
e.zh: 这种药物产生了缓慢却致命的影响。

pernickety.t: adj. 挑剔的；吹毛求疵的

e.en: My grandfather is {pernickety} about how his tea is brewed.
e.zh: 我爷爷对泡茶的方式特别讲究。

e.en: The editor is {pernickety} about every comma.
e.zh: 那位编辑对每一个逗号都吹毛求疵。

pernod.t: n. 潘诺（法国茴香酒品牌）

e.en: He ordered a {Pernod} with ice at the Paris café.
e.zh: 他在巴黎咖啡馆点了一杯加冰的潘诺酒。

e.en: The bar serves classic cocktails made with {Pernod}.
e.zh: 这家酒吧供应用潘诺酒调制的经典鸡尾酒。

e.en: The runner injured his {peroneal} tendon during the marathon.
e.zh: 那位跑者在马拉松中拉伤了腓骨肌腱。

e.en: Doctors examined the {peroneal} nerve for damage.
e.zh: 医生检查腓神经是否受损。

peronist.t:
n. 庇隆主义者
adj. 庇隆派的

e.en: The {Peronist} party still dominates Argentine politics today.
e.zh: 庇隆主义政党至今仍主导着阿根廷政坛。

e.en: She comes from a deeply {Peronist} family in Buenos Aires.
e.zh: 她来自布宜诺斯艾利斯一个根深蒂固的庇隆主义家庭。

peroration.t: n. 演讲的结束语；总结陈词

e.en: His {peroration} brought the entire audience to its feet.
e.zh: 他慷慨激昂的结语让全场观众起立鼓掌。

e.en: The lawyer ended with a stirring {peroration} about justice.
e.zh: 律师以一段关于正义的激昂收场白结束了辩护。

e.en: Scientists used {peroxidase} to detect the protein in samples.
e.zh: 科学家用过氧化物酶来检测样本中的蛋白质。

e.en: Horseradish {peroxidase} is common in immunoassay kits.
e.zh: 辣根过氧化物酶常用于免疫检测试剂盒。

e.en: Pour a little {peroxide} on the cut to clean it.
e.zh: 在伤口上倒一点双氧水清洁一下。

e.en: She bleached her hair with {peroxide} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天她用双氧水把头发漂白了。

e.en: Police arrested the {perp} just two blocks from the bank.
e.zh: 警方在距银行仅两个街区处逮捕了嫌犯。

e.en: Detectives are still searching for the {perp} on camera.
e.zh: 警探仍在追查监控录像中的那名嫌犯。

perpendicular.t:
adj. 垂直的
n. 垂线

e.en: Draw a line {perpendicular} to the base of the triangle.
e.zh: 画一条与三角形底边垂直的直线。

e.en: The cliff rose almost {perpendicular} from the sea.
e.zh: 悬崖几乎垂直地从海面升起。

e.en: The two streets cross {perpendicularly} at the main square.
e.zh: 两条街在主广场处垂直交叉。

e.en: Hold the brush {perpendicularly} to the canvas for clean strokes.
e.zh: 将画笔垂直于画布,笔触才会干净利落。

e.en: Hackers continue to {perpetrate} fraud against elderly users.
e.zh: 黑客持续对老年用户实施诈骗。

e.en: He was accused of helping {perpetrate} the massive scam.
e.zh: 他被指控协助实施了那起大规模骗局。

e.en: The {perpetration} of the crime was caught on security cameras.
e.zh: 作案过程被监控摄像头完整记录下来。

e.en: Investigators traced the {perpetration} back to an inside job.
e.zh: 调查人员发现案件是内部人员所为。

e.en: Police are still searching for the {perpetrator} of the robbery.
e.zh: 警方仍在搜捕这起抢劫案的犯罪嫌疑人。

e.en: Surveillance footage clearly shows the {perpetrator}'s face.
e.zh: 监控录像清楚地拍到了作案者的脸。

e.en: He lives in a state of {perpetual} anxiety about money.
e.zh: 他终日为钱财处于焦虑之中。

e.en: The startup promises {perpetual} access for early subscribers.
e.zh: 这家创业公司承诺早期订阅者可永久使用。

e.en: My inbox is {perpetually} flooded with newsletters I never read.
e.zh: 我的邮箱里永远塞满了我从不看的订阅邮件。

e.en: Teenagers seem {perpetually} glued to their phones.
e.zh: 青少年似乎永远离不开手机。

e.en: Stereotypes in movies {perpetuate} harmful gender roles.
e.zh: 电影中的刻板印象延续了有害的性别角色观念。

e.en: The new policy may {perpetuate} existing inequalities.
e.zh: 这项新政策可能会延续现有的不平等。

e.en: Tabloid coverage {perpetuated} the myth for decades.
e.zh: 小报报道使这个传言延续了数十年。

e.en: The system has {perpetuated} the wage gap between genders.
e.zh: 这套制度延续了性别间的薪资差距。

perpetuates.t: v. 使延续（第三人称单数）

e.en: Algorithmic bias {perpetuates} discrimination in hiring decisions.
e.zh: 算法偏见在招聘决策中延续了歧视现象。

e.en: This narrative {perpetuates} a dangerous misunderstanding of history.
e.zh: 这种叙述延续了对历史的危险误解。

e.en: The textbook is criticized for {perpetuating} outdated stereotypes.
e.zh: 这本教科书因延续过时的刻板印象而受到批评。

e.en: Are we {perpetuating} the problem by staying silent?
e.zh: 我们保持沉默是不是在助长这个问题?

e.en: Activists oppose the {perpetuation} of unfair labor practices.
e.zh: 活动人士反对延续不公平的劳工做法。

e.en: His writing contributed to the {perpetuation} of the legend.
e.zh: 他的著作助推了这个传说的延续。

e.en: The donor funded the scholarship in {perpetuity}.
e.zh: 捐赠人为这项奖学金提供了永久性资金。

e.en: The land is protected from development in {perpetuity}.
e.zh: 这片土地受到永久保护,免遭开发。

perpignan.t: n. 佩皮尼昂（法国城市）

e.en: We took the train south to {Perpignan} near the Spanish border.
e.zh: 我们坐火车南下到靠近西班牙边境的佩皮尼昂。

e.en: {Perpignan} is famous for its Catalan culture and cuisine.
e.zh: 佩皮尼昂以其加泰罗尼亚文化和美食而闻名。

e.en: The sudden change in his behavior continues to {perplex} me.
e.zh: 他行为的突然转变让我至今困惑不解。

e.en: Math problems like this often {perplex} my students.
e.zh: 这类数学题常常让我的学生摸不着头脑。

e.en: She looked {perplexed} when I explained the new software.
e.zh: 我解释新软件时,她一脸困惑。

e.en: Doctors were {perplexed} by the patient's strange symptoms.
e.zh: 医生们对病人怪异的症状感到不解。

e.en: The most {perplexing} part of the case was the missing key.
e.zh: 这案子最令人困惑的地方就是钥匙不见了。

e.en: Quantum physics can be deeply {perplexing} to beginners.
e.zh: 量子物理对初学者来说可能极其费解。

e.en: He stared at the contract in obvious {perplexity}.
e.zh: 他盯着合同,显得一脸困惑。

e.en: Researchers measure model quality using {perplexity} scores.
e.zh: 研究人员使用困惑度分数来衡量模型质量。

e.en: A company car is a common {perquisite} for senior executives.
e.zh: 配车是高管们常见的一项福利。

e.en: Free meals are a nice {perquisite} of working here.
e.zh: 在这里工作有提供免费餐这项不错的福利。

perrier.t: n. 巴黎水（矿泉水品牌）

e.en: I'll have a {Perrier} with lemon, please.
e.zh: 请给我来一瓶加柠檬的巴黎水。

e.en: The restaurant only serves {Perrier} as sparkling water.
e.zh: 这家餐厅的气泡水只供应巴黎水。

perry.t:
n. 梨酒
n. 佩里（人名）

e.en: The orchard sells homemade {perry} every autumn.
e.zh: 这家果园每年秋天都会售卖自制的梨酒。

e.en: English {perry} tastes like cider but is made from pears.
e.zh: 英式梨酒口感像苹果酒,但是用梨子酿造的。

e.en: Authoritarian regimes often {persecute} journalists who tell the truth.
e.zh: 专制政权常常迫害讲真话的记者。

e.en: It is illegal to {persecute} anyone for their religious beliefs.
e.zh: 因宗教信仰迫害他人是违法的。

e.en: Many minority groups have been {persecuted} throughout history.
e.zh: 历史上许多少数群体都曾遭受迫害。

e.en: She felt {persecuted} by her constantly critical coworkers.
e.zh: 她觉得不断挑剔的同事是在针对她。

persecutes.t: v. 迫害（第三人称单数）

e.en: The regime openly {persecutes} religious minorities.
e.zh: 该政权公然迫害宗教少数群体。

e.en: No fair government {persecutes} citizens for peaceful protest.
e.zh: 任何公正的政府都不会因和平抗议而迫害公民。

e.en: The government was accused of {persecuting} political opponents.
e.zh: 政府被指控迫害政治异见人士。

e.en: Stop {persecuting} him over a tiny mistake from years ago.
e.zh: 别再为多年前的小错纠缠他了。

e.en: Her family fled religious {persecution} in the 1930s.
e.zh: 她的家人在三十年代为躲避宗教迫害而逃离。

e.en: Refugees often arrive carrying scars of past {persecution}.
e.zh: 难民们常常带着过去遭受迫害的伤痕到来。

e.en: History books document the {persecutions} suffered by early Christians.
e.zh: 史书记载了早期基督徒所遭受的种种迫害。

e.en: The museum chronicles {persecutions} across many centuries.
e.zh: 这座博物馆记录了数个世纪以来的种种迫害事件。

e.en: The former {persecutor} was eventually brought to trial.
e.zh: 那名昔日的迫害者最终被送上了法庭。

e.en: She forgave her childhood {persecutor} after many years.
e.zh: 多年之后,她原谅了童年时欺凌她的人。

persephone.t: n. 珀耳塞福涅（希腊神话冥后）

e.en: In Greek myth, {Persephone} returns from the underworld each spring.
e.zh: 在希腊神话中,珀耳塞福涅每年春天从冥界归来。

e.en: Hades abducted {Persephone} and made her queen of the dead.
e.zh: 哈迪斯掳走了珀耳塞福涅,让她成为冥后。

perseus.t: n. 珀尔修斯（希腊神话英雄）

e.en: {Perseus} slew Medusa using a mirrored shield.
e.zh: 珀耳修斯用一面镜面盾牌斩杀了美杜莎。

e.en: Astronomers spotted a meteor shower in the {Perseus} constellation.
e.zh: 天文学家在英仙座观测到一场流星雨。

e.en: Her {perseverance} through years of rejection finally paid off.
e.zh: 多年屡遭拒绝后,她的坚持终于得到了回报。

e.en: Learning a language requires patience and {perseverance}.
e.zh: 学一门语言需要耐心和毅力。

e.en: The book celebrates the small daily {perseverances} of working mothers.
e.zh: 这本书赞颂了职场母亲日常生活中的种种坚持。

e.en: Their quiet {perseverances} eventually changed the entire industry.
e.zh: 他们默默的坚持最终改变了整个行业。

persevere.t: v. 坚持不懈；锲而不舍

e.en: You have to {persevere} even when progress feels invisible.
e.zh: 即使看不到进展,你也必须坚持下去。

e.en: Despite repeated failures, the team continued to {persevere}.
e.zh: 尽管屡次失败,团队仍坚持不懈。

e.en: She is a {persevering} student who never gives up on a problem.
e.zh: 她是个坚持不懈的学生,从不轻易放弃难题。

e.en: Thanks for {persevering} through this long meeting with me.
e.zh: 谢谢你陪我熬过这场漫长的会议。

e.en: Ancient {Persia} once stretched from Egypt to India.
e.zh: 古代波斯帝国疆域曾从埃及一直延伸到印度。

e.en: The carpets of {Persia} are famous around the world.
e.zh: 波斯地毯闻名于世。

persian.t:
adj. 波斯的
n. 波斯人；波斯语

e.en: She speaks {Persian} fluently with her grandparents.
e.zh: 她能和祖父母流利地用波斯语交流。

e.en: The cafe serves traditional {Persian} stews and rice dishes.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆供应传统的波斯炖菜和米饭料理。

e.en: The dinner party was full of light {persiflage} and laughter.
e.zh: 晚宴上充满了轻松的调侃和欢声笑语。

e.en: His charming {persiflage} hid a sharp critical mind.
e.zh: 他迷人的玩笑话掩藏着一个犀利的批判头脑。

e.en: Mom always washes the towels with {Persil} detergent.
e.zh: 妈妈总是用宝莹洗衣粉来洗毛巾。

e.en: A box of {Persil} costs more than the supermarket brand.
e.zh: 一盒宝莹洗衣粉比超市自有品牌贵。

e.en: I bit into a ripe {persimmon} straight from the tree.
e.zh: 我从树上摘了一颗熟透的柿子直接咬了一口。

e.en: An unripe {persimmon} will make your mouth pucker instantly.
e.zh: 没熟的柿子会让你的嘴瞬间发涩。

e.en: The error messages {persist} even after restarting the app.
e.zh: 即使重启应用，错误信息仍然存在。

e.en: You need to {persist} if you want to learn a new language.
e.zh: 想学一门新语言，你必须坚持下去。

e.en: She {persisted} with her startup despite three failed launches.
e.zh: 尽管三次发布失败，她仍坚持经营自己的初创公司。

e.en: The bug {persisted} in the latest update.
e.zh: 这个漏洞在最新版本中依然存在。

e.en: Her {persistence} eventually paid off with a job offer.
e.zh: 她的坚持最终换来了一份工作录用。

e.en: The database uses local {persistence} to save user settings.
e.zh: 该数据库使用本地持久化来保存用户设置。

e.en: The framework supports multiple {persistences} for different storage backends.
e.zh: 该框架支持多种持久化方案，适配不同的存储后端。

e.en: Various {persistences} were tested before choosing PostgreSQL.
e.zh: 在选择 PostgreSQL 之前，团队测试了多种持久化方案。

e.en: He's a {persistent} salesperson who never takes no for an answer.
e.zh: 他是个执着的销售员，从不接受拒绝。

e.en: The app shows a {persistent} notification at the top.
e.zh: 该应用在顶部显示一条常驻通知。

e.en: The website {persistently} crashes whenever I upload large files.
e.zh: 每当我上传大文件时，这个网站就会反复崩溃。

e.en: She {persistently} asked for a refund until the company agreed.
e.zh: 她不停地要求退款，直到公司同意为止。

e.en: The team is {persisting} with the original design despite criticism.
e.zh: 尽管受到批评，团队仍坚持原本的设计方案。

e.en: Issues with login are {persisting} on Android devices.
e.zh: 安卓设备上的登录问题仍在持续。

persists.t: v. 持续（第三人称单数）

e.en: If the problem {persists}, please contact customer support.
e.zh: 如果问题仍然存在，请联系客户支持。

e.en: She {persists} in believing the project will succeed.
e.zh: 她始终坚信这个项目会成功。

persnickety.t: adj. 挑剔的；讲究细节的

e.en: My boss is {persnickety} about email formatting and punctuation.
e.zh: 我老板对邮件格式和标点非常挑剔。

e.en: The cat is {persnickety} about which brand of food she'll eat.
e.zh: 那只猫对吃哪个牌子的猫粮非常挑食。

e.en: She's the kindest {person} I've ever met.
e.zh: 她是我见过最善良的人。

e.en: I prefer to discuss this in {person} rather than over email.
e.zh: 这件事我更想当面谈，而不是发邮件。

e.en: His online {persona} is very different from his real personality.
e.zh: 他在网上的形象和他真实的性格完全不同。

e.en: The designer created a user {persona} for the new app.
e.zh: 设计师为这款新应用创建了一个用户画像。

personable.t: adj. 讨人喜欢的；有魅力的

e.en: The new manager is {personable} and easy to talk to.
e.zh: 新来的经理为人和善，很好相处。

e.en: Customers love her because she's so {personable}.
e.zh: 顾客都很喜欢她，因为她待人亲切。

personae.t: n. persona 的复数；多个人设

e.en: Many actors maintain different {personae} for different roles.
e.zh: 许多演员会为不同角色塑造不同的形象。

e.en: Social media lets users craft multiple online {personae}.
e.zh: 社交媒体让用户可以打造多个网络身份。

e.en: A famous {personage} from the film industry attended the gala.
e.zh: 一位电影界的知名人物出席了这场晚会。

e.en: The mayor is an important {personage} in this small town.
e.zh: 市长在这个小镇上是位重要人物。

e.en: Please don't share my {personal} information with anyone.
e.zh: 请不要把我的个人信息透露给任何人。

e.en: This is just my {personal} opinion, not the company's view.
e.zh: 这只是我的个人看法，不代表公司立场。

e.en: The app offers deep {personalisation} for your home screen.
e.zh: 该应用为主屏幕提供了深度个性化设置。

e.en: Email {personalisation} significantly improves open rates.
e.zh: 邮件个性化能大幅提升打开率。

personalisations.t: n. 个性化设置（复数，英式）

e.en: The site lets users save multiple {personalisations} for different moods.
e.zh: 该网站允许用户为不同心情保存多种个性化设置。

e.en: Theme {personalisations} are synced across all your devices.
e.zh: 主题的个性化设置会在你所有设备间同步。

personalise.t: v. 个性化定制（英式拼写）

e.en: You can {personalise} the dashboard with your favorite widgets.
e.zh: 你可以用喜爱的小工具来个性化你的仪表板。

e.en: Brands often {personalise} emails using the customer's first name.
e.zh: 品牌常常用客户的名字来个性化邮件内容。

personalised.t: adj. 定制的；个性化的（英式）

e.en: Spotify creates a {personalised} playlist based on your listening history.
e.zh: Spotify 会根据你的听歌记录生成个性化播放列表。

e.en: She gave him a {personalised} mug with his name on it.
e.zh: 她送了他一个印着名字的个性化马克杯。

personalises.t: v. personalise 的第三人称单数

e.en: The algorithm {personalises} ads based on your browsing behavior.
e.zh: 该算法会根据你的浏览行为来个性化广告。

e.en: Netflix {personalises} the home page for every viewer.
e.zh: Netflix 会为每位观众个性化首页内容。

e.en: She spent hours {personalising} her gaming character's outfit.
e.zh: 她花了好几个小时给游戏角色搭配个性化装扮。

e.en: The team is {personalising} the user experience using machine learning.
e.zh: 团队正在用机器学习来个性化用户体验。

personalism.t: n. 人格主义（哲学流派）

e.en: His philosophy emphasizes {personalism} and human dignity above all else.
e.zh: 他的哲学最看重人格主义与人的尊严。

e.en: {Personalism} influenced Catholic social teaching in the twentieth century.
e.zh: 人格主义影响了二十世纪的天主教社会教义。

personalistic.t: adj. 人格主义的；强调个人的

e.en: His leadership style is highly {personalistic} rather than institutional.
e.zh: 他的领导风格非常个人化，缺乏制度化色彩。

e.en: The regime has a {personalistic} structure centered on one leader.
e.zh: 该政权采用以单一领袖为中心的人格化结构。

personalities.t: n. personality 的复数；性格；名人

e.en: The two sisters have completely different {personalities}.
e.zh: 这对姐妹的性格截然不同。

e.en: Several TV {personalities} attended the charity event.
e.zh: 几位电视名人出席了这场慈善活动。

personality.t:
n. 个性；性格
n. 名人

e.en: She has a bubbly {personality} that lights up the room.
e.zh: 她活泼开朗的性格能照亮整个房间。

e.en: The dog has so much {personality} for such a small animal.
e.zh: 这只小狗虽然个头不大，性格却很鲜明。

e.en: AI-driven {personalization} is reshaping how we shop online.
e.zh: AI 驱动的个性化正在重塑我们的网购方式。

e.en: The new feature offers more {personalization} for your notifications.
e.zh: 新功能让你的通知设置更加个性化。

e.en: Save your favorite {personalizations} as presets for quick access.
e.zh: 将你喜欢的个性化设置存为预设，便于快速调用。

e.en: The app supports custom theme {personalizations} for premium users.
e.zh: 该应用为高级用户提供自定义主题的个性化方案。

personalize.t: v. 个性化定制；私人化

e.en: You can {personalize} your iPhone home screen with custom icons.
e.zh: 你可以用自定义图标来个性化 iPhone 主屏幕。

e.en: Restaurants {personalize} the dining experience for repeat customers.
e.zh: 餐厅会为回头客提供个性化的就餐体验。

e.en: Amazon shows {personalized} recommendations based on your purchase history.
e.zh: 亚马逊会根据你的购买记录显示个性化推荐。

e.en: He received a {personalized} jersey with his name printed on it.
e.zh: 他收到了一件印着自己名字的个性化球衣。

personalizes.t: v. personalize 的第三人称单数

e.en: The chatbot {personalizes} responses based on previous conversations.
e.zh: 这款聊天机器人会根据先前的对话来个性化回复。

e.en: Her teaching style {personalizes} learning for each student.
e.zh: 她的教学风格会为每位学生量身定制学习方案。

e.en: I'm {personalizing} my lock screen with photos from the trip.
e.zh: 我正在用旅行的照片个性化我的锁屏。

e.en: Brands are {personalizing} marketing messages using customer data.
e.zh: 品牌正利用客户数据来个性化营销信息。

e.en: {Personally}, I think the new design is much better.
e.zh: 就我个人而言，我觉得新设计要好得多。

e.en: The CEO {personally} apologized to the affected customers.
e.zh: 首席执行官亲自向受影响的客户道歉。

personhood.t: n. 人格；作为人的身份

e.en: The debate centers on when legal {personhood} begins.
e.zh: 这场争论的核心在于法律人格何时开始。

e.en: Some philosophers argue great apes deserve recognition of {personhood}.
e.zh: 一些哲学家认为大型猿类应被承认具有人格。

e.en: She is the {personification} of patience and kindness.
e.zh: 她是耐心与善良的化身。

e.en: In the poem, autumn is a {personification} of melancholy.
e.zh: 诗中，秋天是忧郁情感的拟人化。

personifications.t: n. 化身（复数）；拟人形象

e.en: Greek mythology is full of {personifications} of natural forces.
e.zh: 希腊神话中充满了对自然力量的拟人化形象。

e.en: The four seasons appear as {personifications} in the painting.
e.zh: 画中四季以拟人化的形象出现。

personified.t:
adj. 活生生的典型
v. 拟人化（过去式）

e.en: With his calm demeanor, he {personified} professionalism.
e.zh: 他举止沉稳，正是专业精神的化身。

e.en: In the cartoon, the sun is {personified} as a smiling face.
e.zh: 在动画里，太阳被拟人化成一张笑脸。

personifies.t: v. personify 的第三人称单数

e.en: Her dedication {personifies} what it means to be a great teacher.
e.zh: 她的奉献精神正是优秀教师的真实写照。

e.en: This logo {personifies} the brand's playful spirit.
e.zh: 这个标志体现了品牌活泼的精神。

e.en: Writers often {personify} nature to make scenes more vivid.
e.zh: 作家常将自然拟人化，使场景更加生动。

e.en: Olympic athletes {personify} discipline and dedication.
e.zh: 奥运选手正是自律与奉献精神的化身。

e.en: The statue stands {personifying} liberty and freedom.
e.zh: 这座雕像矗立着，象征着自由与解放。

e.en: She gave a speech {personifying} the company's core values.
e.zh: 她发表的演讲展现了公司核心价值观的化身。

personnel.t: n. 全体人员；人事部门

e.en: All {personnel} must complete the safety training by Friday.
e.zh: 所有员工必须在周五前完成安全培训。

e.en: The {personnel} department handles hiring and benefits.
e.zh: 人事部门负责招聘和员工福利事务。

e.en: Different {personnels} from each branch attended the conference.
e.zh: 来自各分公司的不同人员出席了这次会议。

e.en: Military {personnels} were deployed to assist with disaster relief.
e.zh: 军方人员被派往协助救灾工作。

perspectival.t: adj. 透视的；视角相关的

e.en: The artist used {perspectival} techniques to create depth in the painting.
e.zh: 画家运用透视技法营造画面的纵深感。

e.en: His argument is {perspectival} rather than based on objective facts.
e.zh: 他的论点带有视角性，而非建立在客观事实之上。

perspective.t:
n. 视角；观点
n. 透视法

e.en: Traveling abroad gave me a new {perspective} on life.
e.zh: 出国旅行让我对生活有了全新的视角。

e.en: From a business {perspective}, the merger makes a lot of sense.
e.zh: 从商业角度来看，这次合并非常合理。

e.en: The book offers fresh {perspectives} on modern parenting.
e.zh: 这本书为现代育儿提供了全新的视角。

e.en: Diverse {perspectives} make our team stronger and more creative.
e.zh: 多元的视角让我们团队更强大、更有创造力。

e.en: The artwork was protected by a clear {perspex} cover.
e.zh: 这件艺术品被一块透明亚克力盖保护着。

e.en: They installed {perspex} screens at every checkout counter.
e.zh: 他们在每个收银台都安装了亚克力隔板。

perspicacious.t: adj. 有洞察力的；敏锐的

e.en: Her {perspicacious} analysis impressed everyone at the meeting.
e.zh: 她敏锐的分析让会上的每个人都印象深刻。

e.en: The {perspicacious} investor spotted the trend before anyone else.
e.zh: 这位眼光独到的投资者比所有人都更早发现了趋势。

e.en: The detective's {perspicacity} helped solve the case quickly.
e.zh: 侦探的敏锐洞察力让案件迅速告破。

e.en: She's known for her {perspicacity} in evaluating job candidates.
e.zh: 她以评估求职者时的敏锐眼光而闻名。

e.en: The professor explained the theory with admirable {perspicuity}.
e.zh: 教授以令人钦佩的清晰度阐释了这一理论。

e.en: Good documentation requires {perspicuity} above all else.
e.zh: 好的文档最重要的是表达清晰。

e.en: His writing is {perspicuous} and easy for beginners to follow.
e.zh: 他的文笔清晰明了，初学者也能轻松看懂。

e.en: The instructions were {perspicuous} enough for a child to understand.
e.zh: 这些说明清晰得连小孩都能看明白。

e.en: After the workout, his shirt was soaked with {perspiration}.
e.zh: 锻炼结束后，他的衬衫被汗水浸透了。

e.en: Success requires inspiration but also a lot of {perspiration}.
e.zh: 成功需要灵感，但更需要大量的汗水。

e.en: Heavy {perspirations} soaked through his shirt during the marathon.
e.zh: 马拉松途中,大量汗水浸透了他的衬衫。

e.en: The doctor noted unusual {perspirations} as a symptom of fever.
e.zh: 医生注意到异常出汗是发烧的一种症状。

e.en: Runners {perspire} heavily even in cool weather.
e.zh: 即使天气凉爽,跑者也会大量出汗。

e.en: Spicy food makes me {perspire} within minutes.
e.zh: 吃辣的东西没几分钟我就开始出汗。

perspiring.t: v. perspire 的现在分词；冒汗的

e.en: He arrived {perspiring} after climbing six flights of stairs.
e.zh: 他爬了六层楼,到达时汗流浃背。

e.en: The {perspiring} chef wiped his forehead with a towel.
e.zh: 汗流满面的厨师用毛巾擦了擦额头。

e.en: My boss is usually {persuadable} if you bring solid data.
e.zh: 只要拿出可靠数据,我老板通常是可以被说服的。

e.en: Swing voters are the most {persuadable} group in this election.
e.zh: 摇摆选民是本次选举中最容易被说服的群体。

e.en: I couldn't {persuade} her to join the gym with me.
e.zh: 我没能说服她和我一起去健身房。

e.en: Good ads {persuade} customers without feeling pushy.
e.zh: 好的广告能说服顾客而不显得强势。

persuaded.t: v. persuade 的过去式；被说服的

e.en: She finally {persuaded} her parents to let her study abroad.
e.zh: 她终于说服父母让她出国留学。

e.en: I'm not {persuaded} that this app actually saves time.
e.zh: 我并不相信这款应用真的能节省时间。

e.en: As a salesman, he was a remarkably effective {persuader}.
e.zh: 作为销售员,他是个出奇有效的说客。

e.en: Free shipping is often the deciding {persuader} for online shoppers.
e.zh: 免运费往往是网购者下单的决定性因素。

persuades.t: v. persuade 的第三人称单数

e.en: A confident pitch usually {persuades} investors more than fancy slides.
e.zh: 自信的演讲通常比华丽的幻灯片更能打动投资者。

e.en: Nothing {persuades} my cat to take her medicine.
e.zh: 没有任何办法能让我家猫乖乖吃药。

persuading.t: v. 说服；劝说（persuade 的现在分词）

e.en: She spent an hour {persuading} him to see a doctor.
e.zh: 她花了一个小时劝他去看医生。

e.en: {Persuading} teenagers to read books is harder than ever.
e.zh: 如今要说服青少年读书比以往任何时候都难。

persuasion.t:
n. 说服；劝说
n. 信念；信仰

e.en: It took some gentle {persuasion} to get him on the plane.
e.zh: 费了一番温柔的劝说才让他上飞机。

e.en: Marketing relies on {persuasion} more than raw information.
e.zh: 营销靠的更多是说服力,而非单纯的信息。

persuasions.t: n. 说服；信念（persuasion 的复数）

e.en: Voters of all political {persuasions} agreed on the new park.
e.zh: 各种政治立场的选民都对新公园表示支持。

e.en: His {persuasions} eventually convinced the team to try the new tool.
e.zh: 他的多番劝说最终让团队尝试了这款新工具。

persuasive.t: adj. 有说服力的；令人信服的

e.en: She made a {persuasive} case for working from home.
e.zh: 她为远程办公提出了很有说服力的理由。

e.en: The lawyer's closing argument was extremely {persuasive}.
e.zh: 律师的结案陈词极具说服力。

persuasively.t: adv. 有说服力地；令人信服地

e.en: He argued {persuasively} that the deadline should be extended.
e.zh: 他很有说服力地论证了应该延长截止日期。

e.en: The article {persuasively} explains why sleep matters more than coffee.
e.zh: 这篇文章令人信服地说明了睡眠比咖啡更重要。

e.en: The ad's {persuasiveness} comes from its honest tone.
e.zh: 这则广告的说服力来自于它真诚的语气。

e.en: Her quiet {persuasiveness} won over even skeptical clients.
e.zh: 她沉静的说服力甚至打动了持怀疑态度的客户。

pert.t:
adj. 俏皮的；活泼的
adj. 无礼的

e.en: She gave a {pert} reply that made everyone laugh.
e.zh: 她俏皮地回了一句,逗得大家都笑了。

e.en: The puppy tilted its head at a {pert} angle.
e.zh: 小狗俏皮地把头歪向一边。

e.en: These rules only {pertain} to full-time employees.
e.zh: 这些规定仅适用于全职员工。

e.en: Please skip questions that don't {pertain} to your situation.
e.zh: 请跳过与你情况无关的问题。

pertaining.t: v. 涉及；关于（pertain 的现在分词）

e.en: Documents {pertaining} to the case are stored in the cloud.
e.zh: 与该案件相关的文件都存储在云端。

e.en: She handles all matters {pertaining} to customer refunds.
e.zh: 她负责处理一切与客户退款有关的事务。

perth.t: n. 珀斯（澳大利亚/苏格兰城市）

e.en: We flew to {Perth} for a beach holiday last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们飞到珀斯度海滩假期。

e.en: {Perth} is the most isolated major city in the world.
e.zh: 珀斯是世界上最孤立的大城市。

e.en: We hiked through the rolling hills of {Perthshire} last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们徒步穿越了珀斯郡起伏的山丘。

e.en: {Perthshire} is known for its castles, lochs, and ancient forests.
e.zh: 珀斯郡以其城堡、湖泊和古老森林而闻名。

e.en: Her {pertinacious} questioning eventually uncovered the truth.
e.zh: 她锲而不舍的追问最终揭开了真相。

e.en: The reporter was {pertinacious} in chasing down the story.
e.zh: 那位记者在追踪这个新闻时非常执着。

e.en: His {pertinacity} in debugging finally fixed the elusive bug.
e.zh: 他调试时的执着最终解决了那个难以捉摸的错误。

e.en: She tackled the puzzle with surprising {pertinacity}.
e.zh: 她以惊人的执着解决了这道谜题。

e.en: I doubt the {pertinence} of that example to our discussion.
e.zh: 我怀疑那个例子和我们的讨论是否有关。

e.en: The judge questioned the {pertinence} of the witness's testimony.
e.zh: 法官质疑证人证词的相关性。

e.en: Please share any {pertinent} details before the meeting starts.
e.zh: 请在会议开始前分享任何相关细节。

e.en: That's a {pertinent} question — let me look into it.
e.zh: 这个问题问得很到位,我来研究一下。

e.en: She {pertinently} pointed out a flaw in the original plan.
e.zh: 她切中要害地指出了原计划中的一个缺陷。

e.en: The article {pertinently} addresses concerns raised by users.
e.zh: 这篇文章切题地回应了用户提出的担忧。

e.en: "Why should I?" she asked {pertly}, hands on hips.
e.zh: "我为什么要这么做?"她俏皮地双手叉腰反问道。

e.en: The toddler {pertly} refused to eat her vegetables.
e.zh: 那小孩子俏皮地拒绝吃蔬菜。

e.en: Loud noises tend to {perturb} the neighbor's cat.
e.zh: 巨大的声音往往会让邻居的猫感到不安。

e.en: Even bad reviews don't {perturb} her confidence.
e.zh: 即使差评也无法动摇她的自信。

e.en: He showed no {perturbation} when the server crashed mid-demo.
e.zh: 演示中途服务器崩溃时,他丝毫不显慌乱。

e.en: A small {perturbation} in the data changed the entire forecast.
e.zh: 数据中一个小小的扰动改变了整个预测。

e.en: She seemed {perturbed} by the unexpected email from her boss.
e.zh: 老板那封意外的邮件似乎让她有些不安。

e.en: The cat was {perturbed} by the new vacuum cleaner.
e.zh: 那只猫被新的吸尘器搞得心烦意乱。

e.en: Babies are vaccinated against {pertussis} in their first months.
e.zh: 婴儿在出生头几个月就要接种百日咳疫苗。

e.en: Cases of {pertussis} have risen sharply this year.
e.zh: 今年百日咳的病例急剧上升。

e.en: We trekked to Machu Picchu during our trip to {Peru}.
e.zh: 我们去秘鲁旅行时徒步到了马丘比丘。

e.en: {Peru} is famous for its ceviche and Andean cuisine.
e.zh: 秘鲁以酸橘汁腌鱼和安第斯美食而闻名。

perugia.t: n. 佩鲁贾（意大利城市）

e.en: {Perugia} is a charming hilltop city in central Italy.
e.zh: 佩鲁贾是意大利中部一座迷人的山顶城市。

e.en: We attended a chocolate festival in {Perugia} last October.
e.zh: 去年十月我们参加了佩鲁贾的巧克力节。

e.en: A quick {perusal} of the contract revealed several issues.
e.zh: 快速浏览了一下合同,就发现了几个问题。

e.en: The report is available online for public {perusal}.
e.zh: 该报告已在网上公开供人查阅。

e.en: I like to {peruse} the menu before ordering anything.
e.zh: 我喜欢在点餐前仔细看看菜单。

e.en: Feel free to {peruse} our catalog at your leisure.
e.zh: 请随意慢慢翻阅我们的产品目录。

peruvian.t:
adj. 秘鲁的
n. 秘鲁人

e.en: We had dinner at a fantastic {Peruvian} restaurant downtown.
e.zh: 我们在市中心一家很棒的秘鲁餐厅吃了晚餐。

e.en: {Peruvian} textiles are known for their vibrant colors and patterns.
e.zh: 秘鲁的纺织品以其鲜艳的颜色和图案而闻名。

perv.t: n. 变态；色狼（pervert 的口语缩写）

e.en: Stop staring at strangers — you look like a total {perv}.
e.zh: 别盯着陌生人看,你看起来就像个变态。

e.en: She blocked the {perv} who kept messaging her online.
e.zh: 她拉黑了那个在网上不停骚扰她的变态。

e.en: The smell of fresh bread {pervades} the entire bakery.
e.zh: 新鲜面包的香味弥漫了整个烘焙店。

e.en: A sense of unease seemed to {pervade} the office.
e.zh: 一种不安的气氛似乎弥漫了整个办公室。

e.en: There's a {pervading} silence in the library at midnight.
e.zh: 午夜的图书馆里弥漫着一种无处不在的寂静。

e.en: A {pervading} smell of coffee greeted us at the door.
e.zh: 一进门,一股弥漫开来的咖啡香就扑面而来。

e.en: Smartphones have become {pervasive} in modern daily life.
e.zh: 智能手机在现代日常生活中已经无处不在。

e.en: There's a {pervasive} sense of anxiety among new graduates.
e.zh: 应届毕业生中弥漫着一种普遍的焦虑感。

e.en: AI tools are {pervasively} used across the tech industry now.
e.zh: 如今AI工具在科技行业被广泛使用。

e.en: Misinformation spreads {pervasively} on social media platforms.
e.zh: 虚假信息在社交媒体平台上广泛传播。

e.en: The {pervasiveness} of online ads has reached an annoying level.
e.zh: 网络广告的无孔不入已经到了令人厌烦的程度。

e.en: Researchers studied the {pervasiveness} of plastic in the ocean.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了塑料在海洋中的普遍存在程度。

pervasivenesses.t: n. 普遍性（pervasiveness 的复数）

e.en: The report compared the {pervasivenesses} of various pollutants in rivers.
e.zh: 该报告比较了多种污染物在河流中的普遍程度。

e.en: Sociologists debated the {pervasivenesses} of bias across different cultures.
e.zh: 社会学家讨论了偏见在不同文化中的普遍程度。

perverse.t: adj. 反常的；乖戾的；执意作对的

e.en: He takes a {perverse} pleasure in proving everyone wrong.
e.zh: 他以证明大家都错了为一种乖张的乐趣。

e.en: The new tax rule had a {perverse} effect on small businesses.
e.zh: 新的税收规定对小企业产生了反常的负面影响。

e.en: {Perversely}, the harder she tried, the worse her results became.
e.zh: 奇怪的是,她越努力,结果反而越糟。

e.en: He {perversely} chose the longest route home.
e.zh: 他偏偏选了回家最远的那条路。

perversion.t:
n. 歪曲；堕落
n. 性变态

e.en: Critics called the new policy a {perversion} of democracy.
e.zh: 批评人士称这项新政策是对民主的扭曲。

e.en: That summary is a complete {perversion} of what I actually said.
e.zh: 那个总结完全曲解了我原本所说的话。

perversities.t: n. 乖戾；反常（perversity 复数）

e.en: The tax code is full of strange {perversities} that hurt the poor.
e.zh: 税法中充满了各种伤害穷人的怪异反常之处。

e.en: Life has its own little {perversities} you just have to accept.
e.zh: 生活总有些古怪的反常之处,你只能接受。

e.en: With typical {perversity}, the printer jammed right before the deadline.
e.zh: 以一贯的反常,打印机偏偏在截止时间前卡纸了。

e.en: There's a strange {perversity} in choosing the slowest checkout line.
e.zh: 专挑最慢的收银队排,真是一种奇怪的反常。

pervert.t:
n. 变态者；色狼
v. 歪曲；使堕落

e.en: Don't let politicians {pervert} the original meaning of the law.
e.zh: 别让政客们歪曲这部法律的原意。

e.en: The man was arrested as a suspected {pervert} in the park.
e.zh: 那名男子在公园里因涉嫌猥亵被捕。

e.en: The dictator {perverted} the constitution to keep himself in power.
e.zh: 那位独裁者篡改宪法以维持自己的权力。

e.en: He has a {perverted} sense of humor that disturbs his coworkers.
e.zh: 他有一种让同事感到不适的扭曲幽默感。

pervious.t: adj. 可渗透的；能通过的

e.en: The garden uses {pervious} pavement to let rainwater soak in.
e.zh: 这个花园采用透水铺面,让雨水能渗入地下。

e.en: Sandy soil is highly {pervious} to water and nutrients.
e.zh: 沙质土壤对水和养分有很高的渗透性。

peseta.t: n. 比塞塔（西班牙旧货币）

e.en: My grandfather still keeps a few old {peseta} coins for memory.
e.zh: 我爷爷还留着几枚旧的比塞塔硬币作纪念。

e.en: Spain replaced the {peseta} with the euro back in 2002.
e.zh: 西班牙早在2002年就用欧元取代了比塞塔。

peshawar.t: n. 白沙瓦（巴基斯坦城市）

e.en: My uncle grew up in {Peshawar} near the Khyber Pass.
e.zh: 我叔叔在白沙瓦长大，靠近开伯尔山口。

e.en: The flight from Karachi to {Peshawar} takes about two hours.
e.zh: 从卡拉奇飞往白沙瓦大约需要两小时。

e.en: I can't get rid of these {pesky} mosquitoes in summer.
e.zh: 夏天我怎么也赶不走这些讨厌的蚊子。

e.en: The app keeps showing that {pesky} update reminder every day.
e.zh: 这款应用每天都弹出那个烦人的更新提醒。

e.en: The {peso} dropped sharply against the dollar last week.
e.zh: 上周比索对美元大幅下跌。

e.en: A bottle of water costs about twenty {pesos} here.
e.zh: 在这里一瓶水大约要二十比索。

e.en: The doctor recommended a {pessary} to support her pelvic organs.
e.zh: 医生建议使用子宫托来支撑她的盆腔器官。

e.en: She was fitted with a silicone {pessary} during the appointment.
e.zh: 她在就诊时安装了一个硅胶子宫托。

e.en: His constant {pessimism} drains the energy from every meeting.
e.zh: 他一贯的悲观情绪让每次开会都气氛低落。

e.en: There is growing {pessimism} about the economy among young workers.
e.zh: 年轻打工族对经济前景越来越悲观。

e.en: My brother is a {pessimist} who always expects the worst.
e.zh: 我哥是个悲观主义者，总是往最坏处想。

e.en: Even a {pessimist} would admit the new design looks great.
e.zh: 就连悲观的人也得承认这个新设计挺不错。

e.en: Analysts are {pessimistic} about chip sales in the coming quarter.
e.zh: 分析师对下季度的芯片销量持悲观态度。

e.en: Don't be so {pessimistic}—we still have time to finish.
e.zh: 别那么悲观，我们还有时间做完。

e.en: He shrugged {pessimistically} when asked about the project's chances.
e.zh: 被问到项目成功的可能时，他悲观地耸了耸肩。

e.en: The forecast {pessimistically} predicts another year of slow growth.
e.zh: 预测悲观地认为还会有一年增长缓慢。

e.en: Even the {pessimists} agree this quarter exceeded expectations.
e.zh: 连悲观派都承认本季度超出了预期。

e.en: Stock-market {pessimists} have been wrong for three years running.
e.zh: 看空股市的人已经连续三年判断失误了。

e.en: My little cousin can be a real {pest} at dinner.
e.zh: 我小表弟吃饭时真是个讨厌鬼。

e.en: Farmers spray crops to control insect {pests} in summer.
e.zh: 农民在夏天喷洒农药来防治害虫。

e.en: Don't {pester} your sister while she's studying for finals.
e.zh: 姐姐在准备期末考试时别去烦她。

e.en: Telemarketers keep {pestering} me with calls about car insurance.
e.zh: 推销员一直打电话烦我推销车险。

e.en: The farm switched to organic methods to avoid using {pesticide}.
e.zh: 这家农场改用有机方式以避免使用农药。

e.en: Residues of {pesticide} were detected on imported strawberries.
e.zh: 在进口草莓上检测出了农药残留。

e.en: Medieval Europe was repeatedly devastated by war and {pestilence}.
e.zh: 中世纪的欧洲屡次被战争和瘟疫摧残。

e.en: The novel describes a town gripped by mysterious {pestilence}.
e.zh: 小说描写了一座被神秘瘟疫笼罩的小镇。

e.en: The swamp gave off a {pestilent} smell after the flood.
e.zh: 洪水过后沼泽散发出一股令人作呕的恶臭。

e.en: He called the rumor a {pestilent} influence on the team.
e.zh: 他说那则谣言对团队是一种有害的影响。

e.en: Sailors feared the {pestilential} marshes along the tropical coast.
e.zh: 水手们害怕热带海岸沿线那片传染病肆虐的沼泽。

e.en: Online trolls can be a {pestilential} presence in any forum.
e.zh: 网络喷子在任何论坛都是令人厌恶的存在。

pestle.t:
n. 研杵
v. 用杵捣碎

e.en: Crush the garlic with a {pestle} until it's a paste.
e.zh: 用研杵把蒜捣成蒜泥。

e.en: My grandmother still uses a stone mortar and {pestle}.
e.zh: 我奶奶现在还在用石头做的研钵和研杵。

e.en: I tossed the pasta with homemade basil {pesto} and pine nuts.
e.zh: 我用自制的罗勒青酱和松子拌了意面。

e.en: This sandwich tastes amazing with a smear of {pesto}.
e.zh: 这款三明治抹上一层青酱味道超棒。

pet.t:
n. 宠物
v. 抚摸

e.en: Our family adopted a rescue dog as our first {pet}.
e.zh: 我家收养了一只救助犬作为第一只宠物。

e.en: She gently {petted} the cat curled up on her lap.
e.zh: 她轻轻抚摸着蜷在腿上的猫。

e.en: A single rose {petal} drifted onto the wedding cake.
e.zh: 一片玫瑰花瓣飘落到了婚礼蛋糕上。

e.en: The cherry tree dropped pink {petals} all over the path.
e.zh: 樱花树把粉色花瓣洒满了整条小路。

e.en: He was hoist by his own {petard} when the email leaked.
e.zh: 邮件外泄后，他真是搬起石头砸了自己的脚。

e.en: The play ends with a villain destroyed by his own {petard}.
e.zh: 剧情以反派被自己的炸药炸毁告终。

peter.t:
n. 彼得（人名）
v. 逐渐消失（peter out）

e.en: My friend {Peter} just opened a small coffee shop downtown.
e.zh: 我朋友彼得刚在市中心开了一家小咖啡店。

e.en: Their initial enthusiasm began to {peter} out after a few weeks.
e.zh: 他们最初的热情几周后就慢慢消退了。

e.en: The train to {Peterborough} leaves from platform six.
e.zh: 开往彼得伯勒的火车在六号站台发车。

e.en: She moved to {Peterborough} to be closer to her parents.
e.zh: 她搬到彼得伯勒，好离父母近一些。

peterhead.t: n. 彼得黑德（苏格兰港市）

e.en: {Peterhead} is one of Scotland's busiest fishing ports.
e.zh: 彼得黑德是苏格兰最繁忙的渔港之一。

e.en: We drove up to {Peterhead} to watch the boats unload.
e.zh: 我们开车到彼得黑德看渔船卸货。

e.en: The siege of {Petersburg} dragged on for nearly ten months.
e.zh: 彼得斯堡围城战拖了将近十个月。

e.en: My grandfather grew up in a small town near {Petersburg}.
e.zh: 我爷爷在彼得斯堡附近的一个小镇长大。

e.en: The midwife offered her {pethidine} for the labour pain.
e.zh: 助产士给她用了哌替啶来缓解分娩疼痛。

e.en: {Pethidine} is now used less often than newer painkillers.
e.zh: 哌替啶如今的使用频率已不如更新型的止痛药。

e.en: Each leaf is attached to the stem by a slender {petiole}.
e.zh: 每片叶子通过一根细细的叶柄连在茎上。

e.en: The botanist measured the {petiole} length of every sample.
e.zh: 植物学家测量了每个样本的叶柄长度。

petit.t: adj. 小的（法语借词，多用于法律术语）

e.en: The defendant was charged with {petit} larceny, not a felony.
e.zh: 被告被控的是轻微盗窃，而非重罪。

e.en: She ordered a tray of {petit} fours after dinner.
e.zh: 她饭后点了一盘小法式甜点。

e.en: The store carries jeans designed for {petite} women.
e.zh: 这家店有专为娇小女性设计的牛仔裤。

e.en: She is {petite} but stronger than most people expect.
e.zh: 她个子娇小，但比大多数人想象的要强壮。

petition.t:
n. 请愿书
v. 请愿，申请

e.en: Over ten thousand residents signed the {petition} against the new highway.
e.zh: 超过一万名居民签署了反对新建高速公路的请愿书。

e.en: The lawyers will {petition} the court for an emergency hearing.
e.zh: 律师们将向法院申请紧急听证。

e.en: The {petitioner} argued that the deadline had been unfairly applied.
e.zh: 申请人辩称这个截止期限的适用并不公平。

e.en: Each {petitioner} must submit identification and proof of residence.
e.zh: 每位请愿人必须提交身份证件和居住证明。

e.en: Parents are {petitioning} the school board to keep music classes.
e.zh: 家长们正在向校董会请愿，希望保留音乐课。

e.en: The group spent weekends {petitioning} outside the supermarket.
e.zh: 那个团体周末都在超市门口征集签名。

e.en: The website hosts thousands of {petitions} on environmental issues.
e.zh: 该网站上有成千上万个关于环境问题的请愿。

e.en: She {petitions} the council every year for safer crosswalks.
e.zh: 她每年都向市议会请愿要求更安全的人行横道。

petits.t: adj. 小的（法语复数形式）

e.en: The bakery is famous for its colorful {petits} fours.
e.zh: 这家烘焙店以色彩缤纷的小法式甜点闻名。

e.en: We ordered champagne and a plate of {petits} fours.
e.zh: 我们点了香槟和一盘小法式甜点。

petra.t: n. 佩特拉（约旦古城；人名）

e.en: We hiked through the canyon to reach the ruins of {Petra}.
e.zh: 我们徒步穿过峡谷，来到了佩特拉古城遗址。

e.en: {Petra} was carved directly into rose-colored sandstone cliffs.
e.zh: 佩特拉古城是直接在玫瑰色砂岩崖壁上凿出来的。

petrarch.t: n. 彼特拉克（意大利诗人）

e.en: {Petrarch} is often called the father of Italian Renaissance humanism.
e.zh: 彼特拉克常被称为意大利文艺复兴人文主义之父。

e.en: Her thesis compares Shakespeare's sonnets with those of {Petrarch}.
e.zh: 她的论文比较了莎士比亚和彼特拉克的十四行诗。

e.en: A storm {petrel} darted between the masts of the ship.
e.zh: 一只暴风海燕在船桅之间穿梭。

e.en: Researchers tagged each {petrel} before releasing it back to sea.
e.zh: 研究人员给每只海燕戴上标签后才放回大海。

e.en: The lab assistant streaked bacteria onto a fresh {petri} dish.
e.zh: 实验助理把细菌划在一只新的培养皿上。

e.en: Dozens of {petri} dishes were stacked inside the incubator.
e.zh: 数十个培养皿叠放在恒温箱里。

petrifaction.t: n. 石化作用；呆若木鸡

e.en: The forest is famous for the {petrifaction} of its ancient trees.
e.zh: 这片森林以其远古树木的石化现象而闻名。

e.en: Geologists study the {petrifaction} process in volcanic ash deposits.
e.zh: 地质学家研究火山灰沉积层中的石化过程。

petrified.t:
adj. 吓呆的
v. 使石化

e.en: I was absolutely {petrified} during my first job interview.
e.zh: 我第一次面试时简直吓得动弹不得。

e.en: The museum displays a slice of {petrified} wood from Arizona.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一块来自亚利桑那的硅化木切片。

e.en: Public speaking still tends to {petrify} him completely.
e.zh: 当众演讲到现在还是会把他吓得僵住。

e.en: Minerals slowly seep in and {petrify} the buried logs.
e.zh: 矿物质慢慢渗入，把埋藏的木头石化。

e.en: Theologians debated the {Petrine} authority claimed by the early popes.
e.zh: 神学家们争论早期教皇所声称的彼得权威。

e.en: The lecture covered {Petrine} traditions in the Roman Catholic Church.
e.zh: 讲座讨论了罗马天主教会中的彼得传统。

petrochemical.t:
n. 石油化学产品
adj. 石化的

e.en: The {petrochemical} industry is shifting toward lower-emission feedstocks.
e.zh: 石化行业正在转向排放更低的原料。

e.en: A massive {petrochemical} plant dominates the skyline near the harbor.
e.zh: 一座庞大的石化厂占据了港口附近的天际线。

e.en: Hikers discovered an ancient {petroglyph} carved into the canyon wall.
e.zh: 徒步者在峡谷石壁上发现了一幅古代岩画。

e.en: Each {petroglyph} tells part of the tribe's migration story.
e.zh: 每一幅岩画都讲述着部落迁徙故事的一部分。

petrograd.t: n. 彼得格勒（圣彼得堡旧名）

e.en: The 1917 revolution began on the streets of {Petrograd}.
e.zh: 1917年的革命就是在彼得格勒的街头爆发的。

e.en: The city was renamed {Petrograd} during the First World War.
e.zh: 这座城市在第一次世界大战期间被改名为彼得格勒。

e.en: I need to fill up the car with {petrol} before leaving.
e.zh: 出发前我得给车加满油。

e.en: {Petrol} prices have climbed sharply over the past month.
e.zh: 过去一个月汽油价格大幅上涨。

e.en: Apply a thin layer of {petrolatum} to keep the cut moist.
e.zh: 在伤口上薄薄涂一层凡士林，保持湿润。

e.en: Many lip balms use {petrolatum} as their main base.
e.zh: 许多润唇膏都以凡士林为主要基底。

e.en: The country relies heavily on imported {petroleum} for its energy.
e.zh: 该国的能源严重依赖进口石油。

e.en: Plastics are made from refined {petroleum} products.
e.zh: 塑料是由精炼的石油产品制成的。

e.en: The {petrological} analysis revealed three distinct rock formations.
e.zh: 岩石学分析显示出三种不同的岩石构造。

e.en: She presented her {petrological} findings at the geology conference.
e.zh: 她在地质学大会上介绍了自己的岩石学研究成果。

e.en: He teaches a graduate course on igneous {petrology}.
e.zh: 他教一门关于火成岩岩石学的研究生课程。

e.en: {Petrology} helps geologists understand how the Earth's crust forms.
e.zh: 岩石学帮助地质学家理解地壳是如何形成的。

e.en: Modern {petrols} contain additives that protect engine components.
e.zh: 现代汽油中含有保护发动机部件的添加剂。

e.en: The lab compares different {petrols} for their combustion efficiency.
e.zh: 实验室比较了不同汽油的燃烧效率。

petrous.t: adj. 岩石般的；颞骨岩部的

e.en: The surgeon carefully avoided the {petrous} part of the temporal bone.
e.zh: 外科医生小心避开了颞骨的岩部。

e.en: A CT scan revealed a tumor near the {petrous} ridge.
e.zh: CT扫描显示岩骨嵴附近有一个肿瘤。

pets.t:
n. 宠物（复数）
v. 抚摸

e.en: Many apartments do not allow {pets} like cats or dogs.
e.zh: 很多公寓不允许养猫狗等宠物。

e.en: She {pets} the cat gently while watching TV.
e.zh: 她一边看电视一边轻轻抚摸着猫。

e.en: The vintage dress came with a frilly white {petticoat}.
e.zh: 这件复古连衣裙配有一条带褶边的白色衬裙。

e.en: She lifted her skirt to show the lace {petticoat} underneath.
e.zh: 她掀起裙子,露出里面的蕾丝衬裙。

e.en: I'm tired of the {pettiness} in our office politics.
e.zh: 我厌倦了办公室政治里的小心眼。

e.en: His {pettiness} over small expenses annoyed everyone.
e.zh: 他对小开销斤斤计较,让大家都很烦。

e.en: The kids enjoyed {petting} the rabbits at the farm.
e.zh: 孩子们在农场里开心地抚摸兔子。

e.en: There's a {petting} zoo near the park entrance.
e.zh: 公园入口附近有一个可触摸动物园。

e.en: She gave a {pettish} reply and slammed the door.
e.zh: 她不耐烦地回了一句,然后摔门而去。

e.en: His {pettish} tone made the meeting uncomfortable.
e.zh: 他那种闹脾气的语气让会议气氛很尴尬。

e.en: Don't be so {petty} about who paid for coffee.
e.zh: 别为了谁请的咖啡这么斤斤计较。

e.en: He was charged with {petty} theft at the supermarket.
e.zh: 他被指控在超市犯了轻微盗窃罪。

e.en: The toddler's {petulance} disappeared once the snack arrived.
e.zh: 小孩的闹脾气在零食一到就消失了。

e.en: Her {petulance} during meetings damaged her reputation.
e.zh: 她在开会时爱闹脾气,影响了自己的声誉。

e.en: He shot her a {petulant} glare across the table.
e.zh: 他从桌子对面赌气地瞪了她一眼。

e.en: The actor became {petulant} when reporters asked tough questions.
e.zh: 记者问到尖锐问题时,这位演员变得闹起了脾气。

e.en: She {petulantly} refused to share the remote control.
e.zh: 她耍小性子地拒绝把遥控器让出来。

e.en: He pushed his plate away {petulantly} and left.
e.zh: 他赌气地把盘子推开就离开了。

e.en: She planted bright purple {petunia} along the front path.
e.zh: 她沿着前院小路种了鲜艳的紫色矮牵牛。

e.en: The {petunia} blooms last all summer in this climate.
e.zh: 在这种气候下,矮牵牛能开花一整个夏天。

peugeot.t: n. 标致（法国汽车品牌）

e.en: He drives an old {peugeot} hatchback through Paris traffic.
e.zh: 他开着一辆旧标致两厢车穿梭在巴黎街头。

e.en: My uncle restored a vintage {peugeot} from the seventies.
e.zh: 我叔叔修复了一辆七十年代的老款标致车。

e.en: William the Conqueror landed at {pevensey} in 1066.
e.zh: 征服者威廉于1066年在佩文西登陆。

e.en: We visited the ruined castle at {pevensey} last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们参观了佩文西的城堡遗址。

e.en: She slid into the front {pew} just before the service.
e.zh: 礼拜开始前,她悄悄坐进了前排长椅。

e.en: The wooden {pew} creaked every time someone stood up.
e.zh: 每次有人起身,那张木长椅就吱吱作响。

e.en: The antique shop had a beautiful {pewter} mug for sale.
e.zh: 那家古董店有一只漂亮的白镴杯子在出售。

e.en: My grandmother collected {pewter} plates from old English pubs.
e.zh: 我奶奶收藏了从英国老酒馆来的白镴盘子。

peyote.t: n. 乌羽玉（致幻仙人掌）

e.en: Some Native American ceremonies traditionally use {peyote} for spiritual purposes.
e.zh: 一些美洲原住民的仪式传统上会用乌羽玉来进行灵性活动。

e.en: The {peyote} cactus grows wild in parts of Mexico.
e.zh: 乌羽玉仙人掌在墨西哥部分地区野生。

pfa.t: abbr. 职业足球运动员协会

e.en: The {pfa} negotiates contracts on behalf of professional footballers.
e.zh: 职业足球员协会代表职业球员谈判合同。

e.en: He served on the {pfa} board for three seasons.
e.zh: 他在职业球员协会董事会任职了三个赛季。

e.en: My grandfather kept an old German {pfennig} in his wallet.
e.zh: 我爷爷的钱包里一直放着一枚旧的德国芬尼。

e.en: The coin collector showed me a rare wartime {pfennig}.
e.zh: 那位钱币收藏家给我看了一枚罕见的战时芬尼硬币。

e.en: The enzyme {pfk} controls a key step in glycolysis.
e.zh: 磷酸果糖激酶(PFK)调控糖酵解中的一个关键步骤。

e.en: Mutations in {pfk} can cause muscle metabolism disorders.
e.zh: PFK基因突变可能导致肌肉代谢紊乱。

pflp.t: abbr. 解放巴勒斯坦人民阵线

e.en: The {pflp} was founded as a Marxist political faction in 1967.
e.zh: 巴勒斯坦人民解放阵线(PFLP)成立于1967年,是一个马克思主义派别。

e.en: News reports mentioned a statement issued by the {pflp}.
e.zh: 新闻报道提到了巴解阵发表的一份声明。

pga.t: abbr. 美国职业高尔夫协会

e.en: He qualified for the {pga} tour after years of practice.
e.zh: 经过多年练习,他终于获得了职业高尔夫巡回赛的参赛资格。

e.en: The {pga} championship will be held in California this year.
e.zh: 今年的PGA锦标赛将在加州举办。

e.en: Researchers studied how {pgc} regulates mitochondrial biogenesis in muscle.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了PGC如何调控肌肉线粒体的生成。

e.en: Exercise increases {pgc} expression in skeletal muscle cells.
e.zh: 运动可提高骨骼肌细胞中PGC的表达水平。

pgce.t: abbr. 英国研究生教育证书

e.en: She earned her {pgce} before becoming a primary school teacher.
e.zh: 她考取了教育研究生证书后才成为小学老师。

e.en: The {pgce} program lasts about one academic year in England.
e.zh: 在英国,PGCE课程大约持续一个学年。

e.en: {pge} restored power to thousands of homes after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后,太平洋燃气电力公司恢复了数千户人家的供电。

e.en: My monthly {pge} bill went up again this winter.
e.zh: 今年冬天我的PG&E电费账单又涨了。

phaeton.t: n. 四轮敞篷马车；敞篷轿车

e.en: The wealthy family arrived in a black {phaeton} drawn by horses.
e.zh: 那户富裕人家乘着一辆由马拉的黑色敞篷四轮马车到来。

e.en: The museum displays an elegant {phaeton} from the 1890s.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一辆1890年代的精美敞篷马车。

e.en: Scientists are testing a {phage} therapy against drug-resistant bacteria.
e.zh: 科学家正在测试一种针对耐药菌的噬菌体疗法。

e.en: Each {phage} infects only specific types of bacterial cells.
e.zh: 每种噬菌体只感染特定类型的细菌细胞。

phalanx.t:
n. 密集方阵；（人群）集团
n. 指骨

e.en: A {phalanx} of reporters waited outside the courthouse.
e.zh: 一群记者密集地守在法院门外。

e.en: The ancient Greek {phalanx} was nearly impossible to break.
e.zh: 古希腊的方阵几乎无法被攻破。

e.en: We spotted a red-necked {phalarope} swimming on the pond.
e.zh: 我们发现一只红颈瓣蹼鹬在池塘上游动。

e.en: The {phalarope} spins in circles to stir up tiny prey.
e.zh: 瓣蹼鹬会原地打转,以搅起水中的小型猎物。

phallic.t: adj. 阳具的；男性崇拜的

e.en: Critics called the new skyscraper's design overtly {phallic}.
e.zh: 评论家说这座新摩天大楼的设计明显带有阳具象征。

e.en: The sculpture's {phallic} shape sparked heated debate online.
e.zh: 那座雕塑的阳具形状在网上引发了激烈讨论。

e.en: She critiqued the novel's {phallocentric} view of relationships.
e.zh: 她批评这部小说对两性关系采取了男性中心的视角。

e.en: The professor argued that classical theory remains deeply {phallocentric}.
e.zh: 教授认为古典理论依然带有浓厚的男性中心主义色彩。

e.en: Ancient fertility statues often featured an exaggerated {phallus}.
e.zh: 古代生殖崇拜雕像常常带有夸张的男性生殖器形象。

e.en: The museum's exhibit included a stone {phallus} from antiquity.
e.zh: 博物馆的展品中包括一件来自古代的石制阳具雕像。

e.en: A pale {phantasm} seemed to drift through the dim corridor.
e.zh: 一个苍白的幻影仿佛在昏暗的走廊里飘过。

e.en: His memory of her was now only a fading {phantasm}.
e.zh: 他对她的记忆如今只剩一个渐渐淡去的幻影。

e.en: The film unfolds like a dreamlike {phantasmagoria} of color.
e.zh: 这部电影像一场梦幻般的色彩万花筒徐徐展开。

e.en: His paintings present a swirling {phantasmagoria} of strange creatures.
e.zh: 他的画作呈现出一幅光怪陆离、充满怪兽的奇景。

phantasmagoric.t: adj. 千变万化的；梦幻般的

e.en: The festival lights created a {phantasmagoric} atmosphere downtown.
e.zh: 节日的灯光让市中心弥漫着一种光怪陆离的氛围。

e.en: Her dreams were filled with {phantasmagoric} landscapes and floating figures.
e.zh: 她的梦里满是光怪陆离的景象和飘浮的人影。

phantasmagorical.t: adj. 千变万化的；梦幻般的

e.en: The novel ends in a {phantasmagorical} sequence of shifting images.
e.zh: 小说的结尾是一连串光怪陆离、不断变幻的画面。

e.en: Children gasped at the {phantasmagorical} parade floats.
e.zh: 孩子们看到那些梦幻奇异的游行花车时都惊叹不已。

e.en: He retreated into {phantasy} whenever real life felt overwhelming.
e.zh: 每当现实生活让他喘不过气时,他就躲进幻想之中。

e.en: The book mixes history with elements of {phantasy}.
e.zh: 这本书把历史与幻想元素融合在了一起。

phantom.t:
n. 幽灵；幻影
adj. 虚幻的

e.en: Many amputees still feel {phantom} pain in missing limbs.
e.zh: 许多截肢者仍能在已失去的肢体上感到幻肢痛。

e.en: A {phantom} figure appeared briefly at the end of the hall.
e.zh: 走廊尽头短暂地出现了一个幽灵般的身影。

e.en: Old houses are full of creaks but rarely actual {phantoms}.
e.zh: 老房子里满是吱吱声,但很少真有幽灵。

e.en: He was haunted by the {phantoms} of past mistakes.
e.zh: 他被过去错误的阴影一直困扰着。

e.en: The young {pharaoh} ruled Egypt for less than a decade.
e.zh: 这位年轻的法老统治埃及不到十年。

e.en: Tourists lined up to see the golden mask of the {pharaoh}.
e.zh: 游客们排队参观这位法老的黄金面具。

e.en: The project's {pharaonic} budget shocked even the president.
e.zh: 这个项目堪比法老工程的庞大预算连总统都吓了一跳。

e.en: Archaeologists uncovered {pharaonic} inscriptions deep inside the tomb.
e.zh: 考古学家在墓室深处发现了法老时期的铭文。

pharisaic.t: adj. 伪善的；法利赛人式的

e.en: His {pharisaic} attitude toward charity rubbed donors the wrong way.
e.zh: 他在慈善上那种伪善的态度让捐赠者很反感。

e.en: Critics accused the politician of {pharisaic} moralizing.
e.zh: 评论人士指责这位政客在装腔作势地说教。

e.en: Don't be a {pharisee} who judges others while ignoring your own faults.
e.zh: 别做那种只看别人毛病、却忽视自己缺点的伪君子。

e.en: The sermon warned against acting like a self-righteous {pharisee}.
e.zh: 这场讲道告诫人们不要像自以为义的法利赛人那样行事。

pharma.t: n. 制药公司；医药行业

e.en: Big {pharma} companies invested heavily in vaccine research.
e.zh: 大型制药公司在疫苗研究上投入了巨资。

e.en: She left academia for a high-paying job in {pharma}.
e.zh: 她离开学术界,进入制药行业拿高薪。

e.en: His reputation as a {philanderer} ruined his political career.
e.zh: 他风流成性的名声毁掉了他的政治生涯。

e.en: She finally divorced the {philanderer} after years of betrayal.
e.zh: 在多年的背叛之后,她终于和那个花花公子离了婚。

philandering.t:
n. 玩弄女性的行为
adj. 用情不专的

e.en: His {philandering} ways eventually destroyed the marriage.
e.zh: 他拈花惹草的行为最终毁掉了这段婚姻。

e.en: The novel explores the consequences of his {philandering}.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了他风流行径带来的后果。

e.en: The tech billionaire funds many {philanthropic} causes.
e.zh: 那位科技亿万富翁资助了许多慈善事业。

e.en: Her {philanthropic} work focuses on girls' education in Africa.
e.zh: 她的慈善工作专注于非洲女孩的教育。

philanthropically.t: adv. 出于慈善地；博爱地

e.en: He donates {philanthropically} to several children's hospitals.
e.zh: 他出于慈善向几家儿童医院捐款。

e.en: The foundation operates {philanthropically} without seeking profit.
e.zh: 该基金会以慈善方式运作,不追求利润。

philanthropies.t: n. 慈善事业（philanthropy 的复数）

e.en: The family runs several major {philanthropies} across the country.
e.zh: 这个家族在全国经营着几家大型慈善机构。

e.en: Many tech {philanthropies} now focus on AI safety research.
e.zh: 许多科技慈善机构如今专注于AI安全研究。

e.en: The {philanthropist} donated millions to cancer research.
e.zh: 那位慈善家向癌症研究捐赠了数百万美元。

e.en: She became a famous {philanthropist} after selling her company.
e.zh: 她在卖掉自己的公司后成了著名的慈善家。

e.en: Several {philanthropists} pledged funds to rebuild the school.
e.zh: 几位慈善家承诺出资重建那所学校。

e.en: Tech {philanthropists} are reshaping how charities use data.
e.zh: 科技慈善家正在改变慈善机构使用数据的方式。

e.en: He devotes most of his retirement to {philanthropy}.
e.zh: 他把大部分退休时间投入到慈善事业中。

e.en: Modern {philanthropy} often relies on data-driven impact metrics.
e.zh: 现代慈善事业常依赖数据驱动的影响力指标。

philatelic.t: adj. 集邮的；与集邮相关的

e.en: The museum hosted a {philatelic} exhibition of rare stamps.
e.zh: 博物馆举办了一场珍稀邮票的集邮展览。

e.en: He subscribes to a monthly {philatelic} magazine.
e.zh: 他订阅了一本月刊的集邮杂志。

e.en: The {philatelist} paid thousands for a single rare stamp.
e.zh: 那位集邮家花了数千美元买下一枚稀有邮票。

e.en: As a lifelong {philatelist}, he owns thousands of stamps.
e.zh: 作为终身集邮爱好者,他拥有成千上万枚邮票。

e.en: His grandfather introduced him to {philately} as a quiet hobby.
e.zh: 他祖父把他引入了集邮这一安静的爱好。

e.en: The museum hosts a yearly exhibition celebrating {philately}.
e.zh: 博物馆每年举办一次集邮展览。

e.en: Paul's letter to {Philemon} is one of the shortest in the Bible.
e.zh: 保罗写给腓利门的书信是圣经中最短的之一。

e.en: The pastor preached on forgiveness using {Philemon} as his text.
e.zh: 牧师以腓利门书为经文讲述宽恕。

e.en: The {Philharmonia} performed Mahler's fifth symphony last night.
e.zh: 爱乐乐团昨晚演奏了马勒第五交响曲。

e.en: She dreams of joining the {Philharmonia} as a violinist.
e.zh: 她梦想以小提琴手身份加入爱乐乐团。

philharmonic.t:
adj. 爱乐的
n. 爱乐乐团

e.en: The {philharmonic} orchestra sold out three nights in a row.
e.zh: 爱乐乐团连续三晚门票售罄。

e.en: Tickets to the {philharmonic} concert were surprisingly affordable.
e.zh: 爱乐音乐会的票价出乎意料地实惠。

philippian.t:
n. 腓立比人
adj. 腓立比的

e.en: The pastor read a {Philippian} verse about contentment.
e.zh: 牧师读了一段腓立比书中关于知足的经文。

e.en: He memorized a {Philippian} passage for the church youth contest.
e.zh: 他为教会青年比赛背诵了一段腓立比书的经文。

e.en: We tried authentic {Philippine} adobo at the new restaurant.
e.zh: 我们在新餐厅尝了正宗的菲律宾红烧菜。

e.en: The {Philippine} embassy issued a travel advisory yesterday.
e.zh: 菲律宾大使馆昨天发布了旅行警告。

e.en: She spent two weeks island-hopping in the {Philippines}.
e.zh: 她在菲律宾跳岛旅行了两个星期。

e.en: The {Philippines} is famous for its beautiful beaches and friendly people.
e.zh: 菲律宾以美丽的海滩和友好的人民闻名。

e.en: I bought a new {Philips} electric shaver online.
e.zh: 我在网上买了一台新的飞利浦电动剃须刀。

e.en: The hospital uses {Philips} medical imaging equipment.
e.zh: 这家医院使用飞利浦的医学影像设备。

philistine.t:
n. 市侩；不懂文艺的俗人
adj. 庸俗的

e.en: He called me a {philistine} for not enjoying opera.
e.zh: 他因为我不喜欢歌剧就说我没文化。

e.en: Don't be such a {philistine} — give the poetry a chance.
e.zh: 别这么俗气,给这首诗一个机会嘛。

philistines.t: n. 市侩们；非利士人（复数）

e.en: Critics dismissed the new mall designers as cultural {philistines}.
e.zh: 评论家把新商场的设计师斥为文化俗人。

e.en: The biblical {Philistines} were enemies of ancient Israel.
e.zh: 圣经中的非利士人是古以色列的敌人。

philistinism.t: n. 庸俗；缺乏文化修养

e.en: She accused the city council of {philistinism} for closing the gallery.
e.zh: 她指责市议会关闭画廊是文化粗鄙的表现。

e.en: His review attacked the {philistinism} of modern blockbuster cinema.
e.zh: 他的评论抨击了现代商业大片的庸俗。

phillips.t: n. 飞利浦（品牌）；菲利普斯（姓氏）

e.en: You'll need a {Phillips} screwdriver to open this laptop.
e.zh: 你需要一把十字螺丝刀才能打开这台笔记本。

e.en: The cabinet came with {Phillips}-head screws and an Allen key.
e.zh: 柜子配有十字螺丝和一把内六角扳手。

philo.t: n. 斐洛（人名，古希腊哲学家）

e.en: The recipe calls for thin sheets of {philo} pastry.
e.zh: 这个食谱需要薄薄的费罗酥皮。

e.en: {Philo} of Alexandria blended Jewish and Greek philosophy.
e.zh: 亚历山大的斐洛融合了犹太与希腊哲学。

philodendron.t: n. 喜林芋（常见观叶植物）

e.en: My {philodendron} has grown halfway across the living room.
e.zh: 我的蔓绿绒已经爬过了客厅的一半。

e.en: A heart-leaf {philodendron} thrives in low light.
e.zh: 心叶蔓绿绒在弱光下也能茁壮生长。

philological.t: adj. 语文学的；文献学的

e.en: Her {philological} research traced the word's origins to Old Norse.
e.zh: 她的语文学研究将这个词的源头追溯到古诺斯语。

e.en: The journal published a {philological} analysis of the manuscript.
e.zh: 该期刊发表了对这份手稿的语文学分析。

philologist.t: n. 语文学家；文献学家

e.en: The {philologist} spent decades comparing ancient Sanskrit texts.
e.zh: 这位语文学家花了几十年比较古梵文文本。

e.en: Tolkien was a {philologist} before he wrote fantasy novels.
e.zh: 托尔金在写奇幻小说之前是一位语文学家。

e.en: She studied classical {philology} at Oxford for four years.
e.zh: 她在牛津学了四年古典语文学。

e.en: {Philology} examines how languages evolve through historical texts.
e.zh: 语文学通过历史文献研究语言的演变。

philosophe.t: n. 启蒙时代的哲学家

e.en: Voltaire was the most famous {philosophe} of the French Enlightenment.
e.zh: 伏尔泰是法国启蒙运动最著名的哲人。

e.en: Each {philosophe} championed reason over religious authority.
e.zh: 每位启蒙哲人都倡导理性高于宗教权威。

e.en: My roommate fancies himself a {philosopher} after one ethics class.
e.zh: 我室友上了一节伦理课就自以为是哲学家。

e.en: The ancient {philosopher} taught his students in the marketplace.
e.zh: 那位古代哲学家在集市上教导他的学生。

e.en: Ancient Greek {philosophers} debated the nature of reality endlessly.
e.zh: 古希腊哲学家们无休止地辩论现实的本质。

e.en: Modern {philosophers} often write about ethics in artificial intelligence.
e.zh: 现代哲学家常常撰文讨论人工智能的伦理问题。

e.en: She took the bad news with a {philosophic} calm.
e.zh: 她以哲人般的平静接受了这个坏消息。

e.en: His essays have a deeply {philosophic} tone throughout.
e.zh: 他的散文从头到尾都带着浓厚的哲思味道。

e.en: He's surprisingly {philosophical} about losing the championship.
e.zh: 对于丢掉冠军,他出奇地豁达。

e.en: The novel raises {philosophical} questions about free will.
e.zh: 这部小说提出了关于自由意志的哲学问题。

e.en: She shrugged {philosophically} when her flight was cancelled.
e.zh: 航班被取消时,她达观地耸了耸肩。

e.en: He spoke {philosophically} about aging and regret.
e.zh: 他从哲学的角度谈论衰老与遗憾。

e.en: Different management {philosophies} clashed during the merger negotiations.
e.zh: 在并购谈判中,不同的管理理念产生了冲突。

e.en: Eastern and Western {philosophies} approach happiness very differently.
e.zh: 东西方哲学对幸福的理解截然不同。

philosophise.t: v. 空谈哲理（英式拼写）

e.en: Stop trying to {philosophise} and just answer the question.
e.zh: 别再大谈哲理了,直接回答问题吧。

e.en: They like to {philosophise} about life over late-night coffee.
e.zh: 他们喜欢在深夜喝咖啡时大谈人生哲理。

e.en: He'll {philosophize} for hours if you let him.
e.zh: 你要是任由他说,他能高谈阔论好几个小时。

e.en: Don't {philosophize} about the menu — just order something.
e.zh: 别对着菜单大发议论了,点个菜吧。

e.en: Less {philosophizing}, more action — that's what we need now.
e.zh: 少空谈哲理,多采取行动,这才是我们现在需要的。

e.en: Her endless {philosophizing} drove her practical sister crazy.
e.zh: 她没完没了的高谈阔论把她务实的妹妹逼疯了。

e.en: The company's hiring {philosophy} prioritizes curiosity over credentials.
e.zh: 公司的招聘理念把好奇心看得比学历更重要。

e.en: She's majoring in {philosophy} with a minor in economics.
e.zh: 她主修哲学,辅修经济学。

phishing.t: n. 网络钓鱼（诈骗手段）

e.en: Always check the sender's email to avoid {phishing} scams.
e.zh: 务必查看发件人邮箱,以防钓鱼诈骗。

e.en: The {phishing} email pretended to be from his bank.
e.zh: 那封钓鱼邮件假装是他银行发来的。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed her leg pain as {phlebitis}.
e.zh: 医生诊断她的腿痛是静脉炎。

e.en: Long flights can sometimes trigger {phlebitis} in older passengers.
e.zh: 长途飞行有时会引发年长乘客的静脉炎。

e.en: She enrolled in a {phlebotomy} course at the community college.
e.zh: 她在社区大学报名了一门采血技术课程。

e.en: The technician performed the {phlebotomy} quickly and painlessly.
e.zh: 技师采血又快又不疼。

phlegm.t:
n. 痰
n. 冷静；迟钝

e.en: The cough syrup helped loosen the {phlegm} in his chest.
e.zh: 止咳糖浆帮他化开了胸口的痰。

e.en: Drink warm tea to clear the {phlegm} from your throat.
e.zh: 喝点温茶清一清喉咙里的痰。

phlegmatic.t: adj. 冷静的；不易激动的

e.en: Her {phlegmatic} response surprised everyone in the meeting.
e.zh: 她冷静的反应让会上每个人都很惊讶。

e.en: He remained {phlegmatic} even when the deal collapsed.
e.zh: 即便交易告吹,他仍然不动声色。

e.en: His {phlegmy} cough kept the whole office on edge.
e.zh: 他那带痰的咳嗽让整个办公室都很紧张。

e.en: She woke up with a {phlegmy} throat after the cold weather.
e.zh: 天气转冷后,她一觉醒来嗓子里满是痰。

phlogiston.t: n. 燃素（早期化学假想物质）

e.en: Early chemists believed combustion released a substance called {phlogiston}.
e.zh: 早期化学家认为燃烧会释放一种叫燃素的物质。

e.en: Lavoisier's experiments eventually disproved the {phlogiston} theory.
e.zh: 拉瓦锡的实验最终推翻了燃素说。

e.en: Pink {phlox} bloomed all along the garden path.
e.zh: 粉色的福禄考开满了花园小径两旁。

e.en: She planted creeping {phlox} to cover the rocky slope.
e.zh: 她种了匍匐福禄考来覆盖岩石斜坡。

phnom.t: n. 山（高棉语，多用于地名如金边 Phnom Penh）

e.en: We flew into {Phnom} Penh on Tuesday morning.
e.zh: 我们周二早上飞抵金边。

e.en: {Phnom} Penh is the bustling capital of Cambodia.
e.zh: 金边是柬埔寨繁华的首都。

e.en: She has a serious {phobia} of public speaking.
e.zh: 她对公开演讲有严重的恐惧症。

e.en: His childhood {phobia} of dogs lingered into adulthood.
e.zh: 他童年时对狗的恐惧一直持续到成年。

phobic.t:
adj. 恐惧的
n. 恐惧症患者

e.en: She's a bit {phobic} about flying in small planes.
e.zh: 她对乘坐小飞机有点恐惧。

e.en: Many people are {phobic} about needles at the dentist.
e.zh: 很多人在牙医诊所对针头感到恐惧。

e.en: A small {phoebe} built its nest above our porch light.
e.zh: 一只小霸鹟在我们门廊灯上方筑了巢。

e.en: The eastern {phoebe} returns to the same nest each spring.
e.zh: 东蓝霸鹟每年春天都会回到同一个巢。

phoebus.t: n. 福玻斯（太阳神阿波罗的别称）

e.en: Ancient poets often called the sun {Phoebus} Apollo.
e.zh: 古代诗人常把太阳称为福波斯·阿波罗。

e.en: The hymn praised {Phoebus} rising over the eastern hills.
e.zh: 颂歌赞美福波斯从东方山岭升起。

phoenician.t:
n. 腓尼基人
adj. 腓尼基的

e.en: The {Phoenician} alphabet became the basis for Greek and Latin scripts.
e.zh: 腓尼基字母成为希腊文和拉丁文字的基础。

e.en: Archaeologists uncovered a {Phoenician} trading post on the coast.
e.zh: 考古学家在海岸发现了一处腓尼基贸易站。

e.en: The startup rose like a {phoenix} after its first failure.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在首次失败后如凤凰般涅槃重生。

e.en: We're flying to {Phoenix} for the conference next week.
e.zh: 我们下周要飞到凤凰城参加会议。

e.en: Chinese mythology features dragons and {phoenixes} as symbols of harmony.
e.zh: 中国神话以龙和凤为和谐的象征。

e.en: The temple's roof was decorated with golden {phoenixes}.
e.zh: 寺庙的屋顶装饰着金色的凤凰。

phone.t:
n. 电话；手机
v. 打电话

e.en: I left my {phone} charging in the kitchen.
e.zh: 我把手机放在厨房充电了。

e.en: Could you {phone} the restaurant to confirm our booking?
e.zh: 你能打电话给餐厅确认一下预订吗?

e.en: The radio station hosts a daily {phone-in} about local politics.
e.zh: 这家电台每天有一档关于本地政治的听众来电节目。

e.en: She won concert tickets on a morning {phone-in} show.
e.zh: 她在一个早间听众来电节目中赢得了演唱会门票。

e.en: I haven't opened a paper {phonebook} in over a decade.
e.zh: 我已经十多年没翻过纸质电话簿了。

e.en: Grandma still keeps the old {phonebook} by the kitchen phone.
e.zh: 奶奶还把旧电话簿放在厨房电话旁边。

e.en: I {phoned} my mother right after the interview.
e.zh: 面试一结束我就给妈妈打了电话。

e.en: She {phoned} the restaurant to push back our reservation.
e.zh: 她打电话给餐厅把预订时间推后了。

e.en: English uses about forty-four distinct {phoneme} sounds.
e.zh: 英语大约使用四十四个不同的音位。

e.en: Each {phoneme} can change a word's meaning entirely.
e.zh: 每一个音位都可能完全改变一个词的意思。

e.en: The dictionary uses a {phonemic} transcription for each entry.
e.zh: 这本词典为每个词条都标注了音位转写。

e.en: She studied the {phonemic} differences between British and American English.
e.zh: 她研究了英式和美式英语在音位上的差异。

phones.t:
n. 电话；手机（复数）
v. 打电话

e.en: Most teenagers check their {phones} dozens of times daily.
e.zh: 大多数青少年每天看手机几十次。

e.en: The office {phones} kept ringing all afternoon.
e.zh: 办公室的电话整个下午响个不停。

e.en: The dictionary uses {phonetic} symbols to show pronunciation.
e.zh: 这本词典用音标来标示发音。

e.en: Spanish spelling is largely {phonetic} and easy to learn.
e.zh: 西班牙语拼写基本上是表音的,容易学。

e.en: His name is spelled {phonetically} on the program.
e.zh: 他的名字在节目单上按发音拼写。

e.en: Children often write words {phonetically} before learning rules.
e.zh: 孩子们在学规则前常按读音拼写单词。

e.en: The {phonetician} analyzed regional accents across the country.
e.zh: 这位语音学家分析了全国各地的方言口音。

e.en: She trained as a {phonetician} at the university.
e.zh: 她在大学接受语音学家的专业训练。

e.en: Linguistics students must take a course in {phonetics}.
e.zh: 语言学专业的学生必须修一门语音学课程。

e.en: English {phonetics} can be tricky for new learners.
e.zh: 英语语音对初学者来说可能很有难度。

phoney.t:
adj. 假的；冒牌的
n. 骗子

e.en: That smile of his looks completely {phoney}.
e.zh: 他那种笑容看起来完全是装出来的。

e.en: Police arrested him for using a {phoney} passport.
e.zh: 警方因他使用假护照而将其逮捕。

e.en: Teachers use {phonic} drills to build reading skills.
e.zh: 老师用语音练习来培养阅读能力。

e.en: The app offers {phonic} games for young learners.
e.zh: 这款应用为低龄学习者提供拼读游戏。

e.en: Many schools teach reading through {phonics} in early grades.
e.zh: 许多学校在低年级用自然拼读法教阅读。

e.en: My daughter loves her {phonics} workbook.
e.zh: 我女儿很喜欢她的拼读练习册。

e.en: The {phoniness} of his apology was obvious to everyone.
e.zh: 他道歉的虚假人人都看得出来。

e.en: She hated the {phoniness} of celebrity culture.
e.zh: 她厌恶名人圈的虚伪做作。

e.en: He spent the morning {phoning} potential clients.
e.zh: 他整个上午都在给潜在客户打电话。

e.en: Stop {phoning} me so late at night.
e.zh: 别这么晚还给我打电话。

e.en: Each {phonogram} represents a sound in spoken language.
e.zh: 每个音符代表口语中的一个音。

e.en: Teachers introduce common {phonogram} patterns to early readers.
e.zh: 老师向初级读者介绍常见的拼音组合。

e.en: My grandfather still owns an antique {phonograph}.
e.zh: 我爷爷还留着一台古董留声机。

e.en: Edison invented the {phonograph} in 1877.
e.zh: 爱迪生于1877年发明了留声机。

e.en: The museum displays old {phonographic} records from the 1920s.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了1920年代的老唱片。

e.en: Collectors prize early {phonographic} equipment from that era.
e.zh: 收藏家很看重那个年代早期的留声设备。

e.en: Children develop {phonological} awareness before learning to read.
e.zh: 孩子在学会阅读之前就发展出语音意识。

e.en: The study examined {phonological} differences between dialects.
e.zh: 该研究考察了各方言之间的语音差异。

e.en: These two words are {phonologically} similar but mean different things.
e.zh: 这两个词发音相近,但意思完全不同。

e.en: Japanese and Korean differ {phonologically} in many ways.
e.zh: 日语和韩语在语音上有很多不同。

e.en: English {phonology} includes many vowel sounds learners find difficult.
e.zh: 英语音系包含许多让学习者头疼的元音。

e.en: Her thesis explored the {phonology} of Cantonese tones.
e.zh: 她的论文研究了粤语声调的音系。

e.en: Heat conduction in solids depends on {phonon} behavior.
e.zh: 固体中的热传导取决于声子的行为。

e.en: Physicists model each {phonon} as a quantized vibration.
e.zh: 物理学家把每个声子建模为量子化的振动。

phony.t:
adj. 假的；冒牌的
n. 骗子

e.en: He gave the cashier a {phony} hundred-dollar bill.
e.zh: 他给收银员递了一张假的一百美元钞票。

e.en: Her enthusiasm at the meeting felt totally {phony}.
e.zh: 她在会上的热情显得很假。

e.en: A tiny {phorid} fly hovered near the rotting fruit.
e.zh: 一只小蚤蝇在腐烂的水果旁飞来飞去。

e.en: Scientists study {phorid} flies to control fire ant populations.
e.zh: 科学家研究蚤蝇以控制红火蚁的数量。

e.en: The blood test measures alkaline {phosphatase} levels in the liver.
e.zh: 血液检测会测定肝脏中的碱性磷酸酶水平。

e.en: This enzyme functions as a {phosphatase} during cell signaling.
e.zh: 这种酶在细胞信号传导中起磷酸酶作用。

e.en: Farmers add {phosphate} fertilizer to boost crop yields.
e.zh: 农民施用磷肥来提高作物产量。

e.en: Too much {phosphate} in rivers causes harmful algal blooms.
e.zh: 河水中磷酸盐过多会引发有害的藻华。

phosphatidylcholine.t: n. 磷脂酰胆碱（卵磷脂主成分）

e.en: {Phosphatidylcholine} is a major component of cell membranes.
e.zh: 磷脂酰胆碱是细胞膜的主要成分之一。

e.en: Egg yolks are naturally rich in {phosphatidylcholine}.
e.zh: 蛋黄天然富含磷脂酰胆碱。

e.en: Zinc {phosphide} is sometimes used as a rodent poison.
e.zh: 磷化锌有时被用作灭鼠剂。

e.en: Indium {phosphide} chips power many fiber-optic networks.
e.zh: 磷化铟芯片为许多光纤网络提供动力。

e.en: Every cell membrane is built from a {phospholipid} bilayer.
e.zh: 每个细胞膜都是由磷脂双分子层构成的。

e.en: Soy lecithin is a common dietary {phospholipid}.
e.zh: 大豆卵磷脂是一种常见的膳食磷脂。

e.en: The screen's {phosphor} coating glows when struck by electrons.
e.zh: 屏幕上的荧光涂层在被电子击中时会发光。

e.en: Modern LEDs rely on {phosphor} to produce white light.
e.zh: 现代LED灯依靠荧光粉产生白光。

e.en: The waves glowed with a faint blue {phosphorescence} at night.
e.zh: 夜晚海浪闪烁着淡蓝色的磷光。

e.en: Scientists study {phosphorescence} in deep-sea organisms.
e.zh: 科学家研究深海生物的磷光现象。

e.en: The toy stars are {phosphorescent} and glow after lights-out.
e.zh: 这些玩具星星会发磷光,关灯后还会亮。

e.en: They painted the trail markers with {phosphorescent} paint.
e.zh: 他们用夜光漆涂上了路径标记。

e.en: Cola drinks contain {phosphoric} acid for tangy flavor.
e.zh: 可乐饮料中含有磷酸,带来酸爽的味道。

e.en: The factory produces {phosphoric} acid for industrial use.
e.zh: 这家工厂生产工业用磷酸。

pharmaceutical.t:
adj. 制药的
n. 药品

e.en: The {pharmaceutical} industry faces strict regulatory oversight worldwide.
e.zh: 制药行业在全球都面临严格的监管。

e.en: He works as a {pharmaceutical} sales representative for a major firm.
e.zh: 他在一家大公司当药品销售代表。

e.en: Most {pharmacies} now offer free flu shots to customers.
e.zh: 现在大多数药店都为顾客提供免费的流感疫苗接种。

e.en: Online {pharmacies} have changed how people buy medication.
e.zh: 网上药店改变了人们购买药品的方式。

e.en: The {pharmacist} explained how to take the antibiotics correctly.
e.zh: 药剂师解释了如何正确服用这些抗生素。

e.en: Ask the {pharmacist} if this medicine interacts with caffeine.
e.zh: 问问药剂师这种药是否会和咖啡因发生反应。

e.en: Hospital {pharmacists} review every prescription before it reaches the patient.
e.zh: 医院药剂师会在处方送到病人手中之前逐一审核。

e.en: Many {pharmacists} now offer basic health consultations in store.
e.zh: 现在许多药剂师还会在店内提供基本的健康咨询。

e.en: She studies {pharmacognosy} to identify medicinal compounds in plants.
e.zh: 她研究生药学,以鉴定植物中的药用成分。

e.en: The {pharmacognosy} lab analyzes samples collected from the rainforest.
e.zh: 这个生药学实验室分析的是从雨林采集的样本。

pharmacokinetic.t: adj. 药物代谢动力学的

e.en: Researchers ran a {pharmacokinetic} study on the new diabetes drug.
e.zh: 研究人员对这款新糖尿病药做了一项药代动力学研究。

e.en: The {pharmacokinetic} profile shows the drug clears within twelve hours.
e.zh: 药代动力学曲线显示该药物在十二小时内被清除。

e.en: {pharmacokinetics} explains how the body absorbs and eliminates a drug.
e.zh: 药代动力学研究的是人体如何吸收和排出一种药物。

e.en: Children often have very different {pharmacokinetics} from adults.
e.zh: 儿童的药代动力学特征往往与成人有很大差异。

e.en: The drug showed strong {pharmacologic} effects in early trials.
e.zh: 该药物在早期试验中显示出强烈的药理作用。

e.en: Doctors discussed {pharmacologic} options for managing chronic pain.
e.zh: 医生讨论了控制慢性疼痛的药物治疗方案。

e.en: She studies the {pharmacological} properties of new compounds.
e.zh: 她研究新化合物的药理特性。

e.en: The treatment combines {pharmacological} and behavioral therapy.
e.zh: 该疗法结合了药物治疗与行为治疗。

e.en: The {pharmacologist} explained how the drug interacts with enzymes.
e.zh: 那位药理学家解释了该药物如何与酶相互作用。

e.en: She trained as a clinical {pharmacologist} after medical school.
e.zh: 她在医学院毕业后接受了临床药理学家的训练。

e.en: He teaches {pharmacology} at the university medical school.
e.zh: 他在大学医学院教授药理学。

e.en: Modern {pharmacology} relies heavily on molecular biology.
e.zh: 现代药理学在很大程度上依赖于分子生物学。

e.en: The herb is listed in the official Chinese {pharmacopoeia}.
e.zh: 这种草药被收录于官方的中国药典中。

e.en: Each country maintains its own {pharmacopoeia} of approved drugs.
e.zh: 每个国家都有自己批准药物的药典。

e.en: {Pharmacotherapy} alone may not be enough for severe depression.
e.zh: 对于重度抑郁症,单靠药物治疗可能不够。

e.en: The clinic specializes in {pharmacotherapy} for addiction recovery.
e.zh: 该诊所专门从事成瘾康复的药物治疗。

e.en: I picked up my prescription at the {pharmacy} after work.
e.zh: 我下班后去药房取了处方药。

e.en: She studied {pharmacy} for six years before getting licensed.
e.zh: 她学了六年药学才拿到执照。

e.en: The doctor noticed a mild {pharyngeal} infection.
e.zh: 医生发现了轻微的咽喉感染。

e.en: Some languages use {pharyngeal} consonants that English lacks.
e.zh: 有些语言使用英语中没有的咽辅音。

e.en: Food passes through the {pharynx} on its way to the esophagus.
e.zh: 食物经过咽部进入食道。

e.en: The infection had spread from her nose to her {pharynx}.
e.zh: 感染已从她的鼻子蔓延到咽部。

phase.t:
n. 阶段；时期
v. 分阶段进行

e.en: The project is entering its final {phase} next month.
e.zh: 该项目下个月将进入最后阶段。

e.en: Teenage rebellion is just a {phase} most kids go through.
e.zh: 青春期叛逆只是大多数孩子要经历的一个阶段。

e.en: The company announced a {phased} return to the office.
e.zh: 公司宣布分阶段回到办公室办公。

e.en: Old payment systems will be {phased} out next year.
e.zh: 旧的支付系统将在明年逐步淘汰。

phaser.t: n. 相位效果器；（科幻）光炮

e.en: The guitarist added a {phaser} pedal for a swirly sound.
e.zh: 吉他手加上了相位效果器以制造旋绕音效。

e.en: Set your {phaser} to stun, not kill.
e.zh: 把你的相位枪设为眩晕,而不是击杀。

phases.t:
n. 阶段（复数）
v. 分阶段进行

e.en: The moon goes through eight distinct {phases} each month.
e.zh: 月亮每月会经历八个不同的月相。

e.en: Construction will proceed in three separate {phases}.
e.zh: 施工将分三个独立阶段进行。

phasing.t: n. 分阶段进行；相位调节

e.en: Apple is {phasing} out the old charging port.
e.zh: 苹果正在逐步淘汰旧款充电接口。

e.en: The {phasing} of the rollout depends on regional demand.
e.zh: 推出的阶段安排取决于各地区的需求。

phd.t: n. 博士学位（Doctor of Philosophy）

e.en: She finished her {PhD} in computer science last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天完成了计算机科学博士学位。

e.en: Getting a {PhD} usually takes five to seven years.
e.zh: 攻读博士学位通常需要五到七年。

e.en: A wild {pheasant} flew out of the bushes.
e.zh: 一只野山鸡从灌木丛中飞了出来。

e.en: The restaurant serves roasted {pheasant} with wine sauce.
e.zh: 那家餐厅供应配酒汁的烤山鸡。

e.en: Her dog takes {phenobarbital} to control epileptic seizures.
e.zh: 她的狗服用苯巴比妥来控制癫痫发作。

e.en: {Phenobarbital} was once widely prescribed for anxiety.
e.zh: 苯巴比妥曾被广泛用于治疗焦虑。

e.en: {Phenol} is used to make plastics and disinfectants.
e.zh: 苯酚用于制造塑料和消毒剂。

e.en: Workers must avoid skin contact with concentrated {phenol}.
e.zh: 工人必须避免皮肤接触浓苯酚。

phenolic.t:
adj. 酚的
n. 酚醛树脂

e.en: Red wine contains many beneficial {phenolic} compounds.
e.zh: 红酒含有许多有益的酚类化合物。

e.en: The countertop is made from durable {phenolic} resin.
e.zh: 这块台面由耐用的酚醛树脂制成。

e.en: Climate change is shifting the {phenology} of cherry blossoms.
e.zh: 气候变化正在改变樱花的物候期。

e.en: Scientists track bird {phenology} to monitor seasonal changes.
e.zh: 科学家通过追踪鸟类物候来监测季节变化。

e.en: The teenage tennis {phenom} won her first major title.
e.zh: 那位少年网球天才赢得了她的首个大满贯冠军。

e.en: He's a coding {phenom} who built the app at fifteen.
e.zh: 他是个编程奇才,十五岁就开发了那款应用。

e.en: Scientists study natural {phenomena} like auroras and eclipses.
e.zh: 科学家研究极光和日食等自然现象。

e.en: Several strange {phenomena} were reported near the lake.
e.zh: 湖边有几起奇怪现象被报告。

e.en: The new restaurant has received {phenomenal} reviews online.
e.zh: 那家新餐厅在网上获得了惊人的好评。

e.en: She has a {phenomenal} memory for names and faces.
e.zh: 她对人名和面孔有着惊人的记忆力。

e.en: The startup grew {phenomenally} during its first year.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在第一年里成长得惊人地快。

e.en: His new album is selling {phenomenally} well overseas.
e.zh: 他的新专辑在海外卖得异常火爆。

e.en: She wrote a {phenomenological} study of grief and loss.
e.zh: 她写了一篇关于悲伤与失去的现象学研究。

e.en: The paper takes a {phenomenological} approach to consciousness.
e.zh: 这篇论文采用现象学方法研究意识。

e.en: As a {phenomenologist}, she focuses on lived experience.
e.zh: 作为现象学家,她关注的是亲身体验。

e.en: Husserl is regarded as the founding {phenomenologist}.
e.zh: 胡塞尔被视为现象学的创始人。

e.en: He teaches a graduate course on {phenomenology} and perception.
e.zh: 他教授一门关于现象学与感知的研究生课程。

e.en: {Phenomenology} examines how the world appears to consciousness.
e.zh: 现象学研究世界如何呈现于意识之中。

e.en: Viral memes are a fascinating internet {phenomenon}.
e.zh: 病毒式传播的迷因是一种迷人的网络现象。

e.en: The northern lights are a stunning natural {phenomenon}.
e.zh: 北极光是一种令人惊叹的自然现象。

e.en: Eye color is one example of a visible {phenotype}.
e.zh: 眼睛的颜色就是可见表型的一个例子。

e.en: The same gene can produce different {phenotype} expressions.
e.zh: 相同的基因可能产生不同的表型表现。

e.en: Researchers measured {phenotypic} differences across the populations.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了不同种群间的表型差异。

e.en: Identical twins can still show subtle {phenotypic} variation.
e.zh: 同卵双胞胎仍可能表现出细微的表型差异。

e.en: People with PKU must avoid foods containing {phenylalanine}.
e.zh: 苯丙酮尿症患者必须避免含苯丙氨酸的食物。

e.en: Diet sodas often warn that they contain {phenylalanine}.
e.zh: 无糖汽水通常会警告含有苯丙氨酸。

e.en: Newborns are routinely screened for {phenylketonuria} at birth.
e.zh: 新生儿出生时常规筛查苯丙酮尿症。

e.en: {Phenylketonuria} requires a strict lifelong dietary plan.
e.zh: 苯丙酮尿症需要终生严格的饮食控制。

e.en: The FDA banned {phenylpropanolamine} due to stroke risks.
e.zh: 美国食品药品管理局因中风风险禁用了苯丙醇胺。

e.en: Old cold medicines often contained {phenylpropanolamine} as a decongestant.
e.zh: 旧式感冒药常含有苯丙醇胺作为减充血剂。

e.en: Ants use {pheromone} trails to lead others to food.
e.zh: 蚂蚁用信息素轨迹引导同伴找到食物。

e.en: Some perfumes claim to contain human {pheromone} compounds.
e.zh: 有些香水声称含有人类信息素成分。

e.en: {Phew}, I thought I'd lost my passport for good!
e.zh: 呼,我还以为护照彻底丢了呢!

e.en: {Phew}, that meeting was way longer than expected.
e.zh: 呼,那个会议比预期的长太多了。

phi.t: n. 希腊字母第21个（Φ, φ）

e.en: The Greek letter {phi} often represents the golden ratio.
e.zh: 希腊字母phi常用来表示黄金比例。

e.en: He's pledging the Sigma {Phi} fraternity this semester.
e.zh: 他这学期在加入Sigma Phi兄弟会。

e.en: She handed him a small glass {phial} of perfume.
e.zh: 她递给他一个装着香水的小玻璃瓶。

e.en: The wizard poured a glowing potion into a {phial}.
e.zh: 巫师把一瓶发光的药剂倒进小瓶里。

e.en: {Philadelphia} is famous for cheesesteaks and the Liberty Bell.
e.zh: 费城以芝士牛排和自由钟而闻名。

e.en: She's flying to {Philadelphia} for a conference next week.
e.zh: 她下周要飞往费城参加一个会议。

philadelphian.t:
n. 费城人
adj. 费城的

e.en: As a true {Philadelphian}, he bleeds Eagles green.
e.zh: 作为一个地道的费城人,他对老鹰队忠心耿耿。

e.en: The author writes with a distinctly {Philadelphian} voice.
e.zh: 这位作家有着鲜明的费城风格。

e.en: He continued to {philander} despite being newly married.
e.zh: 尽管刚结婚,他仍然到处沾花惹草。

e.en: She refused to marry a man known to {philander}.
e.zh: 她拒绝嫁给一个出了名花心的男人。

e.en: Some old fertilizers contained {phosphorous} compounds harmful to fish.
e.zh: 一些旧式肥料含有对鱼类有害的亚磷化合物。

e.en: Chemists distinguish {phosphorous} acid from phosphoric acid carefully.
e.zh: 化学家会仔细区分亚磷酸和磷酸。

phosphorus.t: n. 磷（化学元素，符号 P）

e.en: Plants need {phosphorus} for healthy root development.
e.zh: 植物需要磷元素来促进根系健康发育。

e.en: Bones store most of the body's {phosphorus}.
e.zh: 人体大部分的磷储存在骨骼中。

e.en: Enzymes called kinases {phosphorylate} proteins to switch them on.
e.zh: 称为激酶的酶通过磷酸化使蛋白质活化。

e.en: Cells {phosphorylate} sugars before using them for energy.
e.zh: 细胞在用糖供能前先对其进行磷酸化。

e.en: Protein {phosphorylation} regulates many cellular signaling pathways.
e.zh: 蛋白质的磷酸化调控着许多细胞信号通路。

e.en: Researchers tracked the {phosphorylation} of a key receptor.
e.zh: 研究人员追踪了一个关键受体的磷酸化过程。

e.en: She posted a {photo} of her dog on Instagram.
e.zh: 她在Instagram上发了一张自家狗狗的照片。

e.en: Can you take a {photo} of us by the fountain?
e.zh: 你能在喷泉旁给我们拍张照吗?

photocall.t: n. 供媒体拍照的安排

e.en: The actors smiled through the lengthy {photocall} on the red carpet.
e.zh: 演员们在红毯上漫长的拍照环节中始终保持微笑。

e.en: Reporters waited for the team {photocall} to begin.
e.zh: 记者们等待着球队的合影拍摄开始。

e.en: The street lamp uses a {photocell} to switch on at dusk.
e.zh: 路灯通过光电管在黄昏时自动点亮。

e.en: A small {photocell} controls the automatic door sensor.
e.zh: 一个小型光电池控制着自动门感应器。

e.en: Sunlight triggers {photochemical} reactions that create city smog.
e.zh: 阳光引发的光化学反应会产生城市烟雾。

e.en: Plants rely on {photochemical} processes during photosynthesis.
e.zh: 植物在光合作用中依赖光化学反应。

photocopied.t: v. 复印（photocopy 的过去式）

e.en: She {photocopied} the contract before sending the original back.
e.zh: 她在寄回原件前先复印了合同。

e.en: He handed out {photocopied} notes at the workshop.
e.zh: 他在研讨会上分发了复印的笔记。

e.en: The office {photocopier} jammed again this morning.
e.zh: 办公室的复印机今早又卡纸了。

e.en: We bought a faster {photocopier} for the marketing team.
e.zh: 我们为市场部购置了一台更快的复印机。

photocopies.t:
n. 复印件
v. 复印（第三人称单数）

e.en: Please make three {photocopies} of this report.
e.zh: 请把这份报告复印三份。

e.en: The teacher distributed {photocopies} to every student.
e.zh: 老师给每个学生发了一份复印件。

photocopy.t:
v. 复印
n. 复印件

e.en: Could you {photocopy} my passport for the application?
e.zh: 你能帮我把护照复印一下用于申请吗?

e.en: I keep a {photocopy} of my ID in my drawer.
e.zh: 我在抽屉里放了一份身份证复印件。

photocopying.t:
v. 复印（现在分词）
n. 复印
