e.en: She spent the afternoon {photocopying} stacks of paperwork.
e.zh: 她整个下午都在复印一摞摞的文件。

e.en: The library charges ten cents per page for {photocopying}.
e.zh: 图书馆复印每页收费十美分。

e.en: The fiber-optic system uses a {photodetector} to convert light signals.
e.zh: 光纤系统利用光电探测器将光信号转换为电信号。

e.en: Engineers tested a more sensitive {photodetector} for the camera.
e.zh: 工程师们为相机测试了一种更灵敏的光电探测器。

e.en: A tiny {photodiode} senses ambient light on your phone.
e.zh: 手机里的小型光电二极管用来感知环境光。

e.en: The remote control uses a {photodiode} to receive infrared signals.
e.zh: 遥控器通过光电二极管接收红外信号。

e.en: Smoke alarms often rely on a {photoelectric} sensor.
e.zh: 烟雾报警器通常依靠光电传感器工作。

e.en: Einstein explained the {photoelectric} effect using light quanta.
e.zh: 爱因斯坦用光量子解释了光电效应。

photogenic.t: adj. 上镜的；适合拍照的

e.en: Their puppy is incredibly {photogenic} on social media.
e.zh: 他们的小狗在社交媒体上特别上镜。

e.en: The old fishing village is wonderfully {photogenic} at sunset.
e.zh: 那个古老的渔村在日落时分极其上镜。

photograph.t:
n. 照片
v. 拍摄

e.en: She framed an old {photograph} of her grandparents.
e.zh: 她把一张祖父母的旧照片装裱了起来。

e.en: Tourists love to {photograph} the cherry blossoms in spring.
e.zh: 游客们喜欢在春天拍摄樱花。

e.en: The wedding was {photographed} by a famous local artist.
e.zh: 婚礼是由当地一位著名艺术家拍摄的。

e.en: She {photographed} every dish before tasting it.
e.zh: 她每道菜都要先拍照再品尝。

e.en: The wedding {photographer} captured every special moment beautifully.
e.zh: 婚礼摄影师精彩地记录下了每一个特别瞬间。

e.en: She works as a freelance fashion {photographer} in Milan.
e.zh: 她在米兰做自由时尚摄影师。

e.en: Hundreds of {photographers} gathered outside the awards ceremony.
e.zh: 数百名摄影师聚集在颁奖典礼外。

e.en: Wildlife {photographers} often wait days for the perfect shot.
e.zh: 野生动物摄影师常常要等上好几天才能拍到完美的画面。

photographic.t: adj. 摄影的；照片般精确的

e.en: He has an almost {photographic} memory for faces.
e.zh: 他对人脸几乎有照相机般的记忆力。

e.en: The exhibition showcased rare {photographic} prints from the 1950s.
e.zh: 展览展出了1950年代的珍稀摄影印刷品。

photographically.t: adv. 以摄影方式；照片般地

e.en: The scene was {photographically} stunning at golden hour.
e.zh: 金色时分的景象在摄影上极为震撼。

e.en: He documented the protest {photographically} for the newspaper.
e.zh: 他用摄影方式为报纸记录了这场抗议。

e.en: The museum displays early {photographies} from the Civil War era.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了内战时期的早期摄影作品。

e.en: Various {photographies} explore identity and memory in this exhibition.
e.zh: 本次展览中各种摄影作品探讨了身份与记忆。

e.en: She spent the morning {photographing} birds in the wetland.
e.zh: 她整个上午都在湿地拍摄鸟类。

e.en: He is {photographing} the wedding ceremony this Saturday.
e.zh: 他将在本周六拍摄那场婚礼。

photographs.t:
n. 照片（复数）
v. 拍摄

e.en: Old family {photographs} filled the dusty shoebox.
e.zh: 满满一鞋盒积灰的老家庭照片。

e.en: She {photographs} food professionally for restaurant menus.
e.zh: 她专业地为餐厅菜单拍摄美食照片。

e.en: Street {photography} captures the rhythm of daily city life.
e.zh: 街头摄影捕捉城市日常生活的节奏。

e.en: He studied {photography} at art school in Berlin.
e.zh: 他在柏林的艺术学校学习摄影。

photojournalism.t: n. 新闻摄影；图片报道

e.en: Her {photojournalism} from war zones won several awards.
e.zh: 她在战区的新闻摄影作品获得了多个奖项。

e.en: Modern {photojournalism} relies heavily on smartphones and social media.
e.zh: 现代新闻摄影在很大程度上依赖智能手机和社交媒体。

e.en: The {photojournalist} embedded with troops in the conflict zone.
e.zh: 这位新闻摄影师随部队进入冲突地区。

e.en: As a freelance {photojournalist}, she travels constantly.
e.zh: 作为自由新闻摄影师,她经常出差。

e.en: Modern chips are manufactured using advanced {photolithography} techniques.
e.zh: 现代芯片采用先进的光刻技术制造。

e.en: {Photolithography} allows engineers to etch nanometer-scale patterns onto silicon.
e.zh: 光刻技术让工程师能在硅片上蚀刻纳米级图案。

e.en: The lab uses a {photometer} to measure light intensity precisely.
e.zh: 实验室使用光度计精确测量光强。

e.en: She calibrated the {photometer} before starting the experiment.
e.zh: 她在实验开始前校准了光度计。

e.en: Astronomers performed a {photometric} analysis of the distant star.
e.zh: 天文学家对那颗遥远恒星进行了光度分析。

e.en: The survey collected {photometric} data across multiple wavelengths.
e.zh: 该巡天项目收集了多个波段的光度数据。

e.en: Stellar {photometry} helps scientists determine a star's brightness.
e.zh: 恒星光度测定帮助科学家确定恒星的亮度。

e.en: The course covers basic principles of {photometry} and spectroscopy.
e.zh: 该课程涵盖光度学和光谱学的基本原理。

e.en: The textbook includes a detailed {photomicrograph} of plant cells.
e.zh: 教科书中收录了一张详细的植物细胞显微照片。

e.en: She mounted the {photomicrograph} in her research presentation.
e.zh: 她将那张显微照片放进了研究报告中。

photomontage.t: n. 照片拼贴；合成照片

e.en: The artist created a striking {photomontage} from old magazines.
e.zh: 艺术家用旧杂志制作了一幅震撼的拼贴照片。

e.en: Her {photomontage} criticizes consumer culture through layered images.
e.zh: 她的照片蒙太奇通过层叠图像批判消费文化。

e.en: The detector uses a {photomultiplier} tube to amplify weak signals.
e.zh: 探测器使用光电倍增管来放大微弱信号。

e.en: A sensitive {photomultiplier} captured the faint scintillation flashes.
e.zh: 灵敏的光电倍增管捕捉到了微弱的闪烁信号。

e.en: A single {photon} can trigger a chemical reaction in the eye.
e.zh: 单个光子就能在眼睛中触发化学反应。

e.en: The laser emits billions of {photon} particles per second.
e.zh: 激光每秒发射数十亿个光子。

e.en: Researchers are developing {photonic} chips that use light instead of electrons.
e.zh: 研究人员正在开发用光替代电子的光子芯片。

e.en: The startup builds {photonic} sensors for autonomous vehicles.
e.zh: 这家初创公司为自动驾驶汽车制造光子传感器。

e.en: Silicon {photonics} promises faster and more efficient data centers.
e.zh: 硅光子学有望带来更快更高效的数据中心。

e.en: He earned his PhD in quantum {photonics} last year.
e.zh: 他去年获得了量子光子学博士学位。

photoreceptor.t: n. 光感受器；感光细胞

e.en: Each {photoreceptor} in the retina responds to specific wavelengths of light.
e.zh: 视网膜中的每个感光细胞都对特定波长的光做出反应。

e.en: Damage to the {photoreceptor} cells can cause progressive blindness.
e.zh: 感光细胞的损伤会导致进行性失明。

e.en: I uploaded the vacation {photos} to the cloud last night.
e.zh: 我昨晚把度假照片上传到云端了。

e.en: Could you send me the wedding {photos} when you have time?
e.zh: 有空的话能把婚礼照片发给我吗?

photosensitive.t: adj. 感光的；对光敏感的

e.en: This film is highly {photosensitive} and must be kept in darkness.
e.zh: 这种胶片非常感光,必须避光保存。

e.en: Some people have {photosensitive} skin that burns easily.
e.zh: 有些人皮肤对光敏感,容易晒伤。

e.en: The Sun's {photosphere} is the visible surface we see from Earth.
e.zh: 太阳的光球层就是我们从地球上看到的可见表面。

e.en: Sunspots appear as dark patches on the {photosphere}.
e.zh: 太阳黑子在光球层上呈现为暗斑。

photostat.t:
n. 影印件
v. 影印

e.en: Please bring a {photostat} of your passport to the office.
e.zh: 请把护照的复印件带到办公室来。

e.en: He kept a {photostat} of the original contract for his records.
e.zh: 他保留了原始合同的复印件作为记录。

e.en: Plants produce oxygen through {photosynthesis} during the day.
e.zh: 植物在白天通过光合作用产生氧气。

e.en: The textbook explains {photosynthesis} with simple diagrams.
e.zh: 教科书用简单的图解说明了光合作用。

e.en: Algae {photosynthesize} efficiently even in low-light conditions.
e.zh: 藻类即使在弱光条件下也能高效进行光合作用。

e.en: Plants need sunlight and water to {photosynthesize} properly.
e.zh: 植物需要阳光和水才能正常进行光合作用。

e.en: Coral reefs depend on tiny {photosynthetic} algae for survival.
e.zh: 珊瑚礁依赖微小的光合藻类生存。

e.en: Scientists discovered new {photosynthetic} bacteria in the deep sea.
e.zh: 科学家在深海中发现了新的光合细菌。

e.en: They installed {photovoltaic} panels on the warehouse roof.
e.zh: 他们在仓库屋顶上安装了光伏太阳能板。

e.en: {Photovoltaic} technology has become much cheaper over the past decade.
e.zh: 过去十年里光伏技术变得便宜了许多。

phrase.t:
n. 短语；措辞
v. 表达

e.en: That's a clever {phrase} to describe the situation.
e.zh: 用这句话来形容这种情况真是巧妙。

e.en: How would you {phrase} this email to sound more polite?
e.zh: 你会怎么措辞这封邮件让它听起来更礼貌?

e.en: She bought a Japanese {phrasebook} before her Tokyo trip.
e.zh: 她在东京之旅前买了一本日语会话手册。

e.en: The {phrasebook} has useful expressions for ordering food abroad.
e.zh: 这本会话手册有许多在国外点餐的实用短语。

e.en: Legal {phraseology} can be confusing for ordinary readers.
e.zh: 法律措辞对普通读者来说可能令人困惑。

e.en: Pilots use standardized {phraseology} when communicating with air traffic control.
e.zh: 飞行员与空管通话时使用标准化的术语。

phrases.t: n. 短语；词组（phrase 的复数）

e.en: Memorizing useful {phrases} helps when traveling abroad.
e.zh: 出国旅行时记住一些实用短语很有帮助。

e.en: The song repeats the same catchy {phrases} throughout.
e.zh: 这首歌从头到尾重复着同样朗朗上口的短语。

phrasing.t:
n. 措辞；表达方式
n. (音乐) 乐句处理

e.en: The {phrasing} of the question seemed deliberately misleading.
e.zh: 这个问题的措辞似乎是故意误导人的。

e.en: The pianist's {phrasing} brought the melody beautifully to life.
e.zh: 钢琴家的乐句处理让旋律生动起来。

e.en: The museum displayed an old {phrenological} chart of the skull.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一张古老的颅相学头骨图。

e.en: Victorian doctors made {phrenological} judgments about character from head shape.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的医生根据头形做出颅相学的性格判断。

e.en: A 19th-century {phrenologist} would feel bumps to assess personality.
e.zh: 19世纪的颅相学家会通过摸头部凸起来判断性格。

e.en: The {phrenologist} ran his fingers carefully over the patient's scalp.
e.zh: 那位颅相学家仔细地在病人头皮上摸索。

e.en: {Phrenology} was once popular but is now considered pseudoscience.
e.zh: 颅相学曾经流行,如今被视为伪科学。

e.en: He wrote a book debunking the claims of {phrenology}.
e.zh: 他写了一本书揭穿颅相学的种种说法。

phrygian.t:
adj. 弗里吉亚的
n. 弗里吉亚人

e.en: The melody is written in the {phrygian} mode.
e.zh: 这段旋律是用弗里吉亚调式写成的。

e.en: Ancient {phrygian} caps appear in many revolutionary artworks.
e.zh: 古代弗里吉亚帽出现在许多革命题材的艺术作品中。

e.en: The lab keeps several {phs} meters calibrated for accurate readings.
e.zh: 实验室保留多台校准好的pH计以确保读数准确。

e.en: Different {phs} levels affect how plants absorb nutrients.
e.zh: 不同的pH值会影响植物吸收养分的方式。

phthalate.t: n. 邻苯二甲酸盐（塑化剂）

e.en: Many countries restrict {phthalate} use in children's toys.
e.zh: 许多国家限制儿童玩具中邻苯二甲酸酯的使用。

e.en: The label proudly states the bottle is {phthalate}-free.
e.zh: 标签自豪地标明该瓶子不含邻苯二甲酸酯。

e.en: We hiked up {Phu} Chi Fa to watch the sunrise.
e.zh: 我们徒步登上Phu Chi Fa山看日出。

e.en: The northern Thai region of {Phu} Phan has stunning national parks.
e.zh: 泰国北部的Phu Phan地区有壮丽的国家公园。

e.en: We spent a week relaxing on the beaches of {Phuket}.
e.zh: 我们在普吉岛的海滩上度过了悠闲的一周。

e.en: Direct flights to {Phuket} get crowded during winter holidays.
e.zh: 飞往普吉岛的直航在寒假期间非常拥挤。

phyla.t: n. (生物) 门（phylum 的复数）

e.en: Scientists have classified animals into about thirty different {phyla}.
e.zh: 科学家将动物划分为约三十个不同的门。

e.en: The textbook lists examples from all major {phyla}.
e.zh: 教科书列出了所有主要门的例子。

phylactery.t: n. (犹太教) 经文护符匣

e.en: He carefully wrapped the {phylactery} around his arm before prayer.
e.zh: 祷告前他小心地把经文护符匣绑在手臂上。

e.en: The ancient {phylactery} contained tiny scrolls of sacred text.
e.zh: 那只古老的护符匣里装着小小的圣经卷。

e.en: Brush each layer of {phyllo} dough with melted butter.
e.zh: 在每层酥皮面团上刷上融化的黄油。

e.en: The bakery makes baklava with paper-thin {phyllo} sheets.
e.zh: 这家面包店用薄如纸的酥皮制作果仁蜜饼。

e.en: The {phylloxera} epidemic devastated French vineyards in the 19th century.
e.zh: 19世纪根瘤蚜虫疫情毁了法国的葡萄园。

e.en: Growers graft vines onto rootstocks resistant to {phylloxera}.
e.zh: 种植者把葡萄藤嫁接到抗根瘤蚜的砧木上。

phylogenetic.t: adj. 系统发育的；进化谱系的

e.en: The {phylogenetic} tree shows how species are evolutionarily related.
e.zh: 这棵系统发育树展示了物种之间的进化关系。

e.en: DNA sequencing has revolutionized {phylogenetic} research.
e.zh: DNA测序彻底改变了系统发育研究。

e.en: Birds and crocodiles are {phylogenetically} closer than they appear.
e.zh: 鸟类和鳄鱼在系统发育上比看起来更接近。

e.en: The two species are {phylogenetically} distinct despite looking alike.
e.zh: 这两个物种虽然外形相似,但在系统发育上截然不同。

phylogeny.t: n. 系统发育；物种演化史

e.en: Researchers reconstructed the {phylogeny} of flowering plants using genetic data.
e.zh: 研究人员利用基因数据重建了开花植物的系统发育关系。

e.en: Understanding {phylogeny} helps explain biodiversity patterns.
e.zh: 了解系统发生学有助于解释生物多样性的模式。

e.en: Insects belong to the {phylum} Arthropoda.
e.zh: 昆虫属于节肢动物门。

e.en: Each {phylum} represents a major branch on the tree of life.
e.zh: 每个门代表生命之树上的一个主要分支。

e.en: The {physiatrist} designed a rehab program for my back injury.
e.zh: 康复医师为我的背部受伤制定了康复方案。

e.en: She referred her patient to a {physiatrist} for chronic pain management.
e.zh: 她将病人转介给康复医师以管理慢性疼痛。

physic.t:
n. 药物；泻药
v. 给…服药

e.en: In old novels, the doctor often gave the patient a bitter {physic}.
e.zh: 在旧小说里,医生常给病人服一剂苦药。

e.en: The herbalist prepared a {physic} from local roots and leaves.
e.zh: 草药师用当地的根和叶配制了一剂泻药。

physical.t:
adj. 身体的；物理的
n. 体检

e.en: Regular {physical} exercise improves both mood and sleep quality.
e.zh: 经常做体育锻炼能改善心情和睡眠质量。

e.en: You'll need a annual {physical} exam before starting the job.
e.zh: 开始工作前你需要做一次年度体检。

e.en: The dancers explored different {physicalities} on stage.
e.zh: 舞者们在台上展现了不同的身体表现形式。

e.en: Each character has unique {physicalities} that define their movements.
e.zh: 每个角色都有独特的肢体特征来定义其动作。

e.en: The actor's {physicality} brought the role to life.
e.zh: 演员的肢体表现让这个角色栩栩如生。

e.en: Rugby demands a level of {physicality} few sports match.
e.zh: 橄榄球对身体对抗的要求是少有运动能比的。

e.en: Training every day left her {physically} exhausted.
e.zh: 每天训练让她身体上筋疲力尽。

e.en: It's {physically} impossible to be in two places at once.
e.zh: 同时出现在两个地方在物理上是不可能的。

e.en: Always consult a licensed {physician} before changing medication.
e.zh: 更改药物前请务必咨询持牌医生。

e.en: The {physician} reviewed her test results carefully.
e.zh: 医生仔细查看了她的检查结果。

e.en: Many {physicians} now use AI tools to assist diagnosis.
e.zh: 许多医生如今使用人工智能工具辅助诊断。

e.en: The hospital hired ten new {physicians} this year.
e.zh: 医院今年新聘了十名医师。

e.en: The {physicist} explained black holes in simple terms.
e.zh: 这位物理学家用通俗的语言解释了黑洞。

e.en: She became a particle {physicist} after graduate school.
e.zh: 研究生毕业后她成为了一名粒子物理学家。

e.en: Quantum {physics} still puzzles even seasoned researchers.
e.zh: 量子物理至今仍让资深研究者感到困惑。

e.en: The game's {physics} engine makes objects fall realistically.
e.zh: 这款游戏的物理引擎让物体下落非常真实。

physio.t: n. 理疗；理疗师（physiotherapy 的缩写）

e.en: My {physio} gave me stretches to fix my back pain.
e.zh: 我的理疗师给了我一些缓解背痛的拉伸动作。

e.en: She booked a {physio} session after the marathon.
e.zh: 跑完马拉松后她预约了一次理疗。

e.en: The novel includes {physiognomic} descriptions of every character.
e.zh: 小说对每个角色都有面相方面的描写。

e.en: Old textbooks made dubious {physiognomic} claims about personality.
e.zh: 旧教科书对相貌与性格作出过可疑的断言。

e.en: Victorians believed {physiognomy} could reveal a person's character.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的人相信面相能揭示一个人的性格。

e.en: His sharp {physiognomy} made him easy to caricature.
e.zh: 他棱角分明的面容使他很容易被画成漫画。

e.en: The map highlights the region's main {physiographic} features.
e.zh: 这张地图突出显示了该地区主要的地貌特征。

e.en: Geologists divided the country into five {physiographic} provinces.
e.zh: 地质学家将该国划分为五个自然地理区。

e.en: Stress triggers a measurable {physiologic} response in the body.
e.zh: 压力会在体内引发可测量的生理反应。

e.en: Doctors monitored her {physiologic} signs throughout surgery.
e.zh: 医生在整个手术过程中监测她的生理指标。

e.en: Lack of sleep has serious {physiological} consequences.
e.zh: 睡眠不足会带来严重的生理后果。

e.en: Fear produces a clear {physiological} reaction in everyone.
e.zh: 恐惧会在每个人身上产生明显的生理反应。

e.en: Babies are {physiologically} different from adults in many ways.
e.zh: 婴儿在许多方面与成人在生理上是不同的。

e.en: Caffeine affects people {physiologically} in surprising ways.
e.zh: 咖啡因对人的生理影响有时令人意外。

e.en: The {physiologist} studied how muscles recover after exercise.
e.zh: 这位生理学家研究肌肉在运动后的恢复过程。

e.en: A sports {physiologist} designed the team's training plan.
e.zh: 一位运动生理学家为球队设计了训练计划。

e.en: She's taking a course in human {physiology} this semester.
e.zh: 她这学期在修人体生理学课程。

e.en: Understanding plant {physiology} helps farmers grow better crops.
e.zh: 了解植物生理学有助于农民种出更好的作物。

e.en: The {physiotherapist} helped him walk again after the accident.
e.zh: 物理治疗师帮助他在事故后重新学会走路。

e.en: My {physiotherapist} recommended swimming for my knee.
e.zh: 我的理疗师建议我用游泳来锻炼膝盖。

e.en: After surgery, she needed months of {physiotherapy}.
e.zh: 手术后她需要接受数月的物理治疗。

e.en: {Physiotherapy} can relieve chronic lower back pain.
e.zh: 物理治疗可以缓解慢性下腰痛。

e.en: Years of swimming gave him a powerful {physique}.
e.zh: 多年的游泳锻炼让他拥有了强壮的体格。

e.en: Her lean {physique} suits long-distance running.
e.zh: 她精瘦的体型很适合长跑。

e.en: Bodybuilders display very different {physiques} from marathon runners.
e.zh: 健美运动员的体型与马拉松选手截然不同。

e.en: The brothers had nearly identical {physiques}.
e.zh: 这对兄弟的体格几乎一模一样。

e.en: An injury to the {physis} can affect a child's growth.
e.zh: 骨骺受伤可能会影响儿童的生长发育。

e.en: Greek philosophers debated the meaning of {physis} or nature.
e.zh: 古希腊哲学家曾辩论“自然”一词的含义。

phytochemical.t:
n. 植物化学物质
adj. 植物化学的

e.en: Berries contain a {phytochemical} linked to brain health.
e.zh: 浆果含有一种与大脑健康相关的植物化学物质。

e.en: Researchers study {phytochemical} compounds in green tea.
e.zh: 研究人员正在研究绿茶中的植物化学成分。

e.en: Soybeans are rich in a natural {phytoestrogen}.
e.zh: 大豆富含一种天然的植物雌激素。

e.en: Some women take {phytoestrogen} supplements during menopause.
e.zh: 一些女性在更年期服用植物雌激素补充剂。

phytolith.t: n. 植硅体（植物矿化结构）

e.en: Archaeologists found a {phytolith} that revealed ancient diets.
e.zh: 考古学家发现了一种植硅体,揭示了古人的饮食。

e.en: Each {phytolith} preserves clues about prehistoric vegetation.
e.zh: 每一颗植硅体都保留着史前植被的线索。

e.en: {Phytoplankton} produce a large share of Earth's oxygen.
e.zh: 浮游植物产生了地球上很大一部分氧气。

e.en: Whales feed indirectly on tiny {phytoplankton} in the ocean.
e.zh: 鲸鱼间接以海洋中微小的浮游植物为食。

e.en: The {pia} mater is the innermost membrane covering the brain.
e.zh: 软脑膜是包裹大脑最内层的膜。

e.en: Surgeons must avoid damaging the {pia} during the operation.
e.zh: 外科医生在手术中必须避免损伤软膜。

piacenza.t: n. 皮亚琴察（意大利城市）

e.en: We stopped in {Piacenza} for lunch on our drive north.
e.zh: 我们在北上的途中停在皮亚琴察吃了午饭。

e.en: {Piacenza} is famous for its medieval architecture and cuisine.
e.zh: 皮亚琴察以其中世纪建筑和美食而闻名。

e.en: The teacher uses {Piagetian} stages to plan classroom activities.
e.zh: 老师按照皮亚杰理论的阶段来安排课堂活动。

e.en: Critics argue {Piagetian} theory underestimates young children.
e.zh: 批评者认为皮亚杰理论低估了幼儿的能力。

pianissimo.t:
adv. 极弱地（音乐术语）
adj. 极弱的

e.en: The pianist played the final notes {pianissimo}.
e.zh: 钢琴家用极弱的音量弹奏了最后几个音符。

e.en: The score marks this passage {pianissimo} for dramatic effect.
e.zh: 乐谱将这段标为极弱以营造戏剧效果。

pianist.t: n. 钢琴家；钢琴演奏者

e.en: The young {pianist} won first prize at the competition.
e.zh: 这位年轻的钢琴家在比赛中获得了一等奖。

e.en: She trained as a concert {pianist} from age five.
e.zh: 她从五岁起就开始接受演奏会钢琴家的训练。

e.en: He plays the {piano} every evening after dinner.
e.zh: 他每天晚饭后都会弹钢琴。

e.en: Their living room has an old upright {piano}.
e.zh: 他们的客厅里放着一架旧立式钢琴。

e.en: Mozart composed many sonatas for the {pianoforte}.
e.zh: 莫扎特为钢琴谱写了许多奏鸣曲。

e.en: The museum displays an original eighteenth-century {pianoforte}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一台原装的十八世纪古钢琴。

e.en: The store sells both grand and upright {pianos}.
e.zh: 这家店同时出售三角钢琴和立式钢琴。

e.en: Two concert {pianos} stood on opposite sides of the stage.
e.zh: 两架音乐会用钢琴分立在舞台的两侧。

e.en: We sipped coffee in the sunny {piazza} all morning.
e.zh: 我们整个上午都在阳光明媚的广场上喝咖啡。

e.en: Tourists gathered in the central {piazza} to watch street performers.
e.zh: 游客们聚在中央广场观看街头表演。

e.en: Send me a {pic} of the dog when you get home.
e.zh: 你到家后给我发张狗狗的照片。

e.en: She posted a {pic} from the concert on Instagram.
e.zh: 她在 Instagram 上发了一张演唱会的照片。

pica.t:
n. 异食癖
n. 十二点活字

e.en: Children with {pica} sometimes eat dirt or paper.
e.zh: 患有异食癖的儿童有时会吃泥土或纸张。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed her craving for ice as {pica}.
e.zh: 医生将她对冰块的渴望诊断为异食癖。

e.en: The {picador} entered the ring on a padded horse.
e.zh: 长矛斗牛士骑着披甲的马进入斗牛场。

e.en: A skilled {picador} weakens the bull before the matador fights.
e.zh: 熟练的长矛手会先削弱公牛,再由斗牛士登场。

e.en: Captain {Picard} commanded the Enterprise in many episodes.
e.zh: 皮卡德舰长在许多集中指挥着进取号。

e.en: Fans dressed as {Picard} for the convention.
e.zh: 粉丝们扮成皮卡德参加了这次大会。

picardy.t: n. 皮卡第（法国北部地区）

e.en: We toured the rolling fields of {Picardy} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们游览了皮卡第起伏的田野。

e.en: {Picardy} saw fierce battles during the First World War.
e.zh: 皮卡第在第一次世界大战期间发生过激烈战斗。

picaresque.t: adj. 流浪汉小说的；描写无赖冒险的

e.en: The novel is a classic {picaresque} adventure full of misadventures.
e.zh: 这部小说是一部充满倒霉遭遇的经典流浪汉冒险故事。

e.en: Don Quixote helped popularize the {picaresque} tradition.
e.zh: 《堂吉诃德》推广了流浪汉小说的传统。

picayune.t: adj. 琐碎的；不值一提的

e.en: He complained about {picayune} details no one else noticed.
e.zh: 他为别人都没注意到的鸡毛蒜皮的细节抱怨个不停。

e.en: Don't waste meetings on {picayune} formatting issues.
e.zh: 不要把会议时间浪费在无关紧要的格式问题上。

piccadilly.t: n. 皮卡迪利（伦敦街道）

e.en: We caught the bus near {Piccadilly} Circus last night.
e.zh: 昨晚我们在皮卡迪利广场附近赶上了公交。

e.en: Bright neon signs light up {Piccadilly} every evening.
e.zh: 明亮的霓虹灯每晚都点亮皮卡迪利大街。

e.en: The {piccolo} cuts through the orchestra with its high notes.
e.zh: 短笛凭借其高音穿透了整个乐队的声音。

e.en: She switched from flute to {piccolo} for the march.
e.zh: 她在进行曲中由长笛换成了短笛。

pice.t: n. 派士（印度小面值硬币）

e.en: In old India, a {pice} was a small copper coin.
e.zh: 在旧时的印度,派士是一种小铜币。

e.en: The merchant haggled over every {pice} of the deal.
e.zh: 商人对这笔交易的每一个铜板都讨价还价。

pick.t:
v. 挑选；采摘
n. 精选；鹤嘴锄

e.en: You can {pick} any seat you like.
e.zh: 你可以挑任何一个你喜欢的座位。

e.en: Please {pick} up the kids from school at three.
e.zh: 请在三点钟去学校接孩子们。

pickaninny.t: n. 黑人小孩（贬义，已过时）

e.en: The slur {pickaninny} appears in old texts and is deeply offensive today.
e.zh: "pickaninny"这一蔑称出现在旧文献中,如今极具冒犯性。

e.en: Scholars discuss the racist history of the word {pickaninny}.
e.zh: 学者们讨论了"pickaninny"一词的种族主义历史。

e.en: The miner swung his {pickax} against the stone wall.
e.zh: 矿工挥动鹤嘴锄向石壁砸去。

e.en: He bought a sturdy {pickax} for clearing the rocky garden.
e.zh: 他买了一把结实的鹤嘴锄来清理满是石头的花园。

e.en: Players use a {pickaxe} to mine ore in the game.
e.zh: 玩家在游戏里用十字镐采集矿石。

e.en: She lifted the heavy {pickaxe} and broke through the ice.
e.zh: 她举起沉重的鹤嘴锄,凿穿了冰层。

picked.t:
adj. 精选的
v. pick 的过去式

e.en: She {picked} the ripest apple from the tree.
e.zh: 她从树上摘下了最熟的那个苹果。

e.en: They {picked} him to lead the new team.
e.zh: 他们选了他来领导新团队。

e.en: Tap the color {picker} to choose a new shade.
e.zh: 点击取色器即可选择新的色调。

e.en: The fruit {picker} worked from sunrise to sunset.
e.zh: 这位果农从日出工作到日落。

e.en: He caught a small {pickerel} in the lake yesterday.
e.zh: 他昨天在湖里钓到一条小梭鱼。

e.en: The {pickerel} darted quickly through the weeds.
e.zh: 那条梭鱼迅速地穿过水草。

e.en: We drove through {Pickering} on our way north.
e.zh: 我们北上时途经皮克林镇。

e.en: The town of {Pickering} is known for its old castle.
e.zh: 皮克林镇以它的古堡而闻名。

picket.t:
n. 纠察队；警戒哨
v. 在…设置纠察

e.en: Workers formed a {picket} line outside the factory.
e.zh: 工人们在工厂外组成了纠察线。

e.en: A white {picket} fence surrounds the cottage.
e.zh: 小屋周围围着一圈白色尖桩篱笆。

picketer.t: n. 纠察员；罢工示威者

e.en: A {picketer} handed me a flyer about the strike.
e.zh: 一位纠察员递给我一张关于罢工的传单。

e.en: Police asked the {picketer} to step back from the gate.
e.zh: 警察要求那位纠察员从大门后退。

picketing.t: n. 设置纠察线（抗议示威）

e.en: Nurses are {picketing} the hospital for better pay.
e.zh: 护士们正在医院外纠察示威,要求加薪。

e.en: The union began {picketing} early this morning.
e.zh: 工会今早开始了纠察活动。

picking.t:
n. 采摘；拾取
v. pick 的现在分词

e.en: She is {picking} apples in the orchard.
e.zh: 她正在果园里摘苹果。

e.en: Stop {picking} at your food and just eat.
e.zh: 别再挑挑拣拣的,快点吃饭。

pickle.t:
n. 腌黄瓜；泡菜
v. 腌渍

e.en: I added a crunchy {pickle} to my sandwich.
e.zh: 我在三明治里加了一根脆脆的腌黄瓜。

e.en: We're in a real {pickle} without the car keys.
e.zh: 没有车钥匙我们真是麻烦大了。

e.en: She served {pickled} cucumbers with the cheese plate.
e.zh: 她在奶酪拼盘旁配了腌黄瓜。

e.en: The chef {pickled} the onions overnight.
e.zh: 厨师把洋葱腌制了一整夜。

e.en: He always orders extra {pickles} on his burger.
e.zh: 他点汉堡时总要多加酸黄瓜。

e.en: Grandma {pickles} her own beets every fall.
e.zh: 奶奶每年秋天都自己腌甜菜。

pickling.t:
n. 腌制
v. 腌渍（进行时）

e.en: She is {pickling} cucumbers from the garden.
e.zh: 她正在腌制花园里摘的黄瓜。

e.en: {Pickling} preserves vegetables for the winter.
e.zh: 腌制可以让蔬菜保存到冬天食用。

e.en: The pitcher made a quick {pickoff} at first base.
e.zh: 投手在一垒迅速完成了一次牵制出局。

e.en: His sneaky {pickoff} move ended the inning.
e.zh: 他狡猾的牵制动作结束了这一局。

e.en: A {pickpocket} stole my wallet on the subway.
e.zh: 一个扒手在地铁上偷走了我的钱包。

e.en: Tourists should watch out for {pickpocket} thieves.
e.zh: 游客应当小心扒手。

picks.t:
v. 挑选（第三人称单数）
n. 精选

e.en: She {picks} flowers from the garden every Sunday.
e.zh: 她每周日都会从花园里摘花。

e.en: He always {picks} the shortest line at the store.
e.zh: 他在商店里总是挑最短的队伍排。

pickup.t:
n. 皮卡车；拾取
n. 接人；好转

e.en: My order is ready for {pickup} at the counter.
e.zh: 我的订单已经可以在柜台取了。

e.en: He drives a red {pickup} truck to work.
e.zh: 他开着一辆红色皮卡车去上班。

pickwick.t: n. 匹克威克（狄更斯小说人物）

e.en: Dickens wrote "The {Pickwick} Papers" in the 1830s.
e.zh: 狄更斯在十九世纪三十年代写了《匹克威克外传》。

e.en: Mr. {Pickwick} is one of literature's most beloved characters.
e.zh: 匹克威克先生是文学中最受喜爱的人物之一。

picky.t: adj. 挑剔的；爱挑毛病的

e.en: My toddler is really {picky} about vegetables.
e.zh: 我家小孩对蔬菜特别挑食。

e.en: Don't be so {picky} when choosing a movie.
e.zh: 选电影时别这么挑剔。

picnic.t:
n. 野餐
v. 去野餐

e.en: We had a {picnic} by the lake on Saturday.
e.zh: 周六我们在湖边野餐。

e.en: Raising twins is no {picnic}, believe me.
e.zh: 养双胞胎可不是闹着玩的,相信我。

e.en: A {picnicker} left a basket on the bench.
e.zh: 一位野餐者把篮子忘在了长椅上。

e.en: Every {picnicker} in the park watched the sunset.
e.zh: 公园里每个野餐的人都在欣赏日落。

e.en: Families were {picnicking} under the cherry trees.
e.zh: 一家家人正在樱花树下野餐。

e.en: {Picnicking} is not allowed in this protected area.
e.zh: 这片保护区内禁止野餐。

e.en: Summer {picnics} are a tradition in our family.
e.zh: 夏日野餐是我们家的传统。

e.en: The park hosts community {picnics} every July.
e.zh: 公园每年七月都举办社区野餐活动。

e.en: The chip operates on the {pico} scale of seconds.
e.zh: 这块芯片以皮秒级的速度运行。

e.en: She edited the file using the {pico} text editor.
e.zh: 她用 pico 文本编辑器编辑了文件。

picosecond.t: n. 皮秒（万亿分之一秒）

e.en: The laser pulse lasted only one {picosecond}.
e.zh: 这束激光脉冲只持续了一皮秒。

e.en: Modern processors switch states in a {picosecond}.
e.zh: 现代处理器在一皮秒内即可切换状态。

pict.t: n. 皮克特人（古苏格兰民族）

e.en: A {Pict} warrior was buried beneath the stones.
e.zh: 一名皮克特战士被埋在那些石头下面。

e.en: The ancient {Pict} tribes lived in northern Scotland.
e.zh: 古代皮克特部落生活在苏格兰北部。

pictish.t:
adj. 皮克特人的
n. 皮克特语

e.en: Carved {Pictish} stones still stand across Scotland.
e.zh: 雕刻的皮克特石碑至今仍矗立在苏格兰各地。

e.en: The museum displayed several {Pictish} symbols and artifacts.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了若干皮克特符号与文物。

e.en: Each restroom has a clear {pictogram} on the door.
e.zh: 每个洗手间门上都有清晰的图标。

e.en: The chart used a {pictogram} to show population data.
e.zh: 图表使用图形符号来呈现人口数据。

pictograph.t: n. 象形文字；图示符号

e.en: Ancient cave walls feature a deer {pictograph}.
e.zh: 古老的洞壁上有一幅鹿的象形图。

e.en: Each {pictograph} represents a single concept or word.
e.zh: 每个象形符号代表一个概念或词语。

pictographic.t: adj. 象形文字的；图示的

e.en: Chinese is largely a {pictographic} writing system.
e.zh: 汉语在很大程度上是一种象形文字系统。

e.en: They studied {pictographic} scripts of ancient civilizations.
e.zh: 他们研究了古代文明的象形文字。

e.en: The ferry from {Picton} crosses to the North Island.
e.zh: 从皮克顿出发的渡轮驶向北岛。

e.en: We spent the night in the small port of {Picton}.
e.zh: 我们在皮克顿这个小港口过了一夜。

pictorial.t:
adj. 图片的；用图表示的
n. 画报

e.en: The book offers a {pictorial} history of Tokyo.
e.zh: 这本书是一部图文并茂的东京历史。

e.en: She enjoys magazines with a {pictorial} format.
e.zh: 她喜欢以图片为主的杂志。

pictorially.t: adv. 以图画方式；形象地

e.en: The data is presented {pictorially} for clarity.
e.zh: 数据以图示方式呈现,以便清晰理解。

e.en: Children learn faster when taught {pictorially}.
e.zh: 孩子们通过图像学习的速度更快。

picture.t:
n. 图片；照片
v. 想象；描绘

e.en: Can you take a {picture} of us by the fountain?
e.zh: 你能给我们在喷泉旁拍张照吗?

e.en: Try to {picture} the room before we paint it.
e.zh: 在我们粉刷之前,先想象一下这个房间的样子。

pictured.t:
adj. 图示的
v. 描绘（picture 过去式）

e.en: The couple {pictured} above just got engaged.
e.zh: 上图中的这对情侣刚刚订婚。

e.en: She {pictured} herself living by the sea someday.
e.zh: 她想象着自己有一天住在海边。

e.en: He posts beach {pictures} on Instagram every weekend.
e.zh: 他每个周末都在 Instagram 上发海滩照片。

e.en: My phone {pictures} look better with this filter.
e.zh: 用这个滤镜后,我手机里的照片更好看了。

picturesque.t: adj. 风景如画的；生动的

e.en: We stayed in a {picturesque} village in Italy.
e.zh: 我们住在意大利的一个风景如画的小村庄里。

e.en: The harbor looked especially {picturesque} at sunset.
e.zh: 夕阳下的港口显得格外秀丽。

picturesquely.t: adv. 风景如画地；生动地

e.en: The cottage sits {picturesquely} on the hillside.
e.zh: 小屋如画般坐落在山坡上。

e.en: Vines grow {picturesquely} along the old stone wall.
e.zh: 藤蔓沿着古老的石墙优美地攀爬。

picturing.t: v. 想象；描绘（picture 现在分词）

e.en: I'm {picturing} the layout of the new kitchen.
e.zh: 我正在脑海中构想新厨房的布局。

e.en: She kept {picturing} her family back home.
e.zh: 她不停地想象着家乡的家人。

e.en: Don't {piddle} away your afternoon on social media.
e.zh: 别把整个下午都浪费在刷社交媒体上。

e.en: The puppy might {piddle} on the rug if untrained.
e.zh: 小狗如果没训练好,可能会在地毯上撒尿。

piddling.t: adj. 微不足道的；琐碎的

e.en: They paid me a {piddling} sum for the work.
e.zh: 他们为这份工作只付了我一点点钱。

e.en: Don't worry about such {piddling} details right now.
e.zh: 现在别担心这些微不足道的细节。

e.en: Sailors developed a {pidgin} to trade across cultures.
e.zh: 水手们发展出一种洋泾浜语用于跨文化贸易。

e.en: Hawaiian {pidgin} blends English with Polynesian words.
e.zh: 夏威夷洋泾浜语融合了英语与波利尼西亚词汇。

e.en: Mom baked an apple {pie} for dessert tonight.
e.zh: 妈妈今晚烤了苹果派当甜点。

e.en: Everyone wants a bigger slice of the {pie}.
e.zh: 每个人都想分到更大一块蛋糕。

piebald.t: adj. 黑白花斑的（多指马）

e.en: A {piebald} horse grazed quietly in the meadow.
e.zh: 一匹花斑马在草地上静静吃草。

e.en: Her {piebald} cat has black and white patches.
e.zh: 她的猫长着黑白相间的花斑。

piece.t:
n. 一块；一片；作品
v. 拼凑

e.en: Can I have another {piece} of cake, please?
e.zh: 我可以再要一块蛋糕吗?

e.en: She wrote a thoughtful {piece} on climate change.
e.zh: 她写了一篇关于气候变化的深度文章。

piecemeal.t:
adv. 零碎地；逐步地
adj. 零星的

e.en: Reforms were introduced in a {piecemeal} fashion.
e.zh: 改革是以零敲碎打的方式推行的。

e.en: Don't tackle the project {piecemeal}; plan it fully.
e.zh: 别零碎地处理这个项目,要做整体规划。

e.en: The vase shattered into a hundred {pieces}.
e.zh: 花瓶摔成了一百多块碎片。

e.en: The puzzle has five hundred tiny {pieces}.
e.zh: 这个拼图有五百块小碎片。

e.en: Many seamstresses are paid by {piecework} rates.
e.zh: 许多裁缝是按计件工资来计算报酬的。

e.en: He prefers {piecework} because he works very fast.
e.zh: 他喜欢做计件活,因为他干活很快。

e.en: The {Pied} Piper led the children out of town.
e.zh: 花衣魔笛手把孩子们带出了小镇。

e.en: A {pied} crow landed on the windowsill.
e.zh: 一只花斑乌鸦落在了窗台上。

piedmont.t: n. 山麓地带；皮埃蒙特（地名）

e.en: The {piedmont} region lies between mountains and plains.
e.zh: 山麓地带位于群山与平原之间。

e.en: We toured vineyards in the Italian {Piedmont}.
e.zh: 我们参观了意大利皮埃蒙特地区的葡萄酒庄。

e.en: We walked to the end of the {pier} at dusk.
e.zh: 傍晚时分我们走到了码头的尽头。

e.en: Fishermen cast their lines off the wooden {pier}.
e.zh: 渔夫们从木制码头甩出鱼线。

e.en: The needle can {pierce} even thick leather easily.
e.zh: 这根针甚至能轻易刺穿厚皮革。

e.en: Bright lights {pierce} through the morning fog.
e.zh: 明亮的光线穿透了清晨的薄雾。

e.en: She finally got her ears {pierced} last weekend.
e.zh: 她终于在上周末打了耳洞。

e.en: A loud scream {pierced} the silence of the night.
e.zh: 一声尖叫划破了夜晚的寂静。

piercing.t:
adj. 尖锐的；刺骨的
n. 穿孔；穿环

e.en: She gave him a {piercing} stare across the table.
e.zh: 她隔着桌子犀利地盯了他一眼。

e.en: He got a new ear {piercing} at the mall yesterday.
e.zh: 他昨天在商场打了一个新的耳洞。

e.en: The baby cried {piercingly} throughout the long flight.
e.zh: 婴儿在整个长途飞行中尖声哭闹。

e.en: She looked at him {piercingly}, demanding the truth.
e.zh: 她锐利地看着他，要求他说实话。

e.en: My French colleague {Pierre} just moved to New York.
e.zh: 我的法国同事皮埃尔刚搬到纽约。

e.en: {Pierre} is the capital of South Dakota.
e.zh: 皮尔是南达科他州的首府。

e.en: The clown wore a classic {Pierrot} costume on stage.
e.zh: 小丑在舞台上穿着经典的皮埃罗戏服。

e.en: A sad {Pierrot} figure appeared in many old paintings.
e.zh: 忧伤的皮埃罗形象出现在许多旧画作中。

e.en: Grandma baked three apple {pies} for Thanksgiving dinner.
e.zh: 奶奶为感恩节晚餐烤了三个苹果派。

e.en: The bakery sells fresh meat {pies} every morning.
e.zh: 那家面包店每天早上都卖新鲜的肉派。

pieta.t: n. 圣母怜子像（艺术题材）

e.en: Michelangelo's {Pieta} draws millions of visitors each year.
e.zh: 米开朗基罗的《圣殇》每年吸引数百万游客。

e.en: The chapel displays a marble {pieta} from the Renaissance.
e.zh: 小教堂展出一尊文艺复兴时期的大理石圣殇像。

pieties.t: n. 虔诚之举；陈词滥调（复数）

e.en: He dismissed the politician's empty {pieties} about family values.
e.zh: 他对那位政客关于家庭价值观的空洞陈词不屑一顾。

e.en: The book criticizes conventional {pieties} of modern parenting.
e.zh: 这本书批评了现代育儿中老套的虔诚说教。

e.en: German {pietism} influenced Protestant thought in the eighteenth century.
e.zh: 德国虔敬主义影响了十八世纪的新教思想。

e.en: Her writing rejects the {pietism} common in religious circles.
e.zh: 她的作品拒绝宗教圈中常见的虔敬主义。

pietistic.t: adj. 虔信派的；过分虔诚的

e.en: The novel takes a {pietistic} tone that feels outdated today.
e.zh: 这部小说带有今天看来过时的虔敬腔调。

e.en: He grew up in a strict {pietistic} household.
e.zh: 他在一个严格的虔敬派家庭中长大。

e.en: Her quiet {piety} impressed everyone in the congregation.
e.zh: 她安静的虔诚感动了会众中的每一个人。

e.en: The film questions whether public {piety} matches private behavior.
e.zh: 这部电影质疑表面虔诚是否与私下行为相符。

e.en: The lighter uses a {piezoelectric} crystal to create sparks.
e.zh: 这种打火机利用压电晶体产生火花。

e.en: Engineers developed {piezoelectric} sensors for measuring tiny vibrations.
e.zh: 工程师开发了用于测量微小振动的压电传感器。

pig.t:
n. 猪；贪婪者
v. 大吃

e.en: The farmer raises one {pig} in the back yard.
e.zh: 那位农夫在后院养了一头猪。

e.en: Stop eating like a {pig} at the dinner table.
e.zh: 在餐桌上别再像猪一样狼吞虎咽。

e.en: A grey {pigeon} landed on the windowsill outside.
e.zh: 一只灰鸽子落在外面的窗台上。

e.en: Tourists feed bread to every {pigeon} in the square.
e.zh: 游客在广场上给每只鸽子喂面包。

pigeonhole.t:
n. 鸽巢式分格
v. 把…归类；搁置

e.en: Don't {pigeonhole} her as just a pop singer.
e.zh: 别把她简单地归类为流行歌手。

e.en: He found a note tucked into his office {pigeonhole}.
e.zh: 他在办公室的信件格里找到一张便条。

e.en: Hundreds of {pigeons} gather in the city square daily.
e.zh: 每天都有数百只鸽子聚集在城市广场。

e.en: The old man feeds {pigeons} every morning at sunrise.
e.zh: 那位老人每天日出时都喂鸽子。

e.en: The smell from the {piggery} carried across the field.
e.zh: 养猪场的气味飘过田野。

e.en: His grandfather ran a small {piggery} outside the village.
e.zh: 他祖父在村外经营一个小养猪场。

e.en: His {piggish} table manners embarrassed everyone at the dinner.
e.zh: 他粗鲁贪吃的餐桌举止让所有人都很尴尬。

e.en: She found his {piggish} attitude toward food rather disgusting.
e.zh: 她觉得他对食物贪婪的态度相当令人反感。

piggy.t:
n. 小猪
adj. 贪吃的

e.en: My daughter saves coins in a pink {piggy} bank.
e.zh: 我女儿把硬币存在一个粉色的小猪存钱罐里。

e.en: The toddler counted his ten little {piggy} toes.
e.zh: 那个小孩数着他十只胖胖的小脚趾头。

piggyback.t:
adv. 背驮式地
v. 搭载；依附

e.en: Dad gave the toddler a {piggyback} ride home from the park.
e.zh: 爸爸背着小孩从公园回家。

e.en: Our startup will {piggyback} on the existing payment platform.
e.zh: 我们的初创公司将搭便车利用现有的支付平台。

e.en: The tiny {piglet} followed its mother around the pen.
e.zh: 小猪仔跟着母猪在猪圈里转来转去。

e.en: Children laughed as the pink {piglet} squealed loudly.
e.zh: 孩子们看到粉色小猪大声尖叫都笑了。

e.en: Artists mixed natural {pigment} with oil to make paint.
e.zh: 画家把天然颜料和油混合制成油彩。

e.en: Melanin is the {pigment} that gives skin its color.
e.zh: 黑色素是赋予皮肤颜色的色素。

e.en: Sun exposure can change the {pigmentation} of your skin.
e.zh: 日晒会改变你皮肤的色素沉着。

e.en: The bird's bright {pigmentation} helps attract a mate.
e.zh: 这种鸟鲜艳的色素沉着有助于吸引配偶。

e.en: Heavily {pigmented} lipsticks last longer than sheer ones.
e.zh: 色彩浓郁的口红比薄透款持久。

e.en: The dermatologist examined a darkly {pigmented} spot on her arm.
e.zh: 皮肤科医生检查了她手臂上一块深色斑点。

e.en: Your bedroom looks like a {pigpen} again this week.
e.zh: 你的卧室这周又像猪窝一样脏乱。

e.en: The farmer cleaned out the {pigpen} every Saturday morning.
e.zh: 农夫每周六早上都清理猪圈。

e.en: The farmer feeds his {pigs} twice a day.
e.zh: 农夫每天喂两次猪。

e.en: Wild {pigs} have damaged crops across the region.
e.zh: 野猪已破坏了该地区的农作物。

e.en: He bought a {pigskin} wallet at the leather shop.
e.zh: 他在皮具店买了一个猪皮钱包。

e.en: The quarterback gripped the {pigskin} and threw a touchdown.
e.zh: 四分卫握紧橄榄球，投出一记达阵传球。

e.en: Clean up your room — it's a total {pigsty}.
e.zh: 把你的房间收拾一下，简直就是个猪窝。

e.en: The old {pigsty} behind the barn needs new fencing.
e.zh: 谷仓后面那个旧猪圈需要换新围栏。

e.en: She tied her hair into a single {pigtail} for practice.
e.zh: 她把头发扎成一条辫子去练习。

e.en: The little girl wore a red ribbon on each {pigtail}.
e.zh: 小女孩在每条小辫子上系了红丝带。

e.en: A {pigtailed} girl sat reading on the park bench.
e.zh: 一个扎辫子的女孩坐在公园长椅上看书。

e.en: The {pigtailed} children waved as the school bus arrived.
e.zh: 扎着辫子的孩子们在校车到达时挥手。

e.en: Farmers struggle to control {pigweed} in soybean fields.
e.zh: 农民们在大豆田里努力控制苋菜杂草。

e.en: This {pigweed} has grown resistant to several herbicides.
e.zh: 这种苋菜已经对几种除草剂产生了抗药性。

e.en: He used a Water {Pik} to clean between his teeth.
e.zh: 他用冲牙器清洁牙缝。

e.en: The dentist recommended a Water {Pik} for daily flossing.
e.zh: 牙医推荐每天用冲牙器代替牙线。

pika.t: n. 鼠兔（小型哺乳动物）

e.en: A small {pika} darted between the rocks on the mountain.
e.zh: 一只小鼠兔在山上的岩石间飞快穿梭。

e.en: Climate change threatens the {pika} population in alpine regions.
e.zh: 气候变化威胁着高山地区的鼠兔种群。

pike.t: n. 梭鱼；长矛；收费公路

e.en: He caught a huge {pike} in the lake yesterday.
e.zh: 他昨天在湖里钓到一条大梭鱼。

e.en: The medieval soldier carried a long iron {pike}.
e.zh: 那位中世纪士兵扛着一支长铁矛。

e.en: Don't be a {piker} — pitch in for the gift.
e.zh: 别那么小气，凑钱一起买礼物吧。

e.en: He's a {piker} who never tips the waitstaff properly.
e.zh: 他是个吝啬鬼，从不好好给服务员小费。

e.en: She forgot to take her morning {pil} again today.
e.zh: 她今天又忘了吃早上的药丸。

e.en: The doctor prescribed one {pil} every eight hours.
e.zh: 医生开了每八小时服一片的药。

pilaf.t: n. 抓饭（中东米饭料理）

e.en: She served chicken with saffron rice {pilaf} for dinner.
e.zh: 她晚餐做了鸡肉配藏红花抓饭。

e.en: This restaurant makes the best lamb {pilaf} in town.
e.zh: 这家餐厅做的羊肉抓饭是城里最好的。

e.en: A decorative {pilaster} flanks each side of the entrance.
e.zh: 装饰性壁柱分立在入口两侧。

e.en: The architect added a marble {pilaster} to the facade.
e.zh: 建筑师在外立面上加了一根大理石壁柱。

e.en: Pontius {Pilate} appears in many Renaissance paintings.
e.zh: 本丢·彼拉多出现在许多文艺复兴时期的画作中。

e.en: The play depicts {Pilate} as a conflicted Roman official.
e.zh: 这出戏把彼拉多描绘成一个内心矛盾的罗马官员。

e.en: She opened a tin of {pilchard} for lunch.
e.zh: 她打开一罐沙丁鱼当午餐。

e.en: Cornish fishermen once relied on the {pilchard} trade.
e.zh: 康沃尔渔民曾经依赖沙丁鱼贸易为生。

pile.t:
n. 一堆
v. 堆积

e.en: There's a huge {pile} of laundry on the bed.
e.zh: 床上堆着一大堆要洗的衣服。

e.en: Don't {pile} more work onto an already stressed team.
e.zh: 别再把更多工作压给本已紧张的团队。

e.en: A {pileated} woodpecker hammered loudly on the dead oak.
e.zh: 一只北美黑啄木鸟在枯橡树上大声敲击。

e.en: Birders hope to spot a {pileated} woodpecker in this forest.
e.zh: 观鸟者希望在这片森林里发现北美黑啄木鸟。

piled.t:
adj. 堆积的
v. 堆积（过去式）

e.en: She {piled} the dishes high in the kitchen sink.
e.zh: 她把盘子高高地堆在厨房水槽里。

e.en: Books were {piled} everywhere in the cluttered study.
e.zh: 杂乱的书房里到处堆满了书。

e.en: There are {piles} of paperwork waiting on his desk.
e.zh: 他桌上堆着成堆的文件等待处理。

e.en: She has {piles} of photos from her recent trip.
e.zh: 她最近旅行拍了一大堆照片。

e.en: A twenty-car {pileup} closed the highway for hours.
e.zh: 一起二十辆车的连环相撞使高速公路关闭数小时。

e.en: Fog caused a massive {pileup} on the interstate this morning.
e.zh: 今早大雾在州际公路上造成了大规模连环车祸。

e.en: Employees sometimes {pilfer} office supplies for personal use.
e.zh: 员工有时会顺手拿办公用品自用。

e.en: He was caught trying to {pilfer} candy from the shop.
e.zh: 他试图从商店里偷拿糖果时被抓住了。

pilferage.t: n. 小偷小摸；偷窃行为

e.en: Warehouse {pilferage} costs the company thousands each year.
e.zh: 仓库小偷小摸每年给公司造成数千元损失。

e.en: Better security cameras helped reduce {pilferage} in the store.
e.zh: 更好的监控摄像头帮助减少了店内的偷窃。

pilfered.t:
adj. 偷来的
v. 偷（过去式）

e.en: The intern {pilfered} pens and notebooks from the supply closet.
e.zh: 实习生从储物柜里顺走了笔和笔记本。

e.en: Someone {pilfered} snacks from the office kitchen again.
e.zh: 又有人从办公室厨房里顺走了零食。

pilfering.t:
n. 小偷小摸
v. 偷窃

e.en: The clerk was fired for {pilfering} cash from the register.
e.zh: 那位店员因从收银机偷钱而被解雇。

e.en: Constant {pilfering} by staff hurt the small bookstore's profits.
e.zh: 员工不断小偷小摸损害了这家小书店的利润。

e.en: Every {pilgrim} bowed before entering the ancient temple.
e.zh: 每位朝圣者在进入古庙前都鞠躬致敬。

e.en: A weary {pilgrim} rested at the roadside shrine.
e.zh: 一位疲惫的朝圣者在路边神龛旁休息。

e.en: Millions make the {pilgrimage} to Mecca each year.
e.zh: 每年有数百万人前往麦加朝圣。

e.en: Fans made a {pilgrimage} to the late musician's hometown.
e.zh: 歌迷们前往这位已故音乐家的故乡朝圣。

e.en: Thousands of {pilgrims} arrive in Mecca every year.
e.zh: 每年有数千名朝圣者前往麦加。

e.en: The {pilgrims} celebrated the first harvest in 1621.
e.zh: 清教徒移民在1621年庆祝了首次丰收。

piling.t:
n. 桩；桩基
v. 堆积

e.en: Snow kept {piling} up outside the front door.
e.zh: 雪不断在前门外堆积起来。

e.en: Workers drove a steel {piling} into the riverbed.
e.zh: 工人们将一根钢桩打入河床。

e.en: The dock rests on dozens of wooden {pilings}.
e.zh: 码头建在数十根木桩之上。

e.en: Rusted {pilings} still mark where the pier collapsed.
e.zh: 锈蚀的桩柱仍标示着码头倒塌的位置。

e.en: Take one {pill} with water after every meal.
e.zh: 每餐饭后用水送服一片药。

e.en: Losing the match was a bitter {pill} to swallow.
e.zh: 输掉比赛是个难以下咽的苦果。

pillage.t:
v. 劫掠；抢劫
n. 掠夺

e.en: Invading soldiers began to {pillage} the coastal villages.
e.zh: 入侵的士兵开始洗劫沿海村庄。

e.en: The museum displays artifacts saved from wartime {pillage}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了战时劫掠中抢救下来的文物。

pillaging.t:
v. 劫掠；抢劫
n. 掠夺行为

e.en: The army was accused of {pillaging} ancient temples.
e.zh: 军队被指控洗劫古老的寺庙。

e.en: Vikings spent years {pillaging} towns along the coast.
e.zh: 维京人多年来沿海岸线四处劫掠城镇。

e.en: Honesty is a {pillar} of any healthy relationship.
e.zh: 诚实是任何健康关系的支柱。

e.en: A marble {pillar} supports the temple's heavy roof.
e.zh: 一根大理石柱支撑着神庙沉重的屋顶。

e.en: The {pillared} courthouse dominates the small town square.
e.zh: 那座立柱式法院主宰着小镇广场。

e.en: Tourists photographed the grand {pillared} entrance of the museum.
e.zh: 游客们拍下了博物馆宏伟的立柱入口。

e.en: She kept her vitamins in a weekly {pillbox}.
e.zh: 她把维生素装在一个每周药盒里。

e.en: A concrete {pillbox} from the war still stands nearby.
e.zh: 附近仍矗立着一座战时的混凝土碉堡。

e.en: Cheap sweaters often start {pilling} after a few washes.
e.zh: 廉价毛衣洗几次后常常会起球。

e.en: This fabric resists {pilling} even after heavy use.
e.zh: 这种面料即使经常使用也不易起球。

e.en: She rode {pillion} on her brother's motorbike.
e.zh: 她坐在哥哥摩托车的后座上。

e.en: Helmets are required for the {pillion} passenger too.
e.zh: 后座乘客也必须佩戴头盔。

pillock.t: n. 笨蛋，蠢货（英式俚语）

e.en: Don't be such a {pillock} about losing the keys.
e.zh: 别为弄丢钥匙的事像个傻瓜似的。

e.en: He called the driver a {pillock} for cutting in.
e.zh: 他骂那个加塞的司机是个蠢货。

pillory.t:
v. 公开羞辱
n. 颈手枷

e.en: Critics will {pillory} the company for its data leak.
e.zh: 评论人士将因数据泄露事件公开抨击该公司。

e.en: The tabloids love to {pillory} struggling celebrities.
e.zh: 小报喜欢公开嘲弄陷入困境的名人。

e.en: He buried his face in a soft {pillow}.
e.zh: 他把脸埋进一个柔软的枕头里。

e.en: A good {pillow} can completely change your sleep quality.
e.zh: 一个好枕头能彻底改变你的睡眠质量。

e.en: She changed the {pillowcase} every Sunday morning.
e.zh: 她每个周日早上都会换枕套。

e.en: Silk {pillowcase} fabric is gentler on your hair.
e.zh: 丝绸枕套的面料对头发更温和。

e.en: The hotel provides crisp white {pillowcases} every night.
e.zh: 酒店每晚都提供洁白挺括的枕套。

e.en: She bought matching sheets and {pillowcases} on sale.
e.zh: 她趁打折买了配套的床单和枕套。

e.en: The sofa is covered in colorful decorative {pillows}.
e.zh: 沙发上摆满了五颜六色的装饰抱枕。

e.en: Hotels often stack four {pillows} on every bed.
e.zh: 酒店通常会在每张床上摞四个枕头。

pillowy.t: adj. 松软的，如枕头般的

e.en: The bakery serves warm, {pillowy} dinner rolls.
e.zh: 这家面包店供应温热松软的小餐包。

e.en: She sank into the {pillowy} cushions of the armchair.
e.zh: 她陷入扶手椅松软的坐垫里。

e.en: Doctors prescribed two {pills} a day for the infection.
e.zh: 医生为感染开了每天两片的药。

e.en: Old wool sweaters tend to form tiny {pills}.
e.zh: 旧羊毛衫容易起小球球。

pilot.t:
n. 飞行员；试点
v. 驾驶，试行

e.en: The {pilot} announced that we were beginning our descent.
e.zh: 机长宣布我们开始下降了。

e.en: The team launched a {pilot} program in three cities.
e.zh: 团队在三个城市推出了试点项目。

e.en: The captain steered the ferry from the {pilothouse}.
e.zh: 船长在驾驶舱里掌舵这艘渡轮。

e.en: Rain hammered against the windows of the {pilothouse}.
e.zh: 雨点猛烈地敲打着驾驶室的窗户。

piloting.t:
n. 驾驶；领航
v. 试点运行

e.en: She has been {piloting} commercial jets for fifteen years.
e.zh: 她驾驶商用喷气机已经十五年了。

e.en: The school is {piloting} a new online curriculum.
e.zh: 学校正在试行一套新的在线课程。

e.en: The military uses {pilotless} drones for reconnaissance missions.
e.zh: 军方使用无人驾驶飞机执行侦察任务。

e.en: Engineers tested a {pilotless} taxi on closed streets.
e.zh: 工程师在封闭街道上测试了一辆无人驾驶出租车。

e.en: Airline {pilots} train for years before flying passengers.
e.zh: 航空公司飞行员要训练多年才能载客飞行。

e.en: The network ordered six new sitcom {pilots} this season.
e.zh: 电视网本季订购了六部新情景喜剧的试播集。

e.en: He ordered a cold {pilsner} at the rooftop bar.
e.zh: 他在屋顶酒吧点了一杯冰镇皮尔森啤酒。

e.en: This brewery is famous for its crisp {pilsner}.
e.zh: 这家酿酒厂以其清爽的皮尔森啤酒而闻名。

e.en: She stuffed each olive with a tiny {pimento} slice.
e.zh: 她在每颗橄榄里塞了一小片甜椒。

e.en: Southern cooks love {pimento} cheese on white bread.
e.zh: 南方厨师喜欢用白面包搭配甜椒奶酪。

e.en: The salad was topped with strips of red {pimiento}.
e.zh: 沙拉上撒着红色的甜椒条。

e.en: He spread {pimiento} cheese on warm crackers.
e.zh: 他把甜椒奶酪抹在温热的饼干上。

pimp.t:
n. 皮条客
v. 拉皮条；改装炫耀

e.en: Police arrested a {pimp} operating near the train station.
e.zh: 警方逮捕了一名在火车站附近活动的皮条客。

e.en: Teenagers used to {pimp} their cars with neon lights.
e.zh: 青少年过去喜欢用霓虹灯改装他们的车。

pimpernel.t: n. 琉璃繁缕（一种野花）

e.en: A scarlet {pimpernel} bloomed beside the garden path.
e.zh: 一朵猩红的琉璃繁缕在花园小径旁绽放。

e.en: Children pressed {pimpernel} flowers between book pages.
e.zh: 孩子们把琉璃繁缕的花朵夹在书页之间。

e.en: A red {pimple} appeared on her forehead overnight.
e.zh: 她额头上一夜之间冒出一颗红痘痘。

e.en: Don't pop that {pimple} or it will leave a scar.
e.zh: 别挤那颗痘痘,不然会留下疤痕。

e.en: His {pimpled} face turned red with embarrassment.
e.zh: 他长满痘痘的脸因尴尬涨得通红。

e.en: The teenager hid his {pimpled} chin behind a scarf.
e.zh: 那个青少年用围巾遮住了长痘的下巴。

e.en: A {pimply} teenager took our order at the counter.
e.zh: 一个满脸痘痘的青少年在柜台为我们点单。

e.en: Stress can leave even adults with {pimply} skin.
e.zh: 压力会让成年人也长出满是痘痘的皮肤。

pin.t:
n. 别针；图钉
v. 固定，钉住

e.en: Please {pin} this notice to the office bulletin board.
e.zh: 请把这则通知钉在办公室公告板上。

e.en: You'll need a four-digit {pin} to unlock the device.
e.zh: 你需要四位数密码来解锁设备。

e.en: The little girl wore a checkered {pinafore} to school.
e.zh: 小女孩穿着格子背心裙去上学。

e.en: Mom tied a {pinafore} over her dress before cooking.
e.zh: 妈妈做饭前在裙子外系上一条围裙。

pinata.t: n. 皮纳塔（装糖果的彩色纸罐）

e.en: The kids took turns swinging at the colorful {pinata}.
e.zh: 孩子们轮流敲打那个色彩鲜艳的皮纳塔。

e.en: Candy spilled out when the {pinata} finally broke open.
e.zh: 皮纳塔终于被打破时,糖果撒了一地。

e.en: He spent hours playing {pinball} at the arcade.
e.zh: 他在游戏厅玩了好几个小时弹珠台。

e.en: The bar installed a vintage {pinball} machine last month.
e.zh: 那家酒吧上个月装了一台复古弹珠机。

e.en: The crab raised one massive {pincer} in warning.
e.zh: 那只螃蟹举起一只巨大的钳子以示警告。

e.en: Generals planned a {pincer} attack from both flanks.
e.zh: 将军们策划了一场从两翼夹击的钳形攻势。

e.en: He used {pincers} to pull the rusty nail out.
e.zh: 他用钳子把那颗生锈的钉子拔了出来。

e.en: The lobster's {pincers} can crush a thick shell.
e.zh: 龙虾的钳子能压碎厚厚的贝壳。

pinch.t:
v. 捏，掐
n. 一撮

e.en: Add a {pinch} of salt to balance the sweetness.
e.zh: 加一小撮盐来平衡甜味。

e.en: These new shoes {pinch} my toes at the front.
e.zh: 这双新鞋夹我的脚趾。

e.en: She {pinched} her son's cheek and laughed warmly.
e.zh: 她捏了捏儿子的脸颊,温暖地笑了。

e.en: His face looked pale and {pinched} from exhaustion.
e.zh: 他的脸因疲惫而显得苍白消瘦。

e.en: A penny {pincher} like him never tips waiters.
e.zh: 像他这样的小气鬼从来不给服务员小费。

e.en: The beetle has a sharp {pincher} on its tail.
e.zh: 那只甲虫尾部长着锋利的钳子。

pinching.t:
v. 捏，掐
adj. 拮据的

e.en: Stop {pinching} your sister or you'll lose your tablet.
e.zh: 别再掐你妹妹,不然就没收你的平板。

e.en: These new boots are {pinching} my heels badly.
e.zh: 这双新靴子把我的脚后跟夹得很疼。

e.en: My grandmother kept needles stuck in a tomato {pincushion}.
e.zh: 奶奶把针插在一个番茄形状的针插上。

e.en: After surgery he felt like a human {pincushion}.
e.zh: 手术后他感觉自己像个人形针包。

e.en: Greek students still read {Pindar}'s odes in class.
e.zh: 希腊学生至今仍在课堂上研读品达的颂歌。

e.en: The poet modeled his verses on ancient {Pindar}.
e.zh: 那位诗人模仿古代品达的风格创作诗歌。

pine.t:
n. 松树
v. 思念，憔悴

e.en: A tall {pine} stood alone at the hill's summit.
e.zh: 一棵高大的松树孤零零地立在山顶。

e.en: She began to {pine} for her hometown's quiet streets.
e.zh: 她开始思念家乡那些安静的街道。

e.en: The {pineal} gland helps regulate your sleep cycle.
e.zh: 松果体有助于调节你的睡眠周期。

e.en: Scientists study the {pineal} gland's role in melatonin production.
e.zh: 科学家研究松果体在褪黑素生成中的作用。

e.en: He sliced a fresh {pineapple} for the fruit salad.
e.zh: 他切了一个新鲜的菠萝做水果沙拉。

e.en: Whether {pineapple} belongs on pizza is still debated.
e.zh: 菠萝该不该放在披萨上至今仍有争议。

e.en: Hawaiian farms grow some of the sweetest {pineapples}.
e.zh: 夏威夷的农场种出一些最甜的菠萝。

e.en: She bought two {pineapples} for the weekend barbecue.
e.zh: 她买了两个菠萝准备周末烧烤。

e.en: The child collected a perfect {pinecone} from the trail.
e.zh: 孩子在小径上捡到一个完美的松果。

e.en: She decorated the wreath with a single golden {pinecone}.
e.zh: 她用一颗金色的松果装饰花环。

pines.t:
n. 松树（复数）
v. 思念

e.en: Tall {pines} lined both sides of the mountain road.
e.zh: 高大的松树排列在山路两旁。

e.en: The dog still {pines} for its previous owner.
e.zh: 那只狗仍在思念它以前的主人。

e.en: The cabin smelled of fresh {pinewood} and wood smoke.
e.zh: 小木屋里弥漫着新鲜松木和柴烟的味道。

e.en: He carved a small bird from a block of {pinewood}.
e.zh: 他用一块松木雕了一只小鸟。

ping.t:
n. 叮的一声
v. 发消息提醒；ping 测试

e.en: My phone went {ping} every time a new message arrived.
e.zh: 每次有新消息,我的手机就叮一声。

e.en: Just {ping} me on Slack when you're ready to start.
e.zh: 准备好开始时在Slack上吱我一声。

e.en: He felt a sharp {pinge} of guilt after lying.
e.zh: 撒谎之后,他感到一阵刺痛的内疚。

e.en: A small {pinge} of regret crossed her face.
e.zh: 她脸上掠过一丝懊悔。

pinging.t: v. 发出叮声；发消息提醒

e.en: My phone kept {pinging} all night with notifications.
e.zh: 我的手机一整晚都在叮叮响个不停。

e.en: Stop {pinging} me every five minutes about the deadline.
e.zh: 别每隔五分钟就催我截止日期的事。

e.en: The diamond was no bigger than a {pinhead}.
e.zh: 那颗钻石比针头还小。

e.en: Don't be such a {pinhead} about a tiny mistake.
e.zh: 别为一点小错误这么死脑筋。

e.en: Light streamed through a tiny {pinhole} in the curtain.
e.zh: 光线从窗帘上的小针孔里透了进来。

e.en: He built a {pinhole} camera for his physics class.
e.zh: 他为物理课做了一个针孔相机。

pinion.t:
n. 小齿轮；翅膀
v. 捆住翅膀

e.en: The mechanic replaced the worn {pinion} gear in the gearbox.
e.zh: 技工更换了变速箱里磨损的小齿轮。

e.en: Guards moved to {pinion} the suspect's arms behind his back.
e.zh: 警卫上前把嫌疑人的双臂反绑在背后。

pink.t:
adj. 粉色的
n. 粉红色

e.en: She painted her bedroom walls a soft {pink}.
e.zh: 她把卧室的墙刷成了柔和的粉色。

e.en: His cheeks turned {pink} from the cold wind.
e.zh: 冷风把他的脸颊吹得粉红。

pinkerton.t: n. 平克顿（著名侦探事务所）

e.en: A {Pinkerton} agent shadowed the suspect across three states.
e.zh: 一名平克顿侦探跨越三个州跟踪嫌疑人。

e.en: The novel features a tough {Pinkerton} detective in 1890s Chicago.
e.zh: 小说讲述了一名1890年代芝加哥的硬汉平克顿侦探。

e.en: She wore a tiny silver ring on her {pinkie}.
e.zh: 她小指上戴着一枚精致的银戒指。

e.en: Let's {pinkie} promise we won't tell anyone.
e.zh: 我们拉钩约定不告诉任何人。

pinking.t:
n. 锯齿状剪边
v. 发爆震声

e.en: She used {pinking} shears to stop the fabric from fraying.
e.zh: 她用花边剪刀防止布料散边。

e.en: The engine was {pinking} loudly under heavy acceleration.
e.zh: 发动机在猛踩油门时发出明显的爆震声。

e.en: The sky turned a soft {pinkish} hue at sunset.
e.zh: 日落时天空染上一层淡淡的粉色。

e.en: Her skin had a {pinkish} glow after the hike.
e.zh: 徒步之后她的皮肤泛着红润的光泽。

pinkness.t: n. 粉红（的状态或程度）

e.en: The {pinkness} of her cheeks gave away her embarrassment.
e.zh: 她脸颊的红晕暴露了她的尴尬。

e.en: Cooks check the {pinkness} of the meat to gauge doneness.
e.zh: 厨师通过肉的粉红程度来判断熟度。

e.en: His uncle dismissed every liberal as a {pinko}.
e.zh: 他叔叔把每个自由派都骂作左倾分子。

e.en: The columnist was branded a {pinko} during the Cold War.
e.zh: 那位专栏作家在冷战时期被扣上左倾的帽子。

pinks.t: n. 粉红色；石竹花（复数）

e.en: The garden was full of fragrant {pinks} and lavender.
e.zh: 花园里开满了芬芳的石竹花和薰衣草。

e.en: This palette mixes warm {pinks} with soft greys.
e.zh: 这套配色把暖粉色和浅灰色搭在一起。

pinky.t:
n. 小指
adj. 略粉的

e.en: He hooked his {pinky} around hers as a promise.
e.zh: 他用小指勾住她的小指作为约定。

e.en: She broke her {pinky} catching a fastball without a glove.
e.zh: 她没戴手套接快速球,弄断了小指。

e.en: Sound waves are funneled into the ear by the {pinna}.
e.zh: 声波通过耳廓被引入耳道。

e.en: The doctor examined a small cut on the patient's {pinna}.
e.zh: 医生检查了病人耳廓上的一道小伤口。

e.en: The crew lowered a {pinnace} to row ashore.
e.zh: 船员们放下一艘小艇划向岸边。

e.en: A swift {pinnace} carried messages between the warships.
e.zh: 一艘轻快的小艇在战舰之间传递消息。

e.en: Winning the Olympic gold was the {pinnacle} of her career.
e.zh: 赢得奥运金牌是她职业生涯的巅峰。

e.en: Climbers rested briefly at the rocky {pinnacle}.
e.zh: 登山者在岩石尖顶短暂休息。

e.en: The cathedral's stone {pinnacles} pierced the morning fog.
e.zh: 大教堂的石尖塔刺破了清晨的薄雾。

e.en: Few artists reach the {pinnacles} of their craft so young.
e.zh: 很少有艺术家这么年轻就达到技艺的顶峰。

pinned.t: v. 钉住，固定；置顶（pin 的过去式）

e.en: She {pinned} a note to the fridge before leaving.
e.zh: 她出门前在冰箱上别了一张便条。

e.en: I {pinned} the important tweet to the top of my profile.
e.zh: 我把那条重要推文置顶在我的主页。

pinner.t: n. 钉别针的人；别针工具

e.en: The fabric {pinner} held the seams perfectly straight.
e.zh: 那个布料别针把接缝固定得笔直。

e.en: As a top {pinner}, she rarely lost a wrestling match.
e.zh: 作为顶尖的压制选手,她很少输掉摔跤比赛。

pinning.t:
v. 钉住，固定
n. 置顶操作

e.en: She was {pinning} fabric to the dressmaker's dummy.
e.zh: 她正在把布料别在裁缝模特上。

e.en: Stop {pinning} the blame on your little brother.
e.zh: 别再把责任都推到你弟弟身上。

pinniped.t: n. 鳍足类动物（如海豹）

e.en: Seals and walruses belong to the {pinniped} group.
e.zh: 海豹和海象都属于鳍足类动物。

e.en: The aquarium opened a new {pinniped} exhibit last spring.
e.zh: 水族馆去年春天开了一个新的鳍足类展区。

e.en: A small {pinnock} hopped along the garden fence.
e.zh: 一只小山雀沿着花园的篱笆跳来跳去。

e.en: The old farmer called the bluetit a {pinnock}.
e.zh: 那位老农把蓝山雀叫作小山雀。

e.en: Grandma tied on her {pinny} before kneading the dough.
e.zh: 奶奶在揉面之前系上了围裙。

e.en: The kids wore matching {pinny} aprons during art class.
e.zh: 美术课上孩子们穿着配套的小围裙。

e.en: Stop lying or you'll grow a nose like {Pinocchio}.
e.zh: 别再撒谎,不然你会长出匹诺曹的鼻子。

e.en: My daughter watched {Pinocchio} three times this week.
e.zh: 我女儿这周看了三遍《匹诺曹》。

pinochle.t: n. 皮诺克尔（一种纸牌游戏）

e.en: My grandparents play {pinochle} every Friday evening.
e.zh: 我祖父母每周五晚上都打皮纳克尔牌。

e.en: He learned {pinochle} from his uncle as a kid.
e.zh: 他小时候跟叔叔学会了皮纳克尔牌戏。

pinole.t: n. 烤磨玉米粉（墨西哥食品）

e.en: Hikers fueled up with {pinole} mixed into warm water.
e.zh: 登山者把烤玉米粉冲入热水当作能量补给。

e.en: Traditional {pinole} is made from toasted corn and cinnamon.
e.zh: 传统的烤玉米粉用烤玉米和肉桂制成。

e.en: The desert air smelled of sage and burning {pinon}.
e.zh: 沙漠的空气里弥漫着鼠尾草和燃烧矮松的气味。

e.en: They roasted {pinon} nuts over the campfire.
e.zh: 他们在篝火上烤矮松子。

e.en: She ordered a glass of {pinot} noir with dinner.
e.zh: 她晚餐配了一杯黑皮诺红酒。

e.en: Oregon is famous for its earthy {pinot} wines.
e.zh: 俄勒冈州以其带泥土香的皮诺葡萄酒闻名。

pinpoint.t:
v. 精准定位
adj. 精确的

e.en: Engineers struggled to {pinpoint} the source of the bug.
e.zh: 工程师们费尽心思才找出bug的根源。

e.en: The map shows the {pinpoint} location of every store.
e.zh: 地图精确标出了每家门店的具体位置。

e.en: She felt a sudden {pinprick} of pain in her finger.
e.zh: 她突然感到手指上一阵针刺般的疼痛。

e.en: Stars appeared like {pinprick} dots in the dark sky.
e.zh: 星星像针尖般的小点出现在漆黑的天空中。

pins.t:
n. 别针，图钉（复数）
v. 钉住

e.en: She stuck colorful {pins} into the corkboard map.
e.zh: 她在软木板地图上插了一些彩色图钉。

e.en: He saved his favorite recipe {pins} on Pinterest.
e.zh: 他把最喜欢的食谱pin都收藏在了Pinterest上。

e.en: He wore a sharp navy {pinstripe} suit to the interview.
e.zh: 他穿着一身利落的深蓝细条纹西装去面试。

e.en: Bankers in {pinstripe} crowded the morning train.
e.zh: 穿细条纹西装的银行家挤满了早班列车。

e.en: The lawyer arrived in a crisp {pinstriped} suit.
e.zh: 那位律师穿着一身笔挺的细条纹西装走进来。

e.en: He chose a {pinstriped} shirt to dress up the outfit.
e.zh: 他选了一件细条纹衬衫让整体造型更正式。

e.en: Let's grab a {pint} at the pub after work.
e.zh: 下班后我们去酒吧喝一品脱啤酒吧。

e.en: She bought a {pint} of strawberries at the farmer's market.
e.zh: 她在农夫市场买了一品脱草莓。

e.en: Doctors diagnosed the rash as {pinta}, a tropical skin disease.
e.zh: 医生诊断那片皮疹是热带皮肤病品他病。

e.en: He drank a small {pinta} of milk with breakfast.
e.zh: 他早餐配了一小瓶牛奶喝。

e.en: A graceful {pintail} duck glided across the marsh.
e.zh: 一只优雅的针尾鸭滑过沼泽水面。

e.en: Birders spotted a {pintail} among the mallards.
e.zh: 观鸟者在绿头鸭群中发现了一只针尾鸭。

pinto.t:
adj. 花斑的
n. 花斑马

e.en: She rode a beautiful {pinto} horse along the trail.
e.zh: 她骑着一匹漂亮的花斑马沿着小径前行。

e.en: Soak the {pinto} beans overnight before cooking.
e.zh: 煮之前把花斑豆浸泡一晚。

e.en: They downed three {pints} each at the local pub.
e.zh: 他们在本地酒吧每人灌了三品脱啤酒。

e.en: The recipe calls for two {pints} of fresh cream.
e.zh: 这个配方需要两品脱新鲜奶油。

pinwheel.t: n. 纸风车；风车状焰火

e.en: The little boy blew on his {pinwheel} to make it spin.
e.zh: 小男孩对着他的风车吹气让它转起来。

e.en: Fireworks burst into a giant {pinwheel} of color.
e.zh: 烟花炸开成一个巨大的彩色风车形状。

e.en: Squirrels gathered seeds from the gnarled {pinyon} pines.
e.zh: 松鼠在虬曲的矮松树上采集松子。

e.en: The slopes were dotted with juniper and {pinyon}.
e.zh: 山坡上点缀着杜松和矮松。

e.en: Physicists detected a {pion} produced in the collision.
e.zh: 物理学家在碰撞中检测到一个π介子。

e.en: The {pion} decays into lighter particles within nanoseconds.
e.zh: π介子会在纳秒内衰变为更轻的粒子。

pioneer.t:
n. 先驱，开拓者
v. 开创

e.en: She's a {pioneer} in the field of gene editing.
e.zh: 她是基因编辑领域的先驱。

e.en: The startup aims to {pioneer} new battery technology.
e.zh: 这家初创公司志在开创新型电池技术。

e.en: Marie Curie {pioneered} research into radioactivity.
e.zh: 玛丽·居里开创了放射性研究的先河。

e.en: The company {pioneered} contactless payments in Asia.
e.zh: 这家公司在亚洲率先推出了非接触式支付。

e.en: Her {pioneering} work transformed modern neuroscience.
e.zh: 她的开创性工作改变了现代神经科学。

e.en: The lab is doing {pioneering} research on quantum computing.
e.zh: 该实验室正在进行量子计算的开创性研究。

pioneers.t:
n. 先驱者（复数）
v. 开创

e.en: The {pioneers} crossed the prairie in covered wagons.
e.zh: 拓荒者们驾着篷车穿越大草原。

e.en: These engineers are the {pioneers} of self-driving cars.
e.zh: 这些工程师是自动驾驶汽车的先驱。

e.en: Her grandmother was a deeply {pious} woman.
e.zh: 她的祖母是一位非常虔诚的女性。

e.en: He grew tired of the politician's {pious} speeches.
e.zh: 他厌倦了那位政客装腔作势的演讲。

e.en: She knelt {piously} before the altar each morning.
e.zh: 她每天清晨都虔诚地跪在祭坛前。

e.en: He {piously} lectured everyone about saving the environment.
e.zh: 他一本正经地对每个人说教要保护环境。

e.en: The app made a soft {pip} when the message arrived.
e.zh: 消息到达时应用发出轻轻的一声哔。

e.en: She spat out a watermelon {pip} into her hand.
e.zh: 她把一颗西瓜籽吐到手心里。

pipe.t:
n. 管道；烟斗
v. 用管道输送

e.en: A burst {pipe} flooded the kitchen overnight.
e.zh: 一根爆裂的水管在夜里淹了厨房。

e.en: Grandfather lit his {pipe} on the porch.
e.zh: 爷爷在门廊上点燃了他的烟斗。

piped.t: v. 用管道输送（过去式）

e.en: The cafe {piped} soft jazz through every speaker.
e.zh: 咖啡馆通过每个音箱播放着柔和的爵士乐。

e.en: Engineers {piped} fresh water to the remote village.
e.zh: 工程师们把清水引到了那个偏远村庄。

e.en: A slender {pipefish} hid among the swaying seagrass.
e.zh: 一条细长的海龙藏在摇曳的海草丛中。

e.en: Divers spotted a tiny {pipefish} clinging to coral.
e.zh: 潜水员发现一条小海龙紧贴着珊瑚。

pipeline.t: n. 管线；(开发) 流水线

e.en: The startup has several products in the {pipeline}.
e.zh: 这家初创公司有几款产品正在筹备中。

e.en: Engineers built a data {pipeline} to process daily logs.
e.zh: 工程师搭建了一条数据流水线来处理每日日志。

e.en: Oil {pipelines} stretched across the frozen tundra.
e.zh: 输油管道延伸过冰封的苔原。

e.en: Modern teams automate testing using CI {pipelines}.
e.zh: 现代团队使用持续集成流水线来自动化测试。

e.en: A lone {piper} played at the soldier's funeral.
e.zh: 一位孤独的风笛手在士兵的葬礼上吹奏。

e.en: The {piper} led the parade through the old town.
e.zh: 风笛手带领游行队伍穿过古镇。

e.en: Frozen {pipes} burst during the worst of the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雪最猛烈时水管被冻裂了。

e.en: The plumber inspected the rusted {pipes} under the sink.
e.zh: 水管工检查了水槽下生锈的管道。

e.en: She used a {pipette} to transfer the sample carefully.
e.zh: 她用移液管小心地转移样本。

e.en: The technician calibrated each {pipette} every morning.
e.zh: 技术员每天早上校准每一支移液管。

e.en: The old building's {pipework} needs a complete overhaul.
e.zh: 这栋老建筑的管道系统需要彻底翻修。

e.en: Exposed copper {pipework} gave the cafe an industrial feel.
e.zh: 裸露的铜制管道让咖啡馆有种工业风。

piping.t:
n. 管道系统
adj. 尖声的

e.en: She served {piping} hot soup on the cold evening.
e.zh: 她在寒冷的夜晚端上滚烫的热汤。

e.en: The plumber finished {piping} the new bathroom yesterday.
e.zh: 水管工昨天完成了新浴室的管道安装。

e.en: A meadow {pipit} flitted across the open field.
e.zh: 一只草地鹨掠过开阔的田野。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted a rare {pipit} near the cliffs.
e.zh: 观鸟者在悬崖附近发现了一只稀有的鹨。

e.en: The cook simmered stew in a small clay {pipkin}.
e.zh: 厨师用一只小陶锅慢炖着炖菜。

e.en: She found an antique {pipkin} at the village market.
e.zh: 她在乡村市场找到一只古董小陶锅。

pippin.t: n. 一种优质苹果；极品

e.en: He bit into a crisp {pippin} from the orchard.
e.zh: 他咬了一口果园里清脆的小苹果。

e.en: That new puppy is a real {pippin}, isn't she?
e.zh: 那只新来的小狗真是个小宝贝,对吧?

pipsqueak.t: n. 小人物；无足轻重的人

e.en: Stop bossing me around, you little {pipsqueak}!
e.zh: 别再对我指手画脚了,你这小不点!

e.en: The {pipsqueak} rookie outran every veteran on the team.
e.zh: 那个不起眼的新人跑赢了队里所有老将。

piquancy.t: n. 辛辣；有趣刺激的感觉

e.en: A dash of lime adds {piquancy} to the salsa.
e.zh: 一点青柠汁给莎莎酱增添了风味。

e.en: Her witty comments lent {piquancy} to the dull meeting.
e.zh: 她机智的评论为沉闷的会议增添了趣味。

piquant.t: adj. 辛辣的；刺激有趣的

e.en: The chef served a {piquant} sauce with the grilled fish.
e.zh: 主厨为烤鱼配上了一种开胃的辛辣酱汁。

e.en: She told a {piquant} story that intrigued everyone.
e.zh: 她讲了一个引人入胜的故事,让大家都感兴趣。

pique.t:
n. 愠怒
v. 激起（兴趣、好奇）

e.en: The trailer was designed to {pique} viewer curiosity.
e.zh: 这支预告片旨在激起观众的好奇心。

e.en: In a fit of {pique}, she walked out of the room.
e.zh: 她一气之下走出了房间。

e.en: The headline {piqued} my interest immediately.
e.zh: 那个标题立刻引起了我的兴趣。

e.en: She seemed {piqued} when no one noticed her new haircut.
e.zh: 没人注意到她的新发型,她显得有些恼火。

pir.t: n. 皮尔（伊斯兰教圣人）

e.en: Pilgrims visited the shrine of the revered {pir}.
e.zh: 朝圣者前往那位受人尊敬的圣者陵墓朝拜。

e.en: The village {pir} offered blessings to every visitor.
e.zh: 村里的圣者为每位访客赐福。

piracies.t: n. 盗版行为；海盗行径（复数）

e.en: Authorities cracked down on software {piracies} this year.
e.zh: 当局今年对软件盗版行为进行了严厉打击。

e.en: Historians documented the {piracies} of the Caribbean era.
e.zh: 历史学家记录了加勒比时代的种种海盗行径。

e.en: Online {piracy} costs the music industry billions yearly.
e.zh: 网络盗版每年给音乐产业造成数十亿美元损失。

e.en: The navy patrols these waters to combat {piracy}.
e.zh: 海军在这片海域巡逻以打击海盗活动。

piraeus.t: n. 比雷埃夫斯（希腊港市）

e.en: The ferry to Crete departs from {Piraeus} every evening.
e.zh: 开往克里特岛的渡轮每晚从比雷埃夫斯港出发。

e.en: {Piraeus} has served as Athens' main port for millennia.
e.zh: 比雷埃夫斯作为雅典的主要港口已有数千年历史。

e.en: A school of {piranha} tore through the river.
e.zh: 一群食人鱼在河中横冲直撞。

e.en: The lawyer earned a reputation as a courtroom {piranha}.
e.zh: 那位律师赢得了法庭上凶狠攻击者的名声。

pirate.t:
n. 海盗；盗版者
v. 盗版

e.en: Please don't {pirate} the software—buy a license instead.
e.zh: 请不要盗用这款软件,买个正版授权吧。

e.en: The {pirate} buried his treasure on a remote island.
e.zh: 那个海盗把他的宝藏埋在了一座偏僻小岛上。

pirated.t:
adj. 盗版的
v. 盗版（过去式）

e.en: He downloaded a {pirated} copy of the new movie.
e.zh: 他下载了那部新电影的盗版。

e.en: Authorities seized thousands of {pirated} DVDs at the border.
e.zh: 当局在边境查获了数千张盗版DVD。

e.en: Somali {pirates} once threatened ships in the Gulf of Aden.
e.zh: 索马里海盗曾威胁亚丁湾的过往船只。

e.en: The kids dressed as {pirates} for the Halloween party.
e.zh: 孩子们打扮成海盗参加万圣节派对。

e.en: He gave a {piratical} grin and pulled out his phone.
e.zh: 他露出一个海盗般的坏笑,掏出了手机。

e.en: The company's {piratical} tactics drove competitors out.
e.zh: 该公司不择手段的策略把竞争对手赶出了市场。

e.en: The race car was fitted with new {Pirelli} tires.
e.zh: 这辆赛车装上了全新的倍耐力轮胎。

e.en: {Pirelli} sponsors many top motorsport events worldwide.
e.zh: 倍耐力赞助了全球许多顶级赛车赛事。

e.en: The fruit had a distinctly {piriform} shape.
e.zh: 这种水果呈明显的梨形。

e.en: Doctors examined the {piriform} sinus during the scan.
e.zh: 医生在扫描中检查了梨状窦。

e.en: The fisherman paddled his {pirogue} through the bayou.
e.zh: 渔夫划着独木舟穿过沼泽河道。

e.en: They loaded supplies into the narrow wooden {pirogue}.
e.zh: 他们把物资装进那只狭长的木独木舟里。

e.en: The dancer practiced her {pirouet} until midnight.
e.zh: 舞者练习她的旋转动作直到午夜。

e.en: He attempted a quick {pirouet} on the icy sidewalk.
e.zh: 他试图在结冰的人行道上来个快速旋转。

pirouette.t:
n. 脚尖旋转（芭蕾动作）
v. 旋转

e.en: The ballerina ended the solo with a graceful {pirouette}.
e.zh: 芭蕾舞演员以一个优雅的旋转结束了独舞。

e.en: She tried to {pirouette} but stumbled and laughed.
e.zh: 她想做个旋转动作,却踉跄着笑了起来。

pis.t: n. 圆周率（pi 的复数）

e.en: Multiple Raspberry {Pis} powered the home automation setup.
e.zh: 多台树莓派支撑着这套家庭自动化系统。

e.en: The lab kept several {Pis} for student experiments.
e.zh: 实验室备有几台树莓派供学生做实验。

e.en: Tourists posed pretending to hold up the Tower of {Pisa}.
e.zh: 游客们摆姿势假装扶住比萨斜塔。

e.en: We took the train from Florence to {Pisa} that afternoon.
e.zh: 那天下午我们坐火车从佛罗伦萨到比萨。

e.en: He wrote a {piscatorial} memoir about fly fishing.
e.zh: 他写了一本关于飞蝇钓的钓鱼回忆录。

e.en: The lake offers excellent {piscatorial} opportunities year-round.
e.zh: 这个湖全年都提供绝佳的垂钓机会。

e.en: She's a {Pisces} and reads her horoscope every morning.
e.zh: 她是双鱼座,每天早上都看星座运势。

e.en: {Pisces} season runs from late February into March.
e.zh: 双鱼座的时节从二月底持续到三月。

piss.t:
v. 撒尿（粗俗）
n. 尿

e.en: Don't {piss} off the boss right before the review.
e.zh: 评估前别把老板惹毛了。

e.en: The whole project turned out to be a total {piss}-up.
e.zh: 整个项目最后成了一场彻底的烂摊子。

pissant.t: n. 讨厌的小人物（粗俗）

e.en: Don't waste time on that {pissant} little argument.
e.zh: 别在那种鸡毛蒜皮的小争论上浪费时间。

e.en: He called his rival a {pissant} during the heated debate.
e.zh: 他在激烈的辩论中骂对手是个无足轻重的小人物。

pissed.t: adj. 恼火的（美）；喝醉的（英）

e.en: She was really {pissed} when the package never arrived.
e.zh: 包裹一直没送到,她气坏了。

e.en: Half the guests got completely {pissed} at the wedding.
e.zh: 婚礼上一半客人都喝得烂醉。

pisser.t: n. 烦人的事；撒尿者（粗俗）

e.en: Losing my keys this morning was a real {pisser}.
e.zh: 今早把钥匙弄丢了真让人窝火。

e.en: The flat tire on race day was a total {pisser}.
e.zh: 比赛当天爆胎真是糟透了。

e.en: Stop {pissing} around and finish your homework.
e.zh: 别再瞎晃悠了,赶紧把作业写完。

e.en: It was {pissing} rain when we left the stadium.
e.zh: 我们离开体育场时雨下得跟瓢泼一样。

e.en: She ordered a scoop of {pistachio} ice cream.
e.zh: 她点了一球开心果冰淇淋。

e.en: The cake was topped with crushed {pistachio} and rose petals.
e.zh: 蛋糕上撒着碎开心果和玫瑰花瓣。

e.en: The morning {piste} was perfectly groomed for skiers.
e.zh: 清晨的滑雪道为滑雪者修整得十分平整。

e.en: Beginners should stick to the gentler blue {piste}.
e.zh: 初学者应该选择较平缓的蓝色雪道。

e.en: Bees brushed pollen onto the flower's sticky {pistil}.
e.zh: 蜜蜂把花粉刷到花朵黏黏的雌蕊上。

e.en: The biology textbook diagrammed the {pistil} in detail.
e.zh: 生物课本详细图解了雌蕊的结构。

e.en: The officer holstered his {pistol} after the suspect surrendered.
e.zh: 嫌疑人投降后,警官把手枪收回了枪套。

e.en: That toddler is a real {pistol} when she's tired.
e.zh: 那个小宝宝累了的时候真是个小淘气。

e.en: A worn {piston} caused the engine to lose power.
e.zh: 一个磨损的活塞让发动机动力下降。

e.en: The mechanic replaced the cracked {piston} ring.
e.zh: 机修工更换了开裂的活塞环。

pit.t:
n. 坑；矿井
v. 使相斗

e.en: Workers dug a deep {pit} for the new foundation.
e.zh: 工人们为新地基挖了一个深坑。

e.en: My stomach felt like a {pit} before the interview.
e.zh: 面试前我胃里像坠了块石头一样。

pita.t: n. 皮塔饼（中东扁面包）

e.en: He stuffed warm {pita} bread with falafel and salad.
e.zh: 他在温热的皮塔饼里塞满了炸鹰嘴豆和沙拉。

e.en: The restaurant serves homemade {pita} with every dip.
e.zh: 这家餐厅每份蘸酱都配自制皮塔饼。

e.en: Their rescue {pitbull} turned out to be incredibly gentle.
e.zh: 他们救助的那只比特犬其实非常温顺。

e.en: The defense lawyer was a {pitbull} in the courtroom.
e.zh: 那位辩护律师在法庭上像头猛犬般咄咄逼人。

pitch.t:
v. 投掷；推销
n. 音高；球场

e.en: She nailed her sales {pitch} in under two minutes.
e.zh: 她在两分钟内完美地完成了销售陈述。

e.en: The {pitch} of his voice rose when he got excited.
e.zh: 他一激动声音就变高了。

pitched.t:
v. 投掷（过去式）
adj. 倾斜的

e.en: We {pitched} our tent beside the river last night.
e.zh: 昨晚我们在河边搭起了帐篷。

e.en: The startup {pitched} their idea to several investors.
e.zh: 那家初创公司向多位投资者推介了他们的点子。

e.en: She poured cold water from the glass {pitcher}.
e.zh: 她从玻璃水壶里倒出冷水。

e.en: The {pitcher} threw a perfect strike to end the inning.
e.zh: 投手投出一记完美好球结束了这一局。

pitches.t:
v. 投掷（三单）
n. 球场；推销（复数）

e.en: The agency {pitches} new campaigns to clients every week.
e.zh: 该公司每周都向客户推介新的广告方案。

e.en: Football {pitches} were soaked after the heavy rain.
e.zh: 大雨过后足球场都被淋湿了。

pla.t: n. 聚乳酸（3D 打印常用材料）

e.en: The acronym {pla} stood for the local planning authority.
e.zh: 这个缩写 PLA 指的是当地的规划机构。

e.en: He typed {pla} into the search bar by mistake.
e.zh: 他不小心在搜索框里输入了 pla。

placard.t:
n. 标语牌；海报
v. 张贴告示

e.en: Protesters held a {placard} demanding cleaner air.
e.zh: 抗议者举着标语牌,要求改善空气质量。

e.en: A bright {placard} announced the grand opening sale.
e.zh: 一块醒目的告示牌宣告盛大开业促销。

e.en: The manager tried to {placate} the angry customer with a refund.
e.zh: 经理试图用退款来安抚那位愤怒的顾客。

e.en: Nothing he said could {placate} her after the betrayal.
e.zh: 在那次背叛之后,他说什么都无法让她平息怒火。

placating.t:
adj. 抚慰的
v. 安抚（placate 现在分词）

e.en: She spoke in a {placating} tone to calm the toddler.
e.zh: 她用安抚的语气让那个小孩平静下来。

e.en: His {placating} smile only made her angrier.
e.zh: 他那讨好的笑容反而让她更生气了。

e.en: He sent a {placatory} email after the heated meeting.
e.zh: 激烈的会议过后,他发了一封示好的邮件。

e.en: Her {placatory} gesture failed to ease the tension.
e.zh: 她安抚的姿态并未缓解紧张气氛。

place.t:
n. 地方；位置
v. 放置；安放

e.en: This café is my favorite {place} to work remotely.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆是我最喜欢的远程办公地点。

e.en: Please {place} the package by the front door.
e.zh: 请把包裹放在前门旁边。

e.en: Half the patients received a {placebo} instead of the drug.
e.zh: 一半的患者拿到的是安慰剂,而不是真药。

e.en: The new app feels useful, but it might be a {placebo}.
e.zh: 这款新应用感觉很有用,但可能只是心理安慰罢了。

placed.t: v. 放置；下单（place 过去式）

e.en: She {placed} her phone face-down on the table.
e.zh: 她把手机正面朝下放在了桌上。

e.en: Our team {placed} second in the regional finals.
e.zh: 我们队在区域决赛中获得了第二名。

placeholder.t: n. 占位符（输入框提示文字）

e.en: Use a {placeholder} image until the real photo loads.
e.zh: 在真实照片加载前先用一张占位图。

e.en: The form shows a gray {placeholder} inside each input box.
e.zh: 表单的每个输入框里都显示着灰色的占位文字。

placekicker.t: n. 橄榄球定位踢球员

e.en: The team's {placekicker} nailed a 50-yard field goal.
e.zh: 球队的定位踢球员踢进了一记 50 码的射门。

e.en: A reliable {placekicker} can decide close football games.
e.zh: 一名可靠的定位踢球员能左右势均力敌的橄榄球比赛。

placeless.t: adj. 无固定位置的；居无定所的

e.en: Modern airports feel oddly {placeless} and identical.
e.zh: 现代机场给人一种千篇一律、毫无地方特色的感觉。

e.en: Her music has a dreamy, {placeless} quality.
e.zh: 她的音乐带着一种梦幻般、无所归属的特质。

placeman.t: n. 为俸禄谋职者（贬义）

e.en: The minister was dismissed as a mere {placeman} of the party.
e.zh: 那位部长被讥讽为只是党内的一名挂名领薪者。

e.en: Critics called him a {placeman} rewarded for loyalty alone.
e.zh: 批评者称他不过是因效忠而获位的庸吏。

e.en: She set a linen {placemat} under each dinner plate.
e.zh: 她在每个餐盘下铺了一张亚麻餐垫。

e.en: The kids drew on the paper {placemat} while waiting.
e.zh: 孩子们一边等餐一边在纸餐垫上涂鸦。

placement.t:
n. 放置；安置
n. 实习职位

e.en: The {placement} of the logo affects how users notice it.
e.zh: 标志的摆放位置影响用户的注意度。

e.en: She got a summer {placement} at a tech startup.
e.zh: 她在一家科技初创公司获得了暑期实习机会。

placements.t: n. 安置；实习岗位（复数）

e.en: Ad {placements} on the homepage cost more than sidebar ones.
e.zh: 首页的广告位比侧边栏的更贵。

e.en: The university arranges hospital {placements} for nursing students.
e.zh: 这所大学为护理专业学生安排医院实习。

e.en: The {placenta} delivers nutrients from mother to baby.
e.zh: 胎盘将营养从母体输送给胎儿。

e.en: Doctors examined the {placenta} after the birth.
e.zh: 医生在分娩后检查了胎盘。

e.en: Whales are {placental} mammals, despite living in the ocean.
e.zh: 鲸虽然生活在海洋中,却是有胎盘的哺乳动物。

e.en: The doctor warned of possible {placental} complications.
e.zh: 医生提醒可能出现胎盘相关的并发症。

placer.t:
n. 砂矿
n. 放置者

e.en: Miners panned the river for {placer} gold.
e.zh: 矿工们在河中淘洗砂金。

e.en: This valley once had rich {placer} deposits.
e.zh: 这条山谷曾有丰富的砂矿沉积。

places.t:
n. 地方（复数）
v. 放置（第三人称单数）

e.en: Tokyo is one of my favorite {places} to visit.
e.zh: 东京是我最喜欢去的地方之一。

e.en: She {places} a sticker on every notebook she owns.
e.zh: 她在自己每个笔记本上都贴一张贴纸。

e.en: The lake was {placid} and reflected the mountains perfectly.
e.zh: 湖面平静如镜,完美地映出群山。

e.en: He has a {placid} personality that calms the whole team.
e.zh: 他性格温和,让整个团队都安定下来。

e.en: Her {placidity} surprised everyone during the crisis.
e.zh: 危机中她的镇定令所有人惊讶。

e.en: The garden's {placidity} made it perfect for reading.
e.zh: 花园的宁静让它成为读书的绝佳之地。

e.en: The cat sat {placidly} on the windowsill all afternoon.
e.zh: 那只猫整个下午都安静地坐在窗台上。

e.en: She answered the harsh question {placidly} and moved on.
e.zh: 她平静地回答了那个尖锐的问题,然后继续往下讲。

e.en: The tenor {placido} Domingo sang the opening aria.
e.zh: 男高音普拉西多·多明戈演唱了开场咏叹调。

e.en: Eye doctors use a {placido} disc to check the cornea.
e.zh: 眼科医生用普拉西多盘检查角膜。

placing.t:
n. 放置；名次
v. 放（place 现在分词）

e.en: She finished by {placing} third in the marathon.
e.zh: 她以马拉松第三名的成绩冲过终点。

e.en: He kept {placing} his keys in random spots.
e.zh: 他总是把钥匙随手放在各种地方。

plage.t:
n. 太阳光斑
n. 海滨

e.en: We spent the afternoon on a quiet {plage} in Nice.
e.zh: 我们在尼斯一片安静的海滩上度过了一个下午。

e.en: Astronomers observed a bright {plage} on the sun's surface.
e.zh: 天文学家观测到太阳表面一处明亮的光斑区。

plagiarise.t: v. 剽窃；抄袭（英式拼写）

e.en: Students who {plagiarise} essays risk being expelled.
e.zh: 抄袭论文的学生可能面临被开除的风险。

e.en: It's tempting to {plagiarise}, but always cite your sources.
e.zh: 抄袭虽然容易,但一定要标明出处。

e.en: The professor uses software to detect {plagiarism} in essays.
e.zh: 教授用软件检测论文中的抄袭。

e.en: Accusations of {plagiarism} ended the author's career.
e.zh: 抄袭指控终结了那位作家的职业生涯。

e.en: The famous writer was exposed as a {plagiarist}.
e.zh: 那位著名作家被揭穿是个抄袭者。

e.en: No publisher wants to work with a known {plagiarist}.
e.zh: 没有出版商愿意与公认的抄袭者合作。

e.en: Don't {plagiarize} someone else's blog post for your essay.
e.zh: 不要把别人的博客文章抄进你的作业里。

e.en: AI tools make it easier to accidentally {plagiarize} sources.
e.zh: AI 工具让人更容易在无意中抄袭资料来源。

plague.t:
n. 瘟疫；鼠疫
v. 困扰；折磨

e.en: Bugs continue to {plague} the latest software update.
e.zh: 漏洞仍在困扰着最新的软件更新。

e.en: The medieval {plague} killed millions across Europe.
e.zh: 中世纪的瘟疫夺去了欧洲数百万人的生命。

plagued.t: v. 困扰；折磨（plague 过去式）

e.en: The launch was {plagued} by server crashes all weekend.
e.zh: 整个周末发布都被服务器崩溃问题困扰。

e.en: She was {plagued} by self-doubt before the interview.
e.zh: 面试前她被自我怀疑深深困扰。

plagues.t:
n. 瘟疫（复数）
v. 困扰（第三人称单数）

e.en: Lag still {plagues} the game during peak hours.
e.zh: 高峰时段游戏仍然受到延迟问题的困扰。

e.en: History records several deadly {plagues} across the centuries.
e.zh: 历史上记载了数个世纪以来多场致命的瘟疫。

plaguing.t: v. 困扰；折磨（plague 现在分词）

e.en: Memory leaks have been {plaguing} the app since launch.
e.zh: 自从上线以来,内存泄漏一直困扰着这款应用。

e.en: Doubts kept {plaguing} him long after the decision was made.
e.zh: 决定做出之后,疑虑仍久久困扰着他。

e.en: We ordered grilled {plaice} with lemon at the seaside restaurant.
e.zh: 我们在海边餐厅点了配柠檬的烤鲽鱼。

e.en: Fresh {plaice} is a popular catch in the North Sea.
e.zh: 新鲜的鲽鱼是北海常见的渔获。

plaid.t:
n. 格子呢
adj. 格子花纹的

e.en: He wore a red {plaid} shirt with jeans.
e.zh: 他穿着一件红色格子衬衫和牛仔裤。

e.en: The café has cozy chairs covered in {plaid} fabric.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆里摆着覆有格子布的舒适座椅。

plain.t:
adj. 普通的；朴素的；明显的
n. 平原

e.en: I prefer a {plain} white T-shirt over flashy designs.
e.zh: 比起花哨的款式,我更喜欢简单的白 T 恤。

e.en: It was {plain} that he had no idea what to do.
e.zh: 显然他根本不知道该怎么办。

plainchant.t: n. 素歌（中世纪单声部圣咏）

e.en: The monks sang medieval {plainchant} during the service.
e.zh: 修士们在仪式上吟唱中世纪的素歌。

e.en: Her album reimagines ancient {plainchant} with modern beats.
e.zh: 她的专辑用现代节拍重新演绎古老的素歌。

plainclothes.t: adj. 便衣的（警察等不穿制服）

e.en: A {plainclothes} officer was watching the suspect from across the street.
e.zh: 一名便衣警察从街对面监视着嫌疑人。

e.en: Two {plainclothes} detectives mingled with the crowd.
e.zh: 两名便衣探员混在人群中。

e.en: A {plainclothesman} quietly arrested the pickpocket on the train.
e.zh: 一名便衣警员在地铁上悄悄逮捕了那个扒手。

e.en: The {plainclothesman} flashed his badge and asked for ID.
e.zh: 那位便衣警员亮出警徽,要求查看身份证。

plainer.t: adj. 更朴素的；更明显的（plain 比较级）

e.en: Could you explain it in {plainer} language for beginners?
e.zh: 你能用更通俗的语言为初学者解释一下吗?

e.en: Her later novels have a {plainer}, less ornate style.
e.zh: 她后期的小说风格更朴素,少了几分华丽。

e.en: He spoke {plainly} about the company's financial troubles.
e.zh: 他直白地谈到了公司的财务困境。

e.en: The error message {plainly} states what went wrong.
e.zh: 错误信息清楚地说明了哪里出了问题。

e.en: I admire the {plainness} of her writing style.
e.zh: 我欣赏她写作风格中的那份朴实。

e.en: The room's {plainness} made the artwork stand out.
e.zh: 房间的朴素让那幅艺术品格外醒目。

e.en: The cathedral choir performed traditional {plainsong} every Sunday.
e.zh: 大教堂唱诗班每周日演唱传统的素歌。

e.en: He recorded an album of Gregorian {plainsong}.
e.zh: 他录制了一张格里高利素歌专辑。

plainspoken.t: adj. 直言不讳的；坦率的

e.en: Voters appreciate her {plainspoken} approach to tough issues.
e.zh: 选民们欣赏她对棘手问题直言不讳的态度。

e.en: He's a {plainspoken} farmer who avoids political jargon.
e.zh: 他是个说话直来直去的农民,从不用政治术语。

e.en: Her email was a long {plaint} about the company's policies.
e.zh: 她那封邮件是一长段对公司政策的抱怨。

e.en: The lawyer filed a formal {plaint} with the court.
e.zh: 那位律师向法院正式提交了诉状。

e.en: The {plaintiff} is seeking damages for breach of contract.
e.zh: 原告就违约行为要求赔偿损失。

e.en: Witnesses supported the {plaintiff}'s version of events.
e.zh: 证人支持原告对事件的陈述。

e.en: The dog let out a {plaintive} whine at the closed door.
e.zh: 那只狗对着紧闭的门发出哀怨的呜咽。

e.en: Her song has a {plaintive} melody that lingers in your mind.
e.zh: 她的歌有一段哀婉的旋律,久久萦绕在脑海中。

e.en: The kitten meowed {plaintively} outside the kitchen door.
e.zh: 那只小猫在厨房门外可怜地喵叫着。

e.en: He asked {plaintively} why no one had told him sooner.
e.zh: 他哀怨地问为什么没人早点告诉他。

plait.t:
n. 辫子
v. 编成辫子

e.en: She wore a single long {plait} down her back.
e.zh: 她背后垂着一条长长的辫子。

e.en: He learned to {plait} leather strips into a bracelet.
e.zh: 他学会了把皮条编成手链。

pitchfork.t:
n. 干草叉
v. 用叉挑起

e.en: The farmer lifted hay with a wooden {pitchfork}.
e.zh: 农夫用一把木制干草叉叉起干草。

e.en: Angry villagers gathered with torches and a {pitchfork}.
e.zh: 愤怒的村民们手持火把和干草叉聚集起来。

pitching.t:
n. 投球；倾斜
v. pitch 的现在分词

e.en: He spent the morning {pitching} ideas to the marketing team.
e.zh: 他整个上午都在向市场团队推介创意。

e.en: The boat was {pitching} wildly in the storm.
e.zh: 小船在风暴中剧烈颠簸。

pitchman.t: n. 街头推销员；广告代言人

e.en: The TV {pitchman} promised the knife could cut anything.
e.zh: 电视推销员保证这把刀什么都能切断。

e.en: He worked as a {pitchman} at trade shows for years.
e.zh: 他多年来一直在贸易展上担任产品推销员。

piteous.t: adj. 令人同情的；悲惨的

e.en: The stray puppy let out a {piteous} whine.
e.zh: 那只流浪小狗发出了可怜的呜咽声。

e.en: She gave him a {piteous} look across the room.
e.zh: 她从房间另一头投来一个令人怜悯的眼神。

piteously.t: adv. 悲惨地；令人同情地

e.en: The lost child cried {piteously} for her mother.
e.zh: 走失的孩子可怜地哭喊着找妈妈。

e.en: The injured bird chirped {piteously} in the grass.
e.zh: 受伤的小鸟在草地上可怜地叫着。

e.en: Ignoring user feedback is a common {pitfall} for startups.
e.zh: 忽视用户反馈是初创公司常见的陷阱。

e.en: The guide warned us about every {pitfall} on the trail.
e.zh: 向导提醒我们小路上的每一个隐患。

pith.t:
n. 精髓；要点
n. (植物) 髓

e.en: Peel off the white {pith} before juicing the orange.
e.zh: 榨橙汁前先剥掉白色的果皮内层。

e.en: Her speech got straight to the {pith} of the matter.
e.zh: 她的演讲直击问题的核心。

e.en: Miners gathered at the {pithead} after the long shift.
e.zh: 长班结束后矿工们聚集在矿井口。

e.en: Trucks lined up near the {pithead} to load coal.
e.zh: 卡车在矿井口排队装煤。

e.en: He {pithily} summarized the whole report in one line.
e.zh: 他用一句话精辟地概括了整份报告。

e.en: The columnist writes {pithily} about modern life.
e.zh: 这位专栏作家对现代生活的评论简洁有力。

e.en: I admire the {pithiness} of her tweets.
e.zh: 我很欣赏她推文的简练精辟。

e.en: The essay's {pithiness} made it easy to remember.
e.zh: 这篇文章简洁有力,令人难忘。

e.en: The CEO is known for {pithy} one-line replies.
e.zh: 这位首席执行官以简短精辟的一句话回复著称。

e.en: She gave a {pithy} answer that ended the debate.
e.zh: 她给出一个简练的回答,结束了争论。

pitiable.t: adj. 令人怜悯的；可悲的

e.en: The abandoned house was in a {pitiable} state.
e.zh: 那栋废弃的房子处于令人怜悯的破败状态。

e.en: His attempts to lie were almost {pitiable}.
e.zh: 他想撒谎的样子几乎让人觉得可怜。

pities.t:
v. 同情（pity 的第三人称单数）
n. 憾事（复数）

e.en: She {pities} anyone who has to commute two hours daily.
e.zh: 她同情任何每天通勤两小时的人。

e.en: It's one of life's small {pities} that weekends pass quickly.
e.zh: 周末过得太快是生活中的一件小憾事。

pitiful.t:
adj. 可怜的
adj. 可鄙的，糟糕的

e.en: His salary increase was a {pitiful} ten dollars.
e.zh: 他的加薪少得可怜,只有十美元。

e.en: The wet kitten looked absolutely {pitiful}.
e.zh: 那只湿透的小猫看起来真是可怜极了。

e.en: The team performed {pitifully} in the second half.
e.zh: 球队下半场表现得糟糕得可怜。

e.en: He was {pitifully} thin after months of illness.
e.zh: 几个月生病后他瘦得令人心疼。

e.en: The {pitiless} desert sun beat down on the hikers.
e.zh: 无情的沙漠烈日炙烤着徒步者。

e.en: Critics were {pitiless} in their reviews of the film.
e.zh: 影评人对这部电影的评价毫不留情。

e.en: The rain fell {pitilessly} on the marathon runners.
e.zh: 大雨无情地浇在马拉松选手身上。

e.en: She mocked his accent {pitilessly} in front of everyone.
e.zh: 她当着众人的面无情地嘲笑他的口音。

e.en: His grandfather worked as a {pitman} in Welsh coal mines.
e.zh: 他祖父曾在威尔士煤矿当矿工。

e.en: The old {pitman} told stories about life underground.
e.zh: 那位老矿工讲述着井下的生活故事。

e.en: The climber hammered a {piton} into the rock face.
e.zh: 攀登者把一根岩钉敲进岩壁。

e.en: She clipped her rope to the {piton} for safety.
e.zh: 为了安全,她把绳子扣在岩钉上。

pits.t:
n. 坑，洞（复数）
n. 维修站（赛车）

e.en: Remove the {pits} before blending the cherries.
e.zh: 搅拌樱桃前要先去掉果核。

e.en: Waiting in line for hours really {pits}.
e.zh: 排几个小时的队真是糟透了。

e.en: I stuffed warm {pitta} bread with grilled chicken.
e.zh: 我把烤鸡肉塞进温热的皮塔饼里。

e.en: The shop sells fresh {pitta} every morning.
e.zh: 那家店每天早上都卖新鲜的皮塔饼。

pittance.t: n. 微薄的收入；少得可怜的钱

e.en: They paid him a {pittance} for forty hours of work.
e.zh: 他们给他四十小时工作的报酬少得可怜。

e.en: Interns earn a mere {pittance} at most startups.
e.zh: 大多数初创公司的实习生薪水微薄。

pitted.t:
adj. 有凹坑的
v. 使对抗；去核

e.en: The road was badly {pitted} after the harsh winter.
e.zh: 严冬过后这条路坑坑洼洼。

e.en: The final round {pitted} two old rivals against each other.
e.zh: 决赛让两位老对手再次对决。

pitting.t:
n. 点蚀，凹陷
v. 使对抗

e.en: Acid rain is slowly {pitting} the marble statues.
e.zh: 酸雨正慢慢腐蚀着大理石雕像。

e.en: The tournament is {pitting} rookies against veterans.
e.zh: 这场比赛让新秀对阵老将。

e.en: He grew up in {Pittsburg}, California, near the bay.
e.zh: 他在加州海湾附近的匹兹堡长大。
