e.en: The small town of {Pittsburg} hosts a yearly seafood festival.
e.zh: 匹兹堡小镇每年举办一次海鲜节。

e.en: {Pittsburgh} is famous for its three rivers and steel history.
e.zh: 匹兹堡以其三条河流和钢铁历史而闻名。

e.en: She moved to {Pittsburgh} for a tech job last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天为了一份科技工作搬到了匹兹堡。

pituitary.t:
n. 脑垂体
adj. 脑垂体的

e.en: The {pituitary} gland controls many of the body's hormones.
e.zh: 脑垂体调控着人体的许多激素。

e.en: A small {pituitary} tumor was found during the scan.
e.zh: 扫描中发现了一个小的脑垂体肿瘤。

pity.t:
n. 同情；憾事
v. 怜悯

e.en: It's a real {pity} that the concert was cancelled.
e.zh: 演唱会取消了真是太遗憾了。

e.en: I felt deep {pity} for the stranded travelers.
e.zh: 我对那些滞留的旅客深感同情。

e.en: She gave him a {pitying} smile and walked away.
e.zh: 她带着怜悯的微笑转身走开了。

e.en: I hate the {pitying} looks people give me.
e.zh: 我讨厌别人投来的怜悯目光。

e.en: The teacher looked {pityingly} at the failing student.
e.zh: 老师怜悯地望着不及格的学生。

e.en: She shook her head {pityingly} at his excuses.
e.zh: 她带着怜悯地对他的借口摇了摇头。

pivot.t:
n. 支点；核心
v. 转向，转型

e.en: The startup decided to {pivot} from hardware to software.
e.zh: 这家初创公司决定从硬件转型到软件。

e.en: Trust is the {pivot} of any healthy relationship.
e.zh: 信任是任何健康关系的关键。

e.en: The election was a {pivotal} moment in the country's history.
e.zh: 这次选举是该国历史上的关键时刻。

e.en: She played a {pivotal} role in launching the product.
e.zh: 她在产品发布中发挥了关键作用。

pivoting.t:
n. 转型；旋转
v. pivot 的现在分词

e.en: The company is {pivoting} toward AI-powered services.
e.zh: 公司正在转型向人工智能服务方向发展。

e.en: She kept {pivoting} on her heel to face the crowd.
e.zh: 她不停地脚跟旋转,面向人群。

e.en: Send me some {pix} from your trip to Tokyo!
e.zh: 把你东京之旅的照片发几张给我!

e.en: Her phone is full of {pix} of her cat.
e.zh: 她的手机里全是她家猫的照片。

e.en: Every {pixel} on the new display looks razor-sharp.
e.zh: 新显示屏上的每一个像素都极其清晰。

e.en: The designer obsessed over every {pixel} in the logo.
e.zh: 设计师对标志上的每一个像素都精益求精。

pixelated.t: adj. 像素化的；马赛克的

e.en: The video looked {pixelated} on a slow connection.
e.zh: 网络太慢时视频看起来满是马赛克。

e.en: Old games had charmingly {pixelated} graphics.
e.zh: 老游戏的像素画面有种独特的魅力。

e.en: She got a short {pixie} haircut for the summer.
e.zh: 她剪了个短短的精灵头迎接夏天。

e.en: The story features a mischievous forest {pixie}.
e.zh: 故事中有一个调皮的森林小精灵。

e.en: Old uncle Joe was a bit {pixilated} but harmless.
e.zh: 老乔叔叔有点古怪,但人无害。

e.en: She wore a {pixilated} grin all evening.
e.zh: 她整晚都带着一种古怪俏皮的笑容。

pixy.t: n. 小精灵（pixie 的变体）

e.en: The child believed a {pixy} lived in the garden.
e.zh: 那个孩子相信花园里住着一个小精灵。

e.en: Her costume made her look like a tiny {pixy}.
e.zh: 她的服装让她看起来像个小精灵。

e.en: The new singer brings real {pizazz} to the stage.
e.zh: 这位新歌手为舞台带来了真正的活力。

e.en: His outfit needs more color and {pizazz}.
e.zh: 他的穿搭需要更多色彩和亮点。

e.en: Let's order a large pepperoni {pizza} for dinner.
e.zh: 我们晚饭点一个大份意式辣肠披萨吧。

e.en: She makes homemade {pizza} every Friday night.
e.zh: 她每个周五晚上都做手工披萨。

e.en: We ordered three {pizzas} for the office party.
e.zh: 我们为办公室聚会点了三个披萨。

e.en: The shop bakes wood-fired {pizzas} in under five minutes.
e.zh: 那家店用柴火炉五分钟内就能烤好披萨。

e.en: Her presentation lacked the {pizzazz} of her last one.
e.zh: 她这次的演讲少了上次那种活力。

e.en: Add some color to give the design more {pizzazz}.
e.zh: 加点颜色让设计更有活力。

e.en: There's a tiny {pizzeria} on the corner of Main Street.
e.zh: 主街拐角有一家小披萨店。

e.en: This {pizzeria} won an award for the best crust.
e.zh: 这家披萨店因最佳饼底而获奖。

pizzicato.t: n. 拨弦奏法（音乐术语）

e.en: The violinists played a quick {pizzicato} passage.
e.zh: 小提琴手们演奏了一段快速的拨弦乐段。

e.en: I love the cheerful {pizzicato} in this symphony.
e.zh: 我喜欢这部交响曲中欢快的拨弦演奏。

pkk.t: n. 库尔德工人党（缩写）

e.en: News reports often mention the {PKK} in Turkish politics.
e.zh: 新闻报道在谈及土耳其政治时常常提到库尔德工人党。

e.en: The government held talks about the {PKK} ceasefire.
e.zh: 政府就库尔德工人党的停火问题举行了会谈。

e.en: They installed {plasterboard} to divide the open office.
e.zh: 他们装上石膏板把开放式办公区隔开。

e.en: Cutting {plasterboard} cleanly requires a sharp utility knife.
e.zh: 要把石膏板切得整齐需要一把锋利的美工刀。

plastered.t:
adj. 涂满灰泥的
adj. (俚) 烂醉的

e.en: The walls were freshly {plastered} and painted white.
e.zh: 墙壁刚刚抹好灰并漆成白色。

e.en: He got completely {plastered} at the office party.
e.zh: 他在公司聚会上喝得烂醉如泥。

e.en: The {plasterer} smoothed the wall with practiced strokes.
e.zh: 那位泥水匠用熟练的手法把墙抹平。

e.en: We hired a skilled {plasterer} to fix the ceiling.
e.zh: 我们请了一位技艺精湛的抹灰工来修天花板。

plastering.t:
n. 抹灰；粉刷
v. 涂抹

e.en: He spent the morning {plastering} the cracked walls.
e.zh: 他整个上午都在给开裂的墙抹灰。

e.en: The {plastering} on the old house needs urgent repair.
e.zh: 老房子的抹灰层急需修补。

plasters.t:
n. 膏药；灰泥
v. 涂抹

e.en: She {plasters} sunscreen on before going to the beach.
e.zh: 她去海滩前会涂厚厚的防晒霜。

e.en: Buy some {plasters} in case the kids scrape their knees.
e.zh: 买些创可贴以防孩子们擦破膝盖。

e.en: The mansion's ornate {plasterwork} dates back two centuries.
e.zh: 这座宅邸华丽的灰泥装饰可追溯到两百年前。

e.en: Restoring the ceiling's {plasterwork} took skilled craftsmen months.
e.zh: 修复天花板的灰泥工艺花了能工巧匠数月时间。

plastic.t:
n. 塑料
adj. 可塑的；塑料的

e.en: Most ocean pollution comes from single-use {plastic} packaging.
e.zh: 海洋污染大多源自一次性塑料包装。

e.en: The toy is made of cheap, brittle {plastic}.
e.zh: 这个玩具是用廉价、易碎的塑料做的。

e.en: The kids molded animals out of colorful {plasticine}.
e.zh: 孩子们用彩色橡皮泥捏出各种动物。

e.en: She kept a block of {plasticine} for stop-motion projects.
e.zh: 她留着一块橡皮泥来做定格动画。

e.en: The brain's {plasticity} allows it to recover after injury.
e.zh: 大脑的可塑性使它能在受伤后恢复。

e.en: This clay's {plasticity} makes it ideal for sculpting.
e.zh: 这种黏土的可塑性使它非常适合做雕塑。

e.en: The menus were {plasticized} so they could be wiped clean.
e.zh: 菜单经过覆膜处理,可以擦拭干净。

e.en: They used {plasticized} fabric for the waterproof tents.
e.zh: 他们用塑化处理过的织物制作防水帐篷。

e.en: Manufacturers add a {plasticizer} to make PVC pipes flexible.
e.zh: 厂商加入增塑剂以让 PVC 管材变得柔韧。

e.en: Some {plasticizer} chemicals have been linked to health risks.
e.zh: 一些增塑剂化学物质被认为存在健康风险。

e.en: Recycling {plastics} reduces the burden on overflowing landfills.
e.zh: 回收塑料可以减轻爆满垃圾场的负担。

e.en: The factory produces specialty {plastics} for medical equipment.
e.zh: 这家工厂生产用于医疗设备的特种塑料。

e.en: The terrorists allegedly hid {plastique} inside a hollow book.
e.zh: 据称恐怖分子把塑性炸药藏在挖空的书里。

e.en: A small charge of {plastique} was used to breach the door.
e.zh: 他们用一小块塑性炸药炸开了那扇门。

plat.t:
n. 地块；平面图
v. 绘制地图

e.en: The surveyor drew a detailed {plat} of the new subdivision.
e.zh: 测量员绘制了新住宅区的详细地块图。

e.en: You can find the property's {plat} at the county office.
e.zh: 你可以在县政府办公室查到这块土地的地籍图。

plate.t:
n. 盘子；板；车牌
v. 电镀

e.en: She set a clean {plate} on the dinner table.
e.zh: 她在餐桌上摆了一只干净的盘子。

e.en: The car had a stolen license {plate} from another state.
e.zh: 那辆车挂着从外州偷来的车牌。

plateau.t:
n. 高原；平稳期
v. 进入平台期

e.en: My weight loss has hit a frustrating {plateau} this month.
e.zh: 我这个月的减肥进入了令人沮丧的瓶颈期。

e.en: They camped on a windy {plateau} above the valley.
e.zh: 他们在山谷上方一处多风的高原上扎营。

e.en: Vast {plateaux} stretch across the heart of central Asia.
e.zh: 广阔的高原横贯中亚腹地。

e.en: Long training {plateaux} can discourage even dedicated athletes.
e.zh: 漫长的训练瓶颈期连最专注的运动员都会感到气馁。

plated.t: adj. 镀过的；覆有金属板的

e.en: The chef artfully {plated} each dish before serving.
e.zh: 主厨在上菜前精心摆盘。

e.en: Her ring is gold-{plated}, not solid gold.
e.zh: 她的戒指是镀金的,不是纯金的。

e.en: He devoured a {plateful} of pasta in five minutes.
e.zh: 他五分钟就把一整盘意面吃光了。

e.en: She brought him a {plateful} of warm cookies.
e.zh: 她给他端来一盘热乎乎的曲奇。

e.en: A low {platelet} count can lead to excessive bleeding.
e.zh: 血小板计数过低会导致出血不止。

e.en: The patient received a {platelet} transfusion after surgery.
e.zh: 病人术后接受了血小板输注。

e.en: The mineral forms thin, {platelike} crystals under pressure.
e.zh: 这种矿物在压力下会形成薄片状的晶体。

e.en: Tectonic blocks move in {platelike} sections across the mantle.
e.zh: 地壳块体以片状结构在地幔上移动。

e.en: Please stack the dirty {plates} next to the sink.
e.zh: 请把脏盘子叠在水槽旁边。

e.en: Earth's tectonic {plates} shift only a few centimeters yearly.
e.zh: 地球的构造板块每年只移动几厘米。

platform.t: n. 平台；月台；(政治) 纲领

e.en: TikTok has become the dominant short-video {platform} for teens.
e.zh: 抖音已成为青少年最主流的短视频平台。

e.en: The train pulled away just as we reached the {platform}.
e.zh: 我们刚到站台,火车就开走了。

e.en: Many social {platforms} are tightening their content moderation rules.
e.zh: 许多社交平台正在收紧内容审核规则。

e.en: The station has twelve {platforms} for high-speed trains.
e.zh: 这座车站有十二个高铁站台。

plating.t:
n. 电镀；镀层
v. 镀

e.en: The restaurant is famous for its creative {plating}.
e.zh: 这家餐厅以富有创意的摆盘而闻名。

e.en: The gold {plating} on the watch wore off quickly.
e.zh: 手表上的镀金层很快就磨掉了。

e.en: Her engagement ring is set in brushed {platinum}.
e.zh: 她的订婚戒指是用拉丝铂金镶嵌的。

e.en: The album went {platinum} within a single week.
e.zh: 这张专辑一周之内就达到白金销量。

platitude.t: n. 陈词滥调；老生常谈

e.en: His speech was just one {platitude} after another.
e.zh: 他的演讲不过是一句接一句的陈词滥调。

e.en: Avoid the empty {platitude} and tell me what you really think.
e.zh: 别说那些空洞的套话,告诉我你真实的想法。

platitudinous.t: adj. 陈词滥调的；平庸的

e.en: The CEO's {platitudinous} memo failed to reassure worried staff.
e.zh: CEO 那份充满陈词滥调的备忘录并未让忧心的员工安心。

e.en: Critics dismissed the article as shallow and {platitudinous}.
e.zh: 评论家认为这篇文章肤浅且充斥着老生常谈。

e.en: {Plato} founded the Academy in ancient Athens around 387 BC.
e.zh: 柏拉图大约在公元前 387 年在古雅典创办了学园。

e.en: Many philosophy courses begin with the dialogues of {Plato}.
e.zh: 许多哲学课程都从柏拉图的对话录开始讲起。

platonic.t: adj. 柏拉图式的；纯精神的

e.en: Their relationship has stayed strictly {platonic} for years.
e.zh: 他们多年来一直保持纯粹的柏拉图式关系。

e.en: She values their {platonic} friendship more than any romance.
e.zh: 她珍视这份纯友谊胜过任何恋情。

e.en: The {platoon} advanced cautiously through the dense jungle.
e.zh: 这个排谨慎地穿过茂密的丛林前进。

e.en: He commanded a {platoon} of thirty soldiers in Afghanistan.
e.zh: 他在阿富汗指挥着一个三十人的排。

e.en: She arranged the cheese on a wooden {platter}.
e.zh: 她把奶酪摆在一个木盘上。

e.en: The waiter brought a sizzling seafood {platter} to the table.
e.zh: 服务员把一盘嗞嗞作响的海鲜拼盘端上桌。

e.en: The {platypus} lays eggs but still feeds its young milk.
e.zh: 鸭嘴兽会下蛋,却仍然用乳汁喂养幼崽。

e.en: We spotted a {platypus} swimming in the Tasmanian creek.
e.zh: 我们在塔斯马尼亚的小溪里看见一只鸭嘴兽在游泳。

e.en: Tourists gathered in the central {platz} for the parade.
e.zh: 游客们聚集在中央广场观看游行。

e.en: Outdoor cafes line every side of the historic {platz}.
e.zh: 历史悠久的广场四周到处是露天咖啡馆。

e.en: The film earned a {plaudit} from even the harshest critics.
e.zh: 这部电影连最苛刻的影评人都给予了赞誉。

e.en: Her debut novel received a major literary {plaudit}.
e.zh: 她的处女作小说赢得了一项重要的文学褒奖。

e.en: The detective weighed several {plausibilities} before naming a suspect.
e.zh: 侦探在锁定嫌疑人前权衡了几种可能性。

e.en: Different {plausibilities} emerged as new evidence came to light.
e.zh: 随着新证据出现,各种合理的可能性也浮现出来。

e.en: The story's {plausibility} hinges on a single shaky witness.
e.zh: 这则故事的可信度全系在一位证词不稳的证人身上。

e.en: His alibi lacked any real {plausibility} under questioning.
e.zh: 在盘问之下,他的不在场证明毫无可信度。

plausible.t: adj. 看似合理的；貌似可信的

e.en: That's the most {plausible} explanation I've heard so far.
e.zh: 这是我目前听到的最合理的解释。

e.en: The chatbot gives {plausible} answers that are sometimes wrong.
e.zh: 这款聊天机器人给出的答案听起来合理,但有时是错的。

e.en: He could {plausibly} claim he never received the email.
e.zh: 他完全可以说得过去地声称自己没收到那封邮件。

e.en: The new policy could {plausibly} reduce traffic by half.
e.zh: 新政策很有可能将交通流量减少一半。

play.t:
v. 玩；播放；扮演
n. 游戏；戏剧

e.en: The kids love to {play} video games after school.
e.zh: 孩子们放学后特别喜欢玩电子游戏。

e.en: We saw a brilliant {play} at the National Theatre last night.
e.zh: 我们昨晚在国家剧院看了一部非常精彩的话剧。

e.en: We watched the sunset from a quiet Mexican {playa}.
e.zh: 我们在墨西哥一处宁静的海滩上看日落。

e.en: The dry {playa} cracks into hexagons during summer heat.
e.zh: 干涸的盐滩在夏日酷热中裂成一片六边形。

e.en: Reviewers praised the game's smooth {playability} and intuitive controls.
e.zh: 评测者称赞这款游戏操作流畅、易于上手。

e.en: The patch significantly improved the title's overall {playability}.
e.zh: 这个补丁明显提升了游戏的整体可玩性。

e.en: A demo version is {playable} on Steam this weekend.
e.zh: 本周末 Steam 上可以试玩一个 demo 版本。

e.en: This old guitar is dusty but still perfectly {playable}.
e.zh: 这把旧吉他虽然落了灰,但弹起来还是完全没问题。

e.en: Don't {playact} sympathy when you clearly don't care.
e.zh: 你明明不在乎,就别假装同情了。

e.en: The kids love to {playact} as superheroes in the yard.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢在院子里扮演超级英雄。

e.en: Hit the {playback} button to review your recording.
e.zh: 按下回放键就能重听你录的音。

e.en: The audio {playback} sounded distorted on the cheap speakers.
e.zh: 用劣质音箱播放时,音频回放听起来有些失真。

e.en: She kept the {playbill} from every Broadway show she saw.
e.zh: 她把看过的每一场百老汇演出节目单都收藏起来。

e.en: The {playbill} listed an unexpected understudy in the lead role.
e.zh: 节目单上写着主角由一位临时替补出演,出乎意料。

e.en: The startup is following the standard Silicon Valley {playbook}.
e.zh: 这家初创公司沿用的是硅谷的标准打法。

e.en: The coach drew a new play in the team {playbook}.
e.zh: 教练在球队战术手册里画了一个新的战术。

playboy.t: n. 花花公子；纨绔子弟

e.en: The aging {playboy} still hosts wild parties at his villa.
e.zh: 那位上了年纪的花花公子仍在自家别墅里办狂欢派对。

e.en: He cultivated a {playboy} image that hid his shyness.
e.zh: 他刻意营造一副花花公子形象,掩盖自己其实很内向。

plaited.t:
adj. 编成辫的；编织的
v. plait 的过去式

e.en: She {plaited} her daughter's hair before school.
e.zh: 她在女儿上学前给她编了辫子。

e.en: The basket is woven from {plaited} straw.
e.zh: 这个篮子是用编结的稻草编成的。

plan.t:
n. 计划；方案
v. 计划；打算

e.en: We need a backup {plan} in case the server crashes.
e.zh: 我们需要一个备用方案，以防服务器崩溃。

e.en: They {plan} to launch the app next month.
e.zh: 他们计划下个月发布这款应用。

e.en: The chip uses a {planar} transistor design for efficiency.
e.zh: 该芯片采用平面晶体管设计以提高效率。

e.en: Engineers prefer {planar} surfaces for precise measurements.
e.zh: 工程师偏好用平面进行精确测量。

e.en: Quantum theory began with {Planck} and his constant.
e.zh: 量子理论始于普朗克和他的常数。

e.en: The {Planck} length is the smallest meaningful unit of distance.
e.zh: 普朗克长度是最小的有意义距离单位。

plane.t:
n. 飞机；平面
adj. 平的

e.en: Our {plane} lands in Tokyo at midnight.
e.zh: 我们的飞机在午夜降落东京。

e.en: Draw a triangle on the flat {plane}.
e.zh: 在这个平面上画一个三角形。

e.en: A whole {planeload} of tourists arrived this morning.
e.zh: 今早来了整整一飞机的游客。

e.en: The charity sent a {planeload} of supplies to the disaster zone.
e.zh: 慈善机构向灾区运送了一飞机的物资。

e.en: He used a wood {planer} to smooth the boards.
e.zh: 他用木刨把木板刨平。

e.en: The factory bought a new metal {planer} last week.
e.zh: 工厂上周购置了一台新的金属刨床。

e.en: Three {planes} took off within five minutes.
e.zh: 三架飞机在五分钟内相继起飞。

e.en: The sculpture's flat {planes} reflect light beautifully.
e.zh: 这件雕塑的平面将光线反射得很美。

e.en: Mars is the fourth {planet} from the sun.
e.zh: 火星是距离太阳第四近的行星。

e.en: We must protect our {planet} from climate change.
e.zh: 我们必须保护地球免受气候变化的影响。

e.en: The kids loved the star show at the {planetarium}.
e.zh: 孩子们很喜欢天文馆里的星空表演。

e.en: A new {planetarium} opened downtown last weekend.
e.zh: 市中心上周末开了一家新的天文馆。

e.en: Scientists study {planetary} motion using powerful telescopes.
e.zh: 科学家用强大的望远镜研究行星运动。

e.en: Climate change is now a {planetary} crisis.
e.zh: 气候变化如今已是全球性的危机。

e.en: Earth formed from countless tiny {planetesimal} fragments.
e.zh: 地球由无数微小的星子碎片聚合而成。

e.en: Each {planetesimal} slowly merged into a larger body.
e.zh: 每颗星子慢慢合并成更大的天体。

e.en: Astronomers spotted a small {planetoid} beyond Neptune.
e.zh: 天文学家在海王星外发现了一颗小行星。

e.en: Ceres was once classified as a {planetoid}.
e.zh: 谷神星曾被归类为类行星天体。

e.en: Our solar system has eight {planets}.
e.zh: 我们的太阳系有八颗行星。

e.en: Distant {planets} may host alien life.
e.zh: 遥远的行星上可能存在外星生命。

plangent.t: adj. 响亮悲鸣的；凄厉的

e.en: The {plangent} sound of church bells filled the valley.
e.zh: 教堂钟声的悠扬回响充满了山谷。

e.en: Her voice had a {plangent} quality that moved everyone.
e.zh: 她的嗓音带着哀婉之感，打动了每一个人。

planing.t:
v. 刨平；滑行
n. 刨削

e.en: He spent the afternoon {planing} the rough door frame.
e.zh: 他整个下午都在刨那扇粗糙的门框。

e.en: The boat was {planing} smoothly across the lake.
e.zh: 小船在湖面上平稳地滑行。

planisphere.t: n. 活动星图；平面天球图

e.en: Use a {planisphere} to identify constellations tonight.
e.zh: 今晚用星座盘来辨认星座吧。

e.en: The astronomer rotated the {planisphere} to show June stars.
e.zh: 天文学家旋转星座盘展示六月的星空。

plank.t:
n. 厚木板
v. 铺板

e.en: The carpenter nailed a wooden {plank} to the deck.
e.zh: 木匠把一块木板钉在甲板上。

e.en: I can hold a {plank} for two minutes.
e.zh: 我可以做两分钟的平板支撑。

planked.t:
adj. 铺木板的
v. plank 的过去式

e.en: The chef served {planked} salmon on cedar wood.
e.zh: 厨师用雪松木板烤好三文鱼端上桌。

e.en: Workers {planked} the muddy path with old boards.
e.zh: 工人用旧木板把泥泞的小路铺好了。

e.en: The boat's {planking} needs to be replaced before sailing.
e.zh: 出航前必须更换船体的木板。

e.en: Old {planking} creaked under our footsteps.
e.zh: 陈旧的甲板木在我们脚下吱呀作响。

e.en: Whales filter {plankton} from huge volumes of seawater.
e.zh: 鲸从大量海水中滤食浮游生物。

e.en: {Plankton} forms the base of the ocean food chain.
e.zh: 浮游生物构成了海洋食物链的基础。

e.en: Most coral larvae start life in a {planktonic} stage.
e.zh: 大多数珊瑚幼虫初期都处于浮游阶段。

e.en: Tiny {planktonic} organisms drift with ocean currents.
e.zh: 微小的浮游生物随海流漂移。

planned.t:
adj. 有计划的
v. plan 的过去式

e.en: We {planned} the trip months in advance.
e.zh: 我们提前几个月就计划好了这次旅行。

e.en: The merger was carefully {planned} to avoid layoffs.
e.zh: 这次合并经过精心策划以避免裁员。

planner.t: n. 策划者；规划师；日程本

e.en: She uses a paper {planner} to track deadlines.
e.zh: 她用纸质日程本来记录截止日期。

e.en: The wedding {planner} handled every detail flawlessly.
e.zh: 婚礼策划师把每个细节都处理得无可挑剔。

e.en: City {planners} approved the new bike lanes today.
e.zh: 城市规划者今天批准了新的自行车道。

e.en: Many students rely on digital {planners} on their phones.
e.zh: 许多学生依赖手机上的数字日程表。

e.en: We're {planning} a surprise party for Mom.
e.zh: 我们正在为妈妈策划一个惊喜派对。

e.en: Good {planning} saves a lot of time later.
e.zh: 好的规划能在后期节省大量时间。

e.en: The team's various {plannings} finally came together this week.
e.zh: 团队各项规划本周终于整合在了一起。

e.en: Different department {plannings} must align before launch.
e.zh: 各部门的规划必须在发布前协调一致。

plans.t:
n. 计划（复数）
v. 计划

e.en: What are your {plans} for the weekend?
e.zh: 你周末有什么打算？

e.en: The architect showed us the building {plans}.
e.zh: 建筑师向我们展示了大楼的设计图。

plant.t:
n. 植物；工厂
v. 种植

e.en: I water this {plant} every Sunday morning.
e.zh: 我每个周日早上给这株植物浇水。

e.en: The car {plant} employs over five thousand workers.
e.zh: 这家汽车工厂雇用了五千多名工人。

e.en: The {Plantagenet} dynasty ruled England for over three centuries.
e.zh: 金雀花王朝统治英格兰长达三个多世纪。

e.en: Richard III was the last {Plantagenet} king.
e.zh: 理查三世是最后一位金雀花王朝的国王。

e.en: Fried {plantain} is a popular Caribbean side dish.
e.zh: 炸大蕉是加勒比地区流行的配菜。

e.en: She bought a green {plantain} at the market.
e.zh: 她在市场上买了一根青色的大蕉。

e.en: The old coffee {plantation} is now a tourist site.
e.zh: 那座古老的咖啡种植园如今成了旅游景点。

e.en: Workers picked tea on the hillside {plantation} all day.
e.zh: 工人们整天在山坡的种植园采茶。

e.en: Gaston {Planté} invented the lead-acid battery in 1859.
e.zh: 加斯顿·普兰特于1859年发明了铅酸电池。

e.en: Engineers still credit {Planté} for modern car batteries.
e.zh: 工程师们仍把现代汽车电池的功劳归于普兰特。

planted.t:
adj. 栽种的
v. plant 的过去式

e.en: Grandma {planted} tomatoes in the backyard last spring.
e.zh: 奶奶去年春天在后院种了番茄。

e.en: The detective said the evidence had been {planted}.
e.zh: 警探说那些证据是被人栽赃的。

planter.t: n. 花盆；种植者；种植机

e.en: She put fresh herbs in the kitchen {planter}.
e.zh: 她在厨房的花盆里种了新鲜香草。

e.en: The {planter} on the balcony is full of roses.
e.zh: 阳台上的花槽里种满了玫瑰。

e.en: Spring is the best time for {planting} vegetables.
e.zh: 春天是种菜的最佳时节。

e.en: Volunteers are {planting} trees along the river.
e.zh: 志愿者们正在沿河种树。

e.en: Each tiny {plantlet} grew from a single leaf cutting.
e.zh: 每株小幼苗都是从一片叶子扦插长成的。

e.en: The biologist transferred the {plantlet} into a larger pot.
e.zh: 生物学家把小幼苗移植到更大的花盆里。

plants.t:
n. 植物；工厂（复数）
v. 种植

e.en: My apartment is full of indoor {plants}.
e.zh: 我的公寓里摆满了室内植物。

e.en: The company runs three {plants} in different countries.
e.zh: 该公司在三个不同的国家经营工厂。

plantsman.t: n. 园艺师；植物栽培者

e.en: The famous {plantsman} bred dozens of new rose varieties.
e.zh: 那位著名的园艺家培育了几十个玫瑰新品种。

e.en: Every serious {plantsman} keeps a detailed garden journal.
e.zh: 每位专业园艺家都会写详细的园艺日记。

e.en: A bronze {plaque} marks his birthplace on the wall.
e.zh: 墙上一块铜牌标示着他的出生地。

e.en: Brushing daily prevents {plaque} buildup on your teeth.
e.zh: 每天刷牙可防止牙菌斑堆积。

e.en: The hall displayed dozens of memorial {plaques}.
e.zh: 大厅里陈列着几十块纪念牌。

e.en: Alzheimer's brains often show amyloid {plaques}.
e.zh: 阿尔茨海默症患者的大脑常出现淀粉样斑块。

plash.t:
n. 溅水声
v. 溅水

e.en: I heard the gentle {plash} of water in the fountain.
e.zh: 我听到喷泉中轻柔的水花声。

e.en: Raindrops {plash} against the window all night.
e.zh: 雨点整夜啪嗒啪嗒地打在窗户上。

e.en: Scientists examined the cell {plasm} under a microscope.
e.zh: 科学家在显微镜下观察细胞原浆。

e.en: Germ {plasm} carries hereditary information between generations.
e.zh: 种质把遗传信息在世代间传递下去。

e.en: Donating {plasma} can help patients with serious illnesses.
e.zh: 捐献血浆可以帮助患重病的患者。

e.en: The sun is made mostly of hot {plasma}.
e.zh: 太阳主要由炽热的等离子体组成。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed a solitary {plasmacytoma} in his spine.
e.zh: 医生诊断他脊柱上有一处孤立性浆细胞瘤。

e.en: A {plasmacytoma} can sometimes progress to multiple myeloma.
e.zh: 浆细胞瘤有时会发展为多发性骨髓瘤。

e.en: She undergoes {plasmapheresis} weekly to manage her autoimmune disease.
e.zh: 她每周做一次血浆置换来控制自身免疫疾病。

e.en: {Plasmapheresis} removes harmful antibodies from the bloodstream.
e.zh: 血浆置换可以清除血液中有害的抗体。

e.en: Researchers inserted the gene into a bacterial {plasmid}.
e.zh: 研究人员把这段基因插入到细菌质粒中。

e.en: A {plasmid} carries DNA independently of the chromosome.
e.zh: 质粒携带的DNA独立于染色体之外。

e.en: The drug activates {plasminogen} to dissolve dangerous blood clots.
e.zh: 这种药物激活纤溶酶原以溶解危险的血栓。

e.en: Low {plasminogen} levels can cause unusual clotting problems.
e.zh: 纤溶酶原水平偏低会引起异常的凝血问题。

e.en: Malaria is caused by a parasite called {Plasmodium}.
e.zh: 疟疾由一种叫疟原虫的寄生虫引起。

e.en: Mosquitoes spread {Plasmodium} through their bites.
e.zh: 蚊子通过叮咬传播疟原虫。

plaster.t:
n. 石膏；膏药
v. 涂抹

e.en: The workers spread fresh {plaster} on the bedroom walls.
e.zh: 工人在卧室墙上抹了一层新的灰泥。

e.en: Mom put a {plaster} on my scraped knee.
e.zh: 妈妈在我擦伤的膝盖上贴了一片创可贴。

playdate.t: n. (为孩子安排的) 玩耍聚会

e.en: We arranged a {playdate} for our toddlers on Saturday.
e.zh: 我们周六给两个小娃约了一次玩伴聚会。

e.en: Her son had a {playdate} with his preschool friend.
e.zh: 她儿子和幼儿园的朋友约着一起玩。

played.t: v. play 的过去式/过去分词

e.en: We {played} board games until well past midnight.
e.zh: 我们玩桌游一直玩到午夜过后很久。

e.en: She {played} the violin beautifully at the wedding ceremony.
e.zh: 她在婚礼上把小提琴拉得非常动人。

player.t:
n. 玩家；选手
n. 播放器

e.en: He's the best basketball {player} on the entire team.
e.zh: 他是全队最出色的篮球运动员。

e.en: The music {player} on my phone keeps crashing.
e.zh: 我手机上的音乐播放器老是闪退。

e.en: The team signed two new {players} during the transfer window.
e.zh: 球队在转会窗口签下了两名新球员。

e.en: Most music {players} now stream songs from the cloud.
e.zh: 现在大多数音乐播放器都从云端串流歌曲。

e.en: The puppy gave me a {playful} nip on the finger.
e.zh: 小狗顽皮地咬了我的手指一口。

e.en: Her email had a {playful} tone that made me smile.
e.zh: 她的邮件语气俏皮,让我笑了出来。

e.en: He {playfully} ruffled his little sister's hair.
e.zh: 他顽皮地揉了揉小妹妹的头发。

e.en: She {playfully} accused him of stealing her fries.
e.zh: 她开玩笑地指控他偷吃她的薯条。

e.en: The design has a {playfulness} that appeals to younger users.
e.zh: 这个设计带着一种俏皮感,很受年轻用户喜爱。

e.en: His {playfulness} made even meetings feel relaxed.
e.zh: 他的活泼性格让连开会都显得轻松。

e.en: As a regular {playgoer}, she has season tickets to the theater.
e.zh: 作为常去看戏的观众,她买了剧院的季票。

e.en: Every {playgoer} in the audience gave a standing ovation.
e.zh: 全场每一位观众都起立鼓掌。

e.en: The kids raced to the {playground} after school.
e.zh: 放学后孩子们冲向操场。

e.en: This city is a {playground} for food lovers.
e.zh: 这座城市是吃货们的乐园。

e.en: The city is building three new {playgrounds} this summer.
e.zh: 市政府今年夏天将新建三个游乐场。

e.en: Online forums became {playgrounds} for endless debate.
e.zh: 网络论坛成了无休止辩论的乐园。

e.en: My toddler joined a {playgroup} at the community center.
e.zh: 我家小孩在社区中心参加了一个亲子活动小组。

e.en: The {playgroup} meets every Tuesday morning.
e.zh: 这个亲子活动小组每周二早上聚会。

playhouse.t:
n. 儿童玩耍的小屋
n. 剧院

e.en: Dad built a wooden {playhouse} in the backyard.
e.zh: 爸爸在后院搭了一座木制小屋给孩子玩。

e.en: The local {playhouse} is staging Hamlet next month.
e.zh: 当地的小剧院下个月将上演《哈姆雷特》。

playing.t: v. 玩；演奏；播放 (现在分词)

e.en: The kids are {playing} video games in the living room.
e.zh: 孩子们正在客厅里打电子游戏。

e.en: A jazz tune was {playing} softly in the café.
e.zh: 咖啡馆里轻轻播放着一首爵士乐曲。

e.en: The mall has an indoor {playland} for toddlers.
e.zh: 商场里有一个供幼儿玩耍的室内乐园。

e.en: Vegas is a {playland} for adults who love bright lights.
e.zh: 拉斯维加斯是喜欢霓虹灯的成年人的乐园。

e.en: I made a {playlist} for our road trip to the coast.
e.zh: 我为我们去海边的公路旅行做了一个歌单。

e.en: Spotify suggested a new {playlist} based on my taste.
e.zh: Spotify根据我的口味推荐了一个新歌单。

playmaker.t: n. (球队) 组织核心；策划进攻的球员

e.en: The young {playmaker} set up three goals tonight.
e.zh: 这位年轻的组织核心今晚助攻了三球。

e.en: Every winning team needs a creative {playmaker}.
e.zh: 每支冠军球队都需要一位富有创造力的组织者。

e.en: His {playmaking} ability transformed the offense.
e.zh: 他的组织能力彻底改变了球队的进攻。

e.en: The coach praised her {playmaking} in the second half.
e.zh: 教练称赞了她下半场的组织调度。

e.en: My dog needs a {playmate} to keep her company.
e.zh: 我家的狗需要一个玩伴陪着她。

e.en: He was my favorite {playmate} growing up next door.
e.zh: 小时候住在隔壁的他是我最爱的玩伴。

e.en: The twins have always been each other's best {playmates}.
e.zh: 这对双胞胎一直是彼此最好的玩伴。

e.en: Kindergarten is where she met her first {playmates}.
e.zh: 她在幼儿园里结识了第一批玩伴。

playoff.t: n. 季后赛；加时决胜赛

e.en: The team clinched a {playoff} spot with last night's win.
e.zh: 球队凭昨晚的胜利锁定了季后赛席位。

e.en: This {playoff} game will decide who advances to the finals.
e.zh: 这场附加赛将决定谁能晋级决赛。

e.en: The baby giggled inside her colorful {playpen}.
e.zh: 宝宝在彩色的游戏围栏里咯咯地笑。

e.en: We set up a {playpen} so we could cook safely.
e.zh: 我们摆了一个游戏围栏,这样做饭时孩子很安全。

e.en: We turned the basement into a {playroom} for the kids.
e.zh: 我们把地下室改造成了孩子们的游戏房。

e.en: Toys were scattered all over the {playroom} floor.
e.zh: 玩具撒了一地,铺满了游戏房的地板。

plays.t:
v. play 的第三人称单数
n. 戏剧 (复数)

e.en: She {plays} guitar in a local indie band.
e.zh: 她在一支本地独立乐队里弹吉他。

e.en: Shakespeare's {plays} are still performed worldwide.
e.zh: 莎士比亚的戏剧至今仍在世界各地上演。

e.en: My niece just started {playschool} last week.
e.zh: 我侄女上周刚上幼儿园。

e.en: The {playschool} focuses on learning through games.
e.zh: 这所幼儿园注重通过游戏来学习。

e.en: The puppy treated my slipper like a chew {plaything}.
e.zh: 小狗把我的拖鞋当成了啃咬的玩具。

e.en: He felt like a {plaything} in the company's restructuring.
e.zh: 在公司重组中,他觉得自己像个被摆布的玩物。

playtime.t: n. 游戏时间；课间休息

e.en: The kids look forward to {playtime} after lunch.
e.zh: 孩子们都盼着午饭后的游戏时间。

e.en: Even adults need {playtime} to recharge their minds.
e.zh: 即便是成年人也需要玩耍时间来放松心情。

e.en: The young {playwright} won a major award last night.
e.zh: 这位年轻剧作家昨晚获得了一项大奖。

e.en: She is a {playwright} known for sharp social comedy.
e.zh: 她是一位以犀利社会喜剧闻名的剧作家。

e.en: Several modern {playwrights} draw inspiration from current events.
e.zh: 许多当代剧作家从时事中汲取灵感。

e.en: The festival showcases {playwrights} from across Asia.
e.zh: 这个戏剧节展示了来自亚洲各地的剧作家。

e.en: We met for coffee at the {plaza} near city hall.
e.zh: 我们约在市政厅旁边的广场喝咖啡。

e.en: Street performers gathered in the central {plaza}.
e.zh: 街头艺人聚集在中央广场上表演。

plc.t: n. 公众有限公司 (public limited company)

e.en: The British {plc} reported record profits this quarter.
e.zh: 这家英国上市公司本季度公布了创纪录的利润。

e.en: BP {plc} is one of the largest energy firms in Europe.
e.zh: BP公司是欧洲最大的能源公司之一。

plea.t:
n. 恳求；请求
n. (法庭) 抗辩

e.en: The mother made an emotional {plea} for her son's release.
e.zh: 那位母亲含泪恳求释放她的儿子。

e.en: He entered a {plea} of not guilty in court.
e.zh: 他在法庭上做出无罪辩护。

e.en: Lawyers often {plead} for leniency at sentencing.
e.zh: 律师在量刑时常常请求从轻发落。

e.en: I had to {plead} with my boss for a day off.
e.zh: 我不得不央求老板批我一天假。

pleaded.t: v. plead 的过去式/过去分词

e.en: She {pleaded} with him to reconsider his decision.
e.zh: 她恳求他重新考虑这个决定。

e.en: The defendant {pleaded} guilty to two counts of fraud.
e.zh: 被告对两项欺诈指控认罪。

e.en: The {pleader} spoke passionately on behalf of the victims.
e.zh: 辩护人激情澎湃地为受害者陈情。

e.en: As a public {pleader}, he handled hundreds of cases yearly.
e.zh: 作为公共辩护人,他每年处理数百起案件。

pleading.t:
v. 恳求；辩护 (现在分词)
adj. 恳求的

e.en: The dog gave me a {pleading} look for another treat.
e.zh: 小狗用恳求的眼神望着我,想再要一块零食。

e.en: She kept {pleading} with him to come back home.
e.zh: 她不停地哀求他回家。

e.en: The child looked up {pleadingly} for one more story.
e.zh: 孩子抬起头哀求地求再讲一个故事。

e.en: She glanced {pleadingly} at her boss before the meeting.
e.zh: 开会前她哀求似的看了老板一眼。

pleads.t: v. plead 的第三人称单数

e.en: He often {pleads} ignorance to avoid responsibility.
e.zh: 他常以不知情为由来逃避责任。

e.en: The charity {pleads} for donations after every disaster.
e.zh: 每次灾难过后,慈善机构都呼吁捐款。

e.en: Her desperate {pleas} for help finally reached the police.
e.zh: 她绝望的求救声终于传到了警方耳中。

e.en: The judge ignored their {pleas} for a lighter sentence.
e.zh: 法官没有理会他们减刑的请求。

pleasance.t: n. 游乐园；幽静花园 (罕用)

e.en: The garden's {pleasance} drew visitors all summer long.
e.zh: 花园的怡人景致整个夏天吸引着游客。

e.en: They strolled through the manor's quiet {pleasance}.
e.zh: 他们漫步在庄园宁静的游园中。

pleasant.t: adj. 愉快的；舒适的；友善的

e.en: We had a {pleasant} dinner with old college friends.
e.zh: 我们和大学老友共度了一顿愉快的晚餐。

e.en: The weather was surprisingly {pleasant} for November.
e.zh: 对于十一月来说,天气宜人得令人意外。

e.en: I was {pleasantly} surprised by the movie's ending.
e.zh: 电影的结局让我惊喜不已。

e.en: She greeted every customer {pleasantly} at the door.
e.zh: 她在门口愉悦地迎接每一位顾客。

e.en: The host's {pleasantness} put every guest at ease.
e.zh: 主人和蔼可亲的态度让每位客人都感到自在。

e.en: There's a quiet {pleasantness} to small mountain towns.
e.zh: 山间小镇有一种静谧宜人的气息。

e.en: We exchanged a quick {pleasantry} before the meeting started.
e.zh: 会议开始前我们简短地寒暄了几句。

e.en: His opening {pleasantry} broke the tension in the room.
e.zh: 他开场的客套话化解了房间里的紧张气氛。

please.t:
adv. 请
v. 使高兴；取悦

e.en: Could you {please} send me the file by tonight?
e.zh: 麻烦你今晚之前把文件发给我好吗?

e.en: It's hard to {please} everyone on a team this large.
e.zh: 在这么大的团队里,要让每个人都满意很难。

e.en: I'm really {pleased} with how the presentation turned out.
e.zh: 我对这次演讲的效果非常满意。

e.en: My parents were {pleased} to hear about the promotion.
e.zh: 父母听到我升职的消息后很高兴。

pleaser.t: n. 取悦他人的人或物

e.en: This dessert is a real crowd {pleaser} at parties.
e.zh: 这道甜点在派对上总能博得满堂彩。

e.en: He's a people {pleaser} who rarely says no.
e.zh: 他是个讨好型的人,很少拒绝别人。

pleases.t: v. please 的第三人称单数

e.en: Nothing {pleases} my grandmother more than a family dinner.
e.zh: 没什么比家庭聚餐更让我奶奶高兴的了。

e.en: He does whatever {pleases} him, regardless of others.
e.zh: 他想做什么就做什么,不管别人怎么想。

pleasing.t: adj. 令人愉快的；讨人喜欢的

e.en: The app has a clean, visually {pleasing} interface.
e.zh: 这款应用界面简洁,视觉效果赏心悦目。

e.en: She found the soft music quite {pleasing}.
e.zh: 她觉得这柔和的音乐很令人惬意。

e.en: The coffee was {pleasingly} smooth with hints of chocolate.
e.zh: 咖啡顺滑可口,还带着一丝巧克力香气。

e.en: The room was {pleasingly} warm on a cold night.
e.zh: 在寒冷的夜晚,房间里暖意宜人。

pleasurable.t: adj. 令人愉快的；享受的

e.en: Reading a good book on a rainy day is {pleasurable}.
e.zh: 在雨天读一本好书是件惬意的事。

e.en: We had a thoroughly {pleasurable} weekend at the beach.
e.zh: 我们在海边度过了一个非常愉快的周末。

e.en: The hot bath relaxed her {pleasurably} after the long hike.
e.zh: 长途徒步后,这场热水澡让她舒服地放松下来。

e.en: He sighed {pleasurably} at the first sip of wine.
e.zh: 喝下第一口红酒时,他惬意地叹了口气。

pleasure.t:
n. 愉悦，乐趣
v. 使高兴

e.en: It's always a {pleasure} working with such a talented team.
e.zh: 和这么有才华的团队合作真是一种享受。

e.en: She reads novels purely for {pleasure}, not study.
e.zh: 她读小说纯粹是为了消遣,不是为了学习。

pleasures.t: n. 乐事，享受（pleasure 的复数）

e.en: Morning coffee is one of life's simple {pleasures}.
e.zh: 清晨的咖啡是生活中简单的小确幸之一。

e.en: He gave up many {pleasures} to save for a house.
e.zh: 为了存钱买房,他放弃了许多享乐。

pleat.t:
n. 褶，褶裥
v. 打褶

e.en: She ironed a sharp {pleat} into the front of her trousers.
e.zh: 她在裤子前面熨出一道笔直的褶。

e.en: The skirt has a single deep {pleat} down the back.
e.zh: 这条裙子背后有一道很深的褶。

e.en: She wore a {pleated} skirt to the office.
e.zh: 她穿着百褶裙去上班。

e.en: The {pleated} curtains softened the bright afternoon light.
e.zh: 打褶的窗帘柔化了下午刺眼的阳光。

pleating.t:
v. 打褶（pleat 的现在分词）
n. 褶饰

e.en: The tailor is {pleating} the fabric by hand.
e.zh: 裁缝正在手工给布料打褶。

e.en: Fine {pleating} on the dress made it look expensive.
e.zh: 裙子上精致的褶皱让它显得很昂贵。

pleb.t: n. 平民，下层人（贬义口语）

e.en: Don't treat me like a {pleb} just because I'm new.
e.zh: 别因为我是新人就把我当成下等人。

e.en: He jokingly called himself a {pleb} among the executives.
e.zh: 他在高管中开玩笑地自称是个小角色。

e.en: Every {plebe} at the academy goes through tough first-year drills.
e.zh: 军校里每个新生都要经历严苛的第一年训练。

e.en: The senior cadets teased the {plebe} during orientation.
e.zh: 高年级学员在迎新时取笑那名新学员。

plebeian.t:
adj. 平民的，粗俗的
n. 平民

e.en: His tastes in food are decidedly {plebeian}.
e.zh: 他在饮食上的口味相当平民化。

e.en: In ancient Rome, a {plebeian} had fewer rights than a patrician.
e.zh: 在古罗马,平民的权利比贵族少。

plebiscite.t: n. 公民投票，全民公决

e.en: The government held a {plebiscite} on changing the constitution.
e.zh: 政府就修改宪法举行了全民公投。

e.en: Voters approved independence in a national {plebiscite}.
e.zh: 选民在全国公投中通过了独立议案。

e.en: She lost her favorite {plectrum} during the gig.
e.zh: 她在演出时弄丢了最喜欢的拨片。

e.en: Use a thin {plectrum} for a brighter guitar tone.
e.zh: 用薄拨片可以让吉他音色更明亮。

pledge.t:
n. 誓言，承诺
v. 保证，抵押

e.en: He made a {pledge} to donate ten percent of his income.
e.zh: 他承诺捐出收入的百分之十。

e.en: Companies often {pledge} to reduce carbon emissions by 2030.
e.zh: 公司经常承诺在2030年前减少碳排放。

pledged.t: v. 已承诺，已抵押（pledge 的过去式）

e.en: The startup {pledged} all proceeds to disaster relief.
e.zh: 这家创业公司承诺将全部收益用于救灾。

e.en: She {pledged} her support for the new policy.
e.zh: 她承诺支持这项新政策。

pledges.t:
n. 承诺（复数）
v. 保证（第三人称单数）

e.en: The charity received {pledges} totaling over a million dollars.
e.zh: 该慈善机构收到了超过一百万美元的认捐。

e.en: He always keeps the {pledges} he makes to friends.
e.zh: 他对朋友许下的承诺总是说到做到。

pledging.t: v. 正在承诺（pledge 的现在分词）

e.en: Donors are {pledging} record amounts to the relief fund.
e.zh: 捐助者正在向救济基金认捐创纪录的金额。

e.en: He spent weeks {pledging} a fraternity in college.
e.zh: 他在大学里花了好几周时间申请加入兄弟会。

pleistocene.t:
n. 更新世
adj. 更新世的

e.en: Mammoths roamed widely during the {Pleistocene} epoch.
e.zh: 猛犸象在更新世广泛分布。

e.en: This fossil dates back to the late {Pleistocene}.
e.zh: 这块化石可以追溯到更新世晚期。

plena.t: n. 全体会议（plenum 的复数）

e.en: The committee scheduled two {plena} for next month.
e.zh: 委员会下个月安排了两次全体会议。

e.en: Important votes are usually held during the {plena}.
e.zh: 重要表决通常在全体会议上进行。

plenary.t: adj. 全体出席的，全权的

e.en: The conference opens with a {plenary} session on Monday.
e.zh: 会议将于周一以全体大会开幕。

e.en: All delegates must attend the {plenary} meeting.
e.zh: 所有代表都必须出席全体会议。

plenipotentiary.t:
n. 全权代表
adj. 有全权的

e.en: She was sent as a {plenipotentiary} to negotiate the treaty.
e.zh: 她被派为全权代表去谈判这项条约。

e.en: The ambassador holds {plenipotentiary} powers in trade talks.
e.zh: 这位大使在贸易谈判中拥有全权。

e.en: The garden offers a {plenitude} of fresh herbs all summer.
e.zh: 这座花园整个夏天都有大量新鲜香草。

e.en: He spoke with a {plenitude} of confidence.
e.zh: 他说话时充满了自信。

plenteous.t: adj. 丰富的，充裕的（文学用语）

e.en: The harvest this year was {plenteous} and well-timed.
e.zh: 今年的收成丰盛,时机也很好。

e.en: Guests enjoyed a {plenteous} feast at the wedding.
e.zh: 宾客们在婚礼上享用了丰盛的宴席。

plenties.t: n. 丰盛（plenty 的复数，罕用）

e.en: Old farmers still talk about the {plenties} of past harvests.
e.zh: 老农们还在谈论过去丰收的年景。

e.en: The land has known both famines and {plenties}.
e.zh: 这片土地经历过饥荒,也经历过丰年。

e.en: Fresh seafood is {plentiful} along this coast.
e.zh: 这一带海岸的海鲜非常丰富。

e.en: Jobs were {plentiful} during the tech boom.
e.zh: 科技繁荣期工作机会很多。

e.en: Water flowed {plentifully} from the mountain spring.
e.zh: 水从山泉中源源不断地流出。

e.en: She seasoned the stew {plentifully} with garlic.
e.zh: 她在炖菜里放了大量的蒜。

e.en: The market offers a {plentitude} of seasonal vegetables.
e.zh: 市场上有种类繁多的时令蔬菜。

e.en: Streaming services provide a {plentitude} of viewing options.
e.zh: 流媒体服务提供了海量的观看选择。

plenty.t:
n. 大量，充足
adv. 非常

e.en: There's {plenty} of time before the train leaves.
e.zh: 距离火车开车还有充足的时间。

e.en: We have {plenty} of snacks for the road trip.
e.zh: 我们带了很多零食准备公路旅行。

e.en: The party's central {plenum} convened to vote on reforms.
e.zh: 该党的中央全会召开,就改革进行表决。

e.en: Cool air circulates through the ceiling {plenum}.
e.zh: 冷空气在天花板的通风夹层中循环。

e.en: The bacteria appeared {pleomorphic} under the microscope.
e.zh: 这些细菌在显微镜下呈现多形性。

e.en: Tumor cells are often highly {pleomorphic} in shape.
e.zh: 肿瘤细胞的形态往往呈现高度多形性。

e.en: Pathologists noted significant {pleomorphism} in the tissue sample.
e.zh: 病理学家在组织样本中发现了明显的多形性。

e.en: Cellular {pleomorphism} can indicate aggressive cancer.
e.zh: 细胞多形性可能提示癌症具有侵袭性。

e.en: "Free gift" is a {pleonastic} phrase common in advertising.
e.zh: “免费礼物”是广告中常见的冗余表达。

e.en: Editors removed several {pleonastic} expressions from the draft.
e.zh: 编辑从草稿中删去了几处冗赘的表达。

plesiosaur.t: n. 蛇颈龙（史前海洋爬行动物）

e.en: The museum displays a complete {plesiosaur} skeleton.
e.zh: 博物馆展出一具完整的蛇颈龙骨架。

e.en: Some legends compare lake monsters to a {plesiosaur}.
e.zh: 有些传说把湖怪比作蛇颈龙。

e.en: The app offers a {plethora} of customization options.
e.zh: 这款应用提供了大量的自定义选项。

e.en: Streaming has created a {plethora} of new shows.
e.zh: 流媒体催生了大量的新剧集。

e.en: Inflammation of the {pleura} can make breathing painful.
e.zh: 胸膜发炎可能让人呼吸时疼痛。

e.en: The {pleura} is the thin membrane surrounding each lung.
e.zh: 胸膜是包裹每个肺的薄膜。

e.en: The doctor drained fluid from the {pleural} cavity.
e.zh: 医生从胸膜腔抽出了积液。

e.en: A CT scan revealed a small {pleural} effusion.
e.zh: CT 扫描显示有少量胸腔积液。

e.en: He was hospitalized with severe {pleurisy} last winter.
e.zh: 去年冬天他因严重胸膜炎住院。

e.en: Sharp chest pain can be a sign of {pleurisy}.
e.zh: 剧烈的胸痛可能是胸膜炎的征兆。

e.en: The cashier sat behind a {Plexiglas} shield during the pandemic.
e.zh: 疫情期间收银员坐在一块有机玻璃挡板后面。

e.en: The display case is made of clear {Plexiglas}.
e.zh: 这个展示柜是用透明有机玻璃做的。

e.en: They installed {plexiglass} barriers between the office desks.
e.zh: 他们在办公桌之间装上了有机玻璃隔板。

e.en: The hockey rink is surrounded by thick {plexiglass}.
e.zh: 冰球场四周围着厚厚的有机玻璃。

e.en: A punch to the solar {plexus} can knock the wind out of you.
e.zh: 打到太阳神经丛会让人喘不过气。

e.en: The brachial {plexus} controls movement in the arm.
e.zh: 臂丛神经控制着手臂的运动。

e.en: The leather's {pliability} makes it ideal for fine gloves.
e.zh: 这种皮革的柔韧性很适合做精致手套。

e.en: Yoga improves the {pliability} of your muscles.
e.zh: 瑜伽能提高肌肉的柔韧性。

e.en: Warm the clay until it becomes soft and {pliable}.
e.zh: 把黏土加热到柔软易塑的状态。

e.en: Young minds are more {pliable} and open to new ideas.
e.zh: 年轻的头脑更易塑,也更愿意接受新想法。

pliant.t: adj. 柔韧的，易受影响的

e.en: The willow branches are {pliant} enough to weave into baskets.
e.zh: 柳枝够柔韧,可以编成篮子。

e.en: He preferred a {pliant} assistant who never argued back.
e.zh: 他喜欢一个从不顶嘴的顺从助手。

plier.t: n. 钳子（通常用复数 pliers）

e.en: Hand me that {plier} so I can grip the wire.
e.zh: 把那把钳子递给我,我要夹住电线。

e.en: A small {plier} is useful for jewelry repairs.
e.zh: 小钳子在修首饰时很有用。

e.en: Use a pair of {pliers} to twist the wire tight.
e.zh: 用一把钳子把电线拧紧。

e.en: The {pliers} slipped and scratched the metal surface.
e.zh: 钳子滑了一下,把金属表面刮花了。

plight.t:
n. 困境，苦难
v. 宣誓

e.en: The documentary highlights the {plight} of refugees worldwide.
e.zh: 这部纪录片揭示了全球难民的困境。

e.en: Volunteers tried to ease the {plight} of stray animals.
e.zh: 志愿者们努力缓解流浪动物的困境。

e.en: She slipped on a canvas {plimsoll} before heading out.
e.zh: 她出门前套上了一双帆布胶底鞋。

e.en: Old gym classes required white {plimsoll} shoes.
e.zh: 以前的体育课要求穿白色的帆布胶底鞋。

plink.t:
n. 叮当声
v. 发出叮当声

e.en: Raindrops {plink} softly against the metal roof.
e.zh: 雨滴轻轻地敲打着金属屋顶。

e.en: He likes to {plink} cans with his air rifle.
e.zh: 他喜欢用气枪打罐头玩。

e.en: The statue rests on a marble {plinth} in the square.
e.zh: 雕像立在广场上的大理石基座上。

e.en: They cleaned the {plinth} before installing the new sculpture.
e.zh: 他们在安装新雕塑前把基座擦干净了。

pliny.t: n. 普林尼（古罗马学者人名）

e.en: {Pliny} the Elder wrote a famous encyclopedia in ancient Rome.
e.zh: 老普林尼在古罗马写过一部著名的百科全书。

e.en: Historians still cite {Pliny} when describing Pompeii's eruption.
e.zh: 历史学家在描述庞贝火山喷发时仍引用普林尼的记载。

pliocene.t:
n. 上新世
adj. 上新世的

e.en: Many modern mammals first appeared in the {Pliocene} epoch.
e.zh: 许多现代哺乳动物最早出现在上新世。

e.en: These rocks were formed during the {Pliocene}.
e.zh: 这些岩石形成于上新世。

plo.t: n. 巴勒斯坦解放组织（缩写）

e.en: The {PLO} signed historic accords with Israel in 1993.
e.zh: 巴解组织于1993年与以色列签署了历史性协议。

e.en: News reports mentioned a {PLO} delegation visiting Cairo.
e.zh: 新闻报道提到一个巴解组织代表团访问开罗。

plod.t:
v. 沉重缓慢地走
v. 埋头苦干

e.en: The hikers {plod} slowly up the muddy trail.
e.zh: 徒步者们沿着泥泞的小路缓慢前行。

e.en: He had to {plod} through hundreds of pages of contracts.
e.zh: 他不得不费力地读完几百页的合同。

plodder.t:
n. 埋头苦干的人
n. 步履沉重的人

e.en: He's no genius, just a steady {plodder} who finishes the work.
e.zh: 他不是天才,只是个踏实肯干、能把活做完的人。

e.en: Even a {plodder} can outperform a flashy slacker.
e.zh: 踏实苦干的人也能胜过华而不实的懒人。

plodding.t:
adj. 缓慢吃力的
adj. 单调乏味的

e.en: The film's {plodding} pace lost most of the audience.
e.zh: 这部电影节奏拖沓,失去了大部分观众。

e.en: She made {plodding} progress on the long research paper.
e.zh: 她在那篇长论文上慢慢地推进着。

plonk.t:
v. 砰地放下
n. 廉价葡萄酒

e.en: She {plonk} the heavy bag down on the table.
e.zh: 她把那只重包啪地放在桌上。

e.en: We shared a bottle of cheap {plonk} at dinner.
e.zh: 我们晚餐时喝了一瓶廉价的红酒。

e.en: Don't be such a {plonker} and lock the door.
e.zh: 别这么蠢，记得锁门。

e.en: The driver behind me is a complete {plonker}.
e.zh: 我后面那个司机真是个十足的笨蛋。

plop.t:
n. 扑通声
v. 扑通落下

e.en: The frog gave a loud {plop} into the pond.
e.zh: 那只青蛙扑通一声跳进了池塘。

e.en: She watched the ice cubes {plop} into her glass.
e.zh: 她看着冰块扑通掉进她的杯子里。

plot.t:
n. 情节；阴谋
v. 密谋；绘制

e.en: The novel has a twisted {plot} full of surprises.
e.zh: 这部小说情节曲折，充满惊喜。

e.en: They bought a small {plot} of land near the river.
e.zh: 他们在河边买了一小块地。

e.en: Critics called the film beautiful but completely {plotless}.
e.zh: 影评人说这部电影画面很美，但完全没有情节。

e.en: I can't enjoy a {plotless} novel no matter how poetic.
e.zh: 再有诗意的小说，没情节我也读不下去。

e.en: The show's main {plotline} follows a young detective.
e.zh: 这部剧的主线讲述一名年轻侦探。

e.en: Several side {plotline}s never really get resolved.
e.zh: 有几条支线情节始终没有真正交代清楚。

plots.t:
n. 情节；阴谋（复数）
v. 密谋（第三人称）

e.en: The author weaves three different {plots} into one story.
e.zh: 作者把三条不同的情节编织成一个故事。

e.en: Farmers tend their vegetable {plots} every morning.
e.zh: 农民们每天早晨都打理自家的菜地。

e.en: They {plotted} for months to escape the prison.
e.zh: 他们密谋了好几个月想逃出监狱。

e.en: The scientist {plotted} the data points on a graph.
e.zh: 科学家把数据点标注在图表上。

plotter.t:
n. 绘图仪
n. 密谋者

e.en: Police arrested the main {plotter} behind the attack.
e.zh: 警方逮捕了袭击事件的主谋。

e.en: The architect printed blueprints on a large {plotter}.
e.zh: 建筑师用大型绘图仪打印了蓝图。

e.en: The villains were {plotting} to overthrow the king.
e.zh: 反派们正在密谋推翻国王。

e.en: She spent hours {plotting} sales data into charts.
e.zh: 她花了好几个小时把销售数据画成图表。

e.en: The farmer used a horse to {plough} the field.
e.zh: 农夫用马来犁地。

e.en: An old wooden {plough} sat rusting in the barn.
e.zh: 一架老旧的木犁锈迹斑斑地放在谷仓里。

ploughed.t: v. 犁过；艰难前进（过去式）

e.en: He {ploughed} through the report in one evening.
e.zh: 他一个晚上就啃完了那份报告。

e.en: The tractor {ploughed} the field before sunrise.
e.zh: 拖拉机在日出前犁完了那片地。

e.en: {Ploughing} the fields begins in early spring.
e.zh: 犁地的工作在初春就开始了。

e.en: He kept {ploughing} on with his thesis despite the setbacks.
e.zh: 尽管遇到挫折，他仍坚持埋头写论文。

e.en: Most of the village's {ploughland} now grows wheat.
e.zh: 村里大部分的耕地现在种的是小麦。

e.en: Heavy rain has flooded the {ploughland} overnight.
e.zh: 一夜大雨把耕地都淹了。

e.en: The {ploughman} guided his oxen across the field.
e.zh: 犁地人赶着牛走过田地。

e.en: I ordered a {ploughman}'s lunch with cheese and bread.
e.zh: 我点了一份配奶酪和面包的农夫午餐。

e.en: They beat their swords into {ploughshare}s after the war.
e.zh: 战争结束后，他们把刀剑铸成了犁头。

e.en: The rusty {ploughshare} hung above the fireplace.
e.zh: 那把生锈的犁头挂在壁炉上方。

e.en: A small {plover} darted along the wet sand.
e.zh: 一只小鸻鸟沿着湿沙快速跑动。

e.en: Conservationists are protecting the endangered {plover}.
e.zh: 环保人士正在保护这种濒危的鸻鸟。

plow.t:
n. 犁
v. 犁地（plough 美式）

e.en: They used a tractor to {plow} the snowy roads.
e.zh: 他们用拖拉机清理积雪覆盖的道路。

e.en: My grandfather still owns a horse-drawn {plow}.
e.zh: 我祖父至今还留着一架马拉犁。

e.en: The truck {plowed} into a row of parked cars.
e.zh: 那辆卡车撞进了一排停着的车里。

e.en: She {plowed} through her email after vacation.
e.zh: 度假回来后她费力地处理完了所有邮件。

e.en: Snow {plowing} crews worked all night on the highway.
e.zh: 扫雪车队在高速公路上工作了一整夜。

e.en: The farmer is {plowing} the field for spring planting.
e.zh: 农夫正在为春播翻耕田地。

e.en: The {plowman} rose before dawn to work the fields.
e.zh: 农夫天还没亮就起来下田干活。

e.en: An old painting depicted a weary {plowman} at sunset.
e.zh: 一幅老画描绘了夕阳下疲惫的农夫。

e.en: The blacksmith forged a sturdy iron {plowshare}.
e.zh: 铁匠打造了一只结实的铁犁头。

e.en: Nations promised to turn weapons into {plowshare}s.
e.zh: 各国承诺把武器化作犁头。

ploy.t:
n. 策略，手段
n. 花招

e.en: Free shipping is just a {ploy} to boost sales.
e.zh: 免运费不过是促销的一种手段。

e.en: His sudden illness was a clever {ploy} to skip class.
e.zh: 他突然生病只是逃课的小伎俩。

e.en: Marketing {ploys} like flash sales work surprisingly well.
e.zh: 限时抢购这类营销手段效果出奇地好。

e.en: Kids invent endless {ploys} to delay bedtime.
e.zh: 小孩有无数花招来拖延睡觉时间。

pluck.t:
v. 拔，摘
n. 勇气

e.en: She had to {pluck} up the courage to apologize.
e.zh: 她得鼓起勇气去道歉。

e.en: It takes real {pluck} to start your own company.
e.zh: 自己创业需要真正的勇气。

e.en: He {plucked} a ripe apple from the tree.
e.zh: 他从树上摘下了一个熟透的苹果。

e.en: The director {plucked} her from obscurity for the role.
e.zh: 导演把她从无名之辈中挑出来出演这个角色。

e.en: She sat on the porch {plucking} her guitar strings.
e.zh: 她坐在门廊上拨弄着吉他弦。

e.en: {Plucking} weeds from the garden takes all afternoon.
e.zh: 把花园里的杂草拔完得花一下午。

e.en: He {plucks} his eyebrows before every video shoot.
e.zh: 他每次拍视频前都会修一下眉毛。

e.en: The harpist gently {plucks} each string in turn.
e.zh: 竖琴手轻柔地依次拨动每一根琴弦。

e.en: The {plucky} kitten faced down a much larger dog.
e.zh: 那只勇敢的小猫毫不畏惧地面对一只大得多的狗。

e.en: A {plucky} startup is challenging the industry giants.
e.zh: 一家有胆识的初创公司正在挑战行业巨头。

plug.t:
n. 插头；塞子
v. 堵上；推广

e.en: Don't forget to {plug} your phone in tonight.
e.zh: 今晚别忘了给手机充电。

e.en: She gave her new book a quick {plug} on the show.
e.zh: 她在节目里顺势宣传了一下自己的新书。

e.en: I {plugged} the laptop in before the battery died.
e.zh: 我赶在电池没电前把笔记本插上了电源。

e.en: The host {plugged} her podcast at the end of the interview.
e.zh: 主持人在采访末尾推荐了她的播客。

plugger.t: n. 填塞者；卖力推销的人

e.en: He works as a song {plugger} for a record label.
e.zh: 他在一家唱片公司当歌曲推介员。

e.en: The radio {plugger} pitched the new single to DJs.
e.zh: 那位电台推广员向DJ们推销这首新单曲。

plugging.t: v. 堵塞；大力宣传（进行式）

e.en: She kept {plugging} her new app on every podcast.
e.zh: 她在每个播客上都不断推广她的新应用。

e.en: The engineers are {plugging} security holes in the system.
e.zh: 工程师们正在堵上系统中的安全漏洞。

e.en: My ring slipped down the {plughole} this morning.
e.zh: 我的戒指今早顺着排水孔滑下去了。

e.en: All my savings went straight down the {plughole}.
e.zh: 我所有的积蓄都打了水漂。

plugs.t:
n. 插头（复数）
v. 堵住（第三人称）

e.en: European {plugs} won't fit American outlets without an adapter.
e.zh: 欧式插头不用转换器没法插进美式插座。

e.en: The influencer {plugs} her sponsor in every video.
e.zh: 那位网红在每条视频里都帮赞助商打广告。

plum.t:
n. 李子，梅子
adj. 令人满意的（工作）

e.en: She bit into a juicy purple {plum}.
e.zh: 她咬了一口多汁的紫色李子。

e.en: He landed a {plum} job at a top tech company.
e.zh: 他在一家顶级科技公司谋到了一份美差。

e.en: The peacock spread its dazzling {plumage} for the female.
e.zh: 孔雀向雌孔雀展开了它绚丽的羽毛。

e.en: Male birds often have brighter {plumage} than females.
e.zh: 雄鸟的羽毛通常比雌鸟更鲜艳。

e.en: Tropical birds display some of nature's most vivid {plumages}.
e.zh: 热带鸟类拥有自然界最鲜艳的羽毛。

e.en: Their winter and summer {plumages} look completely different.
e.zh: 它们冬季和夏季的羽毛看起来完全不同。

plumb.t:
n. 铅锤
v. 探究；接通管道

e.en: Make sure the wall is perfectly {plumb} before tiling.
e.zh: 贴瓷砖前要确保墙面完全垂直。

e.en: Scientists are trying to {plumb} the depths of the ocean.
e.zh: 科学家们正试图探测海洋的深度。

e.en: Blue {plumbago} flowers brightened the corner of the garden.
e.zh: 蓝色的蓝雪花点亮了花园的一角。

e.en: She planted {plumbago} along the sunny garden wall.
e.zh: 她沿着向阳的院墙种了一排蓝雪花。

e.en: We called a {plumber} to fix the leaking sink.
e.zh: 我们叫了水管工来修漏水的水槽。

e.en: A good {plumber} can be hard to find on weekends.
e.zh: 周末想找到一位靠谱的水管工并不容易。

e.en: Local {plumbers} are booked solid after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后，当地的水管工预约都排满了。

e.en: Two {plumbers} arrived to install the new water heater.
e.zh: 两名水管工来安装新的热水器。

plumbing.t: n. 管道系统；管道工程

e.en: The old house needs new {plumbing} throughout.
e.zh: 这栋老房子的水管需要全部更换。

e.en: He's {plumbing} the depths of medieval philosophy.
e.zh: 他正在深入钻研中世纪哲学。

plumbings.t: n. 管道系统（复数，罕用）

e.en: The two buildings have completely different {plumbings} systems.
e.zh: 这两栋楼的水管系统完全不同。

e.en: Old {plumbings} in heritage homes often need careful repair.
e.zh: 老宅里的旧管道往往需要小心修缮。

plume.t:
n. 羽毛；烟柱
v. 整理羽毛

e.en: A thick {plume} of smoke rose from the chimney.
e.zh: 一股浓烟从烟囱里升起。

e.en: Her hat was decorated with a single white {plume}.
e.zh: 她的帽子上装饰着一根白色的羽毛。

e.en: Officers wore {plumed} helmets in the parade.
e.zh: 军官们在游行中戴着插有羽饰的头盔。

e.en: A {plumed} bird strutted across the lawn.
e.zh: 一只羽毛丰盛的鸟在草坪上昂首走过。

plumes.t:
n. 羽毛；烟柱
v. 喷出

e.en: Volcanic {plumes} drifted high into the atmosphere.
e.zh: 火山喷出的烟柱飘向高空大气层。

e.en: The dancer's costume was covered in ostrich {plumes}.
e.zh: 舞者的服装上缀满了鸵鸟羽毛。

e.en: Mr. {Plummer} taught history at our school for decades.
e.zh: 普卢默先生在我们学校教了几十年历史。

e.en: Christopher {Plummer} won an Oscar in his eighties.
e.zh: 克里斯托弗·普卢默八十多岁时获得了奥斯卡奖。

plummet.t:
v. 暴跌；垂直下落
n. 铅锤

e.en: Stock prices began to {plummet} after the announcement.
e.zh: 消息一出，股价开始暴跌。

e.en: Temperatures {plummet} below zero every January here.
e.zh: 这里每年一月气温都会骤降到零度以下。

plummeting.t: v. 暴跌（plummet 现在分词）

e.en: Sales have been {plummeting} since the new competitor launched.
e.zh: 自从新对手推出产品后，销售额一直在暴跌。

e.en: The skydiver enjoyed {plummeting} toward the earth.
e.zh: 那名跳伞员享受着朝地面急速下坠的感觉。

plummets.t: v. 暴跌（plummet 第三人称单数）

e.en: The stock {plummets} whenever earnings disappoint investors.
e.zh: 每当财报令投资者失望，股价就会暴跌。

e.en: Temperature {plummets} below freezing on winter nights here.
e.zh: 这里冬夜的气温会骤降到零度以下。

e.en: Bitcoin {plummetted} forty percent in a single week.
e.zh: 比特币在一周内暴跌了百分之四十。

e.en: Her confidence {plummetted} after the harsh public criticism.
e.zh: 经历严厉的公开批评后，她的信心一落千丈。

plummetting.t: v. 暴跌（plummet 现在分词）

e.en: App downloads are {plummetting} since the privacy scandal broke.
e.zh: 自隐私丑闻曝光后，应用下载量正急剧下滑。

e.en: With ratings {plummetting}, the network cancelled the show.
e.zh: 由于收视率暴跌，电视台取消了该节目。

plummy.t: adj. (嗓音) 圆润做作；李子似的

e.en: The narrator's {plummy} accent suits classic British dramas.
e.zh: 叙述者那种上流口音很适合经典英剧。

e.en: He landed a {plummy} role in the new film.
e.zh: 他在新片里拿到了一个肥差角色。

plump.t:
adj. 丰满的；圆润的
v. 使饱满

e.en: Add a few {plump} blueberries to your morning oatmeal.
e.zh: 在早餐燕麦里加几颗饱满的蓝莓。

e.en: The {plump} cat napped lazily on the windowsill.
e.zh: 那只胖乎乎的猫懒洋洋地在窗台上打盹。

e.en: The {plumpness} of the dumplings means they're full of filling.
e.zh: 饺子鼓鼓的说明里面馅料很足。

e.en: Moisturizers can restore some {plumpness} to dry skin.
e.zh: 保湿霜能让干燥的皮肤重新变得饱满。

e.en: The {plums} at the farmers' market are perfectly ripe.
e.zh: 农贸市场的李子熟得正好。

e.en: She baked a tart with fresh red {plums}.
e.zh: 她用新鲜的红李子烤了个挞。

plunder.t:
v. 掠夺；抢劫
n. 赃物

e.en: Pirates would {plunder} merchant ships along the coast.
e.zh: 海盗常在沿海一带洗劫商船。

e.en: The museum returned artifacts taken as wartime {plunder}.
e.zh: 博物馆归还了战时被掠夺的文物。

e.en: Invaders {plundered} the ancient temple of its treasures.
e.zh: 侵略者把那座古庙的珍宝洗劫一空。

e.en: Hackers {plundered} millions of user records from the database.
e.zh: 黑客从数据库里盗走了数百万条用户记录。

e.en: History remembers him as a ruthless {plunderer} of cities.
e.zh: 历史记载他是一个无情劫掠城池的强盗。

e.en: The corrupt official was branded a {plunderer} of public funds.
e.zh: 那名贪官被斥为侵吞公款的蛀虫。

plundering.t:
v. 掠夺（现在分词）
n. 抢劫

e.en: The army spent weeks {plundering} villages along the river.
e.zh: 军队花了数周沿河劫掠村庄。

e.en: Critics accuse the company of {plundering} natural resources.
e.zh: 批评者指责该公司在掠夺自然资源。

e.en: Note: {plung} is a misspelling of plunge in most cases.
e.zh: 注意：plung 在多数情况下是 plunge 的拼写错误。

e.en: Spell-checkers usually flag {plung} and suggest plunge instead.
e.zh: 拼写检查通常会标出 plung 并建议改为 plunge。

plunge.t:
v. 跳入；骤降
n. 跳水；暴跌

e.en: Take the {plunge} and finally launch your own startup.
e.zh: 鼓起勇气，把自己的创业项目正式开干吧。

e.en: Stocks could {plunge} if the central bank raises rates.
e.zh: 如果央行加息，股市可能会大跌。

e.en: The city {plunged} into darkness during the massive blackout.
e.zh: 大停电期间，整座城市陷入了黑暗。

e.en: She {plunged} into the cold lake without hesitation.
e.zh: 她毫不犹豫地纵身跳入冰冷的湖水。

plunger.t: n. 活塞；通马桶的皮搋子

e.en: Every bathroom should keep a {plunger} under the sink.
e.zh: 每个卫生间都该在水槽下放一个马桶搋子。

e.en: Press the syringe {plunger} slowly to avoid air bubbles.
e.zh: 慢慢推注射器的活塞，避免产生气泡。

plunges.t: v. 跳入；骤降（第三人称单数）

e.en: The roller coaster {plunges} sharply right after the first turn.
e.zh: 过山车在第一个转弯后会陡然俯冲。

e.en: He {plunges} into work to distract himself from grief.
e.zh: 他埋头工作，借此让自己从悲伤中转移注意力。

plunging.t:
v. 跳入；骤降
adj. 低胸的

e.en: She wore a dress with a {plunging} neckline to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿了一条领口很低的礼服去参加盛会。

e.en: Oil prices keep {plunging} amid weakening global demand.
e.zh: 在全球需求疲软之下，油价持续暴跌。

e.en: Just {plunk} your bag down anywhere and relax.
e.zh: 包随便往哪儿一扔，放松一下吧。

e.en: He'd {plunk} a few coins into the busker's hat.
e.zh: 他会往街头艺人帽子里随手扔几枚硬币。

pluperfect.t:
n. 过去完成时
adj. 过去完成的

e.en: Use the {pluperfect} tense to describe an earlier past action.
e.zh: 用过去完成时来描述更早发生的过去动作。

e.en: In English, the {pluperfect} is formed with had plus past participle.
e.zh: 英语的过去完成时由 had 加过去分词构成。

plural.t:
adj. 复数的
n. 复数形式

e.en: The {plural} of child is children, not childs.
e.zh: child 的复数是 children，而不是 childs。

e.en: Grammar settings should match the {plural} form to the subject.
e.zh: 语法设置应让复数形式与主语保持一致。

e.en: Healthy democracies depend on respect for cultural {pluralism}.
e.zh: 健康的民主制度有赖于对文化多元主义的尊重。

e.en: The constitution enshrines religious {pluralism} as a core value.
e.zh: 宪法将宗教多元化奉为核心价值。

pluralist.t:
n. 多元论者
adj. 多元的

e.en: He defends a {pluralist} vision of modern society.
e.zh: 他坚持一种多元化的现代社会理念。

e.en: The party calls itself {pluralist} and welcomes diverse views.
e.zh: 该党自称多元主义政党，欢迎不同观点。

e.en: Singapore prides itself on being a {pluralistic} society.
e.zh: 新加坡以自己是一个多元社会而自豪。

e.en: A {pluralistic} media landscape strengthens public debate.
e.zh: 多元化的媒体生态会让公共讨论更加充分。

e.en: The candidate won by a {plurality}, not a majority.
e.zh: 那位候选人赢得的是相对多数，而非过半数。

e.en: The decision reflects a {plurality} of opinions on the board.
e.zh: 这项决定反映了董事会内多数派的意见。

e.en: English {pluralization} rules have many irregular exceptions.
e.zh: 英语复数变化规则有很多不规则的例外。

e.en: The library handles {pluralization} for over forty languages.
e.zh: 该库支持四十多种语言的复数处理。

e.en: Some nouns have irregular {plurals} like mouse and mice.
e.zh: 有些名词复数不规则，比如 mouse 和 mice。

e.en: Translation tools often mishandle {plurals} in Slavic languages.
e.zh: 翻译工具常常无法正确处理斯拉夫语的复数。

plus.t:
prep. 加上
adj. 正的；额外的

e.en: Two {plus} two equals four in any number system.
e.zh: 在任何数制中，二加二都等于四。

e.en: The job pays well, {plus} it offers great benefits.
e.zh: 这份工作薪水不错，再加上福利也很好。

e.en: Working from home has many {pluses} for young parents.
e.zh: 对年轻父母来说，居家办公有很多好处。

e.en: Weigh the {pluses} and minuses before signing the contract.
e.zh: 签合同前要权衡利弊。

plush.t:
adj. 豪华的
n. 长毛绒

e.en: The hotel lobby was decorated with {plush} velvet sofas.
e.zh: 酒店大堂里摆着柔软的天鹅绒沙发。

e.en: My niece collects {plush} toys shaped like cartoon animals.
e.zh: 我侄女在收集卡通动物造型的毛绒玩具。

plutarch.t: n. 普鲁塔克（古希腊作家）

e.en: Shakespeare borrowed many plots from {Plutarch}'s ancient biographies.
e.zh: 莎士比亚从普鲁塔克的古代传记里借用了不少情节。

e.en: Students still read {Plutarch} to study Greek and Roman heroes.
e.zh: 学生们至今仍读普鲁塔克来研究希腊罗马的英雄。

e.en: Astronomers reclassified {Pluto} as a dwarf planet in 2006.
e.zh: 天文学家在 2006 年把冥王星重新归为矮行星。

e.en: The New Horizons probe sent stunning photos of {Pluto}.
e.zh: 新视野号探测器传回了冥王星的惊人照片。

plutocracy.t: n. 财阀统治；金权政治

e.en: Critics warn the country is sliding toward a {plutocracy}.
e.zh: 批评者警告该国正在滑向金权统治。

e.en: Tax loopholes for billionaires entrench {plutocracy} over time.
e.zh: 针对亿万富翁的税收漏洞会逐渐固化金权政治。

e.en: The senator was attacked as an out-of-touch {plutocrat}.
e.zh: 那位参议员被抨击为脱离群众的富豪政客。

e.en: Every {plutocrat} on the panel owns a private jet.
e.zh: 小组里的每位富豪都有私人飞机。

e.en: A handful of {plutocrats} now control most global media.
e.zh: 如今全球大部分媒体都掌握在少数富豪手中。

e.en: Reformers want to limit the influence of tech {plutocrats}.
e.zh: 改革派希望限制科技富豪们的影响力。

e.en: Reactor-grade {plutonium} is tightly regulated by international treaties.
e.zh: 反应堆级钚受到国际条约的严格管控。

e.en: The lab safely stores small samples of {plutonium}.
e.zh: 实验室安全存放着少量钚样品。

ply.t:
n. 层；厚度
v. 来回往返；兜售

e.en: Ferries {ply} the route between the two islands daily.
e.zh: 渡轮每天往返于两座岛屿之间。

e.en: This box is made of three-{ply} corrugated cardboard.
e.zh: 这个箱子是三层瓦楞纸板做的。

e.en: The pilgrims landed near {Plymouth} in November 1620.
e.zh: 清教徒于 1620 年 11 月在普利茅斯附近登陆。

e.en: {Plymouth} is a major port city on England's south coast.
e.zh: 普利茅斯是英格兰南岸的一座重要港口城市。

plyometrics.t: n. 增强式训练；爆发力训练

e.en: Coaches use {plyometrics} to develop explosive jumping power.
e.zh: 教练用增强式训练来培养爆发性的弹跳力。

e.en: Add box jumps and burpees if you enjoy {plyometrics}.
e.zh: 如果你喜欢增强式训练，可以加入跳箱和波比跳。

e.en: He boarded up the windows with sheets of {plywood}.
e.zh: 他用一块块胶合板把窗户钉了起来。

e.en: The shelves are built from cheap {plywood} and pine.
e.zh: 这些架子是用便宜的胶合板和松木做的。

pmr.t: abbr. 渐进式肌肉放松；绩效管理评估

e.en: Therapists teach {PMR} to help anxious clients relax their bodies.
e.zh: 治疗师会教渐进式肌肉放松来帮助焦虑者放松身体。

e.en: A short {PMR} session before bed often improves sleep quality.
e.zh: 睡前做一段简短的渐进式肌肉放松，往往能改善睡眠。

e.en: Excel's {PMT} function calculates the periodic payment for a loan.
e.zh: Excel 的 PMT 函数用来计算贷款的每期还款额。

e.en: She blamed her bad mood on {PMT} that morning.
e.zh: 她把那天早上的坏脾气归咎于经前综合征。

pnc.t: abbr. PNC 金融集团（美国银行）

e.en: I opened a checking account at {PNC} last week.
e.zh: 我上周在匹兹堡国民银行开了个支票账户。

e.en: The Pittsburgh Pirates play their home games at {PNC} Park.
e.zh: 匹兹堡海盗队在 PNC 公园进行主场比赛。

e.en: The factory uses {pneumatic} drills to break up concrete.
e.zh: 工厂使用气动钻来破开混凝土。

e.en: Office chairs rely on a {pneumatic} cylinder for height adjustment.
e.zh: 办公椅靠气压杆来调节高度。

pneumatically.t: adv. 以气动方式；靠压缩空气

e.en: The doors open {pneumatically} whenever a passenger steps near.
e.zh: 只要有乘客靠近，车门就会气动开启。

e.en: Robotic arms in the plant are {pneumatically} powered.
e.zh: 工厂里的机械臂是用气压驱动的。

pneumatological.t: adj. 圣灵论的；气体学的

e.en: His thesis takes a {pneumatological} approach to early Christian texts.
e.zh: 他的论文以圣灵论的视角研究早期基督教文献。

e.en: The seminar explored {pneumatological} themes in modern theology.
e.zh: 研讨会探讨了现代神学中的圣灵论主题。

e.en: {Pneumatology} is the branch of theology concerned with the Holy Spirit.
e.zh: 圣灵论是神学中研究圣灵的分支。

e.en: Her course on {pneumatology} drew students from many denominations.
e.zh: 她的圣灵论课程吸引了来自不同教派的学生。

e.en: Doctors recommend the {pneumococcal} vaccine for older adults.
e.zh: 医生建议年长者接种肺炎球菌疫苗。

e.en: A {pneumococcal} infection can quickly turn into severe pneumonia.
e.zh: 肺炎球菌感染可能迅速发展为重症肺炎。

e.en: {Pneumocystis} pneumonia mainly affects people with weakened immune systems.
e.zh: 肺孢子菌肺炎主要影响免疫力低下的人群。

e.en: Doctors prescribed antibiotics targeting {pneumocystis} for the AIDS patient.
e.zh: 医生给那位艾滋病患者开了针对肺孢子菌的抗生素。

e.en: Grandma was hospitalized for two weeks with severe {pneumonia}.
e.zh: 奶奶因重症肺炎住了两周院。

e.en: Annual flu shots help reduce the risk of {pneumonia}.
e.zh: 每年接种流感疫苗有助于降低肺炎的风险。

e.en: Different bacterial {pneumonias} require different antibiotic treatments.
e.zh: 不同的细菌性肺炎需要不同的抗生素治疗。

e.en: The textbook classifies {pneumonias} by their causative organism.
e.zh: 教材按病原体对各种肺炎进行了分类。

e.en: The doctor described the {pneumonic} symptoms in detail.
e.zh: 医生详细描述了肺部相关的症状。

e.en: Severe {pneumonic} infections can require hospital care.
e.zh: 严重的肺部感染可能需要住院治疗。

e.en: The patient developed a {pneumothorax} after the chest injury.
e.zh: 该患者在胸部受伤后出现了气胸。

e.en: A small {pneumothorax} sometimes heals without surgery.
e.zh: 轻微的气胸有时无需手术即可自愈。

png.t: n. PNG 图片格式；巴布亚新几内亚缩写

e.en: Save the logo as a {png} to keep the transparent background.
e.zh: 把这个标志存成 PNG，以保留透明背景。

e.en: This icon is a {png} file under twenty kilobytes.
e.zh: 这个图标是一个不到二十KB的 PNG 文件。

e.en: The circuit uses a {pnp} transistor as a switch.
e.zh: 该电路用一个 PNP 三极管作开关。

e.en: He replaced the broken {pnp} with a fresh one.
e.zh: 他用一个新的 PNP 管替换了坏掉的那个。

e.en: I usually {poach} two eggs for breakfast.
e.zh: 我早餐通常会煮两个水波蛋。

e.en: Big firms often {poach} engineers from smaller startups.
e.zh: 大公司经常从小创业公司挖工程师。

poached.t:
adj. 水煮的
v. 偷猎（过去式）

e.en: She ordered toast with a {poached} egg on top.
e.zh: 她点了一份吐司，上面放了一个水波蛋。

e.en: The rival company {poached} our lead designer last week.
e.zh: 竞争对手公司上周挖走了我们的首席设计师。

e.en: Rangers caught the {poacher} hunting elephants illegally.
e.zh: 巡护员抓到了那个非法猎杀大象的偷猎者。

e.en: A clever {poacher} can ruin a whole recruiting season.
e.zh: 一个高明的挖人者能毁掉整个招聘季。

poaching.t:
n. 偷猎行为
v. 水煮

e.en: {Poaching} threatens the survival of many rare species.
e.zh: 偷猎威胁着许多稀有物种的生存。

e.en: He's good at {poaching} salmon in white wine.
e.zh: 他很擅长用白葡萄酒来低温煮三文鱼。

e.en: A small {pock} remained on his cheek after the illness.
e.zh: 病好后，他脸颊上还留着一个小痘疤。

e.en: Old craters {pock} the surface of the moon.
e.zh: 古老的陨石坑布满了月球表面。

e.en: The dirt road was {pocked} with deep potholes.
e.zh: 那条土路上布满了深深的坑洼。

e.en: Acne had {pocked} his face during his teenage years.
e.zh: 青春期的痘痘在他脸上留下了不少疤痕。

pocket.t:
n. 口袋
v. 把…装进口袋

e.en: He pulled a crumpled note from his {pocket}.
e.zh: 他从口袋里掏出一张皱巴巴的纸条。

e.en: This phone fits easily into a jeans {pocket}.
e.zh: 这部手机能轻松放进牛仔裤的口袋里。

e.en: Rising rents are hurting every family's {pocketbook}.
e.zh: 不断上涨的房租正在影响每个家庭的钱包。

e.en: She kept her ID inside a small leather {pocketbook}.
e.zh: 她把身份证放在一个小皮夹里。

e.en: The kid carried a {pocketful} of marbles to school.
e.zh: 那个小孩带了满满一口袋弹珠去上学。

e.en: He earned a {pocketful} of cash from the side gig.
e.zh: 他靠那份兼职赚了一笔不小的现金。

e.en: He sliced the apple with a small {pocketknife}.
e.zh: 他用一把小折刀把苹果切开了。

e.en: Always carry a {pocketknife} when you go camping.
e.zh: 去露营时一定要带一把折叠刀。

e.en: Check your {pockets} before throwing the jeans in the wash.
e.zh: 把牛仔裤丢进洗衣机前先检查一下口袋。

e.en: There are still {pockets} of fog along the coast.
e.zh: 沿海一带仍有零星的雾区。

pocklington.t: n. 波克灵顿（英国地名）

e.en: They drove through {Pocklington} on the way to York.
e.zh: 他们去约克的路上经过了波克灵顿镇。

e.en: {Pocklington} has a small but well-known grammar school.
e.zh: 波克灵顿有一所规模不大却颇有名气的文法学校。

e.en: A faint {pockmark} remained on her left cheek.
e.zh: 她左脸颊上留着一个淡淡的痘疤。

e.en: Bullet holes left every {pockmark} on the old wall.
e.zh: 那面旧墙上每一个凹痕都是子弹打出来的。

pockmarked.t: adj. 布满麻点或凹痕的

e.en: His face was lightly {pockmarked} from childhood acne.
e.zh: 他的脸上有些童年时长痘留下的浅浅疤痕。

e.en: Shells had {pockmarked} the village walls.
e.zh: 炮弹在村子的墙上留下了一个个弹坑。

e.en: The score is marked {poco} slower in this passage.
e.zh: 乐谱在这一段标注了稍微放慢的速度。

e.en: Play this section {poco} louder than the previous one.
e.zh: 这一段要比上一段演奏得稍微响一点。

pod.t: n. 豆荚；分离舱；一群（鲸）

e.en: A {pod} of dolphins followed the boat for hours.
e.zh: 一群海豚跟着船游了好几个小时。

e.en: Pop a coffee {pod} into the machine and press start.
e.zh: 把咖啡胶囊放进机器，然后按启动键。

podcast.t:
n. 播客
v. 发布播客

e.en: I listen to a tech {podcast} during my commute.
e.zh: 我通勤时会听一档科技类播客。

e.en: Their new {podcast} hit the top charts in a week.
e.zh: 他们的新播客一周内就冲上了排行榜首。

e.en: The baby grabbed the spoon with her {podgy} fingers.
e.zh: 宝宝用她胖乎乎的小手指抓住了勺子。

e.en: He's grown a bit {podgy} since starting the desk job.
e.zh: 他自从开始坐办公室就长胖了一点。

e.en: She booked a {podiatric} appointment for her sore heel.
e.zh: 她为脚跟疼痛预约了一次足科门诊。

e.en: The clinic offers full {podiatric} care for diabetics.
e.zh: 这家诊所为糖尿病患者提供全面的足部护理。

e.en: My {podiatrist} suggested better arch support in my shoes.
e.zh: 我的足科医生建议我穿足弓支撑更好的鞋子。

e.en: Runners often visit a {podiatrist} for nagging foot pain.
e.zh: 跑者常因长期脚痛去看足科医生。

e.en: She studied {podiatry} for four years after college.
e.zh: 她大学毕业后又读了四年足病学。

e.en: Modern {podiatry} can treat almost any foot problem.
e.zh: 现代足病学几乎可以治疗任何足部问题。

e.en: The speaker stepped up to the {podium} and smiled.
e.zh: 演讲者走上讲台，露出了微笑。

e.en: She finished third and stood proudly on the {podium}.
e.zh: 她拿了第三名，自豪地站上了领奖台。

e.en: He wrote a short {poem} for her birthday card.
e.zh: 他在生日卡上为她写了一首短诗。

e.en: This {poem} is taught in nearly every high school.
e.zh: 几乎每所高中都会教这首诗。

e.en: Her {poems} often deal with loss and memory.
e.zh: 她的诗作经常围绕失去与记忆展开。

e.en: He published a small book of love {poems}.
e.zh: 他出版了一本小小的情诗集。

e.en: The {poet} read three new pieces at the bookshop.
e.zh: 那位诗人在书店朗读了三首新作。

e.en: She's both a novelist and a celebrated {poet}.
e.zh: 她既是小说家，也是一位备受赞誉的诗人。

e.en: The Victorian {poetess} wrote mostly about nature.
e.zh: 那位维多利亚时代的女诗人主要写自然题材。

e.en: A young {poetess} won the local writing prize.
e.zh: 一位年轻的女诗人获得了当地的写作奖。

e.en: The anthology features ten famous Tang dynasty {poetesses}.
e.zh: 这本选集收录了十位著名的唐代女诗人。

e.en: Several {poetesses} read their work at the festival.
e.zh: 几位女诗人在艺术节上朗诵了自己的作品。

e.en: His speech had a strangely {poetic} rhythm to it.
e.zh: 他的演讲带着一种奇妙的诗意节奏。

e.en: The film captures a {poetic} view of country life.
e.zh: 这部电影呈现了乡村生活的诗意画面。

e.en: The novel is full of {poetical} descriptions of the sea.
e.zh: 这部小说里满是关于大海的诗意描写。

e.en: His letters reveal a quiet, {poetical} mind.
e.zh: 他的信件流露出一种内敛而富有诗意的心灵。

e.en: She {poetically} described the autumn light over the lake.
e.zh: 她诗意地描绘了湖面上的秋日阳光。

e.en: The chef talks {poetically} about every ingredient.
e.zh: 那位主厨谈起每一种食材都满怀诗意。

e.en: The class focuses on the {poetics} of modern Chinese cinema.
e.zh: 这门课重点讨论中国现代电影的诗学。

e.en: Aristotle's {poetics} still influences storytelling today.
e.zh: 亚里士多德的《诗学》至今仍影响着叙事艺术。

e.en: She fell in love with {poetry} during high school.
e.zh: 她在高中时爱上了诗歌。

e.en: His goals on the field are pure {poetry}.
e.zh: 他在球场上的进球简直如诗一般。

e.en: Several young {poets} read at the open mic night.
e.zh: 好几位年轻诗人在开放麦之夜朗诵了作品。

e.en: Tang dynasty {poets} are still beloved across China.
e.zh: 唐代诗人在中国至今仍深受喜爱。

pogo.t:
n. 弹簧单高跷
v. 蹦跳

e.en: The kid bounced down the street on a {pogo} stick.
e.zh: 那个孩子踩着弹簧高跷在街上一路蹦跶。

e.en: Fans began to {pogo} as the band hit the chorus.
e.zh: 乐队进入副歌时，粉丝们开始原地蹦跳。

e.en: Many families fled the village after the {pogrom}.
e.zh: 那场迫害之后，许多家庭逃离了村庄。

e.en: Historians still debate who organized the 1903 {pogrom}.
e.zh: 史学家至今仍在争论 1903 年那场屠犹事件由谁组织。

e.en: The {Pogues} mixed punk energy with traditional Irish music.
e.zh: Pogues 乐队把朋克的冲劲与传统爱尔兰音乐融在了一起。

e.en: Every Christmas I replay an old {Pogues} song.
e.zh: 每年圣诞我都会重播一首 Pogues 乐队的老歌。

e.en: The film's ending has a quiet, lasting {poignancy}.
e.zh: 这部电影的结尾有一种安静而持久的伤感。

e.en: Her letters gain {poignancy} when read in order.
e.zh: 她的信按顺序读起来更显伤感动人。

polarizing.t:
adj. 引起两极分化的
v. 使极化

e.en: He's a {polarizing} figure—people either love or hate him.
e.zh: 他是个极具争议的人物,要么被爱要么被恨。

e.en: A {polarizing} filter makes clouds pop in landscape photos.
e.zh: 偏振滤镜能让风景照里的云朵更突出。

polaroid.t: n. 宝丽来（即时成像相机品牌）

e.en: She still owns the old {Polaroid} camera from her childhood.
e.zh: 她还留着童年时的那台老宝丽来相机。

e.en: He pinned a faded {Polaroid} of his dog on the fridge.
e.zh: 他在冰箱上贴了一张褪色的爱犬宝丽来照片。

pole.t:
n. 杆；柱
n. 极（地球的南北极）

e.en: He planted a flag at the top of the {pole}.
e.zh: 他在杆子顶端插了一面旗帜。

e.en: Explorers reached the South {Pole} after months of travel.
e.zh: 探险家经过数月跋涉到达了南极。

e.en: A wild {polecat} raided the chicken coop last night.
e.zh: 昨晚一只野鸡貂闯入了鸡舍。

e.en: The European {polecat} is an ancestor of the domestic ferret.
e.zh: 欧洲鸡貂是家养雪貂的祖先。

polemic.t: n. 激烈的论战；抨击文章

e.en: Her new book is a fierce {polemic} against social media.
e.zh: 她的新书是一篇猛烈抨击社交媒体的论战之作。

e.en: The article reads more like a {polemic} than journalism.
e.zh: 这篇文章更像是一篇论战檄文,而非新闻报道。

polemical.t: adj. 好辩的；引发争论的

e.en: His essay takes a sharply {polemical} tone throughout.
e.zh: 他的文章自始至终都带着尖锐的论战口吻。

e.en: The professor is known for her {polemical} lectures on ethics.
e.zh: 这位教授以充满争辩色彩的伦理学讲座著称。

polemicist.t: n. 好辩者；擅长论战的人

e.en: He built his career as a fearless online {polemicist}.
e.zh: 他靠着无畏的网络论战写手身份打出了名气。

e.en: The famous {polemicist} debated the senator on live television.
e.zh: 那位著名的论战家在直播节目中与参议员辩论。

e.en: We had grilled {polenta} with mushrooms for dinner last night.
e.zh: 我们昨晚吃了烤玉米糊配蘑菇。

e.en: Creamy {polenta} pairs beautifully with slow-braised beef.
e.zh: 奶香玉米糊和慢炖牛肉是绝配。

poles.t: n. 杆；两极（pole 的复数）

e.en: Workers installed new utility {poles} along the highway.
e.zh: 工人沿着高速公路架设了新的电线杆。

e.en: Their opinions are at opposite {poles} of the debate.
e.zh: 他们的观点处在辩论的两个极端。

police.t:
n. 警察；警方
v. 维持治安

e.en: The {police} arrived within minutes of the emergency call.
e.zh: 接到报警后警察几分钟内就赶到了。

e.en: Volunteer moderators help {police} the online community.
e.zh: 志愿版主帮助维护这个网络社区的秩序。

e.en: A {policeman} stopped the car for speeding on the highway.
e.zh: 一名警察在高速公路上拦下了那辆超速的车。

e.en: My uncle worked as a {policeman} for thirty years.
e.zh: 我叔叔做了三十年的警察。

policemen.t: n. 男警察（policeman 的复数）

e.en: Two {policemen} guarded the entrance to the embassy.
e.zh: 两名警察守卫着大使馆的入口。

e.en: The {policemen} arrived at the scene within minutes.
e.zh: 几分钟内警察就赶到了现场。

polices.t: v. 维持治安；监管（police 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The committee {polices} content uploaded to the platform.
e.zh: 该委员会负责监管上传到平台的内容。

e.en: An independent body {polices} financial reporting standards.
e.zh: 一个独立机构监管财务报告标准。

e.en: A {policewoman} helped the lost child find her parents.
e.zh: 一位女警帮助迷路的小孩找到了父母。

e.en: The {policewoman} took notes while interviewing the witness.
e.zh: 那位女警在询问证人时做着笔录。

policewomen.t: n. 女警察（policewoman 的复数）

e.en: Several {policewomen} were assigned to the protest route.
e.zh: 几名女警被派往抗议路线沿线值勤。

e.en: The {policewomen} on duty checked every visitor's bag.
e.zh: 值班的女警检查了每位访客的包。

policies.t: n. 政策；保单（policy 的复数）

e.en: The company updated its privacy {policies} last week.
e.zh: 该公司上周更新了隐私政策。

e.en: Many countries are rethinking their immigration {policies}.
e.zh: 许多国家正在重新考虑移民政策。

policing.t:
n. 治安管理
v. 监管（police 的现在分词）

e.en: Community {policing} has improved trust in the neighborhood.
e.zh: 社区警务提升了居民对警方的信任。

e.en: Moderators are {policing} the comments for hate speech.
e.zh: 版主正在审查评论区,清理仇恨言论。

policy.t:
n. 政策；方针
n. 保险单

e.en: Please read the refund {policy} before placing your order.
e.zh: 下单前请先阅读退款政策。

e.en: The new {policy} takes effect at the start of next month.
e.zh: 新政策将于下月初生效。

e.en: Every {policyholder} receives an annual statement by email.
e.zh: 每位投保人每年都会收到一份电子邮件对账单。

e.en: The {policyholder} must report any accident within 24 hours.
e.zh: 投保人必须在24小时内报告任何事故。

e.en: Each {policymaker} weighed the cost of the new tax plan.
e.zh: 每位决策者都在权衡新税收方案的成本。

e.en: As a {policymaker}, she focuses on climate regulation.
e.zh: 作为决策者,她专注于气候监管。

e.en: Data plays a growing role in modern {policymaking}.
e.zh: 数据在现代政策制定中的作用越来越大。

e.en: Public input should shape environmental {policymaking}.
e.zh: 公众意见应当影响环境政策的制定。

polio.t: n. 小儿麻痹症；脊髓灰质炎

e.en: Vaccines have nearly eliminated {polio} worldwide.
e.zh: 疫苗已使脊髓灰质炎在全球几近绝迹。

e.en: Her grandfather walked with a limp from childhood {polio}.
e.zh: 她爷爷因童年得过小儿麻痹而走路一瘸一拐。

polioes.t: n. polio 的非标准复数

e.en: Old textbooks rarely use the plural {polioes} for the disease.
e.zh: 旧教科书很少用 polioes 作为这种疾病的复数形式。

e.en: Spell-checkers often flag {polioes} as a misspelled word.
e.zh: 拼写检查器常将 polioes 标记为拼写错误的词。

poliomyelitis.t: n. 脊髓灰质炎；小儿麻痹症

e.en: {Poliomyelitis} once paralyzed thousands of children each year.
e.zh: 脊髓灰质炎曾每年使成千上万的儿童瘫痪。

e.en: Doctors confirmed the outbreak was caused by {poliomyelitis}.
e.zh: 医生确认这次疫情是由脊髓灰质炎引起的。

e.en: Researchers detected {poliovirus} in the city's wastewater samples.
e.zh: 研究人员在该市的污水样本中检测到了脊灰病毒。

e.en: The vaccine teaches the body to fight {poliovirus}.
e.zh: 这种疫苗能让身体学会对抗脊灰病毒。

e.en: Ancient Athens was the most famous Greek {polis}.
e.zh: 古雅典是最著名的希腊城邦。

e.en: Citizens of the {polis} debated laws in the public square.
e.zh: 城邦的公民在广场上辩论法律。

polisario.t: n. 波利萨里奥阵线（西撒哈拉组织）

e.en: The {Polisario} Front has long sought independence for Western Sahara.
e.zh: 波利萨里奥阵线长期寻求西撒哈拉独立。

e.en: Algeria has historically supported the {Polisario} movement.
e.zh: 阿尔及利亚历来支持波利萨里奥运动。

polish.t:
v. 擦亮；润色
n. 光亮剂

e.en: She used a soft cloth to {polish} her leather shoes.
e.zh: 她用软布把皮鞋擦得发亮。

e.en: He needs to {polish} the draft before sending it to clients.
e.zh: 他需要先把草稿润色一下再发给客户。

polished.t:
adj. 优雅的；精致的
v. 抛光（过去式）

e.en: Her presentation was confident and remarkably {polished}.
e.zh: 她的演讲自信而且非常精炼。

e.en: The {polished} marble floor reflected the chandelier above.
e.zh: 抛光的大理石地面映出了头顶的吊灯。

e.en: The floor {polisher} left every tile shining like new.
e.zh: 那台地板抛光机把每一块瓷砖都擦得像新的一样。

e.en: He bought an electric shoe {polisher} for the hallway.
e.zh: 他给玄关买了一台电动擦鞋机。

polishes.t: v. 擦亮（polish 第三人称单数）

e.en: She {polishes} her résumé every time she applies for a job.
e.zh: 每次求职她都会把简历再润色一遍。

e.en: The store stocks several brands of nail {polishes}.
e.zh: 这家店里有好几个牌子的指甲油。

polishing.t:
n. 抛光
v. 擦亮（进行时）

e.en: He spent the morning {polishing} the silverware for dinner.
e.zh: 他上午一直在为晚餐擦拭银器。

e.en: The editor is {polishing} the final chapter of the novel.
e.zh: 编辑正在润色小说的最后一章。

e.en: The {politburo} met in Beijing to discuss economic reforms.
e.zh: 政治局在北京开会讨论经济改革。

e.en: Every major decision had to be approved by the {politburo}.
e.zh: 每项重大决定都必须经过政治局批准。

e.en: The waiter was {polite} even during the busy lunch rush.
e.zh: 即使在繁忙的午餐高峰,服务员也很有礼貌。

e.en: It's {polite} to say thank you when someone helps you.
e.zh: 别人帮助你时说声谢谢是有礼貌的表现。

e.en: She {politely} declined the second slice of cake.
e.zh: 她礼貌地拒绝了第二块蛋糕。

e.en: He {politely} asked the neighbors to lower the music.
e.zh: 他礼貌地请邻居把音乐声调小一点。

e.en: His {politeness} made a strong impression on the interviewers.
e.zh: 他的礼貌给面试官留下了深刻印象。

e.en: A little {politeness} goes a long way in customer service.
e.zh: 在客户服务中,一点礼貌就能起到很大作用。

politenesses.t: n. 礼貌之举（politeness 的复数）

e.en: The diplomat exchanged the usual {politenesses} before talks began.
e.zh: 会谈开始前,这位外交官先寒暄了几句客套话。

e.en: Their email started with the standard corporate {politenesses}.
e.zh: 他们的邮件以一些标准的商务客套话开头。

e.en: The host greeted every guest with old-fashioned {politesse}.
e.zh: 主人以老派的礼仪迎接每一位客人。

e.en: His reply showed more {politesse} than real warmth.
e.zh: 他的回复礼数周到,却谈不上真心。

e.en: It would be {politic} to apologize before the meeting.
e.zh: 在会议前先道个歉是明智之举。

e.en: She gave a {politic} answer that offended no one.
e.zh: 她给出了一个圆滑的回答,没有得罪任何人。

e.en: The country is facing a serious {political} crisis.
e.zh: 该国正面临严重的政治危机。

e.en: He avoids {political} debates at family dinners.
e.zh: 他在家庭聚餐时避免谈论政治话题。

e.en: The remark was {politically} risky just before the election.
e.zh: 这番话在大选前夕在政治上颇为冒险。

e.en: The two countries are {politically} aligned but economically rivals.
e.zh: 两国在政治上立场一致,但在经济上是对手。

e.en: The {politician} promised tax cuts during her campaign.
e.zh: 那位政治人物在竞选时承诺减税。

e.en: Voters want a {politician} who actually listens to them.
e.zh: 选民想要的是真正会倾听民意的政治人物。

politicians.t: n. 政治家（politician 的复数）

e.en: Many voters distrust {politicians} who change positions often.
e.zh: 许多选民不信任立场反复无常的政客。

e.en: Local {politicians} debated the new housing project.
e.zh: 当地政界人士就新住房项目展开了辩论。

politicise.t: v. 使政治化（英式拼法）

e.en: Critics accused the media of trying to {politicise} the tragedy.
e.zh: 批评者指责媒体试图把这场悲剧政治化。

e.en: Don't {politicise} a public health issue like vaccination.
e.zh: 不要把疫苗接种这样的公共卫生问题政治化。

politicised.t: v. 使政治化（politicise 的过去式）

e.en: The court ruling has become deeply {politicised} in the press.
e.zh: 这项法院裁决在媒体上已被严重政治化。

e.en: Education funding shouldn't be so heavily {politicised}.
e.zh: 教育经费不该被如此严重地政治化。

e.en: The {politicization} of science worries many researchers.
e.zh: 科学的政治化让许多研究人员感到担忧。

e.en: He warned against the {politicization} of the central bank.
e.zh: 他警告不要将央行政治化。

e.en: Some commentators try to {politicize} every natural disaster.
e.zh: 一些评论员试图把每场自然灾害都政治化。

e.en: Don't {politicize} a question that's purely scientific.
e.zh: 不要把一个纯科学的问题政治化。

e.en: Climate change has become a heavily {politicized} topic.
e.zh: 气候变化已经成为一个被高度政治化的话题。

e.en: The investigation was {politicized} from the very beginning.
e.zh: 这次调查从一开始就被政治化了。

e.en: He accused his rivals of {politicizing} the relief effort.
e.zh: 他指责对手将救灾行动政治化。

e.en: Avoid {politicizing} routine appointments to the courts.
e.zh: 避免把法院的常规任命政治化。

politicking.t: n. 搞政治活动；拉选票

e.en: The mayor dismissed the criticism as election-season {politicking}.
e.zh: 市长把这些批评斥为选举季的政治作秀。

e.en: There was too much {politicking} and not enough governing.
e.zh: 政治算计太多,真正的治理却太少。

e.en: He's a seasoned {politico} who knows every lobbyist in town.
e.zh: 他是个老练的政客,认识城里每一个说客。

e.en: The young {politico} was eager to make a name for himself.
e.zh: 那位年轻的政客急于为自己扬名。

politics.t:
n. 政治；政治活动
n. 政见，政治立场

e.en: She studies {politics} at university and hopes to run for office.
e.zh: 她在大学学政治学,希望将来竞选公职。

e.en: Office {politics} can make a great job feel exhausting.
e.zh: 办公室政治会让一份好工作变得让人疲惫。

polities.t: n. 政体；政治组织（polity 复数）

e.en: Ancient {polities} often centered around a single fortified city.
e.zh: 古代的政治体常常围绕一座设防的城市建立。

e.en: Historians compare democratic and authoritarian {polities}.
e.zh: 历史学家会比较民主与威权的政治体制。

e.en: A stable {polity} requires both strong laws and public trust.
e.zh: 一个稳定的政治体既需要强有力的法律,也需要民众的信任。

e.en: The book describes Athens as the first democratic {polity}.
e.zh: 这本书把雅典描述为第一个民主政体。

polka.t: n. 波尔卡舞（一种快节奏舞蹈）

e.en: The couple danced a lively {polka} at the wedding reception.
e.zh: 那对夫妇在婚宴上跳了一支轻快的波尔卡舞。

e.en: She wore a red dress with white {polka} dots.
e.zh: 她穿了一条带白色波点的红裙子。

poll.t:
n. 民意调查；投票
v. 对…进行民意调查

e.en: A recent {poll} shows the candidates are nearly tied.
e.zh: 最近一项民调显示两位候选人几乎不相上下。

e.en: Please {poll} the team about the new meeting time.
e.zh: 请就新的会议时间在团队里做个调查。

e.en: He ordered grilled {pollack} with lemon at the seafood restaurant.
e.zh: 他在海鲜餐厅点了柠檬烤青鳕鱼。

e.en: Frozen {pollack} is often used in fish sticks and fillets.
e.zh: 冷冻青鳕鱼常被用来做鱼柳和鱼条。

pollard.t:
n. 截顶修剪过的树
v. 截去树顶

e.en: The gardener will {pollard} the willow trees again this winter.
e.zh: 园丁今年冬天会再次给柳树截顶。

e.en: That old {pollard} oak has stood by the road for centuries.
e.zh: 那棵被截顶的老橡树已在路边屹立了几百年。

pollarded.t: adj. 已截顶修剪的（树木）

e.en: The {pollarded} plane trees lined both sides of the boulevard.
e.zh: 被截顶过的悬铃木整齐地立在大道两侧。

e.en: He {pollarded} the limes to keep them from blocking the windows.
e.zh: 他把椴树截顶,以免它们挡住窗户。

polled.t: v. 已进行民意调查（poll 过去式）

e.en: Researchers {polled} a thousand voters across five states.
e.zh: 研究人员对五个州的一千名选民进行了民意调查。

e.en: Most users {polled} said they preferred the new interface.
e.zh: 接受调查的大多数用户表示更喜欢新界面。

e.en: Bees carry {pollen} from flower to flower all day.
e.zh: 蜜蜂整天把花粉从一朵花带到另一朵花。

e.en: High {pollen} counts make my allergies flare up in spring.
e.zh: 春天花粉浓度高，让我的过敏发作。

e.en: Bees {pollinate} most of the fruit trees in this orchard.
e.zh: 蜜蜂为这片果园里的大多数果树授粉。

e.en: Farmers rent hives to {pollinate} their almond crops.
e.zh: 农民租用蜂箱给杏仁作物授粉。

pollinating.t: v. 正在授粉（pollinate 现在分词）

e.en: The bees were busy {pollinating} the apple blossoms.
e.zh: 蜜蜂正忙着给苹果花授粉。

e.en: Some moths are {pollinating} flowers only at night.
e.zh: 有些飞蛾只在夜间为花朵授粉。

e.en: Cross-{pollination} produces stronger, healthier plants.
e.zh: 异花授粉能培育出更强壮健康的植物。

e.en: Without bees, {pollination} of many crops would collapse.
e.zh: 没有蜜蜂，许多作物的授粉就会崩溃。

e.en: The bee is the world's most important {pollinator}.
e.zh: 蜜蜂是世界上最重要的传粉者。

e.en: We planted wildflowers to attract {pollinator} insects.
e.zh: 我们种了野花来吸引传粉昆虫。

polling.t:
n. 投票；民意调查
v. 轮询（计算机）

e.en: {Polling} stations open at seven in the morning.
e.zh: 投票站早上七点开门。

e.en: The app keeps {polling} the server for new messages.
e.zh: 该应用不断向服务器轮询新消息。

e.en: We had grilled {pollock} with lemon for dinner.
e.zh: 我们晚餐吃了柠檬烤鳕鱼。

e.en: Most fish sticks are made from Alaska {pollock}.
e.zh: 大多数鱼柳都是用阿拉斯加狭鳕做的。

polls.t: n. 民意调查；投票（poll 复数）

e.en: Recent {polls} show the candidate gaining ground.
e.zh: 最近的民调显示这位候选人支持率上升。

e.en: Voters lined up at the {polls} before sunrise.
e.zh: 选民在日出前就在投票站排起了长队。

e.en: The {pollster} called to ask about my voting intentions.
e.zh: 民调员打电话来询问我的投票意向。

e.en: No major {pollster} predicted the surprise result.
e.zh: 没有一家主要民调机构预测到这个意外结果。

e.en: A {polltaker} stopped me outside the supermarket.
e.zh: 一名民调员在超市外拦住了我。

e.en: The {polltaker} recorded answers on a small tablet.
e.zh: 民调员用一台小平板记录答案。

e.en: Carbon monoxide is a dangerous {pollutant} from car exhaust.
e.zh: 一氧化碳是汽车尾气中一种危险的污染物。

e.en: The factory released a toxic {pollutant} into the river.
e.zh: 工厂向河里排放了一种有毒污染物。

e.en: Industrial {pollutants} have damaged the local fish population.
e.zh: 工业污染物已经损害了当地的鱼类种群。

e.en: Air {pollutants} can trigger asthma in young children.
e.zh: 空气污染物会引发儿童哮喘。

e.en: Plastic bottles {pollute} the ocean for hundreds of years.
e.zh: 塑料瓶会污染海洋数百年之久。
