e.en: Diesel trucks {pollute} the air more than gasoline cars.
e.zh: 柴油卡车比汽油车更污染空气。

polluted.t: adj. 被污染的；受污染的

e.en: The river is too {polluted} for swimming or fishing.
e.zh: 这条河污染太严重，无法游泳或钓鱼。

e.en: Beijing's heavily {polluted} air forced schools to close.
e.zh: 北京严重污染的空气迫使学校停课。

e.en: The chemical plant is the city's worst {polluter}.
e.zh: 那家化工厂是这座城市最严重的污染者。

e.en: China remains the world's largest carbon {polluter}.
e.zh: 中国仍然是世界上最大的碳污染国。

pollutes.t: v. 污染（pollute 第三人称单数）

e.en: Burning coal {pollutes} both the air and the water.
e.zh: 燃烧煤炭既污染空气也污染水源。

e.en: Loud traffic noise {pollutes} the quiet neighborhood.
e.zh: 嘈杂的交通噪音污染了这个安静的社区。

polluting.t:
v. 正在污染
adj. 造成污染的

e.en: The factory was fined for {polluting} the local stream.
e.zh: 那家工厂因污染当地溪流而被罚款。

e.en: Old diesel buses are heavily {polluting} the city center.
e.zh: 老旧的柴油公交车严重污染着市中心。

e.en: Air {pollution} in big cities has gotten much worse.
e.zh: 大城市的空气污染已经严重得多了。

e.en: The government promised to reduce plastic {pollution} by half.
e.zh: 政府承诺将塑料污染减半。

e.en: Don't be such a {pollyanna} about the company's problems.
e.zh: 对公司的问题别那么盲目乐观。

e.en: Her {pollyanna} attitude annoys her more realistic colleagues.
e.zh: 她那种盲目乐观的态度让较务实的同事感到烦躁。

e.en: He plays {polo} every weekend at the country club.
e.zh: 他每个周末都在乡村俱乐部打马球。

e.en: She wore a navy {polo} shirt and white shorts.
e.zh: 她穿着深蓝色 polo 衫和白色短裤。

poloes.t: n. polo 的复数（罕用拼写）

e.en: He owns several {poloes} in different colors for work.
e.zh: 他有好几件不同颜色的 polo 衫上班穿。

e.en: The store sells discounted {poloes} every summer.
e.zh: 这家店每年夏天都打折卖 polo 衫。

polonaise.t: n. 波兰舞曲；波兰风长裙

e.en: Chopin's {polonaise} is a favorite at piano recitals.
e.zh: 肖邦的波兰舞曲是钢琴独奏会上的最爱。

e.en: The dancers performed a stately {polonaise} at the ball.
e.zh: 舞者在舞会上跳了一支庄重的波兰舞曲。

e.en: {Polonium} is an extremely rare and radioactive element.
e.zh: 钋是一种极其稀有的放射性元素。

e.en: The spy was reportedly poisoned with {polonium}-210.
e.zh: 据报道，那名间谍是被钋-210 毒杀的。

polonius.t: n. 波洛涅斯（《哈姆雷特》人物）

e.en: {Polonius} hides behind the curtain and is killed by Hamlet.
e.zh: 波洛涅斯躲在帷幕后面，被哈姆雷特杀死。

e.en: Shakespeare wrote {Polonius} as a long-winded old courtier.
e.zh: 莎士比亚把波洛涅斯写成一个啰嗦的老朝臣。

poltergeist.t: n. 制造声响的鬼怪；喧闹鬼

e.en: The family claimed a {poltergeist} was throwing dishes around.
e.zh: 那家人声称有个吵闹鬼在乱扔盘子。

e.en: Strange noises convinced her the house had a {poltergeist}.
e.zh: 奇怪的声响让她相信屋里有个吵闹鬼。

e.en: He called the bully a cowardly {poltroon}.
e.zh: 他骂那个恶霸是个胆小如鼠的懦夫。

e.en: Only a {poltroon} would abandon his friends in danger.
e.zh: 只有懦夫才会在危险中抛弃朋友。

poly.t:
adj. 多的；聚的（前缀）
n. 聚酯；理工学院（口语）

e.en: This shirt is a {poly} blend, so it dries quickly.
e.zh: 这件衬衫是涤纶混纺的，所以干得快。

e.en: He studied at the local {poly} before transferring to university.
e.zh: 他在当地理工学院读过书，后来转去了大学。

polyacrylamide.t: n. 聚丙烯酰胺（高分子材料）

e.en: {Polyacrylamide} gel is widely used to separate proteins in labs.
e.zh: 聚丙烯酰胺凝胶在实验室中广泛用于分离蛋白质。

e.en: Farmers add {polyacrylamide} to soil to reduce water erosion.
e.zh: 农民在土壤中添加聚丙烯酰胺以减少水土流失。

e.en: Nylon is the best-known type of {polyamide} fiber.
e.zh: 尼龙是最知名的一种聚酰胺纤维。

e.en: The jacket lining is made of lightweight {polyamide} fabric.
e.zh: 这件夹克的衬里是用轻质聚酰胺面料做的。

e.en: A few small societies have traditionally been {polyandrous}.
e.zh: 少数小型社会传统上是一妻多夫制的。

e.en: Some bird species are {polyandrous}, with one female mating with several males.
e.zh: 有些鸟类是一雌多雄的，一只雌鸟会与多只雄鸟交配。

e.en: {Polyandry} is still practiced in parts of rural Tibet.
e.zh: 在西藏部分农村地区，一妻多夫制仍在实行。

e.en: Anthropologists study {polyandry} as a rare marriage system.
e.zh: 人类学家把一妻多夫制作为一种罕见的婚姻制度来研究。

polybius.t: n. 波利比乌斯（古希腊历史学家）

e.en: {Polybius} wrote a famous history of the Roman Republic.
e.zh: 波利比乌斯写过一部著名的罗马共和国史。

e.en: The {Polybius} square is an early form of cipher.
e.zh: 波利比乌斯方阵是一种早期的密码形式。

polycarbonate.t: n. 聚碳酸酯（PC 塑料）

e.en: Safety goggles are usually made of tough {polycarbonate} plastic.
e.zh: 安全护目镜通常用坚韧的聚碳酸酯塑料制成。

e.en: My suitcase has a lightweight {polycarbonate} shell.
e.zh: 我的行李箱有一个轻便的聚碳酸酯外壳。

polychaete.t: n. 多毛纲虫；多毛类环节动物

e.en: A {polychaete} worm wriggled out from under the rock.
e.zh: 一条多毛纲虫从石头底下扭动着钻了出来。

e.en: Most {polychaete} species live on the ocean floor.
e.zh: 大多数多毛纲物种生活在海底。

polychlorinated.t: adj. 多氯化的（如多氯联苯）

e.en: {Polychlorinated} biphenyls were banned because of their toxicity.
e.zh: 多氯联苯因其毒性而被禁用。

e.en: Scientists detected {polychlorinated} compounds in the river sediment.
e.zh: 科学家在河流沉积物中检测到了多氯化合物。

e.en: The artist painted a {polychromatic} mural on the wall.
e.zh: 那位艺术家在墙上画了一幅多彩壁画。

e.en: White light is actually {polychromatic}, made of many wavelengths.
e.zh: 白光其实是多色光，由许多波长组成。

polychrome.t:
adj. 多色的
n. 多彩装饰

e.en: The temple is decorated with bright {polychrome} carvings.
e.zh: 这座寺庙装饰着色彩鲜艳的彩绘雕刻。

e.en: Greek statues were originally {polychrome}, not plain white.
e.zh: 希腊雕像原本是彩色的，并不是纯白的。

e.en: The bedsheets are {polycotton}, so they barely wrinkle.
e.zh: 这些床单是涤棉的，几乎不会起皱。

e.en: School uniforms are often made from durable {polycotton} fabric.
e.zh: 校服通常用耐用的涤棉面料制成。

e.en: Most cheap solar panels use {polycrystalline} silicon cells.
e.zh: 大多数廉价太阳能板使用多晶硅电池。

e.en: The metal sample had a fine {polycrystalline} structure.
e.zh: 这块金属样品具有细密的多晶结构。

e.en: Grilled meat can contain harmful {polycyclic} aromatic hydrocarbons.
e.zh: 烤肉中可能含有有害的多环芳烃。

e.en: Many {polycyclic} compounds are known to cause cancer.
e.zh: 许多多环化合物已知会致癌。

e.en: She was diagnosed with {polycystic} ovary syndrome last year.
e.zh: 她去年被诊断出多囊卵巢综合症。

e.en: {Polycystic} kidney disease often runs in families.
e.zh: 多囊肾病往往具有家族遗传性。

polydor.t: n. 宝丽多（唱片公司名）

e.en: The band signed a record deal with {Polydor} in London.
e.zh: 那支乐队在伦敦与宝丽多唱片签了约。

e.en: {Polydor} released some of the biggest pop albums of the seventies.
e.zh: 宝丽多唱片发行了七十年代一些最重要的流行专辑。

e.en: Cheap {polyester} shirts don't breathe well in hot weather.
e.zh: 廉价的涤纶衬衫在热天透气性很差。

e.en: This jacket is fifty percent {polyester} and fifty percent cotton.
e.zh: 这件夹克是百分之五十涤纶和百分之五十棉。

e.en: Most plastic bags are made from thin {polyethylene} film.
e.zh: 大多数塑料袋是用薄聚乙烯薄膜制成的。

e.en: Water pipes today often use durable {polyethylene} instead of metal.
e.zh: 如今的水管常用耐用的聚乙烯而不是金属。

polygamist.t: n. 一夫多妻或一妻多夫者

e.en: The {polygamist} leader was arrested on multiple charges.
e.zh: 那名一夫多妻者首领因多项罪名被捕。

e.en: He openly identifies as a {polygamist} with three wives.
e.zh: 他公开承认自己是有三位妻子的一夫多妻者。

polygamous.t: adj. 多配偶的；一夫多妻的

e.en: Some cultures still allow {polygamous} marriages between one man and several women.
e.zh: 有些文化仍然允许一夫多妻的婚姻。

e.en: Lions live in {polygamous} groups led by a single male.
e.zh: 狮子生活在由一只雄狮领导的一夫多妻群体中。

polygamy.t: n. 多配偶制；一夫多妻

e.en: {Polygamy} is illegal in most Western countries.
e.zh: 一夫多妻制在大多数西方国家是非法的。

e.en: The novel explores the hidden tensions of {polygamy}.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了一夫多妻制中隐藏的紧张关系。

polyglot.t:
adj. 通晓多种语言的
n. 多语种者

e.en: She is a true {polyglot}, fluent in seven languages.
e.zh: 她是个真正的通晓多国语言者，能流利说七种语言。

e.en: Singapore is a {polyglot} city where many languages mix daily.
e.zh: 新加坡是一座多语言城市，每天多种语言交融。

e.en: A hexagon is a {polygon} with six equal sides.
e.zh: 六边形是一种有六条等边的多边形。

e.en: The game engine renders each character as thousands of {polygon} shapes.
e.zh: 游戏引擎把每个角色渲染成数千个多边形。

e.en: The temple has a striking {polygonal} floor plan.
e.zh: 这座寺庙有一个引人注目的多边形平面布局。

e.en: Old video games used simple {polygonal} characters with few details.
e.zh: 老电子游戏使用简单的多边形角色，细节很少。

e.en: The artist designed a {polygram} with seven interlocking points.
e.zh: 那位艺术家设计了一个由七个互相交错的点构成的多角星形。

e.en: Children traced a {polygram} on the chalkboard during geometry class.
e.zh: 几何课上孩子们在黑板上画了一个多角星形。

e.en: The suspect agreed to take a {polygraph} test.
e.zh: 嫌疑人同意接受测谎仪测试。

e.en: Many courts refuse to admit {polygraph} results as evidence.
e.zh: 许多法院拒绝将测谎结果作为证据采纳。

e.en: The {polygrapher} reviewed the chart before announcing the results.
e.zh: 测谎员在公布结果前仔细检查了图表。

e.en: A trained {polygrapher} interviewed each witness separately.
e.zh: 一位训练有素的测谎员分别约谈了每位证人。

polygynous.t: adj. 一夫多妻的（生物/人类学）

e.en: Some bird species are strictly {polygynous} during breeding season.
e.zh: 某些鸟类在繁殖季节严格实行一夫多妻制。

e.en: The {polygynous} household followed strict traditional rules.
e.zh: 这个一夫多妻制家庭遵循严格的传统规矩。

e.en: {Polygyny} remains legal in several countries today.
e.zh: 一夫多妻制在如今的一些国家仍属合法。

e.en: Biologists studied {polygyny} in lion prides for decades.
e.zh: 生物学家对狮群中的一夫多妻现象研究了数十年。

e.en: A cube is the most familiar regular {polyhedron}.
e.zh: 立方体是最常见的正多面体。

e.en: The kid built a paper {polyhedron} for the science fair.
e.zh: 那孩子为科学展制作了一个纸质多面体。

e.en: Leonardo da Vinci was the ultimate Renaissance {polymath}.
e.zh: 达芬奇是文艺复兴时期最杰出的博学家。

e.en: She's a {polymath} fluent in coding, music, and law.
e.zh: 她是个博学之才,精通编程、音乐和法律。

e.en: Plastic bottles are made from a synthetic {polymer}.
e.zh: 塑料瓶是由合成聚合物制成的。

e.en: The lab developed a {polymer} that conducts electricity.
e.zh: 该实验室研发出一种能导电的聚合物。

e.en: DNA {polymerase} copies genetic material during cell division.
e.zh: DNA聚合酶在细胞分裂时复制遗传物质。

e.en: The PCR test relies on a heat-stable {polymerase} enzyme.
e.zh: PCR检测依赖一种耐热的聚合酶。

polymeric.t: adj. 聚合物的；高分子的

e.en: Engineers coated the surface with a {polymeric} film.
e.zh: 工程师在表面涂了一层聚合物薄膜。

e.en: This {polymeric} material resists heat and corrosion well.
e.zh: 这种聚合材料具有良好的耐热抗腐蚀性能。

polymerization.t: n. 聚合反应；聚合作用

e.en: {Polymerization} turns small monomers into long chain molecules.
e.zh: 聚合反应把小分子单体连成长链分子。

e.en: Heat triggers the {polymerization} of the resin in minutes.
e.zh: 加热可在几分钟内引发树脂的聚合反应。

e.en: The virus is highly {polymorphic} and hard to detect.
e.zh: 这种病毒变化多端,很难被检测出来。

e.en: Java supports {polymorphic} methods through inheritance.
e.zh: Java通过继承机制支持多态方法。

e.en: {Polymorphism} lets one interface handle many object types.
e.zh: 多态性让一个接口能处理多种对象类型。

e.en: Genetic {polymorphism} explains differences in drug response.
e.zh: 基因多态性解释了人们对药物反应的差异。

e.en: The artist's style is {polymorphous}, shifting with each project.
e.zh: 这位艺术家风格多变,每个项目都不一样。

e.en: Freud described infants as {polymorphous} in their desires.
e.zh: 弗洛伊德把婴儿的欲望描述为多形态的。

polynesia.t: n. 波利尼西亚（太平洋地区）

e.en: We're flying to {Polynesia} for our honeymoon next month.
e.zh: 我们下个月要飞往波利尼西亚度蜜月。

e.en: The islands of {Polynesia} share rich cultural traditions.
e.zh: 波利尼西亚群岛拥有丰富的共同文化传统。

polynesian.t:
adj. 波利尼西亚的
n. 波利尼西亚人

e.en: He learned {Polynesian} dance from his grandmother.
e.zh: 他跟奶奶学的波利尼西亚舞蹈。

e.en: The restaurant serves authentic {Polynesian} cuisine on weekends.
e.zh: 这家餐厅周末供应正宗的波利尼西亚菜。

polynomial.t:
n. 多项式（数学）
adj. 多项的

e.en: Solve this {polynomial} equation for all real roots.
e.zh: 求出这个多项式方程的所有实数根。

e.en: The algorithm runs in {polynomial} time on large inputs.
e.zh: 该算法在大输入下以多项式时间运行。

e.en: The doctor removed a small {polyp} during the colonoscopy.
e.zh: 医生在肠镜检查中切除了一个小息肉。

e.en: Each coral {polyp} contributes to building the reef.
e.zh: 每个珊瑚虫都为珊瑚礁的形成出一份力。

e.en: Insulin is a small {polypeptide} hormone made by the pancreas.
e.zh: 胰岛素是胰腺分泌的一种小分子多肽激素。

e.en: Ribosomes link amino acids into a growing {polypeptide} chain.
e.zh: 核糖体把氨基酸连成不断延伸的多肽链。

e.en: Green tea is rich in {polyphenol} antioxidants.
e.zh: 绿茶富含多酚类抗氧化物质。

e.en: Red wine contains a {polyphenol} called resveratrol.
e.zh: 红酒中含有一种名为白藜芦醇的多酚。

e.en: Bach mastered {polyphonic} composition like no one else.
e.zh: 巴赫的复调作曲技艺无人能及。

e.en: Old phones used to play {polyphonic} ringtones.
e.zh: 以前的手机会播放和弦铃声。

e.en: Renaissance choirs are famous for their intricate {polyphony}.
e.zh: 文艺复兴时期的合唱团以精妙的复调音乐闻名。

e.en: The synth supports eight-voice {polyphony} at once.
e.zh: 这台合成器最多可同时发出八个声部。

polyploid.t:
adj. 多倍体的
n. 多倍体生物

e.en: Wheat is a {polyploid} crop with multiple chromosome sets.
e.zh: 小麦是一种具有多套染色体的多倍体作物。

e.en: Scientists created a {polyploid} variety with larger fruit.
e.zh: 科学家培育出果实更大的多倍体品种。

e.en: {Polyploidy} often produces hardier plants with bigger flowers.
e.zh: 多倍化往往能培育出花更大、更耐生的植物。

e.en: Researchers study {polyploidy} to improve crop yields.
e.zh: 研究人员通过研究多倍体来提高作物产量。

e.en: The scan revealed a small {polypoid} growth in her stomach.
e.zh: 扫描显示她胃里有一个息肉样小肿块。

e.en: The lesion had a {polypoid} appearance under the microscope.
e.zh: 在显微镜下,该病变呈现息肉样外观。

e.en: Familial {polyposis} sharply increases the risk of colon cancer.
e.zh: 家族性息肉病会大幅增加患结肠癌的风险。

e.en: Patients with {polyposis} need regular endoscopic screening.
e.zh: 息肉病患者需要定期进行内镜筛查。

e.en: Most yogurt cups are made of food-grade {polypropylene}.
e.zh: 大多数酸奶杯都是用食品级聚丙烯制成的。

e.en: The carpet is woven from durable {polypropylene} fibers.
e.zh: 这块地毯由耐用的聚丙烯纤维织成。

e.en: The cathedral displays a stunning medieval {polyptych} above the altar.
e.zh: 这座大教堂祭坛上方陈列着一幅惊艳的中世纪多联画。

e.en: She painted a five-panel {polyptych} for the gallery show.
e.zh: 她为画廊展览创作了一幅五联画。

e.en: West African drumming is famous for its {polyrhythmic} patterns.
e.zh: 西非鼓乐以复杂的复合节奏闻名。

e.en: The track layers {polyrhythmic} percussion over a steady bassline.
e.zh: 这首曲子在稳定的贝斯线上叠加了多重节奏的打击乐。

e.en: Starch is a {polysaccharide} stored in plant cells.
e.zh: 淀粉是储存在植物细胞中的一种多糖。

e.en: Cellulose is the most abundant {polysaccharide} on Earth.
e.zh: 纤维素是地球上含量最丰富的多糖。

e.en: The word "bank" is a classic example of {polysemy}.
e.zh: "bank"一词是多义现象的经典例子。

e.en: Linguists distinguish {polysemy} from simple homonymy.
e.zh: 语言学家将多义现象与单纯的同音异义区分开来。

e.en: The package was cushioned with {polystyrene} foam peanuts.
e.zh: 包裹里塞满了聚苯乙烯泡沫填充粒。

e.en: Many cities have banned single-use {polystyrene} containers.
e.zh: 许多城市已禁止使用一次性聚苯乙烯餐盒。

e.en: His essays are full of unnecessarily {polysyllabic} words.
e.zh: 他的文章里满是没必要的多音节大词。

e.en: Children sometimes struggle to pronounce {polysyllabic} terms.
e.zh: 孩子们有时候很难念出多音节词汇。

polytechnic.t:
n. 理工学院
adj. 多种工艺的

e.en: She studied mechanical engineering at a local {polytechnic}.
e.zh: 她在当地一所理工学院学习机械工程。

e.en: The {polytechnic} offers strong programs in applied science.
e.zh: 这所理工学院在应用科学方面专业实力很强。

e.en: Ancient Greek religion was a classic form of {polytheism}.
e.zh: 古希腊宗教是典型的多神教信仰。

e.en: {Polytheism} allows worship of many distinct gods.
e.zh: 多神教允许信徒崇拜众多不同的神灵。

polytheistic.t: adj. 多神教的；多神论的

e.en: The Romans practiced a richly {polytheistic} religion.
e.zh: 罗马人信奉一种神祇繁多的多神教。

e.en: Hinduism is often described as a {polytheistic} tradition.
e.zh: 印度教通常被描述为一种多神教传统。

e.en: Wrap the sandwich in a {polythene} bag for the picnic.
e.zh: 把三明治装进聚乙烯袋里好去野餐。

e.en: The greenhouse is covered with a thick {polythene} sheet.
e.zh: 这个温室覆盖着一层厚厚的聚乙烯薄膜。

polyunsaturate.t: n. 多元不饱和脂肪（营养学）

e.en: Fish oils contain a healthy {polyunsaturate} called omega-3.
e.zh: 鱼油中含有一种叫欧米伽-3的健康多不饱和脂肪。

e.en: Each {polyunsaturate} in the diet may lower cholesterol levels.
e.zh: 饮食中的每种多不饱和脂肪都可能有助于降低胆固醇。

poignant.t: adj. 令人感伤的；深刻动人的

e.en: The reunion scene was unexpectedly {poignant}.
e.zh: 重逢的那一幕出乎意料地感人。

e.en: He gave a {poignant} speech at his father's funeral.
e.zh: 他在父亲的葬礼上发表了一段感人至深的悼词。

poignantly.t: adv. 深切地；令人心酸地

e.en: She {poignantly} described losing her childhood home.
e.zh: 她动情地讲述了失去童年故居的经历。

e.en: The song {poignantly} captures the loneliness of touring.
e.zh: 这首歌动人地刻画了巡演中的孤独。

poindexter.t: n. 书呆子（俚语，指呆板的聪明人）

e.en: They teased him as a {poindexter} for loving math.
e.zh: 他们因为他喜欢数学就嘲笑他是书呆子。

e.en: The class {poindexter} always finished tests first.
e.zh: 班上那个书呆子总是第一个考完试。

e.en: A red {poinsettia} sat on the table all December.
e.zh: 整个十二月，一盆红色的一品红都摆在桌上。

e.en: She bought a small {poinsettia} for her grandmother.
e.zh: 她给奶奶买了一小盆一品红。

point.t:
n. 点；要点；分数
v. 指向

e.en: That's a fair {point}, and I hadn't considered it.
e.zh: 这话有道理，我之前没考虑到。

e.en: He scored the winning {point} in the final seconds.
e.zh: 他在最后几秒拿下了制胜的一分。

e.en: She danced on {pointe} for the first time at twelve.
e.zh: 她十二岁时第一次踮起足尖跳舞。

e.en: Years of training prepare a dancer to go on {pointe}.
e.zh: 舞者要经过多年训练才能上足尖。

e.en: She {pointed} at the map to show the route.
e.zh: 她指着地图，向我们展示了路线。

e.en: He gave her a {pointed} look across the table.
e.zh: 他隔着桌子向她投去意味深长的一瞥。

e.en: She {pointedly} ignored his question and changed the subject.
e.zh: 她故意无视他的问题，转移了话题。

e.en: The article {pointedly} criticized the mayor's housing policy.
e.zh: 那篇文章措辞犀利地批评了市长的住房政策。

e.en: Let me give you one quick {pointer} before the interview.
e.zh: 在面试前我先给你一点小提示。

e.en: The {pointer} on the dial swung past the red zone.
e.zh: 刻度盘上的指针越过了红色区域。

pointillism.t: n. 点彩画法（绘画流派）

e.en: Seurat is famous for his use of {pointillism} in painting.
e.zh: 修拉以在绘画中使用点彩派而闻名。

e.en: The artist created the portrait using delicate {pointillism} techniques.
e.zh: 这位艺术家用细腻的点彩技法创作了这幅肖像。

pointing.t:
v. 指向；指出
n. 勾缝（砖墙）

e.en: She kept {pointing} at the strange bird in the tree.
e.zh: 她不停地指着树上那只奇怪的鸟。

e.en: The compass is {pointing} due north right now.
e.zh: 指南针现在正指向正北方。

e.en: Arguing with him about politics feels completely {pointless}.
e.zh: 和他争论政治完全没有意义。

e.en: It's {pointless} to wait any longer for the bus.
e.zh: 再等公交车也是白等了。

pointlessly.t: adv. 毫无意义地；徒劳地

e.en: He {pointlessly} refreshed his inbox every five minutes.
e.zh: 他每五分钟就毫无意义地刷新一次收件箱。

e.en: The meeting dragged on {pointlessly} for another hour.
e.zh: 会议又毫无意义地拖了一个小时。

e.en: She finally realized the {pointlessness} of trying to please everyone.
e.zh: 她终于意识到讨好所有人毫无意义。

e.en: The film captures the {pointlessness} of modern office life.
e.zh: 这部电影刻画了现代办公室生活的虚无感。

points.t: n. 点；分数；要点（point 的复数）

e.en: You earn {points} every time you shop with the app.
e.zh: 每次用这个应用购物都能积分。

e.en: She made several strong {points} during the debate.
e.zh: 她在辩论中提出了几个有力的论点。

e.en: The cat has unusually {pointy} ears for its breed.
e.zh: 这只猫的耳朵在同品种中算很尖的。

e.en: She wore {pointy} black boots to the concert.
e.zh: 她穿着尖头黑靴去看演唱会。

poirot.t: n. 波洛（侦探小说人物名）

e.en: Agatha Christie's detective {Poirot} solves crimes with clever logic.
e.zh: 阿加莎笔下的侦探波洛靠缜密逻辑破案。

e.en: I'm rewatching the old {Poirot} TV series on streaming.
e.zh: 我正在流媒体上重温老版波洛剧集。

poise.t:
n. 沉着；泰然自若
v. 使保持平衡

e.en: She handled the tough question with remarkable {poise}.
e.zh: 她从容自若地应对了那个棘手的问题。

e.en: The dancer's {poise} on stage left the audience speechless.
e.zh: 舞者在台上的优雅气度令观众惊叹不已。

poised.t: adj. 泰然自若的；蓄势待发的

e.en: The startup is {poised} to dominate the market this year.
e.zh: 这家创业公司今年有望主导市场。

e.en: She stood {poised} at the edge of the diving board.
e.zh: 她从容地站在跳板边缘。

poises.t: v. 使保持平衡（poise 的三单）

e.en: The cat {poises} silently before pouncing on the toy.
e.zh: 那只猫在扑向玩具前静静地蓄势待发。

e.en: She {poises} her pen above the page, thinking carefully.
e.zh: 她把笔悬在纸上,认真地思考着。

e.en: The hawk was {poising} itself for a sudden dive.
e.zh: 那只鹰正蓄势准备俯冲。

e.en: She stood {poising} the camera for the perfect shot.
e.zh: 她端稳相机,准备拍出最佳画面。

poison.t:
n. 毒药
v. 使中毒；毒害

e.en: Some mushrooms contain enough {poison} to kill an adult.
e.zh: 有些蘑菇含有的毒素足以致命。

e.en: Constant negativity can {poison} a team's morale.
e.zh: 持续的负能量会毁掉团队的士气。

e.en: The river was {poisoned} by chemicals from the factory.
e.zh: 这条河被工厂排放的化学物质污染了。

e.en: Their friendship was {poisoned} by years of jealousy.
e.zh: 他们的友谊被多年的嫉妒所毒害。

e.en: The medieval {poisoner} was finally caught and executed.
e.zh: 那名中世纪的下毒者最终被抓获处决。

e.en: Detectives suspect a {poisoner} is behind the recent deaths.
e.zh: 侦探怀疑近期的死亡事件背后有人下毒。

poisoning.t:
n. 中毒
v. 投毒

e.en: He got food {poisoning} from the seafood last night.
e.zh: 他昨晚吃海鲜后食物中毒了。

e.en: Lead {poisoning} can cause serious developmental problems in children.
e.zh: 铅中毒会对儿童的发育造成严重影响。

e.en: The text mistakenly used {poisonned} instead of the correct spelling poisoned.
e.zh: 这段文字误将 poisoned 拼成了 poisonned。

e.en: Spell-check flagged {poisonned} as a misspelling in the draft.
e.zh: 拼写检查把草稿里的 poisonned 标为错字。

e.en: She wrote {poisonning} by mistake; the correct form is poisoning.
e.zh: 她误写成了 poisonning,正确形式是 poisoning。

e.en: The form {poisonning} doesn't appear in any standard dictionary.
e.zh: poisonning 这种拼法在任何标准词典中都查不到。

e.en: Be careful—those berries are highly {poisonous} to humans.
e.zh: 小心,那些浆果对人体有剧毒。

e.en: Working there created a {poisonous} atmosphere among colleagues.
e.zh: 在那里工作让同事之间的气氛十分恶劣。

poisons.t:
n. 毒药（复数）
v. 毒害

e.en: Many household {poisons} should be kept away from children.
e.zh: 许多家用毒物都应远离儿童存放。

e.en: Resentment quietly {poisons} even the closest relationships.
e.zh: 怨恨会悄悄毒害最亲密的关系。

poisson.t: n. 泊松（数学家，泊松分布）

e.en: The {Poisson} distribution models the number of rare events.
e.zh: 泊松分布用于建模稀有事件的发生次数。

e.en: We used a {Poisson} regression to analyze the click data.
e.zh: 我们用泊松回归分析了点击数据。

e.en: The Battle of {Poitiers} marked a turning point in medieval Europe.
e.zh: 普瓦捷战役是中世纪欧洲的重要转折点。

e.en: She studied abroad in {Poitiers} for a year.
e.zh: 她在普瓦捷留学了一年。

e.en: The {Poitou} region is known for its donkeys and butter.
e.zh: 普瓦图地区以驴子和黄油而闻名。

e.en: We drove through {Poitou} on our way to the coast.
e.zh: 我们在前往海岸的路上穿过了普瓦图。

poke.t:
v. 戳；捅
n. 戳；猛推

e.en: Don't {poke} the screen so hard—you'll damage it.
e.zh: 别那么用力戳屏幕,会把它弄坏的。

e.en: She gave him a gentle {poke} to wake him up.
e.zh: 她轻轻戳了他一下把他叫醒。

e.en: He won the {poker} tournament after a twelve-hour final.
e.zh: 他在长达十二小时的决赛后赢得了扑克锦标赛。

e.en: She kept a perfect {poker} face during the negotiation.
e.zh: 谈判中她始终保持着完美的扑克脸。

e.en: Traffic was so {pokey} that I missed my flight.
e.zh: 路上太堵了,我都错过航班了。

e.en: He spent a night in the {pokey} for disorderly conduct.
e.zh: 他因扰乱秩序在牢里蹲了一晚。

poking.t: v. 戳；捅（poke 的现在分词）

e.en: Stop {poking} your little brother—he's trying to study.
e.zh: 别再戳你弟弟了,他在努力学习。

e.en: She kept {poking} around the attic looking for old photos.
e.zh: 她一直在阁楼里翻找旧照片。

e.en: Their first apartment was a {poky} little studio downtown.
e.zh: 他们的第一套公寓是市中心一个狭小的单间。

e.en: The internet here is unbearably {poky} during peak hours.
e.zh: 这里的网在高峰时段慢得让人难以忍受。

e.en: Every {pol} in town promised lower taxes this election.
e.zh: 今年选举,镇上每个政客都承诺减税。

e.en: The veteran {pol} knew exactly how to work the crowd.
e.zh: 这位资深政客非常懂得如何笼络人群。

e.en: My grandparents emigrated from {Poland} after the war.
e.zh: 我的祖父母在战后从波兰移民出来。

e.en: {Poland} has become a popular destination for tech workers.
e.zh: 波兰已成为科技工作者热门的目的地。

polar.t: adj. 极地的；两极的；截然相反的

e.en: {Polar} bears are struggling as Arctic ice continues to melt.
e.zh: 随着北极冰层不断融化,北极熊处境艰难。

e.en: Their views on the issue are {polar} opposites.
e.zh: 他们在这个问题上的看法截然相反。

e.en: Sailors used {Polaris} for centuries to navigate at night.
e.zh: 几个世纪以来,水手们靠北极星在夜间导航。

e.en: You can find {Polaris} by following the Big Dipper's pointer stars.
e.zh: 沿着北斗七星的指极星就能找到北极星。

polarisation.t: n. 极化；两极分化（英式拼写）

e.en: Social media has accelerated political {polarisation} in many countries.
e.zh: 社交媒体加剧了许多国家的政治两极分化。

e.en: The {polarisation} of light reveals stress patterns in the glass.
e.zh: 光的偏振可以揭示玻璃中的应力分布。

polarise.t: v. 使两极分化；使极化（英式拼写）

e.en: Few topics {polarise} voters as quickly as immigration.
e.zh: 很少有话题能像移民问题那样迅速让选民两极分化。

e.en: These filters {polarise} the light to reduce glare.
e.zh: 这些滤镜会让光线偏振以减少眩光。

polarised.t: adj. 极化的；两极分化的（英式拼写）

e.en: Public opinion has become deeply {polarised} on climate policy.
e.zh: 公众对气候政策的看法已严重两极分化。

e.en: I bought {polarised} sunglasses for driving in bright sunlight.
e.zh: 我买了偏光太阳镜,适合在强光下开车。

e.en: Make sure the battery {polarity} is correct before powering on.
e.zh: 通电前请先确认电池的极性正确。

e.en: There's a clear {polarity} between the two characters' personalities.
e.zh: 两个角色的性格之间存在明显的对立。

e.en: Cable news has fueled the {polarization} of American politics.
e.zh: 有线电视新闻加剧了美国政治的两极分化。

e.en: The experiment measures the {polarization} of emitted photons.
e.zh: 该实验测量发射光子的偏振状态。

polarize.t: v. 使两极分化；使极化

e.en: New tax proposals tend to {polarize} the electorate quickly.
e.zh: 新的税收提案往往会让选民迅速对立起来。

e.en: Special coatings {polarize} the light passing through the lens.
e.zh: 特殊涂层使穿过镜片的光线发生偏振。

polarized.t: adj. 极化的；两极分化的

e.en: The country has rarely been more {polarized} than it is today.
e.zh: 这个国家很少像今天这样两极分化。

e.en: {Polarized} lenses cut down reflections off water and snow.
e.zh: 偏光镜片能减少水面和雪面的反光。

e.en: Screw a {polarizer} onto your lens for richer sky colors.
e.zh: 在镜头上加装偏振镜可以让天空颜色更浓郁。

e.en: The LCD uses a {polarizer} to control which light passes through.
e.zh: 液晶屏靠偏振片来控制哪些光线能穿过。

polyunsaturated.t: adj. 多不饱和的（脂肪、脂肪酸）

e.en: Olive oil contains both mono- and {polyunsaturated} fats.
e.zh: 橄榄油同时含有单不饱和与多不饱和脂肪。

e.en: Doctors recommend swapping butter for {polyunsaturated} oils.
e.zh: 医生建议用多不饱和油取代黄油。

polyurethane.t: n. 聚氨酯（一种高分子材料）

e.en: The hardwood floor is sealed with clear {polyurethane}.
e.zh: 这块硬木地板涂了一层透明聚氨酯保护漆。

e.en: Memory foam mattresses are made from soft {polyurethane}.
e.zh: 记忆海绵床垫是由柔软的聚氨酯制成的。

polyvalent.t: adj. 多价的（化学、免疫学）

e.en: The new vaccine is {polyvalent}, protecting against four strains.
e.zh: 这种新疫苗是多价的,可预防四种毒株。

e.en: Carbon is a {polyvalent} element with many bonding options.
e.zh: 碳是一种多价元素,可形成多种化学键。

polyvinyl.t: adj. 聚乙烯基的（如 PVC）

e.en: The pipes are made of cheap {polyvinyl} chloride.
e.zh: 这些管道是用廉价的聚氯乙烯制成的。

e.en: She glued the seams with {polyvinyl} acetate.
e.zh: 她用聚醋酸乙烯酯把接缝粘了起来。

pom.t:
n. 博美犬（Pomeranian 的缩写）
n. 英国人（澳俚）

e.en: Her tiny {pom} barked at every passing dog.
e.zh: 她的小博美对每条路过的狗都汪汪叫。

e.en: The cheerleader waved a bright pink {pom} above her head.
e.zh: 啦啦队员把一只亮粉色的绒球举过头顶挥舞。

e.en: He slicked back his hair with a heavy {pomade}.
e.zh: 他用厚重的发蜡把头发往后梳得油光锃亮。

e.en: This {pomade} gives a strong hold without feeling sticky.
e.zh: 这款发蜡定型力强却不黏腻。

e.en: She hung a clove-studded {pomander} in the closet.
e.zh: 她在衣橱里挂了一个插满丁香的香丸。

e.en: Victorian ladies carried a {pomander} to mask street odors.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的女士们随身带着香丸以掩盖街上的气味。

e.en: I sprinkled fresh {pomegranate} seeds over the salad.
e.zh: 我在沙拉上撒了一些新鲜的石榴籽。

e.en: This juice is a blend of {pomegranate} and blueberry.
e.zh: 这款果汁是石榴和蓝莓的混合饮品。

pomerania.t: n. 波美拉尼亚（中欧历史地区）

e.en: The Hanseatic city of Stralsund lies in {Pomerania}.
e.zh: 汉萨同盟城市施特拉尔松德位于波美拉尼亚地区。

e.en: Much of {Pomerania} now belongs to northern Poland.
e.zh: 波美拉尼亚的大部分地区如今归属波兰北部。

e.en: The menu lists a {pomme} purée alongside the duck.
e.zh: 菜单上鸭肉旁边配的是一份土豆泥。

e.en: In French class we learned that {pomme} means apple.
e.zh: 在法语课上我们学到"pomme"是苹果的意思。

pommel.t:
n. 鞍前桥；剑柄球
v. 连续击打

e.en: The knight gripped the sword's heavy {pommel} firmly.
e.zh: 骑士紧紧握住剑柄上沉重的圆头。

e.en: Gymnasts train for years on the {pommel} horse.
e.zh: 体操运动员要在鞍马上训练多年。

e.en: The royal wedding was celebrated with great {pomp}.
e.zh: 这场皇室婚礼办得极尽盛大隆重。

e.en: He hates the {pomp} of formal corporate events.
e.zh: 他讨厌那些正式企业活动上的繁文缛节。

pompadour.t: n. 蓬帕杜发型；飞机头

e.en: He styled his hair into a sleek {pompadour} for the wedding.
e.zh: 他为了婚礼把头发梳成光滑的飞机头。

e.en: The rockabilly singer was famous for his towering {pompadour}.
e.zh: 那位摇滚歌手以高耸的飞机头造型闻名。

e.en: The chef grilled fresh {pompano} with lemon and herbs.
e.zh: 厨师用柠檬和香草烤了新鲜的鲳鱼。

e.en: Florida anglers often catch {pompano} from the surf.
e.zh: 佛罗里达的钓鱼人常在浪花里钓到鲳鱼。

pompeian.t:
adj. 庞贝城的
n. 庞贝人

e.en: The museum displayed vivid {pompeian} frescoes from the ruins.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了来自遗址的鲜艳庞贝壁画。

e.en: She painted her dining room a deep {pompeian} red.
e.zh: 她把餐厅刷成了深沉的庞贝红。

e.en: Tourists wander the ash-covered streets of {pompeii} every day.
e.zh: 游客每天都在庞贝古城被火山灰覆盖的街道上漫步。

e.en: Vesuvius buried {pompeii} under volcanic ash in 79 AD.
e.zh: 维苏威火山在公元79年将庞贝埋在火山灰之下。

e.en: The Roman general {pompey} once rivaled Julius Caesar for power.
e.zh: 罗马将军庞培曾与凯撒争夺权力。

e.en: Locals affectionately call Portsmouth "{pompey}" at football matches.
e.zh: 当地人在足球比赛时亲切地把朴茨茅斯叫做"庞贝"。

pompidou.t: n. 蓬皮杜（法国前总统）

e.en: We spent the afternoon at the {pompidou} center in Paris.
e.zh: 我们在巴黎的蓬皮杜中心度过了一个下午。

e.en: Georges {pompidou} served as president of France in the 1970s.
e.zh: 乔治·蓬皮杜在1970年代担任法国总统。

e.en: She tied a fluffy {pompon} to the top of her hat.
e.zh: 她在帽子顶上系了一个毛茸茸的绒球。

e.en: The cheerleaders waved bright red {pompon} during the halftime show.
e.zh: 啦啦队员在中场表演时挥舞着亮红色的绒球。

e.en: His speech was ruined by sheer {pomposity} and empty phrases.
e.zh: 他的演讲被纯粹的浮夸和空洞辞藻毁了。

e.en: The novel mocks the {pomposity} of Victorian high society.
e.zh: 这部小说讽刺了维多利亚上流社会的浮夸做派。

pompous.t: adj. 自负的；浮夸做作的

e.en: The professor's {pompous} lecture style annoyed many students.
e.zh: 教授浮夸的讲课风格让许多学生反感。

e.en: He gave a {pompous} speech full of long, useless words.
e.zh: 他做了一场充斥冗长无用词汇的浮夸演讲。

e.en: The mayor spoke {pompously} about his minor achievements.
e.zh: 市长浮夸地大谈他那些微不足道的成就。

e.en: He {pompously} declared himself the smartest person in the room.
e.zh: 他自命不凡地宣称自己是房间里最聪明的人。

ponce.t:
n. 娘娘腔男子（英俚，贬）
n. 皮条客

e.en: Don't {ponce} around the office — get back to work.
e.zh: 别在办公室晃来晃去,赶紧回去干活。

e.en: The old man called the dancer a {ponce} rather rudely.
e.zh: 那个老头相当粗鲁地把那位舞者称作娘娘腔。

e.en: She wore a colorful wool {poncho} during the hike.
e.zh: 徒步时她披着一件彩色的羊毛斗篷。

e.en: Pack a plastic {poncho} in case it rains at the festival.
e.zh: 带一件塑料雨披,以防音乐节下雨。

e.en: Ducks were swimming peacefully across the village {pond}.
e.zh: 鸭子在村里的池塘上悠然游过。

e.en: The kids threw stones into the {pond} all afternoon.
e.zh: 孩子们整个下午都在往池塘里扔石头。

e.en: She paused to {ponder} the difficult question for a moment.
e.zh: 她停下来思索了一下那个难题。

e.en: Many people {ponder} the meaning of life at some point.
e.zh: 很多人在某个时刻都会思考人生的意义。

ponderable.t: adj. 可掂量的；值得考虑的

e.en: The proposal raised several {ponderable} questions for the committee.
e.zh: 这项提案给委员会提出了几个值得深思的问题。

e.en: His argument is at least {ponderable}, even if not convincing.
e.zh: 他的论点即便不令人信服,至少也值得思考。

e.en: She {pondered} the job offer for nearly a week.
e.zh: 她对那份工作邀约思量了将近一周。

e.en: He {pondered} quietly before giving his final answer.
e.zh: 他静静地思索了一番才给出最终答复。

pondering.t: v. 沉思；琢磨（ponder 进行式）

e.en: I've been {pondering} whether to switch careers next year.
e.zh: 我一直在考虑明年要不要转行。

e.en: She sat by the window {pondering} her next move.
e.zh: 她坐在窗边思索着下一步该怎么走。

e.en: Tall {ponderosa} pines lined the mountain trail above the lake.
e.zh: 高大的西黄松排列在湖上方的山径两旁。

e.en: The cabin sat in a grove of fragrant {ponderosa} pine.
e.zh: 小木屋坐落在一片芬芳的西黄松林中。

ponderous.t: adj. 笨重的；冗长乏味的

e.en: The book is informative but written in {ponderous} prose.
e.zh: 这本书内容丰富,但文笔沉闷冗长。

e.en: The elephant moved with slow, {ponderous} steps across the field.
e.zh: 大象迈着缓慢沉重的步伐穿过田野。

e.en: The old truck rolled {ponderously} up the steep dirt road.
e.zh: 那辆旧卡车沉重地驶上陡峭的土路。

e.en: He explained the rules {ponderously}, boring everyone in the room.
e.zh: 他冗长沉闷地解释规则,把房间里的人都听烦了。

ponders.t: v. 思索（ponder 第三人称单数）

e.en: The essay {ponders} how technology is reshaping friendship.
e.zh: 这篇文章思考了科技如何重塑友谊。

e.en: She often {ponders} her childhood while walking the dog.
e.zh: 遛狗时她常常会回想起自己的童年。

e.en: Several frog-filled {ponds} dot the edge of the meadow.
e.zh: 草地边缘点缀着几个满是青蛙的池塘。

e.en: The garden has two koi {ponds} connected by a stream.
e.zh: 花园里有两个由溪流相连的锦鲤池。

e.en: Thick {pondweed} clogged the propeller of the small boat.
e.zh: 浓密的眼子菜缠住了小船的螺旋桨。

e.en: Ducks love feeding on the soft {pondweed} near the shore.
e.zh: 鸭子喜欢在岸边吃柔软的眼子菜。

e.en: Grandma served hot corn {pone} with butter and honey.
e.zh: 奶奶端上抹着黄油和蜂蜜的热玉米饼。

e.en: Southern cooks have made corn {pone} for generations.
e.zh: 美国南方厨师世世代代都在做玉米饼。

pong.t:
n. 臭味（英俚）
n. 乒乓（早期电子游戏）

e.en: A nasty {pong} drifted from the forgotten lunch box.
e.zh: 一股难闻的臭味从被遗忘的饭盒里飘出来。

e.en: We played ping {pong} in the basement every Friday night.
e.zh: 我们每周五晚都在地下室打乒乓球。

pons.t: n. 脑桥（大脑解剖部位）

e.en: The {pons} relays signals between the brain and spinal cord.
e.zh: 脑桥在大脑和脊髓之间传递信号。

e.en: Damage to the {pons} can affect breathing and sleep cycles.
e.zh: 脑桥受损会影响呼吸和睡眠周期。

e.en: We crossed the old stone {pont} over the quiet river.
e.zh: 我们从静静的河上的老石桥上走过。

e.en: A small ferry {pont} carried cars across the channel.
e.zh: 一艘小渡船把汽车摆渡过海峡。

e.en: The {ponte} Vecchio in Florence is lined with jewelry shops.
e.zh: 佛罗伦萨的老桥两侧排满了珠宝店。

e.en: She sewed a slim skirt from heavy {ponte} knit fabric.
e.zh: 她用厚实的罗马布缝了一条修身裙。

pontefract.t: n. 庞蒂弗拉克特（英国城镇）

e.en: He bought a tin of traditional {pontefract} cakes at the shop.
e.zh: 他在店里买了一罐传统的庞蒂弗拉克特甘草饼。

e.en: {pontefract} is a market town in West Yorkshire, England.
e.zh: 庞蒂弗拉克特是英格兰西约克郡的一座集镇。

pontiac.t: n. 庞蒂亚克（美国汽车品牌）

e.en: He restored a vintage {pontiac} from the late 1960s.
e.zh: 他修复了一辆60年代末的老式庞蒂亚克汽车。

e.en: My uncle drove a bright red {pontiac} firebird in college.
e.zh: 我叔叔大学时开一辆鲜红色的庞蒂亚克火鸟。

e.en: The {pontiff} addressed thousands of pilgrims in St. Peter's Square.
e.zh: 教皇在圣彼得广场向数千名朝圣者发表讲话。

e.en: A new {pontiff} was elected after weeks of conclave deliberation.
e.zh: 经过数周的秘密会议后,一位新教皇当选。

pontifical.t: adj. 教皇的；自以为是的

e.en: He spoke in a {pontifical} tone that irritated his colleagues.
e.zh: 他用一种装腔作势的口吻说话,惹恼了同事。

e.en: The cardinal wore his full {pontifical} robes for the ceremony.
e.zh: 枢机主教身着完整的教皇礼服参加典礼。

pontificate.t:
v. 自以为是地训话
n. 教皇任期

e.en: He loves to {pontificate} about wine at every dinner party.
e.zh: 他喜欢在每次晚宴上对葡萄酒高谈阔论。

e.en: Please don't {pontificate} — just answer the question simply.
e.zh: 请别夸夸其谈,简单回答问题就好。

e.en: My grandparents took us to a {pontin} holiday camp every summer.
e.zh: 爷爷奶奶每年夏天都带我们去庞廷度假营。

e.en: The old {pontin} resort closed after decades of family holidays.
e.zh: 那家老庞廷度假村在接待家庭客几十年后关门了。

e.en: Engineers built a temporary {pontoon} bridge across the flooded river.
e.zh: 工程师在被洪水淹没的河上架起了一座临时浮桥。

e.en: We rented a {pontoon} boat and cruised the lake all day.
e.zh: 我们租了一条平底游船,在湖上巡游了一整天。

e.en: The little girl learned to ride a gentle Shetland {pony}.
e.zh: 小女孩学会了骑一匹温顺的设得兰矮种马。

e.en: He saddled up his {pony} and rode out at sunrise.
e.zh: 他给小马备好鞍,日出时骑了出去。

e.en: She tied her hair back in a quick {ponytail} before running.
e.zh: 跑步前她迅速把头发扎成马尾。

e.en: His silver {ponytail} reached halfway down his back.
e.zh: 他银白色的马尾辫垂到背的一半。

poo.t:
n. 便便（儿语）
v. 拉屎

e.en: The puppy left {poo} on the kitchen floor again.
e.zh: 小狗又在厨房地板上拉便便了。

e.en: Always pick up your dog's {poo} from the sidewalk.
e.zh: 一定要把你家狗在人行道上的便便捡起来。

e.en: Her little {pooch} follows her everywhere around the house.
e.zh: 她的小狗在家里到处跟着她。

e.en: That fluffy {pooch} in the window is incredibly cute.
e.zh: 橱窗里那只毛茸茸的小狗实在太可爱了。

e.en: Her white {poodle} won first prize at the local dog show.
e.zh: 她的白色贵宾犬在当地的狗展上获得了一等奖。

e.en: A standard {poodle} needs daily exercise and regular grooming.
e.zh: 标准贵宾犬需要每天运动和定期美容。

poof.t:
int. 噗（消失声）
n. 一阵轻烟

e.en: With a sudden {poof}, the magician made the coin disappear.
e.zh: 嘭的一声,魔术师让硬币消失了。

e.en: My savings vanished in a {poof} after the car repair.
e.zh: 修完车后我的积蓄一下子就没了。

e.en: Calling someone a {poofter} is considered an offensive slur today.
e.zh: 如今称人为"poofter"被视为带有冒犯性的蔑称。

e.en: The old film's use of {poofter} hasn't aged well at all.
e.zh: 那部老电影里使用"poofter"一词已经完全不合时宜。

e.en: She wore a {poofy} pink dress to the prom.
e.zh: 她穿了一条蓬松的粉色裙子去参加毕业舞会。

e.en: The humidity made her hair go all {poofy} and frizzy.
e.zh: 潮湿的天气让她的头发变得又蓬又毛糙。

e.en: She tends to {pooh} every suggestion her brother makes.
e.zh: 她总是对弟弟的每个建议都嗤之以鼻。

e.en: Winnie the {pooh} remains a beloved children's character worldwide.
e.zh: 小熊维尼至今仍是全球深受喜爱的儿童角色。

pool.t:
n. 水池；泳池
v. 集中；共用

e.en: The kids splashed happily in the backyard {pool} all afternoon.
e.zh: 孩子们整个下午都在后院的泳池里开心地戏水。

e.en: Let's {pool} our money and buy a better gift together.
e.zh: 我们把钱凑在一起,合买一份更好的礼物吧。

pooled.t:
adj. 汇集的
v. 集中（pool 过去式）

e.en: Rainwater {pooled} in the dips along the muddy road.
e.zh: 雨水在泥泞道路的凹陷处积成了水洼。

e.en: The neighbors {pooled} resources to build a community garden.
e.zh: 邻居们集资共建了一个社区花园。

e.en: Blood was {pooling} under the patient's leg, alarming the nurse.
e.zh: 病人腿下正在积血,把护士吓了一跳。

e.en: Friends are {pooling} cash to rent a cabin this winter.
e.zh: 朋友们正在凑钱,打算今冬租一间小木屋。

e.en: He spent his teenage years hustling games in the local {poolroom}.
e.zh: 他青少年时期都在当地的台球房里打球赚钱。

e.en: Smoke filled the dim {poolroom} above the corner bar.
e.zh: 昏暗的台球房里烟雾弥漫,就在街角酒吧的楼上。

e.en: The hotel has three outdoor {pools} and a hot tub.
e.zh: 这家酒店有三个室外泳池和一个热水浴池。

e.en: Small {pools} of water collected on the uneven pavement.
e.zh: 凹凸不平的人行道上积起了一摊摊小水洼。

poolside.t:
n. 泳池边
adj. 池畔的

e.en: We sipped cocktails {poolside} until the sun went down.
e.zh: 我们在泳池边啜饮鸡尾酒,直到太阳下山。

e.en: The hotel offers free breakfast at its sunny {poolside} cafe.
e.zh: 酒店在阳光明媚的泳池边咖啡厅提供免费早餐。

poop.t:
n. 大便（口语）
v. 拉屎

e.en: The puppy left a {poop} on the rug again.
e.zh: 小狗又在地毯上拉了一坨便便。

e.en: Always carry bags to clean up dog {poop} on walks.
e.zh: 遛狗时记得带袋子清理狗便便。

e.en: I'm totally {pooped} after that long hike.
e.zh: 那次长途徒步后我累坏了。

e.en: The kids are {pooped} from playing all afternoon.
e.zh: 孩子们玩了一下午,累得不行。

e.en: Many {poor} families struggle to afford rent.
e.zh: 许多贫困家庭付房租都很吃力。

e.en: The app got {poor} reviews due to constant crashes.
e.zh: 这款应用因频繁崩溃收到了差评。

e.en: Medical bills nearly sent the family to the {poorhouse}.
e.zh: 医疗费用差点让这家人陷入赤贫。

e.en: In old novels, orphans often ended up in the {poorhouse}.
e.zh: 在旧小说里,孤儿常常最后流落到救济院。

poorly.t:
adv. 不好地；糟糕地
adj. 身体欠佳

e.en: The website is {poorly} designed and hard to navigate.
e.zh: 这个网站设计很差,很难浏览。

e.en: He slept {poorly} the night before the interview.
e.zh: 面试前一晚他没睡好。

pop.t:
adj. 流行的（音乐）
v. 砰地响；弹出

e.en: Click the icon and a menu will {pop} up.
e.zh: 点击图标后会弹出一个菜单。

e.en: She loves listening to Korean {pop} music.
e.zh: 她很喜欢听韩国流行音乐。

e.en: We always get {popcorn} when watching movies.
e.zh: 我们看电影时总会买爆米花。

e.en: The microwave {popcorn} smells amazing.
e.zh: 微波爆米花闻起来香极了。

e.en: The store sells flavored {popcorns} like caramel and cheese.
e.zh: 这家店卖焦糖、芝士等多种口味的爆米花。

e.en: Different {popcorns} are arranged in colorful tins.
e.zh: 各种爆米花装在彩色铁罐里陈列着。

pope.t: n. 教皇；罗马天主教宗

e.en: The {pope} addressed thousands of pilgrims at the Vatican.
e.zh: 教宗在梵蒂冈向数千名朝圣者讲话。

e.en: A new {pope} is elected by the College of Cardinals.
e.zh: 新教宗由枢机团选举产生。

e.en: Old pamphlets fiercely attacked what they called {popery}.
e.zh: 旧时的小册子猛烈抨击所谓的天主教教皇制。

e.en: Reformers rejected {popery} and demanded church reform.
e.zh: 改革者拒斥教皇制,要求教会改革。

popeye.t: n. 大力水手（动画角色）

e.en: My grandfather still watches old {popeye} cartoons.
e.zh: 我爷爷还在看老版的大力水手动画。

e.en: He flexed his arm like {popeye} after spinach.
e.zh: 他像吃了菠菜的大力水手一样秀起手臂。

popinjay.t: n. 爱炫耀者；花花公子

e.en: Critics dismissed the actor as a vain {popinjay}.
e.zh: 评论家把那位演员贬为虚荣的花花公子。

e.en: He dressed like a {popinjay} at every party.
e.zh: 他每次参加派对都打扮得像个花哨的草包。

e.en: Old laws once banned what officials called {popish} rituals.
e.zh: 旧法曾禁止官员所谓的天主教仪式。

e.en: The pamphlet warned against {popish} influence in politics.
e.zh: 那本小册子警告天主教势力对政治的影响。

e.en: Tall {poplar} trees lined both sides of the road.
e.zh: 路两旁种着高高的杨树。

e.en: The furniture is made of light {poplar} wood.
e.zh: 这件家具是用轻质杨木做的。

e.en: He wore a crisp {poplin} shirt to the meeting.
e.zh: 他穿了一件挺括的府绸衬衫去开会。

e.en: This dress is cut from soft cotton {poplin}.
e.zh: 这条裙子是用柔软的纯棉府绸裁的。

e.en: The doctor checked the {popliteal} pulse behind the knee.
e.zh: 医生检查了膝盖后方的腘动脉脉搏。

e.en: Stretching helps loosen the tight {popliteal} muscles.
e.zh: 拉伸有助于放松紧绷的腘窝肌肉。

popover.t:
n. 弹出层（UI 组件）
n. 蛋奶酥饼

e.en: The website shows a discount {popover} when you scroll down.
e.zh: 网页向下滚动时会弹出一个折扣浮窗。

e.en: She baked warm {popover} pastries for breakfast.
e.zh: 她烤了暖暖的爆炸松饼当早餐。

e.en: The little girl ran to hug her {poppa}.
e.zh: 小女孩跑过去抱住爸爸。

e.en: {Poppa} always tells the funniest bedtime stories.
e.zh: 爸爸讲的睡前故事总是最有趣。

popped.t: v. 弹出；爆开（pop 过去式）

e.en: A notification {popped} up on my phone screen.
e.zh: 我的手机屏幕上弹出了一条通知。

e.en: She {popped} into the café for a quick coffee.
e.zh: 她顺路进咖啡馆喝了杯快咖啡。

e.en: We used a giant {popper} to make popcorn.
e.zh: 我们用了一个大爆米花机来做爆米花。

e.en: The dance floor was full of party {popper} confetti.
e.zh: 舞池里满是拉炮喷出的彩色纸屑。

e.en: Grandma called the toddler her little {poppet}.
e.zh: 奶奶把那个小娃娃叫做她的小宝贝。

e.en: The engine has a {poppet} valve that opens vertically.
e.zh: 这台发动机装有竖直开启的提升阀。

popping.t:
v. 弹出；爆裂
n. 机械舞

e.en: Notifications kept {popping} up during the meeting.
e.zh: 会议中通知不停地弹出来。

e.en: The kids loved {popping} bubble wrap after school.
e.zh: 孩子们放学后特别喜欢捏气泡膜。

e.en: A red {poppy} is worn to remember fallen soldiers.
e.zh: 人们佩戴红色罂粟花以纪念阵亡士兵。

e.en: The bagel was sprinkled with {poppy} seeds.
e.zh: 这个贝果上撒着罂粟籽。

e.en: That conspiracy theory is complete {poppycock}.
e.zh: 那个阴谋论完全是一派胡言。

e.en: He dismissed the rumor as utter {poppycock}.
e.zh: 他把那个谣言斥为彻头彻尾的胡说八道。

pops.t: n. 通俗音乐；老爸（口语）

e.en: A new ad {pops} up every time I open the app.
e.zh: 每次打开这个应用都会弹出新广告。

e.en: My {pops} taught me how to ride a bike.
e.zh: 我老爸教会了我骑自行车。

e.en: The kids enjoyed a cold {popsicle} on the hot afternoon.
e.zh: 孩子们在炎热的下午享用着冰棍。

e.en: She made homemade fruit {popsicle} in silicone molds.
e.zh: 她用硅胶模具自制了水果冰棍。

e.en: The new policy angered much of the local {populace}.
e.zh: 新政策激怒了当地大部分民众。

e.en: Officials must listen to the concerns of the {populace}.
e.zh: 官员必须倾听民众的关切。

e.en: This song became {popular} on TikTok overnight.
e.zh: 这首歌一夜之间在抖音上爆红。

e.en: Sushi is increasingly {popular} among young diners.
e.zh: 寿司在年轻食客中越来越受欢迎。

popularisation.t: n. 普及；推广（英式拼写）

e.en: The {popularisation} of smartphones changed how we communicate.
e.zh: 智能手机的普及改变了我们的沟通方式。

e.en: His books contributed to the {popularisation} of science.
e.zh: 他的书籍推动了科学的普及。

popularise.t: v. 普及；推广（英式拼写）

e.en: Influencers helped {popularise} the new fitness trend.
e.zh: 网红们帮助推广了这一新健身潮流。

e.en: The brand wants to {popularise} reusable coffee cups.
e.zh: 该品牌想推广可重复使用的咖啡杯。

e.en: TikTok {popularised} short dance videos worldwide.
e.zh: 抖音让短视频舞蹈在全球流行起来。

e.en: Carl Sagan {popularised} astronomy through his TV series.
e.zh: 卡尔·萨根通过电视节目普及了天文学。

e.en: The channel {popularises} science for curious teenagers.
e.zh: 这个频道为好奇的青少年普及科学知识。

e.en: Her blog {popularises} sustainable fashion among young readers.
e.zh: 她的博客在年轻读者中推广可持续时尚。

e.en: She is {popularising} plant-based cooking through her videos.
e.zh: 她通过视频推广植物饮食烹饪。

e.en: Streaming platforms are {popularising} foreign-language dramas.
e.zh: 流媒体平台正在让外语剧集流行起来。

e.en: The relative {popularities} of the two apps shifted quickly.
e.zh: 两款应用的受欢迎程度此消彼长得很快。

e.en: Survey data tracked the {popularities} of various candidates.
e.zh: 调查数据追踪了各候选人的受欢迎程度。

e.en: The show's {popularity} surged after the finale aired.
e.zh: 大结局播出后这部剧的人气暴涨。

e.en: Electric cars are gaining {popularity} in major cities.
e.zh: 电动车在大城市里越来越受欢迎。

e.en: The {popularization} of streaming hurt traditional cable TV.
e.zh: 流媒体的普及冲击了传统有线电视。

e.en: His lectures aided the {popularization} of quantum physics.
e.zh: 他的讲座推动了量子物理的普及。

e.en: His books are excellent {popularizations} of complex math topics.
e.zh: 他的书是复杂数学主题的优秀通俗读物。

e.en: Several {popularizations} of the theory appeared in magazines.
e.zh: 该理论的几本通俗读物刊登在杂志上。

e.en: YouTubers helped {popularize} home workouts during the pandemic.
e.zh: YouTube博主在疫情期间帮助推广了家庭健身。

e.en: The startup hopes to {popularize} solar-powered chargers.
e.zh: 这家初创公司希望普及太阳能充电器。

e.en: Netflix {popularized} binge-watching entire seasons in one weekend.
e.zh: Netflix让一个周末追完整季剧集变得流行。

e.en: The chef {popularized} fusion cuisine in the nineties.
e.zh: 那位主厨在九十年代让融合菜流行起来。

e.en: He became a famous {popularizer} of evolutionary biology.
e.zh: 他成为了著名的进化生物学普及者。

e.en: The author is a leading {popularizer} of behavioral economics.
e.zh: 这位作者是行为经济学的主要普及者。

e.en: The podcast {popularizes} ideas from academic philosophy.
e.zh: 这档播客把学院派哲学的观点推向大众。

e.en: Her channel {popularizes} cooking techniques from rural China.
e.zh: 她的频道把中国乡村的烹饪手法推广开来。

e.en: Social media is {popularizing} niche hobbies like bookbinding.
e.zh: 社交媒体正让装订书籍这类小众爱好流行起来。

e.en: The documentary is {popularizing} awareness of ocean pollution.
e.zh: 这部纪录片让人们更广泛地关注海洋污染。

e.en: The drink is {popularly} known as bubble tea.
e.zh: 这种饮料通常被称作珍珠奶茶。

e.en: He was {popularly} elected to a second term.
e.zh: 他通过普选当选连任。

e.en: Settlers came to {populate} the western frontier.
e.zh: 移民们前来开垦西部边疆。

e.en: The script will {populate} the dropdown with country names.
e.zh: 该脚本会用国家名称填充下拉菜单。

populated.t:
v. populate 的过去式
adj. 已有居民的

e.en: Tokyo is one of the most densely {populated} cities.
e.zh: 东京是人口最稠密的城市之一。

e.en: The form auto-{populated} my address from saved data.
e.zh: 表单根据已保存的资料自动填好了我的地址。

e.en: China's {population} has begun to slowly decline.
e.zh: 中国人口已经开始缓慢下降。

e.en: The deer {population} in the park is growing rapidly.
e.zh: 公园里鹿的数量正在快速增长。

e.en: Bee {populations} are shrinking due to pesticide use.
e.zh: 由于使用农药,蜜蜂数量正在减少。

e.en: Researchers compared the health of two rural {populations}.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了两个农村人口的健康状况。

e.en: Right-wing {populism} has reshaped European politics.
e.zh: 右翼民粹主义重塑了欧洲政治格局。

e.en: His campaign relied on the appeal of economic {populism}.
e.zh: 他的竞选依靠经济民粹主义的号召力。

populist.t:
adj. 民粹的
n. 民粹主义者

e.en: The {populist} candidate promised to fight corrupt elites.
e.zh: 那位民粹主义候选人承诺打击腐败的精英。

e.en: Her speeches use simple {populist} slogans to win voters.
e.zh: 她的演讲用简单的民粹口号来争取选民。

e.en: India is now the world's most {populous} country.
e.zh: 印度如今是世界上人口最多的国家。

e.en: They opened the new store in a {populous} suburb.
e.zh: 他们在一个人口稠密的郊区开了新店。

e.en: In Spanish class we learned that {por} means "for" or "by."
e.zh: 西班牙语课上我们学到 por 意思是"为了"或"通过"。

e.en: She signed the letter "{por} favor" out of habit.
e.zh: 她出于习惯在信末写下了 por favor。

e.en: My grandmother collects delicate {porcelain} teacups from China.
e.zh: 我祖母收藏来自中国的精致瓷茶杯。

e.en: The bathroom has a classic white {porcelain} sink.
e.zh: 浴室里有一个经典的白色瓷质洗手盆。

e.en: We sat on the {porch} watching the rain fall.
e.zh: 我们坐在门廊上看着雨落下。

e.en: The delivery driver left the package on the front {porch}.
e.zh: 快递员把包裹放在了前门廊上。

e.en: Many old Southern homes have wide wraparound {porches}.
e.zh: 许多南方老宅都有宽阔的环绕式门廊。

e.en: Thieves have been stealing packages off {porches} all week.
e.zh: 小偷整周都在从门廊偷快递。

e.en: We took a weekend trip to {Porchester} to see the castle.
e.zh: 我们周末去了波切斯特看那座城堡。

e.en: The old {Porchester} fortress dates back to Roman times.
e.zh: 古老的波切斯特要塞可追溯到罗马时代。

e.en: The cartoon character had distinctly {porcine} features.
e.zh: 这个卡通人物有着明显的猪一样的特征。

e.en: Scientists study {porcine} organs for human transplant research.
e.zh: 科学家研究猪的器官以用于人体移植研究。

e.en: A {porcupine} waddled across the trail at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时一只豪猪摇摇摆摆地穿过小路。

e.en: Don't touch a {porcupine} — its quills are sharp.
e.zh: 别碰豪猪——它的刺非常锋利。

pore.t:
n. 毛孔；气孔
v. 钻研（over）

e.en: This cleanser shrinks the appearance of every {pore}.
e.zh: 这款洁面产品能让每个毛孔看起来更细小。

e.en: Students {pore} over textbooks the night before exams.
e.zh: 学生们在考试前一晚专心研读课本。

e.en: We grilled {pork} chops for dinner last night.
e.zh: 我们昨晚烤了猪排作晚餐。

e.en: Many cultures avoid eating {pork} for religious reasons.
e.zh: 许多文化出于宗教原因不吃猪肉。

e.en: The farmer raised a prize-winning {porker} for the county fair.
e.zh: 农夫养了一头获奖的肥猪准备参加县集市。

e.en: That huge {porker} weighed nearly three hundred pounds.
e.zh: 那头巨大的肥猪重达近三百磅。

porkpie.t: n. 猪肉馅饼；一种圆顶帽

e.en: He wore a stylish {porkpie} hat to the jazz club.
e.zh: 他戴着一顶时髦的平顶圆帽去爵士酒吧。

e.en: The detective's {porkpie} hat became his signature look.
e.zh: 那位侦探的平顶帽成了他的标志性造型。

e.en: The deli sells various {porks}, from bacon to sausage.
e.zh: 这家熟食店出售各种猪肉制品,从培根到香肠。

e.en: Different {porks} require different cooking temperatures.
e.zh: 不同的猪肉部位需要不同的烹饪温度。

e.en: The chef said the sauce tasted too {porky} for fish.
e.zh: 厨师说那酱汁猪肉味太重,不适合搭配鱼。

e.en: He's gotten a bit {porky} since he stopped exercising.
e.zh: 他不再锻炼后变得有点胖乎乎的。

porn.t: n. 色情内容（pornography 缩写）

e.en: The website blocks {porn} on all school networks.
e.zh: 该网站在所有校园网络上屏蔽色情内容。

e.en: Food {porn} fills my Instagram feed every morning.
e.zh: 每天早上我的Instagram上满是诱人的美食图片。

e.en: The cinema used to show {porno} films in the seventies.
e.zh: 这家影院七十年代曾放映色情电影。

e.en: He was embarrassed when his browser opened a {porno} ad.
e.zh: 浏览器弹出色情广告时他十分尴尬。

e.en: The {pornographer} was charged under new obscenity laws.
e.zh: 那名色情制品制作者依据新的猥亵法被起诉。

e.en: She wrote a controversial novel about a 1970s {pornographer}.
e.zh: 她写了一部关于七十年代色情业者的争议小说。

e.en: The site filters out {pornographic} images automatically.
e.zh: 该网站会自动过滤色情图片。

e.en: The film was banned for its {pornographic} content.
e.zh: 这部电影因色情内容被禁。

pornography.t: n. 色情作品；黄色读物

e.en: Many countries have strict laws against child {pornography}.
e.zh: 许多国家有严厉的反儿童色情法律。

e.en: Researchers debate whether {pornography} influences real behavior.
e.zh: 研究人员争论色情作品是否会影响现实行为。

e.en: The {porosity} of the soil affects how well plants grow.
e.zh: 土壤的孔隙度影响植物的生长状况。

e.en: Engineers measured the {porosity} of the new ceramic material.
e.zh: 工程师测量了这种新陶瓷材料的孔隙率。

e.en: Sandstone is {porous}, so water seeps through easily.
e.zh: 砂岩具有多孔性,水很容易渗透过去。

e.en: Critics say the country's borders are too {porous}.
e.zh: 批评人士说该国边境过于松懈易渗透。

e.en: The {porousness} of the membrane lets small molecules pass.
e.zh: 这种膜的多孔性允许小分子通过。

e.en: Geologists tested the rock's {porousness} in the lab.
e.zh: 地质学家在实验室测试了岩石的多孔性。

e.en: A {porpoise} surfaced beside our kayak in the bay.
e.zh: 一只鼠海豚在海湾里浮出我们皮划艇旁。

e.en: The {porpoise} is smaller and shyer than the dolphin.
e.zh: 鼠海豚比海豚体型更小、更害羞。

e.en: I eat oatmeal {porridge} with berries every morning.
e.zh: 我每天早上吃燕麦粥配浆果。

e.en: Goldilocks complained that the {porridge} was too hot.
e.zh: 金发姑娘抱怨那粥太烫了。

porsch.t: n. 保时捷（Porsche 的误拼）

e.en: He misspelled it as {Porsch} instead of Porsche.
e.zh: 他把保时捷拼错成了 Porsch。

e.en: The forum thread mocked posts that wrote "{Porsch}" without the e.
e.zh: 论坛帖子嘲笑那些把保时捷少写一个 e 的人。

e.en: He drives a vintage {Porsche} 911 on weekends.
e.zh: 他周末开一辆复古的保时捷911。

e.en: The new {Porsche} electric model received excellent reviews.
e.zh: 新款保时捷电动车获得了极佳评价。

e.en: The collector owns three classic {Porsches} in his garage.
e.zh: 这位收藏家车库里有三辆经典保时捷。

e.en: Several {Porsches} lined up for the charity rally.
e.zh: 几辆保时捷为慈善拉力赛排成一列。

port.t:
n. 端口；港口
v. 移植（软件）

e.en: The cargo ship docked at the {port} of Singapore.
e.zh: 这艘货船停靠在新加坡港。

e.en: Plug the cable into the USB {port} on the back.
e.zh: 把线插到背面的USB端口里。

e.en: The construction site rented a {porta} potty for workers.
e.zh: 工地为工人租了一个移动厕所。

e.en: In anatomy class we studied the {porta} hepatis of the liver.
e.zh: 在解剖课上我们学习了肝门的结构。

e.en: Laptops are valued for their lightweight {portability}.
e.zh: 笔记本电脑因其轻便的便携性而受到青睐。

e.en: Health insurance {portability} lets you keep coverage between jobs.
e.zh: 医保的可携带性让你换工作时也能保留保障。

portable.t:
adj. 便携的；可移动的
n. 便携设备

e.en: She bought a {portable} charger for her weekend trip.
e.zh: 她为周末旅行买了一个便携式充电器。

e.en: This speaker is small, {portable}, and waterproof.
e.zh: 这个音箱小巧、便携而且防水。

e.en: The school added two {portables} to handle the extra students.
e.zh: 学校加建了两间活动板房教室以容纳多余学生。

e.en: Travel writers recommend lightweight {portables} for long flights.
e.zh: 旅行作家推荐长途飞行时使用轻便的便携设备。

portacabin.t: n. 活动板房；临时组装房屋

e.en: The construction crew set up a {portacabin} as their office.
e.zh: 施工队搭起一个活动板房作为办公室。

e.en: Students had classes in a {portacabin} during renovations.
e.zh: 翻修期间学生们在活动板房里上课。

portage.t:
n. 陆上搬运（船只或货物）
v. 陆路搬运

e.en: We had to {portage} our canoe around the waterfall.
e.zh: 我们不得不把独木舟陆运绕过瀑布。

e.en: The old fur traders made a long {portage} between rivers.
e.zh: 老一辈毛皮商人在两条河之间做长途陆运。

portakabin.t: n. 活动板房（品牌名，泛指临时组装房屋）

e.en: The site office is just a temporary {Portakabin}.
e.zh: 现场办公室只是一个临时活动板房。

e.en: Workers ate lunch inside the cramped {Portakabin}.
e.zh: 工人们在狭小的活动板房里吃午饭。

portal.t:
n. 门户网站；入口
n. 传送门（游戏）

e.en: Log in to the student {portal} to check your grades.
e.zh: 登录学生门户网站查看你的成绩。

e.en: The novel's hero stepped through a magical {portal}.
e.zh: 小说主角穿过了一道魔法之门。

e.en: The castle's iron {portcullis} crashed down to block invaders.
e.zh: 城堡的铁闸门轰然落下挡住入侵者。

e.en: Tourists photographed the medieval {portcullis} at the gate.
e.zh: 游客在门口拍摄那座中世纪的铁闸门。

e.en: The hotel's grand {porte} cochere shielded guests from rain.
e.zh: 酒店宏伟的车道门廊为客人挡雨。

e.en: Historians studied diplomacy with the Ottoman {Porte}.
e.zh: 历史学家研究了与奥斯曼朝廷的外交往来。

ported.t:
v. 移植（软件到其他平台）；携带
adj. 已移植的

e.en: The developer {ported} the game to Nintendo Switch last month.
e.zh: 开发者上个月把这款游戏移植到了任天堂Switch。

e.en: I {ported} my old phone number to the new carrier.
e.zh: 我把旧手机号转移到了新的运营商。

e.en: In old texts {porten} appears as a variant of portend.
e.zh: 在古文献中 porten 作为 portend 的变体出现。

e.en: The dictionary listed {porten} as an archaic spelling.
e.zh: 词典将 porten 列为一种古旧拼法。

portend.t: v. 预示；预兆（多指不祥之事）

e.en: Dark clouds often {portend} a heavy thunderstorm ahead.
e.zh: 乌云往往预示着即将到来的大雷雨。

e.en: Falling sales {portend} trouble for the small business.
e.zh: 销售下滑预示着这家小企业会有麻烦。

e.en: Some grammar books note that {portens} is a rare form.
e.zh: 一些语法书指出 portens 是一种少见的形式。

e.en: The corpus contained no modern uses of {portens}.
e.zh: 语料库中没有 portens 的现代用法。

e.en: The comet was seen as a {portent} of disaster.
e.zh: 那颗彗星被视为灾难的预兆。

e.en: Falling profits are a worrying {portent} for investors.
e.zh: 利润下滑对投资者来说是令人担忧的预兆。

portentous.t:
adj. 不祥的；预示性的
adj. 自命不凡的

e.en: The speech had a {portentous} tone that worried everyone.
e.zh: 那场演讲带着令人不安的预兆性语气。

e.en: Critics found the film's dialogue overly {portentous}.
e.zh: 影评人觉得这部电影的对白过于煞有介事。

portentously.t: adv. 不祥地；煞有介事地

e.en: The narrator spoke {portentously} about the kingdom's fate.
e.zh: 叙述者煞有介事地讲述着王国的命运。

e.en: Thunder rumbled {portentously} as the climbers reached the summit.
e.zh: 登山者登顶时雷声不祥地隆隆作响。

porter.t:
n. 搬运工；门房
n. 黑啤酒

e.en: A {porter} carried our luggage up to the hotel room.
e.zh: 一名行李员把我们的行李搬到了酒店房间。

e.en: She ordered a chocolate {porter} at the craft brewery.
e.zh: 她在精酿啤酒厂点了一杯巧克力波特啤酒。

e.en: He grilled a thick {porterhouse} steak for his birthday.
e.zh: 他生日时烤了一块厚厚的上等腰肉牛排。

e.en: The steakhouse is famous for its 32-ounce {porterhouse}.
e.zh: 这家牛排馆以32盎司的上等腰肉牛排闻名。

e.en: He earned extra cash {portering} bags at the train station.
e.zh: 他在火车站搬运行李挣外快。

e.en: The hotel offers free {portering} for arriving guests.
e.zh: 酒店为入住客人提供免费的行李搬运服务。

portfolio.t:
n. 作品集；投资组合
n. 公文包

e.en: She updated her design {portfolio} before the job interview.
e.zh: 她在面试前更新了自己的设计作品集。

e.en: Diversify your investment {portfolio} to manage risk.
e.zh: 分散你的投资组合以管理风险。

portfolios.t: n. 作品集；投资组合（复数）

e.en: Top design schools require strong {portfolios} from applicants.
e.zh: 顶尖设计院校要求申请者提交优秀的作品集。

e.en: Their {portfolios} survived the market crash surprisingly well.
e.zh: 他们的投资组合在市场崩盘中保持得出奇地好。

porthcawl.t: n. 波斯考尔（英国威尔士地名）

e.en: We spent the weekend surfing in {Porthcawl}, Wales.
e.zh: 我们在威尔士的波斯考尔冲浪度过了周末。

e.en: {Porthcawl} hosts a famous Elvis festival every September.
e.zh: 波斯考尔每年九月举办著名的猫王音乐节。

e.en: She gazed out the {porthole} at the endless blue ocean.
e.zh: 她透过舷窗凝视着一望无际的蓝色海洋。

e.en: A small {porthole} let sunlight into the cramped cabin.
e.zh: 一个小舷窗将阳光透进狭窄的船舱。

e.en: In the play, {Portia} disguises herself as a young lawyer.
e.zh: 剧中，鲍西娅乔装成一位年轻的律师。

e.en: My friend named her daughter {Portia} after the Shakespeare character.
e.zh: 我朋友以莎士比亚笔下的角色给女儿取名鲍西娅。

portico.t: n. 门廊；有柱廊的入口

e.en: We sheltered from the rain under the marble {portico}.
e.zh: 我们在大理石门廊下躲雨。

e.en: The mansion's grand {portico} features six towering columns.
e.zh: 这座大宅气派的门廊有六根高耸的石柱。

portion.t:
n. 一部分；一份
v. 分配

e.en: A large {portion} of my salary goes to rent.
e.zh: 我工资的一大部分都用来交房租了。

e.en: The restaurant serves a generous {portion} of pasta.
e.zh: 这家餐厅的意面分量很足。

e.en: Please divide the cake into eight equal {portions}.
e.zh: 请把蛋糕分成八等份。

e.en: Large {portions} of the forest were destroyed by fire.
e.zh: 森林的大片区域被火灾摧毁。

e.en: We flew to {Portland} for the food festival last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们飞到波特兰参加美食节。

e.en: {Portland} is famous for its coffee shops and craft beer.
e.zh: 波特兰以咖啡馆和精酿啤酒闻名。

e.en: A {portly} gentleman in a tweed suit greeted us warmly.
e.zh: 一位穿粗花呢西装的微胖绅士热情地迎接我们。

e.en: The {portly} chef laughed loudly at his own joke.
e.zh: 那位身材富态的厨师为自己的笑话开怀大笑。

portmanteau.t:
n. 混成词（如 brunch）
n. 大旅行箱

e.en: "Brunch" is a {portmanteau} of breakfast and lunch.
e.zh: "Brunch"是breakfast和lunch合成的混合词。

e.en: She packed her old leather {portmanteau} for the trip.
e.zh: 她为这次旅行收拾好了那只旧皮箱。

porto.t: n. 波尔图（葡萄牙城市）

e.en: We tasted vintage wines along the river in {Porto}.
e.zh: 我们在波尔图沿河品尝了陈年葡萄酒。

e.en: {Porto} is known for its colorful riverside houses.
e.zh: 波尔图以色彩缤纷的河畔房屋而闻名。

portobello.t: n. 大褐菇（一种大型蘑菇）

e.en: I grilled a {portobello} mushroom for my veggie burger.
e.zh: 我烤了一个大褐菇做素食汉堡。

e.en: The chef stuffed each {portobello} with cheese and herbs.
e.zh: 主厨在每个大褐菇里塞满了奶酪和香草。

portrait.t:
n. 肖像；画像
n. 竖屏（屏幕方向）

e.en: She painted a stunning {portrait} of her grandmother.
e.zh: 她为奶奶画了一幅惊艳的肖像。

e.en: Switch your phone to {portrait} mode for better selfies.
e.zh: 把手机切到竖屏模式，自拍效果更好。

e.en: The royal {portraitist} captured every detail of the queen's gown.
e.zh: 那位皇室肖像画家细致地描绘了女王礼服的每个细节。

e.en: As a {portraitist}, she specialized in painting children.
e.zh: 作为肖像画家，她专门画儿童。

e.en: The gallery displayed dozens of family {portraits} from the 1800s.
e.zh: 画廊展出了数十幅十九世纪的家庭肖像。

e.en: He takes professional headshot {portraits} for LinkedIn profiles.
e.zh: 他为领英资料拍摄专业头像。

portraiture.t: n. 肖像画艺术；人像摄影

e.en: She studied classical {portraiture} at the art academy.
e.zh: 她在艺术学院学习古典肖像画。

e.en: Modern {portraiture} often blends photography and digital effects.
e.zh: 现代肖像艺术常将摄影与数码效果相结合。

e.en: The museum exhibits various {portraitures} from different cultures.
e.zh: 博物馆展出来自不同文化的各种肖像艺术作品。

e.en: His collection of Renaissance {portraitures} drew huge crowds.
e.zh: 他收藏的文艺复兴肖像画吸引了大批观众。

e.en: The film tries to {portray} ordinary life in rural China.
e.zh: 这部电影试图描绘中国乡村的日常生活。

e.en: She was chosen to {portray} the queen in the new series.
e.zh: 她被选中在新剧中饰演女王。

e.en: His {portrayal} of the villain earned him an Oscar nomination.
e.zh: 他对反派的演绎为他赢得了奥斯卡提名。

e.en: The novel offers a vivid {portrayal} of wartime Berlin.
e.zh: 这部小说生动地描绘了战时的柏林。

e.en: Media {portrayals} of teenagers often feel unrealistic.
e.zh: 媒体对青少年的描绘往往不切实际。

e.en: Her {portrayals} of historical figures are remarkably nuanced.
e.zh: 她对历史人物的演绎极具细腻层次。

e.en: The documentary {portrayed} him as a misunderstood genius.
e.zh: 这部纪录片把他描绘成一位被误解的天才。

e.en: She {portrayed} the lead role with surprising emotional depth.
e.zh: 她对主角的演绎情感深度令人惊叹。

e.en: The artist enjoys {portraying} ordinary people on the street.
e.zh: 这位艺术家喜欢描绘街头的普通人。

e.en: She won acclaim for {portraying} a struggling immigrant mother.
e.zh: 她因饰演一位艰难求生的移民母亲而广受赞誉。

portrays.t: v. 描绘；刻画（第三人称单数）

e.en: The novel {portrays} New York in the 1920s vividly.
e.zh: 这部小说生动地描绘了二十年代的纽约。

e.en: He {portrays} the detective with quiet intensity.
e.zh: 他以内敛的张力诠释了那位侦探。

portrush.t: n. 波特拉什（北爱尔兰地名）

e.en: We watched the Open Championship at {Portrush} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们在波特拉什观看了英国公开赛。

e.en: {Portrush} has some of the best beaches in Northern Ireland.
e.zh: 波特拉什拥有北爱尔兰最美的海滩之一。

ports.t:
n. 端口（网络/接口）；港口
v. 移植（软件）

e.en: Most laptops now have only two USB-C {ports}.
e.zh: 现在大多数笔记本电脑只有两个 USB-C 接口。

e.en: Container ships dock at major {ports} along the coast.
e.zh: 集装箱船停靠在沿海的主要港口。

portsmouth.t: n. 朴茨茅斯（英国港口城市）

e.en: The naval base in {Portsmouth} dates back centuries.
e.zh: 朴茨茅斯的海军基地有着数百年的历史。

e.en: We took a ferry from {Portsmouth} across the Channel.
e.zh: 我们从朴茨茅斯坐渡轮穿越英吉利海峡。

e.en: We spent two weeks exploring the beaches of {Portugal}.
e.zh: 我们花了两周时间游览葡萄牙的海滩。

e.en: {Portugal} is famous for its custard tarts and port wine.
e.zh: 葡萄牙以蛋挞和波特酒闻名。

portuguese.t:
adj. 葡萄牙的
n. 葡萄牙人；葡萄牙语

e.en: She speaks fluent {Portuguese} after living in Lisbon.
e.zh: 在里斯本生活后她葡萄牙语说得很流利。

e.en: The recipe calls for traditional {Portuguese} sausage.
e.zh: 这道食谱需要传统的葡萄牙香肠。

pos.t:
n. 销售点（point of sale 缩写）
n. 词性（part of speech）

e.en: The cafe upgraded its {POS} system to accept mobile payments.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆升级了收银系统以支持移动支付。

e.en: Every {POS} terminal in the store crashed this morning.
e.zh: 今早店里所有的收银终端都崩溃了。

e.en: We stayed at a charming family-run {posada} in Mexico.
e.zh: 我们住在墨西哥一家温馨的家族经营小旅馆。

e.en: The {posada} served homemade tortillas every morning.
e.zh: 那家小客栈每天早上供应自制玉米饼。

pose.t:
v. 摆姿势；造成（威胁）
n. 姿势

e.en: Hold that {pose} while I take the photo.
e.zh: 保持这个姿势，我来拍照。

e.en: Climate change continues to {pose} a serious threat globally.
e.zh: 气候变化仍对全球构成严重威胁。

posed.t: v. 摆姿势（过去式）；造成（问题）

e.en: The kids {posed} happily in front of the Christmas tree.
e.zh: 孩子们开心地在圣诞树前摆姿势拍照。

e.en: The new policy {posed} unexpected challenges for small businesses.
e.zh: 新政策给小企业带来了意想不到的挑战。

e.en: In Greek mythology, {Poseidon} ruled the seas with his trident.
e.zh: 在希腊神话中，波塞冬手持三叉戟统治海洋。

e.en: The temple of {Poseidon} stands dramatically on the cliff.
e.zh: 波塞冬神庙巍然屹立在悬崖之上。

poser.t:
n. 装腔作势的人
n. 难题

e.en: He's a total {poser} who pretends to love jazz.
e.zh: 他完全是个装腔作势的人，假装喜欢爵士乐。

e.en: That last exam question was a real {poser}.
e.zh: 考试的最后一道题真是个棘手的难题。

poses.t:
n. 姿势（复数）
v. 摆姿势；造成

e.en: The model {poses} elegantly for the fashion magazine.
e.zh: 模特优雅地为时尚杂志摆姿势。

e.en: Smoking {poses} serious risks to your long-term health.
e.zh: 吸烟会对长期健康构成严重威胁。

e.en: Critics dismissed him as a literary {poseur}.
e.zh: 评论家把他看作一个装模作样的文学骗子。

e.en: Don't trust that {poseur} who claims to know everyone famous.
e.zh: 别相信那个自称认识所有名人的装腔作势者。

posh.t: adj. 高档的；时髦奢华的

e.en: They had dinner at a {posh} restaurant in Mayfair.
e.zh: 他们在梅菲尔区一家高档餐厅吃晚餐。

e.en: Her accent sounds incredibly {posh} to my American ears.
e.zh: 她的口音在我这个美国人听来非常上流。

e.en: The skater landed a clean {posi} grind on the rail.
e.zh: 滑手在栏杆上干净利落地完成了一个正向滑行。

e.en: Vibes at the show were super {posi} all night.
e.zh: 那场演出整晚的氛围都超级正能量。

posing.t: v. 摆姿势；造成（现在分词）

e.en: She caught him {posing} in front of the bathroom mirror.
e.zh: 她撞见他在浴室镜子前摆造型。

e.en: Someone is {posing} as a bank employee in phishing emails.
e.zh: 有人在钓鱼邮件中冒充银行员工。

e.en: Scientists {posit} that dark matter shapes the entire universe.
e.zh: 科学家们假设暗物质塑造了整个宇宙。

e.en: The author tries to {posit} a new theory of consciousness.
e.zh: 作者试图提出一种新的意识理论。

e.en: Einstein {posited} that time and space are deeply connected.
e.zh: 爱因斯坦提出时间和空间紧密相连。

e.en: The researchers {posited} a link between sleep and memory.
e.zh: 研究人员推测睡眠与记忆之间存在关联。

e.en: The paper is {positing} a radical new economic model.
e.zh: 这篇论文提出了一种激进的新经济模型。

e.en: She kept {positing} bold theories without much evidence.
e.zh: 她不断提出大胆的理论却缺乏充分证据。

position.t:
n. 位置；职位；立场
v. 放置；定位

e.en: She got promoted to a senior management {position} last month.
e.zh: 她上个月升任高级管理职位。

e.en: Please {position} the camera closer to the window.
e.zh: 请把摄像头放得离窗户近一些。

e.en: The argument depends on the {positional} order of the words.
e.zh: 这种语义取决于词语的位置顺序。

e.en: Football players train for their specific {positional} roles.
e.zh: 足球运动员针对各自的位置角色进行训练。

e.en: The startup is well {positioned} to enter the Asian market.
e.zh: 这家初创公司已做好进军亚洲市场的准备。

e.en: She {positioned} the lamp directly above her desk.
e.zh: 她把台灯摆放在书桌正上方。

e.en: The clear aligner acts as a {positioner} for misaligned teeth.
e.zh: 这种透明牙套可作为错位牙齿的矫正定位器。

e.en: Engineers installed a precise {positioner} on the robotic arm.
e.zh: 工程师在机械臂上安装了精密的定位器。

positioning.t:
n. 定位
v. 放置（现在分词）

e.en: The brand's {positioning} targets eco-conscious millennials.
e.zh: 该品牌的市场定位瞄准注重环保的千禧一代。

e.en: He's carefully {positioning} himself for the upcoming election.
e.zh: 他正在为即将到来的选举精心布局。

positions.t:
n. 位置；职位（复数）
v. 放置

e.en: The company is hiring for several remote engineering {positions}.
e.zh: 公司正在招聘多个远程工程职位。

e.en: Yoga {positions} can really help with chronic back pain.
e.zh: 瑜伽体式对慢性背痛很有帮助。

positive.t:
adj. 积极的；肯定的；正的
n. 正数；阳性

e.en: Try to stay {positive} even when things get tough.
e.zh: 即使情况艰难，也要尽量保持积极心态。

e.en: Her COVID test came back {positive} this morning.
e.zh: 她今早的新冠检测结果呈阳性。

e.en: The audience responded {positively} to the new product launch.
e.zh: 观众对新产品发布反应积极。

e.en: I {positively} cannot eat another bite of cake.
e.zh: 我真的一口蛋糕都吃不下了。

e.en: Her {positiveness} lifts everyone's mood at the office.
e.zh: 她的乐观让办公室里每个人的心情都好起来。

e.en: The team's {positiveness} carried them through tough setbacks.
e.zh: 团队的积极心态帮他们度过了艰难的挫折。

positives.t: n. 积极因素；阳性结果（复数）

e.en: Try focusing on the {positives} instead of dwelling on mistakes.
e.zh: 试着关注积极面，而不是纠结于错误。

e.en: The lab reported several false {positives} this week.
e.zh: 实验室本周报告了几例假阳性结果。

e.en: Auguste Comte founded {positivism} as a philosophy of science.
e.zh: 奥古斯特·孔德创立了实证主义这一科学哲学。

e.en: Legal {positivism} separates law from moral judgment entirely.
e.zh: 法律实证主义将法律与道德判断完全分开。

positivist.t:
n. 实证主义者
adj. 实证主义的

e.en: He took a strict {positivist} approach to social research.
e.zh: 他对社会研究采取了严格的实证主义方法。

e.en: The {positivist} insists that only observable facts count.
e.zh: 这位实证主义者坚持认为只有可观察的事实才算数。

e.en: Her {positivistic} methods relied heavily on measurable data.
e.zh: 她那套实证主义方法非常依赖可测量的数据。

e.en: Critics rejected the {positivistic} view of human behavior.
e.zh: 批评者否定了对人类行为的实证主义看法。

e.en: Her {positivity} brightens the whole office every morning.
e.zh: 她的乐观每天早晨都让整个办公室亮起来。

e.en: Toxic {positivity} can make people hide real struggles.
e.zh: 过度的正能量会让人们隐藏真实的困境。

e.en: A {positron} is the antimatter counterpart of an electron.
e.zh: 正电子是电子的反物质对应粒子。

e.en: PET scans detect gamma rays from {positron} annihilation.
e.zh: PET扫描通过探测正电子湮灭产生的伽马射线成像。

posits.t: v. 假定；断定（第三人称单数）

e.en: The theory {posits} that consciousness emerges from complexity.
e.zh: 该理论假定意识源自复杂性。

e.en: She {posits} a direct link between sleep and creativity.
e.zh: 她假设睡眠与创造力之间存在直接联系。

e.en: Text me ASAP, soon as {poss}, okay?
e.zh: 尽快给我发短信,越快越好,好吗?

e.en: I'll come over as soon as {poss} after work.
e.zh: 下班后我会尽快赶过来。

e.en: The sheriff gathered a {posse} to chase the outlaws.
e.zh: 警长召集了一队人马去追捕逃犯。

e.en: She arrived at the party with her whole {posse}.
e.zh: 她带着她的一群好友来到了派对。

possess.t: v. 拥有；占有；（情绪）支配

e.en: Few people {possess} both talent and discipline.
e.zh: 很少有人同时拥有天赋与自律。

e.en: You must {possess} a valid passport to board.
e.zh: 你必须持有有效护照才能登机。

possessed.t:
adj. 着魔的；被控制的
v. 拥有（过去式）

e.en: He fought like a man {possessed} until the final whistle.
e.zh: 他像着了魔一样拼到终场哨响。

e.en: She {possessed} a rare gift for languages.
e.zh: 她有着罕见的语言天赋。

possesses.t: v. 拥有（第三人称单数）

e.en: This phone {possesses} the best camera on the market.
e.zh: 这款手机拥有市面上最好的相机。

e.en: He {possesses} a calm that nothing seems to shake.
e.zh: 他有一种似乎什么都动摇不了的沉着。

e.en: {Possessing} stolen goods is a serious offense.
e.zh: 持有赃物是严重的犯罪行为。

e.en: She is known for {possessing} an extraordinary memory.
e.zh: 她以拥有非凡的记忆力而闻名。

possession.t: n. 拥有；所有物；（球类）控球

e.en: Police found drugs in his {possession} during the search.
e.zh: 警方在搜查中发现他持有毒品。

e.en: The team kept {possession} for most of the half.
e.zh: 该队在半场大部分时间里都控制着球权。

e.en: She packed her {possessions} into two small suitcases.
e.zh: 她把自己的财物装进了两个小行李箱。

e.en: Fire destroyed nearly all of their {possessions}.
e.zh: 大火几乎毁掉了他们所有的财物。

possessive.t:
adj. 占有欲强的
n. 所有格

e.en: He gets really {possessive} when other guys talk to her.
e.zh: 别的男生跟她说话时,他会变得非常占有欲强。

e.en: "My" and "your" are {possessive} pronouns in English.
e.zh: 在英语中,"my"和"your"是物主代词。

e.en: He held her hand {possessively} throughout the dinner.
e.zh: 整顿晚饭他都占有性地握着她的手。

e.en: The dog growled {possessively} over its bone.
e.zh: 那只狗护食般地对着骨头低吼。

e.en: His {possessiveness} eventually drove her out of the relationship.
e.zh: 他的占有欲最终把她逼出了这段感情。

e.en: A little jealousy is normal, but {possessiveness} is unhealthy.
e.zh: 一点嫉妒是正常的,但占有欲过强就不健康了。

e.en: She is the proud {possessor} of three Olympic medals.
e.zh: 她自豪地拥有三枚奥运奖牌。

e.en: The current {possessor} of the title will defend it Saturday.
e.zh: 目前的卫冕者将在周六进行冠军卫冕赛。

e.en: The {possessors} of the rare cards can sell them online.
e.zh: 持有这些稀有卡牌的人可以在网上出售它们。

e.en: Only a few {possessors} of the original recording remain.
e.zh: 原始录音的持有者只剩下寥寥数人。

e.en: The tenant filed a {possessory} claim against the landlord.
e.zh: 租客对房东提出了占有权主张。

e.en: He has a {possessory} interest but not full ownership.
e.zh: 他享有占有权益,但并非完全所有权。

e.en: This new technology opens up endless {possibilities}.
e.zh: 这项新技术开辟了无限的可能性。

e.en: We discussed several {possibilities} before making a decision.
e.zh: 我们在做决定之前讨论了几种可能性。

e.en: There's a strong {possibility} of rain tomorrow afternoon.
e.zh: 明天下午很有可能下雨。

e.en: We can't rule out the {possibility} of a recession.
e.zh: 我们不能排除经济衰退的可能性。

e.en: Please reply as soon as {possible}.
e.zh: 请尽快回复。

e.en: Is it {possible} to change my flight to Friday?
e.zh: 我能把航班改到周五吗?

e.en: He couldn't {possibly} have finished the report so quickly.
e.zh: 他不可能这么快就写完这份报告。

e.en: The package will arrive Thursday, or {possibly} Friday.
e.zh: 包裹会在周四送到,也可能是周五。

e.en: A {possum} was rummaging through our trash last night.
e.zh: 昨晚有一只负鼠在翻我们的垃圾桶。

e.en: When threatened, the animal plays {possum} to survive.
e.zh: 受到威胁时,这种动物会装死以求生存。

post.t:
n. 帖子；邮件；职位
v. 发布；邮寄

e.en: She decided to {post} the photos on Instagram tonight.
e.zh: 她决定今晚把这些照片发到Instagram上。

e.en: The letter arrived in the morning {post}.
e.zh: 那封信是早上邮递时送到的。

e.en: The {post-war} economy boomed throughout the 1950s.
e.zh: 战后经济在整个二十世纪五十年代蓬勃发展。

e.en: Many {post-war} novels deal with trauma and loss.
e.zh: 许多战后小说都在书写创伤与失去。

e.en: International {postage} has gone up again this year.
e.zh: 国际邮资今年又涨价了。

e.en: Don't forget to add {postage} before mailing the envelope.
e.zh: 寄信封之前别忘了贴邮票。

e.en: The {postal} service delivers packages even on Sundays now.
e.zh: 邮政现在连周日也派送包裹了。

e.en: Please write your full {postal} address on the form.
e.zh: 请在表格上填写完整的邮寄地址。

e.en: The surgeon made a small {postauricular} incision behind the ear.
e.zh: 外科医生在耳后做了一个小的耳后切口。

e.en: Swollen {postauricular} lymph nodes can indicate infection.
e.zh: 耳后淋巴结肿大可能提示感染。

e.en: The show received a huge {postbag} after the finale aired.
e.zh: 节目大结局播出后收到了大量来信。

e.en: The editor sifted through the morning {postbag}.
e.zh: 编辑翻阅着早上送来的一大袋信件。

e.en: She dropped the letter into the red {postbox} on the corner.
e.zh: 她把信投进了街角那个红色邮筒里。

e.en: The {postbox} is emptied twice a day on weekdays.
e.zh: 工作日邮筒每天会被取信两次。

e.en: He sent me a {postcard} from Kyoto last week.
e.zh: 他上周从京都给我寄了一张明信片。

e.en: The view was like something from a {postcard}.
e.zh: 那景色就像明信片上的画面一样。

e.en: She collects vintage {postcards} from European cities.
e.zh: 她收集来自欧洲各城市的复古明信片。

e.en: Tourists were buying {postcards} outside the cathedral.
e.zh: 游客们在大教堂外面买明信片。

e.en: The {postclassic} period saw the rise of the Aztec empire.
e.zh: 后古典时期见证了阿兹特克帝国的兴起。

e.en: Archaeologists studied pottery from the {postclassic} era.
e.zh: 考古学家研究了后古典时期的陶器。

e.en: Please enter your {postcode} to find the nearest store.
e.zh: 请输入你的邮编以查找最近的门店。

e.en: Healthcare quality often depends on your {postcode}.
e.zh: 医疗水平的好坏往往取决于你住在哪个邮编区。

e.en: She teaches {postcolonial} literature at the university.
e.zh: 她在大学里教授后殖民文学。

e.en: {Postcolonial} theory critiques lasting effects of empire.
e.zh: 后殖民理论批判帝国主义的持久影响。

postdate.t: v. 把日期填迟；晚于……发生

e.en: Don't {postdate} the check or the bank may reject it.
e.zh: 不要把支票日期填到以后,否则银行可能拒收。

e.en: These ruins {postdate} the earlier temple by centuries.
e.zh: 这些遗迹比之前的神庙晚了好几个世纪。

e.en: She landed a {postdoc} position at MIT after graduation.
e.zh: 毕业后她在麻省理工拿到了一个博士后职位。

e.en: Most {postdoc} contracts last only two or three years.
e.zh: 大多数博士后合同只有两到三年。

e.en: He is doing {postdoctoral} research on quantum computing.
e.zh: 他正在从事量子计算方面的博士后研究。

e.en: The lab hired three new {postdoctoral} fellows this fall.
e.zh: 实验室今年秋天新招了三名博士后研究员。

posted.t: v. 已发布；已邮寄（post 的过去式）

e.en: She {posted} a photo of her dog this morning.
e.zh: 她今早发了一张自家狗狗的照片。

e.en: I {posted} the package yesterday, so it should arrive soon.
e.zh: 我昨天把包裹寄出了,应该很快就到。

e.en: A movie {poster} hung above his bed for years.
e.zh: 一张电影海报在他床头挂了好多年。

e.en: They printed a {poster} to advertise the school play.
e.zh: 他们印了一张海报来宣传学校话剧。

posterior.t:
adj. 后部的；靠后的
n. 臀部

e.en: The pain is concentrated in the {posterior} of the knee.
e.zh: 疼痛集中在膝盖的后侧。

e.en: She landed flat on her {posterior} after slipping.
e.zh: 她滑了一跤,屁股结结实实地着了地。

e.en: The tumor had spread {posteriorly} toward the spine.
e.zh: 肿瘤已经向后扩散到脊柱方向。

e.en: The muscle attaches {posteriorly} to the shoulder blade.
e.zh: 该肌肉在后方附着于肩胛骨。

e.en: Different {posterities} will judge our era in different ways.
e.zh: 不同的后世子孙会以不同方式评价我们这个时代。

e.en: The artifacts were preserved for future {posterities} to study.
e.zh: 这些文物被保存下来,留给后世研究。

e.en: He kept a journal for {posterity} to read.
e.zh: 他写日记是为了留给后人去读。

e.en: This footage will be preserved for {posterity}.
e.zh: 这段影像将被保存下来留给后世。

e.en: The knights escaped through a hidden {postern} in the wall.
e.zh: 骑士们从城墙上一道隐蔽的小后门逃了出去。

e.en: A narrow {postern} led to the castle's herb garden.
e.zh: 一道狭窄的后门通往城堡的香草园。

e.en: Concert {posters} covered every wall of the dorm room.
e.zh: 演唱会海报贴满了宿舍的每一面墙。

e.en: Volunteers put up campaign {posters} all over town.
e.zh: 志愿者们在全城张贴了竞选海报。

e.en: The show was praised for its {postfeminist} sensibility.
e.zh: 这部剧因其后女性主义的视角而广受好评。

e.en: She critiques {postfeminist} ideas in popular culture.
e.zh: 她在批判流行文化中的后女性主义观念。

postgraduate.t:
n. 研究生
adj. 研究生的

e.en: He is pursuing a {postgraduate} degree in economics.
e.zh: 他正在攻读经济学的研究生学位。

e.en: Many {postgraduate} students work as teaching assistants.
e.zh: 许多研究生都在做助教工作。

e.en: He dug a deep {posthole} for the new fence.
e.zh: 他为新围栏挖了一个很深的柱坑。

e.en: The farmer rented a {posthole} digger for the weekend.
e.zh: 那位农夫周末租了一台挖柱坑机。

e.en: The author received a {posthumous} award for her novel.
e.zh: 这位作家因她的小说获得了一项追授奖项。

e.en: His {posthumous} album became an instant classic.
e.zh: 他去世后发行的专辑立刻成为经典。

e.en: The medal was {posthumously} awarded to the brave soldier.
e.zh: 那枚勋章被追授给这位勇敢的士兵。

e.en: Her diary was {posthumously} published last year.
e.zh: 她的日记于去年在她身后出版。

posting.t:
n. 帖子；职位任命
v. 发布中

e.en: I saw your {posting} about the apartment online.
e.zh: 我在网上看到你发的那则公寓帖子。

e.en: She is {posting} updates on social media every hour.
e.zh: 她每小时都在社交媒体上发更新。

e.en: The {postman} delivers our mail every morning.
e.zh: 邮递员每天早上送我们的邮件。

e.en: I tipped the {postman} during the holidays.
e.zh: 我在假期给邮递员了点小费。

postmark.t:
n. 邮戳
v. 盖邮戳

e.en: The {postmark} on the envelope showed it came from Paris.
e.zh: 信封上的邮戳显示它来自巴黎。

e.en: Entries must have a {postmark} dated before Friday.
e.zh: 参赛作品的邮戳日期必须早于星期五。

e.en: The {postmaster} sorted the packages behind the counter.
e.zh: 邮政局长在柜台后面整理包裹。

e.en: She was promoted to {postmaster} of the small town.
e.zh: 她被提升为这个小镇的邮政局长。

e.en: Several {postmen} were delayed by the heavy snowstorm.
e.zh: 好几位邮递员都被大雪暴耽搁了。

e.en: The {postmen} gather at the depot before sunrise.
e.zh: 邮递员们在日出前到邮局集合。

e.en: The village {postmistress} knew everyone by name.
e.zh: 村里的女邮政局长能叫出每个人的名字。

e.en: She served as {postmistress} for over thirty years.
e.zh: 她担任女邮政局长超过三十年。

e.en: The novel uses many {postmodern} narrative tricks.
e.zh: 这部小说运用了许多后现代主义的叙事技巧。

e.en: Their gallery features {postmodern} architecture and art.
e.zh: 他们的画廊以后现代风格的建筑与艺术为特色。

e.en: {Postmodernism} questioned the idea of a single universal truth.
e.zh: 后现代主义质疑存在唯一普遍真理这一观念。

e.en: She wrote her thesis on {postmodernism} in cinema.
e.zh: 她写了一篇关于电影中后现代主义的论文。

postmodernist.t:
n. 后现代主义者
adj. 后现代主义的

e.en: The {postmodernist} writer plays with form and irony.
e.zh: 这位后现代主义作家在形式和反讽上玩花样。

e.en: Critics call the building boldly {postmodernist}.
e.zh: 评论家称这栋建筑大胆地具有后现代主义风格。

postmortem.t:
n. 尸检；事后复盘
adj. 死后的

e.en: The team held a {postmortem} after the failed launch.
e.zh: 团队在发布失败后进行了一次复盘会。

e.en: The {postmortem} revealed she died of natural causes.
e.zh: 尸检显示她死于自然原因。

e.en: She attended {postnatal} classes to learn about newborn care.
e.zh: 她参加了产后课程,学习如何照顾新生儿。

e.en: {Postnatal} depression affects many new mothers.
e.zh: 产后抑郁影响着许多刚生产的母亲。

e.en: The {postoperative} pain faded after a few days.
e.zh: 术后的疼痛几天后就消退了。

e.en: Nurses monitor patients during {postoperative} recovery.
e.zh: 护士在术后恢复期间监护病人。

e.en: Patients are usually monitored {postoperatively} for infection.
e.zh: 病人通常在术后会被监测是否感染。

e.en: She felt much better {postoperatively} than expected.
e.zh: 她术后感觉比预期好得多。

e.en: Many women experience {postpartum} mood changes.
e.zh: 许多女性会经历产后情绪波动。

e.en: Her {postpartum} checkup went smoothly last week.
e.zh: 她上周的产后检查很顺利。

postpon.t: v. 推迟（postpone 的拼写变体）

e.en: He misspelled {postpon} when he meant postpone.
e.zh: 他想写 postpone 却拼成了 postpon。

e.en: The form had a typo reading {postpon} instead of postpone.
e.zh: 表格上有个拼写错误,把 postpone 写成了 postpon。

e.en: We had to {postpone} the meeting until next Monday.
e.zh: 我们不得不把会议推迟到下周一。

e.en: Bad weather forced organizers to {postpone} the concert.
e.zh: 恶劣天气迫使主办方推迟音乐会。

postponed.t: v. 已推迟（postpone 的过去式）

e.en: The flight was {postponed} due to thick fog.
e.zh: 航班因浓雾被推迟了。

e.en: They {postponed} the wedding by two months.
e.zh: 他们把婚礼推迟了两个月。

e.en: The {postponement} of the trial frustrated the victims.
e.zh: 审判的延期让受害者们感到失望。

e.en: Fans complained about the latest {postponement} of the tour.
e.zh: 歌迷们对巡演再次延期表示不满。

postpones.t: v. 推迟（第三人称单数）

e.en: He always {postpones} difficult conversations until later.
e.zh: 他总是把难谈的话题往后拖。

e.en: The league {postpones} games whenever lightning is nearby.
e.zh: 附近一有闪电,联盟就会延期比赛。

e.en: Stop {postponing} your dental appointment any longer.
e.zh: 别再拖着你的牙科预约了。

e.en: They are {postponing} the launch to fix bugs.
e.zh: 他们推迟发布以修复漏洞。

e.en: A short {postprandial} walk helps with digestion.
e.zh: 饭后散一会儿步有助于消化。

e.en: She measured her {postprandial} blood sugar daily.
e.zh: 她每天测量饭后血糖。

posts.t:
n. 帖子；岗位
v. 发布

e.en: She {posts} new recipes on her blog every weekend.
e.zh: 她每个周末都在博客上发新菜谱。

e.en: The fence {posts} were rotting at the base.
e.zh: 围栏的柱子底部正在腐烂。

e.en: She added a quick {postscript} at the end of the letter.
e.zh: 她在信末加了一段简短的附言。

e.en: The book includes a {postscript} written years later.
e.zh: 这本书附有一段多年后写的后记。

postseason.t:
n. 季后赛
adj. 赛季后的

e.en: The team narrowly qualified for the {postseason} this year.
e.zh: 球队今年勉强进入了季后赛。

e.en: Fans love the intensity of {postseason} basketball.
e.zh: 球迷们喜爱季后赛篮球的紧张激烈。

postsecondary.t: adj. 高中以后的，高等教育的

e.en: Many jobs now require some {postsecondary} education.
e.zh: 许多工作现在要求接受过高中以上教育。

e.en: She enrolled in a {postsecondary} nursing program.
e.zh: 她报读了一项高中后护理课程。

e.en: Her essay applies {poststructural} theory to popular music.
e.zh: 她的文章把后结构主义理论应用于流行音乐。

e.en: The seminar focused on {poststructural} readings of the text.
e.zh: 研讨会聚焦于对文本的后结构主义解读。

e.en: {Poststructuralism} challenged fixed meanings in language.
e.zh: 后结构主义挑战了语言中固定意义的观念。

e.en: He teaches a course on {poststructuralism} and film.
e.zh: 他教一门关于后结构主义与电影的课程。

poststructuralist.t:
n. 后结构主义者
adj. 后结构主义的

e.en: The {poststructuralist} critic rejected stable interpretations.
e.zh: 这位后结构主义批评家拒绝接受稳定的诠释。

e.en: Her {poststructuralist} approach unsettled many readers.
e.zh: 她的后结构主义方法让许多读者感到困惑。

e.en: The {postsurgical} swelling went down within a week.
e.zh: 术后的肿胀一周内就消下去了。

e.en: Doctors recommend gentle exercise during {postsurgical} recovery.
e.zh: 医生建议在术后恢复期做温和的运动。

e.en: The drug binds to {postsynaptic} receptors in the brain.
e.zh: 该药物与大脑中的突触后受体结合。

e.en: Researchers studied the {postsynaptic} response to dopamine.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了突触后对多巴胺的反应。

e.en: Students completed a {posttest} to measure what they learned.
e.zh: 学生完成后测来评估他们学到的内容。

e.en: Scores improved sharply on the {posttest}.
e.zh: 后测的成绩有了大幅提高。

postulant.t: n. 申请者；（修会）志愿者

e.en: The young {postulant} hoped to join the convent next year.
e.zh: 这位年轻的志愿修女希望明年加入修道院。

e.en: Each {postulant} spends a year studying before taking vows.
e.zh: 每位志愿修士在宣誓前会先学习一年。

postulate.t:
v. 假定，假设
n. 公设，基本假设

e.en: Scientists {postulate} that dark matter shapes galaxies.
e.zh: 科学家们假设暗物质塑造了星系的形态。

e.en: The geometry begins with a simple {postulate} about lines.
e.zh: 这门几何学从一个关于直线的简单公设开始。

postulated.t:
v. 假定（过去式）
adj. 被假设的

e.en: Einstein {postulated} that the speed of light is constant.
e.zh: 爱因斯坦假定光速是恒定的。

e.en: The author {postulated} a connection between diet and mood.
e.zh: 作者假设饮食与情绪之间存在联系。

e.en: His {postulation} about hidden variables sparked debate.
e.zh: 他关于隐变量的假设引发了争论。

e.en: The theory rests on a single bold {postulation}.
e.zh: 该理论依赖于一个大胆的假设。

e.en: Poor {postural} habits often cause back pain.
e.zh: 不良的姿势习惯常常导致背痛。

e.en: The therapist showed her some {postural} exercises.
e.zh: 治疗师教了她一些体态训练动作。

posture.t:
n. 姿势，姿态
v. 故作姿态

e.en: Sit up straight to improve your {posture}.
e.zh: 坐直一点以改善你的体态。

e.en: The country adopted a defensive military {posture}.
e.zh: 该国采取了防御性的军事姿态。

e.en: He {postured} as an expert without any real experience.
e.zh: 他装出一副专家的样子,其实毫无真才实学。

e.en: The politicians {postured} for the cameras during debates.
e.zh: 政客们在辩论中对着镜头摆姿态作秀。

postures.t:
n. 姿势（复数）
v. 装腔作势

e.en: Yoga teaches a series of calming {postures}.
e.zh: 瑜伽教授一系列让人放松的体式。
