e.en: The old cottage was hardly {prepossessing} from the outside.
e.zh: 那间老木屋从外面看几乎毫无吸引力。

e.en: His claim that fish can fly is absolutely {preposterous}.
e.zh: 他说鱼会飞,这种说法实在荒谬至极。

e.en: The price for that tiny apartment is simply {preposterous}.
e.zh: 那间小公寓的价格简直荒唐。

e.en: The hotel charged us {preposterously} high prices for water.
e.zh: 酒店收我们的水费高得离谱。

e.en: He behaved {preposterously} at the formal dinner last night.
e.zh: 昨晚的正式晚宴上他举止荒唐。

preppy.t:
adj. 美式预科生风格的
n. 预科生

e.en: He showed up in a {preppy} sweater and khaki pants.
e.zh: 他穿着一件学院风毛衣和卡其裤出现了。

e.en: The brand is known for its clean, {preppy} style.
e.zh: 该品牌以其干净的学院风风格而闻名。

e.en: The film is currently in {preproduction} and casting actors.
e.zh: 这部电影目前处于前期制作阶段,正在选角。

e.en: We tested the {preproduction} model before mass manufacturing.
e.zh: 在大规模生产之前,我们测试了试产样机。

preprogrammed.t: adj. 预先编程的；预设的

e.en: The robot vacuum follows a {preprogrammed} cleaning route.
e.zh: 扫地机器人按照预先编好的路线进行清扫。

e.en: My coffee maker is {preprogrammed} to brew at 7 a.m.
e.zh: 我的咖啡机被预设在早上七点煮咖啡。

e.en: The clinic specializes in care for {prepubescent} children.
e.zh: 该诊所专门为青春期前的儿童提供医疗服务。

e.en: Many {prepubescent} kids enjoy collecting trading cards.
e.zh: 许多青春期前的孩子喜欢收集卡牌。

e.en: The {prequel} reveals how the villain became so powerful.
e.zh: 这部前传揭示了反派是如何变得如此强大的。

e.en: Fans waited years for a {prequel} to the popular trilogy.
e.zh: 粉丝们等了多年才等到这部热门三部曲的前传。

e.en: The host will {prerecord} the show before going on vacation.
e.zh: 主持人会在度假前先把节目录制好。

e.en: Many podcasters {prerecord} episodes to release weekly.
e.zh: 许多播客主播会预先录制好节目以便每周发布。

e.en: The interview was {prerecorded} and aired the next morning.
e.zh: 这段访谈是预先录制的,第二天早上播出。

e.en: Press one to hear a {prerecorded} message about store hours.
e.zh: 按一可收听关于营业时间的预先录制信息。

prerequisite.t:
n. 前提；必备条件
adj. 必备的

e.en: Calculus is a {prerequisite} for the advanced physics course.
e.zh: 微积分是高等物理课程的先修要求。

e.en: Trust is a {prerequisite} for any healthy relationship.
e.zh: 信任是任何健康关系的先决条件。

e.en: Choosing the team captain is the coach's {prerogative}.
e.zh: 选择队长是教练的特权。

e.en: It is your {prerogative} to change your mind at any time.
e.zh: 随时改变主意是你的权利。

e.en: Reporters shouted questions at the {pres} after the speech.
e.zh: 演讲结束后,记者们向总统大声提问。

e.en: The vice {pres} will fill in while the boss is away.
e.zh: 老板不在时,副总裁将代为主持工作。

presage.t:
v. 预示；预兆
n. 预兆

e.en: Dark clouds often {presage} a heavy thunderstorm.
e.zh: 乌云常常预示着一场大雷雨。

e.en: Falling sales may {presage} layoffs at the company.
e.zh: 销售下滑可能预示着公司将要裁员。

e.en: Most adults develop {presbyopia} after the age of forty.
e.zh: 大多数成年人在四十岁以后会出现老花眼。

e.en: Reading glasses help people manage {presbyopia} comfortably.
e.zh: 老花镜能帮助人们舒适地应对老花眼。

e.en: The {presbyter} led the small congregation for many years.
e.zh: 这位长老多年来一直带领着这个小教会。

e.en: Each {presbyter} was responsible for one parish in the region.
e.zh: 每位长老负责该地区的一个教区。

presbyterian.t:
adj. 长老会的
n. 长老会教徒

e.en: She grew up attending a {presbyterian} church in Scotland.
e.zh: 她从小在苏格兰一所长老会教堂做礼拜。

e.en: The {presbyterian} minister gave a moving sermon on Sunday.
e.zh: 这位长老会牧师在周日做了一场感人的布道。

presbyterianism.t: n. 长老宗；长老会教义

e.en: {Presbyterianism} spread widely in Scotland during the Reformation.
e.zh: 长老宗在宗教改革时期在苏格兰广泛传播。

e.en: His book traces the history of American {presbyterianism}.
e.zh: 他的书追溯了美国长老宗的历史。

e.en: The local {presbytery} voted to ordain three new ministers.
e.zh: 当地长老会投票决定按立三位新牧师。

e.en: They restored the old {presbytery} next to the chapel.
e.zh: 他们修复了教堂旁边那座古老的牧师住所。

preschool.t:
adj. 学前的
n. 幼儿园

e.en: My daughter starts {preschool} next September.
e.zh: 我女儿明年九月开始上幼儿园。

e.en: The {preschool} focuses on play-based learning.
e.zh: 这家幼儿园注重以游戏为基础的学习。

e.en: My {preschooler} loves drawing dinosaurs every afternoon.
e.zh: 我家学龄前的孩子每天下午都喜欢画恐龙。

e.en: Each {preschooler} brings a small snack to share.
e.zh: 每个学龄前的小朋友都带一份小零食来分享。

e.en: Her {prescience} about the market crash saved the company.
e.zh: 她对市场崩盘的先见之明拯救了公司。

e.en: The author's {prescience} about technology was remarkable.
e.zh: 这位作者对科技发展的预见令人惊叹。

e.en: His {prescient} warnings about the bubble proved correct.
e.zh: 他对泡沫的先见警告后来被证明是对的。

e.en: The novel offered a {prescient} view of social media addiction.
e.zh: 这部小说对社交媒体成瘾给出了富有先见的描述。

e.en: She {presciently} sold her stocks before the market crashed.
e.zh: 她颇有先见之明地在股市崩盘前抛掉了股票。

e.en: The author {presciently} predicted the rise of remote work.
e.zh: 这位作者颇具远见地预言了远程办公的兴起。

prescott.t: n. 普雷斯科特（人名/地名）

e.en: We drove through {prescott} on our way to the Grand Canyon.
e.zh: 在去大峡谷的路上,我们经过了普雷斯科特。

e.en: Mr. {prescott} has taught math at this school for decades.
e.zh: 普雷斯科特先生在这所学校教数学已有几十年。

e.en: The doctor will {prescribe} antibiotics if the infection worsens.
e.zh: 如果感染加重,医生会开抗生素。

e.en: Company rules {prescribe} a strict dress code for meetings.
e.zh: 公司规定为会议规定了严格的着装要求。

prescribed.t:
adj. 规定的
v. 开处方（过去式）

e.en: My doctor {prescribed} a new medication for my allergies.
e.zh: 医生给我开了一种新的过敏药。

e.en: Students must complete the {prescribed} reading before class.
e.zh: 学生必须在上课前完成规定的阅读材料。

prescribes.t: v. 开处方；规定（第三人称单数）

e.en: The manual {prescribes} weekly maintenance for this machine.
e.zh: 手册规定这台机器每周需要保养一次。

e.en: Her physician {prescribes} exercise rather than pills first.
e.zh: 她的医生先建议运动而不是直接开药。

prescribing.t: v. 开处方；规定（进行时）

e.en: Doctors are {prescribing} fewer opioids than a decade ago.
e.zh: 医生们开的阿片类药物比十年前少了。

e.en: The vet is {prescribing} a special diet for my old dog.
e.zh: 兽医正在为我的老狗开一种特殊饮食方案。

e.en: You'll need a {prescription} from your doctor for this drug.
e.zh: 购买这种药需要医生开的处方。

e.en: The pharmacy can fill your {prescription} in twenty minutes.
e.zh: 药房可以在二十分钟内为你配好处方药。

e.en: Many patients pick up their {prescriptions} on Friday afternoons.
e.zh: 许多病人在周五下午来取处方药。

e.en: Insurance covers most of my monthly {prescriptions}.
e.zh: 保险报销了我每月大部分处方药费用。

prescriptive.t: adj. 规定性的；约定俗成的

e.en: The style guide is too {prescriptive} for creative writing.
e.zh: 这本风格指南对创意写作来说过于死板。

e.en: Teachers prefer descriptive grammar over {prescriptive} rules.
e.zh: 老师们更喜欢描述性语法,而非规定性的规则。

preseason.t:
n. 季前赛
adj. 赛季前的

e.en: The team won every {preseason} game this year.
e.zh: 球队今年赢得了所有季前赛。

e.en: {Preseason} training starts in early August.
e.zh: 季前训练于八月初开始。

e.en: You can {preselect} your seat during online check-in.
e.zh: 你可以在网上值机时预先选定座位。

e.en: The form lets users {preselect} their dietary preferences.
e.zh: 该表单允许用户预先选择饮食偏好。

e.en: Her calm {presence} reassured the nervous team.
e.zh: 她沉稳的气场让紧张的团队安心下来。

e.en: The brand has a strong {presence} on social media.
e.zh: 该品牌在社交媒体上有很强的存在感。

e.en: Several diplomatic {presences} were noted at the summit.
e.zh: 峰会上有多方外交人员到场。

e.en: The novel describes ghostly {presences} in the old mansion.
e.zh: 小说描述了老宅中幽灵般的存在。

present.t:
v. 呈现；展示
n. 礼物；现在
adj. 目前的

e.en: She gave him a birthday {present} wrapped in gold paper.
e.zh: 她送给他一份用金色包装纸包好的生日礼物。

e.en: Please {present} your ID at the front desk.
e.zh: 请在前台出示您的身份证件。

presentable.t: adj. 像样的；拿得出手的

e.en: Make the slides {presentable} before the client meeting.
e.zh: 在客户会议前把幻灯片整理得像样一些。

e.en: He changed clothes to look {presentable} for dinner.
e.zh: 他换了衣服,为晚餐打扮得体面些。

e.en: Her {presentation} on climate change impressed everyone.
e.zh: 她关于气候变化的演讲让所有人印象深刻。

e.en: The food's {presentation} matters as much as the taste.
e.zh: 食物的摆盘和味道一样重要。

e.en: React favors small {presentational} components for the UI.
e.zh: React 倾向于使用小型展示型组件来构建界面。

e.en: The film uses a {presentational} style that breaks the fourth wall.
e.zh: 这部电影采用打破第四面墙的呈现式风格。

e.en: We sat through three {presentations} in one afternoon.
e.zh: 我们一个下午听了三场演讲。

e.en: His sales {presentations} always close the deal.
e.zh: 他的销售演示总能拿下订单。

e.en: She {presented} the award to the youngest winner.
e.zh: 她将奖项颁给了最年轻的获奖者。

e.en: The data was {presented} clearly with helpful charts.
e.zh: 数据通过清晰的图表呈现出来。

e.en: The TV {presenter} interviewed three guests live.
e.zh: 电视主持人现场采访了三位嘉宾。

e.en: Each {presenter} had ten minutes to share their idea.
e.zh: 每位演讲者有十分钟时间分享自己的想法。

e.en: The conference invited five expert {presenters} from abroad.
e.zh: 会议邀请了五位来自国外的专家演讲者。

e.en: Award show {presenters} read from the teleprompter.
e.zh: 颁奖典礼的主持人照着提词器念稿。

e.en: She had a strange {presentiment} that something was wrong.
e.zh: 她有一种奇怪的预感,觉得出事了。

e.en: His {presentiment} of danger turned out to be correct.
e.zh: 他对危险的预感后来证实是对的。

e.en: He's {presenting} the quarterly results tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 他明天上午要汇报季度业绩。

e.en: The patient is {presenting} with mild fever and a cough.
e.zh: 该患者表现出轻微发烧和咳嗽症状。

presently.t:
adv. 目前，现在
adv. 不久，很快

e.en: The manager will be with you {presently}.
e.zh: 经理稍后就会过来接待您。

e.en: She is {presently} working on her second novel.
e.zh: 她目前正在创作第二部小说。

presentment.t:
n. 呈递，提交
n. (法律) 陈述书

e.en: The grand jury issued a {presentment} against the official.
e.zh: 大陪审团对该官员发出了起诉书。

e.en: Banks handle the {presentment} of checks for payment.
e.zh: 银行负责支票的提示付款手续。

e.en: Meditation helps cultivate a sense of {presentness}.
e.zh: 冥想有助于培养当下的觉知感。

e.en: The poem captures the {presentness} of a single moment.
e.zh: 这首诗捕捉了某个瞬间的当下感。

presents.t:
n. 礼物（复数）
v. 呈现，展示

e.en: The kids opened their {presents} on Christmas morning.
e.zh: 孩子们在圣诞节早晨拆开了礼物。

e.en: This case {presents} a unique legal challenge.
e.zh: 这个案件带来了独特的法律挑战。

preservation.t:
n. 保护，保存
n. 维护，保留

e.en: The group works on the {preservation} of old buildings.
e.zh: 该组织致力于保护古老建筑。

e.en: Salt is essential for the {preservation} of meat.
e.zh: 盐对肉类的保存至关重要。

e.en: The {preservationist} fought to save the historic theater.
e.zh: 这位文物保护者奋力抢救这座历史剧院。

e.en: She became a {preservationist} after studying architecture.
e.zh: 学了建筑后,她成为了一名文物保护者。

e.en: Local {preservationists} rallied against the demolition plan.
e.zh: 当地文物保护者联合起来反对拆迁计划。

e.en: {Preservationists} mapped every endangered wetland in the state.
e.zh: 保护人士绘制了全州每一片濒危湿地的地图。

e.en: The museum oversees several long-term {preservations} of artifacts.
e.zh: 博物馆负责多项文物的长期保护工作。

e.en: Various food {preservations} were used before refrigeration existed.
e.zh: 在冰箱出现之前人们使用各种食物保存方法。

preservative.t:
n. 防腐剂
adj. 防腐的

e.en: This bread contains no artificial {preservative}.
e.zh: 这种面包不含任何人工防腐剂。

e.en: Vinegar acts as a natural {preservative} in pickles.
e.zh: 醋在腌菜中起到天然防腐剂的作用。

preserve.t:
v. 保护，保存
n. 果酱；专属领域

e.en: We must {preserve} the rainforest for future generations.
e.zh: 我们必须为后代保护好热带雨林。

e.en: She spread strawberry {preserve} on her toast.
e.zh: 她在烤面包上抹了草莓果酱。

preserved.t:
adj. 保存的，腌制的
v. preserve 的过去式

e.en: The ancient scrolls were remarkably well {preserved}.
e.zh: 这些古老的卷轴保存得非常完好。

e.en: Grandma {preserved} peaches in jars every summer.
e.zh: 奶奶每年夏天都会用罐子腌制桃子。

e.en: Throw the life {preserver} to the swimmer in trouble.
e.zh: 把救生圈扔给那位遇险的游泳者。

e.en: He's a passionate {preserver} of folk music traditions.
e.zh: 他是民间音乐传统的热情守护者。

preserves.t:
n. 蜜饯，果酱
v. 保存（第三人称）

e.en: My aunt makes the best apricot {preserves} every fall.
e.zh: 我阿姨每年秋天都做最好吃的杏子果酱。

e.en: The reserve {preserves} habitats for endangered birds.
e.zh: 该保护区为濒危鸟类保留了栖息地。

preserving.t:
v. 保存，保护
adj. 用于保存的

e.en: The library is dedicated to {preserving} rare manuscripts.
e.zh: 图书馆致力于保存珍稀手稿。

e.en: She's busy {preserving} tomatoes from the garden.
e.zh: 她正忙着把园子里的番茄做成罐头。

preset.t:
v. 预先设定
n. 预设值（软件）

e.en: Tap the {preset} button to load your favorite station.
e.zh: 按预设按钮即可加载你最喜欢的电台。

e.en: The camera has a night-mode {preset} for low light.
e.zh: 相机有专为弱光设计的夜间模式预设。

preside.t: v. 主持（会议）；担任主席

e.en: The judge will {preside} over the trial next month.
e.zh: 法官将在下个月主持这场审判。

e.en: She was asked to {preside} at the awards ceremony.
e.zh: 她受邀主持颁奖典礼。

presided.t: v. preside 的过去式，主持

e.en: The mayor {presided} over the opening of the new park.
e.zh: 市长主持了新公园的开幕仪式。

e.en: Justice Roberts {presided} at the impeachment trial.
e.zh: 罗伯茨大法官主持了弹劾审判。

presidencies.t: n. 总统职位/任期（复数）

e.en: Both {presidencies} were marked by economic crises.
e.zh: 两届总统任期都以经济危机为标志。

e.en: Historians compare the two {presidencies} side by side.
e.zh: 历史学家将两届总统任期进行对比。

presidency.t: n. 总统职位，主席任期

e.en: He won the {presidency} by a narrow margin.
e.zh: 他以微弱优势赢得了总统之位。

e.en: Her {presidency} of the club lasted four years.
e.zh: 她担任俱乐部主席长达四年。

president.t:
n. 总统，主席
n. 校长；总裁

e.en: The {president} addressed the nation on live television.
e.zh: 总统通过电视直播向全国发表讲话。

e.en: She was elected {president} of the student council.
e.zh: 她当选为学生会主席。

e.en: The {presidential} debate aired on every major channel.
e.zh: 总统辩论在各大主要频道播出。

e.en: His calm tone sounded very {presidential}.
e.zh: 他沉着的语气听起来很有总统风范。

e.en: He carried himself {presidentially} during the crisis.
e.zh: 危机期间他举止颇有总统风范。

e.en: The site was {presidentially} designated as a monument.
e.zh: 该地点经总统指定为纪念地。

e.en: Four {presidents} attended the historic peace summit.
e.zh: 四位总统出席了这次具有历史意义的和平峰会。

e.en: Mount Rushmore features four American {presidents}.
e.zh: 拉什莫尔山雕刻着四位美国总统的头像。

e.en: The {presider} of the meeting kept everyone on schedule.
e.zh: 会议主持人确保每个人都按时进行。

e.en: As {presider}, she guided the discussion carefully.
e.zh: 作为主持人,她小心地引导讨论进行。

presides.t: v. 主持（第三人称单数）

e.en: The chief justice {presides} over the supreme court.
e.zh: 首席大法官主持最高法院的工作。

e.en: She {presides} at every board meeting personally.
e.zh: 她亲自主持每一次董事会会议。

presiding.t:
adj. 主持的，主管的
v. 主持

e.en: The {presiding} judge silenced the courtroom.
e.zh: 主审法官让法庭安静下来。

e.en: He's the {presiding} officer at today's session.
e.zh: 他是今天会议的主持官员。

e.en: The old Spanish {presidio} now serves as a museum.
e.zh: 这座古老的西班牙要塞如今成了博物馆。

e.en: We hiked through the {presidio} park overlooking the bay.
e.zh: 我们徒步穿过俯瞰海湾的要塞公园。

e.en: The {presidium} met in secret to discuss the policy.
e.zh: 主席团秘密开会讨论这项政策。

e.en: Members of the {presidium} sat at the front table.
e.zh: 主席团成员坐在前排的桌子边。

presley.t: n. 普雷斯利（姓氏，如猫王 Elvis Presley）

e.en: Elvis {Presley} remains one of music's most iconic figures.
e.zh: 猫王普雷斯利依然是乐坛最具标志性的人物之一。

e.en: Her grandfather collected every {Presley} record ever released.
e.zh: 她爷爷收藏了普雷斯利发行过的每一张唱片。

press.t:
v. 按，按压
n. 媒体，新闻界

e.en: {Press} the red button to start the machine.
e.zh: 按下红色按钮即可启动机器。

e.en: The {press} gathered outside the courthouse for a statement.
e.zh: 记者们聚集在法院外等候声明。

pressed.t:
v. 按下（过去式）
adj. 被迫的；熨过的

e.en: She {pressed} the elevator button repeatedly.
e.zh: 她反复按着电梯按钮。

e.en: He felt {pressed} for time before the deadline.
e.zh: 截止日期前他感到时间紧迫。

e.en: The coach held a {presser} after the championship win.
e.zh: 赢得冠军后教练举行了一场记者会。

e.en: She bought a garlic {presser} for her new kitchen.
e.zh: 她为新厨房买了一个压蒜器。

presses.t:
v. press 的第三人称单数
n. 压力机（复数）

e.en: The factory has six printing {presses} running daily.
e.zh: 工厂里有六台印刷机每天运转。

e.en: He {presses} his shirts every Sunday evening.
e.zh: 他每周日晚上都熨衬衫。

pressing.t:
adj. 紧迫的，迫切的
v. 按压

e.en: Climate change is the most {pressing} issue of our time.
e.zh: 气候变化是我们这个时代最紧迫的问题。

e.en: She's busy {pressing} flowers from her garden.
e.zh: 她正忙着把园子里的花压成标本。

e.en: The {pressman} adjusted the ink levels on the machine.
e.zh: 印刷工调整了机器上的油墨量。

e.en: An experienced {pressman} can spot defects instantly.
e.zh: 经验丰富的印刷工能立刻发现瑕疵。

pressroom.t: n. 印刷车间；新闻发布室

e.en: Reporters gathered in the {pressroom} to hear the announcement.
e.zh: 记者们聚集在新闻发布室聆听公告。

e.en: The newspaper's {pressroom} runs all night before deadline.
e.zh: 报社的印刷车间在截稿前彻夜运转。

pressure.t:
n. 压力，压强
v. 施压，逼迫

e.en: Students often feel a lot of {pressure} before exams.
e.zh: 学生在考试前常常感到很大压力。

e.en: Check the tire {pressure} before a long drive.
e.zh: 长途驾驶前请检查轮胎气压。

pressured.t:
v. 被施压（过去式）
adj. 有压力的

e.en: He felt {pressured} into signing the contract too quickly.
e.zh: 他感觉被迫匆忙签下了合同。

e.en: Investors {pressured} the CEO to step down.
e.zh: 投资者向首席执行官施压让其辞职。

pressures.t:
n. 压力（复数）
v. 施压

e.en: Modern life puts many {pressures} on young families.
e.zh: 现代生活给年轻家庭带来许多压力。

e.en: The valve regulates the {pressures} inside the tank.
e.zh: 该阀门调节罐内的各处压力。

pressurise.t: v. 加压；施压（英式拼法）

e.en: Activists tried to {pressurise} the government into action.
e.zh: 活动人士试图向政府施压促其行动。

e.en: Engineers {pressurise} the cabin before takeoff.
e.zh: 工程师在起飞前给机舱加压。

pressurised.t:
adj. 加压的（英式）
v. 加压（过去式）

e.en: The aircraft cabin is fully {pressurised} during the flight.
e.zh: 飞行途中机舱保持完全增压。

e.en: Managers {pressurised} staff to meet the tight deadline.
e.zh: 经理们向员工施压以赶上紧迫的截止日期。

e.en: Cabin {pressurization} keeps passengers comfortable at altitude.
e.zh: 机舱增压让乘客在高空也能舒适。

e.en: A leak disrupted the {pressurization} of the spacecraft.
e.zh: 泄漏破坏了航天器的增压系统。

e.en: Repeated {pressurizations} can stress the fuselage over time.
e.zh: 反复增压会随时间使机身承受压力。

e.en: Engineers logged the {pressurizations} during each test flight.
e.zh: 工程师记录了每次试飞中的增压情况。

pressurize.t:
v. 加压，增压
v. 向…施加压力

e.en: Lobby groups {pressurize} lawmakers to change the bill.
e.zh: 游说团体向议员施压修改法案。

e.en: Divers {pressurize} their suits before descending.
e.zh: 潜水员下潜前会给潜水服加压。

pressurized.t: adj. 加压的，密封增压的

e.en: Astronauts work inside a {pressurized} module on the station.
e.zh: 宇航员在空间站的增压舱内工作。

e.en: Critics {pressurized} the company to lower its prices.
e.zh: 批评者向公司施压要求降价。

pressurizes.t: v. 加压（第三人称单数）

e.en: The pump {pressurizes} water before sending it through the pipes.
e.zh: 水泵先给水加压再送入管道。

e.en: Social media constantly {pressurizes} teenagers to look perfect.
e.zh: 社交媒体不断逼迫青少年追求完美外表。

e.en: The team is {pressurizing} suppliers for faster delivery.
e.zh: 团队正在向供应商施压要求加快交货。

e.en: A faulty valve stopped the system from {pressurizing} properly.
e.zh: 阀门故障导致系统无法正常增压。

e.en: The historian studied a {prest} paid to medieval soldiers.
e.zh: 历史学家研究了发给中世纪士兵的预付款。

e.en: Records show a small {prest} given before the campaign.
e.zh: 记录显示出征前发放了少量预付军饷。

prestel.t: n. Prestel，英国早期视讯服务 (罕用)

e.en: Older Britons remember browsing news on {Prestel} at home.
e.zh: 上了年纪的英国人记得在家用 Prestel 看新闻。

e.en: {Prestel} was an early videotex service from British Telecom.
e.zh: Prestel 是英国电信早期推出的可视图文服务。

prestige.t:
n. 声望，威望
adj. 享有声望的

e.en: Harvard carries enormous {prestige} in academic circles.
e.zh: 哈佛在学术界享有极高的声望。

e.en: Winning the award added real {prestige} to her career.
e.zh: 获奖为她的事业增添了真正的威望。

e.en: The two universities enjoy comparable {prestiges} worldwide.
e.zh: 这两所大学在全球享有相当的声望。

e.en: Different cultures grant {prestiges} to very different professions.
e.zh: 不同文化对各种职业给予的声望大相径庭。

prestigious.t: adj. 有声望的；享有盛誉的

e.en: She won a {prestigious} scholarship to study abroad.
e.zh: 她赢得了一项著名的海外留学奖学金。

e.en: The firm occupies a {prestigious} address in Manhattan.
e.zh: 这家公司位于曼哈顿一处声誉显赫的地段。

presto.t:
adv. 急速地
int. 瞧（变魔术时用语）

e.en: Add a pinch of salt and, {presto}, dinner is ready.
e.zh: 加一撮盐,瞧,晚餐就做好了。

e.en: The pianist played the {presto} movement with dazzling speed.
e.zh: 钢琴家以惊人的速度演奏了急板乐章。

preston.t: n. 普雷斯顿（英国地名/人名）

e.en: The train from London to {Preston} takes about two hours.
e.zh: 从伦敦到普雷斯顿的火车约需两小时。

e.en: {Preston} is a city in northwest England.
e.zh: 普雷斯顿是英格兰西北部的一座城市。

prestwich.t: n. 普雷斯特维奇（英国地名）

e.en: My grandparents grew up in {Prestwich}, near Manchester.
e.zh: 我的祖父母在曼彻斯特附近的普雷斯特维奇长大。

e.en: {Prestwich} has a lively high street full of cafés.
e.zh: 普雷斯特维奇的主街上咖啡馆林立,十分热闹。

presumable.t: adj. 可假定的；可推测的

e.en: His silence makes a guilty conscience {presumable}.
e.zh: 他的沉默让人有理由推测他心中有愧。

e.en: It is {presumable} that the shop will reopen next week.
e.zh: 商店下周大概会重新开业。

e.en: He's late, {presumably} because of the heavy traffic.
e.zh: 他迟到了,大概是因为交通拥堵。

e.en: The package, {presumably} from Amazon, arrived this morning.
e.zh: 包裹今早送到,大概是亚马逊寄来的。

e.en: I {presume} you've already had breakfast this morning.
e.zh: 我猜你今早已经吃过早餐了。

e.en: Courts {presume} every defendant innocent until proven guilty.
e.zh: 法庭推定每位被告在罪名成立前都是无辜的。

presumed.t:
v. 推定（过去式）
adj. 假定的

e.en: The missing hiker is {presumed} dead after two weeks.
e.zh: 两周过去,失踪的徒步者被推定已遇难。

e.en: She {presumed} the meeting had been cancelled.
e.zh: 她以为会议已经取消了。

presumes.t: v. 推定；假定（第三人称单数）

e.en: This argument {presumes} that everyone owns a smartphone.
e.zh: 这个论点假定每个人都有智能手机。

e.en: The plan {presumes} good weather throughout the trip.
e.zh: 该计划假定整个旅程都是好天气。

presuming.t: v. 假定；推测（现在分词）

e.en: {Presuming} the train is on time, we'll arrive by noon.
e.zh: 假如火车准点,我们中午前就能到。

e.en: He kept {presuming} I'd pay for dinner without asking.
e.zh: 他一直擅自认定晚餐由我来买单。

e.en: There's a legal {presumption} of innocence in our system.
e.zh: 我们的法律体系奉行无罪推定原则。

e.en: Her {presumption} that I agreed annoyed everyone.
e.zh: 她擅自认定我同意此事,惹恼了大家。

e.en: He's the {presumptive} nominee after winning every primary.
e.zh: 赢下所有初选后,他成为推定的提名人。

e.en: Doctors made a {presumptive} diagnosis based on early symptoms.
e.zh: 医生根据早期症状作出了推定诊断。

e.en: The driver was {presumptively} at fault for running the light.
e.zh: 该司机因闯红灯被推定负有过错。

e.en: Documents from that era are {presumptively} authentic.
e.zh: 那个时代的文件通常被推定为真实可信。

presumptuous.t: adj. 放肆的；自以为是的

e.en: It would be {presumptuous} to assume she'll say yes.
e.zh: 假定她一定会答应未免太冒昧了。

e.en: Don't be {presumptuous} and order food for everyone.
e.zh: 别那么自以为是地替大家点餐。

e.en: Most economic models {presuppose} rational human behavior.
e.zh: 大多数经济模型预设人是理性的。

e.en: Your question seems to {presuppose} that I'm wrong.
e.zh: 你的问题似乎预设了我是错的。

e.en: The whole plan {presupposed} a reliable internet connection.
e.zh: 整个计划的前提是网络要稳定。

e.en: Her advice {presupposed} that I had savings to invest.
e.zh: 她的建议预设了我有积蓄可以投资。

presupposes.t: v. 预设（第三人称单数）

e.en: Democracy {presupposes} an informed and engaged citizenry.
e.zh: 民主的前提是公民知情且积极参与。

e.en: The recipe {presupposes} you have a stand mixer at home.
e.zh: 这份食谱预设你家里有台立式搅拌机。

e.en: You're {presupposing} I want to move, but I don't.
e.zh: 你预设我想搬家,但其实我不想。

e.en: The argument falls apart, {presupposing} facts not in evidence.
e.zh: 这个论点站不住脚,因为它预设了未经证实的事实。

e.en: The debate rests on a flawed {presupposition} about human nature.
e.zh: 这场辩论基于对人性的错误预设。

e.en: Every theory carries some {presupposition} about reality.
e.zh: 每种理论都对现实抱有某种预设。

e.en: Good philosophers question their own {presuppositions}.
e.zh: 优秀的哲学家会质疑自己的预设。

e.en: The study challenged common {presuppositions} about teenagers.
e.zh: 这项研究挑战了人们对青少年的常见预设。

e.en: Calcium triggers neurotransmitter release at the {presynaptic} terminal.
e.zh: 钙离子会触发突触前末梢释放神经递质。

e.en: The drug acts on {presynaptic} receptors in the brain.
e.zh: 该药物作用于大脑中的突触前受体。

preteen.t:
n. 12岁以下儿童
adj. 未满13岁的

e.en: This app is designed for {preteen} kids learning to code.
e.zh: 这款应用专为学习编程的青春期前孩子设计。

e.en: Many {preteen} fashion trends spread quickly on TikTok.
e.zh: 许多少年儿童的时尚潮流在 TikTok 上迅速流传。

pretence.t: n. 假装；借口（英式拼写）

e.en: She kept up the {pretence} of being happy at work.
e.zh: 她一直假装在工作上很开心。

e.en: He entered the building under the {pretence} of delivering mail.
e.zh: 他借口送信进入了那栋大楼。

e.en: Children love to {pretend} they are astronauts in space.
e.zh: 小朋友喜欢假装自己是太空中的宇航员。

e.en: Don't {pretend} you didn't see my message yesterday.
e.zh: 别装作没看到我昨天的信息。

pretended.t:
v. 假装（过去式）
adj. 假装的

e.en: He {pretended} to be asleep when his mom came in.
e.zh: 妈妈进来时他装作睡着了。

e.en: She {pretended} not to notice the awkward silence.
e.zh: 她假装没注意到那阵尴尬的沉默。

e.en: The throne attracted yet another {pretender} from abroad.
e.zh: 王位又引来了一位来自国外的觊觎者。

e.en: Critics called him a {pretender} with no real talent.
e.zh: 评论家说他是个毫无真才实学的冒牌货。

e.en: Stop {pretending} everything is fine when it clearly isn't.
e.zh: 别再假装一切都好了,显然并非如此。

e.en: The kids are {pretending} the couch is a pirate ship.
e.zh: 孩子们在把沙发当成海盗船玩。

pretends.t: v. 假装（第三人称单数）

e.en: My cat {pretends} to be asleep whenever guests arrive.
e.zh: 每当有客人来,我的猫就假装在睡觉。

e.en: He {pretends} he doesn't care, but everyone knows he does.
e.zh: 他装作不在乎,但大家都看得出来他在乎。

e.en: They dropped the {pretense} of friendship after the argument.
e.zh: 那场争吵后,他们不再假装是朋友。

e.en: He visited her under the {pretense} of borrowing a book.
e.zh: 他借口借书去探望她。

e.en: The little café has charm without any {pretension}.
e.zh: 这家小咖啡馆很有韵味,毫不做作。

e.en: His {pretension} to expertise quickly fell apart in court.
e.zh: 他对专业身份的吹嘘在法庭上很快露馅。

pretentious.t: adj. 自命不凡的；矫饰的

e.en: The menu uses {pretentious} French words for ordinary dishes.
e.zh: 这份菜单用花哨的法语词汇标注普通菜肴。

e.en: Her review of the film sounded a bit {pretentious}.
e.zh: 她对那部电影的影评听起来有点做作。

pretentiously.t: adv. 自命不凡地；浮夸地

e.en: He spoke {pretentiously}, quoting philosophers no one had read.
e.zh: 他装腔作势,引用一些没人读过的哲学家。

e.en: The bar is {pretentiously} named 'The Curated Spirit Atelier'.
e.zh: 那家酒吧自命不凡地起名为「精选烈酒工坊」。

pretentiousness.t: n. 自命不凡；装腔作势

e.en: I love her writing because it has zero {pretentiousness}.
e.zh: 我喜欢她的文章,因为毫无矫饰之气。

e.en: The film's {pretentiousness} drove most viewers away.
e.zh: 这部电影的故作高深让大多数观众望而却步。

e.en: In Spanish class we practiced verbs in the {preterite} tense.
e.zh: 在西班牙语课上,我们练习了简单过去式动词。

e.en: 'Walked' is the {preterite} form of 'walk'.
e.zh: walked 是 walk 的过去式形式。

e.en: The child showed a {preternatural} talent for solving puzzles.
e.zh: 这孩子在解谜方面展现出超乎寻常的天赋。

e.en: A {preternatural} silence fell over the empty street.
e.zh: 空荡的街道上笼罩着一种异样的寂静。

e.en: She remained {preternaturally} calm during the crisis.
e.zh: 在危机中她出奇地镇定。

e.en: The forest was {preternaturally} quiet that evening.
e.zh: 那天傍晚森林里静得出奇。

pretest.t:
n. 预先测试
v. 预测

e.en: Students take a {pretest} before the new unit begins.
e.zh: 学生在新单元开始前先做一个前测。

e.en: The team will {pretest} the survey on a small group.
e.zh: 团队会先在小范围内对问卷进行预测试。

e.en: He called her on the {pretext} of asking for help.
e.zh: 他以求助为借口给她打了电话。

e.en: The meeting was just a {pretext} for office gossip.
e.zh: 那场会议不过是办公室闲聊的借口。

pretoria.t: n. 比勒陀利亚（南非城市）

e.en: {Pretoria} is one of South Africa's three capital cities.
e.zh: 比勒陀利亚是南非三个首都之一。

e.en: She flew to {Pretoria} for a diplomatic meeting.
e.zh: 她飞往比勒陀利亚参加一场外交会议。

e.en: The fabric needs a chemical {pretreatment} before dyeing.
e.zh: 染色前布料需要进行化学预处理。

e.en: Doctors recommend {pretreatment} to reduce allergic reactions.
e.zh: 医生建议先做预处理以减少过敏反应。

pretrial.t:
adj. 审判前的
n. 预审

e.en: The judge scheduled a {pretrial} hearing for next month.
e.zh: 法官把审前听证安排在下个月。

e.en: Both sides exchanged evidence during the {pretrial} phase.
e.zh: 双方在审前阶段交换了证据。

e.en: Designers tried to {prettify} the dashboard with new icons.
e.zh: 设计师试图用新图标美化这个仪表盘。

e.en: Don't {prettify} the report—just show the real numbers.
e.zh: 别把报告美化了,直接给出真实数据。

e.en: The flowers were {prettily} arranged on the dining table.
e.zh: 鲜花在餐桌上摆得很漂亮。

e.en: She smiled {prettily} at the camera.
e.zh: 她对着镜头甜美地笑了笑。

e.en: The town's {prettiness} attracts tourists every summer.
e.zh: 小镇的秀美每年夏天都吸引着游客。

e.en: There's more to her than just {prettiness}.
e.zh: 她不只是漂亮而已。

pretty.t:
adj. 漂亮的
adv. 相当；挺

e.en: That's a {pretty} good idea, actually.
e.zh: 说真的,这主意挺不错的。

e.en: She wore a {pretty} blue dress to the party.
e.zh: 她穿了一条漂亮的蓝色裙子去参加派对。

e.en: He grabbed a salty {pretzel} from the street vendor.
e.zh: 他从街边小贩那买了一个咸味椒盐卷饼。

e.en: My legs were twisted like a {pretzel} after yoga.
e.zh: 瑜伽课后我的腿扭得像椒盐卷饼一样。

e.en: In the end, common sense will {prevail}.
e.zh: 最终,常识会占上风。

e.en: The team worked hard to {prevail} over their rivals.
e.zh: 球队努力拼搏,最终战胜了对手。

e.en: Calm {prevailed} after the storm passed.
e.zh: 风暴过后,一切恢复了平静。

e.en: Their argument {prevailed} in the final court ruling.
e.zh: 他们的论点在终审判决中占了上风。

e.en: The {prevailing} view is that remote work is here to stay.
e.zh: 目前的主流观点是远程办公将长期存在。

e.en: Sailors used the {prevailing} winds to cross the ocean.
e.zh: 水手们借助盛行风穿越大洋。

e.en: In this office, a casual dress code {prevails}.
e.zh: 在这间办公室里,随意的着装风格占主导。

e.en: Justice usually {prevails}, even if it takes time.
e.zh: 正义通常会胜出,哪怕需要时间。

e.en: The {prevalence} of smartphones changed daily life forever.
e.zh: 智能手机的普及彻底改变了日常生活。

e.en: Researchers studied the {prevalence} of diabetes in the region.
e.zh: 研究人员调查了该地区糖尿病的发病率。

e.en: The report compares disease {prevalences} across several countries.
e.zh: 报告比较了几个国家的疾病患病率。

e.en: Different regions show very different obesity {prevalences}.
e.zh: 不同地区的肥胖率差别很大。

e.en: Misinformation is especially {prevalent} on social media.
e.zh: 错误信息在社交媒体上尤其普遍。

e.en: The flu is most {prevalent} during winter months.
e.zh: 流感在冬季最为流行。

e.en: Don't {prevaricate}—just tell me what really happened.
e.zh: 别支支吾吾,直接告诉我到底发生了什么。

e.en: Politicians often {prevaricate} when asked tough questions.
e.zh: 政客面对尖锐问题时常常含糊其辞。

e.en: The witness's {prevarication} annoyed the entire jury.
e.zh: 证人的支吾搪塞惹恼了整个陪审团。

e.en: After much {prevarication}, he finally admitted the truth.
e.zh: 几番搪塞之后,他终于承认了真相。

e.en: Wash your hands often to {prevent} the spread of germs.
e.zh: 勤洗手可以防止细菌传播。

e.en: Nothing can {prevent} her from chasing her dream.
e.zh: 没有什么能阻止她追逐自己的梦想。

preventable.t: adj. 可预防的；可避免的

e.en: Many traffic accidents are easily {preventable}.
e.zh: 许多交通事故其实是完全可以避免的。

e.en: The disease is {preventable} with a simple vaccine.
e.zh: 这种疾病靠一支简单的疫苗就能预防。

preventative.t:
adj. 预防性的
n. 预防措施

e.en: Regular checkups are an effective {preventative} measure.
e.zh: 定期体检是一种有效的预防措施。

e.en: The clinic focuses on {preventative} care for seniors.
e.zh: 这家诊所专注于老年人的预防性保健。

e.en: Heavy rain {prevented} us from going hiking yesterday.
e.zh: 昨天的大雨让我们没能去远足。

e.en: Quick action by the firefighters {prevented} a disaster.
e.zh: 消防员的迅速行动避免了一场灾难。

e.en: Asthma patients often carry a {preventer} inhaler daily.
e.zh: 哮喘患者通常每天随身带着一支预防型吸入器。

e.en: This app acts as a screen-time {preventer} for kids.
e.zh: 这款应用充当孩子们使用屏幕时间的限制器。

e.en: Sunscreen is essential for {preventing} skin damage.
e.zh: 防晒霜对预防皮肤损伤非常重要。

e.en: Heavy traffic is {preventing} the ambulance from arriving quickly.
e.zh: 严重的拥堵让救护车无法迅速赶到。

e.en: Fire {prevention} is everyone's responsibility.
e.zh: 防火是每个人的责任。

e.en: The campaign focuses on cancer {prevention} and early detection.
e.zh: 这场宣传聚焦于癌症的预防和早筛。

e.en: The guide lists common injury {preventions} for runners.
e.zh: 指南列出了跑步者常见的伤病预防方法。

e.en: Different cultures have unique disease {preventions} and remedies.
e.zh: 不同文化有各自独特的疾病预防方法和疗法。

preventive.t:
adj. 预防性的
n. 预防措施

e.en: Many companies now offer {preventive} health screenings.
e.zh: 许多公司现在都提供预防性健康筛查。

e.en: The government took {preventive} measures against the outbreak.
e.zh: 政府采取了预防措施来应对疫情。

e.en: Engineers replaced the parts {preventively} before they failed.
e.zh: 工程师在零件出故障前就预防性地更换了。

e.en: Doctors sometimes prescribe antibiotics {preventively} after surgery.
e.zh: 医生有时在术后预防性地开抗生素。

prevents.t: v. 防止（第三人称单数）

e.en: This cream {prevents} dry skin during cold weather.
e.zh: 这款面霜能在寒冷天气下防止皮肤干燥。

e.en: A strong password {prevents} unauthorized access to your account.
e.zh: 强密码能防止账号被未授权访问。

preview.t:
n. 预览；试映
v. 预览

e.en: You can {preview} the document before printing it.
e.zh: 打印前你可以先预览一下文档。

e.en: The trailer offers a quick {preview} of the movie.
e.zh: 预告片让人快速一窥这部电影的内容。

e.en: In her {previous} job, she managed a small team.
e.zh: 在上一份工作里,她管理着一个小团队。

e.en: Please refer to the {previous} chapter for context.
e.zh: 请参阅上一章了解相关背景。

e.en: This feature was {previously} only available to paid users.
e.zh: 这个功能之前只对付费用户开放。

e.en: He had {previously} worked as a software engineer.
e.zh: 他之前从事软件工程师的工作。

e.en: Her uncanny {prevision} of the market crash saved millions.
e.zh: 她对市场崩盘的精准预见挽救了上百万元。

e.en: The novel describes a strange {prevision} of future events.
e.zh: 小说描写了对未来事件的一种奇异预知。

e.en: The museum displays photos of {prewar} Berlin.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了战前柏林的照片。

e.en: Their family lived in a charming {prewar} apartment.
e.zh: 他们一家住在一套迷人的战前公寓里。

prey.t:
n. 猎物
v. 捕食

e.en: The eagle swooped down on its {prey}.
e.zh: 老鹰俯冲下来扑向猎物。

e.en: Online scammers often {prey} on lonely people.
e.zh: 网络骗子常常专挑孤独的人下手。

e.en: The old text spelled "prey" as {preye} in places.
e.zh: 那部古籍中有些地方把"prey"写作"preye"。

e.en: Scholars debated whether {preye} meant the same as today.
e.zh: 学者们讨论"preye"的含义是否与今天相同。

e.en: Wolves were seen {preying} on the herd at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时分有狼在捕食羊群。

e.en: The unpaid bills kept {preying} on her mind.
e.zh: 那些未付的账单一直萦绕在她心头。

preys.t:
v. 捕食（第三人称单数）
n. 猎物（复数）

e.en: This scam {preys} on elderly people who live alone.
e.zh: 这种骗局专门针对独居的老人。

e.en: The owl silently {preys} on mice at night.
e.zh: 猫头鹰夜里悄无声息地捕食老鼠。

e.en: Our club {prez} just announced the next big event.
e.zh: 我们俱乐部主席刚宣布了下次的大活动。

e.en: He's been the company {prez} for over a decade.
e.zh: 他担任公司总裁已经超过十年了。

pri.t: n. 优先级（priority 的缩写）

e.en: Set the task {pri} to high so it runs first.
e.zh: 把任务优先级设为高,这样它会先运行。

e.en: Each ticket has a {pri} field from one to five.
e.zh: 每张工单都有一个从一到五的优先级字段。

priam.t: n. 特洛伊国王（希腊神话）

e.en: King {Priam} ruled Troy during the famous war.
e.zh: 普里阿摩斯王在那场著名战争中统治着特洛伊。

e.en: Achilles returned Hector's body to {Priam} at last.
e.zh: 阿喀琉斯最终把赫克托耳的遗体归还给了普里阿摩斯。

priapic.t: adj. 阳具崇拜的；好色的

e.en: The novel features a brash, {priapic} young hero.
e.zh: 小说塑造了一个鲁莽而沉湎情欲的年轻主角。

e.en: Critics found the film's {priapic} humor unnecessary.
e.zh: 影评人觉得这部电影的色情幽默毫无必要。

e.en: {Priapism} is a rare but serious medical condition.
e.zh: 持续勃起症是一种罕见但严重的疾病。

e.en: The drug's label warns about possible {priapism}.
e.zh: 该药物说明书警告可能引发持续勃起症。

price.t:
n. 价格
v. 定价

e.en: What's the {price} of this jacket on sale?
e.zh: 这件外套打折后多少钱?

e.en: Fame often comes at a heavy personal {price}.
e.zh: 名气往往要付出沉重的个人代价。

priced.t:
adj. 已标价的
v. 定价（过去式）

e.en: This phone is {priced} much higher than its competitors.
e.zh: 这款手机的定价比竞品高出许多。

e.en: The apartments are {priced} to sell quickly.
e.zh: 这些公寓的定价是为了快速售出。

e.en: The look on his face was absolutely {priceless}.
e.zh: 他脸上的表情简直无价。

e.en: The museum houses several {priceless} ancient artifacts.
e.zh: 博物馆收藏着几件无价的古代文物。

prices.t:
n. 价格（复数）
v. 定价

e.en: Gas {prices} have risen sharply over the past month.
e.zh: 过去一个月里油价大幅上涨。

e.en: The store {prices} every item by hand each morning.
e.zh: 这家店每天早上都人工给每件商品定价。

e.en: That restaurant downtown is a bit {pricey} for lunch.
e.zh: 市中心那家餐厅的午餐有点贵。

e.en: Organic groceries can be {pricey} compared to regular ones.
e.zh: 有机食品比普通的要贵不少。

e.en: The startup updated its {pricing} page last week.
e.zh: 那家初创公司上周更新了定价页面。

e.en: Competitive {pricing} helped the brand gain market share.
e.zh: 有竞争力的定价帮助该品牌赢得了市场份额。

prick.t:
v. 刺；扎
n. 刺痛

e.en: She felt a sharp {prick} when the needle went in.
e.zh: 针扎进去时她感到一阵刺痛。

e.en: Be careful not to {prick} your finger on that thorn.
e.zh: 小心别让那根刺扎到手指。

e.en: The dog {pricked} up its ears at the sound.
e.zh: 狗听到声音竖起了耳朵。

e.en: He {pricked} his thumb while sewing the button on.
e.zh: 他缝扣子时扎到了大拇指。

pricking.t:
n. 刺痛感
v. 刺（进行时）

e.en: I felt a {pricking} sensation in my leg after sitting too long.
e.zh: 坐太久后我感觉腿有点刺痛。

e.en: She kept {pricking} the balloon until it popped.
e.zh: 她一直戳那个气球直到它爆掉。

prickle.t:
n. 荆棘；刺
v. 感到刺痛

e.en: A sudden {prickle} of fear ran down her spine.
e.zh: 一阵恐惧顺着她的脊背窜了上来。

e.en: The cactus has tiny {prickle} clusters on its surface.
e.zh: 那株仙人掌表面长着一簇簇细小的尖刺。

prickling.t:
n. 刺痛
v. 刺痛（进行时）

e.en: She had a {prickling} feeling someone was watching her.
e.zh: 她有种被人盯着的刺痛般的感觉。

e.en: My skin was {prickling} from the cold wind outside.
e.zh: 外面的冷风吹得我皮肤发刺。

e.en: The {prickly} bush scratched my arm as I passed.
e.zh: 我经过时那丛带刺的灌木划到了我的手臂。

e.en: He gets {prickly} whenever someone questions his decisions.
e.zh: 一有人质疑他的决定他就变得很易怒。

pricks.t:
v. 刺（第三人称单数）
n. 刺（复数）

e.en: A few {pricks} from the rose bush left tiny marks.
e.zh: 被玫瑰丛扎了几下,留下了小小的痕迹。

e.en: The nurse {pricks} my finger to test the blood sugar.
e.zh: 护士扎我的手指来测血糖。

e.en: Concert tickets have gotten really {pricy} this year.
e.zh: 今年的演唱会门票变得相当贵。

e.en: That handbag looks nice but it's way too {pricy}.
e.zh: 那个手提包很好看,但实在太贵了。

pride.t:
n. 自豪；骄傲
v. 以…自豪

e.en: She takes great {pride} in her handmade pottery.
e.zh: 她对自己手工制作的陶器感到非常自豪。

e.en: A {pride} of lions rested under the acacia tree.
e.zh: 一群狮子在金合欢树下休息。

e.en: He was too {prideful} to admit he was wrong.
e.zh: 他太自负了,不肯承认自己错了。

e.en: Her {prideful} attitude made teamwork really difficult.
e.zh: 她那种傲慢的态度让团队合作变得很困难。

e.en: The {priest} blessed the couple at the wedding ceremony.
e.zh: 神父在婚礼上为这对新人祝福。

e.en: A young {priest} led the morning service today.
e.zh: 今天一位年轻的神父主持了晨间礼拜。

priestess.t: n. 女祭司；女神职人员

e.en: In the legend, a {priestess} guarded the sacred temple.
e.zh: 传说中,一位女祭司守护着这座神庙。

e.en: The high {priestess} performed an ancient ritual at dawn.
e.zh: 大女祭司在黎明时分举行了古老的仪式。

priesthood.t: n. 神职；神职人员（总称）

e.en: He entered the {priesthood} after finishing seminary school.
e.zh: 他从神学院毕业后就进入了神职界。

e.en: The {priesthood} has shaped religious life for centuries.
e.zh: 神职阶层数百年来塑造了宗教生活。

e.en: He wore his {priestly} robes for the Sunday service.
e.zh: 他穿着神职袍参加周日的礼拜。

e.en: Her tone took on an almost {priestly} solemnity.
e.zh: 她的语气变得几乎像神职人员般庄严。

e.en: Several {priests} gathered at the cathedral for the ceremony.
e.zh: 几位神父聚集在大教堂里参加典礼。

e.en: Buddhist {priests} chanted softly in the temple hall.
e.zh: 佛教僧侣在寺庙大殿中低声诵经。

prig.t: n. 自命清高的人；一本正经的人

e.en: Don't be such a {prig} about table manners.
e.zh: 别在餐桌礼仪上那么一本正经。

e.en: His classmates called him a {prig} for refusing to joke around.
e.zh: 他不肯开玩笑,同学们都说他古板。

priggish.t: adj. 自命不凡的；一本正经的

e.en: His {priggish} comments annoyed everyone at the dinner.
e.zh: 他那一本正经的评论让饭桌上的人都很不爽。

e.en: She found his {priggish} attitude toward modern art tiresome.
e.zh: 她觉得他对现代艺术那种古板的态度令人厌烦。

prim.t: adj. 一本正经的；拘谨的

e.en: She gave a {prim} smile and straightened her collar.
e.zh: 她端庄地笑了笑,理了理衣领。

e.en: His {prim} manner felt out of place at the casual party.
e.zh: 他那拘谨的举止在休闲派对上显得格格不入。

prima.t: adj. 首席的；第一的（多见于 prima donna）

e.en: She trained for years to become a {prima} ballerina.
e.zh: 她苦练多年才成为首席芭蕾舞演员。

e.en: The {prima} donna received a standing ovation last night.
e.zh: 昨晚那位首席女歌手获得了全场起立鼓掌。

primacy.t: n. 首要地位；至高无上

e.en: English has lost its {primacy} in some online communities.
e.zh: 在某些网络社区,英语已不再占据主导地位。

e.en: The CEO emphasized the {primacy} of customer experience.
e.zh: 首席执行官强调了客户体验的首要地位。

primaeval.t: adj. 远古的；原始的（= primeval）

e.en: The {primaeval} forest had never been touched by loggers.
e.zh: 这片原始森林从未被伐木者踏足过。

e.en: Something {primaeval} stirred in him at the sight of fire.
e.zh: 看到火光时,他心中涌起一种原始的悸动。

e.en: Hunger is one of our most {primal} instincts.
e.zh: 饥饿是我们最原始的本能之一。

e.en: She let out a {primal} scream after the long week.
e.zh: 经过漫长的一周后,她发出了一声原始的尖叫。

e.en: The app is {primarily} used by college students.
e.zh: 这款应用主要被大学生使用。

e.en: He works {primarily} from home these days.
e.zh: 他最近主要在家办公。

primary.t:
adj. 主要的；首要的
n. 初选

e.en: Email is still my {primary} way of contacting clients.
e.zh: 邮件仍然是我联系客户的主要方式。

e.en: Their {primary} concern is keeping the data secure.
e.zh: 他们最主要的关切是保护数据安全。

primate.t: n. 灵长类动物；大主教

e.en: The chimpanzee is our closest {primate} relative.
e.zh: 黑猩猩是与我们最近的灵长类亲属。

e.en: Researchers studied the {primate} for over a decade.
e.zh: 研究人员对这种灵长类动物研究了十多年。

e.en: The {primatologist} spent years observing gorillas in Rwanda.
e.zh: 这位灵长类学家在卢旺达观察大猩猩多年。

e.en: She became a famous {primatologist} after her field studies.
e.zh: 她做了田野调查后成了著名的灵长类学家。

primavera.t: n. 春日时蔬（意式烹饪）；春天

e.en: I ordered the pasta {primavera} with extra vegetables.
e.zh: 我点了蔬菜意面,还加了额外的蔬菜。

e.en: This restaurant's chicken {primavera} is absolutely delicious.
e.zh: 这家餐厅的春蔬鸡肉真的非常美味。

prime.t:
adj. 首要的；最佳的
v. 使准备好；打底

e.en: This is {prime} time for streaming services to launch new shows.
e.zh: 现在是流媒体平台推新剧的黄金时段。

e.en: Seven is a {prime} number divisible only by itself and one.
e.zh: 七是只能被自身和一整除的质数。

primed.t: adj. 准备就绪的；已打底的

e.en: The team is {primed} to win the championship this season.
e.zh: 这支球队已经做好准备本赛季夺冠。

e.en: She {primed} the wall before painting it white.
e.zh: 她在把墙刷成白色之前先打了底漆。

e.en: This article is a great {primer} on machine learning.
e.zh: 这篇文章是机器学习入门的绝佳读物。

e.en: Apply a thin coat of {primer} before the topcoat.
e.zh: 涂面漆之前先薄薄地涂一层底漆。

e.en: The hikers were awed by the {primeval} forest.
e.zh: 徒步者们被这片原始森林深深震撼。

e.en: A {primeval} fear gripped him in the dark cave.
e.zh: 在漆黑的洞穴里,一种原始的恐惧攫住了他。

priming.t: n. 启动；打底；启发效应

e.en: The marketing team is {priming} customers for the big launch.
e.zh: 营销团队正在为重大发布会预热客户情绪。

e.en: He spent the morning {priming} the wooden door.
e.zh: 他花了一上午给那扇木门刷底漆。

primitive.t:
adj. 原始的；简陋的
n. 基本类型

e.en: Early phones were {primitive} compared to today's smartphones.
e.zh: 早期的电话和如今的智能手机相比相当原始。

e.en: The cabin had only {primitive} plumbing and no heating.
e.zh: 那间小屋只有简陋的水管,也没有暖气。

e.en: The website was {primitively} designed but functional enough.
e.zh: 这个网站设计得很简陋,但勉强够用。

e.en: They lived {primitively}, without electricity or running water.
e.zh: 他们过着原始的生活,没有电也没有自来水。

e.en: The film captures the raw {primitiveness} of frontier life.
e.zh: 这部电影捕捉到了边疆生活的原始粗犷。

e.en: There was a charming {primitiveness} to the village's traditions.
e.zh: 这个村子的传统中有种迷人的原始气息。

primitivism.t: n. 原始主义（艺术流派）

e.en: Picasso's early work showed the influence of {primitivism}.
e.zh: 毕加索的早期作品显示出原始主义的影响。

e.en: The exhibit explored {primitivism} in twentieth-century painting.
e.zh: 该展览探讨了二十世纪绘画中的原始主义。

primly.t: adv. 一本正经地；拘谨地

e.en: She sat {primly} on the edge of the sofa.
e.zh: 她端端正正地坐在沙发边上。

e.en: He {primly} declined the second glass of wine.
e.zh: 他一本正经地谢绝了第二杯酒。

e.en: Her {primness} softened once she got to know us.
e.zh: 她跟我们熟了之后,那份拘谨就缓和了下来。

e.en: There was a hint of {primness} in the way she dressed.
e.zh: 她的穿着透着一丝端庄拘谨的味道。

e.en: This is {primo} coffee — the best I've had all week.
e.zh: 这咖啡顶级,是我这一周喝过最好的。

e.en: He scored {primo} seats for the championship game.
e.zh: 他抢到了总决赛的顶级座位。

e.en: Under {primogeniture}, the eldest son inherits the family estate.
e.zh: 按照长子继承制,长子会继承家族产业。

e.en: Many modern countries have abolished the rule of {primogeniture}.
e.zh: 许多现代国家已经废除了长子继承制。

e.en: Life may have started in a {primordial} ocean billions of years ago.
e.zh: 生命可能起源于数十亿年前的原始海洋。

e.en: The film taps into a {primordial} fear of the dark.
e.zh: 这部电影触动了人对黑暗的原始恐惧。

e.en: She likes to {primp} in front of the mirror before dates.
e.zh: 约会前她喜欢对着镜子精心打扮。

e.en: He didn't {primp} much before heading out for coffee.
e.zh: 他出门去喝咖啡前没怎么打扮。

e.en: A pale yellow {primrose} bloomed by the garden gate.
e.zh: 一朵淡黄色的报春花在花园门旁绽放。

e.en: She planted {primrose} along the front walkway last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天在前院小路边种了报春花。

e.en: The greenhouse was full of pink {primula} flowers in February.
e.zh: 二月份温室里开满了粉色的报春花。

e.en: She gave me a potted {primula} for my birthday.
e.zh: 她送了我一盆报春花作为生日礼物。

primus.t: n. 首席主教；普利姆斯炉

e.en: Campers heated soup over a small {primus} stove.
e.zh: 露营者用一个小煤油炉热汤。

e.en: The old {primus} still works after decades of use.
e.zh: 那个老煤油炉用了几十年依然能用。

e.en: The young {prince} waved to the crowd from the balcony.
e.zh: 年轻的王子在阳台上向人群挥手致意。

e.en: In the fairy tale, a {prince} rescues the trapped maiden.
e.zh: 童话里,王子救出了被困的少女。

e.en: The small {princedom} declared independence in the eighteenth century.
e.zh: 这个小公国在十八世纪宣布独立。

e.en: His {princedom} stretched along the river for many miles.
e.zh: 他的公国沿着河岸绵延数英里。

princeling.t: n. 小王子；太子党成员

e.en: The young {princeling} lived a sheltered life in the palace.
e.zh: 这位小王子在宫中过着养尊处优的生活。

e.en: Critics called him a spoiled {princeling} of the tech industry.
e.zh: 评论者称他为科技界被宠坏的小王子。

e.en: He received a {princely} sum for selling the startup.
e.zh: 他卖掉那家初创公司，获得了一笔可观的金额。

e.en: The hotel offered {princely} treatment to every guest.
e.zh: 那家酒店给每位客人都提供了王子般的待遇。

e.en: Two {princes} attended the royal wedding in London.
e.zh: 两位王子出席了在伦敦举行的皇家婚礼。

e.en: The fairy tale features brave {princes} and clever animals.
e.zh: 这个童话讲述了勇敢的王子和聪明的动物。

e.en: My daughter dressed up as a {princess} for Halloween.
e.zh: 我女儿万圣节打扮成了一位公主。

e.en: The {princess} gave a speech at the charity event.
e.zh: 公主在慈善活动上发表了讲话。

princesse.t: n. 公主式连衣裙（合身连体剪裁）

e.en: She wore a classic {princesse} gown to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿着一件经典的公主裙参加晚会。

e.en: The dress features a flattering {princesse} silhouette.
e.zh: 这件礼服采用了显瘦的公主线剪裁。

e.en: Disney movies often feature strong {princesses} now.
e.zh: 如今迪士尼电影常常塑造坚强的公主形象。

e.en: The two {princesses} waved to the cheering crowd.
e.zh: 两位公主向欢呼的人群挥手致意。

princeton.t: n. 普林斯顿（大学/地名）

e.en: She got accepted to {Princeton} University last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天被普林斯顿大学录取了。

e.en: The conference will be held at {Princeton} next month.
e.zh: 会议下个月将在普林斯顿举行。

principal.t:
adj. 主要的
n. 校长；本金

e.en: The school {principal} announced new safety rules today.
e.zh: 校长今天宣布了新的安全规定。

e.en: Our {principal} concern is protecting user privacy.
e.zh: 我们最主要的关切是保护用户隐私。

e.en: Monaco is a tiny {principality} on the French Riviera.
e.zh: 摩纳哥是位于法国蔚蓝海岸的一个小公国。

e.en: The {principality} maintains its independence from neighboring countries.
e.zh: 该公国一直保持独立于周边国家。

e.en: The fund invests {principally} in tech startups.
e.zh: 该基金主要投资于科技初创公司。

e.en: Air pollution comes {principally} from vehicle emissions.
e.zh: 空气污染主要来自汽车尾气排放。

e.en: All the school {principals} met to discuss the new curriculum.
e.zh: 所有校长聚在一起讨论新课程。

e.en: The deal's {principals} signed the contract this morning.
e.zh: 交易的几方主事人今天上午签了合同。

principalship.t: n. 校长职位；负责人身份

e.en: She accepted the {principalship} of a large urban high school.
e.zh: 她接受了一所大型城市高中的校长职务。

e.en: His {principalship} lasted nearly fifteen years.
e.zh: 他担任校长一职将近十五年。

e.en: São Tomé and {Príncipe} is a small island nation in Africa.
e.zh: 圣多美和普林西比是非洲的一个小岛国。

e.en: We sailed to {Príncipe} for a quiet beach holiday.
e.zh: 我们坐船去普林西比岛度过了一个宁静的海滩假期。

principia.t: n. 原理（牛顿《自然哲学的数学原理》）

e.en: Newton's {Principia} laid the foundations of modern physics.
e.zh: 牛顿的《原理》为现代物理学奠定了基础。

e.en: The library owns a rare first edition of {Principia}.
e.zh: 图书馆收藏着一本珍贵的《原理》初版。

e.en: Honesty is a core {principle} in our company culture.
e.zh: 诚实是我们公司文化的核心原则。

e.en: The engine works on the same {principle} as a turbine.
e.zh: 这台发动机的工作原理与涡轮机相同。

e.en: She is a {principled} leader who never compromises on ethics.
e.zh: 她是位有原则的领导者，从不在道德上妥协。

e.en: The team made a {principled} decision to refund customers.
e.zh: 团队做出了有原则的决定，给顾客退款。

e.en: Good design follows a few simple {principles}.
e.zh: 好的设计遵循几条简单的原则。

e.en: He refused the offer on moral {principles}.
e.zh: 出于道德原则，他拒绝了这项提议。

pringle.t: n. 品客（薯片品牌）；姓氏

e.en: I can never eat just one {Pringle} from the can.
e.zh: 我从来都做不到只吃一片品客薯片。

e.en: He wore a classic {Pringle} sweater to the golf club.
e.zh: 他穿着一件经典的普林格毛衣去高尔夫俱乐部。

print.t:
v. 打印；印刷
n. 印刷品；版画

e.en: Please {print} two copies of the contract for the meeting.
e.zh: 请把合同打印两份带去会议。

e.en: The newspaper still has a strong {print} edition.
e.zh: 这份报纸的纸质版仍然很受欢迎。

e.en: Download the {printable} worksheet from our website.
e.zh: 请从我们的网站下载可打印的练习题。

e.en: The recipe page has a {printable} version for the kitchen.
e.zh: 这个食谱页面提供了适合厨房使用的打印版。

printed.t:
adj. 印刷的
v. 打印（过去式）

e.en: She {printed} the boarding pass before leaving home.
e.zh: 她在出门前打印了登机牌。

e.en: The shirt is {printed} with colorful tropical flowers.
e.zh: 这件衬衫上印着色彩鲜艳的热带花朵。

e.en: My {printer} ran out of ink right before the deadline.
e.zh: 我的打印机就在截止日期前没墨了。

e.en: Buy a wireless {printer} so everyone can use it.
e.zh: 买台无线打印机，这样大家都能用。

e.en: Office {printers} often jam at the worst possible moment.
e.zh: 办公室打印机总在最不该卡纸的时候卡纸。

e.en: 3D {printers} have become much more affordable recently.
e.zh: 3D打印机近来已经便宜了很多。

e.en: Clean the {printhead} if your prints look streaky.
e.zh: 如果打印件出现条纹，就清洁一下打印头。

e.en: A clogged {printhead} is the most common printer problem.
e.zh: 打印头堵塞是打印机最常见的故障。

printing.t:
n. 印刷；打印
v. 打印（现在分词）

e.en: The book is currently in its third {printing}.
e.zh: 这本书目前已经印到第三版了。

e.en: {Printing} large posters at home is rarely cost-effective.
e.zh: 在家打印大幅海报通常并不划算。

e.en: Early {printings} of the novel are now collector's items.
e.zh: 这本小说的早期印本如今已成为藏品。

e.en: The publisher ordered two more {printings} after strong sales.
e.zh: 销量强劲后，出版社又加印了两次。

e.en: She is a talented {printmaker} who works with woodblocks.
e.zh: 她是一位才华横溢的版画家，专攻木刻。

e.en: The gallery features a young Japanese {printmaker} this month.
e.zh: 画廊本月展出一位年轻的日本版画家的作品。

e.en: She studied {printmaking} at art school for four years.
e.zh: 她在艺术学院学了四年版画。

e.en: {Printmaking} requires patience and a steady hand.
e.zh: 做版画需要耐心和稳定的双手。

e.en: Bring a {printout} of your itinerary to the airport.
e.zh: 请带一份行程单的打印件到机场。

e.en: He highlighted key numbers on the financial {printout}.
e.zh: 他在财务报表打印件上标出了关键数字。

prints.t:
n. 印刷品；指纹
v. 打印（三单）

e.en: The store sells limited-edition art {prints} online.
e.zh: 这家店在网上销售限量版艺术印刷品。

e.en: She {prints} all her receipts for tax purposes.
e.zh: 她为了报税把所有发票都打印出来。

e.en: Mad cow disease is caused by a misfolded {prion} protein.
e.zh: 疯牛病是由一种错误折叠的朊蛋白引起的。

e.en: Scientists study how a {prion} spreads through the brain.
e.zh: 科学家研究朊病毒如何在大脑中扩散。

prior.t:
adj. 先前的；优先的
n. 修道院副院长

e.en: Please book your seat {prior} to the deadline.
e.zh: 请在截止日期之前预订座位。

e.en: No {prior} experience is required for this role.
e.zh: 这个职位不要求有相关工作经验。

e.en: The {prioress} welcomed the visitors at the convent gate.
e.zh: 女修道院院长在修道院门口迎接了访客。

e.en: Chaucer's tales include a memorable {prioress} character.
e.zh: 乔叟的故事中有一位令人难忘的女修道院院长形象。

e.en: My top {priorities} this week are health and family.
e.zh: 我这周最重要的事情是健康和家人。

e.en: You need to set clear {priorities} to finish on time.
e.zh: 你需要设定明确的优先事项才能按时完成。

prioritise.t: v. 优先处理（英式拼写）

e.en: We must {prioritise} customer feedback in the next sprint.
e.zh: 我们必须在下个迭代中优先考虑用户反馈。

e.en: Learn to {prioritise} sleep over late-night scrolling.
e.zh: 学会把睡眠看得比熬夜刷手机更重要。

prioritised.t: v. 优先处理（过去式，英式）

e.en: The team {prioritised} bug fixes before adding new features.
e.zh: 团队优先处理了缺陷修复，然后才添加新功能。

e.en: She {prioritised} her family during the busy holiday season.
e.zh: 在繁忙的假期里，她把家人放在了首位。

e.en: Good {prioritization} is the key to managing a large project.
e.zh: 良好的优先级排序是管理大型项目的关键。

e.en: The team uses a simple framework for task {prioritization}.
e.zh: 团队使用一个简单的框架来对任务排定优先级。

prioritize.t: v. 优先处理；排定优先级

e.en: Always {prioritize} tasks that move the project forward.
e.zh: 永远优先处理能推动项目前进的任务。

e.en: Doctors must {prioritize} patients based on severity.
e.zh: 医生必须根据病情严重程度对病人分轻重。

e.en: The product team {prioritized} mobile features this quarter.
e.zh: 产品团队本季度优先开发了移动端功能。

e.en: Emails are {prioritized} automatically by the new AI filter.
e.zh: 邮件由新的AI过滤器自动按优先级排序。

e.en: Safety is our number-one {priority} on this construction site.
e.zh: 安全是我们工地的头号优先事项。

e.en: Give this ticket high {priority} — the customer is waiting.
e.zh: 把这张工单设为高优先级，客户还在等。

e.en: The medieval {priory} now serves as a small museum.
e.zh: 那座中世纪小修道院如今被改作一座小型博物馆。

e.en: We stayed overnight at an inn near the old {priory}.
e.zh: 我们在那座古老小修道院附近的客栈住了一晚。

e.en: He used a screwdriver to {prise} open the rusty lid.
e.zh: 他用螺丝刀撬开了那个生锈的盖子。

e.en: It's hard to {prise} honest feedback out of close friends.
e.zh: 想从亲密好友那里撬出真心话并不容易。

e.en: She {prised} the lid off the paint can with a coin.
e.zh: 她用一枚硬币撬开了油漆罐的盖子。

e.en: Reporters finally {prised} the truth from the witness.
e.zh: 记者们终于从目击者口中撬出了真相。

e.en: He always {prises} the door open with the same old tool.
e.zh: 他总是用那把旧工具把门撬开。

e.en: A good interviewer {prises} interesting stories from quiet guests.
e.zh: 优秀的采访者能从内向的嘉宾口中挖出有趣的故事。

e.en: She is {prising} the stuck window open with a butter knife.
e.zh: 她正用一把黄油刀撬开那扇卡住的窗户。

e.en: {Prising} information from him takes real patience.
e.zh: 想从他嘴里套出消息需要十足的耐心。

e.en: A glass {prism} splits white light into a rainbow.
e.zh: 玻璃棱镜会把白光分解成彩虹般的光谱。

e.en: He views politics through the {prism} of economics.
e.zh: 他从经济学的视角来看待政治。

prismatic.t: adj. 棱镜的；五彩缤纷的

e.en: Sunlight created {prismatic} patterns on the kitchen wall.
e.zh: 阳光在厨房墙上投出了七彩斑斓的图案。

e.en: The diamond's {prismatic} sparkle caught everyone's eye.
e.zh: 那颗钻石如棱镜般的闪光吸引了所有人的目光。

e.en: He spent five years in {prison} for fraud.
e.zh: 他因诈骗在监狱里待了五年。

e.en: The old {prison} has been converted into a museum.
e.zh: 那座旧监狱已被改造成一座博物馆。

e.en: The {prisoner} was released after serving his full sentence.
e.zh: 那名囚犯在服满刑期后被释放了。

e.en: She felt like a {prisoner} of her own busy schedule.
e.zh: 她觉得自己像是被自己忙碌的日程表困住了。

e.en: The {prisoners} were transferred to a new facility yesterday.
e.zh: 那些囚犯昨天被转移到了一座新监狱。

e.en: All {prisoners} of war must be treated humanely.
e.zh: 所有战俘都必须受到人道对待。

e.en: Many {prisons} are dangerously overcrowded these days.
e.zh: 如今许多监狱都严重超员。

e.en: The country is reforming its {prisons} to focus on rehabilitation.
e.zh: 该国正在改革其监狱体系，更注重改造功能。

prissy.t: adj. 一本正经的；过分讲究的

e.en: Don't be so {prissy} about a little dirt on your shoes.
e.zh: 别为鞋上一点泥就那么挑剔。

e.en: Her {prissy} manners annoyed everyone at the camping trip.
e.zh: 她那一本正经的做派让露营的大家都很烦。

pristine.t: adj. 崭新的；原始纯净的

e.en: The beach was {pristine}, with no trash in sight.
e.zh: 海滩一尘不染,看不到一点垃圾。

e.en: He keeps his vintage car in {pristine} condition.
e.zh: 他把那辆老爷车保养得完好如新。

e.en: The new law protects the {privacies} of online users.
e.zh: 新法律保护网络用户的各项隐私权。

e.en: Different cultures define personal {privacies} in different ways.
e.zh: 不同文化对个人隐私的界定各不相同。

e.en: Please respect my {privacy} and stop reading my messages.
e.zh: 请尊重我的隐私,别再看我的消息了。

e.en: The app updated its {privacy} policy last week.
e.zh: 该应用上周更新了隐私政策。

private.t:
adj. 私人的；私密的
n. 列兵

e.en: This is a {private} conversation between me and my doctor.
e.zh: 这是我和医生之间的私人谈话。

e.en: She set her Instagram account to {private} yesterday.
e.zh: 她昨天把 Instagram 账号设成了私密。

e.en: The {privateer} attacked Spanish ships under royal license.
e.zh: 那名私掠船长持王室许可袭击西班牙船只。

e.en: He raced as a {privateer}, without any factory team support.
e.zh: 他作为私人车手参赛,没有任何厂队支持。

e.en: She {privately} admitted that the project was failing.
e.zh: 她私下承认这个项目正在失败。

e.en: The company is {privately} owned by three siblings.
e.zh: 该公司由三兄妹私人持有。

proboscis.t: n. （象等动物的）长鼻；（昆虫的）喙

e.en: A butterfly sips nectar through its long {proboscis}.
e.zh: 蝴蝶用它细长的口器吸食花蜜。

e.en: The elephant lifted a log with its powerful {proboscis}.
e.zh: 那头大象用它强壮的长鼻卷起一根原木。

procedural.t:
adj. 程序上的
n. 程序剧（影视类型）

e.en: The judge dismissed the case on {procedural} grounds.
e.zh: 法官以程序上的理由驳回了此案。

e.en: I love watching police {procedural} dramas on weekends.
e.zh: 我喜欢周末看警察办案的程序剧。

procedurally.t: adv. 按程序地；在程序上

e.en: The vote was {procedurally} correct but politically risky.
e.zh: 这次投票程序上没问题，但在政治上有风险。

e.en: {Procedurally}, you must file the form before Friday.
e.zh: 按程序，你必须在周五前提交这份表格。

procedurals.t: n. 程序剧（警匪、法律题材剧集）

e.en: Streaming services keep churning out crime {procedurals}.
e.zh: 流媒体平台不断推出新的犯罪程序剧。

e.en: Medical {procedurals} dominated TV ratings last decade.
e.zh: 过去十年医疗程序剧称霸电视收视榜。

e.en: Please follow the standard check-in {procedure} at the desk.
e.zh: 请在前台按标准的入住程序办理。

e.en: The dental {procedure} took less than an hour.
e.zh: 这项牙科手术不到一个小时就完成了。

procedures.t: n. 步骤；程序（procedure 的复数）

e.en: New safety {procedures} were introduced after the accident.
e.zh: 事故发生后引入了新的安全规程。

e.en: The clinic performs minor {procedures} on weekday mornings.
e.zh: 该诊所在工作日上午进行小型手术。

e.en: You may {proceed} to checkout once your cart is ready.
e.zh: 购物车准备好后你就可以去结账了。

e.en: The committee voted to {proceed} with the merger.
e.zh: 委员会投票决定继续推进合并。

proceeded.t: v. 继续进行（proceed 的过去式）

e.en: After lunch, she {proceeded} to write the report.
e.zh: 午饭后，她接着开始写报告。

e.en: The driver ignored the sign and {proceeded} through the intersection.
e.zh: 司机无视路标，径直穿过了路口。

proceeding.t:
n. 进行；诉讼
v. 继续进行

e.en: The court {proceeding} was livestreamed on the news site.
e.zh: 法庭审理过程在新闻网站上直播。

e.en: She kept {proceeding} with the plan despite the warnings.
e.zh: 尽管有警告，她仍继续推进这项计划。

proceedings.t: n. 会议记录；诉讼程序

e.en: Reporters were barred from the closed-door {proceedings}.
e.zh: 记者被禁止参加闭门会议的议程。

e.en: The company faces legal {proceedings} over data misuse.
e.zh: 该公司因滥用数据而面临法律诉讼。

e.en: All {proceeds} from the concert go to disaster relief.
e.zh: 演唱会的所有收益都将用于救灾。

e.en: She {proceeds} carefully whenever the road is icy.
e.zh: 每当路面结冰，她都会小心驾驶。

process.t:
n. 过程；流程
v. 处理（数据、信息）

e.en: The hiring {process} usually takes about three weeks.
e.zh: 招聘流程通常需要大约三周时间。

e.en: Servers {process} thousands of requests every second.
e.zh: 服务器每秒处理数以千计的请求。

processed.t:
v. 已处理
adj. 加工过的

e.en: Doctors warn against eating too much {processed} food.
e.zh: 医生警告不要吃太多加工食品。

e.en: Your refund has been {processed} and should arrive Monday.
e.zh: 您的退款已处理完毕，应于周一到账。

processes.t:
n. 过程；进程
v. 处理（process 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The factory is automating its production {processes}.
e.zh: 这家工厂正在将其生产流程自动化。

e.en: The brain {processes} sound much faster than light.
e.zh: 大脑处理声音的速度比处理光线快得多。

processing.t:
n. 处理；加工
v. 正在处理

e.en: Photo {processing} can take a minute on older phones.
e.zh: 在旧手机上，照片处理可能需要一分钟。

e.en: I'm still {processing} the news from this morning.
e.zh: 我还在消化今早的那条消息。

processings.t: n. 处理；加工（罕用复数）

e.en: The lab logged multiple sample {processings} this week.
e.zh: 实验室本周记录了多次样本处理流程。

e.en: Different image {processings} produce subtly different results.
e.zh: 不同的图像处理流程会产生略有差异的结果。

procession.t: n. 游行队伍；列队行进

e.en: A long {procession} of mourners followed the coffin.
e.zh: 一长队哀悼者跟在灵柩后面。

e.en: The wedding {procession} moved slowly down the aisle.
e.zh: 婚礼队伍沿着走廊缓缓前行。

processional.t:
adj. 游行的
n. 游行圣歌

e.en: The choir sang a hymn during the {processional}.
e.zh: 唱诗班在入场仪式中唱了一首圣歌。

e.en: Guests stood as the {processional} music began.
e.zh: 入场进行曲响起时，宾客们纷纷起立。

e.en: The new laptop has a much faster {processor} than mine.
e.zh: 这款新笔记本的处理器比我的快多了。

e.en: She blended the soup smooth using a food {processor}.
e.zh: 她用料理机把汤打得细腻顺滑。

processors.t: n. 处理器（processor 的复数）

e.en: Modern phones pack incredibly powerful {processors}.
e.zh: 现代手机搭载着性能极强的处理器。

e.en: Payment {processors} charge a small fee per transaction.
e.zh: 支付处理商每笔交易会收取少量手续费。

e.en: Critics {proclaim} the film a masterpiece of the year.
e.zh: 评论家们宣称这部电影是年度杰作。

e.en: The mayor will {proclaim} Saturday as a city holiday.
e.zh: 市长将宣布周六为本市的节日。

proclaimed.t: v. 宣告（proclaim 的过去式）

e.en: The startup {proclaimed} itself the future of fintech.
e.zh: 这家初创公司宣称自己是金融科技的未来。

e.en: He {proclaimed} his innocence loudly outside the courtroom.
e.zh: 他在法庭外大声宣称自己无罪。

e.en: Banners {proclaiming} victory hung across the stadium.
e.zh: 宣告胜利的横幅悬挂在整个体育场内。

e.en: She posted online {proclaiming} her engagement to friends.
e.zh: 她在网上发帖向朋友们宣布订婚的消息。

proclaims.t: v. 宣告（proclaim 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The headline boldly {proclaims} a breakthrough in cancer research.
e.zh: 头条新闻大胆宣布癌症研究取得突破。

e.en: Every spring, the festival {proclaims} the arrival of new tea.
e.zh: 每年春天，这个节日都宣告新茶上市。

e.en: The president signed a {proclamation} honoring frontline workers.
e.zh: 总统签署了一份表彰一线工作者的公告。

e.en: His sudden {proclamation} of love surprised everyone at dinner.
e.zh: 他在晚餐上突然的爱情宣言让所有人都吃了一惊。

e.en: He has a {proclivity} for staying up far too late.
e.zh: 他有熬夜熬得太晚的习惯。

e.en: Her {proclivity} toward risk made her a natural trader.
e.zh: 她爱冒险的天性让她天生就是个交易员。

e.en: The Roman {proconsul} governed the province for two years.
e.zh: 这位罗马总督管辖该行省长达两年。

e.en: Critics called the diplomat a modern {proconsul} abroad.
e.zh: 评论家把这位外交官称为驻外的现代总督。

e.en: I always {procrastinate} when I have a big essay due.
e.zh: 每当有大篇论文要交，我总是拖延症发作。

e.en: Don't {procrastinate} on filing your taxes this year.
e.zh: 今年报税别再拖延了。

e.en: Chronic {procrastination} can really hurt your grades.
e.zh: 长期拖延确实会严重影响你的成绩。

e.en: He blames {procrastination} for missing the deadline.
e.zh: 他把错过截止日期归咎于自己的拖延。

e.en: Her many {procrastinations} finally caught up at exam time.
e.zh: 她那么多次拖延，最终在考试时彻底失算了。

e.en: Daily {procrastinations} slowly piled into a serious backlog.
e.zh: 每天的拖延慢慢堆积成了严重的积压。

procrastinator.t: n. 拖延者；有拖延症的人

e.en: I'm a hopeless {procrastinator} when it comes to chores.
e.zh: 在做家务这件事上，我是个无可救药的拖延者。

e.en: Every {procrastinator} swears next week will be different.
e.zh: 每个拖延者都信誓旦旦说下周一定不一样。

e.en: Many species migrate long distances to {procreate}.
e.zh: 许多物种会长途迁徙以繁衍后代。

e.en: Pandas rarely {procreate} successfully in captivity.
e.zh: 大熊猫在圈养环境下很少能成功繁育。

e.en: Salmon swim upstream for {procreation} each summer.
e.zh: 鲑鱼每年夏天逆流而上进行繁殖。

e.en: The book separates love from mere {procreation}.
e.zh: 这本书把爱情与单纯的繁衍区分开来。

procreative.t: adj. 生育的；有繁殖能力的

e.en: Frogs enter their {procreative} season after the first rains.
e.zh: 青蛙在初雨过后进入繁殖季节。

e.en: The clinic studies {procreative} health in older couples.
e.zh: 该诊所研究高龄夫妇的生育健康问题。

procrustean.t: adj. 强求一致的；削足适履的

e.en: The new rules force teachers into a {procrustean} format.
e.zh: 新规则把老师强行套进一个削足适履的模式。

e.en: Avoid {procrustean} thinking when designing for diverse users.
e.zh: 为多元用户设计时，避免削足适履式的思维。

procter.t: n. 普罗克特（姓氏，如宝洁 P&G）

e.en: Shares of {Procter} & Gamble rose after strong earnings.
e.zh: 宝洁公司公布亮眼业绩后股价上涨。

e.en: She interned at {Procter} & Gamble's marketing division last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天她在宝洁的市场部实习。

e.en: The patient underwent a {proctocolectomy} to treat severe colitis.
e.zh: 这位患者接受了直肠结肠切除术以治疗严重的结肠炎。

e.en: Recovery from a {proctocolectomy} usually takes several weeks.
e.zh: 直肠结肠切除术的恢复通常需要数周时间。

e.en: His doctor referred him to a {proctologist} last month.
e.zh: 上个月他的医生把他转诊给了一位肛肠科专家。

e.en: The {proctologist} reassured her the screening was routine.
e.zh: 肛肠科医生安慰她说这次检查只是常规项目。

proctor.t:
n. 监考员
v. 监考

e.en: A {proctor} walked between the rows during the exam.
e.zh: 考试期间，一位监考员在座位间来回走动。

e.en: The school will {proctor} the test online this year.
e.zh: 今年学校将以在线方式监考这场考试。

e.en: The {procurator} reviewed the evidence before filing charges.
e.zh: 检察官在提起诉讼前审阅了证据。

e.en: In ancient Rome, a {procurator} managed the emperor's estates.
e.zh: 在古罗马，皇帝的庄园由总督代理人管理。

e.en: The team had to {procure} new laptops before the launch.
e.zh: 团队必须在发布前采购新的笔记本电脑。

e.en: It took weeks to {procure} a permit for the festival.
e.zh: 为这场节庆活动办许可证花了好几周。

e.en: The {procurement} department handles all supplier contracts.
e.zh: 采购部负责处理所有供应商合同。

e.en: Government {procurement} rules require competitive bidding.
e.zh: 政府采购规定要求进行竞标。

e.en: She works as a {procurer} of rare books for collectors.
e.zh: 她为收藏家专门搜罗稀有书籍。

e.en: The hotel's {procurer} sources fresh seafood every morning.
e.zh: 酒店的采购员每天早晨都会采购新鲜海产。

prod.t:
v. 戳；督促
n. 刺；激励

e.en: She gave him a gentle {prod} to wake him up.
e.zh: 她轻轻戳了他一下把他叫醒。

e.en: The manager had to {prod} the team to meet the deadline.
e.zh: 经理不得不催促团队按期完成任务。

prodding.t: v. 督促；戳（prod 的现在分词）

e.en: After much {prodding} from friends, he finally applied for the job.
e.zh: 在朋友们再三劝说下,他终于去申请了那份工作。

e.en: The cat kept {prodding} the box with its paw.
e.zh: 那只猫不停地用爪子戳那个盒子。

e.en: He was {prodigal} with his money during college.
e.zh: 他在大学期间花钱大手大脚。

e.en: The {prodigal} son returned home after years away.
e.zh: 那个浪子离家多年后终于回来了。

e.en: His {prodigality} eventually left him bankrupt.
e.zh: 他的挥霍无度最终使他破产。

e.en: The party showed a striking {prodigality} of food and drink.
e.zh: 那场派对展现出令人惊叹的食物饮品之奢侈。

e.en: She has a {prodigious} memory for names and faces.
e.zh: 她对人名和面孔有着惊人的记忆力。

e.en: The author produced a {prodigious} amount of work in one year.
e.zh: 那位作家在一年里写出了数量惊人的作品。

e.en: He reads {prodigiously}, finishing a book every two days.
e.zh: 他读书极多,每两天就能读完一本。

e.en: The startup grew {prodigiously} after the viral launch.
e.zh: 那家初创公司在爆红上线后增长惊人。

e.en: She was a piano {prodigy} who performed at age six.
e.zh: 她是一位六岁就登台演奏的钢琴神童。

e.en: The young chess {prodigy} defeated a grandmaster online.
e.zh: 那位年轻的国际象棋神童在网上击败了一位特级大师。

e.en: Refugees endured years of {privation} during the war.
e.zh: 难民们在战争中忍受了多年的贫困匮乏。

e.en: He spoke about the {privation} he faced growing up poor.
e.zh: 他谈起了自己贫困成长时所经历的困苦。

e.en: The {privatisation} of the railways sparked public protests.
e.zh: 铁路私有化引发了公众抗议。

e.en: Critics argue {privatisation} often raises consumer prices.
e.zh: 批评者认为私有化往往会抬高消费者价格。

e.en: The government plans to {privatise} the national airline.
e.zh: 政府计划将国家航空公司私有化。

e.en: Many countries chose to {privatise} state-run utilities.
e.zh: 许多国家选择把国营公用事业私有化。

privatised.t:
v. privatise 的过去式/过去分词
adj. 已私有化的

e.en: Britain {privatised} its phone network in the 1980s.
e.zh: 英国在上世纪八十年代将电话网络私有化。

e.en: The newly {privatised} firm laid off thousands of workers.
e.zh: 刚刚私有化的公司裁掉了数千名员工。

e.en: The {privatization} of healthcare remains a controversial topic.
e.zh: 医疗私有化仍是一个有争议的话题。

e.en: Economists debate the long-term effects of {privatization}.
e.zh: 经济学家就私有化的长期影响展开辩论。

e.en: The 1990s saw a wave of {privatizations} across Eastern Europe.
e.zh: 九十年代东欧出现了一波私有化浪潮。

e.en: Several major {privatizations} are scheduled for next year.
e.zh: 明年安排了几项重大的私有化项目。

e.en: Lawmakers voted to {privatize} the city's water system.
e.zh: 议员们投票将该市的供水系统私有化。

e.en: There's pressure to {privatize} the postal service entirely.
e.zh: 有压力要求将邮政服务完全私有化。

privatized.t:
v. privatize 的过去式/过去分词
adj. 已私有化的

e.en: The {privatized} prison system has faced harsh criticism.
e.zh: 私有化的监狱体系受到了严厉批评。

e.en: Argentina {privatized} most of its airports in the 1990s.
e.zh: 阿根廷在九十年代将大部分机场私有化。

e.en: The minister was a well-known {privatizer} of state assets.
e.zh: 那位部长是著名的国有资产私有化推动者。

e.en: Critics labeled him a ruthless {privatizer} of public services.
e.zh: 批评者称他是无情推动公共服务私有化的人。

e.en: A neat {privet} hedge surrounded the small garden.
e.zh: 一圈整齐的女贞树篱围着这座小花园。

e.en: He trimmed the {privet} every weekend in summer.
e.zh: 夏天他每个周末都修剪女贞。

privilege.t:
n. 特权；优待
v. 给予特权

e.en: It's a {privilege} to work with such a talented team.
e.zh: 能与这么有才华的团队共事是一种荣幸。

e.en: Voting is both a right and a {privilege}.
e.zh: 投票既是一种权利,也是一种特权。

privileged.t: adj. 享有特权的；优越的

e.en: She grew up in a {privileged} household with private tutors.
e.zh: 她在富裕的家庭长大,有私人家教。

e.en: Only {privileged} accounts can access this admin panel.
e.zh: 只有特权账户才能访问该管理面板。

privileges.t:
n. privilege 的复数
v. 第三人称单数

e.en: Premium members enjoy several extra {privileges}.
e.zh: 高级会员享有若干额外特权。

e.en: The hospital granted him full surgical {privileges}.
e.zh: 医院授予了他完整的外科手术权限。

e.en: The algorithm is {privileging} popular posts over recent ones.
e.zh: 该算法把热门帖子的权重置于最新帖子之上。

e.en: Critics accused the school of {privileging} wealthy applicants.
e.zh: 批评者指责学校偏袒富裕家庭的申请者。

e.en: He {privily} warned his friend about the upcoming layoffs.
e.zh: 他私下里提醒朋友即将到来的裁员。

e.en: The senator {privily} met with the lobbyists last night.
e.zh: 那位参议员昨晚秘密会见了游说人士。

privity.t: n. (法律) 私人关系；知情

e.en: There was no {privity} of contract between the two companies.
e.zh: 两家公司之间没有合同上的相互关系。

e.en: The court ruled that {privity} did not apply to the bystander.
e.zh: 法院裁定合同相对性不适用于那位旁观者。

privy.t:
adj. 私下知情的
n. 户外厕所

e.en: Only a few executives were {privy} to the merger plans.
e.zh: 只有少数高管知晓这项合并计划。

e.en: I'm not {privy} to what was discussed in that meeting.
e.zh: 我不知道那次会议讨论了什么。

prix.t: n. 奖（法语借词，常见于 Grand Prix）

e.en: He won the Grand {Prix} in Monaco last weekend.
e.zh: 他上周末赢得了摩纳哥大奖赛冠军。

e.en: The film took home the top {Prix} at Cannes.
e.zh: 这部电影摘得戛纳的最高奖项。

prize.t:
n. 奖品；奖金
v. 珍视

e.en: She won first {prize} in the photography contest.
e.zh: 她在摄影比赛中获得了一等奖。

e.en: I really {prize} the time I spend with my family.
e.zh: 我非常珍视和家人相处的时光。

prized.t:
adj. 被珍视的
v. prize 的过去式

e.en: His {prized} guitar was signed by his favorite musician.
e.zh: 他珍爱的那把吉他是他最喜欢的音乐家签名的。

e.en: Honesty is highly {prized} in this company's culture.
e.zh: 在这家公司的文化里,诚实备受推崇。

e.en: The {prizefight} drew over fifty thousand spectators.
e.zh: 这场职业拳击赛吸引了五万多名观众。

e.en: He trained for months before the championship {prizefight}.
e.zh: 他在冠军职业拳赛前训练了好几个月。

e.en: The retired {prizefighter} now runs a boxing gym.
e.zh: 那位退役的职业拳手现在经营着一家拳击馆。

e.en: As a young {prizefighter}, he never lost a single match.
e.zh: 年轻时作为职业拳手,他从未输过一场比赛。

e.en: The school's annual {prizegiving} ceremony is tomorrow night.
e.zh: 学校每年的颁奖典礼定在明晚。

e.en: Parents gathered for the {prizegiving} at the end of term.
e.zh: 学期末家长们聚集参加颁奖典礼。

prizes.t:
n. prize 的复数
v. 第三人称单数

e.en: Top {prizes} include a laptop and a paid trip to Tokyo.
e.zh: 头奖包括一台笔记本电脑和一次东京全包旅行。

e.en: He {prizes} loyalty above almost any other quality.
e.zh: 他几乎把忠诚看得高于任何其他品质。

e.en: The Nobel {prizewinner} gave a moving acceptance speech.
e.zh: 那位诺贝尔奖得主发表了感人的获奖致辞。

e.en: Her latest novel was a {prizewinner} at the book awards.
e.zh: 她最新的小说在图书奖项中获奖。

pro.t:
n. 专业人士；赞成者
adj. 专业的

e.en: She's a total {pro} when it comes to public speaking.
e.zh: 在公开演讲方面她绝对是个老手。

e.en: Let's list the {pro} and con of moving abroad.
e.zh: 我们来列一下出国生活的利与弊吧。

proactive.t: adj. 积极主动的；先发制人的

e.en: Being {proactive} about your health saves trouble later.
e.zh: 主动关注健康可以省去日后的麻烦。

e.en: The team took a {proactive} approach to fixing bugs.
e.zh: 团队采取了主动的方法来修复漏洞。

e.en: The company {proactively} reached out to affected customers.
e.zh: 公司主动联系了受影响的客户。

e.en: He {proactively} updated the documentation before anyone asked.
e.zh: 还没人提要求,他就主动更新了文档。

e.en: No {prob}, I can pick you up from the airport.
e.zh: 没问题,我可以去机场接你。

e.en: That'll {prob} take about an hour to finish.
e.zh: 那个大概需要一个小时才能完成。

e.en: Weather forecasts rely on {probabilistic} models, not certainties.
e.zh: 天气预报依赖概率模型,而不是确定的结果。

e.en: The algorithm uses a {probabilistic} approach to rank results.
e.zh: 该算法使用概率方法来对结果排序。

e.en: The model outputs {probabilities} for each possible outcome.
e.zh: 该模型为每种可能的结果输出概率值。

e.en: Insurance companies calculate {probabilities} of various risks daily.
e.zh: 保险公司每天都在计算各类风险的发生概率。

e.en: There's a high {probability} of rain tomorrow afternoon.
e.zh: 明天下午下雨的概率很高。

e.en: In all {probability}, the flight will be delayed again.
e.zh: 很可能这趟航班还会再次延误。

e.en: It's {probable} that the meeting will be rescheduled.
e.zh: 会议很可能会改期。

e.en: The most {probable} cause of the crash was human error.
e.zh: 撞车最可能的原因是人为失误。

e.en: I'll {probably} stay home and watch a movie tonight.
e.zh: 我今晚大概会待在家里看部电影。

e.en: She's {probably} stuck in traffic again, like yesterday.
e.zh: 她可能又像昨天一样堵在路上了。

probate.t:
n. 遗嘱认证
v. 认证遗嘱

e.en: The will is currently going through {probate} court.
e.zh: 这份遗嘱目前正在遗嘱认证法院进行认证。

e.en: {Probate} can take many months to complete in some states.
e.zh: 在有些州,遗嘱认证要几个月才能完成。

e.en: He was sentenced to two years of {probation} instead of jail.
e.zh: 他被判两年缓刑,而不是入狱。

e.en: New employees are on {probation} for the first three months.
e.zh: 新员工前三个月处于试用期。

e.en: All new hires complete a six-month {probationary} period.
e.zh: 所有新员工都要经过六个月的试用期。

e.en: She's still in her {probationary} role at the firm.
e.zh: 她在公司里仍处于试用期岗位。

e.en: The {probationer} must check in with her officer weekly.
e.zh: 这名缓刑人员必须每周向缓刑官报到。

e.en: As a {probationer}, he wasn't allowed to leave the state.
e.zh: 作为缓刑人员,他不被允许离开本州。

e.en: The judge ruled the photo had no {probative} value.
e.zh: 法官裁定这张照片没有证据价值。

e.en: Lawyers argued the email was highly {probative} of intent.
e.zh: 律师们认为这封邮件对证明意图非常有力。

probe.t:
v. 探查；调查
n. 探针；调查

e.en: Investigators launched a {probe} into the company's finances.
e.zh: 调查人员对该公司的财务展开了调查。

e.en: The space {probe} sent back images of distant moons.
e.zh: 那个太空探测器传回了遥远卫星的图像。

probed.t: v. probe 的过去式/过去分词

e.en: The reporter {probed} the senator about his recent vote.
e.zh: 记者就那位参议员近期的投票进行追问。

e.en: Doctors {probed} the wound carefully before stitching it up.
e.zh: 医生小心地探查伤口,然后才缝合。

probes.t:
n. probe 的复数
v. 第三人称单数

e.en: The agency {probes} hundreds of fraud cases every year.
e.zh: 该机构每年调查数百起欺诈案件。

e.en: Two robotic {probes} are heading toward the asteroid belt.
e.zh: 两个机器人探测器正飞向小行星带。

probing.t:
adj. 刨根问底的
v. probe 的现在分词

e.en: The journalist asked several {probing} questions about the scandal.
e.zh: 记者就这桩丑闻提了好几个尖锐的问题。

e.en: Doctors are still {probing} the cause of the strange illness.
e.zh: 医生们仍在探究这种怪病的病因。

probiotic.t:
n. 益生菌
adj. 益生的

e.en: Yogurt contains {probiotic} bacteria that support gut health.
e.zh: 酸奶含有益生菌，有助于肠道健康。

e.en: She takes a daily {probiotic} supplement after breakfast.
e.zh: 她每天早餐后服用一粒益生菌补充剂。

e.en: The judge was known for his unwavering {probity}.
e.zh: 这位法官以其坚定不移的正直而闻名。

e.en: Voters demand {probity} from their elected officials.
e.zh: 选民要求民选官员具备廉正品格。

e.en: I ran into a small {problem} with the login screen.
e.zh: 我在登录界面遇到了一个小问题。

e.en: Math homework always gives him a hard {problem} to solve.
e.zh: 数学作业总会给他出道难解的题目。

problematic.t: adj. 有问题的；成问题的

e.en: The new policy is {problematic} for small businesses.
e.zh: 这项新政策对小企业来说很成问题。

e.en: His comments on the show were widely seen as {problematic}.
e.zh: 他在节目里的言论被普遍认为不妥。

e.en: The contract's wording remains {problematical} for both sides.
e.zh: 合同的措辞对双方而言仍然有问题。

e.en: Funding the project on time looks increasingly {problematical}.
e.zh: 按时为该项目筹资看起来越来越成问题。

e.en: The app behaves {problematically} on older phones.
e.zh: 该应用在旧款手机上运行起来很有问题。

e.en: The report {problematically} ignores key data points.
e.zh: 报告有问题地忽略了关键数据。

e.en: We fixed several {problems} in today's software update.
e.zh: 我们在今天的软件更新中修复了几个问题。

e.en: She's been having sleep {problems} for weeks.
e.zh: 她已经失眠好几个星期了。

produce.t:
v. 生产；制作
n. 农产品

e.en: The factory can {produce} a thousand units per day.
e.zh: 这家工厂一天可以生产一千件产品。

e.en: She buys fresh {produce} at the farmers' market every Saturday.
e.zh: 她每周六都在农贸市场买新鲜的农产品。

e.en: The studio {produced} three hit shows last year.
e.zh: 该工作室去年制作了三部热门剧集。

e.en: Climate change has {produced} more extreme weather worldwide.
e.zh: 气候变化在全球范围内引发了更多极端天气。

producer.t: n. 生产者；（影视）制作人

e.en: She's a famous music {producer} based in Los Angeles.
e.zh: 她是一位驻洛杉矶的著名音乐制作人。

e.en: Brazil is the largest coffee {producer} in the world.
e.zh: 巴西是世界上最大的咖啡生产国。

producers.t: n. 生产者；制作人（复数）

e.en: Independent {producers} are reshaping the streaming industry.
e.zh: 独立制片人正在重塑流媒体行业。

e.en: Local {producers} struggle to compete with cheap imports.
e.zh: 本地生产商难以与廉价进口商品竞争。

produces.t: v. 生产；制作（第三人称单数）

e.en: This algorithm {produces} more accurate recommendations.
e.zh: 这个算法能给出更精准的推荐。

e.en: The orchard {produces} apples and pears each autumn.
e.zh: 这个果园每年秋天都出产苹果和梨。

producing.t: v. 生产、制作（现在分词）

e.en: The team is {producing} a documentary about ocean pollution.
e.zh: 该团队正在制作一部关于海洋污染的纪录片。

e.en: That bee colony has been {producing} honey for years.
e.zh: 那个蜂群已经持续产蜜很多年了。

e.en: Our new {product} launches on the app store next week.
e.zh: 我们的新产品下周在应用商店上线。

e.en: His success is the {product} of years of hard work.
e.zh: 他的成功是多年努力的结果。

e.en: The factory halted {production} due to a chip shortage.
e.zh: 工厂因芯片短缺而停产。

e.en: The Broadway {production} received rave reviews.
e.zh: 这部百老汇剧目获得了好评如潮。

e.en: Netflix released several original {productions} this month.
e.zh: Netflix本月推出了多部原创作品。

e.en: Their theater {productions} always sell out quickly.
e.zh: 他们的舞台剧总是很快售罄。

productive.t: adj. 多产的；富有成效的

e.en: I had a really {productive} morning at the coffee shop.
e.zh: 我在咖啡店度过了一个非常高效的早晨。

e.en: We need a more {productive} conversation about the budget.
e.zh: 我们需要就预算进行一次更有成效的讨论。

productively.t: adv. 高效地；富有成效地

e.en: He spent the weekend {productively} cleaning out the garage.
e.zh: 他高效地利用周末把车库清理干净。

e.en: Remote teams can collaborate {productively} with the right tools.
e.zh: 借助合适的工具,远程团队也能高效协作。

productivities.t: n. 生产率；生产力（复数）

e.en: The report compares {productivities} across different industries.
e.zh: 该报告比较了不同行业的生产率。

e.en: Software upgrades boosted {productivities} in both factories.
e.zh: 软件升级提升了两家工厂的生产效率。

e.en: Working from home actually improved my {productivity}.
e.zh: 在家办公其实提高了我的工作效率。

e.en: The company invested in tools to boost team {productivity}.
e.zh: 公司投资了一些工具来提升团队生产力。

e.en: Apple announced three new {products} at the event.
e.zh: 苹果在发布会上推出了三款新产品。

e.en: She avoids dairy {products} due to her allergy.
e.zh: 由于过敏,她避免食用乳制品。

e.en: My econ {prof} cancelled class again this morning.
e.zh: 我的经济学教授今早又取消了课。

e.en: He's a cool {prof} who actually replies to emails fast.
e.zh: 他是个挺酷的教授,回邮件还很快。

profanation.t: n. 亵渎；对神圣事物的玷污

e.en: Locals saw the graffiti as a {profanation} of the temple.
e.zh: 当地人认为那些涂鸦是对寺庙的亵渎。

e.en: Critics called the remix a {profanation} of the classic song.
e.zh: 评论家称这版混音是对那首经典歌曲的亵渎。

profane.t:
adj. 亵渎的；世俗的
v. 亵渎

e.en: The comedian's routine was full of {profane} language.
e.zh: 那位喜剧演员的表演充斥着粗俗的语言。

e.en: They refused to {profane} the sacred ground with construction.
e.zh: 他们拒绝以施工玷污这片圣地。

e.en: The streamer was banned for using {profanity} on air.
e.zh: 那位主播因直播中说脏话而被封禁。

e.en: Please avoid {profanity} in the workplace chat.
e.zh: 请在工作群聊中避免使用脏话。

e.en: Politicians often {profess} to care about ordinary citizens.
e.zh: 政客们常常声称关心普通民众。

e.en: I don't {profess} to be an expert on quantum physics.
e.zh: 我不敢自称是量子物理学的专家。

professed.t: adj. 自称的；公开声明的

e.en: Despite his {professed} love of nature, he never goes hiking.
e.zh: 尽管他自称热爱大自然,却从不去远足。

e.en: She {professed} her innocence throughout the trial.
e.zh: 她在整个庭审过程中都声称自己无辜。

professes.t: v. 宣称；自称（第三人称单数）

e.en: He {professes} to know nothing about the missing files.
e.zh: 他声称对丢失的文件一无所知。

e.en: The brand {professes} a strong commitment to sustainability.
e.zh: 该品牌声称对可持续发展有着坚定承诺。

professing.t: v. 宣称；自称（现在分词）

e.en: She kept {professing} her loyalty to the company.
e.zh: 她不停地表白自己对公司的忠诚。

e.en: He apologized while {professing} that it was an accident.
e.zh: 他一边道歉,一边声称那只是意外。

profession.t: n. 职业（尤指专业性的）

e.en: Nursing is a demanding but rewarding {profession}.
e.zh: 护理是一项要求很高但回报丰厚的职业。

e.en: He left the legal {profession} to start a bakery.
e.zh: 他离开了法律行业去开了一家面包店。

professional.t:
adj. 专业的
n. 专业人士

e.en: You should hire a {professional} to fix the wiring.
e.zh: 你应该请专业人员来修电线。

e.en: Her email had a very {professional} tone.
e.zh: 她的邮件语气非常专业。

professionalism.t: n. 专业素养；职业精神

e.en: The team handled the crisis with remarkable {professionalism}.
e.zh: 团队以非凡的专业精神处理了这场危机。

e.en: Clients praised her {professionalism} during the project.
e.zh: 客户们对她在项目中的专业表现赞赏有加。

professionalisms.t: n. 专业素养（复数，罕用）

e.en: Different industries develop their own {professionalisms} over time.
e.zh: 不同行业随着时间逐渐形成各自的专业规范。

e.en: The book contrasts the {professionalisms} of law and medicine.
e.zh: 这本书对比了法律界与医学界的专业规范。

e.en: The {professionalization} of esports has changed the industry.
e.zh: 电子竞技的职业化改变了整个行业。

e.en: Nursing underwent rapid {professionalization} in the twentieth century.
e.zh: 护理行业在二十世纪经历了迅速的职业化。

professionalize.t: v. 使专业化；使职业化

e.en: The startup is trying to {professionalize} its hiring process.
e.zh: 这家初创公司正努力让招聘流程更加规范化。

e.en: Many hobbyist creators eventually {professionalize} their channels.
e.zh: 许多业余创作者最终会把自己的频道做成职业化运营。

e.en: Cooking has become highly {professionalized} thanks to TV shows.
e.zh: 得益于电视节目,烹饪行业已变得高度职业化。

e.en: She {professionalized} her side hustle into a real business.
e.zh: 她把自己的副业打造成了一份正式的事业。

e.en: He's been playing tennis {professionally} for ten years.
e.zh: 他已经做了十年的职业网球选手。

e.en: The photos were shot {professionally} for the magazine cover.
e.zh: 那些照片是为杂志封面专业拍摄的。

e.en: Many {professionals} are switching to remote work permanently.
e.zh: 许多专业人士正在永久转向远程办公。

e.en: The conference brings together {professionals} from across Asia.
e.zh: 这场大会汇集了来自亚洲各地的专业人士。

e.en: AI is reshaping many traditional {professions}.
e.zh: 人工智能正在重塑许多传统职业。

e.en: Some {professions} require years of certification.
e.zh: 有些职业需要多年才能取得资格认证。

e.en: My history {professor} writes a popular blog on the side.
e.zh: 我的历史教授业余还经营着一个很受欢迎的博客。

e.en: She became a {professor} at MIT after finishing her PhD.
e.zh: 她博士毕业后成为了麻省理工的教授。

professorate.t: n. 教授职位；教授群体

e.en: The {professorate} voted against the proposed curriculum changes.
e.zh: 全体教授投票反对拟议的课程改革。

e.en: Joining the {professorate} requires years of research and teaching.
e.zh: 进入教授行列需要多年的研究与教学积累。

e.en: He has a calm, {professorial} way of explaining things.
e.zh: 他解释事情的方式平静而充满教授风范。

e.en: The CEO took a {professorial} tone during the keynote.
e.zh: 那位CEO在主题演讲中用了一种教授般的口吻。

professoriate.t: n. 教授阶层；教授群体

e.en: Diversity in the {professoriate} has slowly improved over decades.
e.zh: 教授群体的多元化在数十年间有所改善。

e.en: Budget cuts threaten the future of the {professoriate}.
e.zh: 预算削减威胁着教授群体的未来。

e.en: Several {professors} signed the open letter to the dean.
e.zh: 几位教授联名签署了致院长的公开信。

e.en: My favorite {professors} always made lectures feel like stories.
e.zh: 我最喜欢的那几位教授总能把课讲得像故事一样。

professorship.t: n. 教授职位；教授身份

e.en: She was offered a {professorship} at Stanford last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天获得了斯坦福大学的教授职位。

e.en: He turned down a {professorship} to join a tech startup.
e.zh: 他放弃教授职位,加入了一家科技初创公司。

proffer.t:
v. 提出；呈上
n. 提议

e.en: She didn't {proffer} an explanation for her sudden departure.
e.zh: 她没有就突然离开给出任何解释。

e.en: He stepped forward to {proffer} his hand in greeting.
e.zh: 他上前伸手以示问候。

e.en: The host {proffered} a glass of wine to each guest.
e.zh: 主人给每位客人递上一杯红酒。

e.en: She politely declined the {proffered} job in Berlin.
e.zh: 她礼貌地拒绝了那份在柏林提供的工作。

e.en: The job requires {proficiency} in both Python and SQL.
