e.zh: 这份工作要求精通Python和SQL。

e.en: She passed the language {proficiency} test with high marks.
e.zh: 她以高分通过了语言水平测试。

e.en: He's quite {proficient} at editing videos in Premiere.
e.zh: 他相当擅长用Premiere剪辑视频。

e.en: You need to be {proficient} in English for this role.
e.zh: 这个职位要求你的英语水平熟练。

e.en: She handles client calls {proficiently} despite being new.
e.zh: 尽管刚入职,她仍能熟练地应对客户来电。

e.en: He plays three instruments {proficiently}.
e.zh: 他能熟练地演奏三种乐器。

profile.t:
n. 个人资料；侧面
v. 描述

e.en: Please update your {profile} picture before the meeting.
e.zh: 请在会议前更新你的头像。

e.en: The article paints a vivid {profile} of the young scientist.
e.zh: 这篇文章生动地刻画了这位年轻科学家。

profiled.t: v. 描述特征；剖析（过去式）

e.en: The magazine {profiled} ten rising tech founders this month.
e.zh: 该杂志本月专访了十位崛起的科技创始人。

e.en: We {profiled} the app and found a major memory leak.
e.zh: 我们对应用做了性能分析，发现了严重的内存泄漏。

profiler.t: n. 性能分析器；剖析工具

e.en: Run the {profiler} to see which function is the bottleneck.
e.zh: 运行性能分析器，看看哪个函数是瓶颈。

e.en: The FBI {profiler} studied the suspect's behavior patterns.
e.zh: 联邦调查局的犯罪侧写师研究了嫌疑人的行为模式。

e.en: Many fake {profiles} have appeared on the dating app.
e.zh: 这款交友软件上出现了许多虚假账号。

e.en: The browser supports multiple user {profiles} on one device.
e.zh: 该浏览器在一台设备上支持多个用户配置文件。

profiling.t: n. 性能分析；用户画像

e.en: Racial {profiling} by police remains a serious concern.
e.zh: 警方的种族特征定性仍是一个严重问题。

e.en: We spent the afternoon {profiling} the slow database queries.
e.zh: 我们花了一下午分析速度慢的数据库查询。

profit.t:
n. 利润；收益
v. 获利

e.en: The startup turned its first {profit} this quarter.
e.zh: 这家初创公司本季度首次实现盈利。

e.en: Students {profit} greatly from studying abroad for a year.
e.zh: 出国留学一年让学生受益良多。

profitabilities.t: n. 盈利能力（复数，罕用）

e.en: The report compared the {profitabilities} of three different stores.
e.zh: 报告比较了三家不同门店的盈利情况。

e.en: Analysts charted the {profitabilities} of various product lines.
e.zh: 分析师绘制了各产品线的盈利能力图表。

e.en: Higher fuel costs hurt the airline's {profitability} last year.
e.zh: 去年燃油成本上升损害了这家航空公司的盈利能力。

e.en: The new pricing model improved {profitability} across all regions.
e.zh: 新的定价模式提升了各地区的盈利水平。

profitable.t: adj. 有利可图的；盈利的

e.en: Selling subscriptions proved more {profitable} than running ads.
e.zh: 销售订阅服务比投放广告更赚钱。

e.en: We had a {profitable} discussion about the project's direction.
e.zh: 我们就项目方向进行了一次富有成效的讨论。

e.en: You can spend the weekend more {profitably} reading good books.
e.zh: 你可以更有意义地利用周末读些好书。

e.en: The company has been operating {profitably} for five straight years.
e.zh: 该公司已连续五年盈利经营。

profiteer.t:
n. 牟取暴利者
v. 牟取暴利

e.en: The wartime {profiteer} sold flour at ten times the normal price.
e.zh: 那个战时奸商以十倍的价格出售面粉。

e.en: Critics accused him of being a shameless pandemic {profiteer}.
e.zh: 批评者指责他是个无耻的疫情奸商。

e.en: The government cracked down on {profiteering} during the crisis.
e.zh: 政府在危机期间严厉打击哄抬牟利的行为。

e.en: Drug companies were accused of {profiteering} from the shortage.
e.zh: 制药公司被指控趁短缺哄抬价格牟取暴利。

e.en: She ordered a chocolate {profiterole} for dessert.
e.zh: 她点了一份巧克力泡芙作为甜点。

e.en: The café's signature {profiterole} is filled with vanilla cream.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆招牌的奶油泡芙里夹着香草奶油。

profitless.t: adj. 无利可图的；徒劳的

e.en: Arguing with online trolls is usually a {profitless} exercise.
e.zh: 和网络喷子争论通常是徒劳无益的。

e.en: The factory shut down after years of {profitless} operation.
e.zh: 工厂经过多年无利可图的经营后关门了。

e.en: The company's {profits} doubled after launching the mobile app.
e.zh: 推出手机应用后，公司利润翻了一番。

e.en: All {profits} from the concert go to local animal shelters.
e.zh: 演唱会的全部收益将捐给当地的动物收容所。

e.en: The prince's {profligacy} eventually emptied the royal treasury.
e.zh: 王子的挥霍最终掏空了皇家国库。

e.en: Critics condemned the government's {profligacy} with public funds.
e.zh: 批评者谴责政府对公共资金的挥霍浪费。

e.en: He led a {profligate} lifestyle and went bankrupt at thirty.
e.zh: 他生活挥霍无度，三十岁就破产了。

e.en: The team was {profligate} with chances and lost the match.
e.zh: 球队浪费了大量机会，最终输掉了比赛。

e.en: Losing her grandmother had a {profound} effect on her writing.
e.zh: 祖母的离世对她的写作产生了深远的影响。

e.en: The book offers a {profound} look at modern loneliness.
e.zh: 这本书对现代孤独感进行了深刻的剖析。

e.en: AI is {profoundly} changing how we work and learn.
e.zh: 人工智能正在深刻改变我们的工作和学习方式。

e.en: She was {profoundly} grateful for everyone's support.
e.zh: 她对大家的支持深表感激。

e.en: Critics praised the {profundity} of the novel's themes.
e.zh: 评论家称赞这部小说主题的深刻性。

e.en: His casual jokes often hide surprising {profundity}.
e.zh: 他随口的玩笑往往蕴藏着惊人的深意。

e.en: He offered {profuse} apologies for being an hour late.
e.zh: 他为迟到一小时再三道歉。

e.en: The wound was causing {profuse} bleeding down her arm.
e.zh: 伤口让血顺着她的手臂大量流下。

e.en: He apologized {profusely} after spilling coffee on her laptop.
e.zh: 他把咖啡洒在她笔记本上后连连道歉。

e.en: The runner was sweating {profusely} by the tenth kilometer.
e.zh: 跑到第十公里时，那名跑者已经大汗淋漓。

e.en: The garden burst into a {profusion} of colors each spring.
e.zh: 每到春天，花园里就开满了五彩缤纷的花朵。

e.en: There's a {profusion} of streaming services to choose from now.
e.zh: 现在可供选择的流媒体服务多得让人眼花缭乱。

prog.t: n. 前卫摇滚（progressive 的缩写）

e.en: He's a huge fan of seventies {prog} rock bands.
e.zh: 他是七十年代前卫摇滚乐队的铁杆粉丝。

e.en: The album leans heavily into classic {prog} influences.
e.zh: 这张专辑深受经典前卫摇滚的影响。

e.en: This early synthesizer was the {progenitor} of modern electronic music.
e.zh: 这台早期合成器是现代电子音乐的鼻祖。

e.en: Scientists traced the species back to a single {progenitor}.
e.zh: 科学家将该物种追溯到唯一的祖先。

e.en: The champion racehorse produced dozens of successful {progeny}.
e.zh: 那匹冠军赛马繁育出了几十匹优秀的后代。

e.en: He often boasted about the achievements of his {progeny}.
e.zh: 他常常炫耀子女们取得的成就。

e.en: Her doctor prescribed {progesterone} to support the early pregnancy.
e.zh: 医生开了黄体酮来帮助维持早期妊娠。

e.en: {Progesterone} levels rise sharply during the second half of the cycle.
e.zh: 在月经周期的后半段，孕酮水平会急剧上升。

e.en: Most birth control pills contain a synthetic {progestin}.
e.zh: 大多数避孕药都含有合成孕激素。

e.en: The new IUD slowly releases {progestin} over five years.
e.zh: 这种新型宫内节育器在五年内缓慢释放孕激素。

e.en: It's hard to {prognose} the housing market a year ahead.
e.zh: 很难预测一年后的房地产市场走势。

e.en: Doctors hesitate to {prognose} outcomes for such rare cases.
e.zh: 医生不愿对如此罕见的病例预后下结论。

e.en: The doctor said her {prognosis} after surgery was excellent.
e.zh: 医生说她术后的康复前景非常好。

e.en: Economists offered a gloomy {prognosis} for next year's growth.
e.zh: 经济学家对明年的增长给出了悲观的预测。

prognostic.t:
adj. 预兆的
n. 征兆

e.en: Blood pressure is a strong {prognostic} indicator for heart disease.
e.zh: 血压是心脏病的一个重要预后指标。

e.en: The study identified several {prognostic} markers in cancer patients.
e.zh: 该研究确定了癌症患者的几个预后标志物。

e.en: Pundits love to {prognosticate} about election results on TV.
e.zh: 评论员们喜欢在电视上对选举结果指点预测。

e.en: Nobody can reliably {prognosticate} where bitcoin will be next year.
e.zh: 没人能可靠地预测比特币明年会到什么价位。

e.en: His New Year {prognostication} about the stock market proved wrong.
e.zh: 他对股市的新年预测最终被证明是错的。

e.en: The economist's gloomy {prognostication} alarmed investors worldwide.
e.zh: 这位经济学家的悲观预测让全球投资者感到不安。

e.en: He's known as the most accurate election {prognosticator} on cable news.
e.zh: 他以有线新闻台最准的选举预测专家著称。

e.en: Even the best market {prognosticator} gets it wrong sometimes.
e.zh: 就算最厉害的市场预测专家有时也会看走眼。

program.t:
n. 程序；节目
v. 编程

e.en: I downloaded a free {program} to edit my podcast.
e.zh: 我下载了一个免费程序来剪辑我的播客。

e.en: The school launched a new mentorship {program} for freshmen.
e.zh: 学校为大一新生推出了新的导师计划。

e.en: Our office has a {programmable} thermostat that learns our schedule.
e.zh: 我们办公室有一台能学习作息的可编程恒温器。

e.en: The robot arm is fully {programmable} from a phone app.
e.zh: 这只机械臂完全可以通过手机应用进行编程。

programmatic.t: adj. 程序化的；按计划的

e.en: Most online ads today are bought through {programmatic} auctions.
e.zh: 如今大多数网络广告都是通过程序化竞价购买的。

e.en: The team prefers a {programmatic} approach to managing infrastructure.
e.zh: 团队更喜欢用程序化的方式来管理基础设施。

programme.t: n. 节目；计划（英式拼写）

e.en: The BBC aired a fascinating {programme} about deep-sea creatures.
e.zh: BBC播出了一档关于深海生物的精彩节目。

e.en: She enrolled in a graduate {programme} at Oxford last fall.
e.zh: 她去年秋天加入了牛津的一个研究生项目。

programmed.t: v. 编程（过去式）；已设定

e.en: I {programmed} the coffee machine to start brewing at seven.
e.zh: 我把咖啡机设定为七点开始煮咖啡。

e.en: The robot is {programmed} to greet customers as they enter.
e.zh: 这台机器人被编程为顾客进门时主动问候。

e.en: She works as a backend {programmer} at a fintech startup.
e.zh: 她在一家金融科技初创公司当后端程序员。

e.en: A good {programmer} writes code that other people can read.
e.zh: 好的程序员写出的代码让别人也能读懂。

e.en: AI tools are changing how {programmers} work day to day.
e.zh: AI工具正在改变程序员们的日常工作方式。

e.en: The conference attracted thousands of {programmers} from around the world.
e.zh: 这次大会吸引了来自世界各地的数千名程序员。

programmes.t: n. 节目；计划（英式复数）

e.en: Several charity {programmes} help refugees learn English for free.
e.zh: 几个慈善项目免费帮助难民学习英语。

e.en: The channel airs documentary {programmes} every Sunday evening.
e.zh: 该频道每周日晚间播放纪录片节目。

e.en: She's been learning Python {programming} on YouTube tutorials.
e.zh: 她一直在通过YouTube教程学Python编程。

e.en: Netflix's original {programming} has earned numerous awards this year.
e.zh: Netflix的原创节目今年赢得了众多奖项。

e.en: Different {programmings} on the channel target different age groups.
e.zh: 该频道不同的节目编排针对不同的年龄层。

e.en: The festival featured experimental {programmings} from emerging filmmakers.
e.zh: 电影节展映了新锐导演的多组实验性节目单。

e.en: My laptop runs too many background {programs} and feels slow.
e.zh: 我的笔记本后台运行着太多程序，感觉很卡。

e.en: The university offers excellent exchange {programs} with Asian partners.
e.zh: 这所大学与亚洲伙伴院校开设了优质的交换项目。

progress.t:
n. 进步；进度
v. 进展

e.en: The team is making steady {progress} on the new feature.
e.zh: 团队在新功能上稳步推进。

e.en: Negotiations didn't {progress} much during the heated meeting.
e.zh: 那场激烈的会议中谈判没有取得多大进展。

e.en: As the night {progressed}, the conversation grew more relaxed.
e.zh: 随着夜色渐深，谈话变得越来越轻松。

e.en: Her illness {progressed} faster than the doctors had expected.
e.zh: 她的病情发展得比医生预想的还要快。

progresses.t: v. 进展（第三人称单数）

e.en: The dashboard shows how each task {progresses} in real time.
e.zh: 仪表盘实时显示每项任务的进展情况。

e.en: As the season {progresses}, the team's chemistry keeps improving.
e.zh: 随着赛季的推进，球队的默契度不断提升。

e.en: The renovation is {progressing} faster than we initially planned.
e.zh: 装修进度比我们最初计划的要快。

e.en: Her recovery is {progressing} nicely thanks to daily physical therapy.
e.zh: 得益于每日的理疗，她正在顺利康复。

e.en: The chord {progression} in this song is hauntingly beautiful.
e.zh: 这首歌的和弦走向美得令人难忘。

e.en: Doctors monitored the {progression} of the disease over six months.
e.zh: 医生在六个月内监测了病情的发展。

e.en: She holds {progressive} views on education reform.
e.zh: 她对教育改革持进步的观点。

e.en: The disease causes a {progressive} loss of memory.
e.zh: 这种疾病会导致记忆力逐渐丧失。

e.en: The weather got {progressively} colder through November.
e.zh: 整个十一月天气逐渐变冷。

e.en: Tasks become {progressively} harder as you level up.
e.zh: 随着等级提升，任务变得越来越难。

e.en: Critics praised the law for its {progressiveness}.
e.zh: 评论家称赞这项法律的进步性。

e.en: The party's {progressiveness} appealed to young voters.
e.zh: 该党的进步色彩吸引了年轻选民。

e.en: American {progressivism} reshaped politics in the early 1900s.
e.zh: 美国进步主义在二十世纪初重塑了政治格局。

e.en: She wrote a thesis on European {progressivism}.
e.zh: 她写了一篇关于欧洲进步主义的论文。

e.en: Economists debated the {progressivity} of the new tax code.
e.zh: 经济学家们讨论了新税法的累进性。

e.en: Higher rates on top earners increase {progressivity}.
e.zh: 对高收入者征收更高税率会提高累进程度。

e.en: Local laws {prohibit} smoking inside restaurants.
e.zh: 当地法律禁止在餐厅内吸烟。

e.en: School rules {prohibit} phones during exams.
e.zh: 校规禁止考试期间使用手机。

prohibited.t:
adj. 被禁止的
v. 禁止（prohibit 的过去式）

e.en: Photography is strictly {prohibited} inside the museum.
e.zh: 博物馆内严禁拍照。

e.en: Pets are {prohibited} in this apartment building.
e.zh: 这栋公寓楼内禁止饲养宠物。

prohibiting.t: v. 禁止（prohibit 的现在分词）

e.en: The city passed a law {prohibiting} plastic bags.
e.zh: 该市通过了一项禁止使用塑料袋的法律。

e.en: Signs {prohibiting} swimming line the rocky shore.
e.zh: 岩石海岸上立着许多禁止游泳的告示牌。

e.en: The {prohibition} on alcohol lasted thirteen years in America.
e.zh: 美国的禁酒令持续了十三年。

e.en: Many countries enforce a {prohibition} against ivory trade.
e.zh: 许多国家执行禁止象牙贸易的禁令。

prohibitionist.t: n. 禁酒主义者；主张禁令者

e.en: Her grandfather was a famous {prohibitionist} preacher.
e.zh: 她的祖父是一位著名的禁酒主义传道者。

e.en: The {prohibitionist} movement gained steam in rural areas.
e.zh: 禁酒运动在农村地区势头日盛。

e.en: Religious {prohibitions} shape what foods people eat.
e.zh: 宗教禁忌影响着人们的饮食选择。

e.en: The contract lists several {prohibitions} on subletting.
e.zh: 合同列出了几项关于转租的禁止条款。

prohibitive.t:
adj. （价格）高得令人却步的
adj. 禁止性的

e.en: Housing prices in the city are {prohibitive} for young buyers.
e.zh: 市区的房价让年轻买家望而却步。

e.en: Shipping costs were {prohibitive} for small online sellers.
e.zh: 运费高得令小型网店难以承受。

e.en: Concert tickets have become {prohibitively} expensive.
e.zh: 演唱会门票贵得让人买不起。

e.en: The new medication is {prohibitively} costly without insurance.
e.zh: 没有保险，新药贵得吓人。

prohibits.t: v. 禁止（第三人称单数）

e.en: The constitution {prohibits} discrimination based on race.
e.zh: 宪法禁止基于种族的歧视。

e.en: This trail {prohibits} mountain bikes on weekends.
e.zh: 这条小径周末禁止山地车进入。

project.t:
n. 项目；工程
v. 投射；预计

e.en: Our team finished the {project} two weeks ahead of schedule.
e.zh: 我们团队提前两周完成了项目。

e.en: Analysts {project} steady growth for next year.
e.zh: 分析师预测明年将稳步增长。

projected.t:
adj. 预计的；投影的
v. project 的过去式

e.en: The film was {projected} onto the side of the building.
e.zh: 电影被投影到了建筑物的侧墙上。

e.en: Sales are {projected} to double by 2027.
e.zh: 预计到2027年销售额将翻一番。

e.en: The catapult launched a heavy stone {projectile}.
e.zh: 投石机抛出了一块沉重的石弹。

e.en: Police recovered the {projectile} from the wall.
e.zh: 警方从墙里取出了那枚弹丸。

projecting.t:
adj. 凸出的
v. 投射（现在分词）

e.en: A small balcony was {projecting} from the second floor.
e.zh: 二楼伸出一个小阳台。

e.en: Stop {projecting} your insecurities onto your friends.
e.zh: 别把你的不安投射到朋友身上。

e.en: The latest sales {projection} looks promising.
e.zh: 最新的销售预测看起来很乐观。

e.en: The movie {projection} began ten minutes late.
e.zh: 电影放映晚了十分钟才开始。

e.en: The {projectionist} threaded the old film carefully.
e.zh: 放映员小心地装好那卷旧胶片。

e.en: Few cinemas still employ a full-time {projectionist}.
e.zh: 如今很少有影院还聘请专职放映员。

e.en: Economic {projections} for next quarter look gloomy.
e.zh: 下季度的经济预测看起来很悲观。

e.en: Light {projections} transformed the building's facade at night.
e.zh: 夜晚的灯光投影改变了建筑的外观。

e.en: The Rorschach is a classic {projective} personality test.
e.zh: 罗夏墨迹测验是经典的投射性人格测验。

e.en: She studies {projective} geometry at university.
e.zh: 她在大学里研究射影几何。

e.en: Please connect your laptop to the {projector}.
e.zh: 请把你的笔记本电脑连接到投影仪。

e.en: The classroom {projector} keeps flickering during lectures.
e.zh: 教室的投影仪在上课时总是闪烁。

projects.t:
n. 项目（复数）
v. 投射（第三人称单数）

e.en: She juggles three {projects} at work this month.
e.zh: 她这个月在工作中同时处理三个项目。

e.en: The report {projects} a sharp rise in housing demand.
e.zh: 该报告预测住房需求将急剧上升。

e.en: A bacterium is a single-celled {prokaryote}.
e.zh: 细菌是一种单细胞原核生物。

e.en: Every {prokaryote} lacks a true nucleus.
e.zh: 所有原核生物都没有真正的细胞核。

e.en: {Prolactin} levels rise dramatically after childbirth.
e.zh: 产后催乳素水平会显著上升。

e.en: The doctor ordered a blood test for {prolactin}.
e.zh: 医生开了一项催乳素血液检查。

prolapse.t:
n. （器官）脱垂
v. 脱垂

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with a uterine {prolapse}.
e.zh: 这位患者被诊断出子宫脱垂。

e.en: Mitral valve {prolapse} often causes no symptoms.
e.zh: 二尖瓣脱垂往往没有任何症状。

e.en: She underwent surgery for a {prolapsed} disc.
e.zh: 她因椎间盘脱出而接受了手术。

e.en: The vet treated the dog's {prolapsed} eye.
e.zh: 兽医治疗了那只狗脱出的眼球。

e.en: In Orwell's novel, every {prole} lived in poverty.
e.zh: 在奥威尔的小说中，每个无产者都生活在贫困中。

e.en: He jokingly called himself a working {prole}.
e.zh: 他开玩笑地自称是个打工的无产者。

proletarian.t:
adj. 无产阶级的
n. 无产者

e.en: The film celebrates {proletarian} struggle and solidarity.
e.zh: 这部电影颂扬了无产阶级的斗争与团结。

e.en: Marx wrote extensively about {proletarian} revolution.
e.zh: 马克思就无产阶级革命撰写了大量著作。

e.en: Industrialization led to the {proletarianization} of rural farmers.
e.zh: 工业化导致了农村农民的无产阶级化。

e.en: Scholars debate the {proletarianization} of office workers.
e.zh: 学者们讨论办公室职员的无产阶级化现象。

e.en: Marx believed the {proletariat} would eventually overthrow capitalism.
e.zh: 马克思相信无产阶级最终将推翻资本主义。

e.en: Factory workers formed the urban {proletariat}.
e.zh: 工厂工人构成了城市无产阶级。

e.en: Fake news websites continue to {proliferate} online.
e.zh: 虚假新闻网站在网上不断激增。

e.en: Cancer cells {proliferate} much faster than normal cells.
e.zh: 癌细胞的增殖速度远快于正常细胞。

e.en: Coffee shops have {proliferated} across the neighborhood.
e.zh: 咖啡馆在这一带如雨后春笋般涌现。

e.en: Conspiracy theories {proliferated} during the pandemic.
e.zh: 疫情期间各种阴谋论层出不穷。

proliferates.t: v. 激增（第三人称单数）

e.en: Misinformation {proliferates} whenever big news breaks.
e.zh: 每当重大新闻爆出，错误信息便迅速蔓延。

e.en: Bacteria {proliferates} rapidly in warm, moist conditions.
e.zh: 细菌在温暖潮湿的环境中迅速繁殖。

e.en: AI startups are {proliferating} in Silicon Valley.
e.zh: 人工智能初创公司在硅谷大量涌现。

e.en: Algae kept {proliferating} in the warming lake.
e.zh: 藻类在变暖的湖水中持续繁殖。

e.en: The {proliferation} of streaming services confuses many viewers.
e.zh: 流媒体服务的激增让许多观众感到困惑。

e.en: Treaties aim to prevent nuclear weapons {proliferation}.
e.zh: 条约旨在防止核武器扩散。

e.en: Sudden algal {proliferations} can devastate marine life.
e.zh: 藻类的突然大量繁殖会摧毁海洋生物。

e.en: Doctors monitor cell {proliferations} during cancer treatment.
e.zh: 医生在癌症治疗期间监测细胞的增殖情况。

e.en: The biopsy revealed a {proliferative} skin lesion.
e.zh: 活检显示有一处增生性皮肤病变。

e.en: Doctors monitored the {proliferative} phase of healing.
e.zh: 医生监测了愈合过程中的增生期。

e.en: Stephen King is a {prolific} novelist with dozens of books.
e.zh: 斯蒂芬·金是一位高产的小说家，著有数十本书。

e.en: Tomato plants are surprisingly {prolific} in summer.
e.zh: 番茄在夏天的产量出奇地高。

e.en: She writes {prolifically}, publishing two novels every year.
e.zh: 她笔耕不辍，每年出版两部小说。

e.en: The artist painted {prolifically} during his Paris years.
e.zh: 那位艺术家在巴黎时期创作十分多产。

e.en: {Proline} is one of the twenty standard amino acids.
e.zh: 脯氨酸是二十种标准氨基酸之一。

e.en: Collagen contains a high percentage of {proline}.
e.zh: 胶原蛋白含有较高比例的脯氨酸。

e.en: His {prolix} introduction nearly put the audience to sleep.
e.zh: 他冗长的开场白几乎让观众昏昏欲睡。

e.en: Editors trimmed the {prolix} draft by half.
e.zh: 编辑把那份冗长的草稿删去了一半。

e.en: The lecturer was famous for his tedious {prolixity}.
e.zh: 那位讲师以其乏味的冗长发言而闻名。

e.en: Good editing eliminates needless {prolixity}.
e.zh: 好的编辑能消除不必要的冗赘。

prolog.t: n. Prolog 编程语言；序言

e.en: She's learning {Prolog} for her logic programming course.
e.zh: 她正在为逻辑编程课学习Prolog语言。

e.en: The book's brief {prolog} sets the historical scene.
e.zh: 这本书简短的开篇介绍了历史背景。

e.en: The novel opens with a haunting {prologue}.
e.zh: 这部小说以一段令人难忘的序章开篇。

e.en: That meeting was just a {prologue} to bigger negotiations.
e.zh: 那次会议只是更大规模谈判的序幕。

e.en: Stretching daily can {prolong} an athlete's career.
e.zh: 每天拉伸可以延长运动员的职业生涯。

e.en: Don't {prolong} the meeting with unnecessary slides.
e.zh: 别用不必要的幻灯片拖长会议时间。

e.en: Doctors warned against the {prolongation} of suffering.
e.zh: 医生警告不要延长病人的痛苦。

e.en: The contract's {prolongation} requires both parties' consent.
e.zh: 合同延期需要双方同意。

e.en: A {prolonged} drought devastated the region's farms.
e.zh: 长期干旱重创了该地区的农场。

e.en: She suffered {prolonged} back pain after the accident.
e.zh: 事故后她长期遭受背痛折磨。

e.en: Avoiding the topic is just {prolonging} the conflict.
e.zh: 回避这个话题只会拖长冲突。

e.en: The medication is {prolonging} the patient's life.
e.zh: 这种药物正在延长病人的生命。

prolongs.t: v. 延长（第三人称单数）

e.en: Stretching daily {prolongs} the life of your knees.
e.zh: 每天拉伸能延长膝盖的使用寿命。

e.en: Adding sugar {prolongs} the shelf life of jam.
e.zh: 加糖可以延长果酱的保质期。

e.en: She bought a stunning red dress for the {prom}.
e.zh: 她为毕业舞会买了一条惊艳的红裙。

e.en: Our {prom} was held at a downtown hotel.
e.zh: 我们的毕业舞会在市中心一家酒店举行。

promenade.t:
n. 散步道；漫步
v. 散步

e.en: We took a slow {promenade} along the seafront.
e.zh: 我们沿着海滨悠闲地散了步。

e.en: The {promenade} is lined with cafes and street artists.
e.zh: 那条海滨步道两旁全是咖啡馆和街头艺人。

e.en: The city's wide {promenades} fill up every Sunday evening.
e.zh: 每到周日傍晚,城里宽阔的步行道就挤满了人。

e.en: She {promenades} through the park in her new coat.
e.zh: 她穿着新外套在公园里漫步炫耀。

promethean.t: adj. 普罗米修斯式的；富创造力的

e.en: AI feels like a {promethean} gift to modern science.
e.zh: 人工智能仿佛是赐予现代科学的普罗米修斯之火。

e.en: His {promethean} ambition drove him to risk everything.
e.zh: 他那种盗火者般的野心驱使他孤注一掷。

prometheus.t: n. 普罗米修斯（希腊神话人物）

e.en: In Greek myth, {Prometheus} stole fire for humanity.
e.zh: 在希腊神话中,普罗米修斯为人类盗取了火种。

e.en: The startup named its rocket {Prometheus} for symbolic reasons.
e.zh: 这家初创公司将火箭命名为普罗米修斯,寓意深远。

prominence.t:
n. 突出；著名
n. 突出物

e.en: The young director rose to {prominence} after one viral film.
e.zh: 这位年轻导演凭一部爆红影片一举成名。

e.en: Climate policy gained {prominence} in this year's debates.
e.zh: 气候政策在今年的辩论中变得格外突出。

prominences.t: n. 突出物；显著之处（prominence 复数）

e.en: Solar {prominences} arc thousands of kilometers above the sun.
e.zh: 日珥可以在太阳上方延伸数千公里。

e.en: The map highlights mountain {prominences} across the region.
e.zh: 这张地图标出了该地区各座山峰的相对高度。

prominent.t: adj. 著名的；显著的；突出的

e.en: She is a {prominent} researcher in machine learning.
e.zh: 她是机器学习领域一位知名的研究者。

e.en: Place the warning in a {prominent} spot on the page.
e.zh: 把警告放在页面上显眼的位置。

e.en: His name appears {prominently} on the conference poster.
e.zh: 他的名字显眼地出现在会议海报上。

e.en: The new feature is {prominently} displayed on the homepage.
e.zh: 新功能在首页被显眼地展示出来。

e.en: The novel explores themes of love, loyalty, and {promiscuity}.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了爱情、忠诚与滥交等主题。

e.en: Sexual {promiscuity} was once heavily stigmatized in that society.
e.zh: 在那个社会,性方面的放纵曾受到强烈污名化。

e.en: The character is portrayed as charming but {promiscuous}.
e.zh: 这个角色被刻画成迷人却滥情的样子。

e.en: He has a {promiscuous} taste in music, from jazz to metal.
e.zh: 他对音乐口味很杂,从爵士到金属都听。

promiscuously.t: adv. 滥交地；不加选择地

e.en: The blogger borrows ideas {promiscuously} from many fields.
e.zh: 这位博主从许多领域杂乱地借用观点。

e.en: Don't share your password {promiscuously} across websites.
e.zh: 不要随意把密码到处分享给各种网站。

promise.t:
v. 承诺；保证
n. 承诺；前景

e.en: I {promise} I'll reply by tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 我保证明早之前回复你。

e.en: The young athlete shows real {promise} on the court.
e.zh: 这位年轻运动员在场上展现出真正的潜力。

promised.t:
v. 承诺（过去式）
adj. 被许诺的

e.en: He {promised} to pick me up at the airport.
e.zh: 他答应到机场来接我。

e.en: The company {promised} faster shipping this holiday season.
e.zh: 公司承诺今年假期发货会更快。

promises.t:
n. 承诺（复数）
v. 承诺（第三人称单数）

e.en: Politicians often make {promises} they can't keep.
e.zh: 政客们经常开出无法兑现的承诺。

e.en: This update {promises} better battery life and performance.
e.zh: 这次更新承诺会带来更长的电池续航和更好的性能。

promising.t: adj. 有前途的；有希望的

e.en: Early test results look very {promising}.
e.zh: 早期测试结果看起来非常有希望。

e.en: She is {promising} her team a bonus if they ship on time.
e.zh: 她答应团队按时发布就发奖金。

promisingly.t: adv. 有希望地；前景看好地

e.en: The trial began {promisingly} but ran into safety issues.
e.zh: 试验开局不错,但后来遇到了安全问题。

e.en: Sales started {promisingly} in the first quarter.
e.zh: 第一季度的销售开局十分喜人。

promissory.t: adj. 约定的；约期支付的（如 promissory note 本票）

e.en: He signed a {promissory} note for the loan.
e.zh: 他为这笔贷款签了一张本票。

e.en: The contract includes a {promissory} clause about repayment.
e.zh: 合同里有一条关于还款的允诺条款。

promo.t: n. 宣传片；促销（promotion 的缩写）

e.en: Use this {promo} code for ten percent off.
e.zh: 使用这个优惠码可以打九折。

e.en: The band released a short {promo} video on TikTok.
e.zh: 乐队在 TikTok 上发布了一段简短的宣传视频。

e.en: The lighthouse stands on a rocky {promontory}.
e.zh: 那座灯塔矗立在一处多岩石的海岬上。

e.en: From the {promontory}, you can see whales in spring.
e.zh: 春天从这处海角可以看到鲸鱼。

promotable.t: adj. 可晋升的；可推广的

e.en: His manager said he is clearly {promotable} this year.
e.zh: 他的主管说他今年明显具备晋升条件。

e.en: The product needs a more {promotable} feature to stand out.
e.zh: 这款产品需要一个更有卖点的功能才能脱颖而出。

promote.t:
v. 推广；促进
v. 晋升

e.en: They plan to {promote} her to senior engineer next month.
e.zh: 他们打算下个月把她升为高级工程师。

e.en: The campaign aims to {promote} healthier eating habits.
e.zh: 这场活动旨在推广更健康的饮食习惯。

e.en: She was {promoted} to director after just two years.
e.zh: 她仅用两年就被提拔为总监。

e.en: The studio heavily {promoted} the film on social media.
e.zh: 片方在社交媒体上大力宣传这部电影。

e.en: The concert {promoter} sold out the venue in minutes.
e.zh: 演出主办方几分钟内就把场馆门票卖光了。

e.en: She became a vocal {promoter} of remote work.
e.zh: 她成了远程办公的积极倡导者。

promotes.t: v. 推广；促进（第三人称单数）

e.en: Regular exercise {promotes} better sleep at night.
e.zh: 规律运动能促进夜间睡眠质量。

e.en: The app actively {promotes} videos from new creators.
e.zh: 这款应用会主动推广新创作者的视频。

promoting.t: v. 推广；宣传（现在分词）

e.en: She spent the week {promoting} her new book online.
e.zh: 她这一周都在网上宣传自己的新书。

e.en: The school is {promoting} students based on test scores.
e.zh: 学校正根据考试成绩让学生升级。

promotion.t:
n. 推广；促销
n. 晋升

e.en: He got a {promotion} and a small raise this quarter.
e.zh: 他这个季度升职了,还小幅加薪。

e.en: The store is running a summer {promotion} on swimwear.
e.zh: 这家店正在做泳装的夏季促销。

e.en: We received free samples and {promotional} stickers.
e.zh: 我们收到了免费样品和宣传贴纸。

e.en: Click the link to redeem the {promotional} discount.
e.zh: 点击链接即可领取促销折扣。

promotions.t: n. 促销活动；晋升（复数）

e.en: Most year-end {promotions} go to senior team members.
e.zh: 年终的大多数晋升名额都给了资深成员。

e.en: Check the app for this week's grocery {promotions}.
e.zh: 在 App 里查看本周的超市促销活动。

prompt.t:
n. 提示词（AI/命令行）
v. 促使；提示

e.en: A good {prompt} can make the AI's answer much better.
e.zh: 一个好的提示词能让 AI 的回答好得多。

e.en: Thank you for your {prompt} response to my email.
e.zh: 感谢您对我邮件的及时回复。

e.en: His question {prompted} a long discussion in the meeting.
e.zh: 他的问题在会上引发了长时间的讨论。

e.en: The app {prompted} me to update before logging in.
e.zh: 应用在登录前提示我先更新。

e.en: The news anchor read smoothly from the tele{prompter}.
e.zh: 新闻主播流畅地读着提词器上的稿件。

e.en: A backstage {prompter} whispered the forgotten line to him.
e.zh: 后台的提词员小声给他提示忘掉的台词。

prompting.t:
n. 提示词工程
v. 促使（现在分词）

e.en: Good {prompting} is now a real skill in tech jobs.
e.zh: 如今,提示词写得好已经是技术岗的一项真本事。

e.en: She answered without any {prompting} from her teacher.
e.zh: 她不用老师任何提示就答出来了。

e.en: Please reply {promptly} so we can finalize the plan.
e.zh: 请尽快回复,以便我们敲定方案。

e.en: The meeting started {promptly} at nine o'clock.
e.zh: 会议九点准时开始。

e.en: I appreciate your {promptness} in handling the refund.
e.zh: 感谢你处理退款时的迅速反应。

e.en: His {promptness} impressed every client he worked with.
e.zh: 他做事麻利,每位客户都印象深刻。

prompts.t:
n. 提示词（复数）
v. 促使（第三人称单数）

e.en: She writes detailed {prompts} to get better AI responses.
e.zh: 她会写详细的提示词,好让 AI 回答得更好。

e.en: The system {prompts} you to enter a verification code.
e.zh: 系统会提示你输入验证码。

proms.t: n. 毕业舞会（prom 复数）

e.en: American {proms} are a huge deal in many high schools.
e.zh: 在许多美国高中,毕业舞会是件大事。

e.en: They attended two different {proms} that same weekend.
e.zh: 那个周末他们参加了两场不同的毕业舞会。

e.en: The agency will {promulgate} new safety rules next month.
e.zh: 该机构将于下月颁布新的安全条例。

e.en: Reformers worked hard to {promulgate} their ideas online.
e.zh: 改革者努力在网上传播他们的理念。

e.en: The {promulgation} of the new law took effect immediately.
e.zh: 新法律的颁布立即生效。

e.en: Critics questioned the rushed {promulgation} of the policy.
e.zh: 批评者质疑这项政策颁布得过于仓促。

pronation.t: n. (手/脚) 内旋；掌心向下

e.en: Excessive {pronation} can cause pain in long-distance runners.
e.zh: 过度内旋可能让长跑者出现疼痛。

e.en: The shoe is designed to control foot {pronation}.
e.zh: 这款鞋设计上能控制足部内旋。

prone.t:
adj. 易于…的；有…倾向的
adj. 俯卧的

e.en: Older laptops are {prone} to overheating in summer.
e.zh: 老款笔记本在夏天容易过热。

e.en: He lay {prone} on the mat for the back massage.
e.zh: 他俯卧在垫子上接受背部按摩。

e.en: His {proneness} to anxiety made public speaking difficult.
e.zh: 他容易焦虑的倾向让他害怕公开演讲。

e.en: The study examined teens' {proneness} to risky behavior.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了青少年做出冒险行为的倾向。

e.en: One {prong} of the fork bent during dinner.
e.zh: 叉子的一根齿在吃饭时弯了。

e.en: The third {prong} of the strategy is community outreach.
e.zh: 该策略的第三个方面是社区拓展。

e.en: The plug is three-{pronged} for safety reasons.
e.zh: 出于安全考虑,这个插头是三脚的。

e.en: They launched a multi-{pronged} marketing campaign.
e.zh: 他们发起了一场多管齐下的营销活动。

e.en: The {pronghorn} is the fastest land animal in North America.
e.zh: 叉角羚是北美陆地上跑得最快的动物。

e.en: We spotted a herd of {pronghorn} crossing the prairie.
e.zh: 我们看到一群叉角羚穿过草原。

e.en: English has fairly simple {pronominal} forms compared to French.
e.zh: 和法语相比,英语的代词形式相当简单。

e.en: The textbook explains {pronominal} reference with clear examples.
e.zh: 这本教材用清晰的例子讲解了代词指代。

e.en: Many people now share their preferred {pronoun} in bios.
e.zh: 现在很多人会在个人简介里写上自己希望使用的代词。

e.en: "They" can be used as a singular {pronoun} in English.
e.zh: 在英语中,"they" 可以用作单数代词。

pronounce.t:
v. 发音
v. 宣布；宣判

e.en: Could you teach me how to {pronounce} this word correctly?
e.zh: 你能教我怎么把这个词读对吗?

e.en: The judge will {pronounce} the sentence tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 法官将于明天上午宣判。

pronounced.t:
adj. 明显的
v. 发音（过去式）

e.en: There is a {pronounced} difference between the two flavors.
e.zh: 这两种口味之间有明显的差别。

e.en: She {pronounced} every syllable slowly for the beginners.
e.zh: 她为初学者把每个音节都慢慢读出来。

e.en: The judge made a final {pronouncement} on the case yesterday.
e.zh: 法官昨天对此案做出了最终裁决。

e.en: His {pronouncement} about the merger surprised everyone in the room.
e.zh: 他关于合并的声明让在场所有人都感到意外。

pronounces.t: v. 发音；宣布（第三人称单数）

e.en: She {pronounces} the French words with a perfect accent.
e.zh: 她用完美的口音发法语单词。

e.en: The court {pronounces} its verdict at three this afternoon.
e.zh: 法庭将于今天下午三点宣布判决。

pronouncing.t: v. 发音；宣布（现在分词）

e.en: He keeps {pronouncing} my last name incorrectly at meetings.
e.zh: 他在会上总是把我的姓发错音。

e.en: The app helps kids practice {pronouncing} difficult English words.
e.zh: 这款应用帮助孩子练习发难读的英语单词。

e.en: Many people now share their preferred {pronouns} on social profiles.
e.zh: 很多人现在会在社交资料上注明自己希望使用的代词。

e.en: Chinese learners often confuse English {pronouns} like he and she.
e.zh: 中文学习者常会混淆英语中的他和她。

e.en: Finish your homework {pronto} or you'll miss the bus.
e.zh: 赶紧把作业写完,不然你就赶不上校车了。

e.en: The manager wants this report on her desk {pronto}.
e.zh: 经理要这份报告马上送到她桌上。

e.en: My English {pronunciation} improved a lot after watching American shows.
e.zh: 看了美剧之后我的英语发音进步很大。

e.en: The dictionary shows the {pronunciation} next to each entry.
e.zh: 词典在每个词条旁边都标注了发音。

e.en: British and American {pronunciations} of tomato sound quite different.
e.zh: 英式和美式英语中 tomato 的发音差别挺大。

e.en: The app lets you compare {pronunciations} from native speakers worldwide.
e.zh: 这款应用可以让你对比世界各地母语者的发音。

proof.t:
n. 证据；证明
adj. 防……的

e.en: Do you have any {proof} that he sent the package?
e.zh: 你有任何证据证明是他寄出包裹的吗?

e.en: Please show {proof} of vaccination at the front desk.
e.zh: 请在前台出示疫苗接种证明。

e.en: I'm {proofing} the article one more time before publishing.
e.zh: 我在发布之前再校对一遍这篇文章。

e.en: The bakery is {proofing} the dough overnight in the fridge.
e.zh: 面包店让面团在冰箱里发酵一整晚。

e.en: Could you {proofread} my essay before I submit it?
e.zh: 你能在我提交前帮我校对一下论文吗?

e.en: I always {proofread} important emails twice before hitting send.
e.zh: 重要邮件我总会校对两遍才点发送。

e.en: The publisher hired a freelance {proofreader} for the new novel.
e.zh: 出版社为这部新小说聘请了一名自由校对员。

e.en: A good {proofreader} catches mistakes the writer always misses.
e.zh: 优秀的校对员能发现作者总是忽略的错误。

e.en: The detective gathered enough {proofs} to convince the jury.
e.zh: 侦探收集到了足以说服陪审团的证据。

e.en: The author reviewed the printer's {proofs} before final publication.
e.zh: 作者在最终出版前审阅了印刷厂的样张。

prop.t:
n. 支柱；道具
v. 支撑

e.en: Could you {prop} the door open with this brick?
e.zh: 你能用这块砖把门撑开吗?

e.en: That sword is just a movie {prop}, not a real weapon.
e.zh: 那把剑只是电影道具,不是真武器。

e.en: The regime used television {propaganda} to control public opinion.
e.zh: 该政权利用电视宣传来控制公众舆论。

e.en: Critics called the new ad campaign nothing but corporate {propaganda}.
e.zh: 批评者称这场新广告无非就是企业宣传。

e.en: Historians study how wartime {propagandas} shaped public attitudes across nations.
e.zh: 历史学家研究战时各国宣传如何塑造了公众态度。

e.en: The exhibit compares Cold War {propagandas} from both superpowers.
e.zh: 该展览对比了冷战期间两个超级大国的宣传作品。

e.en: He worked as a wartime {propagandist} for the radio service.
e.zh: 他战时在电台担任宣传员。

e.en: Critics labeled the columnist a shameless {propagandist} for the regime.
e.zh: 评论人士称这位专栏作家是该政权的无耻宣传者。

e.en: The film felt overly {propagandistic} rather than genuinely artistic.
e.zh: 这部电影宣传味太浓,缺乏真正的艺术性。

e.en: Scholars criticized the textbook for its {propagandistic} tone.
e.zh: 学者们批评这本教科书带有宣传色彩。

e.en: The state tried to {propagandize} citizens through controlled news outlets.
e.zh: 国家试图通过受控的新闻渠道对公民进行宣传洗脑。

e.en: Activists accused the company of using ads to {propagandize} children.
e.zh: 活动人士指责该公司利用广告对儿童进行宣传灌输。

e.en: Social media can {propagate} misinformation faster than ever before.
e.zh: 社交媒体传播错误信息的速度比以往任何时候都快。

e.en: Gardeners often {propagate} new plants from cuttings of old ones.
e.zh: 园丁经常用老植株的枝条来繁殖新苗。

e.en: The {propagation} of fake news online concerns many parents today.
e.zh: 虚假新闻在网上的传播让很多家长感到担忧。

e.en: Plant {propagation} by cuttings is cheaper than buying new seedlings.
e.zh: 用扦插繁殖植物比买新苗便宜。

e.en: She bought a heated {propagator} to start her tomato seeds.
e.zh: 她买了一个加热育苗箱来培育番茄种子。

e.en: He became a leading {propagator} of the new economic theory.
e.zh: 他成为这一新经济理论的主要传播者。

e.en: We need to refill the {propane} tank before the barbecue tomorrow.
e.zh: 明天烧烤前我们得把丙烷罐灌满。

e.en: Many rural homes still rely on {propane} for heating in winter.
e.zh: 许多农村家庭冬天仍然依靠丙烷取暖。

e.en: Strong winds can {propel} a sailboat across the bay quickly.
e.zh: 强风能让帆船快速穿过海湾。

e.en: This promotion could {propel} her career to the next level.
e.zh: 这次晋升可能会把她的事业推向新高度。

e.en: The rocket uses liquid hydrogen as its main {propellant}.
e.zh: 这枚火箭使用液氢作为主要推进剂。

e.en: Modern spray cans use a less harmful {propellant} than before.
e.zh: 现代喷雾罐使用的推进剂比以前危害更小。

e.en: The viral video {propelled} her to overnight internet fame.
e.zh: 那段爆红视频让她一夜之间在网上走红。

e.en: The boat was {propelled} forward by a small electric motor.
e.zh: 小船由一台小型电动马达推动前进。

e.en: The plane's left {propeller} stopped spinning during the emergency landing.
e.zh: 飞机迫降时左侧螺旋桨停止了转动。

e.en: Be careful not to swim near the boat's {propeller}.
e.zh: 小心不要在船的螺旋桨附近游泳。

e.en: He has a {propensity} for spending too much on gadgets.
e.zh: 他有把太多钱花在电子产品上的倾向。

e.en: Teenagers show a higher {propensity} to take risks online.
e.zh: 青少年在网上冒险的倾向更明显。

e.en: Make sure you wear {proper} shoes for the hiking trail.
e.zh: 徒步时一定要穿合适的鞋子。

e.en: There is a {proper} way to format the resume header.
e.zh: 简历的标题部分有一种规范的写法。

e.en: The printer won't work {properly} until you update the driver.
e.zh: 在你更新驱动之前打印机无法正常工作。

e.en: Please wash your hands {properly} before handling the food.
e.zh: 接触食物前请把手好好洗干净。

e.en: The {propertied} class dominated politics throughout the nineteenth century.
e.zh: 在整个十九世纪,有产阶级主导着政治。

e.en: Only {propertied} men were allowed to vote in early elections.
e.zh: 早期选举中只有有产男性才有投票权。

e.en: He owns several rental {properties} in the downtown area.
e.zh: 他在市中心拥有好几套出租房产。

e.en: This metal has unusual magnetic {properties} at low temperatures.
e.zh: 这种金属在低温下具有不寻常的磁性。

property.t:
n. 属性（编程）
n. 财产；房产

e.en: They bought a beachfront {property} in southern Thailand last year.
e.zh: 他们去年在泰国南部买了一处海边房产。

e.en: This phone is the {property} of the company, not yours.
e.zh: 这部手机是公司财产,不是你的。

e.en: The ancient {prophecy} foretold the rise of a new king.
e.zh: 那个古老的预言预示着一位新国王的崛起。

e.en: Her warning about the market crash turned out to be {prophecy}.
e.zh: 她对市场崩盘的警告后来证实是预言。

e.en: Economists {prophesy} a slowdown in the housing market this year.
e.zh: 经济学家预言今年房地产市场会放缓。

e.en: Few dared {prophesy} that the small startup would dominate globally.
e.zh: 很少有人敢预言这家小创业公司会称霸全球。

e.en: He's been called a {prophet} of the modern tech industry.
e.zh: 他被誉为现代科技行业的先知。

e.en: The {prophet} preached his message in the desert for years.
e.zh: 那位先知在沙漠里布道传教多年。

e.en: In the legend, a young {prophetess} warned the king of danger.
e.zh: 传说中,一位年轻的女预言家曾警告国王有危险。

e.en: The temple was guarded by an elderly {prophetess} for decades.
e.zh: 那座神庙数十年来由一位年长的女先知守护。

e.en: Her early novel about pandemics now seems eerily {prophetic}.
e.zh: 她早期那本关于大流行病的小说如今看来颇有预言意味。

e.en: His {prophetic} warnings about climate change went largely ignored.
e.zh: 他对气候变化的预言式警告基本上被忽视了。

e.en: He {prophetically} predicted the smartphone boom a decade in advance.
e.zh: 他像预言一般提前十年预测了智能手机的兴起。

e.en: The author wrote {prophetically} about social media's effect on democracy.
e.zh: 这位作家像预言般写下了社交媒体对民主的影响。

e.en: Religious texts speak of many ancient {prophets} delivering divine messages.
e.zh: 宗教典籍中提到许多古代先知传达神的旨意。

e.en: Tech magazines crown new {prophets} of innovation almost every year.
e.zh: 科技杂志几乎每年都会捧出新一代的创新先知。

prophylactic.t:
adj. 预防的
n. 预防药

e.en: Doctors recommend a {prophylactic} dose of antibiotics before this surgery.
e.zh: 医生建议在这种手术前预防性地服用抗生素。

e.en: Wearing a helmet is a simple {prophylactic} measure for cyclists.
e.zh: 戴头盔是骑行者最简单的预防措施。

e.en: The team treated all players {prophylactically} after the flu outbreak.
e.zh: 流感爆发后,球队对所有队员进行了预防性治疗。

e.en: She takes vitamin D {prophylactically} during the dark winter months.
e.zh: 她在阴沉的冬季会预防性地服用维生素 D。

e.en: Travelers to malaria zones should consider {prophylaxis} before departure.
e.zh: 前往疟疾高发地区的旅行者出发前应考虑预防用药。

e.en: Daily {prophylaxis} can dramatically reduce the risk of HIV infection.
e.zh: 每日预防用药可以大幅降低感染艾滋病毒的风险。

e.en: The {propinquity} of their desks turned colleagues into close friends.
e.zh: 办公桌的相邻让两位同事变成了亲密的朋友。

e.en: Studies show {propinquity} strongly influences who we end up dating.
e.zh: 研究显示,空间上的接近极大影响我们最终和谁约会。

e.en: The villagers offered fruit to {propitiate} the mountain spirits.
e.zh: 村民们供奉水果以安抚山神。

e.en: He sent flowers to {propitiate} his wife after the argument.
e.zh: 吵架之后他送花来哄妻子消气。

e.en: Ancient cultures performed sacrifices as {propitiation} to angry gods.
e.zh: 古代文化通过献祭来安抚愤怒的神明。

e.en: He offered a public apology as {propitiation} for his rude comments.
e.zh: 他公开道歉,以平息因自己粗鲁言论引起的怒气。

e.en: This is a {propitious} moment to launch the new product.
e.zh: 现在是推出新产品的有利时机。

e.en: The clear weather seemed {propitious} for our weekend hike.
e.zh: 晴朗的天气看起来很适合我们周末的徒步。

e.en: Beekeepers often harvest {propolis} for use in natural remedies.
e.zh: 养蜂人常采集蜂胶用于天然疗法。

e.en: She takes a {propolis} spray whenever her throat feels sore.
e.zh: 她喉咙不舒服时就喷点蜂胶喷雾。

e.en: She is a strong {proponent} of remote work for tech employees.
e.zh: 她是科技员工远程办公的坚定支持者。

e.en: He became a leading {proponent} of renewable energy in Congress.
e.zh: 他成为国会中可再生能源的主要倡导者。

e.en: {Proponents} of the new bill say it will create jobs.
e.zh: 这项新法案的支持者表示它能创造就业机会。

e.en: Early {proponents} of electric cars were once mocked by industry experts.
e.zh: 电动汽车的早期支持者曾被业内专家嘲笑。

e.en: A large {proportion} of users access the site on mobile.
e.zh: 很大一部分用户通过手机访问这个网站。

e.en: The room's windows look small in {proportion} to the high ceiling.
e.zh: 相对于高高的天花板,房间的窗户显得很小。

e.en: The fine is {proportional} to the driver's income.
e.zh: 罚款金额与司机的收入成正比。

e.en: Each region gets {proportional} representation in the council.
e.zh: 每个地区在委员会中按比例获得代表席位。

e.en: The court stressed {proportionality} between the crime and the punishment.
e.zh: 法院强调罪行与刑罚之间的相称性。

e.en: Tax reform aims to restore {proportionality} across income brackets.
e.zh: 税改旨在恢复各收入阶层之间的比例公平。

e.en: Smaller startups suffer {proportionally} more from new regulations.
e.zh: 小型初创公司受新规影响在比例上更大。

e.en: Bonuses are distributed {proportionally} to each team's revenue.
e.zh: 奖金按各团队的营收按比例分配。

e.en: The response should be {proportionate} to the actual threat.
e.zh: 应对措施应与实际威胁相称。

e.en: Workers received pay raises {proportionate} to their seniority.
e.zh: 员工根据资历获得相应比例的加薪。

e.en: Costs rise {proportionately} as the project scales up.
e.zh: 随着项目扩大,成本也按比例上升。

e.en: Smaller files compress {proportionately} faster than huge ones.
e.zh: 小文件压缩的速度按比例比大文件更快。

proportions.t:
n. 比例、大小
n. (复) 规模

e.en: The scandal grew to enormous {proportions} overnight.
e.zh: 丑闻一夜之间扩大到了惊人的规模。

e.en: Mix the ingredients in equal {proportions} for best results.
e.zh: 将各种原料按等比例混合,效果最佳。

proposal.t:
n. 提案、建议
n. 求婚

e.en: She submitted a {proposal} for a new mobile app.
e.zh: 她提交了一份开发新移动应用的提案。

e.en: His marriage {proposal} caught everyone by surprise.
e.zh: 他的求婚让所有人都感到意外。

e.en: The committee reviewed three budget {proposals} this morning.
e.zh: 委员会今早审查了三份预算提案。

e.en: Most startup {proposals} get rejected on the first round.
e.zh: 大多数创业提案在第一轮就被拒绝。

propose.t:
v. 提议、建议
v. 求婚

e.en: I'd like to {propose} a different approach to this problem.
e.zh: 我想提出解决这个问题的另一种方法。

e.en: He plans to {propose} to his girlfriend next weekend.
e.zh: 他打算下周末向女朋友求婚。

proposed.t:
adj. 拟议的、被提议的
v. 提议（过去式）

e.en: The {proposed} law would ban single-use plastics.
e.zh: 这项拟议中的法律将禁止一次性塑料制品。

e.en: She {proposed} a toast to the newly married couple.
e.zh: 她提议为新婚夫妇干杯。

e.en: The {proposer} of the motion defended it for ten minutes.
e.zh: 动议的提出者用了十分钟为其辩护。

e.en: Each {proposer} must present evidence supporting their idea.
e.zh: 每位提议人都必须提供支持其观点的证据。

proposes.t: v. 提议、建议（第三人称单数）

e.en: The report {proposes} stricter rules for online advertising.
e.zh: 该报告建议对网络广告实施更严格的规定。

e.en: He {proposes} that we meet again next Friday.
e.zh: 他建议我们下周五再开一次会。

proposing.t:
v. 提议中
v. 求婚（进行时）

e.en: The team is {proposing} a complete redesign of the homepage.
e.zh: 团队正在提议对首页进行全面改版。

e.en: He's nervous about {proposing} to her tonight.
e.zh: 他对今晚向她求婚感到很紧张。

proposition.t:
n. 主张、命题
n. 提议

e.en: Starting a business in this market is a risky {proposition}.
e.zh: 在这个市场创业是一件风险很大的事。

e.en: Voters rejected the ballot {proposition} on new taxes.
e.zh: 选民否决了关于新增税收的公投提案。

e.en: Logic students must master {propositional} formulas before predicate logic.
e.zh: 逻辑学学生必须先掌握命题公式,再学谓词逻辑。

e.en: The proof relies on basic {propositional} reasoning.
e.zh: 该证明依赖于基本的命题推理。

e.en: The philosopher examined several {propositions} about consciousness.
e.zh: 那位哲学家研究了关于意识的几个命题。

e.en: Investors weighed competing {propositions} from rival startups.
e.zh: 投资者权衡了几家竞争创业公司的方案。

e.en: The professor likes to {propound} controversial theories in class.
e.zh: 那位教授喜欢在课堂上提出有争议的理论。

e.en: Critics {propound} that the law violates free speech.
e.zh: 批评者主张这项法律侵犯了言论自由。

e.en: She {propped} her phone against a coffee mug to record.
e.zh: 她把手机靠在咖啡杯上录视频。

e.en: Government subsidies {propped} up the failing airline for years.
e.zh: 政府补贴多年来一直在支撑这家濒临倒闭的航空公司。

e.en: Stop {propping} the door open with that heavy book.
e.zh: 别再用那本厚书顶着门让它开着了。

e.en: Cheap loans are {propping} up an unhealthy housing market.
e.zh: 廉价贷款正在支撑着一个不健康的房地产市场。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {propranolol} for his stage fright.
e.zh: 医生为他的怯场症开了普萘洛尔。

e.en: {Propranolol} can lower blood pressure and slow the heart rate.
e.zh: 普萘洛尔能降低血压并减慢心率。

e.en: The lamina {propria} contains blood vessels and immune cells.
e.zh: 固有层中含有血管和免疫细胞。

e.en: Inflammation often begins in the lamina {propria} of the gut.
e.zh: 炎症通常起始于肠道的固有层。

proprietary.t:
adj. 专有的、专利的
adj. 私营的

e.en: The company guards its {proprietary} algorithm very carefully.
e.zh: 公司非常严密地保护其专有算法。

e.en: Avoid {proprietary} formats so your data stays portable.
e.zh: 避免使用专有格式,这样数据才能保持可迁移性。

e.en: The {proprietor} of the café greeted every customer by name.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆的老板能叫出每位顾客的名字。

e.en: As sole {proprietor}, she handles every business decision herself.
e.zh: 作为独资经营者,她亲自处理每一项业务决策。

e.en: He had a {proprietorial} attitude toward the shared kitchen.
e.zh: 他对公用厨房表现出一副霸占式的态度。

e.en: She placed a {proprietorial} hand on her boyfriend's arm.
e.zh: 她带着占有欲把手放在男友的手臂上。

e.en: He registered the bakery as a sole {proprietorship}.
e.zh: 他将这家面包店注册为独资企业。

e.en: Sole {proprietorship} offers simplicity but unlimited personal liability.
e.zh: 独资经营手续简单,但个人承担无限责任。

e.en: The {proprietress} of the inn served us homemade pie.
e.zh: 那家小旅馆的女老板给我们端上了自制馅饼。

e.en: As {proprietress}, she chose every painting on the walls.
e.zh: 作为女店主,她亲自挑选了墙上的每一幅画。

e.en: She questioned the {propriety} of accepting gifts from clients.
e.zh: 她对接受客户礼物是否得体提出了质疑。

e.en: Victorian novels are obsessed with rules of social {propriety}.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的小说极其执着于社交礼仪规范。

proprioception.t: n. 本体感觉（身体位置感）

e.en: Yoga improves balance by training your {proprioception}.
e.zh: 瑜伽通过训练本体感觉来改善平衡能力。

e.en: Injury can temporarily impair {proprioception} in the affected joint.
e.zh: 受伤可能会暂时损害受影响关节的本体感觉。

e.en: Athletes do {proprioceptive} drills to prevent ankle injuries.
e.zh: 运动员做本体感觉训练以预防脚踝受伤。

e.en: The brain integrates visual and {proprioceptive} signals to maintain balance.
e.zh: 大脑整合视觉和本体感觉信号以维持平衡。

props.t:
n. 道具（影视）
n. 赞扬、称赞

e.en: The film crew packed up the {props} after the shoot.
e.zh: 拍摄结束后剧组人员收拾好了道具。

e.en: Big {props} to the team for shipping on time.
e.zh: 非常感谢团队按时完成发布。

e.en: Severe thyroid disease can cause obvious {proptosis} of the eyes.
e.zh: 严重的甲状腺疾病可导致明显的眼球突出。

e.en: The patient's {proptosis} prompted an urgent MRI scan.
e.zh: 患者的眼球突出促使医生立即安排了核磁共振检查。

e.en: Rocket {propulsion} relies on expelling mass at high speed.
e.zh: 火箭推进依靠以高速喷出物质来产生动力。

e.en: Engineers are testing a new electric {propulsion} system.
e.zh: 工程师们正在测试一种新的电动推进系统。

e.en: The novel has a {propulsive} plot that keeps you turning pages.
e.zh: 这部小说情节扣人心弦,让人欲罢不能。

e.en: Jet engines generate enormous {propulsive} force at takeoff.
e.zh: 喷气发动机在起飞时会产生巨大的推力。

e.en: {Propylene} glycol is a common ingredient in vape liquids.
e.zh: 丙二醇是电子烟液中常见的成分。

e.en: The plant produces {propylene} for plastics manufacturing.
e.zh: 该工厂生产用于塑料制造的丙烯。

e.en: The prime minister moved to {prorogue} parliament until October.
e.zh: 首相提出将议会休会至十月。

e.en: Critics argued it was unconstitutional to {prorogue} the legislature.
e.zh: 批评者认为让立法机构休会是违宪的。

pros.t:
n. 优点（pros and cons）
n. 职业选手

e.en: List the {pros} and cons before making your decision.
e.zh: 做决定前先列出利弊。

e.en: Only seasoned {pros} can finish that course in under par.
e.zh: 只有经验丰富的职业选手才能在标准杆以内完成那条球道。

e.en: Her job sounds glamorous but is actually quite {prosaic}.
e.zh: 她的工作听起来光鲜,实际上相当平淡乏味。

e.en: He gave a {prosaic} explanation for the strange noise.
e.zh: 他对那个奇怪的声音给出了一个平淡无奇的解释。

e.en: He {prosaically} described the sunset as just a sky changing color.
e.zh: 他平淡地把日落形容为天空变了个颜色而已。

e.en: The report {prosaically} listed the casualties without emotion.
e.zh: 那份报告平铺直叙地列出了伤亡名单,毫无情感。

e.en: The actors stepped beyond the {proscenium} to address the audience.
e.zh: 演员们走出舞台前沿向观众讲话。

e.en: Old theaters often feature an ornate {proscenium} arch.
e.zh: 老剧院通常都有装饰华丽的台口拱门。

e.en: She wrapped melon slices in {prosciutto} for the appetizer.
e.zh: 她用意式生火腿卷起哈密瓜片做开胃菜。

e.en: This deli imports authentic {prosciutto} from Parma.
e.zh: 这家熟食店从帕尔马进口正宗的意式生火腿。

e.en: Many countries {proscribe} the use of certain pesticides.
e.zh: 许多国家禁止使用某些农药。

e.en: The new policy will {proscribe} smoking in all public buildings.
e.zh: 新政策将禁止在所有公共建筑内吸烟。

proscribed.t:
adj. 被禁止的
v. 禁止（过去式）

e.en: The group was officially {proscribed} as a terrorist organization.
e.zh: 该团体被正式列为恐怖组织而遭到取缔。

e.en: Several {proscribed} chemicals were found in the warehouse.
e.zh: 在仓库里发现了几种被禁的化学品。

proscribes.t: v. 禁止（第三人称单数）

e.en: The constitution {proscribes} discrimination based on religion.
e.zh: 宪法禁止基于宗教的歧视。

e.en: Company policy {proscribes} accepting gifts from vendors.
e.zh: 公司规定禁止接受供应商的礼物。

e.en: Lawmakers are debating a bill {proscribing} hidden tracking software.
e.zh: 议员们正在讨论一项禁止隐藏追踪软件的法案。

e.en: The treaty went further, {proscribing} the development of such weapons.
e.zh: 该条约更进一步,禁止研发此类武器。

e.en: The {proscription} on alcohol lasted thirteen years in America.
e.zh: 美国对酒精的禁令持续了十三年。

e.en: Religious {proscription} of certain foods shapes everyday cooking.
e.zh: 宗教对某些食物的禁忌影响着日常烹饪。

e.en: Ancient codes contained strict {proscriptions} against theft.
e.zh: 古代法典中包含对盗窃的严格禁令。

e.en: Modern free speech debates often challenge old {proscriptions}.
e.zh: 现代关于言论自由的讨论常常挑战过去的种种禁令。

e.en: The guide is {proscriptive}, listing things teachers must never do.
e.zh: 该指南采取禁令式写法,列出教师绝不能做的事项。

e.en: Critics call the new code overly {proscriptive} and rigid.
e.zh: 批评者认为新规章过于禁绝化且僵化。

e.en: His {prose} flows smoothly and is a pleasure to read.
e.zh: 他的散文文笔流畅,读起来令人愉悦。

e.en: She prefers writing {prose} to writing poetry.
e.zh: 比起写诗,她更喜欢写散文。

e.en: The evidence wasn't strong enough to make the case {prosecutable}.
e.zh: 证据不够充分,案件无法提起公诉。

e.en: Online harassment is now a {prosecutable} offense in many states.
e.zh: 在许多州,网络骚扰如今已是可起诉的犯罪行为。

e.en: The state will {prosecute} him for tax fraud next month.
e.zh: 州政府下个月将以税务欺诈罪对他提起公诉。

e.en: Trespassers will be {prosecute}d to the fullest extent of the law.
e.zh: 擅闯者将被依法追究到底。

e.en: He was {prosecuted} for tax fraud last year.
e.zh: 他去年因税务欺诈被起诉。

e.en: The company {prosecuted} the case aggressively in court.
e.zh: 该公司在法庭上积极推进此案。

prosecutes.t: v. 起诉（第三人称单数）

e.en: The district attorney {prosecutes} serious crimes in this county.
e.zh: 地区检察官负责起诉本县的重大犯罪。

e.en: She {prosecutes} her career goals with relentless energy.
e.zh: 她以不懈的精力追求自己的职业目标。

e.en: The {prosecuting} attorney called the first witness.
e.zh: 控方律师传唤了第一位证人。

e.en: They are {prosecuting} him for embezzlement.
e.zh: 他们正在以挪用公款罪起诉他。

e.en: The {prosecution} presented strong evidence against the defendant.
e.zh: 控方提出了对被告不利的有力证据。

e.en: She faces {prosecution} if she breaks the agreement.
e.zh: 如果她违反协议,将面临起诉。

e.en: Successful {prosecutions} for cybercrime have increased this year.
e.zh: 今年网络犯罪的成功起诉案件有所增加。

e.en: The agency reported fewer {prosecutions} last quarter.
e.zh: 该机构报告上季度起诉案件减少。

e.en: The {prosecutor} questioned the witness for two hours.
e.zh: 检察官盘问了证人两个小时。

e.en: She worked as a federal {prosecutor} for a decade.
e.zh: 她担任联邦检察官长达十年。

e.en: The judge criticized the {prosecutorial} misconduct in the case.
e.zh: 法官批评了此案中的检方不当行为。

e.en: He has years of {prosecutorial} experience in fraud cases.
e.zh: 他在欺诈案件方面有多年检察经验。

e.en: Federal {prosecutors} announced charges against three executives.
e.zh: 联邦检察官宣布对三名高管提起诉讼。

e.en: The {prosecutors} are reviewing new evidence in the case.
e.zh: 检察官们正在审查此案的新证据。

proselytise.t: v. 劝人改变信仰（英式拼写）

e.en: He likes to {proselytise} about his favorite programming language.
e.zh: 他喜欢宣扬他最爱的编程语言。

e.en: Volunteers were told not to {proselytise} during the relief mission.
e.zh: 志愿者被告知在救援任务中不要传教。

proselytism.t: n. 劝人改变宗教信仰的行为

e.en: The country has strict laws against religious {proselytism}.
e.zh: 该国有严格的反宗教劝诱法律。

e.en: His aggressive {proselytism} alienated many of his friends.
e.zh: 他咄咄逼人的劝信方式疏远了许多朋友。

proselytization.t: n. 劝诱他人改变信仰

e.en: The school banned any form of {proselytization} on campus.
e.zh: 学校禁止在校园内进行任何形式的劝信活动。

e.en: Critics accused the group of online {proselytization}.
e.zh: 批评者指责该团体进行网络劝信。

proselytize.t: v. 劝人改变信仰或立场

e.en: Don't try to {proselytize} your colleagues at work.
e.zh: 不要试图在工作中向同事传教。

e.en: Tech enthusiasts often {proselytize} about open-source software.
e.zh: 科技爱好者常常鼓吹开源软件。

proselytizer.t: n. 劝人改变信仰的人

e.en: He became a passionate {proselytizer} for the new diet.
e.zh: 他成为了这种新饮食法的狂热推广者。

e.en: The {proselytizer} handed out pamphlets at the train station.
e.zh: 那位传教者在火车站分发小册子。

proselytizing.t:
v. 劝人改信
adj. 劝诱改宗的

e.en: The company forbids {proselytizing} in the workplace.
e.zh: 公司禁止在工作场所传教。

e.en: She spent years {proselytizing} for clean energy reform.
e.zh: 她多年来一直在为清洁能源改革奔走呼号。

e.en: He {proses} on about politics whenever we have dinner.
e.zh: 每次吃饭他都絮絮叨叨地谈论政治。

e.en: The professor {proses} endlessly about medieval literature.
e.zh: 教授没完没了地谈论中世纪文学。

prosocial.t: adj. 有利于社会的；亲社会的

e.en: Children learn {prosocial} behavior by watching their parents.
e.zh: 孩子通过观察父母学习亲社会行为。

e.en: The app encourages {prosocial} interactions among users.
e.zh: 该应用鼓励用户之间的亲社会互动。

e.en: Her speech showed unusual {prosodic} patterns and rhythm.
e.zh: 她的言语展现出不寻常的韵律模式和节奏。

e.en: Linguists study {prosodic} features like stress and intonation.
e.zh: 语言学家研究重音和语调等韵律特征。

e.en: English {prosody} relies heavily on stress and rhythm.
e.zh: 英语韵律在很大程度上依赖于重音和节奏。

e.en: The poet has a remarkable command of {prosody}.
e.zh: 这位诗人对韵律有非凡的掌控力。

e.en: The poem uses {prosopopoeia} to give the river a voice.
e.zh: 这首诗运用拟人法让河流开口说话。

e.en: Ancient orators often employed {prosopopoeia} for dramatic effect.
e.zh: 古代演说家常用拟人法以增强戏剧效果。

prospect.t:
n. 前景；可能性
v. 勘探（矿产）

e.en: The {prospect} of a long vacation excited the whole team.
e.zh: 长假的前景让整个团队兴奋不已。

e.en: Sales teams call every {prospect} on the list.
e.zh: 销售团队会致电名单上的每位潜在客户。

e.en: The startup is {prospecting} for new enterprise customers.
e.zh: 这家初创公司正在寻找新的企业客户。

e.en: Miners spent months {prospecting} in the remote mountains.
e.zh: 矿工在偏远山区勘探了数月。

e.en: We met with several {prospective} buyers this morning.
e.zh: 我们今早会见了几位潜在买家。

e.en: The university hosted an event for {prospective} students.
e.zh: 大学为准学生举办了一场活动。

e.en: The new policy will apply {prospectively} from next January.
e.zh: 新政策将从明年一月起向后生效。

e.en: Researchers tracked the patients {prospectively} for five years.
e.zh: 研究人员对患者进行了为期五年的前瞻性追踪。

e.en: The old {prospector} struck gold in the dry riverbed.
e.zh: 那位老探矿者在干涸的河床上发现了金矿。

e.en: She works as a talent {prospector} for a film studio.
e.zh: 她为一家电影公司担任星探。

e.en: His career {prospects} improved after the promotion.
e.zh: 升职后他的职业前景大为改善。

e.en: The team scouted several {prospects} at the college tournament.
e.zh: 球队在大学锦标赛上考察了几位新秀。

prospectus.t: n. 招股说明书；简介手册

e.en: The company filed its IPO {prospectus} with the SEC.
e.zh: 该公司向证交会提交了其首次公开募股招股书。

e.en: Read the fund {prospectus} carefully before investing.
e.zh: 投资前请仔细阅读基金招股说明书。

e.en: Small businesses can {prosper} with the right support.
e.zh: 小企业在适当的支持下可以蓬勃发展。

e.en: May your family live long and {prosper}.
e.zh: 愿您全家长寿安康。

e.en: The town {prospered} after the new highway opened.
e.zh: 新高速公路开通后,这个小镇繁荣起来。

e.en: Her bakery {prospered} despite the difficult economy.
e.zh: 尽管经济不景气,她的面包店仍然兴旺。

prospering.t: v. 日益兴旺（现在分词）

e.en: Their startup is {prospering} in the competitive tech market.
e.zh: 他们的初创公司在激烈的科技市场中蒸蒸日上。

e.en: Local farmers are {prospering} thanks to fair-trade programs.
e.zh: 得益于公平贸易项目,当地农民正在富起来。

e.en: History records the rise and fall of many {prosperities}.
e.zh: 历史记录了许多繁荣时期的兴衰。

e.en: The region experienced several {prosperities} during the trade boom.
e.zh: 该地区在贸易繁荣期经历了数次兴盛。

e.en: The country enjoyed decades of peace and {prosperity}.
e.zh: 这个国家享受了数十年的和平与繁荣。

e.en: Education is the foundation of long-term {prosperity}.
e.zh: 教育是长期繁荣的基础。

prospero.t: n. 莎剧《暴风雨》主角名

e.en: In Shakespeare's play, {Prospero} controls the magical island.
e.zh: 在莎士比亚的戏剧中,普洛斯彼罗掌控着那座魔法岛。

e.en: The actor delivered {Prospero}'s farewell speech beautifully.
e.zh: 演员精彩地演绎了普洛斯彼罗的告别演说。

e.en: Singapore has become one of Asia's most {prosperous} nations.
e.zh: 新加坡已成为亚洲最繁荣的国家之一。

e.en: They wished us a happy and {prosperous} new year.
e.zh: 他们祝我们新年快乐、繁荣昌盛。

prospers.t: v. 兴旺（第三人称单数）

e.en: A business {prospers} when it truly understands its customers.
e.zh: 真正理解客户的企业才会兴旺发达。

e.en: This plant {prospers} in warm, humid climates.
e.zh: 这种植物在温暖潮湿的气候中长势良好。

e.en: The Germans raised their beers and shouted {prost}!
e.zh: 德国人举起啤酒高呼“干杯”!

e.en: At Oktoberfest, strangers clink glasses and say {prost}.
e.zh: 在慕尼黑啤酒节,陌生人会碰杯并说“干杯”。

e.en: {Prostacyclin} helps prevent unwanted blood clot formation.
e.zh: 前列环素有助于防止不必要的血栓形成。

e.en: Doctors use {prostacyclin} to treat pulmonary hypertension.
e.zh: 医生用前列环素治疗肺动脉高压。

e.en: {Prostaglandin} levels rise during inflammation in the body.
e.zh: 身体发炎时前列腺素水平会升高。

e.en: Aspirin works by blocking {prostaglandin} production.
e.zh: 阿司匹林通过抑制前列腺素的产生发挥作用。

e.en: Men over fifty should get regular {prostate} screenings.
e.zh: 五十岁以上的男性应定期进行前列腺检查。

e.en: His father was diagnosed with {prostate} cancer last year.
e.zh: 他父亲去年被诊断出患有前列腺癌。

e.en: The surgeon performed a robotic {prostatectomy} this morning.
e.zh: 外科医生今早进行了一次机器人前列腺切除术。

e.en: Recovery from a {prostatectomy} usually takes several weeks.
e.zh: 前列腺切除术的恢复通常需要几周时间。

e.en: The doctor reviewed his {prostatic} biopsy results carefully.
e.zh: 医生仔细查看了他的前列腺活检结果。

e.en: Benign {prostatic} enlargement is common in older men.
e.zh: 良性前列腺肥大在老年男性中很常见。

e.en: Chronic {prostatitis} can cause persistent pelvic discomfort.
e.zh: 慢性前列腺炎可引起持续的盆腔不适。

e.en: Antibiotics are often prescribed for bacterial {prostatitis}.
e.zh: 细菌性前列腺炎通常需用抗生素治疗。

e.en: After the accident, he was fitted with a leg {prosthesis}.
e.zh: 事故后他装上了一条假肢。

e.en: Modern {prosthesis} designs use lightweight carbon fiber.
e.zh: 现代假肢设计采用轻质碳纤维材料。

e.en: The veteran received a high-tech {prosthetic} arm.
e.zh: 这位退伍军人获得了一只高科技义肢手臂。

e.en: Makeup artists used {prosthetic} pieces to age the actor.
e.zh: 化妆师用假体让演员显得苍老。

e.en: Advances in {prosthetics} have transformed many amputees' lives.
e.zh: 假肢技术的进步改变了许多截肢者的生活。

e.en: The film's {prosthetics} won an Academy Award for makeup.
e.zh: 这部电影的特效化妆赢得了奥斯卡化妆奖。

e.en: The {prosthetist} carefully measured his residual limb.
e.zh: 假肢技师仔细测量了他的残肢。

e.en: A skilled {prosthetist} can dramatically improve a patient's mobility.
e.zh: 熟练的假肢技师能极大改善患者的活动能力。

prostitute.t:
n. 妓女
v. 出卖（才能、人格）

e.en: He refused to {prostitute} his artistic talent for money.
e.zh: 他拒绝为金钱而出卖自己的艺术才华。

e.en: The novel tells the story of a former {prostitute}.
e.zh: 这部小说讲述了一位前妓女的故事。

e.en: Critics said the writer {prostituted} her ideals for fame.
e.zh: 批评家说这位作家为名声出卖了自己的理想。

e.en: He felt he had {prostituted} his skills writing clickbait.
e.zh: 他觉得自己写标题党文章是糟蹋了才华。

e.en: Several countries have decriminalized {prostitution} in recent years.
e.zh: 近年来一些国家已将卖淫合法化。

e.en: The documentary exposed networks involved in human {prostitution}.
e.zh: 这部纪录片揭露了人口卖淫的网络。

prostrate.t:
adj. 俯卧的；精疲力竭的
v. 使屈服

e.en: The pilgrims lay {prostrate} before the temple altar.
e.zh: 朝圣者俯伏在寺庙祭坛前。

e.en: She was {prostrate} with grief after her mother's death.
e.zh: 母亲去世后,她因悲痛而崩溃。

prostrated.t: v. 俯伏；使衰竭（过去式）

e.en: The monk {prostrated} himself before the ancient statue.
e.zh: 僧人在古老的雕像前俯身叩拜。

e.en: The summer heat {prostrated} workers across the city.
e.zh: 夏日酷热让全城工人精疲力竭。

prostrates.t: v. 俯伏（第三人称单数）

e.en: He {prostrates} himself before the altar every morning.
e.zh: 他每天早上都在祭坛前俯身跪拜。

e.en: Grief {prostrates} her whenever she hears that song.
e.zh: 每当听到那首歌,悲痛就让她崩溃倒下。

e.en: The pilgrims were {prostrating} themselves on the temple steps.
e.zh: 朝圣者们在寺庙台阶上行五体投地之礼。

e.en: A {prostrating} fever kept him in bed for days.
e.zh: 一场让人虚脱的高烧使他卧床数日。

e.en: Heat {prostration} sent several runners to the hospital.
e.zh: 中暑虚脱让几名跑者被送进了医院。

e.en: The monks bowed in deep {prostration} before the statue.
e.zh: 僧侣们在佛像前深深叩拜。

e.en: The {protagonist} of the novel struggles with memory loss.
e.zh: 小说的主人公正在与失忆症作斗争。

e.en: She became a leading {protagonist} of education reform.
e.zh: 她成了教育改革的主要倡导者。

e.en: Both {protagonists} grow up in the same village.
e.zh: 两位主人公都在同一个村庄长大。

e.en: The {protagonists} of the climate movement met in Berlin.
e.zh: 气候运动的主要倡导者在柏林会面。

e.en: A pink {protea} bloomed beside the garden path.
e.zh: 花园小径旁绽放着一朵粉色的普罗梯亚花。

e.en: She arranged a {protea} in the center of the bouquet.
e.zh: 她把一朵帝王花插在花束的中央。

protean.t: adj. 千变万化的；多才多艺的

e.en: His {protean} acting style suits any role.
e.zh: 他多变的演技能驾驭任何角色。

e.en: The internet has a {protean} ability to reshape culture.
e.zh: 互联网有着重塑文化的多变能力。

e.en: The drug works by blocking a viral {protease}.
e.zh: 这种药物通过阻断病毒蛋白酶来发挥作用。

e.en: Pineapple contains a {protease} that tenderizes meat.
e.zh: 菠萝含有一种能嫩化肉类的蛋白酶。

e.en: Use a strong password to {protect} your account.
e.zh: 使用强密码来保护你的账户。

e.en: Sunscreen helps {protect} your skin from UV damage.
e.zh: 防晒霜有助于保护皮肤免受紫外线伤害。

protectant.t:
n. 保护剂
adj. 起保护作用的

e.en: Apply a leather {protectant} to keep the seats supple.
e.zh: 涂上皮革保护剂能让座椅保持柔软。

e.en: The spray acts as a {protectant} against rust.
e.zh: 这种喷雾可作为防锈保护剂。

protected.t:
adj. 受保护的
v. 保护（过去式）

e.en: All user data is {protected} by end-to-end encryption.
e.zh: 所有用户数据都受端到端加密保护。

e.en: The forest is a {protected} wildlife area.
e.zh: 这片森林是受保护的野生动物保护区。

protecting.t:
v. 保护（现在分词）
adj. 保护的

e.en: She wore gloves, {protecting} her hands from the cold.
e.zh: 她戴着手套保护双手不受寒冷侵袭。

e.en: The new law focuses on {protecting} consumer privacy.
e.zh: 新法律重点保护消费者隐私。

e.en: The case offers solid {protection} for your phone.
e.zh: 这个保护壳能为你的手机提供可靠保护。

e.en: Vaccines provide strong {protection} against severe illness.
e.zh: 疫苗能有效防止重症。

e.en: Rising {protectionism} could slow global trade growth.
e.zh: 贸易保护主义抬头可能拖慢全球贸易增长。

e.en: Critics warned that {protectionism} would raise consumer prices.
e.zh: 批评者警告称保护主义会推高消费者价格。

protectionist.t:
n. 贸易保护主义者
adj. 保护主义的

e.en: The government adopted {protectionist} tariffs on steel imports.
e.zh: 政府对进口钢铁实施了保护主义关税。

e.en: Many farmers support a more {protectionist} trade policy.
e.zh: 许多农民支持更具保护主义色彩的贸易政策。

e.en: The bill expands {protections} for gig workers.
e.zh: 该法案扩大了对零工劳动者的保护。

e.en: Browsers add new {protections} against tracking each year.
e.zh: 浏览器每年都会新增防止追踪的保护措施。

e.en: Workers must wear {protective} goggles in the lab.
e.zh: 工人在实验室里必须戴防护眼镜。

e.en: She is fiercely {protective} of her younger brother.
e.zh: 她对弟弟非常护着。

e.en: He wrapped his arm {protectively} around the puppy.
e.zh: 他把胳膊护着小狗。

e.en: She stood {protectively} in front of her students.
e.zh: 她护在学生们前面站着。

e.en: His {protectiveness} toward his sister sometimes felt suffocating.
e.zh: 他对妹妹的过度保护有时让人窒息。

e.en: The dog showed surprising {protectiveness} around the baby.
e.zh: 那只狗在婴儿身边表现出惊人的护幼本能。

e.en: This screen {protector} resists scratches and fingerprints.
e.zh: 这款屏幕保护膜耐刮且防指纹。

e.en: He saw himself as the {protector} of the village.
e.zh: 他把自己视为村子的守护者。

e.en: The island was once a British {protectorate}.
e.zh: 这座岛曾是英国的保护国。

e.en: The treaty established a {protectorate} over the small kingdom.
e.zh: 条约确立了对这个小王国的保护关系。

e.en: The goddess was honored as the {protectress} of sailors.
e.zh: 这位女神被尊为水手的守护者。

e.en: She acted as a quiet {protectress} of the orphans.
e.zh: 她默默地担任着孤儿们的守护者。

protects.t: v. 保护（第三人称单数）

e.en: This app {protects} your messages with encryption.
e.zh: 这个应用通过加密来保护你的信息。

e.en: A thick fur {protects} the fox from harsh winters.
e.zh: 厚厚的皮毛让狐狸抵御严冬。

protege.t: n. 门生；被保护的男性

e.en: The young chef is a {protege} of a Michelin master.
e.zh: 这位年轻厨师是一位米其林大师的得意门生。

e.en: She introduced her {protege} at the industry conference.
e.zh: 她在行业大会上介绍了自己的门生。

protegee.t: n. 女门生；被保护的女性

e.en: His {protegee} won her first design award last night.
e.zh: 他的女门生昨晚赢得了她的第一个设计奖。

e.en: The director cast his {protegee} in the lead role.
e.zh: 导演让他的女门生出演主角。

e.en: Eggs are a cheap and reliable source of {protein}.
e.zh: 鸡蛋是便宜又可靠的蛋白质来源。

e.en: Researchers identified a {protein} linked to the disease.
e.zh: 研究人员发现了一种与该疾病相关的蛋白质。

e.en: The enzyme behaves like a typical {proteinase}.
e.zh: 这种酶的行为类似于典型的蛋白酶。

e.en: Scientists isolated a new {proteinase} from soil bacteria.
e.zh: 科学家从土壤细菌中分离出一种新蛋白酶。

e.en: Beans and tofu provide plant-based {proteins}.
e.zh: 豆类和豆腐提供植物性蛋白质。

e.en: Many {proteins} fold into precise three-dimensional shapes.
e.zh: 许多蛋白质会折叠成精确的三维结构。

e.en: The test detected mild {proteinuria} in the patient.
e.zh: 检查发现患者有轻微蛋白尿。

e.en: {Proteinuria} can be an early sign of kidney disease.
e.zh: 蛋白尿可能是肾脏疾病的早期信号。

e.en: The fencer would {protend} her sword before lunging.
e.zh: 那位击剑手会先伸出剑再突刺。

e.en: He likes to {protend} his arm dramatically when speaking.
e.zh: 他说话时喜欢夸张地伸出手臂。

e.en: Papaya contains {proteolytic} enzymes that break down meat.
e.zh: 木瓜含有能分解肉类的蛋白水解酶。

e.en: The cleaner uses {proteolytic} agents to remove blood stains.
e.zh: 这种清洁剂使用蛋白水解成分去除血迹。

e.en: Advances in {proteomics} are reshaping cancer research.
e.zh: 蛋白质组学的进展正在重塑癌症研究。

e.en: Her lab specializes in clinical {proteomics}.
e.zh: 她的实验室专注于临床蛋白质组学。

protest.t:
n. 抗议；反对
v. 抗议；声明

e.en: Thousands marched in {protest} against the new law.
e.zh: 数千人游行抗议这项新法律。

e.en: Students plan to {protest} outside the city hall tomorrow.
e.zh: 学生们计划明天在市政厅外抗议。

protestant.t:
n. 新教徒
adj. 新教的

e.en: She grew up in a small {protestant} community.
e.zh: 她在一个小型新教社区长大。

e.en: The old church belongs to a {protestant} denomination.
e.zh: 这座古老的教堂属于一个新教教派。

e.en: {Protestantism} spread quickly across northern Europe.
e.zh: 新教在北欧迅速传播开来。

e.en: He wrote a history of early American {protestantism}.
e.zh: 他撰写了一部早期美国新教史。

e.en: Despite his {protestation} of innocence, the jury convicted him.
e.zh: 尽管他声称无辜,陪审团仍判他有罪。

e.en: She signed the letter as a {protestation} against the policy.
e.zh: 她签下这封信以表达对该政策的抗议。

e.en: Workers {protested} outside the factory all weekend.
e.zh: 工人们整个周末都在工厂外抗议。

e.en: He {protested} that the charges were completely unfair.
e.zh: 他抗议说这些指控完全不公平。

e.en: A lone {protester} stood quietly outside parliament.
e.zh: 一名抗议者独自静静地站在议会外。

e.en: Police asked the {protester} to step off the road.
e.zh: 警察请那位抗议者离开道路。

e.en: Hundreds of {protesters} gathered in the city square.
e.zh: 数百名抗议者聚集在市中心广场。

e.en: The {protesters} chanted slogans about climate justice.
e.zh: 抗议者们高呼气候正义的口号。

protesting.t:
v. 抗议（现在分词）
adj. 抗议的

e.en: Students are {protesting} the rise in tuition fees.
e.zh: 学生们正在抗议学费上涨。

e.en: She left, {protesting} that the meeting was a waste of time.
e.zh: 她离开了,抱怨说这次会议是浪费时间。

protestor.t: n. 抗议者（protester 的变体）

e.en: A {protestor} held up a handmade cardboard sign.
e.zh: 一名抗议者举着自制的纸板标语。

e.en: The {protestor} was detained for blocking traffic.
e.zh: 那位抗议者因阻塞交通而被拘留。

protests.t:
n. 抗议活动（复数）
v. 抗议

e.en: Peaceful {protests} continued for several weeks.
e.zh: 和平抗议持续了好几周。

e.en: He {protests} every time someone touches his desk.
e.zh: 每次有人碰他的桌子,他都会抗议。

proteus.t: n. 普罗透斯（希腊海神）

e.en: Like {Proteus}, the startup keeps reinventing itself.
e.zh: 这家初创公司像变形神普罗透斯一样不断自我重塑。

e.en: The blind cave salamander is sometimes called {Proteus}.
e.zh: 那种盲洞螈有时被称为普罗透斯。

e.en: Each {protist} we observed had a single nucleus.
e.zh: 我们观察到的每一种原生生物都只有一个细胞核。

e.en: Algae are a familiar example of a {protist}.
e.zh: 藻类是大家熟悉的原生生物的例子。

protocol.t: n. 协议（网络）；礼仪；规程

e.en: The hospital follows a strict safety {protocol}.
e.zh: 这家医院遵循严格的安全规程。

e.en: HTTPS is the standard {protocol} for secure web traffic.
e.zh: HTTPS 是安全网络通信的标准协议。

e.en: New testing {protocols} were introduced after the outbreak.
e.zh: 疫情爆发后引入了新的检测规程。

e.en: Modern routers support several wireless {protocols}.
e.zh: 现代路由器支持多种无线协议。

e.en: A hydrogen atom contains a single {proton}.
e.zh: 一个氢原子含有一个质子。

e.en: The collider smashes one {proton} into another.
e.zh: 对撞机让一个质子撞向另一个质子。

e.en: The young {protoplanet} is still pulling in nearby gas.
e.zh: 这颗年轻的原行星仍在吸收周围的气体。

e.en: Astronomers spotted a {protoplanet} forming around a distant star.
e.zh: 天文学家发现一颗原行星正在一颗遥远恒星周围形成。

e.en: The cell's {protoplasm} flowed slowly under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下,细胞的原生质缓慢流动。

e.en: Early biologists studied {protoplasm} as the basis of life.
e.zh: 早期生物学家把原生质作为生命的基础来研究。

e.en: A young {protostar} glows inside the dust cloud.
e.zh: 一颗年轻的原恒星在尘埃云中发出光芒。

e.en: Telescopes revealed a {protostar} hidden behind cosmic dust.
e.zh: 望远镜揭示了一颗隐藏在宇宙尘埃后的原恒星。

e.en: The team built a {prototype} of the new app in two weeks.
e.zh: 团队在两周内做出了新应用的原型。

e.en: This phone is just a {prototype}, not the final product.
e.zh: 这款手机只是样机,并不是最终产品。

e.en: The lab studied a {prototypic} cell to understand the disease.
e.zh: 实验室研究了一个典型细胞以了解该疾病。

e.en: He is the {prototypic} startup founder, young and ambitious.
e.zh: 他是典型的创业者,年轻又有野心。

e.en: She is the {prototypical} New Yorker, fast-talking and direct.
e.zh: 她是典型的纽约客,语速快又直接。

e.en: This café offers a {prototypical} Parisian breakfast experience.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆提供典型的巴黎式早餐体验。

e.en: The villain is {prototypically} evil, with no redeeming traits.
e.zh: 那个反派是典型的邪恶,毫无可取之处。

e.en: His writing is {prototypically} American in its blunt humor.
e.zh: 他的文风以直白幽默著称,典型的美国风格。

prototyping.t:
n. 原型设计
v. 制作原型

e.en: Rapid {prototyping} helps designers test ideas before full production.
e.zh: 快速原型设计帮助设计师在量产前测试创意。

e.en: We are {prototyping} a new checkout flow this sprint.
e.zh: 我们这个冲刺周期在做一个新结账流程的原型。

e.en: Pond water often contains tiny {protozoa} visible under a microscope.
e.zh: 池塘水里常含有显微镜下可见的微小原生动物。

e.en: Some {protozoa} cause serious diseases like malaria in humans.
e.zh: 有些原生动物会引起人类的严重疾病,例如疟疾。

protozoan.t:
n. 原生动物
adj. 原生动物的

e.en: Malaria is caused by a single-celled {protozoan} parasite.
e.zh: 疟疾是由一种单细胞原生动物寄生虫引起的。

e.en: The biologist identified a new {protozoan} species in the soil.
e.zh: 这位生物学家在土壤中发现了一种新的原生动物。

e.en: Lawyers tried to {protract} the trial for several more months.
e.zh: 律师们试图把审判再拖延几个月。

e.en: Don't {protract} the meeting with unnecessary discussion.
e.zh: 不要用不必要的讨论拖长会议时间。

e.en: After a {protracted} battle, the company finally won the lawsuit.
e.zh: 经过一场旷日持久的较量,公司终于赢得了官司。

e.en: The negotiations became {protracted} and exhausting for both sides.
e.zh: 谈判变得漫长,让双方都精疲力竭。

e.en: Use a {protractor} to measure the angle accurately.
e.zh: 用量角器来准确测量这个角度。

e.en: Every student needs a ruler and a {protractor} for geometry class.
e.zh: 每个学生上几何课都需要一把尺子和一个量角器。

e.en: Don't let your elbows {protrude} into the aisle on the plane.
e.zh: 在飞机上不要让胳膊肘伸到过道里。

e.en: Sharp rocks {protrude} from the cliff face above the trail.
e.zh: 小路上方的崖壁上有尖石突出。

e.en: A nail {protruded} from the board and snagged her sleeve.
e.zh: 一颗钉子从木板上突出,挂住了她的袖子。

e.en: His belly {protruded} slightly over his belt.
e.zh: 他的肚子微微凸出,挂在皮带上方。

protrudes.t: v. 突出（第三人称单数）

e.en: A small bone {protrudes} from the back of the wrist.
e.zh: 手腕背面有一小块骨头凸起。

e.en: The balcony {protrudes} two meters from the side of the building.
e.zh: 阳台从楼侧面伸出两米。

protruding.t:
adj. 突出的
v. 突出（现在分词）

e.en: Watch out for the {protruding} branch above the path.
e.zh: 小心小路上方那根伸出来的树枝。

e.en: She tripped on a {protruding} root in the forest.
e.zh: 她在森林里被一条凸出的树根绊倒了。

e.en: There's a small {protrusion} on the back of the phone case.
e.zh: 手机壳背面有一个小凸起。

e.en: The doctor examined a strange {protrusion} on his shoulder.
e.zh: 医生检查了他肩膀上一个奇怪的凸起。

e.en: The cliff has sharp {protrusions} that climbers use as handholds.
e.zh: 悬崖上有尖锐的凸起,攀岩者把它们当作抓手。

e.en: Tiny {protrusions} on the chip help dissipate heat.
e.zh: 芯片上的小凸起有助于散热。

e.en: A bony {protuberance} formed where the bone had healed.
e.zh: 骨头愈合的地方形成了一个骨质凸起。

e.en: The strange {protuberance} on the rock turned out to be a fossil.
e.zh: 那块岩石上奇怪的突起原来是一块化石。

e.en: The frog has large {protuberant} eyes on top of its head.
e.zh: 这只青蛙头顶上长着一对凸出的大眼睛。

e.en: He had a {protuberant} belly from years of overeating.
e.zh: 多年暴饮暴食让他的肚子明显凸起。

e.en: I'm so {proud} of you for finishing the marathon.
e.zh: 你跑完了马拉松,我真为你骄傲。

e.en: She was too {proud} to ask anyone for help.
e.zh: 她太要强了,不肯向任何人求助。

proudfoot.t: n. 人名/姓氏（如《魔戒》角色）

e.en: Hobbits like the {Proudfoot} family appear in Tolkien's novels.
e.zh: 普劳德富特家族这样的霍比特人出现在托尔金的小说里。

e.en: Bilbo greeted the {Proudfoot} relatives at his birthday party.
e.zh: 比尔博在生日派对上向普劳德富特家的亲戚打了招呼。

e.en: She {proudly} showed off her new tattoo to everyone.
e.zh: 她得意地把新纹身展示给每个人看。

e.en: He {proudly} announced that his daughter got into Harvard.
e.zh: 他自豪地宣布女儿被哈佛录取了。

proust.t: n. 普鲁斯特（法国作家）

e.en: Reading {Proust} requires patience but rewards careful attention.
e.zh: 读普鲁斯特需要耐心,但用心读会有回报。

e.en: The smell of madeleines always makes her think of {Proust}.
e.zh: 玛德琳蛋糕的香味总让她想起普鲁斯特。

e.en: The taste of grandma's soup triggered a {Proustian} memory.
e.zh: 奶奶煲的汤的味道勾起了一段普鲁斯特式的记忆。

e.en: His novel has a {Proustian} obsession with time and memory.
e.zh: 他的小说带有普鲁斯特式对时间和记忆的执念。

e.en: His alibi was easily {provable} with security camera footage.
e.zh: 他的不在场证明用监控录像很容易就能证实。

e.en: Not every theory is {provable} through experiment alone.
e.zh: 并非所有理论都能仅靠实验来证明。

e.en: Can you {prove} that you were home that night?
e.zh: 你能证明那晚你在家吗?

e.en: This experiment will {prove} our hypothesis is correct.
e.zh: 这个实验将证明我们的假设是正确的。

proved.t: v. 证明（过去式/过去分词）

e.en: The new strategy {proved} successful within just three months.
e.zh: 新策略在短短三个月内就证明是成功的。

e.en: DNA evidence {proved} his innocence after twenty years.
e.zh: DNA证据在二十年后证明了他的清白。

proven.t:
adj. 已证实的
v. prove 的过去分词

e.en: She has a {proven} track record in software engineering.
e.zh: 她在软件工程领域有过硬的履历。

e.en: This medicine has been {proven} safe for children.
e.zh: 这种药已被证明对儿童是安全的。

provenance.t: n. 出处，来源（艺术品、数据等）

e.en: The painting's {provenance} was traced back to 19th-century Paris.
e.zh: 这幅画的来源被追溯到十九世纪的巴黎。

e.en: Buyers want to know the {provenance} of every diamond.
e.zh: 买家都想知道每一颗钻石的来源出处。

provencal.t:
adj. 普罗旺斯的
n. 普罗旺斯人/语

e.en: We ordered a {Provencal} stew with tomatoes, olives, and herbs.
e.zh: 我们点了一道用番茄、橄榄和香草做的普罗旺斯炖菜。

e.en: The villa is decorated in classic {Provencal} style.
e.zh: 这栋别墅以经典的普罗旺斯风格装饰。

provence.t: n. 普罗旺斯（法国地区）

e.en: We spent the summer in {Provence} among lavender fields.
e.zh: 我们在普罗旺斯的薰衣草田间度过了夏天。

e.en: The wine from {Provence} is famous for its rosé.
e.zh: 普罗旺斯出产的葡萄酒以桃红酒闻名。

e.en: The farmer stored {provender} in the barn for winter.
e.zh: 农夫把饲料储存在谷仓里以备过冬。

e.en: Travelers carried enough {provender} for the long journey.
e.zh: 旅人带上了足够长途跋涉的口粮。

provenience.t: n. 起源，出处（美式拼法）

e.en: Archaeologists carefully recorded the {provenience} of every artifact.
e.zh: 考古学家仔细记录了每件文物的出土位置。

e.en: Without clear {provenience}, the museum refused to buy the relic.
e.zh: 由于来源不明,博物馆拒绝购买这件文物。

e.en: There's an old Chinese {proverb} about patience and persistence.
e.zh: 有一句关于耐心和坚持的中国古老谚语。

e.en: Her grandmother quoted a {proverb} for every situation.
e.zh: 她外婆遇到什么事都会引一句谚语。

proverbial.t: adj. 谚语中的，众所周知的

e.en: He hit the {proverbial} nail on the head with that comment.
e.zh: 他那句评论真是一语中的。

e.en: She has the {proverbial} memory of an elephant.
e.zh: 她真的像谚语说的那样有大象般的记忆力。

e.en: Cats are {proverbially} curious, often getting into trouble.
e.zh: 俗话说猫天生好奇,常常因此惹麻烦。

e.en: He is {proverbially} tight with money, never paying for drinks.
e.zh: 他出了名的吝啬,从不请人喝酒。

e.en: Many {proverbs} contain practical wisdom from past generations.
e.zh: 许多谚语蕴含着前人的实用智慧。

e.en: She collects {proverbs} from cultures around the world.
e.zh: 她收集来自世界各地文化的谚语。

proves.t: v. 证明（第三人称单数）

e.en: This study {proves} that exercise improves mental health.
e.zh: 这项研究证明运动能改善心理健康。

e.en: Her promotion {proves} that hard work pays off.
e.zh: 她的晋升证明了努力是有回报的。

e.en: The hotel will {provide} towels and toiletries in your room.
e.zh: 酒店会在房间里提供毛巾和洗漱用品。

e.en: Parents work hard to {provide} for their children.
e.zh: 父母努力工作以养育孩子。

provided.t:
conj. 假如，倘若
v. 提供（过去式）

e.en: The school {provided} free lunches for low-income students.
e.zh: 学校为低收入学生提供了免费午餐。

e.en: You can attend the event {provided} you register in advance.
e.zh: 只要你提前注册,就可以参加活动。

e.en: By some kind of {providence}, they survived the avalanche.
e.zh: 似乎是天意,他们在雪崩中幸存下来。

e.en: He believed {providence} had brought them together.
e.zh: 他相信是上天的安排让他们走到一起。

e.en: A {provident} saver puts money aside every single month.
e.zh: 懂得未雨绸缪的人每个月都会存一些钱。

e.en: Her {provident} planning helped the family weather the recession.
e.zh: 她未雨绸缪的规划帮家里挺过了经济衰退。

e.en: Their meeting at the airport seemed almost {providential}.
e.zh: 他们在机场的相遇仿佛是天意。

e.en: It was {providential} that a doctor was on the train.
e.zh: 火车上正好有位医生,真是天助。

e.en: {Providentially}, the rain stopped just before the wedding began.
e.zh: 幸运的是,雨在婚礼开始前正好停了。

e.en: {Providentially}, a passerby called the ambulance in time.
e.zh: 幸亏一位路人及时叫了救护车。

e.en: My internet {provider} keeps raising the monthly fee.
e.zh: 我的网络服务商一直在涨月费。

e.en: She is the main {provider} for her elderly parents.
e.zh: 她是年迈父母的主要经济支柱。

provides.t: v. 提供（第三人称单数）

e.en: This app {provides} real-time traffic updates for your commute.
e.zh: 这个应用为你的通勤提供实时路况更新。

e.en: The new policy {provides} extra leave for new parents.
e.zh: 新政策为新手父母提供额外的假期。

providing.t:
conj. 假如，只要
v. 提供（现在分词）

e.en: The charity is {providing} meals to flood victims.
e.zh: 慈善机构正在为洪灾灾民提供餐食。

e.en: You can borrow my car, {providing} you fill up the tank.
e.zh: 你可以借我的车,只要你把油加满。

e.en: Sichuan {province} is famous for its spicy hotpot.
e.zh: 四川省以麻辣火锅闻名。

e.en: Tax policy is not within the {province} of this committee.
e.zh: 税收政策不属于本委员会的职权范围。

e.en: China has 23 {provinces}, plus several autonomous regions.
e.zh: 中国有二十三个省,另外还有几个自治区。

e.en: Many young people leave the {provinces} to work in big cities.
e.zh: 许多年轻人离开外省到大城市工作。

provincial.t: adj. 省的；地方的，狭隘的

e.en: The {provincial} government announced new education funding.
e.zh: 省政府宣布了新的教育拨款。

e.en: His tastes in food are quite {provincial} and unadventurous.
e.zh: 他的饮食口味相当保守,不爱尝鲜。

provincialism.t: n. 地方主义，乡土观念

e.en: Travel helps cure the {provincialism} of small-town thinking.
e.zh: 旅行有助于消除小城镇思维的狭隘。

e.en: Her writing is criticized for its narrow {provincialism}.
e.zh: 她的作品因狭隘的地方主义而受到批评。

e.en: Critics mocked the {provinciality} of the small town's art scene.
e.zh: 评论家嘲笑这个小镇艺术圈的狭隘乡土气。

e.en: Her writing exposes the {provinciality} of suburban attitudes.
e.zh: 她的文章揭露了郊区思维的狭隘。

e.en: The festival is funded {provincially} rather than by the federal government.
e.zh: 这个节日由省级而非联邦政府资助。

e.en: He dressed {provincially}, in clothes a decade out of style.
e.zh: 他穿得很土气,衣服款式过时十年了。

e.en: The new intern is {proving} herself a quick learner.
e.zh: 这位新实习生正证明自己是个快速学习者。

e.en: Climate models are {proving} surprisingly accurate this decade.
e.zh: 气候模型在这十年里被证明出奇地准确。

provision.t:
n. 供应；条款
v. 提供（物资）

e.en: The contract includes a {provision} for early termination.
e.zh: 合同中包含一项提前终止的条款。

e.en: Schools must {provision} laptops for every new student.
e.zh: 学校必须为每个新生配备笔记本电脑。

e.en: They reached a {provisional} agreement before final negotiations.
e.zh: 在最终谈判前他们达成了临时协议。

e.en: My driver's license is still {provisional} for another six months.
e.zh: 我的驾照还要再过六个月才转正。

e.en: The merger has been {provisionally} approved by regulators.
e.zh: 这项合并已获监管机构临时批准。

e.en: She was {provisionally} hired pending a background check.
e.zh: 她在背景调查通过前被临时录用。

e.en: The dentist fitted me with {provisionals} until the crowns arrive.
e.zh: 在牙冠到货前,牙医给我装了临时牙套。

e.en: Hospital {provisionals} cover staff during the licensing process.
e.zh: 医院的临时执照在审批期间覆盖员工。

provisioning.t:
n. 配置；供给
v. 提供物资

e.en: Cloud {provisioning} now takes minutes instead of weeks.
e.zh: 云端资源调配如今只需几分钟而非几周。

e.en: The crew spent the morning {provisioning} the boat for the trip.
e.zh: 船员们花了一上午为这趟旅程备齐物资。

e.en: We packed enough {provisions} for a week in the mountains.
e.zh: 我们带了够在山里待一周的食物补给。

e.en: The bill contains several {provisions} protecting consumer privacy.
e.zh: 该法案包含几条保护消费者隐私的条款。

e.en: She accepted the offer with the {proviso} that she could work remotely.
e.zh: 她接受了这份工作,但前提是可以远程办公。

e.en: The loan was approved with one strict {proviso}.
e.zh: 贷款获批,但有一项严格的附加条件。

provisory.t: adj. 有附加条件的；临时的

e.en: The treaty contains a {provisory} clause about future tariffs.
e.zh: 该条约包含一条关于未来关税的附带条款。

e.en: Their arrangement was {provisory}, pending court approval.
e.zh: 他们的安排是有条件的,需等法院批准。

e.en: BYU's campus dominates downtown {Provo}, Utah.
e.zh: 杨百翰大学校园占据了犹他州普罗沃市中心。

e.en: We stopped in {Provo} on our drive to the national park.
e.zh: 我们在开往国家公园途中在普罗沃停了一下。

e.en: The online {provocateur} thrives on outraged comment threads.
e.zh: 那位网络挑事者靠激怒人的评论串生存。

e.en: She built a career as a fashion {provocateur}.
e.zh: 她以时尚界的挑衅者形象立足。

e.en: He stayed calm despite repeated {provocation} from the crowd.
e.zh: 尽管人群一再挑衅,他仍保持冷静。

e.en: The drone strike was seen as a deliberate {provocation}.
e.zh: 这次无人机袭击被视为蓄意挑衅。

e.en: Diplomats ignored the minor {provocations} along the border.
e.zh: 外交官们对边境上的小挑衅置之不理。

e.en: His tweets are calculated {provocations} aimed at journalists.
e.zh: 他的推文是针对记者精心策划的挑衅。

e.en: The documentary asks {provocative} questions about social media.
e.zh: 这部纪录片提出了关于社交媒体的发人深省的问题。

e.en: She wore a {provocative} red dress to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿了一件惹眼的红裙子出席晚会。

e.en: The headline was worded {provocatively} to drive clicks.
e.zh: 这个标题措辞挑衅,目的是吸引点击。

e.en: He leaned forward {provocatively} during the debate.
e.zh: 辩论时他挑衅地向前倾身。

e.en: Don't {provoke} the dog while he's eating.
e.zh: 狗在吃东西时不要去惹它。

e.en: The article will surely {provoke} a strong response online.
e.zh: 这篇文章肯定会在网上引发强烈反响。

provoked.t:
v. 激怒（过去式）
adj. 被激怒的

e.en: The new tax {provoked} widespread protests across the country.
e.zh: 新税收在全国引发了广泛抗议。

e.en: She felt {provoked} by his condescending tone.
e.zh: 他那居高临下的语气惹恼了她。

provokes.t: v. 激怒（第三人称单数）

e.en: His latest film {provokes} viewers to rethink consumerism.
e.zh: 他的新片促使观众重新思考消费主义。

e.en: Loud music {provokes} complaints from the neighbors every weekend.
e.zh: 大声的音乐每个周末都引来邻居抱怨。

provoking.t:
adj. 恼人的
v. 激怒（进行时）

e.en: Stop {provoking} your little brother during dinner.
e.zh: 吃饭的时候别再招惹你弟弟了。

e.en: The senator's remarks were thought-{provoking} but controversial.
e.zh: 参议员的言论发人深思但有争议。

provolone.t: n. 波萝伏洛奶酪（意大利奶酪）
