e.en: I ordered a sandwich with turkey and {provolone} cheese.
e.zh: 我点了一个火鸡加波萝伏洛奶酪的三明治。

e.en: The pizza was topped with mozzarella and aged {provolone}.
e.zh: 披萨上撒了马苏里拉和陈年波萝伏洛奶酪。

e.en: The university {provost} announced sweeping changes to the curriculum.
e.zh: 大学教务长宣布了课程的全面改革。

e.en: She was promoted from dean to {provost} last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天从院长升任教务长。

e.en: Waves crashed against the {prow} of the small fishing boat.
e.zh: 海浪拍打着小渔船的船头。

e.en: A wooden dragon was carved into the Viking ship's {prow}.
e.zh: 维京船的船头雕刻着一条木龙。

e.en: Her coding {prowess} earned her a job at a top startup.
e.zh: 她出色的编程能力让她进入了一家顶级创业公司。

e.en: The team's defensive {prowess} carried them to the finals.
e.zh: 该队出色的防守实力把他们带进了决赛。

prowl.t:
v. 潜行；四处觅食
n. 潜行

e.en: Foxes {prowl} the back gardens after midnight.
e.zh: 狐狸午夜后在后院里游荡觅食。

e.en: Security guards {prowl} the parking lot every two hours.
e.zh: 保安每两小时在停车场巡逻一次。

e.en: The cat {prowled} silently along the garden fence.
e.zh: 那只猫沿着花园栅栏悄无声息地潜行。

e.en: He {prowled} the kitchen looking for a late-night snack.
e.zh: 他在厨房里转悠,想找点宵夜。

e.en: A neighbor reported a {prowler} in the backyard last night.
e.zh: 一位邻居昨晚报告说有人在后院鬼鬼祟祟。

e.en: The motion sensor caught a {prowler} on camera.
e.zh: 动作感应器拍到了一个潜行者。

prowling.t:
v. 潜行（进行时）
adj. 伺机而动的

e.en: A coyote was {prowling} near the chicken coop at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时分,一只郊狼在鸡舍附近游荡。

e.en: Reporters were {prowling} the courthouse for a quote.
e.zh: 记者们在法院附近转悠,想要一段引言。

prowls.t: v. 潜行（第三人称单数）

e.en: The leopard {prowls} the riverbank after sunset.
e.zh: 豹子在日落后沿河岸潜行。

e.en: A new buyer {prowls} the auction house every Friday.
e.zh: 每周五都有一位新买家在拍卖行里转悠。

e.en: The pain is centered in the {proximal} part of the femur.
e.zh: 疼痛集中在股骨近端。

e.en: Engineers focused on the {proximal} cause of the failure.
e.zh: 工程师们集中研究故障的直接原因。

proximally.t: adv. 近端地；靠近中心地

e.en: The fracture is located {proximally} on the right tibia.
e.zh: 骨折位于右胫骨近端。

e.en: Nerves branch {proximally} from the spinal cord.
e.zh: 神经从脊髓的近端分支出来。

e.en: Investigators identified the {proximate} cause of the crash.
e.zh: 调查员查明了此次事故的直接原因。

e.en: Stress was the {proximate} trigger for her migraine.
e.zh: 压力是她偏头痛的直接诱因。

e.en: The app calculates {proximities} between users using GPS.
e.zh: 该应用利用 GPS 计算用户之间的距离。

e.en: Cell {proximities} affect how quickly tissues heal.
e.zh: 细胞之间的距离会影响组织的愈合速度。

e.en: The cafe's {proximity} to my office makes it my daily stop.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆离我办公室很近,成了我每天必去的地方。

e.en: AirTags use Bluetooth {proximity} to locate lost items.
e.zh: AirTag 利用蓝牙近距离感应来定位丢失的物品。

e.en: She voted by {proxy} since she couldn't attend the meeting.
e.zh: 她无法出席会议,所以委托他人代为投票。

e.en: Set up a {proxy} server to bypass the network restrictions.
e.zh: 设置一个代理服务器来绕过网络限制。

e.en: Her doctor prescribed {Prozac} for moderate depression.
e.zh: 医生给她开了百忧解治疗中度抑郁。

e.en: He stopped taking {Prozac} after a year of treatment.
e.zh: 治疗一年后,他停用了百忧解。

prp.t: n. 富血小板血浆（缩写）

e.en: She got a {PRP} injection to speed up her knee recovery.
e.zh: 她打了一针富血小板血浆,以加速膝盖恢复。

e.en: Athletes often turn to {PRP} therapy for tendon injuries.
e.zh: 运动员经常采用富血小板血浆疗法治疗肌腱损伤。

e.en: The reviewer left comments on three open {PRs} this morning.
e.zh: 评审者今早在三个待审拉取请求上留了评论。

e.en: Our team merges roughly twenty {PRs} every week.
e.zh: 我们团队每周大约合并二十个拉取请求。

e.en: My grandmother kept her savings with the {Pru} for decades.
e.zh: 我奶奶把积蓄存在保诚保险好几十年。

e.en: The {Pru} announced its quarterly dividend on Tuesday.
e.zh: 保诚保险周二公布了季度股息。

prude.t: n. 过分拘谨的人；假正经者

e.en: Don't be such a {prude}; it's just a beach photo.
e.zh: 别这么古板,不过是张海滩照而已。

e.en: Her friends teased her for being a total {prude}.
e.zh: 她的朋友们取笑她太过保守。

e.en: Financial {prudence} helped her retire at fifty.
e.zh: 理财上的谨慎让她五十岁就退休了。

e.en: The board praised the CEO's {prudence} during the downturn.
e.zh: 董事会称赞首席执行官在低迷期的审慎。

e.en: It's {prudent} to keep three months of expenses in savings.
e.zh: 在存款里留够三个月开销是明智之举。

e.en: A {prudent} investor diversifies across several asset classes.
e.zh: 谨慎的投资者会在多个资产类别间分散投资。

e.en: Banks must follow strict {prudential} regulations after the crisis.
e.zh: 金融危机后银行必须遵守严格的审慎监管规定。

e.en: The committee made a {prudential} decision to delay the launch.
e.zh: 委员会做出了谨慎的决定,推迟产品发布。

e.en: She invested her bonus {prudently} in index funds.
e.zh: 她把奖金谨慎地投到了指数基金里。

e.en: The mayor {prudently} reserved part of the budget for emergencies.
e.zh: 市长审慎地预留了一部分预算以备紧急之用。

e.en: Victorian {prudery} shaped much of nineteenth-century literature.
e.zh: 维多利亚时期的拘谨塑造了大部分十九世纪文学。

e.en: The film mocks suburban {prudery} with sharp humor.
e.zh: 这部电影用犀利的幽默讽刺了郊区的假正经。

e.en: Oil from {Prudhoe} Bay flows south through the Alaska pipeline.
e.zh: 普拉德霍湾的石油通过阿拉斯加输油管南输。

e.en: Engineers brave brutal cold to maintain the {Prudhoe} field.
e.zh: 工程师们顶着严寒维护普拉德霍油田。

prudish.t: adj. 过分拘谨的；假正经的

e.en: Her parents were too {prudish} to discuss anything personal.
e.zh: 她父母太古板,不愿谈论任何私人话题。

e.en: Critics called the censorship rules outdated and {prudish}.
e.zh: 批评者称这些审查规定过时而拘谨。

e.en: Her {prudishness} about the topic surprised her younger colleagues.
e.zh: 她对这个话题的拘谨让年轻同事们感到意外。

e.en: The novel pokes fun at small-town {prudishness}.
e.zh: 这部小说取笑了小镇的假正经。

prune.t:
v. 修剪；精简
n. 西梅干

e.en: You should {prune} the rose bushes before spring arrives.
e.zh: 你应该在春天到来前修剪玫瑰丛。

e.en: Run this command to {prune} unused Docker images.
e.zh: 运行这条命令可以清理未使用的 Docker 镜像。

e.en: She {pruned} the rose bushes before winter arrived.
e.zh: 她在冬天到来之前修剪了玫瑰丛。

e.en: The editor {pruned} unnecessary scenes from the script.
e.zh: 编辑删减了剧本中多余的场景。

prunella.t: n. 普鲁内拉（人名）；夏枯草

e.en: The vintage coat was lined with soft {prunella} fabric.
e.zh: 那件复古外套内衬着柔软的紫绒呢面料。

e.en: Herbalists use {prunella} to soothe sore throats.
e.zh: 草药师用夏枯草来缓解咽喉疼痛。

e.en: He bought a sharp {pruner} for trimming hedges.
e.zh: 他买了一把锋利的修枝剪用来修剪树篱。

e.en: A skilled {pruner} can shape a tree beautifully.
e.zh: 熟练的修剪师能把树修成漂亮的形状。

pruning.t:
n. 修剪（枝叶）
v. prune 的现在分词

e.en: Spring is the best time for {pruning} fruit trees.
e.zh: 春天是修剪果树的最佳时机。

e.en: The team is {pruning} unused code from the repo.
e.zh: 团队正在清理代码库中无用的代码。

e.en: The film was criticized for its blatant {prurience}.
e.zh: 这部电影因明显的低俗趣味受到批评。

e.en: Tabloids thrive on the public's {prurience} for scandal.
e.zh: 小报靠大众对丑闻的猎奇心理生存。

e.en: Critics dismissed the novel's various {pruriences} as cheap.
e.zh: 评论家将小说中种种低俗趣味斥为廉价。

e.en: Censors flagged the show's repeated {pruriences}.
e.zh: 审查员标记了节目中反复出现的色情内容。

e.en: The article had a {prurient} interest in her private life.
e.zh: 那篇文章对她的私生活带着窥探的兴趣。

e.en: He was uncomfortable with the {prurient} questions.
e.zh: 他对那些低俗的问题感到不自在。

e.en: The patient complained of severe {pruritus} on her arms.
e.zh: 病人抱怨手臂上严重瘙痒。

e.en: Dry winter air often causes {pruritus}.
e.zh: 干燥的冬季空气常常引起皮肤瘙痒。

e.en: {Prussia} once dominated much of northern Europe.
e.zh: 普鲁士曾一度统治北欧大部分地区。

e.en: The kingdom of {Prussia} was dissolved after World War II.
e.zh: 普鲁士王国在二战后被解散。

prussian.t:
adj. 普鲁士的
n. 普鲁士人

e.en: He admired the {Prussian} discipline of the old army.
e.zh: 他钦佩那支老军队的普鲁士式纪律。

e.en: She painted the sky a deep {Prussian} blue.
e.zh: 她把天空涂成了深深的普鲁士蓝。

e.en: Please don't {pry} into my personal messages.
e.zh: 请不要窥探我的私人信息。

e.en: He used a crowbar to {pry} the lid open.
e.zh: 他用撬棍把盖子撬开。

prying.t:
adj. 爱打听的
v. pry 的现在分词

e.en: She kept the diary hidden from {prying} eyes.
e.zh: 她把日记藏起来,避开窥探的目光。

e.en: Stop {prying} into other people's business.
e.zh: 别再打探别人的私事了。

psa.t: n. 前列腺特异抗原；公益广告

e.en: The radio aired a {PSA} about wearing seatbelts.
e.zh: 电台播出了一条关于系安全带的公益广告。

e.en: His doctor ordered a {PSA} test to screen for prostate issues.
e.zh: 医生让他做了前列腺特异抗原检测。

e.en: The choir sang a {psalm} during the evening service.
e.zh: 唱诗班在晚祷时吟唱了一首圣咏。

e.en: She found comfort reading a {psalm} every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上读一篇赞美诗以寻得慰藉。

e.en: The {psalmist} praised God's faithfulness in every verse.
e.zh: 诗篇作者在每一节中都称颂上帝的信实。

e.en: Scholars debate the identity of the ancient {psalmist}.
e.zh: 学者们对古代诗篇作者的身份争论不休。

e.en: The monk carried a worn {psalter} to chapel.
e.zh: 那位修士带着一本破旧的诗篇集去小教堂。

e.en: Her grandmother's leather {psalter} sat on the shelf.
e.zh: 她祖母那本皮面诗篇集放在书架上。

psbr.t: n. 公共部门借款需求（缩写）

e.en: The chancellor announced a lower {PSBR} for the year.
e.zh: 财政大臣宣布今年公共部门借贷需求下降。

e.en: Economists watch the {PSBR} as a key fiscal indicator.
e.zh: 经济学家把公共部门借贷需求视为关键财政指标。

psc.t: n. 公共服务委员会（缩写）

e.en: The candidates passed the {PSC} exam after months of study.
e.zh: 考生们经过几个月备考通过了公务员委员会考试。

e.en: She was appointed by the {PSC} last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天由公共服务委员会任命。

e.en: The designer sent over the layered {PSD} file.
e.zh: 设计师发来了带图层的 PSD 文件。

e.en: Open the {PSD} in Photoshop to edit the layers.
e.zh: 在 Photoshop 中打开 PSD 文件来编辑图层。

e.en: His {pseudo} concern fooled nobody at the meeting.
e.zh: 他那种假惺惺的关心在会上没骗过任何人。

e.en: The article is full of {pseudo} science about diets.
e.zh: 这篇文章满是关于饮食的伪科学。

pseudoephedrine.t: n. 伪麻黄碱（感冒药成分）

e.en: Cold tablets often contain {pseudoephedrine} as a decongestant.
e.zh: 感冒药通常含有伪麻黄碱作为减充血剂。

e.en: Pharmacies require ID to sell {pseudoephedrine}.
e.zh: 药店出售伪麻黄碱时需要查验身份证件。

e.en: The lab identified a {pseudomonas} infection in the wound.
e.zh: 实验室在伤口中检测出假单胞菌感染。

e.en: {Pseudomonas} bacteria can resist many common antibiotics.
e.zh: 假单胞菌对许多常用抗生素有耐药性。

e.en: She published her thrillers under a male {pseudonym}.
e.zh: 她用男性笔名发表她的惊悚小说。

e.en: Mark Twain was the {pseudonym} of Samuel Clemens.
e.zh: 马克·吐温是塞缪尔·克莱门斯的笔名。

e.en: The blog post was {pseudonymous} but widely read.
e.zh: 那篇博客是用化名发表的,却广为流传。

e.en: Bitcoin's creator remains a {pseudonymous} figure.
e.zh: 比特币的创造者至今仍是一个化名人物。

e.en: The amoeba extended a {pseudopod} to engulf its prey.
e.zh: 变形虫伸出伪足吞噬猎物。

e.en: Under the microscope, we watched a {pseudopod} form.
e.zh: 在显微镜下,我们看到伪足慢慢形成。

e.en: Astrology is widely considered a {pseudoscience}.
e.zh: 占星术普遍被视为伪科学。

e.en: He warned readers against the dangers of medical {pseudoscience}.
e.zh: 他提醒读者警惕医学伪科学的危害。

psi.t: n. 压强单位（pounds per square inch）

e.en: Check that the tires are inflated to 32 {psi}.
e.zh: 检查一下轮胎是否充气到 32 磅每平方英寸。

e.en: The pressure gauge reads 60 {psi} at the valve.
e.zh: 压力表在阀门处显示 60 psi。

psilocybin.t: n. 裸盖菇素（致幻成分）

e.en: Researchers are studying {psilocybin} for treating depression.
e.zh: 研究人员正在研究用裸盖菇素治疗抑郁症。

e.en: Some mushrooms naturally contain {psilocybin}.
e.zh: 有些蘑菇天然含有裸盖菇素。

e.en: He still keeps an old {Psion} organizer in his drawer.
e.zh: 他抽屉里还留着一台旧的 Psion 掌上电脑。

e.en: The {Psion} was a popular handheld device in the nineties.
e.zh: Psion 是九十年代流行的掌上设备。

e.en: Tight {psoas} muscles can cause lower back pain.
e.zh: 腰大肌紧绷可能引起下背疼痛。

e.en: The yoga teacher demonstrated stretches for the {psoas}.
e.zh: 瑜伽老师示范了拉伸腰大肌的动作。

psoe.t: n. 西班牙工人社会党（缩写）

e.en: The {PSOE} won the Spanish general election that year.
e.zh: 那年西班牙工人社会党赢得了大选。

e.en: Many voters in Andalusia traditionally support the {PSOE}.
e.zh: 安达卢西亚许多选民历来支持工人社会党。

e.en: Cold weather often worsens her {psoriasis}.
e.zh: 寒冷天气常常让她的银屑病加重。

e.en: New treatments have improved life for {psoriasis} patients.
e.zh: 新疗法改善了银屑病患者的生活。

e.en: {Psst}, can you pass me that pen quietly?
e.zh: 喂,你能悄悄把那支笔递给我吗?

e.en: {Psst}, the surprise party starts in five minutes.
e.zh: 嘘,惊喜派对五分钟后开始。

psv.t: n. 公共服务车辆；埃因霍温足球俱乐部

e.en: {PSV} Eindhoven defeated Ajax in the cup final.
e.zh: 埃因霍温在杯赛决赛中击败了阿贾克斯。

e.en: He has supported {PSV} since he was a child.
e.zh: 他从小就一直支持埃因霍温队。

psych.t:
v. 使紧张；做心理准备
n. 心理学（口语）

e.en: She tried to {psych} herself up before the big speech.
e.zh: 她在大演讲前努力给自己打气。

e.en: He's taking an intro {psych} class this semester.
e.zh: 他这学期在上心理学入门课。

e.en: The trauma left a deep mark on her {psyche}.
e.zh: 那次创伤在她的心灵上留下了深深的烙印。

e.en: Advertisers study the consumer {psyche} carefully.
e.zh: 广告商会仔细研究消费者的心理。

e.en: I'm so {psyched} about the concert tomorrow night!
e.zh: 我对明晚的演唱会超级兴奋!

e.en: She got {psyched} up before stepping onto the stage.
e.zh: 她在登台前给自己鼓足了劲。

psychedelia.t: n. 迷幻文化；迷幻艺术

e.en: The album cover captured the spirit of sixties {psychedelia}.
e.zh: 这张专辑封面捕捉了六十年代迷幻文化的精神。

e.en: His art studio was filled with vibrant {psychedelia}.
e.zh: 他的艺术工作室充满了鲜艳的迷幻风格作品。

e.en: The walls were painted in {psychedelic} swirling patterns.
e.zh: 墙上画着迷幻的漩涡图案。

e.en: Researchers are exploring {psychedelic} drugs for therapy.
e.zh: 研究人员正在探索迷幻药物用于治疗。

e.en: The therapist treats fragile {psyches} with great care.
e.zh: 治疗师非常细心地对待脆弱的心灵。

e.en: Wartime experiences shaped the {psyches} of a generation.
e.zh: 战时经历塑造了一代人的心灵。

psychiatric.t: adj. 精神病学的；精神科的

e.en: He was admitted to a {psychiatric} ward for evaluation.
e.zh: 他被送进精神科病房接受评估。

e.en: Many universities now offer better {psychiatric} support for students.
e.zh: 许多大学现在为学生提供更好的精神健康支持。

e.en: The patient was {psychiatrically} stable after weeks of treatment.
e.zh: 经过数周治疗,病人在精神状态上趋于稳定。

e.en: He was assessed {psychiatrically} before sentencing.
e.zh: 在量刑前他接受了精神科评估。

e.en: She sees a {psychiatrist} every other Tuesday.
e.zh: 她每隔一个周二去看一次精神科医生。

e.en: The {psychiatrist} prescribed a low dose of medication.
e.zh: 精神科医生开了低剂量的药物。

e.en: Several {psychiatrists} reviewed the defendant's mental state.
e.zh: 几位精神科医生评估了被告的精神状态。

e.en: {Psychiatrists} often work alongside therapists and social workers.
e.zh: 精神科医生常与心理治疗师和社工合作。

e.en: She specialized in child {psychiatry} after medical school.
e.zh: 她医学院毕业后专攻儿童精神病学。

e.en: Modern {psychiatry} relies on both medication and therapy.
e.zh: 现代精神病学依赖药物与心理治疗相结合。

psychic.t:
adj. 通灵的；精神的
n. 灵媒

e.en: She claims to have {psychic} abilities and reads minds.
e.zh: 她声称拥有通灵能力,可以读心。

e.en: The detective consulted a {psychic} as a last resort.
e.zh: 侦探最后无奈去求助一位通灵者。

e.en: He joined a society for {psychical} research in London.
e.zh: 他加入了伦敦一个心灵研究学会。

e.en: The book explores {psychical} phenomena from a skeptic's view.
e.zh: 这本书从怀疑论角度探讨灵异现象。

e.en: She felt {psychically} connected to her twin sister.
e.zh: 她感到与孪生姐妹之间有心灵感应般的联系。

e.en: He claimed to sense danger {psychically} before it happened.
e.zh: 他声称能在危险发生前以通灵方式感知到。

psycho.t:
n. 精神变态者
adj. 疯狂的

e.en: My ex-roommate went total {psycho} when I moved out.
e.zh: 我搬走时我的前室友彻底抓狂了。

e.en: Hitchcock's {Psycho} remains a classic horror film.
e.zh: 希区柯克的《惊魂记》至今仍是经典恐怖片。

psychoactive.t: adj. 影响精神状态的（药物等）

e.en: Caffeine is the world's most widely used {psychoactive} substance.
e.zh: 咖啡因是全世界使用最广泛的精神活性物质。

e.en: The plant contains a mild {psychoactive} compound.
e.zh: 这种植物含有一种温和的精神活性化合物。

e.en: Freud is widely regarded as the father of {psychoanalysis}.
e.zh: 弗洛伊德被广泛视为精神分析学之父。

e.en: She underwent {psychoanalysis} for several years to address childhood trauma.
e.zh: 她接受了几年精神分析以处理童年创伤。

e.en: Her {psychoanalyst} helped her uncover repressed memories.
e.zh: 她的精神分析师帮她揭开被压抑的记忆。

e.en: He trained as a {psychoanalyst} after finishing medical school.
e.zh: 他读完医学院后接受了精神分析师培训。

e.en: The book offers a {psychoanalytic} reading of Hamlet's behavior.
e.zh: 本书对哈姆雷特的行为做了精神分析式解读。

e.en: She uses a {psychoanalytic} approach with her long-term clients.
e.zh: 她对长期来访者采用精神分析的方法。

e.en: His essay applies {psychoanalytical} theory to modern film.
e.zh: 他的论文将精神分析理论应用于现代电影。

e.en: The therapist took a {psychoanalytical} stance during our sessions.
e.zh: 治疗师在咨询中采取了精神分析的立场。

e.en: Stop trying to {psychoanalyze} every comment your friends make.
e.zh: 别老想着对朋友的每句话都做心理分析。

e.en: Critics love to {psychoanalyze} the director's recurring themes.
e.zh: 评论家喜欢分析这位导演反复出现的主题心理。

psychobabble.t: n. 滥用心理学术语的空话

e.en: His self-help book is full of empty {psychobabble}.
e.zh: 他的自助书里充斥着空洞的心理学行话。

e.en: Cut the {psychobabble} and tell me what actually happened.
e.zh: 少说那些心理学术语,告诉我到底怎么了。

e.en: The therapist used {psychodrama} to help patients reenact difficult memories.
e.zh: 治疗师用心理剧帮患者重演痛苦的回忆。

e.en: Their family dinners often turn into a full-blown {psychodrama}.
e.zh: 他们的家庭聚餐常常演变成一场闹剧。

e.en: She practices {psychodynamic} therapy rooted in Freudian principles.
e.zh: 她从事以弗洛伊德理论为根基的心理动力学治疗。

e.en: The course covers both cognitive and {psychodynamic} approaches.
e.zh: 这门课涵盖认知和心理动力两种方法。

e.en: He studies the {psychodynamics} of small group conflict.
e.zh: 他研究小群体冲突中的心理动力机制。

e.en: Family {psychodynamics} can shape a child's personality for life.
e.zh: 家庭心理动力会终生塑造孩子的性格。

e.en: The clinic offers {psychoeducational} workshops for parents of teens.
e.zh: 诊所为青少年家长开设心理教育工作坊。

e.en: She received a full {psychoeducational} assessment before starting school.
e.zh: 她入学前接受了完整的心理教育评估。

psychogenic.t: adj. 心因性的（源于心理）

e.en: Doctors concluded the pain was {psychogenic} rather than physical.
e.zh: 医生认为疼痛是心因性的,而非生理性的。

e.en: He suffers from {psychogenic} seizures triggered by stress.
e.zh: 他患有由压力诱发的心因性癫痫发作。

e.en: The hospital opened a new {psychogeriatric} ward last month.
e.zh: 医院上月新开设了老年精神科病房。

e.en: She specializes in {psychogeriatric} care for dementia patients.
e.zh: 她专攻痴呆患者的老年精神病学护理。

e.en: The movie features a girl with the power of {psychokinesis}.
e.zh: 电影讲述一个拥有念力的女孩。

e.en: Scientists have found no convincing evidence for {psychokinesis}.
e.zh: 科学家未找到任何令人信服的念力证据。

e.en: The {psycholinguist} studies how children acquire grammar.
e.zh: 这位心理语言学家研究儿童如何习得语法。

e.en: She became a leading {psycholinguist} after her PhD at MIT.
e.zh: 她在麻省理工读完博士后成为顶尖心理语言学家。

e.en: The lab runs {psycholinguistic} experiments on word recognition.
e.zh: 实验室进行有关词汇识别的心理语言学实验。

e.en: His paper offers a {psycholinguistic} account of bilingual processing.
e.zh: 他的论文从心理语言学角度解释双语加工。

e.en: She teaches an introductory course on {psycholinguistics}.
e.zh: 她教授一门心理语言学入门课程。

e.en: {Psycholinguistics} examines how the brain processes language.
e.zh: 心理语言学研究大脑如何处理语言。

e.en: The injury caused both physical and {psychological} damage.
e.zh: 这次伤害造成了身体和心理上的双重创伤。

e.en: He wrote a gripping {psychological} thriller last year.
e.zh: 他去年写了一部扣人心弦的心理惊悚小说。

psychologically.t: adv. 心理上，从心理学角度

e.en: The long lockdown left many people {psychologically} exhausted.
e.zh: 漫长的封控让许多人在心理上筋疲力尽。

e.en: Athletes need to be {psychologically} prepared for big games.
e.zh: 运动员需要为大型比赛做好心理准备。

e.en: My {psychologist} helped me develop better coping strategies.
e.zh: 我的心理学家帮我培养了更好的应对策略。

e.en: She works as a child {psychologist} at a local clinic.
e.zh: 她在本地诊所担任儿童心理学家。

e.en: Many {psychologists} now use online sessions with their clients.
e.zh: 许多心理学家现在通过在线方式为来访者咨询。

e.en: {Psychologists} warn that constant scrolling harms attention spans.
e.zh: 心理学家警告,不停刷手机会损害注意力。

e.en: She majored in {psychology} before going to law school.
e.zh: 她在读法学院前主修心理学。

e.en: Marketers exploit consumer {psychology} to drive impulse buys.
e.zh: 营销人员利用消费者心理来刺激冲动购买。

e.en: Job applicants must complete a short {psychometric} test online.
e.zh: 应聘者须在线完成一个简短的心理测评。

e.en: The survey was validated using rigorous {psychometric} methods.
e.zh: 该问卷通过严格的心理测量方法进行了验证。

e.en: The new scale is {psychometrically} sound and easy to administer.
e.zh: 这套新量表心理测量学上可靠且易于施测。

e.en: Researchers want assessments that are {psychometrically} reliable across cultures.
e.zh: 研究者希望评估在跨文化上心理测量学可靠。

e.en: She specializes in {psychometrics} and test design.
e.zh: 她专攻心理测量学和测验设计。

e.en: Modern {psychometrics} relies heavily on statistical modeling.
e.zh: 现代心理测量学高度依赖统计建模。

e.en: {Psychoneuroimmunology} explores how stress affects the immune system.
e.zh: 心理神经免疫学研究压力如何影响免疫系统。

e.en: Her lab is a leading center for {psychoneuroimmunology} research.
e.zh: 她的实验室是心理神经免疫学研究的重要中心。

psychopath.t: n. 精神病态者，反社会人格者

e.en: The film depicts a charming but cold-blooded {psychopath}.
e.zh: 电影描绘了一个迷人却冷血的精神变态者。

e.en: Not every selfish person is actually a {psychopath}.
e.zh: 并不是每个自私的人都真的是精神变态者。

e.en: The killer showed clear {psychopathic} traits during the trial.
e.zh: 凶手在庭审中表现出明显的精神变态特征。

e.en: Researchers debate whether {psychopathic} tendencies are inherited.
e.zh: 研究者争论精神变态倾向是否会遗传。

e.en: The study identified several {psychopathological} symptoms in the group.
e.zh: 研究在该群体中发现了几种精神病理症状。

e.en: Her thesis focuses on the {psychopathological} effects of isolation.
e.zh: 她的论文聚焦于隔离造成的精神病理影响。

e.en: The textbook covers child and adolescent {psychopathology}.
e.zh: 这本教材涵盖儿童和青少年精神病理学。

e.en: Trauma can contribute to long-term {psychopathology} in adults.
e.zh: 创伤可能导致成年人长期的精神病理问题。

psychopathy.t: n. 精神病态（人格障碍）

e.en: Researchers use a checklist to measure levels of {psychopathy}.
e.zh: 研究人员用一份量表评估精神变态的程度。

e.en: {Psychopathy} is characterized by a lack of empathy and remorse.
e.zh: 精神变态的特征是缺乏共情和悔意。

e.en: The patient responded well to {psychopharmacological} treatment.
e.zh: 该患者对精神药理治疗反应良好。

e.en: Recent {psychopharmacological} advances have transformed depression care.
e.zh: 近年精神药理学的进展改变了抑郁症的治疗。

e.en: He teaches a graduate course on {psychopharmacology}.
e.zh: 他教授一门精神药理学的研究生课程。

e.en: Modern {psychopharmacology} relies on careful clinical trials.
e.zh: 现代精神药理学依赖严谨的临床试验。

e.en: The lab runs {psychophysical} experiments on visual perception.
e.zh: 实验室开展关于视觉感知的心理物理学实验。

e.en: Her thesis used a classic {psychophysical} method to measure thresholds.
e.zh: 她的论文用经典心理物理方法测量感知阈值。

e.en: Researchers measured {psychophysiological} responses like heart rate and sweating.
e.zh: 研究者测量了心率和出汗等心理生理反应。

e.en: The clinic offers {psychophysiological} assessments for anxiety patients.
e.zh: 诊所为焦虑患者提供心理生理评估。

e.en: Freud described several stages of {psychosexual} development.
e.zh: 弗洛伊德描述了若干性心理发展阶段。

e.en: The therapist specializes in {psychosexual} counseling for couples.
e.zh: 该治疗师专长于夫妻性心理咨询。

e.en: He was hospitalized after his first episode of {psychosis}.
e.zh: 他在首次精神病发作后被送入医院。

e.en: Lack of sleep can sometimes trigger temporary {psychosis}.
e.zh: 睡眠不足有时会引发短暂的精神错乱。

e.en: The program addresses the {psychosocial} needs of refugees.
e.zh: 该项目关注难民的社会心理需求。

e.en: Cancer patients often benefit from extra {psychosocial} support.
e.zh: 癌症患者通常能从额外的心理社会支持中受益。

psychosomatic.t: adj. 身心失调的，心身症的

e.en: The doctor suggested her headaches might be {psychosomatic}.
e.zh: 医生认为她的头痛可能是心身性的。

e.en: Stress can produce very real {psychosomatic} symptoms.
e.zh: 压力可以引发非常真实的心身症状。

e.en: The clinic offers various {psychotherapeutic} interventions for depression.
e.zh: 诊所为抑郁症提供多种心理治疗手段。

e.en: She trained in several {psychotherapeutic} techniques over the years.
e.zh: 多年来她接受了多种心理治疗技术的培训。

e.en: My {psychotherapist} encouraged me to journal between sessions.
e.zh: 我的心理治疗师鼓励我在咨询间隙写日记。

e.en: He sees a {psychotherapist} once a week after work.
e.zh: 他每周下班后去见一次心理治疗师。

e.en: She started weekly {psychotherapy} to manage her anxiety.
e.zh: 她开始每周接受心理治疗来缓解焦虑。

e.en: Online {psychotherapy} has become much more common since the pandemic.
e.zh: 疫情以来在线心理治疗变得普遍得多。

psychotic.t:
adj. 精神病的
n. 精神病患者

e.en: He had a {psychotic} episode and was taken to the ER.
e.zh: 他出现精神病发作,被送进了急诊室。

e.en: Certain drugs can trigger {psychotic} symptoms in vulnerable users.
e.zh: 某些药物可能在易感人群中引发精神病症状。

e.en: The villain laughs {psychotically} as the building burns.
e.zh: 反派在大楼燃烧时疯狂地大笑。

e.en: He drove {psychotically} fast through the empty streets.
e.zh: 他在空荡的街道上疯了一样地飞驰。

e.en: The doctor prescribed a low dose of a {psychotropic} medication.
e.zh: 医生开了小剂量的精神类药物。

e.en: Many countries strictly regulate {psychotropic} substances.
e.zh: 许多国家对精神药物实行严格管控。

e.en: She stirs a spoonful of {psyllium} husk into her morning smoothie.
e.zh: 她在早晨的果昔里加一勺洋车前子壳。

e.en: Doctors often recommend {psyllium} for improving digestive health.
e.zh: 医生常推荐洋车前子来改善肠道健康。

pta.t: n. 家长教师联合会（Parent-Teacher Association）

e.en: My mom volunteers at every {PTA} meeting at school.
e.zh: 我妈妈每次学校家长教师协会会议都去做志愿者。

e.en: The {PTA} raised funds for new playground equipment.
e.zh: 家长教师协会筹款购置了新的游乐设施。

ptarmigan.t: n. 雷鸟（一种雪地鸟类）

e.en: A white {ptarmigan} was barely visible against the snow.
e.zh: 一只白色的雷鸟在雪地里几乎看不见。

e.en: Hikers spotted a {ptarmigan} hiding among the rocks.
e.zh: 徒步者发现一只雷鸟藏在石头间。

e.en: She is preparing for the {PTE} exam to study in Australia.
e.zh: 她在准备PTE考试以便去澳大利亚留学。

e.en: He scored well on the {PTE} after just two months of practice.
e.zh: 他练习两个月就在PTE考试中拿到了高分。

pterodactyl.t: n. 翼手龙（史前飞行爬行动物）

e.en: Kids love the model {pterodactyl} hanging in the museum hall.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢博物馆大厅里悬挂的翼手龙模型。

e.en: A {pterodactyl} was not actually a dinosaur but a flying reptile.
e.zh: 翼手龙其实不是恐龙,而是一种会飞的爬行动物。

pterosaur.t: n. 翼龙（史前飞行爬行动物）

e.en: Paleontologists unearthed a giant {pterosaur} fossil in the desert.
e.zh: 古生物学家在沙漠中发掘出一具巨大的翼龙化石。

e.en: The {pterosaur} had a wingspan wider than a small plane.
e.zh: 那只翼龙的翼展比一架小飞机还宽。

ptfe.t: n. 聚四氟乙烯（特氟龙材料）

e.en: The pan has a {ptfe} coating to prevent sticking.
e.zh: 这只锅有特氟龙涂层，可以防粘。

e.en: Engineers use {ptfe} tape to seal pipe threads.
e.zh: 工程师用聚四氟乙烯胶带密封管螺纹。

ptolemaic.t: adj. 托勒密王朝的；地心说的

e.en: The {ptolemaic} model placed Earth at the universe's center.
e.zh: 托勒密体系把地球放在宇宙的中心。

e.en: Ancient Egypt's {ptolemaic} dynasty ended with Cleopatra's death.
e.zh: 古埃及的托勒密王朝随克利奥帕特拉之死而终结。

ptolemy.t: n. 托勒密（古希腊天文学家）

e.en: {Ptolemy} mapped the known world in the second century.
e.zh: 托勒密在公元二世纪绘制了当时已知的世界地图。

e.en: Astronomers studied {Ptolemy} long before Copernicus appeared.
e.zh: 天文学家早在哥白尼之前就研究托勒密的学说。

e.en: Hold the {ptt} button to talk on the radio.
e.zh: 按住对讲键才能在无线电上说话。

e.en: The walkie-talkie uses a side {ptt} key.
e.zh: 这款对讲机的发话键在侧面。

e.en: The company is registered as a {pty} ltd in Australia.
e.zh: 该公司在澳大利亚注册为私人有限公司。

e.en: Linux assigns each terminal session a {pty} device.
e.zh: Linux为每个终端会话分配一个伪终端设备。

e.en: We met friends at the local {pub} after work.
e.zh: 下班后我们在附近的酒吧和朋友见面。

e.en: The old {pub} serves traditional fish and chips.
e.zh: 那家老酒馆供应传统的炸鱼薯条。

e.en: He nervously plucked a stray {pube} from the towel.
e.zh: 他紧张地从毛巾上拈走一根阴毛。

e.en: Doctors say a single {pube} can carry bacteria.
e.zh: 医生说一根阴毛也可能携带细菌。

e.en: {Pubertal} changes can affect a teenager's mood and sleep.
e.zh: 青春期的变化会影响青少年的情绪和睡眠。

e.en: The clinic studies {pubertal} development in young athletes.
e.zh: 该诊所研究年轻运动员的青春期发育。

e.en: Most kids reach {puberty} between ages ten and fourteen.
e.zh: 大多数孩子在十到十四岁之间进入青春期。

e.en: Hormones surge dramatically during {puberty}.
e.zh: 青春期时荷尔蒙会大幅激增。

e.en: The doctor noted early signs of {pubescence} in the patient.
e.zh: 医生注意到这名病人有青春期早期的迹象。

e.en: Many plants have a soft {pubescence} on their leaves.
e.zh: 许多植物的叶面上有柔软的茸毛。

e.en: The novel follows a {pubescent} girl moving to a new town.
e.zh: 这本小说讲述一个青春期女孩搬到新城镇的故事。

e.en: The shrub has small {pubescent} leaves covered in fine hairs.
e.zh: 这种灌木的小叶上覆盖着细密的茸毛。

e.en: The X-ray showed a hairline fracture in the {pubic} bone.
e.zh: X光片显示耻骨上有一条细微骨裂。

e.en: Many adults trim their {pubic} hair for hygiene.
e.zh: 许多成年人为了卫生会修剪阴毛。

e.en: The {pubis} forms the front part of the pelvic bone.
e.zh: 耻骨构成骨盆的前部。

e.en: The cyclist landed hard and bruised his {pubis}.
e.zh: 那位骑手重重摔下，把耻骨摔伤了。

public.t:
adj. 公共的；公开的
n. 公众

e.en: The mayor made the report {public} on Friday morning.
e.zh: 市长在周五上午公开了这份报告。

e.en: Many cities offer free {public} Wi-Fi downtown.
e.zh: 许多城市在市中心提供免费的公共Wi-Fi。

publican.t: n. 酒馆老板；(古罗马) 收税人

e.en: The friendly {publican} remembered every regular's favorite drink.
e.zh: 那位热情的酒馆老板记得每位常客最爱的酒。

e.en: A new {publican} took over the village inn last spring.
e.zh: 去年春天有位新酒馆老板接手了村里的客栈。

e.en: The book's {publication} was delayed by six months.
e.zh: 这本书的出版被推迟了六个月。

e.en: She subscribes to a monthly travel {publication}.
e.zh: 她订阅了一份月刊旅行刊物。

e.en: Her research has appeared in many academic {publications}.
e.zh: 她的研究发表在许多学术刊物上。

e.en: The library archives old {publications} dating back a century.
e.zh: 图书馆收藏着可追溯到一个世纪前的旧刊物。

publicise.t: v. 宣传；公开（英式拼写）

e.en: The charity hired a firm to {publicise} the fundraiser.
e.zh: 该慈善机构请了公司来宣传这次筹款活动。

e.en: Activists used social media to {publicise} the protest.
e.zh: 活动人士利用社交媒体宣传这场抗议。

e.en: The studio heavily {publicised} the film before its release.
e.zh: 片厂在电影上映前大力宣传。

e.en: Her wedding was widely {publicised} in the tabloids.
e.zh: 她的婚礼在小报上被广泛报道。

publicises.t: v. publicise 的第三人称单数

e.en: The blog regularly {publicises} new restaurants in town.
e.zh: 这个博客经常宣传市里的新餐厅。

e.en: He {publicises} every product launch on his podcast.
e.zh: 他在自己的播客上宣传每一次产品发布。

e.en: The team is {publicising} their new app through influencers.
e.zh: 团队正通过网红来宣传他们的新应用。

e.en: She spent weeks {publicising} the upcoming charity concert.
e.zh: 她花了几周时间宣传即将举行的慈善音乐会。

e.en: Her {publicist} arranged interviews with three major magazines.
e.zh: 她的公关人员安排了三家主流杂志的采访。

e.en: A good {publicist} can turn a scandal into headlines.
e.zh: 好的公关能把丑闻变成头条新闻。

publicities.t: n. publicity 的复数形式（罕用）

e.en: The brand ran several {publicities} during the holiday season.
e.zh: 该品牌在假日季投放了多则宣传广告。

e.en: Different {publicities} target different age groups.
e.zh: 不同的宣传活动面向不同年龄层的人群。

e.en: The scandal generated a lot of unwanted {publicity}.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻带来了大量不想要的曝光。

e.en: The startup needs more {publicity} to attract investors.
e.zh: 这家初创公司需要更多曝光来吸引投资者。

e.en: They will {publicize} the event on every social platform.
e.zh: 他们会在每个社交平台上宣传这场活动。

e.en: The mayor wants to {publicize} the new bike lanes.
e.zh: 市长想宣传新建的自行车道。

e.en: The trial was widely {publicized} across cable news.
e.zh: 这场审判在有线电视新闻上被广泛报道。

e.en: She {publicized} her startup through podcast interviews.
e.zh: 她通过播客采访宣传了自己的创业公司。

publicizes.t: v. publicize 的第三人称单数

e.en: The school regularly {publicizes} student achievements online.
e.zh: 学校经常在网上宣传学生的成就。

e.en: He {publicizes} every gig on his Instagram story.
e.zh: 他在Instagram上宣传每一场演出。

e.en: The agency is {publicizing} the museum's new exhibit.
e.zh: 那家公关公司正在宣传博物馆的新展览。

e.en: She avoided {publicizing} her personal life on social media.
e.zh: 她避免在社交媒体上公开自己的私人生活。

e.en: The CEO {publicly} apologized for the data breach.
e.zh: 首席执行官公开为数据泄露事件道歉。

e.en: He rarely shares his political views {publicly}.
e.zh: 他很少公开分享自己的政治观点。

e.en: The {publicness} of the trial drew international attention.
e.zh: 庭审的公开性吸引了国际关注。

e.en: Social media has changed our sense of {publicness}.
e.zh: 社交媒体改变了我们对公共性的理解。

publics.t: n. public 的复数；各类受众

e.en: Different {publics} respond to advertising in different ways.
e.zh: 不同的公众群体对广告的反应各不相同。

e.en: Brands tailor messages for younger and older {publics}.
e.zh: 品牌会为年轻和年长的受众群体量身定制信息。

e.en: She plans to {publish} her novel next spring.
e.zh: 她计划明年春天出版自己的小说。

e.en: Bloggers can {publish} a post in just a few clicks.
e.zh: 博主只需点几下就能发布一篇文章。

publishable.t: adj. 可发表的；适合出版的

e.en: The editor said the draft wasn't quite {publishable} yet.
e.zh: 编辑说这份初稿还不够能出版的水平。

e.en: With revisions, the paper became fully {publishable}.
e.zh: 经过修改，这篇论文完全达到了发表水平。

e.en: The author has {published} five novels in ten years.
e.zh: 这位作家十年间出版了五部小说。

e.en: Her photo essay was {published} in a leading magazine.
e.zh: 她的图片故事发表在一本知名杂志上。

e.en: A small indie {publisher} took a chance on her debut book.
e.zh: 一家小型独立出版社接下了她的处女作。

e.en: The {publisher} sent the manuscript back for revisions.
e.zh: 出版社把书稿退回让她修改。

e.en: Major {publishers} are investing heavily in audiobooks.
e.zh: 各大出版商正大举投资有声书业务。

e.en: Several {publishers} bid for the rights to her memoir.
e.zh: 几家出版商竞标她回忆录的版权。

publishes.t: v. publish 的第三人称单数

e.en: The journal {publishes} new research every quarter.
e.zh: 该期刊每季度发表新的研究成果。

e.en: He {publishes} a weekly newsletter about tech trends.
e.zh: 他每周发布一份关于科技趋势的简报。

publishing.t:
n. 出版业
v. 正在发布

e.en: The {publishing} industry is shifting toward digital formats.
e.zh: 出版行业正在转向数字化格式。

e.en: She landed her first job in book {publishing} after college.
e.zh: 她大学毕业后在图书出版业找到了第一份工作。

e.en: The author's recent {publishings} have all been bestsellers.
e.zh: 这位作家最近出版的几本书都成了畅销书。

e.en: He archives all his digital {publishings} in one folder.
e.zh: 他把自己所有数字出版物都存在一个文件夹里。

e.en: London's old {pubs} are full of history and character.
e.zh: 伦敦的老酒馆充满了历史与韵味。

e.en: They visited three {pubs} along the river last night.
e.zh: 他们昨晚沿河逛了三家酒吧。

puccini.t: n. 普契尼（意大利作曲家）

e.en: The opera house is staging {Puccini}'s La Bohème this season.
e.zh: 这家歌剧院本季将上演普契尼的《波西米亚人》。

e.en: Her favorite aria comes from a {Puccini} opera.
e.zh: 她最爱的咏叹调出自普契尼的一部歌剧。

puce.t:
n. 暗红褐色
adj. 暗褐色的

e.en: She painted the front door a dusty {puce} color.
e.zh: 她把前门刷成了一种暗淡的褐紫色。

e.en: The vintage sofa was upholstered in faded {puce} velvet.
e.zh: 那张旧沙发包着褪色的褐紫色天鹅绒。

e.en: The goalie blocked the {puck} with his glove.
e.zh: 守门员用手套挡住了冰球。

e.en: She slid the {puck} across the ice to her teammate.
e.zh: 她把冰球沿着冰面滑给了队友。

pucker.t:
v. 皱起；使起褶
n. 皱褶

e.en: Sour candy can make your lips {pucker} instantly.
e.zh: 酸糖会让嘴唇瞬间皱起来。

e.en: A small {pucker} formed in the seam of her dress.
e.zh: 她裙子的接缝处出现了一个小褶皱。

e.en: The toddler {puckered} his lips for a goodnight kiss.
e.zh: 小孩噘起嘴唇要一个晚安吻。

e.en: The fabric {puckered} after going through the dryer.
e.zh: 这块布料在烘干机里转过后皱了起来。

puckering.t: v. pucker 的现在分词；起皱中

e.en: She kept {puckering} her lips while applying lipstick.
e.zh: 她一边涂口红一边不停地噘嘴。

e.en: Cheap stitching causes the seams to start {puckering}.
e.zh: 劣质的缝线会让接缝开始起皱。

e.en: Unripe persimmons taste really {puckery} on the tongue.
e.zh: 未熟的柿子在舌头上尝起来非常涩。

e.en: The wine was young and a bit {puckery}.
e.zh: 这款酒还很新，喝起来有点涩口。

e.en: He gave her a {puckish} grin before pulling the prank.
e.zh: 他在恶作剧前对她露出顽皮的笑容。

e.en: Her {puckish} sense of humor made everyone laugh.
e.zh: 她那调皮的幽默感让大家都笑了起来。

pud.t: n. 布丁（pudding 的口语缩写）

e.en: Mum always serves a hot {pud} after Sunday lunch.
e.zh: 妈妈总会在周日午餐后端上一份热布丁。

e.en: What's for {pud} tonight, chocolate cake or ice cream?
e.zh: 今晚的甜点是什么，巧克力蛋糕还是冰淇淋？

e.en: She made a creamy chocolate {pudding} for dessert.
e.zh: 她做了一份顺滑的巧克力布丁当甜点。

e.en: Yorkshire {pudding} pairs perfectly with roast beef.
e.zh: 约克郡布丁配烤牛肉再合适不过。

e.en: She baked three Christmas {puddings} for the family dinner.
e.zh: 她为家庭聚餐烤了三个圣诞布丁。

e.en: The café sells warm sticky toffee {puddings} every evening.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆每晚都卖热腾腾的太妃糖布丁。

e.en: The toddler jumped into a muddy {puddle} and laughed.
e.zh: 小孩跳进泥水坑里哈哈大笑。

e.en: A {puddle} of coffee spread across the kitchen floor.
e.zh: 一摊咖啡在厨房地板上漫开。

puddled.t:
adj. 积了水的
v. 弄成水洼（过去式）

e.en: Rainwater {puddled} on the uneven sidewalk after the storm.
e.zh: 暴雨过后,雨水积在凹凸不平的人行道上。

e.en: Wax had {puddled} around the base of the candle.
e.zh: 蜡油已经在蜡烛底部积成一摊。

e.en: He grabbed the {pudge} around his waist and frowned.
e.zh: 他捏着腰间的赘肉皱起了眉头。

e.en: A bit of {pudge} on the baby's cheeks looked adorable.
e.zh: 婴儿脸颊上那点肉嘟嘟的样子非常可爱。

e.en: The baby reached out with {pudgy} little fingers.
e.zh: 婴儿伸出胖乎乎的小手指。

e.en: He felt self-conscious about his {pudgy} stomach at the beach.
e.zh: 在海滩上他对自己圆鼓鼓的肚子感到不好意思。

pudsey.t: adj. 胖乎乎的（英式口语）

e.en: Children donated coins to a {pudsey} bear collection box.
e.zh: 孩子们把硬币投进了一只普西熊募捐箱。

e.en: The charity event featured the famous {pudsey} mascot.
e.zh: 这场慈善活动出现了著名的普西熊吉祥物。

pueblo.t: n. 印第安人村落（美国西南部）

e.en: We toured an ancient {pueblo} carved into the cliffs.
e.zh: 我们参观了一座凿在悬崖上的古老印第安村落。

e.en: The {pueblo} community gathers each summer for traditional dances.
e.zh: 那个普韦布洛社区每年夏天都聚在一起跳传统舞蹈。

e.en: His {puerile} jokes annoyed everyone in the meeting.
e.zh: 他幼稚的玩笑惹恼了会议上的每个人。

e.en: The film's humor felt {puerile} and unfunny to adults.
e.zh: 这部电影的幽默对成年人来说显得幼稚又乏味。

puerto.t: n. 港口（西语，多用于地名如 Puerto Rico）

e.en: We flew to {puerto} Rico for a beach vacation.
e.zh: 我们飞往波多黎各度海滩假期。

e.en: The cruise ship docked at a small Mexican {puerto}.
e.zh: 游轮停靠在墨西哥的一个小港口。

puff.t:
n. 一阵（气、烟）
v. 喷气，喘气

e.en: She blew a {puff} of air onto her hot tea.
e.zh: 她朝热茶吹了一口气。

e.en: The chef served a cream {puff} dusted with sugar.
e.zh: 厨师端上了一个撒着糖粉的奶油泡芙。

e.en: We found a giant {puffball} mushroom growing in the meadow.
e.zh: 我们在草地上发现了一个巨大的马勃菌。

e.en: Her hairstyle looked like a fluffy {puffball} after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后她的发型看起来像个蓬松的绒球。

puffed.t: adj. 膨胀的，气喘吁吁的

e.en: The runner {puffed} heavily as he climbed the hill.
e.zh: 那个跑者爬坡时气喘吁吁。

e.en: She {puffed} out her cheeks to make the kids laugh.
e.zh: 她鼓起腮帮子逗孩子们笑。

e.en: He bought a warm {puffer} jacket for winter hikes.
e.zh: 他买了件保暖的羽绒服用于冬季徒步。

e.en: A {puffer} fish inflated itself when the diver approached.
e.zh: 潜水员靠近时,一条河豚把自己鼓了起来。

e.en: The ad was full of {puffery} and empty promises.
e.zh: 那则广告满是夸大其词和空洞承诺。

e.en: Investors saw through the CEO's marketing {puffery}.
e.zh: 投资者看穿了首席执行官的营销吹嘘。

e.en: A colorful {puffin} perched on the cliff above the sea.
e.zh: 一只色彩斑斓的海雀停在海上的悬崖上。

e.en: Tourists photographed the {puffin} colony on the Icelandic island.
e.zh: 游客们拍下了冰岛小岛上的海雀群。

e.en: Cold compresses can reduce {puffiness} under your eyes.
e.zh: 冷敷可以减轻眼下的浮肿。

e.en: The {puffiness} in her ankles worried the doctor.
e.zh: 她脚踝的肿胀让医生很担心。

e.en: The old steam train came {puffing} into the station.
e.zh: 那列老蒸汽火车喷着汽驶进了车站。

e.en: He arrived at the top of the stairs {puffing} hard.
e.zh: 他气喘吁吁地爬到了楼梯顶端。

e.en: Her eyes looked {puffy} after a night of crying.
e.zh: 哭了一夜之后她的眼睛肿肿的。

e.en: Big {puffy} clouds drifted across the summer sky.
e.zh: 大朵蓬松的云在夏日天空中飘过。

e.en: Her {pug} snores louder than her husband does.
e.zh: 她的哈巴狗打呼噜比她老公还响。

e.en: The {pug} waddled happily across the living room.
e.zh: 那只哈巴狗摇摇摆摆地穿过客厅。

pugh.t: int. 呸（表示轻蔑或厌恶）

e.en: "{pugh}!" he exclaimed, smelling the rotten cheese.
e.zh: “呸!”他闻到腐烂的奶酪叫了出来。

e.en: She muttered "{pugh}" and turned away from the trash.
e.zh: 她嘟囔了一声“呸”就转身离开了垃圾桶。

e.en: He studied the history of {pugilism} for his thesis.
e.zh: 他为论文研究了拳击运动的历史。

e.en: Old-school {pugilism} required bare knuckles and raw courage.
e.zh: 老派拳击讲究赤手空拳和真正的胆量。

e.en: The retired {pugilist} now trains young boxers in Brooklyn.
e.zh: 这位退役拳击手如今在布鲁克林训练年轻拳手。

e.en: He had the broken nose of a seasoned {pugilist}.
e.zh: 他有一只老练拳击手般的塌鼻梁。

e.en: The senator took a {pugilistic} stance during the debate.
e.zh: 这位参议员在辩论中摆出咄咄逼人的姿态。

e.en: His {pugilistic} style made every meeting feel like combat.
e.zh: 他好斗的作风让每次开会都像打仗。

e.en: Tourists admired the Gothic interiors designed by {pugin}.
e.zh: 游客们欣赏着普金设计的哥特式室内装饰。

e.en: The cathedral's altar shows clear {pugin} influence.
e.zh: 这座大教堂的祭坛明显受到普金风格的影响。

e.en: The {pugnacious} reporter asked tough questions all afternoon.
e.zh: 那位好斗的记者整个下午都在尖锐发问。

e.en: His {pugnacious} attitude made teamwork nearly impossible.
e.zh: 他爱挑衅的态度让团队合作几乎无法进行。

e.en: She {pugnaciously} defended her client during cross-examination.
e.zh: 在交叉询问中她寸步不让地为当事人辩护。

e.en: The candidate {pugnaciously} attacked every rival on stage.
e.zh: 那位候选人在台上咄咄逼人地攻击每个对手。

e.en: His natural {pugnacity} served him well as a litigator.
e.zh: 他天生的好斗性格让他在诉讼律师工作中如鱼得水。

e.en: The team admired her {pugnacity} during contract negotiations.
e.zh: 团队很欣赏她在合同谈判中的好斗劲头。

e.en: Scientists gathered at a {pugwash} conference to discuss disarmament.
e.zh: 科学家们齐聚帕格沃什会议讨论裁军问题。

e.en: Captain {pugwash} sailed across screens of British children's television.
e.zh: 普格沃什船长驶过了英国儿童电视屏幕。

puissance.t: n. 力量，权势；马术跳高赛

e.en: The horse cleared the {puissance} wall to thunderous applause.
e.zh: 那匹马跃过了高墙障碍,赢得雷鸣般的掌声。

e.en: Her speech demonstrated the {puissance} of careful rhetoric.
e.zh: 她的演讲展现了精心修辞的力量。

e.en: The novel features a {puissant} sorceress who rules the kingdom.
e.zh: 这部小说讲述了一位统治王国的强大女巫师。

e.en: He wielded {puissant} influence over the company's board.
e.zh: 他对公司董事会有着强大的影响力。

puja.t: n. 普迦（印度教礼拜仪式）

e.en: The family performs a {puja} every morning before breakfast.
e.zh: 这家人每天早餐前都会做一次礼拜。

e.en: Devotees offered flowers during the temple {puja}.
e.zh: 信徒们在寺庙礼拜仪式上献花。

puke.t:
v. 呕吐
n. 呕吐物

e.en: The smell alone made him want to {puke}.
e.zh: 光是那股味道就让他想吐。

e.en: My toddler had a stomach bug and started to {puke}.
e.zh: 我家宝宝得了肠胃炎,开始呕吐起来。

pukka.t: adj. 地道的，正宗的（英式口语）

e.en: That curry house serves a {pukka} chicken tikka masala.
e.zh: 那家咖喱店做的咖喱鸡正宗得很。

e.en: He always wears a {pukka} suit to client meetings.
e.zh: 他见客户时总穿一身正经的西装。

pula.t: n. 普拉（博茨瓦纳货币单位）

e.en: She exchanged dollars for {pula} at the Botswana airport.
e.zh: 她在博茨瓦纳机场把美元换成了普拉。

e.en: A coffee in Gaborone costs about fifteen {pula}.
e.zh: 在哈博罗内一杯咖啡大约十五普拉。

e.en: The poem celebrated the {pulchritude} of the Tuscan countryside.
e.zh: 这首诗赞颂了托斯卡纳乡村的秀美。

e.en: Her quiet {pulchritude} captivated everyone at the gallery.
e.zh: 她那份恬静的美让画廊里的每个人都为之倾倒。

e.en: The journalist won a {pulitzer} for her investigative reporting.
e.zh: 这位记者凭借调查报道赢得了普利策奖。

e.en: His debut novel was nominated for a {pulitzer} prize.
e.zh: 他的处女作小说获得了普利策奖提名。

pull.t:
v. 拉，拖
n. 拉力，吸引力

e.en: Please {pull} the door firmly to close it.
e.zh: 请用力拉门把它关上。

e.en: The new feature has serious {pull} with younger users.
e.zh: 这项新功能对年轻用户很有吸引力。

pullback.t: n. 回撤，撤退（金融、军事）

e.en: The market saw a sharp {pullback} after yesterday's rally.
e.zh: 市场在昨天的上涨后出现了大幅回调。

e.en: Generals ordered a tactical {pullback} from the front line.
e.zh: 将军们下令从前线进行战术撤退。

pulled.t: v. 拉（过去式）；adj. 撕碎的（肉）

e.en: He {pulled} a muscle while lifting the heavy box.
e.zh: 他搬重箱子时拉伤了一块肌肉。

e.en: She {pulled} the curtains shut against the morning sun.
e.zh: 她拉上窗帘挡住晨光。

e.en: This new mascara is a real lash {puller}.
e.zh: 这款新睫毛膏真的很拉睫毛。

e.en: The mechanic used a bearing {puller} to remove the part.
e.zh: 机修工用拔轮器把零件拆了下来。

e.en: The young {pullet} laid her first egg this morning.
e.zh: 那只小母鸡今早下了第一枚蛋。

e.en: Farmers separate each {pullet} from the older hens.
e.zh: 农民们把每只小母鸡和老母鸡分开养。

e.en: The workers used a {pulley} to lift the piano.
e.zh: 工人们用滑轮把钢琴吊了上去。

e.en: A broken {pulley} caused the elevator to stall.
e.zh: 一个坏掉的滑轮导致电梯停了下来。

e.en: The truck stopped at a roadside {pullin} for the night.
e.zh: 那辆卡车在路边停车场过夜。

e.en: Drivers can rest at the next highway {pullin}.
e.zh: 司机们可以在下一个高速路休息区休息。

pulling.t:
v. 拉（进行时）
n. 拉动

e.en: The dog kept {pulling} on the leash during the walk.
e.zh: 散步时那只狗一直拽着牵引绳。

e.en: She's {pulling} long hours to finish the project.
e.zh: 她为完成这个项目正长时间加班。

pullman.t: n. 普尔曼式豪华卧铺车厢

e.en: They booked a {pullman} car for the overnight train trip.
e.zh: 他们为这趟夜间火车旅行订了一节卧铺车厢。

e.en: The hotel's classic {pullman} suite features vintage furniture.
e.zh: 这家酒店的经典普尔曼套房配有复古家具。

pullout.t: n. 撤离，撤军；可抽出的插页

e.en: The magazine included a glossy {pullout} poster of the band.
e.zh: 那本杂志附赠了一张该乐队的精美抽页海报。

e.en: Officials announced a complete {pullout} of troops by December.
e.zh: 官员们宣布部队将于十二月前全部撤出。

e.en: She knit a wool {pullover} for her grandson's birthday.
e.zh: 她为孙子的生日织了一件羊毛套头衫。

e.en: He grabbed a cozy {pullover} before heading outside.
e.zh: 出门前他抓起一件舒适的套头衫。

e.en: The shop sells cashmere {pullovers} at a steep discount.
e.zh: 那家店正在大幅打折出售羊绒套头衫。

e.en: She packed two warm {pullovers} for the mountain trip.
e.zh: 她为这次山区旅行收拾了两件保暖套头衫。

pulls.t:
v. 拉；拖
n. 拉力；吸引力

e.en: The repository {pulls} new commits every five minutes.
e.zh: 该代码库每五分钟拉取一次新的提交。

e.en: He {pulls} on his coat and heads for the door.
e.zh: 他套上外套径直走向门口。

pullulate.t: v. 迅速繁殖；大量涌现

e.en: Bacteria {pullulate} rapidly in warm, moist environments.
e.zh: 细菌在温暖潮湿的环境中迅速繁殖。

e.en: Tourists {pullulate} in the old town every summer evening.
e.zh: 每个夏夜,游客都在老城区里熙熙攘攘。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed a serious {pulmonary} infection in his lungs.
e.zh: 医生诊断他患有严重的肺部感染。

e.en: Smoking greatly increases the risk of {pulmonary} disease.
e.zh: 吸烟会大大增加患肺病的风险。

e.en: The {pulmonologist} reviewed her chest scan before prescribing treatment.
e.zh: 肺科医生在开处方前查看了她的胸部扫描。

e.en: My grandfather sees a {pulmonologist} every three months.
e.zh: 我祖父每三个月看一次肺科医生。

pulp.t:
n. 果肉；纸浆
v. 捣成浆

e.en: She likes orange juice with extra {pulp} in it.
e.zh: 她喜欢果肉多一点的橙汁。

e.en: The factory turns wood chips into paper {pulp}.
e.zh: 工厂把木屑加工成纸浆。

e.en: The pastor spoke calmly from the {pulpit} on Sunday.
e.zh: 牧师周日在讲坛上平静地讲道。

e.en: A carved wooden {pulpit} stood at the front of the chapel.
e.zh: 小教堂前方矗立着一座雕花木讲坛。

pulpwood.t: n. 纸浆木；造纸用木材

e.en: Trucks hauled {pulpwood} from the forest to the paper mill.
e.zh: 卡车把纸浆木从森林运到造纸厂。

e.en: Pine trees are commonly grown for {pulpwood} production.
e.zh: 松树常被种植用于生产纸浆木。

e.en: The mango was overripe and slightly {pulpy} inside.
e.zh: 那只芒果熟过头了,里面有点软烂。

e.en: He prefers {pulpy} orange juice over the smooth kind.
e.zh: 他更喜欢带果肉的橙汁,而不是清澈的那种。

e.en: Astronomers detected radio signals from a distant {pulsar}.
e.zh: 天文学家探测到来自遥远脉冲星的无线电信号。

e.en: A {pulsar} rotates rapidly and emits beams of radiation.
e.zh: 脉冲星高速自转并发射出辐射束。

e.en: Engineers calculated the {pulsatance} of the oscillating circuit.
e.zh: 工程师计算了振荡电路的角频率。

e.en: The signal's {pulsatance} determines how fast its phase changes.
e.zh: 信号的角频率决定其相位变化的快慢。

pulsate.t: v. 搏动；跳动；有节奏地震动

e.en: The neon lights {pulsate} in time with the music.
e.zh: 霓虹灯随着音乐有节奏地闪动。

e.en: You could feel the wound {pulsate} with each heartbeat.
e.zh: 伤口随着每次心跳一阵阵地搏动。

e.en: Doctors monitored the {pulsatile} flow of blood through the artery.
e.zh: 医生监测着动脉中血液的脉动血流。

e.en: The device delivers medication using a {pulsatile} pump.
e.zh: 该设备使用脉动泵输送药物。

e.en: A {pulsating} headache made it hard to focus at work.
e.zh: 一阵阵搏动的头痛让她在工作时难以集中精神。

e.en: The club was filled with {pulsating} bass and flashing lights.
e.zh: 夜店里充满了震动的低音和闪烁的灯光。

e.en: The nurse felt a faint {pulsation} at the patient's wrist.
e.zh: 护士在病人手腕处感到微弱的脉动。

e.en: Sensors recorded each {pulsation} of the engine's vibration.
e.zh: 传感器记录下引擎振动的每一次脉冲。

pulse.t:
n. 脉搏；脉冲
v. 跳动

e.en: The nurse checked his {pulse} before starting the IV.
e.zh: 护士在开始输液前检查了他的脉搏。

e.en: Lentils and chickpeas are a healthy {pulse} to add to soups.
e.zh: 扁豆和鹰嘴豆是适合加入汤里的健康豆类。

pulsed.t:
adj. 脉冲的
v. 跳动（过去式）

e.en: Her heart {pulsed} faster as she opened the results.
e.zh: 她打开结果时心跳加快了。

e.en: The lab uses a {pulsed} laser to cut delicate materials.
e.zh: 实验室使用脉冲激光切割精密材料。

e.en: The machine sends short electrical {pulses} into the muscle.
e.zh: 这台机器向肌肉发送短促的电脉冲。

e.en: Indian cuisine uses many kinds of {pulses} in daily cooking.
e.zh: 印度菜在日常烹饪中使用多种豆类。

pulsing.t:
v. 跳动；脉动
adj. 搏动的

e.en: A {pulsing} red light warned drivers of road work ahead.
e.zh: 一盏闪烁的红灯提醒司机前方有道路施工。

e.en: She felt blood {pulsing} in her temples after the run.
e.zh: 跑步后她感到血液在太阳穴里搏动。

pulverise.t: v. 粉碎；碾成粉（英式拼写）

e.en: Use the blender to {pulverise} the almonds into fine powder.
e.zh: 用搅拌机把杏仁打成细粉。

e.en: The storm threatened to {pulverise} the small fishing village.
e.zh: 风暴有可能将这个小渔村彻底摧毁。

e.en: The chef {pulverised} the spices in a stone mortar.
e.zh: 厨师在石臼里把香料磨成粉。

e.en: The earthquake {pulverised} several old brick buildings downtown.
e.zh: 地震将市中心几座老砖楼夷为平地。

e.en: Industrial mills can {pulverize} rock into fine dust.
e.zh: 工业磨机可以把岩石粉碎成细粉。

e.en: The team came back to {pulverize} their rivals in the final.
e.zh: 球队卷土重来,在决赛中横扫对手。

e.en: The recipe calls for finely {pulverized} dried mushrooms.
e.zh: 这道菜的配方需要磨得很细的干蘑菇粉。

e.en: Heavy machinery {pulverized} the concrete from the demolished bridge.
e.zh: 重型机械把拆下的桥梁混凝土碾成了碎渣。

e.en: A {puma} was spotted prowling near the hiking trail.
e.zh: 有人在徒步小径附近看到一只美洲狮在游荡。

e.en: The {puma} can leap surprisingly high to catch prey.
e.zh: 美洲狮能跳得惊人地高来捕捉猎物。

e.en: She used a {pumice} stone to smooth her heels.
e.zh: 她用浮石搓光脚后跟。

e.en: Volcanic eruptions often produce large amounts of {pumice}.
e.zh: 火山喷发常常产生大量浮岩。

e.en: Heavy rain began to {pummel} the windshield as we drove.
e.zh: 我们开车时大雨开始猛烈地敲打挡风玻璃。

e.en: Critics continued to {pummel} the company over the data leak.
e.zh: 评论人士因数据泄露事件持续猛烈抨击该公司。

e.en: Waves {pummeled} the small boat throughout the night.
e.zh: 海浪整夜猛烈地拍打着那条小船。

e.en: The stock was {pummeled} after the disappointing earnings report.
e.zh: 令人失望的财报公布后,该股票遭到重挫。

e.en: The boxer kept {pummeling} his opponent against the ropes.
e.zh: 拳击手把对手逼到绳边,不断地猛揍。

e.en: Tech stocks took a {pummeling} during yesterday's sell-off.
e.zh: 科技股在昨天的抛售中遭受重创。

pump.t:
n. 泵
v. 抽水；打气

e.en: You'll need to {pump} the tires before the bike ride.
e.zh: 骑车之前你得先给车胎打气。

e.en: The water {pump} broke and flooded the basement.
e.zh: 水泵坏了,把地下室淹了。

pumped.t:
adj. 兴奋的；亢奋的
v. 抽取（过去式）

e.en: She {pumped} her fist when the team finally scored.
e.zh: 球队终于进球时她兴奋地挥拳庆祝。

e.en: The kids are {pumped} about the trip to Disneyland.
e.zh: 孩子们对去迪士尼乐园的旅行兴奋极了。

e.en: The fire {pumper} arrived first and connected to the hydrant.
e.zh: 消防泵车最先赶到并接上消防栓。

e.en: He works as a gas {pumper} at a rural service station.
e.zh: 他在乡下的加油站当加油员。

e.en: I ordered a sandwich on dark {pumpernickel} bread.
e.zh: 我点了一份用黑麦粗面包做的三明治。

e.en: The bakery is famous for its dense German {pumpernickel}.
e.zh: 这家面包店以其紧实的德国黑麦面包闻名。

e.en: My heart was {pumping} as I walked onto the stage.
e.zh: 我走上舞台时心跳怦怦直跳。

e.en: They spent the morning {pumping} water out of the basement.
e.zh: 他们花了一上午把地下室的水抽出来。

e.en: We carved a scary face into the {pumpkin} for Halloween.
e.zh: 我们在南瓜上刻了一张吓人的脸过万圣节。

e.en: She baked a {pumpkin} pie for the family dinner.
e.zh: 她为家庭聚餐烤了一个南瓜派。

e.en: The farm sells fresh {pumpkins} every October weekend.
e.zh: 这家农场每年十月的周末都卖新鲜南瓜。

e.en: Kids picked tiny {pumpkins} from the patch to take home.
e.zh: 孩子们从南瓜地里挑了几个小南瓜带回家。

pumps.t: n. 泵（复数）；浅口高跟鞋

e.en: She wore black leather {pumps} to the job interview.
e.zh: 她穿了一双黑色皮高跟鞋去面试。

e.en: The factory uses several large {pumps} to circulate cooling water.
e.zh: 这家工厂用几台大泵来循环冷却水。

pun.t:
n. 双关语
v. 用双关语

e.en: His dad jokes always end with a terrible {pun}.
e.zh: 他的冷笑话总是以一个糟糕的双关语结尾。

e.en: The headline used a clever {pun} on the candidate's name.
e.zh: 那条新闻标题用候选人的名字玩了个巧妙的双关。

punch.t:
v. 拳打；打孔
n. 一拳；冲击力

e.en: He threw a quick {punch} that knocked his rival down.
e.zh: 他迅速一拳把对手打倒在地。

e.en: The fruit {punch} at the party was way too sweet.
e.zh: 派对上的水果潘趣酒太甜了。

e.en: A crystal {punchbowl} sat at the center of the buffet table.
e.zh: 自助餐桌中央摆着一只水晶潘趣酒钵。

e.en: Guests gathered around the {punchbowl} after the toast.
e.zh: 祝酒过后,客人们都围到潘趣酒钵旁边。

punchcard.t: n. 打孔卡（早期计算机存储介质）

e.en: Early computers were programmed using stacks of {punchcard} sheets.
e.zh: 早期的计算机是用一叠叠打孔卡片来编程的。

e.en: The cafe gives a free coffee after a full {punchcard}.
e.zh: 这家咖啡店集满一张积分卡就送一杯免费咖啡。

e.en: He angrily {punched} the wall and bruised his knuckles.
e.zh: 他愤怒地一拳打在墙上,把指关节都擦伤了。

e.en: The conductor {punched} my ticket as the train left the station.
e.zh: 火车驶离车站时,列车员在我车票上打了孔。

e.en: The young boxer is a heavy {puncher} with knockout power.
e.zh: 这位年轻拳手出拳很重,有一击制胜的实力。

e.en: He used a hole {puncher} to bind the report together.
e.zh: 他用打孔器把报告装订在一起。

punches.t: n./v. 拳打；打孔（复数/三单）

e.en: The fighter landed several solid {punches} in the third round.
e.zh: 那名拳手在第三回合打出了几记实在的重拳。

e.en: Her presentation really {punches} above its weight.
e.zh: 她的演讲表现得远远超出预期。

e.en: He spent an hour {punching} the heavy bag at the gym.
e.zh: 他在健身房对着沙袋打了一个小时。

e.en: Stop {punching} the elevator button — it won't come faster.
e.zh: 别再猛按电梯按钮了,它不会因此来得更快。

e.en: He forgot the {punchline} halfway through telling the joke.
e.zh: 他讲笑话讲到一半,忘了笑点。

e.en: The whole story builds up to a surprising {punchline}.
e.zh: 整个故事都在为一个意想不到的笑点做铺垫。

punchy.t: adj. 有冲击力的；简洁有力的

e.en: The ad had a short, {punchy} slogan that everyone remembered.
e.zh: 那则广告有一句简短有力的口号,人人都记得住。

e.en: Try to keep your headlines {punchy} and clear.
e.zh: 尽量让你的标题简洁有力又清楚。

punctilious.t: adj. 一丝不苟的；拘泥细节的

e.en: She is {punctilious} about returning every email the same day.
e.zh: 她对当天回复每一封邮件这件事一丝不苟。

e.en: The accountant was {punctilious} in checking every receipt.
e.zh: 那位会计在核对每一张收据时极其严谨。

e.en: My new colleague is always {punctual} for our morning meetings.
e.zh: 我的新同事开晨会总是准时到。

e.en: Being {punctual} shows respect for other people's time.
e.zh: 守时是对他人时间的一种尊重。

e.en: The teacher praised the various {punctualities} of her students this term.
e.zh: 老师称赞了这学期学生们各方面的守时表现。

e.en: The report compared train {punctualities} across European cities.
e.zh: 这份报告比较了欧洲各城市火车的准点率。

e.en: Japanese trains are famous for their incredible {punctuality}.
e.zh: 日本的火车以惊人的准点率而闻名。

e.en: Her boss values {punctuality} more than almost anything else.
e.zh: 她的老板几乎把守时看得比什么都重要。

e.en: The meeting started {punctually} at nine in the morning.
e.zh: 会议在早上九点准时开始。

e.en: He always pays his rent {punctually} on the first.
e.zh: 他每月一号都准时付房租。

punctuate.t:
v. 加标点
v. 不时打断

e.en: Loud cheers {punctuate} the speaker's points throughout the rally.
e.zh: 集会期间,响亮的欢呼声不时打断演讲者的话。

e.en: Remember to {punctuate} your sentences correctly in the essay.
e.zh: 记得在作文里正确使用标点符号。

e.en: Good {punctuation} makes your writing much easier to read.
e.zh: 好的标点符号能让你的文章更容易阅读。

e.en: The teacher marked every {punctuation} mistake in red ink.
e.zh: 老师用红墨水把每一个标点错误都标了出来。

e.en: Check your essay for missing {punctuations} before submitting.
e.zh: 提交前检查一下你文章里漏掉的标点符号。

e.en: Different languages use different {punctuations} in writing.
e.zh: 不同语言书写时使用不同的标点符号。

puncture.t:
v. 刺穿；扎破
n. 穿孔；漏气

e.en: A nail caused a slow {puncture} in my front tire.
e.zh: 一颗钉子让我的前胎慢慢漏气了。

e.en: The nurse warned me the {puncture} might sting briefly.
e.zh: 护士提醒我针刺时可能会有点疼。

punctured.t: v. 被刺破；被戳穿（过去式）

e.en: The cat {punctured} the inflatable mattress with its claws.
e.zh: 那只猫用爪子把充气床垫戳破了。

e.en: His confident remark {punctured} the tense silence in the room.
e.zh: 他自信的一句话打破了房间里紧张的沉默。

e.en: A political {pundit} predicted a close election outcome.
e.zh: 一位政治评论员预测选举结果会很接近。

e.en: Every tech {pundit} has an opinion on the new chip.
e.zh: 每位科技评论员都对这款新芯片有自己的看法。

punditry.t: n. 权威评论；专家言论

e.en: Cable news is full of empty political {punditry} these days.
e.zh: 如今有线新闻里充斥着空洞的政治评论。

e.en: Sports {punditry} rarely predicts the actual game results accurately.
e.zh: 体育评论很少能准确预测真实的比赛结果。

e.en: The {pungency} of the garlic filled the entire kitchen.
e.zh: 大蒜的刺鼻气味弥漫了整个厨房。

e.en: I love the sharp {pungency} of fresh wasabi.
e.zh: 我喜欢新鲜山葵那股冲鼻的辣味。

e.en: The cheese had a {pungent} smell that filled the fridge.
e.zh: 那块奶酪散发出充满整个冰箱的刺鼻气味。

e.en: She wrote a {pungent} review criticizing the film's lazy plot.
e.zh: 她写了一篇尖锐的影评,批评电影情节懒散。

e.en: The curry smelled {pungently} of cumin and fresh ginger.
e.zh: 那道咖喱浓郁地散发着孜然和鲜姜的香气。

e.en: He {pungently} criticized the company's handling of the data leak.
e.zh: 他尖锐地批评了公司对数据泄露的处理方式。

e.en: We studied the {Punic} Wars between Rome and Carthage in class.
e.zh: 我们在课上学习了罗马与迦太基之间的布匿战争。

e.en: Archaeologists uncovered a {Punic} temple buried near the coast.
e.zh: 考古学家在海岸附近发掘出一座布匿神庙。

e.en: Teachers shouldn't {punish} students for asking honest questions.
e.zh: 老师不该因为学生提出真诚的问题而惩罚他们。

e.en: The new law will {punish} companies that leak user data.
e.zh: 新法律会处罚那些泄露用户数据的公司。

e.en: Driving without a license is {punishable} by a heavy fine.
e.zh: 无证驾驶可处以高额罚款。

e.en: Cheating on the exam is {punishable} by immediate expulsion.
e.zh: 考试作弊将被立即开除处分。

e.en: The coach {punished} the team with extra laps after practice.
e.zh: 教练在训练后罚全队多跑了几圈。

e.en: Investors {punished} the stock for its weak earnings report.
e.zh: 投资者因为糟糕的财报抛售了这只股票。

e.en: In the comic, the {Punisher} hunts criminals through the night.
e.zh: 在漫画里,惩罚者整夜追捕罪犯。

e.en: That hill on the route is a real {punisher} for cyclists.
e.zh: 路线上那座山坡对骑行者来说真是折磨。

punishes.t: v. 惩罚（第三人称单数）

e.en: The algorithm {punishes} accounts that post spam links repeatedly.
e.zh: 该算法会惩罚反复发布垃圾链接的账号。

e.en: This game {punishes} players who rush in without strategy.
e.zh: 这款游戏会惩罚那些不讲策略乱冲的玩家。

punishing.t:
adj. 使人精疲力竭的
v. 正在惩罚

e.en: She kept a {punishing} schedule of twelve-hour workdays.
e.zh: 她保持着每天工作十二小时的折磨般日程。

e.en: The marathon route was {punishing} under the summer sun.
e.zh: 马拉松路线在夏日烈阳下令人难以忍受。

e.en: His {punishment} for cheating was a week of detention.
e.zh: 他作弊的惩罚是被留校察看一周。

e.en: Many countries have abolished capital {punishment} entirely.
e.zh: 许多国家已完全废除了死刑。

e.en: The school reviewed its list of {punishments} for late arrivals.
e.zh: 学校重新审视了对迟到学生的处罚清单。

e.en: Harsh {punishments} rarely change criminal behavior in the long run.
e.zh: 严厉的惩罚长期来看很少能改变犯罪行为。

e.en: The court awarded {punitive} damages against the negligent company.
e.zh: 法院判决该疏忽的公司支付惩罚性赔偿。

e.en: Critics called the new tariffs {punitive} rather than protective.
e.zh: 批评者称新关税具有惩罚性,而非保护性。

e.en: The agency acted {punitively} against firms that ignored the warnings.
e.zh: 该机构对无视警告的公司采取了惩罚性措施。

e.en: Some parents react {punitively} when their child makes mistakes.
e.zh: 一些家长在孩子犯错时会以惩罚的方式回应。

e.en: My grandparents were born in a small village in {Punjab}.
e.zh: 我的祖父母出生在旁遮普的一个小村庄。

e.en: {Punjab} is famous for its wheat fields and vibrant festivals.
e.zh: 旁遮普以麦田和热闹的节日而闻名。

punjabi.t:
n. 旁遮普人；旁遮普语
adj. 旁遮普的

e.en: She speaks fluent {Punjabi} with her grandmother every weekend.
e.zh: 她每周末都和奶奶用流利的旁遮普语聊天。

e.en: We had homemade {Punjabi} food at the wedding reception.
e.zh: 我们在婚宴上吃到了家常的旁遮普菜。

punk.t:
n. 朋克（音乐风格）
adj. 朋克风的

e.en: He still listens to old-school {punk} bands from the eighties.
e.zh: 他仍然听着八十年代的老派朋克乐队。

e.en: Her jacket and pink hair give off a strong {punk} vibe.
e.zh: 她的夹克和粉发散发出浓厚的朋克气息。

e.en: A few {punks} were skating outside the abandoned mall.
e.zh: 几个朋克少年在废弃商场外玩滑板。

e.en: The {punks} in the front row sang along to every song.
e.zh: 前排那群朋克跟着每一首歌一起合唱。

e.en: She paired the suit with a {punky} leather choker.
e.zh: 她给那套西装搭配了一条朋克风的皮项圈。

e.en: The cafe has a {punky} atmosphere with graffiti-covered walls.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆墙上满是涂鸦,氛围很朋克。

e.en: I bought a {punnet} of strawberries at the farmers market.
e.zh: 我在农夫市集买了一小盒草莓。

e.en: She finished the whole {punnet} of blueberries in one sitting.
e.zh: 她一口气把整盒蓝莓吃完了。

punning.t:
n. 使用双关语
v. 说双关语

e.en: His {punning} jokes made the entire dinner table groan.
e.zh: 他那些双关语笑话让整桌人都忍不住翻白眼。

e.en: The headline used clever {punning} to grab readers' attention.
e.zh: 那个标题用巧妙的双关语吸引了读者注意。

punt.t:
v. 弃踢（橄榄球）
v. 暂缓决定

e.en: The quarterback decided to {punt} on fourth down.
e.zh: 四档进攻时四分卫选择了弃踢。

e.en: Let's {punt} that decision until next week's meeting.
e.zh: 我们把这个决定推迟到下周的会议再说吧。

punta.t: n. 海角（地名用，西班牙语）

e.en: We watched the sunset from {Punta} del Este last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们在埃斯特角看了日落。

e.en: Locals dance {punta} at every wedding along the Honduran coast.
e.zh: 在洪都拉斯沿岸的婚礼上,当地人都会跳蓬塔舞。

e.en: The {punter} kicked the ball deep into the opponent's territory.
e.zh: 弃踢手把球踢到了对手腹地深处。

e.en: Every {punter} at the racecourse hoped to pick the winner.
e.zh: 赛马场上每位下注者都希望能选中冠军。

punting.t:
v. 撑篙行船
v. 弃踢

e.en: We spent a sunny afternoon {punting} along the Cambridge river.
e.zh: 我们在阳光下花了一个下午在剑桥河上撑船。

e.en: The team is {punting} the launch date to next quarter.
e.zh: 团队把发布日期推迟到了下个季度。

puny.t: adj. 弱小的；微不足道的

e.en: His {puny} arms could barely lift the heavy box.
e.zh: 他那纤弱的手臂几乎抬不动那个重箱子。

e.en: The raise was a {puny} amount compared to inflation.
e.zh: 相比通货膨胀,这次涨薪简直微不足道。

e.en: The {pup} chewed on my slipper while I was working.
e.zh: 我在工作的时候,小狗把我的拖鞋啃坏了。

e.en: A seal {pup} rested on the rocks near the shore.
e.zh: 一只海豹幼崽在岸边的礁石上休息。

e.en: The caterpillar transformed into a {pupa} hanging beneath the leaf.
e.zh: 毛毛虫在叶子下面变成了一个蛹。

e.en: Inside the {pupa}, the insect undergoes complete metamorphosis.
e.zh: 在蛹内,昆虫经历着完全变态发育。

e.en: We collected several {pupae} for our biology class observation.
e.zh: 我们收集了好几个蛹用于生物课观察。

e.en: The fish tank water was full of mosquito {pupae}.
e.zh: 鱼缸里的水中满是蚊子的蛹。

e.en: The butterfly remains motionless during its long {pupal} stage.
e.zh: 蝴蝶在漫长的蛹期内一动不动。

e.en: Scientists studied genetic changes during the insect's {pupal} phase.
e.zh: 科学家研究了昆虫蛹期内发生的基因变化。

e.en: The caterpillars will {pupate} once they finish eating the leaves.
e.zh: 毛毛虫吃完叶子后就会化蛹。

e.en: Most moth larvae {pupate} hidden underground or beneath bark.
e.zh: 大多数蛾类幼虫会藏在地下或树皮下化蛹。

e.en: The desert {pupfish} survives in remarkably hot, salty springs.
e.zh: 沙漠鳉鱼能在异常炎热咸涩的泉水中生存。

e.en: Conservationists are working hard to protect endangered {pupfish} populations.
e.zh: 环保人士正努力保护濒危的鳉鱼种群。

pupil.t:
n. 小学生
n. 瞳孔

e.en: Every {pupil} in the class submitted their homework on time.
e.zh: 班上每个学生都按时交了作业。

e.en: The doctor checked whether her {pupil} responded to light.
e.zh: 医生检查了她的瞳孔是否对光有反应。

pupils.t:
n. 学生（复数）
n. 瞳孔

e.en: The school has about three hundred {pupils} this year.
e.zh: 这所学校今年大约有三百名学生。

e.en: His {pupils} dilated when he stepped into the dark room.
e.zh: 他走进黑暗房间时,瞳孔放大了。

e.en: The child laughed as the {puppet} danced across the stage.
e.zh: 孩子看着木偶在舞台上跳舞,笑个不停。

e.en: Critics accused the new prime minister of being a {puppet}.
e.zh: 批评者指责新任首相只是个傀儡。

e.en: The {puppeteer} skillfully made the dragon breathe imaginary fire.
e.zh: 那位木偶师巧妙地让龙喷出虚拟的火焰。

e.en: She trained for years to become a professional {puppeteer}.
e.zh: 她训练了多年才成为一名专业木偶师。

puppetry.t: n. 木偶艺术；木偶表演

e.en: Traditional Chinese {puppetry} has been performed for over a thousand years.
e.zh: 中国传统木偶戏已经传承了一千多年。

e.en: The film uses stunning shadow {puppetry} to tell its story.
e.zh: 这部电影用惊艳的皮影戏来讲述故事。

e.en: The shelter has six {puppies} ready for adoption this weekend.
e.zh: 这家收容所本周末有六只小狗等待领养。

e.en: My dog gave birth to four healthy {puppies} last night.
e.zh: 我家狗昨晚生下了四只健康的小狗。

e.en: Our new {puppy} chewed every shoe in the hallway.
e.zh: 我们的新小狗把走廊里的鞋全啃了个遍。

e.en: She posted a video of her {puppy} learning to sit.
e.zh: 她发了一段她家小狗学坐下的视频。

pur.t: v. 发呼噜声（purr 的变体）

e.en: My cat began to {pur} loudly the moment I sat down.
e.zh: 我一坐下,我的猫就开始大声地咕噜咕噜叫。

e.en: The kitten curled up and started to {pur} contentedly.
e.zh: 小猫蜷成一团,满足地咕噜起来。

e.en: He was {purblind} to the obvious flaws in his plan.
e.zh: 他对自己计划中明显的缺陷视而不见。

e.en: The aging dog grew {purblind} but still found his way home.
e.zh: 那只老狗几乎瞎了,却仍能找到回家的路。

purchase.t:
v. 购买
n. 购买；购得之物

e.en: You can {purchase} the ebook directly from our website.
e.zh: 你可以直接在我们的网站上购买这本电子书。

e.en: My boots couldn't get any {purchase} on the icy slope.
e.zh: 我的靴子在结冰的斜坡上完全抓不住地面。

purchased.t: v. 购买（过去式/过去分词）

e.en: She {purchased} a used laptop for her online classes.
e.zh: 她为上网课买了一台二手笔记本电脑。

e.en: The company {purchased} a smaller startup last quarter.
e.zh: 该公司在上个季度收购了一家较小的初创企业。

e.en: The {purchaser} must sign the contract before delivery is arranged.
e.zh: 买方必须在安排发货前签署合同。

e.en: As the original {purchaser}, you qualify for a free repair.
e.zh: 作为原购买者,你有资格享受免费维修。

purchases.t:
n. 购买的物品
v. 购买（第三人称单数）

e.en: All online {purchases} include free returns within thirty days.
e.zh: 所有线上购物都享有三十天内免费退货。

e.en: He {purchases} fresh vegetables at the market every Saturday.
e.zh: 他每周六都在市场上采购新鲜蔬菜。

purchasing.t:
n. 采购
v. 购买（现在分词）

e.en: The company is {purchasing} new laptops for the entire team.
e.zh: 公司正在为整个团队采购新笔记本电脑。

e.en: He works in the {purchasing} department of a large retailer.
e.zh: 他在一家大型零售商的采购部门工作。

purdah.t: n. (印度/伊斯兰)女性隔离制度

e.en: The candidates remained in {purdah} until the election results were announced.
e.zh: 候选人在选举结果公布前一直保持沉默。

e.en: In some traditional households, women observed strict {purdah}.
e.zh: 在一些传统家庭中,女性遵守严格的深闺制度。

pure.t: adj. 纯的，纯粹的；纯洁的

e.en: This bottle contains 100% {pure} olive oil.
e.zh: 这瓶装的是百分之百的纯橄榄油。

e.en: Meeting her at the airport was {pure} luck.
e.zh: 在机场遇到她纯属运气。

purebred.t:
adj. 纯种的
n. 纯种动物

e.en: She bought a {purebred} Labrador from a licensed breeder.
e.zh: 她从持证繁育者那里买了一只纯种拉布拉多。

e.en: The farm specializes in raising {purebred} Arabian horses.
e.zh: 这家农场专门饲养纯种阿拉伯马。

pured.t: v. puree 的过去式；打成泥状

e.en: The chef {pured} the tomatoes into a smooth sauce.
e.zh: 厨师把番茄打成顺滑的酱汁。

e.en: She {pured} the soup until no lumps remained.
e.zh: 她把汤打成泥,直到没有任何颗粒。

puree.t:
n. 果蔬泥
v. 打成泥状

e.en: Add a spoonful of tomato {puree} to the simmering pasta sauce.
e.zh: 在炖煮的意面酱中加一勺番茄泥。

e.en: Babies often start solids with simple vegetable {puree}.
e.zh: 宝宝添加辅食通常从简单的蔬菜泥开始。

e.en: This meeting is {purely} informational, not a decision point.
e.zh: 这次会议纯属信息分享,不做决定。

e.en: He plays guitar {purely} for fun on weekends.
e.zh: 他周末弹吉他纯粹是为了好玩。

purest.t: adj. 最纯的（pure 的最高级）

e.en: The lab uses the {purest} water available for these experiments.
e.zh: 实验室在这些实验中使用最纯净的水。

e.en: Watching her dance was the {purest} joy I've felt all year.
e.zh: 看她跳舞是我今年感受到的最纯粹的快乐。

e.en: The ritual was meant to provide spiritual {purgation} for the participants.
e.zh: 这场仪式旨在为参与者提供精神上的净化。

e.en: Ancient medicine often relied on {purgation} to treat illness.
e.zh: 古代医学常依靠泻法来治疗疾病。

purgative.t:
n. 泻药
adj. 通便的

e.en: The doctor warned against using {purgative} herbs without supervision.
e.zh: 医生警告不要在无监督下使用泻药草本。

e.en: Writing about the trauma had a {purgative} effect on her.
e.zh: 写下那段创伤经历对她产生了宣泄的作用。

e.en: The long layover felt almost {purgatorial} after the red-eye flight.
e.zh: 红眼航班之后漫长的转机感觉像是煎熬。

e.en: He described the waiting room as a {purgatorial} space.
e.zh: 他把候诊室形容为一个像炼狱般的地方。

e.en: Sitting through that three-hour meeting was sheer {purgatory}.
e.zh: 熬过那场三小时的会议简直就是受罪。

e.en: In Catholic tradition, souls are cleansed in {purgatory} before heaven.
e.zh: 在天主教传统中,灵魂在升天前要在炼狱中净化。

purge.t:
v. 清除，清洗
n. 清洗，肃清

e.en: Click this button to {purge} all cached files from the system.
e.zh: 点击此按钮可清除系统中所有的缓存文件。

e.en: The new CEO began to {purge} the company of underperformers.
e.zh: 新任首席执行官开始清除公司中表现不佳的员工。

purged.t: v. 清除（过去式/过去分词）

e.en: The administrator {purged} thousands of inactive accounts last night.
e.zh: 管理员昨晚清理了数千个不活跃的账户。

e.en: She {purged} her closet of clothes she hadn't worn in years.
e.zh: 她把多年没穿的衣服从衣柜里清理出去。

purging.t:
n. 清除
v. 清除（现在分词）

e.en: The server is {purging} old logs to free up disk space.
e.zh: 服务器正在清除旧日志以释放磁盘空间。

e.en: He spent the weekend {purging} years of clutter from his garage.
e.zh: 他花了一个周末清理车库里多年的杂物。

e.en: We had hot {puri} with spicy potato curry for breakfast.
e.zh: 我们早餐吃了热乎的炸饼配辣味土豆咖喱。

e.en: The street vendor fried fresh {puri} right in front of us.
e.zh: 街边小贩就在我们面前现炸印度炸饼。

e.en: The plant uses reverse osmosis for water {purification}.
e.zh: 该工厂使用反渗透技术进行水净化。

e.en: Many cultures have rituals of spiritual {purification} before major events.
e.zh: 许多文化在重大活动前都有精神净化的仪式。

purified.t:
adj. 提纯的
v. 净化（过去式）

e.en: The bottle is filled with {purified} drinking water.
e.zh: 瓶子里装的是净化后的饮用水。

e.en: Engineers {purified} the silicon to nearly perfect crystalline form.
e.zh: 工程师将硅提纯到近乎完美的晶体形态。

e.en: I bought an air {purifier} to help with my allergies.
e.zh: 我买了一台空气净化器来缓解过敏。

e.en: The water {purifier} needs a new filter every six months.
e.zh: 这台净水器每六个月需要更换一次滤芯。

purifies.t: v. 净化（第三人称单数）

e.en: This filter {purifies} tap water in just thirty seconds.
e.zh: 这个滤芯只需三十秒就能净化自来水。

e.en: Sunlight naturally {purifies} the air on your balcony plants.
e.zh: 阳光自然地净化阳台植物周围的空气。

e.en: You can boil water to {purify} it during a camping trip.
e.zh: 露营时可以通过煮沸来净化水。

e.en: Meditation helps some people {purify} their thoughts each morning.
e.zh: 冥想帮助一些人每天早上净化思绪。

purifying.t:
v. 净化（现在分词）
adj. 净化的

e.en: This face mask has a {purifying} clay that draws out impurities.
e.zh: 这款面膜含有清洁泥土,能吸出毛孔杂质。

e.en: The factory is {purifying} the wastewater before releasing it.
e.zh: 工厂在排放废水之前正在对其进行净化。

e.en: People with gout should avoid foods high in {purine}.
e.zh: 痛风患者应避免食用嘌呤含量高的食物。

e.en: DNA contains two {purine} bases: adenine and guanine.
e.zh: DNA中含有两种嘌呤碱基:腺嘌呤和鸟嘌呤。

e.en: His linguistic {purism} makes him reject any new slang.
e.zh: 他在语言上的纯粹主义使他排斥任何新俚语。

e.en: Architectural {purism} dominated the early modernist movement.
e.zh: 建筑上的纯粹主义主导了早期现代主义运动。

e.en: As a coffee {purist}, he refuses to add sugar or milk.
e.zh: 作为一名咖啡纯粹主义者,他拒绝加糖或牛奶。

e.en: Film {purist} fans hated the colorized version of the classic.
e.zh: 电影纯粹派粉丝讨厌这部经典作品的彩色版本。

puritan.t:
n. 清教徒
adj. 清教徒式的

e.en: His {puritan} upbringing made him uneasy about parties.
e.zh: 他清教徒式的成长背景让他对派对感到不安。

e.en: The {puritan} settlers built simple wooden meeting houses.
e.zh: 清教徒移民建造了简朴的木制聚会所。

puritanical.t: adj. 清教徒式的，拘谨的

e.en: Her {puritanical} attitude toward dating annoyed her younger sister.
e.zh: 她对约会的清教徒式态度让妹妹很反感。

e.en: The school had {puritanical} rules about dress and behavior.
e.zh: 这所学校在着装和行为方面有清教徒式的严格规定。

puritanism.t: n. 清教主义；严苛的道德观

e.en: American {puritanism} still influences modern attitudes toward work.
e.zh: 美国的清教主义至今仍影响着现代人对工作的态度。

e.en: He criticized the {puritanism} of his small hometown.
e.zh: 他批评家乡小镇的清教徒式作风。

e.en: The lab tests samples of varying chemical {purities}.
e.zh: 实验室测试不同化学纯度的样品。

e.en: Different gold {purities} are marked with karat numbers.
e.zh: 不同的黄金纯度用克拉数标记。

e.en: The diamond's value depends on its clarity and {purity}.
e.zh: 钻石的价值取决于它的净度和纯度。

e.en: She admired the {purity} of the freshly fallen snow.
e.zh: 她欣赏那刚落下的雪的纯净。

purl.t:
n. 反针
v. 织反针；潺潺流

e.en: Knit two stitches, then {purl} two for the ribbed pattern.
e.zh: 织两针下针,再织两针上针,形成罗纹花样。

e.en: She listened to the {purl} of the small stream nearby.
e.zh: 她聆听着附近小溪潺潺的水声。

e.en: He commutes from {Purley} into central London every weekday.
e.zh: 他每个工作日从珀利通勤到伦敦市中心。

e.en: They bought a small house in {Purley} last summer.
e.zh: 他们去年夏天在珀利买了一栋小房子。

e.en: The cafe sits in the quiet {purlieu} of the old town.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆坐落在老城区幽静的近郊。

e.en: Hikers explored the wooded {purlieu} beyond the village.
e.zh: 徒步者探索了村外林木茂密的边缘地带。

e.en: The carpenter checked each {purlin} supporting the roof rafters.
e.zh: 木匠检查了每根支撑屋椽的檩条。

e.en: A rotting {purlin} caused the barn roof to sag.
e.zh: 一根腐朽的檩条导致谷仓屋顶下垂。

e.en: He tried to {purloin} a few cookies from the kitchen counter.
e.zh: 他想从厨房台面上偷几块饼干。

e.en: Hackers attempted to {purloin} customer data from the server.
e.zh: 黑客试图从服务器上窃取客户数据。

purloined.t: v. 窃取（过去式/过去分词）

e.en: The thief had {purloined} a rare painting from the gallery.
e.zh: 小偷从画廊偷走了一幅稀有画作。

e.en: She {purloined} her brother's hoodie and never gave it back.
e.zh: 她偷拿了弟弟的连帽衫,再也没还回去。

purple.t:
n. 紫色
adj. 紫色的

e.en: She painted her bedroom walls a soft shade of {purple}.
e.zh: 她把卧室的墙壁刷成了柔和的紫色。

e.en: The sunset turned the sky a deep {purple} over the lake.
e.zh: 日落把湖面上空染成了深紫色。

e.en: The artist used several {purples} to capture the twilight sky.
e.zh: 画家用了好几种紫色来描绘暮色的天空。

e.en: This palette contains warm reds and rich {purples}.
e.zh: 这套调色板里有暖红色和浓郁的紫色调。

e.en: A {purplish} bruise had formed around his ankle.
e.zh: 他脚踝周围形成了一块泛紫的瘀青。

e.en: The grapes had a {purplish} hue when ripe.
e.zh: 葡萄成熟时呈现出泛紫的色泽。

purport.t:
v. 声称，据称
n. 主旨，要义

e.en: These emails {purport} to be from your bank, but they're scams.
e.zh: 这些邮件声称来自你的银行,但其实是诈骗。

e.en: I couldn't grasp the full {purport} of his long speech.
e.zh: 我没能完全理解他那篇长篇演讲的主旨。

e.en: The {purported} leak turned out to be completely fabricated.
e.zh: 所谓的泄露内容结果完全是捏造的。

e.en: Police are investigating the {purported} cyberattack on the agency.
e.zh: 警方正在调查针对该机构的所谓网络攻击。

e.en: The startup is {purportedly} working on a flying car prototype.
e.zh: 据称这家初创公司正在研发飞行汽车原型。

e.en: He {purportedly} sold his stake before the company collapsed.
e.zh: 据说他在公司倒闭前出售了自己的股份。

purpose.t:
n. 目的，用途
v. 打算

e.en: What's the main {purpose} of this app's notification system?
e.zh: 这款应用通知系统的主要用途是什么?

e.en: After retiring, she struggled to find a sense of {purpose}.
e.zh: 退休后,她难以找到生活的意义。

e.en: She walked toward the stage with {purposeful} strides.
e.zh: 她迈着坚定的步伐走向舞台。

e.en: His lessons feel {purposeful} rather than just filling time.
e.zh: 他的课让人觉得有意义,而不只是消磨时间。

e.en: The designer chose each color {purposefully} to evoke calm.
e.zh: 设计师有意选择每种颜色来营造平静感。

e.en: He walked {purposefully} past the security desk without stopping.
e.zh: 他目的明确地从保安台旁走过,没有停下。

e.en: Her quiet {purposefulness} inspired the whole team.
e.zh: 她那份沉静的目的感激励了整个团队。

e.en: The project moved forward with surprising {purposefulness}.
e.zh: 这个项目以令人惊讶的目标性向前推进。

purposeless.t: adj. 漫无目的的；没有意义的

e.en: He felt {purposeless} after losing his job of twenty years.
e.zh: 丢掉做了二十年的工作后,他感到失去了人生方向。

e.en: The meeting felt long, repetitive, and largely {purposeless}.
e.zh: 这次会议冗长、重复,基本上毫无意义。

e.en: The retiree battled feelings of {purposelessness} during the pandemic.
e.zh: 那位退休人员在疫情期间与无目标感作斗争。

e.en: The novel explores the {purposelessness} of modern office life.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了现代办公室生活的虚无感。

e.en: I {purposely} arrived early to find a good seat.
e.zh: 我故意提早到,以便找个好位子。

e.en: She {purposely} left her phone at home during vacation.
e.zh: 她度假时故意把手机留在了家里。

purposes.t: n. 目的；用途（purpose 复数）

e.en: This data is collected for analytics {purposes} only.
e.zh: 这些数据仅出于分析目的而收集。

e.en: The app serves multiple {purposes}, from messaging to file sharing.
e.zh: 这款应用有多种用途,从消息收发到文件共享。

purposive.t: adj. 有目的的；有意图的

e.en: The study took a {purposive} sample of frequent app users.
e.zh: 该研究采用了对常用App用户的目的性抽样。

e.en: Her movements were calm, deliberate, and clearly {purposive}.
e.zh: 她的动作冷静、从容,显然有明确目的。

e.en: The essay explores the {purposiveness} of human evolution.
e.zh: 这篇文章探讨了人类进化的目的性。

e.en: Critics doubted the {purposiveness} of the new policy.
e.zh: 评论者怀疑新政策是否具有明确目的。

e.en: The doctor noticed small {purpura} on the patient's legs.
e.zh: 医生注意到病人腿上有小片紫癜。

e.en: Low platelet counts can cause {purpura} under the skin.
e.zh: 血小板偏低可能导致皮下紫癜。

purr.t:
v. (猫) 发出呼噜声
n. 呼噜声

e.en: The cat began to {purr} the moment I sat down.
e.zh: 我一坐下,猫就开始呼噜呼噜叫。

e.en: The new engine has a smooth, satisfying {purr}.
e.zh: 这台新引擎发出平稳悦耳的轰鸣声。

purring.t:
n. 呼噜声
adj. 发出呼噜声的

e.en: The kitten fell asleep {purring} on my lap.
e.zh: 小猫在我腿上呼噜着睡着了。

e.en: After the tune-up, the car is {purring} like new.
e.zh: 调校之后,这辆车跑得像新的一样平顺。

purse.t:
n. 钱包；手袋
v. 噘起（嘴唇）

e.en: She pulled a card out of her {purse} to pay.
e.zh: 她从钱包里掏出一张卡来付账。

e.en: The winner took home a {purse} of fifty thousand dollars.
e.zh: 冠军将五万美元奖金收入囊中。

pursed.t: v. 噘起（嘴唇）（purse 过去式）

e.en: She {pursed} her lips and shook her head silently.
e.zh: 她抿紧嘴唇,默默地摇了摇头。

e.en: He {pursed} his mouth, clearly unhappy with the answer.
e.zh: 他撅起嘴,显然对这个回答不满。

purser.t: n. （船、飞机的）事务长；乘务长

e.en: The {purser} announced that boarding would begin shortly.
e.zh: 乘务长宣布很快就要开始登机。

e.en: Ask the {purser} if you need to change cabins.
e.zh: 如果需要换舱位,请咨询事务长。

purses.t:
n. 钱包（复数）
v. 噘嘴

e.en: The shop sells designer {purses} at outlet prices.
e.zh: 这家店以折扣价出售名牌手提包。

e.en: She always {purses} her lips when she's thinking hard.
e.zh: 她认真思考时总会抿起嘴唇。

e.en: Wild {purslane} grows between the cracks in the sidewalk.
e.zh: 野生马齿苋在人行道的缝隙间生长。

e.en: The salad was tossed with lemon and fresh {purslane}.
e.zh: 沙拉中拌入了柠檬和新鲜的马齿苋。

e.en: The order was issued in {pursuance} of the new law.
e.zh: 该命令是依照新法律发布的。

e.en: In {pursuance} of his goal, he studied every night.
e.zh: 为实现目标,他每晚都坚持学习。

e.en: {Pursuant} to the contract, payment is due in thirty days.
e.zh: 根据合同规定,款项应在三十天内付清。

e.en: The data was collected {pursuant} to a court order.
e.zh: 这些数据是依据法院命令收集的。

e.en: She decided to {pursue} a career in software engineering.
e.zh: 她决定追求软件工程方面的职业发展。

e.en: Police continued to {pursue} the suspect through the alley.
e.zh: 警察继续在小巷里追捕嫌疑人。

pursued.t: v. 追求；追赶（pursue 过去式）

e.en: He {pursued} his master's degree while working full-time.
e.zh: 他一边全职工作一边攻读硕士学位。

e.en: The journalist {pursued} the story for over a year.
e.zh: 那位记者追踪这则报道超过一年。

e.en: The thief glanced back at his {pursuer} and ran faster.
e.zh: 小偷回头看了一眼追赶者,跑得更快了。

e.en: She lost her {pursuer} by ducking into a side street.
e.zh: 她钻进一条小巷,甩掉了追她的人。

pursues.t: v. 追求（pursue 第三人称单数）

e.en: He {pursues} every lead with relentless energy.
e.zh: 他以不懈的精力追查每一条线索。

e.en: The company {pursues} aggressive growth in overseas markets.
e.zh: 该公司在海外市场积极寻求扩张。

pursuing.t: v. 追求；从事（pursue 进行式）

e.en: She is {pursuing} a PhD in machine learning.
e.zh: 她正在攻读机器学习方向的博士学位。

e.en: The detective is {pursuing} several promising leads.
e.zh: 侦探正在追查几条颇有希望的线索。

e.en: She moved abroad in {pursuit} of better opportunities.
e.zh: 她为了寻求更好的机会而搬到了国外。

e.en: The high-speed {pursuit} ended on the freeway.
e.zh: 那场高速追逐最终在高速公路上结束。

pursuits.t: n. 追求；消遣活动（复数）

e.en: He spends weekends on creative {pursuits} like painting.
e.zh: 他周末会从事画画之类的创意活动。

e.en: Her academic {pursuits} took her to three continents.
e.zh: 她的学术追求把她带到了三大洲。

e.en: The wound was red and oozing {purulent} fluid.
e.zh: 伤口又红又渗出脓液。

e.en: A {purulent} infection requires immediate antibiotic treatment.
e.zh: 化脓性感染需要立即使用抗生素治疗。

e.en: The shop {purvey} fresh seafood to local restaurants.
e.zh: 这家店向本地餐厅供应新鲜海鲜。

e.en: Tabloids often {purvey} rumors as if they were facts.
e.zh: 小报常常把谣言当作事实来传播。

e.en: The bakery is a well-known {purveyor} of artisan bread.
e.zh: 这家面包房是有名的手工面包供应商。

e.en: He's a {purveyor} of bad takes on social media.
e.zh: 他在社交媒体上专门散播糟糕的观点。

e.en: Tax matters fall outside the {purview} of this committee.
e.zh: 税务问题不在本委员会的职权范围内。

e.en: Content moderation is within the {purview} of the trust team.
e.zh: 内容审核属于信任团队的管辖范围。

e.en: The infected cut was filled with yellow {pus}.
e.zh: 感染的伤口里满是黄色的脓液。

e.en: Squeezing a pimple to release {pus} can cause scarring.
e.zh: 挤痘痘把脓挤出来可能会留下疤痕。

push.t:
v. 推；按（按钮）；推动
n. 推；推广

e.en: {Push} the button to start the dishwasher.
e.zh: 按下按钮就能启动洗碗机。

e.en: Don't forget to {push} your code before logging off.
e.zh: 下班前别忘了把代码推上去。

e.en: The new policy received significant {pushback} from employees.
e.zh: 新政策遭到了员工的强烈反对。

e.en: Expect some {pushback} when you propose the price hike.
e.zh: 提出涨价方案时,预计会遇到一些抵制。

e.en: He rides his {pushbike} to the office every morning.
e.zh: 他每天早上骑自行车去上班。

e.en: The kids left their {pushbike} leaning against the fence.
e.zh: 孩子们把自行车靠在篱笆上。

e.en: A vendor sold roasted nuts from a wooden {pushcart}.
e.zh: 一位小贩用木制手推车叫卖烤坚果。

e.en: The street is lined with food {pushcart} stalls at night.
e.zh: 夜里街道两旁摆满了手推餐车。

e.en: She folded the {pushchair} and loaded it into the car.
e.zh: 她把婴儿推车折好放进了车里。

e.en: The toddler fell asleep in his {pushchair} at the park.
e.zh: 小家伙在公园里坐在婴儿车里睡着了。

e.en: He {pushed} the heavy door open with his shoulder.
e.zh: 他用肩膀把那扇重门推开了。

e.en: The team {pushed} the deadline back by one week.
e.zh: 团队把截止日期向后推迟了一周。

e.en: The drug {pusher} was arrested outside the nightclub.
e.zh: 那名毒贩在夜店门口被逮捕了。

e.en: Slide the {pusher} forward to feed paper into the shredder.
e.zh: 把推杆向前推,将纸送入碎纸机。

pushes.t:
v. 推（push 第三人称单数）
n. 推

e.en: She {pushes} herself harder than anyone else on the team.
e.zh: 她对自己的要求比队里任何人都严苛。

e.en: He always {pushes} the elevator button several times.
e.zh: 他总爱反复按好几下电梯按钮。

pushing.t:
v. 推；逼迫（push 进行式）
adj. 强求的

e.en: Stop {pushing} me — there's no room to move.
e.zh: 别再推我了,根本没地方动。

e.en: My grandmother is {pushing} ninety and still gardens daily.
e.zh: 我奶奶快九十了,仍然每天打理花园。

e.en: Russian schoolchildren memorize poems by {Pushkin} every year.
e.zh: 俄罗斯学童每年都要背诵普希金的诗。

e.en: The museum displays original manuscripts written by {Pushkin}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了普希金亲笔写的手稿。

pushover.t: n. 容易对付的人；轻而易举的事

e.en: Don't think the new manager is a {pushover}.
e.zh: 别以为新来的经理好欺负。

e.en: The exam was no {pushover}, even for top students.
e.zh: 那场考试可不轻松,连尖子生也吃力。

e.en: She fastened the photo to the corkboard with a {pushpin}.
e.zh: 她用一枚图钉把照片固定在软木板上。

e.en: The map was dotted with red {pushpin} markers.
e.zh: 地图上点缀着许多红色图钉作标记。

e.en: A bent {pushrod} can cause the engine to misfire.
e.zh: 推杆变形会导致发动机点火不顺。

e.en: The mechanic replaced a worn {pushrod} in the V8 engine.
e.zh: 机修工更换了V8发动机里磨损的推杆。

pushy.t: adj. 爱出风头的；死缠烂打的

e.en: The salesperson was too {pushy}, so I left the store.
e.zh: 那位销售太死缠烂打,我直接离开了店里。

e.en: Try to follow up without sounding {pushy} in your email.
e.zh: 邮件跟进时尽量别让人觉得咄咄逼人。

e.en: Critics called the leader {pusillanimous} for avoiding the debate.
e.zh: 评论人士批评这位领导人因回避辩论而胆小怯懦。

e.en: His {pusillanimous} response disappointed everyone on the team.
e.zh: 他懦弱的回应让团队里的每个人都失望。

e.en: Here, {puss} — come get your dinner.
e.zh: 过来咪咪,来吃晚饭啦。

e.en: The old {puss} curled up by the fireplace.
e.zh: 那只老猫蜷在壁炉旁边。

e.en: The little girl cuddled her {pussy} cat after school.
e.zh: 小女孩放学后抱着她的小猫咪。

e.en: A friendly {pussy} wandered into our garden this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上一只乖巧的小猫跑进了我们的花园。

pussycat.t:
n. 小猫（儿语）
n. 温顺的人

e.en: He looks tough but he's really a {pussycat} inside.
e.zh: 他看起来很凶,其实内心是个温柔的人。

e.en: The fluffy {pussycat} purred on the windowsill.
e.zh: 毛茸茸的小猫在窗台上呼噜着。

e.en: A small {pustule} formed on her chin overnight.
e.zh: 她下巴上一夜之间长出一个小脓包。

e.en: The doctor warned not to pop the {pustule} yourself.
e.zh: 医生警告不要自己挤破脓疱。

put.t:
v. 放置；使处于
v. 表达；提出

e.en: Please {put} your phone on the table during dinner.
e.zh: 吃饭时请把手机放在桌上。

e.en: How would you {put} that in simpler English?
e.zh: 你会怎样用更简单的英文表达呢?

e.en: The {putative} author of the leak has not been confirmed.
e.zh: 被认为是泄密源头的人尚未得到证实。

e.en: Scientists debated the {putative} cause of the outbreak.
e.zh: 科学家们就这次疫情的推定原因展开了讨论。

e.en: The painting is {putatively} a lost work by Vermeer.
e.zh: 这幅画据称是维米尔失传的作品。

e.en: The startup is {putatively} valued at over a billion dollars.
e.zh: 这家初创公司据称估值超过十亿美元。

e.en: They moved to {Putney} for the riverside walks.
e.zh: 他们为了能沿河散步搬到了普特尼。

e.en: The boat race starts near {Putney} Bridge each spring.
e.zh: 赛艇比赛每年春天从普特尼桥附近出发。

e.en: The smell of {putrefaction} drifted from the abandoned cellar.
e.zh: 一股腐烂的气味从废弃的地窖飘出来。

e.en: Refrigeration slows the {putrefaction} of meat and fish.
e.zh: 冷藏可以减缓肉类和鱼类的腐败。

e.en: Leftovers will quickly {putrefy} in the summer heat.
e.zh: 剩饭剩菜在夏天的高温下很快就会腐烂。
