e.en: The fallen leaves began to {putrefy} after the rains.
e.zh: 落叶在雨后开始腐烂。

e.en: Place all {putrescible} waste in the compost bin.
e.zh: 请把所有易腐垃圾放进堆肥桶里。

e.en: The truck collects {putrescible} garbage twice a week.
e.zh: 这辆卡车每周收两次易腐烂的垃圾。

e.en: The fridge gave off a {putrid} smell after the power outage.
e.zh: 停电后冰箱散发出一股腐臭味。

e.en: He made a {putrid} excuse for missing the meeting.
e.zh: 他为缺席会议找了个糟糕透顶的借口。

puts.t:
v. put 的第三人称单数
n. 看跌期权（金融）

e.en: She {puts} her phone on silent during meetings.
e.zh: 开会时她会把手机调成静音。

e.en: He always {puts} family before work.
e.zh: 他总是把家庭放在工作之前。

e.en: The failed {putsch} led to mass arrests across the capital.
e.zh: 那场失败的政变导致首都各地大规模逮捕。

e.en: Historians still debate what triggered the 1923 {putsch}.
e.zh: 历史学家仍在争论1923年那场政变的起因。

putt.t:
v. 轻击（高尔夫推杆入洞）
n. 推杆

e.en: She sank a long {putt} to win the tournament.
e.zh: 她推进一记长推杆赢得了比赛。

e.en: He missed an easy {putt} on the final hole.
e.zh: 他在最后一洞错失了一个简单的推杆。

putter.t:
n. 推杆（高尔夫）
v. 磨蹭；闲逛

e.en: He likes to {putter} around the garden on weekends.
e.zh: 他喜欢周末在花园里慢悠悠地忙活。

e.en: She bought a new {putter} before the golf trip.
e.zh: 高尔夫旅行前她买了一支新推杆。

putting.t:
v. put 的现在分词
n. 推杆（高尔夫）

e.en: I'm {putting} together a slide deck for tomorrow's pitch.
e.zh: 我正在为明天的提案准备幻灯片。

e.en: She's {putting} the kids to bed right now.
e.zh: 她现在正在哄孩子们睡觉。

e.en: He used {putty} to fill the gaps around the window frame.
e.zh: 他用油灰填补了窗框周围的缝隙。

e.en: After her speech, the audience was {putty} in her hands.
e.zh: 演讲过后,观众完全被她拿捏在手心。

puzzle.t:
n. 谜题；拼图
v. 使困惑

e.en: My niece can finish a 500-piece {puzzle} in one afternoon.
e.zh: 我侄女一个下午就能拼完500片的拼图。

e.en: How the keys ended up in the freezer is a {puzzle}.
e.zh: 钥匙怎么会跑到冰箱里去真是个谜。

e.en: She gave me a {puzzled} look when I mentioned the meeting.
e.zh: 我提到那个会议时她一脸困惑地看着我。

e.en: Engineers were {puzzled} by the recurring server crashes.
e.zh: 工程师们对反复出现的服务器崩溃感到困惑。

e.en: Her face showed clear {puzzlement} at the strange request.
e.zh: 听到这个奇怪的请求,她脸上写满了困惑。

e.en: There was general {puzzlement} over the sudden policy change.
e.zh: 大家对政策的突然变动普遍感到不解。

e.en: That math problem is a real {puzzler} for beginners.
e.zh: 那道数学题对初学者来说真是个难题。

e.en: Why the app keeps crashing remains a {puzzler}.
e.zh: 这个应用为什么不停崩溃仍是个谜。

puzzles.t:
n. puzzle 的复数
v. 使困惑（第三人称单数）

e.en: He solves crossword {puzzles} every morning with coffee.
e.zh: 他每天早上一边喝咖啡一边解填字游戏。

e.en: It {puzzles} me why she never replied to the email.
e.zh: 她为什么始终没回邮件,这让我很纳闷。

puzzling.t: adj. 令人困惑的；费解的

e.en: The test results were {puzzling} and didn't match the symptoms.
e.zh: 检查结果令人费解,与症状对不上。

e.en: She found his sudden silence deeply {puzzling}.
e.zh: 她觉得他突然的沉默非常令人不解。

e.en: The website is {puzzlingly} slow despite the recent upgrade.
e.zh: 尽管最近升级过,这个网站仍慢得令人费解。

e.en: He remained {puzzlingly} calm throughout the chaos.
e.zh: 在一片混乱中,他出奇地保持镇定,令人不解。

e.en: Kids' craft glue is usually a type of {pva}.
e.zh: 儿童手工胶水通常是一种聚乙烯醇胶。

e.en: He sealed the wood with a thin coat of {pva}.
e.zh: 他用一层薄薄的白胶给木材封底。

pvc.t: n. 聚氯乙烯（塑料材质）

e.en: The plumber replaced the rusty pipe with a {pvc} one.
e.zh: 水管工把生锈的管子换成了PVC的。

e.en: She wore a glossy {pvc} jacket to the concert.
e.zh: 她穿着一件亮面PVC夹克去看演唱会。

e.en: The forecast model uses a {pwl} function to approximate demand.
e.zh: 该预测模型用分段线性函数来近似需求。

e.en: Engineers fitted the data with a {pwl} curve.
e.zh: 工程师用分段线性曲线拟合了数据。

pwr.t:
n. 电源/功率（power 缩写）
n. 压水反应堆

e.en: Most commercial reactors today are {pwr} designs.
e.zh: 如今大多数商用反应堆都是压水堆设计。

e.en: The plant operates a 1000-megawatt {pwr} unit.
e.zh: 该电厂运行着一台1000兆瓦的压水堆机组。

pycnogenol.t: n. 碧萝芷（松树皮提取物）

e.en: She takes {pycnogenol} supplements for skin health.
e.zh: 她服用碧萝芷补剂来改善皮肤健康。

e.en: Some studies suggest {pycnogenol} may improve circulation.
e.zh: 一些研究表明碧萝芷可能有助于改善血液循环。

e.en: The old recipe book belonged to a baker named {pye}.
e.zh: 那本旧食谱属于一位姓派伊的面包师。

e.en: Dr. {pye} published several papers on medieval liturgy.
e.zh: 派伊博士发表过多篇关于中世纪礼拜仪式的论文。

pygmalion.t: n. 皮格马利翁（希腊神话人物）

e.en: The film is a modern retelling of {pygmalion}.
e.zh: 这部电影是《皮格马利翁》的现代翻拍版。

e.en: Teachers can fall into a {pygmalion} effect with bright students.
e.zh: 老师对优等生容易产生皮格马利翁效应。

pygmy.t:
n. 俾格米人；矮小者
adj. 矮小的

e.en: The {pygmy} hippo at the zoo drew huge crowds.
e.zh: 动物园里的倭河马吸引了大批游客。

e.en: They spotted a tiny {pygmy} owl in the pine tree.
e.zh: 他们在松树上发现了一只小小的姬鸮。

e.en: She spent the whole rainy Sunday in her {pyjamas}.
e.zh: 那个下雨的周日她一整天都穿着睡衣。

e.en: He bought matching {pyjamas} for the whole family.
e.zh: 他给全家人买了情侣款的睡衣。

pylon.t:
n. 高压电塔
n. 标桩

e.en: A massive electricity {pylon} stood at the edge of the field.
e.zh: 田地边上立着一座巨大的输电铁塔。

e.en: Drivers weaved between {pylon} markers in the parking lot.
e.zh: 司机们在停车场的锥形桩之间绕行。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed the baby with {pyloric} stenosis.
e.zh: 医生诊断这名婴儿患有幽门狭窄。

e.en: The {pyloric} valve controls food leaving the stomach.
e.zh: 幽门瓣控制食物离开胃部。

pylorus.t: n. 幽门（胃与十二指肠连接处）

e.en: Surgeons carefully examined the {pylorus} during the operation.
e.zh: 医生在手术中仔细检查了幽门部位。

e.en: The {pylorus} connects the stomach to the small intestine.
e.zh: 幽门连接胃部与小肠。

e.en: The diplomats flew to {pyongyang} for emergency talks.
e.zh: 外交官们飞往平壤进行紧急会谈。

e.en: State media in {pyongyang} reported the launch as a success.
e.zh: 平壤的官方媒体称此次发射取得了成功。

pyramid.t:
n. 金字塔
n. 锥形结构；层级

e.en: Tourists climbed slowly toward the top of the {pyramid}.
e.zh: 游客们缓缓地朝金字塔顶端攀登。

e.en: The company has a steep management {pyramid}.
e.zh: 这家公司有着层级分明的管理金字塔。

pyramidal.t: adj. 金字塔形的；锥形的

e.en: The tent had a simple {pyramidal} shape.
e.zh: 那顶帐篷是简单的金字塔造型。

e.en: Researchers studied {pyramidal} neurons in the cortex.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了大脑皮层中的锥体神经元。

e.en: Mourners lit the funeral {pyre} at sunset.
e.zh: 送葬者在日落时点燃了火葬柴堆。

e.en: The villagers built a tall wooden {pyre} by the river.
e.zh: 村民们在河边搭起了一座高高的木柴堆。

e.en: The hikers followed a {pyrenean} trail toward the summit.
e.zh: 徒步者沿着一条比利牛斯山的小径向山顶进发。

e.en: She adopted a fluffy {pyrenean} mountain dog.
e.zh: 她领养了一只毛茸茸的大白熊犬。

e.en: They drove across the {pyrenees} from France into Spain.
e.zh: 他们驱车翻越比利牛斯山,从法国进入西班牙。

e.en: Snow still covers the high peaks of the {pyrenees}.
e.zh: 比利牛斯山的高峰上依然覆盖着积雪。

pyres.t: n. pyre 的复数；火葬柴堆

e.en: Smoke from the funeral {pyres} drifted over the river.
e.zh: 火葬柴堆的烟雾飘过河面。

e.en: Several {pyres} burned through the night along the shore.
e.zh: 几座柴堆在岸边彻夜燃烧。

pyrex.t: n. 派热克斯（耐热玻璃品牌）

e.en: She baked the lasagna in a clear {pyrex} dish.
e.zh: 她用一只透明的派热克斯玻璃烤盘做千层面。

e.en: The lab measured the liquid in a {pyrex} beaker.
e.zh: 实验室用派热克斯玻璃烧杯量取液体。

e.en: Miners often mistook {pyrite} for real gold.
e.zh: 矿工们常把黄铁矿误认成真金。

e.en: The rock glittered with flecks of {pyrite}.
e.zh: 那块石头上闪烁着点点黄铁矿。

pyro.t: n. 纵火狂；烟火爱好者

e.en: The concert's {pyro} effects nearly singed the front row.
e.zh: 演唱会的烟火特效差点燎到了前排观众。

e.en: Police suspect a local {pyro} started the warehouse fire.
e.zh: 警方怀疑仓库火灾是当地一个纵火狂所为。

e.en: A {pyroclastic} flow swept down the volcano's slopes.
e.zh: 一股火山碎屑流顺着火山坡倾泻而下。

e.en: Geologists studied {pyroclastic} deposits near the crater.
e.zh: 地质学家研究了火山口附近的火山碎屑沉积物。

e.en: The plant uses {pyrolysis} to recycle plastic into fuel.
e.zh: 这家工厂利用热解技术把塑料回收成燃料。

e.en: {pyrolysis} breaks down material in the absence of oxygen.
e.zh: 热解是在无氧条件下分解物质的过程。

e.en: The therapist diagnosed him with {pyromania} after years of incidents.
e.zh: 经过多年的事件,治疗师诊断他患有纵火癖。

e.en: Novels sometimes romanticize {pyromania} in disturbing ways.
e.zh: 小说有时会以令人不安的方式美化纵火癖。

e.en: Police arrested a known {pyromaniac} near the burned building.
e.zh: 警方在烧毁的建筑附近逮捕了一名已知的纵火狂。

e.en: The thriller follows a detective hunting a {pyromaniac}.
e.zh: 这部惊悚片讲述一名警探追捕纵火狂的故事。

pyrotechnic.t: adj. 烟火的；烟火表演般炫目的

e.en: The festival ended with a stunning {pyrotechnic} display.
e.zh: 节日以一场令人惊叹的烟火表演收尾。

e.en: The guitarist gave a {pyrotechnic} solo that wowed the crowd.
e.zh: 吉他手献上了一段炫技十足的独奏,震撼全场。

pyrrhic.t: adj. 得不偿失的；惨胜的

e.en: Winning the lawsuit was a {pyrrhic} victory for the small firm.
e.zh: 赢得这场官司对这家小公司而言是一场惨胜。

e.en: Their election win felt {pyrrhic} after losing key allies.
e.zh: 在失去关键盟友后,他们的胜选显得得不偿失。

pythagorean.t: adj. 毕达哥拉斯（学派）的

e.en: Students learn the {pythagorean} theorem in middle school.
e.zh: 学生们在初中时就学过勾股定理。

e.en: He used the {pythagorean} formula to find the diagonal length.
e.zh: 他用勾股定理算出了对角线的长度。

python.t:
n. 蟒蛇
n. Python 编程语言

e.en: Most data scientists today work primarily in {python}.
e.zh: 如今大多数数据科学家主要使用Python编程。

e.en: A huge {python} was spotted curled up in the rafters.
e.zh: 有人发现一条巨蟒盘在屋梁上。

pacified.t: vt. 使平静, 安慰, 绥靖, 使服从

palest.t:
n. 栅栏, 界线, 范围
a. 苍白的, 暗淡的, 无力的
vi. 变苍白, 变暗, 失色
vt. 使变苍白, 使失色, 用栅栏围

papyri.t: n. 纸草, 草制成之纸

parentheses.t: n. 圆括号, 插入语, 附带, 插曲

parodied.t: n. 打油诗文, 诙谐的模仿诗文, 拙劣的模仿\nvt. 拙劣模仿, 作模仿诗文

parried.t: vt. 挡开, 回避, 闪避的回答\nn. 挡开, 回避, 闪避的回答

partaken.t: vt. 参与, 分担, 分享\nvi. 分享, 参与, 带有

patchier.t: a. 补缀的, 凑合的, 不调和的, 散落的, 斑驳的, 不完全的

patrolmen.t: n. 巡视者, 巡逻者, 巡警\n[法] 巡逻人, 巡逻警察

perkier.t: a. 得意洋洋的, 快活的, 敏捷的, 美观的, 傲慢的, 神气的

peskiest.t: a. 麻烦的, 恼人的, 棘手的, 讨厌的

pettier.t: a. 琐碎的, 小规模的, 小气的, 委琐的\n[经] 小额的, 微小的, 小规模的

pettiest.t: a. 琐碎的, 小规模的, 小气的, 委琐的\n[经] 小额的, 微小的, 小规模的

phantasied.t: n. 幻想, 怪念头, 想象\nvt.vi. 幻想, 怪念头, 想象

phoniest.t: n. 假货, 假冒者, 赝品\na. 伪造的, 假的, 不可信的, 华而不实的

picnicked.t: n. 野餐, 远足, 愉快的经历\nvi. 去野餐, 远足

pilloried.t: n. 颈手枷, 笑柄, 示众\nvt. 上颈手枷, 使惹人嘲笑, 使受众辱, 将...示众

pithiest.t: a. 有髓的, 由髓组成的, 简洁有力的

pitmen.t: n. 矿工, 煤矿工, 连杆\n[化] 连杆

pitied.t: n. 遗憾, 同情, 怜悯, 憾事, 可惜\nvt. 同情, 怜悯\nvi. 觉得可怜, 有同情心

plainest.t:
n. 平原, 草原, 朴实无华的东西, 无格式
a. 简单的, 明白的, 平常的, 不好看的, 朴素的, 清晰的, 普通的, 平坦的, 十足的
adv. 清楚地, 显然地
[计] 无格式

pleasantest.t: a. 愉快的, 可爱的, 活泼的, 亲切的

ploughmen.t: n. 把犁人, 庄稼汉

pluckiest.t: a. 有勇气的, 有胆量的, 大胆的

plumpest.t:
a. 圆胖的, 丰满的, 直接下落的, 直率的
vt. 突然放下, 支持, 使丰满, 使鼓起
vi. 扑通落下, 投票赞成, 变丰满, 鼓起
adv. 沉重地, 突然地, 直截了当地

plushest.t: n. 长毛绒, 长毛绒裤\na. 长毛绒制的, 豪华的

plied.t: n. 厚度, 板层\nvt. 使用, 使劲挥舞, 从事, 折, 弯\nvi. 辛勤工作, 定期航行

politest.t: a. 有礼貌的, 文雅的, 客气的, 有教养的

poorest.t: a. 贫穷的, 贫乏的, 不幸的, 可怜的, 拙劣的, 卑鄙的\n[经] 低劣的, 不良的

poshest.t: a. 豪华的, 漂亮的, 优雅的, 极好的\ninterj. 呸

potbellied.t: n. 大肚子, 大肚子的人, 圆火炉

pressmen.t: n. 印刷工, 新闻记者

prettified.t: vt. 美化, 雕琢, 粉饰

prettiest.t: a. 漂亮的, 优美的, 机灵的, 狡猾的, 恰当的\nadv. 相当, 颇

prettier.t: a. 漂亮的, 优美的, 机灵的, 狡猾的, 恰当的\nadv. 相当, 颇

pricier.t: a. 昂贵的, 价格高的

priciest.t: a. 昂贵的, 价格高的

primmest.t: a. 整洁的, 端正的, 规规矩矩的, 呆板的, 拘谨的\nvt. 弄整齐, 使显出一本正经的表情\nvi. 作出一本正经的样子

proudest.t: a. 骄傲的, 自大的, 自豪的, 辉煌的, 壮丽的

puffier.t: a. 胀大的, 肥胖的, 喘气的, 一阵阵吹的\n[医] 虚肿的, 浮肿的

punchier.t: a. 有力的, 生气勃勃的

punier.t: a. 微小的, 弱小的, 微不足道的

puniest.t: a. 微小的, 弱小的, 微不足道的

pushiest.t: a. 粗鲁的, 固执己见的, 好胜而爱出风头的

puttied.t: n. 油灰, 淡灰色, 氧化锡\nvt. 用油灰填塞

e.en: The engineer checked the {p-display} during the test.
e.zh: 工程师在测试时检查了磷光屏显示。

e.en: Older radar sets used a {p-display} for readings.
e.zh: 较老的雷达设备用磷光屏显示读数。

e.en: The dye contained {p-phenylenediamine} as an ingredient.
e.zh: 这种染料含有对苯二胺成分。

e.en: Some people are allergic to {p-phenylenediamine}.
e.zh: 有些人会对对苯二胺过敏。

e.en: The device uses {p-type} silicon in one layer.
e.zh: 该器件的一层使用P型硅。

e.en: A {p-type} semiconductor carries current mainly by holes.
e.zh: P型半导体主要靠空穴传导电流。

e.en: The fare was ten {pa'anga} for the short ride.
e.zh: 这段短途车费是十潘加。

e.en: She exchanged dollars for {pa'anga} at the bank.
e.zh: 她在银行把美元兑换成潘加。

e.en: He offered guests sweet {paan} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后他给客人端上甜味槟榔叶包嚼料。

e.en: The shop sells {paan} with spices and betel nut.
e.zh: 这家店卖加香料和槟榔的槟榔叶包嚼料。

e.en: The judge seemed {paartial} to the wealthy client.
e.zh: 法官似乎偏袒那位富有的客户。

e.en: A {paartial} report can mislead readers.
e.zh: 一份不公正的报告会误导读者。

e.en: The doctor discussed the patient's {pabular} needs.
e.zh: 医生讨论了病人的营养需求。

e.en: The essay used {pabular} imagery to describe comfort.
e.zh: 这篇文章用食物意象来描写安慰感。

e.en: The lecture offered little {pabulin} for serious thought.
e.zh: 这场讲座几乎没有提供多少可供深思的精神食粮。

e.en: Plants absorb {pabulin} from the enriched soil.
e.zh: 植物从肥沃的土壤中吸收养料。

e.en: A {paca} crossed the forest path at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时，一只无尾刺豚鼠穿过林间小路。

e.en: The zoo keeps a shy {paca} in the nocturnal house.
e.zh: 动物园在夜行动物馆里养着一只胆小的无尾刺豚鼠。

e.en: Several {pacas} were feeding near the riverbank.
e.zh: 几只无尾刺豚鼠正在河岸附近觅食。

e.en: Researchers tracked {pacas} with small radio collars.
e.zh: 研究人员用小型无线电项圈追踪无尾刺豚鼠。

e.en: Her {pace-making} role helped the team finish strongly.
e.zh: 她定步速的作用帮助团队有力地完成比赛。

e.en: The {pace-making} cells control the heart's rhythm.
e.zh: 这些起搏细胞控制心脏节律。

e.en: The Kenyan runner acted as the {pace-setter} early on.
e.zh: 那名肯尼亚选手在前段充当领跑者。

e.en: The company became a {pace-setter} in battery design.
e.zh: 这家公司成了电池设计领域的标杆。

e.en: His {pace-setting} lap broke the field apart.
e.zh: 他领跑的一圈把整个队伍拉散了。

e.en: The firm made a {pace-setting} move in clean energy.
e.zh: 这家公司在清洁能源领域做出了定标杆的举措。

e.en: Modern {pacemaking} can stabilize a slow heartbeat.
e.zh: 现代起搏技术可以稳定过慢的心跳。

e.en: Her {pacemaking} kept the runners on schedule.
e.zh: 她的定步速让跑者保持了预定节奏。

e.en: His {pacesetting} forced the pack to respond.
e.zh: 他的领跑迫使大部队作出反应。

e.en: The startup's {pacesetting} design influenced the industry.
e.zh: 这家初创公司的标杆设计影响了整个行业。

e.en: The horse moved smoothly along the {paceway}.
e.zh: 那匹马沿着赛马跑道平稳前进。

e.en: A narrow {paceway} led visitors through the ruins.
e.zh: 一条狭窄的步行通道带游客穿过遗址。

e.en: The old {pacha} received visitors in a tiled hall.
e.zh: 那位老帕夏在铺瓷砖的大厅里接待访客。

e.en: He lived like a {pacha} after the promotion.
e.zh: 升职后他过得像个高官一样阔绰。

e.en: The map marked the old {pachalic} near the coast.
e.zh: 地图标出了海岸附近旧时的帕夏辖区。

e.en: Taxes from the {pachalic} supported the governor's court.
e.zh: 来自该总督领地的税收供养了总督府。

e.en: The band played a lively {pachanga} after midnight.
e.zh: 午夜过后，乐队演奏了一支热烈的帕昌加舞曲。

e.en: Their backyard {pachanga} lasted until dawn.
e.zh: 他们后院那场热闹聚会一直持续到天亮。

e.en: The report listed {pachemia} among possible complications.
e.zh: 报告把血液浓稠症列为可能的并发症之一。

e.en: Doctors monitored him for signs of {pachemia}.
e.zh: 医生监测他是否出现血液浓稠症的迹象。

e.en: The label listed {p-acetamidophenol} as the active ingredient.
e.zh: 标签上列出对乙酰氨基酚为有效成分。

e.en: Chemists know {p-acetamidophenol} as another name for paracetamol.
e.zh: 化学家知道对乙酰氨基酚是扑热息痛的另一个名称。

e.en: The radar experiment used the {p-band} for deeper penetration.
e.zh: 这项雷达实验使用P波段以获得更深的穿透能力。

e.en: Engineers compared {p-band} signals with higher-frequency data.
e.zh: 工程师将P频段信号与更高频的数据进行了比较。

e.en: Her {pacificism} shaped every vote on military policy.
e.zh: 她的和平主义影响了她在军事政策上的每一次投票。

e.en: The essay defends {pacificism} after years of conflict.
e.zh: 这篇文章在多年冲突之后为反战立场辩护。

e.en: The {pacificist} refused to support the invasion.
e.zh: 那位和平主义者拒绝支持这场入侵。

e.en: As a lifelong {pacificist}, she opposed all armed solutions.
e.zh: 作为终身反战者，她反对一切武装解决办法。

e.en: A mule is a reliable {pack-animal} on mountain trails.
e.zh: 在山路上，骡子是可靠的驮畜。

e.en: The expedition needed one {pack-animal} for the heavy equipment.
e.zh: 探险队需要一头驮畜来运送沉重的设备。

e.en: This jacket is light and {packable} for travel.
e.zh: 这件夹克很轻，旅行时便于收纳。

e.en: Choose {packable} furniture for a small apartment.
e.zh: 小公寓最好选择便于打包搬动的家具。

e.en: He strapped the crate to a wooden {packboard}.
e.zh: 他把箱子绑在一个木制背货架上。

e.en: The old {packboard} made carrying supplies much easier.
e.zh: 那个旧背负板让搬运补给轻松了许多。

e.en: The club was {packed-out} by midnight.
e.zh: 到午夜时，俱乐部已经挤满了人。

e.en: They played to a {packed-out} theater every night.
e.zh: 他们每晚都在爆满的剧院演出。

e.en: The salmon {packery} closed after the season ended.
e.zh: 鲑鱼罐头加工厂在季节结束后关闭了。

e.en: Workers at the {packery} sorted fruit before shipment.
e.zh: 包装厂的工人在发货前分拣水果。

e.en: Video calls rely on {packetization} of audio and images.
e.zh: 视频通话依赖音频和图像的数据包化。

e.en: Poor {packetization} can increase delays on the network.
e.zh: 分组化处理不佳会增加网络延迟。

e.en: The oranges are washed at the {packhouse} before shipping.
e.zh: 橙子发货前会在包装场清洗。

e.en: A new {packhouse} helped farmers sell fresher produce.
e.zh: 新的农产品包装厂帮助农民卖出更新鲜的农产品。

e.en: The dishes arrived safely in a wooden {packing-case}.
e.zh: 餐具装在木质包装箱里安全送达。

e.en: He nailed the {packing-case} shut before the ship departed.
e.zh: 船出发前，他把装运箱钉牢了。

e.en: The {packmen} carried cloth from village to village.
e.zh: 这些背货商人把布料从一个村子带到另一个村子。

e.en: Old stories describe {packmen} selling needles and ribbons.
e.zh: 老故事里写到小贩们售卖针线和彩带。

e.en: A {packplane} brought food to the remote camp.
e.zh: 一架补给飞机把食物送到偏远营地。

e.en: The pilot landed the {packplane} on a rough strip.
e.zh: 飞行员把货运小飞机降落在简陋跑道上。

e.en: She kept dry socks in her {packsack}.
e.zh: 她把干袜子放在背包里。

e.en: The hiker dropped his {packsack} beside the fire.
e.zh: 徒步者把行囊放在火堆旁。

e.en: The guide tightened the {packsaddle} on the mule.
e.zh: 向导把骡子身上的驮鞍系紧。

e.en: A broken {packsaddle} delayed the caravan for hours.
e.zh: 一个坏掉的载货鞍让商队耽搁了好几个小时。

e.en: The peddler leaned on his {packstaff} at the gate.
e.zh: 小贩在门口倚着他的行商手杖。

e.en: His heavy bundle hung from a worn {packstaff}.
e.zh: 他的沉重包袱挂在一根磨旧的背货杖上。

e.en: She tied the parcel with strong {packthread}.
e.zh: 她用结实的包装线把包裹扎好。

e.en: The old book was bundled in brown {packthread}.
e.zh: 那本旧书用棕色捆扎线捆着。

e.en: The {packtrain} crossed the pass before sunset.
e.zh: 驮队在日落前穿过了山口。

e.en: Supplies arrived by {packtrain} during the winter campaign.
e.zh: 冬季战役期间，补给由驮畜队运来。

e.en: The dispute ended with a formal {paction}.
e.zh: 这场争端以一份正式契约告终。

e.en: Lawyers debated whether the {paction} was still valid.
e.zh: 律师们争论这份协议是否仍然有效。

e.en: The poem imagines a {pactolian} river of wealth.
e.zh: 这首诗想象了一条流淌财富的富金之河。

e.en: Investors hoped the mine would prove {pactolian}.
e.zh: 投资者希望这座矿能证明是财富丰厚的。

e.en: The cabinet was made from reddish {padauk}.
e.zh: 这个柜子是用红色的花梨木做成的。

e.en: Woodworkers value {padauk} for its color and strength.
e.zh: 木工看重紫檀类木材的颜色和强度。

e.en: The steamboat's {paddle-wheel} churned the brown river.
e.zh: 汽船的明轮搅动着浑浊的河水。

e.en: Engineers repaired the broken {paddle-wheel} before dawn.
e.zh: 工程师们在黎明前修好了坏掉的桨轮。

e.en: The technician checked the film with a {pachimeter}.
e.zh: 技术员用厚度计检查了这层薄膜。

e.en: A digital {pachimeter} measured the cornea precisely.
e.zh: 数字测厚仪精确测量了角膜厚度。

e.en: They played {pachisi} on a cloth board.
e.zh: 他们在布棋盘上玩印度十字棋。

e.en: The rules of {pachisi} inspired later board games.
e.zh: 印度十字棋的规则启发了后来的棋盘游戏。

e.en: The engineer used a {pachometer} before drilling the wall.
e.zh: 工程师钻墙前使用钢筋探测仪检查。

e.en: A {pachometer} can locate hidden reinforcement bars.
e.zh: 钢筋探测仪可以定位隐藏的加固钢筋。

e.en: Her scarf smelled faintly of {pachouli}.
e.zh: 她的围巾隐约有广藿香的气味。

e.en: The soap was scented with {pachouli} oil.
e.zh: 这块肥皂用了广藿香油调香。

e.en: The fossil showed a {pachydermal} layer of skin.
e.zh: 这块化石显示出一层厚皮动物般的皮肤。

e.en: His {pachydermal} indifference annoyed the whole team.
e.zh: 他厚脸皮般的冷漠惹恼了整个团队。

e.en: The surgeon identified a small {pachydermatocele}.
e.zh: 外科医生发现了一个小的厚皮性皮肤膨出。

e.en: A rare {pachydermatocele} can distort nearby tissue.
e.zh: 罕见的厚皮性皮肤膨出会使附近组织变形。

e.en: The patient had {pachydermatous} changes around the ankle.
e.zh: 患者脚踝周围出现了皮肤增厚的变化。

e.en: Critics mocked his {pachydermatous} resistance to shame.
e.zh: 评论者嘲笑他厚脸皮地不知羞耻。

e.en: The diagnosis included localized {pachydermia}.
e.zh: 诊断包括局部皮肤增厚症。

e.en: Severe {pachydermia} made the skin feel rough.
e.zh: 严重的皮肤增厚症让皮肤摸起来粗糙。

e.en: The doctor noted a {pachyglossal} appearance.
e.zh: 医生注意到舌头肥厚的外观。

e.en: A {pachyglossal} condition may affect speech.
e.zh: 舌头肥厚的状况可能影响说话。

e.en: Infants with {pachyglossia} may have trouble feeding.
e.zh: 患有巨舌症的婴儿可能进食困难。

e.en: The specialist treated the child's {pachyglossia}.
e.zh: 专科医生治疗了这个孩子的舌肥大。

e.en: The scan suggested possible {pachymenia}.
e.zh: 扫描提示可能存在硬脑膜增厚症。

e.en: Chronic inflammation can cause {pachymenia}.
e.zh: 慢性炎症可能导致硬脑膜增厚症。

e.en: The tumor pressed against the {pachymeninx}.
e.zh: 肿瘤压迫到了硬脑膜。

e.en: Surgeons carefully opened the {pachymeninx}.
e.zh: 外科医生小心地打开了硬脑膜。

e.en: The dermatologist diagnosed {pachyonyxis} in both feet.
e.zh: 皮肤科医生诊断双脚都有甲增厚症。

e.en: Inherited {pachyonyxis} can make nails painful.
e.zh: 遗传性甲增厚症可能让指甲疼痛。

e.en: The extinct mammal was described as a {pachyosteomorph}.
e.zh: 这种已灭绝哺乳动物被描述为骨质厚重型动物。

e.en: A {pachyosteomorph} often has unusually dense bones.
e.zh: 骨质厚重型动物通常骨骼异常致密。

e.en: The report mentioned chronic {pachypelviperitonitis}.
e.zh: 报告提到了慢性盆腔腹膜增厚性炎症。

e.en: Severe {pachypelviperitonitis} may cause pelvic pain.
e.zh: 严重的盆腔腹膜增厚性炎症可能引起盆腔疼痛。

e.en: Researchers tested {pacifarin} in the laboratory.
e.zh: 研究人员在实验室测试了一种抗凝血物质pacifarin。

e.en: The article described {pacifarin} as an anticoagulant.
e.zh: 文章把pacifarin描述为一种抗凝血物质。

e.en: The angry crowd was barely {pacifiable}.
e.zh: 愤怒的人群几乎无法安抚。

e.en: Some disputes are {pacifiable} with a sincere apology.
e.zh: 有些争端可以通过真诚道歉平息。

e.en: She preferred a {pacifical} solution to the quarrel.
e.zh: 她更愿意用和平方式解决争吵。

e.en: His {pacifical} temperament made him a trusted mediator.
e.zh: 他爱和平的性格使他成为受信任的调解人。

e.en: The leaders spoke {pacifically} after the crisis.
e.zh: 危机过后，领导人以和平语气讲话。

e.en: She answered {pacifically}, refusing to argue further.
e.zh: 她温和地回答，不再继续争辩。

e.en: The governor tried to {pacificate} the province.
e.zh: 总督试图平定这个省份。

e.en: Kind words may {pacificate} a frightened child.
e.zh: 温柔的话语或许能安抚受惊的孩子。

e.en: The elder acted as a {pacificator} between the families.
e.zh: 这位长者充当两家之间的调停者。

e.en: A skilled {pacificator} can calm tense negotiations.
e.zh: 熟练的调停者能缓和紧张的谈判。

e.en: The minister made a {pacificatory} speech.
e.zh: 部长发表了一次调停性的讲话。

e.en: Her {pacificatory} gesture softened the dispute.
e.zh: 她安抚性的举动缓和了争端。

e.en: The professor treated {paedeutics} as a serious science of teaching.
e.zh: 这位教授把教育学视为严肃的教学科学。

e.en: Old books on {paedeutics} often discuss moral training.
e.zh: 关于教育学的旧书常讨论道德培养。

e.en: The {paediatrist} examined the child after the fever returned.
e.zh: 孩子再次发烧后，儿科医生给他做了检查。

e.en: A rural {paediatrist} may treat many kinds of childhood illness.
e.zh: 乡村儿科医生可能要处理多种儿童疾病。

e.en: The church defended {paedobaptism} as an ancient Christian practice.
e.zh: 该教会把婴儿洗礼辩护为古老的基督教做法。

e.en: Their debate over {paedobaptism} lasted well into the evening.
e.zh: 他们关于婴儿洗礼的争论一直持续到晚上。

e.en: The {paedobaptist} minister baptized infants in the parish church.
e.zh: 这位主张婴儿洗礼的牧师在堂区教堂为婴儿施洗。

e.en: A {paedobaptist} argument often appeals to covenant theology.
e.zh: 主张婴儿洗礼的论证常诉诸圣约神学。

e.en: Some insects reproduce by {paedogenesis} before reaching full maturity.
e.zh: 有些昆虫在完全成熟前会通过幼体生殖繁殖。

e.en: The textbook described {paedogenesis} in several small aquatic animals.
e.zh: 教材描述了几种小型水生动物的幼态发生现象。

e.en: The {paedologist} observed how children learned through play.
e.zh: 这位儿童学研究者观察儿童如何通过游戏学习。

e.en: A careful {paedologist} records both speech and behavior.
e.zh: 严谨的儿童学研究者会记录言语和行为。

e.en: Early {paedology} tried to measure children's mental development.
e.zh: 早期儿童学试图衡量儿童的心理发展。

e.en: Her interest in {paedology} began during teacher training.
e.zh: 她对儿童学的兴趣始于师范培训期间。

e.en: The species has {paedomorphic} features even as an adult.
e.zh: 这个物种成年后仍保留幼态形态特征。

e.en: Biologists noted the animal's {paedomorphic} skull proportions.
e.zh: 生物学家注意到这种动物头骨比例呈幼态形态。

e.en: The salamander shows {paedomorphism} by retaining its gills.
e.zh: 这种蝾螈保留鳃，表现出幼态持续。

e.en: Human facial evolution is sometimes discussed in terms of {paedomorphism}.
e.zh: 人类面部进化有时会从幼态形态角度讨论。

e.en: The lecture explained {paedomorphosis} with examples from amphibians.
e.zh: 讲座用两栖动物的例子解释了幼态演化。

e.en: Researchers linked {paedomorphosis} to changes in developmental timing.
e.zh: 研究人员把幼态形成与发育时间变化联系起来。

e.en: The report discussed {paedophilia} as a serious psychiatric disorder.
e.zh: 报告把恋童癖作为严重的精神障碍来讨论。

e.en: Laws against child abuse are not limited to cases of {paedophilia}.
e.zh: 反儿童虐待法律并不限于恋童癖案件。

e.en: The court heard evidence about the accused {paedophiliac}.
e.zh: 法庭听取了有关被告恋童癖者的证据。

e.en: Police investigated suspected {paedophiliac} material on the computer.
e.zh: 警方调查了电脑上疑似恋童癖相关材料。

e.en: The poem uses a {paeon} to vary its rhythm.
e.zh: 这首诗用四音步格来变化节奏。

e.en: His speech became a {paeon} to public service.
e.zh: 他的演讲成了对公共服务的颂歌。

e.en: The berries contain {paeonidin} and other red pigments.
e.zh: 这些浆果含有芍药花青素和其他红色色素。

e.en: Scientists measured {paeonidin} in the flower extract.
e.zh: 科学家测量了花提取物中的芍药花青素。

e.en: The root bark yielded {paeonol} during chemical analysis.
e.zh: 化学分析中，根皮提取出了丹皮酚。

e.en: Researchers studied {paeonol} for its possible anti-inflammatory effects.
e.zh: 研究人员研究丹皮酚可能具有的抗炎作用。

e.en: A pink {paeony} opened beside the garden path.
e.zh: 一朵粉色牡丹在花园小径旁绽放。

e.en: She planted a {paeony} for its large spring flowers.
e.zh: 她种了一株芍药，欣赏它春天的大花。

e.en: He greeted the old {paesano} with a warm embrace.
e.zh: 他热情拥抱了那位老同乡。

e.en: In the neighborhood, every {paesano} knew the bakery owner.
e.zh: 在这个街区，每个老乡都认识面包店老板。

e.en: Medieval writers often imagined {pagandom} as a hostile world.
e.zh: 中世纪作家常把异教世界想象成敌对的世界。

e.en: The sermon warned against the customs of {pagandom}.
e.zh: 这篇布道告诫人们不要沾染异教徒群体的习俗。

e.en: Critics claimed the festival would {paganise} Christian worship.
e.zh: 批评者声称这个节日会使基督教礼拜异教化。

e.en: The old spelling {paganise} appears more often in British texts.
e.zh: 旧拼法paganise更常见于英国文本。

e.en: The ritual had a {paganish} flavor to strict observers.
e.zh: 在严苛的观察者看来，这种仪式有点近似异教。

e.en: He disliked the {paganish} symbols carved above the door.
e.zh: 他不喜欢门上方刻着的近似异教符号。

e.en: The reformers feared that folk customs would {paganize} the ceremony.
e.zh: 改革者担心民俗会使仪式异教化。

e.en: Some artists tried to {paganize} classical Christian images.
e.zh: 一些艺术家试图把古典基督教图像异教化。

e.en: The chronicler described a {paganized} version of the old feast.
e.zh: 编年史作者描述了旧节日的一个被异教化版本。

e.en: They argued that the temple had been {paganized} after the conquest.
e.zh: 他们认为这座神庙在征服后已被异教化。

e.en: He says the new rite {paganizes} a traditional service.
e.zh: 他说这种新仪式使传统礼拜异教化。

e.en: The novel {paganizes} the hero by surrounding him with ancient gods.
e.zh: 小说让古代众神围绕英雄，从而使他带上异教色彩。

e.en: The bishop condemned the {paganizing} influence of local festivals.
e.zh: 主教谴责地方节日带来的异教化影响。

e.en: They accused the poet of {paganizing} sacred stories.
e.zh: 他们指责那位诗人把神圣故事异教化。

e.en: The old {paddle-wheeler} carried tourists down the river.
e.zh: 那艘老式明轮船载着游客顺河而下。

e.en: A restored {paddle-wheeler} now serves as a floating museum.
e.zh: 一艘修复后的桨轮汽船如今成了水上博物馆。

e.en: We played {paddleball} against the gym wall after class.
e.zh: 下课后我们对着体育馆的墙玩墙拍球。

e.en: She bought a wooden {paddleball} toy for the picnic.
e.zh: 她为野餐买了一个木制板球玩具。

e.en: He balanced carefully on the {paddleboard}.
e.zh: 他小心地在桨板上保持平衡。

e.en: They rented a {paddleboard} near the beach.
e.zh: 他们在海滩附近租了一块划桨板。

e.en: The children steered the {paddleboat} across the pond.
e.zh: 孩子们驾驶脚踏船穿过池塘。

e.en: A red {paddleboat} waited beside the dock.
e.zh: 一艘红色的明轮小船停在码头旁。

e.en: Stop being such a {paddlefoot} and watch the steps.
e.zh: 别这么笨手笨脚的，注意台阶。

e.en: The tired hiker became a slow {paddlefoot} by sunset.
e.zh: 到日落时，疲惫的徒步者走路已经拖拖拉拉。

e.en: A white {paddybird} stood in the flooded field.
e.zh: 一只白色稻田鸟站在被水淹着的田里。

e.en: The guide pointed out a {paddybird} near the marsh.
e.zh: 向导指给我们看沼泽边的一只池鹭。

e.en: Farmers worked knee-deep in the {paddyfield}.
e.zh: 农民们在没到膝盖的稻田里劳作。

e.en: The village was surrounded by green {paddyfields}.
e.zh: 村庄四周环绕着绿色的水田。

e.en: A shy {paddymelon} appeared at the forest edge.
e.zh: 一只胆小的小袋鼠出现在森林边缘。

e.en: The zoo keeps a rescued {paddymelon} from Tasmania.
e.zh: 动物园收养了一只来自塔斯马尼亚的获救帕德梅隆。

e.en: The butcher trimmed the tough {paddywack} from the meat.
e.zh: 屠夫把肉上坚韧的颈韧带修掉。

e.en: She called every odd souvenir a little {paddywack}.
e.zh: 她把每件古怪纪念品都叫作小玩意儿。

e.en: The dog chewed a dried {paddywhack} for hours.
e.zh: 那条狗啃了好几个小时的干牛颈韧带。

e.en: His shelf was crowded with every sort of {paddywhack}.
e.zh: 他的架子上摆满了各种小玩意儿。

e.en: The {pademelon} vanished into the dense undergrowth.
e.zh: 那只小袋鼠消失在茂密的灌木丛里。

e.en: Researchers tracked a rare {pademelon} at night.
e.zh: 研究人员夜间追踪一只罕见的帕德梅隆。

e.en: The sunscreen label listed {padimate} among its ingredients.
e.zh: 防晒霜标签把帕地马酯列在成分中。

e.en: Some older lotions used {padimate} as a UV filter.
e.zh: 一些较老的乳液曾用帕地马酯作为紫外线过滤剂。

e.en: The court addressed him as {padishah} in formal letters.
e.zh: 宫廷在正式信函中称他为帕迪沙。

e.en: In the novel, the {padishah} ruled a vast empire.
e.zh: 在那部小说里，帕迪沙统治着庞大的帝国。

padkos.t: 旅途食物；路上吃的干粮

e.en: They packed {padkos} before the long drive.
e.zh: 长途开车前，他们打包了路上吃的干粮。

e.en: Grandmother's {padkos} included fruit, bread, and tea.
e.zh: 祖母准备的旅途食物有水果、面包和茶。

e.en: The farmer rode a tired {padnag} into town.
e.zh: 农夫骑着一匹疲惫的劣马进城。

e.en: No one expected the old {padnag} to win the race.
e.zh: 没人指望那匹瘦弱老马赢得比赛。

e.en: The villagers asked the {padri} to bless the school.
e.zh: 村民请神父为学校祝福。

e.en: A Portuguese {padri} kept records of the settlement.
e.zh: 一位葡萄牙传教士记录了这个定居点的情况。

e.en: The {padrone} greeted every guest at the door.
e.zh: 那位老板在门口迎接每一位客人。

e.en: Immigrant workers once depended on a powerful {padrone}.
e.zh: 移民工人曾依赖一位有权势的意大利式工头。

padrones.t: 老板们；意大利式主人们

e.en: The old {padrones} controlled jobs in the district.
e.zh: 那些老派老板控制着这个区的工作机会。

e.en: Several {padrones} met to settle the dispute.
e.zh: 几位意大利式主人碰面解决争端。

padroni.t: 老板们；意大利式主人们

e.en: The {padroni} recruited laborers from nearby villages.
e.zh: 这些老板从附近村庄招募劳工。

e.en: Stories about harsh {padroni} spread among the workers.
e.zh: 关于苛刻意大利式工头的故事在工人中流传。

e.en: The chronicler praised the {padshah} as a just ruler.
e.zh: 编年史家称赞这位帕夏是公正的统治者。

e.en: Every ambassador bowed before the {padshah}.
e.zh: 每位使节都在东方君主面前鞠躬。

e.en: Her gown was made of blue {paduasoy}.
e.zh: 她的礼服是用蓝色厚罗缎做成的。

e.en: The museum displayed a rare strip of {paduasoy}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一条罕见的帕杜亚丝绸。

e.en: The article criticized his rigid {paedagogic} style.
e.zh: 那篇文章批评他僵硬的教学风格。

e.en: Her {paedagogic} training shaped every lesson plan.
e.zh: 她的教育训练影响了每一份教案。

e.en: The village {paedagogue} taught Latin to every child.
e.zh: 村里的教师给每个孩子教拉丁语。

e.en: He sounded like a tiresome {paedagogue} at dinner.
e.zh: 他在晚餐时听起来像个惹人厌的学究。

e.en: The law treated the convicted {paederast} as a serious offender.
e.zh: 法律把被定罪的娈童者视为严重罪犯。

e.en: The historian used {paederast} in its ancient Greek context.
e.zh: 历史学家在古希腊语境中使用了恋童男性这个词。

page-boy.t: 旧时旅馆侍童；童仆发型；伴童侍从貌似（上下文定）

e.en: The old hotel still employed a {page-boy} to carry bags.
e.zh: 那家老旅馆仍雇着一名侍童帮客人提行李。

e.en: She wore a neat {page-boy} haircut in the photograph.
e.zh: 照片里她留着整齐的童仆式短发。

e.en: Her new thriller is a real {page-turner}.
e.zh: 她的新惊悚小说真是让人一读就停不下来。

e.en: The memoir became a surprising {page-turner} despite its quiet subject.
e.zh: 尽管题材平静，这本回忆录却意外地十分引人入胜。

e.en: His brief {pagehood} at court taught him discipline.
e.zh: 他短暂的宫廷侍童经历让他学会了守规矩。

e.en: The manuscript's {pagehood} mattered once the fragments were numbered.
e.zh: 残片编号后，手稿作为书页的身份就变得重要了。

e.en: The boy sought {pageship} in a noble household.
e.zh: 那个男孩想在贵族府邸谋一个侍童职位。

e.en: His {pageship} ended when he was old enough for military training.
e.zh: 到他足够大可以接受军事训练时，他的侍童身份便结束了。

e.en: The costume gave him a strangely {pagetoid} appearance.
e.zh: 那套服装让他看起来有种奇怪的侍童气质。

e.en: Critics mocked the singer's {pagetoid} haircut and velvet jacket.
e.zh: 评论家嘲笑那位歌手童仆式的发型和天鹅绒外套。

paggy.t: 湿软泥泞的；潮湿沉闷的

e.en: The path was {paggy} after three days of rain.
e.zh: 下了三天雨后，小路变得湿软泥泞。

e.en: A {paggy} mist hung over the fields at dawn.
e.zh: 拂晓时，田野上笼罩着潮湿沉闷的薄雾。

e.en: The editor corrected several {paginal} references before printing.
e.zh: 编辑在印刷前更正了几处页码引用。

e.en: Its {paginal} layout made the old index easy to use.
e.zh: 它按页编排的版式让旧索引用起来很方便。

e.en: Please {paginate} the report before you send the final PDF.
e.zh: 发送最终PDF之前，请先给报告编好页码。

e.en: The website will {paginate} long comment threads automatically.
e.zh: 网站会自动把很长的评论串分页显示。

e.en: The {paginated} manuscript was easier for reviewers to discuss.
e.zh: 编好页码的手稿更便于审稿人讨论。

e.en: Search results are {paginated} to reduce loading time.
e.zh: 搜索结果会分页显示，以减少加载时间。

e.en: The software {paginates} the document as you edit it.
e.zh: 你编辑文档时，软件会自动为它分页。

e.en: This setting {paginates} the product list after twenty items.
e.zh: 这个设置会在二十个商品后把列表分页显示。

e.en: A small {pagod} stood beside the river shrine.
e.zh: 河边神龛旁立着一座小宝塔。

e.en: The collector bought an ivory {pagod} from the antique dealer.
e.zh: 收藏家从古董商那里买了一座象牙塔形神龛。

e.en: The roof rose in {pagoda-like} tiers above the garden.
e.zh: 屋顶在花园上方层层升起，形似宝塔。

e.en: A {pagoda-like} ornament sat on the mantelpiece.
e.zh: 壁炉架上摆着一个宝塔形的装饰物。

e.en: The museum displayed a carved {pagodite} figure from China.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件来自中国的塔形滑石雕像。

e.en: Victorian collectors prized {pagodite} for delicate ornamental carving.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的收藏家珍视宝塔石，因为它适合精细装饰雕刻。

pahoehoe.t: 绳状熔岩；平滑玄武岩熔岩

e.en: The hikers crossed cooled {pahoehoe} near the volcano.
e.zh: 徒步者在火山附近穿过已经冷却的绳状熔岩。

e.en: Fresh {pahoehoe} can look smooth but remain dangerously hot.
e.zh: 新形成的平滑熔岩看似光滑，却可能仍然灼热危险。

e.en: The company reported a higher {paid-in} capital this year.
e.zh: 该公司今年报告的实缴资本更高。

e.en: Only {paid-in} members may vote at the meeting.
e.zh: 只有已缴费会员才能在会议上投票。

e.en: The rent is {paid-in-advance} at the start of each month.
e.zh: 房租在每个月初预先支付。

e.en: Guests with {paid-in-advance} bookings can check in faster.
e.zh: 已预付订房费用的客人可以更快办理入住。

e.en: The insurer listed every {paid-out} claim in the report.
e.zh: 保险公司在报告中列出了每一笔已赔付的索赔。

e.en: Bonuses are {paid-out} only after the project closes.
e.zh: 奖金只在项目结束后才会发放出去。

e.en: She is a {paid-up} member of the professional association.
e.zh: 她是该专业协会已缴清会费的会员。

e.en: He became a {paid-up} believer in remote work after the trial.
e.zh: 试行之后，他成了远程办公的坚定支持者。

e.en: Early {paidology} tried to study childhood scientifically.
e.zh: 早期儿童学试图用科学方法研究童年。

e.en: The professor mentioned {paidology} in a lecture on education history.
e.zh: 教授在一场教育史讲座中提到了儿童研究。

e.en: A yellow {paigle} bloomed beside the lane.
e.zh: 小路旁开着一朵黄色的黄花九轮草。

e.en: The herbalist dried {paigle} flowers for an old country remedy.
e.zh: 草药师晒干报春花，用来制作一种乡间老方。

e.en: She carried a {pailful} of water from the well.
e.zh: 她从井边提来满满一桶水。

e.en: A {pailful} of sand was enough for the small hole.
e.zh: 一桶沙子就足够填那个小洞了。

e.en: They hauled several {pailfuls} of coal upstairs.
e.zh: 他们把好几桶煤搬上楼。

e.en: Two {pailfuls} of berries filled the kitchen sink.
e.zh: 两桶浆果把厨房水槽装满了。

e.en: The chef served chicken {paillard} with lemon and herbs.
e.zh: 厨师端上了配柠檬和香草的薄煎鸡肉片。

e.en: A veal {paillard} cooks quickly in a hot pan.
e.zh: 薄小牛肉片在热锅里很快就能煎熟。

e.en: Her dress glittered with tiny silver {paillettes}.
e.zh: 她的裙子上缀着细小的银色亮片，闪闪发光。

e.en: The costume designer chose a large {paillette} for each sleeve.
e.zh: 服装设计师给每只袖子都选了一片大亮片。

e.en: The clinic promised a {pain-free} dental procedure.
e.zh: 诊所承诺这次牙科操作不会疼。

e.en: After therapy, she could walk {pain-free} again.
e.zh: 经过治疗后，她又能无痛行走了。

e.en: He took a {pain-killer} before the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行前他吃了一片止痛药。

e.en: The doctor prescribed a stronger {pain-killer} after surgery.
e.zh: 手术后医生开了更强效的止痛药。

e.en: The nurse applied a {pain-relieving} cream to the burn.
e.zh: 护士在烫伤处涂了止痛药膏。

e.en: Yoga can have a {pain-relieving} effect for some patients.
e.zh: 瑜伽对一些患者可能有缓解疼痛的作用。

e.en: The old editor was a careful {painstaker} with every comma.
e.zh: 那位老编辑连每个逗号都仔细推敲，是个极其用心的人。

e.en: A true {painstaker} checks the figures twice.
e.zh: 真正一丝不苟的人会把数字核对两遍。

e.en: The archive was a {painsworthy} subject for years of research.
e.zh: 这份档案值得花多年时间研究。

e.en: He called the restoration a {painsworthy} labor of love.
e.zh: 他称这次修复是一项值得费心的热爱之作。

e.en: She cleaned the {paint-brush} after finishing the wall.
e.zh: 刷完墙后，她把油漆刷洗干净了。

e.en: The child dipped a {paint-brush} into blue paint.
e.zh: 孩子把画笔蘸进蓝色颜料里。

paint-by-numbers.t: 按编号涂色的；机械照做的

e.en: She relaxed with a {paint-by-numbers} kit on Sunday.
e.zh: 星期天她用一套按编号涂色的画具来放松。

e.en: The report offered a {paint-by-numbers} solution to a complex problem.
e.zh: 那份报告给复杂问题提供了机械照搬式的方案。

e.en: The student opened her {paintbox} before art class.
e.zh: 美术课前，学生打开了她的颜料盒。

e.en: His garden looked like a bright {paintbox} in spring.
e.zh: 春天他的花园像鲜艳的颜料盒一样五彩斑斓。

e.en: The teacher stacked the {paintboxes} near the sink.
e.zh: 老师把颜料盒堆放在水槽旁边。

e.en: Old wooden {paintboxes} lined the studio shelf.
e.zh: 旧木制颜料盒排在画室的架子上。

e.en: The door needs another {paintcoat} before winter.
e.zh: 入冬前这扇门还需要再刷一层漆。

e.en: A thin {paintcoat} protected the metal from rust.
e.zh: 薄薄一层油漆保护金属不生锈。

e.en: Critics admired the {painterliness} of her loose brushwork.
e.zh: 评论家欣赏她松动笔触中的绘画性。

e.en: The photograph has a surprising {painterliness} in its shadows.
e.zh: 这张照片的阴影里有一种出人意料的画意。

e.en: The children left open {paintpots} across the table.
e.zh: 孩子们把打开的小颜料罐散放在桌上。

e.en: Empty {paintpots} were piled behind the workshop.
e.zh: 空油漆罐堆在工坊后面。

e.en: The Victorian {paintress} exhibited under her own name.
e.zh: 那位维多利亚时代的女画家以本名参展。

e.en: A forgotten {paintress} filled the chapel with murals.
e.zh: 一位被遗忘的女画家为小教堂绘满壁画。

painty.t: 有油漆味的；沾满颜料的

e.en: The room still smelled {painty} after the renovation.
e.zh: 装修后房间里仍有一股油漆味。

e.en: He wiped his {painty} fingers on an old rag.
e.zh: 他把沾满颜料的手指擦在旧抹布上。

e.en: Many {pair-bonded} birds share nesting duties.
e.zh: 许多形成配偶纽带的鸟会共同承担筑巢任务。

e.en: The study tracked {pair-bonded} adults over several years.
e.zh: 这项研究跟踪了多年处于伴侣关系中的成年个体。

e.en: The algorithm uses {pair-closure} to group related nodes.
e.zh: 该算法用配对闭包来分组相关节点。

e.en: In the proof, {pair-closure} follows from the relation's symmetry.
e.zh: 在证明中，配对闭合由该关系的对称性推出。

e.en: The carriage needed a steady {pair-horse} on the left.
e.zh: 这辆马车左侧需要一匹稳当的并驾马。

e.en: A tired {pair-horse} stumbled near the market gate.
e.zh: 一匹疲惫的并驾马在市场门口附近绊了一下。

e.en: They practiced in a narrow {pair-oar} boat at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时他们在一条窄窄的双桨艇上练习。

e.en: The club entered a {pair-oar} crew in the race.
e.zh: 俱乐部派出一支双桨队参加比赛。

e.en: The breeder recorded the {pairage} of each bird.
e.zh: 饲养员记录了每只鸟的配对情况。

e.en: Successful {pairage} depends on timing and territory.
e.zh: 成功配对取决于时机和领地条件。

e.en: The deer become restless during the {pairing-season}.
e.zh: 鹿在交配季节会变得躁动不安。

e.en: Fishing is restricted in the {pairing-season} to protect breeding stocks.
e.zh: 为保护繁殖种群，交配季节会限制捕鱼。

e.en: The old coin was worth only one {paisa}.
e.zh: 那枚旧硬币只值一派萨。

e.en: He refused to waste a single {paisa} on the scheme.
e.zh: 他不愿在这个计划上浪费哪怕一派萨。

e.en: She greeted the older woman as a {paisana}.
e.zh: 她把那位年长女子当作女同乡来问候。

e.en: The letter was written to a trusted {paisana} abroad.
e.zh: 这封信写给一位在国外可信赖的女同胞。

e.en: The ticket once cost fifty {paise}.
e.zh: 这张票以前只卖五十派萨。

e.en: He counted the remaining {paise} in his pocket.
e.zh: 他数了数口袋里剩下的派萨硬币。

e.en: He wore a blue {pajama} top to breakfast.
e.zh: 他穿着蓝色睡衣上衣去吃早餐。

e.en: The costume had loose {pajama} trousers and a sash.
e.zh: 那套服装有宽松的睡裤式长裤和一条腰带。

e.en: A {pajamaed} child appeared at the bedroom door.
e.zh: 一个穿着睡衣的孩子出现在卧室门口。

e.en: The guests laughed at the {pajamaed} host answering the bell.
e.zh: 客人们看到穿睡衣的主人来开门都笑了。

e.en: Add the {pakchoi} just before serving the soup.
e.zh: 汤快上桌前再加入小白菜。

e.en: The market sells fresh {pakchoi} from local farms.
e.zh: 市场出售本地农场的新鲜青江菜。

e.en: The term {Pakeha} is common in New Zealand discussions of identity.
e.zh: 在新西兰关于身份认同的讨论中，Pakeha这个词很常见。

e.en: Some {Pakeha} families have lived there for generations.
e.zh: 一些新西兰白人家庭已在那里生活了好几代。

e.en: The antique box was decorated with {paktong} fittings.
e.zh: 那个古董盒子饰有白铜配件。

e.en: Collectors prize early {paktong} candlesticks for their pale sheen.
e.zh: 收藏家珍视早期白铜烛台的淡雅光泽。

e.en: The cave contained {palaeanthropic} tools and bones.
e.zh: 洞穴里有古人类的工具和骨骼。

e.en: Researchers debated the {palaeanthropic} features of the skull.
e.zh: 研究人员争论这具头骨的古人类特征。

palaeethnology.t: 古民族学；史前民族研究

e.en: Her thesis focused on {palaeethnology} in the Danube basin.
e.zh: 她的论文研究多瑙河流域的古民族学。

e.en: The museum lecture introduced {palaeethnology} to local students.
e.zh: 博物馆讲座向本地学生介绍了古民族学。

e.en: The jawbone showed several {palaeoanthropic} traits.
e.zh: 这块颌骨显示出若干古人类特征。

e.en: A {palaeoanthropic} site was found beneath the river terrace.
e.zh: 河阶下发现了一处古人类遗址。

e.en: She studies {palaeoanthropology} at a university in London.
e.zh: 她在伦敦一所大学学习古人类学。

e.en: New DNA evidence has changed debates in {palaeoanthropology}.
e.zh: 新的DNA证据改变了古人类学中的争论。

e.en: Fossil pollen is important evidence in {palaeobotany}.
e.zh: 化石花粉是古植物学中的重要证据。

e.en: He used {palaeobotany} to reconstruct the ancient forest.
e.zh: 他利用古植物学重建那片古森林。

e.en: Ice cores are central to {palaeoclimatology}.
e.zh: 冰芯是古气候学研究的核心资料。

e.en: Her work in {palaeoclimatology} explains past drought patterns.
e.zh: 她在古气候学方面的研究解释了过去的干旱模式。

e.en: Ripple marks can reveal the {palaeocurrent} direction.
e.zh: 波痕可以显示古水流方向。

e.en: The geologist mapped each {palaeocurrent} from the sandstone layers.
e.zh: 地质学家根据砂岩层绘制出每股古水流。

e.en: The laboratory specializes in {palaeodendrology} and fossil wood.
e.zh: 这个实验室专门研究古树木学和化石木。

e.en: Through {palaeodendrology}, they identified the ancient conifer species.
e.zh: 通过古树木学，他们鉴定出那种古代针叶树。

e.en: Shell deposits help reconstruct coastal {palaeoenvironments}.
e.zh: 贝壳沉积物有助于重建海岸古环境。

e.en: The report compares several Ice Age {palaeoenvironments}.
e.zh: 报告比较了几个冰河时代的古环境。

e.en: Charred seeds are key evidence in {palaeoethnobotany}.
e.zh: 炭化种子是古民族植物学中的关键证据。

e.en: She used {palaeoethnobotany} to study ancient farming diets.
e.zh: 她用古民族植物学研究古代农耕饮食。

palaeogeographies.t: 古地理格局；古地理复数

e.en: The maps show changing {palaeogeographies} across deep time.
e.zh: 这些地图显示了漫长地质时期中古地理格局的变化。

e.en: Different basins preserve different {palaeogeographies}.
e.zh: 不同盆地保存着不同的古地理格局。

e.en: The course covers regional {palaeogeology} and fossil evidence.
e.zh: 这门课涵盖区域古地质学和化石证据。

e.en: Understanding the basin's {palaeogeology} helped locate the coal seams.
e.zh: 了解该盆地的古地质情况有助于定位煤层。

e.en: She studied {palaeography} to read medieval manuscripts.
e.zh: 她学习古文字学，以便阅读中世纪手稿。

e.en: The dating relied on careful {palaeography}.
e.zh: 年代判定依靠细致的古书写研究。

e.en: The museum displayed a chipped {palaeolith}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件有打制痕迹的旧石器。

e.en: A {palaeolith} was found near the riverbank.
e.zh: 河岸附近发现了一件旧石器。

e.en: Researchers used {palaeomagnetism} to date the lava flow.
e.zh: 研究人员利用古地磁学测定熔岩流的年代。

e.en: The rocks preserved a record of {palaeomagnetism}.
e.zh: 这些岩石保存了古磁性的记录。

e.en: A {palaeoneurologist} examined the fossil skull.
e.zh: 一位古神经学家检查了那块化石头骨。

e.en: The {palaeoneurologist} compared ancient brain casts.
e.zh: 这名古神经学家比较了古代脑腔模型。

e.en: The paper was mainly a work of {palaeontography}.
e.zh: 这篇论文主要是一项古生物描述学研究。

e.en: Accurate {palaeontography} requires detailed fossil drawings.
e.zh: 准确的古生物描述学需要细致的化石图绘。

e.en: She specializes in {palaeozoology} and fossil mammals.
e.zh: 她专攻古动物学和哺乳动物化石。

e.en: The course introduced students to {palaeozoology}.
e.zh: 这门课向学生介绍了古动物学。

palaestra.t: 古希腊摔跤学校；体育场

e.en: Young athletes trained in the {palaestra}.
e.zh: 年轻运动员在古希腊体育场里训练。

e.en: The ruins include a bathhouse and a {palaestra}.
e.zh: 遗址包括一座浴场和一处摔跤学校。

palafitte.t: 湖上桩屋；水上木桩居所

e.en: Archaeologists uncovered a prehistoric {palafitte}.
e.zh: 考古学家发现了一处史前湖上桩屋。

e.en: The village was built as a {palafitte} above the water.
e.zh: 这个村落建成了架在水面上的桩屋。

e.en: The basaltic glass altered into {palagonite}.
e.zh: 玄武质玻璃蚀变成了橙黄色的火山玻璃蚀变物。

e.en: Thin layers of {palagonite} coated the volcanic ash.
e.zh: 薄薄的 palagonite 层覆盖在火山灰上。

e.en: Moisture accelerated {palagonitization} in the ash deposit.
e.zh: 水分加速了灰层中的火山玻璃蚀变作用。

e.en: The study measured rates of {palagonitization}.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了火山玻璃蚀变作用的速率。

e.en: The old {palander} carried cargo along the coast.
e.zh: 那艘旧的荷兰平底双桅船沿海运货。

e.en: Sailors repaired the {palander} before winter.
e.zh: 水手们在入冬前修好了那艘平底双桅船。

e.en: The official traveled by {palankeen} through the town.
e.zh: 那位官员乘轿子穿过城镇。

e.en: Servants lifted the {palankeen} onto their shoulders.
e.zh: 仆人们把轿子抬到肩上。

e.en: We ate lunch under a beach {palapa}.
e.zh: 我们在海滩上的棕榈叶凉亭下吃午饭。

e.en: The resort built a {palapa} beside the pool.
e.zh: 度假村在泳池旁建了一座草顶凉亭。

e.en: The collection includes a polished {palasite}.
e.zh: 这个收藏中有一块抛光的石铁陨石。

e.en: A {palasite} often contains green olivine crystals.
e.zh: 橄榄陨铁常含有绿色橄榄石晶体。

e.en: The medicine was flavored more {palatably}.
e.zh: 这种药被调得更可口一些。

e.en: He presented the bad news {palatably}.
e.zh: 他把坏消息说得比较容易让人接受。

e.en: Russian consonants often show {palatalization}.
e.zh: 俄语辅音常常表现出腭化现象。

e.en: The sound change involved {palatalization} before front vowels.
e.zh: 这一音变涉及前元音前的腭音化。

e.en: Speakers may {palatalize} the consonant before this vowel.
e.zh: 说话者可能会在这个元音前把该辅音腭化。

e.en: Children sometimes {palatalize} sounds while learning speech.
e.zh: 儿童学说话时有时会把一些音发成腭音。

e.en: The word begins with a {palatalized} consonant.
e.zh: 这个词以一个腭化辅音开头。

e.en: Her accent used several {palatalized} sounds.
e.zh: 她的口音中使用了几个腭音化的音。

e.en: This dialect {palatalizes} certain consonants before i.
e.zh: 这种方言会把 i 前的某些辅音腭化。

e.en: The child {palatalizes} the sound in that word.
e.zh: 这个孩子把那个词里的音发成腭音。

e.en: The teacher demonstrated {palatalizing} a consonant.
e.zh: 老师演示了如何把一个辅音腭化。

e.en: Linguists described a {palatalizing} sound shift.
e.zh: 语言学家描述了一种腭化音变。

e.en: The surgeon examined the {palatium} carefully.
e.zh: 外科医生仔细检查了腭部。

e.en: In Latin texts, {palatium} can mean a palace.
e.zh: 在拉丁文本中，palatium 可以表示宫殿。

e.en: Tree rings can reveal the {paleoclimate} of a dry region.
e.zh: 树木年轮能揭示干旱地区的古气候。

e.en: The model compares today's warming with past {paleoclimate} changes.
e.zh: 该模型把今天的变暖与过去的古气候变化作比较。

e.en: The cave deposits preserve {paleoclimatic} evidence from the Ice Age.
e.zh: 这些洞穴沉积物保存了冰河时代的古气候证据。

e.en: Researchers used shells to reconstruct {paleoclimatic} conditions.
e.zh: 研究人员利用贝壳重建古气候条件。

e.en: A {paleoclimatologist} studied pollen trapped in the lake mud.
e.zh: 一位古气候学家研究了困在湖泥中的花粉。

e.en: The {paleoclimatologist} warned that ancient droughts lasted centuries.
e.zh: 这位古气候学家警告说，古代干旱曾持续数百年。

e.en: She studies {paleoclimatology} to understand long-term climate cycles.
e.zh: 她研究古气候学，以了解长期气候周期。

e.en: Ice cores are important records in {paleoclimatology}.
e.zh: 冰芯是古气候学中的重要记录。

e.en: The {paleocortex} is associated with basic sensory functions.
e.zh: 古皮质与一些基本感觉功能有关。

e.en: Neuroscientists compared the {paleocortex} with newer cortical regions.
e.zh: 神经科学家把古皮质与较新的皮层区域作了比较。

e.en: The study focused on {paleocortical} structures in the brain.
e.zh: 这项研究聚焦于大脑中的古皮质结构。

e.en: Damage to {paleocortical} areas may affect smell processing.
e.zh: 古皮质区域受损可能影响嗅觉处理。

e.en: Geologists described the rock as {paleocrystic} in texture.
e.zh: 地质学家把这种岩石的结构描述为古结晶质。

e.en: The expedition crossed a field of {paleocrystic} sea ice.
e.zh: 探险队穿过了一片古冰晶海冰区。

e.en: Ripple marks helped identify the ancient {paleocurrent}.
e.zh: 波痕帮助确定了古水流方向。

e.en: The sandstone layers record a northward {paleocurrent}.
e.zh: 这些砂岩层记录了一股向北的古水流。

e.en: In {paleodendrology}, fossil trunks can show past forest patterns.
e.zh: 在古树木学中，化石树干能显示过去的森林格局。

e.en: Her {paleodendrology} research linked ancient wood to climate shifts.
e.zh: 她的古树木学研究把古木材与气候变化联系起来。

e.en: {Paleoecology} examines how extinct organisms lived together.
e.zh: 古生态学研究已灭绝生物如何共同生活。

e.en: The site offers rich data for {paleoecology}.
e.zh: 这个遗址为古生态学提供了丰富资料。

e.en: The {paleoencephalon} was discussed in an old anatomy text.
e.zh: 一本旧解剖学教材中讨论了古脑。

e.en: Some theories linked instinctive behavior to the {paleoencephalon}.
e.zh: 一些理论把本能行为与古脑联系起来。

e.en: Amber fossils are central to {paleoentomology}.
e.zh: 琥珀化石是古昆虫学的重要研究对象。

e.en: He entered {paleoentomology} after finding a fossil beetle.
e.zh: 他在发现一枚甲虫化石后进入了古昆虫学领域。

e.en: Fossil leaves reveal the {paleoenvironment} of the valley.
e.zh: 化石叶片揭示了这个山谷的古环境。

e.en: The team reconstructed the {paleoenvironment} around the settlement.
e.zh: 团队重建了聚落周围的史前环境。

e.en: The museum displayed the island's {paleofauna}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了这座岛的古动物群。

e.en: Changes in {paleofauna} suggest a major climate shift.
e.zh: 古动物群的变化表明曾发生重大气候转变。

e.en: The coal bed contains remains of tropical {paleoflora}.
e.zh: 这层煤中含有热带古植物群的遗迹。

e.en: Scientists mapped the {paleoflora} of the ancient swamp.
e.zh: 科学家绘制了这片古沼泽的古植物群分布。

e.en: The paper discussed the {paleogenesis} of early vertebrate forms.
e.zh: 论文讨论了早期脊椎动物形态的古发生过程。

e.en: Geologists debated the {paleogenesis} of the mineral deposit.
e.zh: 地质学家争论这处矿床的早期成因。

e.en: {Paleogenetics} can recover DNA from ancient bones.
e.zh: 古遗传学可以从古代骨骼中提取DNA。

e.en: Her work in {paleogenetics} traced migration after the Ice Age.
e.zh: 她的古遗传学研究追踪了冰河时代后的迁徙。

e.en: The map shows {paleogeographical} changes across the continent.
e.zh: 这张地图显示了大陆范围内的古地理变化。

e.en: They used fossils as {paleogeographical} evidence.
e.zh: 他们把化石用作古地理证据。

e.en: The basin was {paleogeographically} linked to a shallow sea.
e.zh: 从古地理角度看，该盆地曾与浅海相连。

e.en: These islands were {paleogeographically} closer during the Cretaceous.
e.zh: 在白垩纪，这些岛屿从古地理上看距离更近。

e.en: {Paleogeography} helps explain where ancient seas once lay.
e.zh: 古地理学有助于解释古海洋曾经的位置。

e.en: The textbook includes maps of Jurassic {paleogeography}.
e.zh: 这本教材包含侏罗纪古地理图。

e.en: The survey reconstructed the region's {paleogeology}.
e.zh: 这项调查重建了该地区的古地质状况。

e.en: Oil explorers often study {paleogeology} before drilling.
e.zh: 石油勘探者在钻探前常研究古地质。

e.en: {Paleogeophysics} uses magnetic records preserved in rocks.
e.zh: 古地球物理学利用岩石中保存的磁记录。

e.en: The course introduced {paleogeophysics} through plate-motion data.
e.zh: 这门课通过板块运动数据介绍古地球物理学。

paleographer.t: 古文字学家；古文书专家

e.en: A {paleographer} identified the manuscript's twelfth-century script.
e.zh: 一位古文字学家认出了手稿中的十二世纪字体。

e.en: The museum asked a {paleographer} to read the damaged letter.
e.zh: 博物馆请一位古文书专家辨读那封受损信件。

e.en: The article offered a {paleographic} analysis of the charter.
e.zh: 这篇文章对那份宪章作了古文字学分析。

e.en: Her {paleographic} notes helped date the manuscript.
e.zh: 她的古文书学笔记帮助确定了手稿年代。

paleographical.t: 古文字学的；古文书学的

e.en: The library preserves detailed {paleographical} descriptions of each scroll.
e.zh: 图书馆保存着每卷文书的详细古文字学描述。

e.en: His {paleographical} training made the faded text readable.
e.zh: 他的古文书学训练使褪色文本得以辨读。

e.en: The linguist described the sound as {palatodental} in her notes.
e.zh: 语言学家在笔记中把这个音描述为腭齿音。

e.en: A {palatodental} consonant involves contact near the palate and teeth.
e.zh: 腭齿辅音涉及腭部和牙齿附近的接触。

e.en: The researcher compared each {palatogram} after the speaker repeated the syllable.
e.zh: 说话者重复音节后，研究人员比较了每张腭位图。

e.en: A clear {palatogram} can show where the tongue touches the roof of the mouth.
e.zh: 清晰的舌腭接触图能显示舌头接触上腭的位置。

palatography.t: 腭位描记法；舌腭接触记录法

e.en: The speech lab used {palatography} to study difficult consonants.
e.zh: 语音实验室用腭位描记法研究难发的辅音。

e.en: Traditional {palatography} often requires a coated artificial palate.
e.zh: 传统舌腭接触记录法常需要涂层的人工腭。

e.en: His {palaverous} style made the short meeting last an hour.
e.zh: 他啰嗦的说话方式让短会开了一个小时。

e.en: The novel gives its most {palaverous} character the funniest lines.
e.zh: 这部小说把最爱闲聊的角色写得最有趣。

e.en: Farmers crossed the muddy {palayan} before sunrise.
e.zh: 农民在日出前穿过泥泞的稻田。

e.en: The village festival began after the {palayan} had been planted.
e.zh: 稻田插秧完成后，村里的节庆才开始。

e.en: The botanist examined the {paleae} under a small microscope.
e.zh: 植物学家用小显微镜观察这些内稃。

e.en: Dry {paleae} can remain attached to the grass flower.
e.zh: 干燥的苞片可能仍附着在禾本科小花上。

e.en: A {palebuck} moved quietly through the dry grass.
e.zh: 一只南非小羚羊静静穿过干草地。

e.en: The old field guide called the animal a {palebuck}.
e.zh: 那本旧野外指南把这种动物称为淡色羚羊。

e.en: The lecture connected instinctive behavior with the {paleencephalon}.
e.zh: 讲座把本能行为与古脑联系起来。

e.en: Older anatomy texts sometimes use {paleencephalon} for primitive brain regions.
e.zh: 较早的解剖学教材有时用古脑指原始脑区。

paleethnology.t: 古民族学；史前民族研究

e.en: Her dissertation in {paleethnology} focused on burial customs.
e.zh: 她的古民族学论文研究丧葬习俗。

e.en: Artifacts and legends both mattered to early {paleethnology}.
e.zh: 文物和传说对早期古民族学都很重要。

e.en: The old western used {paleface} as a racial insult.
e.zh: 那部老西部片把“白人”一词用作种族侮辱。

e.en: After the shock, everyone called him a {paleface}.
e.zh: 受惊之后，大家都说他脸色苍白。

palefaces.t: 白人们；脸色苍白的人们

e.en: The novel's narrator distrusts the {palefaces} who enter the valley.
e.zh: 小说叙述者不信任进入山谷的那些白人。

e.en: The cold wind left the hikers looking like {palefaces}.
e.zh: 寒风把徒步者们吹得一个个脸色苍白。

e.en: She entered {paleichthyology} after finding fish fossils as a student.
e.zh: 她学生时代发现鱼类化石后进入了古鱼类学领域。

e.en: Modern {paleichthyology} combines anatomy with geological dating.
e.zh: 现代古鱼类学结合了解剖研究和地质年代测定。

e.en: The cave contained tools from a {paleoanthropic} community.
e.zh: 洞穴里有一个古人类群体留下的工具。

e.en: Researchers debated the {paleoanthropic} origin of the jawbone.
e.zh: 研究人员争论这块颌骨是否源自早期人类。

paleoanthropology.t: 古人类学；人类起源研究

e.en: Her work in {paleoanthropology} examines early human migration.
e.zh: 她的古人类学研究考察早期人类迁徙。

e.en: New fossils can quickly change debates in {paleoanthropology}.
e.zh: 新化石能迅速改变古人类学中的争论。

paleobiochemistry.t: 古生物化学；远古生命化学研究

e.en: The team used {paleobiochemistry} to study ancient proteins.
e.zh: 团队运用古生物化学研究古代蛋白质。

e.en: Questions about fossil pigments belong partly to {paleobiochemistry}.
e.zh: 关于化石色素的问题部分属于古生物化学。

paleobiogeography.t: 古生物地理学；古生物分布研究

e.en: The article uses {paleobiogeography} to explain dinosaur distribution.
e.zh: 这篇文章用古生物地理学解释恐龙的分布。

e.en: Island fossils are valuable evidence for {paleobiogeography}.
e.zh: 岛屿化石是古生物分布研究的重要证据。

e.en: The report included a {paleobiologic} analysis of the fossil bed.
e.zh: 报告包含对这处化石层的古生物学分析。

e.en: Climate models helped explain the {paleobiologic} evidence.
e.zh: 气候模型帮助解释了这些古生命证据。

paleobiological.t: 古生物学的；古生命研究的

e.en: The museum opened a new {paleobiological} research center.
e.zh: 博物馆开设了新的古生物学研究中心。

e.en: Their {paleobiological} evidence suggests a warmer ancient sea.
e.zh: 他们的古生命研究证据表明古代海洋更温暖。

paleobiologist.t: 古生物学家；古生命研究者

e.en: A {paleobiologist} identified the tiny shell fragment.
e.zh: 一位古生物学家鉴定了这块微小的贝壳碎片。

e.en: The {paleobiologist} works with chemists to analyze fossil tissues.
e.zh: 这位古生物学家与化学家合作分析化石组织。

e.en: He studies {paleobiology} at a university museum.
e.zh: 他在一所大学博物馆研究古生物学。

e.en: The course treats evolution as a central theme in {paleobiology}.
e.zh: 这门课把进化作为古生命研究的核心主题。

paleobotanical.t: 古植物学的；化石植物的

e.en: The site produced important {paleobotanical} evidence.
e.zh: 该遗址出土了重要的古植物学证据。

e.en: A {paleobotanical} survey found pollen in the sediment.
e.zh: 一次化石植物调查在沉积物中发现了花粉。

paleobotanically.t: 从古植物学角度；按古植物学方法

e.en: The swamp layer is {paleobotanically} significant because of its seeds.
e.zh: 这层沼泽沉积因含有种子而在古植物学上很重要。

e.en: Researchers interpreted the samples {paleobotanically} before dating them.
e.zh: 研究人员在测定年代前先从古植物学角度解读样本。

paleobotanist.t: 古植物学家；化石植物研究者

e.en: The {paleobotanist} recognized the leaf as an extinct fern.
e.zh: 古植物学家认出这片叶子属于一种已灭绝的蕨类。

e.en: A careful {paleobotanist} can read climate clues from fossil wood.
e.zh: 细致的化石植物研究者能从化石木材中读出气候线索。

paleobotany.t: 古植物学；化石植物研究

e.en: She chose {paleobotany} after studying ancient forests.
e.zh: 她研究古代森林后选择了古植物学。

e.en: In {paleobotany}, pollen grains can reveal old landscapes.
e.zh: 在古植物学中，花粉粒能揭示古代景观。

e.en: The drillers found sand inside an ancient {paleochannel}.
e.zh: 钻探人员在一条古河道内发现了砂层。

e.en: A buried {paleochannel} can guide groundwater through the plain.
e.zh: 埋藏的古水道可能引导地下水穿过平原。

e.en: The inscription was dated {paleographically} to the ninth century.
e.zh: 这段铭文从古文字学角度被判定为九世纪。

e.en: She compared the letters {paleographically} rather than linguistically.
e.zh: 她是从古文字学角度比较这些字母，而不是从语言学角度。

paleography.t: 古文字学；古文书笔迹研究

e.en: He studied {paleography} to read medieval manuscripts.
e.zh: 他学习古文字学，以便阅读中世纪手稿。

e.en: The course in {paleography} focused on old handwriting.
e.zh: 这门古文字学课程重点研究古代笔迹。

e.en: Fossil pollen helped reconstruct the animal's {paleohabitat}.
e.zh: 化石花粉帮助复原了这种动物的古栖息地。

e.en: The river deposits suggest a wet {paleohabitat}.
e.zh: 这些河流沉积物表明当时是潮湿的史前生境。

e.en: A {paleoichthyologist} identified the fossil jaw.
e.zh: 一位古鱼类学家鉴定了这块化石颌骨。

e.en: The {paleoichthyologist} compared ancient sharks with living species.
e.zh: 这位古鱼类学家把古代鲨鱼同现生物种作比较。

e.en: She entered {paleoichthyology} after finding a fossil fish.
e.zh: 她在发现一条鱼类化石后进入了古鱼类学领域。

e.en: Modern {paleoichthyology} uses scans of delicate fossils.
e.zh: 现代古鱼类学会用扫描技术研究脆弱化石。

e.en: The rock's magnetism revealed its ancient {paleolatitude}.
e.zh: 这块岩石的磁性揭示了它的古纬度。

e.en: Researchers estimated the island's {paleolatitude} during the Cretaceous.
e.zh: 研究人员估算了这座岛在白垩纪时的古纬度。

e.en: The team used {paleolimnology} to study old lake climates.
e.zh: 团队利用古湖沼学研究过去的湖泊气候。

e.en: In {paleolimnology}, mud layers can record centuries of change.
e.zh: 在古湖沼学中，泥层能记录数百年的变化。

e.en: The museum displayed a chipped {paleolith} from the valley.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件来自山谷的打制旧石器。

e.en: Archaeologists argued whether the stone was a {paleolith}.
e.zh: 考古学家争论这块石头是否是古石器。

e.en: The {paleologist} specialized in early human tools.
e.zh: 这位古代事物研究者专攻早期人类工具。

e.en: A careful {paleologist} can read history from small traces.
e.zh: 细心的古代事物研究者能从细微痕迹读出历史。

e.en: His interest in {paleology} began with cave paintings.
e.zh: 他对古物学的兴趣始于洞穴壁画。

e.en: The book treats {paleology} as a broad study of antiquity.
e.zh: 这本书把古代研究视为一个宽泛领域。

e.en: {Paleomagnetism} helped prove that continents had moved.
e.zh: 古地磁学帮助证明大陆曾经移动。

e.en: The lava preserved a signal of ancient {paleomagnetism}.
e.zh: 这层熔岩保存了古代磁性的信号。

e.en: The {paleomagnetist} sampled rocks from the mountain road.
e.zh: 这位古地磁学家从山路旁采集岩石样本。

e.en: A {paleomagnetist} can infer past plate positions.
e.zh: 古地磁学家能够推断过去板块的位置。

e.en: Her research in {paleomammalogy} focuses on early horses.
e.zh: 她的古哺乳动物学研究重点是早期马类。

e.en: {Paleomammalogy} links fossil teeth to ancient diets.
e.zh: 古哺乳动物学把化石牙齿同古代食性联系起来。

e.en: The monograph included detailed {paleontographical} plates.
e.zh: 这部专著包含详细的古生物记述学图版。

e.en: Her {paleontographical} notes described each fossil shell.
e.zh: 她的古生物记述学笔记描述了每一枚贝壳化石。

e.en: {Paleontography} requires precise drawings of fossil forms.
e.zh: 古生物记述学需要对化石形态作精确绘图。

e.en: The journal published a classic work of {paleontography}.
e.zh: 这本期刊发表了一篇古生物记述学经典著作。

e.en: The cave has great {paleontologic} importance.
e.zh: 这个洞穴具有重大的古生物学意义。

e.en: They reviewed the site's {paleontologic} evidence carefully.
e.zh: 他们仔细审查了该地点的古生物学证据。

e.en: {Paleopalynology} uses fossil pollen to study past climates.
e.zh: 古孢粉学利用化石花粉研究过去气候。

e.en: She applied {paleopalynology} to date the sediment layers.
e.zh: 她运用古孢粉学来确定沉积层年代。

e.en: {Paleopedology} reveals how ancient soils formed.
e.zh: 古土壤学揭示古代土壤是如何形成的。

e.en: The field report used {paleopedology} to infer rainfall.
e.zh: 这份野外报告用古土壤学推断降雨量。

e.en: {Paleophytology} examines plants preserved as fossils.
e.zh: 古植物学研究以化石形式保存下来的植物。

e.en: His work in {paleophytology} changed views of early forests.
e.zh: 他的古植物学研究改变了人们对早期森林的看法。

e.en: {Paleoprimatology} studies the fossil history of primates.
e.zh: 古灵长类学研究灵长类的化石历史。

e.en: She entered {paleoprimatology} through work on ancient lemurs.
e.zh: 她通过研究古代狐猴进入了古灵长类学领域。

e.en: {Paleornithology} helped explain the evolution of flight.
e.zh: 古鸟类学帮助解释飞行能力的演化。

e.en: The fossil feather became important in {paleornithology}.
e.zh: 这根羽毛化石在古鸟类学中变得很重要。

e.en: The red layer was identified as a {paleosol}.
e.zh: 这层红色地层被认定为古土壤。

e.en: A buried {paleosol} can preserve traces of ancient roots.
e.zh: 被埋藏的化石土壤能保存古代根系痕迹。

e.en: The exhibit showed {paleotechnic} methods of stone working.
e.zh: 展览展示了早期石器加工技术。

e.en: His essay contrasted modern tools with {paleotechnic} skills.
e.zh: 他的文章把现代工具同古技术技能作了对比。

e.en: Shell chemistry can indicate ancient {paleotemperature}.
e.zh: 贝壳的化学成分可以指示古温度。

e.en: The study reconstructed {paleotemperature} from ice cores.
e.zh: 这项研究根据冰芯重建了古温度。

e.en: The paper described the {paleothalamus} in comparative anatomy.
e.zh: 论文在比较解剖学中描述了古丘脑。

e.en: Some neurologists use {paleothalamus} for an older brain division.
e.zh: 一些神经学家用古丘脑指称较早的脑部划分。

paleozoologist.t: 古动物学家；化石动物研究者

e.en: The {paleozoologist} compared the fossil jaw with modern reptiles.
e.zh: 这位古动物学家把化石颌骨同现代爬行动物作比较。

e.en: A senior {paleozoologist} explained why the bones belonged to an extinct horse.
e.zh: 一位资深古动物学家解释了为什么这些骨头属于一种已灭绝的马。

paleozoology.t: 古动物学；化石动物研究

e.en: She studied {paleozoology} to understand ancient animal life.
e.zh: 她研究古动物学，以了解远古动物的生活。

e.en: The museum's {paleozoology} collection includes shells, teeth, and bones.
e.zh: 博物馆的古动物学藏品包括贝壳、牙齿和骨骼。

palestra.t: 古希腊摔跤学校；体育训练场

e.en: Young athletes gathered in the {palestra} before sunrise.
e.zh: 年轻运动员在日出前聚集到古希腊体育训练场。

e.en: The ruined {palestra} still showed traces of its exercise rooms.
e.zh: 这座废弃的摔跤学校仍能看出训练室的遗迹。

e.en: He wore a dark {paletot} over his evening clothes.
e.zh: 他在晚礼服外面穿了一件深色宽松短大衣。

e.en: The old portrait shows her holding a fur-lined {paletot}.
e.zh: 那幅旧画像中，她手里拿着一件毛皮衬里的旧式外套。

e.en: She mixed the paint with a {palette-knife} instead of a brush.
e.zh: 她没有用画笔，而是用调色刀调颜料。

e.en: The artist used a {palette-knife} to scrape texture into the canvas.
e.zh: 画家用油画刮刀在画布上刮出肌理。

palevent.t: 盾形纹章中的浅色纹带

e.en: The shield displayed a silver {palevent} down the center.
e.zh: 盾牌中央有一道银色的浅色纹带。

e.en: Heraldry students argued about whether the {palevent} was properly drawn.
e.zh: 纹章学学生争论那条浅色纹带画得是否合规。

e.en: The three swords were shown {palewise} on the family crest.
e.zh: 家族纹章上的三把剑呈垂直排列。

e.en: In heraldic terms, the arrows lie {palewise} rather than crosswise.
e.zh: 按纹章学说法，这些箭是纵向排列，而不是横向交叉。

e.en: The priest's {palidium} was embroidered with small crosses.
e.zh: 神父的小斗篷上绣着小十字。

e.en: A wool {palidium} protected the traveler from the evening cold.
e.zh: 一件羊毛披肩式外衣帮旅人抵御夜晚的寒气。

e.en: The coral had {paliform} ridges around its central cup.
e.zh: 这块珊瑚的中央杯周围有栅栏状脊突。

e.en: Under the lens, the tissue showed a {paliform} arrangement.
e.zh: 在镜头下，这种组织呈现出似尖桩的排列。

palikar.t: 希腊或阿尔巴尼亚勇士

e.en: The ballad praises a brave {palikar} who defended the village.
e.zh: 这首民谣赞颂了一位保卫村庄的勇敢希腊勇士。

e.en: In the old story, the {palikar} returns home after the war.
e.zh: 在这个古老故事里，那名阿尔巴尼亚勇士战后回到家乡。

e.en: The botanist described the leaf as {palinactinodromous}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这片叶描述为掌状脉再分枝的类型。

e.en: A {palinactinodromous} vein pattern can help identify the fossil leaf.
e.zh: 掌状脉再分枝的叶脉形态有助于识别这片化石叶。

e.en: The {palindromist} spent hours perfecting a sentence that read both ways.
e.zh: 这位回文作者花了数小时完善一句正反都能读的句子。

e.en: As a playful {palindromist}, she hid jokes inside symmetrical phrases.
e.zh: 作为爱玩的回文高手，她把笑话藏在对称短语里。

e.en: The patient reported {palinesthesia} after the pressure test ended.
e.zh: 压力测试结束后，病人报告仍有感觉复现。

e.en: Neurologists considered {palinesthesia} a clue to the sensory disturbance.
e.zh: 神经科医生认为刺激后余觉是感觉障碍的线索。

e.en: The philosopher used {palingenesis} to describe the soul's rebirth.
e.zh: 这位哲学家用轮回来描述灵魂的再生。

e.en: Older biology texts sometimes linked embryology with {palingenesis}.
e.zh: 较早的生物学著作有时把胚胎学同种系重演联系起来。

e.en: The {palingenesist} argued that history moves through cycles of renewal.
e.zh: 这位再生论者认为历史会经历一轮轮更新。

e.en: As a religious {palingenesist}, he believed the soul could be born again.
e.zh: 作为宗教上的轮回论者，他相信灵魂能够再生。

e.en: The poem has a {palingenetic} vision of society after collapse.
e.zh: 这首诗呈现了社会崩溃后再生的愿景。

e.en: The lecturer discussed a {palingenetic} theory of embryonic development.
e.zh: 讲师讨论了一种关于胚胎发育重演的理论。

e.en: The {palingenist} saw revolution as a form of national rebirth.
e.zh: 这位再生论者把革命看作民族重生的一种形式。

e.en: A committed {palingenist}, she wrote essays on spiritual renewal.
e.zh: 她是坚定的重生论者，写过多篇关于精神更新的文章。

e.en: The essay treats {palingeny} as a metaphor for cultural renewal.
e.zh: 这篇文章把再生视为文化更新的隐喻。

e.en: In obsolete biology, {palingeny} referred to ancestral traits reappearing in development.
e.zh: 在旧生物学中，发育重演指祖先性状在发育中重新出现。

e.en: After the scandal, the critic published a {palinode} in the newspaper.
e.zh: 丑闻过后，那位评论家在报纸上发表文章公开收回前言。

e.en: The poet's {palinode} gently retracts the harsh lines of an earlier poem.
e.zh: 诗人的改口诗温和地撤回了早先诗作中尖刻的句子。

e.en: The settlers built a {palisado} around the camp.
e.zh: 定居者在营地周围建起木栅防御工事。

e.en: A broken {palisado} still marked the edge of the old fort.
e.zh: 一段残破的尖桩木栅仍标示着旧堡垒的边界。

e.en: The fort was guarded by rough wooden {palisadoes}.
e.zh: 这座堡垒由粗糙的木栅守护。

e.en: Beyond the {palisadoes}, the forest grew dark and silent.
e.zh: 木栅之外，森林变得幽暗而寂静。

e.en: The cabinet was made from polished {palisander}.
e.zh: 这个柜子是用抛光紫檀木制成的。

e.en: A strip of {palisander} gave the violin a darker tone.
e.zh: 一条玫瑰木让这把小提琴的音色更深沉。

palish.t: 稍显苍白的；有点浅淡的

e.en: A {palish} light entered the room before dawn.
e.zh: 黎明前，一道稍显苍白的光照进房间。

e.en: Her dress was a {palish} green that looked almost silver.
e.zh: 她的裙子是有点浅淡的绿色，看起来几乎像银色。

e.en: The official traveled through the town in a {palkee}.
e.zh: 那名官员乘着轿子穿过城镇。

e.en: Servants carried the covered {palkee} along the dusty road.
e.zh: 仆人们抬着有篷的旧式印度轿舆走过尘土飞扬的道路。

e.en: His oldest friend served as a {pall-bearer} at the funeral.
e.zh: 葬礼上，他最老的朋友担任扶柩者。

e.en: Each {pall-bearer} walked slowly beside the coffin.
e.zh: 每位抬棺人都缓慢地走在棺木旁。

e.en: The old diary mentions a game of {pall-mall} in the park.
e.zh: 那本旧日记提到有人在公园里玩槌球古戏。

e.en: A fashionable {pall-mall} once stood near the palace gardens.
e.zh: 宫廷花园附近曾有一处时兴的槌球场。

e.en: The architect restored the villa's graceful {palladia}.
e.zh: 建筑师修复了别墅优雅的帕拉第奥式窗。

e.en: The relics were treated as {palladia} of the ancient city.
e.zh: 这些圣物被视为那座古城的守护物。

e.en: The chemist prepared a {palladic} salt for the reaction.
e.zh: 化学家为这次反应制备了一种四价钯盐。

e.en: A thin {palladic} coating improved the sensor's stability.
e.zh: 一层薄薄的钯涂层提高了传感器的稳定性。

e.en: The report described a {palladious} compound formed in solution.
e.zh: 报告描述了溶液中形成的一种二价钯化合物。

e.en: They compared {palladious} salts with similar nickel compounds.
e.zh: 他们把亚钯盐与类似的镍化合物作了比较。

e.en: Engineers planned to {palladiumize} the metal surface.
e.zh: 工程师计划给金属表面镀钯。

e.en: The lab can {palladiumize} ceramic samples for testing.
e.zh: 实验室可以用钯处理陶瓷样品以便测试。

e.en: The {palladiumized} wire resisted corrosion better than copper.
e.zh: 这根镀钯的金属丝比铜更耐腐蚀。

e.en: A {palladiumized} catalyst was placed inside the reactor.
e.zh: 一个经钯处理的催化剂被放入反应器中。

e.en: The workshop is {palladiumizing} contacts for electronic switches.
e.zh: 车间正在为电子开关触点进行镀钯处理。

e.en: Careful {palladiumizing} made the sample suitable for analysis.
e.zh: 细致的钯处理使样品适合进行分析。

e.en: They decided to {palladize} the electrode before measurement.
e.zh: 他们决定在测量前给电极镀钯。

e.en: The process can {palladize} fibers without damaging them.
e.zh: 这种工艺能使纤维含钯而不损伤纤维。

e.en: The reaction produced a dark {palladous} oxide.
e.zh: 反应生成了一种深色的二价钯氧化物。

e.en: Students learned why {palladous} salts behave differently in acid.
e.zh: 学生们了解了亚钯盐为何在酸中表现不同。

e.en: The museum displayed a polished slice of {pallasite}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一片抛光的橄榄石铁陨石。

e.en: Collectors prize {pallasite} for its green crystals in metal.
e.zh: 收藏者珍视橄榄石铁陨石，因为金属中嵌着绿色晶体。

e.en: The neurologist tested her {pallesthesia} with a tuning fork.
e.zh: 神经科医生用音叉测试她的振动觉。

e.en: Loss of {pallesthesia} may suggest nerve damage in the feet.
e.zh: 足部振动觉丧失可能提示神经受损。

e.en: Workers {palletize} the boxes before loading the truck.
e.zh: 工人在装车前把箱子码放到托盘上。

e.en: The software tells the robot how to {palletize} each order.
e.zh: 软件会指示机器人如何将每个订单托盘化。

e.en: The new {palletizer} stacks cartons faster than the old line.
e.zh: 新的码垛机堆叠纸箱的速度比旧生产线快。

e.en: A technician adjusted the {palletizer} after the sensor failed.
e.zh: 传感器故障后，技术员调试了托盘装载机。

e.en: The bishop's white {pallia} were kept in a special chest.
e.zh: 主教的白色披带被存放在一个专用箱中。

e.en: The study compared the {pallia} of several vertebrate brains.
e.zh: 这项研究比较了几种脊椎动物大脑的皮质层。

e.en: The pamphlet mocked him as a drunken {palliard}.
e.zh: 那本小册子嘲笑他是个醉醺醺的下贱人。

e.en: In the old play, a {palliard} begs outside the tavern.
e.zh: 在那出旧戏里，一个流浪乞丐在酒馆外乞讨。

e.en: The soldier slept on a straw {palliasse} in the barracks.
e.zh: 士兵在营房里睡在一张草垫床上。

e.en: She shook the dusty {palliasse} before laying it down.
e.zh: 她先抖了抖满是灰尘的简陋床垫才铺下。

e.en: The medicine offered {palliation} but could not cure the disease.
e.zh: 这种药能缓解症状，但无法治愈疾病。

e.en: Hospice care focuses on {palliation} and comfort near the end of life.
e.zh: 临终关怀侧重于姑息治疗和生命末期的舒适。

e.en: Morphine can be a powerful {palliator} of severe pain.
e.zh: 吗啡可以成为缓解剧痛的强效药物。

e.en: The nurse acted as a careful {palliator} during his final weeks.
e.zh: 在他生命的最后几周，护士细心地提供姑息照护。

e.en: The doctor recommended {palliatory} treatment for his symptoms.
e.zh: 医生建议对他的症状采取缓解性治疗。

e.en: Her apology was only a {palliatory} gesture after the damage.
e.zh: 造成伤害之后，她的道歉只是一个姑息性的姿态。

pallidin.t: 苍白菌素；生物化学蛋白

e.en: Researchers measured {pallidin} levels in the tissue sample.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了组织样本中的苍白菌素水平。

e.en: A mutation in {pallidin} affected the cell's pigment granules.
e.zh: 苍白菌素发生突变影响了细胞的色素颗粒。

e.en: The archbishop wore a white {pallium} over his vestments.
e.zh: 大主教在法衣外披着一条白色披带。

e.en: The bird's {pallium} performs functions once linked only to mammals.
e.zh: 鸟类的大脑皮质层执行着过去被认为只属于哺乳动物的功能。

e.en: Several ceremonial {palliums} were displayed in the cathedral.
e.zh: 大教堂里陈列着几条礼仪披带。

e.en: The paper compared the {palliums} of reptiles and birds.
e.zh: 这篇论文比较了爬行动物和鸟类的大脑皮质层。

pallograph.t: 振动记录仪；震颤描记器

e.en: The engineer calibrated the {pallograph} before the vibration test.
e.zh: 工程师在振动测试前校准了振动记录仪。

e.en: A medical {pallograph} traced the tremor in the patient's hand.
e.zh: 一台医用震颤描记器记录了患者手部的震颤。

e.en: The detective found a clear {palm-print} on the glass door.
e.zh: 侦探在玻璃门上发现了清晰的掌纹。

e.en: The scanner records each visitor's {palm-print} for security.
e.zh: 扫描仪会记录每位访客的手掌印以确保安全。

e.en: She typed the address into a small {palm-top} device.
e.zh: 她把地址输入一台小型掌上设备。

e.en: Old {palm-top} computers had tiny screens and simple calendars.
e.zh: 旧式掌上电脑屏幕很小，只带简单日历。

e.en: A tall {palm-tree} stood beside the beach cafe.
e.zh: 海滩咖啡馆旁边立着一棵高高的棕榈树。

e.en: They planted a {palm-tree} in the hotel courtyard.
e.zh: 他们在酒店庭院里种了一棵棕榈树。

e.en: The garden specializes in {palmaceous} plants from warm climates.
e.zh: 这座花园专门种植来自温暖气候的棕榈科植物。

e.en: Its broad leaves give the shrub a {palmaceous} appearance.
e.zh: 宽大的叶子让这灌木显得有点像棕榈。

e.en: The doctor checked the {palmar} surface for cuts.
e.zh: 医生检查了手掌面是否有割伤。

e.en: The nerve supplies sensation to the {palmar} side of the thumb.
e.zh: 这条神经负责拇指掌侧的感觉。

e.en: Her {palmary} achievement was the reform of the school system.
e.zh: 她最卓越的成就是改革了学校制度。

e.en: The judge called honesty the {palmary} virtue in public service.
e.zh: 法官称诚实是公共服务中首要的美德。

e.en: The maple has {palmate} leaves with five pointed lobes.
e.zh: 枫树有五裂尖端的掌状叶。

e.en: Some water birds have {palmate} feet for swimming.
e.zh: 有些水鸟长着适合游泳的蹼状脚。

e.en: The duck's {palmated} feet pushed strongly through the water.
e.zh: 鸭子的蹼足有力地划过水面。

e.en: A {palmated} leaf spreads from one central point.
e.zh: 掌状叶会从一个中心点向外展开。

e.en: The botanist described the leaf as {palmatifid} in her notes.
e.zh: 植物学家在笔记中把这片叶子描述为掌状深裂。

e.en: A {palmatifid} blade has deep cuts radiating from the base.
e.zh: 掌状深裂的叶片有从基部放射出的深裂口。

palmatine.t: 掌叶防己碱；小檗类生物碱

e.en: The extract contained {palmatine} and several related alkaloids.
e.zh: 这种提取物含有掌叶防己碱和几种相关生物碱。

e.en: Researchers measured {palmatine} levels in the herbal sample.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了草药样本中的掌叶防己碱含量。

e.en: The leaf's {palmation} helps identify the species.
e.zh: 叶子的掌状结构有助于识别这个物种。

e.en: The bird shows slight {palmation} between the front toes.
e.zh: 这种鸟前趾之间有轻微的蹼状形成。

e.en: He filmed the parade with a tiny {palmcorder}.
e.zh: 他用一台小型掌上摄像机拍摄游行。

e.en: The old {palmcorder} still records family videos on tape.
e.zh: 那台旧掌上摄像机仍能用磁带录家庭录像。

e.en: A {palmerworm} had eaten holes through the young leaves.
e.zh: 一条食叶毛虫把嫩叶咬出了洞。

e.en: The old sermon compared greed to a devouring {palmerworm}.
e.zh: 那篇旧布道把贪婪比作吞噬一切的害虫。

e.en: The chemist separated {palmin} from the vegetable fat.
e.zh: 化学家从植物脂肪中分离出棕榈脂。

e.en: Older recipes sometimes mention {palmin} as a cooking fat.
e.zh: 老菜谱有时会把棕榈脂列为烹调用油脂。

e.en: A duck is a familiar {palmiped} bird.
e.zh: 鸭子是一种常见的蹼足鸟。

e.en: The museum displayed a {palmiped} specimen from the coast.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件来自海岸的蹼足鸟标本。

e.en: The guide grouped ducks and geese among the {palmipedes}.
e.zh: 这本指南把鸭和鹅归入蹼足鸟类。

e.en: Many {palmipedes} are strong swimmers but awkward walkers.
e.zh: 许多蹼足鸟很会游泳，但走路笨拙。

palmital.t: 棕榈醛的；棕榈酸相关的

e.en: The paper discussed {palmital} compounds in the oil sample.
e.zh: 论文讨论了油样中的棕榈醛类化合物。

e.en: A {palmital} derivative was isolated during the experiment.
e.zh: 实验中分离出一种棕榈酸相关衍生物。

e.en: The supplement contains vitamin A {palmitate}.
e.zh: 这种补充剂含有维生素A棕榈酸酯。

e.en: Sodium {palmitate} is used in some soaps.
e.zh: 棕榈酸钠用于一些肥皂中。

e.en: Butter contains a notable amount of {palmitic} acid.
e.zh: 黄油含有相当多的棕榈酸。

e.en: The lab measured the {palmitic} content of the oil.
e.zh: 实验室测量了这种油的棕榈酸含量。

e.en: Pure {palmitin} melts at a relatively high temperature.
e.zh: 纯棕榈精在较高温度下熔化。

e.en: The sample contained stearin, olein, and {palmitin}.
e.zh: 样本中含有硬脂精、油精和棕榈精。

e.en: The reaction produced a small amount of {palmitone}.
e.zh: 该反应生成了少量棕榈酮。

e.en: They identified {palmitone} by its spectrum.
e.zh: 他们通过光谱鉴定出棕榈酮。

e.en: The molecule includes a long {palmityl} chain.
e.zh: 这个分子包含一条很长的棕榈基链。

e.en: A {palmityl} group can affect how the compound dissolves.
e.zh: 棕榈酰基会影响该化合物的溶解方式。

e.en: The biscuits are made with {palmoil}.
e.zh: 这些饼干是用棕榈油制作的。

e.en: Farmers sell {palmoil} to food and soap factories.
e.zh: 农民把棕榈油卖给食品厂和肥皂厂。

e.en: The old roof was covered with {palmyra} leaves.
e.zh: 旧屋顶铺着扇叶棕榈的叶子。

e.en: Villagers carved the beam from hard {palmyra}.
e.zh: 村民们用坚硬的棕榈木雕成横梁。

e.en: The vendor cracked a {palnut} for the children.
e.zh: 小贩给孩子们敲开了一颗棕榈果仁。

e.en: Oil was pressed from dried {palnuts}.
e.zh: 油是从晒干的棕榈果仁中榨出来的。

e.en: The scholar compared each {palograph} with the inscription.
e.zh: 学者把每份古文字记录同碑文作比较。

e.en: A clear {palograph} helped date the manuscript.
e.zh: 一张清晰的古文字图帮助判定了手稿年代。

e.en: Islanders gathered {palolo} during the night tide.
e.zh: 岛民在夜潮时采集帕洛洛海虫。

e.en: The annual {palolo} rise drew many curious visitors.
e.zh: 一年一度的帕洛洛海虫上浮吸引了许多好奇游客。

e.en: He joked that the tour ended in {Palookaville}.
e.zh: 他开玩笑说巡演最后到了一个无名小镇。

e.en: After the scandal, the champion felt exiled to {Palookaville}.
e.zh: 丑闻之后，那位冠军觉得自己被打入了落魄之地。

e.en: The park hosted a weekend food {palooza}.
e.zh: 公园举办了一场周末美食狂欢活动。

e.en: Their launch became a media {palooza}.
e.zh: 他们的发布会变成了一场媒体盛会。

e.en: A yellow {paloverde} shaded the desert path.
e.zh: 一棵开黄花的绿皮豆科树遮住了沙漠小路。

e.en: The {paloverde} blooms after spring rain.
e.zh: 绿皮豆科树在春雨后开花。

e.en: The {palpability} of the lump worried the doctor.
e.zh: 肿块能够触摸到这一点让医生担心。

e.en: There was a strange {palpability} to her fear.
e.zh: 她的恐惧有一种奇怪的真实可感。

e.en: The insect's {palpal} segments were unusually long.
e.zh: 这只昆虫的须肢节异常地长。

e.en: A {palpal} organ helps the spider sense its prey.
e.zh: 触须器官帮助蜘蛛感知猎物。

e.en: The surgeon found a {palpatant} swelling below the rib.
e.zh: 外科医生在肋骨下方发现一处可触知的肿胀。

e.en: His anger was almost {palpatant} in the silent room.
e.zh: 在寂静的房间里，他的怒气几乎明显可感。

e.en: The nurse performed a brief {palpatory} examination.
e.zh: 护士做了一次简短的触诊检查。

e.en: Good {palpatory} skill takes practice.
e.zh: 熟练的触诊技巧需要练习。

e.en: The upper {palpebra} was red and swollen.
e.zh: 上眼睑又红又肿。

e.en: A small cut marked the patient's {palpebra}.
e.zh: 病人的眼睑上有一道小伤口。

e.en: The doctor checked the {palpebral} reflex carefully.
e.zh: 医生仔细检查了眼睑反射。

e.en: A mild {palpebral} infection caused the swelling.
e.zh: 轻微的眼睑感染导致了肿胀。

e.en: Some animals {palpebrate} slowly in bright light.
e.zh: 有些动物在强光下会慢慢眨眼。

e.en: The specimen was clearly {palpebrate}, unlike its relative.
e.zh: 这个标本显然有眼睑，不同于它的近缘种。

e.en: The {palpebrated} eye was drawn in fine detail.
e.zh: 这只有眼睑的眼睛被画得十分细致。

e.en: She had {palpebrated} only once during the test.
e.zh: 她在测试中只眨过一次眼。

e.en: The lizard {palpebrates} when sand blows across its face.
e.zh: 沙子吹过脸时，这只蜥蜴会眨眼。

e.en: The study compared {palpebrates} with lidless species.
e.zh: 这项研究比较了有眼睑动物和无眼睑物种。

e.en: The {palpebrating} infant soon fell asleep.
e.zh: 那个正在眨眼的婴儿很快睡着了。

e.en: A {palpebrating} motion protects the surface of the eye.
e.zh: 眨眼动作能保护眼球表面。

e.en: The moth's {palpi} curved upward beside its mouth.
e.zh: 飞蛾的触须在口器旁向上弯曲。

e.en: Spiders use their {palpi} during mating.
e.zh: 蜘蛛在交配时会使用须肢。

e.en: She heard the {palpitant} beat of her heart.
e.zh: 她听见自己心脏悸动的跳声。

e.en: The leaves looked {palpitant} in the hot air.
e.zh: 叶子在热气中显得微微颤动。

e.en: The diagram labeled the crab's {palpognath} clearly.
e.zh: 图中清楚标出了螃蟹的颚须结构。

e.en: Damage to the {palpognath} affected the specimen's feeding.
e.zh: 颚须受损影响了这个标本的取食。

e.en: The beetle moved a {palpus} toward the sugar.
e.zh: 甲虫把一根触须伸向糖。

e.en: Each {palpus} helps the spider handle food.
e.zh: 每个须肢都帮助蜘蛛处理食物。

e.en: A low {palsa} rose above the wet tundra.
e.zh: 一座低矮的泥炭冻胀丘高出潮湿的苔原。

e.en: Warming can cause a {palsa} to collapse.
e.zh: 气候变暖可能导致泥炭冻胀丘塌陷。

e.en: The old charter named him {palsgrave} of the Rhine.
e.zh: 那份古老宪章称他为莱茵的普法尔茨伯爵。

e.en: A {palsgrave} held rank among the imperial nobles.
e.zh: 普法尔茨伯爵在帝国贵族中拥有地位。

e.en: The {palsgravine} received guests in the winter hall.
e.zh: 普法尔茨伯爵夫人在冬厅接待宾客。

e.en: Her seal identified her as a {palsgravine}.
e.zh: 她的印章表明她是普法尔茨伯爵夫人。

e.en: Their {palship} began during a long voyage.
e.zh: 他们的朋友关系始于一次漫长航行。

e.en: He valued {palship} more than formal alliance.
e.zh: 他更看重伙伴情谊，而不是正式同盟。

e.en: The museum displayed a Bronze Age {palstave}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件青铜时代的扁斧。

e.en: A farmer found the {palstave} beneath the field.
e.zh: 一名农民在田地下发现了这件古代斧具。

e.en: They became {palsy-walsy} after one meeting.
e.zh: 他们只见了一面就显得过分亲热。

e.en: I distrust his {palsy-walsy} tone with strangers.
e.zh: 我不信任他对陌生人那种装熟的语气。

e.en: The salesman sounded {palsywalsy} on the phone.
e.zh: 那个销售在电话里听起来过分套近乎。

e.en: She avoided his {palsywalsy} invitations to dinner.
e.zh: 她避开了他那些装熟的晚餐邀请。

paltrier.t: 更微不足道的；更卑劣的

e.en: He accepted a {paltrier} reward than expected.
e.zh: 他接受了比预期更微不足道的报酬。

e.en: No {paltrier} excuse could have been offered.
e.zh: 再没有比这更卑劣的借口了。

paltriest.t: 最微不足道的；最卑劣的

e.en: It was the {paltriest} sum in the budget.
e.zh: 那是预算里最微不足道的一笔钱。

e.en: He chose the {paltriest} way to win.
e.zh: 他选择了最卑劣的方式取胜。

e.en: The workers were {paltrily} paid for dangerous labor.
e.zh: 工人做着危险工作，却只拿到微薄报酬。

e.en: He {paltrily} blamed the mistake on an intern.
e.zh: 他卑劣地把错误归咎于一名实习生。

e.en: The {paltriness} of the offer angered them.
e.zh: 报价之低让他们感到愤怒。

e.en: She saw the {paltriness} behind his apology.
e.zh: 她看出了他道歉背后的卑劣。

e.en: The team studied {paludal} plants near the river.
e.zh: 团队研究了河边的沼泽植物。

e.en: Malaria once spread through many {paludal} districts.
e.zh: 疟疾曾在许多沼泽地区传播。

e.en: The statue shows a commander wearing a {paludament}.
e.zh: 这尊雕像展示了一位披着将军披风的统帅。

e.en: His red {paludament} marked his military authority.
e.zh: 他的红色将军披风象征着军事权威。

e.en: The frog is a typical {paludicole}.
e.zh: 这种蛙是典型的沼泽栖居生物。

e.en: Each {paludicole} depends on shallow wetland water.
e.zh: 每种沼泽生物都依赖浅层湿地水域。

e.en: Several {paludicolous} birds nest in the reeds.
e.zh: 几种沼泽栖息鸟类在芦苇丛中筑巢。

e.en: The survey focused on {paludicolous} insects.
e.zh: 这项调查重点关注沼生昆虫。

e.en: Doctors once called the fever {paludism}.
e.zh: 医生们曾把这种发热称为疟疾。

e.en: Drainage projects reduced {paludism} in the valley.
e.zh: 排水工程减少了山谷中的沼泽热。

e.en: The map marked the coast as {paludose} ground.
e.zh: 地图把这片海岸标为多沼泽地带。

e.en: Their boots sank into the {paludose} soil.
e.zh: 他们的靴子陷进了沼泽状的泥土里。

e.en: The Latin word {palus} means a marsh.
e.zh: 拉丁词palus的意思是沼泽。

e.en: Astronomers named the lunar plain {palus}.
e.zh: 天文学家把那片月面平原称作湿地。

e.en: The report described a fragile {palustral} habitat.
e.zh: 报告描述了一处脆弱的湿地栖息地。

e.en: They collected samples from {palustral} sediments.
e.zh: 他们从沼泽沉积物中采集了样本。

e.en: The basin contains several {palustrine} wetlands.
e.zh: 这个盆地包含几处沼泽湿地。

e.en: Geologists identified a {palustrine} layer in the rock.
e.zh: 地质学家在岩石中辨认出湿地形成的岩层。

e.en: A {paly} light filled the room at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时，一片苍白的光照进房间。

e.en: The shield was {paly} in silver and blue.
e.zh: 那面盾牌饰有银蓝相间的竖条纹。

e.en: The clay contains fine fibers of {palygorskite}.
e.zh: 这种黏土含有细小的坡缕石纤维。

e.en: Researchers used {palygorskite} to absorb the dye.
e.zh: 研究人员用凹凸棒石吸附染料。

e.en: The report included a {palynological} analysis of the soil samples.
e.zh: 报告包含了对土壤样本的孢粉学分析。

e.en: Her {palynological} evidence helped date the ancient settlement.
e.zh: 她的花粉研究证据帮助确定了古代聚落的年代。

palynologically.t: 从孢粉学角度；按花粉分析

e.en: The cave layers were dated {palynologically} using preserved pollen grains.
e.zh: 这些洞穴地层通过保存下来的花粉粒从孢粉学角度确定年代。

e.en: The two sites are {palynologically} similar despite their distance.
e.zh: 尽管相距很远，这两个地点在孢粉学上很相似。

e.en: She studied {palynology} to understand ancient climates.
e.zh: 她学习孢粉学，以了解古代气候。

e.en: In forensics, {palynology} can link a suspect to a location.
e.zh: 在法医学中，孢粉学可以把嫌疑人与某个地点联系起来。

palynomorph.t: 孢粉形体；微体化石颗粒

e.en: Each {palynomorph} was photographed under the microscope.
e.zh: 每个孢粉形体都在显微镜下拍了照。

e.en: A fossil {palynomorph} can reveal details about past vegetation.
e.zh: 一个化石孢粉形体能透露过去植被的细节。

palytoxin.t: 岩沙海葵毒素；帕利毒素

e.en: The reef sample contained traces of {palytoxin}.
