e.zh: 这条路的修补是整个地区最东一块西一块的。

e.en: The rent is now {past-due} and must be paid today.
e.zh: 房租现在已经逾期，必须今天支付。

e.en: She received a notice about a {past-due} library book.
e.zh: 她收到了一张关于逾期未还图书的通知。

e.en: He is a {past-master} at turning complaints into compliments.
e.zh: 他很擅长把抱怨转化成称赞，堪称老手。

e.en: The chef was a {past-master} of simple country cooking.
e.zh: 这位厨师是朴素乡村菜的行家。

e.en: The designer checked the final {paste-up} before printing.
e.zh: 设计师在印刷前检查了最后的拼版样稿。

e.en: Old magazines were assembled by hand from a {paste-up}.
e.zh: 旧杂志过去常根据手工拼贴的版面来排版。

e.en: The bookbinder replaced the torn {pastedown} inside the cover.
e.zh: 装订工更换了封面内侧破损的粘贴衬页。

e.en: A small label was hidden on the rear {pastedown}.
e.zh: 后封面的贴页上藏着一张小标签。

e.en: The mixture became {pastelike} after a few minutes of stirring.
e.zh: 搅拌几分钟后，混合物变成了糊状。

e.en: The soil had a heavy, {pastelike} texture after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后泥土质地厚重，像浆糊一样黏。

e.en: The {pastelist} used soft colors for the child's portrait.
e.zh: 这位粉彩画家用柔和的颜色画了孩子的肖像。

e.en: As a skilled {pastelist}, she preferred paper with a rough surface.
e.zh: 作为熟练的粉彩画家，她更喜欢表面粗糙的纸。

e.en: The {pastellist} captured the evening light with delicate strokes.
e.zh: 这位粉彩画家用细腻的笔触捕捉了傍晚的光线。

e.en: A local {pastellist} taught the workshop on portrait drawing.
e.zh: 一位本地粉彩画家教授了肖像画工作坊。

e.en: The vet tested the rabbit for {pasteurellosis} after it developed breathing problems.
e.zh: 兔子出现呼吸问题后，兽医检查它是否患有巴氏杆菌病。

e.en: Good hygiene can reduce the spread of {pasteurellosis} in a crowded kennel.
e.zh: 良好的卫生条件能减少巴氏杆菌病在拥挤犬舍中的传播。

e.en: Milk undergoes {pasteurisation} before it reaches most supermarkets.
e.zh: 牛奶进入多数超市前都会经过巴氏杀菌。

e.en: The factory improved {pasteurisation} to make the juice safer.
e.zh: 工厂改进了巴氏杀菌工艺，使果汁更安全。

e.en: The dairy will {pasteurise} the milk before bottling it.
e.zh: 乳品厂会在装瓶前对牛奶进行巴氏杀菌。

e.en: Some producers {pasteurise} cider to extend its shelf life.
e.zh: 一些生产商会对苹果酒进行巴氏杀菌以延长保质期。

e.en: Early supporters of {pasteurism} argued that microbes caused many diseases.
e.zh: 巴斯德学说的早期支持者认为微生物会导致许多疾病。

e.en: The lecture traced {pasteurism} through nineteenth-century medicine.
e.zh: 讲座梳理了巴斯德学说在十九世纪医学中的发展。

e.en: The opera was a {pasticcio} made from several composers' music.
e.zh: 这部歌剧是由几位作曲家的音乐拼成的混成作品。

e.en: We ordered a rich {pasticcio} baked with pasta and meat sauce.
e.zh: 我们点了一份用面食和肉酱烤成的浓郁意式烤菜。

e.en: The critic called him a clever {pasticheur} of Victorian prose.
e.zh: 评论家称他是维多利亚散文风格的聪明模仿者。

e.en: A good {pasticheur} borrows a style without merely copying it.
e.zh: 优秀的拼仿作者会借用风格，而不是单纯照抄。

e.en: She bought a hot {pastie} from the bakery at lunchtime.
e.zh: 午餐时她在面包店买了一个热馅饼。

e.en: The dancer wore glittering {pasties} as part of the costume.
e.zh: 舞者把闪亮的乳贴作为演出服的一部分。

e.en: He looked {pastier} after three days indoors.
e.zh: 在室内待了三天后，他看起来更苍白了。

e.en: Add less water if you want a {pastier} dough.
e.zh: 如果你想要更糊状的面团，就少加点水。

e.en: He was the {pastiest} person on the beach.
e.zh: 他是海滩上肤色最苍白的人。

e.en: This batch made the {pastiest} sauce of the three.
e.zh: 这一次做出的酱是三批里最糊状的。

e.en: She sucked a herbal {pastil} to soothe her throat.
e.zh: 她含了一片草本锭剂来缓解喉咙不适。

e.en: The room smelled of a burning {pastil} of incense.
e.zh: 房间里有一枚燃烧香锭散发出的气味。

e.en: The soup was filled with tiny stars of {pastina}.
e.zh: 汤里满是星星形的小粒意面。

e.en: Parents often cook {pastina} for children because it is easy to eat.
e.zh: 父母常给孩子煮小粒意面，因为它容易吃。

e.en: The doctor noticed the {pastiness} of his skin.
e.zh: 医生注意到他的皮肤显得苍白。

e.en: Extra flour reduced the unpleasant {pastiness} of the sauce.
e.zh: 多加一些面粉减轻了酱汁令人不快的糊状感。

e.en: The technician checked the {pastometer} during milk processing.
e.zh: 技术员在牛奶加工过程中检查了巴氏杀菌测温器。

e.en: A faulty {pastometer} can give misleading temperature readings.
e.zh: 有故障的巴氏杀菌测温器可能给出误导性的温度读数。

e.en: The old dairy still used a mechanical {pastomiter}.
e.zh: 那家老乳品厂仍在使用机械式巴氏杀菌测温器。

e.en: They replaced the {pastomiter} after the inspection.
e.zh: 检查之后，他们更换了巴氏杀菌测温器。

e.en: The village {pastorage} stood beside the small church.
e.zh: 村里的牧师住宅就在小教堂旁边。

e.en: He accepted the {pastorage} after years of study.
e.zh: 多年学习后，他接受了这个牧师职位。

e.en: The novel's {pastoralization} of village life ignores poverty and hard labor.
e.zh: 这部小说把乡村生活田园化，忽视了贫困和艰苦劳动。

e.en: The report studied the {pastoralization} of farming communities in the region.
e.zh: 报告研究了该地区农业社区向牧业化转变的过程。

patchouly.t: 广藿香；广藿香香味；广藿香精油

e.en: The old scarf smelled faintly of {patchouly}.
e.zh: 那条旧围巾隐约有广藿香的味道。

e.en: She added a drop of {patchouly} to the perfume blend.
e.zh: 她在香水配方里加了一滴广藿香精油。

e.en: The technician labeled every port on the {patchpanel}.
e.zh: 技术员给配线架上的每个端口都贴了标签。

e.en: A crowded {patchpanel} can make network faults hard to trace.
e.zh: 拥挤的接插面板会让网络故障更难追查。

e.en: He replaced the damaged {patchplug} before testing the line.
e.zh: 他在测试线路前更换了损坏的接插插头。

e.en: Each {patchplug} must fit firmly into the switchboard socket.
e.zh: 每个跳线插头都必须牢牢插入交换板插孔。

e.en: The scan showed small fractures in both {patellae}.
e.zh: 扫描显示两侧髌骨都有细小骨折。

e.en: Strong thigh muscles help protect the {patellae} during running.
e.zh: 强壮的大腿肌肉有助于在跑步时保护髌骨。

e.en: The fungus formed tiny {patellate} cups on the bark.
e.zh: 这种真菌在树皮上形成了小小的浅碟状杯体。

e.en: The botanist noted the flower's {patellate} structure under magnification.
e.zh: 植物学家在放大观察时记录了花朵的小盘状结构。

e.en: A {patellid} clung tightly to the wet rock.
e.zh: 一只帽贝科动物紧紧附着在潮湿的岩石上。

e.en: The shell's shape suggested a {patellid} rather than a snail.
e.zh: 贝壳的形状表明它更像帽贝类，而不是蜗牛。

patelliform.t: 碟形的；似髌骨或帽贝的

e.en: The specimen had a low, {patelliform} shell.
e.zh: 这个标本有一个低矮的碟形外壳。

e.en: A {patelliform} growth appeared on the surface of the bone.
e.zh: 骨表面出现了一个似髌骨形的增生。

e.en: The fossil showed a smooth, {patelloid} outline.
e.zh: 这块化石呈现出光滑的似帽贝轮廓。

e.en: The surgeon described the fragment as {patelloid} in shape.
e.zh: 外科医生说这块碎片形状类似髌骨。

e.en: The researcher used a {patellometer} to measure kneecap alignment.
e.zh: 研究人员用髌骨测量器测量膝盖骨的对齐情况。

e.en: A modern {patellometer} can record small changes after surgery.
e.zh: 现代髌骨测量器能记录术后细微变化。

e.en: The {patent-holder} licensed the design to several factories.
e.zh: 专利持有人把这项设计授权给了几家工厂。

e.en: Only the {patent-holder} can approve commercial use of the invention.
e.zh: 只有专利持有人才能批准该发明的商业使用。

e.en: The error was {patente} visible in the final calculation.
e.zh: 这个错误在最后的计算中明显可见。

e.en: The clause was written {patente}, leaving little room for dispute.
e.zh: 该条款写得十分明白，几乎没有争议空间。

patentor.t: 授予专利者；专利权授予人

e.en: The {patentor} transferred certain rights to the manufacturer.
e.zh: 专利权授予人把某些权利转让给了制造商。

e.en: In the contract, the {patentor} retained control over foreign licensing.
e.zh: 合同中，专利权授予人保留了海外许可的控制权。

e.en: The manager spoke {paternalistically} about what employees needed.
e.zh: 经理以家长式口吻谈论员工需要什么。

e.en: The law was defended {paternalistically} as protection for ordinary citizens.
e.zh: 这项法律被以家长式理由辩护为保护普通公民。

paternoster.t: 主祷文；循环式电梯；钓鱼串钩

e.en: The monks recited a {paternoster} before dawn.
e.zh: 修士们在黎明前诵读了一遍主祷文。

e.en: The office still used an old {paternoster} instead of a modern lift.
e.zh: 这栋办公室仍使用老式循环电梯，而不是现代电梯。

paternostered.t: 用循环方式移动；如念主祷文般反复说

e.en: The buckets {paternostered} slowly up the side of the mill.
e.zh: 水桶沿着磨坊侧面缓慢循环上升。

e.en: He {paternostered} the same apology until everyone stopped listening.
e.zh: 他反复念叨同一句道歉，直到没人再听。

paternosters.t: 主祷文；循环式电梯；串钩的复数

e.en: Several medieval {paternosters} were copied into the manuscript.
e.zh: 几篇中世纪主祷文被抄入这份手稿。

e.en: Old {paternosters} are rare because they can be dangerous.
e.zh: 老式循环电梯因有危险性而变得少见。

e.en: The {path-finder} marked a safe route through the marsh.
e.zh: 探路者标出了穿过沼泽的安全路线。

e.en: She became a {path-finder} for women in engineering.
e.zh: 她成了女性进入工程领域的开拓者。

e.en: The expedition needed a {pathbreaker} to cut through the forest.
e.zh: 探险队需要一名开路者穿过森林。

e.en: His study was a {pathbreaker} in modern genetics.
e.zh: 他的研究在现代遗传学中开创了先河。

e.en: Her {pathbreaking} research changed cancer treatment.
e.zh: 她的开创性研究改变了癌症治疗。

e.en: The company released a {pathbreaking} battery design.
e.zh: 这家公司发布了一种突破性的电池设计。

e.en: The old poem ends with a {pathetical} appeal for mercy.
e.zh: 这首旧诗以一段感伤的求饶作结。

e.en: His {pathetical} excuses only made the judge more impatient.
e.zh: 他那些可怜的借口只让法官更加不耐烦。

e.en: The robot's {pathfinding} failed in the crowded hallway.
e.zh: 机器人在拥挤走廊里的寻路失败了。

e.en: Her {pathfinding} work helped create a new field.
e.zh: 她的开创性工作帮助建立了一个新领域。

e.en: A narrow {pathlet} led from the gate to the shed.
e.zh: 一条狭窄的小径从门口通向棚屋。

e.en: The routing system stores each {pathlet} separately.
e.zh: 路由系统会把每个短路径片段分别存储。

e.en: The script printed the full {pathname} of each file.
e.zh: 脚本打印了每个文件的完整路径名。

e.en: Use a relative {pathname} when moving the project folder.
e.zh: 移动项目文件夹时请使用相对路径名。

e.en: The backup tool stores old {pathnames} in a log.
e.zh: 备份工具会把旧的路径名保存在日志里。

e.en: Long {pathnames} can make commands hard to read.
e.zh: 过长的路径名会让命令难以阅读。

e.en: Her research focuses on the {pathobiology} of lung disease.
e.zh: 她的研究集中在肺部疾病的病理生物学。

e.en: The course explains cancer {pathobiology} in molecular terms.
e.zh: 这门课从分子层面讲解癌症病理生物学。

e.en: The doctor noted a {pathoformic} change in the tissue.
e.zh: 医生注意到组织出现了病态形态变化。

e.en: Some artists used {pathoformic} imagery to suggest decay.
e.zh: 一些艺术家用病态形态的意象暗示衰败。

e.en: The suspected {pathogene} was isolated from the sample.
e.zh: 研究人员从样本中分离出了疑似病原体。

e.en: Older texts may call a disease agent a {pathogene}.
e.zh: 较早的文献可能把致病因子称为pathogene。

e.en: The bacteria acted {pathogenically} only in weakened hosts.
e.zh: 这种细菌只在宿主虚弱时才以致病方式起作用。

e.en: The mutation was interpreted {pathogenically} in the report.
e.zh: 报告从病理角度解释了这个突变。

e.en: The article discusses the {pathogeny} of the infection.
e.zh: 这篇文章讨论了这种感染的发病机制。

e.en: Nineteenth-century doctors debated the {pathogeny} of cholera.
e.zh: 十九世纪的医生曾争论霍乱的病原发生。

e.en: Traditional {pathognomy} relied heavily on visible symptoms.
e.zh: 传统病征识别很依赖可见症状。

e.en: The lecture treated {pathognomy} as an early diagnostic art.
e.zh: 讲座把病相学视为早期诊断技艺。

pathographic.t: 病理传记的；病情记述的

e.en: The essay offered a {pathographic} reading of the poet's life.
e.zh: 这篇文章从病理传记角度解读诗人的一生。

e.en: Her notes were more clinical than {pathographic}.
e.zh: 她的笔记更偏临床记录，而不是病情记述。

e.en: The book is a {pathography} of a famous composer.
e.zh: 这本书是一位著名作曲家的病理传记。

e.en: Patients sometimes write {pathography} to make sense of illness.
e.zh: 患者有时会写病情记述来理解自己的疾病。

e.en: The paper described {pathoklisis} in certain nerve cells.
e.zh: 论文描述了某些神经细胞的病变选择性。

e.en: Neurologists use {pathoklisis} to discuss selective vulnerability.
e.zh: 神经科医生用pathoklisis讨论选择性易损倾向。

e.en: The old laboratory kept a mechanical {pathometer} on display.
e.zh: 旧实验室陈列着一台机械式病情测量仪。

e.en: He joked that no {pathometer} could measure his anxiety.
e.zh: 他开玩笑说没有病理计能测出他的焦虑。

e.en: The biopsy showed clear {pathomorphism} after treatment.
e.zh: 活检显示治疗后出现了明显的病理形态变化。

e.en: Researchers compared tumor {pathomorphism} across the samples.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了各个样本中的肿瘤病理形态变化。

e.en: The diagnosis depended on careful {pathomorphology}.
e.zh: 诊断依赖细致的病理形态学分析。

e.en: Students examined slides for lessons in {pathomorphology}.
e.zh: 学生们观察切片来学习病理形态学。

e.en: The clinician used {pathoneurosis} in an outdated classification.
e.zh: 临床医生在一种过时分类中使用了病理性神经症这个词。

e.en: His symptoms were once labeled {pathoneurosis}.
e.zh: 他的症状曾被归为病理性神经症。

e.en: The team studied the {pathophysiological} effects of severe fever.
e.zh: 团队研究了高烧的病理生理学影响。

e.en: A {pathophysiological} explanation can guide treatment choices.
e.zh: 病理生理学解释可以指导治疗选择。

e.en: The report described chronic inflammation as a {pathosis}.
e.zh: 报告把慢性炎症描述为一种病理状态。

e.en: In older medical writing, {pathosis} meant a diseased condition.
e.zh: 在较早的医学写作中，pathosis指病态状况。

e.en: This bacterial {pathovar} attacks tomato plants.
e.zh: 这种细菌致病变种会侵害番茄植株。

e.en: Scientists named the {pathovar} after its preferred host.
e.zh: 科学家按其主要宿主为这个病原型命名。

e.en: Homeopathy ends with the same {pathy} found in many therapies.
e.zh: homeopathy这个词带有许多疗法名称中的pathy后缀。

e.en: The suffix {pathy} can suggest disease or treatment.
e.zh: 后缀pathy可表示疾病状态或治疗方法。

e.en: Serious illness forced him into sudden {patienthood}.
e.zh: 重病让他突然进入了患者身份。

e.en: The memoir reflects on dignity during {patienthood}.
e.zh: 这本回忆录思考了病人状态中的尊严。

e.en: The rural clinic was strangely {patientless} that morning.
e.zh: 那天早上，这家乡村诊所异常地没有病人。

e.en: A {patientless} trial can only test the software workflow.
e.zh: 无患者试验只能测试软件流程。

e.en: Artists sometimes {patinate} bronze with chemical solutions.
e.zh: 艺术家有时用化学溶液让青铜生出铜绿。

e.en: The surface will {patinate} naturally in the weather.
e.zh: 这个表面会在风雨中自然形成包浆。

e.en: A {patinated} bronze statue stood in the garden.
e.zh: 花园里立着一尊有铜绿的青铜雕像。

e.en: The table had a softly {patinated} wooden top.
e.zh: 这张桌子的木质台面带着柔和包浆。

e.en: Copper {patinates} faster in salty coastal air.
e.zh: 铜在咸湿的海边空气中更快生出铜绿。

e.en: The leather {patinates} beautifully with regular use.
e.zh: 这种皮革经常使用后会形成漂亮包浆。

e.en: They are {patinating} the new bronze doors by hand.
e.zh: 他们正在手工给新的青铜门做出铜绿效果。

e.en: The handles were slowly {patinating} from years of touch.
e.zh: 这些把手因多年触摸而慢慢形成包浆。

patination.t: 形成铜绿或包浆的过程；包浆

e.en: The bronze statue developed a green {patination} over time.
e.zh: 这座青铜雕像久而久之形成了绿色铜绿。

e.en: Collectors value the natural {patination} on old furniture.
e.zh: 收藏家看重旧家具上自然形成的包浆。

patine.t: 包浆；表面光泽或古旧感

e.en: The old silver had a soft {patine}.
e.zh: 那件旧银器有一层柔和的包浆。

e.en: Years of use gave the table a warm {patine}.
e.zh: 多年的使用让这张桌子呈现出温润的古旧光泽。

e.en: The museum displayed a {patined} bronze bowl.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一只带有铜绿的青铜碗。

e.en: Her desk was made of dark, {patined} wood.
e.zh: 她的书桌由颜色深沉、带包浆的木头制成。

patinize.t: 使形成包浆；给金属做旧

e.en: The restorer used chemicals to {patinize} the copper surface.
e.zh: 修复师用化学药剂让铜面形成包浆。

e.en: Artists sometimes {patinize} new metal to make it look aged.
e.zh: 艺术家有时会给新金属做旧，让它看起来有年代感。

patinous.t: 有包浆的；带古旧光泽的

e.en: The vase had a {patinous} brown surface.
e.zh: 花瓶表面呈现带包浆的棕色光泽。

e.en: A {patinous} finish made the new frame seem antique.
e.zh: 带古旧光泽的表面处理让新画框像古董一样。

e.en: The hotel hired a skilled {patissier} for its dessert menu.
e.zh: 酒店聘请了一位技艺娴熟的甜点师来设计甜品菜单。

e.en: As a young {patissier}, she trained in Paris.
e.zh: 她年轻时作为法式糕点师在巴黎受训。

e.en: A harmless gut microbe can become a {patobiont} during inflammation.
e.zh: 肠道里无害的微生物在发炎时可能变成条件致病共生菌。

e.en: The study examined how a {patobiont} affects immune responses.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了一种条件致病共生微生物如何影响免疫反应。

patoxene.t: 偶然寄生物；偶寄生生物

e.en: The flea was considered a {patoxene} on that bird species.
e.zh: 那种跳蚤被认为是该鸟类身上的偶然寄生物。

e.en: Researchers recorded the worm as a rare {patoxene} in humans.
e.zh: 研究人员把这种蠕虫记录为在人类身上罕见出现的偶寄生生物。

e.en: The law gave the {patresfamilias} broad authority over households.
e.zh: 这项法律赋予男性家长们对家庭的广泛权力。

e.en: The novel portrays stern {patresfamilias} defending old customs.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了维护旧习俗的严厉一家之主们。

patrial.t: 有居英权者；祖籍相关的

e.en: Under the old rules, a {patrial} could live in Britain freely.
e.zh: 按旧规定，有居英权者可以自由在英国生活。

e.en: The document discussed {patrial} rights in immigration law.
e.zh: 这份文件讨论了移民法中的居英权。

patriarchdom.t: 宗主教职位；父权统治地位

e.en: His rise to {patriarchdom} changed the church hierarchy.
e.zh: 他升任宗主教后改变了教会的等级格局。

e.en: The story questions the old man's {patriarchdom} within the family.
e.zh: 这个故事质疑了老人家族中的父权地位。

e.en: The village followed a strongly {patriarchic} social order.
e.zh: 这个村庄遵循强烈的父权制社会秩序。

e.en: The council preserved an old {patriarchic} tradition.
e.zh: 委员会保留了一项古老的宗主教传统。

e.en: The dispute began during his {patriarchship}.
e.zh: 这场争端始于他担任宗主教期间。

e.en: His {patriarchship} over the family was rarely challenged.
e.zh: 他在家中的家长权威很少受到挑战。

patriate.t: 使宪法归本国掌管；移交本国

e.en: Canada moved to {patriate} its constitution in the early 1980s.
e.zh: 加拿大在二十世纪八十年代初推动将宪法收归本国掌管。

e.en: The government sought to {patriate} authority from the former colonial power.
e.zh: 政府试图把权力从前殖民宗主国手中移交回本国。

e.en: The therapist noted a {patricentric} pattern in the family's decisions.
e.zh: 治疗师注意到这个家庭的决策呈现以父亲为中心的模式。

e.en: A {patricentric} culture may give fathers special symbolic authority.
e.zh: 以父亲为中心的文化可能赋予父亲特殊的象征权威。

e.en: His accent carried a trace of old {patricianism}.
e.zh: 他的口音带着一丝旧式贵族气派。

e.en: The essay criticizes {patricianism} in the city's politics.
e.zh: 这篇文章批评了该市政治中的贵族主义。

e.en: The medieval city was governed by a wealthy {patriciate}.
e.zh: 这座中世纪城市由富有的显贵阶层治理。

e.en: Marriage linked the merchant family to the local {patriciate}.
e.zh: 这桩婚姻把商人家庭与当地贵族阶层联系起来。

e.en: The play turns on a dark {patricidal} secret.
e.zh: 这出戏围绕一个阴暗的弑父秘密展开。

e.en: Psychologists discussed the character's {patricidal} fantasies.
e.zh: 心理学家讨论了这个人物的杀父幻想。

e.en: The offspring showed a {patriclinous} pattern in several traits.
e.zh: 这些后代在几项特征上表现出偏似父系的遗传模式。

e.en: Botanists described the hybrid as largely {patriclinous}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种杂交体描述为很大程度上偏似父本。

e.en: The clan traced its {patriline} through five generations.
e.zh: 这个氏族把父系血统追溯了五代。

e.en: Inheritance followed the eldest son's {patriline} in that village.
e.zh: 在那个村子里，继承权沿长子的父系血统传递。

e.en: The family kept a {patrilinear} record of descent.
e.zh: 这个家族保存着按父系记录的世系。

e.en: Property rights were mostly {patrilinear} in the old system.
e.zh: 旧制度下，财产权大多按父系传承。

e.en: Anthropologists studied {patriliny} among the mountain communities.
e.zh: 人类学家研究了山地社群中的父系继嗣制度。

e.en: Under {patriliny}, children belonged to the father's lineage.
e.zh: 在父系继嗣制度下，孩子归属父亲的宗族。

e.en: A broken twig served as a {patrin} on the path.
e.zh: 一根折断的树枝被当作路上的吉卜赛路标。

e.en: The travelers left a small {patrin} near the crossroads.
e.zh: 旅人在十字路口附近留下了一个小路记。

patrioteer.t: 假爱国者；空喊爱国的人

e.en: The pamphlet mocked him as a noisy {patrioteer}.
e.zh: 那本小册子嘲讽他是个喧闹的假爱国者。

e.en: A {patrioteer} may shout slogans but avoid real service.
e.zh: 空喊爱国的人可能只喊口号，却逃避真正的服务。

e.en: The museum displayed old flags and other {patriotica}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了旧旗帜和其他爱国题材收藏品。

e.en: Collectors paid high prices for Civil War {patriotica}.
e.zh: 收藏家为内战时期的爱国纪念品付出高价。

e.en: Roman law preserved a strongly {patripotestal} household model.
e.zh: 罗马法保留了强烈父权支配的家庭模式。

e.en: The novel criticizes a {patripotestal} view of marriage.
e.zh: 这部小说批判了父权支配的婚姻观。

patrist.t: 教父学者；教父著作研究者

e.en: The {patrist} compared several early Christian manuscripts.
e.zh: 这位教父学者比较了几份早期基督教手稿。

e.en: As a {patrist}, she focused on Augustine's theology.
e.zh: 作为教父著作研究者，她专注于奥古斯丁神学。

e.en: The essay uses {patristical} sources to explain the doctrine.
e.zh: 这篇文章用教父学资料解释该教义。

e.en: His lecture covered {patristical} debates about grace.
e.zh: 他的讲座讲到了早期教父关于恩典的争论。

e.en: The chronicler called her a Roman {patrix}.
e.zh: 编年史作者称她为罗马女贵族。

e.en: A wealthy {patrix} funded the chapel's restoration.
e.zh: 一位富有的贵妇资助了小教堂的修复。

e.en: In Esperanto, {patro} means father.
e.zh: 在世界语中，patro 的意思是父亲。

e.en: The form {patro} appears in several learned compounds.
e.zh: patro 这个形式出现在若干学术复合词中。

e.en: The child's face was strikingly {patroclinous}.
e.zh: 这个孩子的脸明显像父亲。

e.en: The breeder noted a {patroclinous} pattern in the offspring.
e.zh: 育种者注意到后代表现出遗传似父的模式。

e.en: A night {patrolette} moved quietly through the streets.
e.zh: 一支夜间小巡逻队悄悄穿过街道。

e.en: The town hired its first {patrolette} during the festival.
e.zh: 小镇在节日期间雇用了第一位女巡警。

e.en: Several {patrolwomen} joined the downtown safety unit.
e.zh: 几名女巡警加入了市中心安全小组。

e.en: The {patrolwomen} checked the park before sunrise.
e.zh: 女巡逻员在日出前检查了公园。

e.en: The village celebrated its {patronal} feast in June.
e.zh: 这个村庄在六月庆祝守护圣人的节日。

e.en: His {patronal} support kept the artists working.
e.zh: 他的赞助人支持让这些艺术家得以继续创作。

e.en: Each {patronite} owed public thanks to the donor.
e.zh: 每位受赞助者都要公开感谢捐助人。

e.en: The old household treated the clerk as a {patronite}.
e.zh: 那个老家庭把这名书记员视为受庇护者。

patronization.t: 赞助；光顾；居高临下对待

e.en: The theater survived through steady {patronization} by locals.
e.zh: 这家剧院靠本地人持续光顾而维持下来。

e.en: She disliked the manager's constant {patronization}.
e.zh: 她讨厌经理总是居高临下地对待她。

patronless.t: 无赞助人的；无人庇护的

e.en: The {patronless} poet struggled to publish his work.
e.zh: 这位无赞助人的诗人很难出版作品。

e.en: Many {patronless} clients were left outside the legal system.
e.zh: 许多无人庇护的委托人被排除在法律体系之外。

e.en: The cafe's {patronne} greeted every guest by name.
e.zh: 咖啡馆的女老板按名字招呼每位客人。

e.en: A generous {patronne} supported the young painter.
e.zh: 一位慷慨的女主顾资助了这位年轻画家。

e.en: A freedman still owed duties to his {patronus}.
e.zh: 获释奴隶仍对自己的古罗马保护人负有义务。

e.en: The scholar used {patronus} to describe the political sponsor.
e.zh: 那位学者用 patronus 来形容政治庇护者。

e.en: Johnson began as a {patronym} meaning John's son.
e.zh: Johnson 最初是源自父名的姓，意思是约翰之子。

e.en: The village records list each child with a {patronym}.
e.zh: 村庄记录给每个孩子列出了源自父名的称呼。

e.en: The Dutch {patroon} controlled a vast estate along the river.
e.zh: 这位荷兰庄园领主控制着河边大片地产。

e.en: Tenants paid rent directly to the {patroon}.
e.zh: 佃户直接向大地主缴纳租金。

e.en: The garden had a tall {paulownia} near the gate.
e.zh: 花园门口附近有一棵高大的泡桐。

e.en: The craftsman chose {paulownia} for its light weight.
e.zh: 工匠选用泡桐木，因为它重量轻。

paunchier.t: 大腹便便的；肚子更大的

e.en: He looked {paunchier} after months of desk work.
e.zh: 几个月伏案工作后，他看起来肚子更大了。

e.en: The actor seemed {paunchier} in the later scenes.
e.zh: 那位演员在后面的场景里显得更大腹便便。

paunchiest.t: 最大腹便便的；肚子最大的

e.en: He was the {paunchiest} man at the reunion.
e.zh: 他是同学聚会上肚子最大的人。

e.en: The costume made the king look the {paunchiest}.
e.zh: 那套戏服让国王显得最为大腹便便。

e.en: His {paunchiness} became more noticeable with age.
e.zh: 随着年龄增长，他的大肚子变得更明显。

e.en: The portrait exaggerates the merchant's {paunchiness}.
e.zh: 这幅画像夸张地表现了商人的腹部肥胖。

e.en: The novel describes a family sinking into {pauperdom}.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了一家人陷入赤贫的过程。

e.en: Victorian reformers often wrote about {pauperdom}.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的改革者常写到贫民阶层。

pauperis.t: 以贫民身份；免诉讼费地

e.en: The prisoner filed the appeal in forma {pauperis}.
e.zh: 那名囚犯以贫民身份提交上诉，申请免交费用。

e.en: She proceeded in forma {pauperis} after losing her job.
e.zh: 失业后，她以贫民身份继续诉讼。

e.en: The war could {pauperise} thousands of families.
e.zh: 这场战争可能使成千上万的家庭陷入贫困。

e.en: Critics said the policy would {pauperise} rural workers.
e.zh: 批评者说这项政策会让农村工人沦为贫民。

e.en: The report linked disease with urban {pauperism}.
e.zh: 报告把疾病与城市赤贫现象联系起来。

e.en: He studied {pauperism} in nineteenth-century London.
e.zh: 他研究十九世纪伦敦的贫困状态。

e.en: A long drought can {pauperize} small farmers.
e.zh: 长期干旱会使小农户陷入赤贫。

e.en: They feared the new taxes would {pauperize} the poor.
e.zh: 他们担心新税会让穷人更加贫困。

pauperized.t: 被使贫困的；沦为赤贫的

e.en: Many tenants were {pauperized} by the rent increase.
e.zh: 许多租户因租金上涨而陷入贫困。

e.en: The {pauperized} workers demanded relief from the city.
e.zh: 那些沦为赤贫的工人要求市政府救济。

e.en: Inflation {pauperizes} people on fixed incomes.
e.zh: 通货膨胀会让靠固定收入生活的人陷入贫困。

e.en: The system {pauperizes} those already near the edge.
e.zh: 这个制度会使本已艰难的人更加赤贫。

e.en: The {pauperizing} effect of debt spread quickly.
e.zh: 债务造成的致贫影响迅速扩散。

e.en: They accused the company of {pauperizing} its workers.
e.zh: 他们指责公司让工人陷入贫困。

e.en: The chef served a veal {paupiette} with herbs.
e.zh: 厨师端上了一份配香草的小牛肉卷。

e.en: She learned to tie each {paupiette} with kitchen string.
e.zh: 她学会了用厨房线把每个馅料小卷扎好。

patroonship.t: 庄园领主身份或领地权

e.en: The old charter confirmed his {patroonship} over the valley.
e.zh: 那份旧特许状确认了他对山谷的庄园领主权。

e.en: Historians debated whether the {patroonship} encouraged settlement.
e.zh: 历史学家争论这种庄园领主制度是否促进了定居。

e.en: The travelers followed a {patteran} of twigs by the road.
e.zh: 旅人沿着路边一处由树枝摆成的吉卜赛路标前进。

e.en: In the novel, a {patteran} quietly marks the family's route.
e.zh: 在小说里，一个吉卜赛路标悄悄标出了那家人的路线。

e.en: She chose a sleeve design from the {pattern-book}.
e.zh: 她从纸样册里挑了一个袖子设计。

e.en: The wallpaper maker kept every floral print in a {pattern-book}.
e.zh: 墙纸师傅把每种花卉印花都收在图案样本书里。

e.en: The {pattern-maker} adjusted the jacket before production began.
e.zh: 制版师在投产前调整了那件夹克的纸样。

e.en: A skilled {pattern-maker} carved the wooden form for casting.
e.zh: 熟练的制模工为铸造刻出了木制模型。

e.en: The tailor sent the new design to the {pattern-room}.
e.zh: 裁缝把新设计送到了纸样间。

e.en: Only senior workers entered the factory's {pattern-room}.
e.zh: 只有资深工人能进入工厂的制模车间。

e.en: The foundry's {pattern-shop} made forms for metal castings.
e.zh: 铸造厂的制模车间制作金属铸件的模型。

e.en: She bought a vintage dress plan at a small {pattern-shop}.
e.zh: 她在一家小纸样店买到一份复古连衣裙纸样。

e.en: The artist tried to {patternize} the chaos of the street.
e.zh: 艺术家试图把街头的混乱处理成有规律的图案。

e.en: Researchers can {patternize} the data into useful categories.
e.zh: 研究人员可以把数据整理成有用的模式类别。

e.en: She preferred a plain, {patternless} blue dress.
e.zh: 她更喜欢一条素净、没有图案的蓝裙子。

e.en: The attacks seemed {patternless} at first.
e.zh: 这些袭击起初看起来毫无规律。

e.en: The {patternmaker} prepared the coat design for cutting.
e.zh: 纸样师准备好大衣的裁剪版型。

e.en: A foundry {patternmaker} builds precise models for cast parts.
e.zh: 铸造厂的制模工会为铸件制作精确模型。

e.en: Pour the batter into each {pattiepan} before baking.
e.zh: 烘烤前把面糊倒进每个小馅饼模里。

e.en: The farmer picked a yellow {pattiepan} from the vine.
e.zh: 农夫从藤上摘下一个黄色的扁圆南瓜。

e.en: The refinery once used {pattinsonization} to enrich silver.
e.zh: 这家精炼厂曾用帕廷森法来富集银。

e.en: Students read about {pattinsonization} in a metallurgy text.
e.zh: 学生们在冶金课本里读到了帕廷森法分离银铅。

e.en: The knight's {pattis} protected his lower legs.
e.zh: 骑士的护腿甲保护着他的小腿。

e.en: The museum displayed battered {pattis} beside the helmet.
e.zh: 博物馆把有损痕的金属护胫陈列在头盔旁边。

e.en: Grease the {pattypan} before adding the pastry.
e.zh: 放入酥皮前先给小馅饼模抹油。

e.en: She roasted a small {pattypan} with garlic and herbs.
e.zh: 她用蒜和香草烤了一个小扁圆南瓜。

e.en: The lab tested the apple juice for {patulin}.
e.zh: 实验室检测了苹果汁中的展青霉素。

e.en: High {patulin} levels can make spoiled fruit unsafe.
e.zh: 展青霉素含量高会让变质水果不安全。

e.en: The doctor noted a {patulous} opening in the tube.
e.zh: 医生注意到管道有一个张开的开口。

e.en: The flower had broad, {patulous} petals in the sun.
e.zh: 那朵花在阳光下展开宽阔外张的花瓣。

e.en: Even a {patzer} can spot that obvious checkmate.
e.zh: 即使棋艺很差的人也能看出那个明显的将死。

e.en: He called himself a {patzer} after losing the queen.
e.zh: 丢掉皇后之后，他自嘲是个臭棋篓子。

e.en: Some languages use a {paucal} form for a few items.
e.zh: 有些语言会用少数形式表示几个物品。

e.en: The grammar marks two, three, or four with a {paucal} number.
e.zh: 这种语法用少数数来标记二、三或四个。

e.en: The species shows a {pauciform} range of leaf shapes.
e.zh: 这个物种的叶形变化范围很少。

e.en: His classification treated the group as {pauciform}.
e.zh: 他的分类把这一组视为形态较少的一类。

e.en: The warrior's left {pauldron} was dented in battle.
e.zh: 战士左肩的肩甲在战斗中被打凹了。

e.en: Cosplayers often build a foam {pauldron} for armor costumes.
e.zh: 角色扮演者常用泡沫制作铠甲服装的护肩。

paurometabolic.t: 渐变态的；不完全变态的

e.en: A {paurometabolic} insect develops without a pupal stage.
e.zh: 渐变态昆虫发育时没有蛹期。

e.en: The textbook contrasted {paurometabolic} growth with complete metamorphosis.
e.zh: 教材把渐变态发育与完全变态作了对比。

paurometabolous.t: 渐变态的；不完全变态的

e.en: Grasshoppers are often described as {paurometabolous} insects.
e.zh: 蝗虫常被描述为渐变态昆虫。

e.en: In {paurometabolous} development, the young resemble small adults.
e.zh: 在渐变态发育中，幼体像缩小的成体。

e.en: The actor used a {pausal} break before the final line.
e.zh: 演员在最后一句前用了一个停顿。

e.en: Linguists marked the {pausal} forms in the old text.
e.zh: 语言学家标出了古文本中的停顿形式。

e.en: She served a berry {pav} after dinner.
e.zh: 她晚饭后端上了一份浆果蛋白霜甜点。

e.en: The bakery's mini {pavs} sold out by noon.
e.zh: 那家面包店的迷你蛋白霜甜点中午前就卖完了。

e.en: The town collected {pavage} to repair the market road.
e.zh: 镇上征收铺路税来修市场道路。

e.en: Records mention {pavage} for the bridge approach.
e.zh: 记录提到桥头引道的铺路工程。

e.en: The musicians opened with a slow {pavan}.
e.zh: 乐师们以一支缓慢的帕凡舞曲开场。

e.en: Couples crossed the hall in a stately {pavan}.
e.zh: 舞伴们跳着庄重的帕凡舞穿过大厅。

e.en: The court danced a formal {pavane}.
e.zh: 宫廷里跳起了正式的帕凡舞。

e.en: Ravel's {pavane} sounds elegant and mournful.
e.zh: 拉威尔的帕凡舞曲听起来优雅而哀婉。

e.en: The {pavid} child would not enter the dark room.
e.zh: 那个胆怯的孩子不肯进黑屋子。

e.en: His {pavid} glance betrayed his confidence.
e.zh: 他惊惶的一瞥暴露了他的不自信。

e.en: The {pavier} set stones along the lane.
e.zh: 铺路工沿着小巷铺好石块。

e.en: A skilled {pavier} can make the surface drain well.
e.zh: 熟练的铺石工能让路面排水顺畅。

e.en: The old map marked a royal {pavillon} near the gardens.
e.zh: 旧地图在花园附近标出了一座皇家亭阁。

e.en: A bright {pavillon} flew above the ship.
e.zh: 一面鲜艳的旗帜在船上方飘扬。

e.en: The consort played a measured {pavin}.
e.zh: 合奏队演奏了一首节奏庄重的帕凡舞曲。

e.en: They rehearsed the {pavin} for the historical festival.
e.zh: 他们为历史节庆排练帕凡舞。

e.en: One {paving-stone} had come loose near the gate.
e.zh: 大门附近有一块铺路石松动了。

e.en: Workers replaced each cracked {paving-stone} in the square.
e.zh: 工人们更换了广场上每块裂开的铺路石。

e.en: The {pavior} leveled the stones with a heavy mallet.
e.zh: 铺路工用重木槌把石块敲平。

e.en: The builder chose granite {pavior} for the courtyard.
e.zh: 建筑商为庭院选用了花岗岩铺路材料。

e.en: A {paviour} repaired the uneven street.
e.zh: 一名铺路工修好了不平的街面。

e.en: The city hired every available {paviour} after the flood.
e.zh: 洪水过后，市里雇用了所有能找到的铺石工。

e.en: The archer crouched behind a wooden {pavis}.
e.zh: 弓箭手蹲在一面木制大盾后面。

e.en: A painted {pavis} hung on the castle wall.
e.zh: 一面绘有图案的中世纪大盾挂在城堡墙上。

e.en: The crossbowman carried a tall {pavise}.
e.zh: 弩手带着一面高大的中世纪大盾。

e.en: They propped the {pavise} in the mud before reloading.
e.zh: 他们换箭前把大盾支在泥地里。

e.en: The {paviser} protected the archer during the siege.
e.zh: 持大盾者在围城战中保护弓箭手。

e.en: A trained {paviser} moved with the front line.
e.zh: 受过训练的盾牌手随前线推进。

e.en: The {pavisor} planted his shield before the archers.
e.zh: 持大盾者把盾牌立在弓箭手前方。

e.en: Medieval records list a {pavisor} among the hired soldiers.
e.zh: 中世纪记录把一名盾牌手列在雇佣兵之中。

pavone.t: 孔雀蓝绿色；孔雀色彩斑斓的

e.en: The old vase had a {pavone} glaze.
e.zh: 那只旧花瓶有一层孔雀蓝绿色的釉。

e.en: She chose a {pavone} silk for the costume.
e.zh: 她为戏服选了孔雀色彩斑斓的丝绸。

pavonine.t: 像孔雀的；孔雀般华丽的

e.en: The dancer wore a {pavonine} cloak.
e.zh: 舞者披着一件孔雀般华丽的斗篷。

e.en: His prose had a strangely {pavonine} elegance.
e.zh: 他的散文有一种奇异的孔雀般华美。

e.en: She sliced a ripe {paw-paw} for breakfast.
e.zh: 她早餐切了一个熟番木瓜。

e.en: The {paw-paw} tree grows well in the valley.
e.zh: 这种北美番荔枝树在山谷里长得很好。

e.en: A muddy {paw-print} marked the carpet.
e.zh: 地毯上留下了一个泥泞的爪印。

e.en: The tracker studied each {paw-print} in the snow.
e.zh: 追踪者仔细查看雪地里的每个动物脚印。

e.en: He began to {pawk} through the drawer.
e.zh: 他开始在抽屉里用手摸索。

e.en: Don't {pawk} at the machine with greasy fingers.
e.zh: 别用油乎乎的手笨拙地摆弄那台机器。

pawky.t: 狡黠幽默的；机灵逗趣的

e.en: She answered with a {pawky} smile.
e.zh: 她带着狡黠幽默的微笑回答。

e.en: His {pawky} comments kept the meeting lively.
e.zh: 他那些机灵逗趣的评论让会议不沉闷。

e.en: The {pawl} stopped the wheel from slipping back.
e.zh: 棘爪阻止了轮子向后滑动。

e.en: A broken {pawl} made the ratchet useless.
e.zh: 制轮爪坏了，棘轮就没法用了。

e.en: His family had worked in {pawnbroking} for generations.
e.zh: 他家几代人都从事典当业。

e.en: Modern {pawnbroking} is regulated more strictly.
e.zh: 现代当铺经营受到更严格的监管。

e.en: The {pawnor} must repay the loan on time.
e.zh: 出质人必须按时偿还贷款。

e.en: The contract named the jeweler as the {pawnor}.
e.zh: 合同把那名珠宝商列为典当人。

e.en: The creature raised a {pawny} hand.
e.zh: 那生物举起一只像爪子的手。

e.en: He disliked the chair's {pawny} carved feet.
e.zh: 他不喜欢那把椅子爪形雕刻的椅脚。

e.en: The butcher trimmed the tough {paxwax}.
e.zh: 屠夫修掉了那块坚韧的项韧带。

e.en: Old recipes sometimes mention {paxwax} in stews.
e.zh: 老食谱有时会提到炖菜里的颈背筋腱。

pay-as-you-earn.t: 所得税预扣制；按收入扣税

e.en: The company uses a {pay-as-you-earn} tax system.
e.zh: 公司采用所得税预扣制度。

e.en: Under {pay-as-you-earn}, tax is taken from wages.
e.zh: 按收入扣税制度下，税款会从工资中扣除。

pay-as-you-go.t: 用多少付多少；现用现付

e.en: I bought a {pay-as-you-go} phone plan.
e.zh: 我买了一个用多少付多少的手机套餐。

e.en: The service works on a {pay-as-you-go} basis.
e.zh: 这项服务按现用现付的方式收费。

e.en: I need to {pay-back} the money by Friday.
e.zh: 我需要在星期五前把钱还清。

e.en: The prank was his way to {pay-back} an old insult.
e.zh: 这个恶作剧是他报复旧日侮辱的方式。

e.en: The hospital reserved a {pay-bed} for her surgery.
e.zh: 医院为她的手术预留了一个付费病床。

e.en: He could not afford a {pay-bed} in the clinic.
e.zh: 他负担不起诊所里的私费床位。

e.en: Rent is due before {pay-day}.
e.zh: 房租要在发薪日前缴清。

e.en: Everyone seemed happier on {pay-day}.
e.zh: 到了领工资的日子，大家似乎都更开心。

e.en: The army {pay-master} arrived with the wages.
e.zh: 军队发薪官带着薪饷来了。

e.en: In politics, donors can become the real {pay-master}.
e.zh: 在政治中，捐款人可能成为真正掌握钱袋的人。

e.en: The insurer will {pay-out} after the claim is approved.
e.zh: 理赔获批后，保险公司会赔付。

e.en: The lottery may {pay-out} millions this week.
e.zh: 本周彩票可能会支付数百万奖金。

e.en: His {pay-packet} barely covered the bills.
e.zh: 他的工资袋里的钱勉强够付账单。

e.en: A bigger {pay-packet} helped her move out.
e.zh: 更高的一周工资让她有能力搬出去住。

e.en: That was a {pea-brained} plan from the start.
e.zh: 那个计划从一开始就很愚蠢。

e.en: Stop making {pea-brained} jokes during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时别再讲那些没脑子的笑话了。

pea-coat.t: 海军短大衣；厚呢短外套

e.en: He wore a navy {pea-coat} in the cold wind.
e.zh: 冷风中他穿着一件海军蓝厚呢短大衣。

e.en: Her old {pea-coat} still looked stylish.
e.zh: 她那件旧海军短大衣看起来仍然很有型。

pea-green.t: 豌豆绿色的；浅黄绿色的

e.en: She painted the kitchen walls {pea-green}.
e.zh: 她把厨房墙壁刷成了豌豆绿色。

e.en: His face turned {pea-green} after the rough boat ride.
e.zh: 颠簸的船程后，他的脸变得发青。

e.en: The child aimed a {pea-shooter} at a tin can.
e.zh: 那个孩子用吹豆枪瞄准一个铁罐。

e.en: Against modern rifles, his pistol felt like a {pea-shooter}.
e.zh: 面对现代步枪，他的手枪显得像玩具一样没威力。

e.en: A {pea-souper} covered London by evening.
e.zh: 傍晚时伦敦被一场浓雾笼罩。

e.en: Drivers slowed down in the thick {pea-souper}.
e.zh: 司机们在那片浓雾中放慢了速度。

e.en: Old diaries mention several {pea-soupers} that winter.
e.zh: 旧日记提到那年冬天有好几场浓雾。

e.en: The city was once famous for its choking {pea-soupers}.
e.zh: 这座城市曾因令人窒息的浓雾而出名。

pea-soupy.t: 浓雾弥漫的；浑浊浓稠的

e.en: The air grew {pea-soupy} near the river.
e.zh: 河边的空气变得浓雾弥漫。

e.en: The sauce looked strangely {pea-soupy} after cooling.
e.zh: 酱汁冷却后看起来异常浑浊浓稠。

peaberry.t: 圆粒咖啡豆；小圆咖啡豆

e.en: This roast uses Tanzanian {peaberry} beans.
e.zh: 这款烘焙使用坦桑尼亚圆粒咖啡豆。

e.en: A {peaberry} forms as a single rounded seed.
e.zh: 圆粒咖啡豆是由一颗圆形种子形成的。

e.en: Only a {peabrain} would ignore that warning.
e.zh: 只有笨蛋才会无视那个警告。

e.en: He called himself a {peabrain} after missing the exit.
e.zh: 错过出口后，他骂自己是个没脑子的人。

e.en: A UN {peace-keeper} guarded the checkpoint.
e.zh: 一名联合国维和人员守卫着检查站。

e.en: In family arguments, she became the {peace-keeper}.
e.zh: 在家庭争吵中，她成了调停者。

e.en: They described themselves as a {peace-loving} community.
e.zh: 他们称自己是一个爱好和平的社区。

e.en: His {peace-loving} nature made violence hard to accept.
e.zh: 他爱好和平的天性使他难以接受暴力。

e.en: She acted as a {peace-maker} between the rivals.
e.zh: 她在对手之间充当调解人。

e.en: The diplomat was praised as a brave {peace-maker}.
e.zh: 那位外交官被誉为勇敢的和平促成者。

e.en: The talks were part of a wider {peace-making} effort.
e.zh: 这些会谈是更广泛促和努力的一部分。

e.en: Her {peace-making} skills helped calm the dispute.
e.zh: 她的调解能力帮助平息了争端。

e.en: He brought flowers as a {peace-offering}.
e.zh: 他带来鲜花作为和解礼物。

e.en: The small concession was meant as a {peace-offering}.
e.zh: 这个小让步是为了表示和解。

peacebreaker.t: 破坏和平者；挑起争端者

e.en: The king punished the {peacebreaker} harshly.
e.zh: 国王严厉惩罚了那个破坏和平的人。

e.en: No one wanted to be seen as a {peacebreaker}.
e.zh: 没人想被视为挑起争端的人。

peacebreaking.t: 破坏和平的；扰乱安宁的

e.en: The treaty condemned all {peacebreaking} actions.
e.zh: 条约谴责一切破坏和平的行动。

e.en: His {peacebreaking} behavior angered the village elders.
e.zh: 他扰乱安宁的行为激怒了村里的长者。

e.en: They spent a {peaceless} night under shellfire.
e.zh: 他们在炮火下度过了一个不安宁的夜晚。

e.en: Her mind felt {peaceless} after the argument.
e.zh: 争吵过后，她的心里一直不得安宁。

e.en: Critics mocked him as a naive {peacemonger}.
e.zh: 批评者嘲笑他是个天真的和平鼓吹者。

e.en: The old {peacemonger} kept urging both sides to talk.
e.zh: 那位老和平倡导者一直敦促双方对话。

e.en: She chose a {peach-colored} dress for the wedding.
e.zh: 她为婚礼选了一条桃色连衣裙。

e.en: The sunset left a {peach-colored} glow on the clouds.
e.zh: 夕阳给云层染上了淡粉橙色的光。

pay-per-click.t: 按点击付费的网络广告模式或费用

e.en: The agency recommended a {pay-per-click} campaign for the new store.
e.zh: 这家代理公司建议为新店做按点击付费的广告活动。

e.en: Small businesses often watch {pay-per-click} costs very carefully.
e.zh: 小企业通常会很仔细地控制按点击付费的成本。

pay-phone.t: 投币或刷卡使用的公共电话

e.en: She called home from a {pay-phone} outside the station.
e.zh: 她在车站外的公用付费电话给家里打了电话。

e.en: There used to be a {pay-phone} in every busy lobby.
e.zh: 过去每个繁忙大厅里几乎都有一部公用付费电话。

e.en: The union wants a higher {pay-rate} for night shifts.
e.zh: 工会希望夜班能有更高的工资率。

e.en: Her {pay-rate} depends on experience and certification.
e.zh: 她的计酬标准取决于经验和资格证书。

e.en: The clerk added three new workers to the {pay-roll}.
e.zh: 办事员把三名新员工加入了工资名单。

e.en: Rent and {pay-roll} are the cafe's biggest monthly costs.
e.zh: 房租和工资总额是这家咖啡馆每月最大的开支。

pay-roller.t: 发放工资的人；管薪酬者

e.en: The old ledger was kept by the company's {pay-roller}.
e.zh: 那本旧账簿由公司的薪资管理员保管。

e.en: A dishonest {pay-roller} could hide a fake employee for months.
e.zh: 不诚实的发薪人员可能把虚假员工藏上好几个月。

e.en: Drivers stopped at the {pay-station} before entering the car park.
e.zh: 司机进停车场前在收费站停了下来。

e.en: He found an old {pay-station} near the hotel lobby.
e.zh: 他在酒店大厅附近找到一个旧式付费电话亭。

pay-to-play.t: 付费参与的；花钱换机会的

e.en: Critics called the conference a {pay-to-play} event for lobbyists.
e.zh: 批评者称这场会议是游说者花钱换机会的活动。

e.en: The game avoids {pay-to-play} advantages in competitive matches.
e.zh: 这款游戏避免在竞技比赛中出现付费取得优势的情况。

payara.t: 一种南美大型掠食性鱼

e.en: The angler caught a silver {payara} in the fast river.
e.zh: 钓鱼人在湍急的河里钓到一条银色的帕亚拉鱼。

e.en: A {payara} is sometimes called a vampire fish because of its teeth.
e.zh: 帕亚拉鱼有时因牙齿显眼而被叫作吸血鬼鱼。

e.en: Grandmother served warm {payasam} after the festival meal.
e.zh: 节日餐后，祖母端上了热腾腾的南亚甜奶粥。

e.en: The temple kitchen made rice {payasam} with cardamom and nuts.
e.zh: 寺庙厨房用豆蔻和坚果做了米制甜布丁。

e.en: Passengers dropped their coins into the bus {paybox}.
e.zh: 乘客把硬币投进公交车上的收款箱。

e.en: The theater's {paybox} opened an hour before the show.
e.zh: 剧院的售票收款处在演出前一小时开放。

e.en: She spent her first {paycheque} on a winter coat.
e.zh: 她把第一张薪水支票花在一件冬衣上。

e.en: Many families live from {paycheque} to paycheque.
e.zh: 许多家庭都是靠每次工资收入勉强周转。

e.en: The miners finally hit {paydirt} after weeks of digging.
e.zh: 矿工们挖了几个星期后终于碰到了含金矿土。

e.en: The reporter struck {paydirt} when a witness agreed to talk.
e.zh: 一名证人同意开口时，记者终于有了重大收获。

e.en: The promotion moved her into a higher {paygrade}.
e.zh: 这次晋升让她进入了更高的薪级。

e.en: That decision is above my {paygrade}.
e.zh: 那个决定超出了我的职责权限。

e.en: The factory {paymistress} handed each worker an envelope.
e.zh: 工厂的女发薪员给每名工人发了一个信封。

e.en: As {paymistress}, she checked every wage entry twice.
e.zh: 作为女薪资主管，她把每条工资记录都核对两遍。

paynim.t: 异教徒；非基督徒的古称

e.en: The medieval poem calls the foreign warrior a {paynim}.
e.zh: 那首中世纪诗把外来的武士称作异教徒。

e.en: Modern readers may find the word {paynim} harsh and archaic.
e.zh: 现代读者可能会觉得paynim这个词刺耳而古旧。

e.en: The preacher feared the empire would {paynize} the faithful.
e.zh: 传教士担心帝国会使信徒异教化。

e.en: Writers once used {paynize} for turning Christians toward pagan customs.
e.zh: 过去作家用paynize指让基督徒转向异教习俗。

e.en: The merchant would {payse} the wool before naming a price.
e.zh: 商人在开价前会先称量羊毛。

e.en: In the old tale, judges {payse} mercy against strict law.
e.zh: 在那个古老故事里，法官们权衡仁慈与严法。

e.en: The accountant corrected an error on the weekly {paysheet}.
e.zh: 会计更正了每周工资表上的一个错误。

e.en: Every {paysheet} listed hours, deductions, and net pay.
e.zh: 每张薪资清单都列出工时、扣款和实发工资。

e.en: The plain dress needs a little {pazaza} for the party.
e.zh: 这条素色裙子参加派对还需要一点亮眼气势。

e.en: His speech had facts but no {pazaza}.
e.zh: 他的演讲有事实依据，却缺少感染力。

e.en: The singer brought real {pazazz} to the final song.
e.zh: 这位歌手给最后一首歌带来了真正的活力。

e.en: Add a bright scarf if the outfit lacks {pazazz}.
e.zh: 如果这身衣服缺少亮点，就加一条鲜艳围巾。

e.en: She wore a {peach-coloured} scarf to the party.
e.zh: 她戴了一条桃色围巾去参加聚会。

e.en: The walls were painted a soft {peach-coloured} shade.
e.zh: 墙壁刷成了柔和的浅粉橙色。

e.en: The craftsman carved the charm from {peach-wood}.
e.zh: 工匠用桃木雕刻了这个护符。

e.en: Old handles made of {peach-wood} can split in dry weather.
e.zh: 桃木做的旧手柄在干燥天气里可能开裂。

e.en: The lane was bright with {peachblossom} in spring.
e.zh: 春天小路两旁桃花盛开，格外明亮。

e.en: Her dress had a delicate {peachblossom} tint.
e.zh: 她的连衣裙带着淡淡的桃花色。

e.en: The antique vase was glazed in {peachblow}.
e.zh: 那只古董花瓶上了桃花粉色的釉。

e.en: A faint {peachblow} touched the evening clouds.
e.zh: 傍晚的云彩染上了一抹淡桃红。

e.en: That old convertible is a real {peacherino}.
e.zh: 那辆老敞篷车真是个好东西。

e.en: She called the lucky shot a {peacherino}.
e.zh: 她把那次幸运命中称作妙极了的一球。

e.en: The jam had a {peachful} sweetness.
e.zh: 这种果酱有一种桃子般的甜味。

e.en: Morning light gave the room a {peachful} glow.
e.zh: 晨光让房间泛起桃色的光泽。

e.en: The keeper gently moved the {peachick} indoors.
e.zh: 饲养员轻轻把孔雀雏鸟移到室内。

e.en: A young {peachick} followed its mother through the grass.
e.zh: 一只小孔雀跟着母鸟穿过草地。

e.en: The walking stick was made from polished {peachwood}.
e.zh: 这根手杖是用抛光桃木制成的。

e.en: Some traditions treat {peachwood} as protective.
e.zh: 有些传统认为桃木有辟护作用。

e.en: He chose a {peacock-blue} tie for the ceremony.
e.zh: 他为典礼选了一条孔雀蓝领带。

e.en: The lake turned {peacock-blue} under the clear sky.
e.zh: 晴空下，湖水变成了孔雀蓝。

e.en: The speech had more {peacockery} than substance.
e.zh: 这场演讲卖弄多于实质内容。

e.en: He disliked the court's endless {peacockery}.
e.zh: 他厌恶宫廷里无休止的浮华作派。

e.en: His {peacockish} jacket drew every eye.
e.zh: 他那件像孔雀般花哨的夹克吸引了所有目光。

e.en: She found his {peacockish} confidence amusing.
e.zh: 她觉得他那种炫耀式的自信很有趣。

e.en: The dancer made a {peacocklike} turn on stage.
e.zh: 舞者在台上做了一个孔雀般的旋转。

e.en: His {peacocklike} pride annoyed his teammates.
e.zh: 他爱炫耀的骄傲让队友很烦。

e.en: The singer arrived in a {peacocky} silk suit.
e.zh: 歌手穿着一套花哨炫耀的丝绸西装到场。

e.en: His {peacocky} manner faded after the loss.
e.zh: 输掉之后，他那副自负的样子消失了。

peafowl.t: 孔雀类鸟；雌雄孔雀统称

e.en: Several {peafowl} wandered freely around the garden.
e.zh: 几只孔雀在花园里自由走动。

e.en: The term {peafowl} includes both peacocks and peahens.
e.zh: peafowl 这个词包括雄孔雀和雌孔雀。

e.en: Avoid {peak-hour} trains if you carry luggage.
e.zh: 如果带着行李，尽量避开高峰时段的火车。

e.en: The city raised {peak-hour} parking fees downtown.
e.zh: 市里提高了市中心高峰时段的停车费。

e.en: The grid failed during the {peak-load} period.
e.zh: 电网在峰值负荷时段发生了故障。

e.en: Engineers tested the bridge under {peak-load} conditions.
e.zh: 工程师在高峰负载条件下测试了这座桥。

e.en: The oscilloscope showed a ten-volt {peak-to-peak} signal.
e.zh: 示波器显示出一个十伏的峰峰值信号。

e.en: Measure the {peak-to-peak} distance between the waves.
e.zh: 测量这些波之间从峰到峰的距离。

e.en: The mountain looked {peakier} from the north side.
e.zh: 从北侧看，这座山显得更尖。

e.en: He seemed {peakier} after a week of fever.
e.zh: 发烧一周后，他看起来更憔悴了。

e.en: That ridge is the {peakiest} part of the skyline.
e.zh: 那道山脊是天际线上最尖耸的部分。

e.en: She looked the {peakiest} of all the patients.
e.zh: 在所有病人中，她看起来最憔悴。

e.en: You look a bit {peakish} this morning.
e.zh: 你今天早上看起来有点憔悴。

e.en: The roof had a {peakish} outline against the sky.
e.zh: 屋顶在天空映衬下呈现出尖峰似的轮廓。

e.en: The plant cannot meet winter {peakload} demand.
e.zh: 这座电厂无法满足冬季峰值负荷需求。

e.en: Good caching reduces {peakload} on the server.
e.zh: 良好的缓存能降低服务器的高峰负载。

e.en: His book mixes travel writing with {peakology}.
e.zh: 他的书把旅行写作和山峰研究结合在一起。

e.en: Local guides taught visitors some basic {peakology}.
e.zh: 当地向导教游客一些基本的登峰知识。

e.en: The plant produces small {pealike} seeds.
e.zh: 这种植物结出像豌豆一样的小种子。

e.en: A {pealike} smell came from the fresh shoots.
e.zh: 新芽散发出一种类似豌豆的气味。

e.en: The chef joked that the puree would {peamafy} the soup.
e.zh: 厨师开玩笑说，这种泥会把汤变得像豌豆一样。

e.en: Too much green dye can {peamafy} the whole dish.
e.zh: 绿色染料太多会让整道菜显得像豌豆做的。

e.en: The poem is a {pean} to rural life.
e.zh: 这首诗是一曲献给乡村生活的赞歌。

e.en: Critics called the film a {pean} of youthful hope.
e.zh: 评论家称这部电影是青春希望的欢乐颂。

e.en: The report was full of {pedagese} that parents could barely understand.
e.zh: 这份报告满是家长几乎看不懂的教育行话。

e.en: She mocked the principal's {pedagese} after the meeting.
e.zh: 会后她嘲笑校长那套教师腔。

e.en: The old {pedagog} drilled grammar into every pupil.
e.zh: 那位老教师让每个学生反复练习语法。

e.en: He sounded like a {pedagog} correcting everyone at dinner.
e.zh: 他在晚餐时纠正每个人，听起来像个卖弄学问的人。

e.en: The essay attacks {pedagogism} in modern schools.
e.zh: 这篇文章批评现代学校里的教育主义。

e.en: His speeches often slipped into dry {pedagogism}.
e.zh: 他的演讲常常变成枯燥的迂腐说教。

e.en: Her strict {pedagoguism} made the lesson feel old-fashioned.
e.zh: 她严格的教师作风让这堂课显得过时。

e.en: The novel gently ridicules his {pedagoguism}.
e.zh: 小说温和地嘲讽了他的迂腐说教。

e.en: The policy document used {pedaguese} instead of plain language.
e.zh: 这份政策文件不用明白话，而是用了教育行话。

e.en: Parents grew tired of the administrator's {pedaguese}.
e.zh: 家长们听腻了那位行政人员的教师腔。

e.en: She opened the {pedal-bin} without touching the lid.
e.zh: 她不用碰盖子就打开了脚踏垃圾桶。

e.en: The kitchen {pedal-bin} needs a new liner.
e.zh: 厨房的脚踏垃圾桶需要换一个新垃圾袋。

e.en: We rented a {pedalo} on the lake.
e.zh: 我们在湖上租了一艘脚踏游船。

e.en: The children raced their {pedalo} toward the pier.
e.zh: 孩子们踩着脚踏游船向码头比赛前进。

pedantically.t: 迂腐地；过分拘泥细节地

e.en: He {pedantically} corrected every comma in the memo.
e.zh: 他迂腐地纠正了备忘录里的每一个逗号。

e.en: The rule was applied {pedantically}, with no room for judgment.
e.zh: 这条规则被过分拘泥细节地执行，没有留下判断余地。

e.en: Do not {pedantize} a simple explanation with needless terms.
e.zh: 别用不必要的术语把简单解释弄得迂腐。

e.en: He tends to {pedantize} whenever grammar is mentioned.
e.zh: 一提到语法，他就容易卖弄学问。

e.en: The satire imagines a {pedantocracy} run by examiners.
e.zh: 这部讽刺作品设想了一个由考官管理的书呆子统治。

e.en: Critics called the committee a petty {pedantocracy}.
e.zh: 批评者称这个委员会是小题大做的迂儒专政。

e.en: The botanist noted the plant's {pedate} leaves.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这种植物掌状分裂的叶子。

e.en: A {pedate} pattern spread from the central vein.
e.zh: 一种足状纹路从中央叶脉向外展开。

e.en: The guide described the fern as {pedatifid}.
e.zh: 图鉴把这种蕨类描述为足状深裂的。

e.en: Its {pedatifid} leaf helped identify the species.
e.zh: 它那足状深裂的叶子有助于识别这个物种。

e.en: A {pedder} sold ribbons outside the market.
e.zh: 一个小贩在市场外卖丝带。

e.en: The village {pedder} carried needles and thread in his pack.
e.zh: 村里的沿街叫卖者包里带着针线。

e.en: He left farming for {peddlery} along the coast.
e.zh: 他离开农活，改在海岸一带做小贩行当。

e.en: The attic was filled with old {peddlery} from fairs.
e.zh: 阁楼里堆满了集市上来的旧叫卖货品。

e.en: A {pede} crawled from under the stone.
e.zh: 一只蜈蚣从石头下面爬了出来。

e.en: The Latin root {pede} refers to the foot.
e.zh: 拉丁词根pede指的是脚。

e.en: The historian discussed {pederastic} customs in ancient societies.
e.zh: 历史学家讨论了古代社会中的男童性恋习俗。

e.en: The passage contains a disturbing {pederastic} reference.
e.zh: 这段文字含有令人不安的男童性恋暗示。

e.en: The surgeon examined both {pedes} for injury.
e.zh: 外科医生检查了双脚是否受伤。

e.en: The poem has six {pedes} in each line.
e.zh: 这首诗每行有六个韵脚。

e.en: The lecturer used pollen grains to demonstrate {pedesis}.
e.zh: 讲师用花粉颗粒演示布朗运动。

e.en: Under the microscope, {pedesis} made the particles jitter.
e.zh: 在显微镜下，布朗运动使颗粒不停抖动。

e.en: The council voted to {pedestrianise} the old shopping street.
e.zh: 市政会投票决定把那条老商业街改为步行区。

e.en: If they {pedestrianise} the square, traffic will move elsewhere.
e.zh: 如果他们把广场改为步行区，车流就会转到别处。

e.en: Victorian crowds loved competitive {pedestrianism}.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的观众喜爱竞赛性的步行运动。

e.en: The critic complained about the novel's {pedestrianism}.
e.zh: 评论家抱怨这部小说平淡乏味。

e.en: She wore a dress that suited her {pear-shaped} figure.
e.zh: 她穿了一条很适合她梨形身材的连衣裙。

e.en: The plan went {pear-shaped} after the manager resigned.
e.zh: 经理辞职后，那个计划就出了岔子。

e.en: Local divers still {pearl-fish} in the shallow bay.
e.zh: 当地潜水者仍在浅海湾采珠。

e.en: The old crew taught him how to {pearl-fish} safely.
e.zh: 那支老船员队教他如何安全地采珠。

e.en: The island's {pearl-fishery} once employed hundreds of divers.
e.zh: 这座岛的采珠业曾雇用数百名潜水者。

e.en: Storms damaged the old {pearl-fishery} near the reef.
e.zh: 暴风雨毁坏了礁石附近的旧珍珠贝渔场。

e.en: A {pearlike} glow spread across the evening sky.
e.zh: 傍晚的天空泛起一层珍珠般的光泽。

e.en: The painter added {pearlike} highlights to the shell.
e.zh: 画家给贝壳添上了珠光般的高光。

e.en: The invitation was printed on {pearlised} paper.
e.zh: 请柬印在经过珠光处理的纸上。

e.en: Her nails were painted with a {pearlised} polish.
e.zh: 她的指甲涂了带珠光效果的指甲油。

e.en: The steel sample contained fine layers of {pearlite}.
e.zh: 这块钢样中含有细密的珠光体层。

e.en: Gardeners mix {pearlite} into soil to improve drainage.
e.zh: 园丁把珍珠岩混入土壤，以改善排水。

pearlized.t: 珠光处理的；有珍珠光泽的

e.en: The buttons had a {pearlized} finish.
e.zh: 这些纽扣表面带有珍珠般的光泽。

e.en: She chose {pearlized} paint for the bicycle frame.
e.zh: 她给自行车车架选了珠光漆。

e.en: Tiny {pearlwort} grew between the paving stones.
e.zh: 细小的珍珠草长在铺路石之间。

e.en: The botanist noted {pearlwort} on the damp hillside.
e.zh: 植物学家在潮湿的山坡上记录到珍珠草。

e.en: The orchard keeps an old {pearmain} tree near the wall.
e.zh: 果园在墙边保留着一棵老皮尔曼苹果树。

e.en: She baked the {pearmain} with cinnamon and butter.
e.zh: 她用肉桂和黄油烤了这种皮尔曼苹果。

e.en: The market sold several baskets of {pearmains}.
e.zh: 市场上卖着好几篮皮尔曼苹果。

e.en: These {pearmains} keep their flavor well in storage.
e.zh: 这些皮尔曼苹果储存后仍能保持风味。

e.en: The child looked {peart} again after breakfast.
e.zh: 那个孩子吃过早饭后又显得精神起来。

e.en: Grandma sounded {peart} on the phone this morning.
e.zh: 奶奶今天早上在电话里听起来很有精神。

e.en: She answered {peartly} despite the long journey.
e.zh: 尽管旅途很长，她还是精神饱满地回答。

e.en: The old man walked {peartly} into the village shop.
e.zh: 老人轻快地走进村里的商店。

e.en: The craftsman carved the handle from {pearwood}.
e.zh: 工匠用梨木雕刻了这个把手。

e.en: Old engravers valued {pearwood} for its smooth grain.
e.zh: 过去的雕版师看重梨木细腻平滑的纹理。

e.en: The regime tried to {peasantize} urban workers through rural campaigns.
e.zh: 该政权试图通过农村运动把城市工人农民化。

e.en: Some critics said the costume design would {peasantize} the heroine.
e.zh: 一些评论者说这种服装设计会把女主角塑造成乡土形象。

e.en: He wore a simple, {peasantlike} coat in the play.
e.zh: 他在剧中穿着一件朴素的、像农民穿的外套。

e.en: The room had a rough, {peasantlike} charm.
e.zh: 这个房间有一种粗朴的乡野魅力。

e.en: The child split a green {peascod} with her thumb.
e.zh: 孩子用拇指剥开了一个绿色豌豆荚。

e.en: In the old poem, a {peascod} symbolized spring abundance.
e.zh: 在那首古诗里，豌豆荚象征春天的丰饶。

e.en: He found one dry {peasecod} left on the vine.
e.zh: 他在藤上发现了一个干掉的豌豆荚。

e.en: The cook tossed the empty {peasecod} into the compost.
e.zh: 厨师把空豆荚扔进了堆肥里。

e.en: The recipe called for dried {peasen} and barley.
e.zh: 这道食谱需要干豌豆和大麦。

e.en: In older English, {peasen} was often used for peas.
e.zh: 在较古老的英语中，peasen 常用来指豌豆。

e.en: The boy aimed his {peashooter} at a paper target.
e.zh: 男孩把吹豆枪瞄准一个纸靶。

e.en: Against those cannons, our rifle felt like a {peashooter}.
e.zh: 面对那些大炮，我们的步枪显得像玩具枪一样无力。

e.en: The children made {peashooters} from hollow reeds.
e.zh: 孩子们用空心芦苇做了吹豆枪。

e.en: The soldiers joked that their old rifles were {peashooters}.
e.zh: 士兵们开玩笑说他们的旧步枪只是些无力的小枪。

e.en: She pushed a {peastick} into the soil beside each plant.
e.zh: 她在每株植物旁边把一根支豌豆藤的枝条插进土里。

e.en: The gardener cut hazel branches to use as {peasticks}.
e.zh: 园丁砍下榛树枝，用作支撑豌豆藤的枝条。

e.en: A warm {peat-reek} drifted from the cottage chimney.
e.zh: 一股温暖的泥炭烟味从小屋烟囱里飘出。

e.en: The whisky carried a faint {peat-reek} on the finish.
e.zh: 这款威士忌收尾时带着淡淡的泥炭烟味。

e.en: The path crossed a wide {peatbog} before reaching the lake.
e.zh: 小路穿过一大片泥炭沼泽后才到达湖边。

e.en: Scientists took core samples from the ancient {peatbog}.
e.zh: 科学家从这片古老的泥炭沼泽中提取了岩芯样本。

e.en: The family worked a small {peatery} beyond the hill.
e.zh: 这家人在山那边经营一小片泥炭地。

e.en: Rain filled the abandoned {peatery} with dark water.
e.zh: 雨水把废弃的泥炭地灌满了黑色的水。

e.en: This whisky is {peatier} than the one we tried yesterday.
e.zh: 这款威士忌比我们昨天尝的那款泥炭味更重。

e.en: The soil grew {peatier} as we approached the marsh.
e.zh: 我们越接近沼泽，土壤的泥炭质就越重。

peatiest.t: 泥炭最多的；最似泥炭的

e.en: The {peatiest} soil lay near the old marsh.
e.zh: 最富泥炭的土壤在旧沼泽附近。

e.en: This whisky is the {peatiest} in the range.
e.zh: 这款威士忌是这个系列里泥炭味最重的。

e.en: The reserve protects rare birds in the {peatland}.
e.zh: 这个保护区保护泥炭地里的珍稀鸟类。

e.en: Drained {peatland} can release large amounts of carbon.
e.zh: 被排干的泥炭地会释放大量碳。

e.en: The logger carried a {peavie} beside the river.
e.zh: 伐木工在河边带着一根钩杆。

e.en: He turned the floating log with a {peavie}.
e.zh: 他用伐木钩杆翻动漂浮的木头。

peavine.t: 豌豆藤；类似豆藤的植物

e.en: The {peavine} climbed over the garden fence.
e.zh: 豌豆藤爬过了花园篱笆。

e.en: Wild {peavine} covered the sunny bank.
e.zh: 野生豆藤覆盖了向阳的河岸。

e.en: He hooked the log with a {peavy}.
e.zh: 他用伐木钩杆钩住那根木头。

e.en: A worn {peavy} leaned against the shed wall.
e.zh: 一根旧伐木钩杆靠在棚屋墙边。

e.en: The cottage had rough {pebble-dash} on every wall.
e.zh: 那间小屋每面墙都有粗糙的卵石灰泥饰面。

e.en: They chose {pebble-dash} to protect the seaside house.
e.zh: 他们选用卵石灰泥来保护海边的房子。

e.en: Rain darkened the old {pebbledash} on the house.
e.zh: 雨水把房子旧的卵石灰泥外墙弄暗了。

e.en: The builder repaired a crack in the {pebbledash}.
e.zh: 建筑工修补了卵石灰泥饰面上的裂缝。

e.en: They bought a small {pebbledashed} bungalow.
e.zh: 他们买了一栋涂有卵石灰泥的小平房。

e.en: The wall was {pebbledashed} after the plaster dried.
e.zh: 灰泥干后，墙面被做成了卵石灰泥饰面。

pebbledashes.t: 卵石灰泥饰面的复数或动词形式

e.en: Old {pebbledashes} often need careful repair.
e.zh: 老旧的卵石灰泥饰面常常需要仔细修补。

e.en: The mason {pebbledashes} the wall before winter.
e.zh: 泥瓦匠在冬天前给墙面做卵石灰泥饰面。

e.en: A loose {pebblestone} rolled under her shoe.
e.zh: 一颗松动的小卵石滚到了她鞋底下。

e.en: The path was made from smooth {pebblestone}.
e.zh: 这条小路是用光滑的卵石铺成的。

e.en: The museum displayed Victorian {pebbleware} in a glass case.
e.zh: 博物馆把维多利亚时期的卵石纹陶器陈列在玻璃柜里。

e.en: She collected {pebbleware} for its mottled surface.
e.zh: 她收藏卵石纹陶器，因为喜欢它斑驳的表面。

pebblier.t: 卵石更多的；更像卵石的

e.en: The beach became {pebblier} farther north.
e.zh: 越往北走，海滩上的卵石越多。

e.en: This clay feels {pebblier} than the last batch.
e.zh: 这批黏土摸起来比上一批更有颗粒感。

pebbliest.t: 卵石最多的；最似卵石的

e.en: We avoided the {pebbliest} part of the shore.
e.zh: 我们避开了岸边卵石最多的地方。

e.en: The {pebbliest} texture gave the pot a rustic look.
e.zh: 最粗砾的质感让这个陶罐显得朴拙。

e.en: The sermon discussed human {peccability} at length.
e.zh: 那篇布道详细谈到了人的可犯罪性。

e.en: Philosophers argued about the {peccability} of a perfect being.
e.zh: 哲学家们争论完美存在是否可能犯错。

e.en: The theologian described humans as {peccable} creatures.
e.zh: 那位神学家把人类描述为会犯罪的存在。

e.en: Even a wise leader remains {peccable}.
e.zh: 即使明智的领导者也仍可能犯错。

e.en: The essay treats greed as a common {peccancy}.
e.zh: 这篇文章把贪婪视为常见的道德过失。

e.en: He confessed his {peccancy} in formal language.
e.zh: 他用正式措辞承认了自己的罪过。

e.en: The judge condemned the {peccant} official.
e.zh: 法官谴责了那名有罪的官员。

e.en: Medieval doctors blamed a {peccant} humor for the illness.
e.zh: 中世纪医生把疾病归咎于有害的体液。

e.en: He acted {peccantly} despite repeated warnings.
e.zh: 尽管屡次受到警告，他还是有错地行事。

e.en: The character speaks {peccantly} in the old morality play.
e.zh: 这个角色在古老的道德剧中以罪人的口吻说话。

peccatiphobia.t: 恐罪症；害怕犯罪的恐惧

e.en: Her {peccatiphobia} made every mistake feel unforgivable.
e.zh: 她的恐罪症让每个错误都显得不可饶恕。

e.en: The article defined {peccatiphobia} as a fear of sinning.
e.zh: 文章把恐罪症定义为对犯罪或犯戒的恐惧。

peccatophobia.t: 恐罪症；害怕犯罪的恐惧

e.en: Severe {peccatophobia} can trouble a religious patient.
e.zh: 严重的恐罪症可能困扰有宗教信仰的病人。

e.en: He used {peccatophobia} to describe her dread of sin.
e.zh: 他用恐罪症来描述她对罪的恐惧。

e.en: After months of denial, he finally said {peccavi}.
e.zh: 否认了几个月后，他终于承认自己有罪。

e.en: The memoir ends with a quiet {peccavi}.
e.zh: 这本回忆录以一句平静的认罪作结。

e.en: The blood test showed {pecilocythemia} in the sample.
e.zh: 血液检测显示样本中有红细胞大小不均症。

e.en: Doctors noted {pecilocythemia} during the anemia workup.
e.zh: 医生在贫血检查中注意到红细胞大小不均症。

e.en: Do not act like a {peckerhead} in the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时别表现得像个讨厌的蠢货。

e.en: He called the rude driver a {peckerhead}.
e.zh: 他把那个粗鲁的司机骂作蠢货。

e.en: The reformer sounded like a {Pecksniff} when he praised his own humility.
e.zh: 那位改革者夸耀自己的谦逊时，听起来像个伪善的假道学者。

e.en: She dismissed the moral lecturer as a smug {Pecksniff}.
e.zh: 她把那个道德说教者斥为自鸣得意的伪君子。

e.en: His {Pecksniffian} concern for the poor vanished after the cameras left.
e.zh: 镜头一走，他那种伪善做作的济贫关怀就消失了。

e.en: The speech had a {Pecksniffian} tone of injured virtue.
e.zh: 那篇演讲带着一种假道学式的受辱美德腔调。

e.en: The old beam was {pecky} and weak from years of decay.
e.zh: 那根旧横梁因多年腐朽而多孔脆弱。

e.en: Woodworkers sometimes prize {pecky} cypress for its unusual texture.
e.zh: 木匠有时会看重带孔的柏木，因为它纹理独特。

e.en: The chemist added {pectase} to break down the fruit pulp.
e.zh: 化学师加入果胶酶来分解果肉。

e.en: Naturally occurring {pectase} can change the texture of stored juice.
e.zh: 天然存在的果胶酶会改变贮存果汁的质地。

e.en: Calcium {pectate} helps hold plant cell walls together.
e.zh: 果胶酸钙有助于把植物细胞壁黏合在一起。

e.en: The sample contained a small amount of soluble {pectate}.
e.zh: 样品中含有少量可溶性果胶酸盐。

e.en: The bird's eye contains a folded {pecten} that nourishes the retina.
e.zh: 鸟眼中有一个皱褶的梳状结构，为视网膜提供营养。

e.en: The fossil was identified as a {pecten} by its fan-shaped shell.
e.zh: 这块化石因其扇形贝壳被鉴定为扇贝属。

e.en: Apples contain {pectic} substances that help jam set.
e.zh: 苹果含有果胶类物质，有助于果酱凝固。

e.en: The lab measured {pectic} acid in the plant tissue.
e.zh: 实验室测定了植物组织中的果胶酸。

e.en: The fruit left a {pectinaceous} film on the spoon.
e.zh: 这种水果在勺子上留下一层类似果胶的薄膜。

e.en: A {pectinaceous} layer formed as the mixture cooled.
e.zh: 混合物冷却时形成了一层含果胶的物质。

e.en: Winemakers use {pectinase} to clarify cloudy juice.
e.zh: 酿酒师使用果胶酶来澄清浑浊的果汁。

e.en: Adding {pectinase} made the fruit mash easier to press.
e.zh: 加入果胶酶后，水果浆更容易压榨。

e.en: The insect's antennae were {pectinate}, like tiny combs.
e.zh: 这种昆虫的触角呈梳状，像小小的梳子。

e.en: A {pectinate} edge helps the leaf shed water quickly.
e.zh: 齿状边缘有助于叶片迅速排水。

e.en: The shell had a {pectinated} margin along one side.
e.zh: 贝壳一侧有梳齿状的边缘。

e.en: Doctors noted the {pectinated} muscles inside the atrium.
e.zh: 医生注意到心房内呈梳状排列的肌肉。

e.en: The leaf's {pectination} is visible under a hand lens.
e.zh: 用手持放大镜可以看到叶片的齿状排列。

e.en: Anatomists described the fine {pectination} of the heart muscle.
e.zh: 解剖学家描述了心肌细密的梳状结构。

e.en: Heat treatment reduces {pectinesterase} activity in orange juice.
e.zh: 热处理会降低橙汁中的果胶酯酶活性。

e.en: The study measured {pectinesterase} levels during fruit ripening.
e.zh: 研究测量了水果成熟过程中的果胶酯酶水平。

e.en: The analyst reported traces of {pectinose} in the extract.
e.zh: 分析员报告提取物中有微量果胶糖。

e.en: Older chemistry texts list {pectinose} among sugars from pectin.
e.zh: 较早的化学教材把果胶糖列为果胶来源的糖类之一。

pectization.t: 胶凝化；溶胶变凝胶过程

e.en: Salt can trigger {pectization} in certain colloidal mixtures.
e.zh: 盐能促使某些胶体混合物发生胶凝化。

e.en: The experiment tracked {pectization} as the liquid became a gel.
e.zh: 实验跟踪了液体变成凝胶时的胶凝化过程。

pectize.t: 使胶凝；变成果胶状凝胶

e.en: The solution began to {pectize} after the acid was added.
e.zh: 加入酸后，溶液开始胶凝。

e.en: Technicians can {pectize} the colloid by adjusting its salts.
e.zh: 技术人员可以通过调节盐分使胶体胶凝。

e.en: The {pectizing} mixture thickened within minutes.
e.zh: 正在胶凝的混合物几分钟内就变稠了。

e.en: Careful stirring slowed the {pectizing} of the colloid.
e.zh: 小心搅拌减缓了胶体的胶凝过程。

e.en: Unripe fruit contains more {pectose} than ripe fruit.
e.zh: 未成熟水果比成熟水果含有更多不溶性原果胶。

e.en: Heating converted some {pectose} into soluble pectin.
e.zh: 加热使一部分果胶质转化为可溶性果胶。

e.en: The audit uncovered years of {peculation} by senior officials.
e.zh: 审计发现高级官员多年来一直挪用公款。

e.en: He was dismissed for {peculation}, not mere poor bookkeeping.
e.zh: 他被解雇是因为侵吞财物，而不只是账目处理不当。

e.en: The treasurer was exposed as a {peculator} after the accounts were checked.
e.zh: 账目核查后，司库被揭露为挪用公款者。

e.en: A clever {peculator} may hide small thefts for years.
e.zh: 精明的侵吞者可能把小额盗用隐藏多年。

e.en: Local customs {peculiarize} the festival in every village.
e.zh: 地方习俗使每个村庄的节日都各具特色。

e.en: The poet used dialect to {peculiarize} each speaker's voice.
e.zh: 诗人用方言让每个说话者的声音显得独特。

e.en: The decision benefited him {pecuniarily} but damaged his reputation.
e.zh: 这个决定在金钱上让他受益，却损害了他的名声。

e.en: She was not {pecuniarily} responsible for the company's debts.
e.zh: 她在财务上不必为公司的债务负责。

e.en: His sudden {pecuniosity} surprised relatives who knew his debts.
e.zh: 他突然变得富有，让知道他负债的亲戚很惊讶。

e.en: The novel mocks the family's pride in its {pecuniosity}.
e.zh: 小说嘲讽了这个家族对自身财富充裕的自傲。

e.en: Only the most {pecunious} patrons could afford the private box.
e.zh: 只有最富有的赞助人才能负担得起私人包厢。

e.en: He appeared {pecunious}, though his fortune was mostly borrowed.
e.zh: 他看起来很有钱，尽管他的财富大多是借来的。

e.en: The council supported {pedestrianization} of the old market street.
e.zh: 市议会支持把老市场街改成步行区。

e.en: Shop owners feared {pedestrianization} would reduce passing trade.
e.zh: 店主担心步行化会减少路过的生意。

e.en: The city plans to {pedestrianize} several busy streets downtown.
e.zh: 该市计划把市中心几条繁忙街道改为步行区。

e.en: Residents asked officials to {pedestrianize} the square on weekends.
e.zh: 居民要求官员在周末把广场设为步行区。

e.en: The {pedestrianized} avenue is popular with families.
e.zh: 这条已改为步行区的大道很受家庭游客欢迎。

e.en: Cars are banned from the {pedestrianized} town center.
e.zh: 汽车不得进入这个步行化的市中心。

e.en: The proposal {pedestrianizes} the streets around the station.
e.zh: 这项提案会把车站周围的街道改成步行区。

e.en: Every summer the resort {pedestrianizes} its seafront road.
e.zh: 每年夏天，这个度假地都会把海滨路改为步行区。

pedestrianizing.t: 正在步行化；改成步行区

e.en: They are {pedestrianizing} the bridge to improve safety.
e.zh: 他们正在把这座桥改成步行通道以提高安全性。

e.en: The debate over {pedestrianizing} the district lasted months.
e.zh: 关于把该区步行化的争论持续了数月。

e.en: The doctor noted a slight {pedial} deformity in the infant.
e.zh: 医生注意到这个婴儿有轻微足部畸形。

e.en: The fossil showed unusual {pedial} bones for its species.
e.zh: 这块化石显示出该物种少见的足部骨骼。

e.en: The essay mocked the household as a tiny {pediarchy}.
e.zh: 这篇文章嘲讽这个家庭像一个小小的儿童统治国。

e.en: Some critics use {pediarchy} to describe child-centered parenting taken too far.
e.zh: 一些评论者用儿童支配来形容过度以孩子为中心的育儿方式。

e.en: A {pediatrist} examined the child after the fever returned.
e.zh: 孩子再次发烧后，一名儿科医生给他做了检查。

e.en: The old hospital directory listed her as a {pediatrist}.
e.zh: 旧医院名录把她列为儿科医生。

e.en: He studied {pediatry} before joining the rural clinic.
e.zh: 他在加入乡村诊所前学习过儿科学。

e.en: The lecture traced the early history of {pediatry}.
e.zh: 这场讲座回顾了儿科医疗的早期历史。

e.en: Each flower hangs from a slender {pedicel}.
e.zh: 每朵花都由一根细小花梗悬挂着。

e.en: The specimen had a tiny {pedicel} beneath the capsule.
e.zh: 这个标本的蒴果下面有一个细小的柄状结构。

e.en: The plant bears small {pediceled} flowers in spring.
e.zh: 这种植物春天会开出有小花梗的小花。

e.en: Under the lens, the {pediceled} structures became easy to see.
e.zh: 在镜头下，这些有柄结构变得清晰可见。

e.en: The sea urchin uses a {pedicellaria} to remove debris.
e.zh: 海胆会用叉棘清除身上的碎屑。

e.en: A single {pedicellaria} looked like a tiny jaw under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下，一个叉棘看起来像微小的颚。

e.en: The surgeon checked the {pedicular} screw placement carefully.
e.zh: 外科医生仔细检查椎弓根螺钉的位置。

e.en: The report described a {pedicular} infestation in clinical terms.
e.zh: 报告用临床术语描述了一次虱寄生情况。

e.en: The mushroom has a distinctly {pediculate} base.
e.zh: 这种蘑菇有明显的有柄基部。

e.en: Botanists described the fruit as {pediculate} rather than sessile.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种果实描述为有小梗，而不是无柄。

e.en: The diagram shows the {pediculation} of the developing flower.
e.zh: 图示展示了发育中花朵的小梗形成。

e.en: Pathologists noted unusual {pediculation} in the growth.
e.zh: 病理学家注意到这个增生物有异常的有柄状态。

e.en: The nurse recommended a mild {pediculicide} for the outbreak.
e.zh: 护士建议使用一种温和的杀虱剂来处理这次传播。

e.en: Parents should follow the {pediculicide} instructions exactly.
e.zh: 家长应严格按照杀虱剂的说明使用。

e.en: The scan revealed a rare {pediculofrontal} connection.
e.zh: 扫描显示出一种罕见的椎弓根额部连接。

e.en: The paper used {pediculofrontal} to describe the anatomical route.
e.zh: 论文用椎弓根额部的这个词来描述解剖路径。

e.en: Her {pediculophobia} worsened after the school outbreak.
e.zh: 学校暴发虱患后，她的虱恐惧症加重了。

e.en: The therapist treated {pediculophobia} with gradual exposure.
e.zh: 治疗师通过逐步暴露来治疗虱恐惧症。

e.en: The clinic treated several cases of {pediculosis} that week.
e.zh: 那周诊所治疗了几例虱病。

e.en: Good hygiene alone may not prevent {pediculosis}.
e.zh: 仅靠良好卫生习惯未必能预防虱寄生。

e.en: The shelter isolated the {pediculous} patient for treatment.
e.zh: 收容所把这名有虱病的病人隔离治疗。

e.en: Old medical texts used {pediculous} to describe lice-infested clothing.
e.zh: 旧医学文献用有虱的这个词描述长满虱子的衣物。

e.en: The microscope slide showed a clear {pediculus} specimen.
e.zh: 显微镜载玻片上显示出一个清晰的虱标本。

e.en: Researchers identified {pediculus} in the historical sample.
e.zh: 研究人员在历史样本中鉴定出了虱属昆虫。

e.en: The {pedicurist} trimmed her nails carefully.
e.zh: 修脚师仔细地给她修剪脚趾甲。

e.en: A licensed {pedicurist} should sterilize every tool.
e.zh: 持证足部护理师应给每件工具消毒。

e.en: The fossil left a {pediform} mark in the clay.
e.zh: 化石在黏土中留下了足形痕迹。

e.en: The designer rejected the awkward {pediform} handle.
e.zh: 设计师否定了那个像脚一样别扭的把手。

pedigree-man.t: 研究血统的人；谱系专家

e.en: The old {pedigree-man} traced the horse's ancestors.
e.zh: 那位老谱系专家追溯了这匹马的祖先。

e.en: A {pedigree-man} was hired to verify the family's claims.
e.zh: 他们聘请了一名研究血统的人来核实家族说法。

e.en: The lemur was once described as a {pedimane}.
e.zh: 狐猴曾被描述为手足并用的动物。

e.en: In old zoology, a {pedimane} had handlike feet.
e.zh: 在旧动物学中，手足并用动物有像手一样的脚。

e.en: The old sailor walked with a {pegleg}.
e.zh: 那位老水手拄着木腿走路。

e.en: Children imagined the pirate as a fierce {pegleg}.
e.zh: 孩子们把那个海盗想象成凶狠的木腿人。

e.en: The mine exposed a vein of {pegmatite}.
e.zh: 矿井露出了一条伟晶岩脉。

e.en: Large crystals often form inside {pegmatite}.
e.zh: 大晶体常常在伟晶岩中形成。

e.en: The granite showed signs of {pegmatitization}.
e.zh: 这块花岗岩显示出伟晶岩化作用的迹象。

e.en: Geologists debated when {pegmatitization} affected the rock.
e.zh: 地质学家讨论伟晶岩化作用是在何时影响这块岩石的。

e.en: The sample had a {pegmatoid} texture.
e.zh: 这个样本具有似伟晶岩的结构。

e.en: They classified the coarse material as {pegmatoid}.
e.zh: 他们把这种粗粒物质归为似伟晶岩类。

e.en: The thin section revealed a {pegmatophyric} fabric.
e.zh: 薄片显示出具伟晶斑状的结构。

e.en: A {pegmatophyric} rock may contain unusually large crystals.
e.zh: 具伟晶斑状结构的岩石可能含有异常大的晶体。

e.en: The carpenter kept dry {pegwood} for repairs.
e.zh: 木匠留着干燥的木钉木料以便修补。

e.en: Good {pegwood} must be tough and straight-grained.
e.zh: 好的木钉木料必须坚韧且纹理笔直。

e.en: Researchers measured {peimine} in the herbal extract.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了草药提取物中的贝母碱含量。

e.en: The paper discussed possible effects of {peimine}.
e.zh: 论文讨论了贝母碱可能产生的作用。

e.en: He shaped the metal with the hammer's {pein}.
e.zh: 他用锤头尖端给金属塑形。

e.en: Workers {pein} the rivet until it spreads.
e.zh: 工人们敲打铆钉头，直到它展开。

e.en: The potter mixed {peitunitze} with kaolin.
e.zh: 陶工把瓷石和高岭土混合在一起。

e.en: Fine porcelain once depended on good {peitunitze}.
e.zh: 优质瓷器过去离不开好的瓷石。

e.en: Over time, the term began to {pejorate}.
e.zh: 随着时间推移，这个词开始带有贬义。

e.en: Political slogans can {pejorate} a neutral label.
e.zh: 政治口号可能使一个中性称呼贬义化。

e.en: The word underwent {pejoration} in modern usage.
e.zh: 这个词在现代用法中发生了贬义化。

e.en: Linguists traced the {pejoration} of the expression.
e.zh: 语言学家追溯了这个表达的贬义化过程。

e.en: She brewed a pot of {pekoe} after lunch.
e.zh: 午饭后她泡了一壶白毫茶。

e.en: The label described the tea as orange {pekoe}.
e.zh: 标签把这种茶标为橙黄白毫茶。

e.en: The fox's winter {pelage} was thick and pale.
e.zh: 这只狐狸的冬季毛被又厚又浅。

e.en: Scientists compared the {pelage} of related mammals.
e.zh: 科学家比较了近缘哺乳动物的毛被。

e.en: The council condemned {Pelagianism} as heresy.
e.zh: 会议把伯拉纠主义定为异端。

e.en: Students studied {Pelagianism} in early Christian theology.
e.zh: 学生们在早期基督教神学中学习伯拉纠主义。

e.en: The fisherman identified the catch as a {pelamyd}.
e.zh: 渔夫认出捕到的是一条鲣鱼类。

e.en: Old naturalists used {pelamyd} for certain young tunas.
e.zh: 早期博物学家用 pelamyd 指某些幼金枪鱼。

peens.t: 锤尖；锤头尖端，用尖头敲打

e.en: The blacksmith shaped the rivet with the hammer's {peen}.
e.zh: 铁匠用锤子的尖头给铆钉定形。

e.en: She carefully {peened} the metal edge flat.
e.zh: 她小心地用锤尖把金属边敲平。

e.en: He looked through the {peep-hole} before opening the door.
e.zh: 开门前，他先从门上的窥视孔看了看。

e.en: A tiny {peep-hole} let light into the box.
e.zh: 一个小窥孔让光线照进了盒子里。

e.en: She wore black {peep-toe} heels to dinner.
e.zh: 她穿着黑色露趾高跟鞋去吃晚餐。

e.en: The shop sells sandals and {peep-toe} pumps.

e.zh: 她躲在窗帘后面玩躲猫猫。

e.zh: 那个小孩说他要尿尿。

e.zh: 一棵高大的菩提树遮住了寺庙庭院。

e.en: Villagers rested beneath the old {peepul} tree.
e.zh: 村民们在那棵老菩提树下休息。

e.zh: 她的研究在发表前通过了同行评审。

e.zh: 这个说法缺少经过同行评审的证据。

e.en: The {peeress} took her seat in the chamber.
e.zh: 那位女贵族在议院中就座。

e.zh: 维多利亚时代的贵族夫人常有公共职责。

e.zh: 几位女贵族出席了王室仪式。

e.en: The book describes the lives of nineteenth-century {peeresses}.
e.zh: 这本书描写了十九世纪贵族夫人们的生活。

e.en: A {peetweet} cried over the wet meadow.
e.zh: 一只田凫在湿草地上空鸣叫。

e.zh: 农夫凭叫声认出了那只麦鸡。

e.zh: 一些语言挑剔者反对这种新用法。

e.en: Online {peevers} complained about every small mistake.
e.zh: 网上的抱怨者对每个小错误都不满。

e.en: The {peevit} rose suddenly from the field.
e.zh: 那只田凫突然从田里飞起。

e.en: We heard a {peevit} calling near the marsh.
e.zh: 我们听见沼泽附近有麦鸡在叫。

e.en: He became {peevy} when the meeting ran late.
e.zh: 会议拖延时，他变得有些烦躁易怒。

e.en: Her {peevy} comments spoiled the friendly mood.
e.zh: 她那些爱抱怨的话破坏了友好的气氛。

e.en: The {peewee} players practiced after school.
e.zh: 小孩组球员放学后训练。

e.en: They lived in a {peewee} apartment downtown.
e.zh: 他们住在市中心一套很小的公寓里。

e.en: We had to {peg-down} the tent before sunset.
e.zh: 日落前我们得把帐篷用桩固定好。

e.en: The gardener will {peg-down} the netting over the seedlings.
e.zh: 园丁会把幼苗上方的网钉牢。

e.en: The child spun a wooden {peg-top} on the floor.
e.zh: 孩子在地板上转动一个木陀螺。

e.en: He wore old {peg-top} trousers in the photograph.
e.zh: 照片里他穿着旧式上宽下窄的裤子。

e.en: His {peg-topped} trousers looked old-fashioned.
e.zh: 他那条上宽下窄的裤子显得很老派。

e.en: The vase had a {peg-topped} shape.
e.zh: 这个花瓶呈上宽下窄的形状。

e.en: The old suitcase was covered in cracked {pegamoid}.
e.zh: 旧手提箱外面包着开裂的人造革。

e.en: They used {pegamoid} for the cheap book cover.
e.zh: 他们用仿皮材料做廉价书封。

e.en: The violin's {pegbox} needed careful repair.
e.zh: 这把小提琴的弦轴箱需要仔细修理。

e.en: She carved a new {pegbox} for the lute.
e.zh: 她为那把鲁特琴雕了一个新的弦轴箱。

e.en: The museum entrance has a {pedimental} roofline above its columns.
e.zh: 博物馆入口的柱子上方有三角楣式屋顶线。

e.en: She admired the {pedimental} sculpture on the old courthouse.
e.zh: 她欣赏旧法院山墙饰上的雕刻。

pedimentation.t: 山墙饰建造；三角楣装饰

e.en: The architect used {pedimentation} to give the facade a classical look.
e.zh: 建筑师用三角楣装饰让外立面显得古典。

e.en: Heavy {pedimentation} made the small building seem formal.
e.zh: 厚重的山墙饰让这座小楼显得庄重。

e.en: The shoemaker checked my foot with a {pedimeter}.
e.zh: 鞋匠用足部测量器量了我的脚。

e.en: A digital {pedimeter} can record the child's foot length accurately.
e.zh: 数字脚长计能准确记录孩子的脚长。

e.en: The spider uses its {pedipalpi} to sense nearby objects.
e.zh: 蜘蛛用触肢感知附近的物体。

e.en: Under the lens, the scorpion's {pedipalpi} looked like small claws.
e.zh: 在镜头下，蝎子的触肢看起来像小钳子。

e.en: The drawing highlights the animal's {pedipalpid} structures.
e.zh: 这幅图突出了这种动物的触肢结构。

e.en: A {pedipalpid} appendage helps many arachnids handle food.
e.zh: 触肢类附肢帮助许多蛛形动物处理食物。

e.en: Each {pedipalpus} sits beside the spider's mouthparts.
e.zh: 每个触肢都位于蜘蛛口器旁边。

e.en: The male spider's {pedipalpus} is important in mating.
e.zh: 雄蜘蛛的触肢在交配中很重要。

e.en: The old {pediplain} stretched across the dry interior.
e.zh: 古老的山麓夷平面横贯干旱内陆。

e.en: Geologists mapped the {pediplain} below the rocky hills.
e.zh: 地质学家绘制了岩石丘陵下方的剥蚀平原。

e.en: Several {pediplains} formed after long periods of erosion.
e.zh: 长期侵蚀后形成了几片山麓夷平面。

e.en: The atlas marks broad {pediplains} around the plateau.
e.zh: 地图册标出了高原周围宽广的剥蚀平原。

e.en: The landscape was shaped by slow {pediplanation}.
e.zh: 这片地貌由缓慢的山麓夷平作用塑造。

e.en: Researchers debated whether {pediplanation} explained the flat surface.
e.zh: 研究人员争论山麓夷平作用能否解释这个平坦表面。

e.en: A broad {pediplane} lay between the desert hills.
e.zh: 沙漠丘陵之间有一片宽阔的山麓夷平面。

e.en: The survey identified the surface as a late-stage {pediplane}.
e.zh: 勘测把该表面认定为晚期剥蚀平面。

e.en: The doctor noted a fracture in the os {pedis}.
e.zh: 医生记录了足骨的一处骨折。

e.en: The phrase pes {pedis} appears in the anatomy glossary.
e.zh: pes pedis 这个词组出现在解剖学词汇表中。

e.en: Old laws restricted {pedlary} inside the city walls.
e.zh: 旧法律限制城墙内的小贩行当。

e.en: His grandfather made a living by {pedlary} and repair work.
e.zh: 他的祖父靠沿街叫卖和修理活谋生。

e.en: A {pedler} came through the village with ribbons and needles.
e.zh: 一个小贩带着丝带和针线来到村里。

e.en: The story portrays him as a dishonest {pedler}.
e.zh: 故事把他描写成一个不诚实的沿街小贩。

e.en: The minister defended {pedobaptism} in a long sermon.
e.zh: 牧师在长篇布道中为婴儿洗礼辩护。

e.en: Their church rejected {pedobaptism} and baptized only adults.
e.zh: 他们的教会反对婴儿洗礼，只给成年人施洗。

e.en: The {pedobaptist} pastor explained the practice to new members.
e.zh: 这位主张婴儿洗礼的牧师向新成员解释这种做法。

e.en: He wrote a {pedobaptist} argument based on covenant theology.
e.zh: 他写了一篇基于圣约神学的婴儿洗礼论证。

e.en: The valley soil was classified as {pedocal}.
e.zh: 山谷土壤被归类为钙积干旱土。

e.en: A {pedocal} often develops where rainfall is limited.
e.zh: 降雨有限的地方常会形成钙积干旱土。

e.en: The team described the area's {pedocalic} soil profile.
e.zh: 团队描述了该地区钙积干旱土的土壤剖面。

e.en: A {pedocalic} horizon may contain visible calcium carbonate.
e.zh: 钙积干旱土层可能含有可见的碳酸钙。

e.en: The report includes {pedochemical} data from each field site.
e.zh: 报告包含每个野外点的土壤化学数据。

e.en: Her {pedochemical} analysis showed high salt levels.
e.zh: 她的土壤化学分析显示盐分含量很高。

e.en: The clinic added a {pedodontic} room for young patients.
e.zh: 诊所为小患者增设了一间儿童牙科诊室。

e.en: She completed {pedodontic} training after dental school.
e.zh: 她从牙学院毕业后完成了儿童牙科培训。

e.en: He specializes in {pedodontics} at the university hospital.
e.zh: 他在大学医院专攻儿童牙科学。

e.en: Modern {pedodontics} emphasizes prevention and gentle care.
e.zh: 现代儿童牙科学强调预防和温和护理。

e.en: The textbook briefly defines {pedogamy} in protozoan reproduction.
e.zh: 教材简要定义了原生动物繁殖中的幼体配子结合。

e.en: Scientists observed {pedogamy} during the organism's early stage.
e.zh: 科学家在该生物早期阶段观察到幼体配子结合。

e.en: Climate strongly influences {pedogenesis} in mountain regions.
e.zh: 气候强烈影响山区的土壤形成作用。

e.en: The study links {pedogenesis} to vegetation and parent rock.
e.zh: 这项研究把土壤形成作用与植被和母岩联系起来。

pedograph.t: 土壤剖面图；土壤记录图

e.zh: 研究人员为采样山坡绘制了土壤剖面图。

e.en: A clear {pedograph} helps compare soil layers.
e.zh: 清晰的土壤记录图有助于比较土层。

e.en: The expedition collected {pedological} samples across the basin.
e.zh: 考察队在整个盆地采集了土壤学样本。

e.en: Her {pedological} research focuses on tropical soils.
e.zh: 她的土壤学研究聚焦热带土壤。

e.en: The {pedologist} examined the layers of clay and sand.
e.zh: 那位土壤学家检查了黏土和沙层。

e.en: A field {pedologist} can explain why crops fail there.
e.zh: 实地土壤研究者能解释那里作物歉收的原因。

e.en: She studied {pedology} before working in land management.
e.zh: 她先学习土壤学，后来从事土地管理。

e.en: Modern {pedology} links soil formation with climate and geology.
e.zh: 现代土壤研究把土壤形成同气候和地质联系起来。

e.zh: 这项研究使用了腕戴设备的步数测量数据。

e.en: Older {pedometrical} methods were less accurate on uneven ground.
e.zh: 较早的计步方法在不平地面上准确性较差。

e.zh: 这个物种的成年体形表现出幼态持续。

e.en: Biologists use {pedomorphism} to describe retained juvenile traits.
e.zh: 生物学家用幼形保留来描述保留下来的幼年特征。

e.en: The report described {pedophiliac} behavior in clinical terms.
e.zh: 报告用临床术语描述了恋童癖行为。

e.en: Police investigated a suspected {pedophiliac} offender.
e.zh: 警方调查了一名涉嫌恋童的犯罪者。

e.zh: 她的儿童恐惧症让拥挤的游乐场变得极其有压力。

e.zh: 治疗师通过逐步接触来治疗惧童症。

e.zh: 土壤圈支撑着森林、农田和许多微生物。

e.zh: 科学家把土壤圈作为地球系统的一部分来研究。

e.zh: 那台老拖拉机用宽履带式车轮穿过松软地面。

e.zh: 工程师为军用车辆测试了一套履带轮系统。

e.zh: 她在医学院期间轮转过儿科。

e.zh: 孩子发烧后，护士联系了儿科医生。

e.zh: 每朵花都从一根细长的花梗上垂下。

e.zh: 脑部扫描显示大脑脚附近有损伤。

e.zh: 医生在扫描中注意到一个柄状部位的病变。

e.zh: 这种植物花下有短短的花梗部绒毛。

e.zh: 这种橡树有长在短梗上的橡子。

e.zh: 有蒂肿瘤通过一条狭窄的柄相连。

e.en: The toddler said he needed to go {pee-pee}.
e.zh: 那个小孩说他要去尿尿。

e.zh: 她和儿子说话时用尿尿这个温和的说法。

e.en: The children wore their {peejays} to the movie night.
e.zh: 孩子们穿着睡衣参加电影之夜。

e.en: I changed into {peejays} as soon as I got home.
e.zh: 我一到家就换上了睡衣。

e.zh: 这张贴纸可以剥离，而且不会留下痕迹。

e.en: Choose a {peelable} paint for temporary wall designs.
e.zh: 临时墙面设计可以选用可剥离涂料。

e.zh: 他用锤头尖端给铆钉定形。

e.zh: 工人敲击金属表面使其更坚固。

e.zh: 机械师把边缘锤平以固定销钉。

e.zh: 经敲击硬化的表面更能抵抗细小裂纹。

e.en: Stop {peenge} about the rain and bring an umbrella.
e.zh: 别再抱怨下雨了，带把伞吧。

e.zh: 会议拖延时，他开始发牢骚。

e.zh: 她不停地发牢骚让办公室里所有人都很烦。

e.en: He was {peenging} about the price all morning.
e.zh: 他整个上午都在抱怨价格。

e.zh: 那个孩子把小鸡鸡当作滑稽的私密说法。

e.zh: 她的围巾用了鲜艳的佩朗式拼花图案。

e.zh: 这种油散发出淡淡的天竺葵酮气味。

e.zh: 他们在反应过程中测定了壬酮含量。

e.zh: 花瓣因含有天竺葵色素而呈红色。

e.zh: 这种红色染料主要是天竺葵苷。

e.zh: 他们研究了海岸附近几种鹈形目鸟类。

e.zh: 早期论文有时把它称作正电子旧称pelectron。

e.zh: pelectron这个术语后来被positron取代。

e.zh: 这座小岛成了喧闹的鹈鹕栖息处。

e.zh: 我们从船上观察那片鹈鹕群栖地。

e.zh: 医生在检查中使用了骨盆测量器。

e.zh: 暴风雨过后，天空呈现暗青灰色。

e.zh: 他给金属涂上了一层铅灰色调。

e.zh: 她扣好了那件毛皮衬里的长外衣。

e.en: Garnet grew inside the {pelitic} schist.
e.zh: 石榴石生长在泥质片岩内部。

e.zh: 这种泥质岩主要由细小黏土矿物组成。

e.en: Explorers packed {pemican} for the long journey north.
e.zh: 探险者为漫长的北上旅程携带了干肉脂果饼。

e.en: Traditional {pemican} combines dried meat, fat, and berries.
e.zh: 传统干肉脂果饼由干肉、脂肪和浆果混合制成。

e.en: The biopsy supported a diagnosis of {pemphigoid}.
e.zh: 活检结果支持类天疱疮的诊断。

e.en: Elderly patients are more likely to develop bullous {pemphigoid}.
e.zh: 老年患者更容易患大疱性类天疱疮。

e.en: The rash had a {pemphigous} appearance.
e.zh: 这片皮疹呈现天疱疮样外观。

e.en: Doctors monitored the {pemphigous} lesions for infection.
e.zh: 医生监测这些水疱性病灶是否感染。

e.en: The dermatologist treated her severe {pemphigus}.
e.zh: 皮肤科医生治疗了她严重的天疱疮。

e.en: Untreated {pemphigus} can cause painful skin blisters.
e.zh: 未经治疗的天疱疮可能导致疼痛的皮肤水疱。

e.en: The old prescription listed {pempidine} as an antihypertensive drug.
e.zh: 旧处方把喷匹啶列为一种降压药。

e.en: Doctors rarely prescribe {pempidine} in modern practice.
e.zh: 现代临床中医生很少开喷匹啶。

e.en: She made a {pen-and-ink} sketch of the street.
e.zh: 她画了一幅街景钢笔画。

e.en: The book includes delicate {pen-and-ink} illustrations.
e.zh: 这本书收录了精致的笔墨插图。

e.en: The {pen-driver} moved the animals toward the market pens.
e.zh: 赶牲口的人把动物赶向市场围栏。

e.en: In the old town records, a {pen-driver} paid a small license fee.
e.zh: 在旧城镇记录中，一名小贩缴纳了一小笔执照费。

e.en: The biologist examined each {penna} under a lens.
e.zh: 生物学家在透镜下检查每一根羽毛。

e.en: A damaged {penna} can affect the bird's flight.
e.zh: 受损的羽毛会影响鸟的飞行。

e.en: The wing has strong {pennaceous} feathers for flight.
e.zh: 翅膀上有适合飞行的结实羽片状羽毛。

e.en: The fossil showed a clear {pennaceous} structure.
e.zh: 这块化石显示出清晰的羽状结构。

e.en: The bird replaced several old {pennae} after molting.
e.zh: 这只鸟换羽后长出了几根新的羽毛。

e.en: Fine {pennae} were visible along the fossil tail.
e.zh: 化石尾部可以看到细密的羽状结构。

e.en: The plant has {pennate} leaves with narrow leaflets.
e.zh: 这种植物有羽状叶，叶片狭长。

e.en: A {pennate} muscle can produce strong force.
e.zh: 羽状肌能产生很强的力量。

e.en: The specimen had a {pennated} pattern along its edge.
e.zh: 标本边缘呈现羽状纹理。

e.en: His drawing showed a {pennated} muscle fiber arrangement.
e.zh: 他的图画展示了羽状排列的肌纤维。

e.en: A pink {pennatula} swayed gently on the seabed.
e.zh: 一株粉色海鳃在海底轻轻摇动。

e.en: The diver photographed a rare {pennatula} colony.
e.zh: 潜水员拍下了一群罕见的海鳃。

e.en: Several {pennatulae} glowed faintly in the dark water.
e.zh: 几株海鳃在黑暗水中发出微弱的光。

e.en: The survey counted {pennatulae} across the sandy floor.
e.zh: 调查在沙质海底统计了多株海鳃。

e.en: The aquarium displayed living {pennatulas} in a deep tank.
e.zh: 水族馆在深水缸里展示了活海鳃。

e.en: Scientists found {pennatulas} near the cold seep.
e.zh: 科学家在冷泉附近发现了海鳃。

e.en: The old coin was worth one {penni}.
e.zh: 这枚旧硬币面值为一芬尼。

e.en: He found a {penni} in his grandfather's drawer.
e.zh: 他在祖父的抽屉里找到一枚芬尼硬币。

e.en: The artist imagined a {penniferous} creature in the clouds.
e.zh: 艺术家想象出云中一个长着羽毛的生物。

e.en: A {penniferous} covering protected the animal from cold.
e.zh: 一层羽毛覆盖物保护这种动物免受寒冷。

e.en: The leaf had a delicate {penniform} outline.
e.zh: 这片叶子有精致的羽形轮廓。

e.en: The diagram shows a {penniform} muscle structure.
e.zh: 这张图显示了羽状肌肉结构。

e.en: She sang a traditional {pennill} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后她唱了一段传统威尔士短诗。

e.en: The old manuscript preserves one comic {pennill}.
e.zh: 这份旧手稿保存了一首滑稽短诗。

e.en: The rock sample contained green {penninite}.
e.zh: 这块岩石样本含有绿色的叶绿泥石矿物。

e.en: Collectors prize clear crystals of {penninite}.
e.zh: 收藏者珍视透明的叶绿泥石晶体。

e.en: A red {pennon} flew above the tower.
e.zh: 一面红色三角旗在塔顶飘扬。

e.en: The knight carried a small {pennon} into battle.
e.zh: 骑士带着一面小长旗进入战场。

e.en: The chef served {pennone} with a rich tomato sauce.
e.zh: 厨师端上了配浓番茄酱的意式大管面。

e.en: This {pennone} holds thick sauces very well.
e.zh: 这种大管面很能挂住浓稠酱汁。

e.en: He began as a {penny-a-line} journalist in London.
e.zh: 他最初在伦敦做按行计酬的廉价记者。

e.en: The editor mocked the {penny-a-line} style of the article.
e.zh: 编辑嘲笑那篇文章廉价赶稿的风格。

penny-a-liner.t: 廉价撰稿人；按行计酬记者

e.en: The young {penny-a-liner} wrote crime reports for cash.
e.zh: 这个年轻廉价撰稿人为赚钱写犯罪报道。

e.en: Critics dismissed him as a mere {penny-a-liner}.
e.zh: 批评者把他贬为区区廉价撰稿人。

e.en: They played a {penny-ante} poker game after work.
e.zh: 下班后他们玩了一局小赌注扑克。

e.en: Stop wasting time on {penny-ante} complaints.
e.zh: 别再把时间浪费在微不足道的抱怨上。

penny-farthing.t: 前轮巨大的老式自行车

e.en: He rode a {penny-farthing} in the vintage parade.
e.zh: 他在复古游行中骑了一辆前轮巨大的老式自行车。

e.en: The museum restored a rusty {penny-farthing}.
e.zh: 博物馆修复了一辆生锈的老式高轮自行车。

e.en: Two {penny-farthings} stood outside the bicycle shop.
e.zh: 自行车店外停着两辆老式高轮自行车。

e.en: Collectors raced their {penny-farthings} on Sunday.
e.zh: 收藏者们周日骑着老式高轮自行车比赛。

e.en: The station had a {penny-in-the-slot} weighing machine.
e.zh: 车站里有一台投币式体重秤。

e.en: Children loved the {penny-in-the-slot} toy display.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢那个投币启动的玩具展示柜。

e.en: We had to {penny-pinch} during the long recession.
e.zh: 漫长衰退期间，我们不得不精打细算。

e.en: Do not {penny-pinch} on safety equipment.
e.zh: 不要在安全设备上吝啬省钱。

e.en: My uncle is a cheerful {penny-pincher} at restaurants.
e.zh: 我叔叔在餐馆里是个乐呵呵的吝啬鬼。

e.en: A good manager is careful, not a {penny-pincher}.
e.zh: 好的经理是谨慎花钱，而不是过分吝啬。

e.en: Her {penny-pinching} habits annoyed the whole team.
e.zh: 她过分省钱的习惯惹恼了整个团队。

e.en: The company made {penny-pinching} cuts to basic safety equipment.
e.zh: 公司吝啬地削减了基本安全设备的开支。

e.en: He was {penny-wise} about groceries but careless with rent.
