e.en: A {phene} group appears in the formula.
e.zh: 这个分子式中出现了苯基。

e.en: The trial mentioned {phenegol} only briefly.
e.zh: 试验报告只简短提到非奈戈尔。

e.en: Researchers compared {phenegol} with older drugs.
e.zh: 研究人员将非奈戈尔与较早的药物作比较。

e.en: The molecule includes a {phenelyl} substituent.
e.zh: 该分子含有一个苯乙基相关取代基。

e.en: Chemists revised the {phenelyl} structure.
e.zh: 化学家修订了这个苯乙基相关结构。

e.en: His psychiatrist prescribed {phenelzine}.
e.zh: 他的精神科医生开了苯乙肼。

e.en: Patients taking {phenelzine} must avoid certain foods.
e.zh: 服用苯乙肼的患者必须避免某些食物。

e.en: The synthesis produced {phenetetrol} crystals.
e.zh: 这次合成得到了苯乙四醇晶体。

e.en: They measured the purity of {phenetetrol}.
e.zh: 他们测定了苯乙四醇的纯度。

phenethicillin.t: 非奈西林，青霉素类抗生素

e.en: The infection was treated with {phenethicillin}.
e.zh: 这种感染用非奈西林治疗。

e.en: Resistance reduced the value of {phenethicillin}.
e.zh: 耐药性降低了非奈西林的使用价值。

e.en: Doctors once used {phenethyldiguanide} for diabetes.
e.zh: 医生过去曾用苯乙双胍治疗糖尿病。

e.en: Safety concerns limited {phenethyldiguanide} use.
e.zh: 安全性问题限制了苯乙双胍的使用。

phenetic.t: 表型分类的；数值分类的

e.en: The study used a {phenetic} classification.
e.zh: 这项研究采用了表型分类法。

e.en: A {phenetic} approach groups organisms by similarity.
e.zh: 表型分类方法按相似性给生物分组。

e.en: The {pheneticist} compared dozens of traits.
e.zh: 这位表型分类学家比较了几十种特征。

e.en: A careful {pheneticist} avoids single-feature judgments.
e.zh: 谨慎的表型分类学家不会只凭单一特征判断。

phenetics.t: 表型分类学；数值分类学

e.en: {Phenetics} emphasizes observable similarities.
e.zh: 表型分类学强调可观察到的相似性。

e.en: Modern systematics moved beyond simple {phenetics}.
e.zh: 现代系统分类学已超越简单的表型分类学。

e.en: The reaction yielded a {phenetidine} derivative.
e.zh: 该反应生成了一种非那替丁衍生物。

e.en: Handle {phenetidine} with proper protection.
e.zh: 处理非那替丁时要做好防护。

e.en: The solvent contained traces of {phenetol}.
e.zh: 这种溶剂含有微量苯乙醚。

e.en: {Phenetol} has a characteristic aromatic odor.
e.zh: 苯乙醚有一种典型的芳香气味。

e.en: They distilled {phenetole} under reduced pressure.
e.zh: 他们在减压条件下蒸馏苯乙醚。

e.en: The sample of {phenetole} was nearly pure.
e.zh: 这份苯乙醚样品几乎是纯品。

e.en: {Phenformin} was withdrawn in many countries.
e.zh: 苯乙双胍在许多国家已被撤市。

e.en: The paper compared metformin with {phenformin}.
e.zh: 论文将二甲双胍与苯乙双胍进行了比较。

e.en: The schist contains abundant {phengite}.
e.zh: 这种片岩含有大量多硅白云母。

e.en: Geologists used {phengite} to estimate pressure.
e.zh: 地质学家利用多硅白云母估算压力。

e.en: His {phengophobia} worsened in bright rooms.
e.zh: 他在明亮房间里的恐光症加重了。

e.en: Therapy helped her manage {phengophobia}.
e.zh: 治疗帮助她控制恐光症。

e.en: The developer formula used {phenidone}.
e.zh: 这种显影液配方使用了菲尼酮。

e.en: Photographers valued {phenidone} for fine grain.
e.zh: 摄影师看重菲尼酮带来的细腻颗粒效果。

e.en: The allergy tablet contained {phenindamine}.
e.zh: 这种抗过敏药片含有非宁达明。

e.en: Drowsiness may occur after taking {phenindamine}.
e.zh: 服用非宁达明后可能会嗜睡。

e.en: The radiologist injected {pheniodol} before imaging.
e.zh: 放射科医生在成像前注射了非尼碘醇。

e.en: Older studies described {pheniodol} contrast tests.
e.zh: 早期研究描述了非尼碘醇造影检查。

phenoltetrachlorophthalein.t: 酚四氯酞；化学指示剂衍生物

e.en: The chemist used {phenoltetrachlorophthalein} in a specialized assay.
e.zh: 化学师在一项专门测定中使用了酚四氯酞。

e.en: Old manuals list {phenoltetrachlorophthalein} among phthalein dyes.
e.zh: 旧手册把酚四氯酞列在酞类染料之中。

e.en: The note misspelled {phenomemon} throughout the draft.
e.zh: 这份草稿里一直把phenomenon误拼成phenomemon。

e.en: Search results for {phenomemon} usually point to phenomenon.
e.zh: 搜索phenomemon时，结果通常会指向phenomenon。

e.en: The philosopher tried to {phenomenalise} all external objects.
e.zh: 这位哲学家试图把所有外在对象都按现象来解释。

e.en: Some critics say the theory {phenomenalises} moral experience.
e.zh: 一些批评者说，该理论把道德经验现象化了。

e.en: He wrote his thesis on {phenomenalism} and perception.
e.zh: 他的论文研究现象主义与知觉。

e.en: Classical {phenomenalism} treats objects as patterns of experience.
e.zh: 古典现象论把对象视为经验的模式。

e.en: Her argument has a strongly {phenomenalistic} flavor.
e.zh: 她的论证带有很强的现象主义色彩。

e.en: The book rejects a purely {phenomenalistic} account of matter.
e.zh: 这本书反对对物质作纯粹现象论式的解释。

e.en: He interpreted space {phenomenalistically} in the lecture.
e.zh: 他在讲座中以现象主义方式解释空间。

e.en: The passage reads {phenomenalistically}, though the author denies it.
e.zh: 这段文字读起来像是现象主义写法，尽管作者否认。

e.en: The theory attempts to {phenomenalize} physical objects.
e.zh: 该理论试图把物理对象现象化。

e.en: Do not {phenomenalize} every fact into private sensation.
e.zh: 不要把每个事实都解释成私人感觉的现象。

e.en: The seminar compared {phenomenism} with idealism.
e.zh: 研讨课比较了现象论和唯心主义。

e.en: His early {phenomenism} later gave way to realism.
e.zh: 他早期的现象主义后来让位于实在论。

e.en: The essay develops a {phenomenistic} view of knowledge.
e.zh: 这篇文章提出了一种现象论的知识观。

e.en: Critics found his {phenomenistic} language too narrow.
e.zh: 批评者认为他的现象主义表述过于狭窄。

e.en: Flowering is an important {phenophase} for crop monitoring.
e.zh: 开花是作物监测中的一个重要物候阶段。

e.en: Each {phenophase} was recorded during the field study.
e.zh: 田野研究中记录了每一个物候阶段。

e.en: The sample contained traces of {phenopiazine}.
e.zh: 样品中含有微量吩噻嗪类化合物。

e.en: Researchers compared {phenopiazine} with related ring compounds.
e.zh: 研究人员把phenopiazine与相关环状化合物进行了比较。

e.en: The old prescription listed {phenopyrine} as an ingredient.
e.zh: 这张旧处方把非那吡啶列为成分之一。

e.en: Patients should ask a doctor before taking {phenopyrine}.
e.zh: 患者服用非那吡啶前应先咨询医生。

e.en: The reagent was identified as {phenoresorcin}.
e.zh: 该试剂被鉴定为酚间苯二酚化合物。

e.en: Older chemistry texts mention {phenoresorcin} only briefly.
e.zh: 较早的化学教材只简短提到phenoresorcin。

phenothiazine.t: 吩噻嗪；抗精神病药母核

e.en: {Phenothiazine} derivatives changed psychiatric treatment in the 1950s.
e.zh: 吩噻嗪衍生物在20世纪50年代改变了精神科治疗。

e.en: The compound has a {phenothiazine} ring system.
e.zh: 这种化合物具有吩噻嗪环系。

e.en: The paper described a new {phenothioxin} derivative.
e.zh: 论文描述了一种新的吩噻氧杂环衍生物。

e.en: Spectra helped confirm the {phenothioxin} structure.
e.zh: 光谱数据帮助确认了phenothioxin结构。

e.en: The disease showed clear {phenotypical} variation among patients.
e.zh: 这种疾病在患者之间表现出明显的表型差异。

e.en: Researchers measured several {phenotypical} traits in the plants.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了这些植物的若干表型性状。

phenoxarsine.t: 吩噁胂；含砷杂环化合物

e.en: {Phenoxarsine} compounds require careful handling in the lab.
e.zh: 吩噁胂类化合物在实验室中需要谨慎处理。

e.en: The team synthesized a substituted {phenoxarsine}.
e.zh: 该团队合成了一种取代吩噁胂。

e.en: {Phenoxazine} dyes are used in some biological stains.
e.zh: 吩噁嗪染料用于某些生物染色。

e.en: The molecule contains a stable {phenoxazine} core.
e.zh: 该分子含有稳定的吩噁嗪核心。

e.en: Sodium {phenoxide} forms when phenol loses a proton.
e.zh: 苯酚失去一个质子后会形成苯氧钠。

e.en: The reaction proceeds through a {phenoxide} intermediate.
e.zh: 该反应通过一个酚盐中间体进行。

e.en: The herbicide contains a {phenoxy} acid structure.
e.zh: 这种除草剂含有苯氧基酸结构。

e.en: Chemists attached a {phenoxy} group to the ring.
e.zh: 化学家把一个苯氧基连接到环上。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {phenoxybenzamine} before surgery.
e.zh: 医生在手术前开了酚苄明。

e.en: {Phenoxybenzamine} can lower blood pressure significantly.
e.zh: 酚苄明可能会显著降低血压。

e.en: {Phenoxyisopropylpenicillin} appears in older antibiotic literature.
e.zh: 苯氧异丙青霉素见于较早的抗生素文献。

e.en: The laboratory compared {phenoxyisopropylpenicillin} with other penicillins.
e.zh: 实验室将苯氧异丙青霉素与其他青霉素进行了比较。

e.en: Patients taking {phenprocoumon} need regular blood tests.
e.zh: 服用苯丙香豆素的患者需要定期验血。

e.en: {Phenprocoumon} is used as an oral anticoagulant.
e.zh: 苯丙香豆素用作口服抗凝药。

e.en: {Phenpromethamine} was once marketed as a stimulant.
e.zh: 苯丙甲胺曾作为兴奋剂销售。

e.en: Regulators later restricted products containing {phenpromethamine}.
e.zh: 监管机构后来限制了含苯丙甲胺的产品。

phakomatosis.t: 斑痣性错构瘤病；神经皮肤综合征

e.en: The dermatologist suspected {phakomatosis} after seeing the child's unusual skin marks.
e.zh: 皮肤科医生看到孩子异常的皮肤斑痕后，怀疑是斑痣性错构瘤病。

e.en: Some forms of {phakomatosis} affect both the nervous system and the skin.
e.zh: 某些类型的神经皮肤综合征会同时影响神经系统和皮肤。

e.en: The optician used a {phakometer} to examine the lens power.
e.zh: 配镜师用晶状体屈光计检查镜片度数。

e.en: A modern {phakometer} can help measure changes inside the eye.
e.zh: 现代晶状体屈光计可帮助测量眼内变化。

e.en: The old medical text described severe {phalacrosis} in middle age.
e.zh: 那本旧医学书描述了中年时严重秃发的情况。

e.en: He consulted a specialist because the {phalacrosis} had become noticeable.
e.zh: 由于脱发症状已经很明显，他去咨询了专科医生。

e.en: The greenhouse added a rare {phalaenopsid} to its orchid collection.
e.zh: 温室在兰花收藏中添了一株罕见的蝴蝶兰类植物。

e.en: A healthy {phalaenopsid} usually needs bright but indirect light.
e.zh: 健康的蝴蝶兰类植物通常需要明亮但不直射的光线。

e.en: She placed a white {phalaenopsis} on the windowsill.
e.zh: 她把一盆白色蝴蝶兰放在窗台上。

e.en: The {phalaenopsis} bloomed again after months of careful watering.
e.zh: 经过数月细心浇水，那株蝴蝶兰又开花了。

e.en: The X-ray showed a fracture in one {phalange} of his hand.
e.zh: X光片显示他手上的一节指骨骨折了。

e.en: Each toe has more than one {phalange}, except in special cases.
e.zh: 除特殊情况外，每个脚趾都有不止一节趾骨。

e.en: The nocturnal {phalanger} moved quietly through the trees.
e.zh: 那只夜行性的袋貂类动物在树间悄悄移动。

e.en: A {phalanger} uses its tail for balance while climbing.
e.zh: 袋貂类动物攀爬时会用尾巴保持平衡。

e.en: The surgeon checked the small {phalanges} in the patient's fingers.
e.zh: 外科医生检查了病人手指里的小指骨。

e.en: Ancient armies sometimes advanced in tight {phalanges}.
e.zh: 古代军队有时会以紧密的方阵推进。

e.en: The tiny {phalangid} hid under a damp stone.
e.zh: 那只小盲蛛藏在一块潮湿的石头下面。

e.en: A {phalangid} may look like a spider, but it belongs to a different group.
e.zh: 盲蛛看起来可能像蜘蛛，但属于不同的类群。

phalangist.t: 方阵士兵；傅立叶主义者

e.en: The {phalangist} held his shield close to the man beside him.
e.zh: 那名方阵士兵把盾牌紧贴在身旁战友一侧。

e.en: As a committed {phalangist}, she supported communal social organization.
e.zh: 作为坚定的傅立叶主义者，她支持公社式社会组织。

e.en: The {phalangister} fed on fruit during the night.
e.zh: 那只小型袋貂在夜间以水果为食。

e.en: Researchers recorded a {phalangister} in the forest canopy.
e.zh: 研究人员在森林树冠层记录到一只小型袋貂。

phalansterian.t: 法伦斯泰尔公社的；傅立叶主义者

e.en: The essay praised a {phalansterian} model of cooperative living.
e.zh: 那篇文章赞扬了法伦斯泰尔式的合作生活模式。

e.en: A {phalansterian} argued that work should be organized around attraction.
e.zh: 一名傅立叶主义者主张工作应围绕兴趣吸引来组织。

phalansterianism.t: 法伦斯泰尔主义；傅立叶公社思想

e.en: The lecture traced {phalansterianism} through nineteenth-century reform movements.
e.zh: 讲座追溯了法伦斯泰尔主义在十九世纪改革运动中的发展。

e.en: Critics saw {phalansterianism} as too idealistic for industrial society.
e.zh: 批评者认为傅立叶公社思想对工业社会来说过于理想化。

phalanstery.t: 法伦斯泰尔公社；傅立叶式公社

e.en: The reformers planned a {phalanstery} outside the crowded city.
e.zh: 改革者计划在拥挤的城市外建立一个法伦斯泰尔公社。

e.en: Life in the {phalanstery} was meant to combine work and shared domestic life.
e.zh: 傅立叶式公社的生活旨在把劳动和共同家庭生活结合起来。

phalera.t: 古罗马勋章饰牌；马具饰片

e.en: The museum displayed a bronze {phalera} from a Roman cavalry harness.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一枚来自古罗马骑兵马具的青铜饰片。

e.en: A soldier might receive a {phalera} as a military decoration.
e.zh: 士兵可能会获得古罗马勋章饰牌作为军事奖赏。

e.en: The ancient shrine contained carved {phalli} as fertility symbols.
e.zh: 那座古代神祠里有雕刻的阳具形象，作为生育象征。

e.en: Several stone {phalli} were found near the temple ruins.
e.zh: 寺庙遗址附近发现了几件石制阴茎形象。

phallical.t: 阳具崇拜的；阴茎象征的

e.en: The critic described the tower as a {phallical} symbol of power.
e.zh: 评论家把那座塔描述为权力的阴茎象征。

e.en: Some rituals used {phallical} objects in ceremonies of fertility.
e.zh: 一些仪式在祈求生育的典礼中使用阳具崇拜物。

e.en: The monument was interpreted {phallically} by several art historians.
e.zh: 几位艺术史家从阳具象征角度解读了这座纪念碑。

e.en: The object was arranged {phallically} in the center of the ritual space.
e.zh: 那件物品以阳具象征方式摆在仪式空间中央。

phallicism.t: 阳具崇拜；阴茎象征主义

e.en: The book examines {phallicism} in ancient religious art.
e.zh: 这本书研究古代宗教艺术中的阳具崇拜。

e.en: Modern critics discussed {phallicism} as a symbolic system, not merely an image.
e.zh: 现代批评家把阴茎象征主义作为一种符号系统来讨论，而不只是图像。

e.en: The scholar wrote about {phallism} in early Mediterranean cults.
e.zh: 那位学者写过早期地中海祭 cult 中的阳具崇拜。

e.en: Evidence of {phallism} appears in several fertility rites.
e.zh: 若干生育仪式中都出现了阳具崇拜的证据。

e.en: The entomologist examined the {phallobase} under a microscope.
e.zh: 昆虫学家在显微镜下检查昆虫阳茎基部。

e.en: In this species, the {phallobase} helps distinguish males from related insects.
e.zh: 在这个物种中，阳茎基部有助于把雄虫同近缘昆虫区分开。

phallocentrism.t: 男性中心主义；菲勒斯中心主义

e.en: The article criticizes {phallocentrism} in traditional literary theory.
e.zh: 这篇文章批评传统文学理论中的男性中心主义。

e.en: She used the term {phallocentrism} to describe a culture organized around male authority.
e.zh: 她用“菲勒斯中心主义”一词描述围绕男性权威组织起来的文化。

e.en: The columnist called the minister a {phallocrat} after his remarks on women.
e.zh: 那位专栏作家在部长发表关于女性的言论后称他为男权主义者。

e.en: In the satire, every {phallocrat} mistakes privilege for natural order.
e.zh: 在这部讽刺作品中，每个男权主义者都把特权误认为自然秩序。

phallocratic.t: 男权主义的；男性中心的

e.en: The novel attacks a {phallocratic} society through dark humor.
e.zh: 这部小说通过黑色幽默抨击男权主义社会。

e.en: Her essay links {phallocratic} language to patterns of exclusion.
e.zh: 她的文章把男性中心的语言同排斥模式联系起来。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {pheniramine} for her allergy symptoms.
e.zh: 医生开了非尼拉敏来缓解她的过敏症状。

e.en: Some cold medicines contain {pheniramine} to reduce sneezing.
e.zh: 有些感冒药含有非尼拉敏，用来减少打喷嚏。

e.en: The old poem spells phoenix as {phenix}.
e.zh: 那首旧诗把凤凰一词拼作 phenix。

e.en: A {phenix} rose from the ashes in the legend.
e.zh: 传说中，一只凤凰从灰烬中重生。

e.en: The manuscript describes two {phenixes} guarding the gate.
e.zh: 手稿描写两只凤凰守着大门。

e.en: Artists painted {phenixes} on the ceiling panels.
e.zh: 画家们在天花板嵌板上画了凤凰。

e.en: The molecule includes a {phenmethyl} group.
e.zh: 这个分子含有一个苯甲基基团。

e.en: Researchers compared {phenmethyl} derivatives in the trial.
e.zh: 研究人员在试验中比较了苯甲基衍生物。

e.en: {Phenmetrazine} was once prescribed as an appetite suppressant.
e.zh: 苯甲吗啉曾被开作抑制食欲的药物。

e.en: The report detected {phenmetrazine} in the sample.
e.zh: 报告在样本中检出了苯甲吗啉。

e.en: The lab catalog listed {phenmiazine} among related compounds.
e.zh: 实验室目录把吩噻嗪类化合物列在相关化合物中。

e.en: Few modern textbooks mention {phenmiazine} by name.
e.zh: 现代教材很少直接提到 phenmiazine 这个名称。

phenobarbitone.t: 苯巴比妥，镇静抗癫痫药

e.en: The patient had taken {phenobarbitone} for seizures.
e.zh: 这名患者曾服用苯巴比妥控制癫痫发作。

e.en: {Phenobarbitone} can cause drowsiness at high doses.
e.zh: 苯巴比妥剂量较高时可能引起嗜睡。

e.en: The dentist applied {phenocain} before the procedure.
e.zh: 牙医在操作前使用了苯卡因。

e.en: Older formularies sometimes list {phenocain} as a local anesthetic.
e.zh: 旧药典有时把苯卡因列为局部麻醉药。

e.en: The critic was a {phenoclast} in academic circles.
e.zh: 这位评论家在学术圈中是个反传统者。

e.en: Every movement seems to produce its own {phenoclast}.
e.zh: 每场运动似乎都会产生自己的破旧立新者。

phenocopy.t: 表型模拟，环境致相似性状

e.en: Heat stress produced a {phenocopy} of the mutation.
e.zh: 热应激产生了类似该突变的表型模拟。

e.en: A {phenocopy} can confuse genetic analysis.
e.zh: 表型模拟可能会干扰遗传分析。

e.en: A large feldspar {phenocryst} stood out in the basalt.
e.zh: 玄武岩中一颗较大的长石斑晶很显眼。

e.en: The geologist measured each {phenocryst} under the microscope.
e.zh: 地质学家在显微镜下测量每颗斑晶。

e.en: The sample had a {phenocrystic} texture.
e.zh: 这个样本具有斑晶状结构。

e.en: They mapped the {phenocrystic} lava flows separately.
e.zh: 他们把含斑晶的熔岩流单独绘制出来。

e.en: The pharmacist found {phenodin} in an old reference book.
e.zh: 药剂师在一本旧参考书里找到了酚定这个名称。

e.en: Modern labels rarely use the term {phenodin}.
e.zh: 现代药品标签很少使用 phenodin 这个术语。

phenogam.t: 显花植物，有性生殖植物

e.en: A {phenogam} produces visible reproductive organs.
e.zh: 显花植物会产生可见的生殖器官。

e.en: The lesson contrasted a fern with a {phenogam}.
e.zh: 这节课把蕨类植物和显花植物作了对比。

phenogamous.t: 显花植物的，有明显生殖器官的

e.en: The garden specializes in {phenogamous} plants.
e.zh: 这座花园专门种植显花植物。

e.en: Early botanists separated cryptogamous and {phenogamous} species.
e.zh: 早期植物学家区分隐花植物和显花植物物种。

phenogenetics.t: 表型遗传学，表型发生遗传研究

e.en: Her thesis focused on {phenogenetics} in insects.
e.zh: 她的论文研究昆虫的表型遗传学。

e.en: {Phenogenetics} links genes with visible traits.
e.zh: 表型遗传学把基因与可见性状联系起来。

phenolase.t: 酚氧化酶，作用于酚的酶

e.en: The fruit darkened when {phenolase} contacted air.
e.zh: 酚氧化酶接触空气后，水果颜色变深了。

e.en: Heating can reduce {phenolase} activity in vegetables.
e.zh: 加热可以降低蔬菜中酚氧化酶的活性。

e.en: Sodium {phenolate} formed during the reaction.
e.zh: 反应过程中生成了苯酚钠这种酚盐。

e.en: The chemist used base to {phenolate} the compound.
e.zh: 化学家用碱使该化合物形成酚盐。

e.en: Technicians {phenolize} the surface before testing.
e.zh: 技术人员在测试前用酚处理表面。

e.en: The protocol says to {phenolize} the tissue sample.
e.zh: 方案要求对组织样本进行酚化处理。

e.en: The team recorded {phenological} changes in spring flowers.
e.zh: 团队记录了春季花卉的物候变化。

e.en: Climate warming can shift {phenological} events.
e.zh: 气候变暖会改变物候事件的时间。

e.en: The solution turned pink after adding {phenolphthalein}.
e.zh: 加入酚酞后，溶液变成了粉红色。

e.en: Students used {phenolphthalein} during the titration.
e.zh: 学生们在滴定实验中使用了酚酞。

e.en: {Phenolphthalin} can be oxidized to phenolphthalein.
e.zh: 酚酞啉可以被氧化成酚酞。

e.en: The reagent contained a small amount of {phenolphthalin}.
e.zh: 这种试剂含有少量酚酞啉。

phenolquinine.t: 酚奎宁，奎宁酚类化合物

e.en: The archive mentions {phenolquinine} in a medical formula.
e.zh: 档案在一个医用配方中提到了酚奎宁。

e.en: Chemists debated the structure of {phenolquinine}.
e.zh: 化学家们曾讨论酚奎宁的结构。

e.en: The medicine contained potassium {phenolsulfonate}.
e.zh: 这种药含有酚磺酸钾。

e.en: They measured {phenolsulfonate} levels in the urine sample.
e.zh: 他们测量了尿样中的酚磺酸盐水平。

phenolsulfonphthalein.t: 酚磺酞，肾功能检测试剂

e.en: Doctors once used {phenolsulfonphthalein} to test kidney function.
e.zh: 医生过去曾用酚磺酞检测肾功能。

e.en: The dye {phenolsulfonphthalein} appears in older lab manuals.
e.zh: 酚磺酞这种染料出现在较旧的实验手册中。

phenylindanedione.t: 苯茚二酮类化合物；抗凝药物

e.en: The lab identified a {phenylindanedione} derivative in the sample.
e.zh: 实验室在样品中鉴定出一种苯茚二酮衍生物。

e.en: Some older anticoagulants belong to the {phenylindanedione} group.
e.zh: 一些较早的抗凝药属于苯茚二酮类。

e.en: The chemist discussed {phenylisonitramine} during the synthesis review.
e.zh: 化学家在合成评审中讨论了苯基异硝胺。

e.en: Few students had seen {phenylisonitramine} outside a specialist text.
e.zh: 很少有学生在专业文献之外见过苯基异硝胺。

e.en: A {phenylketonuric} infant needs a carefully controlled diet.
e.zh: 患苯丙酮尿症的婴儿需要严格控制饮食。

e.en: The clinic offered counseling for {phenylketonuric} patients.
e.zh: 诊所为苯丙酮尿症患者提供咨询。

e.en: The bottle of {phenylmercaptan} had a strong sulfur smell.
e.zh: 那瓶苯硫酚有很重的硫味。

e.en: Workers handled {phenylmercaptan} only inside the fume hood.
e.zh: 工人只在通风橱内处理苯硫酚。

e.en: Older texts sometimes call toluene {phenylmethane}.
e.zh: 旧教材有时把甲苯称为苯基甲烷。

e.en: The reaction produced {phenylmethane} as a minor by-product.
e.zh: 该反应生成了少量苯基甲烷副产物。

e.en: The spectrum suggested that {phenylpentane} was present in the mixture.
e.zh: 光谱显示混合物中存在苯基戊烷。

e.en: They compared several {phenylpentane} isomers in the study.
e.zh: 他们在研究中比较了几种苯基戊烷异构体。

e.en: The procedure used {phenylpropiophenone} as an intermediate.
e.zh: 该工艺使用苯基苯丙酮作为中间体。

e.en: Impure {phenylpropiophenone} can affect the final yield.
e.zh: 不纯的苯基苯丙酮会影响最终产率。

e.en: The molecule contains a {phenylsulfinyl} group.
e.zh: 这个分子含有一个苯亚磺酰基。

e.en: Adding a {phenylsulfinyl} substituent changed the compound's polarity.
e.zh: 加入苯亚磺酰基取代基改变了化合物的极性。

e.en: The {phenylsulfonyl} group improved the compound's stability.
e.zh: 苯磺酰基提高了该化合物的稳定性。

e.en: Researchers attached a {phenylsulfonyl} moiety to the ring.
e.zh: 研究人员在环上接入了一个苯磺酰基部分。

e.en: Sensitivity to {phenylthiourea} varies among individuals.
e.zh: 不同个体对苯基硫脲的敏感性不同。

e.en: The genetics class used {phenylthiourea} tasting strips.
e.zh: 遗传学课使用了苯基硫脲试味纸。

e.en: The herbicide belongs to the {phenylurea} family.
e.zh: 这种除草剂属于苯基脲类。

e.en: They measured {phenylurea} residues in the soil.
e.zh: 他们测定了土壤中的苯基脲残留。

e.en: The neurologist adjusted her {phenytoin} dose.
e.zh: 神经科医生调整了她的苯妥英剂量。

e.en: Blood tests can monitor {phenytoin} levels.
e.zh: 血液检查可以监测苯妥英浓度。

e.en: Doctors suspected a {pheochromocytoma} after repeated blood pressure spikes.
e.zh: 在血压反复飙升后，医生怀疑是嗜铬细胞瘤。

e.en: Surgery removed the adrenal {pheochromocytoma}.
e.zh: 手术切除了肾上腺嗜铬细胞瘤。

e.en: The pigment analysis detected traces of {pheohemin}.
e.zh: 色素分析检测到微量脱镁血红素。

e.en: Researchers prepared {pheohemin} for the spectroscopy experiment.
e.zh: 研究人员为光谱实验制备了脱镁血红素。

e.en: The algae sample contained {pheophorbide} after chlorophyll breakdown.
e.zh: 叶绿素分解后，藻类样品中含有脱镁叶绿酸。

e.en: Scientists studied {pheophorbide} as a photosensitizer.
e.zh: 科学家研究脱镁叶绿酸作为光敏剂的用途。

pherentasin.t: 非伦他辛；实验性降压物质

e.en: Early reports described {pherentasin} as a pressor substance.
e.zh: 早期报告把非伦他辛描述为一种升压物质。

e.en: The paper mentioned {pherentasin} in a discussion of renal hypertension.
e.zh: 论文在讨论肾性高血压时提到了非伦他辛。

e.en: The author used {pheron} for a chemical signal in insects.
e.zh: 作者用pheron指昆虫中的一种化学信号物质。

e.en: That old biology text defines a {pheron} broadly.
e.zh: 那本旧生物学教材对pheron作了宽泛定义。

e.en: He wore a {philabeg} with a dark wool jacket.
e.zh: 他穿着一条短褶裙，外搭深色羊毛夹克。

e.en: The museum displayed a traditional {philabeg}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件传统苏格兰短裙。

e.en: The old novel calls him a generous {philanthrope}.
e.zh: 那部旧小说称他为慷慨的慈善家。

e.en: A true {philanthrope} cares about strangers as well as friends.
e.zh: 真正的博爱者既关心朋友，也关心陌生人。

e.en: Her {philanthropical} work funded schools in poor villages.
e.zh: 她的慈善工作资助了贫困村庄的学校。

e.en: The speech had a strongly {philanthropical} tone.
e.zh: 这场演讲带有浓厚的博爱色彩。

e.en: His essays defended {philanthropism} against charges of vanity.
e.zh: 他的文章为慈善主义辩护，反驳别人说那只是虚荣。

e.en: Victorian {philanthropism} often mixed compassion with social control.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的博爱思想常把同情心和社会控制混在一起。

e.en: The mayor praised the group's {philanthropistic} aims.
e.zh: 市长赞扬了这个团体的慈善主义目标。

e.en: Her {philanthropistic} language sounded sincere but old-fashioned.
e.zh: 她那种博爱的说法听起来真诚，却有些老派。

e.en: He preferred to {philanthropize} quietly in his own district.
e.zh: 他更愿意在自己的社区低调行善。

e.en: The novel mocks rich men who {philanthropize} for applause.
e.zh: 这部小说嘲讽那些为博取掌声而做慈善的富人。

philanthropoid.t: 近似博爱的；貌似慈善的

e.en: The scheme had a {philanthropoid} appearance but served private profit.
e.zh: 这个计划看似慈善，实际上服务于私人利益。

e.en: Critics called his speech {philanthropoid} rather than truly generous.
e.zh: 批评者说他的演讲只是貌似博爱，并非真正慷慨。

e.en: She kept her {philatelical} notes in a blue folder.
e.zh: 她把自己的集邮笔记放在一个蓝色文件夹里。

e.en: The museum displayed several {philatelical} rarities from the empire.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了几件来自帝国时期的珍贵邮票藏品。

e.en: The cover is {philatelically} important because of its rare postmark.
e.zh: 从集邮角度看，这个信封因罕见邮戳而很重要。

e.en: He described the issue {philatelically}, not politically.
e.zh: 他是从邮票研究角度描述这次发行，而不是从政治角度。

philhellene.t: 亲希腊者；爱希腊文化的人

e.en: Byron became famous as a passionate {philhellene}.
e.zh: 拜伦以热情的亲希腊者身份而闻名。

e.en: The old scholar was a {philhellene} who taught Homer for decades.
e.zh: 那位老学者热爱希腊文化，几十年来一直讲授荷马。

philhellenic.t: 亲希腊的；爱希腊文化的

e.en: The committee raised money for the {philhellenic} cause.
e.zh: 委员会为亲希腊事业筹集资金。

e.en: His {philhellenic} tastes shaped the library's classical collection.
e.zh: 他对希腊文化的热爱影响了图书馆的古典藏书。

philhellenism.t: 亲希腊主义；希腊文化崇尚

e.en: European {philhellenism} grew during the Greek war of independence.
e.zh: 希腊独立战争期间，欧洲的亲希腊主义日益高涨。

e.en: Her lectures traced {philhellenism} in nineteenth-century poetry.
e.zh: 她的讲座追溯了十九世纪诗歌中的希腊文化崇尚。

philhellenist.t: 亲希腊主义者；希腊文化崇尚者

e.en: The diplomat was known as a committed {philhellenist}.
e.zh: 这位外交官以坚定的亲希腊主义者身份闻名。

e.en: A young {philhellenist} translated the ancient plays with care.
e.zh: 一位年轻的希腊文化崇尚者认真翻译了那些古代戏剧。

e.en: The suffix {philia} suggests an unusually strong attraction.
e.zh: 后缀philia表示一种异常强烈的喜爱。

e.en: Aristotle used {philia} to discuss friendship and civic bonds.
e.zh: 亚里士多德用philia来讨论友爱和公民纽带。

e.en: He wore a {philibeg} during the Highland ceremony.
e.zh: 他在高地仪式上穿着苏格兰短褶裙。

e.en: The costume included a woolen {philibeg} and a dark jacket.
e.zh: 这套服装包括一条羊毛苏格兰短褶裙和一件深色外套。

e.en: The basalt cavity contained small crystals of {phillipsite}.
e.zh: 玄武岩空洞里含有细小的钙十字沸石晶体。

e.en: Geologists identified {phillipsite} in the deep-sea sediment sample.
e.zh: 地质学家在深海沉积物样本中鉴定出了钙十字沸石。

e.en: The {phillumenist} arranged his matchbox labels by country.
e.zh: 这位火柴盒收藏者按国家整理自己的火柴盒标签。

e.en: As a careful {phillumenist}, she valued designs from old hotels.
e.zh: 作为细心的火柴盒收藏者，她很珍视老酒店的图案。

e.en: His interest in {phillumeny} began with a café matchbook.
e.zh: 他对火柴盒收藏的兴趣始于一本咖啡馆火柴夹。

e.en: The exhibition treated {phillumeny} as a form of graphic history.
e.zh: 这场展览把火柴盒收藏视为一种图像史。

e.en: His {philobiblic} habits filled every room with shelves.
e.zh: 他的爱书习惯让每个房间都摆满了书架。

e.en: The club attracted a small but {philobiblic} circle of readers.
e.zh: 这个俱乐部吸引了一小群嗜书的读者。

philogynist.t: 喜爱女性的人；崇尚女性者

e.en: The essay calls him a {philogynist} rather than a mere flatterer.
e.zh: 这篇文章称他为崇尚女性者，而不只是奉承者。

e.en: A sincere {philogynist} challenged the club's old prejudices.
e.zh: 一位真诚的喜爱女性者挑战了俱乐部的旧偏见。

e.en: Her lectures took a strongly {philogynous} view of history.
e.zh: 她的讲座以强烈的亲女性视角看待历史。

e.en: The novel's {philogynous} tone was unusual for its time.
e.zh: 这部小说的崇尚女性语调在当时并不常见。

e.en: The critic found clear {philogyny} in the poet's early work.
e.zh: 评论家在这位诗人的早期作品中看出明显的崇尚女性。

e.en: His supposed {philogyny} sometimes sounded like polite condescension.
e.zh: 他所谓的喜爱女性有时听起来像礼貌的居高临下。

e.en: The old {philologer} compared every manuscript by hand.
e.zh: 那位老语文学者亲手比对每一份手稿。

e.en: As a {philologer}, she cared about the history of each word.
e.zh: 作为文献学家，她关心每个词的历史。

e.en: A careful {philologian} noticed the copied spelling error.
e.zh: 一位细心的语文学者注意到了被抄下来的拼写错误。

e.en: The {philologian} traced the phrase through medieval sermons.
e.zh: 那位文献研究者追溯了这个短语在中世纪布道中的用法。

e.en: The editor added a {philologic} note on the disputed verb.
e.zh: 编辑给这个有争议的动词加了一条语文学注释。

e.en: Their {philologic} method relies on comparing old texts.
e.zh: 他们的文献学方法依靠比较古文本。

philologize.t: 作语文学研究；考据词源

e.en: He loved to {philologize} over tiny changes in spelling.
e.zh: 他喜欢围绕拼写的细微变化做语文学考据。

e.en: Do not {philologize} so much that the poem loses its force.
e.zh: 别过度考据，以至于让这首诗失去力量。

philologue.t: 语文学者；语言文献专家

e.en: The visiting {philologue} spoke about lost dialects.
e.zh: 来访的语文学者谈到了已经消失的方言。

e.en: A French {philologue} edited the medieval romance.
e.zh: 一位法国语言文献专家校订了那部中世纪传奇。

philomath.t: 爱学习的人；博学好学者

e.en: As a child, she was already a tireless {philomath}.
e.zh: 她小时候就已经是个不知疲倦的好学者。

e.en: The club attracted every local {philomath} with public lectures.
e.zh: 这个俱乐部用公开讲座吸引了当地所有爱学习的人。

e.en: His {philomathic} curiosity filled the house with books.
e.zh: 他好学的好奇心让家里堆满了书。

e.en: The school encouraged a {philomathic} spirit in every pupil.
e.zh: 学校鼓励每个学生保持爱学习的精神。

e.en: Her {philomathy} survived years of dull schooling.
e.zh: 多年枯燥的学校教育也没有磨灭她的求知欲。

e.en: The library was built to encourage {philomathy} among workers.
e.zh: 这座图书馆是为了鼓励工人们爱学习而建的。

e.en: The poet addressed the night bird as {philomel}.
e.zh: 诗人把那只夜鸟称作夜莺。

e.en: In the old tale, {Philomel} is linked with suffering and song.
e.zh: 在这个古老传说中，菲洛墨拉与苦难和歌声相连。

e.en: They played {philopena} after finding two kernels in one shell.
e.zh: 他们在一个壳里发现两粒仁后玩起了双仁果游戏。

e.en: She owed him a small {philopena} after losing the wager.
e.zh: 她输掉这个打赌后欠他一件小小的罚物。

e.en: The children called the almond game {philopoena}.
e.zh: 孩子们把这个杏仁游戏叫作双仁果游戏。

e.en: He claimed a {philopoena} when she forgot the agreed phrase.
e.zh: 她忘了约定的暗语时，他索要了双仁果游戏的罚物。

e.en: Her {philoprogenitive} nature made her patient with noisy children.
e.zh: 她爱护孩子的天性让她能耐心对待吵闹的孩子。

e.en: The speech praised a {philoprogenitive} concern for future generations.
e.zh: 演讲赞扬了对后代的关爱。

e.en: His {philoprogenitiveness} was obvious whenever his nieces visited.
e.zh: 侄女们来访时，他的爱子女之情十分明显。

e.en: The policy appealed to public {philoprogenitiveness} and duty.
e.zh: 这项政策诉诸公众爱护后代的情感和责任感。

philosophaster.t: 蹩脚哲学家；半吊子哲人

e.en: The reviewer dismissed him as a fashionable {philosophaster}.
e.zh: 评论家把他贬为赶时髦的蹩脚哲学家。

e.en: Noisy certainty made the young {philosophaster} seem ridiculous.
e.zh: 那位年轻半吊子哲人的喧闹自信显得很可笑。

e.en: The sermon avoided empty {philosophism} and spoke plainly.
e.zh: 这篇布道避开空洞哲理，说得很直白。

e.en: Readers mistook his clever {philosophism} for real wisdom.
e.zh: 读者把他机巧的伪哲学论调误当成真正的智慧。

e.en: The pamphlet attacked every radical {philosophist} in Paris.
e.zh: 这本小册子攻击了巴黎每一个激进哲学论者。

e.en: He sounded more like a {philosophist} than a careful thinker.
e.zh: 他听起来更像个伪哲学家，而不是严谨的思想者。

e.en: Her patience ended during his {philosophistical} lecture on love.
e.zh: 他空谈爱情哲理时，她终于失去了耐心。

e.en: The argument was clever but merely {philosophistical}.
e.zh: 这个论证很机巧，但只是伪哲学式的。

philotechnic.t: 爱好艺术的；重视工艺的

e.en: The society had a strongly {philotechnic} purpose.
e.zh: 这个协会有很强的重视工艺的宗旨。

e.en: His {philotechnic} tastes shaped the museum's early collection.
e.zh: 他爱好艺术的品味塑造了博物馆早期的藏品。

philotechnical.t: 爱好艺术的；重视技术工艺的

e.en: A {philotechnical} education joined drawing with practical mechanics.
e.zh: 重视技术工艺的教育把绘画和实用机械结合起来。

e.en: The prince supported many {philotechnical} societies.
e.zh: 这位王子资助了许多爱好艺术与工艺的社团。

e.en: The witch promised a {philter} that would win his heart.
e.zh: 女巫许诺一种能赢得他心的爱情魔药。

e.en: Rumor turned the bitter drink into a dangerous {philter}.
e.zh: 传言把那杯苦饮说成了危险的迷魂药。

e.en: The {philtered} knight forgot his vows by morning.
e.zh: 被爱情魔药迷住的骑士到早晨就忘了自己的誓言。

e.en: She wrote of a {philtered} mind unable to judge clearly.
e.zh: 她写到一颗被迷魂药惑住、无法清醒判断的心。

e.en: The witch was accused of {philtering} the prince.
e.zh: 女巫被指控用爱情药迷惑王子。

e.en: The poem imagines desire {philtering} the mind.
e.zh: 这首诗想象欲望像药酒一样迷惑心智。

e.en: Old tales often mention {philters} made from herbs.
e.zh: 古老故事常提到用草药制成的爱情药。

e.en: She {philters} his wine in the dark comedy.
e.zh: 在那部黑色喜剧里，她给他的酒下迷药。

e.en: He believed the {philtre} would win her love.
e.zh: 他相信这剂爱情药能赢得她的爱。

e.en: The novel treats fame as a dangerous {philtre}.
e.zh: 小说把名声写成一种危险的迷魂药。

e.en: The {philtred} knight followed her everywhere.
e.zh: 那个中了爱情药的骑士到处跟着她。

e.en: His {philtred} imagination turned every smile into a promise.
e.zh: 他被迷住的想象把每个微笑都当成承诺。

e.en: A small scar crossed his {philtrum}.
e.zh: 一道小疤横过他的人中。

e.en: The doctor checked the baby's {philtrum} during the exam.
e.zh: 医生在检查时查看了婴儿的人中。

e.en: The surgeon explained the treatment options for {phimosis}.
e.zh: 外科医生解释了包茎的治疗选择。

e.en: Severe {phimosis} can make urination painful.
e.zh: 严重包茎可能让排尿变得疼痛。

e.en: Criminals may {phish} for passwords through fake emails.
e.zh: 犯罪分子可能通过假邮件网络钓鱼套取密码。

e.en: The message looked like a {phish} from a fake bank.
e.zh: 那条信息看起来像假银行发来的钓鱼诈骗。

e.en: His cheerful {phiz} appeared at the window.
e.zh: 他那张开心的脸出现在窗边。

e.en: The caricature gave the mayor a ridiculous {phiz}.
e.zh: 那幅讽刺画把市长的面孔画得很滑稽。

e.en: Several curious {phizes} peered over the fence.
e.zh: 几张好奇的脸从篱笆上方探出来。

e.en: The artist filled the page with comic {phizes}.
e.zh: 画家在纸上画满了滑稽的面孔。

e.en: The scan suggested mild {phlebectasia} in the neck vein.
e.zh: 扫描显示颈部静脉有轻度静脉扩张症。

e.en: Doctors monitored the {phlebectasia} for possible complications.
e.zh: 医生监测这处静脉扩张症，以防出现并发症。

e.en: The rare anomaly was described as {phlebektopia}.
e.zh: 这种罕见异常被描述为静脉异位。

e.en: Imaging helped confirm {phlebektopia} near the organ.
e.zh: 影像检查帮助确认了器官附近的静脉异位。

e.en: The nurse prepared {phleboclysis} for the dehydrated patient.
e.zh: 护士为脱水患者准备静脉输液。

e.en: Early manuals described {phleboclysis} as a lifesaving procedure.
e.zh: 早期手册把静脉输液描述为救命操作。

e.en: The {phlebogram} showed a blockage behind the knee.
e.zh: 静脉造影图显示膝盖后方有堵塞。

e.en: She brought the old {phlebogram} to her appointment.
e.zh: 她就诊时带来了以前的静脉造影图。

e.en: The specialist ordered {phlebography} before the operation.
e.zh: 专家在手术前安排了静脉造影术。

e.en: Modern ultrasound has replaced {phlebography} in many cases.
e.zh: 现代超声在许多情况下已经取代了静脉造影术。

e.en: The specimen had a {phleboid} pattern under the microscope.
e.zh: 标本在显微镜下呈现似静脉的纹路。

e.en: The artist painted {phleboid} lines across the marble surface.
e.zh: 艺术家在大理石表面画出像静脉一样的线条。

e.en: The X-ray revealed a small {phlebolite} in the pelvis.
e.zh: X光片显示骨盆内有一颗小静脉石。

e.en: A {phlebolite} is usually a calcified clot inside a vein.
e.zh: 静脉石通常是静脉内钙化的血栓。

e.en: The radiologist identified the spot as a {phlebolith}.
e.zh: 放射科医生把这个斑点认定为静脉石。

e.en: A pelvic {phlebolith} can resemble a urinary stone.
e.zh: 盆腔静脉石可能看起来像尿路结石。

e.en: She trained in {phlebology} after medical school.
e.zh: 她从医学院毕业后接受了静脉病学培训。

e.en: The clinic specializes in {phlebology} and vein treatment.
e.zh: 这家诊所专门从事静脉病学和静脉治疗。

e.en: Long-term inflammation may lead to {phlebosclerosis}.
e.zh: 长期炎症可能导致静脉硬化。

e.en: The biopsy showed signs of {phlebosclerosis}.
e.zh: 活检显示出静脉硬化的迹象。

e.en: The team recorded the {phlebostatic} pressure carefully.
e.zh: 团队仔细记录了静脉压测量值。

e.en: A proper {phlebostatic} reference point improves accuracy.
e.zh: 正确的静脉压测量参考点能提高准确性。

e.en: Immobility increases the risk of {phlebothrombosis}.
e.zh: 久坐不动会增加静脉血栓形成的风险。

e.en: The patient received anticoagulants for {phlebothrombosis}.
e.zh: 患者因静脉血栓形成接受了抗凝药治疗。

e.en: The old surgeon kept a silver {phlebotome} in his case.
e.zh: 那位老外科医生在箱子里放着一把银制放血刀。

e.en: A {phlebotome} was once used to open a vein.
e.zh: 放血刀过去曾用于切开静脉。

e.en: They planned to {phlebotomise} the patient at dawn.
e.zh: 他们计划在清晨给病人放血。

e.en: The clinic may {phlebotomise} donors before processing samples.
e.zh: 诊所可能会在处理样本前为捐献者抽血。

e.en: The {phlebotomist} found a vein on the first try.
e.zh: 抽血员第一次就找到了静脉。

e.en: A skilled {phlebotomist} can calm nervous patients.
e.zh: 熟练的采血技师能安抚紧张的病人。

e.en: The old doctor planned to {phlebotomize} the feverish patient.
e.zh: 那位老医生打算给发烧的病人放血治疗。

e.en: Nurses may {phlebotomize} patients for laboratory tests.
e.zh: 护士可能会为病人抽血做化验。

e.en: The patient was {phlebotomized} before the surgery.
e.zh: 病人在手术前被抽了血。

e.en: In earlier medicine, people were often {phlebotomized} for fever.
e.zh: 在早期医学中，人们发烧时常被放血。

e.en: She {phlebotomizes} donors at the blood center.
e.zh: 她在献血中心为献血者抽血。

e.en: The text describes how a surgeon {phlebotomizes} a patient.
e.zh: 这本书描述外科医生如何给病人放血。

e.en: The nurse was {phlebotomizing} a nervous teenager.
e.zh: 护士正在给一名紧张的少年抽血。

e.en: Medieval physicians believed {phlebotomizing} could balance the body.
e.zh: 中世纪医生认为放血能平衡人体。

e.en: The surgeon diagnosed {phlegmasia} in her swollen leg.
e.zh: 外科医生诊断她肿胀的腿出现了静脉炎性肿胀。

e.en: Severe {phlegmasia} can threaten blood flow to the limb.
e.zh: 严重的静脉炎性肿胀会威胁肢体供血。

e.en: His {phlegmatical} manner annoyed the impatient crowd.
e.zh: 他那种冷静迟钝的样子惹恼了急躁的人群。

e.en: Old physicians called the patient {phlegmatical} by temperament.
e.zh: 旧时医生称这名病人的气质属黏液质。

e.en: She answered the accusation {phlegmatically}.
e.zh: 她冷静迟缓地回应了指控。

e.en: He {phlegmatically} continued eating during the argument.
e.zh: 争吵时他仍不慌不忙地继续吃饭。

e.en: Years of routine had {phlegmatized} his reactions.
e.zh: 多年的例行工作让他的反应变得冷淡迟钝。

e.en: The critic said the drama felt {phlegmatized} and lifeless.
e.zh: 评论家说这部戏显得迟钝而没有生气。

e.en: The scan showed a deep {phlegmon} near the appendix.
e.zh: 扫描显示阑尾附近有一个深部蜂窝织炎性肿块。

e.en: Antibiotics helped reduce the painful {phlegmon}.
e.zh: 抗生素帮助减轻了那个疼痛的蜂窝织炎性肿块。

e.en: Sugars move through the plant's {phloem}.
e.zh: 糖分通过植物的韧皮部运输。

e.en: Damage to the {phloem} can weaken a tree.
e.zh: 韧皮部受损会削弱一棵树。

e.en: Chemists once explained fire with {phlogistic} theory.
e.zh: 化学家曾用燃素理论解释燃烧。

e.en: The doctor noted a {phlogistic} swelling around the wound.
e.zh: 医生注意到伤口周围有炎症性肿胀。

e.en: The sample contained brown flakes of {phlogopite}.
e.zh: 样本中含有褐色片状金云母。

e.en: Geologists identified {phlogopite} in the volcanic rock.
e.zh: 地质学家在火山岩中鉴定出金云母。

e.en: The old report described {phlogosis} of the eye.
e.zh: 那份旧报告描述了眼部炎症。

e.en: Doctors no longer use {phlogosis} in everyday notes.
e.zh: 医生如今已不在日常病历中使用“炎症”这个旧称。

e.en: Researchers tested {phloretin} on cultured cells.
e.zh: 研究人员在培养细胞上测试了根皮素。

e.en: Apple peel contains small amounts of {phloretin}.
e.zh: 苹果皮中含有少量根皮素。

e.en: The study measured {phloridzin} in apple extracts.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了苹果提取物中的根皮苷。

e.en: Early diabetes research used {phloridzin} in animals.
e.zh: 早期糖尿病研究曾在动物实验中使用根皮苷。

e.en: Scientists isolated {phlorizin} from apple tree bark.
e.zh: 科学家从苹果树皮中分离出根皮苷。

e.en: The compound {phlorizin} affects glucose transport.
e.zh: 根皮苷这种化合物会影响葡萄糖转运。

e.en: The chemist prepared {phloroglucin} for the reaction.
e.zh: 化学家为这次反应制备了间苯三酚。

e.en: Old laboratory manuals mention {phloroglucin} as a reagent.
e.zh: 旧实验室手册把间苯三酚列为一种试剂。

e.en: The stain uses {phloroglucinol} to reveal lignin.
e.zh: 这种染色法用间苯三酚显示木质素。

e.en: Doctors sometimes prescribe {phloroglucinol} for spasms.
e.zh: 医生有时会开间苯三酚来缓解痉挛。

e.en: The old paper listed {phlorol} among related phenols.
e.zh: 那篇旧论文把phlorol列在相关酚类化合物中。

e.en: Few modern chemists encounter {phlorol} outside archives.
e.zh: 现代化学家很少在档案之外见到phlorol这种化合物名。

e.en: The synthesis produced traces of {phlorone}.
e.zh: 这次合成产生了微量phlorone这种酮类化合物。

e.en: A nineteenth-century chemist named the substance {phlorone}.
e.zh: 一位十九世纪化学家把这种物质命名为phlorone。

e.en: The analyst reported {phlorose} in the plant extract.
e.zh: 分析员报告植物提取物中有phlorose这种糖类化合物。

e.en: Modern textbooks rarely discuss {phlorose}.
e.zh: 现代教材很少讨论phlorose这种化合物。

e.en: The lab used {phloxin} to stain the tissue.
e.zh: 实验室用焰红染料给组织染色。

e.en: Bright {phloxin} marked the damaged cells clearly.
e.zh: 鲜亮的焰红染料清楚标出了受损细胞。

e.en: The ophthalmologist saw a {phlyctenule} on the cornea.
e.zh: 眼科医生在角膜上看到一个小疱。

e.en: A {phlyctenule} may cause redness and irritation.
e.zh: 眼小疱可能引起发红和刺激感。

e.en: Rabies can cause {phobodipsia} in severe cases.
e.zh: 狂犬病严重时可能导致恐饮症。

e.en: The case report described sudden {phobodipsia}.
e.zh: 病例报告描述了突发的怕喝水症状。

e.en: The biologist studied {phocine} behavior along the coast.
e.zh: 生物学家研究了沿海海豹的行为。

e.en: The animal's smooth, {phocine} head broke the water.
e.zh: 那只动物光滑、像海豹的头露出水面。

e.en: The child was born with {phocomelia} affecting both arms.
e.zh: 这个孩子出生时双臂患有海豹肢症。

e.en: Doctors linked some historical cases of {phocomelia} to thalidomide exposure.
e.zh: 医生把一些历史上的短肢畸形病例与沙利度胺暴露联系起来。

e.en: Older medical texts described the patient as a {phocomelus}.
e.zh: 较早的医学文献把这名患者称为患海豹肢症的人。

e.en: The term {phocomelus} is now rarely used in clinical writing.
e.zh: 如今临床写作中很少再使用“患海豹肢症者”这个术语。

e.en: The botanist noted several {phoenicaceous} plants in the garden.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到花园里有几种棕榈科植物。

e.en: A {phoenicaceous} trunk often shows old leaf scars.
e.zh: 棕榈科植物的树干常能看到旧叶痕。

e.en: The red crystal was identified as {phoenicochroite}.
e.zh: 那块红色晶体被鉴定为铬铅矿。

e.en: Collectors value {phoenicochroite} for its vivid color.
e.zh: 收藏者看重铬铅矿鲜艳的颜色。

e.en: The old instrument produced a faint {phogogram} on smoked paper.
e.zh: 那台旧仪器在烟熏纸上留下了淡淡的声波记录图。

e.en: Researchers compared the {phogogram} with a modern waveform.
e.zh: 研究人员把这张录音图同现代波形进行了比较。

e.en: The report used the spelling {phokomelia} for the congenital disorder.
e.zh: 报告用phokomelia这个拼法指称这种先天性短肢畸形。

e.en: Severe {phokomelia} can leave the hands close to the shoulders.
e.zh: 严重的海豹肢症会使双手接近肩部。

e.en: The technician checked the lens with a {phokoscope}.
e.zh: 技术员用验焦器检查了镜片。

e.en: A {phokoscope} helped reveal a small focusing error.
e.zh: 焦点检验器帮助发现了一个小的对焦误差。

e.en: A {pholas} can bore into soft rock near the shore.
e.zh: 穿石贝能钻入海岸附近的软岩中。

e.en: The shell of the {pholas} was found inside the chalk.
e.zh: 人们在白垩岩里发现了海笋贝的贝壳。

e.en: The cough syrup contained {pholcodine}.
e.zh: 这种止咳糖浆含有福尔可定。

e.en: Some countries have restricted {pholcodine} because of safety concerns.
e.zh: 出于安全顾虑，一些国家限制了福尔可定的使用。

e.en: The study measured the cardiovascular effects of {pholedrine}.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了福来君对心血管的影响。

e.en: Doctors once used {pholedrine} to raise blood pressure.
e.zh: 医生曾用福来君来升高血压。

e.en: The sound was rated at forty {phon}.
e.zh: 这个声音的响度级被评为四十方。

e.en: Engineers used the {phon} scale to compare perceived loudness.
e.zh: 工程师用方这个单位来比较人耳感受到的响度。

e.en: The teacher developed {phonasthenia} after months of shouting.
e.zh: 这位老师连续数月大声讲课后出现了嗓音疲劳。

e.en: Voice therapy may help patients with {phonasthenia}.
e.zh: 嗓音治疗可能有助于发声无力的患者。

e.en: The therapist asked him to {phonate} gently.
e.zh: 治疗师让他轻轻发声。

e.en: Some consonants require the speaker to {phonate}.
e.zh: 有些辅音需要说话者用声带发音。

e.en: The vowel was clearly {phonated}.
e.zh: 这个元音发声很清楚。

e.en: Linguists distinguished whispered sounds from {phonated} sounds.
e.zh: 语言学家区分了耳语音和带声音。

e.en: She {phonates} without straining her throat.
e.zh: 她发声时没有让喉咙用力过度。

e.en: The patient {phonates} only for a few seconds.
e.zh: 这名患者只能发声几秒钟。

e.en: He was {phonating} while the camera recorded his vocal folds.
e.zh: 摄像机记录声带时，他正在发声。

e.en: The singer practiced {phonating} on a steady breath.
e.zh: 歌手练习在稳定气息上发声。

e.en: Normal {phonation} depends on healthy vocal folds.
e.zh: 正常发声依赖健康的声带。

e.en: The exam measured airflow during {phonation}.
e.zh: 这项检查测量了发声时的气流。

e.en: The {phonautograph} recorded sound as visible traces.
e.zh: 声波记录仪把声音记录成可见的痕迹。

e.en: Before the phonograph, the {phonautograph} could capture vibrations but not play them back.
e.zh: 在留声机出现以前，声波记录仪能捕捉振动却不能回放。

e.en: She waited inside the {phone-booth} during the rain.
e.zh: 下雨时她在电话亭里等着。

e.en: The old {phone-booth} had a cracked glass door.
e.zh: 那座旧电话亭的玻璃门裂了。

e.en: He found a {phonebooth} near the station.
e.zh: 他在车站附近找到了一座电话亭。

e.en: The movie scene begins in a crowded {phonebooth}.
e.zh: 电影这一幕从拥挤的电话亭里开始。

e.en: She bought a {phonecard} for international calls.
e.zh: 她买了一张电话卡用来打国际电话。

e.en: His wallet still held an unused {phonecard}.
e.zh: 他的钱包里还放着一张没用过的电话卡。

e.en: The analysis focused on {phonematic} contrasts in the language.
e.zh: 这项分析关注该语言中的音位对立。

e.en: A {phonematic} transcription shows meaningful sound differences.
e.zh: 音位转写会显示有意义的语音差别。

e.en: She wrote her thesis on {phonematics}.
e.zh: 她的论文写的是音位学。

e.en: Early {phonematics} shaped modern linguistic theory.
e.zh: 早期音位学影响了现代语言学理论。

e.en: The engineer calibrated the {phonemeter} before testing the room.
e.zh: 工程师在测试房间前校准了声音强度计。

e.en: A {phonemeter} can record small changes in sound pressure.
e.zh: 声音强度计可以记录声压的细微变化。

phonemically.t: 按音位方式；从音位角度

e.en: The two vowels are {phonemically} distinct in that language.
e.zh: 在那种语言中，这两个元音在音位上有区别。

e.en: She transcribed the word {phonemically} rather than phonetically.
e.zh: 她按音位而不是按语音细节来转写这个词。

e.en: The linguist tried to {phonemicise} the spelling system.
e.zh: 语言学家试图把这套拼写系统音位化。

e.en: Students learn to {phonemicise} speech sounds during analysis.
e.zh: 学生在分析时学习按音位处理语音。

e.en: The {phonemicist} argued for a smaller vowel inventory.
e.zh: 这位音位学家主张元音系统应更精简。

e.en: A careful {phonemicist} separates contrast from pronunciation detail.
e.zh: 严谨的音位分析者会区分对立关系和发音细节。

e.en: They {phonemicize} the data before comparing dialects.
e.zh: 他们先对资料作音位分析，再比较方言。

e.en: The software can {phonemicize} broad speech transcriptions.
e.zh: 该软件能把宽式语音转写转成音位形式。

phonendoscope.t: 听诊器的一种；传音听诊器

e.en: The doctor used a {phonendoscope} to listen to the murmur.
e.zh: 医生用传音听诊器听取那处杂音。

e.en: An old {phonendoscope} lay beside the medical notes.
e.zh: 一只旧式听诊器放在病历旁边。

e.en: The editor decided to {phoneticise} the foreign names.
e.zh: 编辑决定用语音形式标出这些外国名字。

e.en: Teachers sometimes {phoneticise} words for beginning readers.
e.zh: 教师有时会给初学阅读者把词按发音写出。

phoneticism.t: 语音主义；按发音拼写倾向

e.en: The reform reflected strong {phoneticism} in spelling policy.
e.zh: 这项改革体现了拼写政策中强烈的语音主义。

e.en: Critics said excessive {phoneticism} ignored historical spelling.
e.zh: 批评者说过度按发音拼写忽视了历史拼法。

e.en: The {phoneticist} recorded every consonant carefully.
e.zh: 语音学家仔细记录了每个辅音。

e.en: A trained {phoneticist} can hear subtle accent differences.
e.zh: 受过训练的语音学家能听出细微的口音差别。

e.en: The dictionary may {phoneticize} rare regional words.
e.zh: 这本词典可能会给少见方言词标出发音形式。

e.en: Some systems {phoneticize} Chinese names for English readers.
e.zh: 有些系统会把中文名音译给英语读者看。

e.en: The {phonetist} compared the speakers' vowel sounds.
e.zh: 语音研究者比较了说话人的元音发音。

e.en: As a {phonetist}, she focused on actual pronunciation.
e.zh: 作为语音学家，她关注实际发音。

phonevision.t: 电话电视；早期可视电话技术

e.en: Early {phonevision} promised pictures during telephone calls.
e.zh: 早期电话电视曾承诺通话时能传送图像。

e.en: The museum displayed a prototype {phonevision} device.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一台早期可视电话设备原型。

phoniatrics.t: 嗓音医学；语音障碍治疗学

e.en: She specialized in {phoniatrics} after medical school.
e.zh: 她从医学院毕业后专攻嗓音医学。

e.en: Modern {phoniatrics} treats voice and speech disorders.
e.zh: 现代嗓音医学治疗发声和言语障碍。

e.en: The children grouped the words {phonically}.
e.zh: 孩子们按发音把这些词分组。

e.en: These letters are {phonically} similar but visually different.
e.zh: 这些字母发音上相近，但外形不同。

e.en: His apology sounded {phonier} than before.
e.zh: 他的道歉听起来比以前更假。

e.en: The second excuse was even {phonier}.
e.zh: 第二个借口甚至更加虚伪。

e.en: She laughed {phonily} at the manager's joke.
e.zh: 她对经理的笑话笑得很假。

e.en: The actor spoke {phonily} in the emotional scene.
e.zh: 演员在那场感情戏里说话很做作。

e.en: The technician carried a {phonmeter} into the studio.
e.zh: 技术员把一台测声计带进录音室。

e.en: A {phonmeter} helped compare the machines' noise levels.
e.zh: 测声计帮助比较了这些机器的噪声水平。

e.en: He connected the turntable to the {phono} input.
e.zh: 他把唱盘接到了唱机输入端。

e.en: An old {phono} stood in the corner of the shop.
e.zh: 店铺角落里放着一台旧留声机。

e.en: The paper described {phonoangiography} as an experimental method.
e.zh: 论文把声血管造影术描述为一种实验方法。

e.en: Clinicians rarely use {phonoangiography} in routine diagnosis.
e.zh: 临床医生很少在常规诊断中使用声血管造影术。

e.en: The {phonocardiogram} showed an abnormal heart sound.
e.zh: 心音图显示出异常心音。

e.en: Doctors compared the new {phonocardiogram} with last year's record.
e.zh: 医生把新的心音图与去年的记录作了比较。

e.en: The team tested a {phonocatheter} during the procedure.
e.zh: 团队在手术过程中测试了一根带声传感器的导管。

e.en: A {phonocatheter} can detect sounds inside a vessel.
e.zh: 带声传感器的导管能探测血管内的声音。

e.en: Her thesis explored reactions in {phonochemistry}.
e.zh: 她的论文探讨了声化学中的反应。

e.en: In {phonochemistry}, sound waves can influence chemical processes.
e.zh: 在声化学中，声波会影响化学过程。

phonodeik.t: 声波显示仪；音振记录器

e.en: The laboratory kept a rare {phonodeik} for demonstrations.
e.zh: 实验室保留了一台少见的声波显示仪用于演示。

e.en: A {phonodeik} made speech vibrations visible on a screen.
e.zh: 声波显示仪能把语音振动显示在屏幕上。

e.en: The old clinic owned a {phonoelectrocardioscope}.
e.zh: 那家老诊所拥有一台心音心电综合观察仪。

e.en: A {phonoelectrocardioscope} displays heart sounds and electrical activity.
e.zh: 心音心电综合观察仪会显示心音和心电活动。

e.en: The archive restored a rare {phonofilm} from 1925.
e.zh: 档案馆修复了一部1925年的罕见有声电影早期录音片。

e.en: His lecture explained how {phonofilm} synchronized sound and image.
e.zh: 他的讲座解释了有声电影早期技术如何让声音和画面同步。

e.en: Her voice sounded unusually {phonogenic} on the old microphone.
e.zh: 她的声音通过那支旧麦克风听起来格外适合录音。

e.en: The study examined {phonogenic} mechanisms in speech production.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了言语产生中的发声机制。

phonogramic.t: 音符文字的；录音符号的

e.en: The script includes several {phonogramic} signs for syllables.
e.zh: 这种文字包含几个表示音节的音符文字符号。

e.en: He compared {phonogramic} notation with ordinary alphabetic spelling.
e.zh: 他把音符式记法同普通字母拼写作了比较。

phonographically.t: 按录音方式；按音标书写

e.en: The songs were preserved {phonographically} on wax cylinders.
e.zh: 这些歌曲以录音方式保存在蜡筒上。

e.en: The dialect was transcribed {phonographically} for later analysis.
e.zh: 这种方言被按音标方式记录下来，供日后分析。

e.en: A skilled {phonographist} adjusted the horn before recording began.
e.zh: 一名熟练的留声机录音员在录音开始前调好了喇叭。

e.en: The museum hired a {phonographist} to identify the antique machines.
e.zh: 博物馆聘请了一位留声机专家来鉴定这些古董机器。

e.en: Early {phonography} changed how people preserved music.
e.zh: 早期录音术改变了人们保存音乐的方式。

e.en: The linguist used {phonography} to record the village accent.
e.zh: 那位语言学家用语音记录法记下了这个村子的口音。

e.en: The hillside contains a hard volcanic rock called {phonolite}.
e.zh: 这片山坡含有一种叫响岩的坚硬火山岩。

e.en: Thin slabs of {phonolite} can ring when struck.
e.zh: 薄片响岩受到敲击时会发出清脆的声音。

e.en: The child showed a {phonologic} pattern common in early speech.
e.zh: 这个孩子表现出早期言语中常见的音系模式。

e.en: Her paper offered a {phonologic} account of vowel change.
e.zh: 她的论文从音系角度解释了元音变化。

e.en: The {phonologist} studied how sounds contrast in Korean.
e.zh: 这位音系学家研究韩语中声音如何形成对立。

e.en: A historical {phonologist} reconstructed the older pronunciation.
e.zh: 一位历史音系学家重建了较早时期的发音。

e.en: The article traces the {phonologization} of tone in the language.
e.zh: 这篇文章追溯了该语言中声调音系化的过程。

e.en: Stress may undergo {phonologization} after other contrasts disappear.
e.zh: 在其他区别消失后，重音可能经历音位化。

e.en: The technician used a {phonometer} to measure classroom noise.
e.zh: 技术员用声强计测量教室里的噪声。

e.en: An early {phonometer} could compare the loudness of different tones.
e.zh: 早期的声音测量器可以比较不同音调的响度。

e.en: The therapist evaluated the patient's {phonomotor} coordination.
e.zh: 治疗师评估了患者的发声运动协调能力。

e.en: The inventor demonstrated a small {phonomotor} driven by vibrations.
e.zh: 发明者演示了一台由振动驱动的小型声动装置。

e.en: The old {phonophone} amplified speech through a simple horn.
e.zh: 那台旧传声器通过一个简单喇叭放大说话声。

e.en: Engineers tested a {phonophone} for underwater communication.
e.zh: 工程师测试了一种用于水下通信的发声装置。

e.en: The experiment used a metal {phonophore} to carry vibrations.
e.zh: 实验使用金属载声体来传递振动。

e.en: A nineteenth-century {phonophore} helped transmit speech over wires.
e.zh: 十九世纪的一种传声器帮助通过电线传送语音。

e.en: The laboratory displayed a rare {phonophote} from early acoustics research.
e.zh: 实验室展出了一台早期声学研究中的罕见声光装置。

e.en: A {phonophote} converted sound vibrations into visible light changes.
e.zh: 光声器把声音振动转换成可见的光变化。

e.en: The amplifier needs a quarter-inch {phonoplug}.
e.zh: 这台放大器需要一个四分之一英寸的音频插头。

e.en: He replaced the cracked {phonoplug} on the record player cable.
e.zh: 他更换了唱机线缆上裂开的唱机插头。

e.en: The insect's {phonopore} helps channel sound toward the receptor.
e.zh: 这种昆虫的听孔有助于把声音导向感受器。

e.en: Dust blocked the tiny {phonopore} in the acoustic device.
e.zh: 灰尘堵住了这个声学装置里的微小传声孔。

e.en: The theater installed a {phonoprojectoscope} for synchronized films.
e.zh: 影院安装了一台有声电影放映机来播放同步影片。

e.en: Collectors prize the bulky {phonoprojectoscope} as a cinema relic.
e.zh: 收藏者把这台笨重的有声电影放映机视为电影史遗物。

e.en: The paper discusses {phonoreception} in nocturnal insects.
e.zh: 这篇论文讨论了夜行昆虫的声音感受。

e.en: Damage to the organ can reduce {phonoreception} in fish.
e.zh: 该器官受损会降低鱼类的听觉接收能力。

e.en: Each {phonoreceptor} responds to a narrow range of frequencies.
e.zh: 每个声音感受器只对较窄范围的频率作出反应。

e.en: The beetle's {phonoreceptor} detects the calls of nearby mates.
e.zh: 这种甲虫的听觉受器能探测附近配偶的鸣叫。

e.en: The library catalog lists the interview as a {phonorecord}.
e.zh: 图书馆目录把这段访谈列为声音记录。

e.en: She found a fragile {phonorecord} in her grandfather's cabinet.
e.zh: 她在祖父的柜子里发现了一张易碎的录音唱片。

e.en: The class compared several Greek {phonos} in ancient texts.
e.zh: 课堂比较了古代文本中的几个希腊语声音单位。

e.en: In the notes, {phonos} refers broadly to speech sounds.
e.zh: 在这些笔记中，phonos泛指言语声音。

e.en: The physicist used a {phonoscope} to visualize sound vibrations.
e.zh: 物理学家用声波显示器观察声音振动。

e.en: An antique {phonoscope} stood beside the other laboratory instruments.
e.zh: 一台古董验声器放在其他实验仪器旁边。

e.en: English has {phonotactic} limits on which consonants can start a word.
e.zh: 英语对哪些辅音能出现在词首有音位组合规则限制。

e.en: The learner's error reflected a native-language {phonotactic} pattern.
e.zh: 这名学习者的错误反映了母语的音位组合模式。

e.en: Japanese {phonotactics} make some English clusters difficult for learners.
e.zh: 日语的音位组合规则会让学习者觉得某些英语辅音连缀很难。

e.en: The course introduced {phonotactics} after basic phoneme theory.
e.zh: 课程在基础音位理论之后介绍了音位组合规则。

phonotelemetry.t: 声音信号遥测术；声遥测

e.en: The engineers used {phonotelemetry} to monitor the animal's movements remotely.
e.zh: 工程师用声音信号遥测术远程监测动物的活动。

e.en: Early {phonotelemetry} systems sent data through sound waves.
e.zh: 早期的声遥测系统通过声波传送数据。

e.en: The researcher classified each accent by its {phonotype}.
e.zh: 研究人员按语音类型对每种口音分类。

e.en: A rare {phonotype} appeared in the village dialect.
e.zh: 村里的方言中出现了一种罕见的音型。

e.en: The study compared {phonotypic} patterns across several dialects.
e.zh: 这项研究比较了几种方言中的音型模式。

e.en: She noticed a {phonotypic} difference in the recorded speech.
e.zh: 她注意到录音语音中有语音类型上的差异。

phonotypical.t: 音型上的；语音类型上的

e.en: The chart shows {phonotypical} variation between the two speakers.
e.zh: 这张图显示了两位说话者之间的音型差异。

e.en: His analysis focused on {phonotypical} features of regional speech.
e.zh: 他的分析集中在地方语音的语音类型特征上。

phonotypist.t: 音型记录员；语音速记者

e.en: The court hired a {phonotypist} to transcribe the testimony.
e.zh: 法庭聘请了一名语音速记者记录证词。

e.en: A skilled {phonotypist} could capture speech almost in real time.
e.zh: 熟练的音型记录员几乎能实时记录讲话。

e.en: Nineteenth-century reformers promoted {phonotypy} as a clearer writing system.
e.zh: 十九世纪的改革者提倡音型文字，认为它更清晰。

e.en: The archive contains pamphlets printed in {phonotypy}.
e.zh: 档案中有一些用语音拼写法印刷的小册子。

phonovision.t: 声像记录技术；声音影像系统

e.en: The museum displayed an early {phonovision} recording device.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一台早期声像记录设备。

e.en: Researchers restored several films made with {phonovision}.
e.zh: 研究人员修复了几部用声像技术制作的影片。

e.en: The old laboratory manual mentioned a {phonozenograph} for recording foreign sounds.
e.zh: 那本旧实验室手册提到一种用于记录外语音的语音外语记录仪。

e.en: No working {phonozenograph} survived in the collection.
e.zh: 馆藏中没有保存下还能运作的语音外语记录仪。

e.en: {Phooey}, I forgot my keys again.
e.zh: 呸，我又忘带钥匙了。

e.en: He dismissed the rumor as {phooey}.
e.zh: 他把那个传言斥为胡说八道。

e.en: Farmers must handle {phorate} with extreme care.
e.zh: 农民处理甲拌磷时必须格外小心。

e.en: The report found traces of {phorate} in the soil.
e.zh: 报告在土壤中发现了甲拌磷残留。

phorbin.t: 卟吩衍生物；叶绿素相关环

e.en: The molecule contains a {phorbin} ring related to chlorophyll.
e.zh: 这种分子含有与叶绿素相关的卟吩衍生环。

e.en: Chemists studied the {phorbin} structure under bright light.
e.zh: 化学家在强光下研究这种卟吩衍生物结构。

e.en: The experiment used {phorbol} to activate the cells.
e.zh: 实验使用佛波醇来激活细胞。

e.en: Some plant oils contain irritating {phorbol} compounds.
e.zh: 有些植物油含有刺激性的佛波醇类化合物。

e.en: Mites often use {phoresis} to travel on larger insects.
e.zh: 螨虫常通过附着传播搭乘较大的昆虫移动。

e.en: The paper describes {phoresis} as transport without feeding on the host.
e.zh: 论文把携播描述为不取食宿主的搭载传播。

e.en: The beetle provided {phoresy} for tiny mites.
e.zh: 这只甲虫为小螨虫提供了附着搭载传播的机会。

e.en: In {phoresy}, one organism rides another without parasitizing it.
e.zh: 在携播中，一种生物搭乘另一种生物而不寄生。

e.en: The {phoretic} mites clung to the beetle's legs.
e.zh: 这些携播螨附着在甲虫的腿上。

e.en: A {phoretic} relationship does not always harm the carrier.
e.zh: 附着传播关系并不一定会伤害搭载者。

e.en: The gardener planted {phormium} beside the path.
e.zh: 园丁在小路旁种了新西兰麻。

e.en: Traditional weavers used {phormium} leaves for strong fiber.
e.zh: 传统织工用新西兰麻叶制作结实的纤维。

e.en: The lecture treated {phorology} as the science of motion.
e.zh: 这堂课把运动学视为研究运动的科学。

e.en: Old physics texts sometimes used {phorology} for kinematics.
e.zh: 旧物理教材有时用phorology来指运动学。

e.en: The reaction produced {phorone} as a yellow crystalline compound.
e.zh: 反应生成了黄色晶体化合物佛尔酮。

e.en: Chemists identified {phorone} by its strong odor.
e.zh: 化学家通过其强烈气味鉴定出佛尔酮。

e.en: The philosopher discussed {phoronomics} before turning to dynamics.
e.zh: 这位哲学家先讨论运动学，然后转向动力学。

e.en: In older terminology, {phoronomics} covered the description of motion.
e.zh: 在较早的术语中，phoronomics涵盖对运动的描述。

e.en: Kant used {phoronomy} to describe pure motion in space.
e.zh: 康德用phoronomy描述空间中的纯粹运动。

e.en: The textbook's section on {phoronomy} precedes its treatment of force.
e.zh: 这本教材的运动学章节位于力学讨论之前。

e.en: The optometrist adjusted the {phoropter} during the eye exam.
e.zh: 验光师在眼科检查中调整综合验光仪。

e.en: A modern {phoropter} helps compare lens prescriptions quickly.
e.zh: 现代综合验光仪能快速比较镜片度数。

e.en: She looked through the {phoroptor} and read the letters aloud.
e.zh: 她透过综合验光仪看字母并大声读出来。

e.en: The clinic replaced its old {phoroptor} with a digital model.
e.zh: 诊所把旧综合验光仪换成了数字型号。

phosgenation.t: 光气化反应；用光气处理

e.en: The plant halted {phosgenation} after a safety review.
e.zh: 安全审查后，工厂停止了光气化反应。

e.en: Chemists use {phosgenation} to introduce carbonyl chloride groups.
e.zh: 化学家用光气化反应引入碳酰氯基团。

e.en: The lab monitored possible {phosgene} leaks after the fire.
e.zh: 火灾后，实验室监测是否有光气泄漏。

e.en: During the war, {phosgene} was used as a choking agent.
e.zh: 战争期间，光气曾被用作窒息性毒剂。

e.en: The collector found a pale crystal of {phosgenite}.
e.zh: 收藏者发现了一块浅色的光卤石晶体。

e.en: Old mine records mention {phosgenite} among the lead minerals.
e.zh: 旧矿山记录把光卤石列为铅矿物之一。

phosphagen.t: 磷酸原；高能磷酸化合物

e.en: Muscles use {phosphagen} stores during sudden effort.
e.zh: 肌肉在突然发力时会利用磷酸原储备。

e.en: Creatine phosphate is an important {phosphagen} in vertebrates.
e.zh: 磷酸肌酸是脊椎动物体内重要的磷酸原。

e.en: The farmer stopped using {phosphamidon} on vegetable crops.
e.zh: 这名农民停止在蔬菜作物上使用磷胺。

e.en: Regulators restricted {phosphamidon} because of its toxicity.
e.zh: 监管部门因磷胺毒性较强而限制其使用。

e.en: Chemists once used {phosphane} as another name for phosphine.
e.zh: 化学家曾把膦称作磷烷。

e.en: The compound is classified as a substituted {phosphane}.
e.zh: 这种化合物被归类为取代膦。

e.en: The island has rich {phosphatic} rock deposits.
e.zh: 这座岛有丰富的磷质岩矿床。

e.en: Farmers applied {phosphatic} fertilizer before planting.
e.zh: 农民在播种前施用了磷酸盐肥料。

e.en: The assay measured {phosphatidalcholine} in the membrane extract.
e.zh: 该检测测定了膜提取物中的缩醛磷脂酰胆碱。

e.en: Researchers compared {phosphatidalcholine} levels across several tissues.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了多种组织中的缩醛磷脂酰胆碱水平。

e.en: The paper reported low {phosphatidalserine} in damaged cells.
e.zh: 论文报告受损细胞中的缩醛磷脂酰丝氨酸含量较低。

e.en: A lipid standard for {phosphatidalserine} was difficult to obtain.
e.zh: 缩醛磷脂酰丝氨酸的脂质标准品很难获得。

e.en: Lecithin is a common {phosphatide} in egg yolk.
e.zh: 卵磷脂是蛋黄中常见的磷脂。

e.en: The extract contained both neutral fat and {phosphatide}.
e.zh: 该提取物同时含有中性脂肪和磷脂类物质。

e.en: The enzyme produces {phosphatidic} acid during signaling.
e.zh: 该酶在信号传导过程中产生磷脂酸。

e.en: They studied {phosphatidic} intermediates in lipid synthesis.
e.zh: 他们研究了脂质合成中的磷脂酸中间体。

e.en: The drug caused mild {phosphatidosis} in animal tests.
e.zh: 这种药物在动物试验中引起了轻度磷脂沉积症。

e.en: Pathologists looked for signs of {phosphatidosis} in lung tissue.
e.zh: 病理学家在肺组织中寻找磷脂沉积症的迹象。

e.en: The molecule contains a {phosphatidyl} group attached to choline.
e.zh: 该分子含有一个连接胆碱的磷脂酰基。

e.en: Several {phosphatidyl} lipids help form cell membranes.
e.zh: 多种磷脂酰类脂质有助于形成细胞膜。

e.en: The label printed {phosphatidylchline} instead of phosphatidylcholine.
e.zh: 标签把磷脂酰胆碱误印成了phosphatidylchline。

e.en: A search for {phosphatidylchline} may miss the correct term.
e.zh: 搜索phosphatidylchline可能会漏掉正确术语。

e.en: Cell membranes contain abundant {phosphatidylethanolamine}.
e.zh: 细胞膜中含有大量磷脂酰乙醇胺。

e.en: The team quantified {phosphatidylethanolamine} by mass spectrometry.
e.zh: 团队用质谱法定量分析磷脂酰乙醇胺。

e.en: Older textbooks mention {phosphatins} in egg yolk chemistry.
e.zh: 较早的教材在蛋黄化学中提到磷蛋白类。

e.en: The term {phosphatins} is rare in modern biochemistry.
e.zh: phosphatins这个术语在现代生物化学中很少见。

e.en: Engineers {phosphatize} steel before applying paint.
e.zh: 工程师在喷漆前会对钢材进行磷化处理。

e.en: Groundwater can {phosphatize} bones over long periods.
e.zh: 地下水可在漫长时间里使骨骼磷酸盐化。

e.en: The patient developed {phosphaturia} after taking the medicine.
e.zh: 患者服药后出现了磷酸盐尿。

e.en: Doctors checked whether {phosphaturia} explained the mineral loss.
e.zh: 医生检查尿磷增多是否能解释矿物质流失。

e.en: She saw a bright {phosphene} when she rubbed her eye.
e.zh: 她揉眼睛时看到了一道明亮的光幻视。

e.en: Electrical stimulation can produce a {phosphene} in blind patients.
e.zh: 电刺激可在盲人患者中产生眼内闪光感。

e.en: The artist called the glowing orb a {phosphere}.
e.zh: 艺术家把这个发光球体称为磷光球。

e.en: In the old article, {phosphere} described a luminous sphere.
e.zh: 在那篇旧文章中，phosphere指一种发光球体。

e.en: The reaction produced a stable {phosphinate} salt.
e.zh: 该反应生成了一种稳定的次膦酸盐。

e.en: A {phosphinate} ester was used as the starting material.
e.zh: 一种次膦酸酯被用作起始原料。

e.en: Stored grain may release toxic {phosphine} gas.
e.zh: 储存的粮食可能释放有毒的磷化氢气体。

e.en: The ligand was a bulky {phosphine} used in catalysis.
e.zh: 该配体是一种用于催化的位阻较大的膦。

e.en: Many {phosphines} serve as ligands in metal catalysts.
e.zh: 许多膦类化合物可作为金属催化剂中的配体。

e.en: Some {phosphines} have a sharp, unpleasant smell.
e.zh: 有些膦类化合物有刺鼻难闻的气味。

e.en: The complex contains a terminal {phosphinylidyne} ligand.
e.zh: 该配合物含有一个末端膦亚基配体。

e.en: Spectra confirmed the proposed {phosphinylidyne} structure.
e.zh: 光谱结果证实了所提出的磷炔基结构。

e.en: Plants absorbed {phosphite} differently from phosphate.
e.zh: 植物吸收亚磷酸盐的方式不同于磷酸盐。

e.en: The chemist added a {phosphite} to the polymer mixture.
e.zh: 化学家向聚合物混合物中加入了一种亚磷酸酯。

e.en: Some invertebrates store energy as {phospho-arginine}.
e.zh: 一些无脊椎动物以磷酸精氨酸的形式储存能量。

e.en: The enzyme transfers phosphate from {phospho-arginine} to ADP.
e.zh: 该酶把磷酸基从磷酸精氨酸转移到ADP上。

e.en: Casein is a common {phosphoprotein} found in milk.
e.zh: 酪蛋白是牛奶中常见的一种磷蛋白。

e.en: The lab measured each {phosphoprotein} after treatment.
e.zh: 处理后，实验室测量了每一种磷蛋白。

e.en: The enzyme converts {phosphopyruvate} during glycolysis.
e.zh: 这种酶在糖酵解过程中转化磷酸丙酮酸。

e.en: Researchers tracked {phosphopyruvate} levels in the sample.
e.zh: 研究人员追踪了样本中的磷酸丙酮酸水平。

e.en: Technicians {phosphorate} the alloy before testing it.
e.zh: 技术人员在测试合金前对其进行加磷处理。

e.en: The process can {phosphorate} the surface evenly.
e.zh: 这个工艺能使表面均匀磷化。

e.en: The factory is {phosphorating} steel parts today.
e.zh: 工厂今天正在对钢件进行磷化处理。

e.en: A {phosphorating} bath requires careful temperature control.
e.zh: 磷化处理槽需要仔细控制温度。

e.en: The painted stars {phosphoresce} after the lights go out.
e.zh: 灯熄灭后，涂过的星星会发出磷光。

e.en: Some minerals {phosphoresce} under ultraviolet light.
e.zh: 有些矿物在紫外线下会发磷光。

e.en: The dial {phosphoresced} faintly in the dark room.
e.zh: 表盘在黑暗的房间里微微发出磷光。

e.en: The jellyfish {phosphoresced} as the waves moved.
e.zh: 海浪涌动时，那只水母泛着冷光。

e.en: This coating {phosphoresces} for several minutes.
e.zh: 这种涂层会发磷光持续几分钟。

e.en: The shoreline {phosphoresces} when plankton bloom there.
e.zh: 浮游生物大量繁殖时，海岸线会泛起冷光。

e.en: The watch face was {phosphorescing} beside the bed.
e.zh: 手表表盘在床边正发着磷光。

e.en: They photographed {phosphorescing} algae in the bay.
e.zh: 他们拍摄了海湾里发出冷光的藻类。

e.en: The chemist described a {phosphoreted} compound in the report.
e.zh: 化学家在报告中描述了一种含磷化合物。

e.en: Old texts mention {phosphoreted} hydrogen as a gas.
e.zh: 旧文献把磷化氢称为一种气体。

e.en: They used the spelling {phosphoretted} in the older manual.
e.zh: 他们在较旧的手册中使用了phosphoretted这个拼法。

e.en: The article discussed {phosphoretted} hydrogen in early chemistry.
e.zh: 那篇文章讨论了早期化学中的磷化氢。

e.en: The term {phosphori} appears in old scientific Latin.
e.zh: phosphori这个词出现在旧式科学拉丁文中。

e.en: Several {phosphori} were compared in the experiment.
e.zh: 实验中比较了几种发光磷体。

e.en: The bacterium lacks functional {phosphoribomutase}.
e.zh: 这种细菌缺少有功能的磷酸核糖变位酶。

e.en: They purified {phosphoribomutase} from the cell extract.
e.zh: 他们从细胞提取物中纯化了磷酸核糖变位酶。

e.en: Cells need {phosphoribosylpyrophosphate} to build nucleotides.
e.zh: 细胞需要磷酸核糖焦磷酸来合成核苷酸。

e.en: The mutation reduced {phosphoribosylpyrophosphate} production sharply.
e.zh: 这个突变使磷酸核糖焦磷酸的生成大幅减少。

e.en: Plants use {phosphoribulokinase} in the Calvin cycle.
e.zh: 植物在卡尔文循环中使用磷酸核酮糖激酶。

e.en: The team measured {phosphoribulokinase} activity in leaves.
e.zh: 团队测量了叶片中的磷酸核酮糖激酶活性。

e.en: British manuals often write {phosphorise} instead of phosphorize.
e.zh: 英国手册常写phosphorise而不是phosphorize。

e.en: The treatment can {phosphorise} the metal surface.
e.zh: 这种处理能使金属表面磷化。

e.en: Workers once suffered {phosphorism} in match factories.
e.zh: 过去火柴厂工人曾患磷中毒。

e.en: The doctor recognized {phosphorism} from the jaw symptoms.
e.zh: 医生根据颌部症状判断为磷中毒。

e.en: The region contains a large bed of {phosphorite}.
e.zh: 该地区有一大片磷块岩矿层。

e.en: Farmers use processed {phosphorite} as phosphate fertilizer.
e.zh: 农民把加工过的磷矿石用作磷肥。

e.en: The drill reached a {phosphoritic} layer underground.
e.zh: 钻头到达了地下的含磷矿层。

e.en: Geologists mapped the {phosphoritic} sediments along the coast.
e.zh: 地质学家绘制了沿海磷块岩沉积物的分布图。

e.en: The coating improves after {phosphorization} of the steel.
e.zh: 钢材经过磷化后，涂层效果会改善。

e.en: Controlled {phosphorization} changed the material's conductivity.
e.zh: 受控加磷处理改变了材料的导电性。

e.en: Engineers {phosphorize} the surface to resist corrosion.
e.zh: 工程师对表面进行磷化以防腐蚀。

e.en: The furnace can {phosphorize} silicon wafers uniformly.
e.zh: 这台炉子能均匀地给硅片加磷。

e.en: The plant installed a new {phosphorizer} last month.
e.zh: 工厂上个月安装了一台新的磷化设备。

e.en: A liquid {phosphorizer} was added to the bath.
e.zh: 他们向处理槽中加入了一种液体加磷剂。

phosphorogen.t: 磷光生成物；发磷光物质

e.en: The scientist isolated a weak {phosphorogen} from the mixture.
e.zh: 科学家从混合物中分离出一种微弱的发磷光物质。

e.en: Old chemistry books call that material a {phosphorogen}.
e.zh: 旧化学书把那种材料称为磷光生成物。

e.en: The museum displayed a nineteenth-century {phosphorograph}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一张十九世纪的磷光照相作品。

e.en: A {phosphorograph} recorded the glow after exposure.
e.zh: 磷光图像记录了曝光后的余辉。

e.en: Early researchers experimented with {phosphorography} in dark rooms.
e.zh: 早期研究者在暗室里试验磷光照相术。

e.en: The lecture covered {phosphorography} and other imaging methods.
e.zh: 讲座介绍了磷光照相术和其他成像方法。

e.en: The enzyme breaks glycogen by {phosphorolysis}.
e.zh: 这种酶通过磷酸解作用分解糖原。

e.en: Unlike hydrolysis, {phosphorolysis} uses inorganic phosphate.
e.zh: 与水解不同，磷酸解作用使用无机磷酸盐。

phosphocreatine.t: 磷酸肌酸，肌肉储能物质

e.en: Muscles use {phosphocreatine} for quick energy during sprinting.
e.zh: 肌肉在短跑时利用磷酸肌酸快速供能。

e.en: The supplement may increase {phosphocreatine} stores in athletes.
e.zh: 这种补剂可能增加运动员体内的磷酸肌酸储备。

e.en: The drug blocks a {phosphodiesterase} in blood vessels.
e.zh: 这种药会阻断血管中的一种磷酸二酯酶。

e.en: A {phosphodiesterase} breaks down signaling molecules inside cells.
e.zh: 磷酸二酯酶会分解细胞内的信号分子。

e.en: Several {phosphodiesterases} regulate heart muscle signaling.
e.zh: 多种磷酸二酯酶调节心肌信号传递。

e.en: Researchers compared different {phosphodiesterases} in immune cells.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了免疫细胞中的不同磷酸二酯酶。

e.en: {Phosphoenolpyruvate} is an important intermediate in glycolysis.
e.zh: 磷酸烯醇式丙酮酸是糖酵解中的重要中间产物。

e.en: The enzyme converts oxaloacetate into {phosphoenolpyruvate}.
e.zh: 这种酶把草酰乙酸转化为磷酸烯醇式丙酮酸。

e.en: {Phosphofructokinase} helps control the speed of glycolysis.
e.zh: 磷酸果糖激酶有助于控制糖酵解的速度。

e.en: Low energy levels activate {phosphofructokinase} in the cell.
e.zh: 能量水平低时会激活细胞内的磷酸果糖激酶。

e.en: {Phosphoglucomutase} changes glucose phosphate from one form to another.
e.zh: 磷酸葡萄糖变位酶会把葡萄糖磷酸从一种形式变为另一种。

e.en: A defect in {phosphoglucomutase} can disturb sugar metabolism.
e.zh: 磷酸葡萄糖变位酶缺陷可能扰乱糖代谢。

e.en: {Phosphoglyceraldehyde} appears in early steps of sugar breakdown.
e.zh: 磷酸甘油醛出现在糖分解的早期步骤中。

e.en: The lab measured {phosphoglyceraldehyde} during the reaction.
e.zh: 实验室在反应过程中测定了磷酸甘油醛。

phosphoglycerate.t: 磷酸甘油酸盐；磷酸甘油酸

e.en: Plants form {phosphoglycerate} during carbon fixation.
e.zh: 植物在固定碳的过程中形成磷酸甘油酸。

e.en: The pathway converts {phosphoglycerate} into another metabolic intermediate.
e.zh: 这条途径把磷酸甘油酸转化为另一种代谢中间产物。

e.en: {Phosphoglyceromutase} is required for one step of glycolysis.
e.zh: 糖酵解的一个步骤需要磷酸甘油酸变位酶。

e.en: Doctors found reduced {phosphoglyceromutase} activity in the biopsy.
e.zh: 医生在活检样本中发现磷酸甘油酸变位酶活性降低。

e.en: {Phosphohexoisomerase} converts glucose phosphate into fructose phosphate.
e.zh: 磷酸己糖异构酶把葡萄糖磷酸转化为果糖磷酸。

e.en: The mutation lowered {phosphohexoisomerase} activity in red blood cells.
e.zh: 这种突变降低了红细胞中的磷酸己糖异构酶活性。

e.en: The assay detected {phosphohexonate} in the bacterial extract.
e.zh: 检测在细菌提取物中发现了磷酸己糖酸盐。

e.en: {Phosphohexonate} can appear in pathways related to glucose oxidation.
e.zh: 磷酸己糖酸盐可出现在与葡萄糖氧化相关的途径中。

e.en: A {phosphohexose} molecule contains both sugar and phosphate groups.
e.zh: 一个磷酸己糖分子含有糖基和磷酸基。

e.en: The enzyme acts on {phosphohexose} during carbohydrate metabolism.
e.zh: 这种酶在碳水化合物代谢中作用于磷酸己糖。

e.en: {Phosphoinositides} help control signals at the cell membrane.
e.zh: 磷酸肌醇脂类有助于控制细胞膜上的信号。

e.en: Cancer cells may alter their {phosphoinositides} to promote growth.
e.zh: 癌细胞可能改变其磷酸肌醇脂类以促进生长。

e.en: A {phosphokinase} transfers phosphate groups during metabolism.
e.zh: 磷酸激酶在代谢过程中转移磷酸基团。

e.en: The study measured {phosphokinase} activity after exercise.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了运动后的磷酸激酶活性。

phospholine.t: 磷胆碱类化合物；磷酰胆碱

e.en: The membrane sample contained a {phospholine} compound.
e.zh: 这份膜样本含有一种磷胆碱类化合物。

e.en: Some papers use {phospholine} when discussing phosphorylcholine derivatives.
e.zh: 有些论文在讨论磷酰胆碱衍生物时会使用phospholine这个词。

e.en: A {phospholipase} cuts fatty acids from membrane lipids.
e.zh: 磷脂酶会从膜脂中切下脂肪酸。

e.en: Snake venom often contains {phospholipase} enzymes.
e.zh: 蛇毒中常含有磷脂酶。

e.en: Different {phospholipases} target different bonds in phospholipids.
e.zh: 不同磷脂酶作用于磷脂中的不同化学键。

e.en: Inflammation can activate {phospholipases} in immune cells.
e.zh: 炎症可能激活免疫细胞中的磷脂酶。

e.en: A {phosphomonoesterase} removes phosphate from organic molecules.
e.zh: 磷酸单酯酶会从有机分子上去除磷酸基。

e.en: Soil tests measured {phosphomonoesterase} activity near plant roots.
e.zh: 土壤测试测量了植物根部附近的磷酸单酯酶活性。

e.en: A {phosphomutase} shifts a phosphate group within a molecule.
e.zh: 磷酸变位酶会在分子内部移动磷酸基团。

e.en: The pathway depends on {phosphomutase} for efficient sugar use.
e.zh: 这条途径依靠磷酸变位酶高效利用糖。

e.en: The detergent contains a {phosphonate} that binds metal ions.
e.zh: 这种洗涤剂含有一种能结合金属离子的膦酸盐。

e.en: Some microbes can break down {phosphonate} compounds.
e.zh: 一些微生物能够分解膦酸盐化合物。

e.en: The chemist described the product as a {phosphonia} salt.
e.zh: 化学家把该产物描述为一种膦鎓盐。

e.en: {Phosphonia} compounds are discussed in specialized organic chemistry texts.
e.zh: 膦鎓类化合物会出现在专业有机化学教材中。

e.en: The molecule has a {phosphonic} acid group attached.
e.zh: 这个分子连接着一个膦酸基团。

e.en: Researchers tested several {phosphonic} compounds against corrosion.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了几种含膦酸基的化合物抗腐蚀效果。

e.en: The compound contains a {phosphonio} group in its structure.
e.zh: 该化合物的结构中含有一个膦鎓基。

e.en: A {phosphonio} substituent can change the molecule's charge.
e.zh: 膦鎓基取代基会改变分子的电荷。

e.en: A {phosphonium} salt was used in the synthesis.
e.zh: 合成过程中使用了一种膦鎓盐。

e.en: The {phosphonium} ion carries a positive charge on phosphorus.
e.zh: 膦鎓离子的正电荷位于磷原子上。

e.en: The paper mentions a {phosphonuclease} involved in nucleic acid processing.
e.zh: 论文提到一种参与核酸加工的磷酸核酸酶。

e.en: A {phosphonuclease} may cleave phosphate-linked nucleic acid chains.
e.zh: 磷酸核酸酶可能切割由磷酸键连接的核酸链。

e.en: The enzyme drives a {phosphorolytic} reaction in the cell.
e.zh: 这种酶在细胞内推动磷酸解反应。

e.en: Researchers measured the {phosphorolytic} breakdown of glycogen.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了糖原的磷酸解分解过程。

e.en: Early scientists used {phosphorophotography} to record faint glows.
e.zh: 早期科学家用磷光摄影术记录微弱的发光。

e.en: The museum displayed plates made by {phosphorophotography}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了用磷光摄影术制作的底片。

e.en: The physicist adjusted the {phosphoroscope} before the demonstration.
e.zh: 物理学家在演示前调好了磷光镜。

e.en: A {phosphoroscope} can measure how long a material keeps glowing.
e.zh: 磷光测定器可以测量材料持续发光的时间。

e.en: The molecule contains a reactive {phosphoryl} group.
e.zh: 这个分子含有一个活泼的磷酰基。

e.en: Chemists studied {phosphoryl} transfer in the reaction.
e.zh: 化学家研究了该反应中的磷酰基转移。

e.en: Muscle cells use {phosphorylase} to release glucose from glycogen.
e.zh: 肌肉细胞利用磷酸化酶从糖原中释放葡萄糖。

e.en: The lab tested whether {phosphorylase} activity increased after exercise.
e.zh: 实验室检测了运动后磷酸化酶活性是否升高。

e.en: The drug altered a {phosphorylative} pathway in the cells.
e.zh: 这种药改变了细胞中的一条磷酸化通路。

e.en: They compared oxidative and {phosphorylative} processes in the sample.
e.zh: 他们比较了样本中的氧化过程和磷酸化过程。

e.en: The antibody binds strongly to {phosphorylcholine}.
e.zh: 这种抗体能牢固结合磷酰胆碱。

e.en: Some bacteria display {phosphorylcholine} on their surface.
e.zh: 一些细菌会在其表面呈现磷酰胆碱。

e.en: The study detected {phosphotaurocyamine} in marine invertebrate muscle.
e.zh: 这项研究在海洋无脊椎动物肌肉中检测到磷牛磺氰胺。

e.en: Scientists compared {phosphotaurocyamine} with other phosphagens.
e.zh: 科学家把磷牛磺氰胺与其他磷酸原作了比较。

e.en: A {phosphotransferase} moves phosphate groups between molecules.
e.zh: 磷酸转移酶在分子之间转移磷酸基团。

e.en: The mutation reduced {phosphotransferase} activity in the pathway.
e.zh: 该突变降低了这条通路中的磷酸转移酶活性。

e.en: Photosynthesis produces {phosphotriose} as an important intermediate.
e.zh: 光合作用会产生作为重要中间产物的磷酸丙糖。

e.en: The assay measured {phosphotriose} levels in the leaf tissue.
e.zh: 该检测测量了叶片组织中的磷酸丙糖水平。

e.en: Egg yolk contains the phosphoprotein {phosphovitin}.
e.zh: 蛋黄中含有卵黄高磷蛋白这种磷蛋白。

e.en: The team purified {phosphovitin} for a nutrition study.
e.zh: 团队为一项营养研究纯化了卵黄高磷蛋白。

e.en: The chemist described the gas as {phosphureted} hydrogen.
e.zh: 化学家把这种气体描述为磷化氢。

e.en: Old texts mention {phosphureted} compounds in early experiments.
e.zh: 旧文献提到早期实验中的磷化化合物。

e.en: Workers once feared {phossy} jaw in match factories.
e.zh: 火柴厂工人过去曾害怕患上磷毒性颌骨坏死。

e.en: The old slang word {phossy} referred to phosphorus exposure.
e.zh: 这个旧俚语phossy指的是接触磷造成的情况。

e.en: The detector used a {phoswich} design to separate signals.
e.zh: 该探测器采用磷光夹层设计来区分信号。

e.en: A {phoswich} combines different scintillators in one device.
e.zh: 磷光夹层探测器把不同闪烁体组合在一个装置中。

e.en: The old measurement was given in {phots}.
e.zh: 这个旧测量值以辐透为单位给出。

e.en: One {phot} is a high level of illuminance.
e.zh: 一辐透表示很高的光照度。

e.en: Algae grow mainly in the ocean's {photic} zone.
e.zh: 藻类主要生长在海洋的透光层。

e.en: The patient had a {photic} response during the eye test.
e.zh: 患者在眼部测试中出现了光刺激反应。

photically.t: 以光照方式；受光影响地

e.en: The neurons were {photically} stimulated during the experiment.
e.zh: 实验中这些神经元受到光刺激。

e.en: Some seizures can be triggered {photically} by flashing lights.
e.zh: 有些癫痫发作可能由闪光以光刺激方式诱发。

e.en: The camera used a {photicon} to convert light into signals.
e.zh: 这台摄像机使用光电图像管把光转换成信号。

e.en: Engineers replaced the old {photicon} in the imaging system.
e.zh: 工程师更换了成像系统中的旧光电图像管。

e.en: The course included a short section on {photics}.
e.zh: 这门课程包括一小节光学内容。

e.en: His notes on {photics} described several light effects.
e.zh: 他关于光现象研究的笔记描述了几种光效应。

e.en: The obsolete term {photion} once meant a quantum of light.
e.zh: 过时术语photion曾表示一个光量子。

e.en: In the paper, a {photion} was treated like a photon.
e.zh: 在那篇论文中，photion被当作光子处理。

e.en: She reported a blue {photism} after hearing the note.
e.zh: 她说听到那个音后出现了蓝色的联觉色感。

e.en: The migraine caused a brief {photism} in his vision.
e.zh: 偏头痛让他的视野中短暂出现了光幻觉。

e.en: The circuit used a {photistor} to detect changes in light.
e.zh: 该电路使用光敏晶体管检测光线变化。

e.en: A damaged {photistor} made the sensor unreliable.
e.zh: 损坏的光敏晶体管让传感器变得不可靠。

e.en: The instrument measured a {photo-beat} between two laser beams.
e.zh: 该仪器测量了两束激光之间的光拍频。

e.en: A clear {photo-beat} appeared in the detector signal.
e.zh: 探测器信号中出现了清晰的光差拍。

e.en: The cast attended a {photo-call} before the premiere.
e.zh: 演员阵容在首映前参加了媒体拍照会。

e.en: Reporters gathered for the minister's brief {photo-call}.
e.zh: 记者们聚集参加部长的简短媒体拍照会。

e.en: The survey used {photo-charting} to map coastal erosion.
e.zh: 这项调查用照片制图来绘制海岸侵蚀情况。

e.en: Early astronomers relied on {photo-charting} of star fields.
e.zh: 早期天文学家依靠星场的照相制图。

e.en: Her {photo-essay} documented life after the flood.
e.zh: 她的摄影散文记录了洪水后的生活。

e.en: The magazine published a {photo-essay} on migrant workers.
e.zh: 这本杂志刊登了一篇关于外来务工者的组照报道。

e.en: The experiment measured {photo-excitation} in the crystal.
e.zh: 实验测量了晶体中的光激发现象。

e.en: Laser pulses can cause {photo-excitation} of electrons.
e.zh: 激光脉冲会引起电子的光致激发。

photo-finish.t: 终点摄影判定；难分胜负

e.en: The race ended in a {photo-finish}.
e.zh: 这场比赛最后要靠终点摄影判定胜负。

e.en: The election was a political {photo-finish}.
e.zh: 这次选举在政治上几乎难分胜负。

e.en: Strong ultraviolet light caused {photo-ionization} of the gas.
e.zh: 强紫外光导致气体发生光电离。

e.en: The paper models {photo-ionization} around young stars.
e.zh: 这篇论文模拟了年轻恒星周围的光致电离。

photo-offset.t: 照相胶印；照相平版印刷

e.en: The printer used {photo-offset} for the catalog pages.
e.zh: 印刷厂用照相胶印来制作目录页面。

e.en: Old manuals describe {photo-offset} as a cheaper process.
e.zh: 旧手册把照相平版印刷描述为一种更便宜的工艺。

photo-op.t: 拍照作秀机会；合影场面

e.en: The mayor turned the visit into a {photo-op}.
e.zh: 市长把这次访问变成了拍照作秀的机会。

e.en: Fans waited outside for a quick {photo-op}.
e.zh: 粉丝在外面等着快速合影。

e.en: The mountain trail offers many {photo-opportunities}.
e.zh: 这条山路提供了很多拍照机会。

e.en: Politicians often look for {photo-opportunities} during crises.
e.zh: 政客常在危机中寻找拍照作秀的机会。

photo-opportunity.t: 拍照机会；上镜作秀场合

e.en: The sunset was a perfect {photo-opportunity}.
e.zh: 那场日落是绝佳的拍照机会。

e.en: Critics called the visit a staged {photo-opportunity}.
e.zh: 批评者称这次访问是安排好的上镜作秀。

photo-realism.t: 照相写实主义；逼真效果

e.en: The painting shows remarkable {photo-realism}.
e.zh: 这幅画呈现出惊人的照相写实效果。

e.en: Modern games often chase {photo-realism} in lighting.
e.zh: 现代游戏常在光照上追求逼真效果。

e.en: The newspaper bought a new {photo-typesetter} in 1978.
e.zh: 这家报社在1978年买了一台新的照相排字机。

e.en: A skilled {photo-typesetter} prepared the book pages.
e.zh: 一名熟练的照排员制作了书页版面。

e.en: Digital systems replaced many {photo-typesetters}.
e.zh: 数字系统取代了许多照相排字机。

e.en: The union represented experienced {photo-typesetters}.
e.zh: 这个工会代表经验丰富的照排员。

e.en: The detector records {photoabsorption} at different wavelengths.
e.zh: 探测器记录不同波长下的光吸收。

e.en: Researchers studied {photoabsorption} in the thin film.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了薄膜中的光致吸收。

e.en: The team built a {photoacoustic} imaging system.
e.zh: 团队搭建了一套光声成像系统。

e.en: A {photoacoustic} signal revealed hidden defects.
e.zh: 光声信号显示出了隐藏缺陷。

e.en: The lab tested the {photoactinic} effect of sunlight.
e.zh: 实验室测试了阳光的光化作用。

e.en: Certain dyes are highly {photoactinic} under ultraviolet light.
e.zh: 某些染料在紫外光下非常容易发生感光反应。

e.en: Blue light can {photoactivate} the drug in tissue.
e.zh: 蓝光可以在组织中光活化这种药物。

e.en: Scientists {photoactivate} proteins to track cell movement.
e.zh: 科学家用光激活蛋白质来追踪细胞运动。

e.en: The coating contains a {photoactive} compound.
e.zh: 这种涂层含有一种光活性化合物。

e.en: A {photoactive} surface breaks down pollutants in sunlight.
e.zh: 光活性表面能在阳光下分解污染物。

e.en: A silent-film {photoactor} needed expressive gestures.
e.zh: 默片电影演员需要富有表现力的手势。

e.en: The catalyst served as a {photoactor} in the reaction.
e.zh: 这种催化剂在反应中充当光作用物。

e.en: The chemist observed {photoaddition} under ultraviolet light.
e.zh: 化学家在紫外光下观察到光加成反应。

e.en: This molecule undergoes {photoaddition} with oxygen.
e.zh: 这种分子会与氧发生光化加成反应。

e.en: The surface showed increased {photoadsorption} after treatment.
e.zh: 处理后，表面显示出更强的光吸附。

e.en: They measured {photoadsorption} of gases on the catalyst.
e.zh: 他们测量了气体在催化剂上的光致吸附。

e.en: The cream may trigger {photoallergy} in sensitive patients.
e.zh: 这种乳霜可能在敏感患者身上引发光过敏。

e.en: Doctors distinguished {photoallergy} from ordinary sunburn.
e.zh: 医生把日光过敏反应与普通晒伤区分开来。

e.en: The sensor uses a {photoamplifier} to boost weak signals.
e.zh: 这个传感器用光放大器增强微弱信号。

e.en: A faulty {photoamplifier} distorted the image data.
e.zh: 故障的光电放大器扭曲了图像数据。

photoassimilate.t: 光合同化产物；光合同化

e.en: Leaves export {photoassimilate} to growing roots.
e.zh: 叶片把光合同化产物输送到正在生长的根部。

e.en: Plants {photoassimilate} carbon more slowly in shade.
e.zh: 植物在阴影中光合同化碳的速度较慢。

e.en: A cyanobacterium is a common {photoautotroph}.
e.zh: 蓝细菌是一种常见的光合自养生物。

e.en: Each {photoautotroph} uses light as its energy source.
e.zh: 每种光合自养生物都利用光作为能量来源。

e.en: Algae are often {photoautotrophic} organisms.
e.zh: 藻类通常是光合自养生物。

e.en: The bacteria shifted to a {photoautotrophic} mode.
e.zh: 这些细菌转向了光合自养模式。

photobathic.t: 深水光照带的；透光深层的

e.en: The team measured {photobathic} conditions below the reef.
e.zh: 团队测量了珊瑚礁下方深水透光层的环境。

e.en: Some algae survive in a narrow {photobathic} zone.
e.zh: 一些藻类能在狭窄的深水光照带中存活。

photobinocular.t: 双目摄影的；照相双筒的

e.en: The museum displayed an early {photobinocular} instrument.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件早期的双目摄影仪器。

e.en: A {photobinocular} viewer gave the images surprising depth.
e.zh: 双目照片观看器让这些图像显得很有纵深感。

e.en: The paper discussed a {photobiologic} response in skin cells.
e.zh: 论文讨论了皮肤细胞中的一种光生物学反应。

e.en: Their lab studies {photobiologic} damage caused by ultraviolet light.
e.zh: 他们的实验室研究紫外线造成的光生物学损伤。

e.en: The {photobiological} effects of blue light remain debated.
e.zh: 蓝光的光生物学影响仍存在争议。

e.en: She designed a {photobiological} experiment with algae.
e.zh: 她用藻类设计了一项光生物学实验。

e.en: A {photobiologist} explained how plants sense day length.
e.zh: 一位光生物学家解释了植物如何感知日照长短。

e.en: The hospital consulted a {photobiologist} about light therapy.
e.zh: 医院就光疗问题咨询了一位光生物学家。

e.en: She studies {photobiology} at a marine research institute.
e.zh: 她在一所海洋研究机构研究光生物学。

e.en: Modern {photobiology} helps explain circadian rhythms.
e.zh: 现代光生物学有助于解释昼夜节律。

e.en: The lichen's {photobiont} provides sugars through photosynthesis.
e.zh: 地衣中的光合共生体通过光合作用提供糖分。

e.en: Researchers identified the algal {photobiont} in the sample.
e.zh: 研究人员在样本中鉴定出了藻类光合共生体。

e.en: The larvae showed a strong {photobiotic} reaction.
e.zh: 这些幼虫表现出强烈的趋光生物反应。

e.en: A {photobiotic} process drives growth in this organism.
e.zh: 一种依赖光的过程推动了这种生物的生长。

e.en: The dye faded because of {photobleaching}.
e.zh: 这种染料因光漂白而褪色。

e.en: Microscopists try to reduce {photobleaching} during imaging.
e.zh: 显微镜操作人员会尽量减少成像过程中的光漂白。

e.en: My brother tried to {photobomb} every holiday picture.
e.zh: 我弟弟想在每张假日照片里抢镜。

e.en: A dog {photobombed} their wedding photo.
e.zh: 一只狗乱入了他们的婚礼照片。

e.en: We took silly pictures in the {photobooth}.
e.zh: 我们在照相亭里拍了几张搞笑照片。

e.en: The party had a {photobooth} with funny hats.
e.zh: 派对上有一台照相亭，还配了滑稽帽子。

photobotany.t: 植物光学研究；光植物学

e.en: Early {photobotany} linked sunlight to plant movement.
e.zh: 早期光植物学把阳光与植物运动联系起来。

e.en: Her thesis in {photobotany} focused on leaf pigments.
e.zh: 她的光植物学论文聚焦于叶片色素。

e.en: The artist used {photocalque} to transfer the outline.
e.zh: 艺术家用照相描摹法转印轮廓。

e.en: A rare {photocalque} process preserved the old design.
e.zh: 一种罕见的照相摹印工艺保存了旧图案。

e.en: The sensor's {photocapacitance} changed under bright light.
e.zh: 传感器在强光下的光电容发生了变化。
