e.en: They add oil to {plasticize} the rubber compound.
e.zh: 他们加入油来使橡胶混合料塑化。

e.en: Solvents may {plasticize} the coating and reduce its hardness.
e.zh: 溶剂可能会使涂层塑化，并降低其硬度。

e.en: This additive {plasticizes} the material without making it sticky.
e.zh: 这种添加剂能使材料塑化，却不会让它发黏。

e.en: Heat {plasticizes} the resin before it enters the mold.
e.zh: 树脂进入模具前，热量会使其塑化。

e.en: A {plastid} can develop into a chloroplast in leaf cells.
e.zh: 质体在叶细胞中可以发育成叶绿体。

e.en: The researcher studied how each {plastid} divides during growth.
e.zh: 研究人员观察每个质体在生长过程中如何分裂。

e.en: The team analyzed {plastidial} genes in several plant species.
e.zh: 团队分析了几种植物中的质体基因。

e.en: Some enzymes move into the {plastidial} compartment after synthesis.
e.zh: 有些酶合成后会进入质体区室。

e.en: Early botanists described the tiny body as a {plastidule}.
e.zh: 早期植物学家把这个微小结构称为小质体。

e.en: The term {plastidule} is now mostly found in older biology texts.
e.zh: 如今“小质体”这个术语多见于较旧的生物学文献。

e.en: Heat caused the resin's {plastification} before it entered the mold.
e.zh: 树脂进模具前受热发生了塑化。

e.en: The report measured {plastification} under different pressure conditions.
e.zh: 报告测量了不同压力条件下的塑化情况。

e.en: The additive helps {plastify} the rubber at lower temperatures.
e.zh: 这种添加剂有助于在较低温度下使橡胶塑化。

e.en: Manufacturers {plastify} the mixture before shaping it into sheets.
e.zh: 厂家先把混合物塑化，再压制成片材。

plastigauge.t: 塑料测量片；间隙测量条

e.en: The mechanic used {plastigauge} to check the bearing clearance.
e.zh: 机修工用塑料测隙条检查轴承间隙。

e.en: A strip of {plastigauge} flattened under the tightened cap.
e.zh: 一条塑料测隙条在拧紧的盖下被压扁了。

e.en: The lab used {plastimetry} to compare the clay samples.
e.zh: 实验室用塑性测定法比较这些黏土样品。

e.en: Modern {plastimetry} gives engineers better data on deformation.
e.zh: 现代塑性计量法为工程师提供更好的变形数据。

e.en: The paper identified {plastin} as part of the cell structure.
e.zh: 论文把质素列为细胞结构的一部分。

e.en: Older textbooks used {plastin} for a substance in protoplasm.
e.zh: 较旧的教材用质素指原生质中的一种物质。

e.en: The farm tested {plastiponics} for growing vegetables indoors.
e.zh: 农场试用塑料基无土栽培法在室内种蔬菜。

e.en: In {plastiponics}, plants grow in plastic-supported nutrient systems.
e.zh: 在塑料基无土栽培中，植物生长在塑料支撑的营养系统里。

e.en: The printer cured the {plastisol} ink with heat.
e.zh: 印刷工用加热方式固化塑溶胶油墨。

e.en: Liquid {plastisol} becomes a flexible coating after baking.
e.zh: 液态塑溶胶烘烤后会变成柔韧的涂层。

plastochondria.t: 质粒体；旧称细胞质颗粒

e.en: The lecture mentioned {plastochondria} as an outdated cell term.
e.zh: 讲座提到质粒体是一个过时的细胞学术语。

e.en: Some early biologists confused {plastochondria} with other cytoplasmic bodies.
e.zh: 一些早期生物学家把质粒体同其他细胞质小体混淆。

e.en: The plant's {plastochron} shortened under warmer conditions.
e.zh: 在更温暖的条件下，这株植物的成叶周期缩短了。

e.en: Botanists measure the {plastochron} between successive leaf initiations.
e.zh: 植物学家测量连续叶片发生之间的叶序间期。

e.en: {Plastocyanin} carries electrons during photosynthesis.
e.zh: 质蓝素在光合作用中传递电子。

e.en: The mutation reduced {plastocyanin} levels in the leaves.
e.zh: 这种突变降低了叶片中的质蓝素水平。

e.en: In some organisms, {plastogamy} occurs before nuclear fusion.
e.zh: 在某些生物中，胞质融合发生在细胞核融合之前。

e.en: The diagram separates {plastogamy} from later genetic events.
e.zh: 这张图把胞质融合同后续遗传事件区分开来。

e.en: The mutation was traced to a {plastogene} in the chloroplast.
e.zh: 这次突变被追踪到叶绿体中的一个质体基因。

e.en: A {plastogene} may be inherited differently from nuclear genes.
e.zh: 质体基因的遗传方式可能不同于核基因。

e.en: The technician read the curve on the {plastograph}.
e.zh: 技术员读取塑性记录仪上的曲线。

e.en: A {plastograph} showed how the material softened during mixing.
e.zh: 塑变图显示材料在混合过程中如何变软。

e.en: The engineer calibrated the {plastometer} before testing the rubber.
e.zh: 工程师在测试橡胶前校准了塑度仪。

e.en: A {plastometer} measures how a sample deforms under load.
e.zh: 塑性计测量样品在载荷下如何变形。

e.en: {Plastometry} helped determine the best processing temperature.
e.zh: 塑性测量帮助确定了最佳加工温度。

e.en: The course introduced {plastometry} for polymers and clays.
e.zh: 这门课介绍了聚合物和黏土的塑度测定。

e.en: The lab replaced the old {platinotron} after repeated failures.
e.zh: 实验室在多次故障后更换了那台旧铂栅磁控管。

e.en: Engineers tested a {platinotron} for high-frequency microwave generation.
e.zh: 工程师测试了一台铂栅磁控管，用于产生高频微波。

e.en: The museum displayed a delicate {platinotype} from the 1890s.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一张十九世纪九十年代的精致铂盐照片。

e.en: She chose {platinotype} printing for its soft tonal range.
e.zh: 她选择铂盐印相法，因为它的色调层次柔和。

e.en: The chemist prepared a {platinous} chloride solution.
e.zh: 化学家配制了一种亚铂氯化物溶液。

e.en: Older texts describe this compound as {platinous}.
e.zh: 较早的文献把这种化合物称为含二价铂的。

e.en: She arrived with {platinum-blonde} hair and a red coat.
e.zh: 她一头银白金发，穿着红色外套来了。

e.en: The actor wore a {platinum-blonde} wig for the role.
e.zh: 那位演员为这个角色戴了一顶银白金色假发。

e.en: His speech sounded polished but {platitudinal}.
e.zh: 他的演讲听起来很流畅，却满是陈词滥调。

e.en: The essay offered only {platitudinal} advice about success.
e.zh: 这篇文章只给出了关于成功的老套建议。

e.en: The columnist dismissed him as a tiresome {platitudinarian}.
e.zh: 专栏作家把他斥为一个令人厌烦的陈词滥调者。

e.en: A {platitudinarian} can make even urgent issues sound empty.
e.zh: 爱说套话的人甚至会把紧迫问题讲得空洞无物。

e.en: Politicians often {platitudinize} when they lack a real plan.
e.zh: 政客没有真正计划时，常常只会说些陈词滥调。

e.en: Please do not {platitudinize} about teamwork in this meeting.
e.zh: 请不要在这次会议上空谈团队合作的套话。

e.en: He {platitudinized} about hope until the audience grew restless.
e.zh: 他不断用关于希望的套话空谈，直到听众开始不耐烦。

e.en: The proposal was {platitudinized} into a vague statement of values.
e.zh: 这项提案被改写成了一段空泛的价值观套话。

e.en: She {platitudinizes} whenever reporters ask difficult questions.
e.zh: 每当记者提出难题时，她就说些陈词滥调。

e.en: The memo {platitudinizes} about innovation without naming any action.
e.zh: 这份备忘录空谈创新，却没有提出任何具体行动。

e.en: Stop {platitudinizing} and tell us what changed.
e.zh: 别再说套话了，告诉我们到底发生了什么变化。

e.en: His {platitudinizing} tone annoyed the younger staff.
e.zh: 他那种满口套话的语气惹恼了年轻员工。

e.en: A {platode} has a flattened body and simple organs.
e.zh: 扁形动物身体扁平，器官结构也较简单。

e.en: The biology text used {platode} as an older term for flatworm.
e.zh: 这本生物教材把platode作为扁虫的旧称。

e.en: The surveyor checked the surface with a {platometer}.
e.zh: 测量员用平面测量仪检查了这个表面。

e.en: A {platometer} can help estimate small variations in flatness.
e.zh: 平面测量仪可以帮助估算平整度的细小变化。

e.en: They loved each other {platonically}, without any romance.
e.zh: 他们以柏拉图式的方式相爱，没有任何恋爱关系。

e.en: He admired her {platonically} as a teacher and friend.
e.zh: 他把她当作老师和朋友，以纯精神的方式敬重她。

e.en: The essay takes a {platonistic} view of beauty.
e.zh: 这篇文章从柏拉图主义角度看待美。

e.en: His {platonistic} language treats ideas as more real than objects.
e.zh: 他的柏拉图主义式语言把理念看得比实物更真实。

e.en: The story was {platonized} into a lesson about ideal love.
e.zh: 这个故事被柏拉图化，变成了一堂关于理想之爱的课。

e.en: Medieval thinkers often {platonized} earlier religious concepts.
e.zh: 中世纪思想家常常把早期宗教概念柏拉图化。

e.en: The scholar was known as a bold {platonizer} of Christian doctrine.
e.zh: 这位学者以大胆柏拉图化阐释基督教教义而闻名。

e.en: A {platonizer} may read ordinary love as a search for ideals.
e.zh: 柏拉图化阐释者可能会把普通爱情解读为对理想的追寻。

platonizing.t: 柏拉图化的；柏拉图化阐释

e.en: Her lecture kept {platonizing} the poet's earthly desires.
e.zh: 她的讲座不断把诗人的世俗欲望作柏拉图化阐释。

e.en: The book has a strongly {platonizing} account of friendship.
e.zh: 这本书对友谊作了很强的柏拉图化说明。

e.en: The dermatologist diagnosed mild {platonychia} after examining her nails.
e.zh: 皮肤科医生检查她的指甲后诊断为轻度扁平甲症。

e.en: Severe {platonychia} can make the nails look unusually flat.
e.zh: 严重的扁平甲症会让指甲看起来异常扁平。

e.en: The boat grounded on a sandy {platte} at low tide.
e.zh: 退潮时，小船搁浅在一片沙质浅滩上。

e.en: Old maps marked the {platte} beside the river.
e.zh: 旧地图标出了河边那片平地。

e.en: The heavy roller {plattens} the metal sheet evenly.
e.zh: 沉重的滚轮把金属板均匀压平。

e.en: Rain {plattens} the tall grass along the path.
e.zh: 雨水把小路旁的高草压倒压平。

e.en: She brought a {platterful} of sandwiches to the table.
e.zh: 她端来满满一大盘三明治放到桌上。

e.en: A {platterful} of fruit disappeared within minutes.
e.zh: 满满一大盘水果几分钟内就被吃光了。

e.en: My first aquarium fish was a bright orange {platy}.
e.zh: 我养的第一条观赏鱼是一条亮橙色的月光鱼。

e.en: The fossil had a broad, {platy} shape.
e.zh: 这块化石呈宽而扁平的形状。

e.en: The doctor noted a mildly {platycephalic} skull shape.
e.zh: 医生注意到头颅形状有轻度扁平。

e.en: Some reptiles have a distinctly {platycephalic} profile.
e.zh: 有些爬行动物具有明显扁头的外形。

e.en: The farm tested a {plastoponic} system for growing lettuce indoors.
e.zh: 农场测试了一套塑料基无土系统，用来在室内种生菜。

e.en: Researchers compared {plastoponic} trays with traditional soil beds.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了塑料基无土托盘和传统土床。

e.en: {Plastoquinone} carries electrons during photosynthesis in chloroplasts.
e.zh: 质体醌在叶绿体光合作用中传递电子。

e.en: The mutation reduced the pool of {plastoquinone} in the leaf tissue.
e.zh: 这种突变减少了叶片组织中的质体醌储量。

plastosol.t: 塑性溶胶；糊状塑料分散体

e.en: The coating was made from a heated {plastosol}.
e.zh: 这层涂层是由加热后的塑性溶胶制成的。

e.en: A vinyl {plastosol} can form a tough flexible film.
e.zh: 乙烯基塑性溶胶能形成坚韧而柔软的薄膜。

plastosome.t: 质体小体；旧称线粒体样颗粒

e.en: Early cytologists described the granule as a {plastosome}.
e.zh: 早期细胞学家把这种颗粒描述为质体小体。

e.en: The term {plastosome} appears mostly in older biology papers.
e.zh: 质体小体这个术语主要见于较早的生物学论文。

e.en: The printer prepared a {plastotype} for the small edition.
e.zh: 印刷工为这批小印量作品准备了塑型印版。

e.en: A {plastotype} could reproduce fine details from the original surface.
e.zh: 塑型印版能够复制原始表面的细小细节。

e.en: The turtle had a deep {plastral} scar near the hinge.
e.zh: 这只龟在腹甲铰合处附近有一道很深的伤痕。

e.en: The costume included a bright {plastral} plate on the chest.
e.zh: 这套服装胸前配有一块醒目的胸甲板。

e.en: Old medical kits often contained herbal {plastres}.
e.zh: 旧式药箱里常有草药膏药。

e.en: The mason repaired the wall with thin {plastres}.
e.zh: 泥瓦匠用薄薄的灰泥层修补了墙面。

e.en: The turtle withdrew its legs against the {plastron}.
e.zh: 乌龟把腿缩回，贴在腹甲旁。

e.en: His fencing jacket had a padded {plastron}.
e.zh: 他的击剑服带有一块加垫的护胸。

e.en: The sponge sample contained a small {plastrotyl} under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下，这份海绵样本含有一根小的扁端骨针。

e.en: Specialists identify some sponges by the shape of a {plastrotyl}.
e.zh: 专家会根据扁端海绵骨针的形状来鉴别某些海绵。

e.en: The speaker stood on a wooden {plat-form}.
e.zh: 演讲者站在一个木制平台上。

e.en: The old spelling {plat-form} appears in the scanned book.
e.zh: 这个旧拼法plat-form出现在扫描版书中。

e.en: The station has two raised {plat-forms}.
e.zh: 这个车站有两个抬高的站台。

e.en: Several online {plat-forms} changed their rules.
e.zh: 几个在线平台修改了规则。

e.en: The lab kept a {platanna} for developmental studies.
e.zh: 实验室养了一只非洲爪蟾，用于发育研究。

e.en: A {platanna} can live fully underwater for long periods.
e.zh: 非洲爪蟾可以长时间完全生活在水下。

e.en: A broad {platano} shaded the village square.
e.zh: 一棵宽大的悬铃木遮住了村里的广场。

e.en: The market sold ripe {platano} beside green bananas.
e.zh: 市场在青香蕉旁边出售成熟的香蕉类果实。

e.en: A carved {platband} ran above the doorway.
e.zh: 门口上方有一道雕刻的扁带饰。

e.en: The architect restored the stone {platband} on the facade.
e.zh: 建筑师修复了正面墙上的石质平拱横带。

e.en: The print has a clear {plate-mark} around the image.
e.zh: 这幅版画的图像周围有清晰的版痕。

e.en: Collectors check the {plate-mark} to judge the impression.
e.zh: 收藏者会查看印版压痕来判断印刷效果。

e.en: The island formed along a {plate-tectonic} boundary.
e.zh: 这座岛形成于板块构造边界附近。

e.en: Her paper explained the {plate-tectonic} cause of the earthquake.
e.zh: 她的论文解释了这次地震的板块构造成因。

e.en: The essay used a {platean} image of ideal beauty.
e.zh: 这篇文章使用了柏拉图式的理想美意象。

e.en: The survey described a dry {platean} landscape.
e.zh: 这份勘测报告描述了一片干燥的高原景观。

e.en: The circuit board used a {plated-resist} process.
e.zh: 这块电路板采用了镀层抗蚀剂工艺。

e.en: Engineers inspected the {plated-resist} before etching the copper.
e.zh: 工程师在蚀刻铜层前检查了镀层抗蚀剂。

e.en: The shopfront was made of heavy {plateglass}.
e.zh: 店面是用厚重的平板玻璃做成的。

e.en: Rain streaked the wide {plateglass} window.
e.zh: 雨水在宽大的厚平板玻璃窗上流下条痕。

e.en: She slid the negative into the camera {plateholder}.
e.zh: 她把底片滑进相机的底片夹里。

e.en: The press operator cleaned the {plateholder} before printing.
e.zh: 印刷机操作员在印刷前清洁了印版夹。

e.en: The {platelayer} checked the rail joints before dawn.
e.zh: 铺轨工在天亮前检查了钢轨接头。

e.en: A skilled {platelayer} can align heavy slabs accurately.
e.zh: 熟练的铺板工能把沉重的板材对齐得很准。

e.en: The {platemaker} prepared the image for offset printing.
e.zh: 制版工为胶印准备了图像。

e.en: A digital {platemaker} replaced the old darkroom equipment.
e.zh: 数字制版机取代了旧的暗房设备。

e.en: Modern {platemaking} reduced the time before printing.
e.zh: 现代制版缩短了印刷前的准备时间。

e.en: She learned traditional {platemaking} in an art workshop.
e.zh: 她在艺术工作坊学习了传统制版工艺。

e.en: The paper wrapped around the typewriter {platen}.
e.zh: 纸张卷在打字机滚筒上。

e.en: The press lowered its steel {platen} onto the mold.
e.zh: 压机把钢制压板降到模具上。

platens.t: 压板；打印机滚筒的复数

e.en: The factory replaced two worn {platens} on the press.
e.zh: 工厂更换了压机上两个磨损的压板。

e.en: Old typewriters often need their rubber {platens} restored.
e.zh: 旧打字机常常需要修复橡胶滚筒。

plateresque.t: 银匠式建筑风格的；装饰繁复的

e.en: The cathedral has a {plateresque} facade covered with fine carving.
e.zh: 这座大教堂有一面装饰繁复的银匠式外立面。

e.en: Critics admired the {plateresque} detail around the doorway.
e.zh: 评论家赞赏门口周围精细的银匠式装饰。

e.en: The palace hall preserved a painted {platfond} from the eighteenth century.
e.zh: 宫殿大厅保留了一幅十八世纪的天花板画。

e.en: Restorers cleaned the cracked {platfond} above the staircase.
e.zh: 修复人员清理了楼梯上方开裂的装饰天花板。

platform-independent.t: 跨平台的；不依赖平台的

e.en: The team chose a {platform-independent} format for the data files.
e.zh: 团队为数据文件选择了不依赖平台的格式。

e.en: A {platform-independent} app can run on many operating systems.
e.zh: 跨平台应用可以在多种操作系统上运行。

e.en: The geologist described the shelf as a {platformate} mass of limestone.
e.zh: 地质学家把这片岩棚描述为台状石灰岩体。

e.en: Erosion may {platformate} the soft rock over many centuries.
e.zh: 侵蚀可能在许多世纪里把软岩削成平台状。

e.en: A tiny {platformula} supported the specimen inside the case.
e.zh: 一个小平台支撑着箱内的标本。

e.en: The old diagram labels the raised base as a {platformula}.
e.zh: 那张旧图把隆起的底座标为小台状结构。

e.en: Early chemists sometimes called platinum {platin} in their notes.
e.zh: 早期化学家有时在笔记中把铂称作platin。

e.en: The alloy contained traces of {platin} and iridium.
e.zh: 这种合金含有微量的铂和铱。

e.en: Miners once separated {platina} from river sand by hand.
e.zh: 矿工过去曾手工从河砂中分离天然白金。

e.en: The museum displayed a nugget of crude {platina}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一块粗天然铂矿。

e.en: The lecture compared several {platinammines} used in coordination chemistry.
e.zh: 讲座比较了配位化学中使用的几种铂氨络合物。

e.en: Some {platinammines} show unusual colors in solution.
e.zh: 有些铂氨络合物在溶液中呈现异常颜色。

e.en: The technician will {platinate} the electrode before the test.
e.zh: 技术员会在测试前给电极镀铂。

e.en: The old reagent bottle was labeled potassium {platinate}.
e.zh: 那只旧试剂瓶标着铂酸钾。

e.en: The experiment used a {platinated} electrode to speed the reaction.
e.zh: 实验使用镀铂电极来加快反应。

e.en: A {platinated} surface can resist corrosion better than plain metal.
e.zh: 经铂处理的表面比普通金属更耐腐蚀。

e.en: The jeweler described the pale metal as {platine}.
e.zh: 珠宝匠把这种浅色金属描述为铂。

e.en: Her dress had a cool {platine} sheen under the lights.
e.zh: 她的裙子在灯光下泛着冷白金色光泽。

e.en: The chemist prepared a {platinic} chloride solution.
e.zh: 化学家配制了一种四价氯铂溶液。

e.en: A {platinic} compound may act as a strong oxidizing agent.
e.zh: 铂化合物可能充当强氧化剂。

e.en: The survey found {platiniferous} gravel along the river.
e.zh: 勘测发现河边有含铂砂砾。

e.en: Investors were interested in the {platiniferous} deposits.
e.zh: 投资者对这些产铂矿床很感兴趣。

e.en: The old standard meter was made of {platiniridium}.
e.zh: 旧的标准米尺由铂铱合金制成。

e.en: Engineers valued {platiniridium} for its stability and hardness.
e.zh: 工程师看重铂铱合金的稳定性和硬度。

e.en: The lamp seal used {platinite} because it expanded like glass.
e.zh: 灯泡封接处使用铂铁镍合金，因为它的膨胀率接近玻璃。

e.en: A collector mislabeled the dark mineral as {platinite}.
e.zh: 一位收藏者误把这种深色矿物标为铂矿物。

e.en: Careful {platinization} improved the electrode's performance.
e.zh: 细致的镀铂处理提高了电极性能。

e.en: The manual explains {platinization} of glassy carbon surfaces.
e.zh: 手册说明了玻碳表面的铂化处理。

e.en: They {platinize} the wire to make it more conductive.
e.zh: 他们给金属丝镀铂，使它更易导电。

e.en: Researchers can {platinize} carbon particles for catalyst studies.
e.zh: 研究人员可以使碳颗粒铂化，用于催化剂研究。

e.en: The sensor used a {platinized} tip for accurate readings.
e.zh: 传感器使用镀铂探头以获得准确读数。

e.en: The {platinized} carbon showed higher catalytic activity.
e.zh: 已铂化的碳表现出更高的催化活性。

e.en: The lab {platinizes} small electrodes before each trial.
e.zh: 实验室在每次试验前给小电极镀铂。

e.en: This process {platinizes} the surface without heating the sample.
e.zh: 这种工艺无需加热样品就能使表面铂化。

e.en: The paper discussed {platinocyanic} acid and its salts.
e.zh: 论文讨论了铂氰酸及其盐类。

e.en: A {platinocyanic} compound formed bright crystals.
e.zh: 一种铂氰酸化合物形成了明亮的晶体。

e.en: The sample was identified as a {platinocyanid} by its color.
e.zh: 样品因其颜色被鉴定为铂氰化物。

e.en: Old texts often spell platinocyanide as {platinocyanid}.
e.zh: 旧文献常把platinocyanide拼作platinocyanid。

e.en: Barium {platinocyanide} was once used in fluorescent screens.
e.zh: 铂氰化钡曾用于荧光屏。

e.en: The chemist handled the {platinocyanide} salt with care.
e.zh: 化学家小心处理这种铂氰化物盐。

e.en: The current passed through the {platinode} into the solution.
e.zh: 电流通过铂电极进入溶液。

e.en: A clean {platinode} gave steadier measurements.
e.zh: 干净的铂电极带来了更稳定的测量结果。

e.en: The alloy had several {platinoid} properties.
e.zh: 这种合金具有几种类铂特性。

e.en: The report grouped palladium with the {platinoid} metals.
e.zh: 报告把钯归入铂族金属。

e.en: The watch case was made from {platinor}, not real platinum.
e.zh: 表壳由仿铂合金制成，并非真正的铂。

e.en: Vintage catalogues advertised {platinor} as a bright jewelry metal.
e.zh: 老商品目录把platinor宣传为明亮的首饰合金。

e.en: The old {play-actor} knew every line by heart.
e.zh: 那位老演员把每句台词都记得很熟。

e.en: He dismissed the politician as a mere {play-actor}.
e.zh: 他把那名政客说成只是个装腔作势的人。

e.en: She {play-acts} bravery whenever the team is nervous.
e.zh: 每当团队紧张时，她都会装出勇敢的样子。

e.en: The children {play-act} a court scene in the classroom.
e.zh: 孩子们在教室里扮演法庭场景。

e.en: The coach watched the {play-back} after the match.
e.zh: 教练在赛后观看了比赛回放。

e.en: Press this button to start {play-back} of the recording.
e.zh: 按这个按钮即可开始播放录音。

e.en: The radio host gave a lively {play-by-play}.
e.zh: 电台主持人做了生动的实况解说。

e.en: She wanted a {play-by-play} of the whole argument.
e.zh: 她想听整场争论的逐步详细经过。

e.en: Their toddler goes to a {play-group} twice a week.
e.zh: 他们的幼儿每周去两次游戏小组。

e.en: The church runs a morning {play-group} for local families.
e.zh: 这座教堂为当地家庭开办上午的幼儿游戏小组。

e.en: The {play-maker} controlled the tempo of the game.
e.zh: 这名组织核心控制了比赛节奏。

e.en: Without their best {play-maker}, the team looked predictable.
e.zh: 少了最好的组织核心后，球队显得很容易被看穿。

e.en: The final {play-off} will decide the champion.
e.zh: 最后的加赛将决定冠军归属。

e.en: They reached the {play-off} after a dramatic win.
e.zh: 他们在一场戏剧性的胜利后进入了季后赛。

e.en: My daughter started {play-school} this spring.
e.zh: 我女儿今年春天开始上学前班。

e.en: The {play-school} has a small garden for outdoor games.
e.zh: 这所幼儿园有个小花园供孩子们户外游戏。

e.en: His first {play-through} of the game took twelve hours.
e.zh: 他第一次完整通关这个游戏花了十二个小时。

e.en: The band did a full {play-through} before recording.
e.zh: 乐队在录音前从头到尾完整演奏了一遍。

e.en: The young {play-wright} wrote a sharp political comedy.
e.zh: 这位年轻剧作家写了一部犀利的政治喜剧。

e.en: Every {play-wright} needs to hear actors read the lines aloud.
e.zh: 每位剧作家都需要听演员把台词读出来。

e.en: A skilled {playactor} can hold an audience in silence.
e.zh: 技艺高超的演员能让观众安静地看下去。

e.en: He sounded like a {playactor} trying too hard.
e.zh: 他说话像个用力过猛的装腔作势者。

e.en: The blocks are stored in the wooden {playbox}.
e.zh: 积木都收在那个木制玩具箱里。

e.en: She packed a small {playbox} for the long train ride.
e.zh: 她为漫长的火车旅程装了一个小玩具箱。

e.en: A colorful {playbus} visits the estate every Friday.
e.zh: 一辆彩色的儿童游戏巴士每周五都会来到这个社区。

e.en: The charity turned an old bus into a {playbus}.
e.zh: 这家慈善机构把一辆旧巴士改造成流动儿童游戏车。

e.en: Change into your {playclothes} before going outside.
e.zh: 出去玩之前先换上你的旧衣服。

e.en: Her {playclothes} were covered with mud by noon.
e.zh: 到中午时，她玩耍穿的衣服已经沾满了泥。

e.en: Friday is {playday} at the nursery.
e.zh: 星期五是托儿所的游戏日。

e.en: They planned a family {playday} at the park.
e.zh: 他们计划在公园安排一个家庭休闲活动日。

e.en: The scandal was discussed across {playdom} for weeks.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻在演艺界被议论了好几个星期。

e.en: In the child's {playdom}, every chair became a castle.
e.zh: 在孩子的游戏世界里，每把椅子都成了城堡。

e.en: Officials tried to {playdown} the size of the problem.
e.zh: 官员们试图淡化问题的严重程度。

e.en: Do not {playdown} her role in the rescue.
e.zh: 不要轻描淡写她在救援中的作用。

e.en: That joke feels completely {played-out} now.
e.zh: 那个笑话现在听起来已经完全过时了。

e.en: After the long shift, we were {played-out}.
e.zh: 长时间轮班后，我们都筋疲力尽了。

e.en: The veteran became a {player-coach} in his final season.
e.zh: 这名老将在最后一个赛季成了兼任教练的球员。

e.en: A {player-coach} must lead while still performing on the field.
e.zh: 兼任教练的球员必须一边上场比赛一边带队。

e.en: He served as {player-manager} for a small football club.
e.zh: 他在一家小足球俱乐部担任兼任经理的球员。

e.en: The {player-manager} chose himself for the starting lineup.
e.zh: 这位兼任经理的球员把自己排进了首发阵容。

e.en: Her brother was her only {playfellow} on the farm.
e.zh: 在农场上，她哥哥是她唯一的玩伴。

e.en: He remembered his childhood {playfellow} with great affection.
e.zh: 他满怀感情地想起儿时的伙伴。

e.en: The school built a new {playfield} behind the gym.
e.zh: 学校在体育馆后面建了一个新的运动场。

e.en: The rules changed the {playfield} for small businesses.
e.zh: 这些规则改变了小企业竞争的领域。

e.en: The children invented a new {playgame} after lunch.
e.zh: 午饭后，孩子们发明了一个新的游戏。

e.en: This old {playgame} teaches counting and patience.
e.zh: 这个老游戏能教人数数和耐心。

e.en: The tabloids called her a wealthy {playgirl}.
e.zh: 小报称她是个有钱的玩乐女子。

e.en: As a child, she was a fearless {playgirl} outdoors.
e.zh: 小时候，她是个在户外无所畏惧地玩耍的女孩。

playgirls.t: 花花公子女郎；性感女郎

e.en: The magazine hired several {playgirls} for the photo shoot.
e.zh: 那本杂志雇了几名性感女郎来拍摄照片。

e.en: Old tabloids often portrayed {playgirls} as symbols of glamour.
e.zh: 旧小报常把花花公子女郎描绘成魅力的象征。

e.en: The {playgoing} public welcomed the new comedy.
e.zh: 爱看戏的公众欢迎这部新喜剧。

e.en: Her {playgoing} habits began when she was a student.
e.zh: 她经常看戏的习惯是学生时代养成的。

e.en: He picked a {playing-card} from the deck.
e.zh: 他从一副牌里抽出一张扑克牌。

e.en: A single torn {playing-card} lay on the table.
e.zh: 桌上放着一张撕破的纸牌。

e.en: The children ran across the {playing-field} after school.
e.zh: 放学后，孩子们跑过运动场。

e.en: The new rules created a fairer {playing-field} for small firms.
e.zh: 新规则为小公司创造了更公平的竞争环境。

e.en: The school repaired the old {playingfield} before winter.
e.zh: 学校在冬天前修好了旧运动场。

e.en: Tax breaks changed the {playingfield} for local businesses.
e.zh: 税收优惠改变了本地企业的竞争条件。

e.en: The students performed a funny {playlet} in class.
e.zh: 学生们在课堂上表演了一出有趣的短剧。

e.en: Her radio {playlet} lasted only ten minutes.
e.zh: 她的广播小戏只持续了十分钟。

e.en: The festival included three short {playlets} by local writers.
e.zh: 艺术节包括本地作家的三出短剧。

e.en: These {playlets} are easy for beginners to perform.
e.zh: 这些小戏很适合初学者表演。

e.en: The toddler pushed a bright {playmobile} across the floor.
e.zh: 那个幼儿把一辆鲜艳的玩具车推过地板。

e.en: They stored the old {playmobile} in the nursery cupboard.
e.zh: 他们把那辆旧儿童玩具车收在育儿室柜子里。

e.en: The children built castles in the {playpit}.
e.zh: 孩子们在玩沙池里堆城堡。

e.en: A clean {playpit} can keep toddlers busy for hours.
e.zh: 干净的儿童游戏坑能让幼儿玩上好几个小时。

e.en: The theater hired a {playreader} to assess new scripts.
e.zh: 剧院雇了一名剧本读者来评估新剧本。

e.en: As a careful {playreader}, she noticed every weak scene.
e.zh: 作为细心的读剧本者，她注意到每个薄弱场景。

e.en: The teacher designed a {playscheme} for the preschool class.
e.zh: 老师为学前班设计了一个游戏方案。

e.en: Their {playscheme} divided the drama into four short scenes.
e.zh: 他们的戏剧计划把这出戏分成四个短场景。

e.en: Each actor received a copy of the {playscript}.
e.zh: 每位演员都收到了一份剧本。

e.en: The teacher edited the {playscript} for younger students.
e.zh: 老师为年龄较小的学生修改了演出脚本。

e.en: The shop sells wooden {playsets} for young children.
e.zh: 这家店出售给幼儿玩的木制成套玩具。

e.en: Movie-themed {playsets} filled the shelves before Christmas.
e.zh: 圣诞节前，电影主题游戏套装摆满了货架。

e.en: She bought a sturdy {playshoe} for her son.
e.zh: 她给儿子买了一只结实的玩耍用鞋。

e.en: The soft {playshoe} was made for indoor games.
e.zh: 这款柔软的儿童游戏鞋是为室内游戏设计的。

e.en: The puppy was {playsome} even after a long walk.
e.zh: 那只小狗散了很久的步后仍然很爱玩。

e.en: Her {playsome} mood made the dull meeting lighter.
e.zh: 她顽皮的情绪让沉闷的会议轻松了一些。

e.en: The baby wore a blue {playsuit} in the photo.
e.zh: 照片里，婴儿穿着一件蓝色连身衣。

e.en: This cotton {playsuit} is comfortable for summer play.
e.zh: 这件棉质儿童游戏服适合夏天玩耍时穿。

e.en: The brand makes durable {playwear} for active children.
e.zh: 这个品牌为好动的孩子制作耐穿的玩耍服装。

e.en: Parents often choose washable {playwear} for nursery days.
e.zh: 家长常为上托儿所的日子选择可水洗的休闲童装。

e.en: She learned to {playwrite} by studying classic comedies.
e.zh: 她通过研究经典喜剧学习写剧本。

e.en: Few students choose to {playwrite} for the school festival.
e.zh: 很少有学生选择为学校艺术节创作戏剧。

e.en: The young {playwriter} won a national prize.
e.zh: 这位年轻剧作家获得了全国奖项。

e.en: A good {playwriter} understands how actors speak.
e.zh: 优秀的写剧本者懂得演员怎样说话。

e.en: She took a course in {playwriting} at university.
e.zh: 她在大学修了一门剧本创作课。

e.en: Good {playwriting} gives every scene a purpose.
e.zh: 好的戏剧写作会让每个场景都有目的。

e.en: The defendant accepted a {plea-bargain} to avoid trial.
e.zh: 被告接受了认罪协商，以避免审判。

e.en: Critics say a {plea-bargain} can pressure innocent people.
e.zh: 批评者说，辩诉交易可能给无辜者施压。

plea-bargaining.t: 认罪协商；辩诉交易过程

e.en: The case ended after months of {plea-bargaining}.
e.zh: 经过数月认罪协商，这个案子终于结束。

e.en: Some lawyers defend {plea-bargaining} as a practical necessity.
e.zh: 一些律师认为辩诉交易过程有其现实必要性。

e.en: Gardeners {pleach} young branches to form a shaded walk.
e.zh: 园丁编结幼枝，形成一条有树荫的小径。

e.en: The vines {pleach} themselves across the old fence.
e.zh: 藤蔓在旧篱笆上自然交织在一起。

e.en: The fungus was described as {plectobasidial} in the monograph.
e.zh: 这本专著把这种真菌描述为具锁状担子的类型。

e.en: A {plectobasidial} structure can help identify certain basidiomycetes.
e.zh: 具锁状担子的结构有助于鉴定某些担子菌。

e.en: The old guide classified the pufferfish as a {plectognath}.
e.zh: 那本旧指南把河豚归为硬颌鱼。

e.en: A {plectognath} has jaws arranged differently from most fishes.
e.zh: 硬颌鱼的颌部排列方式不同于多数鱼类。

plectognathic.t: 硬颌鱼类的；颌骨连合的

e.en: The specimen showed a clearly {plectognathic} jaw structure.
e.zh: 这个标本显示出明显的硬颌鱼类颌部结构。

e.en: Older zoologists used {plectognathic} features to group these fishes.
e.zh: 早期动物学家用颌骨连合特征来归类这些鱼。

e.en: The guitarist kept several {plectra} in his pocket.
e.zh: 吉他手口袋里放着好几枚拨片。

e.en: Ancient string players used small {plectra} made of bone.
e.zh: 古代弦乐演奏者使用骨制的小琴拨。

e.en: The slide showed a swollen {plectridium} at one end.
e.zh: 玻片显示一端有膨大的棒状孢子囊。

e.en: In old bacteriology texts, a {plectridium} was noted by its shape.
e.zh: 在旧细菌学文献中，梭状菌体因其形态而被记载。

e.en: He struck the lyre with a wooden {plectron}.
e.zh: 他用木制拨子弹响了里拉琴。

e.en: The bird's heel bore a sharp {plectron}.
e.zh: 那只鸟的踵部有一个尖锐的距状突起。

e.en: She {pled} guilty after hearing the evidence.
e.zh: 听完证据后，她承认有罪。

e.en: He {pled} with the guards to let him pass.
e.zh: 他恳求守卫让他通过。

e.en: The {pledgee} may sell the collateral after default.
e.zh: 债务违约后，质权人可以出售抵押物。

e.en: A bank often acts as the {pledgee} in secured lending.
e.zh: 在担保贷款中，银行常担任受质押人。

e.en: Their agreement was informal and {pledgeless}.
e.zh: 他们的协议很随意，没有任何誓约。

e.en: The loan was risky because it was {pledgeless}.
e.zh: 这笔贷款没有担保，因此风险很高。

e.en: The {pledgeor} retained ownership until the debt was unpaid.
e.zh: 在债务未清偿前，出质人仍保留所有权。

e.en: Each {pledgeor} must describe the pledged property clearly.
e.zh: 每位质押人都必须清楚说明质押财产。

e.en: The nurse placed a sterile {pledget} over the wound.
e.zh: 护士把一块无菌小敷料放在伤口上。

e.en: A cotton {pledget} absorbed the extra medicine.
e.zh: 一个小棉塞吸收了多余的药液。

e.en: The {pledgor} delivered the jewels as security for the loan.
e.zh: 出质人交出珠宝作为贷款担保。

e.en: If the {pledgor} defaults, the lender may enforce the pledge.
e.zh: 如果质押债务人违约，贷款方可以执行质押权。

e.en: The journal celebrated a {pleiad} of young poets.
e.zh: 这本期刊赞颂了一群杰出的年轻诗人。

e.en: A {pleiad} of reformers shaped the new constitution.
e.zh: 一批杰出的改革者塑造了新宪法。

e.en: The phrase appears in law as {plein} power.
e.zh: 这个词组在法律中表示完全权力。

e.en: Old heraldic notes used {plein} to mean full or entire.
e.zh: 旧纹章学笔记用plein表示完整或全部。

plein-air.t: 户外写生的；露天作画的

e.en: She preferred {plein-air} painting in the morning light.
e.zh: 她喜欢在晨光中进行户外写生。

e.en: The gallery displayed several {plein-air} landscapes from Provence.
e.zh: 画廊展出了几幅来自普罗旺斯的露天风景画。

e.en: French {pleinairism} changed how painters treated natural light.
e.zh: 法国户外写生主义改变了画家处理自然光的方式。

e.en: The lecture traced {pleinairism} from realism to impressionism.
e.zh: 讲座追溯了户外写生主义从现实主义到印象派的发展。

e.en: The {pleinairist} carried a small easel into the fields.
e.zh: 这位户外写生画家带着小画架走进田野。

e.en: As a committed {pleinairist}, he painted directly from nature.
e.zh: 作为坚定的户外写生画家，他直接面对自然作画。

e.en: The plant has a {pleiochasial} branching pattern in its flowers.
e.zh: 这种植物的花部具有多歧聚伞式分枝。

e.en: A {pleiochasial} cyme may split into several equal axes.
e.zh: 多歧聚伞花序可能分成几个相等的轴。

e.en: The mineral showed striking {pleiochromia} under polarized light.
e.zh: 这种矿物在偏振光下呈现明显多色性。

e.en: Doctors noted unusual {pleiochromia} in the stained tissue sample.
e.zh: 医生注意到染色组织样本中有异常的色彩增多。

e.en: The bacterium's {pleiomorphy} made identification difficult.
e.zh: 这种细菌的多形性使鉴定变得困难。

e.en: In cladistics, {pleiomorphy} can obscure true relationships.
e.zh: 在分支分类学中，祖征状态可能掩盖真实亲缘关系。

e.en: The chemist described the material as a complex {pleionomer}.
e.zh: 化学家把这种材料描述为复杂的多聚体。

e.en: A {pleionomer} contains many repeating structural units.
e.zh: 多聚体含有许多重复的结构单元。

e.en: The editor cut the sentence because of {pleiontism}.
e.zh: 编辑因句子赘言而将其删减。

e.en: Legal drafting often suffers from cautious {pleiontism}.
e.zh: 法律文书常因过分谨慎而出现赘言。

e.en: The leaves displayed {pleiotaxy} along the stem.
e.zh: 叶片沿茎呈现多重排列。

e.en: Botanists used {pleiotaxy} to describe the unusual phyllotaxis.
e.zh: 植物学家用多列式来描述这种异常叶序。

e.en: The mutation had {pleiotropic} effects on growth and fertility.
e.zh: 这种突变对生长和生育力都有多效性影响。

e.en: A {pleiotropic} gene can influence several unrelated traits.
e.zh: 一个多效性基因能影响多个不相关性状。

e.en: Scientists studied {pleiotropy} in a gene linked to height.
e.zh: 科学家研究了一个身高相关基因的多效性。

e.en: Drug side effects sometimes reflect biological {pleiotropy}.
e.zh: 药物副作用有时反映出生物学上的一因多效。

pleiotypic.t: 具有多型特征的；多变型的

e.en: The geologist described the mineral as {pleiotypic} in form.
e.zh: 地质学家说这种矿物在形态上具有多型特征。

e.en: A {pleiotypic} species may show several stable shapes.
e.zh: 多变型的物种可能表现出几种稳定形态。

e.en: The committee met {plenarily} before voting on the plan.
e.zh: 委员会在表决方案前举行了全体会议。

e.en: The issue was discussed {plenarily} in the final session.
e.zh: 这个问题在最后一场会议中得到了充分讨论。

e.en: The hammer seemed to {plench} against the iron gate.
e.zh: 锤子似乎重重敲在铁门上。

e.en: We heard the waves {plench} the rocks below.
e.zh: 我们听见海浪拍打下面岩石的重击声。

e.en: The village held a {plenilunary} festival each month.
e.zh: 这个村庄每个月都会举行满月节庆。

e.en: The poet admired the {plenilunary} light over the fields.
e.zh: 诗人欣赏田野上满月洒下的光。

e.en: The old calendar marked the {plenilune} in red ink.
e.zh: 旧日历用红墨水标出了满月那天。

e.en: They began the ritual under the bright {plenilune}.
e.zh: 他们在明亮的望月下开始了仪式。

e.en: The envoy claimed {plenipotence} in negotiating the treaty.
e.zh: 使节声称自己拥有谈判条约的全权。

e.en: No minister should exercise {plenipotence} without oversight.
e.zh: 任何部长都不应在缺乏监督时行使充分权力。

e.en: She served as a {plenipotent} representative at the talks.
e.zh: 她在会谈中担任全权代表。

e.en: The charter created a nearly {plenipotent} council.
e.zh: 这份宪章设立了一个几乎拥有充分权力的委员会。

e.en: They will {plenish} the pantry before winter arrives.
e.zh: 他们会在冬天到来前把食品储藏室装满。

e.en: The landlord promised to {plenish} the cottage modestly.
e.zh: 房东答应给小屋简单配齐家具用品。

e.en: The {plenishing} of the house took several weeks.
e.zh: 把这所房子配齐用品花了好几个星期。

e.en: Her aunt sold the farm and all its {plenishing}.
e.zh: 她姑妈卖掉了农场和里面所有家具用品。

e.en: His lecture contrasted atomism with {plenism}.
e.zh: 他的讲座把原子论与空间充满说作了对比。

e.en: Early philosophers debated {plenism} and the possibility of a vacuum.
e.zh: 早期哲学家曾争论充实论以及真空是否可能存在。

e.en: The archive offered a {plenitudinous} record of village life.
e.zh: 档案馆提供了关于乡村生活的丰富记录。

e.en: She wrote in a {plenitudinous} style full of detail.
e.zh: 她的文风充盈饱满，细节很多。

pleochroic.t: 多色性的；具多向色性的

e.en: The crystal appeared {pleochroic} under polarized light.
e.zh: 这块晶体在偏振光下呈现多色性。

e.en: A {pleochroic} mineral can show different colors from different angles.
e.zh: 具多向色性的矿物从不同角度看会显出不同颜色。

e.en: The gem's {pleochroism} helped identify its structure.
e.zh: 这颗宝石的多色性有助于识别其结构。

e.en: Students observed {pleochroism} through a polarizing microscope.
e.zh: 学生们通过偏光显微镜观察多向色性。

e.en: The sample showed a {pleochromatic} response to changing light.
e.zh: 样品在光线变化下呈现多色反应。

e.en: She selected a {pleochromatic} stone for the collection.
e.zh: 她为收藏挑选了一块呈多向色性的石头。

e.en: The report noted strong {pleochromatism} in the thin section.
e.zh: 报告指出薄片中有明显的多色性。

e.en: Mineralogists use {pleochromatism} as a clue in identification.
e.zh: 矿物学家把变色现象作为鉴定线索。

e.en: The researchers tested {pleocidin} against several bacterial strains.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了这种杀菌物质对几种菌株的作用。

e.en: A small dose of {pleocidin} slowed the culture's growth.
e.zh: 少量抗菌剂减缓了培养物的生长。

pleocytosis.t: 细胞增多症；脑脊液细胞增多

e.en: The spinal fluid showed mild {pleocytosis} after infection.
e.zh: 感染后，脑脊液显示轻度细胞增多。

e.en: Doctors considered {pleocytosis} an important diagnostic clue.
e.zh: 医生把细胞增多症视为重要的诊断线索。

e.en: The physician described the symptom as {pleoergy} of the gland.
e.zh: 医生把这种症状描述为腺体机能亢进。

e.en: Older texts sometimes used {pleoergy} for excessive bodily action.
e.zh: 旧文献有时用pleoergy表示身体活动过度。

e.en: The lab noted {pleolysis} in the treated blood sample.
e.zh: 实验室注意到处理后的血样出现过度溶解。

e.en: Severe {pleolysis} can distort the test results.
e.zh: 严重的异常分解会扭曲检测结果。

e.en: The case report described congenital {pleomazia}.
e.zh: 病例报告描述了先天性多乳房症。

e.en: Surgeons evaluated {pleomazia} before recommending treatment.
e.zh: 外科医生在建议治疗前评估了副乳增多的情况。

e.en: The bacteria were {pleomorphous} under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下这些细菌呈多形状态。

e.en: A {pleomorphous} tumor may contain varied cell shapes.
e.zh: 形态多变的肿瘤可能包含多种细胞形状。

e.en: The diagram labels the crab's {pleon} clearly.
e.zh: 这张图清楚标出了蟹的腹部。

e.en: In many crustaceans, the {pleon} carries swimming appendages.
e.zh: 在许多甲壳动物中，腹节带有游泳附肢。

e.en: The phrase 'free gift' is often cited as a {pleonasm}.
e.zh: “免费礼物”这个短语常被当作赘言的例子。

e.en: His legal style used {pleonasm} for emphasis and caution.
e.zh: 他的法律文风用冗余表达来加强语气并避免疏漏。

e.en: She wrote {pleonastically}, repeating the same idea twice.
e.zh: 她写得很冗余，把同一个意思重复了两遍。

e.en: The contract states the duty {pleonastically} to avoid ambiguity.
e.zh: 合同以赘言方式说明该义务，以避免歧义。

e.en: The sermon condemned {pleonexia} as a moral danger.
e.zh: 布道把贪婪谴责为一种道德危险。

e.en: Unchecked {pleonexia} can corrupt public institutions.
e.zh: 不受约束的贪得无厌会腐蚀公共机构。

e.en: The old group was later judged {pleophyletic} by taxonomists.
e.zh: 这个旧类群后来被分类学家判定为多系发生。

e.en: A {pleophyletic} classification can hide real evolutionary relationships.
e.zh: 多系发生的分类可能掩盖真实的进化关系。

e.en: Each {pleopod} helps the shrimp swim and carry eggs.
e.zh: 每个腹肢都帮助虾游动并携带卵。

e.en: The biologist drew a single {pleopod} under the microscope.
e.zh: 生物学家在显微镜下画出了一只腹肢。

e.en: The crab's {pleopods} are tucked beneath its abdomen.
e.zh: 蟹的腹肢收在腹部下面。

e.en: Female lobsters use their {pleopods} to hold eggs.
e.zh: 雌龙虾用腹肢抱住卵。

e.en: The fish carried a {plerocercoid} larva in its muscle.
e.zh: 这条鱼的肌肉里带有裂头蚴期幼虫。

e.en: Doctors identified the parasite as a {plerocercoid} after surgery.
e.zh: 医生在手术后确认该寄生虫为裂头蚴。

e.en: The {plerome} gives rise to the plant's central cylinder.
e.zh: 中柱原会发育成植物的中柱。

e.en: Students marked the {plerome} in the root-tip diagram.
e.zh: 学生在根尖图中标出了中柱原。

e.en: The physician described the swelling as {plerosis} of the tissue.
e.zh: 医生把这种肿胀描述为组织过度充盈。

e.en: In old medical texts, {plerosis} meant an abnormal fullness.
e.zh: 在旧医学文本中，plerosis 指异常充满。

e.en: The report noted a {plerotic} condition in the vessels.
e.zh: 报告指出血管处于充盈状态。

e.en: Older doctors used {plerotic} to describe excessive bodily fullness.
e.zh: 旧时医生用 plerotic 描述身体过度充盈。

e.en: The network used {plesiochronous} signals from separate clocks.
e.zh: 该网络使用来自不同钟源的准同步信号。

e.en: Engineers replaced the {plesiochronous} system with a synchronous one.
e.zh: 工程师把准同步系统换成了同步系统。

e.en: The clinic offered {plesiocurietherapy} for certain skin cancers.
e.zh: 这家诊所为某些皮肤癌提供近距离放射治疗。

e.en: Modern brachytherapy has largely replaced the term {plesiocurietherapy}.
e.zh: 现代近距离治疗很大程度上取代了 plesiocurietherapy 这个术语。

e.en: The museum displayed fossils of {plesiosauri} from ancient seas.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了古海洋蛇颈龙类的化石。

e.en: Early paleontologists grouped several marine reptiles as {plesiosauri}.
e.zh: 早期古生物学家把几种海生爬行动物归为蛇颈龙类。

e.en: A {plesiosaurus} had a long neck and paddlelike limbs.
e.zh: 蛇颈龙有长脖子和桨状四肢。

e.en: Children stared at the {plesiosaurus} skeleton in the hall.
e.zh: 孩子们盯着大厅里的蛇颈龙骨架看。

e.en: The doctor tapped the chest with a {plesser}.
e.zh: 医生用叩诊锤轻叩胸部。

e.en: An antique {plesser} lay beside the old medical bag.
e.zh: 一把古旧叩诊锤放在旧医药包旁边。

e.en: He placed the {plessimeter} against the patient's ribs.
e.zh: 他把叩诊板贴在病人的肋骨上。

e.en: The wooden {plessimeter} was used before modern percussion methods.
e.zh: 这种木制叩诊板曾用于现代叩诊法出现以前。

e.en: The examiner used a {plessor} during the chest examination.
e.zh: 检查者在胸部检查时使用了叩诊锤。

e.en: A rubber-tipped {plessor} gives a clearer percussion sound.
e.zh: 带橡胶头的叩诊锤能产生更清楚的叩诊音。

e.en: The archaic adjective {plete} means full or complete.
e.zh: 古旧形容词 plete 的意思是充满或完整。

e.en: A dictionary may list {plete} only as a rare form.
e.zh: 词典可能只把 plete 列为罕见形式。

e.en: The patient had a {plethoric} face after the fever.
e.zh: 发烧后病人的脸显得充血发红。

e.en: The committee faced a {plethoric} agenda of minor complaints.
e.zh: 委员会面对的是一长串过多的琐碎投诉。

e.en: The old diagnosis mentioned {plethosomy} as a constitutional trait.
e.zh: 旧诊断把肥胖体型列为一种体质特征。

e.en: Researchers no longer use {plethosomy} in ordinary clinical notes.
e.zh: 研究人员已不在普通临床记录中使用 plethosomy。

e.en: The {plethysmogram} showed changes in blood volume.
e.zh: 体积描记图显示了血容量的变化。

e.en: She compared each {plethysmogram} before writing the report.
e.zh: 她在写报告前比较了每张体积描记图。

e.en: The lab used a {plethysmograph} to measure limb volume.
e.zh: 实验室用体积描记仪测量肢体体积。

e.en: A modern {plethysmograph} can track subtle breathing changes.
e.zh: 现代体积描记仪可以追踪细微的呼吸变化。

e.en: Blood flow was measured {plethysmographically} during the trial.
e.zh: 试验期间用体积描记法测量血流。

e.en: The response was confirmed {plethysmographically} in both hands.
e.zh: 双手的反应都通过体积描记法得到了确认。

e.en: Both {pleurae} were inflamed after the infection.
e.zh: 感染后两侧胸膜都发炎了。

e.en: The textbook labels the insect's lateral plates as {pleurae}.
e.zh: 教材把昆虫的侧板标为 pleurae。

e.en: The diagram shows the {pleurapophysis} beside the vertebral arch.
e.zh: 图中显示肋突位于椎弓旁边。

e.en: Comparative anatomists studied the {pleurapophysis} in early vertebrates.
e.zh: 比较解剖学家研究了早期脊椎动物的肋突。

e.en: The surgeon recommended {pleurectomy} for recurrent fluid buildup.
e.zh: 外科医生建议对反复积液进行胸膜切除术。

e.en: Recovery after {pleurectomy} can require careful breathing exercises.
e.zh: 胸膜切除术后的恢复可能需要认真做呼吸训练。

pleuripotent.t: 多能的，可分化多种细胞

e.en: The paper used {pleuripotent} as a variant spelling of pluripotent.
e.zh: 论文把 pleuripotent 用作 pluripotent 的变体拼写。

e.en: A {pleuripotent} cell can develop into many tissue types.
e.zh: 多能细胞可以发育成多种组织类型。

e.en: The beetle's {pleurite} forms part of its body wall.
e.zh: 甲虫的侧板构成体壁的一部分。

e.en: Older medical notes sometimes used {pleurite} for pleurisy.
e.zh: 旧医学记录有时用 pleurite 表示胸膜炎。

pleached.t: 枝条编织成篱或棚架状；交织的

e.en: The garden path was shaded by {pleached} lime trees.
e.zh: 花园小径被枝条编织成棚架的椴树遮住。

e.en: They walked beneath a {pleached} arch of branches.
e.zh: 他们走在由枝条交织成的拱廊下。

e.en: The gardener {pleaches} young branches along the wall.
e.zh: 园丁把嫩枝沿着墙编织成篱。

e.en: Memory {pleaches} grief with moments of tenderness.
e.zh: 记忆把悲伤与温柔的片刻交织在一起。

pleaching.t: 枝条编织成篱；编枝整形

e.en: {Pleaching} requires patient training of young trees.
e.zh: 编枝造篱需要耐心地牵引幼树。

e.en: The old estate used {pleaching} to form green corridors.
e.zh: 那座老庄园用编枝法形成绿色廊道。

pleadable.t: 可作为抗辩理由的；可申辩的

e.en: The lawyer argued that mistake was a {pleadable} defense.
e.zh: 律师主张误解是可以提出的抗辩理由。

e.en: Not every excuse is {pleadable} in court.
e.zh: 并非每个借口都能在法庭上作为申辩理由。

e.en: The castle had a walled {pleasaunce} for summer evenings.
e.zh: 城堡里有一座围墙环绕的幽静花园，供夏夜消遣。

e.en: Poets imagined the meadow as a medieval {pleasaunce}.
e.zh: 诗人们把那片草地想象成中世纪的游乐园地。

e.en: A small {pleasure-boat} crossed the lake at sunset.
e.zh: 日落时，一艘小游船驶过湖面。

e.en: They rented a {pleasure-boat} for the weekend.
e.zh: 他们周末租了一艘游艇。

e.en: The resort attracts every kind of {pleasure-seeker}.
e.zh: 这座度假村吸引了各种寻欢作乐的人。

e.en: He was no mere {pleasure-seeker}, despite his elegant clothes.
e.zh: 尽管衣着讲究，他并不只是个享乐者。

e.en: The beach filled with {pleasure-seekers} after noon.
e.zh: 中午过后，海滩上挤满了寻欢作乐的人。

e.en: Victorian writers often distrusted urban {pleasure-seekers}.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的作家常常不信任城市里的享乐人群。

e.en: His {pleasure-seeking} habits worried his family.
e.zh: 他追求享乐的习惯让家人担心。

e.en: The novel criticizes a shallow {pleasure-seeking} society.
e.zh: 这部小说批判了一个浅薄享乐的社会。

e.en: The misspelled form {pleasureable} appears in some informal writing.
e.zh: pleasureable 这个误拼形式会出现在一些非正式写作中。

e.en: She meant to write {pleasureable}, though the standard spelling is pleasurable.
e.zh: 她想写的是 pleasureable，尽管标准拼法是 pleasurable。

e.en: The word {pleasureably} is sometimes used instead of pleasurably.
e.zh: pleasureably 这个词有时被用来代替 pleasurably。

e.en: He wrote that the evening passed {pleasureably}.
e.zh: 他写道，那个夜晚过得很愉快。

pleasureful.t: 充满愉悦的；令人快乐的

e.en: The poet described a {pleasureful} garden after rain.
e.zh: 诗人描写了雨后一座充满愉悦感的花园。

e.en: Their reunion was brief but deeply {pleasureful}.
e.zh: 他们的重逢很短暂，却令人深感快乐。

e.en: He lived a disciplined but {pleasureless} life.
e.zh: 他过着自律却毫无乐趣的生活。

e.en: The meal felt strangely {pleasureless} without conversation.
e.zh: 没有交谈，那顿饭显得异常索然无味。

e.en: Her jacket was made of black {pleather}.
e.zh: 她的夹克是黑色塑料仿皮做的。

e.en: Cheap {pleather} can crack after a few months.
e.zh: 廉价人造皮革几个月后可能会开裂。

e.en: He chose {pleatless} trousers for a cleaner line.
e.zh: 他选择无褶长裤，让线条更利落。

e.en: The designer preferred a {pleatless} skirt for this look.
e.zh: 设计师为这套造型选择了没有褶裥的裙子。

e.en: She dismissed the decor as {plebby} and loud.
e.zh: 她把这种装饰说成粗俗又扎眼。

e.en: His friends jokingly called his snack choice {plebby}.
e.zh: 朋友们开玩笑说他选的零食很平民气、没品位。

e.en: The critic saw {plebeianism} in the novel's comic scenes.
e.zh: 评论家在小说的喜剧场景中看到了平民气息。

e.en: His accent was treated as a sign of {plebeianism}.
e.zh: 他的口音被视为粗俗平民气的标志。

e.en: Mass tourism can {plebeianize} once-exclusive resorts.
e.zh: 大众旅游可能使曾经专属的度假地平民化。

e.en: The editor feared slang would {plebeianize} the formal speech.
e.zh: 编辑担心俚语会让正式演讲显得粗俗。

plebeianized.t: 被平民化的；被粗俗化的

e.en: The ceremony felt {plebeianized} after the rules were relaxed.
e.zh: 规则放宽后，仪式显得被平民化了。

e.en: He disliked the {plebeianized} version of the old club.
e.zh: 他不喜欢那个老俱乐部被平民化后的样子。

e.en: Cheap tickets were {plebeianizing} the opera audience.
e.zh: 廉价票正在让歌剧观众群体平民化。

e.en: Critics accused the show of {plebeianizing} classical culture.
e.zh: 批评者指责这档节目把古典文化粗俗化。

plebette.t: 年轻女平民；小市民女子

e.en: The satire portrays her as a fashionable {plebette}.
e.zh: 这部讽刺作品把她描绘成一个赶时髦的小市民女子。

e.en: He used {plebette} with a deliberately snobbish tone.
e.zh: 他说 plebette 时故意带着势利的腔调。

plebiscitary.t: 公民投票的；全民表决的

e.en: The leader sought {plebiscitary} approval for his reforms.
e.zh: 这位领导人希望通过公民投票为改革取得认可。

e.en: Some scholars call the system {plebiscitary} rather than parliamentary.
e.zh: 一些学者称这个制度是全民表决式的，而非议会式的。

e.en: The stream supported several {plecopteran} larvae.
e.zh: 这条溪流里生活着几种襀翅目昆虫幼虫。

e.en: A {plecopteran} adult is often called a stonefly.
e.zh: 襀翅目成虫通常被称为石蝇。

e.en: The chemist described a rare {plectane} structure in the molecule.
e.zh: 化学家描述了分子中一种罕见的编结状结构。

e.en: The term {plectane} appears mostly in specialist writing.
e.zh: plectane 这个术语主要出现在专业写作中。

e.en: The surgeon examined the {plexal} nerves carefully.
e.zh: 外科医生仔细检查了神经丛的神经。

e.en: The report described a rare {plexal} injury.
e.zh: 报告描述了一种罕见的神经丛损伤。

e.en: The biopsy showed a {plexiform} pattern.
e.zh: 活检显示出丛状的结构。

e.en: A {plexiform} network of vessels crossed the tissue.
e.zh: 一片网状交织的血管穿过该组织。

e.en: The doctor placed a {pleximeter} on the chest.
e.zh: 医生把叩诊板放在胸部。

e.en: An old {pleximeter} lay in the medical cabinet.
e.zh: 一个旧叩诊板放在医疗柜里。

e.en: Each {plexon} was mapped during the study.
e.zh: 研究中对每个神经丛单位都进行了标记。

e.en: The diagram labels the {plexon} near the spine.
e.zh: 图中标出了脊柱附近的丛状结构。

e.en: She tapped the plate with a {plexor}.
e.zh: 她用叩诊锤轻敲那块板。

e.en: The antique {plexor} belonged to a physician.
e.zh: 那把古董叩诊锤曾属于一位医生。

e.en: The wire bent {pliably} in his hands.
e.zh: 铁丝在他手里柔顺地弯了下来。

e.en: She answered {pliably} to avoid conflict.
e.zh: 她柔顺地作答，以免发生冲突。

e.en: The material's {pliancy} made it useful for seals.
e.zh: 这种材料的柔韧性使它适合做密封件。

e.en: His political {pliancy} worried his supporters.
e.zh: 他在政治上的顺从让支持者担忧。

e.en: The scan revealed an inflamed {plica}.
e.zh: 扫描显示有一处发炎的皱襞。

e.en: A small {plica} can irritate the knee joint.
e.zh: 一小处皱襞可能刺激膝关节。

e.en: Several {plicae} were visible in the lining.
e.zh: 内膜上可以看到几处皱襞。

e.en: The textbook shows the gastric {plicae} clearly.
e.zh: 教科书清楚展示了胃部皱襞。

e.en: The leaf has a {plicate} surface.
e.zh: 这片叶子的表面有褶皱。

e.en: The fan opened into a {plicate} shape.
e.zh: 扇子打开后呈折叠状。

e.en: The surgeon performed a gastric {plication}.
e.zh: 外科医生进行了胃部折叠术。

e.en: Careful {plication} reduced the loose fabric.
e.zh: 仔细打褶减少了松散的布料。

e.en: The garment had a neat {plicature} at the waist.
e.zh: 这件衣服腰部有一道整齐的褶皱。

e.en: The botanist noted the {plicature} of the leaf.
e.zh: 植物学家记录了叶片的折叠处。

e.en: The dancer began with a slow {plie}.
e.zh: 舞者先做了一个缓慢的芭蕾屈膝动作。

e.en: A steady {plie} strengthens the legs.
e.zh: 稳定的屈膝动作能增强腿部力量。

e.en: The fruit began to {plim} after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后果实开始鼓胀起来。

e.en: Her cheeks seemed to {plim} in the cold.
e.zh: 寒冷中她的脸颊似乎鼓了起来。

e.en: He wore one old {plimsol} to the gym.
e.zh: 他穿着一只旧胶底帆布鞋去健身房。

e.en: A wet {plimsol} squeaked on the floor.
e.zh: 一只湿胶底帆布鞋在地板上吱吱响。

e.en: The engineer tested the cable's {pliobility}.
e.zh: 工程师测试了电缆的柔韧性。

e.en: Good {pliobility} helps the seal fit tightly.
e.zh: 良好的可弯曲性有助于密封件贴合紧密。

e.en: The radio used a {pliodynatron} oscillator.
e.zh: 这台收音机使用了负阻电子管振荡器。

e.en: Few engineers still repair a {pliodynatron}.
e.zh: 如今很少有工程师还会修负阻电子管。

e.en: The boy caught a {pliskie} in the shallow stream.
e.zh: 男孩在浅溪里捉到一条小鱼。

e.en: Old anglers still call small minnows {pliskies}.
e.zh: 老钓手仍把小鲦鱼叫作pliskies。

e.en: A {plisky} shape flickered under the bridge.
e.zh: 桥下闪过一个像小鱼的影子。

e.en: The poem describes a {plisky} glitter in the brook.
e.zh: 诗中写到溪水里小鱼般的闪光。

e.en: She chose a {plisse} skirt for the evening party.
e.zh: 她为晚宴选了一条压褶裙。

e.en: The designer used {plisse} to give the fabric texture.
e.zh: 设计师用褶裥工艺让面料更有纹理。

e.en: The speech uses {ploce} to make the slogan memorable.
e.zh: 这篇演讲用词语重复法让口号更好记。

e.en: In {ploce}, a repeated word gains a new emphasis.
e.zh: 在ploce这种修辞中，重复的词会获得新的强调。

e.en: We had to {plodge} through mud after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨后，我们只好在泥里艰难跋涉。

e.en: He began to {plodge} across the flooded field.
e.zh: 他开始笨重地穿过被水淹的田地。

e.en: The lab measured the {ploidy} of the plant cells.
e.zh: 实验室测定了植物细胞的染色体倍性。

e.en: Changes in {ploidy} can affect fertility in crops.
e.zh: 染色体倍性的变化会影响作物的育性。

e.en: He brought a bottle of cheap {plonko} to the party.
e.zh: 他带了一瓶廉价酒去参加聚会。

e.en: The locals dismissed him as a harmless {plonko}.
e.zh: 当地人把他当成一个无害的醉汉。

e.en: A bright {ploom} decorated the old hat.
e.zh: 一根鲜艳的羽饰装点着那顶旧帽子。

e.en: The bird shook its soft {ploom} in the rain.
e.zh: 那只鸟在雨中抖动柔软的羽毛。

e.en: Colorful {plooms} rose from the dancer's headdress.
e.zh: 舞者头饰上竖着彩色羽饰。

e.en: The pillow leaked tiny {plooms} onto the floor.
e.zh: 枕头漏出细小羽毛，落在地板上。

e.en: The teacher explained {plosion} in English consonants.
e.zh: 老师讲解了英语辅音中的爆破释放。

e.en: Clear {plosion} makes the final consonant easier to hear.
e.zh: 清晰的爆破释放让词尾辅音更容易听见。

e.en: The sound p is a {plosive} in English.
e.zh: p这个音在英语中是爆破音。

e.en: Her microphone exaggerated every {plosive} consonant.
e.zh: 她的麦克风把每个爆破辅音都放大了。

e.en: The class preferred {plot-oriented} novels over experimental prose.
e.zh: 这个班更喜欢以情节为重的小说，而不是实验性散文。

e.en: His films are less {plot-oriented} than character-driven.
e.zh: 他的电影与其说重情节，不如说重人物。

e.en: The philosopher was a committed {Plotinist} in his youth.
e.zh: 那位哲学家年轻时是坚定的普罗提诺学派信徒。

e.en: A {Plotinist} reading emphasizes the ascent of the soul.
e.zh: 普罗提诺学派的解读强调灵魂的上升。

e.en: The village sold each {plottage} to local families.
e.zh: 村里把每块小地卖给当地家庭。

e.en: Old deeds recorded the {plottage} beside the mill.
e.zh: 旧契约记录了磨坊旁那块地的面积。

e.en: The novel's {plottiness} makes it hard to summarize.
e.zh: 这部小说情节太繁复，很难概括。

e.en: Some critics admired the show's cheerful {plottiness}.
e.zh: 有些评论家欣赏这部剧活泼的情节性。

e.en: The sequel is entertaining but rather {plotty}.
e.zh: 续集很有趣，但情节相当繁复。

e.en: Her {plotty} emails made everyone suspect a secret plan.
e.zh: 她那些充满算计的邮件让大家怀疑有秘密计划。

e.en: My grandmother will {plotz} when she hears the news.
e.zh: 我奶奶听到这个消息会激动得要昏倒。

e.en: Fans nearly {plotzed} when the singer walked onstage.
e.zh: 歌手登台时，粉丝们几乎激动得晕过去。

e.en: The company used {ploughback} to fund new equipment.
e.zh: 公司通过利润再投资来购置新设备。

e.en: Good {ploughback} returns organic matter to the soil.
e.zh: 良好的回耕能把有机质还给土壤。

e.en: The {ploughboy} led the horses before dawn.
e.zh: 那个耕田男孩天亮前就牵着马出发了。

e.en: A rustic song tells of a lonely {ploughboy}.
e.zh: 一首乡村歌谣讲述了一个孤单的农家少年。

e.en: The farmer sharpened the {ploughhead} before spring planting.
e.zh: 春播前，农夫把犁头磨得锋利。

e.en: A stone cracked the old {ploughhead} in the field.
e.zh: 田里的一块石头把旧犁头撞裂了。

e.en: The old {ploughshoe} scraped over the stony field.
e.zh: 旧犁鞋刮过满是石头的田地。

e.en: He replaced the broken {ploughshoe} before spring planting.
e.zh: 春播前他换掉了损坏的犁底滑板。

e.en: The farmer leaned on his {ploughstaff} after work.
e.zh: 干完活后，农夫倚着他的犁柄休息。

e.en: A carved {ploughstaff} hung above the cottage door.
e.zh: 一根雕花的赶犁手杖挂在农舍门上方。

e.en: He gripped the {ploughtail} to keep the furrow straight.
e.zh: 他握住犁尾，让犁沟保持笔直。

e.en: Mud gathered around the {ploughtail} during the wet morning.
e.zh: 潮湿的早晨，泥巴积在犁后部把手周围。

e.en: The village {ploughwright} repaired wooden farm tools.
e.zh: 村里的造犁匠修理木制农具。

e.en: A skilled {ploughwright} could shape iron and oak.
e.zh: 熟练的修犁工匠能加工铁件和橡木。

e.en: Only the lower field was {plowable} after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后只有低处那块田还能耕作。

e.en: The survey marked the flat acres as {plowable} land.
e.zh: 勘测把这些平坦的英亩地标为可耕地。

e.en: The company used {plowback} to fund new equipment.
e.zh: 公司用利润再投资来购置新设备。

e.en: Farmers practice {plowback} to return stalks to the soil.
e.zh: 农民采用回耕，把秸秆翻回土里。

e.en: The {plowboy} sang while guiding the horses.
e.zh: 赶犁少年一边引马一边唱歌。

e.en: He began as a {plowboy} and later owned the farm.
e.zh: 他起初是个农家男孩，后来拥有了那座农场。

e.en: The {plowhead} struck a buried stone.
e.zh: 犁头撞上了一块埋在地下的石头。

e.en: Rust covered the old iron {plowhead}.
e.zh: 旧铁犁头上布满了锈。

e.en: The estate included rich {plowland} near the river.
e.zh: 庄园包括河边肥沃的耕地。

e.en: A {plowland} was once measured by farming capacity.
e.zh: 一犁地过去按耕作能力来衡量。

e.en: He tightened the {plowline} before starting across the field.
e.zh: 穿过田地前，他拉紧了犁绳。

e.en: The straight {plowline} divided the dark soil neatly.
e.zh: 笔直的犁沟线把黑土整齐地分开。

e.en: The {plowmen} worked before sunrise.
e.zh: 犁夫们在日出前就开始劳作。

e.en: Old songs praised honest {plowmen} and harvesters.
e.zh: 老歌赞美诚实的耕田人和收割者。

e.en: The metal {plowshoe} helped the blade glide.
e.zh: 金属犁鞋帮助犁刃顺畅滑行。

e.en: He hammered a new {plowshoe} onto the plow.
e.zh: 他把新的犁底滑板锤装到犁上。

e.en: The old man carried a polished {plowstaff}.
e.zh: 老人拿着一根磨得发亮的犁柄。

e.en: She found a cracked {plowstaff} in the barn.
e.zh: 她在谷仓里发现了一根开裂的赶犁手杖。

e.en: The farmer held the {plowtail} firmly.
e.zh: 农夫牢牢握住犁尾。

e.en: Snow froze around the abandoned {plowtail}.
e.zh: 积雪冻在那具废弃犁的后部把手周围。

e.en: The {plowwright} fitted a sharper blade.
e.zh: 造犁匠装上了更锋利的犁刃。

e.en: Every nearby farm knew the careful {plowwright}.
e.zh: 附近每个农场都认识这位细心的修犁工匠。

e.en: The treaty discussed the {ployment} of ships.
e.zh: 条约讨论了船只的部署。

e.en: This rare {ployment} appears in older legal writing.
e.zh: 这种罕见的用法出现在较早的法律文书中。

e.en: Her second attempt was {pluckier} than the first.
e.zh: 她第二次尝试比第一次更有胆量。

e.en: The smaller team looked {pluckier} after halftime.
e.zh: 中场休息后，那支较小的队伍显得更勇敢。

e.en: She {pluckily} faced the hostile crowd.
e.zh: 她勇敢地面对充满敌意的人群。

e.en: The injured runner {pluckily} finished the race.
e.zh: 受伤的跑者仍有胆量地完成了比赛。

e.en: Her {pluckiness} impressed the whole team.
e.zh: 她的勇气让整个团队都很佩服。

e.en: The story celebrates ordinary {pluckiness} under pressure.
e.zh: 这个故事赞颂了压力下普通人的坚韧。

e.en: The {pluckless} guard fled at once.
e.zh: 那个怯懦的守卫立刻逃跑了。

e.en: He mocked himself as {pluckless} after missing the chance.
e.zh: 错过机会后，他自嘲自己缺乏勇气。

e.en: A gray {pluff} of dust rose from the cushion.
e.zh: 一团灰色尘絮从垫子上扬起。

e.en: She brushed a {pluff} of lint from his coat.
e.zh: 她从他的外套上刷掉一团绒毛。

plug-and-play.t: 即插即用的；现成可用的

e.en: The camera is {plug-and-play} on most laptops.
e.zh: 这款摄像头在大多数笔记本上都能即插即用。

e.en: They wanted a {plug-and-play} solution for payroll.
e.zh: 他们想要一个现成可用的薪资处理方案。

plunderage.t: 掠夺；抢劫所得；掠夺行为

e.en: The invaders left a trail of {plunderage} across the valley.
e.zh: 入侵者在山谷中留下了一路掠夺的痕迹。

e.en: The old chronicle describes the {plunderage} of merchant ships.
e.zh: 那部旧编年史记载了商船遭到劫掠的情况。

e.en: Critics called the corrupt cartel a {plunderbund}.
e.zh: 批评者把这个腐败的卡特尔称为掠夺集团。

e.en: The pamphlet attacked a political {plunderbund} that enriched itself.
e.zh: 这本小册子抨击了一个中饱私囊的政治掠夺同盟。

e.en: The rebels feared the army's {plunderous} march through the farms.
e.zh: 叛军担心军队会以劫掠之势穿过农田。

e.en: His {plunderous} business tactics ruined several small suppliers.
e.zh: 他掠夺式的商业手段毁掉了几家小供应商。

e.en: She packed a ripe {pluot} for lunch.
e.zh: 她午餐带了一个熟透的杏李。

e.en: The market sells {pluots} beside peaches and cherries.
e.zh: 市场把杏李和桃子、樱桃摆在一起卖。

e.en: In British English, children learn to {pluralise} nouns carefully.
e.zh: 在英式英语中，孩子们学习仔细把名词变成复数。

e.en: Do not {pluralise} an uncountable noun in formal writing.
e.zh: 在正式写作中，不要把不可数名词写成复数。

e.en: The city is governed {pluralistically} by several community councils.
e.zh: 这座城市由几个社区委员会以多元方式共同治理。

e.en: She argued {pluralistically}, accepting more than one valid tradition.
e.zh: 她以多元主义的方式论证，承认不止一种传统有其合理性。

e.en: Add s to {pluralize} most regular nouns.
e.zh: 给多数规则名词加 s 就能变成复数。

e.en: Some style guides avoid trying to {pluralize} brand names.
e.zh: 有些风格指南避免把品牌名改成复数形式。

e.en: The {pluralized} form appears in the second column.
e.zh: 变成复数后的形式出现在第二栏。

e.en: A mass noun is rarely {pluralized} in ordinary speech.
e.zh: 物质名词在日常口语中很少被用作复数。

pluralizer.t: 复数化工具；使成复数者

e.en: The app includes a simple {pluralizer} for English nouns.
e.zh: 这个应用包含一个简单的英语名词复数化工具。

e.en: A careless {pluralizer} may produce forms like childs.
e.zh: 粗糙的复数化程序可能会生成 childs 这样的形式。

e.en: The rule {pluralizes} words ending in y differently.
e.zh: 这条规则会以不同方式把以 y 结尾的词变成复数。

e.en: He sometimes {pluralizes} slang terms for comic effect.
e.zh: 他有时把俚语词改成复数来制造喜剧效果。

e.en: She is {pluralizing} the nouns in the exercise.
e.zh: 她正在把练习里的名词改成复数。

e.en: The software failed when {pluralizing} irregular animal names.
e.zh: 软件在处理不规则动物名称的复数化时失败了。

e.en: The novelist invented {pluranium} as a miraculous fuel.
e.zh: 小说家虚构了 pluranium 这种神奇燃料。

e.en: In the game, {pluranium} powers every floating city.
e.zh: 在游戏中，这种假想物质为每座浮空城市供能。

e.en: The engineer modeled a {pluriaxial} stress pattern.
e.zh: 工程师建立了一个多轴应力模式。

e.en: A {pluriaxial} joint can move in several directions.
e.zh: 多轴关节可以朝多个方向运动。

e.en: Most animals are {pluricellular} organisms.
e.zh: 大多数动物都是多细胞生物。

e.en: The specimen showed a simple {pluricellular} structure.
e.zh: 这个标本显示出简单的多细胞结构。

e.en: The biologist described a {pluriciliate} cell under the microscope.
e.zh: 生物学家在显微镜下描述了一个具多根纤毛的细胞。

e.en: A {pluriciliate} larva can swim by beating many tiny hairs.
e.zh: 具多根纤毛的幼体能通过摆动许多细小毛状结构游动。

e.en: Doctors suspected a {pluriglandular} endocrine disorder.
e.zh: 医生怀疑这是涉及多腺体的内分泌紊乱。

e.en: The report noted {pluriglandular} involvement in the syndrome.
e.zh: 报告指出该综合征存在多腺体受累。

e.en: The chart identified the patient as a {plurigravida}.
e.zh: 病历把这名患者记录为多次怀孕的妇女。

e.en: A {plurigravida} may still need close prenatal monitoring.
e.zh: 多次怀孕的孕妇仍可能需要密切的产前监测。

e.en: The school promotes a {plurilingual} approach to education.
e.zh: 这所学校提倡多语教育方式。

e.en: She grew up in a {plurilingual} household in Brussels.
e.zh: 她在布鲁塞尔一个多语家庭中长大。

pluriliteral.t: 多字母的；多辅音词根的

e.en: The grammar book analyzes a {pluriliteral} root.
e.zh: 这本语法书分析了一个多辅音词根。

e.en: A {pluriliteral} sign may contain several written elements.
e.zh: 多字母符号可能包含几个书写成分。

e.en: The botanist cut open a {plurilocular} ovary.
e.zh: 植物学家切开了一个多室子房。

e.en: Imaging revealed a {plurilocular} cyst in the tissue.
e.zh: 影像检查显示组织中有一个多腔囊肿。

e.en: The study examined whether {pluriparity} affected recovery time.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了多次分娩是否影响恢复时间。

e.en: Her medical history included {pluriparity} and mild anemia.
e.zh: 她的病史包括经产和轻度贫血。

e.en: They photographed a rare {pluripileate} fungus on the log.
e.zh: 他们拍下了原木上一种罕见的多菌盖真菌。

e.en: The {pluripileate} fruiting body confused the students at first.
e.zh: 这个具多个菌盖的子实体起初让学生们感到困惑。

e.en: The factory worker developed {plumbism} after years of exposure.
e.zh: 这名工厂工人多年接触铅后患上了铅中毒。

e.en: Doctors once called chronic lead poisoning {plumbism}.
e.zh: 医生过去把慢性铅中毒称为铅毒症。

plumbite.t: 亚铅酸盐；含铅酸根化合物

e.en: The chemist identified a {plumbite} in the alkaline solution.
e.zh: 化学家在碱性溶液中鉴定出一种亚铅酸盐。

e.en: Sodium {plumbite} can form when lead compounds dissolve in strong alkali.
e.zh: 铅化合物溶于强碱时可能形成亚铅酸钠。

e.en: The new glaze is {plumbless} and safer for dinnerware.
e.zh: 这种新釉料不含铅，用在餐具上更安全。

e.en: He tried a {plumbless} method to check the wall's alignment.
e.zh: 他尝试不用铅锤的方法检查墙面是否垂直。

plumbosolvency.t: 溶铅性；水溶解铅的能力

e.en: Soft acidic water often has high {plumbosolvency}.
e.zh: 柔软的酸性水通常具有较高的溶铅性。

e.en: Engineers tested the {plumbosolvency} before replacing the pipes.
e.zh: 工程师在更换管道前检测了水的溶铅能力。

e.en: The sample contained a {plumbous} compound.
e.zh: 样品中含有一种二价铅化合物。

e.en: Older chemistry texts often use {plumbous} for lead in a lower valence state.
e.zh: 较早的化学教材常用亚铅的来指低价态的铅。

e.en: The symbol Pb comes from {plumbum}.
e.zh: 元素符号Pb来自铅的拉丁名plumbum。

e.en: Ancient writers used {plumbum} to refer to lead.
e.zh: 古代作者用plumbum来指铅。

e.en: She sliced a ripe {plumcot} for dessert.
e.zh: 她切了一个熟透的李杏杂交果当甜点。

e.en: A {plumcot} tastes like a mix of plum and apricot.
e.zh: 李杏杂交果吃起来像李子和杏子的混合味道。

e.en: The soldier wore a plain, {plumeless} helmet.
e.zh: 那名士兵戴着一顶朴素、没有羽饰的头盔。

e.en: The young bird looked nearly {plumeless} after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后，那只幼鸟看起来几乎没有羽毛。

e.en: A tiny {plumelet} clung to her sleeve.
e.zh: 一根小羽毛粘在她的袖子上。

e.en: The dancer's cap had a bright {plumelet} at the side.
e.zh: 舞者的帽子侧边有一小束鲜艳的羽饰。

e.en: Smoke rose in a {plumelike} column above the hill.
e.zh: 烟雾在山丘上方升起，形成羽毛般的一柱。

e.en: The plant has soft, {plumelike} leaves.
e.zh: 这种植物有柔软的羽状叶片。

e.en: The owl's {plumicorn} looked like a small ear tuft.
e.zh: 猫头鹰的羽角看起来像一小撮耳羽。

e.en: An entomologist examined the moth's {plumicorn} under a lens.
e.zh: 昆虫学家用放大镜观察蛾子的羽状触角。

e.en: The sauce had a sweet, {plumlike} flavor.
e.zh: 这种酱带有甜甜的李子般味道。

e.en: Small {plumlike} fruits hung from the branches.
e.zh: 枝头挂着一些像李子的小果实。

e.en: Her voice sounded {plummier} after the training.
e.zh: 训练之后，她的嗓音听起来更圆润浑厚。

e.en: This jam is {plummier} than last year's batch.
e.zh: 这批果酱比去年的更有李子味。

e.en: He saved his {plummiest} accent for the radio interview.
e.zh: 他把最圆润讲究的口音留给了电台采访。

e.en: The manager kept the {plummiest} assignments for her favorites.
e.zh: 经理把最优厚的任务留给了她偏爱的人。

e.en: The seed has a {plumose} tail that catches the wind.
e.zh: 这种种子有一条羽状尾部，能借风传播。

e.en: Some insects have {plumose} antennae.
e.zh: 有些昆虫长有羽状触角。

e.en: The botanist noted the {plumosity} of the seed hairs.
e.zh: 植物学家记录了种子绒毛的羽毛状特征。

e.en: Its delicate {plumosity} made the fossil easy to recognize.
e.zh: 它精细的羽状结构让这块化石容易辨认。

e.en: Soak the raisins to {plumpen} them before baking.
e.zh: 烘焙前把葡萄干泡一下，让它们变得饱满。

e.en: The berries will {plumpen} after a night of rain.
e.zh: 下了一夜雨后，浆果会变得更饱满。

e.en: He was a cheerful, {plumpish} man in his fifties.
e.zh: 他五十多岁，性格开朗，身材略胖。

e.en: The {plumpish} berries were ready to pick.
e.zh: 那些略显饱满的浆果已经可以采摘了。

e.en: The baby had soft, {plumpy} cheeks.
e.zh: 宝宝有着柔软圆胖的脸颊。

e.en: She served {plumpy} dumplings in a clear broth.
e.zh: 她端上了清汤里圆鼓鼓的饺子。

e.en: The chick was covered with {plumulaceous} down.
e.zh: 小鸡身上覆盖着像幼羽一样的绒毛。

e.en: The microscope revealed a {plumulaceous} texture on the seed.
e.zh: 显微镜显示种子表面有绒羽状纹理。

e.en: The {plumulate} chick stayed close to its mother.
e.zh: 这只有绒羽的小鸟紧跟在母鸟身边。

e.en: A {plumulate} surface helps the seed drift through the air.
e.zh: 具绒羽的表面有助于种子在空气中飘移。

e.en: The seed's {plumule} will become the first shoot.
e.zh: 种子的胚芽会长成第一根幼芽。

e.en: A soft {plumule} fell from the bird's wing.
e.zh: 一根柔软的小羽毛从鸟翅上落下。

e.en: The grass had {plumy} tops that moved in the wind.
e.zh: 这种草有羽毛状的穗，在风中摇动。

e.en: She wore a {plumy} hat to the ceremony.
e.zh: 她戴着一顶有羽饰的帽子参加仪式。

e.en: The abandoned warehouse looked {plunderable} to passing thieves.
e.zh: 那座废弃仓库在路过的小偷眼里很容易被洗劫。

e.en: Weak defenses made the coastal town {plunderable}.
e.zh: 薄弱的防御让这座海滨小镇容易遭到掠夺。

e.en: The adapter kit includes several {plug-compatibles} for older machines.
e.zh: 这个适配器套装包含几种用于旧机器的插头兼容件。

e.en: Engineers tested the {plug-compatibles} before shipping the device abroad.
e.zh: 工程师在把设备发往海外前测试了这些插头兼容件。

e.en: The reactor was designed to maintain {plug-flow} through the tube.
e.zh: 这台反应器被设计成让流体在管内保持塞流状态。

e.en: Ideal {plug-flow} assumes that fluid elements do not mix lengthwise.
e.zh: 理想的活塞流假定流体单元不会沿长度方向混合。

e.en: Install this {plug-in} to block distracting websites.
e.zh: 安装这个插件可以屏蔽让人分心的网站。

e.en: She bought a {plug-in} heater for the small office.
e.zh: 她给小办公室买了一台插电式取暖器。

e.en: The old novel describes a {plug-ugly} guarding the tavern door.
e.zh: 那本旧小说描写了一个恶棍守在酒馆门口。

e.en: Reporters called the hired {plug-ugly} a threat to voters.
e.zh: 记者把那个受雇的街头打手称为对选民的威胁。

e.en: The software uses a {pluggable} system for payment providers.
e.zh: 这款软件采用可扩展系统来接入不同支付服务商。

e.en: Each sensor is {pluggable}, so repairs take only minutes.
e.zh: 每个传感器都是可插拔的，因此维修只需几分钟。

plugged-in.t: 插上电源的；消息灵通的

e.en: Make sure the printer is {plugged-in} before you restart it.
e.zh: 重启打印机前，确认它已经插上电源。

e.en: She is highly {plugged-in} to the local art scene.
e.zh: 她对当地艺术圈的消息非常灵通。

e.en: This browser {plugin} translates selected text instantly.
e.zh: 这个浏览器插件能即时翻译选中的文字。

e.en: The audio {plugin} adds a warmer sound to the recording.
e.zh: 这个音频插件让录音的音色更温暖。

e.en: Too many {plugins} can slow down a website.
e.zh: 插件太多可能会拖慢网站速度。

e.en: The editor supports {plugins} for formatting and linting code.
e.zh: 这个编辑器支持用于格式化和检查代码的插件。

e.en: The host was accused of {plugola} after praising the sponsor repeatedly.
e.zh: 主持人反复称赞赞助商后，被指搞有偿吹捧。

e.en: Strict rules were introduced to prevent {plugola} on radio shows.
e.zh: 相关部门出台严格规定，防止广播节目出现隐性广告。

e.en: A skilled {plumassier} restored the feathers on the old hat.
e.zh: 一位熟练的羽饰工匠修复了旧帽子上的羽毛。

e.en: The costume house hired a {plumassier} for the opera production.
e.zh: 服装工作室为这部歌剧聘请了一名羽饰工匠。

e.en: The moth has delicate {plumate} antennae.
e.zh: 这只蛾子有精致的羽状触角。

e.en: A {plumate} crest rose from the bird's head.
e.zh: 一簇羽毛状的冠羽从鸟头上竖起。

e.en: The mason used a {plumb-line} to check the wall.
e.zh: 泥瓦匠用铅垂线检查墙是否垂直。

e.en: For her, honesty remained the {plumb-line} of public service.
e.zh: 对她来说，诚实始终是公共服务的准绳。

e.en: The lake is shallow enough to be {plumbable} from a small boat.
e.zh: 这个湖很浅，可以从小船上测出深度。

e.en: His motives are barely {plumbable} after such a strange decision.
e.zh: 他作出如此奇怪的决定后，其动机几乎难以理解。

e.en: Researchers measured {plumbagin} levels in the plant extract.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了植物提取物中的蓝雪醌含量。

e.en: The compound {plumbagin} has been studied for possible medicinal effects.
e.zh: 蓝雪醌这种化合物因可能具有药用作用而受到研究。

e.en: The botanist identified the shrub as {plumbaginaceous}.
e.zh: 植物学家认定这株灌木属于蓝雪科。

e.en: Several {plumbaginaceous} plants grow well in salty coastal soil.
e.zh: 几种蓝雪科植物在含盐的海岸土壤中生长良好。

e.en: The rock left a {plumbaginous} mark on the paper.
e.zh: 这块岩石在纸上留下了含石墨般的痕迹。

e.en: A {plumbaginous} haze hung over the industrial valley.
e.zh: 铅灰色的雾霾笼罩着这片工业山谷。

e.en: The chemist prepared a sodium {plumbate} solution.
e.zh: 化学家配制了一种铅酸钠溶液。

e.en: Old notes described the residue as a {plumbate} compound.
e.zh: 旧笔记把这种残留物描述为一种铅酸盐化合物。

e.en: The statue stood on a heavy {plumbean} base.
e.zh: 这座雕像立在沉重的铅制底座上。

e.en: Storm clouds gave the afternoon a {plumbean} light.
e.zh: 暴风云让下午的光线呈现铅灰色。

e.en: The bird is known for its {plumbeous} feathers.
e.zh: 这种鸟以铅灰色羽毛而闻名。

e.en: A {plumbeous} coating was found on the old pipe.
e.zh: 旧管道上发现了一层含铅的涂层。

e.en: The museum displayed medieval {plumberies} from the cathedral roof.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了来自大教堂屋顶的中世纪铅工制品。

e.en: Several {plumberies} in the old district needed urgent repair.
e.zh: 旧城区的几处管道工程急需维修。

e.en: The contract included roofing, drainage, and {plumbery}.
e.zh: 合同包括屋面、排水和管道工程。

e.en: Old manuals used {plumbery} to mean work done in lead.
e.zh: 旧手册用铅工活这个词指用铅完成的工艺。

e.en: The lab detected a {plumbic} compound in the sample.
e.zh: 实验室在样品中检测到一种四价铅化合物。

e.en: Students compared {plumbic} salts with more common lead compounds.
e.zh: 学生们把四价铅盐与更常见的铅化合物作了比较。

e.en: The old camera used a {plumbicon} tube for image pickup.
e.zh: 这台旧摄像机使用氧化铅摄像管来采集图像。

e.en: Technicians replaced the damaged {plumbicon} in the studio camera.
e.zh: 技术人员更换了演播室摄像机中损坏的氧化铅摄像管。

e.en: Miners searched the hills for {plumbiferous} ore.
e.zh: 矿工在山里寻找含铅矿石。

e.en: The survey marked several {plumbiferous} layers beneath the valley.
e.zh: 勘测报告标出了山谷地下几层产铅地层。

e.en: The store sells taps, valves, and other {plumbingware}.
e.zh: 这家店出售水龙头、阀门和其他水暖器材。

e.en: Imported {plumbingware} became more expensive after the tariff change.
e.zh: 关税调整后，进口卫浴管件变得更贵了。

pluripotent.t: 多能性的；有多种潜能的

e.en: Scientists grew {pluripotent} stem cells in the lab.
e.zh: 科学家在实验室培养了多能性干细胞。

e.en: A {pluripotent} idea can develop in many directions.
e.zh: 一个具有多种潜能的想法可以向许多方向发展。

e.en: The novel suggests a ghostly {pluripresence} across the house.
e.zh: 小说暗示屋内各处都有幽灵般的同时存在。

e.en: Digital media creates a strange sense of {pluripresence}.
e.zh: 数字媒体营造出一种奇特的同时多处存在感。

e.en: The fungus has {pluriseptate} spores under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下这种真菌有具多个隔膜的孢子。

e.en: A {pluriseptate} structure divides the cell into chambers.
e.zh: 多隔结构把这个细胞分成几个小室。

e.en: Children often shorten a difficult {plurisyllable}.
e.zh: 孩子们常把难读的多音节词说短。

e.en: The poet chose a rolling {plurisyllable} for emphasis.
e.zh: 诗人选了一个起伏感强的多音节词来加强语气。

e.en: The vaccine was designed to be {plurivalent}.
e.zh: 这种疫苗被设计成多价疫苗。

e.en: Her symbol is deliberately {plurivalent} in the poem.
e.zh: 她在诗中的象征是有意具有多重意义的。

e.en: The {plurivorous} animal survives on seeds, insects, and fruit.
e.zh: 这种杂食动物靠种子、昆虫和水果生存。

e.en: A {plurivorous} diet helped the species adapt quickly.
e.zh: 吃多种食物的饮食让这个物种迅速适应环境。

e.en: He wore tweed {plus-fours} on the golf course.
e.zh: 他在高尔夫球场上穿着粗花呢灯笼裤式及膝男裤。

e.en: Old photographs show hikers in {plus-fours}.
e.zh: 老照片里能看到穿灯笼裤式及膝男裤的徒步者。

e.en: The result is ten, {plus-minus} two.
e.zh: 结果是十，上下大约差二。

e.en: Use the {plus-minus} sign before the number.
e.zh: 在这个数字前使用正负号。

plush-like.t: 像长毛绒的；柔软奢华的

e.en: The blanket had a {plush-like} surface.
e.zh: 这条毯子的表面像长毛绒一样柔软。

e.en: They chose {plush-like} seats for the private cinema.
e.zh: 他们为私人影院选了柔软奢华的座椅。

e.en: The new chairs are the {plushers} of the two models.
e.zh: 这批新椅子是两个型号中更豪华的那种。

e.en: Collectors compared several {plushers} from the toy line.
e.zh: 收藏者比较了这个玩具系列里几款更柔软的毛绒玩具。

e.en: The dress was trimmed with {plushette}.
e.zh: 这条裙子用薄长毛绒织物作了镶边。

e.en: She chose {plushette} for the doll's tiny coat.
e.zh: 她给娃娃的小外套选用了薄长毛绒织物。

e.en: The upgraded room felt {plushier} than ours.
e.zh: 升级后的房间感觉比我们的更豪华。

e.en: This pillow is {plushier} after washing.
e.zh: 这个枕头洗过之后更柔软了。

e.en: The resort offers its {plushiest} rooms in winter.
e.zh: 这家度假村在冬季提供最豪华的房间。

e.en: She picked the {plushiest} toy on the shelf.
e.zh: 她挑了架子上最柔软的毛绒玩具。

e.en: The carpet's {plushiness} made the room quieter.
e.zh: 地毯的柔软厚实感让房间更安静。

e.en: The hotel sells {plushiness} more than convenience.
e.zh: 这家酒店卖点更多是豪华感，而不是便利。

e.en: She hugged a small {plushy} before bed.
e.zh: 她睡前抱着一个小毛绒玩具。

e.en: The lounge had a {plushy} red sofa.
e.zh: 休息室里有一张柔软豪华的红沙发。

e.en: The contract allowed a small {plussage} for materials.
e.zh: 合同允许为材料加入一小笔附加量。

e.en: Critics saw the bonus track as mere {plussage}.
e.zh: 评论家认为这首附加曲只是额外增加物。

e.en: The essay attacks {plutarchy} in modern politics.
e.zh: 这篇文章抨击现代政治中的富豪统治。

e.en: Some feared the republic was sliding into {plutarchy}.
e.zh: 有人担心共和国正滑向财阀统治。

e.en: Workers built a {plute} beside the wall.
e.zh: 工人在墙边搭了一个临时防护棚。

e.en: The old church kept a carved {plute} near the altar.
e.zh: 那座老教堂在祭坛旁保留了一块雕刻挡板。

e.en: The museum identified the stone as a {pluteal} fragment.
e.zh: 博物馆认定这块石头是挡板的残片。

e.en: A {pluteal} shelter protected the workers from falling dust.
e.zh: 一个防护棚式结构保护工人免受落尘影响。

e.en: Several sea urchin {plutei} drifted in the sample.
e.zh: 样本里漂着几只海胆长腕幼虫。

e.en: The archaeologist catalogued two marble {plutei}.
e.zh: 考古学家登记了两块大理石挡板。

e.en: The masons raised wooden {plutes} around the site.
e.zh: 石匠在工地周围竖起了木制防护棚。

e.en: The chapel's marble {plutes} were restored carefully.
e.zh: 小礼拜堂的大理石挡板被仔细修复。

e.en: A sea urchin {pluteus} appeared in the microscope slide.
e.zh: 显微镜载片中出现了一只海胆长腕幼虫。

e.en: The Roman {pluteus} separated the choir from the nave.
e.zh: 这块罗马式挡板把唱诗班区和中殿隔开。

pluteuses.t: 长腕幼虫复数；挡板复数

e.en: The lab counted twenty {pluteuses} after fertilization.
e.zh: 实验室在受精后数出了二十只长腕幼虫。

e.en: Several carved {pluteuses} lined the ancient sanctuary.
e.zh: 几块雕刻挡板排列在古代圣所旁。

e.en: The senator criticized the country's {plutocratic} elite.
e.zh: 参议员批评了该国的富豪统治精英。

e.en: A {plutocratic} system gives wealth too much power.
e.zh: 财阀式制度赋予财富过大的权力。

e.en: The scan suggested {pneumorrhagia} after the injury.
e.zh: 扫描结果提示受伤后出现肺出血。

e.en: Severe {pneumorrhagia} can quickly endanger breathing.
e.zh: 严重肺出血会很快危及呼吸。

e.en: Years in the quarry left him with {pneumosilicosis}.
e.zh: 多年在采石场工作使他患上了矽肺病。

e.en: The clinic screens miners for early {pneumosilicosis}.
e.zh: 诊所为矿工筛查早期硅尘肺。

e.en: The device used a {pneumostatic} valve.
e.zh: 该装置使用了气压平衡阀。

e.en: Engineers checked the {pneumostatic} chamber for leaks.
e.zh: 工程师检查了气压平衡室是否漏气。

e.en: The {pneumotachogram} showed irregular airflow during sleep.
e.zh: 呼吸气流记录图显示睡眠时气流不规则。

e.en: She compared each {pneumotachogram} with the patient's symptoms.
e.zh: 她把每张呼吸气流记录图与患者症状进行比较。

e.en: The lab calibrated the {pneumotachograph} before testing.
e.zh: 实验室在测试前校准了呼吸流量描记器。

e.en: A {pneumotachograph} measured airflow through the mask.
e.zh: 呼吸流量描记器测量了通过面罩的气流。

e.en: The {pneumotachometer} recorded his breathing rate.
e.zh: 呼吸气流计记录了他的呼吸速率。

e.en: Researchers attached a {pneumotachometer} to the mouthpiece.
e.zh: 研究人员把呼吸气流计接到咬嘴上。

e.en: Doctors ordered {pneumotomography} to examine the lesion.
e.zh: 医生安排肺部断层摄影来检查病灶。

e.en: Older reports mention {pneumotomography} before modern CT scans.
e.zh: 早期报告在现代CT出现前提到肺部断层摄影。

e.en: The virus showed a strongly {pneumotropic} pattern.
e.zh: 这种病毒表现出很强的亲肺特性。

e.en: Researchers studied {pneumotropic} strains in animal models.
e.zh: 研究人员在动物模型中研究易侵袭肺部的毒株。

e.en: The study focused on viral {pneumotropism}.
e.zh: 这项研究关注病毒的亲肺性。

e.en: High {pneumotropism} explains the severe lung symptoms.
e.zh: 高度趋肺性解释了严重的肺部症状。

e.en: He gave a {po-faced} apology on television.
e.zh: 他在电视上一本正经地道了歉。

e.en: The comedy works because everyone stays {po-faced}.
e.zh: 这部喜剧好笑，是因为所有人都板着脸演。

e.en: The cafe had a very {po-mo} interior.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆的室内设计很后现代。

e.en: Critics dismissed the novel as empty {po-mo} play.
e.zh: 评论家把这部小说贬为乏味的后现代文字游戏。

e.en: The hillside was covered with {poaceous} plants.
e.zh: 山坡上长满了禾本科植物。

e.en: Botanists noted the specimen's {poaceous} leaves.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到该标本似草的叶片。

e.en: The field's {poachiness} made grazing difficult.
e.zh: 田地湿软泥泞，放牧变得困难。

e.en: Good drainage reduced the soil's {poachiness}.
e.zh: 良好的排水减轻了土壤的湿软状态。

e.en: The cattle crossed a {poachy} meadow.
e.zh: 牛群穿过一片湿软泥泞的草地。

e.en: Avoid driving on {poachy} ground after rain.
e.zh: 雨后不要在湿软泥泞的地面上开车。

poblano.t: 波布拉诺辣椒；墨西哥辣椒

e.en: She roasted a {poblano} for the sauce.
e.zh: 她烤了一只波布拉诺辣椒来做酱。

e.en: The stuffed {poblano} was mild but flavorful.
e.zh: 这道酿波布拉诺辣椒不太辣，但味道很足。

e.en: The trail crossed a sandy {poccosin}.
e.zh: 小路穿过一片沙质沼泽灌丛地。

e.en: Fires sometimes renew the {poccosin} ecosystem.
e.zh: 火灾有时会使沼泽灌丛生态重新更新。

e.en: A male {pochard} drifted near the reeds.
e.zh: 一只雄性潜鸭在芦苇旁漂着。

e.en: Birdwatchers counted several {pochards} on the lake.
e.zh: 观鸟者在湖上数到了好几只潜鸭。

e.en: She carried a silver {pochette} to dinner.
e.zh: 她带着一个银色小手包去赴晚餐。

e.en: The dress had a matching {pochette}.
e.zh: 这条裙子配有一个同款装饰小袋。

e.en: A huge {pochote} shaded the village road.
e.zh: 一棵巨大的木棉树遮住了村路。

e.en: The {pochote} produces light, silky fiber.
e.zh: 这种中美洲木棉会产出轻柔的丝状纤维。

e.en: Each old {pock-mark} showed on his cheek.
e.zh: 他脸颊上的每一道旧痘痕都看得见。

e.en: Rain left a {pock-mark} in the soft clay.
e.zh: 雨水在软黏土上留下了一个小坑痕。

e.en: His {pock-marked} face looked tired.
e.zh: 他那张有痘痕的脸显得很疲惫。

e.en: The wall was {pock-marked} by old bullets.
e.zh: 那面墙被旧弹痕打得布满坑点。

e.en: The lord controlled a {pocket-borough} in Parliament.
e.zh: 那位贵族控制着议会中的一个小选区。

e.en: Reformers attacked the old {pocket-borough} system.
e.zh: 改革者抨击旧时受权贵操控的选区制度。

e.en: He folded a {pocket-handkerchief} neatly.
e.zh: 他把一块随身手帕叠得整整齐齐。

e.en: Her {pocket-handkerchief} matched the suit.
e.zh: 她的口袋手帕和西装很相配。

e.en: I saved my {pocket-money} for books.
e.zh: 我把零花钱攒起来买书。

e.en: The job paid only {pocket-money}.
e.zh: 这份工作只给一点零用钱。

e.en: They printed a {pocket-size} guide.
e.zh: 他们印了一本袖珍大小的指南。

e.en: The camera came in a {pocket-size} case.
e.zh: 这台相机配了一个口袋尺寸的盒子。

e.en: She bought a {pocket-sized} dictionary.
e.zh: 她买了一本袖珍词典。

e.en: The {pocket-sized} speaker filled the room.
e.zh: 这个小巧便携的音箱让整个房间都有声音。

e.en: The jacket folds into a {pocketable} pouch.
e.zh: 这件夹克可以折成一个可放进口袋的小包。

e.en: They wanted a truly {pocketable} camera.
e.zh: 他们想要一台真正能放进口袋的相机。

e.en: The scouts carried {pocketknives} on the trip.
e.zh: 童子军在旅途中带着折叠小刀。

e.en: Old {pocketknives} filled the collector's drawer.
e.zh: 收藏家的抽屉里放满了旧随身小刀。

pocketscope.t: 袖珍望远镜；小型观察镜

e.en: He used a {pocketscope} to inspect stamps.
e.zh: 他用袖珍观察镜检查邮票。

e.en: A {pocketscope} helped her read the tiny print.
e.zh: 一个小型观察镜帮助她看清细小字体。

e.en: The manual was {pocketsized} and waterproof.
e.zh: 这本手册是袖珍大小，而且防水。

e.en: He prefers {pocketsized} tools for travel.
e.zh: 旅行时他更喜欢小巧便携的工具。

e.en: She wore a {pockety} vest while fishing.
e.zh: 她钓鱼时穿了一件多口袋背心。

e.en: The cave had a {pockety} shape inside.
e.zh: 洞穴内部呈现出像口袋一样的形状。

e.en: Water gathered in every {pockhole} on the road.
e.zh: 路面每个小坑里都积了水。

e.en: The stone had a deep {pockhole} near its edge.
e.zh: 石头边缘附近有一个很深的麻点状洞。

pockiness.t: 多麻点；布满坑痕的状态

e.en: The mirror revealed the {pockiness} of his skin.
e.zh: 镜子照出了他皮肤上多处麻点。

e.en: Years of weather caused the wall's {pockiness}.
e.zh: 多年风化使墙面变得布满坑痕。

e.en: A small {pockpit} remained after the infection.
e.zh: 感染后留下了一个小痘坑。

e.en: The metal surface showed a tiny {pockpit}.
e.zh: 金属表面出现了一个细小坑点。

e.en: The old plaster looked {pocky} and rough.
e.zh: 旧灰泥看起来麻点多，而且很粗糙。

e.en: His {pocky} cheeks made him self-conscious.
e.zh: 他有痘痕的脸颊让他很不自在。

e.en: The culture showed {pneumobacillus} in the sputum sample.
e.zh: 培养结果显示痰液样本中有肺炎杆菌。

e.en: Doctors once used {pneumobacillus} as a broad term for certain pneumonia bacteria.
e.zh: 医生过去曾用肺炎杆菌泛指某些引起肺炎的细菌。

e.en: A chest scan revealed a small {pneumocele} after the infection.
e.zh: 胸部扫描显示感染后形成了一个小的肺气囊肿。

e.en: The surgeon monitored the {pneumocele} for signs of rupture.
e.zh: 外科医生监测这个含气囊腔是否有破裂迹象。

e.en: The paper described {pneumocin} produced by the bacterial strain.
e.zh: 论文描述了该细菌菌株产生的肺炎菌素。

e.en: Researchers tested whether {pneumocin} could inhibit related microbes.
e.zh: 研究人员测试肺炎菌素是否能抑制相关微生物。

e.en: The vaccine protects against several types of {pneumococcus}.
e.zh: 这种疫苗可预防多种类型的肺炎球菌。

e.en: A {pneumococcus} infection can cause pneumonia or meningitis.
e.zh: 肺炎球菌感染可能导致肺炎或脑膜炎。

e.en: Miners have a higher risk of {pneumoconiosis}.
e.zh: 矿工患尘肺病的风险更高。

e.en: His cough was later linked to occupational {pneumoconiosis}.
e.zh: 他的咳嗽后来被认为与职业性尘肺病有关。

e.en: The old report mentioned {pneumocystotomography} before modern scans were available.
e.zh: 这份旧报告提到，在现代扫描出现前曾使用气膀胱断层造影。

e.en: Few hospitals now perform {pneumocystotomography} for bladder imaging.
e.zh: 现在很少有医院用气膀胱断层造影来检查膀胱。

e.en: The laboratory used a {pneumodograph} to trace breathing movements.
e.zh: 实验室用呼吸记录器描记呼吸运动。

e.en: A faulty {pneumodograph} made the respiration data unreliable.
e.zh: 一台故障的呼吸记录器使呼吸数据不可靠。

pneumodynamics.t: 呼吸动力学；气体动力学

e.en: The lecture covered lung {pneumodynamics} during exercise.
e.zh: 讲座介绍了运动时肺部的呼吸动力学。

e.en: Engineers studied {pneumodynamics} in the pressure system.
e.zh: 工程师研究了该压力系统中的气体动力学。

e.en: The archive included a faded {pneumoencephalogram} from 1948.
e.zh: 档案中有一张1948年褪色的气脑造影片。

e.en: A {pneumoencephalogram} once helped doctors outline the brain ventricles.
e.zh: 气脑造影片过去曾帮助医生显示脑室轮廓。

e.en: MRI replaced {pneumoencephalography} in most neurological diagnosis.
e.zh: 核磁共振在多数神经系统诊断中取代了气脑造影术。

e.en: Patients found {pneumoencephalography} painful and unpleasant.
e.zh: 患者觉得气脑造影术痛苦且难受。

e.en: The surgeon suspected {pneumoencephalos} after the head injury.
e.zh: 头部受伤后，外科医生怀疑有颅内积气。

e.en: A CT scan confirmed {pneumoencephalos} near the frontal lobe.
e.zh: CT扫描确认额叶附近有颅内积气。

e.en: The {pneumogastric} nerve affects heart rate and digestion.
e.zh: 迷走神经会影响心率和消化。

e.en: Older anatomy texts often use {pneumogastric} for the vagus nerve.
e.zh: 较早的解剖学教材常用pneumogastric指迷走神经。

e.en: The sleep study included a {pneumogram} of the infant's breathing.
e.zh: 睡眠检查包含一份婴儿呼吸的呼吸记录图。

e.en: Her {pneumogram} showed brief pauses during the night.
e.zh: 她的呼吸记录图显示夜间有短暂停顿。

e.en: A {pneumograph} recorded the patient's breathing pattern.
e.zh: 呼吸描记器记录了病人的呼吸模式。

e.en: The old {pneumograph} used a belt around the chest.
e.zh: 旧式呼吸描记器使用绕在胸部的绑带。

e.en: The factory installed a {pneumohydraulic} press for metal parts.
e.zh: 工厂安装了一台用于金属零件的气液压压力机。

e.en: A {pneumohydraulic} system combines compressed air with hydraulic force.
e.zh: 气液压系统把压缩空气和液压力结合起来。

e.en: The bacterium releases {pneumolysin} during infection.
e.zh: 这种细菌在感染过程中释放肺炎溶血素。

e.en: Scientists measured {pneumolysin} to assess the strain's virulence.
e.zh: 科学家测量肺炎溶血素以评估该菌株的毒力。

e.en: The surgeon performed {pneumolysis} to free the collapsed lung.
e.zh: 外科医生进行了肺粘连松解术，以松解塌陷的肺。

e.en: Before antibiotics, {pneumolysis} was sometimes used in tuberculosis treatment.
e.zh: 在抗生素出现前，肺粘连松解术有时用于结核治疗。

e.en: The specialist reviewed a {pneumomediastinogram} from the old case file.
e.zh: 专科医生查看了旧病例中的纵隔充气造影片。

e.en: A {pneumomediastinogram} could show masses around the mediastinum.
e.zh: 纵隔充气造影片可显示纵隔周围的肿块。

e.en: The biopsy supported a diagnosis of {pneumomycosis}.
e.zh: 活检支持肺真菌病的诊断。

e.en: Severe {pneumomycosis} may occur in patients with weak immunity.
e.zh: 免疫力低下的患者可能发生严重肺真菌病。

e.en: He needed a {pneumonectomy} after the tumor spread.
e.zh: 肿瘤扩散后，他需要接受肺切除术。

e.en: Recovery from {pneumonectomy} requires careful breathing exercises.
e.zh: 肺切除术后的恢复需要认真进行呼吸训练。

e.en: Radiation therapy can sometimes cause {pneumonitis}.
e.zh: 放射治疗有时会引起肺部炎症。

e.en: The doctor distinguished {pneumonitis} from bacterial pneumonia.
e.zh: 医生把肺炎样炎症与细菌性肺炎区分开来。

e.en: The radiologist compared the new {pneumonogram} with last year's image.
e.zh: 放射科医生把新的肺部影像图与去年的影像作比较。

e.en: A clear {pneumonogram} helped rule out a large mass.
e.zh: 清晰的肺部影像图有助于排除大肿块。

e.en: Modern CT has largely replaced older {pneumonography}.
e.zh: 现代CT在很大程度上取代了旧式肺部造影术。

e.en: The textbook describes {pneumonography} as imaging of the lungs.
e.zh: 教材把肺部造影术描述为对肺部进行成像。

e.en: The patient underwent {pneumonolysis} to separate pleural adhesions.
e.zh: 患者接受肺粘连松解术，以分离胸膜粘连。

e.en: Historical surgeons used {pneumonolysis} in selected tuberculosis cases.
e.zh: 过去的外科医生在部分结核病例中使用肺粘连松解术。

e.en: Students laughed at the length of {pneumonoultramicroscopicsilicovolcanoconiosis}.
e.zh: 学生们因为pneumonoultramicroscopicsilicovolcanoconiosis这个词太长而发笑。

e.en: The dictionary defines {pneumonoultramicroscopicsilicovolcanoconiosis} as a type of dust disease.
e.zh: 词典把pneumonoultramicroscopicsilicovolcanoconiosis定义为一种粉尘病。

e.en: His {pococurante} manner annoyed the anxious committee.
e.zh: 他那副漠不关心的样子惹恼了焦急的委员会。

e.en: She gave a {pococurante} shrug at the bad news.
e.zh: 听到坏消息时，她只是冷淡地耸了耸肩。

e.en: His {pococurantism} toward politics surprised his friends.
e.zh: 他对政治的漠不关心让朋友们很意外。

e.en: The essay criticized fashionable {pococurantism} among the wealthy.
e.zh: 这篇文章批评了富人中流行的冷淡态度。
