pregenital.t: 性器期前的；生殖器前的

e.en: Freud described {pregenital} stages of development.
e.zh: 弗洛伊德描述了性器期前的发展阶段。

e.en: The doctor noted a {pregenital} anatomical feature.
e.zh: 医生记录了一个生殖器前部的解剖特征。

e.en: The seeds need {pregermination} treatment in water.
e.zh: 这些种子需要先用水做萌发前处理。

e.en: Temperature during {pregermination} affects later growth.
e.zh: 萌发前期的温度会影响后续生长。

e.en: She found out she was {preggers} in June.
e.zh: 她在六月发现自己怀孕了。

e.en: The tabloid claimed the actress was {preggers}.
e.zh: 小报声称那位女演员怀孕了。

e.en: The valley preserves {preglacial} river deposits.
e.zh: 这个山谷保存着冰川期前的河流沉积物。

e.en: Scientists reconstructed the {preglacial} landscape.
e.zh: 科学家重建了冰川期前的地貌。

e.en: The fortress's {pregnability} surprised the attackers.
e.zh: 这座堡垒的可攻破性让进攻者感到意外。

e.en: The paper discussed {pregnability} in older medical terms.
e.zh: 论文用较旧的医学术语讨论了可受孕性。

e.en: The walls looked strong but were {pregnable}.
e.zh: 城墙看似坚固，其实可以攻破。

e.en: Older texts used {pregnable} to mean capable of conception.
e.zh: 较旧的文本用pregnable表示能够受孕。

e.en: The poem's {pregnance} depends on its silence.
e.zh: 这首诗的深意取决于它的留白。

e.en: Old medical notes recorded her {pregnance} carefully.
e.zh: 旧病历仔细记录了她的怀孕状态。

e.en: Chemists use {pregnane} as a parent structure for many steroid names.
e.zh: 化学家把孕烷作为许多甾体命名的母体结构。

e.en: The paper compared several {pregnane} derivatives in liver tissue.
e.zh: 论文比较了肝组织中的几种孕烷衍生物。

e.en: Urinary {pregnanediol} levels can reflect progesterone activity.
e.zh: 尿中孕烷二醇水平可以反映孕酮活性。

e.en: The lab measured {pregnanediol} after ovulation.
e.zh: 实验室在排卵后测定了孕烷二醇。

pregnanedione.t: 孕烷二酮类甾体化合物

e.en: The reaction produced a {pregnanedione} as the main steroid product.
e.zh: 该反应生成了一种孕烷二酮作为主要甾体产物。

e.en: Researchers identified {pregnanedione} in the metabolic profile.
e.zh: 研究人员在代谢谱中鉴定出孕烷二酮。

e.en: {Pregnanolone} may influence signaling in the nervous system.
e.zh: 孕烷醇酮可能影响神经系统中的信号传递。

e.en: The study tracked {pregnanolone} during pregnancy.
e.zh: 这项研究追踪了妊娠期间的孕烷醇酮。

e.en: The molecule contains a {pregnene} skeleton with one double bond.
e.zh: 这个分子含有带一个双键的孕烯骨架。

e.en: Several {pregnene} compounds were tested for hormonal activity.
e.zh: 几种孕烯类化合物被测试其激素活性。

e.en: The synthetic route yielded {pregneninolone} in small quantities.
e.zh: 这条合成路线只得到少量孕烯炔醇酮。

e.en: Older pharmacology texts mention {pregneninolone} among steroid intermediates.
e.zh: 较早的药理学文献把孕烯炔醇酮列为甾体中间体之一。

e.en: {Pregnenolone} is a precursor of several steroid hormones.
e.zh: 孕烯醇酮是多种甾体激素的前体。

e.en: The doctor discussed {pregnenolone} supplements with caution.
e.zh: 医生谨慎地谈到了孕烯醇酮补充剂。

e.en: When I thanked the waiter, he smiled and said {prego}.
e.zh: 我向服务员道谢时，他笑着说不用谢。

e.en: In slang, she said she was {prego} with twins.
e.zh: 她用俚语说自己怀了双胞胎。

e.en: The assay detected {pregram} amounts of the compound.
e.zh: 该检测能测出前克级数量的这种化合物。

e.en: A {pregram} sample was too small for the old balance.
e.zh: 前克级样品对那台旧天平来说太少了。

e.en: The teacher asked us to {pregroup} the data before class.
e.zh: 老师要求我们课前先把数据预先分组。

e.en: A small {pregroup} met before the main workshop.
e.zh: 一个预备小组在正式研讨会前先开了会。

e.en: The frog's {prehallux} supports part of the inner foot.
e.zh: 青蛙的前拇趾支撑足内侧的一部分。

e.en: Anatomists debated whether the {prehallux} was a true digit.
e.zh: 解剖学家曾争论前拇趾是否算真正的趾。

e.en: Farmers adjusted irrigation during the {preharvest} period.
e.zh: 农民在收获前阶段调整了灌溉。

e.en: {Preharvest} spraying can affect fruit residue levels.
e.zh: 采收前喷药会影响水果的残留水平。

e.en: A monkey's tail can be {prehensible} and useful for climbing.
e.zh: 猴子的尾巴可以抓握，对攀爬很有用。

e.en: The argument was barely {prehensible} after several revisions.
e.zh: 经过几次修改后，这个论证勉强能被理解。

e.en: The study measured the {prehensility} of the animal's tail.
e.zh: 研究测量了这种动物尾巴的抓握能力。

e.en: Clear diagrams improved the {prehensility} of the theory.
e.zh: 清晰的图示提高了这个理论的可理解性。

prehistorian.t: 史前史学家；史前研究者

e.en: The {prehistorian} examined stone tools from the cave.
e.zh: 那位史前史学家研究了洞穴中的石器。

e.en: As a {prehistorian}, she studies societies without written records.
e.zh: 作为史前研究者，她研究没有文字记录的社会。

e.en: The museum displayed {prehistorical} pottery from the region.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了该地区的史前陶器。

e.en: His novel imagines a {prehistorical} coastal village.
e.zh: 他的小说想象了一个史前海岸村落。

prehistorically.t: 在史前时期；按史前情况

e.en: The valley was {prehistorically} home to hunter-gatherers.
e.zh: 这个山谷在史前时期曾是狩猎采集者的家园。

e.en: {Prehistorically}, the island was reached by simple boats.
e.zh: 在史前时期，人们用简易船只到达这座岛。

e.en: The pendant was made from pale green {prehnite}.
e.zh: 这个吊坠是用淡绿色葡萄石制成的。

e.en: Collectors value clear {prehnite} with a soft glow.
e.zh: 收藏者看重带柔和光泽的透明葡萄石。

e.en: The fossil may belong to a {prehominid} primate.
e.zh: 这块化石可能属于人科以前的灵长类。

e.en: A {prehominid} species showed early signs of upright walking.
e.zh: 一种前人类物种显示出早期直立行走的迹象。

e.en: Vitamin D acts as a {prehormone} in the body.
e.zh: 维生素D在体内起激素前体的作用。

e.en: The gland releases a {prehormone} that must be activated later.
e.zh: 该腺体释放一种之后必须被激活的前激素。

e.en: Athletes used {prehydration} before the desert race.
e.zh: 运动员在沙漠赛前进行了事先补水。

e.en: {Prehydration} of the cement improved the mixing process.
e.zh: 水泥的预水化改善了搅拌过程。

e.en: Engine knock can result from {preignition} in the cylinder.
e.zh: 发动机爆震可能由气缸内提前点火引起。

e.en: The technician checked for {preignition} during the test run.
e.zh: 技术员在试运行中检查是否有预燃现象。

e.en: The camera sensor received {preillumination} before the exposure.
e.zh: 相机传感器在曝光前接受了预照明。

e.en: {Preillumination} changed the response of the plant cells.
e.zh: 预先光照改变了植物细胞的反应。

e.en: In this function, every output has at least one {preimage}.
e.zh: 在这个函数中，每个输出至少有一个原像。

e.en: The cryptographic hash should make finding a {preimage} difficult.
e.zh: 这种加密哈希应当让寻找原像变得困难。

e.en: The clinic offers {preimplantation} genetic testing for embryos.
e.zh: 这家诊所提供胚胎植入前遗传检测。

e.en: {Preimplantation} development occurs before the embryo attaches to the uterus.
e.zh: 着床前发育发生在胚胎附着到子宫之前。

preimpregnate.t: 预先浸渍；预先使怀孕或受精

e.en: The technician will {preimpregnate} the fibers with resin.
e.zh: 技术员会先用树脂浸渍这些纤维。

e.en: Some breeders try to {preimpregnate} animals before transport.
e.zh: 一些饲养者会在运输前先让动物受孕。

preincline.t: 预先倾向于；事先使偏向

e.en: Early praise can {preincline} readers toward the book.
e.zh: 早期的好评会让读者预先偏向这本书。

e.en: Her training {preinclined} her to trust careful measurements.
e.zh: 她的训练使她一开始就倾向于相信精确测量。

preincubation.t: 预孵化；正式孵育前阶段

e.en: The eggs require a short {preincubation} period.
e.zh: 这些蛋需要一段短暂的预孵化时间。

e.en: During {preincubation}, the samples stayed at room temperature.
e.zh: 在预孵育期间，样本保持在室温下。

e.en: The dark clouds {preindicate} a sudden storm.
e.zh: 乌云预示着一场突如其来的暴风雨。

e.en: The form should {preindicate} which documents are required.
e.zh: 这张表应提前说明需要哪些文件。

preinduction.t: 诱导前阶段；入职或引产前

e.en: She attended a {preinduction} meeting before starting work.
e.zh: 她入职前参加了一次岗前说明会。

e.en: The doctor ordered tests during the {preinduction} phase.
e.zh: 医生在引产前阶段安排了检查。

e.en: Please {preinform} the team about any schedule changes.
e.zh: 如有日程变动，请提前通知团队。

e.en: The notice {preinformed} guests of the security checks.
e.zh: 通知事先告知客人会有安检。

e.en: The engine uses a {preinjector} to improve fuel mixing.
e.zh: 这台发动机使用预喷射器来改善燃油混合。

e.en: A faulty {preinjector} caused uneven dosing in the system.
e.zh: 一个故障的预注入装置导致系统给量不均。

e.en: Manufacturers often {preinstall} useful apps on the device.
e.zh: 制造商常在设备上预装实用应用。

e.en: The laptop came with antivirus software {preinstalled}.
e.zh: 这台笔记本出厂时已预装杀毒软件。

e.en: The report studied troop movements in the {preinvasion} period.
e.zh: 报告研究了入侵前时期的军队调动。

e.en: Doctors detected abnormal cells at a {preinvasion} stage.
e.zh: 医生在侵袭前阶段发现了异常细胞。

e.en: The biopsy showed a {preinvasive} form of cancer.
e.zh: 活检显示这是一种侵袭前癌变。

e.en: Historians debate the {preinvasive} strategy of the army.
e.zh: 历史学家争论这支军队入侵前的战略。

e.en: The lens can {preject} the image onto a screen.
e.zh: 这枚镜头能把图像向前投射到屏幕上。

e.en: He tried to {preject} his fears onto future events.
e.zh: 他试图把自己的恐惧预先投射到未来事件上。

e.en: The agency offers {prejob} training for young applicants.
e.zh: 该机构为年轻求职者提供就业前培训。

e.en: A {prejob} safety briefing is required on this site.
e.zh: 这个工地要求开工前进行安全简报。

e.en: Her {prejudgement} made the interview unfair.
e.zh: 她的预先判断使这次面试不公平。

e.en: Try to read the evidence without {prejudgement}.
e.zh: 尽量不要带着成见去看证据。

e.en: The lawyer objected to any {prejudication} of the case.
e.zh: 律师反对对案件作任何预先裁定。

e.en: Public comments risked {prejudication} before the hearing.
e.zh: 公开评论有在听证前造成预判的风险。

e.en: The article took a {prejudicious} view of the proposal.
e.zh: 这篇文章对该提案持有带偏见的看法。

e.en: A judge must avoid {prejudicious} remarks in court.
e.zh: 法官必须避免在法庭上发表预断性言论。

e.en: Their daughter starts {prekindergarten} in September.
e.zh: 他们的女儿九月开始上学前班。

e.en: The district expanded its {prekindergarten} program this year.
e.zh: 该学区今年扩大了幼儿园前教育项目。

e.en: No one could {preknow} the final result.
e.zh: 没有人能预知最终结果。

e.en: The legend says the oracle {preknew} every disaster.
e.zh: 传说那位神谕者预先知道每场灾难。

prelacies.t: 高级教士职位；主教辖区

e.en: Several medieval {prelacies} controlled large estates.
e.zh: 几个中世纪高级教士辖区掌控着大片地产。

e.en: The reform reduced the privileges of the {prelacies}.
e.zh: 改革削弱了这些高级教士职位的特权。

e.en: The bishop defended the authority of the {prelacy}.
e.zh: 主教维护高级教士职位的权威。

e.en: Some reformers opposed {prelacy} in the church.
e.zh: 一些改革者反对教会中的主教制。

e.en: The technician checked the surface during the {prelaser} stage.
e.zh: 技术员在激光处理前阶段检查了表面。

e.en: Patients received {prelaser} instructions before the procedure.
e.zh: 患者在手术前收到了激光治疗前说明。

prelateship.t: 高级教士职位；主教身份

e.en: His {prelateship} gave him influence at court.
e.zh: 他的高级教士身份使他在宫廷中有影响力。

e.en: The document described the duties of {prelateship}.
e.zh: 文件描述了高级教士职位的职责。

e.en: The council rejected the {prelatic} structure of governance.
e.zh: 委员会拒绝了主教制的治理结构。

e.en: His writings attacked {prelatic} power in the church.
e.zh: 他的著作抨击教会中高级教士的权力。

e.en: They debated the church's {prelatical} traditions.
e.zh: 他们辩论教会的主教制传统。

e.en: The pamphlet criticized {prelatical} authority sharply.
e.zh: 这本小册子尖锐批评高级教士权威。

prelatise.t: 使成主教制；按高级教士方式治理

e.en: The king tried to {prelatise} the national church.
e.zh: 国王试图把国教改造成主教制。

e.en: Critics feared the reforms would {prelatise} local congregations.
e.zh: 批评者担心改革会让地方教会受高级教士式治理。

e.en: The movement opposed {prelatism} and demanded simpler governance.
e.zh: 该运动反对主教制，并要求更简单的治理。

e.en: His essay traced the history of {prelatism}.
e.zh: 他的文章梳理了高级教士制度的历史。

e.en: The organist began to {preludize} before the service.
e.zh: 礼拜开始前，管风琴师先弹了一段前奏。

e.en: The essay seems to {preludize} a larger argument.
e.zh: 这篇文章似乎是在为更大的论点作铺垫。

e.en: The speech was a {prelusion} to the main debate.
e.zh: 这场演讲是主要辩论的序幕。

e.en: Their quiet meeting proved a {prelusion} to reform.
e.zh: 他们那次低调会面后来成了改革的前奏。

e.en: The chapter has a {prelusive} tone.
e.zh: 这一章带有序幕般的语气。

e.en: Her remarks were merely {prelusive}, not decisive.
e.zh: 她的话只是铺垫性的，并非最终决定。

e.en: He spoke {prelusively} before announcing the plan.
e.zh: 宣布计划前，他先作了一番铺垫式发言。

e.en: The music moved {prelusively} into the final theme.
e.zh: 音乐以一种前奏般的方式进入了最后主题。

e.en: She commented {prelusorily} on the evidence.
e.zh: 她先对证据作了预备性的评论。

e.en: The narrator speaks {prelusorily} before the tale begins.
e.zh: 故事开始前，叙述者先作序言式说明。

e.en: The poem opens with a {prelusory} stanza.
e.zh: 这首诗以一节前奏性的诗句开头。

e.en: His first visit was only {prelusory}.
e.zh: 他的第一次拜访只是预备性的。

e.en: The tiny {prem} needed special care.
e.zh: 这个小早产儿需要特别护理。

e.en: Fans debated the best {Prem} match of the season.
e.zh: 球迷们争论本赛季英超哪场比赛最好。

e.en: The image received {premagnification} before analysis.
e.zh: 图像在分析前先进行了预放大。

e.en: Too much {premagnification} can distort the signal.
e.zh: 预放大过度可能会使信号失真。

e.en: The fossil was first described as {preman}.
e.zh: 这块化石最初被描述为史前人类。

e.en: Older theories placed {preman} outside modern humanity.
e.zh: 较早的理论把早期人类排除在现代人类之外。

e.en: The stock rose in {premarket} trading.
e.zh: 这只股票在盘前交易中上涨。

e.en: The device passed {premarket} safety review.
e.zh: 该设备通过了上市前安全审查。

e.en: The team planned {premarketing} for the new drug.
e.zh: 团队为这种新药安排了上市前营销。

e.en: Effective {premarketing} created early demand.
e.zh: 有效的预营销提前制造了需求。

e.en: Students in {premastery} need guided practice.
e.zh: 处于掌握前阶段的学生需要有指导的练习。

e.en: The test identifies {premastery} skills clearly.
e.zh: 这项测试能清楚识别尚未完全掌握的技能。

e.en: The fish has teeth on the {premaxilla}.
e.zh: 这种鱼的前上颌骨上有牙齿。

e.en: A fracture damaged the child's {premaxilla}.
e.zh: 一次骨折损伤了这个孩子的前上颌骨。

e.en: The two {premaxillae} meet at the midline.
e.zh: 两块前上颌骨在中线处相接。

e.en: Bird skulls show varied {premaxillae}.
e.zh: 鸟类头骨显示出形态各异的前上颌骨。

e.en: The surgeon examined the {premaxillary} region.
e.zh: 外科医生检查了前上颌骨区域。

e.en: Several {premaxillary} teeth were missing.
e.zh: 有几颗前上颌骨上的牙齿缺失了。

e.en: She is taking {premed} courses this year.
e.zh: 她今年在修医学预科课程。

e.en: A nervous {premed} shadowed the surgeon.
e.zh: 一名紧张的医预科学生跟着外科医生见习。

e.en: Doctors may {premedicate} patients before anesthesia.
e.zh: 医生可能会在麻醉前给病人预先用药。

e.en: They {premedicate} him to prevent nausea.
e.zh: 他们给他预先用药以防恶心。

e.en: The letter had a {premeditative} quality.
e.zh: 这封信带有一种深思熟虑的意味。

e.en: Prosecutors noted his {premeditative} behavior.
e.zh: 检方指出了他的预谋性行为。

e.en: The police searched for the {premeditator}.
e.zh: 警方在寻找这名预谋者。

e.en: A careful {premeditator} leaves few obvious traces.
e.zh: 谨慎的事先策划者很少留下明显痕迹。

e.en: The mutation occurred during {premeiotic} development.
e.zh: 这种突变发生在减数分裂前的发育阶段。

e.en: Researchers studied {premeiotic} cells in the ovary.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了卵巢中的减数分裂前细胞。

e.en: The academy will {premiate} the winning poet.
e.zh: 学院将给获胜诗人授奖。

e.en: Judges decided to {premiate} innovation over polish.
e.zh: 评委决定奖励创新，而不是只看完成度。

e.en: The argument rests on false {premices}.
e.zh: 这个论证建立在错误的前提之上。

e.en: No alcohol may be sold on the {premices}.
e.zh: 这些场所内不得出售酒类。

e.en: Their {premie} stayed in the hospital for weeks.
e.zh: 他们的早产儿在医院住了好几个星期。

e.en: The nurse checked the {premie}'s breathing carefully.
e.zh: 护士仔细检查了这个早产儿的呼吸。

e.en: Many {premies} need help feeding at first.
e.zh: 许多早产儿起初需要帮助才能进食。

e.en: The unit cares for fragile {premies}.
e.zh: 这个病区照护身体脆弱的早产儿。

prelatist.t: 高级教士制度支持者；主教制拥护者

e.en: The pamphlet was written by a committed {prelatist}.
e.zh: 这本小册子是一位坚定的主教制拥护者写的。

e.en: As a {prelatist}, he defended bishops in church government.
e.zh: 作为高级教士制度支持者，他为教会治理中的主教辩护。

prelatize.t: 使受主教管辖；按主教制组织

e.en: The reformers feared the plan would {prelatize} the congregation.
e.zh: 改革者担心这项计划会使会众受主教管辖。

e.en: They tried to {prelatize} local church administration.
e.zh: 他们试图按主教制来组织地方教会管理。

prelatized.t: 受主教管辖的；按主教制组织的

e.en: The formerly independent parish became {prelatized} after the decree.
e.zh: 法令颁布后，原本独立的教区变成了受主教管辖的机构。

e.en: Critics described the new structure as heavily {prelatized}.
e.zh: 批评者称新的结构带有浓厚的主教制色彩。

prelatizing.t: 使主教化；按主教制改组

e.en: Opponents accused him of {prelatizing} the local churches.
e.zh: 反对者指责他把地方教会主教化。

e.en: The synod rejected any {prelatizing} tendency in the proposal.
e.zh: 宗教会议拒绝了提案中任何按主教制改组的倾向。

prelature.t: 高级教士职位；主教辖区

e.en: He accepted the {prelature} after years of parish work.
e.zh: 多年从事教区工作后，他接受了高级教士职位。

e.en: The remote {prelature} served communities across the mountains.
e.zh: 这个偏远的主教辖区服务着山地各处的社区。

e.en: The team fixed several bugs during the {prelaunch} period.
e.zh: 团队在发布前阶段修复了几个错误。

e.en: Engineers completed the {prelaunch} checks before sunrise.
e.zh: 工程师们在日出前完成了发射前检查。

prelaw.t: 法学预科的；法学院预备课程

e.en: She joined a {prelaw} society in her first year.
e.zh: 她大一时加入了一个法学预科社团。

e.en: His {prelaw} courses included ethics and political theory.
e.zh: 他的法学院预备课程包括伦理学和政治理论。

e.en: The professor will {prelect} on medieval poetry tomorrow.
e.zh: 教授明天将正式讲授中世纪诗歌。

e.en: He liked to {prelect} from the original Latin text.
e.zh: 他喜欢根据拉丁原文来讲解。

prelected.t: 已讲授的；正式讲解过的

e.en: She {prelected} on Aristotle to a crowded hall.
e.zh: 她在挤满人的大厅里讲授亚里士多德。

e.en: The passage was {prelected} before the class discussed it.
e.zh: 在全班讨论之前，这段文字已经被正式讲解过。

e.en: He spent the morning {prelecting} on church history.
e.zh: 他整个上午都在讲授教会史。

e.en: Her style of {prelecting} was precise but lively.
e.zh: 她正式讲解的风格准确而生动。

e.en: The students took notes during the {prelection}.
e.zh: 学生们在正式讲课期间做了笔记。

e.en: His {prelection} clarified several difficult lines of the poem.
e.zh: 他的讲解课阐明了诗中几处难懂的诗句。

e.en: The {prelector} began with a passage from Virgil.
e.zh: 讲师先引用了维吉尔的一段文字。

e.en: A patient {prelector} can make old texts feel alive.
e.zh: 一位耐心的讲解者能让古老文本显得鲜活。

prelexical.t: 词汇形成前的；前词汇阶段的

e.en: Infants show {prelexical} abilities before they speak words.
e.zh: 婴儿在开口说词之前就表现出前词汇阶段的能力。

e.en: The study examined {prelexical} sound patterns in early language learning.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了早期语言学习中的前词汇声音模式。

prelibation.t: 预先少量饮用；祭前献酒

e.en: The host allowed a small {prelibation} before dinner.
e.zh: 主人允许晚餐前先少量饮用一点酒。

e.en: The ritual included a quiet {prelibation} at the altar.
e.zh: 仪式包括在祭坛前安静地先行献酒。

e.en: The novel describes village life in the {preliberation} years.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了解放前年代的乡村生活。

e.en: Prison records from the {preliberation} period were incomplete.
e.zh: 释放前阶段的监狱记录并不完整。

prelicense.t: 许可前的；执照发放前阶段

e.en: Applicants must complete a {prelicense} training course.
e.zh: 申请人必须完成执照发放前的培训课程。

e.en: The agency reviewed all {prelicense} documents carefully.
e.zh: 该机构仔细审查了所有许可前文件。

e.en: The philosopher speculated about consciousness in {prelife}.
e.zh: 这位哲学家推测出生前生命中的意识状态。

e.en: The myth describes a soul waiting in {prelife}.
e.zh: 这个神话描写了一个灵魂在前世状态中等待。

e.en: The rules {prelimit} how much each player can spend.
e.zh: 这些规则预先限制了每位玩家可以花费的金额。

e.en: A strict budget may {prelimit} creative choices.
e.zh: 严格的预算可能会事先限制创意选择。

prelingual.t: 语言习得前的；学会说话前的

e.en: The test is designed for {prelingual} children with hearing loss.
e.zh: 这项测试是为学会说话前就有听力损失的儿童设计的。

e.en: Researchers studied {prelingual} communication in infants.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了婴儿在语言习得前的交流方式。

prelinguistics.t: 语言学前阶段；前语言学研究

e.en: The seminar covered {prelinguistics} and early speech development.
e.zh: 研讨课涵盖了语言学前阶段和早期言语发展。

e.en: Her thesis treats {prelinguistics} as a bridge to phonology.
e.zh: 她的论文把前语言学研究视为通向音系学的桥梁。

prelithic.t: 石器时代以前的；用石前的

e.en: The exhibit imagined {prelithic} tools made from bone and wood.
e.zh: 展览设想了石器时代以前用骨头和木头制成的工具。

e.en: Some scholars debate whether a {prelithic} culture can be identified.
e.zh: 一些学者争论是否能识别出用石前的文化。

e.en: The survey recorded wildlife during the {prelogging} phase.
e.zh: 调查在采伐前阶段记录了野生动物情况。

e.en: Good {prelogging} planning reduces damage to nearby streams.
e.zh: 良好的伐木前准备能减少对附近溪流的破坏。

e.en: The composer added a {preludial} passage before the aria.
e.zh: 作曲家在咏叹调前加了一段序曲性质的乐段。

e.en: His remarks had a {preludial} quality before the main argument.
e.zh: 在主要论证之前，他的发言带有前奏性质。

e.en: The essay opens with a {preludious} meditation on silence.
e.zh: 这篇文章以一段像前奏般的沉思开头，主题是沉默。

e.en: Her {preludious} remarks prepared the audience for the debate.
e.zh: 她引入性的发言让听众为接下来的辩论做好准备。

premillenarian.t: 千禧年前论者；前千禧年派的

e.en: The {premillenarian} preacher expected history to end soon.
e.zh: 那位千禧年前论传道人认为历史很快会终结。

e.en: Her essay analyzes {premillenarian} hopes in early Protestant groups.
e.zh: 她的文章分析早期新教团体中的前千禧年派盼望。

premillenarianism.t: 千禧年前论；前千禧年主义

e.en: {Premillenarianism} shaped his reading of the Book of Revelation.
e.zh: 千禧年前论影响了他对《启示录》的解读。

e.en: The lecture compared {premillenarianism} with other Christian end-time beliefs.
e.zh: 讲座把前千禧年主义与其他基督教末世信仰作了比较。

premillennial.t: 前千禧年的；千禧年前论的

e.en: They held a {premillennial} view of Christ's return.
e.zh: 他们持有基督再临发生在千禧年之前的观点。

e.en: The novel borrows imagery from {premillennial} prophecy.
e.zh: 这部小说借用了前千禧年预言中的意象。

premillennialism.t: 前千禧年主义；千禧年前论

e.en: {Premillennialism} became influential in several evangelical churches.
e.zh: 前千禧年主义在一些福音派教会中变得很有影响力。

e.en: The historian traced {premillennialism} through nineteenth-century sermons.
e.zh: 历史学家从十九世纪的布道中追溯千禧年前论的发展。

premillennialist.t: 前千禧年主义者；前千禧年派的

e.en: A {premillennialist} might read the passage as a future event.
e.zh: 前千禧年主义者可能会把这段经文理解为未来事件。

e.en: The article challenged several {premillennialist} assumptions.
e.zh: 这篇文章质疑了若干前千禧年派的假设。

e.en: He interpreted the prophecy {premillennially}.
e.zh: 他按前千禧年主义来解释这则预言。

e.en: The church's teaching was framed {premillennially} in those years.
e.zh: 那些年里，教会的教导以千禧年前论的方式来阐述。

e.en: The argument rests on a doubtful {premis}.
e.zh: 这个论证建立在一个可疑的前提上。

e.en: She rejected the whole {premis} of the question.
e.zh: 她否定了这个问题的整个假定。

e.en: The clerk was told to {premit} the notice before the hearing.
e.zh: 办事员被要求在听证会前预先发出通知。

e.en: Old legal forms sometimes {premit} a warning to the debtor.
e.zh: 旧式法律文书有时会提前向债务人发出警告。

premium-class.t: 高端级别的；优质舱等的

e.en: The airline added more {premium-class} seats on long routes.
e.zh: 这家航空公司在长途航线上增加了更多高端舱位。

e.en: They sell {premium-class} coffee machines for small offices.
e.zh: 他们销售面向小型办公室的高端级咖啡机。

e.en: In "cold water," "cold" is a {premodifier}.
e.zh: 在“cold water”中，“cold”是前置修饰语。

e.en: The grammar book explains how a {premodifier} changes a noun phrase.
e.zh: 这本语法书解释前置修饰语如何改变名词短语。

e.en: The dentist found a cavity in my upper {premolar}.
e.zh: 牙医发现我的上前磨牙有一个蛀洞。

e.en: A {premolar} sits between a canine and a molar.
e.zh: 前磨牙位于犬齿和磨牙之间。

e.en: The captain tried to {premonish} the crew about the storm.
e.zh: 船长试图预先告诫船员暴风雨将至。

e.en: Ancient writers often {premonish} readers before describing disaster.
e.zh: 古代作者在描写灾难前常常先警告读者。

e.en: His letter served as a {premonishment} of harder times ahead.
e.zh: 他的信起到了预先警告艰难时期将至的作用。

e.en: The judge's {premonishment} was ignored by the reckless witness.
e.zh: 法官的事先告诫被那名鲁莽的证人无视了。

e.en: The tremor was a {premonitor} of the larger quake.
e.zh: 这次震动是更大地震的预兆。

e.en: In the tale, the old servant acts as a {premonitor}.
e.zh: 在故事中，那位老仆人充当了预先警告者。

premonitorily.t: 以预警方式；带告诫意味地

e.en: She raised her hand {premonitorily} before the debate grew heated.
e.zh: 辩论变得激烈前，她带着警示意味举起了手。

e.en: The clouds gathered {premonitorily} over the valley.
e.zh: 云层带着不祥预兆聚集在山谷上空。

e.en: The beam passed through a {premonochromator} before reaching the sample.
e.zh: 光束在到达样品前先通过预单色器。

e.en: Engineers adjusted the {premonochromator} to reduce unwanted wavelengths.
e.zh: 工程师调节前置单色仪以减少不需要的波长。

e.en: The botanist noted the leaf's {premorse} tip.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到叶尖呈像被咬掉的形状。

e.en: A {premorse} root can look abruptly cut off.
e.zh: 端部残缺状的根看起来可能像突然被截断。

e.en: The report described his {premortuary} symptoms in detail.
e.zh: 报告详细描述了他临终前的症状。

e.en: She studied {premortuary} rituals in several rural communities.
e.zh: 她研究了几个农村社区中的死前仪式。

e.en: The hospital opened a new unit for each fragile {premter}.
e.zh: 医院为每个脆弱的早产儿开设了新的护理单元。

e.en: A {premter} may need help breathing after birth.
e.zh: 早产儿出生后可能需要呼吸支持。

e.en: The shader performs several {premultiplications} before blending colors.
e.zh: 着色器在混合颜色前执行几次预乘法运算。

e.en: Matrix {premultiplications} changed the order of the transformations.
e.zh: 矩阵预先相乘改变了变换的顺序。

premundane.t: 创世以前的；世界形成前的

e.en: The poem imagines a {premundane} silence before creation.
e.zh: 这首诗想象了创世以前的一片寂静。

e.en: His theology speaks of a {premundane} divine plan.
e.zh: 他的神学谈到一个世界形成前的神圣计划。

e.en: The vaccine may {premune} animals against a later infection.
e.zh: 这种疫苗可能使动物对后续感染预先具备免疫力。

e.en: Old medical texts used {premune} to mean protect beforehand.
e.zh: 旧医学文本用premune表示预先保护。

e.en: Careful hygiene offered some {premunition} against infection.
e.zh: 细致的卫生措施对感染提供了一定预防。

e.en: The doctrine treated grace as a form of {premunition}.
e.zh: 这一教义把恩典视为一种预先防护。

e.en: The doctor recommended {premunitory} treatment before the trip.
e.zh: 医生建议旅行前进行预防性治疗。

e.en: Their walls had a {premunitory} purpose, not merely a decorative one.
e.zh: 他们的城墙有预先防护的用途，并不只是装饰。

e.en: She bought a {preowned} car from a trusted dealer.
e.zh: 她从一家可靠的经销商那里买了一辆二手车。

e.en: The shop sells {preowned} watches with a one-year warranty.
e.zh: 这家店出售带一年保修的二手手表。

e.en: He won a scholarship to a famous {prep-school}.
e.zh: 他获得奖学金，进入一所著名预备学校。

e.en: The novel satirizes {prep-school} manners and privilege.
e.zh: 这部小说讽刺了私立中学的礼仪和特权。

e.en: The factory will {prepack} the meals before delivery.
e.zh: 工厂会在配送前把餐食预先包装好。

e.en: Campaign staff tried to {prepack} every answer for the candidate.
e.zh: 竞选团队试图为候选人预先安排好每个回答。

e.en: They {prepackage} the snacks in small paper bags.
e.zh: 他们把零食预先装进小纸袋里。

e.en: The agency likes to {prepackage} stories for easy publicity.
e.zh: 这家机构喜欢把故事预先包装好，方便宣传。

e.en: The company {prepackages} software with basic security tools.
e.zh: 这家公司把软件和基础安全工具预先打包在一起。

e.en: The course {prepackages} difficult ideas into simple lessons.
e.zh: 这门课程把复杂概念预先整理成简单课程。

e.en: The team held a {preparative} meeting before negotiations began.
e.zh: 谈判开始前，团队举行了一次准备性会议。

e.en: The chemist used a {preparative} method to isolate the compound.
e.zh: 化学家采用制备方法分离出这种化合物。

e.en: A museum {preparator} repaired the damaged fossil display.
e.zh: 一名博物馆标本制作员修复了受损的化石展品。

e.en: The laboratory {preparator} arranged the samples before class.
e.zh: 实验室制备员在上课前整理好了样本。

e.en: The documents were reviewed {preparatorily} before the hearing.
e.zh: 听证会前，这些文件已作为准备进行审阅。

e.en: She spoke {preparatorily} about the risks ahead.
e.zh: 她预先谈到了接下来可能出现的风险。

e.en: The study examined {preparental} attitudes toward childcare.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了为人父母前对育儿的态度。

e.en: They attended a {preparental} class at the clinic.
e.zh: 他们在诊所参加了一门准父母课程。

e.en: Thou {preparest} a place for the weary traveler.
e.zh: 你为疲惫的旅人预备了一个地方。

e.en: In the old hymn, God {preparest} comfort for the faithful.
e.zh: 在那首古老赞美诗中，上帝为信徒预备安慰。

prepayable.t: 可预付的；可提前还款的

e.en: The loan is {prepayable} without any penalty.
e.zh: 这笔贷款可以提前偿还且不收罚金。

e.en: Some fees are {prepayable} at the time of booking.
e.zh: 有些费用可在预订时预先支付。

e.en: Please {prepend} the country code to each phone number.
e.zh: 请在每个电话号码前加上国家代码。

e.en: The script will {prepend} a timestamp to every log entry.
e.zh: 脚本会在每条日志前加上时间戳。

e.en: The court described the attack as malice {prepense}.
e.zh: 法院称这次袭击带有预谋恶意。

e.en: His decision was {prepense}, not a sudden impulse.
e.zh: 他的决定是事先考虑过的，并非一时冲动。

e.en: The act was carried out {prepensely}, according to prosecutors.
e.zh: 检方称，这一行为是蓄意实施的。

e.en: He spoke {prepensely}, choosing each word with care.
e.zh: 他说话经过深思熟虑，字字斟酌。

e.en: The {preplacement} of equipment saved time during filming.
e.zh: 设备的预先安置为拍摄节省了时间。

e.en: The school offers {preplacement} counseling before internships begin.
e.zh: 实习开始前，学校提供预先岗位咨询。

e.en: We need to {preplan} the route before the storm arrives.
e.zh: 暴风雨来临前，我们需要提前规划路线。

e.en: Good managers {preplan} for delays and supply problems.
e.zh: 优秀的管理者会预先考虑延误和供应问题。

e.en: The robbery seemed carefully {preplanned}.
e.zh: 这起抢劫案似乎是精心预谋的。

e.en: They followed a {preplanned} schedule during the conference.
e.zh: 会议期间他们按照预先安排好的日程进行。

e.en: Careful {preplanning} made the move less stressful.
e.zh: 周密的预先规划让搬家没那么紧张。

e.en: Disaster teams rely on {preplanning} for quick responses.
e.zh: 救灾团队依靠提前规划来快速应对。

e.en: Farmers applied a {preplant} fertilizer to the field.
e.zh: 农民在田里施用了种植前肥料。

e.en: They will {preplant} seedlings before the rainy season.
e.zh: 他们会在雨季前预先栽种幼苗。

e.en: The {preplanting} treatment helped the seeds germinate faster.
e.zh: 种植前处理帮助种子更快发芽。

e.en: Workers began {preplanting} trees along the new road.
e.zh: 工人开始在新路旁预先栽种树木。

e.en: The report showed a {preponderancy} of evidence against him.
e.zh: 报告显示，不利于他的证据占明显优势。

e.en: There was a {preponderancy} of older voters in the district.
e.zh: 该选区年长选民占多数。

e.en: The committee voted {preponderatingly} in favor of reform.
e.zh: 委员会以压倒性多数投票支持改革。

e.en: The evidence was {preponderatingly} circumstantial, but still persuasive.
e.zh: 证据主要是间接证据，但仍有说服力。

e.en: A {preponderation} of data supports the new theory.
e.zh: 大量占优势的数据支持这一新理论。

e.en: The {preponderation} of opinion favored a cautious policy.
e.zh: 多数意见倾向于采取谨慎政策。

e.en: Can we {prepone} the meeting to Monday morning?
e.zh: 我们能把会议提前到周一上午吗？

e.en: The airline decided to {prepone} the flight because of bad weather.
e.zh: 由于天气恶劣，航空公司决定把航班提前。

prepubertal.t: 青春期前的儿童发育阶段

e.en: The study followed {prepubertal} children for three years.
e.zh: 这项研究跟踪了青春期前儿童三年。

e.en: Doctors checked whether the symptoms were normal for a {prepubertal} boy.
e.zh: 医生检查这些症状对青春期前男孩是否正常。

e.en: Nutrition during {prepuberty} can affect later growth.
e.zh: 青春期前的营养会影响之后的生长。

e.en: Her height increased slowly throughout {prepuberty}.
e.zh: 她在青春期前阶段身高增长较慢。

e.en: The disorder is often noticed in {prepubescence}.
e.zh: 这种疾病常在青春期前期被发现。

e.en: Children in {prepubescence} may still show very different growth patterns.
e.zh: 处于青春期前期的儿童仍可能呈现很不同的生长模式。

e.en: The author received {prepublication} reviews from several experts.
e.zh: 作者收到了几位专家的出版前评审意见。

e.en: A {prepublication} copy was sent to journalists.
e.zh: 一本出版前样书被寄给了记者。

e.en: The doctor examined the {prepuce} for signs of infection.
e.zh: 医生检查包皮是否有感染迹象。

e.en: In anatomy, the {prepuce} can refer to tissue around the clitoris.
e.zh: 在解剖学中，prepuce 也可指阴蒂周围的包皮组织。

e.en: The engineers used {prepulsing} to stabilize the laser output.
e.zh: 工程师使用预脉冲处理来稳定激光输出。

e.en: {Prepulsing} the circuit reduced the initial voltage spike.
e.zh: 对电路进行预脉冲处理降低了初始电压尖峰。

e.en: The technician ran the {prepump} cycle before starting the main system.
e.zh: 技术员在启动主系统前运行了预泵送循环。

e.en: A small {prepump} removes air from the chamber.
e.zh: 一个小型预泵会把腔室里的空气抽走。

e.en: The machine requires {prepurging} before the gas is introduced.
e.zh: 在通入气体前，机器需要进行预吹扫。

e.en: {Prepurging} the lines helped prevent contamination.
e.zh: 预先清除管线有助于防止污染。

e.en: The sample underwent {prepurification} before detailed analysis.
e.zh: 样品在详细分析前经过了预纯化。

e.en: A simple filter was used for {prepurification} of the water.
e.zh: 他们用一个简单过滤器对水进行初步净化。

e.en: The scan showed a lesion in the {prepyloric} region.
e.zh: 扫描显示幽门前区域有一处病灶。

e.en: Surgeons inspected the {prepyloric} part of the stomach.
e.zh: 外科医生检查了胃的幽门前部位。

prepyrogen.t: 致热原前体；产热前物质

e.en: Researchers measured {prepyrogen} levels in the tissue sample.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了组织样本中的致热原前体水平。

e.en: The compound may act as a {prepyrogen} under inflammatory conditions.
e.zh: 该化合物在炎症条件下可能作为致热原前体发挥作用。

e.en: Only {prequalified} contractors may bid on the project.
e.zh: 只有已通过预审的承包商才能竞标该项目。

e.en: She was {prequalified} for a mortgage before house hunting.
e.zh: 她在看房前已获得房贷预先资格。

e.en: The bank will {prequalify} buyers before approving a loan.
e.zh: 银行会在批准贷款前预先审核买家的资格。

e.en: Companies must {prequalify} to join the tender process.
e.zh: 公司必须先通过资格预审才能参加招标流程。

e.en: The alloy was treated with {prequenching} before final hardening.
e.zh: 这种合金在最终硬化前进行了预淬火处理。

e.en: {Prequenching} the reaction reduced unwanted side products.
e.zh: 预先猝灭反应减少了不需要的副产物。

e.en: Basic algebra is a {prequisite} for this course.
e.zh: 基础代数是这门课的先决条件。

e.en: The manager treated safety training as a {prequisite} for the job.
e.zh: 经理把安全培训视为上岗的前提要求。

e.en: The philosopher described myth as a {prerational} way of explaining nature.
e.zh: 这位哲学家把神话描述为解释自然的前理性方式。

e.en: Some reactions come from a {prerational} layer of fear.
e.zh: 有些反应来自恐惧中尚未经过理性处理的层面。

e.en: The catalyst was activated by {prereducing} it in hydrogen.
e.zh: 催化剂通过在氢气中预还原而被活化。

e.en: {Prereducing} the data made the final analysis faster.
e.zh: 预先缩减数据使最终分析更快。

e.en: Participants must {preregister} online before the conference.
e.zh: 参会者必须在会前在线预先注册。

e.en: Researchers often {preregister} their hypotheses to improve transparency.
e.zh: 研究人员常预先登记假设，以提高透明度。

e.en: Online {preregistration} closes two days before the event.
e.zh: 在线预登记在活动前两天截止。

e.en: The journal encourages {preregistration} of clinical trials.
e.zh: 该期刊鼓励临床试验进行预先注册。

e.en: Newtonian mechanics belongs to a {prerelativistic} view of physics.
e.zh: 牛顿力学属于相对论以前的物理观。

e.en: The paper compares relativistic and {prerelativistic} models of motion.
e.zh: 论文比较了相对论模型和相对论以前的运动模型。

e.en: Fans tested the {prerelease} version of the game.
e.zh: 粉丝试玩了这款游戏的预发行版本。

e.en: The studio held a {prerelease} screening for critics.
e.zh: 制片方为影评人举行了上映前放映。

e.en: You should {preroast} the vegetables before adding them to the soup.
e.zh: 把蔬菜加入汤里之前，应该先烘烤一下。

e.en: The factory uses a {preroast} step to improve the flavor of the beans.
e.zh: 工厂采用预烘焙步骤来改善豆子的风味。

e.en: The software applies {prerotation} before aligning the images.
e.zh: 软件在对齐图像前会先进行预旋转。

e.en: Students complete {prerotation} training before entering the clinic.
e.zh: 学生进入诊所实习轮转前要完成轮转前培训。

e.en: The crisis was {presageable} from the early warning signs.
e.zh: 从早期警讯来看，这场危机是可以预见的。

e.en: A change in tone made the ending {presageable}.
e.zh: 语气的变化让结局变得可以预示。

e.en: Poets sometimes {prepose} adjectives for emphasis.
e.zh: 诗人有时会把形容词前置以加强语气。

e.en: The editor asked him to {prepose} the clause.
e.zh: 编辑让他把这个从句放到前面。

e.en: English usually has {prepositive} adjectives before nouns.
e.zh: 英语通常把前置形容词放在名词前。

e.en: The grammar note explains the {prepositive} modifier.
e.zh: 这条语法说明解释了置于前面的修饰语。

prepositively.t: 以前置方式；放在前面地

e.en: The adjective is used {prepositively} in this phrase.
e.zh: 这个形容词在该短语中以前置方式使用。

e.en: Some modifiers appear {prepositively} only in formal style.
e.zh: 有些修饰语只在正式文体中放在前面。

e.en: The linguist called the moved word a {prepositor}.
e.zh: 这位语言学家把被移到前面的词称为前置成分。

e.en: In the old analysis, the {prepositor} carried emphasis.
e.zh: 在旧式分析中，这个前置成分带有强调作用。

e.en: Her calm manner can {prepossess} interviewers in her favor.
e.zh: 她沉着的举止会让面试官先对她有好感。

e.en: Early praise may {prepossess} readers before they judge the book.
e.zh: 早期赞誉可能会让读者在评价此书前先入为主。

prepossessed.t: 先入为主的；已被吸引的

e.en: He seemed {prepossessed} against the proposal from the start.
e.zh: 他从一开始似乎就对这项提议抱有成见。

e.en: The audience was {prepossessed} by her confident entrance.
e.zh: 观众被她自信的登场先声夺人地吸引住了。

e.en: A polished cover {prepossesses} many casual buyers.
e.zh: 精致的封面会先吸引许多随手购买的人。

e.en: His reputation {prepossesses} critics before the debate begins.
e.zh: 他的名声在辩论开始前就让评论者先入为主。

e.en: Her {prepossession} in favor of tradition shaped the review.
e.zh: 她偏爱传统的先入之见影响了这篇评论。

e.en: He felt an immediate {prepossession} toward the quiet village.
e.zh: 他立刻对这个安静的村庄产生了预先的好感。

e.en: The school appointed a senior boy as {prepostor}.
e.zh: 学校任命一名高年级男生担任级长。

e.en: A {prepostor} checked the dormitory after lights out.
e.zh: 熄灯后，一名学生监督员检查了宿舍。

e.en: The sire's {prepotency} showed in every young horse.
e.zh: 这匹种马的遗传优势在每匹幼马身上都显现出来。

e.en: The empire's cultural {prepotency} shaped neighboring courts.
e.zh: 这个帝国的文化支配力影响了周边宫廷。

e.en: A {prepotent} idea can dominate a whole generation.
e.zh: 一个占优势的观念可能支配整整一代人。

e.en: Breeders valued the {prepotent} stallion for stable traits.
e.zh: 育种者看重这匹遗传力强的种马，因为其性状稳定。

e.en: The theory assumes a {prepotential} state before action begins.
e.zh: 该理论假定行动开始前存在一种预先潜在的状态。

e.en: Researchers measured {prepotential} signals in the motor cortex.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了运动皮层中的前潜能信号。

e.en: The old custom acted {prepotently} on village life.
e.zh: 旧习俗以支配性的方式影响着村庄生活。

e.en: That line breeds {prepotently} for size and stamina.
e.zh: 这一血系在体型和耐力方面表现出很强的遗传优势。

e.en: He dressed like a {preppie} in loafers and a blazer.
e.zh: 他穿着乐福鞋和西装外套，像个学院风青年。

e.en: The novel mocks a wealthy {preppie} from New England.
e.zh: 这部小说嘲讽了一位来自新英格兰的富家预科生。

e.en: The doctor checked her {preprandial} blood sugar.
e.zh: 医生检查了她的餐前血糖。

e.en: They enjoyed a brief {preprandial} walk by the river.
e.zh: 他们饭前在河边短暂散了个步。

e.en: The survey recorded each buyer's {prepreference} before testing.
e.zh: 调查在测试前记录了每位买家的预先偏好。

e.en: Her {prepreference} changed once she saw the real samples.
e.zh: 她看到真实样品后，原先的初步倾向改变了。

e.en: The child read a simple {preprimer} before first grade.
e.zh: 这个孩子在上一年级前读了一本简单的启蒙读本。

e.en: Teachers used the {preprimer} to introduce common words.
e.zh: 老师用这本预备教材介绍常见词。

e.en: The researchers posted a {preprint} before peer review.
e.zh: 研究人员在同行评审前发布了预印本。

e.en: The publisher will {preprint} the forms for the conference.
e.zh: 出版社会为会议预先印好这些表格。

e.en: She joined a {preprofessional} program for future lawyers.
e.zh: 她参加了一个面向未来律师的职业预备项目。

e.en: The dancer received {preprofessional} training as a teenager.
e.zh: 这名舞者十几岁时接受过专业前训练。

e.en: The cell first produces a larger {preprohormone}.
e.zh: 细胞首先产生一种更大的前激素原。

e.en: Enzymes later cut the {preprohormone} into active hormones.
e.zh: 酶随后把前激素原切割成活性激素。

e.en: Beta cells synthesize {preproinsulin} before making insulin.
e.zh: β细胞在制造胰岛素前会合成前胰岛素原。

e.en: A mutation in {preproinsulin} can disrupt hormone processing.
e.zh: 前胰岛素原中的突变可能破坏激素加工过程。

e.en: The lawyer relied on facts already {preproved} in court.
e.zh: 律师依靠的是法庭上已经预先证明的事实。

e.en: Only {preproved} claims were included in the final report.
e.zh: 最终报告只纳入了预先得到证明的主张。

e.en: The young {prepster} wore a striped tie to class.
e.zh: 那个年轻预科生系着条纹领带去上课。

e.en: She styled the character as a polished {prepster}.
e.zh: 她把这个角色塑造成讲究的学院风人士。

e.en: Clinicians watched for {prepsychotic} changes in his behavior.
e.zh: 临床医生留意他行为中精神病发作前的变化。

e.en: The study focused on {prepsychotic} symptoms in adolescents.
e.zh: 这项研究关注青少年的精神病发作前症状。

e.en: The editor sent a {prepub} copy to reviewers.
e.zh: 编辑把出版前样书寄给了评论者。

e.en: Bookstores can order titles from the {prepub} catalog.
e.zh: 书店可以从预出版目录中订购书目。

e.en: The engineer recommended {presedimentation} before filtration.
e.zh: 工程师建议在过滤前先进行预沉降。

e.en: {Presedimentation} reduced the amount of mud entering the tanks.
e.zh: 预沉降减少了进入水箱的泥沙量。

e.en: The study used a {preselective} screening process.
e.zh: 这项研究采用了预先筛选的流程。

e.en: A {preselective} bias shaped the final sample.
e.zh: 一种预选偏差影响了最终样本。

e.en: They tried to {presell} tickets before announcing the lineup.
e.zh: 他们想在公布阵容前预售门票。

e.en: The pitch helped {presell} the idea to investors.
e.zh: 这次推介帮助投资者预先接受了这个想法。

e.en: The patient showed {presenile} memory loss.
e.zh: 这名患者出现了早老性记忆衰退。

e.en: Doctors discussed possible {presenile} dementia.
e.zh: 医生讨论了可能的早老性痴呆。

e.en: The report linked the symptoms to {presenility}.
e.zh: 报告把这些症状与早老衰退联系起来。

e.en: {Presenility} was once used as a broad medical label.
e.zh: 早老曾被用作一个宽泛的医学标签。

e.en: {Present-day} cities depend on complex transport networks.
e.zh: 当今城市依赖复杂的交通网络。

e.en: The ruins stand inside {present-day} Turkey.
e.zh: 这些遗址位于今天的土耳其境内。

e.en: She worried about the room's {presentability}.
e.zh: 她担心这个房间是否够体面。

e.en: The editor improved the manuscript's {presentability}.
e.zh: 编辑提高了稿件的可展示性。

e.en: He dressed {presentably} for the interview.
e.zh: 他为了面试穿得很体面。

e.en: The report was {presentably} formatted but thin on evidence.
e.zh: 这份报告格式像样，但证据不足。

e.en: The essay criticizes {presentationism} in modern politics.
e.zh: 这篇文章批评现代政治中的表现主义。

e.en: His theory of perception was a form of {presentationism}.
e.zh: 他的知觉理论是一种表象论。

e.en: The lecture described a {presentative} function of language.
e.zh: 讲座描述了语言的一种呈现功能。

e.en: She rejected the merely {presentative} role of the image.
e.zh: 她拒绝把图像只看作表象性的角色。

e.en: Each {presentee} received a small certificate.
e.zh: 每位受赠者都收到了一张小证书。

e.en: The manager counted every {presentee} at the meeting.
e.zh: 经理清点了会议上的每位出席者。

e.en: The company tracked {presenteeism} after flu season.
e.zh: 公司在流感季后追踪带病上班现象。

e.en: Remote work reduced some forms of {presenteeism}.
e.zh: 远程办公减少了某些低效出勤现象。

e.en: The judge ordered a {presentence} investigation.
e.zh: 法官下令进行判刑前调查。

e.en: His lawyer submitted a {presentence} memorandum.
e.zh: 他的律师提交了一份宣判前备忘录。

e.en: She felt strangely {presentient} before the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨前，她有一种奇怪的预感。

e.en: The poem has a {presentient} sense of disaster.
e.zh: 这首诗带着一种预知灾难的感觉。

e.en: A {presentimental} unease filled the room.
e.zh: 房间里弥漫着一种带预兆感的不安。

e.en: His {presentimental} warning later seemed accurate.
e.zh: 他那带有预感的警告后来显得很准确。

e.en: Historians warned against {presentism} in judging the past.
e.zh: 历史学家告诫不要用现在主义评判过去。

e.en: In philosophy, {presentism} says only the present exists.
e.zh: 在哲学中，现在主义认为只有当下存在。

presentist.t: 现在主义者；现在主义的

e.en: A {presentist} reading can distort ancient customs.
e.zh: 现在主义的解读会扭曲古代习俗。

e.en: The philosopher defended a {presentist} view of time.
e.zh: 这位哲学家为现在主义的时间观辩护。

e.en: The symbol has a {presentive} force in the ritual.
e.zh: 这个符号在仪式中具有呈现力量。

e.en: Her prose is more {presentive} than explanatory.
e.zh: 她的散文更偏呈现，而不是解释。

e.en: Salt improves the {preservability} of the fish.
e.zh: 盐提高了鱼的可保存性。

e.en: Archivists tested the paper's long-term {preservability}.
e.zh: 档案员测试了这种纸的长期保存能力。

e.en: Only a few documents were still {preservable}.
e.zh: 只有少数文件仍然可以保存。

e.en: The wetland is fragile but {preservable}.
e.zh: 这片湿地很脆弱，但仍可保护。

e.en: The law supported the {preserval} of historic sites.
e.zh: 这项法律支持历史遗址的保护。

e.en: Food {preserval} was essential during the voyage.
e.zh: 航行期间，食物保存至关重要。

e.en: The campaign tried to {preservatize} local culture.
e.zh: 这场运动试图使当地文化保守化。

e.en: Factories began to {preservatize} fruit for export.
e.zh: 工厂开始给出口水果作防腐处理。

e.en: The museum hired a skilled {preservator}.
e.zh: 博物馆聘请了一位熟练的文物保存者。

e.en: He saw himself as a {preservator} of tradition.
e.zh: 他把自己视为传统的保护人。

e.en: They applied a {preservatory} coating to the wood.
e.zh: 他们给木材涂上了保护性涂层。

e.en: The policy had a mainly {preservatory} purpose.
e.zh: 这项政策主要具有保护性的目的。

e.en: The dark clouds gave the morning a {presageful} air.
e.zh: 乌云让这个早晨显得不祥，仿佛有所预兆。

e.en: Her {presageful} silence worried everyone in the room.
e.zh: 她那带有预兆意味的沉默让屋里所有人都担心。

e.en: The sudden chill felt like a {presagement} of trouble.
e.zh: 突如其来的寒意像是麻烦将至的预兆。

e.en: Ancient writers treated eclipses as a {presagement} of disaster.
e.zh: 古代作家把日食视为灾难的预示。

e.en: Tickets are cheaper during the {presale} period.
e.zh: 门票在预售期间会便宜一些。

e.en: The company improved its {presale} support for new clients.
e.zh: 公司改善了面向新客户的售前支持。

e.en: The priest used {presanctified} gifts during the service.
e.zh: 神父在礼拜中使用了预先祝圣的圣物。

e.en: The {presanctified} bread was kept for a special rite.
e.zh: 预先祝圣的面包被留作特殊仪式使用。

e.en: The technician mounted the circuit on a {presboard}.
e.zh: 技术员把电路安装在一块预装板上。

e.en: A thin {presboard} protected the package during shipping.
e.zh: 一块薄预制板在运输中保护了包裹。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed her hearing loss as {presbycusis}.
e.zh: 医生诊断她的听力下降为老年性听力减退。

e.en: Many older adults develop {presbycusis} gradually.
e.zh: 许多老年人会逐渐出现老年性听力减退。

e.en: A {presbyope} may need glasses for reading.
e.zh: 老花眼患者可能需要戴眼镜阅读。

e.en: The optician explained why a {presbyope} struggles with small print.
e.zh: 验光师解释了老花眼患者为何看小字吃力。

e.en: The old term {presbyophrenia} appears in historical psychiatry texts.
e.zh: presbyophrenia这个旧术语出现在精神病学史料中，指老年性精神错乱。

e.en: Doctors no longer commonly diagnose patients with {presbyophrenia}.
e.zh: 医生如今已不常用老年性精神错乱这个诊断名。

e.en: He became {presbyopic} in his late forties.
e.zh: 他四十多岁后开始有老花眼。

e.en: The lenses are designed for {presbyopic} readers.
e.zh: 这些镜片是为老花眼读者设计的。

e.en: The village {presbyte} led the evening prayers.
e.zh: 村里的长老主持了晚祷。

e.en: In older church records, a {presbyte} often meant a priest.
e.zh: 在较早的教会记录中，presbyte常指司祭。

e.en: The bishop praised the council's {presbyteral} wisdom.
e.zh: 主教称赞议会中长老们的智慧。

e.en: He received his {presbyteral} duties after ordination.
e.zh: 他受任后承担了司祭职责。

e.en: He entered the {presbyterate} after years of study.
e.zh: 经过多年学习后，他进入了司祭职。

e.en: The bishop met with the local {presbyterate} on Monday.
e.zh: 主教周一会见了当地长老团。

e.en: The church followed a {presbyterial} form of government.
e.zh: 这座教会采用长老会式的治理形式。

e.en: The document described several {presbyterial} responsibilities.
e.zh: 文件说明了几项司祭职责。

e.en: His {presbytership} lasted for nearly thirty years.
e.zh: 他的长老职位持续了近三十年。

e.en: The ceremony marked her formal entry into {presbytership}.
e.zh: 这场仪式标志着她正式取得长老身份。

e.en: The engineer adjusted the {prescaler} to slow the clock signal.
e.zh: 工程师调整预分频器来降低时钟信号速度。

e.en: A camera chip may use a {prescaler} before image processing.
e.zh: 相机芯片在图像处理前可能会使用预缩放器。

prescientific.t: 科学出现前的；前科学的

e.en: The book examines {prescientific} ideas about disease.
e.zh: 这本书研究了科学出现前人们对疾病的看法。

e.en: His argument relies on {prescientific} assumptions about nature.
e.zh: 他的论证依赖于前科学时代对自然的假设。

e.en: We must {prescind} personal feelings from the legal question.
e.zh: 我们必须把个人感情从法律问题中撇开。

e.en: The philosopher tried to {prescind} form from matter.
e.zh: 这位哲学家试图把形式从物质中抽离出来考虑。

e.en: The report {prescinds} politics from the economic data.
e.zh: 这份报告把政治因素从经济数据中撇开。

e.en: Her analysis {prescinds} intention from actual harm.
e.zh: 她的分析把意图与实际伤害分开考虑。

e.en: Teachers {prescore} the essays before the final review.
e.zh: 教师们在最终评审前先给作文预评分。

e.en: The software assigns a {prescore} to each application.
e.zh: 软件会给每份申请先分配一个预评分。

e.en: The law read like a strict {prescript} for public behavior.
e.zh: 这条法律读起来像是对公共行为的严格规定。

e.en: The physician wrote a {prescript} in formal Latin.
e.zh: 医生用正式拉丁文写下了一张处方。

e.en: The lawyer discussed the {prescriptibility} of the property claim.
e.zh: 律师讨论了该财产权利请求能否因时效取得。

e.en: Roman law shaped later ideas of {prescriptibility}.
e.zh: 罗马法影响了后来关于时效取得性质的观念。

e.en: The court held that the easement was {prescriptible}.
e.zh: 法院认定该地役权可以因时效取得。

e.en: Some rights are not {prescriptible} under local law.
e.zh: 根据当地法律，有些权利不能因时效取得。

prescriptivism.t: 规范主义；语言规定主义

e.en: Linguists often contrast {prescriptivism} with descriptivism.
e.zh: 语言学家常把语言规定主义与描写主义相对照。

e.en: His grammar column defended strict {prescriptivism}.
e.zh: 他的语法专栏为严格的规范主义辩护。

prescriptivist.t: 规范主义者；语言规定主义者

e.en: A {prescriptivist} may object to split infinitives.
e.zh: 语言规定主义者可能会反对分裂不定式。

e.en: The editor sounded like a strict {prescriptivist}.
e.zh: 这位编辑听起来像个严格的规范主义者。

e.en: The ambassador claimed {preseance} at the formal dinner.
e.zh: 大使在正式晚宴上主张自己的席次优先权。

e.en: Court etiquette carefully regulated {preseance} among nobles.
e.zh: 宫廷礼仪严格规定贵族之间的席次尊卑。

e.en: The biopsy showed many abnormal {premyelocytes} in the marrow.
e.zh: 活检显示骨髓中有许多异常早幼粒细胞。

e.en: A {premyelocyte} develops before becoming a mature granulocyte.
e.zh: 早幼粒细胞会先发育，然后成为成熟的粒细胞。

e.en: The researchers {prename} each sample before testing begins.
e.zh: 研究人员在测试开始前先给每个样本命名。

e.en: Parents sometimes {prename} a child long before birth.
e.zh: 父母有时会在孩子出生很久前就提前取名。

preneural.t: 神经形成前的；神经前期的

e.en: The embryo showed changes in the {preneural} tissue.
e.zh: 胚胎的神经形成前组织出现了变化。

e.en: Scientists studied {preneural} signals during early development.
e.zh: 科学家研究了早期发育中的神经前期信号。

e.en: In Roman naming, the {prenomen} identified the individual.
e.zh: 在罗马命名法中，个人名用来标识具体个人。

e.en: The inscription preserves his family name but not his {prenomen}.
e.zh: 碑文保留了他的家族名，却没有保留他的古罗马个人名。

prenominal.t: 名词前的；置于名词前的

e.en: English adjectives are usually {prenominal} modifiers.
e.zh: 英语形容词通常是置于名词前的修饰语。

e.en: The phrase contains a long {prenominal} sequence before the noun.
e.zh: 这个短语在名词前有一长串前置修饰成分。

e.en: The committee may {prenominate} candidates before the public vote.
e.zh: 委员会可以在公开投票前预先提名候选人。

e.en: They tried to {prenominate} a successor quietly.
e.zh: 他们试图悄悄提前指定一名继任者。

e.en: The rules allow {prenomination} before the formal meeting.
e.zh: 这些规则允许在正式会议前预先提名。

e.en: His {prenomination} caused arguments inside the party.
e.zh: 他的提前提名在党内引发了争议。

e.en: She approached the evidence without any fixed {prenotion}.
e.zh: 她没有带着固定的先入之见去看这些证据。

e.en: The theory rests on a false {prenotion} about language.
e.zh: 这个理论建立在一种关于语言的错误预设概念上。

e.en: The mayor made a {prenouncement} before the report was released.
e.zh: 报告发布前，市长作了提前声明。

e.en: Their {prenouncement} shaped public expectations for the trial.
e.zh: 他们的预先宣布影响了公众对审判的预期。

e.en: Astronomers compared the {prenova} image with later observations.
e.zh: 天文学家把新星爆发前的图像与后来的观测结果进行比较。

e.en: The star's {prenova} brightness was difficult to estimate.
e.zh: 这颗恒星爆发前的亮度很难估算。

e.en: The cell was observed during its {prenuclear} stage.
e.zh: 研究人员在细胞的核形成前阶段进行了观察。

e.en: Some {prenuclear} proteins move rapidly through the cytoplasm.
e.zh: 一些核前蛋白会在细胞质中快速移动。

e.en: The molecule contains a reactive {prenyl} group.
e.zh: 这个分子含有一个活泼的异戊烯基。

e.en: Chemists traced the {prenyl} chain in the natural product.
e.zh: 化学家追踪了这种天然产物中的异戊烯基链。

e.en: The law recognized {preoccupancy} as a claim to the land.
e.zh: 法律承认预先占有可作为对土地的权利主张。

e.en: Their {preoccupancy} of the site complicated later negotiations.
e.zh: 他们对该地点的先占状态使后来的谈判更复杂。

e.en: The first {preoccupant} claimed rights over the cabin.
e.zh: 第一位先占者声称对这间小屋拥有权利。

e.en: Each {preoccupant} had to prove continuous use of the field.
e.zh: 每个预先占有者都必须证明自己持续使用过这块地。

e.en: The lizard has a dark {preocular} scale near the snout.
e.zh: 这只蜥蜴在吻部附近有一片深色眼前鳞。

e.en: The doctor noted mild swelling in the {preocular} area.
e.zh: 医生注意到眼前部位有轻微肿胀。

preoiler.t: 预先加油器；预润滑装置

e.en: The mechanic installed a {preoiler} to protect the engine.
e.zh: 机械师安装了预先加油器来保护发动机。

e.en: A {preoiler} can reduce wear during cold starts.
e.zh: 预润滑装置可以减少冷启动时的磨损。

e.en: Some theories describe a {preon} as smaller than a quark.
e.zh: 有些理论把前子描述为比夸克更小的粒子。

e.en: No experiment has confirmed the existence of a {preon}.
e.zh: 还没有实验确认前子的存在。

e.en: The word {preonunced} appears to be a misspelling in the manuscript.
e.zh: 手稿中的preonunced这个词似乎是拼写错误。

e.en: Editors marked {preonunced} because it was not standard English.
e.zh: 编辑标出了preonunced，因为它不是标准英语。

e.en: The nurse reviewed the {preoperation} checklist with him.
e.zh: 护士和他一起核对了手术前检查清单。

e.en: Careful {preoperation} planning reduced delays in the factory.
e.zh: 周密的操作前规划减少了工厂里的延误。

e.en: The contract gave tenants a {preoption} to buy the house.
e.zh: 合同赋予租户购买这所房子的优先选择权。

e.en: Their {preoption} of the route saved time later.
e.zh: 他们预先选定路线，后来节省了时间。

e.en: The worm has small structures in the {preoral} region.
e.zh: 这种蠕虫在口前区域有一些小结构。

e.en: A {preoral} examination checked the tissues around the lips.
e.zh: 口前部检查查看了嘴唇周围的组织。

e.en: The deer has a visible {preorbital} gland below the eye.
e.zh: 这只鹿眼下有明显的眼眶前腺。

e.en: The scan showed a fracture near the {preorbital} bone.
e.zh: 扫描显示眶前部骨骼附近有一处骨折。

e.en: The doctrine of {preordination} shaped his theology.
e.zh: 预定论影响了他的神学思想。

e.en: She rejected the idea of {preordination} in human choices.
e.zh: 她反对人类选择早已被预先安排的想法。

e.en: Temperature affected the insect's {preoviposition} period.
e.zh: 温度影响了这种昆虫的产卵前期。

e.en: Researchers observed {preoviposition} behavior in the female moths.
e.zh: 研究人员观察了雌蛾的产卵前行为。

e.en: Hormone levels rise during the {preovulatory} phase.
e.zh: 激素水平会在排卵前期上升。

e.en: The doctor measured the {preovulatory} follicle with ultrasound.
e.zh: 医生用超声测量了排卵前的卵泡。

preservice.t: 任职前的；服役前的；职前的

e.en: The college offers {preservice} training for new teachers.
e.zh: 这所学院为新教师提供职前培训。

e.en: All recruits completed a {preservice} medical check.
e.zh: 所有新兵都完成了入伍前体检。

e.en: The committee held a {presession} briefing on Monday.
e.zh: 委员会周一举行了会前简报会。

e.en: Lawyers exchanged documents during the {presession} period.
e.zh: 律师们在开庭前阶段交换了文件。

e.en: The engineer recommended {presettling} the soil before construction.
e.zh: 工程师建议在施工前让土壤预先沉降。

e.en: The agency began {presettling} families near the new site.
e.zh: 该机构开始把家庭预先安置在新地点附近。

presexual.t: 性成熟前的；性发育前的

e.en: The study examined behavior during the {presexual} stage of development.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了性成熟前发育阶段的行为。

e.en: Some symptoms appear in the {presexual} years.
e.zh: 有些症状会在性发育前的几年出现。

e.en: The crew solved most lighting issues during the {preshoot} meeting.
e.zh: 摄制组在拍摄前会议上解决了大多数灯光问题。

e.en: Farmers tested the seeds in the {preshoot} phase.
e.zh: 农民在发芽前阶段检测了种子。

e.en: This {preshrunk} cotton shirt should keep its size.
e.zh: 这件预缩水棉衬衫应该能保持尺码。

e.en: The pattern was printed on {preshrunk} fabric.
e.zh: 这个图案印在预缩水处理过的布料上。

e.en: Her {presidence} over the council lasted two years.
e.zh: 她主持该委员会的工作持续了两年。

e.en: The rules define the judge's {presidence} in court.
e.zh: 这些规则规定了法官在法庭上的主持职责。

e.en: The {president-elect} met foreign leaders before taking office.
e.zh: 当选总统在就职前会见了外国领导人。

e.en: Our club's {president-elect} will announce the new plan tomorrow.
e.zh: 我们俱乐部的候任主席明天会公布新计划。

president-elects.t: 当选总统们；候任主席们

e.en: Several {president-elects} attended the regional forum.
e.zh: 几位候任总统出席了地区论坛。

e.en: The handbook gives advice to new {president-elects}.
e.zh: 这本手册给新任候任主席们提供建议。

e.en: The old charter used {presidentess} for a female president.
e.zh: 旧章程用这个词称呼女性主席。

e.en: She disliked being called a {presidentess}.
e.zh: 她不喜欢别人称她为女总统。

e.en: His {presidentship} changed the direction of the association.
e.zh: 他的主席任期改变了协会的方向。

e.en: The scandal damaged her hopes for the {presidentship}.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻损害了她竞逐总统职位的希望。

presidial.t: 主席的；审判庭的；主管的

e.en: The {presidial} seat was placed at the center of the hall.
e.zh: 主席座位被安排在大厅中央。

e.en: The document described the court's {presidial} powers.
e.zh: 文件说明了该审判庭的主管权力。

e.en: A {presidiary} force guarded the mountain pass.
e.zh: 一支驻防部队守卫着山口。

e.en: The town grew around a {presidiary} fort.
e.zh: 这座城镇围绕一座要塞发展起来。

presignified.t: 预先表明的；预先象征的

e.en: The ritual {presignified} the king's coming authority.
e.zh: 这一仪式预先象征了国王即将拥有的权威。

e.en: Her silence had {presignified} a refusal.
e.zh: 她的沉默早已预示了拒绝。

e.en: Dark clouds can {presignify} a sudden storm.
e.zh: 乌云可能预示一场突如其来的暴风雨。

e.en: The emblem was meant to {presignify} loyalty.
e.zh: 这个徽记本意是预先表示忠诚。

e.en: The candles were {presignifying} hope in the ceremony.
e.zh: 仪式中的蜡烛预先象征着希望。

e.en: His careful tone was {presignifying} bad news.
e.zh: 他谨慎的语气预示着坏消息。

e.en: Technicians {presinter} the ceramic powder before final firing.
e.zh: 技术人员在最终烧制前预先烧结陶瓷粉末。

e.en: The lab used a furnace to {presinter} the samples.
e.zh: 实验室用炉子对样品进行预烧结。

e.en: You should {presoak} the beans overnight.
e.zh: 你应该把豆子提前浸泡一夜。

e.en: This detergent helps {presoak} stained clothes.
e.zh: 这种洗涤剂有助于预浸有污渍的衣物。

e.en: The recipe calls for {presoaked} chickpeas.
e.zh: 这道食谱需要预先浸泡过的鹰嘴豆。

e.en: She washed the {presoaked} sheets in hot water.
e.zh: 她用热水清洗了预先浸泡过的床单。

e.en: {Presoaking} the rice shortens the cooking time.
e.zh: 预先浸泡大米可以缩短烹煮时间。

e.en: The stain faded after two hours of {presoaking}.
e.zh: 经过两个小时的预浸，污渍变淡了。

e.en: She {presoaks} towels before washing them.
e.zh: 她洗毛巾前会先把它们浸泡。

e.en: Different laundry {presoaks} work on different stains.
e.zh: 不同的洗衣预浸剂适用于不同污渍。

e.en: Gas bubbles formed during {presolidification} of the metal.
e.zh: 金属固化前阶段形成了气泡。

e.en: The team measured temperature in the {presolidification} zone.
e.zh: 团队测量了预凝固区域的温度。

e.en: The process includes {presplitting} the logs before drying.
e.zh: 这一流程包括在干燥前预先劈开原木。

e.en: {Presplitting} the data reduced the training time.
e.zh: 预先拆分数据减少了训练时间。

e.en: Reporters watched the match from the {press-box}.
e.zh: 记者们在新闻席观看了比赛。

e.en: The stadium's {press-box} has a clear view of the field.
e.zh: 体育场的记者席能清楚看到球场。

e.en: Press the {press-button} switch to start the machine.
e.zh: 按下这个按钮开关来启动机器。

e.en: The lamp has a simple {press-button} control.
e.zh: 这盏灯有一个简单的按压式控制键。

press-corrector.t: 校样校对员；印刷校正员

e.en: The {press-corrector} caught the missing comma before printing.
e.zh: 印刷前，校样校对员发现了漏掉的逗号。

e.en: A careful {press-corrector} could save the whole edition.
e.zh: 细心的印刷校正员能挽救整版书稿。

e.en: A {press-gang} seized sailors for the navy.
e.zh: 一支强征入伍队抓走水手送进海军。

e.en: Critics said the campaign felt like a political {press-gang}.
e.zh: 批评者说这场运动像是在政治上强迫拉人。

e.en: He was {press-ganged} into naval service.
e.zh: 他被强征去服海军役。

e.en: I was {press-ganged} into helping at the fundraiser.
e.zh: 我被硬拉去帮忙办筹款活动。

e.en: A {press-photographer} waited outside the courthouse.
e.zh: 一名新闻摄影记者在法院外等候。

e.en: The {press-photographer} captured the minister's arrival.
e.zh: 新闻摄影记者拍下了部长抵达的画面。

e.en: The jacket closes with a metal {press-stud}.
e.zh: 这件夹克用一个金属按扣扣上。

e.en: One {press-stud} came loose from the baby suit.
e.zh: 婴儿衣上的一个揿钮松掉了。

e.en: He did one {press-up} before giving up.
e.zh: 他做了一个俯卧撑就放弃了。

e.en: A proper {press-up} keeps the body straight.
e.zh: 标准的俯卧撑要让身体保持笔直。

e.en: She does twenty {press-ups} every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上做二十个俯卧撑。

e.en: The coach added {press-ups} to the warm-up.
e.zh: 教练把俯卧撑加入了热身训练。

e.en: The box was made from cheap {pressboard}.
e.zh: 这个盒子是用廉价压制纸板做的。

e.en: Old binders often used {pressboard} covers.
e.zh: 旧文件夹常用硬纸板做封面。

e.en: The old radio had a broken {pressbutton}.
e.zh: 那台旧收音机有个按钮坏了。

e.en: A red {pressbutton} started the emergency alarm.
e.zh: 一个红色按键开关启动了紧急警报。

e.en: The officer held the {pressel} while speaking.
e.zh: 警官说话时按住了通话按钮。

e.en: A faulty {pressel} can interrupt radio messages.
e.zh: 有故障的对讲按键会中断无线电消息。

e.en: The {pressgang} dragged men from the tavern.
e.zh: 强征队把男人们从酒馆里拖走。

e.en: They tried to {pressgang} volunteers for the cleanup.

e.zh: 这个工具可以美化打印杂乱的JSON文件。

e.en: Enable {prettyprint} to make the logs readable.
e.zh: 启用格式化输出能让日志更易读。

e.en: The doctor described a {pretuberculous} condition.
e.zh: 医生描述了一种结核病前期状态。

e.en: Early care may help during the {pretuberculous} stage.
e.zh: 在结核前阶段，早期护理可能会有帮助。

pretypified.t: 预先类型化的；预先定型

e.en: The data were {pretypified} before analysis.
e.zh: 这些数据在分析前已被预先类型化。

e.en: A {pretypified} response can miss unusual cases.
e.zh: 预先定型的回应可能会漏掉特殊情况。

e.en: The first case seemed to {pretypify} the whole debate.
e.zh: 第一个案例似乎预先代表了整场争论的典型样貌。

e.en: Critics said the sketch would {pretypify} his later style.
e.zh: 评论家说这幅素描会预示他后来风格的典型特征。

e.en: The scene was {pretypifying} the novel's central conflict.
e.zh: 这一场景预先体现了小说的核心冲突。

e.en: Her early speech was {pretypifying} the movement's tone.
e.zh: 她早期的演讲预先显示了这场运动的典型语气。

e.en: Researchers measured the {prevalency} of the infection.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了这种感染的流行程度。

e.en: The {prevalency} of online shopping changed local stores.
e.zh: 网上购物的普遍性改变了当地商店。

e.en: The witness was dismissed as a habitual {prevaricator}.
e.zh: 这名证人被认为惯于闪烁其词而不受重视。

e.en: No skilled {prevaricator} could hide the missing records forever.
e.zh: 再高明的说谎者也无法永远隐瞒那些缺失的记录。

e.en: The linguist marked the sound as {prevelar}.
e.zh: 语言学家把这个音标记为前软腭音。

e.en: Children often simplify a {prevelar} consonant in early speech.
e.zh: 儿童早期说话时常会简化前软腭辅音。

e.en: The treaty depended on the {prevenance} of royal approval.
e.zh: 这项条约取决于王室批准是否先行发生。

e.en: Writers debated the {prevenance} of grace over human will.
e.zh: 作家们争论恩典是否先于人的意志。

e.en: The doctrine stresses the {prevenience} of divine grace.
e.zh: 这一教义强调神恩的先行作用。

e.en: Her argument rests on the {prevenience} of duty over choice.
e.zh: 她的论点建立在责任先于选择的观念上。

e.en: The sermon described {prevenient} grace as already present.
e.zh: 布道把先行恩典描述为已经存在。

e.en: A {prevenient} warning saved the crew from danger.
e.zh: 一个预先发出的警告使船员免于危险。

e.en: Grace acts {preveniently} before conscious faith appears.
e.zh: 恩典在有意识的信仰出现之前就先行作用。

e.en: The rule was applied {preveniently} to avoid confusion.
e.zh: 这条规则被预先适用，以避免混乱。

e.en: Doctors studied the {preventability} of the disease.
e.zh: 医生研究了这种疾病的可预防性。

e.en: The report questioned the {preventability} of the accident.
e.zh: 报告质疑这起事故本来是否可以预防。

e.en: Many childhood injuries are {preventible} with simple precautions.
e.zh: 许多儿童伤害通过简单预防措施是可以避免的。

e.en: The deaths were tragic and largely {preventible}.
e.zh: 这些死亡令人痛心，而且在很大程度上本可预防。

e.en: The child spent winter in a mountain {preventorium}.
e.zh: 那个孩子在山里的预防疗养院度过了冬天。

e.en: Old records show the building once served as a {preventorium}.
e.zh: 旧记录显示，这栋楼曾用作预防疗养院。

e.en: In this language, the {preverb} changes the verb's direction.
e.zh: 在这种语言中，动词前缀成分会改变动词的方向含义。

e.en: Students learned how each {preverb} affected tense and aspect.
e.zh: 学生学习每个前动词成分如何影响时态和体貌。

e.en: The object appears in a {preverbal} position.
e.zh: 这个宾语出现在动词前的位置。

e.en: Infants show {preverbal} understanding before they speak.
e.zh: 婴儿在会说话之前就表现出言语前理解能力。

e.en: The doctors discussed risks for a {previable} fetus.
e.zh: 医生讨论了尚不能存活胎儿面临的风险。

e.en: Care decisions differ when a pregnancy is {previable}.
e.zh: 妊娠处于胎儿尚不能存活阶段时，护理决定会不同。

e.en: The analyst tried to {previse} the market crash.
e.zh: 分析师试图预见市场崩盘。

e.en: Officials will {previse} residents of the coming restrictions.
e.zh: 官员将预先告知居民即将实施的限制。

e.en: She {prevised} the shortage months before it happened.
e.zh: 她在短缺发生前几个月就预见到了。

e.en: The committee was {prevised} of the legal risk.
e.zh: 委员会已被预先告知这一法律风险。

e.en: The model {previses} a sharp fall in demand.
e.zh: 该模型预见需求将急剧下降。

e.en: The notice {previses} tenants of scheduled repairs.
e.zh: 这份通知预先告知租户计划中的维修。

e.en: They spent weeks {prevising} possible supply problems.
e.zh: 他们花了数周预见可能出现的供应问题。

e.en: The lawyer was {prevising} clients of new obligations.
e.zh: 律师正在预先告知客户新的义务。

e.en: The team prepared a {previsional} budget for next year.
e.zh: 团队为明年准备了一份预估预算。

e.en: A {previsional} clause covered delays in delivery.
e.zh: 一项预防性条款涵盖了交付延误的情况。

e.en: Her {previsionary} essay predicted the housing crisis.
e.zh: 她那篇有预见力的文章预测了住房危机。

e.en: The novel has a strangely {previsionary} quality.
e.zh: 这部小说带有一种奇特的预示性特质。

e.en: Sunlight converts the compound into a {previtamin}.
e.zh: 阳光会把这种化合物转化为维生素前体。

e.en: The lab measured {previtamin} D in the skin sample.
e.zh: 实验室测量了皮肤样本中的维生素D前体。

e.en: The article changes before a {prevocalic} sound.
e.zh: 冠词在元音前的音之前会发生变化。

e.en: Some dialects preserve r only in {prevocalic} positions.
e.zh: 有些方言只在元音前位置保留r音。

e.en: The school offers {prevocational} training for older students.
e.zh: 学校为高年级学生提供职业预备培训。

e.en: She joined a {prevocational} program before starting an apprenticeship.
e.zh: 她在开始学徒工作前参加了一个职业预备项目。

e.en: The rubber compound undergoes {prevulcanization} before final molding.
e.zh: 这种橡胶混合物在最终成型前会进行预硫化。

e.en: Poor {prevulcanization} control can weaken the finished seal.
e.zh: 预硫化控制不当会削弱成品密封件的强度。

e.en: Manufacturers {prevulcanize} the latex to improve stability.
e.zh: 制造商会预先硫化乳胶，以提高其稳定性。

e.en: Do not {prevulcanize} the batch at too high a temperature.
e.zh: 不要在过高温度下对这一批材料进行预硫化。

e.en: The nurse recommended {prewarming} the blanket before surgery.
e.zh: 护士建议手术前先把毯子预热。

e.en: Engine {prewarming} helps the vehicle start in severe cold.
e.zh: 发动机预热有助于车辆在严寒中启动。

e.en: {Prewashing} the fabric prevents colors from bleeding later.
e.zh: 先预洗布料可以防止之后掉色串色。

e.en: The label says {prewashing} is required before sewing.
e.zh: 标签上写着缝制前需要预洗。

e.en: Farmers use {prewatering} to soften dry soil before planting.
e.zh: 农民会先浇水软化干土，再进行播种。

e.en: Careful {prewatering} reduced dust on the construction site.
e.zh: 细致的预先洒水减少了工地上的扬尘。

e.en: The inspector checked every {preweld} joint for contamination.
e.zh: 检查员查看了每个焊前接头是否受到污染。

e.en: Technicians {preweld} the frame before the final seam is made.
e.zh: 技术人员会先预焊框架，再完成最后的焊缝。

e.en: {Prewetting} the paper helps the ink spread evenly.
e.zh: 先把纸张润湿有助于墨水均匀铺开。

e.en: The cleaner works better after {prewetting} the stained area.
e.zh: 先润湿有污渍的区域后，清洁剂效果会更好。

e.en: Please {prewrap} the sandwiches before the guests arrive.
e.zh: 请在客人到来前先把三明治包好。

e.en: The trainer used {prewrap} under the athlete's tape.
e.zh: 教练在运动员的胶带下面用了预包扎带。

e.en: Brainstorming is an important {prewriting} activity.
e.zh: 头脑风暴是一项重要的写前准备活动。

e.en: Her {prewriting} included sketches and short notes.
e.zh: 她的预写内容包括草图和简短笔记。

e.en: The app sends a {prewritten} reply when you are busy.
e.zh: 你忙的时候，这个应用会发送预先写好的回复。

e.en: Candidates should avoid sounding like they memorized a {prewritten} speech.
e.zh: 候选人应避免听起来像是在背预先写好的演讲稿。

e.en: The students invited the {prex} to speak at dinner.
e.zh: 学生们邀请校长在晚宴上讲话。

e.en: Old alumni still called the college president the {prex}.
e.zh: 老校友仍把学院院长称作prex。

e.en: Several former {prexies} attended the university ceremony.
e.zh: 几位前校长出席了大学典礼。

e.en: The magazine interviewed three college {prexies} about admissions.
e.zh: 这本杂志采访了三位大学校长，讨论招生问题。

e.en: The new {prexy} promised to expand student aid.
e.zh: 新校长承诺扩大对学生的资助。

e.en: In campus slang, the president was simply the {prexy}.
e.zh: 在校园俚语里，校长就被简称为prexy。

e.en: The crab larva briefly passed through a {prezoea} stage.
e.zh: 这种蟹幼体短暂经历了前溞状幼体阶段。

e.en: Researchers recorded mortality during the {prezoea} phase.
e.zh: 研究人员记录了前溞状幼体阶段的死亡率。

e.en: The geologist described a {prezonal} layer below the main deposit.
e.zh: 地质学家描述了主矿床下方的带前层。

e.en: A {prezonal} change appeared before the tissue boundary formed.
e.zh: 在组织边界形成前，出现了区前变化。

e.en: The planner marked a {prezone} for future industrial use.
e.zh: 规划人员标出了一个供未来工业使用的前期分区。

e.en: Engineers {prezone} the site before detailed surveys begin.
e.zh: 工程师会在详细勘测开始前先给场地预先分区。

e.en: She brought a small {prezzie} for her nephew.
e.zh: 她给侄子带了一份小礼物。

e.en: In British slang, a {prezzie} is simply a present.
e.zh: 在英国俚语里，prezzie就是礼物的意思。

e.en: The doctor noted {priapitis} in the old medical report.
e.zh: 医生在旧病历中注意到阴茎异常勃起性炎症。

e.en: Modern texts rarely use the term {priapitis}.
e.zh: 现代医学文本很少使用priapitis这个术语。

e.en: The new store became a fierce {price-cutter} in town.
e.zh: 这家新店成了城里激烈降价的商家。

e.en: A reckless {price-cutter} can damage an entire market.
e.zh: 鲁莽的削价者可能会破坏整个市场。

e.en: The committee preferred a {principle-based} approach to regulation.
e.zh: 委员会更倾向于采用基于原则的监管方式。

e.en: Her decision was {principle-based}, not driven by personal gain.
e.zh: 她的决定是基于原则的，并非出于个人利益。

e.en: The school {principal} spoke at the assembly.
e.zh: 学校校长在集会上发了言。

e.en: Trust is the {principal} reason we chose her.
e.zh: 信任是我们选择她的主要原因。

e.en: Honesty is an important {principle} in business.
e.zh: 诚实是商业中的一项重要原则。

e.en: The machine works on a simple {principle}.
e.zh: 这台机器按一个简单原理运转。

e.en: She liked to {prink} before every formal dinner.
e.zh: 每次正式晚宴前，她都喜欢精心打扮一番。

e.en: The old shop window was {prinked} with ribbons and lamps.
e.zh: 那家老店的橱窗用丝带和灯饰装点起来。

e.en: He {prinked} himself in front of the mirror.
e.zh: 他在镜子前把自己精心打扮了一番。

e.en: The tables were {prinked} with flowers for the wedding.
e.zh: 婚礼上，桌子都用鲜花装饰过。

e.en: My uncle was a careful {prinker} before church.
e.zh: 我叔叔去教堂前总是认真打扮。

e.en: The young {prinker} adjusted his collar again.
e.zh: 那个爱打扮的年轻人又整理了一下衣领。

e.en: She spent an hour {prinking} before the dance.
e.zh: 舞会前她花了一个小时精心打扮。

e.en: They were {prinking} the hall with paper flowers.
e.zh: 他们正用纸花装饰大厅。

e.en: He {prinks} whenever he expects important guests.
e.zh: 每当有重要客人要来，他都会精心打扮。

e.en: The florist {prinks} each display with bright ribbons.
e.zh: 花店老板用鲜艳丝带装点每个陈列。

e.en: The {print-maker} signed each copy by hand.
e.zh: 这位版画家亲手在每一张作品上签名。

e.en: A skilled {print-maker} can control very subtle tones.
e.zh: 熟练的印刷工匠能控制非常细微的色调。

e.en: The author used {print-on-demand} to sell a small run of books.
e.zh: 作者用按需印刷的方式销售少量书籍。

e.en: Our store offers {print-on-demand} shirts for custom designs.
e.zh: 我们店为定制设计提供按需印制的衬衫。

e.en: The designer checked the {printability} of the tiny text.
e.zh: 设计师检查了这些小字是否适合印刷。

e.en: Ink quality affects the {printability} of recycled paper.
e.zh: 油墨质量会影响再生纸的适印性。

e.en: The form includes a {printback} with the full terms.
e.zh: 这张表格背面印有完整条款。

e.en: The system stores a {printback} of every receipt.
e.zh: 系统会保存每张收据的打印回执内容。

e.en: The tailor chose a bright {printcloth} for the dress.
e.zh: 裁缝为这条裙子选了一块鲜艳的印花布。

e.en: Old workshops used {printcloth} to test new dye patterns.
e.zh: 老作坊会用印刷用布测试新的染色图案。

e.en: The old {printery} still smells of ink and paper.
e.zh: 那家老印刷所里仍有油墨和纸张的气味。

e.en: He learned the {printery} trade from his father.
e.zh: 他从父亲那里学会了印刷业的手艺。

e.en: The novel was sent to a {printing-house} in London.
e.zh: 这部小说被送到伦敦一家印刷厂印制。

e.en: A respected {printing-house} issued the scholar's essays.
e.zh: 一家有声望的出版社出版了这位学者的论文集。

e.en: Several {printing-offices} closed after the newspaper strike.
e.zh: 报社罢工后，有几家印刷所关门了。

e.en: The town's {printing-offices} produced pamphlets for local campaigns.
e.zh: 镇上的印刷办公室为地方活动印制小册子。

e.en: The thief left the glass {printless} and clean.
e.zh: 小偷没有在玻璃上留下指纹，表面很干净。

e.en: She preferred a {printless} cotton shirt for the meeting.
e.zh: 她开会时更喜欢穿一件没有印花的棉衬衫。

e.en: Use {println} to show the message on a new line.
e.zh: 使用println可以把消息打印到新的一行。

e.en: The beginner forgot that {println} adds a line break.
e.zh: 初学者忘了println会添加换行。

e.en: The museum displayed a rare {printograph} from the 1890s.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一张19世纪90年代的罕见照片印刷品。

e.en: He called the image a {printograph}, not a painting.
e.zh: 他把那幅图称为照相印图，而不是绘画。

e.en: The technician calibrated the {printometer} before the press run.
e.zh: 技术员在开机印刷前校准了印刷计量器。

e.en: A faulty {printometer} gave the wrong sheet count.
e.zh: 有故障的印刷计量器给出了错误的纸张数量。

e.en: The store began {price-cutting} before the holidays.
e.zh: 这家商店在节日前开始削价促销。

e.en: Aggressive {price-cutting} hurt smaller competitors.
e.zh: 激烈的降价竞争伤害了较小的竞争对手。

e.en: The firms were fined for {price-fixing}.
e.zh: 这些公司因串通定价而被罚款。

e.en: Investigators found evidence of {price-fixing} in the market.
e.zh: 调查人员在市场中发现了操纵价格的证据。

e.en: Please send me the latest {price-list}.
e.zh: 请把最新的价目表发给我。

e.en: The old {price-list} no longer includes delivery fees.
e.zh: 旧的价格清单不再包含配送费。

e.en: The {price-tag} on the jacket surprised her.
e.zh: 夹克上的价格标签让她很惊讶。

e.en: The project carries a heavy {price-tag}.
e.zh: 这个项目要付出很高的代价。

e.en: The restaurant updated its {pricelist} online.
e.zh: 这家餐厅在网上更新了价目表。

e.en: Check the {pricelist} before ordering custom parts.
e.zh: 订购定制零件前先查看价格清单。

e.en: {Pricewise}, this hotel is hard to beat.
e.zh: 就价格而言，这家酒店很难被超越。

e.en: The two models are similar {pricewise}.
e.zh: 这两款型号在价格方面差不多。

e.en: A {prick-eared} dog watched the gate.
e.zh: 一只竖耳狗守着大门。

e.en: The statue shows a {prick-eared} hunting hound.
e.zh: 这座雕像表现的是一只竖耳猎犬。

e.en: The hunter spotted a young {pricket} near the wood.
e.zh: 猎人在树林边发现了一头年轻的两岁公鹿。

e.en: The candle was fixed on a metal {pricket}.
e.zh: 蜡烛固定在一个金属烛台尖钉上。

e.en: This cactus has the {prickliest} spines in the garden.
e.zh: 这株仙人掌有花园里最刺人的刺。

e.en: Funding was the {prickliest} issue in the talks.
e.zh: 资金是谈判中最棘手的问题。

e.en: The wool's {prickliness} made the sweater uncomfortable.
e.zh: 羊毛的刺痒感让这件毛衣穿起来不舒服。

e.en: His {prickliness} made simple discussions difficult.
e.zh: 他的易怒让简单讨论也变得困难。

e.en: The old boot still had a rusty {prickspur}.
e.zh: 那只旧靴子上还留着一个生锈的马刺。

e.en: The flower has a small {prickspur} at its base.
e.zh: 这朵花的基部有一个小小的距状突起。

e.en: The blanket felt {pricky} against his skin.
e.zh: 这条毯子贴着他的皮肤感觉很扎。

e.en: She avoided the {pricky} bushes beside the path.
e.zh: 她避开了小路旁那些扎人的灌木。

e.en: The scholar cited a {pridian} entry in the diary.
e.zh: 那位学者引用了日记中前一天的条目。

e.en: A {pridian} report had already warned of delays.
e.zh: 前一天的报告已经警告会有延误。

e.en: She knelt at the {prie-dieu} before dawn.
e.zh: 黎明前，她跪在跪祷椅前祈祷。

e.en: The chapel kept an antique {prie-dieu} by the altar.
e.zh: 小礼拜堂在祭坛旁放着一张古董跪祷椅。

e.en: He mocked the town as {priest-ridden} and fearful.
e.zh: 他嘲笑这座城镇受教士控制且充满恐惧。

e.en: The novel portrays a {priest-ridden} society.
e.zh: 这部小说描绘了一个受教士支配的社会。

e.en: The pamphlet denounced {priestcraft} in harsh terms.
e.zh: 这本小册子用严厉言辞谴责教士权术。

e.en: Reformers saw the ritual as mere {priestcraft}.
e.zh: 改革者把这种仪式看作纯粹的僧侣欺骗。

e.en: The remote village remained {priestless} for years.
e.zh: 这个偏远村庄多年没有教士。

e.en: They held a simple {priestless} ceremony at home.
e.zh: 他们在家举行了一个没有教士主持的简单仪式。

e.en: He spoke in a calm, {priestlike} voice.
e.zh: 他说话时声音平静，带着教士般的庄重。

e.en: Her black robe gave her a {priestlike} appearance.
e.zh: 她的黑袍让她显得像一位教士。

e.en: His {priestliness} impressed the congregation.
e.zh: 他的教士气质给会众留下了深刻印象。

e.en: The actor added quiet {priestliness} to the role.
e.zh: 演员为这个角色增添了安静庄严的神态。

e.en: The old bishop scolded the nervous {priestling}.
e.zh: 老主教责备了那个紧张的年轻教士。

e.en: Critics dismissed him as a meddling {priestling}.
e.zh: 批评者把他贬称为爱管闲事的小教士。

e.en: Her essay attacked the {priggery} of polite society.
e.zh: 她的文章抨击了上流社会的自命清高。

e.en: The teacher's {priggery} annoyed the older students.
e.zh: 老师那种一本正经的做派惹恼了年长的学生。

e.en: His {priggism} made casual conversation feel like an exam.
e.zh: 他的自命清高让闲聊都像在考试。

e.en: The essay attacks Victorian {priggism} with dry humor.
e.zh: 这篇文章用冷幽默讽刺维多利亚式的道德拘泥。

e.en: The fertilizer was sold as tiny {prills} that dissolved slowly.
e.zh: 这种肥料以小颗粒出售，会慢慢溶解。

e.en: Molten metal formed a bright {prill} on the surface.
e.zh: 熔化的金属在表面形成了一颗发亮的小珠。

e.en: The old contract included {primage} above the basic freight charge.
e.zh: 这份旧合同在基本运费之外还包括额外运费。

e.en: Sailors once treated {primage} as part of a captain's earnings.
e.zh: 水手们过去把船长津贴视为船长收入的一部分。

e.en: The algorithm tests the {primality} of very large numbers.
e.zh: 该算法检验超大数字是否为素数。

e.en: The poem returns to a sense of {primality} and first beginnings.
e.zh: 这首诗回到一种原初状态和开端感。

e.en: The study compared {primatal} behavior across several species.
e.zh: 这项研究比较了几个物种的灵长类行为。

e.en: Researchers noted a distinctly {primatal} pattern of social learning.
e.zh: 研究人员注意到一种明显的灵长类社会学习模式。

e.en: His appointment to the {primateship} changed the church's politics.
e.zh: 他出任大主教后改变了教会政治格局。

e.en: The city claimed cultural {primateship} in the region.
e.zh: 这座城市声称自己在该地区拥有文化首席地位。

e.en: The letter carried a {primatical} seal from the archbishop.
e.zh: 这封信盖有大主教的印章。

e.en: The court recognized his {primatical} authority over the province.
e.zh: 法院承认他对该省拥有首席权威。

e.en: Her {primatological} research focused on tool use in apes.
e.zh: 她的灵长类学研究集中在猿类使用工具上。

e.en: The museum opened a new {primatological} exhibit this spring.
e.zh: 博物馆今年春天开设了一个新的灵长类学展览。

e.en: She studied {primatology} before becoming a field researcher.
e.zh: 她先学习灵长类学，后来成了野外研究员。

e.en: Modern {primatology} often combines genetics with observation.
e.zh: 现代灵长类学常把遗传学与观察研究结合起来。

e.en: A {primaveral} breeze moved through the open windows.
e.zh: 一阵春天般的微风吹过敞开的窗户。

e.en: The painting has a {primaveral} freshness despite its age.
e.zh: 这幅画虽年代久远，却有一种春日般的清新。

prime-time.t: 黄金时段；最受关注时刻

e.en: The debate aired during {prime-time} television.
e.zh: 这场辩论在电视黄金时段播出。

e.en: After years of practice, she was ready for {prime-time}.
e.zh: 经过多年练习，她已经准备好登上最受关注的舞台。

e.en: The {prime minister} answered questions in parliament.
e.zh: 首相在议会回答了提问。

e.en: A new {prime minister} will form the government.
e.zh: 新总理将组建政府。

e.en: They played {primero} by candlelight after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后，他们在烛光下玩普里梅罗纸牌戏。

e.en: {Primero} appears in several Renaissance plays and diaries.
e.zh: 普里梅罗纸牌戏出现在几部文艺复兴时期的戏剧和日记中。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {primidone} to control his seizures.
e.zh: 医生开了扑米酮来控制他的癫痫发作。

e.en: Patients taking {primidone} should report severe dizziness.
e.zh: 服用扑米酮的患者应报告严重头晕。

e.en: The myth describes a {primigenial} sea before creation.
e.zh: 这个神话描述了创世之前的原始海洋。

e.en: He sought a {primigenial} purity in early folk songs.
e.zh: 他在早期民歌中寻找一种原初的纯净。

e.en: The clinic offered extra counseling for each {primigravida}.
e.zh: 诊所为每位初孕妇提供额外咨询。

e.en: A {primigravida} may feel anxious before the first scan.
e.zh: 初孕妇在第一次检查前可能会感到焦虑。

e.en: The botanist identified the {primine} around the ovule.
e.zh: 植物学家确认了胚珠周围的外珠被。

e.en: Contact with {primine} can irritate sensitive skin.
e.zh: 接触报春花素可能会刺激敏感皮肤。

e.en: The ward kept detailed records for every {primipara}.
e.zh: 病房为每位初产妇保存了详细记录。

e.en: A {primipara} often needs clear guidance after delivery.
e.zh: 初产妇在分娩后常需要清楚的指导。

e.en: The study examined risks associated with {primiparity}.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了初产相关的风险。

e.en: Age at {primiparity} varies across different populations.
e.zh: 首次分娩年龄在不同人群中有所差异。

e.en: The hospital created classes for {primiparous} mothers.
e.zh: 医院为初产母亲开设了课程。

e.en: A {primiparous} cow may require closer observation.
e.zh: 首次生产的母牛可能需要更密切的观察。

e.en: The dancers performed a lively {primitiva} at the festival.
e.zh: 舞者们在节日上表演了一支活泼的原始舞。

e.en: Critics called the sculpture a modern {primitiva}.
e.zh: 评论家称这座雕塑是现代的原始风格作品。

primitivist.t: 原始主义者；原始主义的

e.en: The painter became known as a bold {primitivist}.
e.zh: 这位画家以大胆的原始主义者身份闻名。

e.en: Her {primitivist} style rejected academic polish.
e.zh: 她的原始主义风格拒绝学院派的精致修饰。

e.en: The mask has a deliberately {primitivistic} design.
e.zh: 这个面具有意采用原始主义风格设计。

e.en: His {primitivistic} music uses rough rhythms and simple chants.
e.zh: 他的原始主义风格音乐使用粗犷节奏和简单吟唱。

e.en: The sculpture's {primitivity} gave it unusual power.
e.zh: 这座雕塑的原始感赋予它异样的力量。

e.en: Anthropologists no longer treat {primitivity} as a simple stage of culture.
e.zh: 人类学家不再把原始性视为文化的简单阶段。

e.en: The myth describes a {primogenial} darkness before creation.
e.zh: 这个神话描写了创世之前的原初黑暗。

e.en: She searched for the {primogenial} impulse behind the tradition.
e.zh: 她探寻这一传统背后的最初冲动。

e.en: The estate followed a {primogenitary} rule for inheritance.
e.zh: 这份地产按长子继承规则传承。

e.en: A {primogenitary} system often excluded younger children from power.
e.zh: 嫡长继承制度往往把年幼子女排除在权力之外。

e.en: The clan honored its legendary {primogenitor} each spring.
e.zh: 这个氏族每年春天祭奠传说中的始祖。

e.en: Scientists traced the mutation to a common {primogenitor}.
e.zh: 科学家把这种突变追溯到一个共同的早期祖先。

e.en: His {primogenitureship} gave him control of the manor.
e.zh: 他的长子继承权使他掌管了庄园。

e.en: The dispute centered on her brother's claimed {primogenitureship}.
e.zh: 争议集中在她兄弟所声称的嫡长继承地位上。

e.en: The old lawyer remained a firm {primogeniturist}.
e.zh: 那位老律师仍是坚定的长子继承制支持者。

e.en: A {primogeniturist} would defend the eldest son's claim first.
e.zh: 支持长子继承制的人会首先维护长子的权利主张。

e.en: Leaf {primordia} appear near the tip of the shoot.
e.zh: 叶原基出现在嫩梢顶端附近。

e.en: The embryo already contained the {primordia} of several organs.
e.zh: 胚胎中已经含有几个器官的初始形态。

e.en: His theory leaned toward {primordialism} in explaining ethnicity.
e.zh: 他的理论在解释族群性时偏向原生论。

e.en: Critics argue that {primordialism} overlooks political change.
e.zh: 批评者认为族群本源论忽视了政治变化。

e.en: A tooth {primordium} forms early in development.
e.zh: 牙齿原基在发育早期形成。

e.en: The poem hints at the {primordium} of his later style.
e.zh: 这首诗暗示了他后来风格的萌芽。

e.en: The botanist identified a {primulaceous} plant near the stream.
e.zh: 植物学家在溪边辨认出一种报春花科植物。

e.en: Its {primulaceous} features include simple leaves and delicate flowers.
e.zh: 它的报春花科特征包括单叶和细致的花朵。

e.en: The fabric was stained with {primuline} in the laboratory.
e.zh: 这块织物在实验室里用淡黄染料着色。

e.en: Early chemists used {primuline} to study fluorescent dyes.
e.zh: 早期化学家用报春花素研究荧光染料。

e.en: The garden had a {primy} freshness after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后花园带着早春般的清新。

e.en: She picked a {primy} blossom from the hedge.
e.zh: 她从树篱上摘下一朵初开的花。

e.en: She planted {prince's-feather} along the sunny wall.
e.zh: 她沿着向阳的墙种了王子羽。

e.en: The red spikes of {prince's-feather} brightened the border.
e.zh: 王子羽的红色穗状花让花坛边缘亮了起来。

e.en: The tale follows a spoiled {princekin} through exile.
e.zh: 这个故事讲一个被宠坏的小王子流亡的经历。

e.en: Courtiers bowed whenever the {princekin} entered the hall.
e.zh: 每当年轻王族走进大厅，侍臣们便鞠躬。

e.en: The kingdom remained {princeless} after the heir vanished.
e.zh: 继承人失踪后，这个王国一直没有王子。

e.en: Her story imagines a {princeless} court ruled by ministers.
e.zh: 她的故事想象了一个由大臣掌权、没有王子的宫廷。

e.en: A minor {princelet} controlled the mountain pass.
e.zh: 一个小诸侯控制着山口。

e.en: The young {princelet} learned diplomacy before he learned war.
e.zh: 这位小王子先学会外交，后来才学习战争。

e.en: He greeted the guests with {princelike} courtesy.
e.zh: 他以王子般的礼貌迎接客人。

e.en: The actor had a {princelike} bearing on stage.
e.zh: 这位演员在舞台上有一种高贵气派。

e.en: His {princeliness} impressed even the skeptical ambassador.
e.zh: 他的王子气派甚至打动了怀疑的 ambassador。

e.en: The portrait captures her quiet {princeliness}.
e.zh: 这幅肖像捕捉到了她含蓄的高贵风度。

e.en: The inscription names him {princep} of the council.
e.zh: 铭文称他为议会的首领。

e.en: In that circle, she was treated as the {princep}.
e.zh: 在那个圈子里，她被视为第一人。

e.en: Augustus styled himself {princeps} rather than king.
e.zh: 奥古斯都自称罗马元首，而不是国王。

e.en: The scholar prepared a {princeps} edition of the text.
e.zh: 这位学者整理了该文本的首版。

e.en: His {princeship} brought duties as well as privilege.
e.zh: 他的王子身份既带来特权，也带来责任。

e.en: The treaty confirmed the ruler's {princeship}.
e.zh: 这项条约确认了统治者的王侯地位。

e.en: She made a {princesslike} entrance in a silver gown.
e.zh: 她穿着银色礼服，以公主般的姿态入场。

e.en: The child refused lunch with a {princesslike} pout.
e.zh: 那孩子像娇贵公主一样撅着嘴拒绝吃午饭。

e.en: The {principate} replaced the republic in practice.
e.zh: 元首制在事实上取代了共和国。

e.en: During his {principate}, the province became more stable.
e.zh: 在他的首席任期内，该省变得更加稳定。

e.en: The debate raised a {principial} objection to the policy.
e.zh: 这场辩论提出了对该政策的原则性反对。

e.en: Her argument was {principial}, not merely personal.
e.zh: 她的论点是原则性的，而不只是个人意见。

e.en: The label was {printon} the bottle in blue ink.
e.zh: 标签用蓝色油墨印在瓶子上。

e.en: Please {printon} both sides of the sheet.
e.zh: 请在这张纸的两面都印上内容。

e.en: The {printseller} specialized in old maps and engravings.
e.zh: 那位版画商专门经营旧地图和雕版画。

e.en: A street {printseller} offered cheap posters to tourists.
e.zh: 街头印刷品卖家向游客兜售便宜海报。

e.en: The invitations are ready at the {printshop}.
e.zh: 请柬已经在印刷店做好了。

e.en: She runs a small {printshop} near the university.
e.zh: 她在大学附近经营一家小印务店。

e.en: Thin paper can cause {printthrough} on the next page.
e.zh: 纸太薄会导致下一页出现透印。

e.en: The conservator reduced the {printthrough} in the old manuscript.
e.zh: 修复师减轻了那份旧手稿上的背面显印。

e.en: The old {printworks} closed after a century of operation.
e.zh: 那家老印刷厂经营一个世纪后关闭了。

e.en: The textile {printworks} produced bright patterned cotton.
e.zh: 这家印染厂生产色彩鲜艳的花纹棉布。

prionotron.t: 普里奥诺管；微波电子管

e.en: The engineer tested a {prionotron} in the microwave laboratory.
e.zh: 工程师在微波实验室测试了一只普里奥诺管。
