e.en: Older radar papers sometimes mention the {prionotron}.
e.zh: 较早的雷达论文有时会提到这种微波电子管。

e.en: The monk carried out his {prioral} duties quietly.
e.zh: 那位修士默默履行小修道院院长的职责。

e.en: The charter confirmed the house's {prioral} rights.
e.zh: 这份宪章确认了该院院长的权利。

e.en: He entered the {priorate} after many years as a monk.
e.zh: 他做了多年修士后担任小修道院院长。

e.en: During her {priorate}, the community expanded its library.
e.zh: 在她任院长期间，团体扩充了图书馆。

e.en: We cannot reject the idea {priori} without evidence.
e.zh: 没有证据时，我们不能先验地否定这个想法。

e.en: The theory was built on {priori} assumptions about human behavior.
e.zh: 这个理论建立在关于人类行为的先验假设上。

e.en: The committee gave {priorite} to urgent medical cases.
e.zh: 委员会优先处理紧急医疗案例。

e.en: Safety remained the project's first {priorite}.
e.zh: 安全仍是这个项目的首要事项。

e.en: His {priorship} lasted only three difficult years.
e.zh: 他的小修道院长任期只持续了艰难的三年。

e.en: The abbey records list each monk's {priorship}.
e.zh: 修道院档案列出了每位修士担任院长的情况。

e.en: Medieval kings claimed {prisage} on imported wine.
e.zh: 中世纪国王对进口葡萄酒主张征收酒税。

e.en: The merchant protested against the officer's {prisage}.
e.zh: 商人抗议那名官员行使征用权。

e.en: The old text spells prisoner as {prisaoner}.
e.zh: 这篇旧文本把 prisoner 拼作 prisaoner。

e.en: A {prisaoner} was released after the pardon.
e.zh: 一名囚犯在赦免后获释。

e.en: The scholar admired the {priscan} style of the poem.
e.zh: 学者欣赏这首诗古雅的风格。

e.en: They preserved several {priscan} customs in the village.
e.zh: 他们在村里保留了几项古老习俗。

e.en: The crown ordered a {prisere} of grain for the army.
e.zh: 王室下令为军队征收粮食。

e.en: Records mention the sheriff's {prisere} of local goods.
e.zh: 档案提到郡长扣押当地货物。

e.en: The manuscript uses {prision} where modern English says prison.
e.zh: 这份手稿用 prision 表示现代英语的 prison。

e.en: He feared years of {prision} after the verdict.
e.zh: 判决后他害怕多年监禁。

e.en: The crystal cast {prismatical} colors on the wall.
e.zh: 水晶在墙上投下棱镜般的彩色光斑。

e.en: His essay used a {prismatical} metaphor for memory.
e.zh: 他的文章用光彩变幻的比喻来写记忆。

e.en: The glass split the sunlight {prismatically}.
e.zh: 玻璃像棱镜一样分解了阳光。

e.en: Her story presents the city {prismatically}, through many voices.
e.zh: 她的故事通过多种声音折射般呈现这座城市。

e.en: The geometry class calculated the volume of a {prismatoid}.
e.zh: 几何课计算了一个拟柱体的体积。

e.en: The mineral formed a small {prismatoid} shape.
e.zh: 这种矿物形成了一个小的棱柱状体。

e.en: The architect sketched a {prismatoidal} roof for the hall.
e.zh: 建筑师为大厅画了一个棱柱状屋顶。

e.en: A {prismatoidal} solid has two parallel polygonal faces.
e.zh: 拟柱体有两个平行的多边形面。

prismatometer.t: 棱镜测角仪；折射测量器

e.en: The optician adjusted the {prismatometer} before measuring the lens.
e.zh: 验光师在测量镜片前调好了棱镜测角仪。

e.en: A {prismatometer} can help determine a prism's angle.
e.zh: 棱镜测角仪可用来确定棱镜的角度。

e.en: The formula estimates the volume of a {prismoid}.
e.zh: 这个公式用来估算拟柱体的体积。

e.en: The block was cut into a rough {prismoid}.
e.zh: 这块材料被切成一个粗略的似棱柱体。

e.en: The chandelier cast {prismy} light across the ceiling.
e.zh: 枝形吊灯把像棱镜般多彩的光投到天花板上。

e.en: Her poem has a {prismy} quality, shifting with each reading.
e.zh: 她的诗有种多面而斑斓的质感，每读一次都不同。

e.en: The gang planned a {prison-breaking} attempt at dawn.
e.zh: 那伙人计划在黎明时发动一次越狱行动。

e.en: The movie turns {prison-breaking} into a tense puzzle.
e.zh: 这部电影把越狱拍成了一场紧张的谜局。

e.en: A {prison-officer} checked every visitor at the gate.
e.zh: 一名狱警在门口检查每位访客。

e.en: She trained as a {prison-officer} after leaving the army.
e.zh: 她退伍后接受培训，成了一名监狱官。

e.en: The treaty required both sides to release {prisoners-of-war}.
e.zh: 条约要求双方释放战俘。

e.en: Many {prisoners-of-war} wrote letters home through the Red Cross.
e.zh: 许多战俘通过红十字会给家里写信。

e.en: The dormitory felt {prisonlike} with bars on every window.
e.zh: 宿舍每扇窗都有铁栏，让人觉得像监狱。

e.en: His routine became {prisonlike} after months indoors.
e.zh: 在室内待了几个月后，他的日常变得压抑得像坐牢。

e.en: Don't be such a {priss} about a little mud.
e.zh: 不过是一点泥，别这么过分讲究。

e.en: She called him a {priss} for refusing to bend the rules.
e.zh: 他不肯变通规则，她就说他太拘谨。

e.en: The new uniforms looked {prissier} than the old ones.
e.zh: 新制服看起来比旧制服更拘谨做作。

e.en: He became {prissier} about table manners after joining the club.
e.zh: 加入俱乐部后，他对餐桌礼仪变得更挑剔拘谨。

e.en: She was the {prissiest} guest at the picnic.
e.zh: 她是野餐客人里最拘谨讲究的一个。

e.en: Even the {prissiest} critic enjoyed the messy comedy.
e.zh: 就连最古板挑剔的评论家也喜欢这部闹哄哄的喜剧。

e.en: He wiped the glass {prissily} before taking a sip.
e.zh: 他拘谨做作地擦了擦杯子才喝了一口。

e.en: She {prissily} corrected everyone else's pronunciation.
e.zh: 她挑剔做作地纠正每个人的发音。

e.en: His {prissiness} made the camping trip less fun.
e.zh: 他的过分讲究让这次露营少了些乐趣。

e.en: The essay mocks the {prissiness} of polite society.
e.zh: 这篇文章讽刺了上流社交圈的拘谨做作。

e.en: The sample contained traces of {pristane} from petroleum.
e.zh: 样品中含有来自石油的微量姥鲛烷。

e.en: Researchers used {pristane} to study inflammation in mice.
e.zh: 研究人员用姥鲛烷研究小鼠的炎症反应。

e.en: {Prithee}, tell me what has happened here.
e.zh: 请你告诉我这里发生了什么。

e.en: Stay a moment, {prithee}, before you leave.
e.zh: 求你离开前再停留片刻。

e.en: The meeting dissolved into {prittle-prattle} about office gossip.
e.zh: 会议变成了关于办公室八卦的无聊闲扯。

e.en: She had no patience for {prittle-prattle} during a crisis.
e.zh: 危机当前，她没耐心听那些无谓碎语。

e.en: The reforms encouraged {private-enterprise} in rural towns.
e.zh: 这些改革鼓励了乡镇的民营企业发展。

e.en: She believes {private-enterprise} can create jobs faster.
e.zh: 她相信私营经济能更快创造就业机会。

e.en: A {private-equity} firm bought the struggling retailer.
e.zh: 一家私募股权公司收购了这家陷入困境的零售商。

e.en: He works in {private-equity}, focusing on healthcare investments.
e.zh: 他从事私募股权工作，专注医疗投资。

e.en: The millionaire hired a {private-eye} to follow the suspect.
e.zh: 那位百万富翁雇了一名私家侦探跟踪嫌疑人。

e.en: In the novel, the {private-eye} narrates every case with dry humor.
e.zh: 小说里，私家侦探用冷幽默讲述每个案件。

e.en: The supermarket sells {private-label} cereal at a lower price.
e.zh: 这家超市以较低价格销售自有品牌麦片。

e.en: Many factories produce {private-label} goods for foreign retailers.
e.zh: 许多工厂为外国零售商生产贴牌商品。

e.en: The {privateersman} claimed the captured cargo was lawful prize.
e.zh: 那名私掠船船员声称缴获的货物是合法战利品。

e.en: A former {privateersman} told stories of raids at sea.
e.zh: 一名前私掠船船员讲述海上突袭的故事。

e.en: The {privateersmen} divided the prize money after returning to port.
e.zh: 私掠船船员们返港后分了赏金。

e.en: Several {privateersmen} later joined the royal navy.
e.zh: 几名私掠船船员后来加入了皇家海军。

e.en: The museum is {privately-owned} but open to the public.
e.zh: 这家博物馆为私人拥有，但对公众开放。

e.en: A {privately-owned} company built the new toll road.
e.zh: 一家私营公司修建了这条新的收费公路。

e.en: His essay attacked {privatism} in public education.
e.zh: 他的文章批评了公共教育中的私人主义倾向。

e.en: The policy was shaped by a strong spirit of {privatism}.
e.zh: 这项政策受到强烈私有化观念的影响。

privatistic.t: 私人主义的；偏私有化的

e.en: The mayor rejected a {privatistic} approach to health care.
e.zh: 市长拒绝用偏私有化的方式处理医疗服务。

e.en: Critics called the reform too {privatistic} for a public system.
e.zh: 批评者认为这项改革对公共体系来说过于私人主义。

e.en: The court described the penalty as {privative} of basic rights.
e.zh: 法院称这项处罚具有剥夺基本权利的性质。

e.en: In grammar, a {privative} prefix can mark absence or negation.
e.zh: 在语法中，否定性前缀可表示缺失或否定。

e.en: The rule operated {privatively}, removing powers once assumed.
e.zh: 这条规则以剥夺方式运作，取消了原先默认的权力。

e.en: The term is used {privatively} to mean lacking that quality.
e.zh: 这个词以否定方式使用，意思是缺少那种性质。

e.en: The typo {priviilege} clearly meant privilege in the old document.
e.zh: 旧文件里的拼写错误priviilege显然指的是特权。

e.en: She corrected {priviilege} before sending the application.
e.zh: 她在提交申请前改正了priviilege这个拼写错误。

e.en: Crowds gathered for the illegal {prize-fight} outside town.
e.zh: 人群聚集到城外观看那场非法职业拳击赛。

e.en: The novel describes a brutal {prize-fight} in vivid detail.
e.zh: 小说生动描写了一场残酷的有奖拳赛。

e.en: The retired {prize-fighter} opened a small gym.
e.zh: 那位退役职业拳击手开了一家小健身房。

e.en: He moved like a {prize-fighter}, calm and dangerous.
e.zh: 他行动起来像个奖金拳手，冷静而危险。

e.en: Parents were invited to the school {prize-giving} ceremony.
e.zh: 家长们受邀参加学校的颁奖典礼。

e.en: The annual {prize-giving} lasted nearly two hours.
e.zh: 一年一度的发奖活动持续了将近两个小时。

e.en: She attended three {prize-givings} in one week.
e.zh: 她一周内参加了三场颁奖典礼。

e.en: The college holds separate {prize-givings} for each faculty.
e.zh: 学院为每个院系分别举行颁奖活动。

e.en: The old newspaper reported a local {prizeflight} for racing pigeons.
e.zh: 那份旧报纸报道了一场本地赛鸽飞行赛。

e.en: His bird won the village {prizeflight} that summer.
e.zh: 那年夏天，他的赛鸽赢得了村里的获奖飞行赛。

e.en: The contest was {prizeless}, but many children still joined.
e.zh: 比赛没有奖品，但仍有许多孩子参加。

e.en: He dismissed the medal as {prizeless} beside her trust.
e.zh: 他认为那枚奖章与她的信任相比毫无价值。

e.en: The young {prizeman} was praised at the college dinner.
e.zh: 那位年轻获奖者在学院晚宴上受到表扬。

e.en: As a school {prizeman}, he was expected to speak first.
e.zh: 作为学校的优胜学生，他被要求先发言。

e.en: The {prizemen} sat together near the front.
e.zh: 获奖者们一起坐在靠前的位置。

e.en: Several {prizemen} later became famous scholars.
e.zh: 几名优胜学生后来成了著名学者。

e.en: Her {prizewinning} novel was translated into six languages.
e.zh: 她那部获奖小说被翻译成六种语言。

e.en: The farm displayed its {prizewinning} roses at the fair.
e.zh: 农场在集市上展示了获奖的玫瑰。

e.en: She played in a charity {pro-am} with a famous golfer.
e.zh: 她和一位著名高尔夫球手参加了慈善职业业余配对赛。

e.en: The tournament added a {pro-am} event on Friday.
e.zh: 锦标赛在星期五增设了一场职业业余配对赛。

e.en: The newspaper took a strongly {pro-american} line.
e.zh: 这家报纸采取了强烈亲美的立场。

e.en: His speech sounded {pro-american} without being anti-European.
e.zh: 他的演讲听起来支持美国，但并不反欧洲。

e.en: We need a {pro-and-con} discussion before voting.
e.zh: 投票前我们需要进行一次正反两面的讨论。

e.en: She wrote a {pro-and-con} list for each option.
e.zh: 她为每个选项列了一张利弊清单。

e.en: The chemical is a {pro-carcinogen} activated by liver enzymes.
e.zh: 这种化学物质是会被肝酶激活的前致癌物。

e.en: Researchers tested whether the compound behaved as a {pro-carcinogen}.
e.zh: 研究人员测试该化合物是否表现为致癌物前体。

e.en: The club hosted a {pro-celebrity} golf event for charity.
e.zh: 俱乐部举办了一场慈善职业名人高尔夫配对赛。

e.en: Tickets for the {pro-celebrity} match sold out quickly.
e.zh: 那场职业名人配对赛的门票很快售罄。

e.en: She joined a {pro-choice} march downtown.
e.zh: 她参加了市中心一场支持堕胎选择权的游行。

e.en: The candidate described himself as personally cautious but {pro-choice}.
e.zh: 这位候选人称自己个人态度谨慎，但支持选择权。

e.en: A {pro-choicer} challenged the senator during the debate.
e.zh: 一名支持堕胎选择权者在辩论中质问了参议员。

e.en: She identified as a lifelong {pro-choicer}.
e.zh: 她称自己一生都支持堕胎选择权。

e.en: The {pro-consul} governed the province in Rome's name.
e.zh: 这位古罗马行省总督代表罗马治理该省。

e.en: Historians found letters written by a former {pro-consul}.
e.zh: 历史学家发现了一位前行省总督写的信件。

e.en: Students organized a {pro-democracy} rally after the election.
e.zh: 选举后，学生组织了一场支持民主的集会。

e.en: The paper published several {pro-democracy} editorials.
e.zh: 这家报纸发表了几篇亲民主的社论。

pro-drug.t: 支持毒品的；赞成用药的

e.en: The campaign was accused of sending a {pro-drug} message.
e.zh: 这场宣传被指传递了支持毒品的信息。

e.en: Some patients joined a {pro-drug} group advocating faster access.
e.zh: 一些患者加入了赞成用药的团体，主张更快获得药物。

pro-european.t: 支持欧洲一体化的；亲欧的

e.en: The party adopted a {pro-European} platform before the election.
e.zh: 该党在选举前采纳了亲欧的政纲。

e.en: She is strongly {pro-European} on trade and migration policy.
e.zh: 她在贸易和移民政策上强烈支持欧洲一体化。

pro-family.t: 支持家庭价值的；有利家庭的

e.en: The mayor promised {pro-family} tax reforms.
e.zh: 市长承诺推行有利家庭的税制改革。

e.en: They described the campaign as {pro-family} and community focused.
e.zh: 他们称这场运动支持家庭价值，并关注社区。

pro-forma.t: 形式上的；预计财务报表的

e.en: The board gave {pro-forma} approval after a brief discussion.
e.zh: 董事会简短讨论后给予了形式上的批准。

e.en: The report included {pro-forma} earnings for the merged company.
e.zh: 报告列出了合并后公司的预计收益。

e.en: A {pro-independence} rally filled the main square.
e.zh: 一场支持独立的集会挤满了主广场。

e.en: The newspaper took a {pro-independence} position during the referendum.
e.zh: 公投期间，这家报纸采取了支持独立的立场。

e.en: Stress can increase {pro-inflammatory} signals in the body.
e.zh: 压力会增加体内促炎信号。

e.en: The study measured several {pro-inflammatory} proteins in blood samples.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了血样中的几种促炎蛋白。

pro-life.t: 反对堕胎的；维护胎儿生命的

e.en: The senator spoke at a {pro-life} conference.
e.zh: 那位参议员在反对堕胎的会议上发言。

e.en: Her {pro-life} views shaped her vote on the bill.
e.zh: 她维护胎儿生命的观点影响了她对法案的投票。

e.en: The government became more {pro-nuclear} after the energy crisis.
e.zh: 能源危机后，政府变得更支持核能。

e.en: He wrote a {pro-nuclear} article about low-carbon electricity.
e.zh: 他写了一篇支持核能的文章，讨论低碳电力。

e.en: High doses of the vitamin may have {pro-oxidant} effects.
e.zh: 高剂量的这种维生素可能产生促氧化作用。

e.en: The researchers tested whether the compound acted as a {pro-oxidant}.
e.zh: 研究人员测试该化合物是否起氧化促进剂的作用。

e.en: Several {pro-Palestinian} groups joined the march downtown.
e.zh: 几个支持巴勒斯坦人的团体参加了市中心的游行。

e.en: The article was criticized for its {pro-Palestinian} tone.
e.zh: 这篇文章因其支持巴勒斯坦人的语气而受到批评。

e.en: Bonuses will be paid on a {pro-rata} basis.
e.zh: 奖金将按比例发放。

e.en: Part-time staff receive {pro-rata} holiday entitlement.
e.zh: 兼职员工按比例享有假期权益。

e.en: In grammar, do can function as a {pro-verb}.
e.zh: 在语法中，do 可以充当代动词。

e.en: The teacher explained how a {pro-verb} avoids repeating the main verb.
e.zh: 老师解释了代动词如何避免重复主要动词。

e.en: The {pro-vice-chancellors} met to discuss research funding.
e.zh: 几位大学副校长开会讨论科研经费。

e.en: Two {pro-vice-chancellors} signed the university's new policy.
e.zh: 两名副校长签署了大学的新政策。

e.en: The sailor crossed the lagoon in a {proa}.
e.zh: 水手乘一艘太平洋双体帆船穿过泻湖。

e.en: A traditional {proa} has an outrigger on one side.
e.zh: 传统的太平洋双体帆船一侧有支架浮体。

e.en: The group ran a {proabortion} campaign before the vote.
e.zh: 投票前，该团体开展了支持堕胎权的宣传。

e.en: She avoided the label {proabortion} and spoke about reproductive rights.
e.zh: 她避免使用支持堕胎权这个标签，而谈论生育权利。

proaccelerin.t: 凝血酶原加速素；第五凝血因子

e.en: Doctors once used {proaccelerin} as a name for factor V.
e.zh: 医生曾用凝血酶原加速素来称呼第五凝血因子。

e.en: A deficiency of {proaccelerin} can affect normal clotting.
e.zh: 第五凝血因子缺乏会影响正常凝血。

e.en: The enzyme converts the {proactivator} into an active form.
e.zh: 这种酶会把前激活物转化为活性形式。

e.en: Researchers identified a {proactivator} in the blood sample.
e.zh: 研究人员在血样中发现了一种激活前体。

e.en: Her {proactivity} helped the team avoid delays.
e.zh: 她的主动性帮助团队避免了延误。

e.en: Managers value {proactivity} when problems are still small.
e.zh: 问题还小时，管理者很看重积极预见问题的能力。

e.en: The paper described a rare {proagglutinoid} reaction in serum.
e.zh: 论文描述了血清中一种罕见的前凝集素样反应。

e.en: Few modern textbooks mention {proagglutinoid} as a diagnostic term.
e.zh: 现代教材很少把前凝集素样物质作为诊断术语提到。

probabiliorism.t: 较可靠说；神学道德学派

e.en: The seminar discussed {probabiliorism} in Catholic moral theology.
e.zh: 研讨课讨论了天主教道德神学中的较可靠说。

e.en: Under {probabiliorism}, the safer opinion should usually be followed.
e.zh: 按照较可靠说，通常应遵循更可靠的意见。

e.en: A {probabiliorist} would reject the less supported moral opinion.
e.zh: 较可靠说信奉者会拒绝依据较弱的道德意见。

e.en: The historian called him a strict {probabiliorist}.
e.zh: 历史学家称他是严格的较可靠说信奉者。

e.en: The lecture traced {probabilism} through early modern theology.
e.zh: 讲座追溯了近代早期神学中的盖然论。

e.en: In ethics, {probabilism} allows action on a probable opinion.
e.zh: 在伦理学中，或然说允许依据有可能成立的意见行动。

e.en: The model predicts outcomes {probabilistically}, not with certainty.
e.zh: 这个模型按概率预测结果，而不是给出确定答案。

e.en: Risk is best understood {probabilistically} in this case.
e.zh: 在这种情况下，风险最好从概率上理解。

e.en: The theory tries to {probabilize} claims about future events.
e.zh: 该理论试图把关于未来事件的主张概率化。

e.en: Researchers may {probabilize} uncertain observations before analysis.
e.zh: 研究人员可能在分析前按概率处理不确定的观察结果。

e.en: The judge was admired for his {probacy} and restraint.
e.zh: 这位法官因正直和克制而受人敬重。

e.en: Her reputation for {probacy} made the accusation surprising.
e.zh: 她一向以诚实著称，因此这项指控令人意外。

procacious.t: 大胆鲁莽的；放肆的；无礼的

e.en: His {procacious} reply shocked the committee.
e.zh: 他那放肆的回答让委员会震惊。

e.en: The critic admired her {procacious} refusal to flatter anyone.
e.zh: 评论家欣赏她大胆地拒绝奉承任何人。

e.en: Her {procacity} made the interview uncomfortable.
e.zh: 她的放肆无礼让这次采访很不自在。

e.en: The essay praised the artist's {procacity} in attacking convention.
e.zh: 这篇文章称赞那位艺术家挑战传统的大胆。

e.en: The dentist used {procaine} before removing the tooth.
e.zh: 牙医在拔牙前使用了普鲁卡因。

e.en: A small dose of {procaine} numbed the skin quickly.
e.zh: 小剂量普鲁卡因很快让皮肤麻木。

procambial.t: 原形成层的；前维管组织的

e.en: The {procambial} cells later formed vascular tissue.
e.zh: 这些原形成层细胞后来形成了维管组织。

e.en: Researchers traced {procambial} strands in the young stem.
e.zh: 研究人员追踪了幼茎中的原形成层条索。

e.en: The {procambium} gives rise to xylem and phloem.
e.zh: 原形成层会发育成木质部和韧皮部。

e.en: Damage to the {procambium} affected the seedling's growth.
e.zh: 原形成层受损影响了幼苗的生长。

procamide.t: 普鲁卡酰胺；抗心律失常药

e.en: The physician prescribed {procamide} for the arrhythmia.
e.zh: 医生为心律失常开了普鲁卡酰胺。

e.en: Patients taking {procamide} need regular monitoring.
e.zh: 服用普鲁卡酰胺的患者需要定期监测。

e.en: The regimen included {procarbazine} and radiation therapy.
e.zh: 治疗方案包括丙卡巴肼和放射治疗。

e.en: Nausea is a common side effect of {procarbazine}.
e.zh: 恶心是丙卡巴肼常见的副作用。

procarp.t: 原果器；红藻雌性生殖结构

e.en: The biologist identified a {procarp} under the microscope.
e.zh: 生物学家在显微镜下辨认出一个原果器。

e.en: In red algae, the {procarp} is part of reproduction.
e.zh: 在红藻中，原果器是生殖结构的一部分。

procaryote.t: 原核生物；无细胞核生物

e.en: A bacterium is a typical {procaryote}.
e.zh: 细菌是典型的原核生物。

e.en: The textbook contrasted a {procaryote} with a eukaryote.
e.zh: 教材把原核生物与真核生物作了对比。

e.en: The sample contained several {procaryotic} cells.
e.zh: 样本中含有几种原核细胞。

e.en: Antibiotics often target {procaryotic} ribosomes.
e.zh: 抗生素常常以原核生物的核糖体为靶点。

procathedral.t: 临时主教座堂；代主教座堂

e.en: The old church served as a {procathedral} for decades.
e.zh: 这座老教堂几十年来充当临时主教座堂。

e.en: A {procathedral} may function until a permanent cathedral is built.
e.zh: 临时主教座堂可在永久主教座堂建成前发挥作用。

proceleusmatic.t: 四短音步的；催促节奏的

e.en: The poem ends with a {proceleusmatic} foot.
e.zh: 这首诗以一个四短音步结尾。

e.en: The chant had a brisk, {proceleusmatic} movement.
e.zh: 这段吟唱带有明快催促的四短音步节奏。

e.en: The ship crossed a {procellous} sea at night.
e.zh: 船在夜里穿过波涛汹涌的大海。

e.en: His memoir recalls a {procellous} season of politics.
e.zh: 他的回忆录写到一段风雨飘摇的政治时期。

e.en: The embryo showed early {procephalic} development.
e.zh: 胚胎显示出早期前头部发育。

e.en: Scientists mapped the {procephalic} region of the larva.
e.zh: 科学家绘制了幼虫前头部区域的图谱。

e.en: The parasite develops into a {procercoid} inside the copepod.
e.zh: 这种寄生虫在桡足类体内发育成原尾蚴。

e.en: Students examined a stained {procercoid} in the lab.
e.zh: 学生们在实验室观察了染色的原尾蚴。

e.en: The alloy's {processability} improved after heat treatment.
e.zh: 热处理后，这种合金的可加工性提高了。

e.en: Engineers tested the data's {processability} at scale.
e.zh: 工程师测试了这些数据在大规模条件下的可处理性。

e.en: The files are {processable} by the new system.
e.zh: 这些文件可以由新系统处理。

e.en: The plastic becomes {processable} only at high temperatures.
e.zh: 这种塑料只有在高温下才可加工。

e.en: The paper discusses the {processibility} of complex sentences.
e.zh: 这篇论文讨论复杂句的可处理性。

e.en: Manufacturers value the resin's high {processibility}.
e.zh: 制造商看重这种树脂较高的可加工性。

e.en: The raw data was not {processible} without cleaning.
e.zh: 原始数据未经清洗无法处理。

e.en: At that temperature, the compound becomes {processible}.
e.zh: 在那个温度下，这种化合物变得可以加工。

e.en: The monks followed a {processionary} route through the town.
e.zh: 修士们沿着城中的游行路线列队前进。

e.en: The caterpillars moved in a {processionary} line.
e.zh: 这些毛虫排成一列向前移动。

processionist.t: 游行参加者；列队行进者

e.en: Each {processionist} carried a candle through the square.
e.zh: 每位游行参加者都举着蜡烛穿过广场。

e.en: The marshal directed every {processionist} to the left gate.
e.zh: 司仪指引每个列队行进者走向左侧大门。

e.en: The enzyme is highly {processive} on long DNA strands.
e.zh: 这种酶在长DNA链上具有很强的连续作用能力。

e.en: Her argument has a {processive} structure, moving step by step.
e.zh: 她的论证具有逐步推进的结构。

e.en: The scan revealed a fracture near the {processus}.
e.zh: 扫描显示突起附近有一处骨折。

e.en: Anatomists used {processus} to describe the bony projection.
e.zh: 解剖学家用processus来描述这个骨性突部。

e.en: The chemist identified {procetane} in the wax sample.
e.zh: 化学家在蜡样品中鉴定出鲸蜡烷。

e.en: Older texts describe {procetane} as a hydrocarbon from spermaceti.
e.zh: 旧文献把鲸蜡烷描述为来自鲸蜡的烃类物质。

proban.t: 用于试验的人或物；受试对象

e.en: The scientist recorded each {proban} separately during the trial.
e.zh: 科学家在试验中分别记录每个受试对象。

e.en: A single {proban} cannot prove the treatment works.
e.zh: 单个受试对象不能证明这种治疗有效。

e.en: The {proband} was the first family member diagnosed.
e.zh: 这名先证者是家族中第一个被诊断的人。

e.en: Researchers traced the mutation from the {proband} to relatives.
e.zh: 研究人员从先证者追踪这种突变到其亲属。

probang.t: 食管探条；长柄海绵探子

e.en: The doctor used a {probang} to examine the throat.
e.zh: 医生用长柄探子检查喉部。

e.en: A {probang} can help remove an obstruction in the esophagus.
e.zh: 食管探条可帮助取出食管中的阻塞物。

e.en: Her {probational} period ended after three months.
e.zh: 她的试用期三个月后结束。

e.en: The judge set strict {probational} conditions for him.
e.zh: 法官为他设定了严格的缓刑条件。

e.en: His {probationership} at the firm lasted six months.
e.zh: 他在公司的试用职位持续了六个月。

e.en: The school offered a {probationership} before permanent appointment.
e.zh: 学校在正式任命前提供了一个见习职位。

e.en: The lawyer presented {probatory} documents to support the claim.
e.zh: 律师提交了证明性文件来支持这一主张。

e.en: The committee began with a {probatory} review of the method.
e.zh: 委员会先对该方法进行了试验性审查。

e.en: The surface is {probeable} with a fine medical instrument.
e.zh: 这个表面可用精细医疗器械探查。

e.en: Only some parts of the scandal were {probeable}.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻只有部分内容可以调查。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {probenecid} for chronic gout.
e.zh: 医生为慢性痛风开了丙磺舒。

e.en: Some antibiotics last longer when taken with {probenecid}.
e.zh: 有些抗生素与丙磺舒同服时作用时间更长。

e.en: The senior firefighter showed the {probie} around the station.
e.zh: 资深消防员带这名新手熟悉了消防站。

e.en: As a {probie}, she had to prove herself quickly.
e.zh: 作为试用期人员，她必须很快证明自己。

probit.t: 概率单位；概率模型转换值

e.en: The analyst used a {probit} model for the survey data.
e.zh: 分析师对调查数据使用了概率单位模型。

e.en: Each {probit} value represents a transformed probability.
e.zh: 每个概率单位值都表示一个转换后的概率。

e.en: The course uses {problem-based} learning from the first week.
e.zh: 这门课从第一周开始采用以问题为基础的学习。

e.en: A {problem-based} approach helped students connect theory with practice.
e.zh: 以问题为基础的方法帮助学生把理论和实践联系起来。

e.en: The team adopted a {problem-oriented} method for the audit.
e.zh: 团队在审计中采用了以问题为导向的方法。

e.en: His notes were concise and {problem-oriented}.
e.zh: 他的笔记简明扼要，并且以问题为导向。

e.en: The workbook lists {problem-solutions} after each chapter.
e.zh: 练习册在每章后列出问题解决方案。

e.en: Teachers compared different {problem-solutions} in class.
e.zh: 老师们在课堂上比较了不同的问题解决方案。

e.en: She is a practical {problem-solver} under pressure.
e.zh: 她在压力下是个务实的解题能手。

e.en: Every project needs at least one calm {problem-solver}.
e.zh: 每个项目都至少需要一位冷静的问题解决者。

e.en: The essay explores the colonial {problematique} in modern fiction.
e.zh: 这篇文章探讨现代小说中的殖民问题框架。

e.en: Her lecture reframed the {problematique} of urban poverty.
e.zh: 她的讲座重新界定了城市贫困的问题意识。

e.en: The article tries to {problematise} the idea of neutrality.
e.zh: 这篇文章试图把中立这一观念问题化。

e.en: Good theory can {problematise} assumptions that seem obvious.
e.zh: 好的理论能质疑那些看似显然的假设。

e.en: The author {problematises} the usual definition of progress.
e.zh: 作者质疑了进步的通常定义。

e.en: This chapter {problematises} the boundary between public and private.
e.zh: 本章把公共与私人之间的界限问题化。

e.en: The chess {problemist} composed puzzles for magazines.
e.zh: 这位国际象棋排局作者为杂志创作谜题。

e.en: As a social {problemist}, he studied poverty and reform.
e.zh: 作为社会问题研究者，他研究贫困与改革。

e.en: The drawing showed a strange {proboscidate} insect.
e.zh: 图画展示了一只有奇特吻突的昆虫。

e.en: A {proboscidate} face gave the mask a comic look.
e.zh: 一个长鼻状的脸让面具显得滑稽。

e.en: The museum displayed a {proboscidean} fossil from the Ice Age.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件冰河时代的长鼻目动物化石。

e.en: Elephants are the best-known {proboscidean} animals today.
e.zh: 大象是如今最著名的长鼻目动物。

e.en: Butterflies extend their {proboscides} to drink nectar.
e.zh: 蝴蝶伸出吻突来吸食花蜜。

e.en: The statue had several carved {proboscides} like elephant trunks.
e.zh: 这座雕像刻有几条像象鼻一样的长鼻。

e.en: A mammoth was a prehistoric {proboscidian}.
e.zh: 猛犸象是一种史前长鼻目动物。

e.en: The skull has clear {proboscidian} features.
e.zh: 这个头骨具有明显的象类特征。

e.en: The plant has a {proboscidiform} tube that attracts insects.
e.zh: 这种植物有一根吸引昆虫的长鼻状管。

e.en: A {proboscidiform} ornament hung from the old helmet.
e.zh: 旧头盔上垂着一个长鼻状装饰。

e.en: The surgeon was {probusing} the wound with great care.
e.zh: 外科医生正十分小心地用探子探查伤口。

e.en: He spent the afternoon {probusing} the blocked pipe.
e.zh: 他花了一下午用长柄探子探查堵塞的管道。

proctiger.t: 肛门括约肌；直肠括约肌

e.en: The surgeon identified the {proctiger} during the dissection.
e.zh: 外科医生在解剖过程中辨认出了肛门括约肌。

e.en: Damage to the {proctiger} can affect continence.
e.zh: 肛门括约肌受损可能影响控便能力。

e.en: Radiation therapy sometimes causes {proctitis}.
e.zh: 放射治疗有时会引起直肠炎。

e.en: The patient reported bleeding during a flare of {proctitis}.
e.zh: 患者说直肠炎发作时出现了出血。

e.en: The nurse prepared {proctoclysis} for the dehydrated patient.
e.zh: 护士为脱水患者准备了直肠输液法。

e.en: Before modern intravenous therapy, {proctoclysis} was sometimes used.
e.zh: 在现代静脉输液出现以前，有时会使用直肠输液法。

e.en: The paper described {proctodaeal} development in early embryos.
e.zh: 论文描述了早期胚胎中的原肛发育。

e.en: A {proctodaeal} opening forms near the tail end.
e.zh: 原肛开口会在尾端附近形成。

e.en: The {proctodaeum} later contributes to the anal canal.
e.zh: 原肛随后参与形成肛管。

e.en: In some animals, the {proctodaeum} is easy to identify.
e.zh: 在某些动物中，原肛很容易辨认。

e.en: The lecturer pointed to the {proctodeum} on the diagram.
e.zh: 讲师在图上指出了原肛的位置。

e.en: Abnormal growth of the {proctodeum} may affect the anus.
e.zh: 原肛异常发育可能影响肛门。

e.en: He went to a {proctological} clinic for treatment.
e.zh: 他去了肛肠科诊所接受治疗。

e.en: The report used several {proctological} terms.
e.zh: 这份报告使用了几个肛肠病学术语。

e.en: She chose {proctology} as her surgical specialty.
e.zh: 她选择肛肠病学作为自己的外科专科。

e.en: Modern {proctology} treats disorders of the rectum and anus.
e.zh: 现代肛肠病学治疗直肠和肛门疾病。

e.en: The university issued new {proctorial} rules for exams.
e.zh: 大学发布了新的考试监考规则。

e.en: His {proctorial} duties included supervising student conduct.
e.zh: 他的学监职责包括监督学生行为。

e.en: The platform can {proctorize} online exams automatically.
e.zh: 这个平台可以自动监督线上考试。

e.en: They hired staff to {proctorize} the entrance test.
e.zh: 他们雇了人员来监考入学考试。

e.en: He held the {proctorship} for two academic years.
e.zh: 他担任了两个学年的学监职位。

e.en: The {proctorship} required fairness during every examination.
e.zh: 监考职务要求在每场考试中保持公正。

e.en: The doctor examined the rectum with a {proctoscope}.
e.zh: 医生用直肠镜检查了直肠。

e.en: A disposable {proctoscope} was used in the clinic.
e.zh: 诊所里使用了一次性直肠镜。

e.en: The cancer was treated with a {proctosigmoidectomy}.
e.zh: 这种癌症通过直肠乙状结肠切除术治疗。

e.en: Recovery after {proctosigmoidectomy} can take several weeks.
e.zh: 直肠乙状结肠切除术后的恢复可能需要数周。

e.en: The herb has long {procumbent} stems.
e.zh: 这种草本植物有长长的匍匐茎。

e.en: A {procumbent} figure lay across the old painting.
e.zh: 那幅旧画里有一个平卧的人影。

e.en: Fresh water was not easily {procurable} there.
e.zh: 在那里淡水并不容易获得。

e.en: The parts are {procurable} from several suppliers.
e.zh: 这些零件可以从几家供应商那里买到。

e.en: Several regional {procuracies} reviewed the corruption cases.
e.zh: 几个地区检察机关审查了这些腐败案件。

e.en: The old records list two vacant {procuracies}.
e.zh: 旧记录列出了两个空缺的代理职位。

e.en: The {procuracy} opened an investigation into the company.
e.zh: 检察机关对这家公司展开了调查。

e.en: He accepted a temporary {procuracy} in the province.
e.zh: 他接受了该省一个临时代理职务。

e.en: The lawyer reviewed the {procural} documents carefully.
e.zh: 律师仔细审查了代理文件。

e.en: They discussed the {procural} process for rare materials.
e.zh: 他们讨论了稀有材料的取得流程。

e.en: The agent assisted in the {procurance} of supplies.
e.zh: 代理人协助取得了物资。

e.en: His {procurance} of the deal surprised everyone.
e.zh: 他促成这笔交易让所有人都很意外。

e.en: She signed the contract by {procuration}.
e.zh: 她凭代理权签署了合同。

e.en: The notary checked the {procuration} before accepting it.
e.zh: 公证员在接受前核查了授权书。

e.en: The {procuratorate} approved the arrest warrant.
e.zh: 检察院批准了逮捕令。

e.en: Cases were transferred to the provincial {procuratorate}.
e.zh: 案件被移交给省级检察机关。

e.en: The court reviewed the {procuratorial} recommendation.
e.zh: 法院审查了检察机关的建议。

e.en: His {procuratorial} authority came from a written mandate.
e.zh: 他的代理人权限来自一份书面授权。

procuratorship.t: 代理人职位；检察官职位

e.en: He resigned from the {procuratorship} after the inquiry.
e.zh: 调查结束后，他辞去了检察官职位。

e.en: The estate required a formal {procuratorship}.
e.zh: 这份遗产事务需要一个正式的代理人职位。

e.en: The clerk filed the {procuratory} letter with the court.
e.zh: 书记员把授权信提交给了法院。

e.en: A {procuratory} role allowed him to act for the owner.
e.zh: 代理角色允许他代表业主行事。

e.en: The surgeon marked the {procheilon} before repairing the lip.
e.zh: 外科医生在修复嘴唇前标出了上唇红缘。

e.en: Swelling along the {procheilon} made speech uncomfortable.
e.zh: 前唇部边缘肿胀让他说话很不舒服。

e.en: The molecule shows {prochirality} before the enzyme binds it.
e.zh: 这种分子在酶结合之前表现出前手性。

e.en: Students often confuse {prochirality} with ordinary chirality.
e.zh: 学生常把前手性和普通手性混淆。

e.en: The thin section contained altered {prochlorite} near the vein.
e.zh: 薄片中在矿脉附近含有蚀变的前绿泥石。

e.en: Some geologists described the mineral as {prochlorite}.
e.zh: 一些地质学家把这种矿物描述为前绿泥石。

e.en: The embryo develops a {prochorion} during the early stage.
e.zh: 胚胎在早期阶段会形成前绒毛膜。

e.en: Researchers stained the {prochorion} to observe its structure.
e.zh: 研究人员给前绒毛膜染色，以观察其结构。

e.en: The nucleus showed dense {prochromatin} under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下，细胞核显示出致密的原染色质。

e.en: Older papers used {prochromatin} for material seen before division.
e.zh: 早期论文用原染色质指分裂前可见的物质。

e.en: Calling the ancient ruler a president is a {prochronism}.
e.zh: 把那位古代统治者称为总统，是年代提前误置。

e.en: The novel uses {prochronism} to make history feel familiar.
e.zh: 这部小说用年代提前误置让历史显得更亲近。

e.en: Calf stomach cells produce {prochymosin} before active chymosin forms.
e.zh: 小牛胃细胞先产生凝乳酶原，然后才形成活性凝乳酶。

e.en: The lab converted {prochymosin} into an enzyme for cheese making.
e.zh: 实验室把凝乳酶原转化为用于制奶酪的酶。

procidentia.t: 子宫完全脱垂；器官脱垂

e.en: The patient was treated for uterine {procidentia}.
e.zh: 这名患者接受了子宫完全脱垂的治疗。

e.en: Severe {procidentia} can make walking and sitting painful.
e.zh: 严重的器官脱垂会使行走和坐下都很疼。

e.en: The mayor adopted a {proclamatory} tone at the ceremony.
e.zh: 市长在仪式上采用了宣告式的语气。

e.en: Her essay ends with a bold, {proclamatory} sentence.
e.zh: 她的文章以一句大胆而宣告性的句子收尾。

proclimax.t: 前顶极群落；准顶极群落

e.en: Fire kept the forest in a {proclimax} state for decades.
e.zh: 火灾使这片森林几十年来一直处于前顶极群落状态。

e.en: The ecologist identified the grassland as a stable {proclimax}.
e.zh: 生态学家把这片草原认定为稳定的准顶极群落。

e.en: The insect has {proclinate} bristles above its eyes.
e.zh: 这种昆虫眼睛上方有向前倾斜的刚毛。

e.en: A {proclinate} posture can strain the lower back.
e.zh: 身体向前倾斜的姿势可能会拉伤下背部。

e.en: In that phrase, the article functions as a {proclitic}.
e.zh: 在那个短语中，冠词起前附着词的作用。

e.en: A {proclitic} form attaches to the following word.
e.zh: 前附着形式会依附在后面的词上。

procnemial.t: 胫骨前部的；小腿前侧的

e.en: The athlete felt pain in the {procnemial} region after running.
e.zh: 这名运动员跑步后感到小腿前侧疼痛。

e.en: The doctor examined the {procnemial} surface for tenderness.
e.zh: 医生检查了胫骨前部表面是否有压痛。

e.en: The venom contains a strong {procoagulant} protein.
e.zh: 这种毒液含有一种强效促凝血蛋白。

e.en: Doctors monitored the patient's {procoagulant} activity after surgery.
e.zh: 医生在手术后监测患者的促凝血活性。

e.en: Many frogs have {procoelian} vertebrae in the backbone.
e.zh: 许多青蛙的脊柱中有前凹椎。

e.en: The fossil was identified by its {procoelian} centrum.
e.zh: 这块化石因其前凹的椎体而被鉴定出来。

e.en: He governed the province with {proconsular} authority.
e.zh: 他以总督权力治理这个行省。

e.en: The inscription mentions a {proconsular} official from Rome.
e.zh: 铭文提到了一名来自罗马的总督级官员。

e.en: His {proconsulate} in Asia lasted only one year.
e.zh: 他在亚细亚的总督任期只有一年。

e.en: The historian studied records from the Roman {proconsulate}.
e.zh: 历史学家研究了罗马总督职位相关的记录。

e.en: The senator gained wealth during his {proconsulship}.
e.zh: 这位元老在担任总督期间积累了财富。

e.en: His {proconsulship} became a subject of later debate.
e.zh: 他的总督任期后来成了争论的话题。

e.en: A lack of {proconvertin} can impair normal clotting.
e.zh: 缺乏凝血因子七会影响正常凝血。

e.en: The assay measured {proconvertin} levels in the plasma.
e.zh: 这项检测测量了血浆中的前转变素水平。

e.en: The poet praised the {procreant} power of spring.
e.zh: 诗人赞美春天孕育生命的繁殖力量。

e.en: They viewed marriage as a {procreant} union.
e.zh: 他们把婚姻看作能孕育后代的结合。

e.en: The law recognized him as the child's {procreator}.
e.zh: 法律承认他是这个孩子的生育者。

e.en: She was called the {procreator} of a new artistic style.
e.zh: 她被称为一种新艺术风格的创造者。

e.en: The moth relies on {procrypsis} against tree bark.
e.zh: 这种蛾依靠保护性隐蔽融入树皮。

e.en: Desert insects use {procrypsis} to avoid hungry birds.
e.zh: 沙漠昆虫利用拟态隐身来躲避饥饿的鸟类。

e.en: The lizard's {procryptic} pattern matches the sand.
e.zh: 这只蜥蜴的保护色花纹与沙地相配。

e.en: A {procryptic} animal may remain still when threatened.
e.zh: 具有隐蔽性的动物在受威胁时可能会保持不动。

e.en: The surgeon recommended a {proctectomy} after repeated complications.
e.zh: 在反复出现并发症后，外科医生建议进行直肠切除术。

e.en: Recovery from {proctectomy} requires careful wound care.
e.zh: 直肠切除术后的恢复需要仔细护理伤口。

e.en: The novel portrays the {procuress} as cold and calculating.
e.zh: 小说把那个老鸨描写得冷酷又精于算计。

e.en: She was accused of acting as a {procuress} for wealthy clients.
e.zh: 她被指控为有钱客户拉皮条。

e.en: The police arrested several {procuresses} in the raid.
e.zh: 警方在突击行动中逮捕了几名老鸨。

e.en: Victorian reformers often wrote about {procuresses} in city slums.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的改革者常写到城市贫民区里的拉皮条女人。

e.en: The botanist noted the leaf's {procurrent} base.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这片叶子的基部向前延伸。

e.en: A {procurrent} ridge runs along the shell.
e.zh: 一道前伸的脊沿着贝壳延伸。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {procyclidine} for the tremor.
e.zh: 医生开了丙环定来缓解震颤。

e.en: Patients should not stop taking {procyclidine} suddenly.
e.zh: 患者不应突然停用丙环定。

e.en: The hunter carried a {prodag} beside his bow.
e.zh: 猎人除了弓之外还带着一支短标枪。

e.en: An old {prodag} hung above the fireplace.
e.zh: 壁炉上方挂着一支旧投矛。

e.en: The linguist described the form as {prodelision}.
e.zh: 语言学家把这种形式称为词首音省略。

e.en: In casual speech, {prodelision} can make words harder to recognize.
e.zh: 在随意口语中，词首音省略会让词更难辨认。

e.en: Fine mud settled across the {prodelta}.
e.zh: 细泥沉积在前三角洲区域。

e.en: The cores showed a buried {prodelta} layer.
e.zh: 岩芯显示出一层被埋藏的前三角洲沉积层。

e.en: New {prodentin} forms before it mineralizes.
e.zh: 新的前期牙本质会先形成，然后再矿化。

e.en: The microscope revealed a thin band of {prodentin}.
e.zh: 显微镜下可见一条薄薄的前期牙本质带。

e.en: He began to {prodigalise} his inheritance abroad.
e.zh: 他开始在国外挥霍自己的遗产。

e.en: The satire mocks nobles who {prodigalise} public money.
e.zh: 这篇讽刺作品嘲笑那些挥霍公款的贵族。

e.en: She refused to {prodigalize} the family's savings.
e.zh: 她拒绝挥霍家里的积蓄。

e.en: The prince was known to {prodigalize} vast sums on feasts.
e.zh: 那位王子以在宴会上挥霍巨款而闻名。

e.en: The bacterium produces {prodigiosin} under certain conditions.
e.zh: 这种细菌在特定条件下会产生灵菌红素。

e.en: Researchers studied {prodigiosin} for possible medical uses.
e.zh: 研究人员研究灵菌红素是否有医学用途。

e.en: The larval shell is called the {prodissoconch}.
e.zh: 这种幼体贝壳称为幼贝初壳。

e.en: Growth lines on the {prodissoconch} helped identify the species.
e.zh: 幼贝初壳上的生长线帮助鉴定了物种。

e.en: The specimen was classified as a {prodorit}.
e.zh: 这个标本被归为未成熟多利特体。

e.en: A {prodorit} may show features absent in adults.
e.zh: 未成熟多利特体可能呈现成体没有的特征。

e.en: Fever can be a {prodromal} sign of infection.
e.zh: 发热可能是感染的前驱症状。

e.en: The patient reported {prodromal} anxiety before each migraine.
e.zh: 患者说每次偏头痛前都会有先兆性的焦虑。

e.en: The rash appeared after several {prodromata}.
e.zh: 在出现几种前驱症状后，皮疹才显现出来。

e.en: Doctors asked about early {prodromata} before the seizure.
e.zh: 医生询问癫痫发作前是否有早期先兆。

e.en: A stiff neck was her usual migraine {prodrome}.
e.zh: 颈部僵硬是她偏头痛常见的先兆。

e.en: The {prodrome} lasted two days before the fever began.
e.zh: 发烧开始前，前驱期持续了两天。

e.en: The nurse recorded several {prodromic} symptoms.
e.zh: 护士记录了几个前驱症状。

e.en: His {prodromic} mood changes warned him of an attack.
e.zh: 先兆性的情绪变化提醒他病情即将发作。

e.en: The report compared each {producer-city} with nearby markets.
e.zh: 报告把每个生产城市与附近市场进行了比较。

e.en: A {producer-city} often depends on strong transport links.
e.zh: 产地城市往往依赖发达的交通联系。

e.en: Engineers tested the design for {producibility}.
e.zh: 工程师测试了这个设计的可制造性。

e.en: Low {producibility} can make a clever prototype unprofitable.
e.zh: 可生产性低会让巧妙的原型难以盈利。

e.en: The part is {producible} with existing machines.
e.zh: 这个零件可以用现有机器制造。

e.en: A theory must make {producible} results in the lab.
e.zh: 一种理论必须能在实验室产生可复现的结果。

e.en: The company follows a {product-driven} growth strategy.
e.zh: 这家公司采取产品驱动的增长策略。

e.en: A {product-driven} team listens closely to user behavior.
e.zh: 产品驱动的团队会密切关注用户行为。

e.en: The company expanded its {product-line} last year.
e.zh: 这家公司去年扩展了产品线。

e.en: Each {product-line} has its own sales team.
e.zh: 每条产品线都有自己的销售团队。

e.en: Investors questioned the invention's {productability}.
e.zh: 投资者质疑这项发明的可产品化程度。

e.en: Good design can improve the {productability} of a concept.
e.zh: 优秀设计能提高一个概念的可产品化程度。

e.en: The old essay praises labor as {productile}.
e.zh: 那篇旧文章赞扬劳动具有生产力。

e.en: A {productile} soil can support several harvests.
e.zh: 富有生产力的土壤能支撑多次收成。

profilograph.t: 轮廓记录仪；断面描绘仪

e.en: The engineer used a {profilograph} to measure the road surface.
e.zh: 工程师用轮廓记录仪测量路面。

e.en: A {profilograph} traced the tiny curves on the metal part.
e.zh: 轮廓记录仪描绘出金属零件上的细微曲线。

e.en: The lab checked the coating with a {profilometer}.
e.zh: 实验室用轮廓仪检查涂层。

e.en: A {profilometer} can detect scratches too small to see.
e.zh: 轮廓仪能检测肉眼看不见的划痕。

profit-hungry.t: 贪图利润的；唯利是图的

e.en: The {profit-hungry} landlord raised rents again.
e.zh: 那个唯利是图的房东又涨了房租。

e.en: Critics called the merger a {profit-hungry} move.
e.zh: 批评者称这次合并是贪图利润的举动。

e.en: Several {profit-takers} sold shares after the rally.
e.zh: 几名获利了结者在股价上涨后卖出股票。

e.en: The market fell as {profit-takers} moved in.
e.zh: 套现者入场后，市场下跌了。

e.en: The sample was treated with {proflavin} before imaging.
e.zh: 成像前，样本用原黄素处理过。

e.en: Doctors once used {proflavin} as an antiseptic dye.
e.zh: 医生过去曾把原黄素用作消毒染料。

e.en: The poet described a {profluent} river under the moon.
e.zh: 诗人描写了月光下一条向前流淌的河。

e.en: A {profluent} stream carried silt into the bay.
e.zh: 一股流出的溪水把淤泥带进海湾。

e.en: The old medical text mentioned a bloody {profluvium}.
e.zh: 那本旧医学书提到一种带血的异常排出。

e.en: A foul {profluvium} seeped from the damaged pipe.
e.zh: 恶臭的流出物从破损管道渗出。

e.en: He kept the coins in a leather {profonde}.
e.zh: 他把硬币放在一个皮制深包里。

e.en: The rider searched the {profonde} beside the saddle.
e.zh: 骑手翻找马鞍旁的鞍袋式口袋。

e.en: The crew lowered a {profondometer} into the lake.
e.zh: 船员把测深仪放入湖中。

e.en: A {profondometer} gave the diver a safer reading.
e.zh: 测深仪给潜水员提供了更安全的读数。

e.en: The supplier sent a {proforma} invoice before shipping.
e.zh: 供应商在发货前寄来形式发票。

e.en: The board gave only {proforma} approval to the plan.
e.zh: 董事会只是形式上批准了该计划。

e.en: The surgeon identified the {profunda} during the operation.
e.zh: 外科医生在手术中辨认出深部动脉。

e.en: Damage near the {profunda} can reduce blood flow.
e.zh: 深部动脉附近受损会减少血流。

profundal.t: 深水底层的；湖底深处的

e.en: Few plants survive in the {profundal} zone of the lake.
e.zh: 很少有植物能在湖底深水带生存。

e.en: The study compared shallow and {profundal} sediments.
e.zh: 这项研究比较了浅层和深水底层沉积物。

e.en: A {profusive} bleeding worried the young doctor.
e.zh: 大量出血让年轻医生很担心。

e.en: His {profusive} spending soon emptied the account.
e.zh: 他挥霍无度的开支很快掏空了账户。

e.en: The microscope revealed a developing {progamete}.
e.zh: 显微镜显示出一个正在发育的原配子。

e.en: Each {progamete} later becomes a mature gamete.
e.zh: 每个原配子随后会变成成熟配子。

progamic.t: 受精前的；配子结合前的

e.en: The paper examined {progamic} events in flowering plants.
e.zh: 论文研究了开花植物中受精前的事件。

e.en: A {progamic} barrier can prevent successful fertilization.
e.zh: 配子结合前的障碍可能阻止成功受精。

progeid.t: 近地点的；近地点相关的

e.en: The moon's {progeid} position affected the tide tables.
e.zh: 月球的近地点位置影响了潮汐表。

e.en: Astronomers noted a {progeid} variation in the orbit.
e.zh: 天文学家注意到轨道中的近地点相关变化。

e.en: Some insects reproduce through {progenesis} under stress.
e.zh: 一些昆虫在压力下会通过早熟生殖繁殖。

e.en: The lecture contrasted {progenesis} with ordinary maturation.
e.zh: 讲座把幼态生殖与正常成熟作了对比。

e.en: The myth gave the river a {progenitive} power.
e.zh: 神话赋予这条河繁衍生命的力量。

e.en: Biologists studied the cell's {progenitive} function.
e.zh: 生物学家研究了该细胞的生殖功能。

e.en: His {progenitorship} of the movement is often disputed.
e.zh: 他作为该运动创始者的地位常有争议。

e.en: The family records emphasized her {progenitorship}.
e.zh: 家族记录强调了她的祖先身份。

e.en: They honored the queen as the clan's {progenitress}.
e.zh: 他们尊奉那位女王为氏族的女祖先。

e.en: The novelist is seen as a {progenitress} of the genre.
e.zh: 这位小说家被视为该文类的女性创始者。

e.en: The legend names her as the tribe's {progenitrix}.
e.zh: 传说称她为部族的女祖先。

e.en: Critics called the poet a {progenitrix} of modern verse.
e.zh: 评论家称这位诗人为现代诗的女性先驱。

e.en: The estate passed to his {progeniture} after his death.
e.zh: 他去世后，庄园传给了他的后代。

e.en: Writers spoke of ideas as the mind's {progeniture}.
e.zh: 作家们把思想称作心灵的产物。

e.en: The doctor measured the drug's {progestational} activity in the study.
e.zh: 医生在研究中测量了这种药物的孕激素活性。

e.en: Some contraceptives rely mainly on {progestational} effects.
e.zh: 有些避孕药主要依靠孕激素作用。

e.en: The researcher described a {progesteronic} change in the tissue.
e.zh: 研究人员描述了组织中的孕酮相关变化。

e.en: Her symptoms were linked to a {progesteronic} imbalance.
e.zh: 她的症状与孕酮失衡有关。

e.en: The sample contained a synthetic {progestine}.
e.zh: 样本中含有一种合成孕激素。

e.en: A {progestine} can affect the menstrual cycle.
e.zh: 孕激素可能会影响月经周期。

e.en: The pill includes a low dose of {progestogen}.
e.zh: 这种药片含有低剂量孕激素。

e.en: Doctors sometimes prescribe {progestogen} after menopause.
e.zh: 医生有时会在绝经后开孕激素。

e.en: The lab tested the level of {progestone} in the blood.
e.zh: 实验室检测了血液中的孕酮水平。

e.en: Older papers sometimes used {progestone} for progesterone.
e.zh: 早期论文有时用progestone指孕酮。

e.en: The compound showed weak {progestoral} properties.
e.zh: 这种化合物表现出较弱的孕激素性质。

e.en: They compared several {progestoral} agents in animals.
e.zh: 他们在动物身上比较了几种促孕药物。

e.en: Each {proglottid} contains reproductive organs.
e.zh: 每个绦虫节片都含有生殖器官。

e.en: A detached {proglottid} may pass in the stool.
e.zh: 脱落的绦虫节片可能随粪便排出。

e.en: The tapeworm released mature {proglottides}.
e.zh: 这条绦虫释放了成熟的节片。

e.en: Technicians identified {proglottides} under the microscope.
e.zh: 技术人员在显微镜下辨认出绦虫节片。

e.en: A {proglottis} is one segment of a tapeworm.
e.zh: proglottis是绦虫的一个节片。

e.en: The specimen included a damaged {proglottis}.
e.zh: 这个标本包含一个受损的绦虫节片。

e.en: The skull had a distinctly {prognathic} jaw.
e.zh: 这个头骨有明显突出的颌部。

e.en: Some apes have a more {prognathic} face.
e.zh: 有些猿类的面部更加突颌。

e.en: The dentist diagnosed mild {prognathism}.
e.zh: 牙医诊断出轻度突颌。

e.en: Facial {prognathism} can affect the bite.
e.zh: 面部突颌可能影响咬合。

e.en: The fossil shows a {prognathous} profile.
e.zh: 这块化石显示出突颌的侧面轮廓。

e.en: A {prognathous} jaw may require orthodontic treatment.
e.zh: 下颌前突可能需要正畸治疗。

e.en: The disease is partly {prognosticable} from early symptoms.
e.zh: 这种病可部分根据早期症状预测。

e.en: Only some outcomes are {prognosticable} with current data.
e.zh: 以现有数据看，只有部分结果可以预测。

e.en: Fever can be a {prognosticative} sign in this illness.
e.zh: 发热可能是这种疾病中有预后意义的迹象。

e.en: The report used several {prognosticative} indicators.
e.zh: 报告使用了几个预测性指标。

e.en: Rapeseed meal may contain {progoitrin}.
e.zh: 菜籽粕中可能含有前致甲状腺肿素。

e.en: Heating reduced the amount of {progoitrin} in the sample.
e.zh: 加热降低了样本中的前致甲状腺肿素含量。

e.en: The planet has a {prograde} orbit around the star.
e.zh: 这颗行星绕恒星作顺行轨道运动。

e.en: The river built a {prograde} delta over time.
e.zh: 这条河随着时间形成了向前推进的三角洲。

e.en: The shoreline {prograded} as sediment accumulated.
e.zh: 随着沉积物堆积，海岸线向前推进。

e.en: The deposits formed a {prograded} coastal plain.
e.zh: 这些沉积物形成了向海推进的海岸平原。

e.en: The thermostat is {programable} for each day of the week.
e.zh: 这个恒温器可以按一周每天进行编程。

e.en: They installed a {programable} controller in the machine.
e.zh: 他们在机器中安装了可编程控制器。

e.en: The chip's {programmability} makes it useful in many devices.
e.zh: 这种芯片的可编程性使它适用于许多设备。

e.en: Developers valued the system's {programmability}.
e.zh: 开发者看重这个系统的可编程性。

e.en: The paper introduced {programmetry} as a measurement approach.
e.zh: 这篇论文把程序测量学作为一种测量方法介绍。

e.en: Few students had heard of {programmetry} before the lecture.
e.zh: 讲座前很少有学生听说过程序测量学。

e.en: The therapist noted {progressional} gains in balance.
e.zh: 治疗师注意到平衡能力逐步改善。

e.en: The music follows a {progressional} pattern.
e.zh: 这段音乐遵循渐进式的模式。

e.en: The historian called him a cautious {progressionist}.
e.zh: 历史学家称他为谨慎的渐进主义者。

e.en: As a {progressionist}, she favored steady reform.
e.zh: 作为渐进主义者，她支持稳步改革。

e.en: The magazine attracted many young {progressist} writers.
e.zh: 这本杂志吸引了许多年轻的进步主义作家。

e.en: He spoke as a {progressist} in the debate.
e.zh: 他在辩论中以进步主义者的立场发言。

productivism.t: 生产主义；重视生产的观念；生产力至上

e.en: The party's platform was shaped by {productivism} and faith in industrial growth.
e.zh: 该党的纲领受到生产主义和对工业增长信念的影响。

e.en: Critics say {productivism} ignores leisure, care, and ecological limits.
e.zh: 批评者说，生产力至上的观念忽视了闲暇、照护和生态限制。

e.en: The poet added a brief {proem} before the first canto.
e.zh: 诗人在第一章前加了一段简短的序诗。

e.en: Her speech began with a formal {proem} praising the hosts.
e.zh: 她的演讲以一段正式的开场白开始，称赞了主办方。

e.en: The botanist examined the {proembryo} under a microscope.
e.zh: 植物学家在显微镜下观察这个原胚。

e.en: Cell divisions in the {proembryo} determine the young plant's early structure.
e.zh: 原胚中的细胞分裂决定幼小植物的早期结构。

e.en: The study focused on {proembryonic} cell development in seeds.
e.zh: 这项研究关注种子中原胚细胞的发育。

e.en: A {proembryonic} stage appears before the embryo takes a recognizable form.
e.zh: 在胚胎形成可辨认形态之前，会出现早期胚胎阶段。

e.en: Trypsinogen is a {proenzyme} that becomes active in the intestine.
e.zh: 胰蛋白酶原是一种在肠道中被激活的酶原。

e.en: The cell releases a {proenzyme} to prevent damage before activation.
e.zh: 细胞释放非活性的酶前体，以免在激活前造成损伤。

proepimeron.t: 前上侧片；昆虫胸部骨片

e.en: The diagram labels the {proepimeron} on the insect's thorax.
e.zh: 图中标出了昆虫胸部的前上侧片。

e.en: A damaged {proepimeron} can complicate identification of the specimen.
e.zh: 前上侧片受损会使这个标本的鉴定变得更复杂。

proepisternum.t: 前胸前侧片；昆虫胸部骨片

e.en: The taxonomic key mentions the shape of the {proepisternum}.
e.zh: 分类检索表提到了前胸前侧片的形状。

e.en: She compared the {proepisternum} across several related beetles.
e.zh: 她比较了几种近缘甲虫的前胸前侧片。

proerythroblast.t: 原红细胞；红细胞前体细胞

e.en: A {proerythroblast} is an early cell in red blood cell formation.
e.zh: 原红细胞是红细胞形成过程中的早期细胞。

e.en: The marrow sample showed an increased number of {proerythroblasts}.
e.zh: 骨髓样本显示原红细胞数量增加。

e.en: The inactive {proesterase} requires chemical activation before testing.
e.zh: 这种非活性的酯酶原在检测前需要化学激活。

e.en: Researchers measured how quickly the {proesterase} converted to active esterase.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了酯酶原转化为活性酯酶的速度。

e.en: Hormone levels rise during {proestrum} in many mammals.
e.zh: 许多哺乳动物在发情前期激素水平会上升。

e.en: The veterinarian recorded signs of {proestrum} before breeding began.
e.zh: 兽医在配种开始前记录了动情前期的迹象。

e.en: The mouse entered {proestrus} earlier than expected.
e.zh: 这只小鼠比预期更早进入发情前期。

e.en: During {proestrus}, the animal may show clear behavioral changes.
e.zh: 在动情前期，动物可能表现出明显的行为变化。

profanatory.t: 亵渎的；不敬神圣事物的

e.en: The bishop condemned the painting as {profanatory}.
e.zh: 主教谴责这幅画亵渎神圣。

e.en: Her poem used deliberately {profanatory} language to shock readers.
e.zh: 她的诗故意使用亵渎性的语言来震动读者。

e.en: The laboratory isolated a {proferment} from the digestive fluid.
e.zh: 实验室从消化液中分离出一种酶原。

e.en: A {proferment} remains inactive until conditions trigger its conversion.
e.zh: 酶原在条件触发转化之前保持非活性。

professionalise.t: 使专业化；按职业标准管理

e.en: The club hired full-time staff to {professionalise} its operations.
e.zh: 俱乐部聘请了全职人员，使运营更加专业化。

e.en: New regulations may {professionalise} the childcare sector.
e.zh: 新规可能会推动托育行业按职业标准管理。

professionless.t: 无职业的；没有固定职业的

e.en: He felt adrift and {professionless} after leaving the army.
e.zh: 离开军队后，他感到漂泊无依，没有固定职业。

e.en: The census listed several adults as {professionless}.
e.zh: 人口普查把几名成年人列为无职业者。

e.en: The word {proffesor} is a misspelling of professor.
e.zh: proffesor这个词是professor的拼写错误。

e.en: She typed {proffesor} by mistake in the email.
e.zh: 她在邮件里误把professor打成了proffesor。

profibrinolysin.t: 纤溶酶原；溶纤维蛋白酶前体

e.en: The older paper refers to plasminogen as {profibrinolysin}.
e.zh: 那篇较早的论文把纤溶酶原称为profibrinolysin。

e.en: Activation of {profibrinolysin} helps dissolve fibrin clots.
e.zh: 纤溶酶原的激活有助于溶解纤维蛋白凝块。

e.en: The essay praises her {proficience} in several languages.
e.zh: 这篇文章称赞她精通好几种语言。

e.en: His {proficience} at chess surprised the older players.
e.zh: 他下棋的熟练程度让年长的棋手感到惊讶。

profilist.t: 侧面像画家；人物剪影师

e.en: The {profilist} drew quick silhouettes at the fair.
e.zh: 那位剪影师在集市上快速画出侧面剪影。

e.en: A skilled {profilist} can capture a face with a few clean lines.
e.zh: 熟练的侧面像画家能用几条干净的线条抓住面部特征。

profilogram.t: 轮廓图；表面形貌记录图

e.en: The engineer studied the {profilogram} of the polished metal surface.
e.zh: 工程师研究了抛光金属表面的轮廓记录图。

e.en: A dental {profilogram} helped compare changes in the patient's jaw.
e.zh: 牙科轮廓图帮助比较了患者颌部的变化。

progressivist.t: 进步主义者；革新派人士

e.en: The young {progressivist} argued for broader voting rights.
e.zh: 那位年轻的进步主义者主张扩大投票权。

e.en: Her essays made her known as a social {progressivist}.
e.zh: 她的文章使她以社会革新派人士闻名。

e.en: The party adopted a more {progressivistic} platform.
e.zh: 该党采纳了更具进步主义色彩的纲领。

e.en: His {progressivistic} rhetoric appealed to younger voters.
e.zh: 他的革新派言辞吸引了年轻选民。

e.en: The senator was mocked as a strict {prohi}.
e.zh: 那位参议员被嘲笑为严厉的禁酒派。

e.en: Old newspapers called him a tireless {prohi} campaigner.
e.zh: 旧报纸称他是不知疲倦的禁酒令支持者。

e.en: American {prohibitionism} reshaped nightlife in the 1920s.
e.zh: 美国的禁酒主义重塑了二十世纪二十年代的夜生活。

e.en: Critics said his policy drifted into moral {prohibitionism}.
e.zh: 批评者说他的政策滑向了道德禁令主义。

e.en: The new rule acted as a {prohibitor} of risky trades.
e.zh: 这项新规定起到了禁止高风险交易的作用。

e.en: Fear became the strongest {prohibitor} of honest debate.
e.zh: 恐惧成了坦诚辩论最强的抑制因素。

e.en: The sign used clear {prohibitory} language.
e.zh: 标牌使用了明确的禁止性措辞。

e.en: High fees had a {prohibitory} effect on small firms.
e.zh: 高额费用对小公司产生了限制性影响。

e.en: The supplement was marketed as a {prohormone}.
e.zh: 这种补充剂被宣传为一种激素原。

e.en: A {prohormone} can be converted into an active hormone.
e.zh: 前体激素可以转化为有活性的激素。

e.en: The pancreas first produces {proinsulin}.
e.zh: 胰腺最初会产生胰岛素原。

e.en: Doctors measured her {proinsulin} level after fasting.
e.zh: 医生在她空腹后测量了胰岛素原水平。

e.en: The document discusses the {proiority} of royal claims.
e.zh: 这份文件讨论了王室主张的优先权。

e.en: Scholars debated the {proiority} of one manuscript over another.
e.zh: 学者们争论一份手稿相对另一份的优先性。

project-manages.t: 管理项目；负责项目推进

e.en: She {project-manages} several software launches each year.
e.zh: 她每年管理好几个软件发布项目。

e.en: The consultant {project-manages} the renovation from start to finish.
e.zh: 顾问从头到尾负责这个翻新项目的推进。

e.en: The diagram uses a {projectional} view of the cube.
e.zh: 这张图使用了立方体的投影视图。

e.en: Her analysis focused on {projectional} fantasies in the novel.
e.zh: 她的分析集中在小说中的投射性幻想。

e.en: The engineer calibrated the {projectometer} before testing.
e.zh: 工程师在测试前校准了投影测量仪。

e.en: An old {projectometer} sat beside the optical bench.
e.zh: 一台旧投影计放在光学平台旁边。

e.en: The architect described the work as {projectual} research.
e.zh: 建筑师把这项工作描述为设计构想研究。

e.en: Their studio values {projectual} thinking over decoration.
e.zh: 他们的工作室重视项目性思维，而不是装饰。

e.en: A stone {projecture} sheltered the doorway from rain.
e.zh: 一块石头凸出部分为门口挡住了雨水。

e.en: The map showed every {projecture} along the coast.
e.zh: 地图标出了海岸线上每一处突出部。

e.en: Bacteria have {prokaryotic} cells without a nucleus.
e.zh: 细菌具有没有细胞核的原核细胞。

e.en: The course compared {prokaryotic} and eukaryotic genomes.
e.zh: 这门课比较了原核生物和真核生物的基因组。

e.en: The enzyme is produced as an inactive {prokinase}.
e.zh: 这种酶以无活性的激酶前体形式产生。

e.en: Researchers studied how the {prokinase} becomes active.
e.zh: 研究人员研究前激酶如何变得有活性。

e.en: The paper misspelled {prokryotic} in its title.
e.zh: 那篇论文在标题中把“原核的”拼错了。

e.en: Students confused {prokryotic} with the standard spelling prokaryotic.
e.zh: 学生把prokryotic和标准拼法prokaryotic混淆了。

e.en: The surgeon carefully repaired the infant's {prolabium}.
e.zh: 外科医生仔细修复了婴儿的上唇中央部。

e.en: Anatomy texts describe the {prolabium} of certain insects.
e.zh: 解剖学教材描述了某些昆虫的唇前部。

e.en: The mayor took a clearly {prolabor} position.
e.zh: 市长采取了明确支持劳工的立场。

e.en: Several {prolabor} groups opposed the new contract.
e.zh: 几个亲工会团体反对这份新合同。

e.en: Dopamine acts as {prolactostatin} in the pituitary gland.
e.zh: 多巴胺在垂体中起催乳素抑制素的作用。

e.en: Low {prolactostatin} activity may raise prolactin levels.
e.zh: 催乳素抑制素活性偏低可能会使催乳素水平升高。

e.en: Wheat {prolamin} can trigger symptoms in sensitive patients.
e.zh: 小麦醇溶谷蛋白可能会引发敏感患者的症状。

e.en: The lab measured {prolamin} content in several grains.
e.zh: 实验室测定了几种谷物中的醇溶谷蛋白含量。

e.en: Barley {prolamine} is important in brewing research.
e.zh: 大麦醇溶谷蛋白在酿造研究中很重要。

e.en: The paper compared {prolamine} fractions from wheat and rye.
e.zh: 论文比较了小麦和黑麦中的醇溶谷蛋白组分。

e.en: Early pregnancy tests sometimes referred to {prolan} in urine.
e.zh: 早期妊娠检测有时会提到尿液中的促性腺激素。

e.en: The old textbook used {prolan} for a placental hormone.
e.zh: 那本旧教材用prolan指一种胎盘激素。

e.en: The surgeon diagnosed a severe rectal {prolapsus}.
e.zh: 外科医生诊断出严重的直肠脱垂。

e.en: Uterine {prolapsus} can cause pressure and discomfort.
e.zh: 子宫脱垂可能引起压迫感和不适。

e.en: A rugby ball has a {prolate} shape.
e.zh: 橄榄球呈长球形。

e.en: The astronomer modeled the planet as a {prolate} spheroid.
e.zh: 天文学家把这颗行星建模为扁长椭球体。

e.en: The droplet became {prolated} under the electric field.
e.zh: 液滴在电场作用下被拉长成椭球状。

e.en: Several {prolated} cells appeared in the microscope image.
e.zh: 显微镜图像中出现了几个被拉长的细胞。

e.en: Finnish has a rare {prolative} case in some expressions.
e.zh: 芬兰语在某些表达中有少见的经由格。

e.en: The grammar note described a {prolative} meaning of motion along a route.
e.zh: 语法说明描述了沿某一路线移动的经由格意义。

e.en: The caterpillar gripped the leaf with each {proleg}.
e.zh: 毛虫用每只腹足抓住叶片。

e.en: A larval {proleg} is not a true jointed leg.
e.zh: 幼虫的腹足并不是真正有关节的腿。

e.en: The book opens with dense {prolegomena} on method.
e.zh: 这本书开篇是关于方法的密集导论。

e.en: Kant's {prolegomena} prepared readers for his larger critique.
e.zh: 康德的导论为读者理解他更大的批判著作作了铺垫。

e.en: The editor added a {prolegomenary} chapter before the text.
e.zh: 编辑在正文前加了一章导论性内容。

e.en: Her lecture was {prolegomenary}, setting terms for later debate.
e.zh: 她的讲座具有导论性质，为后续辩论界定了术语。

e.en: This essay serves as a {prolegomenon} to the study.
e.zh: 这篇文章作为该研究的绪论。

e.en: He wrote a short {prolegomenon} explaining his assumptions.
e.zh: 他写了一篇简短序论来说明自己的假设。

e.en: The {prolegomenous} remarks clarified the author's scope.
e.zh: 这些绪论性 remarks 说明了作者的论述范围。

e.en: A {prolegomenous} discussion came before the technical proof.
e.zh: 技术证明之前先有一段预备性讨论。

e.en: The novel uses {prolepsis} to reveal the ending early.
e.zh: 这部小说用预叙手法提前透露结局。

e.en: His argument relies on {prolepsis}, answering objections before they arise.
e.zh: 他的论证依靠预先反驳，在异议出现前就作回应。

e.en: The film opens with a {proleptic} glimpse of the disaster.
e.zh: 电影开头用预叙方式瞥见了那场灾难。

e.en: Her apology was {proleptic}, made before anyone complained.
e.zh: 她的道歉带有预先回应性质，在没人抱怨前就说出口了。

e.en: The critic noted a {proleptical} passage in the poem.
e.zh: 评论家指出诗中有一段预叙性文字。

e.en: His {proleptical} reply anticipated the committee's doubts.
e.zh: 他的预先回应预料到了委员会的疑虑。

e.en: The seminar covered {proleptics} in classical rhetoric.
e.zh: 研讨课讲到了古典修辞中的预期论法。

e.en: Modern narratology treats {proleptics} as forward-looking narration.
e.zh: 现代叙事学把预叙法视为面向未来的叙述。

proletarianism.t: 无产阶级思想；无产阶级状态

e.en: The pamphlet promoted {proletarianism} as a political ideal.
e.zh: 这本小册子把无产阶级思想作为政治理想来宣传。

e.en: Industrial poverty shaped his sense of {proletarianism}.
e.zh: 工业贫困塑造了他的无产阶级身份意识。

e.en: Rapid factory growth helped {proletarianize} rural workers.
e.zh: 工厂迅速发展促使农村劳动者无产阶级化。

e.en: The policy could {proletarianize} small independent farmers.
e.zh: 这项政策可能使小型独立农民无产阶级化。

e.en: The speech appealed directly to the urban {proletariate}.
e.zh: 演讲直接诉诸城市无产阶级。

e.en: Older writers sometimes used {proletariate} for the working class.
e.zh: 较早的作者有时用proletariate指工人阶级。

e.en: The manifesto addressed the {proletaries} of every nation.
e.zh: 宣言面向各国无产者发声。

e.en: Many {proletaries} lived near the factories where they worked.
e.zh: 许多无产者住在自己工作的工厂附近。

e.en: Debt can {proletarize} formerly independent artisans.
e.zh: 债务可能使原本独立的工匠无产阶级化。

e.en: The regime tried to {proletarize} cultural institutions.
e.zh: 该政权试图使文化机构无产阶级化。

e.en: A {proletary} family occupied the small rented room.
e.zh: 一个无产者家庭住在那间狭小的租住房里。

e.en: The poem adopts a {proletary} voice of anger and hunger.
e.zh: 这首诗采用了带着愤怒与饥饿感的无产阶级声音。

prolongating.t: 延长；使拖长；拉长进行中拖延的

e.en: The engineer was {prolongating} the test to gather more data.
e.zh: 工程师正在延长测试，以收集更多数据。

e.en: His {prolongating} speech tested everyone's patience.
e.zh: 他那拖得很长的演讲考验了大家的耐心。

e.en: They tried to {prolonge} the negotiations until Friday.
e.zh: 他们试图把谈判拖到星期五。

e.en: A cold spring can {prolonge} the flowering season.
e.zh: 寒冷的春天可能会延长花期。

e.en: The {prolongment} of the meeting annoyed the staff.
e.zh: 会议的拖延让员工很恼火。

e.en: Doctors warned against unnecessary {prolongment} of treatment.
e.zh: 医生提醒不要不必要地延长治疗。

prolotherapy.t: 增生疗法；韧带注射疗法

e.en: She considered {prolotherapy} for her chronic knee pain.
e.zh: 她考虑用增生疗法治疗长期膝痛。

e.en: The clinic offers {prolotherapy} for certain tendon injuries.
e.zh: 这家诊所为某些肌腱损伤提供增生疗法。

e.en: The essay begins with a brief {prolusion} on memory.
e.zh: 这篇文章以一段关于记忆的简短序言开头。

e.en: Their small concert felt like a {prolusion} to the festival.
e.zh: 他们的小型音乐会像是音乐节的预演。

prolusory.t: 序言的；预备性的；开场的

e.en: He made a {prolusory} remark before the lecture.
e.zh: 讲座开始前，他说了一句开场性质的话。

e.en: The dancers gave a {prolusory} performance in the square.
e.zh: 舞者们在广场上进行了一场预演性质的表演。

prolyleucylglycinamide.t: 脯氨酰亮氨酰甘氨酰胺

e.en: The paper measured {prolyleucylglycinamide} in neural tissue.
e.zh: 这篇论文测量了神经组织中的脯氨酰亮氨酰甘氨酰胺。

e.en: Researchers synthesized {prolyleucylglycinamide} for the experiment.
e.zh: 研究人员为实验合成了脯氨酰亮氨酰甘氨酰胺。

e.en: The old chart listed {promazine} among his medications.
e.zh: 旧病历把普马嗪列在他的用药中。

e.en: Use of {promazine} declined after newer drugs appeared.
e.zh: 新药出现后，普马嗪的使用减少了。

e.en: A {promegakaryocyte} develops before a mature megakaryocyte.
e.zh: 前巨核细胞会先于成熟巨核细胞发育。

e.en: The sample contained an abnormal {promegakaryocyte}.
e.zh: 样本中含有一个异常的前巨核细胞。

e.en: The stain revealed a large {promegaloblast} in the marrow.
e.zh: 染色显示骨髓中有一个较大的前巨幼红细胞。

e.en: A {promegaloblast} is an early stage in abnormal red cell formation.
e.zh: 前巨幼红细胞是异常红细胞形成的早期阶段。

e.en: The root tip contains {promeristem} cells.
e.zh: 根尖含有原分生组织细胞。

e.en: Botanists studied the {promeristem} under a microscope.
e.zh: 植物学家在显微镜下研究原分生组织。

e.en: The insect's {promerous} segments were clearly marked.
e.zh: 这种昆虫的前部体节标记很清楚。

e.en: A {promerous} structure appears early in development.
e.zh: 前段结构在发育早期就会出现。

e.en: The coating has a {prometal} effect on bonding.
e.zh: 这种涂层对金属结合有促进作用。

e.en: A {prometal} additive improved the alloy's surface reaction.
e.zh: 一种亲金属添加剂改善了合金的表面反应。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {promethazine} for severe nausea.
e.zh: 医生开了异丙嗪来治疗严重恶心。

e.en: {Promethazine} can make some patients very sleepy.
e.zh: 异丙嗪会让一些患者非常困倦。

e.en: Older records mention {promine} as a treatment for leprosy.
e.zh: 旧记录提到普罗明曾用于治疗麻风病。

e.en: The museum label described how {promine} changed therapy.
e.zh: 博物馆说明牌介绍了普罗明如何改变治疗方式。

e.en: The hill's {prominency} made it easy to identify.
e.zh: 这座山丘的突出形态使它很容易辨认。

e.en: Her {prominency} in local politics grew quickly.
e.zh: 她在地方政坛的显要地位迅速上升。

e.en: The {promisee} may sue if the promise is broken.
e.zh: 如果承诺被违反，受诺人可以起诉。

e.en: In the contract, the buyer was the {promisee}.
e.zh: 在这份合同中，买方是受约方。

e.en: The young singer gave a {promiseful} performance.
e.zh: 这位年轻歌手的表演很有前途。

e.en: It was a {promiseful} start to a difficult project.
e.zh: 对一个艰难项目来说，这是一个充满希望的开端。

e.en: The {promisor} must perform the agreed duty.
e.zh: 许诺人必须履行约定的义务。

e.en: A court may consider what the {promisor} intended.
e.zh: 法院可能会考虑允诺方的真实意图。

promissorily.t: 以承诺方式；带有允诺地

e.en: He spoke {promissorily} but never signed the agreement.
e.zh: 他说话带有承诺意味，却从未签署协议。

e.en: The clause was worded {promissorily} rather than conditionally.
e.zh: 该条款写得像承诺，而不是条件。

e.en: The cell contained a developing {promitochondrion}.
e.zh: 这个细胞含有一个正在发育的原线粒体。

e.en: A {promitochondrion} may represent an early mitochondrial form.
e.zh: 原线粒体可能代表线粒体的早期形态。

e.en: The paper describes {promitosis} in early cell development.
e.zh: 这篇论文描述了细胞发育早期的前有丝分裂。

e.en: Researchers observed {promitosis} before the main division stage.
e.zh: 研究人员在主要分裂阶段之前观察到前有丝分裂。

e.en: The drug showed a {promitotic} effect in cultured cells.
e.zh: 这种药物在培养细胞中显示出促进有丝分裂的作用。

e.en: A {promitotic} signal can push cells toward division.
e.zh: 促进有丝分裂的信号会推动细胞进入分裂过程。

e.en: The smear contained an abnormal {promonocyte}.
e.zh: 涂片中含有一个异常的早幼单核细胞。

e.en: Doctors identified the {promonocyte} during marrow testing.
e.zh: 医生在骨髓检查中识别出了早幼单核细胞。

e.en: The {promontoried} coast was hard to navigate at night.
e.zh: 这片多岬角的海岸夜间很难航行。

e.en: A {promontoried} ridge overlooked the valley.
e.zh: 一条突出的山脊俯瞰着山谷。

e.en: The surgeon noted the {promontorium} near the middle ear.
e.zh: 外科医生注意到中耳附近的隆起部。

e.en: Anatomy students learned to locate the {promontorium}.
e.zh: 解剖学学生学习定位这个岬状结构。

e.en: The lecture introduced {promorphology} as a study of basic form.
e.zh: 这场讲座把基本形态学介绍为研究基本形态的学科。

e.en: In biology, {promorphology} examines patterns before detailed anatomy.
e.zh: 在生物学中，基本形态学先于细致解剖来考察形态模式。

e.en: Each {promotee} received a letter from management.
e.zh: 每位被提升者都收到了管理层的信。

e.en: The new {promotee} thanked her former team.
e.zh: 这位新晋升的人感谢了她原来的团队。

e.en: The policy had a {promotive} effect on local trade.
e.zh: 这项政策对本地贸易有促进作用。

e.en: Exercise can be {promotive} of better sleep.
e.zh: 锻炼有助于改善睡眠。

e.en: The study measured the {promotiveness} of several growth factors.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了几种生长因子的促进性。

e.en: Her argument depended on the {promotiveness} of education.
e.zh: 她的论点依赖于教育所具有的促进作用。

e.en: He acted as the main {promotor} of the reform.
e.zh: 他是这项改革的主要推动者。

e.en: The gene contains a strong {promotor} region.
e.zh: 这个基因含有一个强启动子区域。

e.en: The stage manager kept the {promptbook} beside her.
e.zh: 舞台监督把演出提示本放在身边。

e.en: Every cue was marked clearly in the {promptbook}.
e.zh: 每个提示都清楚地标在提词本里。

e.en: She answered with remarkable {promptitude}.
e.zh: 她以惊人的敏捷作出了回答。

e.en: The rescue team's {promptitude} saved several lives.
e.zh: 救援队的迅速行动挽救了数条生命。

e.en: A {promptive} question helped the child remember.
e.zh: 一个提示性问题帮助孩子想了起来。

e.en: The warning had a {promptive} force in the debate.
e.zh: 这个警告在辩论中起到了促使行动的作用。

e.en: The old abbey had a small {promptuary} for supplies.
e.zh: 这座老修道院有一间存放物资的小储藏室。

e.en: His notebook became a {promptuary} of useful quotations.
e.zh: 他的笔记本成了有用引文的资料库。

e.en: The king was the formal {promulgator} of the law.
e.zh: 国王是这项法律的正式颁布者。

e.en: She became a tireless {promulgator} of public health advice.
e.zh: 她成了公共卫生建议的不懈传播者。

e.en: The council will {promulge} the new rules tomorrow.
e.zh: 委员会将于明天公布新规则。

e.en: Teachers helped {promulge} the reform throughout the province.
e.zh: 教师们帮助在全省传播这项改革。

e.en: The newly {promulged} decree changed the tax system.
e.zh: 新公布的法令改变了税制。

e.en: Ideas {promulged} by the group spread quickly online.
e.zh: 该团体传播的观念很快在网上扩散。

e.en: The official served as the {promulger} of the decree.
e.zh: 这名官员担任该法令的公布者。

e.en: He was known as a {promulger} of radical ideas.
e.zh: 他以传播激进思想而闻名。

e.en: The agency is {promulging} stricter safety standards.
e.zh: 该机构正在公布更严格的安全标准。

e.en: They spent years {promulging} the doctrine abroad.
e.zh: 他们花了多年时间在海外传播这一学说。

e.en: The insect has a {promuscidate} mouthpart for feeding.
e.zh: 这种昆虫有用于取食的吻状口器。

e.en: A {promuscidate} structure appears under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下可以看到一个吻状突起结构。

e.en: The fly extended its {promuscis} toward the liquid.
e.zh: 这只苍蝇把吻状突起伸向液体。

e.en: A damaged {promuscis} can prevent the insect from feeding.
e.zh: 受损的喙会使昆虫无法取食。

e.en: The fungus forms a {promycelium} during germination.
e.zh: 这种真菌在萌发过程中形成前菌丝。

e.en: Spores developed on the {promycelium} under moist conditions.
e.zh: 在潮湿条件下，孢子在前菌丝上发育。

e.en: The blood test revealed an excess {promyelocyte} count.
e.zh: 血液检查显示早幼粒细胞数量过多。

e.en: A {promyelocyte} is an immature white blood cell.
e.zh: 早幼粒细胞是一种未成熟的白细胞。

e.en: Farmers applied {pronamide} to control winter weeds.
e.zh: 农民施用拿草特来控制冬季杂草。

e.en: The label lists {pronamide} as the active ingredient.
e.zh: 标签上把拿草特列为有效成分。

e.en: Visitors entered the temple through the {pronaos}.
e.zh: 游客通过神庙前廊进入庙内。

e.en: The columns of the {pronaos} were carefully restored.
e.zh: 神庙前廊的柱子得到了细致修复。

pronase.t: 链霉蛋白酶；蛋白水解酶制剂

e.en: The lab used {pronase} to digest unwanted proteins.
e.zh: 实验室用链霉蛋白酶来消化不需要的蛋白质。

e.en: A mild {pronase} treatment freed the cells from the matrix.
e.zh: 温和的链霉蛋白酶处理使细胞从基质中分离出来。

pronatalism.t: 鼓励生育主义；促生育政策倾向

e.en: The government defended its new {pronatalism} as a response to population decline.
e.zh: 政府为新的鼓励生育政策辩护，称这是对人口下降的回应。

e.en: Critics argue that {pronatalism} can pressure women into traditional roles.
e.zh: 批评者认为，鼓励生育主义可能迫使女性回到传统角色。

pronatalist.t: 鼓励生育的；促生育主义者

e.en: The party proposed {pronatalist} tax benefits for young families.
e.zh: 该党提出面向年轻家庭的鼓励生育税收优惠。

e.en: She is a {pronatalist} who wants stronger support for parents.
e.zh: 她是促生育主义者，希望给父母更多支持。

e.en: Runners with flat feet often {pronate} more than usual.
e.zh: 扁平足跑者的脚往往比一般人更容易向内旋转。

e.en: The therapist asked him to {pronate} his forearm slowly.
e.zh: 治疗师让他慢慢把前臂旋转到手掌朝下。

e.en: His {pronated} foot put extra stress on the ankle.
e.zh: 他旋前的脚给脚踝带来了额外压力。

e.en: The patient held the arm in a {pronated} position.
e.zh: 患者把手臂保持在掌心向下的位置。

pronates.t: 旋前；掌心或脚掌向下转

e.en: Her right foot {pronates} when she gets tired.
e.zh: 她累的时候右脚会向内旋转。

e.en: The forearm {pronates} as the palm turns downward.
e.zh: 手掌向下转时，前臂会发生旋前。

pronathous.t: 下颌前突的；面部前突的

e.en: The fossil skull showed a strongly {pronathous} jaw.
e.zh: 这块化石头骨显示出明显前突的下颌。

e.en: A {pronathous} profile is common in some early human fossils.
e.zh: 在一些早期人类化石中，面部前突的轮廓很常见。

pronating.t: 正在旋前；脚向内旋转的

e.en: The coach noticed his foot {pronating} during the run.
e.zh: 教练注意到他跑步时脚在向内旋转。

e.en: She practiced {pronating} the forearm without moving the elbow.
e.zh: 她练习在不移动肘部的情况下旋前前臂。

e.en: The {pronator} muscle helps turn the palm downward.
e.zh: 旋前肌帮助把手掌转向下方。

e.en: A heavy {pronator} may need shoes with more support.
e.zh: 脚内旋严重的人可能需要支撑性更强的鞋。

e.en: The {pronephros} appears early in vertebrate embryos.
e.zh: 前肾在脊椎动物胚胎早期就会出现。

e.en: In many species, the {pronephros} is later replaced by other kidney forms.
e.zh: 在许多物种中，前肾后来会被其他肾结构取代。

pronethalol.t: 普萘洛尔前身药；早期β阻滞剂

e.en: Researchers studied {pronethalol} before safer beta blockers were developed.
e.zh: 在更安全的β受体阻滞剂出现之前，研究人员曾研究普萘洛尔前身药。

e.en: The use of {pronethalol} declined after toxicity concerns emerged.
e.zh: 出现毒性担忧后，普萘洛尔前身药的使用减少了。

proneural.t: 促神经形成的；前神经的

e.en: The gene has a {proneural} role during brain development.
e.zh: 这个基因在大脑发育过程中有促神经形成的作用。

e.en: Cells with {proneural} markers may later become neurons.
e.zh: 带有前神经标志的细胞后来可能发育成神经元。

e.en: A {prongbuck} crossed the dry plain at high speed.
e.zh: 一只叉角羚高速穿过干旱的平原。

e.en: Hunters once prized the {prongbuck} for its speed and alertness.
e.zh: 猎人过去很看重叉角羚的速度和警觉性。

e.en: The old fork had a bent, {prongy} end.
e.zh: 那把旧叉子的尖叉状末端已经弯了。

e.en: A {prongy} branch scratched the side of the truck.
e.zh: 一根多叉的树枝刮到了卡车侧面。

e.en: The springbok began to {pronk} across the grassland.
e.zh: 跳羚开始在草地上四足腾跃。

e.en: A sudden {pronk} can signal excitement or alarm.
e.zh: 突然的四足腾跃可能表示兴奋或警觉。

pronograde.t: 俯身行走的；躯干水平的

e.en: Many quadrupeds have a {pronograde} posture when moving.
e.zh: 许多四足动物移动时呈躯干水平的姿势。

e.en: The study compared {pronograde} locomotion with upright walking.
e.zh: 这项研究比较了俯身行走和直立行走。

e.en: Some languages {pronominalize} objects more often than English does.
e.zh: 有些语言比英语更常把宾语代词化。

e.en: The phrase can {pronominalize} into a single clitic form.
e.zh: 这个短语可以代词化为一个附着形式。

pronormoblast.t: 原成红细胞；早期红细胞前体

e.en: The blood smear showed an abnormal {pronormoblast}.
e.zh: 血涂片显示出一个异常的原成红细胞。

e.en: A {pronormoblast} develops into later red blood cell precursors.
e.zh: 原成红细胞会发育成更后期的红细胞前体。

pronota.t: 前胸背板复数；昆虫前胸板

e.en: The beetles had dark markings on their {pronota}.
e.zh: 这些甲虫的前胸背板上有深色斑纹。

e.en: Entomologists compared the {pronota} of several related species.
e.zh: 昆虫学家比较了几个近缘物种的前胸背板。

e.en: The password is random but still {pronounceable}.
e.zh: 这个密码是随机的，但仍然读得出来。

e.en: They chose a short, {pronounceable} name for the app.
e.zh: 他们给这款应用选了一个简短且容易发音的名字。

pronuclear.t: 原核的；受精卵原核相关的

e.en: The technician checked the embryo at the {pronuclear} stage.
e.zh: 技术员在原核阶段检查了胚胎。

e.en: A {pronuclear} transfer can replace defective mitochondrial DNA.
e.zh: 原核移植可以替换有缺陷的线粒体DNA。

pronucleus.t: 原核；受精前配子细胞核

e.en: Each gamete contributes one {pronucleus} after fertilization.
e.zh: 受精后，每个配子都会贡献一个原核。

e.en: The male {pronucleus} moves toward the female one.
e.zh: 雄性原核会向雌性原核移动。

pronumeral.t: 代数中字母数；代表数字的符号

e.en: In algebra, a {pronumeral} can stand for an unknown number.
e.zh: 在代数中，字母数可以代表一个未知数。

e.en: The teacher asked students to replace each {pronumeral} with a value.
e.zh: 老师要求学生用具体数值替换每个代表数字的符号。

e.en: The museum displayed {Proletcult} posters from the early Soviet period.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了苏联早期无产阶级文化运动的海报。

e.en: Her article examines {Proletcult} ideas about art and labor.
e.zh: 她的文章研究了无产阶级文化运动关于艺术与劳动的观念。

e.en: The old legal text used {prolicide} for the killing of one's offspring.
e.zh: 那部旧法律文本用prolicide指杀害自己子女的行为。

e.en: The scholar treated {prolicide} as a rare term in criminal history.
e.zh: 这位学者把prolicide视为刑事史中的罕见术语。

e.en: A lack of {prolidase} can affect collagen breakdown.
e.zh: 缺乏脯氨酸二肽酶会影响胶原蛋白分解。

e.en: The lab measured {prolidase} activity in the blood sample.
e.zh: 实验室测定了血样中的脯氨酸二肽酶活性。

e.en: The botanist described the plant as {proliferous} after it spread rapidly.
e.zh: 这种植物迅速蔓延后，植物学家称它繁殖旺盛。

e.en: The scan showed {proliferous} tissue near the wound.
e.zh: 扫描显示伤口附近有增生组织。

e.en: The farmer admired the {prolificacy} of the new tomato variety.
e.zh: 农民很欣赏这个番茄新品种的高产性。

e.en: Critics noted her unusual {prolificacy} as a young novelist.
e.zh: 评论家注意到她作为年轻小说家异常多产。

e.en: The report warned of rapid {prolification} of cells in the tissue.
e.zh: 报告警告说该组织中的细胞正在迅速增殖。

e.en: Urban planners studied the {prolification} of informal markets.
e.zh: 城市规划者研究了非正规市场的大量出现。

e.en: Her literary {prolificity} surprised even her closest friends.
e.zh: 她文学创作上的多产连最亲近的朋友都感到惊讶。

e.en: The species is valued for its {prolificity} in harsh climates.
e.zh: 这个物种因在恶劣气候中的高繁殖力而受到重视。

e.en: The biologist noted a {proligerous} structure on the specimen.
e.zh: 生物学家注意到标本上有一个生殖结构。

e.en: Older botany books call such bud-bearing tissue {proligerous}.
e.zh: 较早的植物学书把这种带芽组织称为proligerous。

e.en: The enzyme {prolinase} helps split certain small peptides.
e.zh: 脯氨酸肽酶有助于分解某些小肽。

e.en: Researchers compared {prolinase} levels before and after treatment.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了治疗前后的脯氨酸肽酶水平。

e.en: The child was tested for {prolinemia} after repeated seizures.
e.zh: 孩子反复癫痫发作后接受了血脯氨酸过多检测。

e.en: Doctors linked the metabolic disorder to {prolinemia}.
e.zh: 医生将这种代谢障碍与血脯氨酸过多联系起来。

e.en: The urine test suggested {prolinuria} in the patient.
e.zh: 尿检提示这名患者存在尿脯氨酸过多。

e.en: A specialist explained that {prolinuria} may indicate an inherited disorder.
e.zh: 专家解释说尿脯氨酸过多可能提示遗传性疾病。

e.en: The fossil had a {prolobous} outline unlike related specimens.
e.zh: 这块化石呈前叶状轮廓，不同于相关标本。

e.en: The anatomist used {prolobous} to describe the forward lobe.
e.zh: 解剖学家用prolobous来描述这个前方叶片。

e.en: The foraminifer's {proloculum} was visible under the microscope.
e.zh: 有孔虫的初室在显微镜下清晰可见。

e.en: Shell growth begins around the {proloculum} in this species.
e.zh: 这个物种的壳体生长从初室周围开始。

e.en: The council chose a {prolocutor} to speak for the clergy.
e.zh: 委员会选出一名代言人为神职人员发言。

e.en: As {prolocutor}, she opened the formal assembly.
e.zh: 作为会议主持者，她宣布正式会议开始。

e.en: The actor liked to {prologise} before the main scene began.
e.zh: 这名演员喜欢在正戏开始前说一段开场白。

e.en: The editor asked him to {prologise} the new edition briefly.
e.zh: 编辑请他为新版简短作序。

e.en: She agreed to {prologize} the play with a short speech.
e.zh: 她同意用一段简短讲话为戏剧作开场。

e.en: Writers sometimes {prologize} to frame the story's mood.
e.zh: 作家有时会写序言来铺垫故事的气氛。

e.en: The {prologizer} introduced the comedy with a sly warning.
e.zh: 写开场白的人用一句狡黠的提醒引出了这部喜剧。

e.en: Critics called him a gifted {prologizer} of historical dramas.
e.zh: 评论家称他是历史剧中很有才华的序言作者。

e.en: The poet chose to {prologuize} before reading the epic.
e.zh: 诗人选择在朗读史诗前先作一段序言。

e.en: Few modern playwrights {prologuize} in such an old-fashioned style.
e.zh: 现代剧作家很少用这种老派方式写开场白。

prologuized.t: 已作序言的；作了开场白

e.en: The printed play was {prologuized} by a famous critic.
e.zh: 这部印刷剧本由一位著名评论家作了序。

e.en: He {prologuized} the performance with a solemn address.
e.zh: 他用一段庄重致辞为演出作了开场。

e.en: She {prologuizes} each lecture with a historical anecdote.
e.zh: 她每次讲座都会先讲一个历史轶事作为开场。

e.en: The narrator {prologuizes} before the action moves onstage.
e.zh: 叙述者在剧情登台展开之前先说开场白。

e.en: His habit of {prologuizing} slowed the ceremony.
e.zh: 他总爱说开场白的习惯拖慢了仪式。

e.en: The director was {prologuizing} when the curtain rose too early.
e.zh: 幕布过早升起时，导演还在作开场说明。

e.en: The physicist mentioned a hypothetical {prolon} in the lecture.
e.zh: 物理学家在讲座中提到了一种假设的普罗隆粒子。

e.en: Older papers used {prolon} for a proposed fundamental particle.
e.zh: 较早论文用prolon指一种被提出的基本粒子。

e.en: The lease is {prolongable} for another six months.
e.zh: 这份租约可以再延长六个月。

e.en: Doctors said the treatment was {prolongable} if side effects stayed mild.
e.zh: 医生说如果副作用仍然轻微，治疗可以延长。

e.en: The drug may {prolongate} the patient's recovery period.
e.zh: 这种药可能会延长患者的恢复期。

e.en: Engineers tried to {prolongate} the tube without weakening it.
e.zh: 工程师试图拉长管子，同时不削弱其强度。

e.en: The experiment required a {prolongated} heating phase.
e.zh: 这个实验需要一个延长的加热阶段。

e.en: A {prolongated} form of the shell appears in older specimens.
e.zh: 较老的标本中可见一种拉长的壳体形态。

e.en: The general issued a {pronunciamento} before dawn.
e.zh: 将军在黎明前发布了一份政治宣言。

e.en: His article read like a stern {pronunciamento}.
e.zh: 他的文章读起来像一篇严厉的公告演说。

e.en: The teacher noted several {pronunciational} errors.
e.zh: 老师指出了几个发音方面的错误。

e.en: Regional speech often shows clear {pronunciational} differences.
e.zh: 地方口音常常表现出明显的发音差异。

e.en: The dictionary includes a {pronunciative} guide.
e.zh: 这本词典附有发音指南。

e.en: She added {pronunciative} notes beside difficult names.
e.zh: 她在难读的名字旁加了发音说明。

e.en: The course begins with {pronunciatory} training.
e.zh: 这门课从发音训练开始。

e.en: His {pronunciatory} habits reveal his hometown.
e.zh: 他的读音习惯透露出他的家乡。

e.en: The animal entered {prooestrus} early this season.
e.zh: 这只动物本季较早进入发情前期。

e.en: Hormone levels rise during {prooestrus}.
e.zh: 在发情前期，激素水平会上升。

e.en: The recording was {proof-positive} of his involvement.
e.zh: 那段录音是他参与其中的确凿证据。

e.en: For her, the letter was {proof-positive}.
e.zh: 对她来说，那封信就是铁证。

e.en: The {proof-reader} caught three spelling mistakes.
e.zh: 校对员发现了三个拼写错误。

e.en: A careful {proof-reader} improves every manuscript.
e.zh: 细心的校对员能让每份稿件更完善。

e.en: Engineers ran a {proof-test} on the bridge cables.
e.zh: 工程师对桥梁钢索进行了强度检验。

e.en: The prototype passed its final {proof-test}.
e.zh: 这个原型通过了最终验证测试。

proofless.t: 没有证据的；无法证明的

e.en: The accusation remained {proofless} and unfair.
e.zh: 这项指控仍然没有证据，也不公正。

e.en: A {proofless} claim should not guide policy.
e.zh: 没有证据的说法不应左右政策。

e.en: Her answer had a {prooflike} structure.
e.zh: 她的回答有一种像证明一样的结构。

e.en: The essay became almost {prooflike} in its logic.
e.zh: 这篇文章在逻辑上几乎像一份证明。

e.en: The editor added a {proofmark} in the margin.
e.zh: 编辑在页边加了一个校样标记。

e.en: The barrel bore an old {proofmark}.
e.zh: 枪管上带有一个旧的检验证印。

e.en: She worked late in the {proofroom}.
e.zh: 她在校样室工作到很晚。

e.en: The {proofroom} smelled of ink and paper.
e.zh: 校对间里有油墨和纸张的气味。

e.en: The island was served by a small {prop-jet}.
e.zh: 这座岛由一架小型螺旋桨喷气式飞机通航。

e.en: A {prop-jet} can use shorter runways.
e.zh: 螺旋桨喷气式飞机可以使用较短跑道。

e.en: The course is {propaedeutic} to medical study.
e.zh: 这门课程是医学学习的预备课程。

e.en: He wrote a {propaedeutic} essay for beginners.
e.zh: 他为初学者写了一篇入门性文章。

e.en: The first chapter is mainly {propaedeutical}.
e.zh: 第一章主要是入门性的内容。

e.en: Students attend {propaedeutical} lectures before practice.
e.zh: 学生在实践前要听预备教学讲座。

e.en: The program begins with {propaedeutics}.
e.zh: 这个项目从预备学科开始。

e.en: Philosophical {propaedeutics} shaped his early training.
e.zh: 哲学入门教学塑造了他的早期训练。

e.en: These plants are easily {propagable} from cuttings.
e.zh: 这些植物很容易通过插枝繁殖。

e.en: The idea proved {propagable} through social media.
e.zh: 这个想法被证明可以通过社交媒体传播。

propagand.t: 被传播的思想；宣传对象

e.en: The movement treated reform as its central {propagand}.
e.zh: 该运动把改革当作核心宣传思想。

e.en: A political {propagand} spread through the pamphlets.
e.zh: 一种政治宣传思想通过小册子传播开来。

e.en: The party tried to {propagandise} the youth.
e.zh: 该党试图向年轻人灌输观点。

e.en: State radio continued to {propagandise} for war.
e.zh: 国家电台继续为战争进行宣传。

e.en: Critics accused the paper of crude {propagandism}.
e.zh: 批评者指责这家报纸搞粗糙的宣传活动。

e.en: His art rejected political {propagandism}.
e.zh: 他的艺术拒绝政治宣传主义。

propagandistically.t: 以宣传方式；带宣传色彩地

e.en: The film presents history {propagandistically}.
e.zh: 这部电影以宣传方式呈现历史。

e.en: The speech was written {propagandistically}, not analytically.
e.zh: 这篇演讲稿写得带有宣传色彩，而非分析性。

e.en: Each seed can act as a {propagule}.
e.zh: 每粒种子都可以充当繁殖体。

e.en: The invasive {propagule} reached the riverbank.
e.zh: 这种入侵性传播体到达了河岸。

e.en: Farmers applied {propanil} to control weeds.
e.zh: 农民使用敌稗除草剂来控制杂草。

e.en: Residues of {propanil} were found in the water.
e.zh: 水中发现了敌稗除草剂残留。

propanol.t: 丙醇，一种醇类溶剂；丙醇类化合物

e.en: The technician cleaned the surface with {propanol} before testing.
e.zh: 技术员在测试前用丙醇清洁了表面。

e.en: {Propanol} can exist as different structural isomers.
e.zh: 丙醇可以以不同的结构异构体形式存在。

e.en: The lab used {propanone} to dissolve the sample.
e.zh: 实验室用丙酮溶解样品。

e.en: {Propanone} is better known to many people as acetone.
e.zh: 很多人更熟悉丙酮的另一个名称acetone。

proparaclase.t: 震前岩石破裂；断层前破碎作用

e.en: The paper described {proparaclase} in the stressed rock layer.
e.zh: 论文描述了受压岩层中的震前破裂现象。

e.en: Evidence of {proparaclase} appeared near the fault zone.
e.zh: 断层带附近出现了岩石预破碎的证据。

proparoxytone.t: 倒数第三音节重读的词

e.en: In Greek grammar, a {proparoxytone} has stress on the antepenult.
e.zh: 在希腊语语法中，倒数第三音节重读词的重音在倒数第三个音节。

e.en: The teacher marked the noun as a {proparoxytone}.
e.zh: 老师把这个名词标为倒数第三音节重读词。

propcopter.t: 螺旋桨直升机；旋翼飞行器

e.en: The hobbyist built a small {propcopter} from spare parts.
e.zh: 这名爱好者用备件做了一架小型螺旋桨飞行器。

e.en: A {propcopter} hovered above the field during the test.
e.zh: 测试时，一架螺旋桨飞行器悬停在田野上方。

e.en: The rocket required a stable {propellent} for launch.
e.zh: 火箭发射需要稳定的推进剂。

e.en: The gas had a {propellent} force inside the chamber.
e.zh: 这种气体在腔室内具有推动力。

e.en: A {propeller-driven} aircraft landed on the island runway.
e.zh: 一架螺旋桨驱动的飞机降落在岛上的跑道。

e.en: The museum displays several {propeller-driven} boats.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了几艘螺旋桨驱动的船。

e.en: The old manual spelled the word as {propellor}.
e.zh: 那本旧手册把这个词拼作propellor。

e.en: A damaged {propellor} delayed the boat trip.
e.zh: 一个损坏的螺旋桨耽误了这次乘船行程。

propeltidium.t: 蛛形动物头胸部前背板

e.en: The arachnid specimen had a narrow {propeltidium}.
e.zh: 这件蛛形动物标本有一块狭窄的前背板。

e.en: Researchers measured the {propeltidium} under a microscope.
e.zh: 研究人员在显微镜下测量了头胸部前背板。

e.en: Some voters {propend} toward cautious economic policies.
e.zh: 一些选民倾向于谨慎的经济政策。

e.en: The committee seemed to {propend} to compromise.
e.zh: 委员会似乎倾向于妥协。

e.en: The judge {propended} toward a narrow interpretation of the law.
e.zh: 法官曾倾向于对法律作狭义解释。

e.en: Early critics {propended} to dismiss the novel.
e.zh: 早期评论家曾倾向于否定这部小说。

e.en: He showed a {propendent} attitude toward reform.
e.zh: 他表现出倾向改革的态度。

e.en: The plant had long, {propendent} branches.
e.zh: 这株植物有长长下垂的枝条。

e.en: The factory converts {propene} into polypropylene.
e.zh: 工厂把丙烯转化为聚丙烯。

e.en: {Propene} is an important feedstock in the chemical industry.
e.zh: 丙烯是化工行业的重要原料。

propense.t: 有倾向的；易于做某事的

e.en: She was {propense} to doubt easy answers.
e.zh: 她倾向于怀疑过于简单的答案。

e.en: The old system was {propense} to failure under stress.
e.zh: 旧系统在压力下容易出故障。

propenylguaiacol.t: 丙烯基愈创木酚，化学香味物质

e.en: The chemist identified {propenylguaiacol} in the flavor sample.
e.zh: 化学家在香味样品中鉴定出丙烯基愈创木酚。

e.en: {Propenylguaiacol} contributes a clove-like aroma.
e.zh: 丙烯基愈创木酚会带来类似丁香的香气。

e.en: The medium contained {propeptone} to support bacterial growth.
e.zh: 培养基中含有前胨以支持细菌生长。

e.en: Older textbooks discuss {propeptone} in protein digestion.
e.zh: 较早的教材会在蛋白质消化部分讨论前胨。

e.en: Low {properdin} levels can affect immune defense.
e.zh: 备解素水平低可能影响免疫防御。

e.en: The assay measured {properdin} in the patient's serum.
e.zh: 这项检测测量了患者血清中的备解素。

properispomenon.t: 希腊语倒数第二音节带曲折重音词

e.en: A {properispomenon} carries a circumflex on the penult.
